# <center><u>**💚🌟PEACE BE UPON YOU ALL💚🌟**</u></center>

<center><u>**Welcome Back to @alive.chat Monday Challenge. Let’s share our goals, track our progress, and support each other.**</u></center>

<center>
![](https://media.tenor.com/Me82v-d-XDIAAAAC/welcome-back-wb.gif)
</center> 

I hope you are all doing great, healthy, and well. I’m happy to have you here and warmly welcome you all.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)
</center>

You already know the purpose of this activity is simple: to share our goals, share our progress, and try to support each other in achieving them.

Everyone has goals, and the journey is not always easy. Here, we can motivate one another, learn from each other, and grow together. There is no pressure, just honest sharing, encouragement, and positive energy.

Feel free to share your goals, update your progress, and engage with others because when we support one another, success becomes more achievable for all.

<center>**<u>We are alive, we are growing, and we are moving forward together. 💪✨</u>**</center>

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

# <center><u>**Challenge Task and Rules.**</u></center> 

<center>**<u>Kindly read the rules before participating in the challenge activity. You must follow all the rules mentioned below to be eligible for the Prizes.</u>**</center>

1. To be eligible, each participant must **<u>share their weekly, monthly, or yearly goals (whether posted or not) in the comments section, along with their progress during the week.</u>**

2. **<u>Sharing your weekly progress is an important part of this activity.</u>**
Please remember to include your progress along with your goals; without it, your entry won’t be eligible for the challenge.   
This requirement does not apply to first-time participants only.

3. <u>**Increased the time duration:**</u> This challenge will remain open for **<u>more than 48 hours, until Wednesday at 11:59 PM UTC</u>**.

4. We will post the participant list and the raffle results (if there are more than five participants) for last week’s challenge in the next post.

5. **<u>Using #alive tag is mandatory, addittionally you can use #aliveandthriving, and #AliveChat tags in your posts.</u>** 

6. Feel free to share your post and receive upvotes from the community.

7. **<u>It’s not mandatory, but we really appreciate it if you reblog the post and tag your friends in your posts and comments.</u>**

8. **<u>Engage with other participants and community members; don't forget the purpose of this activity is to encourage and support each other.</u>**

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

Very special thanks to @benthomaswwd for donating 10K HEARTBEAT for the prize pool. And because of his generosity, now participants and winners are also receiving HEARTBEAT Tokens, along with other Tokens.

The minimum ALIVE Power required to use our tipping bot is 1,000 AP (owned, non-delegated stake plus incoming delegations), which allows you to send 10 tips per day. We have four levels.

- <center>**Level 1: 1K AP = 10 tips per day**</center>
- <center>**Level 2: 5K AP = 20 tips per day**</center>
- <center>**Level 3: 20K AP = 30 tips per day**</center>
- <center>**Level 4: 100K AP = 40 tips per day**</center>

Use the command `!ALIVE ` in a comment to send a tip. Make sure to include a space before and after the command so it works correctly. The counter resets at midnight UTC.

title: Holozing Fan Art | A Friendly Gathering of the Light Healer and Cinella 🐞
body:
>

![41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKSehAUihsGX1DHVVoeJrmtotUNPZ2akMYKohKsYhG9NJyT1j9byeK9aYebzVyi.jpg)
Good evening, my dear readers in the #HIVE art community! Happy Monday to everyone who’s here reading this new post. As always, your friend Manuel is here to greet you once again, and I’m thrilled to bring you a new artistic post for my blog. This time, I wanted to start my week by sharing a piece I’ve been working on over the past weekend. It’s an illustration inspired by the game #Holozing, specifically focused on the Light Healer, who is one of my favorite characters in the game because of her super elegant style; this time, the Healer wouldn’t be alone, as I decided to include the little insect-like creature (Cinella) in the drawing. As you may know, she’s a fast and agile ladybug who specializes in slowing down her opponents and reducing the likelihood of being attacked: >*Muy buenas noches mis queridos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #HIVE, feliz lunes para todos los que se encuentran por aquí leyéndome en esta nueva oportunidad, como siempre los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel super feliz de poder traerles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog. En esta ocasión quise empezar mi semana trayéndoles una obra en la cual estuve trabajando durante el ultimo fin de semana, se trata de una ilustración inspirada en el juego de #Holozing, específicamente enfocada en la Sanadora de la Luz, la cual es de mis personajes favoritos dentro del juego ya que tiene un estilo super elegante; en esta oportunidad la Sanadora no se encontraría sola, pues decidí acompañarla en el dibujo de la pequeña criatura tipo insecto (Cinella), que como sabrán se trata de una mariquita rápida y ágil que se dedica a ralentizar a sus oponentes y a reducir su probabilidad de ser atacada:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJj4p2moWYVEQcQR1bkLXtJw7Vm8KLa3DuV9J5GASjy1T1ajudrjWuhZCSfkxTX.jpg)
I began my illustration as usual, by sketching the two main characters. For the Healer of Light, I tried to give her a look that closely matched my illustration style; I gave her a slender build, yet one that was also sensual and mature. And right on her left hand, resting on her fingers, I drew the little insect from the game, both of them pleasantly surprised to have found each other. For the skin painting, I used salmon and light red tones as a base. With my airbrush, I like to start by applying soft strokes to create a bit of volume, as well as adding a touch of warmth to the mid-tones of the cheeks, nose, and eyelids. >*Empecé mi ilustración como es habitual, realizando un boceto, en este caso de los 2 personajes principales, en este caso a la Sanadora de la Luz trate de darle un estilo bastante apegado a mi estilo de ilustración, le di una contextura delgada, pero al mismo tiempo sensual y madura; y justo sobre su mano izquierda posada sobre sus dedos dibuje al pequeño insecto del juego, ambos gratamente sorprendidos de encontrarse. Para el trabajo de pintado de la piel use como base unos tonos salmones y rojos claros, con mi pincel de aerógrafo me gusta empezar dando trazos suaves para formar un poco de volumen, así como también darle un poco de calidez a la zona media de las mejillas, nariz y parpados.*
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKciKDx5Nf4yvqQwurZcDdevytVSXrtkQfzb7UYsVatvBegq9YG5vPisRH5mi7d.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKciKDuUVJNCDjsKMsZnnVa3fSknPfLgH6h4DKMfYkK2tQPkNcZisNuxMwRupju.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKe9X27EAciY46KkjJxayXvBVBeCeTnu92kr9JdKngVthNDou2PHm4QQJ29CsW6.jpg)
In the second stage, I focused on creating the eyes. As I mentioned earlier, my idea was for the Healer to have a joyful expression upon meeting the creature Cinella, so I created large, wide-open eyes. For this, I used bold yellow tones and a touch of white; then, for the mouth, I used salmon and peach tones to create a smiling expression that would complement the eyes. For the clothing, I wanted to maintain the character’s original in-game style, so I used some shades of gray and yellow to create a dress made of slightly thick fabric, but with plenty of shimmer in the gold areas of the neckline and the logo on the chest. >*En la 2da etapa me centre en la creación de los ojos, como les comenté antes mi idea era que la Sanadora tuviese una expresión de alegría por haberse encontrado a la criatura Cinella, y para eso cree unos ojos grandes y bien abiertos, en este caso use tonos amarillos intensos y un poco de blanco; y luego para la boca use tonos salmones y duraznos para formar una expresión sonriente que complementara la mirada. Para la creación de la ropa quise mantener el estilo original del personaje dentro del juego, entonces tome algunos tonos grises y amarillos y cree un vestido de tela un poco gruesa, pero como muchos brillos en las zonas doradas del cuello y el logo del pecho.*
![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKe9X27EAciY46KkjJxayXvBVBeCeTnu92kr9JdKngVthNDou2PHm2aXLKpP9fT.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKxoHyYAFa9sFvQXsM4a45aQbBPsn6jUrMGs1B2dZJSb8xh9VsEEbFkS8mccHj7.jpg) ![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL1fgQR9XPTcCv3JmmwQhmNYpc9fjB8YGSYaaXddj13ob6gigudAjydUoSn95cv.jpg)
When creating Cinella, the first step was to select a few pale reddish tones from my color palette. Using these red tones, I created the upper part of Cinella’s body, as well as the rounded shells covering her wings; then, using brown tones, I created the lower part, as well as the four small legs that support this creature. For the wings, I used light gray tones for the main structure of two wings on each side, and then slightly adjusted the opacity so that the wings would appear translucent, giving them that realistic insect-wing effect. >*Con respecto a la creación de Cinella lo primero fue buscar unos cuantos tonos rojizos pálidos dentro de mi paleta de colores, con estos tonos rojos cree la parte superior del cuerpo de Cinella, así como los caparazones redondeados que cubre sus alas; luego con tonos marrones cree la parte baja, así como las pequeñas 4 patas con las cuales se sostiene esta criatura. En el caso de las alas para volar use tonos grises claros para la estructura principal de 2 alas por cada lado, y luego ajuste levemente la opacidad para que las alas se transparentaran dando ese efecto realista de alas de insecto.*
![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL1fm74LwGEMJK9C8XDAato7szvKeE4eJ3wLrtyqRAg5HrVpH8Qjn1C1RCJf26J.jpg) ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL1fm71QkzUzNpLUpJoixURAxAPifB9ZVkkUCrD3VpvX7HqqdFxammhBFTg3k4g.jpg) ![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL1fkP42xANx6Jb1t7YfmSFLhQC4vPjnncqHFChqjFUXBfeDjz24iWWqbdhwxD2.jpg) ![35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKGbJjWxLqTUU3Rtdj9QgSHthic6sfySwjWY6JMpswYgfyGSWsX97SqMUsSiTW7.jpg)

REFERENCE
[![refe.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/243WkaMAQW7RzDRJMZ3mYVH3xuMwBpyTotpZNxA4THbqwyitKuwGKLtZ4SYFGAxsqjaoS.jpg)](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/new-creatures-zingtober-event-finished-alpha-vials) Well, guys and girls, that’s all for today. Thank you so much for sticking with me this far and for reading. I hope you really liked the final result of my illustration. Sending you all a big hug, and I hope you have a wonderful evening. We’ll meet again in my next post… see you later!😎 >*Bueno chicos y chicas, eso fue todo por el día de hoy, muchísimas gracias por llegar hasta aquí, por leerme, y espero que el resultado final de mi ilustración les haya gustado muchísimo. Les mando un fuerte abrazo a todos, y les deseo que pasan una feliz noche, y ya nos volveremos a encontrar en un siguiente post…hasta luego!😎.*

title: Move move move! Actifit Diary: June 8 2026
body:
Almost 15k! That does narrate my day quite well. While I write this, I’m thinking about getting it up to the 15k by walking around the flat… I really got around quite a bit today, starting with arranging my apartment, then gym, then a very difficult team meeting. Not sure yet how to solve that to be honest, but I always have, and I think I might be able to do the same this time, too. Hopefully. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f7c62fb6-f7a4-4ca5-a146-c6bc5de5cd82.jpg) After that, another personal meeting, which also took a while and made me late for the next meeting. A friend is selling their house to a couple from Austria, and though my friend is German, too, she’s not allowed to be the translator. So she asked me for the favor to go with them and play pretend. I did read through the document with them, answered some questions, put in some corrections, but overall, it was an easy task. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f29d87de-cc0b-429f-b0ff-6eba7af2cd26.jpg) Since I was already in Otavalo, I took the bus via Quiroga, passing by the clothing manufacturer where Ellie and her brother work. Her brother is designing a sweatsuit, and it’s looking really awesome. Since I had asked him to make one for me a while ago, he’s using a print that I already have as a headband for the gym – I will be super stylish when I get that thing. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d3e72a69-b25f-4ec8-a078-47b22b63a9ae.jpg) I just played a few rounds of #Splinterlands, too – tournaments and modern ranked. Got a matchup with my hive-buddy @seattlea, [and was able to win it]( https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_ecf29643d65a502c10336f2fcb58f2fc?ref=beelzael)! Lorkus is a beast summoner and one of my best investments for my gameplay. Quite expensive, though. I won’t bring him to max level for that reason, though I do need some more maxed ones. I’ll see… So far for today! It was a long one and I’m tired. Have a good night and thank you for reading!

title: I had to rewatch Dorohedoro to enjoy its second season. —eng/esp
body:
https://www.accioncine.es/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/anime-Dorohedoro.jpg [_Source_](https://www.accioncine.es/confirmada-la-secuela-del-anime-dorohedoro?srsltid=AfmBOorELRpsR2o7NTieiBJ0ep8bAYS1hj2fLbfpm4obyEf5do-9aTPQ)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. Hoy me propuse volver a ver un anime que vi hace muchísimo tiempo; ya saben, debido a que algunas veces algunos estudios de anime tardan siglos en sacar una segunda temporada. Este, particularmente, me gustó mucho en su momento, aunque a otros no tanto respecto al CGI, pero volviéndolo a ver sigue pareciéndome perfecto, del mejor uso de este método de animación que he visto en muchísimo tiempo, aún hoy en día. Creo que su segunda temporada pasó muy desapercibida, pero es que, si no mal recuerdo, han pasado como 6 años desde su primera temporada, por lo que evidentemente mucha gente no recordará nada, como yo. Literalmente me vi 5 capítulos hoy y es como si estuviera viendo un anime totalmente nuevo; no recordaba absolutamente nada, solo la premisa principal del anime. Debido a todo esto, debo volver a ponerme al día, así que sin más dilación, hablemos un poco de Dorohedoro, para que más gente se anime a ver este fantástico anime.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you doing today? I hope very well. Today I decided to rewatch an anime I saw a long time ago – you know, because sometimes some anime studios take ages to release a second series. I really liked this one back in the day, even if others weren't so keen on the CGI, but watching it again, it still seems perfect to me, the best use of this animation method I've seen in a very long time, even today. I think its second series went very unnoticed, but if I remember correctly, about 6 years have passed since its first series, so obviously many people won't remember anything, just like me. I literally watched 5 episodes today and it feels like I'm watching a completely new anime; I remembered absolutely nothing, only the main premise. Because of all this, I need to catch up again, so without further ado, let's talk a bit about Dorohedoro, so that more people are encouraged to watch this fantastic anime.

https://www.moviementarios.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/dorohedoro.jpg.jpg [_Source_](https://www.moviementarios.com/critica-de-dorohedoro/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

El anime nos pone en la piel de una persona con cabeza de caimán, a la que, por dicha característica, llaman Caimán, aunque quizás tenga que ver también el hecho de que no recuerda quién es, su nombre o quién le hechizó para que terminara con esa apariencia. Su objetivo durante todo el anime será matar magos hasta dar con el indicado para que deshaga el hechizo y pueda volver a la normalidad. Todo esto será posible gracias a una extraña habilidad: al morderle la cabeza a otra persona, se le aparecerá un ente que indicará si fue él o no. ¿Quién es ese ente? Es otra de las preguntas que nos haremos durante el visionado del anime. Caimán vive en un lugar llamado Hole, donde cae todo el desperdicio del mundo de los magos; además, es donde usualmente vienen a hacer experimentos. Es un lugar sucio y lleno de personas afectadas, y los magos lo consideran un lugar despreciable. Caimán no estará solo en sus aventuras para recuperar su cabeza; su compañía será una mujer llamada Nikaido, quien fue quien lo encontró cuando había perdido su cabeza en un callejón oscuro. ¿Será posible que estos dos cumplan su objetivo? No lo tendrán para nada fácil, con los magos yendo detrás de ellos intentando matarlos.

The anime puts us in the shoes of a person with a crocodile head, who, because of that trait, is called Caiman – although it might also have to do with the fact that he doesn't remember who he is, his name, or who cast a spell on him to end up with that appearance. His goal throughout the anime will be to kill sorcerers until he finds the right one to undo the spell and return to normal. All of this will be possible thanks to a strange ability: when he bites someone's head, an entity appears before him that will indicate whether it was that person or not. Who is that entity? That's another question we'll ask ourselves while watching the anime. Caiman lives in a place called Hole, where all the waste from the sorcerers' world falls; it's also where they usually come to do experiments. It's a dirty place full of afflicted people, and the sorcerers consider it a despicable place. Caiman won't be alone in his quest to get his head back; his companion will be a woman named Nikaido, who found him when he had lost his head in a dark alley. Will these two be able to achieve their goal? It won't be easy for them at all, with sorcerers going after them trying to kill them.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/23tknNSmFpdSmEg2uMag5LTp9SyJ9k1Fyp71kNKgvKG9ZT7yQW2REamnBDW5LBzeiZaWF.jpg [_Source_](https://elpalomitron.com/critica-anime-dorohedoro/)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Acá, observando el nivel de absurdismo que tiene esta obra, de cierta forma podría compararla con Chainsaw Man. Digo que sería una buena obra para recomendar a quienes les gustó ese otro anime. En cada capítulo tendrás peleas, sangre y situaciones bizarras que hacen que quieras seguir viendo más y más; sinceramente, es atrapante. Otra cosa que me sigue encantando como la primera vez es el diseño de los personajes: con ese CGI que parece dibujado, hace que sea una experiencia única de ver; se siente muy bien cuidado. Aunque los capítulos parezcan independientes debido a que se presentan situaciones muy distintas, todo está conectado, sigue una trama totalmente lineal. Creo que se me hace llamativo eso porque, de un momento a otro, parecen estar en \

y al siguiente en año nuevo; no sé si es que pasa una cantidad considerable de tiempo entre capítulos o si es el funcionamiento del mundo en el que se encuentran. En fin, estamos ante un mundo lleno de misterios e incógnitas que se irán resolviendo conforme vayamos viendo. Solamente espero que la calidad mostrada acá se mantenga en la segunda temporada, porque simplemente quedaré encantado con MAPPA, y mira que a mí no me gusta mucho dicho estudio.

Here, observing the level of absurdism in this work, I could in a way compare it to Chainsaw Man. I'd say it would be a good recommendation for those who liked that other anime. In every episode you'll get fights, blood and bizarre situations that make you want to keep watching more and more; it's honestly gripping. Another thing I still love, just like the first time, is the character design: with that CGI that looks drawn, it makes for a unique viewing experience; it feels very well-crafted. Although the episodes may seem standalone because they present very different situations, everything is connected; it follows a completely linear plot. I find that striking because, from one moment to the next, they seem to be in \

and then in the New Year; I don't know if a considerable amount of time passes between episodes or if that's just how the world they're in works. In short, we are facing a world full of mysteries and unknowns that will be resolved as we watch. I just hope the quality shown here is maintained in the second series, because I'll simply be delighted with MAPPA – and mind you, I'm not very fond of that studio.

___

same-sex marriage\\.body: 由於有了媽媽手的關係，我開始要小心雙手的活動，上次看醫生的時候，醫生說我現在只是輕微症狀，不需要治療，最主要是要改變日常不好的姿勢動作讓其不要惡化，這樣才會好轉。 但這實在是太難了，畢竟是用了幾十年的姿勢，而且我不是很痛，只是很輕微的痛，就更加不上心了，經常就忘了某些動作不能做，到感受到輕微痛才想起來。有見及此，我決定買了一雙護指。

/>

就是一條很簡單的有彈性的帶，勝在價錢便宜，比那些所謂專業的便宜多了，我戴上去也不是為了止痛，最主要是限制自己的動作，例如我現在拇指不能隨便動了，手機也要被逼用兩隻手操控，這樣至少能限制我某些姿勢做不了，從而減輕相關關節的勞損。

年紀大了，就開始不中用了，要保養了。

same-sex marriage\\.title: Ahora si a arreglar muchas cosas empezando con mi pantalon negro.....Esp-Eng
same-sex marriage\\.body:
> Saludos amigas, amigos de Hive, tambien de esta comunidad, donde compartimos lo que sabemos, aprendemos de los que saben tambien. Saben que debemos aprovechar esos conocimientos que tenemos, mas si tambien tenemos las herramientas para ello. Tengo una maquina de coser que no es mia, es de mi hermano que emigro hace años, pero fue el año pasado que me traje la maquina, que estaba no dañada pero si le hacia falta como mantenimiento y ponerla a funcionar. Para eso gracias a Dios hay un señor en la comunidad que las repara, le llame, vino, la reviso, la puso operativa de nueva, asi que a darle uso, porque las cosas cuando no se usan tambien se pueden dañar.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EorzR254z71xTQ7YC5wxVqWFaq4qF68Mm6LRaH8D9o7hvieJn7czPKxDRBg1BjL7frL.png)

> No es que voy a realizar costuras, pero si puedo hacer arreglos propios, para mis hijos y mas que una u otra cosa para emprender. Empezare con arreglar un pantalon, que es demasiado ancho en la parte de la bota asi le dicen y muy largo que lo piso. **Primer Paso:** Me puse el pantalon, mi hija me tomo las fotos para que vean lo que les decia sobre lo ancho y largo del mismo, para luego al final hacer las comparaciones: antes y despues. Le dije a mi hija que colocara unos alfileres como guia que le dije donde para desde ahi hacer los arreglos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsHq3ewz9vWe1fti9MJUx698o3RXoQxcGjin7EYq5uZ677q26psEgbZ6vzSjmy1tfXW.png)

> **Segundo Paso:** Me quite el pantalon, fui a la mesa, busque otro para usarlo como guia ya que el otro si me queda bien de ancho abajo y de largo. Coloque el que voy arreglar debajo y el otro arriba, ahi hice las comparaciones.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23uQfkMgT94TfA5JPrjfnocnj8Lq8FtEYJqeAmX8JYpYdTj7fHtdExoBjgudRVhz2yaU3.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoyN4Zd4S2cHLT91jKjoKYEETpjCfuS2yqswa1aww7gqdyuGvRtLfWh5MUqszZ1WkjC.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/242rin98QFL48j2mK8cqUsruPBcFp3ZsDUHwQWLWLTZSF3uUAMBXm4F3cceNvgj3s1GMu.png)

> **Tercer Paso:** Corte el ruedo primero, hice las costuras como desde las rodillas hasta abajo por el lado hacia adentro en las piernas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23uQjqWZCQt4VyqLwu7eU1PM4aGRb5FYUo5WHwk3CvPct3ifP6JttaPk28SLwVuDZd9AV.png)

> **Cuarto Paso:** Tome las medidas desde donde voy a hacer los arreglos, primero use alfileres, quite el pantalon, luego hice unas puntadas o basteado con hilos de otro color para luego quitarlos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoprSpRpyz6VMEXgopTxyVKEEtEiy7a6bT2EWB6a9AbnBJ2dra14FW4a3MunLLU2QmB.png)

> **Quinto Paso:** Me lo probe de nuevo asi antes de coserlo a la maquina, me quedo bien, ahora si a coserlo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Eoc84PxHciJXFoUwWScwDjoB8xgxoyaR21DdBjwAZH22jNhhCoXnjEXKYu4ecChnET3.png)

> **Sexto Paso:** Probarmelo de nuevo ya listo, me gusto el cambio y el arreglo, no hay nada mejor que sentirse a gusto y comodo con la ropa que se usamos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Eoc6W7C6Wd21DLKPVgJaJ9hqvBV1iXV9biJv5im2JGEHQ298KUVnZY7LEMPhkbVz9wu.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vhq38NseAjYTnALAZCYGEGA6wQ8FYJe8wo1pqx3wki4o53VVTQutepaBQz9FkwBYpMS.png)

> Ya mas adelante poco a poco ire haciendo otros arreglos como las cortinas de los cuartos, que por emergencia las coloque asi sin coserlas, pero ahora si lo hare. Como muchas cosas que de seguro encontrare, pero tambien para hacer otras cosas, que de seguro les traere aquí. Fotos tomadas con celular Samsung Galaxy A16. Portada editada en Canva. Traduccion contenido propio con la app DeepL.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23y9HEe2GtE6EYmYpbsWFbMDGsPUkRYHWyiqBJCpAXPjV2rGBDgsxSWZ7w1crc3tPnQ8Q.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23uQpDDL1KoEe8uc5koQXhM1RsufUE1CE2FepTQ2z2WHp8q5rsjaYFJrTZztWrh6Lrpdi.png)

> Greetings, friends of Hive, and of this community, where we share what we know and learn from those who know as well. You know we should make the most of the knowledge we have, especially if we also have the tools to do so. I have a sewing machine that isn’t mine; it belongs to my brother, who emigrated years ago. But it was last year that I brought the machine home. It wasn’t broken, but it did need some maintenance and to be made operational. Thankfully, there’s a man in the community who repairs them. I called him, he came over, checked it out, and got it working again, so now it’s time to put it to use—because things can break down when they’re not used.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EorzR254z71xTQ7YC5wxVqWFaq4qF68Mm6LRaH8D9o7hvieJn7czPKxDRBg1BjL7frL.png)

> It’s not that I’m going to be doing any sewing, but I can make my own alterations—for my kids and, more than anything else, to get started. I’ll start by altering a pair of pants that are too wide at the ankle—that’s what they call it—and so long that they drag on the ground. **Step One:** I put on the pants, and my daughter took some photos so you can see what I was talking about regarding their width and length, so we can compare them later: before and after. I told my daughter to place some pins as a guide where I indicated, so we could make the alterations from there.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsHq3ewz9vWe1fti9MJUx698o3RXoQxcGjin7EYq5uZ677q26psEgbZ6vzSjmy1tfXW.png)

> **Step Two:** I took off my pants, went to the table, and looked for another pair to use as a guide, since the other pair fits me well in width at the bottom and in length. I placed the pair I’m going to alter underneath and the other pair on top, and that’s where I made the comparisons.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23uQfkMgT94TfA5JPrjfnocnj8Lq8FtEYJqeAmX8JYpYdTj7fHtdExoBjgudRVhz2yaU3.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoyN4Zd4S2cHLT91jKjoKYEETpjCfuS2yqswa1aww7gqdyuGvRtLfWh5MUqszZ1WkjC.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/242rin98QFL48j2mK8cqUsruPBcFp3ZsDUHwQWLWLTZSF3uUAMBXm4F3cceNvgj3s1GMu.png)

> **Step 3:** I cut the hem first, sewing from the knees down the inside of the legs.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23uQjqWZCQt4VyqLwu7eU1PM4aGRb5FYUo5WHwk3CvPct3ifP6JttaPk28SLwVuDZd9AV.png)

> **Step Four:** Take measurements from where I’m going to make the alterations. First, use pins; remove the pants; then, I made a few stitches or basted with thread of a different color, which I later removed.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoprSpRpyz6VMEXgopTxyVKEEtEiy7a6bT2EWB6a9AbnBJ2dra14FW4a3MunLLU2QmB.png)

> **Step Five:** I tried it on again like this before sewing it on the machine; it fits well, so now it’s time to sew it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Eoc84PxHciJXFoUwWScwDjoB8xgxoyaR21DdBjwAZH22jNhhCoXnjEXKYu4ecChnET3.png)

> **Step Six:** I tried it on again once it was ready. I liked the change and the alterations—there’s nothing better than feeling comfortable and at ease in the clothes we wear.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Eoc6W7C6Wd21DLKPVgJaJ9hqvBV1iXV9biJv5im2JGEHQ298KUVnZY7LEMPhkbVz9wu.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vhq38NseAjYTnALAZCYGEGA6wQ8FYJe8wo1pqx3wki4o53VVTQutepaBQz9FkwBYpMS.png)

> Later on, I’ll gradually make other adjustments, like the curtains in the rooms, which I put up like this without sewing them as a temporary fix, but now I’ll do it properly. Like many things I’m sure I’ll find, but also to do other things, which I’ll definitely share here. Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A16 cell phone. Cover edited in Canva. Translation of my own content using the DeepL app.

same-sex marriage\\.title: Pasta cremosa con queso y ajoporro/Creamy pasta with cheese and leek 🧀🍜
same-sex marriage\\.body: > \n\nHello foodies, seguramente estaban preguntándose si había cocinado hoy, y la respuesta es obvia, *\

* 🤣🤣 Hoy es lunes, inicio de semana, así que mi esposo va al trabajo y yo vuelvo a la cocina, y les confieso que estaba un poco negada, por lo que quise hacer algo que no me diese mucho trabajo, ni tomara mucho tiempo, y para estos casos la pasta es la mejor opción, y como saben, ahora tengo una adicción por las pastas directo a la sartén, y para el día de hoy decidí preparar una pasta con queso y ajoporro.
Hello foodies, I bet you were wondering if I’d cooked today, and the answer is obvious: *“Of course I have!!”* 🤣🤣 Today is Monday, the start of the week, so my husband’s off to work and I’m back in the kitchen. I must admit I was feeling a bit uninspired, so I wanted to make something that wouldn’t be too much work or take too long. In cases like this, pasta is the best option, and as you know, I’m currently hooked on pan-fried pasta. So today I decided to make a pasta dish with cheese and leeks.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuPRe564ELYa986LWrHYx3RiMkYRB6Rn4aSkmMGgvL1o/1780972056516.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una preparación bastante fácil de hacer, y en la que aunque el sabor del queso predomina, no opaca al ajoporro, ya que usé una buena cantidad de el. Y ahora sin más vamos con la receta.
It’s a fairly easy dish to make, and although the flavour of the cheese comes through, it doesn’t overpower the leek, as I used a generous amount of it. And now, without further ado, let’s get on with the recipe.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8imvJmNsQw8AVwrNtQgH1jZ7J2inD2zG7Yh2dToKNGi/1780972056729.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de pasta corta 2 latas de crema de leche 2 tazas de queso rallado 2 tallos grandes de ajoporro 3 dientes de ajo Sal Pimienta 2 cucharadas de margarina
500 g short pasta 2 tins of double cream 2 cups of grated cheese 2 large leeks 3 cloves of garlic Salt Pepper 2 tablespoons of margarine
## Procedimiento/Procedure Como les comenté arriba, no tenía muchas ganas de cocinar, y la pasta directo a la sartén requiere estar atenta a la preparación durante todo el proceso, por lo que decidí facilitarme un poco las cosas y comenzar cocinando la pasta por separado.
As I mentioned earlier, I didn’t really feel like cooking, and cooking pasta straight in the pan means you have to keep a close eye on it throughout the whole process, so I decided to make things a bit easier for myself and start by cooking the pasta separately.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBv1k44rWnY29N5GJYshLeGc52uTz6YQVmCuo2Xb1DUA/1780972056946.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Mientras la pasta estaba en la cocina corté finamente el ajo y el ajoporro, para luego sofreírlos por 4 minutos en las dos cucharadas de margarina.
Whilst the pasta was cooking, I finely chopped the garlic and leek, then sautéed them for 4 minutes in two tablespoons of margarine.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTLAvBnncsDvmcAa4u5hooozDSTm7KjsNCCYR3R9d9Ee3/1780972057090.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzPyGG87Fod6SdDyCTi7LdefdLR7rtBHXBqVBUjkcWa7/1780972057333.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRgqVajAyeBxTVAjnASnhFeheEXbSF1fZZ4ZdDz2mimwD/1780972157984.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente agregué la crema de leche junto con un poco de sal y pimienta. Incorporé todo muy bien y lo cociné por dos minutos.
I then added the double cream along with a little salt and pepper. I mixed everything together thoroughly and cooked it for two minutes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvaH93wAy2YAM1diAfRcw9soidbmudPyvY9DCdbk547i/1780972158225.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto la pasta ya estaba a mitad de cocción y con ayuda de un cucharón la pasé a la sartén con la salsa, junto con una taza del líquido donde la cocción y mezclé todo.
At this point, the pasta was halfway through cooking, so I used a ladle to transfer it to the frying pan with the sauce, along with a cup of the cooking liquid, and mixed everything together.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBv1k44rWnY29N5GJYshLeGc52uTz6YQVmCuo2Xb1DUA/1780972158393.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3GWzJJxPSr7vM6VK7wkacycgmKnunRmiJHRwRMDbP9c/1780972158530.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente incorporé las dos tazas de queso rallado y mezclé enérgicamente durante 4 minutos, y de esta forma nuestra pasta con queso y ajoporro está lista para ser disfrutada.
I then added the two cups of grated cheese and stirred vigorously for 4 minutes, and with that, our pasta with cheese and leek is ready to enjoy.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWELZGjHXWVyBcDSGjtrsipZABMUPBA1PzZiN6z66CNjZ/1780972158746.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWd9HCGeG5nBXUEhf59sv55jD7JuFZhqcR1Y7nysurJAg/1780972228412.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaBZqZ4LqFRMhfjna9D5nFyYAc8fKkz1xpMktTaTWUfr/1780972228633.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4seox4sn4AxGjgfeo1UKzMskYoxGBsKkyNyPh8V8KzM/1780972228828.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El resultado? Una delicia cremosa con mucho sabor y que estuvo lista en un 2x3! >The result? A creamy, flavourful treat that was ready in no time!
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera⁰⁰/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

same-sex marriage\\.body:
>

<center>
![1001779230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AK2DzJ2yhoT5MVR2G7gSZGiGwcZuDiVgEGswSZAGoXTyBzfevhvVQ7tQjqicr2E.jpg)</center>

Feliz inicio de semana para todos mis queridísimos amigos hivers lectores espero de corazón que pasen una semana de mucho provecho, aprovechando al máximo el tiempo para pasar momentos especiales con la familia y seres queridos, en esta ocasión aprovecho para compartirles un momento mágico en familia, regalos y atenciones para la reina de la casa es su cumpleaños.

La semana pasada, específicamente el miércoles 3 del presente mes estuvo de cumpleaños un ser muy especial para mí y para mi familia, y como no serlo, si les hablo nada más y nada y nada menos que de mi querida madre, el ser que me dio la vida, cada día me guía, orienta y me llena de su amor, ese es un día muy especial para mis hermanos, mis sobrinos y por supuesto, para mi padre, esa fecha nos llena de mucha alegría y nos preparamos días antes para planificar la celebración de esa noche muy especial. 

Esa noche llegó el resto de mi familia, mi cuñada, mi hermano menor y mis sobrinos cada uno con un regalo para la consentida de la casa y por supuesto la respectiva torta a petición de la cumpleañera para cantarle el cumpleaños feliz. 

Mientras transcurría la noche llegó el momento de obsequiarle los regalos a la cumpleañera de ese día, ella muy feliz por tener a gran parte de su familia, solo faltó mi hermana y su esposo que por situaciones ajenas a su voluntad lo pudieron asistir en ese momento sin embargo al resto de lo que es hicimos presente disfrutamos de este lindo momento consintiendo a la reina de la casa.

<center>
![1001779220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKCGPvVJY4gPkpvuZfYv7dAcrmC7pFEpt4qd5SAxwKF7MzT2cBxJx8yr8P5remW.jpg)</center>

<center>

</center>

Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad.
Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo.

Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro.

same-sex marriage\\.body:
Well, the A's did not have a good time in Houston that's for sure. The series was officially lost on Saturday after getting absolutely beat down 13-2. Kade Morris struggled mightily in his MLB debut, giving up nine runs in four innings. The Astros recorded three homers and a total of fourteen hits. Definitely a forgettable game.

Yesterday the A's had a decent bit of revenge, as they [shutout the Astros 5-0](https://youtu.be/1ptPC_mohNo?si=qkH9TukIKlOEPA3o) thanks to another excellent start by rookie starting pitcher Gage Jump! This is Gage's second consecutive fantastic outing! He pitched 6 1/3 innings and allowed zero runs. I think the A's have something with this dude! Even in his first start I had a good feeling about him, he just passed the eye test for me, and now he's simply looking like a veteran! We'll see if he can keep this up! 

Brent Rooker hit his 10th homer, and Nick Kurtz hit his 12th. I feel like, in a perfect world, those two guys can lead the A's to greatness! Hopefully Brent can warm up a bit more as we progress deeper into the season. 

Tonight's matchup against the Brewers is pretty scary, I'm not going to lie. The Brewers are one of three MLB teams with forty wins. For pretty much the past decade they've been a model of consistency, it's very impressive. Starting in 2017, *excluding* the shortened 2020 season, the Brewers have averaged nearly 92 wins a season! That longevity is epic!

For the A's, a franchise trying to re-establish themselves and earn respect, this is a very interesting test!

Jeffrey Springs is on the mound, hopefully he can help give the A's a chance.

[Al leer el trabajo del Dr. @emiliorios en @holos-lotus, sentí una bofetada directa, sin anestesia ni clemencia. Y es que, en estas últimas semanas, me he arrepentido a cada segundo de cada día.](https://ecency.com/@emiliorios/no-no-me-arrepiento-de-nada-pues-yo-si-quisiera-cambiar-algunas-cosas-arrepentirse-o-no-esen) 

​Como se acostumbra a decir en el mundo digital, especialmente en las plataformas de video, \

. Del mismo modo, hoy quiero compartir el mío, con la profunda esperanza de que este camino que he recorrido junto a mi familia sirva como una dura pero necesaria advertencia para otros.

​Tal como señala el amigo @emiliorios, arrepentirse ante los sucesos consumados y pretender regresar el tiempo atrás es un acto ilógico. Sin embargo, la palabra divina también nos recuerda que “de arrepentidos es el reino de Dios en el cielo”.

​En mi caso, **YO SÍ ME ARREPIENTO**. Me arrepiento porque, en su momento, debí ser mucho más insistente ante los primeros síntomas que presencié. Preferí respetar una voluntad ajena antes que \

.

​Todo comenzó el año pasado, en el mes de junio. Las primeras manifestaciones fueron una saciedad temprana (llenura prematura al comer) y eructos constantes. Con el tiempo, estos síntomas parecieron disiparse lentamente, simulando una falsa vuelta a la “normalidad”. No obstante, aquella sintomatología, que solo estaba dormida, volvió a despertar con mayor agresividad. Reapareció la saciedad temprana acompañada de una marcada disfagia (dificultad para tragar); sentíamos que la comida se quedaba atrapada a nivel del esófago y de ahí no avanzaba. El alimento pasaba gran parte del tiempo luchando por ingresar al estómago para iniciar el proceso de digestión, impidiendo que el cuerpo absorbiera los nutrientes y eliminara los desechos.

​Posteriormente, los síntomas empeoraron. Apareció un reflujo gastroesofágico severo que él atribuyó erróneamente a una simple gastritis. Debido a esto, su alimentación cambió notoriamente: eliminamos las grasas, los condimentos picantes, las bebidas gaseosas y los alimentos flatulentos. Sin embargo, esta medida solo ofreció una calma momentánea.

​Los episodios siguientes fueron radicales. Los alimentos sólidos desaparecieron por completo de la mesa. Su dieta diaria se redujo a cremas licuadas a base de pollo, papa, zanahoria, zapallo amarillo y zapallo italiano (calabacín) sin cáscara ni semillas, espesadas con un puñado de arroz.

​Lamentablemente, estas preparaciones se convirtieron en un mero \

biológico más que en una verdadera fuente de nutrición. El peso comenzó a disminuir de forma drástica. Con el avance del cuadro, aparecieron los episodios de vómitos frecuentes, caracterizados por una especie de espuma blanca similar al merengue en su etapa inicial, que no era otra cosa que el moco gástrico protector del propio estómago segregado ante la irritación extrema.

​Ante la evidente pérdida de peso, la deshidratación y la aparición de parestesia (hormigueo) en sus piernas, acudimos a la urgencia hospitalaria el pasado 26 de mayo. Pasamos el día entero en el recinto asistencial hasta que, finalmente, a eso de las 22:50 horas, lo llamaron para su evaluación. 
Ingresé con él; sus niveles de alerta estaban comprometidos y se le enredaban las palabras, por lo que tomé la vocería y expuse detalladamente la cronología de su estado de salud.

​El protocolo médico fue inmediato. Su pérdida ponderal ya se catalogaba como una desnutrición severa: presentaba un peso de apenas 68 kilogramos para una estatura de 1,80 metros. El primer examen diagnóstico fue una tomografía computarizada (TC) de tórax, abdomen y pelvis con contraste (escáner), cuyo informe arrojó los siguientes hallazgos:

​**A nivel pulmonar: Presencia de dos pequeños nódulos bilaterales de 6 milímetros de diámetro.**

**​A nivel gástrico: Una masa tumoral evidente en la pared del estómago y una estenosis pilórica (obstrucción o estrechamiento del píloro) secundaria a la inflamación y al daño por reflujo ácido.**

​Ante este panorama, el diagnóstico diferencial de los especialistas se baraja entre dos opciones principales:

**​Adenocarcinoma gástrico (cáncer gástrico).**

**​Tumoración digestiva (por determinar benignidad o malignidad mediante histopatología).**

​Frente a este escenario, se procedió a su hospitalización inmediata en una unidad de cuidados profesionales. Se le realizó una endoscopia digestiva alta con toma de biopsia para el análisis anatomopatológico. Para estabilizar su estado nutricional y frenar los vómitos, se le instaló una sonda nasogástrica (SNG) para alimentación enteral directa al estómago, además de iniciar una fluidoterapia constante (suero) y la administración endovenosa de vitaminas B1 (tiamina) y D.

​Asimismo, nos encontramos a la espera de la programación de una Tomografía por Emisión de Positrones (PET-CT) para una estadificación celular más precisa.

​Afortunadamente, este lunes 8 de junio se llevó a cabo una intervención paliativa crucial: una endoscopia terapéutica para la instalación de una prótesis endoluminal autoexpandible (malla tubular gástrica). Este dispositivo se expande en la zona obstruida, desplazando la masa hacia un costado para liberar el tránsito digestivo y permitir que pueda volver a alimentarse por vía oral.

​El médico nos informó hoy que el procedimiento fue un éxito rotundo, razón por la cual se procedió al retiro de la sonda nasogástrica. Actualmente se encuentra bajo régimen cero (ayuno absoluto) por 48 horas para asegurar la correcta fijación de la prótesis. Mañana martes iniciará la tolerancia hídrica con pequeños sorbos de agua, para progresar el miércoles a una dieta líquida/papilla, el jueves a una dieta blanda/sólida y, finalmente, evaluar su alta médica de retorno a casa.

​Una vez que recupere el peso y la estabilidad nutricional, continuaremos con el tratamiento oncológico o quirúrgico definitivo, siguiendo las pautas médicas que sean óptimas para él.

​Este es mi contexto. Un escenario donde me arrepiento profundamente de no haber sido más inflexible con mi esposo, de no haber exigido una consulta médica temprana. Pequé de ingenua al creer que solo se trataba de una gastritis que mantendríamos a raya. Pero la enfermedad avanzó, silenciosa al principio, para gritar con fuerza ahora; dejando a su paso miedo, terror, dolor, incertidumbre, la dura separación de la hospitalización, soledad y, de nuevo, más miedo.

​Me arrepiento sabiendo que quizás una acción oportuna habría cambiado el rumbo de esta historia. Pero, tal como escribe @emiliorios, por más que me arrepiente no puedo congelar ni retroceder las manecillas del reloj. No viajaré al pasado ni podré enviarme un mensaje de alerta en letras rojas que diga: \

.

​Este doloroso proceso ha sido el motivo de mi total ausencia en las plataformas. Mi mente no lograba conectar ideas; mis días se resumían en llorar a escondidas en el baño para que mis hijas no notaran mi quiebre. Ante ellas, debo ser una roca inquebrantable, la capitana de un barco que ha navegado por la tormenta más oscura y violenta que nos ha tocado enfrentar. Hoy, lunes 8 de junio, puedo decir que la tempestad finalmente ha comenzado a cesar, y a lo lejos, se divisa el muelle donde, muy pronto, lograremos atracar a salvo.
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000031199.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wWs1oybC5dC1Xt9s9z1EecnNW2uYNQWtESfL9ofdYY6yikzTxZ7dgbaJ2J9t5TNAdym.png)</center>

[Reading Dr @emiliorios’s work on @holos-lotus felt like a slap in the face – without warning or mercy. And the fact is, over the last few weeks, I have regretted every second of every day.](https://ecency.com/@emiliorios/no-no-me-arrepiento-de-nada-pues-yo-si-quisiera-cambiar-algunas-cosas-arrepentirse-o-no-esen) 

​As is customary in the digital world, especially on video platforms, “I’ll give you some context”. In the same vein, today I want to share mine, in the sincere hope that this journey I have undertaken alongside my family serves as a harsh but necessary warning to others.

​As my friend @emiliorios points out, regretting events after the fact and trying to turn back time is illogical. However, the Word of God also reminds us that “the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who repent”.

In my case, **I DO REGRET IT**. I regret it because, at the time, I should have been much more insistent when I first noticed the symptoms. I chose to respect someone else’s wishes rather than “cry out to heaven”.

It all began last year, in June. The first signs were early satiety (feeling full too soon when eating) and constant belching. Over time, these symptoms seemed to slowly fade away, giving the false impression of a return to ‘normality’. However, those symptoms, which had merely been dormant, re-emerged with greater intensity. The early satiety returned, accompanied by marked dysphagia (difficulty swallowing); we felt that food was getting stuck in the oesophagus and wouldn’t go any further. The food spent much of the time struggling to enter the stomach to begin the digestion process, preventing the body from absorbing nutrients and eliminating waste.

Subsequently, the symptoms worsened. Severe gastro-oesophageal reflux developed, which he mistakenly attributed to simple gastritis. Because of this, his diet changed significantly: we eliminated fats, spicy seasonings, fizzy drinks and flatulent foods. However, this measure offered only temporary relief.

The subsequent episodes were drastic. Solid foods disappeared completely from the table. His daily diet was reduced to blended purées made from chicken, potato, carrot, yellow squash and courgette (zucchini), peeled and seeded, thickened with a handful of rice.

Unfortunately, these preparations became merely a biological ‘maintenance’ rather than a true source of nutrition. His weight began to drop dramatically. As the condition progressed, episodes of frequent vomiting occurred, characterised by a kind of white foam similar to meringue in its initial stage, which was nothing other than the stomach’s own protective gastric mucus secreted in response to extreme irritation.

Faced with the obvious weight loss, dehydration and the onset of paraesthesia (tingling) in his legs, we went to A&E on 26 May. We spent the whole day at the hospital until, finally, at around 10.50 pm, he was called in for assessment. 
I went in with him; his alertness was compromised and his speech was slurred, so I took the lead and explained the chronology of his health condition in detail.

The medical protocol was immediate. His weight loss was already classified as severe malnutrition: he weighed just 68 kilograms for a height of 1.80 metres. The first diagnostic test was a contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) scan of the chest, abdomen and pelvis, the report of which revealed the following findings:

**In the lungs: Presence of two small bilateral nodules, 6 millimetres in diameter.**

**​In the stomach: A distinct tumour mass on the stomach wall and pyloric stenosis (obstruction or narrowing of the pylorus) secondary to inflammation and damage caused by acid reflux.**

​Given this picture, the specialists’ differential diagnosis is being considered between two main options:

**​Gastric adenocarcinoma (stomach cancer).**

**​Digestive tract tumour (to be determined as benign or malignant via histopathology).**

​In light of this scenario, he was immediately admitted to a specialist care unit. An upper gastrointestinal endoscopy was performed, with a biopsy taken for histopathological analysis. To stabilise his nutritional status and stop the vomiting, a nasogastric tube (NGT) was inserted for direct enteral feeding into the stomach, in addition to initiating continuous fluid therapy (saline) and the intravenous administration of vitamins B1 (thiamine) and D.

We are also awaiting the scheduling of a Positron Emission Tomography (PET-CT) scan for more precise staging of the cancer.

Fortunately, on Monday 8 June, a crucial palliative procedure was carried out: a therapeutic endoscopy to insert a self-expanding endoluminal prosthesis (gastric tubular mesh). This device expands in the obstructed area, pushing the mass to one side to clear the digestive tract and allow him to resume oral feeding.

The doctor informed us today that the procedure was a resounding success, which is why the nasogastric tube was removed. He is currently on a zero-food regimen (complete fasting) for 48 hours to ensure the prosthesis settles correctly. Tomorrow, Tuesday, he will begin fluid tolerance with small sips of water, progressing on Wednesday to a liquid/pureed diet, on Thursday to a soft/solid diet, and finally, we will assess his discharge to return home.

Once he has regained his weight and nutritional stability, we will continue with definitive oncological or surgical treatment, following the medical guidelines that are best for him.

This is my situation. A scenario in which I deeply regret not having been more insistent with my husband, not having insisted on an early medical consultation. I was naive to believe it was just gastritis that we could keep under control. But the disease progressed, silently at first, only to scream loudly now; leaving in its wake fear, terror, pain, uncertainty, the harsh separation of hospitalisation, loneliness and, once again, more fear.

I regret it, knowing that perhaps timely action might have changed the course of this story. But, as @emiliorios writes, however much I regret it, I cannot freeze or turn back the hands of the clock. I will not travel back in time, nor can I send myself a warning message in red letters saying: ‘Be careful when you feel that food isn’t going down’.

This painful process has been the reason for my complete absence from social media. My mind couldn’t string thoughts together; my days were spent crying in secret in the bathroom so my daughters wouldn’t notice my breakdown. In front of them, I must be an unbreakable rock, the captain of a ship that has sailed through the darkest and most violent storm we have ever had to face. Today, Monday 8 June, I can say that the storm has finally begun to subside, and in the distance, we can make out the jetty where, very soon, we will be able to dock safely.
***

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2a7fe9b9-1630-4569-8bb8-e4d489f8ab5a.jpg) Ok. My oldest son is back working so he isn't home much. This weekend he came back and we went to church as a family and then out for lunch together. That was nice. Before church? Yeah I had to get up early and walk the dog. Then again it wasn't a bad day for walking. Not too hot, rain stayed away, everything was green so no complaints. Other than getting up early sucks. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e345f522-6302-40f8-9cf4-ba9340b0340c.jpg) In the afternoon? My son wanted to show me the route he usually walked the dog while he was studying for his electrician exam. It was a route I used to take and still do sometimes but it was a little longer so I don't unless I want to chat... And only when the weather is good. However I got to chat with my son about life, plans and generally how things are going. I'm pretty proud of him and kind of curious where he will end up. Anyways. We got back and he headed back to his own home to get ready for another week of work. I just relaxed knowing tomorrow I have to work on as well. However with the shorter walk in the morning and longer one in the afternoon it was over 14k steps. Sounds good to me. And we will see what tomorrow brings :)

Today, I revisited the Food Place food court, located at Pavilion Mall. The food court is located beside the Oriental Kopi Restaurant. It is time to try food from another stall.


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/Eos1JkSmtiyC9o2RSgpFHnXWWDVAdzM422irfKecrEgbZbrvz51nQwCjHrMwFnowt5s.jpg)

This time, I ordered XO lala noodles from the Li Ji Lala noodles stall, which cost RM19.90 per bowl.

This bowl of XO Cognac Lala Noodles from Li Ji Lala Noodles features fresh lala (clams) cooked in a light yet flavorful seafood broth infused with premium XO cognac, ginger, garlic, goji berries, and spring onions. The thin rice vermicelli absorbs the sweet clam essence while remaining delicate and silky.

The generous portion of lala is the star of the dish. As the clams open during cooking, they release their natural juices into the soup, creating a broth that is both sweet and briny. The addition of XO cognac elevates the aroma, contributing subtle notes of oak, dried fruit, vanilla, and warmth that complement the seafood without overpowering it.

The chili-soy dipping sauce served on the side provides a spicy and salty contrast, allowing diners to enjoy the clams in a more traditional Cantonese seafood style.

Lala noodles are a relatively modern Malaysian-Chinese creation that became popular in Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley. The dish draws heavily from Cantonese seafood cooking techniques, where fresh shellfish are quickly cooked with wine, ginger, and stock to highlight their natural sweetness.

While many establishments use Chinese rice wine or Hong Kong-style XO sauce, some premium lala noodle specialists use XO cognac, a high-grade French brandy traditionally associated with luxury dining. The cognac is briefly heated during cooking, allowing much of the alcohol to evaporate while leaving behind its distinctive aroma and depth of flavor.

This approach reflects a broader Cantonese culinary tradition of pairing fine seafood with quality spirits to enhance fragrance and complexity. Over time, XO cognac lala noodles developed a reputation as a more premium variation of the classic clam noodle soup.

最近去吃了两顿大餐，一次全天自助午餐和晚餐，一次晚餐烤肉自助。可能是吃太多太上火了，一下子给我一个牙齿发炎警告我不要吃太多太上火的东西。牙疼不是病，疼起来真要命，听了好多遍，这下也是找上我了。

我的智齿随着年龄的增长已经由看不到到看得到一半到全部四颗都齐刷刷地长出来和大牙并排并且丝毫看不出是智齿了。但是由于我小时候太嚣张，大晚上吃糖和水果又不刷牙，所以我的大牙好多都是龋齿。唯一庆幸的是，在我奶奶的监督下，我的牙齿长的还算整齐，没有东倒西歪，所以我一直对我的牙齿很满意。

但是近来开始牙疼，我想拔牙的心情到达顶峰了。但是牙疼又不能拔牙，只能先等牙齿不发炎了才可以去拔牙。以前牙齿不疼的时候我嫌那个拔牙的费用贵，一直拖。现在牙齿疼得不行，恨不得现在立刻马上就把牙齿拔掉，甚至🈶想要徒手拔牙的想法，虽然这个想法一点也不现实。

虽然很想拔牙，但是也只能等不发炎了再从长计议。但是这次好了我真的要把拔牙提上日程了。该补的补起来，该拔的拔了，以绝后患。有些钱真的不能省。

same-sex marriage\\.title: UN OLVIDO DE ESOS | ONE OF THOSE FORGETTINGS  (es|en)
same-sex marriage\\.body:
/>

**¡Hola, Hivers!**

  
Nuevamente les saludo. Gracias por estar leyendo mi post.

  
\

es un texto que tiene que ver con esos estados de ánimo que nos genera la ausencia de alguien muy querido, un ser especial a quien amamos y cuyo recuerdo permanece vivo en nuestros pensamientos más gratificantes, pero también en los más tristes. De la ausencia emana un clamor difícil de ignorar, una memoria que golpea la psiquis, incluso cuando despertamos en medio de la noche y algún sueño o recuerdo nos devuelve el pesar al alma.  
Es un poema sobre la distancia, la memoria y el silencio que queda cuando las palabras ya no alcanzan para reconstruir una historia que se resiste a desaparecer.  
Comparto con ustedes esta nueva e inédita versión, escrita desde ese territorio donde la nostalgia y la contemplación se encuentran.  
Gracias nuevamente por la lectura. ¡Hasta la vista!

**UN OLVIDO DE ESOS**

  
Versión nueva e inédita

Un olvido de esos  
que no extienda su mano  
como un leve suspiro,  
que se aparte del mundo,  
del relámpago  
en la espesa noche  
que duerme  
anclada a mí.

Tu fuiste clara y leve  
como un jazmín,  
y vertiste tu miel como el día  
echó sobre el rocío  
su ramillete dorado.

Mis manos eran de seda y sal,  
de viento infame,  
tú desembocaste  
fresca en mi arbitrio.

Amo tuyo fui, perplejo  
como un lucero en penumbras  
viendo al universo  
echar la red de negritudes  
paridora de mundos.

Partiste con tu diáfana sombra  
y tu albedrío profético,  
clara,  
como luna en medio de las cárceles.

Y por eso esta noche,  
padezco el sordo párrafo  
que ata a la amargura  
la historia nunca escrita.

¿Acaso quise escribirla,  
dotarla de un espíritu luminoso  
para que volaras cerca  
sin ambicionar distancias?

Para espantar la noche  
atada al madero donde habito,  
entre la niebla de los pasadizos  
abiertos a las distancias  
de encumbradas estrellas.

Estos instantes  
que respiran hondo  
para no mostrarme  
el camino por donde marchaste,  
la estela de la ola  
sin agua, que dejó sólo  
el vasto silencio  
que engulle mundos.

**¡Que tengan un lindo día!  
Gracias por tu visita. 😍☀️**

<h4 style=\

/>

**Hello Hivers!!**

It is a pleasure to greet everyone, especially the Freewritehouse community, @freewritehouse.

I am writing for “A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words” and its contest (link to the contest).

On this occasion, the image presents a visual artist decorating a plate or circular piece with plaster or a similar material. Undoubtedly, it brings me a sense of peace and reminds me of the act of creation as a source of strength for the soul and the human spirit. I also reflect on the power of concentration required for such an act, as well as the necessary detachment from the surrounding world, which is so restless and hectic in our times.

As a poet, I imagined the entire world pausing for a moment to contemplate that small act of creation. From that impression, this text was born, and I share it with you with great affection:

Aquí tienes una traducción poética al inglés, procurando conservar el tono lírico, las imágenes y la musicalidad del original más que una literalidad estricta:

**ONE OF THOSE FORGETTINGS**

_New and unpublished version_

One of those forgettings

that does not stretch out its hand

like a faint sigh,

that turns away from the world,

from the lightning

in the dense night

that sleeps

anchored to me.

You were clear and gentle

like a jasmine blossom,

and you poured out your honey as the day

cast upon the dew

its golden bouquet.

My hands were made of silk and salt,

of infamous wind;

you flowed

fresh into my will.

Yours was the love I became, bewildered

like a star in twilight,

watching the universe

cast its net of darknesses,

the womb that gives birth to worlds.

You departed with your diaphanous shadow

and your prophetic free will,

bright,

like the moon amid prisons.

And so tonight,

I suffer the muted paragraph

that binds to bitterness

the story never written.

Did I perhaps wish to write it,

to endow it with a luminous spirit

so that you might fly nearby

without yearning for distances?

To drive away the night

bound to the timber where I dwell,

amid the mist of passageways

opening onto the distances

of exalted stars.

These moments

that breathe deeply

so as not to show me

the road by which you departed,

the wake of a wave

without water, that left behind only

the vast silence

that swallows worlds.

**Have a beautiful day!  
**

**Thank you. 😍☀️**

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ |
|     Coenagrionidae      |      Jun 08, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday morning, when I was out taking pictures in nature, I saw this extraordinary Damselfly and immediately captured it on camera, today I am sharing the beauty of this Damselfly with everyone. This small creature was sitting quietly on the edge of the green leaves, making the soft morning light more charming. Its slender and long body, transparent web-like wings and large eyes depict a remarkable picture of nature's delicate artwork.

The damselfly was completely still while taking the picture, so I was able to clearly present the delicate design of its wings and the extraordinary structure of its eyes. Its extraordinary color and perfect structure amidst the green nature further highlight its beauty in nature.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this damselfly below, I hope everyone will like it and enjoy it.

links.title: Alta Intensidad [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
>

Alta Intensidad. El entrenamiento de hoy será demasiado dinámica, ejecutado a través de una sesión de ejercicios que permitirán quemar calorías, oxidar grasa, ganar masa muscular y por si fuera poco, vamos a mejorar la resistencia y el sistema cardiovascular. Todo esto, en una rutina donde tu cuerpo será el protagonista y el que reciba todos los beneficios de una manera amena y muy variada. Así que vamos a disfrutar de un circuito cargado de mucha potencia, no te quedes atrás y ven a cambiar tu vida para mejor. >High Intensity. Today’s workout will be incredibly dynamic, consisting of a series of exercises designed to burn calories, burn fat, build muscle, and as if that weren’t enough improve your endurance and cardiovascular health. All of this in a routine where your body takes center stage and reaps all the benefits in a fun and varied way. So let’s enjoy a high intensity circuit don’t get left behind and come change your life for the better.

![1000465026.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKAq5iJswUDSccpnj8YerLSufAgnbo7zW8SbJTUJaQV59iTfSSYWMWpcrBZTe5E.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **TWIST CON MOVIMIENTO DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 1**, **TWIST WITH ARM MOVEMENT**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms extended downward at your sides.
![1000464984.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK56997xTqaYNukBL4AE6kF9sSNdtSFWWAAwEocuCmANiWNDitdmgT2P6LqvSsc.gif)
[Ejecución]() Hacemos el movimiento de twist desde el núcleo hacia abajo, acompañado con la extensión y flexión continúa de codos. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >We perform the twisting motion from the core downward, accompanied by continuous extension and flexion of the elbows. 3 minutes of exercise.
![1000464986.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGJKHxZMWAHJgFsuXMPmAH3nyv5MHTi84rB4dZCiSaaPk6RcH9Dx4vUk89dwT.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **DOBLE RODILLAZO A CODO**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas un poco más allá del ancho de hombros. Codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **DOUBLE KNEE-TO-ELBOW**]() >[Stance]() >Legs slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Elbows bent, arms at your sides.
![1000464988.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK7xcRG3HmNXoimR31yTuJmh2F6VTEdcM6x4iNiDji8795DFxLwEBk89JhErKcv.gif)
[Ejecución]() Para ejecutar el movimiento; a través de pequeños saltos, damos doble rodillazo cruzado y al mismo tiempo, llevamos dos veces el codo opuesto hacia la rodilla. Lo hacemos de ambos lados por 3 minutos contínuos. >[Execution]() >To perform the movement, use small jumps to do a double cross-knee lift while simultaneously bringing the opposite elbow toward the knee twice. Do this on both sides for 3 continuous minutes.
![1000464996.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6XPyWA8tEK6wkNoUBQ3aHEgoxuKbTSu61ssZUviWbzKNgnLzXvESgUhbbnroj.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **ABDOMINALES EN VELA CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() Este es un ejercicio muy exigente; si tienen alguna dolencia de columna en cualquiera de sus tres partes, por favor tenga mucho cuidado, o no haga este movimiento. Nos ubicamos muy cerca de la pared; elevamos las piernas y quedamos apoyados de la parte alta de la espalda. Los glúteos se pegan a la pared y las manos se colocan entre la pared y la cadera; piernas juntas. >[**Station 1**, **WALL-SUPPORTED CRUNCHES**]() >[Position]() >This is a very demanding exercise; if you have any spinal issues in any of its three sections, please be very careful, or do not perform this movement. Stand very close to the wall; lift your legs and rest against the upper part of your back. Keep your glutes pressed against the wall and place your hands between the wall and your hips; keep your legs together.
![1000464998.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGMG7GAMRco1eBCxKDJcQvkFJEcS8qP8zkCAKK9F17S5gdAZgPsDcGsp19jxs.gif)
[Ejecución]() Acción directa en la espalda, núcleo y piernas. Activos en la posición indicada, solo flexionamos las rodillas y las llevamos contra el abdomen; extendemos rodillas y nos vamos con 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise targets the back, core, and legs. Starting in the shown position, simply bend your knees and bring them toward your abdomen; then straighten your knees. Perform 20 repetitions for 4 sets.
![1000465002.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDhbzmSr19w3aQmStaGx2BvKSKTctpRgMWQAuDVnBQMT9mcZiUCfvf7bEqNomA.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **EXTENSIÓN Y FLEXIÓN DE CODOS CON APOYO DE NUDILLOS MÁS GOLPES FRONTALES**]() [Postura]() Usamos un cojín o alfombra para proteger los nudillos. Partimos de una plancha con apoyo de antebrazos; piernas al ancho de la cadera y manos empuñadas. >[**Station 2**, **ELBOW EXTENSION AND FLEXION WITH KNUCKLE SUPPORT PLUS FRONT PUNCHES**]() >[Posture]() >Use a cushion or mat to protect your knuckles. Start in a plank position with your forearms on the ground; legs hip-width apart and hands clenched into fists.
![1000465004.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6XTCRbJrry2DVxkDJJ1C4v7XhUJrfCW5gicL3yomp5nV5FzPEuBdt1pjKK1wz.gif)
[Ejecución]() Fortalecimiento de muñecas y antebrazos; núcleo activo. Para ejecutar el movimiento; extendemos los codos de forma alterna y nos apoyamos de los nudillos. Luego; damos un golpe frontal con cada brazo y volvemos a la posición inicial flexionando los codos. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Strengthens the wrists and forearms; engages the core. To perform the movement, extend your elbows one at a time and support yourself on your knuckles. Then, thrust forward with each arm and return to the starting position by bending your elbows. 20 repetitions total, in 4 sets.
![1000465010.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6XRo6UEsDdsYPNB6G9E1kd6SHyqoeFnCDVndjkNwNKppHxTsJV1dLTgmG9hcy.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SENTADILLAS MÁS RODILLAZO CRUZADO Y GOLPE OPUESTO CON MANCUERNA**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de hombros; tomamos la mancuerna con una mano y ubicamos los brazos en posición de combate a nivel del abdomen. >[**Station 3**, **SQUATS WITH CROSS-KNEES AND OPPOSITE-SIDE DUNGEON KICKS WITH A DUMBBELL**]() >[Stance]() >Feet shoulder-width apart; hold the dumbbell in one hand and position your arms in a fighting stance at waist level.
![1000465012.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCFxwwaee4CRH3jorwRZHNtr2xkvuTMsx5ySW3NZfaUEHTDMzBXpDvvr49jCcA.gif)
[Ejecución]() Con la ejecución de este ejercicio, todo el cuerpo trabaja de manera integral. Para llevarlo a cabo, realizamos una sentadilla; al subir, damos un rodillazo cruzado y al mismo tiempo damos un golpe cruzado con el brazo que tiene la mancuerna. Lógicamente; rodilla y brazo opuesto. Al momento de realizar la otra sentadilla; pasamos la mancuerna hacia la otra mano, viene la sentadilla y luego, rodillazo y golpe cruzado con mancuerna. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise works the entire body comprehensively. To perform it, start with a squat; as you rise, deliver a cross-body knee strike and, at the same time, a cross-body punch with the arm holding the dumbbell. Naturally, use the opposite knee and arm. When performing the next squat, switch the dumbbell to the other hand, then do the squat, followed by a knee strike and a cross punch with the dumbbell. 20 total repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000465020.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AK7xM794x9x6BDuZS2nAM5EFPFkkmtFN6LmAjeBTge1cpPZSMK2WdD9cSqqFcFm.gif)
[**Relajación**, **PATADA FRONTAL MÁS FLEXIÓN DE RODILLA Y EXTENSIÓN DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Relaxation**, **FRONT KICK WITH KNEE BEND AND ELBOW EXTENSION**]() >[Posture]() >Feet hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms at your sides.
![1000465022.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKApq3yujK4V2uPhNki5nbyCGi4P5AYCE2wv1Wp8EXgcXQp3BnaTzsRRFmrX6Nk.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, suavemente damos una patada frontal; al mismo tiempo, extendemos los codos al fente. Cuando la pierna regresa, la flexionamos hacia atrás y los brazos vuelven a la posición inicial. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; after 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we gently perform a front kick; at the same time, we extend our elbows forward. As the leg returns, we bend it backward, and the arms return to the starting position.
![1000465024.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AK7xJ19QDLjFhhJwEaPfGE3AcMsaEz7KSqGjT2QaQ2vbjzkca98hiRMshA83H3a.gif)

Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

links.body:
It was a very good day as my legs were feeling good, and I'm feeling a lot more motivated to get back into shape for some longer running. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd0d39d1-a584-476c-9f77-526e22d15904.jpg) An early 2 miles walking around the recreational path with Lulu. Several of our friends were also walking but no critters to amuse Lulu. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f96dafa9-9672-468d-90ba-d40316ba9ca7.jpg) My run took me up onto the brand new (and still under some construction) mountain bike trails alongside of the city campground area. The new section was a series of steep curvy switchbacks that climbed up the steep forested hillside before I had to turn around and zip back down to the older section of trail towards the end of the flat path. From there it was another 3 miles out along the easier bike trails. My pace was pretty good even though I'm usually slower on these narrow trails. The weather was nice and mild for a change which made the 4 miles very good. Off to Rapid City tomorrow for some shopping and then hopefully a run in the early afternoon. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/566c9fb7-5c9b-412a-a93d-f7c60f49b1ff.jpg)

links.title: Freewrite || The Joy of Playing in the Rain
links.body:
![PSX_20260609_084939.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjLq9aoaqGrzPN5xoyByvyH5bQfftGKrR9tN7oDvBX1B/PSX_20260609_084939.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
Rain often changes people's plans, but for children, it can become an opportunity for fun and adventure. In this photo, several children are seen happily playing football in an open yard while the rain falls around them. Their laughter and enthusiasm create a warm atmosphere despite the cloudy weather.

What makes this scene special is the simplicity of their happiness. They do not need expensive toys or modern gadgets. A ball, a little open space, and good friends are enough to create unforgettable memories. The wet ground and falling raindrops do not stop them from enjoying the moment.

Watching children play like this reminds me of my own childhood. Back then, rain was not something to avoid. Instead, it was something we looked forward to because it gave us a chance to play freely, get soaked, and enjoy nature without worrying about anything else.

In today's world, many children spend more time indoors with smartphones and electronic devices. Moments like this show the importance of outdoor activities. Playing outside helps children stay active, build friendships, and develop teamwork while having fun.

This photograph captures more than just a game. It captures freedom, friendship, and the simple joys of childhood. Sometimes, the happiest moments in life come from the simplest experiences, just like playing football in the rain with friends.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
