links.title: Xổ số miền Bắc nổ lớn liên tiếp: Khách Hà Nội trúng hơn 1 tỷ
links.body: **Xổ số miền Bắc nổ lớn liên tiếp: Khách Hà Nội trúng hơn 1 tỷ** Theo dõi KQXSMB trong tháng 5/2026, nhiều khách hàng may mắn đã liên tiếp giành được những giải thưởng giá trị lớn từ các trò chơi xổ số điện toán của Xổ số kiến thiết miền Bắc. Đây là tín hiệu vui mừng, cho thấy cơ hội đổi đời hoàn toàn có thể đến với bất kỳ ai khi tham gia các sản phẩm xổ số hợp pháp của Nhà nước. **Ngày 21/5/2026 – Tấm vé đầu tiên mang về hơn 1 tỷ đồng** Mở đầu chuỗi tin vui, vào kỳ quay số mở thưởng ngày 21/5/2026, đã có khách hàng trúng thưởng Xổ số điện toán lô tô 2 số với giá trị giải thưởng lên tới 1 tỷ 25 triệu đồng. Vé trúng thưởng được bán tại các đại lý xổ số điện toán chính thức trong hệ thống của Công ty Xổ số kiến thiết miền Bắc. Giải thưởng ấn tượng này tiếp tục khẳng định sức hút của dòng sản phẩm lô tô 2 số – một trong những trò chơi phổ biến nhất trong hệ thống xổ số miền Bắc hiện nay. Chỉ với một tấm vé nhỏ, người chơi hoàn toàn có thể đổi thay cuộc sống chỉ sau một kỳ quay thưởng. ➢➢➢ Tra cứu ngay: [https://www.leenkup.com/xosomienbac](https://www.leenkup.com/xosomienbac) **Ngày 25/5/2026 – Thêm hai tấm vé may mắn, tổng giải thưởng vượt 1,1 tỷ đồng** Chưa dừng lại ở đó, chỉ 4 ngày sau, kết quả XSMB ngày 25/5/2026 tiếp tục ghi nhận thêm hai trường hợp trúng thưởng lớn với tổng giá trị giải thưởng lên đến hơn 1,1 tỷ đồng. Trường hợp đầu tiên là khách hàng trúng thưởng khi mua vé Xổ số điện toán lô tô 2 số với giá trị hơn 700 triệu đồng. Vé được bán tại các đại lý xổ số điện toán chính thức thuộc hệ thống SXMB trên toàn mạng lưới của Công ty. Trường hợp thứ hai đặc biệt hơn khi tấm vé may mắn xuất phát từ một địa chỉ cụ thể: đại lý xổ số điện toán tại số 35 Trần Đăng Ninh, Cầu Giấy, thành phố Hà Nội. Tại đây, khách hàng đã trúng Giải đặc biệt khi mua vé Xổ số điện toán lô tô tự chọn 5 số trị giá 400 triệu đồng. Đây là một trong những đại lý uy tín trong hệ thống xổ số kiến thiết miền Bắc tại khu vực phía Tây thủ đô, và sự kiện này cho thấy giải thưởng lớn hoàn toàn có thể đến với người chơi ở bất kỳ đại lý nào trong mạng lưới chính thức. ➢➢➢Theo dõi ngay: [https://colored.club/xosomienbac](https://colored.club/xosomienbac) **Tham gia xổ số miền Bắc – Cơ hội dành cho tất cả mọi người** Liên tiếp xuất hiện những tấm vé may mắn chỉ trong vòng chưa đầy một tuần là minh chứng rõ nét nhất cho sức hút của các sản phẩm XSMB. Với hai dòng sản phẩm chủ lực là lô tô 2 số và lô tô tự chọn 5 số, xổ số miền Bắc đang mang đến những trải nghiệm chơi đơn giản, minh bạch và cơ hội trúng thưởng thực sự hấp dẫn cho người chơi trên khắp các tỉnh thành. Tất cả vé đều được bán qua hệ thống đại lý xổ số điện toán được cấp phép và giám sát chặt chẽ bởi Công ty Xổ số kiến thiết miền Bắc, đảm bảo tính minh bạch, an toàn tuyệt đối cho người tham gia. Bên cạnh đó, mỗi tấm vé bạn mua còn là đóng góp ý nghĩa cho các công trình phúc lợi xã hội, giáo dục, y tế và cơ sở hạ tầng trên toàn quốc. Những đồng tiền từ xổ số đã và đang góp phần xây dựng một xã hội tốt đẹp hơn cho tất cả mọi người. Hãy thử vận may của bạn ngay hôm nay tại các đại lý xổ số điện toán chính thức gần nhất, và đừng quên theo dõi KQXSMB hàng ngày để cập nhật kết quả quay số mở thưởng mới nhất. Biết đâu, người tiếp theo được xướng tên trong danh sách trúng thưởng của SXMB chính là bạn! ➢➢➢ Xem ngay: [https://drukarnia.com.ua/xosomienbac](https://drukarnia.com.ua/xosomienbac)

links.title: The taste of tradition is back.
links.body:
June has arrived, and with it, the good old tradition of typical corn-based foods. The famous **June Festivals** celebrate precisely three saints: **Saint Anthony** (June 13), **Saint John** (June 24) and **Saint Peter** (June 29). Although it is not a widely Brazilian festival (because it is more concentrated in the Northeast region), it is still known throughout the territory for its broad historical context (which ends up becoming an important part of the country).
<center>[OCP News](https://ocp.news/colunistas/as-comidas-tipicas-das-festas-juninas)</center>
Not only do the typical corn-based foods gets prominence, but also the clothes, the music, the decorations, the gatherings with family, friends, and strangers (in this last group, the gatherings that happen by chance due to the existence of musical hubs that host other festivals within the same theme)... In short, it is a time when the June tradition renews all its strength, spreading throughout the country the atmosphere that contagiously affects millions of people.
Another aspect that also draws a lot of attention is the \

done with fireworks. There are many colors, lights, and visual effects that explode in the sky, creating a true (and enchanting) optical show that is always seen as a major highlight at parties. This is one of the most anticipated moments for many people, because they are often themed at some events, thus enhancing the visual style of an already quite famous party.\nIt is also worth mentioning (and it couldn't be otherwise) the dance, which takes on a special dimension through what is done with the Quadrilha groups. Over the years, what began relatively timidly (in all aspects) has long since become a kind of \

(due to its artistic megalomania, which involves not only a lot of money in terms of production... but also a lot of work in terms of history and sewing).
<center>[Jornal da Paraíba](https://jornaldaparaiba.com.br/cultura/festa-de-sao-joao)</center>
<center>[Jornal da Paraíba](https://jornaldaparaiba.com.br/cultura/festa-de-sao-joao)</center>
In addition, the training of these dance groups is very exhausting (but they do everything to deliver a great visual spectacle, which is always very fun and vibrant). Personally, I don't like this part very much nowadays. Due to the essence that has been lost over the years, the quadrilles have become too \
(so to speak) to the point of becoming almost \

. However, the taste for tradition still lives on... And it is quite strong.
---
<center>**El sabor de la tradición ha regresado.**</center>
Llegó junio, y con él, la entrañable tradición de los platos típicos a base de maíz. Las famosas **Fiestas de Junio** celebran precisamente a tres santos: **San Antonio** (13 de junio), **San Juan** (24 de junio) y **San Pedro** (29 de junio). Si bien no es una fiesta muy extendida en Brasil (ya que se concentra principalmente en la región noreste), es conocida en todo el territorio por su amplio contexto histórico (que termina convirtiéndose en una parte importante del país).
No solo cobran protagonismo los platos típicos a base de maíz, sino también la vestimenta, la música, la decoración, las reuniones con familiares, amigos y desconocidos (en este último grupo, las reuniones que surgen de forma espontánea gracias a la existencia de centros musicales que albergan otros festivales de la misma temática)... En resumen, es un momento en que la tradición de junio renueva toda su fuerza, contagiando por todo el país una atmósfera que impacta a millones de personas.
Otro aspecto que también llama mucho la atención es el espectáculo de fuegos artificiales. Una explosión de colores, luces y efectos visuales crea un verdadero (y encantador) espectáculo óptico que siempre se considera uno de los momentos culminantes de las fiestas. Este es uno de los momentos más esperados por muchos, ya que a menudo forman parte de la temática de algunos eventos, realzando así el estilo visual de una fiesta que ya de por sí es muy famosa.
También cabe mencionar (y no podría ser de otra manera) el baile, que adquiere una dimensión especial gracias a la participación de los grupos de cuadrilla. Con el paso de los años, lo que comenzó de forma relativamente modesta (en todos los aspectos) se ha convertido en una especie de \

(debido a su megalomanía artística, que implica no solo una gran inversión en producción, sino también un enorme trabajo de historia y confección). Además, la formación de estos grupos de baile es muy exigente (pero se esfuerzan al máximo para ofrecer un gran espectáculo visual, siempre divertido y vibrante). Personalmente, esta parte no me convence del todo hoy en día. Debido a la pérdida de su esencia con el paso del tiempo, las cuadrillas se han “modernizado” demasiado, hasta el punto de ser casi irreconocibles. Sin embargo, el gusto por la tradición sigue vivo, y con mucha fuerza. ---
**O gosto da tradição está de volta.**
O mês de junho chegou, e com ele, a boa e velha tradição das comidas típicas feitas à base de milho. As famosas **Festas Juninas** celebram precisamente três santos: **Santo Antônio** (13 de junho), **São João** (dia 24) e **São Pedro* (dia 29). Ainda que não seja uma festa amplamente brasileira (porque é mais concentrada na região Nordeste), ainda sim, é conhecida por todo o território pela sua amplitude de contexto histórico (que acaba se tornando uma parte importante do país). Não apenas as comidas típicas à base de milho ganham um destaque, mas também as roupas, a música, as decorações, as reuniões com familiares, amigos e desconhecidos (neste último grupo, as reuniões que acontecem ao acaso devido a existência de polos musicais que sediam outras festas dentro do mesmo tema)... Enfim, é uma época onde a tradição junina renova todas as suas forças, espalhando pelo país inteiro a atmosfera que vai contagiando milhões de pessoas. Um outro aspecto que também chama muito à atenção é a “orquestração” que é feita com fogos de artifício. Há muitas cores, luzes e efeitos visuais que explodem no céu, criando um verdadeiro (e encantador) show de ótica que sempre é visto como um grande destaque nas festas. Esse é um dos momentos mais esperados por muitas pessoas, porque eles costumam ser temáticos em alguns eventos, aumentando assim o estilo visual de uma festa que já é bastante famosa. Vale à pena mencionar também (e não poderia ser diferente) a dança, que ganha um contorno especial através do que é feito com os grupos de Quadrilha. Ao longo dos anos, o que começou de maneira relativamente tímida (em todos os aspectos), há algum tempo já se tornou em uma espécie de “desfile carnavalesco” (devido à sua megalomania artística, que não envolve apenas muito dinheiro em termos de produção... mas também, muito trabalho de história e costura). Além disso, os treinos desses grupos de dança são muito exaustivos (mas eles fazem de tudo para entregar um grande espetáculo visual, que sempre é muito divertido e vibrante). Particularmente, eu não gosto muito dessa parte nos dias atuais. Devido a essência que foi perdida ao longo dos anos, as quadrilhas foram se “modernizando” demais (por assim dizer) ao ponto de se tornarem quase “irreconhecíveis”. No entanto, o gosto da tradição ainda vive... E é bastante forte. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-taste-of-tradition-is-back-6w5)

links.title: Twilight Zone: The Movie. Four Directors, Four Incredible Stories, And One Unforgettable Legacy & Sadly One Unforgettable Tragedy.
links.body:
Twilight Zone: The Movie remains one of the most fascinating anthology films ever made. It successfully brought Rod Serling’s legendary television series to the big screen while giving four talented directors the opportunity to put their own stamp on classic Twilight Zone storytelling. Unfortunately, it is also forever remembered because of a tragedy during production that changed Hollywood safety standards forever.

![IMG_2957.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZAXKR4r7v3WBgYrBMjVTaTwN2Qmu3vyNjtGzfP2z4saW/IMG_2957.webp)

Released in 1983, Twilight Zone: The Movie was produced by Steven Spielberg and John Landis. Like the original television series, the movie is divided into separate stories, each exploring strange situations, moral lessons, fantasy, horror, or science fiction themes. The anthology format worked perfectly because The Twilight Zone had always been about taking ordinary people and placing them into extraordinary circumstances.

The first segment was directed by John Landis and starred Vic Morrow as Bill Connor, a racist and deeply prejudiced man. After expressing his hateful views in a bar, Connor suddenly finds himself transported through various periods of history where he becomes the victim of the same hatred he once directed at others. He experiences persecution as a Jewish man in Nazi-occupied Europe, as a Black man facing the Ku Klux Klan, and as a Vietnamese civilian during the Vietnam War.

Landis’s segment is darker and more serious than the others. It attempts to use fantasy and irony to teach a moral lesson in classic Twilight Zone fashion. Vic Morrow gives a strong performance as a deeply flawed man who is forced to confront the consequences of his own prejudice. Sadly, this segment is forever linked to the fatal accident that claimed the lives of Morrow and child actors Myca Dinh Le and Renee Shin-Yi Chen during production.

The tragedy occurred during the Vietnam sequence. A helicopter filming the scene crashed after special effects explosions caused catastrophic damage to the aircraft. The deaths led to years of legal battles and public scrutiny. More importantly, the accident resulted in major changes involving stunt work, special effects safety, helicopter operations, and child labor regulations. Many of the safety practices used on film sets today can trace their origins back to lessons learned from this heartbreaking event.

The second segment, Kick the Can, was directed by Steven Spielberg. This story stars Scatman Crothers as Mr. Bloom, an elderly man living in a retirement home. Bloom introduces the residents to the idea that youth is a state of mind and encourages them to reconnect with the joy and imagination they once possessed as children.

Unlike the darker stories surrounding it, Spielberg’s segment is warm, sentimental, and optimistic. The cast includes Scatman Crothers, who brings tremendous charm and heart to the role, along with Helen Shaw, Bill Quinn, and several veteran character actors. Spielberg fills the segment with the same sense of wonder that appeared in films like E.T. While some viewers feel it runs a bit long, it captures the hopeful side of The Twilight Zone and provides a nice emotional break from the more intense stories.

The third segment, It’s a Good Life, was directed by Joe Dante. This story is a remake of one of the most famous episodes from the original television series. Kathleen Quinlan stars as Helen Foley, a schoolteacher who becomes trapped inside the bizarre household of a young boy named Anthony, played by Jeremy Licht.

Anthony possesses godlike powers and can alter reality however he chooses. Because everyone around him fears his abilities, they constantly pretend to be happy no matter how strange or terrifying his actions become. Nancy Cartwright, best known as the future voice of Bart Simpson, plays Anthony’s sister, while Kevin McCarthy appears as her father.

Joe Dante was the perfect choice for this material. Known for combining horror, fantasy, and dark comedy, Dante creates some of the movie’s most imaginative visuals. The segment feels like a live-action cartoon at times, featuring bizarre creatures, impossible transformations, and surreal imagery. It captures the unsettling feeling of the original episode while expanding it with bigger special effects and a more playful visual style.

The final segment, Nightmare at 20,000 Feet, was directed by George Miller. Miller had already impressed audiences with Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior, and he brought tremendous energy and visual skill to the film. The segment stars John Lithgow as John Valentine, a nervous airline passenger who believes he sees a monstrous creature on the wing of his airplane during a storm.

Lithgow absolutely carries the story. His performance is intense, paranoid, funny, and sympathetic all at once. The audience constantly questions whether he is actually seeing the creature or suffering a mental breakdown. The confined setting inside the aircraft creates enormous tension, and Miller’s direction keeps the suspense building throughout the segment.

Richard Matheson, who wrote the original television episode, adapted the screenplay himself. Fans often compare Lithgow’s performance to William Shatner’s famous portrayal in the television version. Rather than imitate Shatner, Lithgow creates his own interpretation, making the character even more frantic and emotionally unstable. The result is one of the strongest and most memorable portions of the entire movie.

The film concludes with a brief wraparound sequence featuring Dan Aykroyd and Albert Brooks. Their opening scene has become iconic among horror fans and delivers one of the movie’s most memorable surprises. Though short, the sequence effectively sets the tone for the strange and unpredictable stories that follow.

What makes Twilight Zone: The Movie so interesting is that it feels like four very different films sharing the same title. Landis delivers a morality tale, Spielberg offers sentimental fantasy, Dante embraces bizarre dark comedy, and Miller crafts a suspenseful horror thriller. Each director brings a unique style while remaining connected to the themes that Rod Serling made famous decades earlier.

As a film, Twilight Zone: The Movie isn’t perfect. Some segments work better than others, and viewers often disagree about which stories are strongest. Yet that variety is part of its appeal. There is something here for almost every fan of fantasy, science fiction, horror, or classic storytelling.

Today, the movie remains a fascinating tribute to one of television’s greatest series. It features excellent performances from Vic Morrow, Scatman Crothers, Kathleen Quinlan, Jeremy Licht, Kevin McCarthy, Dan Aykroyd, Albert Brooks, and especially John Lithgow. The contributions of John Landis, Steven Spielberg, Joe Dante, and George Miller give the film an impressive creative pedigree that few anthology movies can match.

![IMG_2956.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfGJ7Fp1UaGNgj2hurMY7uumZhgQcYycQgy8tWCoo35Q/IMG_2956.webp)

While the tragic deaths of Vic Morrow, Myca Dinh Le, and Renee Shin-Yi Chen will always be part of the film’s legacy, Twilight Zone: The Movie also deserves recognition for its ambitious storytelling, talented cast, and creative filmmaking. It stands as both an entertaining anthology and an important piece of Hollywood history, remembered for its memorable stories and for the lasting changes it inspired throughout the film industry.

![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSMqpOW2dbvKoP_tumMt_FIM_KdVbxMtfGESJeUMwnUNQ&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSMqpOW2dbvKoP_tumMt_FIM_KdVbxMtfGESJeUMwnUNQ&s=10)

Sitting in his spaceship orbiting around the galaxy. Issac sees a ray of reflected light from one unknown planet from his current coordinates. 

As he is bored from his current mission, Issac decided to check out that planet and sees what he can find, he comms his team and shortly after, zoom to his new coordinates. Upon landing, he realized this planet is so secluded that no other prior expedition trip has discovered it as no flags or sign of landig is spotted. 

Issac was delighted as he became the first man to discover a new planet. He saw a piece of mosaic tile on the floor that is black and white with some figures embedded. Picking it up, Issac has some sense of familiarity. Looking at it from a distance with his hand stretch out. He saw a QR code which might indicate the presence of an unknown civilization that is monitoring Earth. All excited, Issac decided to bring this mosaic tile back to Earth to see what the QR code lead them to it might just be a starting piece to a greater discovery.

links.title: The World Is Holding Its Breath: Is the Middle East on the Brink of a Regional War?
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPyEW6ZWksyVj7aJ32Y9DmXDxgsVzpG54dVtbRm9DuMAB/1000720710.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYXMfa8L6QRGM5KgjjVqH85ceouAFKxxddhkFR7K4ihMW/1000720708.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbKQYQhtKmteX6hMgdWSEnZ5b44YYRxDVZmm5xN4woQ44/1000720706.jpg 

For decades, the Middle East has been one of the world's most volatile regions. Yet today's situation feels different.
Iran and Israel have once again exchanged attacks, despite previous diplomatic efforts and fragile ceasefire arrangements. Reports indicate that Iran launched missiles toward Israel following Israeli strikes connected to Lebanon, while Israel has vowed to continue responding if threatened.
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/israel-and-iran-exchange-attacks-as-ceasefire-falters?utm
https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-june-8-2026/?utm
This is no longer a story that concerns only the Middle East.
It is becoming a story about global security, global inflation, and the future of the world economy.

**How Did We Get Here?**
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW8r3vhAUvwtSA3Vp6WrvJak32qmagH4SjEgSKGNfCodn/1000720723.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS8ENLr2V6wfsYPeVrp8pQ1AaKz7SqFeipAHi1D7m6wY9/1000720721.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRPd6k9rWJS6UyiJWUA1F7pFVs3vPfJPLoXgxSj8fLGPm/1000720727.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVPRNEg9BuYgHg9yzCnCrvyPYnjXmNd142MLMBHorBJU9/1000720725.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaamDeQsH5Uj8V3icdkSTamYpPxyfuPAa9sENfbZAk5eb/1000720719.jpg 
The current escalation did not happen overnight.
Years of rivalry between Iran and Israel have involved disputes over security, Iran's nuclear program, regional influence, and proxy groups across the Middle East.
The latest exchange followed Israeli strikes connected to Beirut, after which Iran retaliated with missile launches toward Israel. Israel responded by warning that further attacks would bring additional military action.
https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/8/iran-and-israel-trade-threats-after-tehran-launches-missiles?utm
History shows that wars often expand not because one side planned a regional conflict from the beginning, but because each response triggers another.

**Why This Crisis Matters to Everyone**
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPBDZN226SwgkEoTVgFNFbaFqRvP2RcaqS3XGhP39NgNQ/1000720739.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWMK1iCmexBt6nuN89NDQw3oD2yCKwHeco69pVK8ZsyNP/1000720729.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPspwpmEeH3rtaduZBTqZ5gTPcV1yqUV2LRgLTo9Gpaug/1000720735.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfYfDSFL34ACo2J1QMXdSPRRDyNY4daa3y1PoR7jn1zmP/1000720737.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXqmLJAM6szu7HuAXcsaroYT4ZLWn85r6H42uywBTBeqB/1000720731.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYqmLvfpoN71rLLadJMS6oDtEn8a9xxuLDUdctneyK2o7/1000720733.jpg 
Many people believe wars only affect countries directly involved.
Reality is very different.
The global economy depends on confidence, stable trade routes, and affordable energy.
When geopolitical tensions increase:
Investors become nervous.
Companies delay investment.
Shipping costs rise.
Insurance costs increase.
Consumers eventually pay more.
Even countries located thousands of kilometers away can experience higher prices because today's economy is deeply interconnected.

**The Strait of Hormuz: A Narrow Waterway with Global Importance** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeA4r9xvFXSf3y4BikJLBCPuKtgDq69z1R1BCTaZcmb8K/1000720745.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWBqf9haqcMeaQJwAQD125YzYxrHitmt7UupRLDqPrqtj/1000720751.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTbXiRQcQ2u59YEfghwB1T9zivofbnciNBacr8crcZioR/1000720743.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWP2qhGRK7aDF9PzyEEAwsnKM8tHTwUvU7fZLHsy6m4E2/1000720747.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd4EzrSFuc2VucA4RoPgRVBk2RUxCrqt3kcN8iWEfke8P/1000720741.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPZXDkb24p8x4ENQKSj1qsvik94JGNtHcZ9Kxei4dFTBZ/1000720749.jpg 
Perhaps the biggest economic concern is the Strait of Hormuz.
A significant share of the world's seaborne oil trade passes through this narrow corridor.
Recent tensions have again raised fears about disruptions to shipping, and oil markets reacted quickly to renewed conflict.
https://www.reuters.com/commentary/reuters-open-interest/energy-watch-mideast-flare-up-2026-06-08/?utm
Even if the waterway remains open, uncertainty alone can push energy prices higher.
Markets price risk before shortages actually occur.

**From Missiles to Inflation: The Domino Effect** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbXJeCWQ4xPrNpAfiQ2HtJAjXTAsXSdnTkE5R4Zu2wZbY/1000720759.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVKfHX2RP52iMA44377MyyTMqhEad1G3PUzNS84esDW8t/1000720755.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ7HsowT1ZwFrQ86Rk2MmoHRiLQz2kyHzSW3vGLURYmcJ/1000720757.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSwJgoRuCLcPwJMi9n1z5vzqn6sYYtLpND36SMuje6FYj/1000720753.jpg 
Many people ask:
How can a missile launched in the Middle East affect my daily life?
The answer lies in the chain reaction.
Higher oil prices mean:
Transportation becomes more expensive.
Food distribution costs increase.
Manufacturing expenses rise.
Airline tickets become more costly.
Inflation pressures households worldwide.
One geopolitical event can eventually influence the price of everyday necessities.

**Markets React Before Governments Do** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP239PQD8CkCWpjW74r8VijQ7xAtxke6hC3FuCaNnMSty/1000720765.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP7riNWP1pNQUxAjYfKweXKNy2BJxQ5oBEP8bwyo8ZUPh/1000720763.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQMxHng8BRX34oTCKpbpN78NiwSEcVR7ToYUqpusBS3bA/1000720767.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmedE9QkW4S6ZFK7AKCTjSDC2tTSM1KSJM95rjPvThkPto/1000720773.jpg 
Financial markets operate on expectations.
Whenever uncertainty grows, investors often seek safer assets such as gold, while some also turn to Bitcoin and other alternatives.
Recent market movements showed oil prices jumping during renewed tensions before easing as hopes for de-escalation emerged.
https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jun/08/stock-markets-fall-oil-jumps-middle-east-conflict-ai-boom-falters-live-news-
updates?utm
Sometimes fear moves markets faster than actual damage.

**Could This Become a Regional War?** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWeC4Z4or9bGAX4e5ACtwG6dxYfrkh5k5sRgvm1ryPdX7/1000720777.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNwCebYUp1qcK36VqmAT9CYSuj1xwrAGjfDi4PKUeibYW/1000720781.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc4oaFbb6NPY5jH7p2d6EeEPbtDN4gKgR5hsFJzh5xVtv/1000720783.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma7sdgqqCgRu2x1w2bfxS4KX69Hti9cK942AVaA5PnKDj/1000720775.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPWxe3XuYRYDRmm4vXTnW5mEKRad6GjoeZ8URyXyZiuhZ/1000720779.jpg 
This is the question worrying governments around the world.
The issue is not only Iran and Israel.
The broader region involves multiple actors and alliances, including developments related to Lebanon and armed groups that could widen the confrontation if diplomacy fails.
https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/6/8/how-lebanon-and-irans-war-of-words-became-backdrop-for-latest-israel-war?utm
The more participants involved, the greater the chance of miscalculation.
History reminds us that regional wars often begin with a series of retaliatory actions rather than a single planned event.

**The Human Cost Behind the Headlines**
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXwsGHvFwkEzQMKX2Z7y8E3ZjkfQPNAcQzXCBpJtRsVy5/1000720795.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTu3TT7FQJVuocqsqmzwp3iqemJB1HmPdo2cMevzRkZrY/1000720791.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT3Xc2iymGoGQ6UwMDFhf2pzJTYwFP31VRcwgCgR4Rak5/1000720793.jpg 
Beyond military strategy and financial markets are ordinary people.
Families worry about safety.
Children lose access to normal life.
Businesses struggle with uncertainty.
Communities face displacement and hardship.
While headlines focus on missiles and diplomacy, the greatest cost of war is almost always paid by civilians.

**Can Diplomacy Still Prevent Something Bigger?**
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY3t86qiTpL9dQwTed8n1TBmg828DR7y6FgLUTn2sgjuQ/1000720799.jpg 
Despite the escalation, diplomatic efforts continue.
Reports indicate that U.S. leaders have urged restraint and sought to prevent further retaliation while negotiations remain active.
https://www.axios.com/2026/06/07/trump-netanyahu-israel-iran-strikes-call?utm_source
The coming days will be critical.
If dialogue succeeds, tensions may gradually ease.
If retaliation continues, the conflict could draw in more actors and create wider economic consequences.

**Final Thoughts**
Today's exchange between Iran and Israel is more than another headline.
It is a reminder that the world economy, energy markets, and geopolitical stability are closely connected.
The greatest danger is not only the missiles already launched—it is the possibility that each new strike creates another cycle of retaliation.
The world is watching because what happens in the Middle East rarely stays in the Middle East.
It can influence inflation, investment, energy prices, and the daily lives of billions of people.

**Question:**
**Do you believe diplomacy will eventually prevail, or are we witnessing the early stages of a much larger regional conflict that could reshape the global economy?**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@yordan96/the-world-is-holding-its-breath-is-the-middle-east-on-the-brink-of-a-regional-war-hqa)

links.title: Mujeres que sostienen el hogar y el amor a la distancia
links.body:
Hola comunidad Holos y Lotus ,antes de empezar mi post les pido que lean  a :
@milagroscmiranda mi mami bella que cada día me sorprende más con sus post 
@valderalazaro mi hombre bello el amor de mi vida que cada día pone esfuerzo y dedicación para escribir aquí ,con historias nuevas e interesantes 
Y como siempre pidiendo apoyo para la comunidad BBH para que siga ayudando a tantas personas que como yo necesitamos su granito de arena
![image_1778723176043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mUxfi8Zs7EiaNcP4eejtWw4CmqVUJyuPJVvev73FgRq1Xdj1VfBHP28.jpg)
 
🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴🥴
Vivir en Cuba siendo ama de casa y madre de un niño pequeño no es tarea fácil. Muchas veces, los días parecen eternos y la responsabilidad de mantener el hogar recae casi por completo sobre nosotras. Para mí, estos días son aún más largos porque mi esposo trabaja en un hotel en Varadero, siete días fuera y solo tres con nosotros.
Mi hijo Lukas y yo pasamos gran parte del tiempo solos. Me despierto temprano para preparar el desayuno, organizar la casa, lavar ropa, cocinar y atender cada necesidad de Lukas. Los días pueden ser agotadores, y hay momentos en los que el cansancio pesa. Pesan las noches cuando Lukas se enferma y debo cuidarlo sola, los días en los que deseo compartir una decisión importante con mi esposo y esperar su llamada, o simplemente esos instantes en que necesito un abrazo que calme mi agotamiento.
Pero también hay momentos de alegría y amor que hacen que todo valga la pena. Las risas de Lukas mientras jugamos, sus abrazos espontáneos y preguntas curiosas me recuerdan cada día que mi esfuerzo tiene sentido.
He aprendido que la fortaleza no es no cansarse nunca, sino seguir adelante a pesar del cansancio. Estos días a solas me enseñan paciencia, resiliencia y amor incondicional. Y aunque pocas veces se reconozca, sostener un hogar y criar un hijo es un trabajo enorme y valioso.
A todas las mujeres que viven esta realidad: no están solas. Cada esfuerzo, cada sacrificio y cada momento de amor construye un hogar fuerte y lleno de esperanza. Ser madre y ama de casa en estas circunstancias es un acto de heroísmo cotidiano que merece todo respeto y admiración.
🤍💛💛🤍💛🤍🤍💛🤍💛🤍🤍💛🤍💛🤍💛
Agradecimiento especial a todos ustedes
Quiero tomar un momento para expresar mi más sincero agradecimiento a todos mis seguidores en HIVE, Holos y Lotus. Cada comentario, cada “me gusta” y cada mensaje que recibo me recuerda que no estoy sola en este camino. Su apoyo, su compañía y sus palabras de aliento significan mucho para mí y para mi familia.
Un agradecimiento muy especial a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por ser mi compañero, mi fuerza y mi motivación cada día, aun cuando las circunstancias nos separan temporalmente. Gracias por tu amor incondicional y por cada esfuerzo que haces por nuestra familia.
También quiero reconocer a @bradleyarrow y @cathyarrow por su apoyo, por compartir este espacio y por acompañarme en cada proyecto y en cada paso que damos juntos en esta comunidad. Su cercanía y amistad hacen que todo sea más fácil y más bonito.
Gracias de corazón a todos los que forman parte de este viaje. Cada uno de ustedes, con su participación y sus palabras, ayuda a construir un espacio lleno de creatividad, inspiración y cariño. Sin ustedes, nada de esto tendría el mismo significado.
Sigan acompañándome, sigamos compartiendo historias, aprendizajes y momentos. Este camino es más valioso gracias a ustedes. 
Con todo mi cariño y gratitud,
Katy

links.body: > In a country called Palenzuela, on the American continent, during the colonial era, where most of the inhabitants were of Indigenous descent, the economy was based on agriculture, hunting, fishing, and livestock raising. They were organized into tribes; their government was led by a chieftain. In addition, there was a highly respected figure chosen by the people: the shaman. He was deeply connected to nature and the spiritual realm and possessed a superpower to predict events. Within a few days, the entire tribe would see that what the shaman had predicted came true. By the early 19th century, the nation-state had already taken shape; it possesses abundant natural resources, a vast ocean, and a diverse network of rivers, making it the second-richest country in this mineral. Furthermore, it is the world’s leading oil-producing nation. It is a major power in gold, bauxite, lithium, and various precious stones. This coexists with indigenous territory, which has its own political structure: a chieftain who was the highest authority, with the shaman prevailing, possessing a mind with superpowers. A century later, in that nation-state, a young woman named Celia—kind, charismatic, elegant, with eyes as light as honey and hair as black as jet, and a lawyer by profession—met a young man named Pablo, who was tall, elegant, had a thick mustache, and possessed an incomparable warmth. A political science graduate. They began a friendship that soon turned into love; six years later, they married and started a family. From their relationship, they had a beautiful son. Celia wasn’t particularly interested in politics, but her husband invited her to the political party of his choice. She accompanied him, and in that way, she became interested in politics. Five years later, his people nominated him as a presidential candidate, and he won the country’s election. He built and consolidated a government made up of members of his people, including a vice president named Delys; he also took the members of the tribes into account to improve their living conditions, giving indigenous leaders a role in his government to ensure effective governance. The shaman Bruno was a frequent visitor to the presidential residence. In another country on that continent, there was a president. A very evil man named Tomás wanted all the countries to be his property. His aim was to seize their renewable and non-renewable natural resources; if those countries did not obey willingly, he would make them do so by force. One day, the shaman arrived at the presidential residence; Pablo welcomed him warmly and looked him straight in the eye. Bruno said to him: “Be careful! I have a bad feeling about you.” Pablo asked him mischievously, “What’s on your mind, Bruno?” Bruno replied: “The time hasn’t come yet. Be patient.” Then they began to chat, while enjoying a delicious cup of coffee. When Pablo had been serving as his country’s president for three years, Mr. Tomás sent ambassadors from his country to establish trade relations with Palenzuela; both agreed to trade in oil and gold. From that moment on, during Pablo’s final year in office, the agreement was very amicable. The presidential term ended. Presidential elections were held again, and he returned to power. Two months later, greed took hold of President Tomás; every day he demanded more barrels of oil without paying for them. A week later, Bruno arrived at the presidential residence; addressing Pablo, he said: “I guarantee that economic sanctions will be imposed on our country.” With a smile on his face, Pablo replied: “I find that hard to believe.” Very confident, the shaman responded: “Well, believe it.” The next day, the country was subject to several economic sanctions. Two weeks later, Bruno went to the presidential residence; after greeting him, Pablo said: “I was amazed by the assertiveness of your words; I see you have a super-powerful mind.” Bruno replied: “That’s so you can see that everything I think becomes reality.” Three years later, Bruno stopped by the presidential residence, approached the president, and said: “Since last night, I’ve had a feeling that your presidential compound will be stormed late at night and that you and your wife will be kidnapped.” Pablo replied confidently: “To get to where I am, they’d have to get past several security checkpoints,” Bruno retorts sarcastically: “Don’t be so sure!” The next day, around 1 a.m., events unfolded at the presidential residence exactly as the shaman had predicted. Estaban organizados en tribus; su gobierno estaba dirigido por un jefe tribal. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQikQrm8keVEHX9Px6pFvMBoownd6TrvdHgMjdFMwc4tK/image.png) Además, había una figura muy respetada elegida por el pueblo: el chamán. Estaba profundamente conectado con la naturaleza y el reino espiritual y poseía un superpoder para predecir los acontecimientos. En pocos días, toda la tribu veía cómo se cumplía lo que el chamán había predicho. A principios del siglo XIX, el Estado-nación ya había tomado forma; cuenta con abundantes recursos naturales, un vasto océano y una variada red fluvial, lo que lo convierte en el segundo país más rico en este mineral. Además, es la principal nación productora de petróleo del mundo. Es una potencia importante en oro, bauxita, litio y diversas piedras preciosas. Esto coexiste con el territorio indígena, que tiene su propia estructura política: un jefe tribal que era la máxima autoridad, con el chamán como figura predominante, dotado de una mente con superpoderes. Un siglo más tarde, en ese Estado-nación, una joven llamada Celia —amable, carismática, elegante, con ojos tan claros como la miel y el pelo tan negro como el azabache, y abogada de profesión— conoció a un joven llamado Pablo, que era alto, elegante, tenía un bigote tupido y poseía una calidez incomparable. Licenciado en Ciencias Políticas. Comenzaron una amistad que pronto se convirtió en amor; seis años más tarde, se casaron y formaron una familia. De su relación nació un hermoso hijo. A Celia no le interesaba especialmente la política, pero su marido la invitó al partido político de su elección. Ella lo acompañó y, de esa manera, se interesó por la política. Cinco años después, su pueblo lo designó candidato a la presidencia y ganó las elecciones del país. Formó y consolidó un gobierno compuesto por miembros de su pueblo, entre ellos una vicepresidenta llamada Delys; además, tuvo en cuenta a los miembros de las tribus para mejorar sus condiciones de vida, otorgando a los líderes indígenas un papel en su gobierno con el fin de garantizar una gobernanza eficaz. El chamán Bruno era un visitante habitual de la residencia presidencial. En otro país de ese continente, había un presidente. Un hombre muy malvado llamado Tomás quería que todos los países fueran de su propiedad. Su objetivo era apoderarse de sus recursos naturales renovables y no renovables; si esos países no obedecían de buena gana, los obligaría a hacerlo por la fuerza. Un día, el chamán llegó a la residencia presidencial; Pablo le dio una cálida bienvenida y lo miró directamente a los ojos. Bruno le dijo: «¡Ten cuidado! Tengo un mal presentimiento sobre ti». Pablo le preguntó con picardía: «¿Qué te ronda por la cabeza, Bruno?». Bruno respondió: «Aún no ha llegado el momento. Ten paciencia». Entonces comenzaron a charlar, mientras disfrutaban de una deliciosa taza de café. Cuando Pablo llevaba tres años como presidente de su país, el señor Tomás envió embajadores de su país para establecer relaciones comerciales con Palenzuela; ambos acordaron comerciar con petróleo y oro. A partir de ese momento, durante el último año de mandato de Pablo, el acuerdo fue muy cordial. El mandato presidencial terminó. Se celebraron de nuevo elecciones presidenciales y él volvió al poder. Dos meses después, la codicia se apoderó del presidente Tomás; cada día exigía más barriles de petróleo sin pagarlos. Una semana más tarde, Bruno llegó a la residencia presidencial; dirigiéndose a Pablo, le dijo: «Te garantizo que se impondrán sanciones económicas a nuestro país». Con una sonrisa en el rostro, Pablo respondió: «Me cuesta creerlo». Muy seguro de sí mismo, el chamán respondió: «Pues créetelo». Al día siguiente, el país fue objeto de varias sanciones económicas. Dos semanas después, Bruno acudió a la residencia presidencial; tras saludarlo, Pablo dijo: «Me sorprendió la firmeza de tus palabras; veo que tienes una mente super poderosa». Bruno respondió: «Eso es para que puedas ver que todo lo que pienso se convierte en realidad». Tres años después, Bruno se pasó por la residencia presidencial, se acercó al presidente y le dijo: «Desde anoche tengo la sensación de que su complejo presidencial será asaltado a altas horas de la noche y de que usted y su esposa serán secuestrados». Pablo respondió con seguridad: «Para llegar hasta donde estoy, tendrían que superar varios controles de seguridad», replicó Bruno con sarcasmo: «¡No esté tan seguro!». Al día siguiente, alrededor de la 1 de la madrugada, los acontecimientos se desarrollaron en la residencia presidencial exactamente como había predicho el chamán.

links.title: Desafío a la indiferencia ante publicaciones en HIVE.(es/en)
links.body:
Nuestro amigo @emiliorios,  con su trabajo     https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nadie-esta-leyendo-mis-articulos-cuando-el-fracaso-obliga-a-revisarnos-como-evaluar-esen,    nos llevó a reflexionar sobre el decepcionante problema que estamos afrontando en @HIVE, ya que cada día disminuye el número de personas que realizan la lectura consciente y reflexiva de los post que se escriben y publican con tanta pasión.

También nuestro amigo, y valga la redundancia, porque es su nombre de usuario, @amigoponc; nos mostró su excelente trabajo   https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@amigoponc/esp-eng-no-me-votes   , en el cual reflexiona y profundiza en el tema al tocar una cuestión medular: la importancia de los comentarios.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNisXnkJVTveEv8oyq41W3YBLYZ2aMxGxnm485NcyUHag/1780968570309.jpg)

[Recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/m%C3%BAsico-callejero-ni%C3%B1o-pobreza-9826033/)
Agradecimiento a izafi.
En lo personal puedo decirles, y pienso que muchos también lo habrán experimentado, resulta DECEPCIONANTE cuando después de haber invertido un tiempo considerable en la producción de un post, los resultados son funestos, tanto por la disminuida cantidad de lecturas, la ausencia casi total de comentarios y el número de votos dista mucho de nuestras expectativas.

El grado de inconformidaud interior se incrementa si para nuestro trabajo hemos abordado un tema polémico, concebido con la esperanza de poder intercambiar opiniones, y fundamentalmente conocer qué piensan otros sobre las ideas expuestas, lo cual no quiere decir que todos deban estar de acuerdo. Opiniones adversas respetuosas, bien fundamentadas, resultan de gran utilidad y generan desarrollo. 

Recientemente hice una publicación sobre la IA, en cuyo título aparece la interrogante :¿Desarrollo o amenaza? Un tema que se presta para el debate, sin embargo solo recibí tres comentarios: uno del Proyecto Enlace, uno de la curadora, los cuales me reconfortan, por ser muy positivos y alentadores, pero son muy generales; y un excelente comentario de nuestro amigo @apineda. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWuNcuBnAKpjQHvPZNjaC3oi86q59LZEP4akFwxLmJoWk/1780968680140.png)

[Recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/nao-robot-m%C3%A1quina-robot-humanoide-6654027/)
Agradecimiento a Mentagi.
Hago esta reflexión con el propósito de que meditemos en la magnitud del problema que estamos afrontando en @hive, fundamentalmente en cuanto a la lectura y los comentarios. En este caso es de suponer que haya sido leído por los107 que  emitieron el voto, aunque el resultado total solo alcanzó la ínfima cifra de 0,553.

Esta situación me llevó una vez más a reflexionar sobre lo que no estoy haciendo bien. En lo personal estoy convencido de que me corresponde ser más exigente con lo que escribo, y sobre todo superarme en el empleo de las tecnologías,  como es el caso de editar en CANVA, pues por mucho que he tratado, no he logrado el éxito. 

Pero en fin, considero que la riqueza mayor a que podemos aspirar con nuestras publicaciones, radica en el intercambio, y este solo sepuede lograr mediante los comentarios.

Estos no siempre tienen que ser favorables, puede haber discrepancias, desacuerdos; siempre con mucho respeto y el debido tacto para no herir sensibilidades. Y este intercambio fructífero y amistoso, genera el crecimiento personal a que aspiramos. 

Como es de suponer, un gesto de cortesía y agradecimiento nos debe impulsar para responder cada comentario recibido, pues este paso patentiza el intercambio, además se solidifican las relaciones interpersonales aunque sea desde la distancia; ya que la práctica nos lo ha demostrado, y mediante ese intercambio se transmite calor humano, llegando a sentir familiaridad con quienes nos comentan con frecuencia.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTK8eF6gTEpnSiqkUrTeMNbrk1NBjXV6tnoWfakocKNY/1780968783087.png)

[Recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ganso-amabilidad-amigo-alegr%C3%ADa-1339261/)
Muchas gracias por haber leído,  quedaré muy agradecido con sus comentarios. 
Texto traducido al inglés por traductor de Google. 
Fotos tomadas de pixabay.com. 

ENGLISH VERSION. 

I challenge indifference towards HIVE posts. 
Our friend @emiliorios, with his work https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nadie-esta-leyendo-mis-articulos-cuando-el-fracaso-obliga-a-revisarnos-como-evaluar-esen, led us to reflect on the disappointing problem we're facing at @HIVE, as the number of people who consciously and thoughtfully read the posts written and published with such passion is decreasing every day.

Our friend, and it's worth repeating because that's his username, @amigoponc, also showed us his excellent work https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@amigoponc/esp-eng-no-me-votes, in which he reflects on and delves deeper into the topic by touching on a core issue: the importance of comments.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNisXnkJVTveEv8oyq41W3YBLYZ2aMxGxnm485NcyUHag/1780968618295.jpg)

[Resource](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/m%C3%BAsico-callejero-ni%C3%B1o-pobreza-9826033/) 
Thanks to izafi. 
Personally, I can tell you, and I think many others have experienced this too, it's DISAPPOINTING when, after investing considerable time in producing a post, the results are dismal, both due to the low number of reads, the almost total absence of comments, and the number of votes falling far short of our expectations.

The degree of internal dissatisfaction increases if our work involves a controversial topic, conceived with the hope of exchanging opinions and, fundamentally, understanding what others think about the ideas presented—which doesn't mean everyone has to agree. Respectful, well-founded opposing opinions are very useful and foster development.

I recently made a post about AI, whose title includes the question: Development or threat? A topic that lends itself to debate, however I only received three comments: one from Proyecto Enlace, one from the curator, which are comforting, as they are very positive and encouraging, but very general; and an excellent comment from our friend @apineda.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWuNcuBnAKpjQHvPZNjaC3oi86q59LZEP4akFwxLmJoWk/1780968728583.png)
[Resource](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/nao-robot-m%C3%A1quina-robot-humanoide-6654027/) 
Thanks to Mentagi. 
I'm sharing this reflection so we can consider the magnitude of the problem we're facing on @hive, especially regarding readership and comments. In this case, it's safe to assume it was read by the 107 people who voted, even though the total only reached the minuscule figure of 0.553.

This situation led me once again to reflect on what I'm not doing right. Personally, I'm convinced that I need to be more demanding of myself in my writing, and above all, improve my use of technology, such as editing in Canva, because no matter how hard I've tried, I haven't been successful.

But in short, I believe that the greatest wealth we can aspire to with our publications lies in the exchange, and this can only be achieved through comments.

These exchanges don't always have to be positive; there may be discrepancies and disagreements. However, these should always be conducted with respect and tact to avoid hurting feelings. This fruitful and friendly exchange fosters the personal growth we aspire to.

As you might expect, a gesture of courtesy and gratitude should encourage us to respond to every comment received, as this step demonstrates the exchange and strengthens interpersonal relationships, even from a distance; as practice has shown us, and through this exchange, human warmth is transmitted, leading to a feeling of familiarity with those who frequently comment on our posts.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTK8eF6gTEpnSiqkUrTeMNbrk1NBjXV6tnoWfakocKNY/1780968911931.png)

[Resource](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ganso-amabilidad-amigo-alegr%C3%ADa-1339261/) 
Thank you so much for reading, I would be very grateful for your comments.

links.title: Visiting a Neoclassical heritage site in Venezuela. | Visita a un lugar de interés patrimonial neoclásico en Venezuela.
links.body:
> **Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos viajeros de todas partes del mundo hoy les mostraré un gran lugar de historia de mi ciudad.** **A warm greeting to all my dear travelling friends from all over the world. Today I’m going to show you a place in my city that’s steeped in history.** Viajeros justamente en la medida principal las delicias en Maracaibo muy cerca del casco histórico de la ciudad, podemos encontrar un museo a cielo abierto donde las almas descansan y muchos fotógrafos, turistas e historiadores, visitan para hacer turismo oscuro o funerario, como también para tener las mejores tomas artísticas de todo el arte que hay en su interior, hace más de 170 años, este lugar esconde en su interior, la vida apagada de tantos guerreros, artistas, proceres, piratas, entre otros grandes son las historias que se encuentran en el puesto que también es un patrimonio histórico de nuestra ciudad y país, albergando, así grandes tesoros de arquitectura, cultura, historia y misticismo, justamente inaugurado el 12 de Noviembre 1879, siendo un patrimonio cultural e histórico del estado Zulia. >Travellers seeking the main attractions of Maracaibo, very close to the city’s historic centre, will find an open-air museum where souls rest; many photographers, tourists and historians visit for ‘dark’ or ‘funerary’ tourism, as well as to capture the finest artistic shots of all the art within. For over 170 years, this place has concealed within it the faded lives of so many warriors, artists, heroes and pirates, amongst others. These are the great stories found in this site, which is also a historical heritage site of our city and country, thus housing great treasures of architecture, culture, history and mysticism. It was inaugurated on 12 November 1879 and is a cultural and historical heritage site of the state of Zulia. ![Collage de fotos horizontal de viajes y aventuras color gris_20260608_211311_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhFD53nE2n6ZjjBctbmM8ZgMpGfSdFsF1remNHM888BZ/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20de%20viajes%20y%20aventuras%20color%20gris_20260608_211311_0000.png) Para producirse es el panteón más antiguo de la ciudad, el primer lugar donde se enterraban, a cualquier persona de diversas religiones ya sean católicos, protestantes judíos, entre otros estaba conformado por 3 panteones, el inglés, el de Santa Lucía y el panteón colonial, es un lugar de ensueño para las personas amante de la historia y de la cultura ya que estas 2 se entrelanzan en cada rincón a pesar de ser un tesoro netamente privado conserva una esencia romántica con cierta fascinación, descansando en lo más interno de sus entrañas personajes históricos que contribuyeron de gran manera a la historia de nuestra localidad. >It is the oldest cemetery in the city, the first place where people of various religions including Catholics, Protestants and Jews, amongst others were buried. It consisted of three cemeteries: the English Cemetery, the Santa Lucía Cemetery and the Colonial Cemetery. It is a dream destination for lovers of history and culture, as these two elements are intertwined in every corner. Despite being a strictly private treasure, it retains a romantic essence with a certain allure, with historical figures who contributed greatly to the history of our town resting deep within its heart. En mi visita, me llamó la el gran interés y siento que es parte del protagonismo principal del lugar, su arquitectura, el diseño arquitectónico en su gran totalidad tiende a ser creado, por Hermes Romero, cierta estructura del lugar en su cuadrado perfecto, ha ido modificando a una especie de trapezoide, teniendo así hacer una obra de arte por completo ahora bien cuando se comenzó a construir el material era traído de afuera más que todo era mármol italiano de alta calidad de estilos neoclásico, art nouveav, gótico, naco, y contemporáneo, lo que más llama la atención es lo gran imponente y elegante de cada uno de las estatuas que se encuentran en el lugar realmente son increíbles, hechas de las más altas calidad en la que su gran mayoría son elaboradas de mármol italiano totalmente importado, han sido vandalizadas con el tiempo pero la gran mayoría aún se conservan. >During my visit, I was struck by the great interest it aroused, and I feel that it is one of the main attractions of the place; its architecture; the architectural design as a whole tends to be the work of Hermes Romero. A certain structure of the site, originally a perfect square, has been modified into a sort of trapezium, thus creating a complete work of art. Now, when construction began, the materials were brought in from outside; mostly high-quality Italian marble in neoclassical, Art Nouveau, Gothic, Naco, and contemporary styles. What catches the eye most is the sheer grandeur and elegance of each of the statues found on the site; they are truly incredible, crafted to the highest standards, the vast majority of which are made from entirely imported Italian marble. Hoy arranqué la semana súper activa y directo a atender al pequeño Mandarino!! Sí,le pusimos ese nombre por ahora jeje 🤭 De verdad que él es un amor y se porta súper bien; durmió corrido toda la noche y se levantó tempranito pidiendo su comidita.
Antes de darle el desayuno, me tocó bañarlo, secarlo bien y dejarle su espacio impecable. Como no le funcionan sus patitas traseras, no controla sus esfínteres y se hace encima, así que requiere de cuidados súper especiales. He estado todo el día pegada con él, limpiándolo y cambiándolo a cada rato... Literalmente como un bebé! 🫶🏻 Pero vale totalmente la pena cuidarlo con tanto amor, Mandarino es muy agradecido, me ronronea cuando lo estoy limpiando 🥰

links.title: The Eye
links.body: <center>\n\n***The young woman's eye peeks out from behind a seashell. Half of her face seems broken, divided between two worlds. Her gaze questions us with a disquieting silence. \

she asks herself. We wonder the same thing, but the answer eludes us, like a secret the sea holds in its depths.***

El ojo de la joven asoma detrás de una concha marina. La mitad de su rostro parece quebrada, dividida entre dos mundos. Su mirada nos interroga con un silencio inquietante. “¿Qué está pasando?”, se pregunta a sí misma. Nosotros también lo pensamos, pero la respuesta se nos escapa, como un secreto que el mar guarda en sus profundidades.

![1 00002-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23tkkCYSYLoGNR3NTVgtkKzJzG8g4bDuZeGMfHufwGtrbbuWdFL47Ghne89kjfKdjDVtz.jpg)

***This series of strange photographs originated from a single shot. The image is peculiar: the model is standing behind a small pane of glass covered with cling film, and a seashell is stuck to its surface. The result is unsettling, almost surreal. A strange shot, isn't it?***

Esta serie de fotografías tan extrañas nació a partir de una toma directa. La imagen es peculiar: la modelo se encuentra detrás de un pequeño vidrio cubierto con un film de cocina, y sobre él descansa una concha marina adherida a su superficie. El resultado es inquietante, casi surreal. Una toma extraña, ¿verdad?

![2 00002-bis.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23tGTUawwHep88p89Szm4PUL1596G9BUsJiHRHKD4vHBP24Sqn72vHFYumSaRs9Jb2Tg1.jpg)

***Then came the editing, done with several layers superimposed, one on top of the other.*** Luego vino la edición, realizada con varias capas superpuestas, una sobre otra.

![3 02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23tbLvbDpD1fGeTf4WWcyw6LiLJPSGPs2Q6R2J5GiJrZ1LzwhZXrXiBAvjJydsfCW3H7V.jpg)

***And finally, here are some details of the final edited photo.*** Y para terminar vemos aquí algunos detalles de la foto final editada.

![4 00002-detalle-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23uFHAuTtrrFpF25XhGC9SdiHJuqj1A6CyDs7Ay5Dynh1TDs9RPVRL1Kg5QoS8AMMSd4D.jpg)

![5 00002-detalle-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23w2D1tWSS5vH6iL1Skcue9NSn4a4y572CMVmQUADVA7K6Sq7YhBRMn7jZsd83jwEuDix.jpg)

![6 00002-detalle-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23uQJER2ib2VknyC5srk54TkyfN5GF9EypaAq3nkVCaY3xamH9ZScP2ZCGKJA47bT1MCC.jpg)

links.title: Primer día de trabajo - (esp/eng)
links.body: > El día de hoy fue diferente a los demás días, diferente desde hace años ya, pues después de mucho tiempo, empecé a trabajar. Debido a que tengo un problema con mi rodilla se me dificulta mucho conseguir trabajo y mas aun en la situación económica del pais, por lo que he estado sin oficio hace mucho tiempo, esto hizo que me dedique a beber y salir cuando me invitaban ya que al no tener nada que hacer a todo decía que si. Mi día empezó muy temprano, exactamente a las 5:30, el lugar donde laboro esta a una hora y media de donde vivo por lo que fue un largo viaje para llegar y no conocía mucho el sector por lo que me perdí un poco. Tengo un largo viaje por carretera antes de llegar.

> Today was different from all the other days, unlike anything I've done in years, because after a long time, I finally started working. Because I have a problem with my knee, it's very difficult for me to find work, especially given the country's economic situation. I've been unemployed for a long time, which led me to spend my time drinking and going out whenever I was invited, since I had nothing to do and I always said yes to everything. My day started very early, at 5:30 a.m. exactly. The place where I work is an hour and a half from where I live, so it was a long commute, and I didn't know the area very well, so I got a little lost. I have a long drive ahead of me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEWKc4XnZF28uUsN7H1caje2yRs74Xgw25QuwpmPFfbo/df7c6136_7153_4882_b8dd_fc50c94e946d.jpg)
> El lugar era una zona alejada de la ciudad, un sector industrial pero finalmente llegue, todo era dentro de esta puerta y mi día comenzó.

> The place was an area far from the city, an industrial sector, but I finally arrived, everything was inside this door and my day began. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf313ghfMQQE8oqyyFckTvdeDfYgHVWbB5VVxhoRcDHNa/5f2199ee_ce76_4f77_83a2_b3d14a0df095.jpg)

> Estuve ayudando con un poco de archivos y recolección de datos en lo que me instalaban mi computadora, eso fue casi toda la mañana pero ya en la tarde pude ayudar desde la computadora buscando unos documentos que me pedían para una auditoria. Me dieron un almuerzo algo malo la verdad pero el ambiente laboral me gustó, una vez dieron las 5 pm salí del lugar e hice mi gran viaje de regreso a la ciudad, llegue algo cansado pero me alegro ver a mis gatos esperándome, le deje las llaves de mi casa a mi mami para que alimente a mis niños y de paso ella arreglo mi casa, la amo, fue un lindo retorno.

> I helped out with some filing and data collection while they were setting up my computer. That took up almost the entire morning, but in the afternoon I was able to help from the computer by looking for some documents they needed for an audit. They gave me a rather poor lunch, to be honest, but I liked the work environment. Once it was 5 pm, I left and made my long trip back to the city. I arrived a little tired, but I was happy to see my cats waiting for me. I left the keys to my house with my mom so she could feed my kids, and she also cleaned up my house. I love her; it was a lovely homecoming. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZS1KF9efUFEKRMKRthm8Am9tZ3KW8DiZ5p1aaRAseEt1/image.png)

> Una vez en casa ahora estoy descansando y a pesar de sentirme muy cansado, estoy feliz y es lo que les quiero transmitir hoy, lo necesitaba, sentirme útil de nuevo, espero que las cosas vayan a mejor de aquí en adelante, y como estuvo tu inicio de semana?

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 8 2026
links.body:
> Happy Monday, athletes and advocates of a healthy lifestyle! We’re staying active with this DApp, ACTIFIT, for our physical and mental well-being.
![1001750065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EqFuunRnphEzoijMH4ub6DUiDMB4P9AzXez2oKCjfn2zNnGkxqJ4eshErGfUDwxB4aJ.jpg)

> Today I’ve been feeling a bit down because of everyday things and the ups and downs that come up; my mind is racing. I know I have to do something about this, because this isn’t like me—I’m usually a cheerful and active person. So what better therapy than to go for a brisk, long walk? In the late afternoon, as night was falling, I dressed comfortably and headed out.
![1001750053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/244KJfxgJibLRJsHEsNdfKWaDVLPJj4aHZRtfCgo2P8KryiNE9HWDzFJsnTEaoxKfkWJr.jpg) ![1001750058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/242DGWG6zMPM7d6pew56k1UdFAD1aPHtkKYWdVpzBAyPEugoyJaU9yei9BzgHESiaQnpt.jpg)
I felt energized after having a cup of coffee, and I went out into the cool weather. My thoughts vanished as if by magic, and I focused on my body; my steps were quick. I never imagined the solution to changing my mood would come so quickly. The walk paused for a moment; I realized it when I went into a supermarket to buy some snacks.
![1001750061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/244KLpndPfmj7yugcsknewK3P8dETfd4T11KLf9rRbk2Z3NpcKTZHU2HEjPjSvqDFSoTG.jpg)

> Then I came home to write, and my spirits returned. Honestly, this is the best therapy—doing the exercise you enjoy most. I love my long walks. It’s worth noting that the photos I’m sharing are from another walk through the city center along the Manzanares River.

> >! [spanish,Here]> Feliz Lunes, deportistas y dueños del estilo de vida saludable, donde nos mantenemos en movimiento con este DApp, ACTIFIT, para nuestro bienestar físico y mental. Hoy me he sentido algo desanimada por las cosas cotidianas y eventualidades que se presentan, mis pensamientos a miles, para esto se que tengo que actuar, porque esto no es normal en mi, puesto que soy una chica que siempre esta alegre y activa, para ello que mejor terapia que caminar rapidamente largos kilometros. A media tarde ya al caer la noche, me vesti comodamente y me fui, estaba enérgica luego de tomar un café y sali con este clima fresco, mis pensamientos como por arte de magia desaparecieron y me enfoque en mi cuerpo mis pasos estaban rapidos, no imagine que fuera tan veloz la solución a cambiar mi temperamento. El dapp se detuvo un momento, me di cuenta cuando entre en un supermercado a comprar unos snacks, luego me vine a casa, a escribir y el ánimo volvio, la verdad que esta es la mejor terapia y es hacer el ejercico que más te guste, yo amo mis caminatas kilométricas. Cabe destacar que las imagenes que muestro fue de otra caminata por el centro de la ciudad junto al rio Manzanares .Espero que el mes de Junio me traiga más alegrías que quejas. Hasta aquí, mis amigos aventureros de Actifit. >_**Photos of my property taken from the Redmi Note 12/// Text translated by DeepL**_

_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@wendyth16/actifit-wendyth16-20260609t013144385z)_

সুবাহানাতালার অশেষ রহমতে আমিও ভাল আছি এবং সুস্থ আছি আজ আমি আপনাদের মাঝে শেয়ার করব দারুন একটি জঙ্গলে ফুলের ফটোগ্রাফি। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNjByYM7F7vFetjj9FR1P54Bi6qPLWxNLiV2tBDWCFkey/1780968249828.jpg)| |-| আমি আগে কখনো কল্পনা করতে পারি নাই যে জঙ্গলের ভিতরে এত সুন্দর ফুল ফুটবে আজ সকালে ঘুম থেকে উঠে যখন একটি পাহাড়ের গোল দিয়ে যাচ্ছিলাম তখন দেখতে পেলাম দুইটি বেগুন রঙের ফুল খুব সুন্দর ভাবে ফুটে রয়েছে আশেপাশের আর কোন ফুল আমি দেখতে পাই নাই সবুজ ঘাসের ভিতরে এর ফুলগুলো অসম্ভব সুন্দর লাগছিল। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7yhYBPE17GJ9JVUKkjpniAtXtGjbKndu4NvEprsqhZ9/1780968274381.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKuhteHxLT3pKJS8iWYhkmzTyM2Yggx4Z27Nz8pUr75V/1780968274435.jpg) বেগুনি রঙের এই ফুলগুলো দেখতে অনেক সুন্দর লাগছিল বিশেষ করে অন্যান্য ফুলের তুলনায় এই ফুলগুলো একটু ভিন্ন রকম এটা দেখতে ছোট ঘন্টার মত অথবা মাইকের মত ফুলের সামনের অংশ অনেক প্রশস্ত এবং পিছনের অংশটা সরল লম্বাটে। এই গাছগুলো অনেকটা লতার মত দেখতে হয় মাটি থেকে খুব বেশি উচ্চ হয় না জঙ্গলে ফুল বলে সবাই অবহেলা করে। তবে এদিকে সুন্দর একটি আকৃতি রয়েছে এবং ফুলের সৌন্দর্য রয়েছে সেটা হয়তোবা মানুষ কাছ থেকে না দেখলে বুঝতে পারবেনা। আমি এই ফটোগ্রাফি গুলো খুব কাছ থেকেই করেছি যার কারণে আরো সুন্দর হয়েছে সকালের রোদের আদ্রতা খুব বেশি ছিল না তাই আমার ফোনের লাইটিং বাড়িয়ে ছবিগুলো সুন্দর করার চেষ্টা করেছি ছবি তোলার সময় বিভিন্ন অ্যাঙ্গেল থেকে ছবি তুলে দেখছিলাম যে কোন সাইট থেকে ছবি সুন্দর হয়। যাই হোক আমার দেখা জঙ্গলেফোটা অসম্ভব সুন্দর ফুল আপনাদের মাঝে শেয়ার করতে পেরেছি এর ফুলগুলো আপনাদের কাছে কেমন লাগছে অবশ্যই কমেন্টের মাধ্যমে জানাবেন। আজকের মত আমি এখানে বিদায় নিচ্ছি সবাই ভালো থাকুন সুস্থ থাকবেন এই প্রত্যাশাই করি আল্লাহ সবার মঙ্গল করুন।

links.title: An impressive historical replica: the Antonio José de Sucre House Museum [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
> Greetings, dear friends of Worldmappin, and welcome to my blog. Today I’d like to share another wonderful experience with you: a very special visit to the Grand Marshal of Ayacucho House Museum. This building is located on a hill along the same route leading to San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle, on La Luneta Street. Sometimes, I would pass by and look at the imposing structure guarded by guards who even told me there was no entry, so it was a long time before I got to visit this magnificent historic site. This house museum recreates a space very similar to what the birthplace of the Grand Marshal of Ayacucho was like and was inaugurated on December 30, 2024.<div>

<hr>

<div class=\

>Its design features a very distinctive architectural style that blends traditional colonial elements with modern techniques. This elevated structure remains true to the traditional style of grand aristocratic mansions, with large windows and a central courtyard surrounded by a two-story building topped with a gabled roof. On the day of my visit, some time after discovering it, I followed the staff’s instructions to the letter and took a long walk to reach the house and take the tour. If I had entered through the front, I would have only had to climb the steps; however, the other path was longer, and I had to walk quite a distance. Despite that, the walk was pleasant; from there, one of the highest points in the city, you can take in the best panoramic views of Cumaná and enjoy the xerophytic vegetation that accompanies the entire wonderful route.
![1780869176262.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXskQYS4opkMWWFwAdTKKU31bLJgHTGCgqixbtF9B4yCe/1780869176262.jpg)
![1780869176256.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma8siJFCgZssHKNKQhoAyU8yMzxAparyi6gHKqVWg74S9/1780869176256.jpg)
![1772466312309.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZi5W7y45SusQU7wBtTWfTqYLBPkqjJfC4bwdJwPEV5W5/1772466312309.jpg)
![1772466311694.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUcY6JQm6HQBq5qZxYVFRxB6H7vVcZV4p7yFS4bQL6MDM/1772466311694.jpg)
![1772466312089.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby3iBoWpJBr3goFCbCwfvnekJwiQHMQxxn6dJsxGZz8D/1772466312089.jpg)
![1772466312156.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEv4zjkCYTM8eRaTQSpY9tfnbTMUagQXGiJCe6eApHCu/1772466312156.jpg)
![1772466312231.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZFR9yYLUC8tZy7JTgCxvxAouBFwY1V6Nb4qcBNQpgBAo/1772466312231.jpg)
![1772466311999.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvYReJCMHVfsS5JPZHVd1sFoyVokjCn5yhQpTCXWUo5L/1772466311999.jpg)
![1772466311840.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFycBBYSxJMJkpY3Rnp3qmRxKm1RFd5myjzTzAA2J4Fj/1772466311840.jpg)

>When I arrived, the first thing I did was take photos of the garden and the building. Then, a young woman welcomed me and invited me to the reception desk to sign the guestbook, and that’s where the adventure began—I was really excited, by the way. Once inside the monument, the person assigned to be my guide explained the rules: no leaning against the walls, only flash-free photos allowed, no touching objects inside the house, and no food or drinks during the tour. The first space we visited was the royal chapel, dedicated to Our Lady of Mount Carmel, patron saint of the Sucre and Alcalá families. Among the notable figures, we can see the Virgin of the Rosary, the Divine Child, Saint Francis of Assisi, and Saint Agnes. This place was sacred to Antonio José de Sucre, who lost his mother at the age of 7. Here, he sought closeness to the religious realm and also to his mother, who spent a great deal of time in the chapel. The chapel is decorated in blue and white, as these colors symbolize closeness to heaven.

>Next, we move on to the ballroom, a space that was a social necessity depending on one’s class; those who did not have one were not well-regarded in society. This room was designed for music and dance, and its decor was inspired by an artistic style known as “Rococo,” featuring walls in pastel shades and other elements in golden tones. As a curious fact, there was no electricity at that time; the social expectation was that these mansions be equipped with many mirrors and large glass windows so that the light from the candelabras holding the candles would reflect off them. This ballroom, in addition to music, was used by the lady of the house to teach catechism classes.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUJmSWtiWY2CMhA1F15N33y8zLLtGuS26TxzsoFoE8RB6/image.png)
![1772466311911.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcLJqRK5gU4S4TzPhhs7QAAYAXNzdv4joQi8FHqoX953A/1772466311911.jpg)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaK9q8FwpXSTfzKJc6Hy3rqddYacALjcgu3afhBgyma5G/image.png)
![1777663236720.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPNMmA121YJMfFH1vpUbFxVFa8NpPF8UKPDCFXKE8NAc/1777663236720.jpg)
![1777663236780.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4EMP5eUmC4VT88Zus1cw5ksfmDcUY2gXTg4xVnLLxmS/1777663236780.jpg) Royal Chapel

>Another unique feature of this replica of the home of the Grand Marshal of Ayacucho is the Armory. At the time, only those with military connections had the privilege of having a place to store weapons. In his office, Colonel Vicente de Sucre kept his weapons—both long-barreled and short-barreled—securely stored. Next to the armory is the treasure chest, which served as a safe where important documents were kept, and only the father of the Cumaná hero possessed the key. The office was a place of great importance, where the colonel handled matters concerning his family and the city.

>Next to this highly militarized and historically significant site lies the “Grand Hall,” a beautiful space used for social gatherings and tea parties. Ladies and gentlemen were seated within the same room but in separate areas. Armchairs were the most suitable seating for the ladies, both for sitting down and for standing up while wearing their voluminous dresses. Next, we move to the central corridor, which features a small garden and a glass-covered foundation serving as an exhibition space. Although this historic site is a replica of the house where Antonio José de Sucre was born, the foundation contains artifacts discovered during a soil survey, indicating that the Sucre family’s home was indeed built on this site. Many festivals were celebrated in this central courtyard, including the Cruz de Mayo. The most famous dances of that era were “El Fandango” and “El Fandanguillo,” now known as flamenco.

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmaWrP6JTBqNjQ6Q1KqZvz8f1o7C7HnoX1RRr6tfE4cwuh/1777663236735.jpg
![1777663236628.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXuvop3wgETpiQXLGuTBL4SJCdts3EP9VBUPN5KjtEbi/1777663236628.jpg) Office of Colonel Vicente de Sucre
![1777663236613.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRem8k1Fwd7TUCZUnK3AfuRTTdsCnHX6uL8uHKTkuUono/1777663236613.jpg) The Grand Hall, a ladies' lounge
![1777663236582.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPhs9BStM782S5snC3HVCc1s8dBeu65Hux6BxZVNqR9o1/1777663236582.jpg) The Great Hall, Gentlemen's Room

>The next room is the dining room, which was the perfect setting for family gatherings, where they could enjoy meals and conversations about values and principles that were instilled not only in Antonio José de Sucre but also in his siblings. As a point of interest, this room featured very striking and eye-catching decorative elements, such as paintings, shelves, and rugs. The rugs played an important role in protecting the porcelain tableware and glassware from falls; if they suffered minor fractures, they were later restored with gold for display purposes. The tapestries of this era were not painted; rather, they employed the Gobelin technique, which involves recreating scenes in ornamental fabric—a form of artisanal craftsmanship—using threads of multiple colors. The dining table was an extendable type, with a section that could be pulled out to accommodate the number of guests. None of the seats at the table could be occupied by anyone outside the immediate family.

>Adjacent to the dining room is the kitchen. At that time, since water was not supplied through a plumbing system, it was brought in barrels from the Manzanares River. Dishes were washed on a table equipped with several openings, through which the wastewater flowed into a drain and was carried away to another location. In this area, you can see a rustic console table and handcrafted wooden utensils, including paddles, ladles, an antique griddle, and a metal grain mill.
![1777663236439.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeKrDP3fP9b1y2QrSN9bHr5aehcAoyQyxDg6ZTEVTra6/1777663236439.jpg) Dining area
![1777663236424.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzUVziHvWfwk3u7HmPfg6svAS8eqhrAN5wu1V2BKKfTK/1777663236424.jpg)
![1777663236408.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdiNq56zyGL77sJcWW5Mum62isCFwe2Lft17RWz5xHkUE/1777663236408.jpg) Decorative painting in the Gobelin style
![1777663236185.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajcNMidJqVyE6vPYrauC2RDtLDGdreKU1tc1WgJXxjiP/1777663236185.jpg) Decorative painting in the Gobelin style
![1777663236378.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRvrdpK53AGoNa1p3Nbqs2vBVcs8oup4HsJBjYTpitxdF/1777663236378.jpg) Kitchen area

>To conclude our tour of the house’s ground floor, we move on to the courtyards. Given the Sucre family’s status, the house had several of these, including stables. The courtyards were divided into sections designated for growing ornamental, medicinal, and fruit plants for the family’s own consumption.
![1777663236316.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXViDNKaCjbQQwV4Nh4GU8SRdV8qZegY4oFycgpiKoh8i/1777663236316.jpg) Stable
![1777663236301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeZXMEfUBkwwYer2aRjuUEabM2LLZchFrcpk6YCuHYLKg/1777663236301.jpg)
![1777663236246.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVTjUwjZAg3cVMKSJRWuTkJjLxHHJvgzTXbDqBgRuVq6B/1777663236246.jpg)
![1777663235935.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQAdYQnhgZ45H8F64rdNusj8pXgUVvccQ9gva2XqBGCoD/1777663235935.jpg)

>Next, we went to the second floor of the house, where the bedrooms, the sewing room, the movie theater, and the interactive room are located. I visited the bedroom of the Marquise, María Manuela de Alcalá y Sánchez—a lavish room that stands out as the largest and most opulent, meeting the architectural requirements of the era by being situated at the highest point of the house to maximize natural light and ventilation. The reason for this requirement was that children had to be born inside their mothers’ bedrooms. Births were not permitted to take place outside the bedrooms; these were equipped with the necessary tools for the occasion, such as basins, which were later removed by the servants. Manuela gave birth to her nine children in her bedroom.

>For his part, Colonel Vicente de Sucre y Urbaneja stayed in a different room from the Marquise’s. Interestingly, they did not share the same space, and although the rooms were adjacent, their privacy was ensured by a wooden door separating the two rooms. Unlike María Manuela’s room, the floor was entirely carpeted. Next, we move on to the children’s rooms, which feature some characteristics typical of the era. The girls’ room was blue because it symbolizes purity and resembles the sky, while the boys’ room was pink, as it bears a greater resemblance to the blood shed by men fighting in wars and battles. This color scheme changed over time.

>The next room is the interactive gallery, which consists of several sections. The first displays period costumes worn by the Sucre family, armor, accessories, wigs, and complex garments such as crinolines and corsets, all of which can be viewed in detail on a digital screen set up in the room for visitors. The second space is dedicated to scents with a history. On the table, several capsules have been placed that simulate the scent of the house’s wood, the perfumes brought from Paris for the Marquise, and the incense that perfumed the atmosphere of the Royal Chapel, known as “Echoes of Faith.” A family secret: the cultivation of a herb, rue, with medicinal uses to soothe pain and irritability.

>The third space features a display case showcasing artifacts and objects found during the archaeological excavation that suggest the house may have once stood on this site. Finally, there is the movie theater; in the home of the illustrious Cumaní national hero’s parents, this served as a room for informal gatherings. Currently, it operates as the “Teresita de Sucre” movie theater, with the purpose of showcasing the life, struggles, and work of the Grand Marshal of Ayacucho.

>Saludos estimados amigos de Worldmappin, bienvenidos a mi blog. Hoy les comparto otra maravillosa experiencia, una visita muy especial, la casa Museo del Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho. Esta edificación se encuentra ubicada en una colina, la misma ruta hacia el castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia, en la calle La Luneta. A veces, pasaba por allí y miraba la imponente estructura custodiada por guardias que llegaron a decirme que no había entrada, así que pasó mucho tiempo antes de conocer este grandioso recinto histórico. Esta casa museo, recrea un espacio muy semejante a lo que fue la casa natal del Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho y fue inaugurada el 30 de diciembre del año 2024.<div>

<hr>
