title.title: Random Tunes on a Breezy Tuesday
title.body:
<center><center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/744463/pexels-photo-744463.jpeg</center></center>
<sbr>

<div class ='text-justify'>

A breezy Tuesday morning in DD. The cool season is finally upon us, which means jackets and bonnets out (for me, that is, since I easily shiver in the cold). Good times, still!

Anyway, we will be driving out of town soon, but first, let me share three nice tunes that I enjoyed recently.

Recognized as the pioneer of the \

genre, Skusta Clee released a new single this year, featuring his former Ex-Battalion member, Flow G. ### Skusta Clee ft Flow G - Since Day 1 ft Flow G
https://youtu.be/T8DLCWW6EpY?list=RDT8DLCWW6EpY
A Pinoy Hip-Hop that blends smooth contemporary R&B elements. The song is quite groovy and a bit nostalgic, enhanced by a steady, rhythmic trap drum pattern that invites head-nodding or foot-tapping (which I did, joyfully)😁 The next is one (accidentally* discovered yesterday. It appeared on my YT feed, and curiosity got me to click play. The contemporary country blending pop elements *feels* fresh to the ears. ### Morgan Wallen ft Tate McRae- What I Want
https://youtu.be/hNrwlzBeFN8?list=PLDIoUOhQQPlWc-Kd6TCjTRIl0Z6fSQV0X
I haven't encountered Morgan before, and I learned from a quick search that he was a contestant on The Voice in 2014. Accordingly, he has broken nearly every streaming record in the Country music genre since he released his first album in 2018, with his songs topping charts for weeks. This song is Wallen's first-ever official duet with a female artist. It is commercially successful, debuting at No. 1 on the US Billboard Hot 100.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/What_I_Want_(Morgan_Wallen_song)). I like that the artists' voices harmonized with each other, not one overpowering the other. Both delivered their verses true to their own signature genres. And the third tune for the day:
https://youtu.be/RSNmgE6L8AU?list=RDRSNmgE6L8AU
Aha! A poignant, indie-rock ballad with the artist's soaring vocals, plus the expressive, looping piano melodies. It gives that intimate, nostalgic, and vulnerable feeling
--- ---

> This trio of photos, taken a couple of days ago outside the church where I usually attend Mass on Sundays, captures what has been the norm over the past few weeks: cloudy days with constant rain and drizzle, mainly at night and in the early morning. Since the rainy season in Venezuela lasts until late October or early November, it’s very likely that in my upcoming entries for this weekly contest, the reflections in the puddles I come across will be the main focus of my photos. As I have described in previous posts, I process the original photographs using the editing tools offered in their free versions by the applications Picsart and Snapseed. #

Como la temporada de lluvias en Venezuela se extiende hasta finales de Octubre o principios de Noviembre, es muy probable que en mis próximas participaciones en este concurso semanal, los reflejos en los charcos de agua que encuentre a mi paso, sean los grandes protagonistas de mis imágenes. title.title: The Dead Woman´s  Ring (En/ Es)
title.body:
> Damian hadn't been working at the old cemetery in his town for very long; he didn't much care for the job, but it was all he had. After losing his job and with his wife pregnant, he couldn’t afford to be out of work, with many bills to pay and pending expenses to face; so after the old gravedigger died and with only one other gravedigger who was also quite elderly, they needed fresh blood for this grueling work of preparing the future resting places of the deceased. One day, another cemetery opened, and many relatives decided to “move” their deceased to this new place. To do so, the closest relatives would go to the authorities with a list detailing the belongings that had been buried alongside their family members, since some of the deceased had been buried according to last century’s customs—with jewelry, coins, dolls; in short, you could find just about anything in those graves. Damián had already witnessed these exhumations; it was part of his job. Around that time, a family whose great-great-grandmother was buried in the old cemetery decided to exhume her to transfer her remains to the new cemetery, where they had purchased a new plot for their relatives. That day, a great-great-grandson of the deceased arrived with his inventory, which, according to how the woman had been buried, listed a gold bracelet and some earrings, an old pearl rosary, and nothing else; everything was there alongside the old woman’s remains. These items were handed over to him, and the remains were transferred, as was proper, to their new resting place. The old coffin, damp with moisture, was left there in the sun for Damian to dispose of it in the designated area; so Damian left it in the sun to avoid having to handle so much moisture, even though he had all the necessary gear to do so; he wanted to be on the safe side and left it there until the next day. When he arrived the next morning to dispose of the coffin, as he was handling it, a thin gold ring with a small red stone in the center fell to the ground, shining brightly in the sun. He picked up the ring and recalled the list from his relative, and as far as he could remember, there was no mention of this ring. And although he hesitated a little, he decided to take it, have it cleaned, and give it to his wife as a gift. That night, Damian arrived with that lovely gift for his wife and simply told her he’d bought it from a drunkard; since he thought it was pretty and, besides, it was gold, he thought it was the perfect gift for her; his wife was overjoyed. But that very night, Damian began dreaming of a woman dressed in clothes from the last century who demanded that he return her ring, and so it went for the following nights, with her growing increasingly angry with him... At first, Damian thought it was because he’d been psychologically affected by taking that item from that grave, so he tried to play it off as nothing, until one day a muffled scream from his wife woke him in the middle of the night, with her crying out and telling him that an old woman was yelling at her: “Give me what’s mine!” with great fury; but the poor woman didn’t understand the reason for that horrible nightmare. Damian convinced her that it had only been a bad dream, but deep down he knew it was that furious deceased woman demanding what was hers; he didn’t know what to do. Until he decided, ashamed, to tell the truth to his colleague, the old gravedigger, and the man told him that he had broken one of the gravediggers’ cardinal rules: never to take any belongings from the deceased, because many of them came to reclaim them—and not in a friendly manner. so he told him he must locate the deceased woman’s new resting place, take her ring there, ask her forgiveness for his mistake, and beg her to grant it. So Damián located the grave of the deceased in the new cemetery and, while his wife wasn’t looking, took that item and brought it to its owner at that resting place from which it should never have left, hoping that the deceased would forgive him for that terrible mistake...
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23t79FcbGGMQctzWet3Es5nmeg88aBkGCtYx8hFpogmh5rrPV5mN61TJuQiqgtKawmZpo.png) [Source/ Fuente](https://gemini.google.com/app/9bea89658bce0e31?utm_source=app_launcher&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=base_all)
This is my entry for [Spooky Cemetery Stories on Spooky Zone! 💀 Initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/historias-perturbadoras-de-cementerios-en-spooky-zone-iniciativaes-en). Also, I’d like to thank my lovely friends @issymarie2 and @avdesing for the invitations. Cheers, friends!

Español

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/Eo6DbWY4jKeYnos1zpTVePgC794FUXzeCuWJNMAR1G5LXdhdmasGzvjUWmiinUFw5Sz.png)
Damián tenía poco tiempo trabajando en el viejo cementerio de su pueblo; no le agradaba mucho el asunto, pero era lo que había. Después de perder su empleo y con su esposa en embarazo, no podía darse el lujo de quedarse sin trabajar, con muchas cuentas que pagar y gastos pendientes por enfrentar; así es que luego de la muerte del viejo sepulturero y con solo otro sepulturero que también estaba bastante anciano, necesitaban sangre fresca para este trabajo tan rudo, preparando los futuros aposentos de los difuntos. Un día abren otro cementerio y muchos familiares deciden \

a sus difuntos a este nuevo lugar y para esto los familiares más cercanos se presentaban con las autoridades y con un listado donde tenían registrada las pertenencias con que se habían enterrado junto a sus familiares, pues había algunos difuntos que fueron enterrados como se estilaba el siglo pasado, con joyas, monedas, muñecas; en fin, en esas tumbas podías encontrar cualquier cosa. Ya Damián había sido testigo de estas exhumaciones; era parte de su trabajo.

Por esos días, una familia que tenía a su tatarabuela enterrada en el viejo cementerio decide exhumarla para trasladar sus restos al nuevo cementerio, donde habían comprado un nuevo lote para sus familiares. Ese día se presentó un tataranieto de la difunta con su listado, con lo que, según había sido enterrada la señora, en ella estaba anotada una pulsera de oro y unos aretes, un viejo rosario de perlas y nada más; todo estaba allí junto a los restos de la vieja mujer. Se le entregaron estas prendas y se trasladaron los restos, como se debía, a su nuevo lugar de reposo.

El viejo ataúd, lleno de humedad, quedó allí al sol para que Damian lo desechara en el lugar que tenían dispuesto para esto, de modo que Damian lo dejó al sol para no tener que tocar tanta humedad, aunque tuviera toda la indumentaria para hacerlo; quería prevenir cualquier cosa y lo dejó en el lugar hasta el otro día. Cuando llegó a la mañana siguiente, para desechar el ataúd, al manipularlo, se cae a la tierra un anillo delgado de oro con una pequeña piedra roja al centro que brillaba intensamente al sol. Él tomó aquella prenda y recordó aquella lista del pariente y, según lo que recuerda, no se decía nada de este anillo.


Y aunque dudó un poco, decidió tomarlo y mandarlo a limpiar y obsequiárselo a su esposa. Esa noche, Damian llegó con ese hermoso detalle para con su esposa y solo le dijo que se lo compró a un borrachín y, como le pareció bonito y además era de oro, le pareció un regalo perfecto para ella; su mujer se puso muy feliz. Pero esa misma noche, Damian empezó a soñar con una mujer vestida con ropas del siglo pasado que le exigía que le devolviera su anillo, y así por las noches siguientes y cada vez más colérica con él...



Damian en un principio pensó que era por haberse sugestionado por haber tomado esa prenda de aquella sepultura y trató de hacerse el loco, hasta que un buen día un grito sordo de su mujer lo despertó en medio de la noche, con ella llorando a gritos diciéndole que una mujer anciana le gritaba: \

, con mucha furia; pero la pobre mujer no entendía el porqué de aquella horrible pesadilla. Damián la convenció de que solo había sido un mal sueño, pero él sabía en el fondo que era aquella difunta furiosa reclamando lo que era suyo; él no sabía qué hacer. Hasta que decidió contarle avergonzado la verdad a su compañero, al viejo sepulturero, y este le dijo que había roto una de las reglas de todo sepulturero, que era no tomar ninguna pertenencia de ningún difunto, porque muchos de estos venían a reclamar y no de buena manera, así es que le dijo que debía ubicar el nuevo lugar de descanso de la difunta y llevarle hasta allá su anillo y pedirle perdón por su falta y rogar porque esta lo hiciera. De tal manera que Damián ubicó en el nuevo cementerio la tumba de esta difunta y, en un descuido de su esposa, tomó aquella prenda y la llevó a su dueña en aquel lugar de reposo desde donde nunca debió salir, esperando que esta difunta le perdonara aquella terrible falta... Esta es mi participación en [Historias perturbadoras de cementerios en Spooky Zone! 💀 Iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/historias-perturbadoras-de-cementerios-en-spooky-zone-iniciativaes-en). Por otra parte, agradezco las invitaciones de mis lindas amigas @issymarie2 y @avdesing. ¡Saludos, amigos!

title.title: USING QUORA IN THE BORN AGAIN RULESET BETWEEN THE TWO MARTYR ABILITIES MONSTERS AND LAST STAND ABILITY
title.body:
> Hello Splinterland Warriors! How are you all? I hope you are blessed and well. In today's post, I am here again today with another blog in which i am sharing a battle from the brawl tournament and showing the power of Quora epic monster from the earth Splinter, which i used in this battle along with two martyr ability monsters, and to get the last stand ability from the summoner. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaTeLWJe4wBiTzgogVGPK88F2BbTBVQqZYXHVjxFR8esc/image.png) [WATCH BATTLE HERE](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_gf9cugKBTU11wmUQ464J?ref=moeenali)
BATTLE LINE UP
I was allowed to use some other Splinters but when i saw the ruleset of Born Again in which all the monsters will come back to the field after death to get another chance so in this case i went for the Earth Splinter and used the two martyr ability monsters to get benefit from these martyr ability twice, and also the last stand ability boosted the damage Quora that you can see. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
Scarred Llama Mage
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Scarred%20Llama%20Mage.png Well, not going deeply for this Summoner already i wrote about it that i got it from the airdrop and using it for my Earth Splinter. The great benefit of this summoner is to remove the negative stats with the help of its cleansing ability, and also adds two health, along with the last stand ability to increase the stats +50%. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
RULESETS
The Ruleset was Born Again, and Earthquake.

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Grund.png
Well, the mana was enough, so I went for this epic card with double strike, which has no flying ability but enough health and double-strike damage to deal some damage to enemy monsters and weaken the enemy team with its double-strike attack. Also, the earthquake ruleset was given some damage to both teams' non-flying monsters, especially to my friendly monsters, because i have not used any flying monsters in my team because of the quora.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Kron%20the%20Undying.png
To utilize the full mana i went for another card, which is a legendary monster from the untamed edition with a heal ability that restores its health and also has enough serious magic damage before the quora. This card was used for the last stand ability, and it worked well by giving some nice damage to the enemy monsters and stayed for a long time in the battlefield because of its awesome ability to restore health each round.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Fungus%20Flinger.png
To use this card in this position, based on the rulesets i used this card because this is a non-flying monster, so it will get damage from the earthquake, and also it will be born again so in both conditions it will give benefit to the adjacent monsters. Quora and kron the Undying both monsters get the martyr ability, so this monster did well to support its friendly team monsters, and the Born Again ruleset was awesome for this card to give twice martyr benefits.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

I’ve seen it in real life more than online fights.  
Friends move out not to replace anyone, but to find work, study, better hospitals.  
Places with older populations actually look for young hands to run shops, care homes, farms.  So what looks like “taking over” from outside, feels like “filling gaps” from inside.  
For me, it’s less about fear of losing and more about how we all keep moving to survive + grow...!

title.title: Wave Brood Card Purchase Another Powerful Addition to My Collection
title.body:
Today I purchased a new card for Splinterlands, and that card is called Wave Brood. I have been eyeing this card for a long time, as it is known as one of the most popular and effective tank cards among Water Splinter. I am really happy to finally add the card to my collection today. As a regular player, I always try to collect cards that are not only powerful, but also capable of giving good results in the long run in various types of battles. Wave Brood is just that kind of card.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaLWk2RGXKybEwgtFEegor3BBZKdSakTQpJM4am7NeQip/1780962366822.png)

When I first saw the stats of this card, I immediately realized that this is no ordinary card. This Epic Water unit with an 8 mana cost basically acts as a powerful tank. Its Health is very high, which helps it withstand the opponent's attacks for a long time. In addition its special abilities make it even more effective. Sometimes, just one strong tank in a battle can change the outcome  entire match Wave Brood can do that job very well.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzpqUhQpqxYPywcLqrVg2M8LbpLx1mA1kcxLnSEzkJet/1780962366985.png)

 The most important thing about this card is its Taunt ability. Splinterlands players know very well how valuable an ability Taunt is. When a card has Taunt, all the opponent's attacks are necessarily focused on that card. As a result, other important cards in the team are safe and they can continue their work. I have personally played many battles where my damage dealer or support cards were destroyed very quickly. But having Wave Brood solves this problem to a large extent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXbL4whdUdvme1XFAGk14qvRz31zY6RhRsfg1pYgKXHa/1780962367176.jpg)

Another notable aspect of the card is its huge Health Pool. Its health increases as the level increases, which helps it survive on the field for a long time. When the opponent has multiple attacking units, normal tanks are defeated very quickly. But Wave Brood can use its huge health to withstand attacks for a long time. During this time, my other cards gradually weaken the opponent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSRgo4MevEUWbVZo3Xx1D4Cfhx3mrec3Zaxf5ce4AevVC/1780962367143.png)

I especially like to use Water Splinter. Most of Water Splinter's cards rely on speed, magic damage, and tactical ability.  Wave Brood is an ideal defensive unit for this team. It can withstand frontal attacks and allows magic or ranged units in the back to attack safely. This creates a balance within the entire team.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWP8zKxnbTZaSF7Tc95NAqu3rYLeabreKRTwEZjQqWLZQ/1780962367258.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP8HeWhURaTkpaGak8RxyRhGWhrsmRohBSiK4urstcCTL/1780962418232.jpg)

Another good thing about the card is its Close Range ability. This ability allows it to attack from the first position despite being a ranged attacker. Normally ranged units cannot attack when they come forward, but Wave Brood is free from that limitation due  its Close Range.  it can contribute not only defense but also offense. I think this feature has increased the value  card even more.

As the level increases, Wave Brood gains some more interesting abilities. Of these, Knock Out and Forcefield are particularly notable. Knock Out helps deal extra damage against enemies that are in a Stun state. On the other hand, Forcefield reduces damage from large-scale attacks. After these two abilities are added card becomes even more terrifying. In high-level matches these abilities can often turn the tide  match.

When I buy a new card, I consider not only current use but also its future potential.  Wave Brood is a card that I believe will be useful for a long time. Even with the meta change Water Splinter, there is always a demand for strong tanks and taunt cards. So it is not just a card, but a valuable investment in my gaming collection.

I felt quite excited when I bought card today. Because I know that it will play important role in my future battles. Sometimes the joy getting new card is different. Especially when that card has been a goal for a long time. After buying Wave Brood, I feel that my Water Deck is now stronger than before.

This card is used a lot in guild battles, ranked matches, or various special rules battles. Especially where Sneak, Snipe, or Opportunity attacks are common, the Taunt ability works wonders. It is truly a tactical advantage to protect other team members by drawing the opponent's attacks towards you.

Another thing is its excellent design. I found the artwork Wave Brood be very attractive. This card, which looks like a mysterious creature emerging from depths  sea, fits the theme of Water Splinter very well. I always like cards that are not only effective, but also beautiful look at.

All things considered, today's purchase is very satisfying for me. Wave Brood is not just an Epic card, but also a powerful tactical weapon. Its Taunt Close Range Forcefield and other abilities make it one best defensive units in Water Splinter. I am sure that this card will help me win countless matches  future.

Finally as a Splinterlands player, collecting new powerful cards is always a pleasure.  Today, with the addition Wave Brood my collection, that joy has increased many times over. Now my goal will be  gradually level it up and use its full potential achieve even better results. I am hopeful that this card will become one  mainstays  my Water Deck and will lead me success in many difficult battles in the future.

title.body:
**“Flor”** es una palabra perfecta para una serie como la tuya porque sirve a la vez para vocabulario cotidiano y para ciencia básica. La imagen principal funciona muy bien: **“I brought some flowers for you” → “Te traje unas flores”** suena natural, clara y útil en conversación diaria.

La segunda imagen también añade valor porque aterriza la palabra en biología. Las partes que señalas —**estigma, estilo, ovario, estambres, antera, filamento, pétalos, sépalos, óvulos y granos de polen**— coinciden con explicaciones educativas estándar sobre la anatomía floral, como las de [Science Friday](https://www.sciencefriday.com/educational-resources/flower-anatomy/), [PBS NOVA](https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/nova/education/nature/reproductive-role-flowers.html) y [BBC Bitesize](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/articles/ztvntrd). Eso le da a tu post un toque doblemente útil: **idioma + contenido académico**.

También me gusta el detalle de enlazar la entrega anterior. Le da continuidad a la serie y deja claro que esto no es un post suelto, sino un proyecto serio y constante, como se ve en [tu publicación 426](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-425-tg...).

Si quisieras afinar una sola cosa, sería una mininota sobre número: **“flower” = “flor”** y **“flowers” = “flores”**. Ese contraste ayuda mucho a principiantes y evita que se queden solo con la palabra aislada.

title.title: [Retrogaming] We became the Junkman! | GTA: Advance (Game Boy Advance)
title.body:
>**My 3Speaking Today**   Hey, what's up, players! Welcome back everyone to this my gaming channel on 3Speak. I am very pleased to have you here once again, and today I truly hope you enjoy this new retro gameplay : ) . Players, today we are once again going with main missions in our very beloved Grand Theft Auto: Advance, where we will continue following the lead of our friend and sidekick Vinnie, who remains involved in carrying out dangerous jobs for the Liberty Mafia. As we will see in today's gameplay, this will be his downfall, and therefore we will have to embark on new paths and meet new allies in the city of liberty of the Rockstar Universe.   ***Going for the Getaway Car.*** From Chinatown we receive Vinnie's call asking us to go and pick up our getaway car, which was parked at our hideout in the Hepburn Heights area, and then meet up with him at Callahan Point. So we head to the hideout, take our powerful blue Banshee and go to get Vinnie. However, none of the above went as we expected, since upon arriving at Callahan Point aboard our Banshee, we are met with the fact that Vinnie was killed after a bomb detonated his car. This leaves Mike in complete shock and disbelief at what has just occurred, and he has to flee the scene leaving behind the charred body of his faithful friend and criminal companion.   ***Guided by 8-Ball.*** We had no time to mourn the death of the good Vinnie, as immediately the LCPD (Liberty City Police Department) began a manhunt with two wanted stars over Mike's head. We therefore had to flee the scene at full speed aboard our powerful Banshee while facing strong resistance along the way, making the Pay 'n' Spray our next stop in order to lose the wanted stars. Even so, after repainting the car we were unable to return to our hideout in Hepburn Heights, since according to our new ally 8-Ball, that location would be under investigation by the LCPD. 8-Ball suggests we head to his hideout at Portland Beach, and from there we begin an operation to determine who might be behind the murder of our friend Vinnie. In the meantime, 8-Ball asks us to do some jobs for him.   ***Twisted Metal.*** We keep finding new ways to make money in Liberty City, as 8-Ball indicates that we must get rid of Vinnie's remains as soon as possible to avoid trouble with the Police. We therefore have to head to the nearest Junk Yard in order to completely destroy every trace of Vinnie. And although Mike points out that he did not want to dispose of his friend in this manner, he also understands that it is the best way to move forward while avoiding trouble with the cops. In addition to this, a new mechanic is introduced to us, which is the ability to **use the Junk Yard** to earn money by converting vehicles into scrap. Just as you can see in the gameplay, at around **minute 06:55** of the gameplay that we destroy a BF Injection that was in the vicinity to earn some extra cash for our bank account 🤑 Well, this is how I bring today's retro gameplay to an end, but not before giving you as always my thanks for the support of the gaming channel on 3Speak and my content in general. Incluso, también añado algunas iniciativas que veo para participar en ellas. Solo que hoy también estoy bastante cansada; veo la lista y no tengo ganas de escribir sobre ninguno de los temas en ella. title.title: Why Neck Pain is becoming Common?
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSv8HVFLSBY5R2UDMFG1GyuG5Xwtifu7d7ZGBS7yAwcVu/1780960882455.jpg)
Picture from Pinterest 

Look around you right now. Bus, classroom, cafe, hostel, office. 8 out of 10 people have their head bent forward, eyes locked on a glowing screen. We call it scrolling, working, studying. Our necks call it something else: “heavy lifting.”This is not about fear. This is about awareness. Because neck pain from poor posture, mobile overuse, and computer work has become the most common “new-age” pain. Doctors call it “tech neck” or “text neck.” I call it “the pain we invited ourselves.“

Trust me in my daily cinical routine....90% of patients come wth neck pain. And surprisingly age group starts from childhood...Oh Goodness save us all...!

The good news? It’s preventable. It’s reversible. And it starts with understanding, not panic. So let’s talk , simply, honestly, creatively .. about what’s happening to our necks, why it matters, and what anyone can do about it.


→Your head weighs about 4.5 to 5.5 kg. That’s like carrying a big watermelon or a newborn baby on your shoulders all day. When you stand straight, ears over shoulders, that weight is balanced. Muscles, bones, and ligaments share the load. Easy.But tilt your head forward 15° to check a WhatsApp message? Now your neck muscles feel ∼12 kg. Tilt 30°? ∼18 kg. Tilt 60°, the way most of us scroll in bed? ∼27 kg. 

Imagine holding a 5-year-old kid with your arms stretched forward for 2 hours. Your arms would shake, burn, and beg for rest. That’s exactly what your neck muscles do when you “quickly check Instagram” for 2 hours.This extra load is called “lever force.” Physics doesn’t care if you’re young, strong, or “used to it.” It just adds weight.

  
→Good posture is not about looking like a soldier. It’s about alignment. Ear over shoulder, shoulder over hip, hip over ankle. A straight line.Poor posture breaks that line. Chin juts forward. Upper back rounds like a “C.” Shoulders roll inward. We call this “forward head posture” or “computer hunch.”

Why do we do it? 3 reasons: 
1→ Screens are below eye level. We bend to meet them. 
2→ Chairs/tables are wrong height. We adapt to furniture instead of furniture adapting to us. 
3→ Habit. The more we slouch, the more “normal” slouch feels. Brain thinks curved = comfortable.

Over months, muscles shorten on front of neck/chest and lengthen/weaken on back of neck/upper back. Muscles are like rubber bands. If you stretch one side for too long, it stops bouncing back. That imbalance = pain.

  
→Phones are amazing. They fit in pockets and carry the world. But they also train us to look down. 

Worst positions for neck:
- *Lying on side, phone above face*: Neck bends sideways for 30-60 min. One-sided strain. 
- *Lying on stomach, chin on bed*: Neck twists + extends backward. Nerves get pinched. 
- *Sitting, phone at lap level*: Head drops 60° for reels, gaming, reading. 




→Laptops and desktops aren’t evil. But 90% of setups are wrong. 

Common mistakes:
1. Laptop on desk = screen 20-30cm below eye level. So head drops all day. 
2. Keyboard + trackpad attached = either screen too low OR arms stretched too far. Both hurt neck/shoulders. 
3. Chair with no lumbar support = lower back collapses → upper back rounds → neck has to push head forward to balance. Domino effect. 
4. No breaks = muscles stay contracted for hours. Contracted muscle = no blood flow = pain + stiffness.

Result: By 5 PM, neck feels “rusted.” Headaches start from base of skull. Shoulders feel like they’re carrying bricks.
Let’s keep it simple. No medical terms, just visuals.

*Muscles*: Front neck muscles get tight/short. Back neck muscles get weak/long. Like one side of a tug-of-war team has all strong players, other side has kids. Neck gets pulled forward.

*Joints*: Neck has 7 small bones = cervical spine. Each has discs like jelly donuts between them. Poor posture squeezes front of disc, stretches back. Over years, disc can bulge or wear out. That’s “cervical spondylosis.” Not old-age only anymore.

*Nerves*: Neck nerves go to arms, hands, head. If joint/disc presses nerve → tingling in fingers, numbness, shooting pain, or headaches. That’s why “neck pain” sometimes feels like “head pain.”

*Breathing*: Slouched posture compresses chest. You take shallow breaths. Less oxygen → more fatigue → more slouching. Pain loop.

But wait....

Your neck is polite. It whispers before it shouts. Learn the whispers:

*Early whispers — Stage 1:*
1. Morning stiffness. Neck feels “locked” for first 5-10 min after waking.
2. Need to “crack” neck/shoulders often to feel relief.
3. Pain at base of skull after long phone/laptop use.
4. Shoulders feel tired even without lifting anything.

*Middle warnings — Stage 2:*
1. Headaches that start from neck and move to forehead/eyes. “Tension headaches.”
2. Pain radiates to shoulder blade or upper arm.
3. Feeling like you “can’t hold head up” after 2-3 hours of work.
4. Numbness/tingling in fingers, especially ring + little finger.

*Red flags — Stage 3, see a doctor:*
1. Sudden loss of neck movement after waking up.
2. Pain + weakness in arm/hand. Dropping things.
3. Numbness that doesn’t go away.
4. Pain at night that wakes you up.

Important note: I’m sharing info, not diagnosis. If pain is severe, sudden, or has numbness/weakness, check with a doctor or physiotherapist. Early help = faster recovery.

NOW LETS TALK ABOUT SOLUTION 

No gym, no expensive gadgets needed. Just habits. Pick 3 to start.

*A. Setup Fixes — Change your environment*
1→ The 1/3rd of your screen should hit your eye level.
2→Your spine should be supported 
3→Your screen should be at least 60-70cm away from your eyes. 
4→Not too bright light to squint eyes nor too dimm light to glare at screen.


*B. Movement Fixes — Motion is lotion*
1→ Change your movement after every 20min. Give rest to your eyes.
2→Take breaks, after 40-45 mins try to walk some steps pr any other little activities.
3→Practice Chin Tucks Excercises 
4→Do slef Stretching of neck muscles on regular basis.


*C. Habit Fixes — Change daily patterns*
1→ Use appropriate pillow according to your neck size 
2→Try to shorten the duration of screen time before sleeping.
3→Do not use earphones for too long or too loud.
4→Sleeping pillow should be comfortable.


Tech isn’t the villain. Habits are.We blame phones, laptops, “modern life.” But tech is just a tool. Hammer can build house or break window. Same with screens. The problem is “unconscious use.” We sit without noticing. We scroll without breaks. We accept pain as “normal for students/workers.” Awareness is the first fix. Next time you catch yourself with head forward, smile and correct it. That’s a rep for your neck gym.



Hunched posture = closed body language. Research shows it even affects mood and confidence. Straight posture = open chest = deeper breathing = calmer mind. 
So fixing neck posture is also fixing mental posture. Body and mind are teammates.We treat pain like an enemy. Pop a pill, ignore it, hope it goes away. But pain is a messenger. 

Neck stiffness = “Hey, change position.” 
Headache after laptop = “Hey, take a break.” 
Tingling in fingers = “Hey, nerve is pressed.” 

If we listen early, small changes work. If we ignore, body has to shout louder with bigger problems. Think of pain like phone battery warning. At 20% you charge. You don’t wait till 0% and phone dies. Treat neck same way.

 
Our parents didn’t grow up with 8 hours/day of screens. We’re the first “screen-native” generation. Science is still learning long-term effects. But one thing is clear: human body evolved for movement, varied positions, looking at distant horizons. Not 10 hours of 30cm screen. 


NOW LETS TALK ABOUT ROUTINE MODIFICATIONS
Morning  2 min:
1. Wall check 30 sec
2. Chin tucks 10 reps
3. Neck side stretch 20 sec each side

Every work/study hour 1 min:
1. Stand up
2. Reach arms to ceiling 3x
3. Look out window 20 sec
4. Shoulder rolls 5x backward

Night 2 min:
1. Doorway chest stretch 20 sec
2. Upper trap stretch 20 sec each side
3. Lie flat, no pillow for 1 min to decompress neck

Total = 5 min/day. Less time than 2 reels. Impact = years of healthy neck.


Your neck holds your head. Your head holds your thoughts, dreams, memory, face. It’s worth caring for.We can’t go back to a world without screens. And we shouldn’t want to. Screens connect, teach, create, heal. But we CAN go forward into a world where we use screens without becoming screen-shaped. Where we bend for goals, not for gadgets. Where we listen to whispers so we never hear screams.

So next time you scroll, remember: 
1. Raise the screen.
2. Straighten the back. 
3. Take the break.

Small acts. Big difference.

Share this with your friends who live on their phones/laptops. Because “tech neck” is a group problem, and “neck care” should be a group habit.

Your future self will thank you. And your neck will too.

title.title: From granny squares to bookmarks📚
title.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear knitting friends. I hope you are all well and in good health 🙏🏻 This weekend I sat down for a while with my needles and yarn, without a clear idea of what I wanted to knit. And that’s how my new bookmark came about – a simple, delicate and very special piece. It all started with a small granny square. As I looked at it finished, I thought I could turn it into something more than just a simple knitted square. So I decided to add a long chain stitch to give it movement and a unique touch. When I reached the end of the chain, I wanted to add a special detail. I had a wooden bead that seemed perfect for this project. I used it as the centre of a small flower and, around it, I worked single crochet stitches to simulate the petals.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridas amigas de las agujas. Espero se encuentren bien con salud y bienestar 🙏🏻 Este fin de semana me senté un rato con mis agujas y mis hilos, sin una idea demasiado clara de lo que quería tejer. Y así nació mi nuevo marcalibros, una pieza sencilla, delicada y muy especial. Todo comenzó con un pequeño granny square. Mientras lo observaba terminado, pensé que podía transformarlo en algo más que un simple cuadrito tejido. Entonces decidí añadirle una larga cadeneta que le diera movimiento y un toque diferente. Cuando llegué al final de la cadeneta, quise colocar un detalle especial. Tenía una cuenta de madera que me pareció perfecta para este proyecto. title.title: The Donut That Won My Heart
title.body:
I have this favorite comfort food that I have been craving until today, it was the donut from Dunkin Donuts. Specifically, the donut's name is the Boston Kreme, you know why? Because this Boston Kreme has chocolate outside and a filling inside which was the Bavarian cream. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/EouEvUY8B4Hk68iNWRM6wCAnGQ3y2GJskbopQ6B9oYENxYyhKFPDAtKTzRs4A4Xm9We.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/illustrations/box-of-assorted-colorful-donuts-on-a-yellow-background-vzyINg3n6UE)


This Boston Kreme is not a premium kind of a donut but a classic donut, so it's much cheaper than the premium donut and it was more delicious compare to the premium donut. 

Well, whenever I went to the Dunkin myself, this is my only donut that I am looking for aside from the Choco Wacko which is I think a super premium donut. Well, this donut which is the Boston Kreme is not sweet on the outside but the the filling on the inside makes it more delicious. 

This classic donut is like a two in one donut because there's chocolate and Bavarian cream that is also the only donut that have this one on the Classic donut. 

Hmm... I eat this donut whenever I went to the city and since my place is not a city and there were a few to no fast food chain or other food store that most cities have, I need to go to the city just to buy this donut.

The city is not that far away from the place where I live and I think it needs about 40 minutes to get there and if ever I am craving one, I would just go there and buy it, well, it's more expensive since the fare is much higher now compared before, that's why I rarely went to the city.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/242rygSwtustwdcdMwYWFft1H6EHQZmZ5WJHdNeVMMMHcrN4BxR5XqZbtXd4DqowLRYDZ.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/illustrations/hand-holding-a-pink-frosted-donut-with-sprinkles-_Qg6PP8Opls)

title.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Lux’s Favor:  From Pit Challenge to Battle Challenge
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX8XWa8GE7ShAB94zCocnffwLYQgwW45fnhzy3yaQe6Eu/Portada%20-%20Battle%20Challenge.png</center>

<center>This past day there was a change in the **Lux’s Favor** Wheel, although I don't know the exact day it was implemented since I only noticed after I reached another challenge without realizing that it changed, but it is very possible that it happened with the update of [**2026-06-02**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-06-02).</center>

><center>Esto último día hubo un cambio en la Ruleta de **Lux’s Favor** aunque no sé qué día exacto que se implemento ya que solo me di cuenta después que alcancé para otro desafío sin darme cuenta que cambio pero es muy posible que pasara con la actualización del [**2026-06-02**](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-06-02).</center>

<center>Now it was removed from the direct access to the combat against the **3** bosses (**Al the Mountain**, **The Big Leronski**, and **Eagle Libre**). Under the new structure of the **Battle Challenge**, the game introduces a mandatory preparation phase composed of **7** pre-designed challenges consecutively.</center>

><center>Ahora se eliminó del acceso directo al combate contra los **3** jefes (**Al the Mountain**, **The Big Leronski** y **Eagle Libre**). Bajo la nueva estructura del **Battle Challenge**, el juego introduce una fase de preparación obligatoria compuesta por **7** retos prediseñados de forma consecutiva.</center>

<center>To advance in the campaign, players must measure their decks against a series of teams predetermined by the system. This mechanic transforms the format into a challenge of consistency and adaptability, since it is necessary to overcome each of the previous steps to unlock the final battle against the **Pit Fighter**. The lineups of these intermediate phases maintain a controlled scheme, serving as a ladder of fixed pairings that tests the general solidity of your collection before allowing you to claim the major rewards of the boss of the day.</center>

><center>Para avanzar en la campaña, los jugadores deben medir sus mazos contra una serie de equipos predeterminados por el sistema. Esta mecánica transforma el formato en un reto de constancia y adaptabilidad, ya que es necesario superar cada uno de los escalones previos para desbloquear la batalla final contra el **Pit Fighter**. Las alineaciones de estas fases intermedias mantienen un esquema controlado, sirviendo como una escalera de emparejamientos fijos que pone a prueba la solidez general de tu colección antes de permitirte reclamar las recompensas mayores del jefe de la jornada.</center>

<center>This new system extends the time and effort to be able to get the rewards for defeating one of the **3** bosses, this in principle serves to avoid farming the bosses easily with pre-established teams that can be shared by players. It is no longer enough to design a single strategy and execute it at any time of the day; now the player must calculate the time it will take to resolve the **7** previous curated challenges to ensure reaching the definitive combat.</center>

><center>Este sistema nuevo extiende el tiempo y esfuerzo para poder conseguir las recompensas al derrotas a uno de los **3** jefes, esto es un principio sirve para evitar farmear los jefes de manera sencilla con equipos preestablecidos que se puedan compartir por los jugadores. Ya no basta con diseñar una estrategia única y ejecutarla en cualquier momento del día; ahora el jugador debe calcular el tiempo que le tomará resolver los **7** desafíos curados previos para asegurarse de llegar al combate definitivo.</center>

<center>This can cause annoyance among players who want to get **Sparks** fast to get the Skins from the **Circa Royale Spark Shop** but at the same time it makes the Skins more exclusive as not just anyone can get them.</center>

><center>Esto puede causar molestia entre los jugadores que quieren obtener **Sparks** rápido para obtener las Skins de las **Circa Royale Spark Shop** pero a la vez hace más exclusivas las Skins a no cualquiera poder obtenerlas.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRX4jTMPKLGmRmJpyeTEVex28tKXj1AweJiXxmG2s6W24/Acceso%20V2.png</center>

<center>Another change that arrived with this new system is that you can access the information of these battles from the **campaign** section where you will not only see the tutorial of Book 1 but also the **Battle Challenge** with all the information about the battle from the enemy team as well as all the battle variables such as Rulesets and Mana, and taking advantage of this I want to show you my first time facing this challenge.</center>

><center>Otro de los cambios que llego con este nuevo sistema es que se puede acceder a la información de estas batallas desde la sección de **campaign** donde no solamente se vera el tutorial del Book 1 sino los **Battle Challenge** con toda la información sobre la batalla desde el equipo enemigos como todas las variables de la batalla como Rulesets y Mana, y aprovechando quiero mostrarle mi primera vez enfrentando este desafío.</center>

### <center>[Battle Challenge #1](https://next.splinterlands.com/battle/sl_durlan_battle_challenge_1?t=1780781320903)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXRigdKFNxEtXWKUjdzy7ShnJatAQWrFo6ViLtwQYsoHX/Info%201%20V2.png</center>

<center>**Battle Challenge #1** is with the **Standard** Ruleset (without secondary modifications) with **99** mana but only allowing the **Water** element against a team of **Marlai Singariel** but without taking much advantage of the magic damage booster.</center>

><center>El **Battle Challenge #1** es con un la Ruleset **Standard** (sin modificaciones secundarias) con **99** de mana pero solo permitido el elemento **Agua** contra un equipo de **Marlai Singariel** pero sin aprovechar mucho el potenciador de daño mágico.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmShqoY9Mr4KJpq1zZc7pzKd9F7bFDLx766R8xsKM3GfTL/Batalla%201%20V2.png</center>

<center>And for my team I used the typical team based on all units with magic damage possible and winning **200 Sparks** for the victory.</center>

><center>Y para mi equipo use el típico equipo basado en todas las unidades con daño magico posible y ganando **200 Sparks** por la victoria.</center>

### <center>[Battle Challenge #2](https://next.splinterlands.com/battle/sl_durlan_battle_challenge_2?t=1780782070361)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZKjZbwCdVJYER6spDuw8iEyccoVZwvWmfFQHwj5KUuVE/Info%202%20V2.png</center>

<center>**Battle Challenge #2** was quite different to start with, in this battle the only thing the same was the amount of mana which was once again **99** mana but all elements could be used but there were **2** Rulesets: **Shades of Gray** which only let you use **Neutral** units and **Briar Patch** to punish those using melee attacks against a team that was quite bad against **Thorns** damage.</center>

><center>**El Battle Challenge #2** si fue bastante distinto para empezar en esta batalla lo único igual fue la cantidad de mana que fue otra vez de **99** de mana pero si se podían usar todos los elementos pero hubieron **2** Rulesets: **Shades of Gray** que solo dejaba usar unidades **Neutrales** y **Briar Patch** para castigar las que usaban ataques cuerpo a cuerpo contra un equipo bastante malo contra el daño de **Thorns**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbfpNnNEy4LzsFdXKNXKKGV95XJCyRCTRecaKQSPrRoH9/Batalla%202%20V2.png</center>

<center>For my team I used a team mainly based on magic and ranged damage to avoid the damage from **Briar Patch** with **Great Bear Druid** placed behind to prevent it from hitting with its melee attack and winning **200 Sparks** for the victory.</center>

><center>Para mi equipo use un equipo principalmente basado en daño magico y a distancia para evitar el daño de **Briar Patch** con **Great Bear Druid** puesto detrás para evitar que golpee con su ataque cuerpo a cuerpo y ganando **200 Sparks** por la victoria.</center>

### <center>[Battle Challenge #3]</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU4uePwZSoKijtLocKAoZ4KdQ6XyJUtHyx17GZvCtLJLH/Info%203%20V2.png</center>

<center>With those **2** victories I could no longer face the third challenge but it lets see how the next battle will be with: **99** mana, all elements allowed but with **2** defensive Rulesets **Arcane Dampening** and **Thick Skinned** that will make it a battle of attrition.</center>

><center>Con esas **2** victoria ya no podía enfrentar el tercer desafio pero deja ver como sera la próxima batalla con: **99** de mana, todos los elementos permitidos pero con **2** Rulesets defensivas **Arcane Dampening** y **Thick Skinned** que haran que sea una batalla de desgaste.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>The evolution from **Pit Challenge** to **Battle Challenge** within **Lux’s Favor** consolidates the commitment of the **Splinterlands** team to expand its **PvE** (Player vs Environment) modalities, offering a campaign system with greater structure, step-by-step goals and a direct link with the player's consistency if they want the rewards, but depending on chance with the wheel can be frustrating not only being able to lose the battle but having to wait for several days to be able to face the most interesting enemies having to face a battle for **200 Sparks** which in my opinion would be more interesting if winning obtained another spin of the wheel or another version of the wheel where you could win the opportunity to get further in the **Battle Challenges**.</center>

><center>La evolución de **Pit Challenge** a **Battle Challenge** dentro de **Lux’s Favor** consolida la apuesta del equipo de **Splinterlands** por expandir sus modalidades **PvE** (Jugador contra Entorno), ofreciendo un sistema de campaña con mayor estructura, metas paso a paso y una vinculación directa con las constancia del jugador si quieren las recompensas, pero el depender del azar con la ruleta puede ser frustrante el no solo poder perder la batalla sino que tener que esperar por varios días para poder enfrentar a los enemigos más interesantes teniendo que enfrentar una batalla por **200 Sparks** que a mi parecer seria más interesante si al ganar se obtuviera otra tirada de la ruleta o de otra versión de la ruleta donde poder ganar la oportunidad de llegar más lejos en los **Battle Challenge**.</center>

title.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1419 - Continued Progress with LM Studio Settings and More Stable Hermes Sessions - Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Sunday, June 7, 2026
title.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_074520281.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQjr1B4C7VGBdCVtrTxWiC2vnYy3bVUAhfrV52beZqfzknBccdQjBiRnFa6UAuYsEGk.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 25.75% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.049 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.978 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.02136184 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.11118896 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00078117 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.152076 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001521 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 63,303.15 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 210.37 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 43.245 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,327.80 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 68.13 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #126 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#100 (among active witnesses only)/642.8k HP in votes/50 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 Well it would seem that the new settings in LM Studio, which is my backend LLM server (*and also how I usually procure AI models*), that I gleamed from some focused web research, have very much improved the stability of my Hermes Agent sessions, with everything running smoothly for more than 24 hours. That's excellent, though it's definitely not a stopping point, as much more is still possible than I've yet attempted. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_082244065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2aXoApjuBMUpaxsRR7CDETxg1bV5gid9vrd72Fh4TopYfNcWYEQKYXQsn5kp8Uece1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_082448859_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQP5P9iR8LmvoWXiw6ifKdDwiNxMkhDNpkd8mHEVaAygM5KyZ1VzLPYb2gmN1MzNLXM.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Running and experimenting with AI models and agentic-AI frameworks on local hardware, systems, and networks, is very much at the cutting edge of discovery and further development in this exceedingly-rapidly evolving tech domain. Keeping track of, and staying on top of of it all, is daunting to say the least, because it's coming very, very, very quickly, and I only have so much time. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_082742060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbnxFCUthoYNXSgfjfZuQjpVvrBbRCjBfPfb4YX54r21qK3irK49BxAydDR6gq3Fdk6.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_082823154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC1ZbFAuhbKMkr9U5Jag7dd9625obkU4w4LGC2875wTDTU2CFyFhYmMdjNByzexZgvM.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) With the information that I've found from more focused web research last night, I will likely soon be able to run notably larger and more capable models on my laptop, thanks to some super useful llama.cpp run flags. Larger models are just able to do more, and in a more effective and efficient manner, so I'm keen to explore these new possibilities. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_082943191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23ywgikwAMdTcgyhKyFVnZzAvaadWegmnbYMdohWSt8mNYZepv1UtpcxL9g5arvLnhZ6H.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_083407237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbnXmMkr8t6aZVC2uPvybNGM6p1zwh8Cj1nsHG5fjo89y8ePPwJkpiMT7cHtqcPNXqQ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) With increasingly ingenious quantization formats, compression, and how models are trained, tuned, and run, ever more capable models are able to run successfully on ever more modest hardware, and from what I can tell, this is just the beginning. Likely quite soon, incredibly powerful models, even surpassing the best cloud-based models, will be able to be run on pretty much any laptop or phone. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_083615379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23zbFNHkdm1oEs2BzspX67Q8Sa4cCnJ9Pr2DL7PEGGfeSTBxBVhcfwforqhYaz1ooxGVB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_091247910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tRvWxY35XPWoursixohVP1wya9zSyhR4Jjhbj21zCDBnUTDQZCoxg8UQFoszZnTEuaf.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Being able to run larger and more capable models than I've been running on my laptop up to this point is essential for realizing my intentions of building a functional, elegant, and coherent agentic-AI operating system, so I'll certainly be exploring that soon, though at the moment I'm just celebrating having a more stable system, while working with what I have set up now. One step at a time. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_145435495_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQiGx6VFcyru2adKGBdT1nxmgxUohQxTSf1fABn3JuBCMrhCgznJNw19KRFCoF71AuB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260606_145525577_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tSS67oz8M1zTw5Dcderb7EiEi3P85yTX4E1wBWUxPNQ27xSSFcUcXYH8mnDvKK3JgDh.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Sunday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my numerous important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by a little after 4PM, giving my attention to a few small jungle-community tasks, and to a bit of photography for my posts. I headed to Wabisabi by the early evening, to make myself some food, to collect my leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge, and with those in hands, I returned to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks, and to do a tad more agentic-AI research. I got through all of my notifications by just after 9:15PM, and after some asset management, and some more agentic-AI research, I went to bed by just after 11:15PM. I woke up by about 7:45AM, having slept reasonably well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to prepare my goals-and-progress update to write later, and to write this post. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! title.title: Jornada de Recuperación de Espacios CBIT Ezequiel Zamora
title.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @geekzone, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes mi experiencia en la recuperación de equipos de computación del Centro Bolivariano CBIT Ezequiel Zamora, de una institución educativa del municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to everyone at Hive and @geekzone. Today I’m going to share with you my experience in refurbishing computer equipment at the CBIT Ezequiel Zamora Bolivarian Centre, an educational institution in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260608_171212721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23y8yxxTMk2ex6r5NB3EtifE2VmJyhr3jajzmqq91xPFvQmR3SwM2ct1CHQTXx13eWoct.jpg) Cabe destacar que este CBIT, es uno de los centros que no estaba operativo y que planificamos para una revisión de cada equipo que presentaron fallas. Por eso todo el equipo de tutores nos trasladamos a otra parroquia para realizar este trabajo técnico, el cual tiene más de quince años en funcionamiento y hace unos meses venía presentando problemas de encendido de varios equipos y problemas en los monitores pantalla plana. >It is worth noting that this CBIT is one of the centres that was not operational, and we had planned to carry out a check on all the equipment that had malfunctioned. For this reason, the entire team of tutors travelled to another parish to carry out this technical work. The centre has been in operation for over fifteen years, but in recent months it had been experiencing problems with several pieces of equipment failing to power up, as well as issues with the flat-screen monitors. ![GridArt_20260608_170054478.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wqpwjnicFeH2Bb2C6LddnLk1XMDCDwz39BqVfWkzxRpNZz5gGyo2Q6wPgqdcVyh5TXV.jpg) Asimismo, iniciamos la revisión de cada computadora, la cual requiere de un mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, ya que presentan mucho polvo en la parte interna de la tarjeta madre y sus componentes, se sacaron las memorias y luego de fueron limpiando los contactos con un borrador. Después de éstos la gran mayoría encendieron. Pero como son 21 equipos cada una con 512mb, se activaron once, y se le agregaron 512mb, para completar 1gb de ram y optimizar su funcionamiento. >We also began inspecting each computer, which required preventive and corrective maintenance, as there was a significant amount of dust on the inside of the motherboard and its components. The memory modules were removed and their contacts were cleaned with an eraser. After this, the vast majority powered up. However, as there are 21 computers, each with 512MB, eleven were upgraded with an additional 512MB to bring the total RAM to 1GB and optimise their performance. ![GridArt_20260608_170332110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23uFW8pSwVUzftp1fbFTjiCsmef9zNNd34j9Qq1ni1eDXyv7P5n4fUf8q89rYVQhaUsU8.jpg) En cuanto a la revisión de los monitores pantalla plana, todos presentan manchas que dificulta la visualización, se seleccionaron los que estaban mejores para ponerlos a funcionar, pero ya estos cumplieron su vida útil y requieren de reemplazarlo por unos más nuevos. Por otro lado se intentó instalar otro sistema en el servidor pero.no se pudo debido a problemas con la instalación, se recomienda instalar a través de un pendrive con el sistema operativo. >As for the flat-screen monitors, they all have spots that make viewing difficult. We selected the ones in the best condition to put into use, but these have now reached the end of their useful life and need to be replaced with newer ones. Meanwhile, we attempted to install another operating system on the server but were unable to do so due to installation issues; it is recommended that the operating system be installed via a USB stick. ![GridArt_20260608_170505946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yToMb8HtxA3TfEv2dCbPiHVnkRc5KZLoHYWcwd7nFusXSz1W23c4Su8kxQ7MqjgnkBo.jpg) Esta fue una experiencia donde el trabajo en equipo es importante para poder rescatar algunos espacios y también informar a los organismos educativos que se requiere una redotacion de nuevos equipos que ya cumplieron su funcionamiento con más de quince años, ya que están obsoletos con las nuevas tecnologías. >This was an experience in which teamwork was essential to reclaiming certain spaces and also to inform educational bodies that new equipment is required to replace the existing gear, which has been in use for over fifteen years and is now obsolete in the face of new technologies. ![GridArt_20260608_170731910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23x16wVw5eLQXdGykb7eNdmw7K6gvgby2Wy9hq48AFMJuzgLJhFcGJaW6TJBEdiRB1kBw.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_114249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ynQgVthi9H3YXGRWfLVDqq9srufwCBe59mN7sTn41iLeeZiG4S88aXc9QPzsBB4WPCf.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. title.title: Black Tiger Getting Ported to Sega Genesis
title.body:
Way back in 1987 Capcom released a game called Black Tiger in arcades. Fans are actively working on porting Black Tiger to the Sega Genesis using the Scorpion Engine. Interestingly, they are using the arcade original sprites and artwork for this port meaning this is going to be visually impressive and likely play well.

First Time on a Sega Console

For whatever reason, Black Tiger was never ported to the Sega Genesis, either by Sega who were keen on Capcom arcade games on Genesis, nor by Capcom themselves later. Likely Capcom passed on a port because by the time they were a 3rd party licensee on Genesis, that did not happen until around 1993. By then Black Tiger was probably considered “old” or at least too old for a costly port. [According to Indie Retro News]( https://www.indieretronews.com/2026/05/black-tiger-capcoms-brilliant-1987.html) that did not stop companies from porting Black Tiger to computers such as the Commodore Amiga, Atari ST, etc. It seems the Atari ST version is the one to avoid out of the computer ports. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=utvIpHjE2s8

Arcade Gaming With Console Niceties

It was not all that common in 1987 for arcade games to offer shops and things. Those were often relegated to home gaming on computers or consoles. Black Tiger features other home gaming niceties such as sprawling levels, again, most arcade games of the time were more focused on moving to the right and attack till you lose all your lives and pay up with more quarters. Games that featured large levels to explore meant more playtime per quarter and that is simply not the business model of arcades of the time. Turnover and getting quarters was the name of the arcade game. Check out Black Tiger and if it is in your wheelhouse, get ready for the first 16-Bit home console port. For me, it looks interesting and I enjoy this style of game quite a bit so I will definitely be covering it as it continues development.

title.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you had a happy and blessed start to the week. Today I want to show you the makeup I wore for the concert. It was a special night and deserved beautiful makeup. I hope you like it. \n

> Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta nueva oportunidad , espero hayan tenido un feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, hoy quiero presentarles el maquillaja que use para el concierto , era una noche especial se merecia un bonito maquillaje espero les guste ![IMG_9245.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/243M5Mpd2RcpAkQYJFCiMZCyA1gpsrRrZnbq61JqyRecVxBiNR1UvUh8J8GvbQGnYVDSf.jpeg)

> The first step is to cleanse and moisturize my face, then I start my makeup with my eyebrows. For this, I apply glycerin soap and shape my eyebrows. Now I work on my eyelid, adding brown concealer because I wanted a smoky brown look. Then I set it with a slightly darker brown eyeshadow. Now I apply black eyeliner to add more drama to my eyes. \n

> el primer paso es limpiar e hidratar el rostro, luego comienzo con mi maquillaje por las cejas para esto aplico jabon de glicerina y le doy la forma a mis cejas , ahora trabajo en el parpado , agrego corrector café porque quería unos smoke con café , luego lo sello con un café en sombras un poco más oscuro ahora realizo el delineado en color negro para darle más drama a mis ojos ![EECE700A-6CB0-41D1-AD03-CCCA9678B8C1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AJhYzyZUjDEGSfmDEu1YSrNpioGjxmWmsG1AgLdkKCjsycuLiso9hepYYA9gFpZ.jpeg)

> Now I apply foundation and blend it, then I apply brown concealer to my nose and cheekbones and blend it. Next, I apply concealer to the under-eye area and blend it. Then I set everything with pressed powder, dark concealer, and blush. In the inner corner of my eye, I blend black, and on the waterline, I apply black and blend it with a deep brown. I also add a little fairy powder to my eyelids. \n

¡Hola, @fabrizziose!

Me encanta esa caja. Me trae recuerdos de cuando en secundaria me tocó armar sólidos para la clase de mineralogía. Desde pirámides y cubos hasta estrellas en tres dimensiones.  Días recortando y pegando, pero al final me pidieron, no que los pintara, sino que los parafinara para que se conservaran. 
Sumergirlos en parafina de velas derretidas fue lo más tedioso, pero la verdad disfruté cortando y pegando aquellos modelos geométricos de nombres que ya no recuerdo.

Buena suerte y éxito en los estudios.

title.title: Kermit's cousins
title.body:
It had been a while since I saw these cool creatures in nature, without counting with the tiny one in a friend's garden this last weekend. So, why not showcase them in a #monomad post? The creatures in question are a fascinating group, with almost 8000 species worldwide. And no, they won't harm you, unless you try to lick them.
![111.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/23u6NFZBH7u6ePZ8Rsbyh5J7AioSe492KH6QMJ61e7CNAcb1Hvrq1V65rTJiMKkVNKphd.JPG)
Yes, I'm serious. *Thow shall not lick frogs or toads*. First, it's kind of common sense - some species have special glands with a foul taste to avoid predation; besides, it's unlikely they will be attracted to you, so you would be kind of harassing the poor creatures.
![333.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoK5pgZ7Mg4uAvUrEPVnNPww2ess7NwqmR1AS7gA2EGn1s7qe5cU2iTDP2b2nY9KAx8.JPG)
And if you ignore my advice and grab one like this cutie on the picture above, it might be the last thing you'll do. Might as well leave them alone, and enjoy the luck of finding them on your nature walks.
![222.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoAaJwmL4sjA9vpq17AxsVhb11fV5LgzB4y9xypc4hozxUsgAGptARYGspvjsaGH6TH.JPG)
Amphibians normally have a slimy skin, and that slime provides protection, so touching them with your bare hands also doesn't work: nothing bad would come to you, but damaging the protective barrier could mean death to them. If you need to grab them (for relocation, for example), use a moist cloth, or wetted gloves.
![444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/EoEq1DpCsETPdvCbfBn3qke8CScQtpbRY1CzK4Cbpigg9qXsss2LVECumdgAvmPiwyJ.jpg)
The warts all over the body tell you this one is a toad, although scientifically speaking, all toads are frogs. And no, you can't touch toads either.
![555.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pardinus/23u6Ba4BSuDoz8cLEKd9LDHGNxaBazQdYPsU9R5hgPcSJmnWBdPwqVnNUBku8fEFCqB86.JPG)
As a general rule when encountering wildlife, I heard a rule a long time ago that I cherish; I learned it during a diving course, but it works with creatures above and below sea level. It's something like this: *if it's too beautiful, too ugly, or doesn't run away when you get close... don't touch it!!!* In fact, you never know if the creature in question has a short temper, and decides to teach you a lesson. You never know what might be lurking out there... waiting and plotting a revenge!

title.title: The Ominous Medical Wing.
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=lazybug/nso7hgsp

<center><sup>The thumbnail was created in Canva.</sup></center>

<div class=\

>

After cleansing a point, I fought Hiss soldiers and floating entities before a sniper took me down. Following a restart, I visited the Wall of Honor and analyzed trapped enemies in photo mode at a security checkpoint. I then progressed to the medical wing, where Hiss shields and grenades forced another restart before a security level 6 door blocked my path.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJ5BgVYVKeFN3ht743vzMkV2qfPPXadxwjitFwPaJ6uA/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbpAyZXsXoYTHfyL8vh9MkTbWUeR5aLxj6PkAbqGSw3gU/screenshot_2_.png)

After cleansing the last point, I still had to find Dylan, but some Hiss soldiers, along with those floating entities around that cleanse zone, came around, so I had to fight them first.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd4MwqvZUnDwSvpFDscWoG7gerEeKuNvLSBAocXde8j2v/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWzZp4VchtieEeeJi4YNiTBCCqJSam9ng7r4h5zsM3mgR/screenshot_4_.png)

Suddenly, I noticed a sniper was shooting at me from afar, so I took cover behind that door, and when I went back to shoot that enemy, I was taken down by that sniper or someone else.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjuRokK61UWMkgqnSjAqnh2TYvGjf5XKrTc5q4TsTetn/screenshot_5_.png)

I didn't want to fight those enemies at the restart, so I just moved ahead and found this wall of honor, which was set in memory of the heroic agents who gave their lives to forces, known and unknown, for the protection and greater knowledge of all humankind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVh6nWB8MByiYiNtgL36kyc8jZ1JkAyMSongVKSzwpqJM/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2yH8kyohXCZ2UmSy7K7DFDj8U1gWKaNsHb4Gefx4TPj/screenshot_7_.png)

Well, then I reached this security check center where a handful of floating entities ambushed me, but they couldn't get to me, as there were some locked doors between us.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNbzVhxgbKaDPu7dbT2a5oVupUEaMU1eFviS2ngYqnajn/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJtiWgVk8FBpEURhTGsJxmGFBmrMmsX8xt5W6taQVBnm/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdnfX1iwjnmtvnpf2RDkJvM8rRCNNMoT8VzZ25CMA4RBa/screenshot_10_.png)

Taking that chance, I used the photo mode to check on them from a close-up, and I found that they are regular people who got bent backwards, and they can now float around having evil power.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPpsKks3jidmaBknDNHwEUagjgLcy4XrM1oD8coXmmzs/screenshot_11_.png)

After shooting down all those enemies, I was trying to open that gate, and I even passed that walkthrough metal detector, but the gate was not opening anyhow.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT8C1XXyGhG72vqocBNGB6DA8sfJSXjUSDHQL3F55C1YA/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPekKptFBbtJUq7Hf9zMLwTSrPaX1KHYUhR53fd6qNpsF/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNyFVYnykMtEXCPee6hLPRsWti9yMhdV7eFhjnJJX3HH6/screenshot_14_.png)

I came back, and I noticed there was an alternative way that goes to the medical wing, but after reaching the medical wing, I found the place was even scarier, with more Hiss soldiers who had shields around them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR37JdGprKtAHBMfiY4pjWu2FaeWFXH1qxvrjEafF9UJ8/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcpwUz2a8nbqE9B6ZAMbKyTMazeUmDMhKFV3SwaUU2u1/screenshot_16_.png)

I took cover behind some concrete, and I started shooting them, but they were throwing grenades toward me, and at last they overpowered me and killed me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6pkqffx6F2ER8S3GTDRx7AacguJ4CbjhfQThRw8prC2/screenshot_17_.png)

At the restart, I took all those enemies down first, and then I reached this part where I needed clearance level 6 to open up a door, but I didn't have this, so I had to try the alternative way that was blocked.

**To be Continued...**
