title.title: [EN/PT] What's Your Side Income?
title.body:
>

# [EN]

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhuAfDvZ86JqTRXAb6L5xca4gQ8gN3BHNqoHugyRj3nKfuSzT6JZQuAL1gSie6qLQwN.png)

# Hello Hive Community!

Year after year, the cost of living keeps rising all over the world, and you've probably already felt the effects of inflation on your wallet. To maintain their standard of living, many people have been looking for ways to earn extra income.

With the internet and the many apps available today, it's possible to make money in several different ways. Not too long ago, this was usually only possible by working two or more jobs. Nowadays, the internet is a place where a lot of money circulates, and you can grab a small piece of it by becoming part of this ecosystem.

<center>![rochelle.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tmBKsDVJbQUaVFaGW9kpzugyauh9SP5L7cwELathYXYc1cfNdA9Mur43kxKrGr7DhsY.gif)</center><center><sub>[src](https://ogostomeu.wordpress.com/2019/10/04/bvndit-nao-precisa-trabalhar-porque-a-chungha-tem-dois-empregos/)</sub></center>

Every month when I go grocery shopping, I get the same feeling: things that used to cost X now cost X plus a little more. It's amazing how inflation gradually erodes our purchasing power, and before we realize it, we're forced to switch to lower-quality products and services. At least here in Brazil, a country that has historically lived with relatively high accumulated inflation, though still under control... for now 😅.

Everyone here on Hive has at least one source of extra income: Hive itself. It's undeniable that the platform is attractive because it allows users to earn rewards through content creation. Perhaps that's why it's so popular in countries with weaker economies. Although Hive has been affected by the cryptocurrency bear market, many users continue posting and earning rewards on the platform.

Putting Hive aside for a moment, I'd like to hear about other income sources. Besides creating content in Web3, do you have any side income? If so, what is it?

# Freelance Work

Everyone has some skill that can be turned into extra income. For example, I worked as an electrician for many years in a company. This profession opened many doors for me, and from time to time I still take on some residential and industrial electrical installation jobs.

However, since it's a job that requires physical presence and constant effort, I've gradually moved away from it. On top of that, people usually want the work completed as quickly as possible. The income from this type of work was good, but nowadays it's no longer a viable option for me because my job and studies leave me with very little free time.

# Affiliate Programs

The internet is full of people selling courses that supposedly teach you how to make money online. The problem is that many of these courses end up teaching nothing more than how to sell other courses, and the only person really making money is the course creator.

Nowadays, one popular alternative is joining affiliate programs from platforms such as Mercado Livre, Shopee, TikTok Shop, and similar marketplaces. However, success requires strategy. Having a social media account with many followers helps a lot, and some people even use automation tools to boost sales.

From what I've seen some of my friends doing, the earnings can be quite impressive. However, this market has become highly saturated, requiring time, dedication, and some investment in paid advertising.

# YouTube Channel

With the rise of AI, many people created automated channels powered by artificial intelligence and managed to earn a considerable amount of money. However, YouTube has started restricting certain types of content generated exclusively by AI.

I've never really wanted to create videos for YouTube because I'm not someone who enjoys being in front of a camera. Even so, producing content for the platform remains an interesting way to earn extra income. I constantly see new channels appearing out of nowhere, which suggests there's still plenty of opportunity in this market.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23uQfcHvYa7sdpBE9QhMyGcvLz21T5crtjsu3KmepQKFCAaHjxpKmpcbRwQQAhpsdSWKN.png)</center><center><sub>[src](https://janela.com.br/2025/09/16/youtube-anuncia-expansao-da-plataforma-para-o-brasil/)</sub></center>

# Cutting Expenses

But it's not always a season of abundance. Today, practically all of my extra income sources have disappeared. Besides that, all of them required a significant amount of time and energy.

Because of that, my strategy shifted toward cutting expenses and reducing unnecessary spending. My wife and I used to go out for lunch every weekend. Now we only do that once a month.

I also used to buy snacks and treats every morning at work. Nowadays, I prepare my coffee at home and bring it with me, which is healthier and, of course, much cheaper.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xL15WZufnrjLPGXLbPuiWhacifrgWX2JKhx6qyVFJYx2Scwz8geejmCKabNHB8fqYhC.png)</center><center><sub>Canva</sub></center>

Although this isn't technically \

the result is practically the same: more money left over at the end of the month, whether to invest or to spend on things we truly want, such as traveling or buying something special.

Lately, I've realized that I had been consuming far more than necessary. I spent money on many things purchased online—some useful, others not so much. Now I'm cutting back on those expenses and trying to pay off my credit card balances completely.

# **I even joked with my friend @shiftrox about heading to the highway to work as male escorts in search of extra income—after all, life has been pretty tough lately 😂**

<center>![peter-griffin-prostitute.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EokgxCPnGE2fAc539k9DsUUAMhBUZt3i1CkpjBbSBjUhhK7esmLCQeUErcR6hbLSpJP.gif)</center>

# What about you? Do you have any source of extra income? If so, what is it?




![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTis9tBwkQSipYNmc4xL6zDFhHVpFwuDhyu4hJzCfqQrUa8.gif)



# [PT]

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhuAfDvZ86JqTRXAb6L5xca4gQ8gN3BHNqoHugyRj3nKfuSzT6JZQuAL1gSie6qLQwN.png)

# Olá, Comunidade Hive!

Ano após ano, o custo de vida tem aumentado em todo o mundo, e provavelmente você já sentiu os efeitos da inflação no seu bolso. Para tentar manter o padrão de vida, muitas pessoas têm buscado formas de obter uma renda extra.

Com a internet e os diversos aplicativos disponíveis atualmente, é possível ganhar dinheiro de várias maneiras. Até algum tempo atrás, isso geralmente só era possível trabalhando em dois ou mais empregos. Hoje, a internet é um lugar onde circula muito dinheiro, e você pode conquistar uma pequena fatia dele participando desse ecossistema.

<center>![rochelle.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tmBKsDVJbQUaVFaGW9kpzugyauh9SP5L7cwELathYXYc1cfNdA9Mur43kxKrGr7DhsY.gif)</center><center><sub>[src](https://ogostomeu.wordpress.com/2019/10/04/bvndit-nao-precisa-trabalhar-porque-a-chungha-tem-dois-empregos/)</sub></center>

Todo mês faço minhas compras de mercado e tenho a mesma sensação: aquilo que antes custava X agora custa X mais alguma coisa. É impressionante como a inflação vai reduzindo nosso poder de compra e, quando percebemos, somos obrigados a migrar para produtos e serviços cada vez piores. Pelo menos no Brasil, país que historicamente convive com uma inflação acumulada relativamente alta, mas ainda controlada... por enquanto 😅.

Todos aqui na Hive possuem ao menos uma fonte de renda extra: a própria Hive. É inegável que a plataforma possui um grande atrativo ao permitir que usuários obtenham renda por meio da criação de conteúdo. Talvez por isso ela seja tão popular em países com economias mais frágeis. Embora atualmente esteja sofrendo com a baixa do mercado de criptomoedas, muitos usuários continuam publicando e recebendo recompensas na plataforma.

Deixando a Hive de lado, gostaria de saber sobre outras fontes de renda. Além da criação de conteúdo na Web3, você possui alguma fonte de renda extra? Se sim, qual?

# Profissional Autônomo

Todo mundo possui alguma habilidade que pode ser transformada em renda extra. Eu, por exemplo, trabalhei durante muitos anos como eletricista em uma empresa. Essa profissão me abriu diversas portas e, ocasionalmente, ainda realizo alguns serviços extras de instalações residenciais e industriais.

Porém, como é um trabalho que exige presença física e esforço constante, fui deixando essa atividade de lado aos poucos. Além disso, as pessoas geralmente querem que o serviço seja executado o mais rápido possível. A renda proveniente desse tipo de trabalho era boa, mas atualmente não é uma opção para mim, pois meu emprego e meus estudos não me deixam com tempo disponível.

# Aplicativos de Afiliados

A internet está cheia de pessoas vendendo cursos para ensinar a ganhar dinheiro online. O problema é que muitos desses cursos acabam ensinando apenas como vender outros cursos, e quem realmente ganha dinheiro é o próprio vendedor.

Atualmente, uma alternativa bastante explorada é o programa de afiliados de plataformas como Mercado Livre, Shopee, TikTok Shop e outros aplicativos semelhantes. No entanto, é necessário ter estratégia. Ter uma conta com muitos seguidores ajuda bastante, e algumas pessoas utilizam ferramentas de automação para aumentar as vendas.

Pelo que vejo alguns colegas fazendo, os ganhos podem ser muito altos. Porém, hoje esse mercado está bastante saturado, exigindo tempo, dedicação e algum investimento em anúncios pagos.

# Canal no YouTube

Com a popularização das IAs, muitas pessoas criaram canais automatizados utilizando inteligência artificial e conseguiram faturar uma boa quantia. No entanto, o YouTube passou a restringir alguns formatos de conteúdo gerados exclusivamente por IA.

Eu nunca tive vontade de criar vídeos para o YouTube, pois não sou uma pessoa que gosta de aparecer diante das câmeras. Mesmo assim, produzir conteúdo para a plataforma continua sendo uma forma interessante de ganhar uma renda extra. Vejo muitos canais surgindo do nada, o que mostra que ainda existe bastante potencial nesse mercado.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23uQfcHvYa7sdpBE9QhMyGcvLz21T5crtjsu3KmepQKFCAaHjxpKmpcbRwQQAhpsdSWKN.png)</center><center><sub>[src](https://janela.com.br/2025/09/16/youtube-anuncia-expansao-da-plataforma-para-o-brasil/)</sub></center>


# Redução de Custos

Mas nem sempre estamos em tempos de vacas gordas. Hoje, praticamente todas as minhas fontes de renda extra desapareceram. Além disso, todas elas exigiam bastante tempo e energia.

Diante disso, minha estratégia passou a ser cortar gastos e reduzir despesas. Antes, minha esposa e eu saíamos para almoçar fora todos os finais de semana. Agora fazemos isso apenas uma vez por mês.

Também costumava comprar alguma besteira para comer pela manhã no trabalho. Hoje preparo meu café em casa e levo comigo, o que é mais saudável e, obviamente, mais econômico.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xL15WZufnrjLPGXLbPuiWhacifrgWX2JKhx6qyVFJYx2Scwz8geejmCKabNHB8fqYhC.png)
</center><center><sub>Canva</sub></center>

Apesar de não ser uma \

propriamente dita, o resultado é praticamente o mesmo: sobra mais dinheiro no fim do mês, seja para investir, seja para gastar com coisas que realmente desejamos, como viagens ou algum produto especial. Ultimamente percebi que estava consumindo de forma exagerada. Gastei dinheiro com muitas coisas compradas pela internet, algumas úteis e outras nem tanto. Agora estou reduzindo esses gastos e tentando zerar as faturas do cartão de crédito. # **Eu até cogitei com meu amigo @shiftrox a ir para rodovia rodar bolsinha e vender o corpo, em busca de renda extra, afinal a vida está muito difícil 😂**
![peter-griffin-prostitute.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EokgxCPnGE2fAc539k9DsUUAMhBUZt3i1CkpjBbSBjUhhK7esmLCQeUErcR6hbLSpJP.gif)
# E você? Possui alguma fonte de renda extra? Se sim, qual? --- **Se chegou até aqui muito obrigado pelo seu tempo e se de alguma forma este conteudo foi útil, deixe seu upvote e reblog!** ___ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tw426MWpq8fAr4TjRAatv8RwXWtzcP357eShoipfuxkE1BHsWcWEbp8254ifYYmqBjS.png)](https://discord.gg/zYcJfq7tdQ) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-whats-your-side-income-5vm)

title.title: Urban Rush -  B&W PHOTOGRAPHY - from São Paulo - Brasil II ENG - PT_BR II ( 10 Shots )
title.body:
![TEMPLATE ART ALIEN HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/48XBajXLpVSr2e6meRLCrSMFx7Vkg4HQDUWbH2hCJZjyezJV1Agtayzh7BFDUJYsof.jpg)








Another entrance facing the street. Another one of those days when I go out without a defined destination, but with my eyes attentive to everything happening around me. The street has that quality: it never stops. As we walk, we realize that each person who crosses our path is carrying a story, a worry, a dream, or a goal that perhaps no one else knows.




> Mais uma entrada de cara com a rua. Mais um daqueles dias em que eu saio sem destino definido, mas com os olhos atentos para tudo que acontece ao redor. A rua tem dessas coisas: ela nunca para. Enquanto a gente caminha, percebe que cada pessoa que cruza o nosso caminho está carregando uma história, uma preocupação, um sonho ou uma meta que talvez ninguém conheça.
------------------------













![_MG_2796pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wMctWKzLpYovzYHKSRGQQ2nsupgvNsJYN7fLHiBecvzNVtdfc5AME34QDGX5m2RjWac.jpg)












📷 **01.** / Canon EOS 60D





















![_MG_2983pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xKt8RzD4Ykc3rUUNcGr88zuwKKGcGKafFoYBVmE9Uk5fACURpV67KSc4ugnP3DqaRDd.jpg)





📷 **02.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

The truth is that most people are rushing to achieve their goals. Chasing money, to be honest. People going to work, returning from a tiring shift, rushing to close a deal, study, start a business, or simply provide for their families. Every face that passes has a silent battle raging behind it.



> A verdade é que a maioria está na correria atrás dos seus objetivos. Atrás do money, para falar a real. Gente indo para o trabalho, voltando de um turno cansativo, correndo para fechar um negócio, estudar, empreender ou simplesmente garantir o sustento de casa. Cada rosto que passa tem uma batalha silenciosa acontecendo por trás.
-----------------------


















![_MG_3089.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23x19TS3oAMbTsBi3smawNunJ7JoUtCbp5Zb8YgR19D592WewX7ckJfx5FAnxjbwSSJhE.JPG)






📷 **03.**  / Canon EOS 60D
























![_MG_3201pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xKt8RzD1bQBngQgUMvFYLDcEhERsoCJFS758Hg8rktt5aBCD4Qo6i2rmGTt5vr7N8Mm.jpg)





📷 **04.**  / Canon EOS 60D





















![_MG_3238pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xeX4PA6QmqmVpjBUSmkzhFjshZr2TKRgL6DerovtK7WcDhV1kEidgDufUmFNxYiUMur.jpg)




📷 **05.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

That's what catches my attention when I photograph the street. It's not just buildings, cars, or urban scenery. It's the people and the energy they carry. The desire to grow, to evolve, to achieve something better than yesterday. Even amidst the chaos, the traffic, the noise, and the rush, there is a collective force that moves the city every day.



> É isso que me chama atenção quando fotografo a rua. Não são apenas prédios, carros ou cenários urbanos. São as pessoas e a energia que elas carregam. A vontade de crescer, de evoluir, de conquistar algo melhor do que ontem. Mesmo em meio ao caos, ao trânsito, ao barulho e à pressa, existe uma força coletiva que move a cidade todos os dias.
------------------------















![_MG_3253pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wWxriuLMmsbQUJ4mpcodyPkEiLV4W8VFGR233msQD62QR8d1gRtJjeLJs3DgCjnm25j.jpg)



📷 **06.**  / Canon EOS 60D




While many see only another crowded sidewalk, I see hundreds of stories unfolding simultaneously. Dreams being built step by step, goals being pursued, and lives being shaped by everyday experiences. And perhaps that's precisely what makes me return to the street whenever I can: the opportunity to freeze for a moment all this never-ending movement.

> Enquanto muitos enxergam apenas mais uma calçada cheia, eu vejo centenas de histórias acontecendo ao mesmo tempo. Sonhos sendo construídos passo a passo, metas sendo perseguidas e vidas sendo moldadas pelas experiências do cotidiano. E talvez seja justamente isso que me faça voltar para a rua sempre que posso: a oportunidade de congelar por um instante toda essa movimentação que nunca para.












![_MG_3267pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xAXWDDPVVUu9htSfnWn8NEikri7nfai9j4N1QX4xpCq58f38EV3x2QRvL7c7zjvdK7H.jpg)




📷 **07.**  / Canon EOS 60D























![_MG_3285pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23tc1MVGi7ZBLDt63E959bBsiNP7EJqJAh4hdsxTT1FWXkeHXwSR9HLDdA4GFK25Z2cdy.jpg)








📷 **08.**  / Canon EOS 60D





------------------------
Each click ends up being more than just a photograph. It's a small snapshot of real life. A record of ordinary people doing extraordinary things: persisting, believing, and moving forward, even when no one is watching.



> Cada clique acaba sendo mais do que uma fotografia. É um pequeno recorte da vida real. Um registro de pessoas comuns fazendo coisas extraordinárias: persistindo, acreditando e seguindo em frente, mesmo quando ninguém está olhando.

------------------------



















![_MG_3361pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23u6BQYo85v31sS8esWJoU9JegubPwULHT3bn41LG5FAYjRu1JdfQDTaDrFGdR9oAxRz1.jpg)

title.title: Tioman Island 2026 刁曼島2026 #6
title.body:
Here comes the exciting part. I can't swim, but I already have snorkeling experience many years ago. The difference is, many years ago I was healthy and we didn't bring kids to the snorkeling trip. This time around, I do not know how my body would react under the water. I can't tell if I'm overly excited about having NOT wearing glasses but I can see the coral clearly under the water, or if I am worry about if my body can adapt, what about the kids?

> 雖然我是個旱鴨子，但好歹多年前也有過浮潛的經驗。只不過，當年的我身體還算健壯，而且那時候出遊還沒帶上家裡的小魔怪。這一次，我心裡其實挺沒底的，不知道自己的身體在水底下會有什麼反應。我也說不清楚自己到底是太興奮（因為不戴眼鏡居然能在水底把珊瑚看得一清二楚），還是太擔心自己的身體吃不消，順便還要操心家裡的那兩隻小魔怪？

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6KsDuh3fEqRiYVdZDiRy5fJzw1LBHVy5VuXYpYacjbA/1780932322423.jpg)

I woke up wayyyyyy too damn early sitting at the balcony so I don't disturb the family too much. The more I am trying to NOT think, the more ideas of how to die at a snorkeling trip came to attack me 😅 added with the most recent Maldives cave diving incident \

the entire social media platforms, it's hard to not think about how the victim's family felt. The sunrise picture was taken after hours of mosquito feeding session at the balcony.

> 結果，老子大清早、真的是太太太早醒來了。為了不打擾家裡那幾位「大爺」，我只好一個人坐在陽台發呆。人就是這樣，越努力叫自己不要胡思亂想，腦袋就越是不爭氣，各種「浮潛的一百種死法」排山倒海地在腦海裡開片😅。再加上最近網上鋪天蓋地都是馬爾代夫洞穴潛水的意外新聞，想不聯想到遇難者家屬的心情都很難。這張日出照片，就是我用肉身在陽台餵了幾十隻蚊子、挨了好幾個小時才拍到的心血結晶。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGcmacVBitgrweUGGKLTgFtFLUQGcofjxGZGKJj68Ehw/1780932322519.jpg)

After prepping the family, and then we headed to the Barat restaurant for a quick breakfast. We ordered two sets of breakfast so the 4 of us can share. This will be the first time the kids riding on a boat going out for snorkeling. We wouldn't want these kids become sea sick. Barfing out at the open sea whilst others snorkeling nearby isn't really a good impression 😂 and guess what, we're going to be on the same boat for half a day. We really don't want the fishes nor the passengers to know what we had for breakfast, so we keep our fuel level at minimum.

> 好不容易把全家人伺候好，我們便出發去 Barat 餐廳隨便塞點麵包填飽肚子。我們只點了兩份早餐，四個人分著吃。這可是家裡那兩隻小魔怪第一次坐船出海浮潛，我們可不想他們搞到暈船浪。要是別人在旁邊快快樂樂地浮潛，他們在公海上「湯」（嘔吐），那畫面太美我不敢看，印象分直接扣光 😂。而且你想想看，我們可是要在同一條船上呆足足半天。我們真的不想讓海裡的魚、還有同船的乘客知道我們早餐吃了什麼，所以還是把「燃油量」保持在最低水平就好。

----

Wait?! Where are the bikinis? Well, instruction from home minister to NOT bring our phones. Her argument being, no signal coverage at the sea. Risk of losing the phone is great. The seal pouch couldn't survive underwater pressure. So, here's the explanation and the entire snorkeling experience were all documented in my brain. I can try to describe a few things here, but you'll be calling me BS, believe it or not, so I'm just going to tell you some mental picture that you will NOT believe.

1. We have a total of 19 passengers (including 2 operator and tour guide), in a 12 passenger boat 😂
2. After \

many other people's wife, I like my home minister's body most 😂
3. Unfortunately, the stroke causes balancing problems extended to the water. Every time when I try to move forward, my body wll be automatically roll to the right 😂 the more I try to fight it, the more I do barrel roll. If I don't fight it, spread my arms apart, I can at least face down for a short period of time and see some corals, but that eventually becomes boring after sme 5 minutes soaking my face on the same place saying hi to the same fishes.
4. I insist to jump into the water on all 5 snorkeling spot so the RM160 trip doesn't go to waste.
5. The best snorkeling location, is the nearest to where we stayed 😂 I think with the property sorkeling gear, floats and fins, we can already float our way to these coral reefs.

> 等等？！你們一定會問：說好的比基尼呢？唉，這全靠我家「母老虎」下達的最高指示——不准帶手機出海！她的理由很充分：海上面又沒有信號，手機弄丟的風險還大得要命，萬一那防水袋頂不住水壓就直接報銷。所以啦，別問了，整個浮潛的精彩畫面，全都一滴不漏地記錄在我的「腦袋瓜」裡了。我可以在這裡跟你們吹一下水，但不管信不信，你們大概都會覺得我在扯淡，所以我就隨便分享幾個你們絕對不信的「腦袋畫面」吧：
>  1. 我們這條船，原本限載 12 人，最後竟然塞了 19 個人（包括兩位船員兼導遊），簡直是神蹟 😂。
 > 2. 在「讀」了那麼多別人的老婆之後，我發現我還是最欣賞我家母老虎的身材 😂。
>  3. 遺憾的是，之前中風留下來的平衡障礙，竟然也跟著我下水了。每當我試著想往前游，我的身體就會自動自覺向右邊來個「側滾翻」 😂。我越是用力去跟它對抗，就翻滾得越厲害（直接變桶滾動作）。後來我索性不掙扎了，把雙手攤開，唉，好歹還能面向下趴在海面上泡個 5 分鐘，看看底下的珊瑚。不過，一直泡在同一個地方、對著同一批魚打招呼，很快就悶了。
 > 4. 雖然身體不聽使喚，但我依然堅持在全部 5 個浮潛點都跳下水去，畢竟 160 塊大洋的船費，總不能虧給他吧！
 > 5. 最好笑的是，最漂亮的浮潛點，竟然就是我們住的附近 😂。我看只要裝備齊全、套上救生衣和蛙鞋，我們自己都能一路飄到那片珊瑚礁去。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeESWAjpEMVEr3WCoBMaGvATxNxbHpkMXU1YbNG8gY5gQ/1780932322597.jpg)

After the snorkeling trip, we are super hungry since we didn't eat much in the morning. We went to take a shower and proceed to Island Station for ultra late lunch. The girl got herself the usual fired chicken rice meal.

> 浮潛完回來，因為早上一肚子空空，大家簡直餓到要吃人。衝進浴室洗了個痛快澡後，我們便直奔 Island Station 去吃一頓「超級遲」的午餐。我家閨女點了她雷打不動的老樣—炸雞飯。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXt1sLntBC5mpiv9sSnC4QZrp2cpxnEFX6anE1Z7n4zZK/1780932322679.jpg)

Boy got himself the chicken mayo sandwich. Funnily, on the first day of our arrival, thechicken mayo was NOT toasted.

> 兒子則點了一份美乃滋雞肉三明治。搞笑的是，我們第一天到的時候，這款三明治的麵包竟然是沒有烘過的。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAyZbnYEybp3K3AmAHwDEQZQoJctWr7e4HhHpvKirnbD/1780932322745.jpg)

After the Bihun Ladna experience the day before, I decided to go deeper, trying their Chinese style Kung Fu Kuey Teow(deep fried flat noodles on egg brothe). Once again, they surprise me by deep frying the flat noodles INTO the egg wash. That makes it a rice noodle omelette 😂 it's absolutely nothing like Chinese style yo, but surprisingly tasty.

> 有了前一天吃「馬來式廣府米粉」（Bihun Ladna）的驚嚇體驗，這天我決定深入虎穴，試試他們的「中式廣府炒粿條」（Kung Fu Kuey Teow）。不出所料，他們再次驚艷了我,他們竟然把粿條直接丟進蛋液裡一起去油炸！這哪裡是廣府炒，這簡直是「粿條煎蛋餅」 😂。雖然味道跟正宗的中式廣府炒完全不沾邊，但居然出奇地好吃，算他過關。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYNDCt2a1WMiUcqWgT7KQzBKkQSFQ2m94Qq1swnRfk6cT/1780932381052.jpg)

We also ordered an omelette to share. I cant tell if it's any different than two days ago when we had dinner, but it's still surely the best in the island 😂 better than our resort restaurant!

> 我們還加點了一份煎蛋一起分。雖然分不出跟兩天前晚餐吃的那份有什麼差別，但它絕對是這座島上水準最高的煎蛋了 😂，比我們度假村自家餐廳做的好吃幾百倍！

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQbV351MQWQ6m5v1k6bbBBWk8m2yLHrLpBXU76hjCo4Y/1780932381176.jpg)

Home minister got herself a Kampung fried rice. This is a typical Malaysian style fried rice. Kampung means Village. Since we're in Kampung Juara, the champion village, it's good to have a village fried rice hat came with anchovies and chicken cubes. According to her, marvelous. Apologize on the cucumber whom got beaten before the camera sets in.

> 我家母老虎則點了一份甘榜炒飯（Kampung Fried Rice）。這是非常地道的大馬風味，Kampung 就是鄉村的意思。既然我們身在「冠軍村」（Kampung Juara），來一盤加了江魚仔和雞肉丁的鄉村炒飯自然最應景。據她本人評價：味道一絕。至於照片裡那幾片在相機定焦前就被偷吃了一半的小黃瓜，我就在這裡向大家賠個不是啦。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdcYQ57PMwj8rE5xLN9A4iqcDVn84fXjP75tHSkWyLney/1780932381243.jpg)

After the late lunch, home minister finally ran out of battery, she had to hit the sack for recharge, so as my boy. The girl decided to go visit those cats at Tamara after seeing my photograph. And later on we found a new resort hotel Mutiara Beach Resort, which was closed down a couple of years ago during the lockdown. The premises is restored and have a brand spanking new double storey hotel by the beach. What caught our attention was the food menu. From here, we decided this will be our last breakfast in the island, which is the following day.

> 這頓遲來的午餐吃完，母老虎的電量終於徹底耗盡，不得不回房「充電」見周公，兒子也跟著一起去睡午覺。閨女看過我拍的照片後，決定獨自跑去 Tamara 探望那幾隻可愛的貓咪。晚些時候，我們在海灘邊發現了一家新裝修的度假酒店Mutiara Beach Resort。據說它在幾年前疫情封鎖期間倒閉了，如今重新翻修，變成了一座全新的兩層海景酒店。最吸引我們眼球的是他們的菜單，當下我們就決定，明天在島上的最後一頓早餐，就在這裡解決了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYaSXVw3LKYZT4XmWL6hXMAFarRuAuVbQYcT2obgygW5J/1780932381313.jpg)

The sky went dark quite quickly, the girl doesn't feel too well after blasting by the sea water splashes during the snorkeling trip, so I sent her back to take rest. Me and son watch TV for a while before I set my foot out to find food again.

> 天色暗得比想象中快。閨女在浮潛時被海浪無情地拍打摧殘，身體開始有點不舒服，我便趕緊送她回房休息。我和兒子在房間看了會電視，眼看肚子又開始打鼓，我只好再次移步出去覓食。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKTJNitNuFcMjUUhn29C1skGH6xJuQKmnNdvJJ2Vb5cX/1780932381359.jpg)

Many of the restaurants remain closed because of Eid Ul-Adhar celebration. So I ended up with more getting burgers from once again, Island Station. I think I can eat in this place for as long as I am staying in Juara Village. I've got us one burger each, and later more cup noodles fr supper and that's the final night we spent in Tioman Island.

> 因為正逢哈芝節（Eid Ul-Adha）慶典，島上很多餐廳都關門休息。轉了一圈，最後我還是回到 Island Station 打包漢堡。我想，只要我繼續住在甘榜朱阿拉，我大概可以天天吃這家都不會厭。我給每人打包了一個漢堡，晚點再泡幾杯杯麵當宵夜，這就是我們在刁曼島度過的最後一個夜晚了。

title.title: XRP Evolves Beyond Remittance: XRPL Targets Institutional Tokenization of Stocks, Funds, and Credit Markets
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPEWWRGBNHeH1bHTvKS2ei2i1ksu3YRLSqgX3G3uuP2nF/xrpl.png 


For years, critics have pigeonholed XRP as nothing more than a cross-border payment utility. That short-sighted narrative is officially dead. David Schwartz, Ripple’s CTO Emeritus and a co-creator of the XRP Ledger (XRPL), recently clarified that the network's ecosystem is executing a massive structural shift. The architecture of XRPL is no longer restricted to simple value transfers; it is moving directly into institutional-grade decentralized finance (DeFi) via Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization.

Schwartz highlighted that while Bitcoin established the primitive model of public ledger transfers, XRPL was built to issue and manage both native assets and arbitrary tokenized value. Enterprises are already deploying tokenized assets on the network, but the immediate pipeline includes money market funds, fractionalized stocks, and traditional securities. This is not speculative retail froth—this is infrastructure designed to migrate trillions of dollars of traditional capital onto blockchain rails.

The integration goes deeper than ownership tracking. XRPL is preparing to roll out complex credit machinery, specifically tokenized repurchase agreements (repos) and tokenized corporate loans. Repos form the absolute backbone of daily institutional liquidity in legacy banking. By shifting these contracts to smart-ledger execution, XRPL removes counterparty latency, automates collateral management, and lowers operational overhead dramatically.

Schwartz's core thesis is clear: mass retail adoption of DeFi will not happen because users suddenly understand blockchain jargon; it will occur when traditional financial products become cheaper, faster, and more accessible through enterprise implementation. The continuous enterprise adoption validates this data. For instance, Anodos Finance disclosed that they have integrated XRP directly into their corporate treasury, utilizing it for operational liquidity and payroll settlement since 2023. This empirical data proves that the utilities are already live and functional, positioning XRPL as a foundational layer for the next iteration of global financial markets.

Source: [bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/xrp-utility-moves-beyond-payments-as-xrpl-eyes-tokenized-stocks-funds-loans/)

title.title: 喻世明言十二《沈小官一鸟害七命》
title.body:
接上回

一进这禽鸟馆，这只他儿子的画眉还认得老主人呢，就叫得格外的欢畅，还频频地对他点头。这个沈老板睹物思人，想起他的儿子，他就开始嚎啕大哭，抑制不住的悲屈，那个管事儿的问他也不答话，没办法，只得把他给押到了大理寺，一审才知道，他有冤情。
所以大理寺就抓来了进贡的这个人李吉，李吉怎么解释也解释不通，有口难辩呢，鸟属实是买的，但是法官让他说是从谁那里买的呢？姓甚名谁，他也不认识啊，就在路上遇到了买的，他哪知道他是谁？

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVyPu1kPbxdMFvgrRfmFruhqsZvfKBLp8vpv6yb5nzRqS/img_3053.jpg)

所以说，有一些便宜贪不得，来路不明的东西，哎，也真不好说，谁知道他这个鸟儿还是恶手段得来的呢？

那可能就是买东西要去正规的场所买吧。就像现在一些法拍房啊，法拍车什么的，有时候儿听说真是不能乱买，买了以后会遇到一些很难办的事情，很难缠的原主人。

那现在话题回到这个李吉身上，他有口难辩，法官也不讲别的证据，就说你是杀人夺鸟来的，也就像是要你证明你自己是你自己一样，他都证明不了，又挨不过打，屈打成招了，命案就是死刑。
李吉死了之后啊，这案子结了，县官儿就安排把棺木烧了。
沈老板家把这个棺木烧了，把里面的骨灰给撒了。
为什么撒了骨灰呢？这不是正常操作呀，应该是觉得这儿子不争气，又不得好死，以后他们还要好好的生活呀，不要被他死去的儿子所影响吧。

未完待续……


***

title.body:
<center>
The world grows still as the clock strikes twelve
A silence that steals the night
Buried in our thoughts are the noises that filled the day
Leaving the stage for the howling owls

In the dark night, the mind unwrap her wounds 
Dropping behind the day's rules
Laughter or regret crawls in uninvited
Whispering memories and secrets of what could be

Yet in the moment the star finds room to wake and dance
It shows of her beauty
And in silence
We find comfort in the dark

For the dark night, however long
Must yield at last to morning song
As the darks breaks, the burden fades
And we awake made whole and new</center>

title.body: > Happy Monday everyone! I'm grateful to share a new post here with you, where I can also show these excellent photos I took a few days ago on my uncle's land. He has several uncut plants, which are weeds, and I hadn't noticed they could produce such a beautiful wildflower as this one. >Feliz lunes para todos agradecida por compartir una nueva publicación aquí con ustedes dónde además puedo mostrar estás excelentes fotos qué tomé hace unos días en el terreno de mí tío quién tiene varías plantas sin cortar las cuáles digamos qué son maleza y las cuáles no había visto qué tiene la posibilidad de mostrar una flor silvestre tan hermosa cómo puede ser esta. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXBENSWpw7KJqjUerejR7SoBF1sEeFrmfZeDZ9LcDjqi/1780959706936.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVVX8GdQP18F6RkDnimK29LicFWCFoKKDYpFU2KwPKv4/1780959707424.jpg) It's truly incredible how nature can surprise us, and the best part is that it happens in the most unexpected places. I've spent so much time visiting my uncle at his house—I even lived there for a while—and this is the first time I've seen this plant. Or perhaps it's my new passion to take photos of it and share them here on #Hive, which I'm keeping a close eye on. >La verdad que es increíble cómo la naturaleza puede sorprendernos y lo mejor es qué en los lugares menos pensados tanto tiempo visitando a mí tío en su casa hasta he vivido allí por un tiempo y es primera vez que veo esta planta ó sería qué es ahora mí nueva pasión de tomar fotos para mostrarlas aquí en #Hive qué estoy al pendiente. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNc1Btn5ae6og2GRPEeBSQzb3PCessFcbT8v9TNAvstFq/1780959734968.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCUbrmJ8m29bd1AHN5dSDtEfyRwhpXGjnshpGQUkESq6/1780959735199.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTqLurUy2FuHdLaxF8LCUKjht6LYJ8qKawj4tTNKdJ4vW/1780959735400.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTbEREeU3FyMnkZSAdPk2aHonTaCVNT2mpzD45SkvmNs/1780959735596.jpg) I'm signing off, but not before thanking you for the opportunity to participate in the weekly contests, this time with number -116 in #phonephotography, sponsored by my friend @untilwelearn. So everyone is welcome to participate in this one, as well as the next ones, with the only condition being that the photos are taken with a cell phone. >Me despido no sin antes agradecer por la oportunidad de participar en los concursos semanales en esta ocasión con el número -116 en el #phonephotography con el patrocinio del amigo @untilwelearn así que son todos bienvenidos a participar en este así cómo en los próximos con la única condición de qué sean tomadas con el teléfono celular.

title.title: Verse of the Day | Monday, June 8th
title.body:
Genesis 3:6***

Today's verse reminds us that the fall of humanity did not begin with a violent act or a great rebellion — it began with looking too long at something God had forbidden, until convincing oneself that it was good, desirable, and necessary. Temptation rarely presents itself as something evil; almost always it appears attractive, reasonable, and even beneficial.

That is why we must guard not only our actions, but our gaze and our thoughts. What we allow to occupy our minds ends up influencing our decisions, and a decision made outside the will of God always has consequences that reach far beyond ourselves.

</br>

## Versículo del Día | Lunes 8 de Junio

> ***\

Génesis 3:6***

El versículo del día nos recuerda que la caída del ser humano no comenzó con un acto violento ni con una gran rebelión — comenzó con mirar demasiado tiempo algo que Dios había prohibido, hasta convencerse de que era bueno, deseable y necesario. La tentación rara vez se presenta como algo malo; casi siempre luce atractiva, razonable y hasta beneficiosa.

Es por eso que debemos cuidar no solo nuestras acciones, sino nuestra mirada y nuestros pensamientos. Lo que permitimos que ocupe nuestra mente termina influyendo en nuestras decisiones, y una decisión tomada fuera de la voluntad de Dios siempre tiene consecuencias que van más allá de uno mismo.

title.title: Phillies win fun series vs White Sox | Team travels north to face Blue Jays in Toronto, Cristopher Sánchez is on the mound!!
title.body:
Well, once again life gets slightly busy. I had to run some errands, do several small things I was behind on and so yeah. Baseball doesn't stop for me though!

On Saturday, the White Sox got a bit of revenge vs the Phillies. Andrew Painter continues to struggle for the most part. He's shown a handful of flashes but it's overall been a struggle in his rookie season. Stinks to see but I wouldn't be shocked to see him be sent down somewhat soon. Just being honest. It's a business at the end of the day! Offensively, the Phils weren't great either, they only scored three runs. Alec Bohm and Brandon Marsh homered, and Adolis García drove in the third run. The Phils only had five hits that day so, those three provided the majority of the offense in the loss. 

Yesterday's contest was another offensive battle, which ended in favor of the Phillies! The game featured pretty much six lead changes overall but the Phillies pulled away starting in the fifth. The fellas [won 9-5.](https://youtu.be/XmKPTnKz7ks?si=ynYanoMjch53YtN2) I keep wanting to be optimistic about Aaron Nola but he then has a rough start. I guess the conclusion about Nola is that he's simply the fourth or fifth best guy in a rotation at this point. Maybe I'll just have to start holding him to a different standard these days. 

Brandon Marsh simply cannot be stopped! He's homered in three straight games now! Oh yeah, the man **leads the majors in batting average with a .338 average!!** Some perhaps thought he was simply off to a hot start, but now we're in June people! Too cool. He now has eight homers. Marsh is a pretty big dude I always felt like he had more to offer from a power perspective. Maybe he can keep that aspect of his offense up, that would be glorious!

Cristopher Sánchez is on the mound tonight in Toronto. I always get so excited to see him pitch these days!!! Fun times when he pitches! Life's short, it's nice to appreciate greatness!

title.title: Daily prompt : Mosaic
title.body: **The grain and mosaic gains **\n\nEver heard someone say, \

A single grain does not make sense to the ears or the eyes itself. A bag of grains excites the heart as a gift and pleasing to the human eyes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRDcPrSnZNMND61rVai2Gezbvmp6NdzRFVNCh71zzqFQB/1780959269623.jpg)


Sometimes, it is not every little drop, grain or thread that counts, but the abundance of the little things that matters.

A grain of fabric is as good as useless, but when the grains of fabric come together they give an amazing textile design. It becomes an art that covers the body.

The mosaic of beauty is in the different threads and grains that make up a fabric and become food. 
The daily food for the body and a shield on the body to protect from the cold and insects.

Little things on their own can be negligible and insignificant. But when the little things come together they form a character that is almost unimaginable from the beginning.

Indeed, the plethora of life is in the avalanche of the little things of life that adds meaning and rewards to life....

Mosaic is simply the piece that qualifies, refines, defines and completes the cycle called future...

title.title: El deporte en 2026: esto tiene que cambiar
title.body:
No sé ustedes pero yo siento que este año está siendo espectacular para el deporte. Cada semana pasa algo que te deja con la boca abierta. Arranquemos con lo que más me llamó la atención.

Analizando los numeros de esta temporada, hay datos que llaman la atencion. Por ejemplo, la cantidad de goles (o puntos) que se estan haciendo es increible. Nunca habia visto algo asi en los ultimos años.

Hay una cosa que me rompe las pelotas: los arbitrajes. No es posible que en pleno 2026 sigan existiendo errores tan basicos. El VAR esta para ayudar pero parece que a veces complica mas de lo que soluciona.

Bueno gente, eso es lo que pensaba compartir hoy. Ojalá les haya gustado la lectura y si no, también pueden dejar su queja en los comentarios. Los leo ahí.

title.title: Do You Have your own Spider Sense?
title.body:
>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3rJH67T2TyUD4WzmSXy3tvu7hWUawF71XKtkhJ6aaCh/do_you_have_you_own_spider_sense.jpg)

When we think of the word instinct, those who are a bit more nerdy should automatically remember the neighborhood hero, the people's friend, and one of the most well-known and beloved superheroes: Spider-Man. For those unfamiliar with Spider-Man, as the name suggests, he has the powers of a spider, so he can climb walls, shoot webs, and has a basic hero kit along with super strength and agility. But there's a very characteristic detail about Spider-Man that has saved him many times: his spider-sense.

Spider-sense is a sensation, like an alert that Spider-Man feels whenever something strange is about to happen. The animations make it seem like a \
in his head that can even leave him a little confused, perhaps a slight headache. Generally, this \

begins when some danger is approaching, even if there seems to be nothing wrong nearby. Interestingly, just like Spider-Man, human beings possess a special kind of power called instinct, which may have arisen at some point in our evolution as a species. Could it be our Spider-Sense? I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

Do you have your own Spider-Sense?

There are two examples of Spider-Sense in one of the latest Spider-Man movies with Tom Holland, where his aunt – who knew his \

identity – throws something at him and ends up hitting him. She's confused, thinking his spider-sense would activate, but on that occasion it's revealed that if it's not a threat, the spider-sense doesn't work.

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNZ3N1nF2Z185rpFeJHS6Ny8q2GL2Bj5fGA3663bexYQ8/spider_sense.gif) </center>
<center>[Giphy](https://giphy.com/explore/spider-sense)</center>

Another case with the same actor was when the effect actually activated before the villain appeared on screen. The Green Goblin, an alter-ego of Norman Osborn, shares consciousness with him, something like a split personality. His spider-sense is so \

that it detected when the personality change occurred. Finally, I couldn't fail to mention the last great example with the actor in Endgame, where Peter started feeling unwell even before turning to dust with Thanos' snap. These days I ended up watching another version of Spider-Man in the Spider-Noir series, which is very good and presents a completely different version of the hero everyone knows, with him being an older character, with his powers malfunctioning at times, and with a slightly different origin for his powers. And why mention a new version of Spider-Man? Because, just like with normal people, everyone feels different sensations—maybe a feeling of unease, dizziness, a tightness in the chest—even spiders have differences in their instincts. I believe we all have some form of instinct, because we are all animals, so we have some traits from our ancestors that haven't fully adapted to modern life, given the great transformations that have occurred in just a few years. The difference is that instead of being an almost perfect predictive feeling, our instincts can be just a feeling; there's no way to know exactly if it's correct or not. Generally, when we're at a point where we have to make an important decision, we get this feeling that something might go wrong if we choose one of the paths. But is there any certainty that it will actually cause a problem? No. So what to do about our instincts? The best answer is to gather information. Besides these often unexplained sensations, we have an incredible computing capacity in our brains. The problem is that we often choose to trust our instincts instead of using this supercomputer in our heads. For it to work, you need to seek information about the situation you're unsure about and, of course, ensure the security of your computing machine. By doing this, you stop relying solely on instinct and also use a bit of reason to arrive at a more optimal answer. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeCJZEK6UG5Tc3avBibmLNHkgkN9PXcmVN1jYhHR6aHGG/image.png ---

>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3rJH67T2TyUD4WzmSXy3tvu7hWUawF71XKtkhJ6aaCh/do_you_have_you_own_spider_sense.jpg)

Quando pensamos na palavra instinto quem é um pouco mais nerd deve automaticamente se lembrar do herói da vizinhança, o amigo do povo e o um dos super-heróis mais conhecidos e amados pelo público o Homem Aranha. Para quem não conhece o Homem Aranha como o nome sugere tem os poderes de uma aranha, então ele consegue escalar paredes, soltar teias, e tem um kit básico de herói junto como super força e agilidade. Só que existe um detalhe bem característico do spider e que acabou salvando ele diversas vezes que é seu sentido aranha.

O sentido aranha é uma sensação, como se fosse um alerta que o Spider Man sente sempre que algo estranho está para acontecer. As animações fazem parecer como se fosse uma \
na cabeça que chega até a deixá-lo um pouco confuso, talvez uma leve dor de cabeça. Geralmente, essa \

se inicia quando algum perigo está se aproximando, mesmo que aparentemente não tenha nada de errado próximo à ele. O interessante é que assim como o Spider, os seres humanos possuem um tipo de poder especial chamado instinto, que pode ter surgido em algum momento da nossa evolução como espécie. Será que ele seria o nosso Spider Sense? Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

>

## Do you have you own Spider Sense?

Existem dois exemplos do Spider Sense em um dos últimos filmes do homem aranha com o Tom Holland, em que a tia - que sabia da identidade \

dele - joga algo na direção dele e acaba acertando, ela fica confusa achando que o sentido de aranha dele seria ativado, mas nessa ocasião é revelado que se não for uma ameaça o sentido de aranha não funciona.

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNZ3N1nF2Z185rpFeJHS6Ny8q2GL2Bj5fGA3663bexYQ8/spider_sense.gif) </center>
<center>[Giphy](https://giphy.com/explore/spider-sense)</center>

Já um caso com o mesmo ator, foi quando o efeito realmente se ativou antes do vilão aparecer em cena. O duende verde que é um alter-ego do Norman Osborn, divide a consciência com ele, algo como uma dupla personalidade. O sentido aranha é tão \

que conseguiu detectar quando a mudança de personalidade aconteceu. Por fim, não poderia deixar de mencionar o último grande exemplo que teve com o ator que foi em ultimato, que o Peter começou a se sentir mal antes mesmo de começar a transformação em pó com o estalo do Thanos. Esses dias eu acabei vendo uma outra versão do Homem Aranha na série Spider Noir, que por sinal é muito boa e trás uma versão completamente diferente do herói que todos conhecem, com ele já sendo um personagem mais velho, com os poderes apresentando problemas em alguns momentos e com uma origem para os poderes um pouco diferente. E o porque de mencionar uma nova versão do spider? É que igual acontece com as pessoas normais, em que cada um sente uma sensação diferente, talvez um mal estar, uma tonteira, um aperto no coração, até mesmo os spiders tem diferença com relação aos instintos deles. Acredito que todos nós tenhamos alguma forma de instinto, até porque somos todos animais, então temos alguns traços de nossos ancestrais que não conseguiram se adaptar completamente à vida moderna, já que em poucos anos as transformações foram tão grandes. A diferença é que em vez de ser uma sensação preditiva quase perfeita, os nossos instintos podem ser apenas uma sensação, não tem como saber exatamente se está correto ou não. Geralmente quando estamos em um ponto de tomar alguma decisão importante, vem essa sensação de algo pode dar errado se escolher um dos caminhos. Mas existe uma certeza de que realmente dará algum problema? Não. Então o que fazer com relação aos nossos instintos? A melhor resposta é coletar informações. Além dessas sensações muitas vezes sem explicação, temos uma capacidade incrível de computação no cérebro. O problema é que muitas vezes resolvemos confiar no instinto em vez de usar esse super computador que fica na nossa cabeça. Para que ele possa funcionar, você precisa buscar informações sobre a situação em que está com dúvida e claro garantir a segurança da sua máquina computacional. Com isso, você deixa de confiar apenas no instinto e também utiliza um pouco da razão para chegar em uma resposta mais próxima da ótima possível. ---

title.title: StepJar: make every day count
title.body:
![StepJar: make every day count](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-01-introducing-v1.png)

*Fixed-commitment step pools on Hive. Clear rules before you join. Private steps while you move. Public qualification when it counts.*

Most step challenges are easy to ignore.

You join, you forget, you maybe check the leaderboard once, and then the whole thing disappears into the background.

StepJar is designed to feel different.

StepJar turns a daily step goal into a simple promise: join an official pool, commit a fixed amount of HBD, lock your timezone, and hit the daily step target every challenge day. If you make every day, you qualify. If you miss a day, your commitment stays in the jar.

That is the whole point. A step goal with just enough weight behind it to make tomorrow matter.

![StepJar: how it works](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-02-how-it-works-v1.png)

## What it feels like

**Pick an official pool.** StepJar pools are opened deliberately by liketu, so participation stays focused instead of scattered across dozens of tiny challenges.

**Read the rules before you send anything.** Every pool shows the fixed commitment, daily step target, duration, timezone rule, failure condition, and payout logic before deposit.

**Send the exact HBD commitment.** StepJar prepares the escrow account and memo. You send the exact amount, liketu watches for the receipt, and your entry becomes active once the deposit is confirmed.

**Walk every challenge day.** Your phone stays with you, your steps sync, and StepJar checks whether each day clears the target.

**Track the outcome.** Public status can show whether you qualified and what payout state the pool is in, without turning your exact private step count into public performance.

![StepJar: before you join](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-03-before-you-join-v1.png)

## Before you join

StepJar is strict on purpose.

The commitment is fixed. If the pool says `10 HBD`, then `10 HBD` joins the pool. Not `9.5`, not `12`, not a top-up later. Everyone in that jar is playing by the same deposit rule.

Your timezone locks when you join. That timezone sets the daily cutoff for your entry, so StepJar knows what \
means for you across the whole challenge.\n\nEvery challenge day has to qualify. A seven-day jar means seven daily targets. If the target is 10,000 steps, then the goal is not \

It is 10,000 steps each day.

Miss a challenge day and your commitment stays in the pool.

That sounds hard because it is meant to be clear. StepJar is not trying to make movement vague. It is trying to turn \

into a specific promise with a visible outcome.

![StepJar: live progress](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-04-live-progress-v1.png)

## During the jar

Once you are in, the important thing is the day in front of you.

StepJar shows the pool status, the daily target, how far you are through the current day, and whether you are still on track.

The dashboard is built around practical questions:

**Am I in?**

**What do I need today?**

**How many challenge days have I hit?**

**Am I still qualified?**

That’s the heart of the feature: a simple daily target, a commitment you actually stick to, and just enough visibility to stay accountable. No noisy fitness feed. No leaderboard making you feel behind. Just a focused way to show up every day.

## How the payout works

The jar rewards consistency.

Qualifiers get their commitment back and split the failed commitments. If everyone qualifies, everyone gets their commitment back. If someone misses, their failed commitment is divided between the people who made every challenge day.

For example, imagine a 10 HBD jar with three people.

If all three qualify, each gets 10 HBD back.

If two qualify and one misses, the failed 10 HBD is split between the two qualifiers, so each qualifier receives 15 HBD.

The point is not luck. The point is follow-through.

![StepJar: payout logic](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-05-payout-logic-v1.png)

## Why StepJar matters

A lot of people do not need a perfect fitness system.

They need a reason to get out the door today.

StepJar is built around that small but powerful shift: make the target plain, make the commitment real, and let the result speak for itself.

Everything is clear before you commit: your stake, your daily target, and how the jar pays out. The rules stay fixed, and the reward goes to the people who keep showing up.

![StepJar: launch](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/stepjar-twitter-06-launch-v1.png)

StepJar is coming to liketu: fixed commitment, locked timezone, daily target, private steps, public qualification, and HBD payout logic shown before you deposit.

Move every day. Keep the promise. Let the jar keep score.

If you like what we are building, one of the most meaningful ways to support liketu is to vote for the **@liketu** Hive witness.

Witness votes help us keep building, operating, and improving the infrastructure behind liketu for the Hive community.

No pressure, just appreciation. If liketu is something you want to see grow, your witness vote genuinely helps.

description.title: Power restored….
description.body: Evening everyone….. I wrote about the storm that had come through on late Saturday evening. A huge tree had been uprooted and took down the power lines on both sides of the road. As I wrote my post yesterday there was a street crew cutting up the fallen tree in order for the power company crew to do their work restoring the power. Just before eleven last night our power was restored. But the damage was done…. This morning I had to empty out my entire refrigerator and put it in the garbage. I drove around trying to buy ice on Sunday, but because of the large number of people without power every place was sold out. I had just made a large pot of jambalaya that night which now was garbage. I was pretty upset about that. The only bright spot was nearly everything in the freezer was still rock solid. I had some organic ground beef that was starting to thaw and the ice cream my mom had were garbage. So I’ll take that, because I easily had over $500 in meat in the freezer in vacuum sealed bags. I also had to trouble shoot my spit unit in my shop. It was showing a “PF” failure. Which obviously means power failure. I’m not overly familiar with split units, so I had to look it up. Luckily it wasn’t to much of an issue. Two days of working lost, so I’m behind now. It’s going to be a very busy week now. Here’s some shiny for the read…

description.title: eLoan Warehouse (LMS)
description.body:
Lending businesses often run into problems when their operations depend on disconnected tools, manual processes, and limited visibility across the loan lifecycle. What may seem manageable at a smaller scale quickly becomes harder to control as servicing, repayments, collections, and reporting grow more complex. In many cases, the issue is not the lending model itself, but the software environment supporting it.

This is why a strong **loan management system** matters so much. An effective platform should do far more than store loan records. It should support the full lifecycle of a loan, from onboarding and approvals to servicing, payments, collections, and reporting. When these functions are brought together in one structured system, lending operations become easier to manage, more efficient, and better prepared to scale.

One of the most important parts of this process is **loan servicing software**. Lenders need more than payment tracking alone. They need visibility into borrower activity, repayment schedules, servicing workflows, and reporting, all in one place. Without that, teams often end up relying on manual coordination and fragmented systems that slow down operations and increase the risk of mistakes.

This is also why businesses increasingly look for an experienced **lending software development company** when building or modernizing lending platforms. It is no longer enough to create basic fintech functionality and leave the rest to manual work. Modern lending systems often require integrations, workflow automation, lifecycle visibility, secure data handling, and support for both internal teams and borrowers. The right development partner can make the delivery process much more structured and predictable.

At the same time, [lending software development](https://globaldev.tech/case-studies/loan-management-system-for-consumer-lending-operations) itself has become more important as financial companies try to improve efficiency and support growth. Standard tools often fail to reflect the real complexity of lending operations. From borrower management and repayment tracking to collections and platform integrations, custom development gives lenders the flexibility to build around their own workflows instead of adapting to software limitations.

In this context, eLoan Warehouse represents the type of platform modern consumer lending operations increasingly need: a system designed to unify loan servicing, lifecycle management, and operational control in one environment. For lenders aiming to reduce friction, improve visibility, and create a more scalable process, this kind of solution is becoming essential rather than optional.

description.title: GOD'S CEILING HAS NO LEAKS
description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdN6rUH4aPdDeNiqN1F5C2bafiqWUHtU9modjAZGyg7hv/1780958311957.png)


We pray looking down. 
At our bills. At our problems. At our feet. 

But what if God answers looking UP?

I stood under a ceiling like this today. 
Gold. Paintings. Clouds. Fingers reaching out. 

And it hit me: 
This is how God sees us. 

From His ceiling. 
Not our floor. 

From heaven, our “mess” looks like mosaic. 
Every broken piece placed by a Master Artist. 
Every delay is just paint drying. 
Every closed door is gold trim around a bigger window. 

We think our life is cracked. 
God sees a masterpiece on His ceiling. 

So the next time you cry “God where are you?” 
Look up. 

He’s not far. 
He’s just on His ceiling, 
leaning over, 
finger stretched out, 
waiting to touch yours.

“Be still, and know that I am God.” - Psalm 46:10

What’s one “cracked ceiling” in your life that God is turning to gold?

Inage is graphic design by me ✨

description.title: Creamy vegan cauliflower white sauce, very easy recipe (ENG-ESP)
description.body:
***Greetings, dear vegan community 💚***

+ ***Saludos querida comunidad vegana 💚***

---
---
![photo_4985717721215470707_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wgU1YYdRB2YeXfzQBKbKxfhq6h7wYN4sqRYXDEFmcWb3agyLPvkVj9KLNwKrYa9PgDs.jpg)

---
---
Today I want you to join me in preparing a delicious and creamy white sauce. I made this recipe over the weekend to accompany my favorite pasta.

I bought a beautiful cauliflower, especially for this sauce, and we'll also add cashews, which will give this recipe even more flavor and creaminess.

This sauce is very easy to make, perfect for those times when we're in a hurry and want to cook something delicious and healthy, but without any fuss.

+ Hoy quiero que me acompañen a preparar una deliciosa y cremosa salsa blanca, esta receta la hice el fin de semana para acompañar mi pasta preferida.

+ Compre una hermosa coliflor, especialmente para hacer esta salsa, además añadiremos anacardos que darán a esta receta más sabor y cremosidad.

+ Esta salsa es muy fácil de hacer, indicada para esos momentos en que tenemos prisa y deseamos cocinar algo delicioso, saludable, pero sin complicaciones.

***Are you interested in the recipe? Then let's make it together! 😉***

+ ***¿Te interesa la receta? entonces hagámosla juntos! 😉***

# Ingredients:
-270 grams of cauliflower.
-40 grams of cashew nuts.
-Approximately 400 ml of plant-based milk (you can use almond, soy, or coconut milk).
-3 to 4 cloves of garlic.
-1/2 large onion.
-Salt and pepper to taste.
-Cilantro for garnish.

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -270 gramos de coliflor.
+ -40 gramos de anacardo.
+ -400 ml aproximados de leche vegetal, puedes usar de almendras, Soya o de coco.
+ -3 a 4 ajos.
+ -1/2 cebolla grande.
+ -Sal y pimienta al gusto.
+ -cilantro para decorar.

![photo_4985717721215470685_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eoc7aFPzNt3wTSowcHSHFLKF7oa5kwfo8NNVjzXQn9JkfZ1LoncvCgTEJ3cchNLFJ4a.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started with the preparation:

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

We start by chopping half the onion into julienne strips and finely chopping the garlic.

+ Empezamos picando la media cebolla en juliana y los ajos los picamos finamente.

![photo_4985717721215470686_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23uFXzpPyCQQ44jmxaB6mW8vPrGbHqJgMwxJxbjVHy7sKWxF5rPMpDQQY1jH6d7Ppm5bJ.jpg)

We sauté it in a pan with two tablespoons of vegetable oil that you have on hand, I have used extra virgin coconut oil, but if you have extra virgin olive oil, much better, sauté over low heat for a couple of minutes.

+ Llevamos a sofreír en una sarten con dos cucharadas de aceite vegetal que tengas a tu alcance, yo he usado aceite extra virgen de coco, pero si tienes aceite extra virgen de oliva, mucho mejor, sofreímos a fuego bajo por un par de minutos.

![photo_4985717721215470687_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogMqb4rkXVotnp7YCqnSJsQ233CWJ95MKtPz7q7jtNVK9MKHwtmvzhJo6xQ4sCyT86.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470688_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoK5uVWZJmNoFX3fr6cc7bQfyWC5PsvQ61yPjTnxRe7sQcQCkrwqXHU77QzdCkaJJH7.jpg)

While the onion and garlic are cooking, we chop the cauliflower and add it to the seasonings, mixing the ingredients well with a spoon.

+ Mientras dejamos cocinando la cebolla y los ajos, nos disponemos a picar la coliflor y la agregamos a los aliños, mezclamos con una cuchara integrado bien los ingredientes.

![photo_4985717721215470689_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xVMbUWm8ebfMHTAvQuKarmGgf4w7ShWoyPwwheYeoe7vsPQ3nqyzrDmm8hvhQhusznt.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470690_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wqpNQzSUzcXfEy9G4ExhjuQpommXApzqhZ841471DYb52Ni3vBYFcKa5jPu82i9B1gW.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470691_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EonkWUXy1FYwBfZooBPx2oLyUnKLticJCc8ZfU2nnZYbNKnsxyo5PeZGrrNXUGfAZ4Y.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470692_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EonkZDDF1J7BfWJXfZg3WhX5bfV56wDrUm5ShjTvX3sibrj6a1ceeAVuyLGQ1MrNV9X.jpg)

Then we add the cashews, salt and pepper, and mix.

+ Luego incorporamos los anacardos, la sal y la pimienta, mezclamos.

![photo_4985717721215470693_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEySQctYrjDNq79EhaYBLPGh88mrKTV6HZ2RmC28BwRRr31Di5VabwcDAn4iRGShT.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470694_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eos1kCPRqSThUxPQZSmg5fYNLj3VX3PWwwtzVkpF3wF7tAPxzAjffPycZ1QNTQJv5Np.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470695_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiWBJ5GT5rAmxPhYB4iPKpjxoAotctxUPHF2VsmHQLFk1v62yUTECHyfCvrPKQMH1h.jpg)

We also add the plant-based milk, I used almond milk, and cook over medium heat until the cauliflower is tender, then let it rest for about 10 minutes.

+ Agregamos también la leche vegetal, yo he usado de almendras, dejamos cocinar a fuego medio hasta que la coliflor esté tierna, dejamos reposar unos 10 minutos.

![photo_4985717721215470696_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpCAPp6V4mQDA9xhyFzd8Nm4LrDrhif5Map9J98DBpWUAACTzSPkTrBdLRhpkEYnjTL.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470697_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEN2s6wTTgvzh5h8oX7uQW5r23vaBsRQ3VqW5X5dYzdRDMdkdHYSwd8kvY2PE2rSk.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470698_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEV7zvFeTT7vYGqSxfpjW4byiYhvBsyzm6VE6Sa72tik1JQtQYyweNXnY2dfFy1C4.jpg)

Now we put this mixture into the blender and blend, pausing occasionally. If you see that the mixture is too thick, add a splash of plant-based milk. We should end up with a thick and creamy sauce.

+ Ahora echamos esta preparación en el vaso de la licuadora y licuamos haciendo pausas, si ves que la mezcla está muy gruesa, agrega un chorrito de leche vegetal, nos debe quedar una salsa espesa y bien cremosa.

![photo_4985717721215470699_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEN3jUaWGoEhgd9N2VQd1zfCaZADZWMYvqCDTgxrA1MdohCPbqDxvjcKFKwEFvmdK.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470700_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoEq3GHXbkyWtGFYPbcnieNiL8fpJkpGiiL4huZfdEf5aNk2BtpFFYiKN6vvphP57K8.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470701_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoAadPFdL9a91uQANvV12iX8DYQgWeNVok1ms4DQVUjaPnrjHSjWVjGFcAMGwcyQnPX.jpg)

**Our sauce is ready to serve! The cashew flavor is very prominent, and I love the texture because it's super creamy.**

+ **¡Nuestra salsa está lista para servir! el sabor a anacardos está muy presente y la textura me encanta porque está super cremosa.**

![photo_4985717721215470702_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wX5h1UFuWLCVkB9ZDEsxDbgQcd5Y5p2wMBf6vkzTxDPuom6iC7s6bMayy5PeJ6oZxpH.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470708_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wMcP7T2qb29k3XAAQjW6JLbDSC5YXLgChe2V8RbaaK7rfyUPh6BzYuMSGZMqmQ82Kq5.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470703_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoptpKVKnSbp5zA8s8KkRJUyv6LUGKNFsaVKG8T9TE1ZmMty9wZD8tNx5Kvs8qfu75u.jpg)

**I made this sauce especially to go with spaghetti! What would you serve it with?**

+ **¡En mi caso hice esta salsa especialmente para acompañar unos espaguetis! con que la acompañarías tu?**

![photo_4985717721215470704_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eos2hnksdNhHLkSnyU9hWcyfQpz6Dn5AussqZP4o2z4D7pJ8WRpVzFdt8DMGxjmaQMx.jpg)

---
![photo_4985717721215470706_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/48HC4SRZ9L3ZLnBvABuXPfhCHJsXGtqpXLqup4xBj6MofYav2viuAcAQkTkjJQ4Kcw.jpg)

---
---
**Note:** This type of sauce is great with added nutritional yeast and nutmeg, in this case I didn't use them because I didn't have them on hand.

+ **Nota:** a este tipo de salsa le queda estupendo añadir levadura nutricional y nuez moscada, en este caso no los usé porque no los tenía a mi alcance.

The first time I heard of mosaic was in highschool, during one of the art classes. I did not get the whole picture but I knew what it was and recognized that it comprises of various parts to complete a whole. It can be an art work, picture, science or mapping.




I usually imagine mosaic as a collage, I can see the similarities. 
A mosaic is an example of uniting different arms together. It brings out the beauty in diversity, it might not be beautiful individually but when combined, you will love the way it blends.




You can also participate by clicking [here](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/8-june-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3128-mosaic)

description.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavH7xQgeA4wXfVF4sgsxY8YCBSttXdEb6zmexpisfNsB/luxs_favor_battle.png)</center>

 ----   
      
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)   
</center>   

<div class=\

>

English Version

--- ---

> Hello, good morning or afternoon, my dear fellow Praetorians. A post telling you a little about how I'm going with roulette and battles. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Lux’s Favor

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> 21 days ago the Lux's Favor roulette update came out and its daily streak, an eye-catching way to win some items: card or avatar skins, energy for frontier, sparks and battle challenges. Sparks are a token to use in the Spark store, where you can buy other skins or items to equip in the avatar. Now, I want to comment a little bit about the battle challenges. When you get this reward on the roulette, you receive sparks and one of the battles of the challenges is unlocked. When entering the campaign mode, there is the battles section; so far there are seven and you have to unlock all of them, in addition to completing them to unlock the Pit challenges.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYzC6iE2HacsFHdSW8pSQhGZfsRT7C3hnMwe3m6dYNGn/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSpAba7GtWNb3TUFuf17f1c7phUCHcocGMLXfBHJp6RcU/image.png)
--- --- So far I have faced two battles. My first battle was against the archon of the water element; both the archon and his warriors were at the highest level.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeFromGZQv4AgxfnGpLyTVX4MqXTvRPvXuwYXtppusv34/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamFeBhZLpkhU94qPLtZLgUwCmQUtUqpXot55BV7pHC2b/image.png)
Note: Something to mention is that these battles offer a tip to get the victory. In this battle, the tip is: Which type of attack benefits the most from Marlai's +1 magic? Taking that into account, I chose the Marlai archon and a battle formation that had mainly four warriors: with magic attack, another with melee attack and one with ranged attack.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXJgNyyHDiBpPfxoQf73ePvtNjXmMBBctbVYvDuxboBVU/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdC5rHPn2shSLMv4HAQ4aK6zjaLunr76SpcvsB6zQeStc/image.png)
This training was effective for my victory. My opponent in challenge #1 did not take advantage of the benefit of his archon; he only included a warrior with magic attack. --- --- My second challenge had an increase in difficulty; now two rules or modifiers were already applied to the battle. The tip for this battle is: What types of attack will not receive damage from Thorns?
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma8U4MrtGw9gd2y82zZEdXSYNAYh8U9eZsG8oKB39XHjf/image.png)
When facing a battle where all units have thorns, two things have to be taken into account: - The first is that units with melee attack take damage from the spines and you need to think about how to reduce the damage. - The second one is about the tip, which units do not take damage by thorns, as are the units with ranged and magic attack. Thinking about this, I selected the Archon Incessant Sage, which grants +1 in armor. That armor would protect all units from melee and ranged attacks, but it would also provide extra protection against thorns for melee units.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTL4CBTwRSVuz7euLQpWF2opwY1kXB78cc6wLcCtmBQo9/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqBwhRZEaZqvN57PKtvpuX2SwPRzSVF7v2dAhbihG8g6/image.png)
Having the same units available for this battle, the choice of the archon influences the outcome. My opponent chose an increase in speed; that made his melee units that would attack me wear out against the armor and in the end defeating them was easier. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> So far I have liked roulette and its extra benefit for maintaining a streak of daily activity. Some things are being gained to customize our accounts a little. I really like the challenges section; it's interesting to see that they add new tools where new players can try the foundations cards to the maximum and have tips to improve in their battles. As I see, the difficulty will increase as each of the battles is overcome. I'm a little intrigued about what the challenge that unlocks at the end of the seven battles will be about. I hope they will surprise us with it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW51ySmhBAFtobgvKqCMNSdQ6tfzZJUxwM4QyN4Y71XqS/image.png)
-----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

>

Versión en Español

---

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Una publicación contándoles un poco de cómo voy con la ruleta y las batallas. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Lux’s Favor

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Hace 21 días salió la actualización de la ruleta de Lux's Favor y su racha diaria, una forma llamativa de ganar algunos ítems: skins de cartas o avatar, energía para frontier, sparks y battle challenges. Los sparks son un token para usar en la tienda Spark, donde se pueden comprar otras skins o ítems para equipar en el avatar. Ahora bien, quiero comentar un poco sobre los battle challenges. Al obtener esta recompensa en la ruleta, recibes sparks y se desbloquea una de las batallas del challenges. Al ingresar en el modo campaña, se encuentra el apartado de batallas; hasta el momento son siete y se tienen que desbloquear todas, además de completarlas para desbloquear los Pit challenges.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYzC6iE2HacsFHdSW8pSQhGZfsRT7C3hnMwe3m6dYNGn/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSpAba7GtWNb3TUFuf17f1c7phUCHcocGMLXfBHJp6RcU/image.png)
--- --- Hasta el momento he enfrentado dos batallas. Mi primera batalla fue contra el arconte del elemento agua; tanto el arconte como sus guerreros estaban a máximo nivel.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeFromGZQv4AgxfnGpLyTVX4MqXTvRPvXuwYXtppusv34/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamFeBhZLpkhU94qPLtZLgUwCmQUtUqpXot55BV7pHC2b/image.png)
Nota: Algo para mencionar es que estas batallas ofrecen un tip para obtener la victoria. En esta batalla, el tip es: ¿Qué tipo de ataque se beneficia más de la magia +1 de Marlai? Tomando eso en cuenta, elegí al arconte Marlai y una formación de batalla que tenía principalmente cuatro guerreros: con ataque mágico, otra con ataque melee y una con ataque a distancia.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXJgNyyHDiBpPfxoQf73ePvtNjXmMBBctbVYvDuxboBVU/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdC5rHPn2shSLMv4HAQ4aK6zjaLunr76SpcvsB6zQeStc/image.png)
Esta formación fue efectiva para mi victoria. Mi oponente en el challenge #1 no aprovechó el beneficio de su arconte; solo incluyó un guerrero con ataque mágico. --- --- Mi segundo desafío tuvo un aumento en la dificultad; ahora ya se aplicaban dos reglas o modificadores a la batalla. El tip para esta batalla es: ¿Qué tipos de ataque no recibirán daño de Espinas?
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma8U4MrtGw9gd2y82zZEdXSYNAYh8U9eZsG8oKB39XHjf/image.png)
Al enfrentar una batalla donde todas las unidades tienen espinas, se tiene que tener en cuenta dos cosas: - La primera es que las unidades con ataque melee reciben daño por las espinas y se debe pensar en cómo reducir el daño. - La segunda es sobre el tip, cuáles unidades no reciben daño por espinas, como lo son las unidades con ataque a distancia y mágico. Pensando en esto, seleccioné al arconte Incessant Sage, que otorga +1 en armadura. Esa armadura protegería a todas las unidades de los ataques melee y a distancia, pero además brindaría una protección extra contra las espinas para las unidades melee.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTL4CBTwRSVuz7euLQpWF2opwY1kXB78cc6wLcCtmBQo9/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqBwhRZEaZqvN57PKtvpuX2SwPRzSVF7v2dAhbihG8g6/image.png)
Al contar con las mismas unidades disponibles para esta batalla, la elección del arconte influye en el resultado. Mi oponente eligió un aumento en la velocidad; eso hizo que sus unidades melee que me atacarían se desgastaran contra las armaduras y, al final, derrotarlos fuera más sencillo. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Hasta el momento me ha gustado la ruleta y su beneficio extra por mantener una racha de actividad diaria. Se van ganando algunas cosas para personalizar un poco nuestras cuentas. El apartado de challenges me gusta mucho; es interesante ver que agregan nuevas herramientas donde los nuevos jugadores pueden probar las cartas foundations al máximo y cuentan con tips para ir mejorando en sus batallas. Según veo, la dificultad irá aumentando a medida que se supere cada una de las batallas. Me intriga un poco sobre qué tratará el challenge que se desbloquea al final de las siete batallas. Espero que nos sorprendan con ello.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW51ySmhBAFtobgvKqCMNSdQ6tfzZJUxwM4QyN4Y71XqS/image.png)

description.title: Hyperion Update: The Curation Inbox Lives Again
description.body: *Hyperion Is Back* It has been a while since I posted about [Hyperion](https://www.hyperion.zone). As projects often do, things took a backseat. Hive evolved, dependencies grew older, APIs shifted, and browsers became more demanding. Rails continued to progress. The curation workflow I envisioned remained valuable, but the app needed a more thorough update.

/></center>

---

So, I’ve given it a fresh start!

This wasn’t just a simple update.  Hyperion is now running on a modern Rails platform, back on Heroku for production, linked to HafSQL for indexing, and equipped with a new React-based curation inbox.  The older Rails views are still available as a backup, but the main experience is now a speedy SPA that focuses on what Hyperion was always designed to do: help curators streamline the seven-day Hive payout window into a manageable collection of posts to explore.

And Codex.app helped this all happen quickly.

### What Changed

The most noticeable change is how the curation inbox is presented.

Hyperion now launches into a packed, keyboard-friendly post list with a preview pane.  You can easily navigate through posts, mark them as read, filter them by tag or author, search for keywords, check out ignored, deleted, or blacklisted views, and still keep the list’s context while you’re reading.  The idea isn’t to replicate another general Hive frontend; PeakD, Ecency, and others already handle that pretty well.  Hyperion focuses more on curation.

The app now gets a better grasp of the signals that matter most to me when I’m curating:

- read state
- ignored tags
- favorite tags
- muted authors
- author reputation
- Hive blacklist subscriptions
- Hivewatchers blacklist status
- deleted and edited posts
- payout estimates

### Why Bring It Back?

Well, I was paying for the domain anyway.  And I just like the inbox model + keyboard navigation.  There were (are?) other projects that did some of this.  And I thought it'd be fun to see if there were any ways to use HaF-backed accelerators, which there are.  But most importantly, I had the Codex credits available and GPT-5.5 is a great coding buddy.

You can find it again at:

https://hyperion.zone
