links.title: So, Nobody Here Has Seen Sailor Moon, Am I Wrong?
links.body:
>This is the story of a girl with no friends. A girl who, overwhelmed by the reality she had to navigate in one of the most prosperous, advanced, and technologically developed societies in human history, turned to her imagination and, above all, her creativity. As an amateur artist, she began creating a series of manga that eventually became the world-famous anime that made her a household name. Through those stories, she gave life to the friendships and connections she had longed for but never truly experienced herself. And that is how Sailor Moon was born.

*\n\n*

>As you can probably tell, the story is not nearly as simple as it seemed when we were sitting on our couches as children, completely absorbed by our favorite anime playing on television. I understand that Sailor Moon was never quite as popular among boys as it was among girls, but what fascinates me most is the idea that loneliness, a lack of empathy, and the feeling of not being fully understood were the very things that fueled the creative spirit of its creator, Naoko Takeuchi. A chemical engineer by profession, she nevertheless created a story that would become unforgettable for billions of people around the world.

* ![1000245111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zSC3cBofXnsEhoPiFJkhLHvErx9nGJfnYENhUVyHHW24bauskn17vHxsTEyhTeQ3xda.jpg) ![1000245112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xyhp2uiMiWp9hEsV1Sfx4Q4XodHZXQ9GCYncqgumpU47Ep9Akw2bt7EkzJYBgoqb9dX.jpg) ![1000245110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wCNCUmzBHP8ThxEaYqSLyJXmy6y4fZiNoV5xnbAyZfT9zcGVr4zbFe7UqyHCNEjCnpr.jpg) Source *

>And that is how we arrive at a tale about schoolgirls fighting fantastic villains while slowly discovering the harshness of the world and the bitterness of pain. Somehow, that story resonated deeply with all of us. Even today, the legacy of Sailor Moon remains remarkably strong. Personally, I find it difficult to believe anyone can honestly say they never wished they belonged to a group like the one portrayed in this series. Looking even deeper, the role of love as a central force within the story is absolutely essential. It serves not only as a narrative pillar but also, in many ways, as a personal confession from the author herself.

*\n\n*

>There are details you can only fully appreciate once you've left behind the innocence and idealism of childhood. No male character in the series ever mattered more than the bond shared between Sailor Moon and her friends, the other Sailor Guardians. That spirit of \

feels both beautiful and slightly utopian. Deep down, I am now roughly the same age that Takeuchi was when she first created this story, and because of that, I can understand certain things that never would have crossed my mind years ago.

* https://youtu.be/V5HACYYJUUw?si=Tug_K_kjCq6B3pph *

>For me, Sailor Moon is an icon, a masterpiece, and a huge part of both my life and my identity. It connects me to a period of loneliness that shaped my personality in ways that still linger today. At the same time, it has become part of the legacy I share with my daughter. I trust that when she grows older and becomes more aware of the complexities of life, she will understand many of the things that now seem like simple anecdotes or small details.

*\n\n*

>You might be wondering whether an anime about magical girls and fantasy adventures can really be that meaningful. Unequivocally, yes. And I know I am far from alone in feeling that way. Not because I am a woman, but because countless men watched it too, connected with it, and loved it just as much. Beneath the transformations, the romance, and the fantasy lies something universal: the longing to belong, to be understood, and to find people who make the world feel a little less lonely.

* ![1000245113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23ywwQPga31QJDYKWza3xk7ZvoDAefFEmvkRCRph8v5XTbaTKbsZGnS8Ar2xZeCv9Do5S.jpg) Source

links.title: 📚 Book Review: Appointment with Death  | Cita con la Muerte by Agatha Christie…..[ENG-ESP]
links.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxCgRHzhrxfQ53gxsanvfJzKJJKS6rzfbPNF488fvL19/1780953416662.jpg)</center>

¡Hi, readers! 👋🏽 It’s me. It’s so nice to say hello to all of you; I know it’s been a while since my last post, but I’m here to catch up. I wanted to tell you that I’m doing a little reading challenge with my sister: Each of us picks three books for the other to read throughout the year. There’s no rush—the only requirement is to finish them before the year ends and, of course, to enjoy stories we might not otherwise choose on our own.

My first book for this challenge is none other than Agatha Christie's *Appointment with Death*. 🕵🏽‍♂️📖

>¡Hola, lectores! 👋🏽 Em por aquí. Qué lindo saludarlos a tod@s; sé que ha pasado un tiempo desde mi último posteo, pero vengo a ponerme al día. Les cuento que tengo un pequeño reto de lectura con mi hermana: Cada una escoge tres libros para que la otra los lea a lo largo del año. No hay prisa, el único requisito es terminarlos antes de que termine el año y, obviamente, disfrutar de historias que quizás de otra forma no elegiríamos por nuestra cuenta.

>Mi primer libro para este reto no es otro que: Cita con la Muerte de Agatha Christie. 🕵🏽‍♂️📖

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLUcHJNSkm7tGcqUF7zZr462cNdyhU6fH5GoTWEDdyri/1780953416714.jpg)</center>

<center>Synopsis / Sinopsis</center>

“Mrs. Boynton is an elderly woman who, rather than guiding her grown stepchildren, treats them like slaves. But she controls the money, and until her death, everyone must revolve around her. During a trip to the ruins of Petra, the Boyntons meet other travelers, among whom is Poirot. When the group returns from the excursion—which the elderly woman did not attend—they find her dead at the entrance to her tent. Everyone has a motive for wanting her dead; everyone is a suspect.” - Source: Goodreads.

>“Mrs. Boynton es una mujer entrada en años que más que gobernar, esclaviza a sus hijastros ya mayores. Pero ella es la dueña del dinero y, hasta su muerte, todos deberán girar a su alrededor. En el transcurso de un viaje a las ruinas de Petra, los Boynton coinciden con otros viajeros entre los que está Poirot. Cuando el grupo vuelve de la excursión, a la que la anciana no ha acudido, la encuentran muerta a la puerta de su tienda. Todos tienen motivos para desear su muerte, todos son sospechosos.” - Fuente: Goodreads.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQLMpa5LQqafGtUgMEeHjfjbtursxGmUYnbHDaF7k4pac/1780953416762.jpg)</center>
Opinion Em / Opinión Em

Overall, I liked the story and the setting, but what I found most interesting was the dynamic within the Boynton family. However, since it’s a short novel, I felt like I needed a few more pages to fully immerse myself in the plot and the complexity the author was trying to convey; I would have liked more time to connect with the characters. On the other hand, although I didn’t see the final twist coming at all, I felt it happened a bit out of the blue, and the explanation for the plot twist didn’t quite convince me.

>En general, la historia y la ambientación me gustaron, pero, lo que me pareció mas interesante fue la dinámica de la familia Boynton. Sin embargo, al ser una novela corta, sentí que me hicieron falta algunas páginas más para sumergirme por completo en la trama y en la complejidad que la autora quería transmitir; me habría gustado tener más tiempo para empatizar con los personajes. Por otro lado, aunque no vi venir para nada el giro final, sentí que ocurrió un poco de la nada y la explicación del plot twist no terminó de convencerme.

I think my main issue was with the length of the episodes (and keep in mind, this is coming from someone who loves short episodes 😂). Maybe a little more character development would have helped me connect better with the plot, though I’ll admit the suspense worked: my curiosity kept me hooked until the end, eager to find out how it would all turn out.

>Creo que mi conflicto principal estuvo en la duración de los capítulos (y miren que esto lo dice alguien a quien le encantan los capítulos cortos 😂) Quizás con un poco mas de profundidad en los personajes me habría ayudado a conectar mejor con la trama, aunque admito que la intriga funcionó: la curiosidad me mantuvo enganchada hasta el final para descubrir cómo se resolvería todo.


<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQLt1Axbg9aycNYxxF7jsP5meXCqJYy9VLwVmNEBjjx1f/1780953416794.jpg)</center>

Although this first encounter with the author wasn't exactly what I expected, I'm definitely going to give her another chance. After all, they don't call her the “Queen of Crime” for nothing. Thank you so much for reading this far! Em ✨

>Aunque este primer acercamiento con la autora no fue exactamente lo que esperaba, sin duda voy a darle otra oportunidad. Después de todo, no la llaman la «Reina del Crimen» por nada. ¡Muchas gracias por leer hasta aquí! Em ✨

links.title: Maggico Casino: donde cada jugador construye su propia historia
links.body:
# Del primer depósito a los grandes premios: historias que reflejan la experiencia de los jugadores de Maggico Casino en Chile


![Screenshot_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miguelra/23wzzGMMfeiXS27hm5M6DY2JRvtcYpYBsRmnfTPXabtd9eCzLEQSce3CD3Bn8VsdSZ8Hy.png)


Cada jugador tiene una historia diferente. Algunos llegan por curiosidad, otros porque un amigo les habló de una plataforma interesante y muchos simplemente buscan una nueva forma de entretenimiento digital. Lo cierto es que detrás de cada cuenta creada hay una experiencia personal que evoluciona con el tiempo. En Chile, cada vez es más común encontrar relatos de usuarios que comenzaron explorando opciones como [maggico casino](https://maggicocasinocl.com/) sin grandes expectativas y terminaron viviendo momentos llenos de emoción, sorpresas y recuerdos que todavía comentan con amigos y familiares.

Lo interesante es que estas historias rara vez empiezan con una búsqueda de grandes premios. La mayoría nace de algo mucho más simple: la curiosidad por descubrir una nueva experiencia digital.

## Todo comienza con una decisión sencilla

Muchos jugadores recuerdan perfectamente su primer depósito. No fue una cifra espectacular ni una apuesta extraordinaria. Fue simplemente el primer paso dentro de una experiencia desconocida.

Al principio predominan las dudas. ¿Qué juego elegir? ¿Cómo funciona cada categoría? ¿Vale la pena probar las mesas en vivo o es mejor empezar por tragamonedas? Son preguntas habituales que forman parte del recorrido de prácticamente cualquier usuario nuevo.

Y precisamente ahí aparece una de las características más interesantes del entretenimiento online moderno: la sensación de exploración.

### Las primeras experiencias suelen tener algo en común

*   Curiosidad por descubrir nuevos juegos.
*   Sesiones cortas para familiarizarse con la plataforma.
*   Interés por probar diferentes categorías.
*   Búsqueda de una experiencia entretenida y accesible.
*   Descubrimiento gradual de nuevas funciones.
*   Momentos inesperados que generan emoción desde el inicio.

## Cuando los pequeños éxitos aumentan la confianza

Una de las etapas más recordadas por muchos jugadores es aquella en la que comienzan a sentirse cómodos dentro del entorno digital. Después de varias sesiones, ya conocen mejor los juegos, entienden las dinámicas y desarrollan sus propias preferencias.

Es en ese momento cuando aparecen los primeros resultados memorables. No necesariamente grandes premios, sino pequeñas victorias que generan entusiasmo y alimentan las ganas de seguir explorando.

Para muchos usuarios, esos momentos son incluso más importantes que los grandes premios posteriores, porque representan el instante en que la experiencia comienza a sentirse verdaderamente personal.

## Las tragamonedas protagonizan muchas historias memorables

Cuando se habla de experiencias destacadas, los tragamonedas aparecen constantemente en las conversaciones de los jugadores chilenos. La enorme variedad de temáticas y funciones especiales convierte cada sesión en una experiencia diferente.

Algunos recuerdan haber encontrado por casualidad un título que terminó convirtiéndose en su favorito. Otros cuentan cómo una ronda de bonificación inesperada transformó una sesión común en una noche inolvidable.

La imprevisibilidad forma parte del atractivo y explica por qué tantas historias comienzan precisamente frente a los carretes de un slot.

## Las mesas en vivo aportan recuerdos completamente distintos

No todas las experiencias memorables están relacionadas con los tragamonedas. Muchos jugadores destacan las emociones vividas en las mesas con crupieres en vivo.

La interacción en tiempo real, la tensión de cada decisión y la sensación de estar participando en una experiencia compartida generan recuerdos diferentes a los de los juegos automatizados.

Algunos usuarios incluso afirman que sus momentos favoritos no fueron necesariamente los más rentables, sino aquellos en los que vivieron partidas especialmente emocionantes junto a otros participantes.

## Las historias de grandes premios siguen despertando fascinación

Por supuesto, también existen relatos que giran alrededor de premios importantes. Son las historias que circulan en grupos de amigos, foros y comunidades digitales, alimentando la imaginación de quienes recién comienzan.

Lo curioso es que muchas de estas experiencias comparten un patrón similar: los protagonistas rara vez esperaban que algo extraordinario ocurriera durante esa sesión concreta.

Esa mezcla de sorpresa y emoción es una de las razones por las que estos relatos continúan captando tanta atención.

## Más allá de los resultados: lo que realmente valoran los jugadores


![Screenshot_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miguelra/23wByPAELexyZ33S8ZjYRTQ6v9tEVPGXW67PPgH3j6qEvb4ukwJ6c3UzNqEzNE49FMqvw.png)


Aunque los grandes premios suelen ocupar los titulares, la mayoría de los usuarios destaca otros aspectos cuando habla de sus mejores experiencias.

La posibilidad de descubrir nuevos juegos, participar en torneos, compartir momentos con amigos o simplemente disfrutar de una sesión entretenida después de un día de trabajo aparece con mucha más frecuencia de lo que muchos imaginan.

Al final, los recuerdos más duraderos no siempre están ligados a una cifra concreta, sino a las emociones vividas durante el proceso.

## Una comunidad que sigue creciendo en Chile

El auge del entretenimiento online ha permitido que miles de jugadores compartan experiencias, recomendaciones y anécdotas. Cada historia contribuye a construir una comunidad más activa y conectada.

Las plataformas digitales ya no son únicamente espacios de juego; también funcionan como puntos de encuentro donde los usuarios intercambian opiniones y descubren nuevas formas de disfrutar su tiempo libre.

Por eso las historias personales continúan teniendo tanto valor. Reflejan cómo evoluciona la experiencia real de quienes forman parte de este fenómeno digital.

links.title: Why what God thinks matters more than having control | Cómo dar cambia tu imagen de vos mismo
links.body:
No matter what happens, remember who walks beside you. The God who created the heavens and the earth is with you. And if He is with you, who can be against you?

Faith is not seeing to believe. It's believing to see. And when we believe, God acts in ways we could never imagine.

Maybe today you feel alone, like no one understands what you're going through. But here's the thing: God not only understands, He's walking right beside you.

It's easy to trust when everything is going well. But real faith shows up when things don't go as we expected and we still choose to believe.

God always has good news for us. Regardless of your social status, your history, your past, or anything else. The message from heaven is one of grace, redemption, and forgiveness.
  
> The Sovereign LORD is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to tread on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.

Habakkuk 3:19 (Habacuc 3:19)

## May this word stay in your heart...

With the current value of the $Hive token at 5 cents, I started thinking about what strategy to use at the moment. This year I completed 5 years in Hive and saw the token, which when I joined was worth $1, fall to a measly $0.05, which is certainly discouraging, but also, as many say, is the best time to grow. While I was around $6 or $7, I was withdrawing about $10 a week. This year I decided to withdraw more than usual, precisely to avoid that fear we all have of accumulating and accumulating money and never being able to use it for what we want. I think that as great as growing our HP here is, obviously, being able to use the return from posts or project transfers for our own enjoyment is even better. But it hurts to see that something around 180 Hive is only $10. So, with that in mind, I think I'll simply take advantage of the moment to grow my HP, and God knows what the future holds. I'll hold onto the Hive I already have in net income, but from the posts, I'll try to focus more on HP. I've been recording some videos and posting them on 3speak; I'll use the payments in a 50/50 or 100% HP split, and from the Peakd posts, I'll start using that new model of 75% HP and the rest net income. Is that crazy? Yes, will I possibly be losing money? Also, is believing in Hive and continuing to invest more in HP the best option? I don't know, but basically that's what I'll do. If I have an emergency, I can manage; I already withdrew almost $800 from HBD some time ago, precisely because I was afraid it would lose $1 in value, so now there's not much I can do. Sell in desperation to avoid further losses or believe and continue growing. I think Hive has already given me a lot of good things. I don't think I received what I deserve, but I won't get into that either. After all, we all always think we receive less than we deserve, but I am grateful, whether for money, friendships, or knowledge. I am grateful for everything Hive has done, so now it's about increasing HP more and more and seeing where all this leads. Like a captain sailing the seven seas, the only way is to go to the end and believe there's a treasure chest, or simply sink with the ship. ![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)

Este ano completei 5 anos de Hive e vi o token que, quando entrei, valia $1, cair para míseros $ 0,05 o que com certeza bate um desânimo, mas que também, como muitos dizem, é o melhor momento para crescer. Enquanto estava ali na casa dos 6 ou 7, estava retirando mais ou menos uns $10 por semana. Este ano resolvi tirar mais do que o normal, justamente para não deixar acontecer aquele medo que todos temos, de juntar, juntar e nada de aproveitar ou retirar valores para podermos utilizar no que desejamos. Acho que tão legal quanto crescer o nosso HP aqui, obviamente, é poder utilizar o valor do retorno de postagens ou transferências de projetos para nosso bem prazer. Mas, dói o coração ver que algo em torno de 180 Hive são $10. Então, com isso, acho que vou simplesmente aproveitar o momento para crescer o meu HP e Deus sabe como vai ser no futuro. Vou segurar o Hive que já tenho líquido, mas das postagens, vou tentar focar mais em HP. Tenho gravado alguns vídeos e assim postando pelo 3speak, vou utilizar os pagamentos em 50/50 ou 100% HP e pelas postagens do Peakd, vou começar a utilizar aquele novo modelo de 75% em HP e o restante líquido. I will try and respond to your questions in order,

Assessing a businesses potential would have to be proven by the person who is trying to get it started. They would provide a business plan with data and outlines for the potential profit of their idea.

I'd imagine it would be done similar to Dragons Den, where multiple people listen to the proposal, and decide whether they are satisfied with the persons idea enough to fund it. Really, there should be people in charge of the funding department with a proven track record of running businesses who can mentor and help the person if needed, as a way to ensure the business doesn't go bust.

I would be happily provide personal information of myself, and I think anyone doing this should also have to, if they want to gain funding. Also, so the person doesn't run away, I have an idea. I'm in Ireland, so if I signed a contract with another Hive user from Ireland, who is standing in as a representative of the DHF. Then if I default on the contract, they can take me to court.

Having a stand in from the same country as the business owner, would mean we would have a representative of the DHF in the same country, so it would be easier to take legal action (if ever needed)

If a business goes bust there isn't much fall back, as there wouldn't be in the real world. Because it's in the best interest of Hive to keep the business running, people should be there to help in whatever way they can to stop the business sinking. If it sank, it would just have to be liquidated and any money gained from that would be given directly to the DHF as reimbursement.

There's no way to guarantee whales wouldn't do that, apart from general trust, transparency and responsibility by those with a large stakes. 

I was thinking of the money being placed in escrow too, and unlocked as it is required, when it is required, rather than just handing someone a stack of money and wish them luck. In my case, I would need equipment to open, so I could potentially find the things I need, send it to a representative who could then buy and have the items delivered to the shop.

The way I'd personally look at something like this, is, I'd make more money in the long run by running a successful business as opposed to just taking a lump sum and running. I know some people out there could be bad actors though, so funding would have to be granted based on trust and gut feelings. If somebody just shows up on chain with their hand out, it's safe to assume they may be trying to pull a fast one.

The idea of funding startups is thinking outside the box, and is a way to gain a return on investment for our ecosystem here. Crypto sentiment is so low now that it wouldn't be a bad idea to go traditonal, rather than focusing soly on tech alone.

json_metadata.title: Feliz con mi nueva lavadora [Spa/Eng]
json_metadata.body:
>

   

*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*

>

Hola, mi gente bella de @homesolutions, es un gusto saludarlos en este día maravilloso en donde comienza una nueva semana llena de bendiciones para todos. En casa estamos superfelices con esta nueva adquisición de las que les vengo a comentar hoy. Primero les hago un recuento de nuestra situación con este electrodoméstico tan esencial en cualquier hogar. Hace más de un año, después de mandar a reparar nuestra lavadora, dejó de funcionar y el técnico nos tenía en una espera angustiante y nunca venía; incluso le pagamos unas piezas y no las trajo. El tiempo fue pasando y yo andaba lavando a mano o a veces iba a casa de mi mamá a lavar en su lavadora, que solo era lavar y lo demás era a mano. Así que a principios de año nos propusimos comprar una nueva.

![1001769201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uQvaHw4FXuvs8ui2JymhWWGcUgRkvHkmwRnssbJSrxuwM8mdXEzXu7o81gug8yaFphB.jpg) ![1001769202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK3ecLtvt7H9B2RjzknEq92g7rWJCE5b1uKgqAQsYMV2nGwakwxmS8fL83CzU6q.jpg) ![1001769203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK56CuFYxTDpwYVbMvoD55z6W68ZfPrhVVtuNKpaRhMyRDwrcbwjv8zrWDwucy6.jpg)

>

Empezamos a ver en diferentes tiendas a ver cuál nos convenía; había de todos los tamaños, precios y marcas. También estábamos viendo los distintos tipos de financiamiento que había. Como no teníamos para comprarla de contado, decidimos apartarla y así fue como en 3 meses poco a poco la fuimos pagando. Hasta que por fin ya teníamos para hacer el último pago y así poder retirarla, más fino. El encargado me dijo que podían llevarla en dos días y que ya estaba en caja. Que ellos se comunicarían conmigo para la entrega. Lo bueno es que ya faltaba muy poquito para poder lavar en mi lavadora nueva. El sábado era el día que tenían que traerla; no salimos de casa a la espera; llegó la tarde y nada. Me estaba preparando para ir al centro para preguntar qué había pasado, cuando me llega un mensaje, que el camión que hacía las entregas se había quedado accidentado, que pasarían días para que lo repararan, que si podía, lo fuera a buscar.

![1001769205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK6XkTMuvCvywc19GGDvBZgUV9DuCCUw6bhunSBc6SrsQRvADUNUSgKTKqm3skD.jpg) ![1001769204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uQtoBzir8zz3jRsSqBxPvUVGxBcPAPLMGbVpp9i4ZEN1Jmh1M633MYs7QSVpg4Y7Jpn.jpg) ![1001769206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vsFsJWGCtwnmbv6EFcaFRYaryiWiwmmobTwa2qUcpV8GRuTDVVdrUwafm3J8qLws8Rv.jpg)

>

Así que nos alistamos y fui con el sobrino de mi esposo en la camioneta a buscarla en otra de las sucursales de las tiendas Genesis; la revisamos y el señor que nos atendió me dijo que tenía una lavadora de esas y que era muy buena. En casa, mi esposo sacó la lavadora vieja y conectó la nueva. Estuve leyendo el manual de instrucciones y una de las cosas que decía era que la primera lavada era sin meterle ropa y así lo hice. La dejé reposar por un rato y estuve lavando hasta la madrugada, aprovechando el agua, porque aquí uno no sabe cuándo nos quedamos sin el vital líquido, jejeje. Y bueno, amigos, esto era lo que les quería contar; la verdad que estamos muy contentos y esperamos seguir adquiriendo otras cosas para nuestro hogar. Gracias por visitar mi blog. ******

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>

Hello, my lovely friends at @homesolutions! It’s a pleasure to greet you on this wonderful day, as we kick off a new week full of blessings for everyone. At home, we’re absolutely thrilled with this new purchase I’m here to tell you about today. First, let me give you a rundown of our situation with this essential household appliance. Over a year ago, after sending our washing machine in for repairs, it stopped working, and the technician kept us waiting anxiously and never showed up; we even paid him for some parts, but he never brought them. Time went by, and I was washing by hand or sometimes going to my mom’s house to use her washing machine—which was only for the wash cycle, so the rest had to be done by hand. So at the beginning of the year, we decided to buy a new one.

![1001769201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uQvaHw4FXuvs8ui2JymhWWGcUgRkvHkmwRnssbJSrxuwM8mdXEzXu7o81gug8yaFphB.jpg) ![1001769202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK3ecLtvt7H9B2RjzknEq92g7rWJCE5b1uKgqAQsYMV2nGwakwxmS8fL83CzU6q.jpg) ![1001769203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK56CuFYxTDpwYVbMvoD55z6W68ZfPrhVVtuNKpaRhMyRDwrcbwjv8zrWDwucy6.jpg)

>

We started looking at different stores to see which one suited us best; there were all sizes, prices, and brands. We were also looking into the different financing options available. Since we couldn’t afford to buy it outright, we decided to put it on layaway, and that’s how, over three months, we gradually paid it off. Until finally, we had enough to make the last payment and pick it up—what a relief. The manager told me they could deliver it in two days and that it was already packed up. They said they’d contact me for the delivery. The good news was that I was just a little bit away from being able to do laundry in my new washing machine. Saturday was the day they were supposed to bring it; we stayed home waiting; the afternoon came and nothing happened. I was getting ready to go downtown to ask what had happened when I got a message saying that the delivery truck had been in an accident, that it would take days to repair it, and asking if I could go pick it up.

![1001769205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/AK6XkTMuvCvywc19GGDvBZgUV9DuCCUw6bhunSBc6SrsQRvADUNUSgKTKqm3skD.jpg) ![1001769204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uQtoBzir8zz3jRsSqBxPvUVGxBcPAPLMGbVpp9i4ZEN1Jmh1M633MYs7QSVpg4Y7Jpn.jpg) ![1001769206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vsFsJWGCtwnmbv6EFcaFRYaryiWiwmmobTwa2qUcpV8GRuTDVVdrUwafm3J8qLws8Rv.jpg)

>

So we got ready, and I went with my husband’s nephew in the van to pick it up at another Genesis store location; we checked it out, and the man who helped us told me he had one of those washing machines and that it was very good. At home, my husband took out the old washing machine and hooked up the new one. I was reading the instruction manual, and one of the things it said was that the first wash should be done without any clothes in it, so that’s what I did. I let it sit for a while and kept washing until the early hours of the morning, making the most of the water, because here you never know when we’ll run out of that precious liquid, hehehe. And well, friends, that’s what I wanted to tell you; the truth is we’re really happy and hope to keep buying other things for our home. Thanks for visiting my blog. **********

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>

Band Maid es una banda de rock japonesa originaria de la ciudad de Tokio, formada en el año 2013. El grupo está integrado por Saiki Atsumi (vocalista), Miku Kobato (vocalista y guitarra), Kanami Tono (guitarra), Akane Hirose (batería) y Misa (bajo).

El grupo combina una imagen potente de rock y heavy metal con la estética de las camareras o maids de los maid café, locales muy populares en Japón. Esta apariencia responde a la visión de la fundadora, Miku Kobato, quien trabajó como camarera en un café del barrio de Akihabara. Por eso, en sus conciertos llaman a sus seguidores masculinos \

, términos propios de la jerga de las camareras de estos establecimientos.

Este contraste visual, sumado a una mezcla musical que abarca el hard rock, heavy metal, metal alternativo y pop rock, junto con letras que hablan de empoderamiento, resistencia y amor propio, convierte a Band Maid en una propuesta novedosa tanto en la escena musical japonesa como en la mundial.

![](https://external-content.duckduckgo.com/iu/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fspice.eplus.jp%2Fimages%2Fz0ddRPIxOcF7vZeBXy264i7xlWx5KZlprdFyzTBSdQNmDEAdHlfwNVzBBFOBYXi1&f=1&nofb=1&ipt=e0097d5b1d729f4576f3bb8c2adcd4f8923354e17522c8d83a1f5382b561f602)

links.title: Not Unreplaceable
links.body:
>

> It is getting weird.

This is just a general statement about the world at large, where it at least appears that everything that matters, is falling apart. With all of our collective intelligence as a species, we have created a global society that is so incredibly imbalanced, that we are heading to total destruction. The major reason for this is that rather than developing for societal growth, meaning wellbeing and opportunity, we focus on making imaginary money instead - and all the silly things that can generate more.

For instance, the \

to maintain population size is around 2.1 children per woman, yet the vast majority of developed countries are *well below* this, with countries like Finland around 1.3, Australia 1.48, South Korea 0.8, and the US around 1.6. Even India, the most populous country on earth, is under replacement at 1.94. Even though developed countries aren't having enough children to replace, underdeveloped countries are having plenty, with Chad and Somalia over 6, Congo 5.98 and Niger 5.94. The global average is around 2.3, which is why the global population is increasing by about 70 million people per year.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23tmFZE4vSgyLQxj9GQB6dETXjyi2RZZRLtfFHShEJV2mwp23N2F4hYARZiUkk7pyMToZ.png)


---

> # Replacement theory?

If you don't know what replacement theory is, it is a conspiracy theory where some believe that white people are being replaced by non-white people in some kind of grand scheme to change the political landscape. While I don't believe in that nonsense, white people *are being replaced* because that is the world we have created, where the poorest countries on earth, often those that have been stripped of natural resources for profit, are having *well above* the number of children for replacement and will ultimately emigrate to places where there aren't enough people.


> Aren't enough people?

Yes. Because while there would be enough people in for instance Australia without the very high immigration levels, the economy isn't made for a declining population. Companies are about increasing profits, and that requires demand and ultimately, growing populations have been the mechanism for that. Not only this, in many countries like Australia, housing has been the main investment vehicle, with most people's largest holding being their home. But, if a population is decreasing, the demand on housing decreases too and therefore, the value of dwellings decrease. 

> In declining population countries, immigration keeps the real estate values up.

The entire economy is built on the need to grow and therefore increase profits. There are other ways to increase profits too, like becoming more efficient, but ultimately it is still going to have to grow eventually otherwise it will start to retract. And for a long time this has been happening, with people putting it down to all the technological advancements. But, I don't think that was the major driver at all.

Because:

---
- 10,000 BCE: ~4 million people
- 1 CE: ~188 million people
- 1800 (1st Billion): ~1 billion people
- 1927 (2nd Billion): ~2 billion people (took 127 years)
- 1960 (3rd Billion): ~3 billion people (took 33 years)
- 1974 (4th Billion): ~4 billion people (took 14 years)
- 1987 (5th Billion): ~5 billion people (took 13 years)
- 1999 (6th Billion): ~6 billion people (took 12 years)
- 2011 (7th Billion): ~7 billion people (took 12 years)
- 2022 (8th Billion): ~8 billion people (took 11 years)
---

The major driving force behind the economy has been a massive growth in the number of consumers, with 6 billion added in the last 100 years, a quadrupling. This massive increase has pushed *everything* and has been further catalysed by technological advancement, globalisation, and the explosion in financial instruments used to generate wealth. But when the populations start to decline, the economic growth model starts to degrade.

And this is especially true once the population is \

increased by immigration from underdeveloped countries, because the demand model changes based on individual resources. People with not much, can't buy much. People with a lot, can buy a lot. But most of the money is in the hands of the extremely wealthy and while they seem to spend a lot to you and me, as a percentage of their actual wealth, they aren't spending much at all. Most of their money is being rolled back into investments to generate more money. 

> The economic system we use is fundamentally broken.

While we have changed in terms of the way we organise ourselves, the economic systems we use haven't evolved to take this into consideration. For example, Keynesian economic theory which champions government intervention through stimulus and taxes to smooth out the economy, wasn't ideated in a world of global conglomerates that do not pay their taxes where they earn them, *if at all.* This means that the government access to the funds for stimulus (government spending) has been removed, so they only have the other side to raise the funds, increasing taxes for citizens who *have to pay their tax locally.* 

> It doesn't work. 

Which is why while corporations are hitting all time highs in valuations, governments are taking on more and more debt burden at the cost to their citizens. The corporations can rip money out of a country like diamonds out of Africa, without having to return any value into the country. And of course the many digital service companies, don't even employ many local people to pay personal income taxes anyway. The corporations benefit from the broken system, the average citizen pays the price, *multiple times.*

And then, to try and keep valuations up on investments like housing and to ensure there is a large enough customer base, the countries up immigration. But, the immigrants aren't coming in flush with cash looking to spend, because the countries where some people have some wealth, have a declining birth rate and people don't emigrate away as much. So, the majority of immigrants have to come from places where they have to \

which means they are coming into a population where their personal wealth is likely at the bottom of the local average. So they can't really drive demand much locally anyway, but still need housing and essentials. 

>Still, they might have a better quality of life living in poverty in their new country, than their old.

But, while average people are fighting over immigration and the reasons for housing and cost of living crises, the real reason for all of the problems is that we have built the economy around maximising wealth, rather than wellbeing. This has created a world where there are massive disparities in wealth even within the same country, city or suburb, which means large differences in opportunity, quality of life, and general wellbeing. At A city has its wealthy suburbs and its slums, but we have done the same thing to the entire global population, all in the name of a few having an extreme amount more than the 99 percent. 

And it is this disparity where resources and opportunity haven't been distributed by the economic systems adequately, that has created a complete breakdown of all of the things that actually matter to our species; Wellbeing, opportunity, social value, health, family, education, environmental and social improvement... 

\

can't be a take from the rich and hand to the poor either, because that is going to fail spectacularly. It has to be a change in the way we organise ourselves, and the way we *value each other.* Wealth can't just keep increasing, because it has to be tied to something. It was tied to a growing population that generated demand, but that system has been broken, and wasn't sustainable due to resource constraints anyway. Economic growth has to be tied to something that *has no end,* and that is advancing human wellbeing. > A population can retract and human wellbeing can keep increasing. We have less children being born in many countries and therefore a rapidly increasing aging population. Healthcare systems are being inundated at the same time they are being stripped of resources, companies are making insane profits by reducing workforce, and government debt just keeps increasing, as spending on unnecessaries expands rapidly, whilst their access to wealth is being blocked due to severely outdated corporate tax laws. > As said, *the world is falling apart. And these are just a couple of the points that are impacting on the entire macro of humanity, which is rapidly falling into a state of decay, with mental, physical and social health issues mounting up to the point that many people are just giving up, because without access to opportunity and resources, *Why the fuck bother?* > We are all being replaced. It isn't a conspiracy, it is the economy. links.title: Good Omens - Amazon Prime Video.
links.body:
>

Last month, one of the most exciting finales arrived on Prime Video, a series that carved out a niche for itself with a loyal fanbase over its run. A series that touched many hearts, including mine. As a huge fan of drama and comedy, I must say that discovering this show brought me some of the best moments as a viewer and a loyal Prime Video subscriber.

>***El mes pasado llegó uno de los finales más emocionantes a Prime Video, una serie que hizo su lugar con muchos fans fieles, que obtuvo a lo largo de los años que esta duró. Una serie que ha llegado a muchos corazones, incluyéndome a mí, como gran fanática del drama y la comedia debo decir que haber descubierto esta serie me trajo de los mejores momentos como televidente y fiel a Prime Video.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

I remember starting to watch this series when its second season premiered, and it was mostly because of the posters, which I found very appealing. The fantasy theme of Angels and Demons drew me in even more. I can also say that the chemistry between the characters is incredibly palpable, truly unique, and feels real and genuine, which made me grow very fond of each of them.

>***Recuerdo que comencé a ver esta serie cuando se estrenó su segunda temporada, y fue más por sus pósteres que me parecieron muy atractivos, y más aún con la temática fantástica de Ángeles y Demonios que esta tiene me atrajo aún más. También, puedo decir que la química que hay entre los personajes es altamente palpable, realmente única, se siente real y muy genuina, algo que me hizo encariñar mucho con cada uno de ellos.***

Good Omens tells the story of Aziraphale and Crowley, an angel and a demon who have spent their existence watching over and intervening in \

since the beginning. They grow increasingly close, sharing a love story that I simply admire. And as I already mentioned, this series makes the interaction between the characters feel real, and many have attributed this to the fact that Michael Sheen and David Tennant are friends in real life, and they share a very entertaining on-screen chemistry.\n\n>***Good Omens nos cuenta la historia de Aziraphale y Crowley, un ángel y un demonio que han pasado su existencia vigilando e interviniendo en \

desde el inicio de la existencia. Estos se vuelven cada vez más unidos, y comparten una historia de amor que sencillamente admiro. Y tal cual ya dije, esta serie te hace sentir real la interacción entre los personajes, y muchos han dicho a que se debe a que Michael Sheen y David Tennant son amigos en la vida real, y estos comparten una muy divertida química como actores en pantalla.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23u5bK9G2oAkxY8zqtGRHVsmBh95fpRFYHZSyw9zQhDmRY2BAD4UFqjhFkue5B67CR2ai.png)

[Espinof](https://www.espinof.com/amazon-prime-video/temporada-2-sandwich-relleno-como-final-good-omens-enlazara-temporada-3-serie-amazon-prime-video-secuela-inedita-libro)

<div class\

>

I'm not saying their real-life relationship is like that of platonic lovers or anything; they're both heterosexual (as far as I know, or maybe I just don't care), but their chemistry is intense. So, besides being palpable, it's clear they had fun and enjoyed working together on a unique and intelligent love story.

>***No me refiero a que el amor entre ellos en la vida real sea como la de amantes platónicos ni nada, realmente ellos son Heterosexuales (hasta donde sé, o realmente ni idea ni atención con ello), sino, que su química es intensa. Así que aparte de palpable, es notorio que estos se divirtieron y disfrutaron trabajar juntos en una historia de amor distinta e inteligente.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23uQ3c1UgQaUpMbtw8ojmYNWQZXGmqm6f7v4hLwrbpgabXZ9XVQf4iqKjcDBGjEbksWQU.png)

[Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/0N4OPSBX6TV4Y1WU0O8ELH2D4T)

<div class\

>

This series draws on biblical elements, but obviously with its own twists and turns beyond fiction. Despite a low budget, this series has succeeded thanks to something quite different. I must say, whoever created this series is one of the most skilled and entertaining people in the world. They know exactly what to say and how to make their shows work. It's not about epic battles or over-the-top CGI, but rather about comedic, sad, and moving moments, among many others, that give the series its meaning—something that reminds me of The Good Place.

>***Esta serie trabaja con datos bíblicos, pero obviamente con sus toques más allá de ficción. Con un bajo presupuesto, esta serie se sostuvo con algo muy distinto, debo decir que quien hizo esta serie es de las personas más hábiles y entretenida del mundo, sabe que palabras usar y como hacer que eso sea lo que vale en sus series, no luchas épicas, ni llevadas al extremo con mucho CGI, sino de momentos cómicos, tristes, emocionantes y muchas más que le dan sentido a esta serie, algo que me recuerda a The Good Place.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/Eoc1CEBQbNS3hGNfmJdVBZHMsLGtf3amKxHaskpZm6yfLQo1W8ZEd6ZqJxWyTdZ5AZM.png)

[Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/0Q7GFNBQ6IPO87MX4G4WD4GT4I)

<div class\

>

On the other hand, some controversies Neil Gaiman faced some time ago led him to completely resign from the production of this series, cruelly impacting the show and bringing it to an end. Fans insisted too much on a proper ending, which he didn't want, and they had to improvise a lot for the finale, with only one episode for the third season. That is, they only gave us an hour and a half for the finale, but although the episode was rushed, they really gave it a beautiful and dignified ending for the protagonists, with a message of encouragement and hope that made me cry.

>***Por otro lado, algunas polémicas que tuvo Neil Gaiman hace un tiempo hizo que este renunciara en su totalidad de la producción de esta serie, afectando cruelmente la serie y llevándola a su fin, los fans insistieron demasiado a que se le diera un cierre digno, que no quería llegar, y debieron improvisar mucho en su final, con un único episodio para su temporada número tres, o sea, solo nos dieron una hora y media para su final, pero aunque el episodio fue apresurado, realmente le dieron un final hermoso, y digno para los protagonistas, con un mensaje de aliento y esperanza que me hizo llorar.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23uQpZRvBfpJT6YL8ePamwh71WX2CgM9UX44mCepMJzZEWjEPk8AoMPV7XbAhx2snApwh.png)

[Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/0Q7GFNBQ6IPO87MX4G4WD4GT4I)

<div class\

> Good Omens is a fantastic series available on Amazon Originals, and I guarantee you'll enjoy every episode of Aziraphale and Crowley's adventures. If you decide to watch it, I hope you enjoy it. >***Good Omens es una serie muy genial que puedes conseguir en el catálogo de Amazon Originals, y te aseguro que disfrutaras cada episodio con las aventuras que tienen Aziraphale y Crowley. links.title: The \
Ruling Must Go!  It's An Outdated Legal Aberration
links.body: ![OhBillyBoy is the author of this picture/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/01/13/23/05/us-1978465_1280.jpg)\n\nConsidering that there are now six conservative Republican Supreme Court justices on the bench of the Supreme Court of the United States (\
), I cannot even fathom how the ruling of ***[Coker vs. Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coker_v._Georgia)*** (\

) has lasted for as long as it has.  I would think that these Supreme Court justices would have been as anxious to get rid of this ruling as they were to overturn *Roe vs. Wade* back in 2022, but somehow this same case law continues to hang on.\n\nPerhaps we need to send these Supreme Court justices a copy of the YouTube video below so that they are able to see how vitally important it is for them to overturn the *Coker* ruling.  In his video below, a gentleman whose YouTube channel is named \

delivers an informative presentation of the facts behind a young man's nightmare upon entering into a dangerous state correctional facility. A Teenager Is Locked Up In State Prison And Is Gang-Raped By Inmates He Thought Were His Friends https://youtu.be/8Wq_SviEy0M?si=9OUuDQ4ksMXZKFfl It doesn't take a rocket scientist to realize that the only way the United States is going to put a stop to sexual violence behind bars is by expanding the death penalty to execute prison rapists, period. The *Coker* ruling simply has no place in our criminal justice system at this point in time. Young inmates are contracting deadly venereal diseases at the hands of hardened criminals. The fact that the narrator in the above video was a minor himself when he was locked up with career criminals in an adult correctional facility shows you precisely how broken our prisons are throughout our nation. Meanwhile, you have truly dangerous criminals like Joshua Duggar having the time of their life behind bars. It makes absolutely no sense at all. According to the video above, here we have a case of a young man who was barely out of high school that made the mistake of getting behind a wheel while he was intoxicated and wrecked his vehicle, causing the death of his high-school sweetheart, among other things. Then he was tried and convicted and then locked up with the worst of the worst. For the purpose of this article, I'm going to refer to him as \

The inmates that Cliff had thought were his friends turned on him like betraying angels and each took turns raping him. Then after he spent two weeks in a hospital, he found out that they gave him HIV. Now, tell me that these actions on the part of his inmates do not warrant the death penalty for each and every one of them. They are moles on the butt of society. Reverend Al Sharpton does not need to be defending these scumbags, because you know and I know that if someone did this to his daughter, he would immediately be on his cell phone, putting a contract out on their lives. In that event, he wouldn't even care if their ancestors were from the same African tribe as his. Their black lives would not matter to him. No racial offense intended. Are any of these rapists' names and information going to appear on a sex-offender registry after they are someday released from prison? Probably not. As ridiculous as our sex-offender-registration laws are here in the United States, the people who deserve the most to be listed on the sex-offender registry somehow never seem to become subjected to that same indignity for some reason or another. Prison rapists never seem to get punished for their crimes behind bars. Once they are released from prison, they'll probably reap the benefits of some ex-offender program that will provide them with a college education on the taxpayers' dime so that they can get jobs making $50 an hour. Meanwhile, their rape victim will likely end up destitute and homeless and will spend his last days of life suffering from HIV. Our criminal justice system is such a joke that it's not even funny. Back when the SCOTUS handed down the *Coker* ruling, the United States of America was a much different society than it is today. The year was 1977. A gay Canadian flight attendant had just brought the AIDS virus into the United States. Therefore, nobody really knew about it or what AIDS or HIV was until a couple of years later. There were different people on the bench of the SCOTUS back then. Americans were not as learned about the tragedies of prison rape back then as they are now. The big argument behind the *Coker* ruling is that if a prison rapist does not murder his victim, then he should not go to death row. My response to that school of thought is that if a prison rapist gives his victims the AIDS virus and they later die, why doesn't he at least get sentenced to the death penalty then? Never mind all this crap about something being a thing of the past. If you fell victim to an injustice 50 years ago and it's still adversely affecting your life, then it is no different from whether it happened to you 50 minutes ago. I don't believe in a statute of limitations for something like this in any shape, way, or form. What really disgusts me is that whenever one of these teenage inmates kills a prison rapist in self-defense, usually the court system will add time to their sentence instead of taking their situation into consideration. The police are equally as corrupt in our nation as our judicial officials insofar as they are violating the very same statutes that they push elected officials to put on the law books. Norman Michael Achin exposes this same problem in his video below. Norman Michael Achin Exposes The Hypocrisy Of American Police Officers When It Comes To Enforcing The Laws https://youtu.be/cCGHw7VFUgo?si=cpq2B8g5l3X4Otxq The only thing that the governor of any state jurisdiction of our nation would have to do in an effort to overturn the *Coker* ruling would be to pass a law in their state that would redefine prison rape as a capital offense. Once a case of that nature was to surface in their court system, then the SCOTUS would politely allow their state's attorney general to appear before them in Washington, D.C. to argue in favor of overturning this same case law. I found out about these same procedures to get a SCOTUS ruling overturned when I was watching what I vaguely recalled to be the Attorney General of Alabama talking about how the SCOTUS would factor into their state's recent enactment of the death penalty for anyone who sexually victimized a child under 12 years of age. You cannot make this stuff up. The industrial-prison complex cares nothing about fairness and justice. The oligarchs and billionaires behind this same industry are only interested in making money off of human slave labor. At the same time, correctional facilities are breeding savages that have no mercy for anyone that falls prey to them. Prison rapists seldom ever get rehabilitated, and likely none of them suffer an attack of conscience for the atrocities that they commit against inmates that they see as weaklings. Therefore, it is time that state jurisdictions across the United States enact laws that would sentence these same lowlifes to the death penalty for their heinous crimes. We don't needs these statutes placed on our law books as trigger laws. We need elected officials to enact them as actual laws that actively do what they are designed to do. That is, eliminate the scourge of our prison system. Let's also not forget that Cliff contracted HIV from the inmates that gang-raped him. Once he gets out of prison, his life is going to continue to go downhill, because we have to remember that the United States does not have Universal Healthcare; and it is going to be difficult for him to find a job with a police record. Therefore, getting health insurance through an employer will be no guarantee for him. Cliff won't even be able to get state-assisted suicide legally if the pain he suffers from his ailment becomes too unbearable. Our lawmakers have a way adding insult to injury whenever religious zealots somehow find their way into the mix. Not that I would ever want anyone to commit suicide. I simply don't understand why our more faith-based elected officials, so to speak, seem to like pain and suffering as long as it's not their own. ![ArtsyBeeKids is the creator of this image/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/10/18/19/23/fairness-5665879_1280.png) I realize that I'm going to receive harsh backlash for this article as I did for a similar previous article of mine, but I'm publishing it anyhow. There is no other direction for our nation to move in at this point in time. Prison rape will never go away in our nation, unless elected officials and appointed officials work together to provide a deterrent against it. I'm all in favor of stare decisis, but judges in the highest court of our land need to take a good look at the bigger picture and do what is right. **This article is copyright-protected.**

links.title: Bizcocho húmedo de coco (sin horno) [ESP-ENG]
links.body: >¡Hola comunidad de Hive Food! A veces las recetas más memorables son aquellas que nos sorprenden cuando menos lo esperamos. Este fin de semana me animé a preparar un bizcocho húmedo de coco utilizando únicamente la cocina, sin horno, y debo admitir que no tenía grandes expectativas. Sin embargo, el resultado fue mucho mejor de lo que imaginaba. El bizcocho quedó suave, esponjoso y con una textura increíble. Lo que más me gustó fue ver cómo absorbió toda la leche condensada, convirtiéndose en un postre húmedo y lleno de sabor en cada bocado. Para darle el toque final, tosté un poco de coco con azúcar y lo utilicé como cobertura. Ese detalle sencillo aportó una textura crocante que contrastó perfectamente con la suavidad del bizcocho. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes esta deliciosa experiencia que me dejó con ganas de repetir la receta muy pronto.\n\n

>Hello Hive Food community! Sometimes the most memorable recipes are the ones that surprise us when we least expect it. This past weekend, I decided to make a moist coconut cake using only the stovetop, without an oven, and honestly, I wasn’t expecting much. However, the result turned out far better than I imagined. The cake was soft, fluffy, and had an amazing texture. What I loved most was how it absorbed all the condensed milk, creating a rich and moist dessert full of flavor in every bite. To finish it off, I toasted some coconut with sugar and used it as a topping. That simple touch added a crunchy texture that paired perfectly with the softness of the cake. Today, I’m excited to share this delicious experience with all of you.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:

>3 tazas de harina de trigo, 4 huevos, 3 tazas de leche, 1 cucharada de polvo para hornear, 1 pizca de sal, 1 1/2 taza de azúcar, 1/2 taza de aceite, 150 GR de coco rallado, 60 ML de leche condensada.\n\n

>3 cups all-purpose flour, 4 eggs, 3 cups milk, 1 tablespoon baking powder, a pinch of salt, 1 1/2 cups sugar, 1/2 cup oil, 150 g shredded coconut, 60 ml condensed milk. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:
>En un bol mezclé parte de los ingredientes secos, la harina, el polvo para hornear y una pizca de sal, en otro bol mezclé los huevos, el aceite y 1 taza de azúcar, reservé todo.\n\n
>In one bowl, I mixed some of the dry ingredients—the flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt—and in another bowl, I mixed the eggs, oil, and 1 cup of sugar. I set everything aside. ***

>Uní ambas mezclas, luego incorporé la leche para terminar de integrar los ingredientes, cociné prácticamente a baño María, usé un sartén grueso y dos ollas que encajaban a la perfección, en la más grande deben añadir un poco de agua, no olviden enharinar el recipiente que usarán para cocinar su bizcocho, cociné a fuego bajo durante 1 y 30 minutos, eso sí, demora más cocinar en la cocina.\n

>I combined both mixtures, then added the milk to fully incorporate the ingredients. I cooked it almost like a double boiler—I used a heavy skillet and two pots that fit together perfectly. Add a little water to the larger pot. Don’t forget to flour the pan you’ll use to bake your cake. I cooked it over low heat for 1 hour and 30 minutes, though it does take longer to cook on the stovetop. ***

>Terminé la cocción y retiré del fuego, prueben insertando un palillo, si sale limpio está listo el bizcocho, retire la pancita del bizcocho que estaba un poco quemada, ahora preparé un líquido para mojar el bizcocho usando 2 tazas de leche y 60 ML de leche condensada, bañé el bizcocho con el líquido y dejé reposar toda la noche.\n

>I finished baking it and took it off the heat. Test it by inserting a toothpick—if it comes out clean, the cake is done. I removed the bottom of the cake, which was a little burnt. Then I made a syrup to soak the cake using 2 cups of milk and 60 ml of condensed milk. I poured the syrup over the cake and let it sit overnight. ***
>Finalmente coroné la receta con coco tostado, al estar frío el coco integré 1/2 taza de azúcar, esa preparación la usé como cobertura crocante para el bizcocho.\n
>Finally, I topped the cake with toasted coconut. Since the coconut was cold, I mixed in 1/2 cup of sugar, and used that mixture as a crunchy topping for the cake. ***

Con un poco de creatividad y ganas de experimentar, es posible obtener resultados que incluso superan nuestras expectativas. Este bizcocho fue una prueba de ello, y cada bocado valió completamente la pena. Ahora me gustaría conocer su opinión. ¿Han preparado alguna vez un bizcocho en la cocina sin horno? ¿Qué ingrediente le agregarían a esta versión de coco? Los invito a compartir sus comentarios, ideas y experiencias. Siempre es un placer leerlos y descubrir nuevas inspiraciones culinarias. Muchas gracias por llegar hasta aquí y acompañarme en esta dulce aventura. ¡Nos vemos en una próxima receta! > This recipe reminded me that we don’t always need special equipment to create something delicious. With a little creativity and a willingness to experiment, we can achieve results that even exceed our expectations. This cake was proof of that, and every bite was absolutely worth it. Now I would love to hear your thoughts. Have you ever made a cake on the stovetop without an oven? What ingredient would you add to this coconut version? Feel free to share your comments, ideas, and experiences. I always enjoy reading them and discovering new culinary inspirations. Thank you so much for making it this far and joining me on this sweet adventure. See you in the next recipe!

links.body:
Today I collected some berries at my mothers garden and froze them in the freezer for her. Unfortunately there were a lot of ticks wandering around on the bushes and I stopped pretty early since I didn't want any to bite me. Afterwards I took a bath and inspected every inch of my body so I don't get one sticking to me. 
I really hate these blood sucking insects. All that I found, I burned in a piece of toilet paper.

links.title: For a Gyrocompass.
links.body: > To aid two Quen navigators, I scaled a landing zone and flew a Sunwing toward a nearby shipwreck. Upon arrival at the beach, I easily brought down an attacking Frost Glinthawk using acid arrows, but the overwhelming strength of a nearby Snapmaw forced me to call my mount and retreat. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbKh6C2oeo39nxbPfdt5KV7rdL1y1wwU7S87bgu26p1WE/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPftCvYQfvVHhAcgr9VKqktigVTiU6Ng2nrXvrdFNtgpZ/screenshot_2_.png) Harriem and Kristia, two Quen navigators, required a gyroscompass to guide their fleet on the return journey home; they needed Aloy to retrieve it from the wreckage of one of their ships. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHnSmhUZdUUGSrsHDjuh8ZppvAFiUNJP31UQP1UhhCVk/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW9zjKqjabNV3Ab6LfK8xwtnAj6Bg4zSW1uCDt1WAwpfn/screenshot_4_.png) After promising I would help them, I climbed up to that Sunwing landing zone to see if I could find the right there, but I didn't. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkRDgS9YwfVsodjEbxvftLJdiPyCMXQgDKbf8MjY2hJU/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQTPJ2PjwSk5GK8t62rb9d2mcWyJLcFMssTcL1z3Gnugu/screenshot_6_.png) But right when I whistled, the Sunwing came to take me on its back, which it was not doing while I was below on the camp, and I started flying towards the shipwreck. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRK15qCLLsx47ZjDXxTquSXuVJ4yxTb7icGPqs4ZV1xT/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRPzZ7xidTjKyFG6jr5kUbDEBk47Pq2KzeBqGumdLpqp3/screenshot_8_.png) After flying for a moment, I noticed the shipwreck was not so far from that land, as I used the photo mode to check both ways, my forward and my backward. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcG32eQ4iz91CA2Vc7VzXSXd32i23tYfs8BRqgcvxukrq/screenshot_9_.png) And then I noticed, as per those navigators were mentioning, the ocean water was too tight with its current on my way toward the shipwreck. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcdKU2KdYUDZCMsSk9J86xJmdvyjnzdgeD3McenAvS9TF/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeFUCjuieg5zA9xQ7W3JhgzGGYLsBNmSsmz63mmqABuaz/screenshot_11_.png) After reaching the shipwreck, I noticed there was a bird, which was a Frost Glinthawk, and it started attacking me right when it saw me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQbd4iWVpgYKrUQaV39VXDQBkapJUG3KskoFT4SmHudm/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvvJ4BQqSfjNF6DGk31D1iAXWoS1XYp1kPdRbikZJj6y/screenshot_13_.png) I knew I couldn't attack it back while I was on my mount, so I landed on the tiny beach there and that Glinthawk still kept attacking us, which was worrying me that I might lose my ride back to the land. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeySMSEWPp1PJrP4oL7ZxUHv3BX7zTj5XheiGK4H3aBx/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1j4QD4iPY6f4kX6zsPaEhZTsJcNUTScQDApeD98iiMu/screenshot_15_.png) Then I started shooting the Glinthawk with acid arrows, though I didn't hope in my dream that it would be this easy to take this beast down. My Sunwing still didn't leave me behind while I was taking down the beast. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfEg2k8VRxPt6x8a5PoftbD8RZT7fdDFGhhdstBVKLkq/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmmW3oHTN4A7SnzrwjtuvGy5jbVgGxXVUv5EkQrAvDZZ/screenshot_17_.png) That bird was not the only predator there; there was Snapmaw around, so I started shooting it, but it was far stronger than the bird, that I understood when I engaged in a fight with it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSpC8MuHPJnb7jrCbcjYeE26mHKfrK6QQT6pG49SSC936/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQi8qQC5npv6AbYssa7vG4WovvrewTLkzh6iUnn9Urr1n/screenshot_19_.png) When I understood I didn't have any opening on that machine from up close, I whistled and took help of my Sunwing to escape its wrath at first while the Snapmaw kept attacking us from afar. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU.

links.title: THE COW FROM THE NIGHTMARE WORLD
links.body:
![IMG_20260607_103627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damoclesart/23wgaPLcaDzxWUzhVAyxEhcNUqTTmAQbT1dBZX9L1ZftrwpehWcewe15R6QyeQGPhridW.jpg)

Happy afternoon to everyone at #alienarthive! I hope you're all doing well today. It's been a while since I posted here, but today I'm sharing a recent illustration with a surreal and dark theme. It's a cow that lives in nightmares, one that wanders through endless fields with an uncertain path. links.title: Reflection Hunters Contest - The First Fishing Of This Year
links.body:
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4Q6TCwdf9QpYeZPiJXXFKJNyf6NJLnDJkP4Cxgf9hQE/20260607_030207427_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4Q6TCwdf9QpYeZPiJXXFKJNyf6NJLnDJkP4Cxgf9hQE/20260607_030207427_ios.jpg) *This is my application for the contest [Reflection Hunters Contest - SMARP (Show Me A Reflection Picture) ~ Round 275 🎺 Announcement 🎺](https://ecency.com/@olgavita/reflection-hunters-contest-smarp-show-0db473787e887) by @olgavita* @olgavita, how do you feel about walking along the riverbank? Are you ready to go fishing with me on a fishing, a virtual fishing trip? I already went to the river this morning and even waved the spinning rod a little. It was a spinning test, the first fishing in 2026. I'm not going to create an intrigue, and I'll say right away that I didn't see any fish today, but I caught the reflection of clouds in the river.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKTmBcZdecwpa6TCyv2RxWPMHLAgD2bEmBUfhebKHpuS/20260607_030843639_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKTmBcZdecwpa6TCyv2RxWPMHLAgD2bEmBUfhebKHpuS/20260607_030843639_ios.jpg) This is the closest riverbank to my house. I don't usually fish in this place anymore, but I only stretch my arm at the beginning of the season. There are always a lot of fishermen on this site from spring to autumn. Once upon a time, people went fishing on foot, but now almost everyone has equipment - a car, a motorcycle, and therefore people can easily move to the right place on the river. And this is especially facilitated by the availability of motorboats. 20 years ago, it was very rare.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUSSQcuuz1CA1rfWXTJW2ToommHjGijaRmd5SmhPNaWum/20260607_031147714_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUSSQcuuz1CA1rfWXTJW2ToommHjGijaRmd5SmhPNaWum/20260607_031147714_ios.jpg) I didn't take my dog for a walk today. When I walked past her, she didn't even realize she was staying at home. When I was already on the river, my wife called me and said that the dog was crying, whining, and howling. I would take Nora with me, but I am not sure that she will walk along the shore calmly, especially since I saw two more people, and I do not know what their reaction to the dog will be.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsci7KQKLUjBPow36Jq5UQX1EJt3nXgNgDWTEi7V37ev/20260607_031423585_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsci7KQKLUjBPow36Jq5UQX1EJt3nXgNgDWTEi7V37ev/20260607_031423585_ios.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGumDKPBYecejcbDfo4kGnDf9vWiZXCkYk3u2sPnQ2Vx/20260607_033503235_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGumDKPBYecejcbDfo4kGnDf9vWiZXCkYk3u2sPnQ2Vx/20260607_033503235_ios.jpg) When I went to the river, the sun was shining brightly, but in an hour the sky changed, and by the end of the fishing trip, the Sun was not visible. Mosquitoes. Where did these bloodthirsty mosquitoes come from? I'm going home. I still have to get to my computer and work.
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png)
**Thanks for reading...**

With love @apnigrich
Good luck and have fun

links.title: Dnešní den
links.body:
S Ráďou Náprstkem jsme strávili odpoledne u pivka, tabáku a sdílením schizofrenních zážitků.

On má důchod jako já, ale je hrozně hodnej kluk.

Večer jsem byl na piuku s Honzou Dobiášem a přišla řeč na Mateníky a jeho 24 preludií v 72 preludiích.

Krásně zkomponovaná skladba a krásně dravá a živočišná:

https://youtu.be/cRZevu7spvQ?is=dGXTE7SHFV4Pufn9

Včerejší vystoupení s Jirkou už je na webu:

[https://youtu.be/uMPCzB4VWWM?is=t00h87KDQMHpvwfp](https://youtu.be/uMPCzB4VWWM?is=t00h87KDQMHpvwfp)

A druhý kus:

[https://youtu.be/YxUPt57Dr3Y?is=\_pkN-W9nr-KFUDLY](https://youtu.be/YxUPt57Dr3Y?is=_pkN-W9nr-KFUDLY)

Jsem za naše výstupy rád a Jirka je hrozně fajn hráč, čekají nás velké věci.

Teda až se vrátí z Erasmu...

Těším se na Ostravu, kde mi budou hrát skladbu. Přenáší ji rozhlas, dám včas vědět, kdy ho naladit.

Třeba se mi poštěstí soutěž vyhrát, jsem napjatý.

Přijímačky na magistra by měly být v pohodě, doufám, že mě nikdo nepotopí.

Honza mě pozval na dvě pivka, v rozpočtu to udělá znatelný vliv.

Chybí mi blízkost a něha...

Martička šíří svému kamarádovi mojí tvorbu a ptala se na to, čím na mém kanálu začít.

Nabízí se Mateníky, Cesta, Světlosmutnění, Labyrint, Vločka...

Doufám, že se máte dobře, já mířím na poslední bus do Strašecí a pak rovnou do hajan.

Dobrou!

H.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYfStHBcLWAdxkzvBkBeQSV1SuTvbRxYFjDLZPzfTBrBu/1780951573356.jpg)

Hello friends!
Happy  #aliveandthriving Monday afternoon to you, and thank you for your visit!
✨🙋🏻‍♀️✨ 
This morning I was outside watering the plants and took a few photos I would like to share with you this afternoon!

So first (they are on the property, but not mine) I passed the Lilies that grow in the back area, they are the white variety and not the pink ones. This is a view from top down,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcj25vTTSk8YSFrwHPkAN6oMwVH1GWhFry4hZ4esaqkr2/1780951588133.jpg)

And this is a straight on view,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGJrGTWnsfe6U2hqfZiCqaTtQW89tHuvMDN6fYWqCLWu/1780951599335.jpg)

These plants get really no care and keep growing back - a good thing!

And now back to my plants! 
This is the Portulaca / \

that a month ago was a tiny piece someone gave me,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZmCotdvtcohy33SnN5chvJB3MBuoo397ft9yyZmg8a2q/1780951619538.jpg)

It has taken off like nothing I have ever seen! This is a top down view,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqsd5FNtcF1my6mWQubCyBkoZaLfkp7ygs4pDd67wVVQ/1780951640505.jpg)

A Very happy plant!

These are the Pineapple plant. After the freeze in February it was looking \

, but they have come back and look pretty healthy!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSw3DsEhhMtgT22hGctTvkkyXWuHCQCpZL95YpD6hsLXi/1780951654279.jpg)

And finally I also grew some Habinaro peppers that I had not shown you all before. From the Pepper plants that I grew - this one Habinaro plant has more peppers than the rest - combined! This is a look through the leaves,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVp3teeD6o4n9kA7CuHVUw2hBH2vauBr4wDPp4yZvbime/1780951664836.jpg)

And this is another pepper, only a few days old,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmetFBmaiCp72dF6ggcNRPyjGscvRjXKqBfxTBxnJ2FUZS/1780951678197.jpg)

And that was my #aliveandthriving Monday morning with the plants!
I want to thank you again for your visit and I am Wishing you a Very Blessed, Happy, and Safe Tuesday!
