links.title: Making a short for a little boy  with elastic waist band and side pockets
links.body:
# Hello everyone 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYQuCqH4fiDjhYJCwyoWHsfxjgfYYeVKwkSbR6zy8xVJB/1780940787283.jpg)

Greetings to you all on this beautiful Monday and I hope you are all doing great, it is my pleasure to share with you today the cutting and sewing process of this lovely short I made for a little boy with elastic waist band, it is one of the things I hav been wanted to try out but unfortunately the opportunity didn't come until fewdays ago that I had to make some outfit from some of the fabric I was given. I will be showing you below the cutting and sewing process.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNib9cjKKwzK8VumLMoqv9jBCuDsoSQawfsLJhkrZoei/1780941053106.jpg)

This idea cae as a result of the limited fabric I had with me, initially,I was supposed make a long trouser bu unfortunately fabric was not enough so I decided to make a short instead of a long trouser, though tis is my first attempt of makia short for a little boy with side pockets and I'm glad the outcome was really nice. Before now, I have been making top and trouser outfit for adults with elastic waist band, all I needed to do is to follow same step with the measurements I had with me and the end result was just perfect.

# Join me as I take you through the cutting and sewing below 

 I folded the fabric in two to cut out the front part of the short, I marked the waist circumference 20÷4= 5 plus 2\

extra at the side for ease and seam allowance 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjdGC3g7jGvKhJJX9Y6LP4SqQhMpinJxX3gCC81zB83A/1780941988375.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGwtENeWtrDeptvZLLY55eWTJVeCiUAsYX6QcvwoqqaP/1780941988475.jpg)

I took 1 piece from the front and 1 piece from the back as well and it was sewn together with the side pockets and hem with the 2\

into the waist line and this is the final outcome 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNib9cjKKwzK8VumLMoqv9jBCuDsoSQawfsLJhkrZoei/1780942324909.jpg)

I hope you like the beautiful outcome of this short I mad for a little boy with elastic waist band and side pockets.

# Join me in my next post for beautiful creativity and craft from my sewing.

# Thanks so much for your time, support, comment and encouragement. Until my next post, do have a great and productive week.

links.title: The Expensive Mistake of Gaslighting Your Own Instincts
links.body:
> I'm still surprised by the human ability to tell where it could go wrong and still they don't believe their intuition and proceed to make that one wrong decision which will haunt them forever.
I believe our instincts are one of the Goat'ed instrument we have got and the ability to listen to your gut saying is something else, we all need to master it and save our time from the disaster. Everytime I went against my own instincts, it cost me a lot of fortune and I've realised there's no point of gaslighting yourself into thinking that you're wrong about something. Accept it and move on, your instinct rarely lies and are mostly true cause it somehow knows the pattern but you're not willing to recognise it which is bad.

My instinct saved me from Luna, ftx and more

Back then in 2021 people were very convincing that you should invest into Luna and trade on ftx but I've always dodged that bullet. Cause I had this feeling like it's not something I should get involved into. I stayed out, missed the potential returns but those are not promised Weren't promising at all, it ended up collapsing and plenty of people lost life savings while I suffered loss in other coins that recovered in upcoming years but not the Luna nor ftx has recovered ever since. If only it wasn't me trusting my own instincts it'd have been gone very bad for me. But when it turned bad? The times when I ignored my instincts, always ended up as a regret.

My instincts told me to sell before October

I'd never stop blaming myself for not selling back before October. I was into sei position and clipped like 70% of Portfolio into it When market started going down I felt like it is still right time to sell and stay in stables, instead I bought more. Ignoring my own instincts And what happened? I'm still bagholding while it is down more than 95% from the entry. So basically what Luna and ftx couldn't do, SEI and XPL did it in couple of months. I'm looking like an absolute retard whenever I show myself mirror for buying those coins when it were that high and I've been telling myself I should have listened to my own gut feelings but I guess now isn't the right time to say all that? We are way past it and now either riding it to zero or making it all back when we will get alt coins season that will recover our coins that are down 95%? But at this point I don't even feel anything after recurring losses, it's like mind has adapted to this reality and now I'm somehow suppose to break this endless pattern before it is too late. Wonder how you treat your instincts? Do share about it in the comments. that's all folks. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@idksamad78699/the-expensive-mistake-of-gaslighting-your-own-instincts-bpe)

links.title: /Es-En/  \
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Cada vez que visito la comunidad @holos-lotus, me llevo algún aprendizaje e ideas para meditar, como esta semana en que tocaron el tema del arrepentimiento varios de ustedes.  Muy apreciados por mí, no los nombro para hacerles sentir obligados a responder. 
# Solidaridad, arrepentimiento y resiliencia  
Destacaron la semana pasada y hoy que llueve, miro las calles de mis caminatas en las fotos que les comparto.
>Every time I visit the @holos-lotus community, I take away some learning and ideas for reflection, like this week when several of you touched on the topic of regret. I greatly appreciate your contributions, and I won't name you to make you feel obligated to respond.

# Solidarity, regret, and resilience
>You stood out last week, and today, as it rains, I look at the streets from my walks in the photos I'm sharing with you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcm7KYZhviBfimG2AJj6Tegvi9H5iWkveZnsnZxUGR2Hy/image.png)

Emigrado de Venezuela a Argentina hace escasos dos años en edad de jubilación, cuando no estoy haciendo jabón, salgo a caminar por el barrio en esta agradable y enorme metrópoli que es Buenos Aires y cuando no leo y escribo en Hive o miro el acontecer mundial por las redes sociales.
Y aunque no lo parezca, la solidaridad está presente en todas partes, solo que las buenas acciones suelen ser calladas. Silenciosas y hasta anónimas, como aconsejaba el buen Jesús. Que no sepa tu mano izquierda el hacer de la derecha, pues quien da con fanfarria y timbal a la vista de todos, ya recibió su recompensa. 
Aunque no está de más dar a conocer las iniciativas de voluntariado y ayuda, sí con ello se consigue motivar a los demás a participar.

> Having emigrated from Venezuela to Argentina just two years ago, now of retirement age, when I'm not making soap, I go for walks around the neighborhood in this pleasant and enormous metropolis that is Buenos Aires, and when I'm not reading and writing on Hive or following world events on social media.
And although it may not seem like it, solidarity is present everywhere; it's just that good deeds are usually quiet. Silent and even anonymous, as the good Jesus advised: \

For he who gives with fanfare and drums in full view of everyone has already received his reward. While it's always good to publicize volunteer and aid initiatives, it's even more important if it motivates others to participate. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkaYsq2iMiMMjrY8xAsyqgr6ApzJjDYCDyf7eFiUMDA7/image.png) Me encantan estas calles arboladas de casas antiguas con altos techos y puertas con dos hojas junto a otras de fachadas decoradas con murales. Que si un día ya no te gusta y te arrepientes de haberla pintado, no hay más que raspar y pintar otra cosa. Arrepentimiento o deseo de no haber hecho alguna cosa implica un cambio de opinión porque el hecho en sí no nos parece bien y nos gustaría deshacerlo, lo cual es imposible, pero en algunos casos se puede intentar enmendar las consecuencias, siempre y cuando no se genere un mal mayor. Pues no es cuestión de buscar librarse de la culpa con una confesión y solicitud de perdón si al hacerlo se causa otro mal. Cada quien deberá cargar con la responsabilidad de sus actos. >I love these tree-lined streets with old houses, high ceilings, and double doors, alongside others with facades decorated with murals. >If one day you no longer like it and regret having painted it, there's nothing more to do than scrape it off and paint something else. Regret or the desire to undo something implies a change of opinion because the act itself doesn't seem right to us and we'd like to undo it, which is impossible, but in some cases, one can try to amend the consequences, as long as it doesn't cause greater harm. It's not a matter of trying to get rid of guilt with a confession and a plea for forgiveness if doing so causes further harm. Each person must bear the responsibility for their actions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1euTF5hfxL5QAKbfd9ws5V4ryQqj1UxcCiBHS3AMNqY/image.png) Hay sucesos, actos o situaciones que no se pueden remediar y puede suceder que la culpa llegue a ser un peso para el culpable arrepentido que quisiera obtener el perdón del agraviado, pero al solicitarlo causará un nuevo mal o agravará el anterior. Solo queda cargar con la culpa o solicitar el perdón a un confesor, el que sea de esa creencia. De lo contrario, trabajar por alcanzar el propio perdón y seguir adelante, pues de lo pasado solo debemos guardar el aprendizaje y los gratos recuerdos. >There are events, actions, or situations that cannot be undone, and guilt can become a burden for the repentant offender who desires forgiveness from the wronged party. However, seeking forgiveness might cause further harm or exacerbate the previous one. The only option left is to bear the guilt or seek forgiveness from a confessor, regardless of their beliefs. Otherwise, one must strive for self-forgiveness and move forward, keeping only the lessons learned and the fond memories from the past. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX8jjDjjCJqFcgU7HBginpPtBeMzi9mpQMyBZNTRiaVp9/image.png) No ventilemos en pública reunión los detalles de la vida privada de nadie. Dejemos oculto lo que no se deba ventilar en la calle. Dejemos algunos asuntos entre cuatro paredes o detrás de una tupida cerca de hiedra. Hay una variedad que, lejos de ser venenosa, es excelente remedio para la tos y las flemas. > Let's not air anyone's private life details in public. Let's keep hidden what shouldn't be aired in the street. Let's keep some matters behind closed doors or behind a thick ivy fence. There's a variety that, far from being poisonous, is an excellent remedy for coughs and phlegm. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPRy8aASJy2faVMWzjrtmJx7HFfbsmRzNGZQAo7EJwmu4/image.png) Esta preciosa casa de tres pisos es un centro cultural sufí del Islam que destaca por la arquitectura morisca y los azulejos. Siempre que paso, está cerrada, pero me consta que la abren para recibir a cualquiera que la quiera visitar con buena voluntad. >This beautiful three-story house is a Sufi cultural center of Islam, notable for its Moorish architecture and tiles. It's always closed when I pass by, but I know they open it to welcome anyone who wishes to visit. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUx6DWXAifZpc6e7sA4B52htPPgAo6V2iPRpPeMthyqsK/image.png) El día que atrapé esta imagen, me hizo mucha gracia el perrito que dejó en la esquina un testimonio de su presencia, pero no pude evitar reírme cuando detrás llegó el dueño y me miró riéndose, pues no solo era dueño del perro, sino también de la casa. >The day I captured this image, I found it very funny that the little dog left evidence of its presence in the corner, but I couldn't help but laugh when the owner arrived behind it and looked at me laughing, because he was not only the owner of the dog, but also of the house. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbu4YZNb1mUeofGyEeYzhvLfKZPnPKxhWw39Ef14kvGVk/image.png) Cierro la publicación pensando en el perdón, sin el cual no será posible la convivencia, sin dejar de lado la justicia que, siendo humana, no alcanzará a satisfacer a todos, pero ambos, perdón y justicia, nos son indispensables para salir adelante. Todos somos necesarios, incluso los que ya no prestan servicio, como este buzón de correos, que recientemente restauró la ciudad, pero no habiendo carteros al estilo de antes, solo sirve como recuerdo y tal vez para recibir las cartas al Niño Jesús, a Santa y a los Reyes Magos. Espero que disfrutaran del paseo y la reflexión y que, si no aporté, al menos nada les quite. Gracias por su compañía. >I close this post reflecting on forgiveness, without which coexistence is impossible, without forgetting justice, which, being human, cannot satisfy everyone. But both forgiveness and justice are essential for us to move forward. We are all needed, even those who no longer serve, like this mailbox, recently restored by the city. But without postmen in the old style, it now serves only as a reminder and perhaps for receiving letters to Baby Jesus, Santa Claus, and the Three Wise Men. >I hope you enjoyed this stroll and this reflection, and that if I didn't contribute anything, at least I didn't take anything away from you. Thank you for your company. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTovBpBa7aPDYNPhmVtXBWw6rNDmJ4wVee51JKmSDEJE/image.png)[MY PARTICULAR VIEW OF THE WORLD] Escrito en español, la traducción al inglés por Google. Fotos propias. >Written in Spanish, translated into English by Google. Photos are my own.

Deadwood is wonderful. I loved this series and was so happy when the movie was approved and released in 2019, giving the story closure.

I put my phone away when I'm going to watch a series or a movie; that way I avoid distractions. It's difficult these days, but I recommend rediscovering the pleasure of stories that unfold gradually. I wouldn't binge-watch it; I suggest watching one or two episodes, taking a break for a couple of days, and then continuing.

It's not a series to watch all the episodes in a row like we do now, and I understand that it can be hard to get hooked with the first few.

I'm rewatching Oz, another excellent series from the beginning of the second golden age of television with HBO, although it definitely shows its age. I'm watching one episode a week, the old-fashioned way.

I hope you get a taste for Deadwood and watch it all the way through; for me, it's another gem from HBO.

links.title: LOH292 //  If a Magic Genie Could Grant Me One Wish
links.body:
If there is a magic genie that could grant me just one wish, I will use my wish wisely, I wouldn't ask for money, fame, or a life of luxury. My wish would be simple, I would wish for peace to return to our land.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjZ3im118WsBfojutDMji9eqMisZa5aEqfESGA7z4xXm/1780947136013.jpg)

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/genie-desert-aladin-alladin-lamp-4198396/)

The reason is personal. Living with insecurity is mentally and emotionally draining. Every day, people wake up hoping that they and their loved ones will make it safely through the day. News of kidnappings, bandit attacks, and violence has become so common that many of us now live with a constant sense of fear.

What hurts the most is how this fear affects even the happiest moments in life. Recently, my brother and his wife welcomed a new baby. It should have been a time of celebration, family gatherings, and thanksgiving. Normally, I would have traveled to visit them and attend the child's dedication. Instead, I found myself thinking about the risks of traveling and the possibility of being kidnapped along the way. Imagine not being able to fully share in your family's joy because you are afraid for your safety. That is the reality many people are facing today.

There are days when family members leave home and we silently pray for their safe return. There are nights when every unusual sound outside makes people uneasy. Even when nothing happens, the fear never completely goes away. It follows you wherever you go.

That is why my one wish would be for all those terrorizing innocent people to disappear and for lasting peace to return. I want a future where people can travel freely without fear. I want farmers to work on their farms safely, children to attend school without worry, and families to celebrate important occasions together without thinking about security threats.

Peace is something many people take for granted until it is lost. When there is peace, businesses thrive, education improves, and communities grow stronger. People can focus on building their lives instead of simply trying to stay safe. Peace gives people hope and allows them to dream about a better future.

Some people would use their wish to become rich, and I understand why. But to me, wealth means very little if there is no peace. What is the point of having money when you cannot travel freely, sleep peacefully, or enjoy special moments with your loved ones?

So if a magic genie appeared before me and offered me only one wish, I would choose peace without hesitation. A peaceful society would bring happiness, security, and freedom to countless people. More importantly, it would allow families to celebrate life's precious moments together without fear. For me, there is no greater wish than that.





**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

links.title: 3D printing some tool storage
links.body:
Like a lot of people I have plenty of tools, but finding the right one when you need it can be tricky. I quite often do bits of wiring or soldering as well as needing to change batteries in things that need a screwdriver. I decided it was time to put my [Bambu Lab A1](https://uk.store.bambulab.com/products/a1) 3D printer to work on organising my tools.

![Tool rack](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/Eos1qgsyZ4ir5vq9PPxj4gbMCvakk4Uy7g63vjSHv8ce7ZqvmtSjD5FM4GEHzyzPBMr.png)

This is based on the [Ikea SKÅDIS](https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/cat/skadis-series-37813/) system that was intended to things like desk items, but the 3D printing community has really taken to it and you can find attachments for all sorts of item.

The issue around my desk is a lack of wall space as I have guitars and pictures covering most of it. I do have these hefty speakers though and decided that I could make use of those. They are made from thick wood and so easy to screw into.

The [base board](https://makerworld.com/en/models/1741798-lightweight-infinite-skadis-240x240mm#profileId-2137047) is about as big as my printer can do, but was just right. Bambu Labs just brought out the [A2L](https://uk.store.bambulab.com/products/a2l) that can go a bit bigger.

I had plenty of options for attachments. Some I printed either went wrong or were just not right for me. I tried a screwdriver rack with slots, but some would not stay in that. The items I printed were:

* [Pliers rack](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2712508-skadis-pliers-side-cutter-tool-holder)
* [Screwdriver holder](https://makerworld.com/en/models/1182158-skadis-screwdriver-holder)
* [Craft knife holder](https://makerworld.com/en/models/918587-ikea-skadis-cutter-knife-holder) times two
* [Caliper hook](https://makerworld.com/en/models/1339087-ikea-skadis-caliper-holder)
* [Glue pot](https://makerworld.com/en/models/696652-skadis-glue-holder-2-pegs)

If you have an appropriate printer you can do these straight from the mobile app, but you can also download the models to use on other printers. Your needs will probably be different, but I hope this gives you some ideas.

![Printer](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/EpXKWTFDx2JR4tZEtrck8BW9bYZyHNshKJRT1nFimzD5YZVLEd6Hfaquev6TEBL1xE6.png)

All this used up a fraction of a roll of filament, so will not have cost much. I may make another for the other speaker. I did wonder if things would rattle when music is playing, but I think it would have to be pretty loud for that to happen.

![Tool tub](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/EoAbcBwv8UewfnVFYcxxhy8SyttoYi2ZcJUR2m5fZyspUaJXLJMS5wivSvpd7j7Avvv.png)

Previously the tools were in this tub. I may put the items in something else. I have some small drawers that I got many years ago and they are full of electrical parts. As for my shed, that is a bit of a nightmare!

I still have plans to get into designing things to print when I find the time, but there are massive libraries of items from others. As well as Bambu's Makerworld there are [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/), [Printables](https://www.printables.com/) and [Cults 3D](https://cults3d.com). You should find most things you might want on those.

Happy printing!

links.title: One Day, I Want To Be The Answer To Someone Else's Prayer.
links.body:
I love this topic, and without beating around the bush, I will love to go straight to the point.


The one goal I'm aiming at is to be in a position where I can truly bless, assist, help, and look out for others without issues.



![1000216857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2oQTooJXcTZZRQYUw9TfjZJApLSdpQFneG8gUCwf4UzMtnWQ69b11L5kDg5aDD2CUG.jpg)

And as little as that goal may seem, you will know a lot of things are embedded in it, talk of being financially stable amongst other things.

And when I say this is my goal, I know what I'm saying. It's coming from a deep place, a place of experience. I have not been here for long, but for the little time that I've been here, it was Grace that carries me and has been carrying me. I've seen people make sacrifices for me, I've received help from people and thinking about it all now, if not for that, if not for those people I wouldn't be here today.


So, I know first hand what help actually is, I know what coming through for a person really looks and feels like. And like I said earlier, I've had lots of experiences, and those experiences have birthed this goal I'm aiming towards, which so to be stable and be in a position where I won't just be living comfortably, but also be able to ease the burden of others. I just want to make an impact, make a difference in people's lives, and touch lives.


![1000201542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xKxw1NDz9B9yKTpWFuPqoRSAzNX2ZphdBBBCB5e92qVRBED1chjEW3MJ1VguejJHT7X.jpg)


And talking about a life lesson that has had an impact on me, it is that no one succeeds alone, and no one can live life alone. You will definitely need someone on your way to the top, you will definitely need someone as you navigate life. And it is evident even in my own life, of all the hard times I went through, I am here today because people came through for me, I am here because some people refused to give up on me, I'm here today because some people choose to walk the path with me.... I was never alone.


And I now see things differently now, that experience taught me a lot. It taught me kindness, compassion, and love. And it also taught me that I don't need to have it all before helping, if there's an opportunity or an opening to help, so far you have little, do it. Practicing that would make it easier for you to give and help when you have more.



🌹

links.title: Modern Gold I League Unlocked!
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfqpihKg1KRNyih6GqKtzpTuNpcPFw2NxJmKvaCPdF9C/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Midway through the season, I just unlocked Gold I League in Modern. Again, I expect my SPS rewards earned per win to increase given the higher league. I was also rewarded with advancement chests that contained cards, among others. Advancing in leagues as you win more battles is part of the fun I find in playing Splinterlands. 

***

# Advancement Reward Chests

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMfGWyif68gGgLwKecZfrPQ1wdEKEA12eWcfy5M5tiNK/image.png)

Not the best since I only got common cards and plenty of merits. I even used legendary potions for this one. There were also potions, scrolls and energy. I like the cards best especially if I can get legendary cards but this time the ones I got were mostly common cards. 

***

# Featured Battle

I have several fun battles on the way to reaching Gold I but I will feature one battle I liked most. 

## Spamming the Weaken Ability to Win

What I liked in this battle was I used three cards that each decreased the enemy's health. That means even before the battle started, the enemy's units already lost three health. This is huge given the damage output of my units means they can eliminate enemies in one hit. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaRHrstnUHv7toAHraMTMiS8YPLmAyChNRHUPg2MKnSr/image.png)

The ruleset was included Outsider that allowed one unit from Wild to play in Modern. I chose the Frontier Death archon who debuffs the enemy health as part of my strategy. The rest of my units were as follows. 

## Ulundin Overseer

Ulundin Overseer is a beefy tank but has no attack of his own. To give him an attack, I paired him with a unit with Weapons Training ability. 

## Shiraza

My favorite card in the Escalation set. She has the Weapons Training ability that grants two magic attacks to no attack units similar to the legendary Rebellion card, Daarg Deadblast. 

## Will O Wisp

The unit I imported from the Wild Mode. Will O Wisp also has no attack of its own but has high health and useful abilities. One of those abilities was Weaken that decrease the enemy's health. 

## Grimshield Hexpriest

Grimshield Hexpriest is one of my magic damage dealers in the Death splinter. He deals three magic damage and has Apex Strike and Magic Reflect abilities making him a great card to play in Wands Out ruleset.

## Gravebrand Warlock

Gravebrand Warlock is another one of my magic damage dealers in the Death splinter. He also deal three magic damage and has the Swiftness ability that increase the speed of my team. He also has the Execute ability that allows him to attack twice in a round if certain conditions are met. 

## Sorrow Harvester

Sorrow Harvester is a magic unit from the Frontier set that I frequently use in the Modern mode. She deals two magic damage and has the Weaken ability. Together with the archon and Will O Wisp, that makes three units who decrease the enemy's health. 

The enemy had a higher level archon but doesn't have any abilities. His team was composed of an explosive dual tank combo of Doomshield Warden and Drybone Barbarian. Both deal high melee damage but their attacks were further strengthened by Janni Rebel's Inspire ability. His team included a unit with Tank Heal ability and also the legendary card Gramel the Hunger. My strategy worked well as the enemy team's units lost three health and were easier to dispose of. Inspite of the enemy's high attacks, my Ulundin Overseer was able to withstand their attacks. My team's magic attacks were effective to decimate the enemy team and win the battle. 

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_85fb4e6b5d99b42a109d00aabe7051f0?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

links.title: A Legacy of Sovereignty and Joy: BAŞİDER Commemorates April 23rd National Sovereignty and Children’s Day in Başakşehir/Istanbul
links.body: /> Every year, the twenty-third of April holds a unique and profoundly sacred place in the heart of the Turkish nation. It is a day where deep-rooted historical reverence converges seamlessly with the vibrant, forward-looking optimism of youth. This year, the Başakşehir Businesspeople Association (BAŞİDER) had the distinct honor of participating in the official April 23rd National Sovereignty and Children’s Day celebrations, representing the local business community in a day filled with civic pride, remembrance, and community solidarity. The main commemoration took place in the heart of our district, gathering local dignitaries, civil society organizations, schools, and families at the iconic Bahçeşehir Atatürk Monument. As BAŞİDER, our presence at this event underscored our firm belief that economic progress and social responsibility go hand in hand with preserving our national heritage and investing in the future of our children.

/> The Historical Weight of April 23rd To truly appreciate the atmosphere at the Bahçeşehir Atatürk Monument, one must look back to April 23, 1920. On this historic day, amidst the ashes of a collapsing empire and the existential threat of foreign occupation, the Grand National Assembly of Turkey was founded in Ankara. It was a revolutionary step initiated by Gazi Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, establishing the foundational principle that “Sovereignty belongs unconditionally to the nation.” Yet, Atatürk did not just leave this date as a political milestone. In a gesture of unparalleled visionary genius, he gifted this momentous day to the world’s children. He recognized that while armies and assemblies could secure a nation’s borders, only educated, happy, and free thinking children could secure its future. Today, April 23rd stands as the world’s first and only official holiday dedicated entirely to children, celebrating both national independence and global peace through the eyes of youth.

/> A Solemn Start: The Wreath-Laying Ceremony at Bahçeşehir Atatürk Monument The morning in Başakşehir began with a crisp, clear spring air, perfectly mirroring the reflective yet celebratory mood of the attendees. Long before the official start time, the plaza surrounding the Bahçeşehir Atatürk Monument began to fill. A sea of Turkish flags painted the square in vibrant crimson and white, fluttering gently against the backdrop of the district's modern architecture. The ceremony officially commenced with the traditional wreath-laying protocol. This segment of the event represents a formal renewal of our collective vow to protect the republic and uphold the values passed down by our founding ancestors. Local government offices, political representatives, and prominent non-governmental organizations came forward one by one to pay their respects.

/> A Proud Moment for BAŞİDER As the Başakşehir Businesspeople Association (BAŞİDER), our delegation stepped forward to lay our official wreath at the base of the Atatürk Monument. For us, this act was far more than a routine bureaucratic tradition. It was a public reaffirmation of our commitment to Başakşehir and to Turkey. As business leaders, entrepreneurs, and employers, we recognize that our commercial achievements are entirely dependent on the stability, democracy, and independence of our republic. Laying that wreath was our way of saying that the business world stands firmly behind the vision of a modern, progressive, and prosperous Turkey.

/> Unity in Voice: The National Anthem Following the completion of the wreath-laying ceremony, the entire assembly stood at strict attention for a moment of profound silence, dedicated to the memory of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, his brothers in arms, and all the martyrs who sacrificed their lives for the independence of the homeland. What followed was a deeply moving rendition of the İstiklal Marşı (The Turkish National Anthem). Accompanied by a live band, hundreds of voices ranging from seasoned local bureaucrats and business owners to eager young school children joined together in perfect harmony. The collective roar of the anthem echoing off the buildings in Bahçeşehir served as a powerful reminder of our unbreakable national unity. It was a moment that sent chills down the spines of everyone present, reinforcing the shared identity that binds our diverse community together.

/> Voices of Governance: Speeches by District Bureaucrats With the formal protocols observed, prominent bureaucrats and district leaders took to the podium to deliver their commemorative addresses. The speeches strike a delicate balance between honoring the sacrifices of the past and laying out a roadmap for the district's future. The speakers highlighted the rapid development of Başakşehir, transforming from a quiet suburb into one of Istanbul’s most dynamic economic and residential hubs. However, they emphasized that infrastructure, skyscrapers, and industrial parks are meaningless without a strong cultural and educational foundation. A recurring theme among the officials was the critical role of education in the 21st century. Bureaucrats urged local institutions, businesses, and parents to collaborate in providing local youth with the tools necessary to compete on a global stage specifically pointing to digital literacy, science, and the arts. Hearing these priorities resonated deeply with us at BAŞİDER, as our association frequently advocates for bridging the gap between current market demands and youth education.

/> The Heart of the Day: The Children’s Performance While the morning's early hours belonged to official protocols and speeches, the true essence of April 23rd came alive during the second half of the program. The atmosphere shifted instantly from formal solemnity to pure, infectious joy as the local schoolchildren took center stage. The children arrived dressed in spectacular, vibrant 23 Nisan costumes. Some wore traditional, intricately embroidered regional attire representing the rich cultural tapestry of Anatolia, while others wore modern, symbolic outfits in red and white, adorned with stars, crescents, and portraits of Atatürk. The sheer amount of effort put in by teachers, parents, and the children themselves was evident in every single detail.

/>

The children put on a magnificent mini-show that captivated every adult in attendance. Their performance included:

Choreographed Dance Routines: Perfectly synchronized dances set to patriotic anthems and upbeat traditional folk music.

Poetry Recitations: Young students stepped up to the microphone with immense courage, reciting poems about liberty, Atatürk, and the love of the homeland with astonishing passion and clarity.

Theatrical Skits: Short, heartwarming representations of the founding of the parliament and the spirit of national solidarity.

Watching these little ones perform with such enthusiasm, bright eyes, and innocent pride was an unforgettable experience. The executives and members of BAŞİDER watched the entire display with smiles on our faces and pride in our hearts. In those moments, the abstract concept of \
became tangible. It was right there, dancing and laughing in front of the Atatürk Monument.\n\n

/> BAŞİDER’s Vision for the Future As the celebrations drew to a close and families began to mingle in the spring sunshine, the members of BAŞİDER reflected on the day’s deeper meaning. Participation in events like the April 23rd commemoration is central to our mission. We believe that a thriving local economy cannot exist in isolation; it must be built upon a healthy, connected, and historically conscious society. Our association remains dedicated to supporting the next generation of Başakşehir's residents. Whether through creating internship opportunities, supporting local educational initiatives, or fostering an environment of innovation, BAŞİDER is committed to ensuring that the children who danced today will have the resources, jobs, and economic stability they need to lead tomorrow. We extend our deepest gratitude to the Başakşehir Governorate, our local municipality, the dedicated educators, and above all, the wonderful children who made this National Sovereignty and Children’s Day a resounding success. Happy April 23 National Sovereignty and Children’s Day!

links.body:
Hello Friends of the Butter... This week we will be resorting to only text, which is more than adequate for reports, I take it. It has been a very, and I do mean, a very productive week.
![logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mantequilla-soft/23vsBZYELbrvYgiL6vtvxt3ZTHEVHFK9KjTtnYyrVmentmXXPip7VVVtgVrDY1Ehpsznp.png)
# @tibfox

> The resident fox, @tibfox, has decided to really step on the gas, and has worked tirelessly to finish the, yet again, relaunch of @threespeak - Yes, relaunch. So many things have been added, so much work has been done, we strongly believe that minds will be blown. 🚀 **3Speak Update Highlights** We've added a lot since the last major release: 🎧 **Audio Support** * Upload podcasts, music, voice notes, and more. * New Audio section with playlists, creators, and filters. * Audio covers now display consistently across the platform. 🟣 **OpenPods** * Live audio and video rooms are here. * Invite guests, share links, and publish recordings. ⭐ **3Speak Pro** * Premium subscriptions with Pro badges. * Pay-per-listen audio and exclusive Pro features. * Free trial available. 🔔 **Notifications** * New notification center for comments, mentions, follows, rewards, and whale votes. * Improved mobile experience and cleaner design. 🎬 **Creator Tools** * Edit videos after publishing. * More reliable publishing for all login methods. * Improved thumbnail and cover uploads. * Better post creation with character counters. ▶️ **Performance & Discovery** * Faster loading throughout the platform. * View counts restored and improved. * Enhanced playlists, tag pages, community pages, and scheduled posts. * See who voted on your content and estimated payouts. 🛡️ **Moderation** * New content reporting tools for videos, comments, and profiles. ✨ **Quality of Life** * Refreshed dark mode. * Mobile improvements. * Better HiveAuth login experience. * Node selection and app version info in Settings. * Built-in changelog so you can always see what's new. # @meno

>

 Progress Report — Week of June 1–8, 2026

  
  ---

🚀

Another productive week on Snapie, with **25 commits shipped** and a strong mix of new features, performance improvements, and UX polish.

### 📱 Hangouts (@snapie/hangouts-react - Deployed on @threespeak)

  - Full-screen mobile rooms — embedded rooms now go full-screen on phones ≤640px
  - Video recording fixes — boosts now work correctly in recordings; added wake lock to prevent screen sleep; polished the boost dialog

### 📱 Shorts Arrive on Snapie

* Built a full vertical video experience powered by 3Speak.
* TikTok-style swipe navigation with randomized feeds.
* Improved preloading for smooth browsing in both directions.

### 💰 Wallet Upgrades

* Fast HIVE ↔ HBD swaps.
* Claim rewards with automatic balance refresh.
* New transaction filters, dust hiding, and mobile-friendly wallet navigation.

### ✍️ Better Blogging

* Added New, Hot, Trending, and Top feed filters.
* Draft auto-save support.
* Community selector when publishing.
* Theme color improvements and cleaner editor styling.
* HiveSense-powered blog search with a refreshed results interface.

### 🔔 Smarter Social Features

* Reply context previews now appear in notifications and post views.
* Twitter-inspired feed layout with improved image handling, carousels, and composer controls.
* Faster chat experience through incremental timeline syncing.

### ✨ Fixes & Polish

* Improved image viewer with proper overlay behavior and close controls.
* Fixed a navigation issue caused by an infinite render loop.
* Consistent blog card sizing across feed grids.
* More resilient video embeds with fallback handling.
* Notification badges now clear instantly when marked as read.
* Improved unread notification styling and navigation flow.
* Deployment reliability and overall app responsiveness received additional polish.

### 📊 By the Numbers

* **25 commits** on Snapie.io this week.
* Major feature work focused on Shorts, Wallets, Search, and Compose.
* Additional mobile fixes landed in Hangouts and were rolled back into Snapie through package updates.

---
## In Closing

And there you have it, friends of the butter.

A week filled with commits, deployments, bug hunts, feature launches, relaunches, and the occasional moment of staring at a screen wondering why a thing that worked five minutes ago suddenly decided it preferred chaos.

The good news is that chaos appears to be losing.

3Speak is preparing to spread its wings once again, Snapie continues to evolve at a pace that occasionally surprises even us, and the broader ecosystem is slowly gaining the tools it needs to become more useful, more social, and a little more fun.

As always, thank you to everyone testing things, reporting bugs, sharing feedback, and supporting these projects. Building in public means the victories belong to all of us, and the bugs... well, those belong mostly to the developers.

Until next week, may your deployments be smooth, your nodes stay synced, and your commit history remain green.

-Mantequilla Team

🐝🦊

links.title: LOH Contest #292 - Wet Season
links.body:
>

As a wet season lover, I could say that I have more likes for rain than I have a dislike for it. For as long as I know I've never been a summer or dry season person. I easily get agitated and annoyed at the sight of a blazing sun. But every drop of rain makes my heart yearn for more. It brings peace and calmness to my wandering soul, soothes my disturbed mind in an unexplainable way. 
Here in my country the dry season comes with extreme and unbearable heat, one that will have you going around with rechargeable hand fans which is something I do not miss in my handbag whenever I'm stepping out. The harshness is unbearable and makes me so uncomfortable and frustrated at times, sleeping at night without power supply can be really saddening because of how difficult it will be to get any sleep because of the weather condition
---
---

![17809452307735190216056482487860.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zanoz/242NhKbPZXqm7f7ZrmhQJnj3aG8bhiBQyBqVwgqfzbcrvjrYTbnuA8g4TmTVCQYdu6PLv.png)

<sup>[Image](https://pixabay.com/images/download/shlomaster-little-boy-731165_1920.jpg)</sup>

___
Currently it's the wet season in my country and the part I am in, it rains nearly everyday and I love that for myself, because not only will I have my room always feeling cold and fresh,  I get to enjoy the privilege of not stepping out with an excuse that the rain restricted my movement especially on occasions that I really didn't want to step out, which could be a disadvantage to many other people. 
Another thing I love about this season is that it aids the germination of our crops and farm produce, our vegetables and crops tend to grow fast and healthy too because there is enough rainfall to aid germination. The soil too is soft and easy to till for cultivation.
You can call it an obsession but seeing the sky suddenly turn dark and the clouds taking different shapes and forms gladdens my heart, I'm easily drawn in and I stare in amazement at the wonders of nature and how changes in weather condition could affect the entire environment in seconds. 

The one thing I think I dislike the most about the wet season even though I love it so much  depends on my environment and location, I'm allergic to muddy and wet soil, the sight of a dirty environment with the muddiness and wetness from the after rain makes my body itch all over. I do not like to see it, and at that moment I would pray for the sun to dry it up just a bit. But aside from this, everything about the wet or rainy season has my entire heart cause no season can be compared to it.

This is my response to ladies of hive community contest #292, If you wish to be a part of this, you can join  the contest [here](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-292)

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 7 2026
links.body:
Hello again! I'm very happy to be posting on Actifit again after such a long time. We were without internet access for several months, and I didn't have anywhere to record and share my walks and daily activities. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e290fa96-2a4b-49e3-9220-a76a04a7c7e0.jpg) Yesterday, my father and us went on a short trip. My father loves plants and birds. We decided to visit a forest near where we live. We had been there before, and my father had really liked it, but that time it had been during a rainy period, and because the ground was so muddy, we couldn't reach the destination we had in mind. This time, however, we made it all the way to the spot we wanted to reach near the entrance of the forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fde6b548-fd13-44a4-b626-9d43f35d8a40.jpg) The area was full of blackberry bushes, but there were very few berries on them. Along the way, we had to be careful not to walk into spider webs because there were so many of them. Even though we were cautious, we still ran into them a few times. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1eff8a5b-eae2-47ca-8649-cbe12bb13b67.jpg) The uphill parts of the trail were difficult for my father, but we promised him that it would be worth climbing higher. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/45b11435-81db-42e7-b88b-bc89904fe630.jpg) When we arrived, he saw that we had been telling the truth. It was truly beautiful there. The trees were dense, and so much mint was growing on the forest floor that it looked like it could be harvested with a scythe. We spread out a mat and sat in the shade of the trees, but there were so many mosquitoes that we soon packed up our things and started heading back. By the time we reached the car, it was already getting dark, and we began the drive home. When we got back, Milo and the other dogs excitedly sniffed us, trying to figure out where we had been and what we had been doing.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@sabajfa/actifit-sabajfa-20260608t192928125z)_

This is my post on #freewriters3128 #dailyprompt mosaic hosted by @marinnewest's.
In the heart of Uyo, the Uruan community gathered under the warm, golden light of June to celebrate a legacy etched in time. They were unveiling \

a breathtaking installation commissioned by Lady Elizabeth, a patron whose heart beat in sync with the spirit of the Uruan people.\n​The mosaic was not merely a decorative wall; it was a vibrant tapestry of history. Composed of thousands of tiny, hand-cut glass tiles, it depicted the lush riverine landscapes of Uruan, the strength of its farmers, and the wisdom of its elders. Lady Elizabeth, elegant yet humble, stood before the crowd. She had spent months listening to the stories of the community, ensuring every curve of the river and every stitch in the traditional attire was rendered with archival precision.\n​\
she told the hushed assembly, her voice carrying clearly across the square. \

\n​As she pulled the velvet veil, the sun caught the mosaic, igniting a spectrum of blues, greens, and ochres. A collective gasp echoed through the plaza. The villagers saw themselves—their struggles and their triumphs—immortalized in a masterpiece that turned their modest community space into a sanctuary of culture. That evening, as the community danced beneath the shimmering tiles, the bond between the patron and the people solidified, ensuring that the legacy of Uruan would glow brilliantly for generations to come.

links.title: Following Instinct While Applying Common Sense
links.body:
Human instinct is their inner gut feeling; it's their mind's opinions or take on different things, which could be on a person, decision-making, or the like. There are lots of people who trust their instincts and whatever they feel about different matters, and to be honest, we can't disregard the fact that instincts can be right on several occasions. But then, at the same time, it can be wrong, especially when mixed with bias or when the instinct is just outrightly wrong, because sometimes our instinct decides based on what we buy, and then we all know the saying that says never judge a book by its cover, meaning our instinct can be wrong at times. ![1000380692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/243zffCnDcDnJVD4cJpGMzbkQKq9HqAk6QBqJ4cEFQpEsM42Wiefww8G8XbT8pzHAMFkG.jpg) Now to direct a question to me: Do I trust my instincts, and how well do I trust them? To be candid, I do trust my instincts, and it has played a huge part in different decisions I've made in the past, because most of my instincts have usually been right. My instincts are my gut feelings about something or people. And I can remember each time I doubt the legitimacy of something, it always turns out to be, indeed, not legitimate stuff. Take, for instance, when someone was introducing a business to me for me to partner with her; I said no because my instinct didn't feel good about it. And at the end of the year, when she partnered with someone else, the business ended up crumbling, and they lost most of their investments. I can't help but thank my star for following my instinct and not delving into something that'll end up making me regret it. There have been times I didn't follow my instinct, and I ended up regretting it, because at the end of the day things turned out how my instinct predicted, but I'd taken a different route that made me wish I had followed my instinct. But then it's worth noting that I don't just follow my instinct blindly. On most occasions when my instinct has an opinion about something, I still use common sense with it; that's exploring the situation or person before reaching a conclusion that'll determine if I'll follow my instinct or let it slide. Doing this has helped me sharpen my instinct to the point where it on its own seems to critically examine things, situations, and a person before giving me its take because it's okay on most occasions and accurate. Talking about if I let my instinct determine how I see a person, to be honest, yes, I do, but then like I said, even though my instinct tells me something about someone, I'll still move close to try and understand who they actually are and not just let my instinct judge someone, and I'd be damned if it ended up being wrong. If my instinct ended up being wrong, it's not the end of the world; it only shows I'm human and not perfect. I'd just move to the next and be more careful about how I believe or follow my instinct. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/following-instinct-while-applying-common-sense-kqp)

links.title: Peace and Tranquility by the Shore [🇬🇧ENG/SPA🇻🇪]
links.body: > My greetings and respect to everyone. It's my day off after an arduous week of work at the business, which has taken incredible steps forward. I will be showing you those improvements soon once they are finished. But this time I want to share with you a brief moment of peace and tranquility that I took for myself. # I went to the beach shore. The street where I live is barely 500 meters away, just around the corner. For me, this is one of the most accessible luxuries of living in the city center. I wanted to go sit very early on the sand to appreciate the sound of the waves and soak up some sun. # Recently I have been a little sick, so I thought this was the best way to clear my mind a bit and recharge my energy alone. To be completely honest, I really enjoy this kind of solitary activity. That's how I relax, think, meditate, and plan. # I usually go often because it is one of my favorite places to watch the sunsets. There is something special about the sea at dawn. The light, the breeze, the sound of the water — everything invites you to simply be present. # I hope the photos are to your liking and that you can appreciate the peace and tranquility that I also felt. Stay tuned for upcoming publications. See you soon.

> Mis saludos y respetos para todos. Es mi día libre después de una ardua semana de trabajo en el negocio, el cual ha dado increíbles pasos de mejora. Se los estaré mostrando prontamente cuando estén terminados. Pero en esta oportunidad quiero compartir con ustedes un breve espacio de paz y tranquilidad que me tomé. # Fui a la orilla de la playa. La calle de mi casa queda a escasos 500 metros, a la vuelta de la esquina. Para mí es uno de los lujos más accesibles de lo que es vivir en el centro de la ciudad. Quise ir a sentarme muy temprano en la arena para apreciar el sonido de las olas y tomar un poco el sol. # Recientemente he estado un poco enfermo, así que pensé que era la mejor manera de despejar un poco la mente y recargar mi energía a solas. Para ser completamente honesto, realmente disfruto esta clase de actividad solitaria. Así me relajo, pienso, medito y planifico. # Suelo ir a menudo ya que es uno de mis lugares favoritos para ver los atardeceres. Hay algo especial en el mar al amanecer. La luz, la brisa, el sonido del agua — todo invita a simplemente estar presente. # Espero que las fotos sean de su agrado y se aprecie la paz y la tranquilidad que yo también sentí. Estén atentos a las próximas publicaciones. Nos vemos pronto. ------ ---- |

links.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: TRAPOS INTIMOS (2002-2003).
links.body:
***Hola mi gente bella, por aqui nuevamente trayecndo una nueva ediciòn del archivo biografico que estamos creando de los dramticos de nuestro pais. Una memoria historica que quedara para el tiempo. Despues de varios vias ausente por cuestiones personales estoy aqui nuevamente para seguir aportando este contenido para todos ustedes.***

---

![207..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23wCNNxPz2ymxjf3jKS1oD77QnFs3L9dbTmH4GhHD9bx2H8pyzS2qAvHKHRpdPoLefFab.jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***Trapos íntimos es una telenovela venezolana producida y transmitida por RCTV entre los años 2002 y 2003. Fue creada y escrita por la reconocida autora Valentina Párraga. La producción se destacó por romper con los dramas densos de la época al presentar una comedia romántica ágil, urbana y picante, ambientada en el competitivo e innovador mundo del diseño de modas y la ropa interior femenina.***

---

<center>![https3.bp.blogspot.com_AcGHGKPa-DATQrM1gLsaMIAAAAAAAAMg8IXo05AD8e6Us1600TRAPOS_INTIMIOS_PANAMA[1].jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23x1Q4us2zH3yCp3WTWZAq26BiEg8rNR94TsiUhUfrSqoDd5rVw7YiAiW21myX3ibZrTo.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](https3.bp.blogspot.com_AcGHGKPa-DATQrM1gLsaMIAAAAAAAAMg8IXo05AD8e6Us1600TRAPOS_INTIMIOS_PANAMA[1].jpg)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***​-Titulo Original: Trapos Intimos.
-Productora: Radio Caracas Televisión (RCTV).
​-Año: 2002 – 2003 (162 episodios).
​-Guion: Valentina Párraga.
​-Dirección: Luis Padilla y Arnaldo Limansky.
​-Protagonistas: Marlene De Andrade, Carlos Montilla, Gabriela Vergara y Alfonso Medina.
​-Antagonistas: Dad Dáger, Iván Tamayo, Flavia Gleske y Alicia Plaza.
​-Elenco Estelar: Amanda Gutiérrez, Juan Carlos Alarcón, Norkys Batista y Jerónimo Gil.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por Guaco.***

---

<center>![httpsi.ytimg.comvitQtFEwl6Ab0maxresdefault.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23xL4icuQULUnnXZ1jhL2MusCCMas7CvxACtUcdGvj6TCHB7yTweqGaWVjFL4THhd9d3m.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsi.ytimg.comvitQtFEwl6Ab0maxresdefault.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***La historia gira en torno a Fernando Lobo (Carlos Montilla), un hombre viudo, atractivo y adinerado que decide mudarse de los llanos venezolanos a Caracas junto a sus tres rebeldes hijas con el objetivo de rehacer su vida. Fernando asume la gerencia de una importante fábrica de ropa interior femenina llamada \

, un entorno completamente ajeno para él.***

***​Allí conoce a Isabel Cordero (Marlene De Andrade), una joven diseñadora de modas, talentosa, independiente y apasionada que trabaja en la fábrica. Isabel tiene un carácter fuerte y un trauma del pasado que la hace desconfiar de los hombres. El choque inicial entre la mentalidad tradicional de Fernando y el espíritu vanguardista de Isabel desata una guerra de egos que poco a poco se transforma en una intensa atracción.
​En paralelo, se desarrolla la historia de la ambiciosa Lucía Lobo (Gabriela Vergara), la hermana de Fernando, una mujer frívola que se debate entre la búsqueda del estatus social y su amor por William Ruiz (Alfonso Medina), un humilde pero noble empleado de la fábrica.***

---

<center>![httpsimage-resizer-cloud-cdn.cms.api.canela.tvimage836CD6D2-C39F-49AC-961A-63F0432E40A00-16x9.jpgwidth=1920&updatedTime=2026-05-15T223436Z&dt=MWeb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23xf111CLsCWQGenwweBxqmRM9FETrbHbWCiqsewhoBteEZSRktQdPz2QaccDvBJrquXS.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpsimage-resizer-cloud-cdn.cms.api.canela.tvimage836CD6D2-C39F-49AC-961A-63F0432E40A00-16x9.jpgwidth=1920&updatedTime=2026-05-15T223436Z&dt=MWeb)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***​Esta producción es recordada como el gran trampolín protagónico para Marlene De Andrade, quien demostró una enorme frescura y carisma en la comedia. Su química con Carlos Montilla fue todo un éxito; además, Montilla interpretó uno de los temas secundarios más sonados de la novela, mientras que el grupo musical Guaco le dio un sello único de sabor caribeño con el pegajoso tema principal.***

***​La crítica elogió a Valentina Párraga por estructurar un libreto ingenioso, lleno de diálogos rápidos y dobles sentidos elegantes que hacían honor al título de la producción, sacando al sol los \

y las hipocresías de la sociedad de consumo. La novela también sirvió para consolidar a parejas secundarias entrañables como la de Norkys Batista (Chiquinquirá Lorenz) y Jerónimo Gil (Abelardo Lobo), quienes se robaron el show con sus constantes discusiones y fogosos encuentros.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202110TRAPOS-INTIMOS-900x900_6.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AL4XAfUtMATQixqJejuVmFwyKm6MwFjwd51LhfudARw67METKUz98DGNWQvEEbq.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202110TRAPOS-INTIMOS-900x900_6.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Trapos íntimos es considerada uno de los grandes aciertos de RCTV a principios de los 2000. Logró equilibrar de forma magistral el melodrama romántico con la comedia de enredos y el diseño de modas. Su legado reside en haber sido una propuesta alegre, colorida y moderna que cautivó los hogares venezolanos, demostrando el altísimo nivel de las producciones corales de la planta televisiva.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comproductotrapos-intimos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AKs3eYMrvZdTYSky83GdmwzSWCcLHFErEvWDWuh4rVefPfEnKhkEAMcU9Xfymxr.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comproductotrapos-intimos)</center>

links.title: DRAMA IN SAN ANTONIO! The Knicks eke out a narrow victory in Game 2 and put the Spurs on the ropes (English/Spanish)
links.body:
![gettyimages-2279451268-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23wqe8bqaHeTiHXiFYWAt6e8PP5uqwbvtk8HopF8ezXwcxRyfBDep3Ub29UiBfMiqKxKa.png)

The Frost Bank Center witnessed one of the most dramatic and tense finishes in the recent history of the NBA Finals. In a white-knuckle finish of pure strategy, the New York Knicks once again stormed the Texan stronghold, taking Game 2 with a thrilling 105-104 victory over the San Antonio Spurs. With this win, the Big Apple squad takes a 2-0 series lead and returns home with a historic advantage.

The game was a tactical battle from start to finish, with Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson tightening the screws to orchestrate a much more physical and aggressive game. San Antonio dominated the paint and constantly sought the free-throw line, forcing a total of 27 attempts. However, the Knicks, led by Mike Brown, showed tremendous maturity, weathering a long drought without free throws in the second half to execute with a cool head in the final two minutes.


![gettyimages-2279450930-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23uQvpQEaDzbMNi2na2Y9mP315GDiVk1cv5upZTREKdSgi9m8pXQYP1HfekYo4T4KSud5.png)


The final stretch of the game was marked by controversy and nerves of steel. With the score 105-104 in New York’s favor, a play by Spurs backup center Luke Kornet set off alarms over a possible kicked ball that went uncalled by the referees. On the final and decisive possession of the game, the suffocating defensive pressure orchestrated by Mike Brown forced a costly turnover by the home team’s star, dashing San Antonio’s hopes of a comeback just before the final buzzer.


![gettyimages-2279462250-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/48QuNPk6HDqEopQ84yYtktCeRcTe14Z3ZdYtbLdk8Zsxj7nFYWLWjpoQMLf7g2xhTj.png)


The cornerstone of New York’s victory was center Karl-Anthony Towns, who dominated the paint with an impressive double-double of 21 points and 13 rebounds. For his part, star point guard Jalen Brunson, despite struggling against tight defense that limited him to a lackluster 7-for-25 from the field, stepped up in the clutch to contribute 20 points and slow down the pace of the game when the clock was ticking down.

For San Antonio, French giant Victor Wembanyama put up a massive individual stat line with 29 points, 9 rebounds, 4 blocks, and 2 steals in 39 minutes of action. However, the “Alien’s” effort was marred by his 4 turnovers, including the one that ended the game. Rookie Dylan Harper once again stepped up with poise off the bench, scoring 14 points, while Stephon Castle and Jeremy Sochan each contributed 13 points.


![gettyimages-2279461880-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23uRDdZ9shgo545Z8pXhbLa33vrihWVfHsLraKSzhDn5Dv84fpCFA4VnZ6Q1AhqpSeud6.png)


With this result, Mike Brown’s Knicks achieve a feat that only two teams had previously accomplished in the NBA Finals: winning the first two games on the road. Now, the series moves to the legendary Madison Square Garden for Game 3 on Monday. Mitch Johnson’s Spurs are on the ropes, forced to play with a knife between their teeth and with a cool head if they want to salvage the season. The stage is set for a colossal battle in New York!

Twitter https://twitter.com/agfnzn1
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/dread_negro/

▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥ ▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥ ▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥ ▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥▤▥

#### ¡DRAMA EN SAN ANTONIO! Los Knicks ganan por la mínima en el Juego 2 y ponen a los Spurs contra la pared

El Frost Bank Center fue testigo de uno de los desenlaces más dramáticos y tensos en la historia reciente de las Finales de la NBA. En un final de bandera blanca y pura estrategia, los New York Knicks volvieron a asaltar el feudo texano al llevarse el Juego 2 con un electrizante marcador de 105 a 104 sobre los San Antonio Spurs. Con esta victoria, el quinteto de la Gran Manzana pone la serie 2-0 a su favor y regresa a casa con una ventaja histórica.

El encuentro fue una batalla táctica de principio a fin, donde el director técnico de los Spurs, Mitch Johnson, ajustó las tuercas para plantear un juego mucho más físico y agresivo. San Antonio castigó la pintura y buscó la línea de de tiros libres constantemente, forzando un total de 27 intentos. Sin embargo, los Knicks dirigidos por Mike Brown demostraron una tremenda madurez, resistiendo una larga sequía sin tiros libres en la segunda mitad para ejecutar con la mente fría en los dos minutos finales.

La recta final del compromiso estuvo rodeada de polémica y nervios de acero. Con el marcador 105-104 a favor de Nueva York, una jugada del pívot suplente de los Spurs, Luke Kornet, encendió las alarmas por un posible balón pateado (kicked ball) que no fue sentenciado por los árbitros. En la última y definitiva posesión del encuentro, la asfixiante presión defensiva planteada por Mike Brown forzó una dolorosa pérdida de balón de la estrella local, sepultando las esperanzas de remontada de San Antonio justo antes del pitazo final.

El pilar de la victoria neoyorquina fue el pívot Karl-Anthony Towns, quien dictó una cátedra en la pintura al firmar un imponente doble-doble de 21 puntos y 13 rebotes. Por su parte, el base estrella Jalen Brunson, a pesar de sufrir ante una marca pegajosa que lo limitó a un gris 7 de 25 en tiros de campo, apareció en el embrague para aportar 20 unidades y congelar el ritmo del juego cuando la pelota quemaba una tonelada.

Por el bando de San Antonio, el gigante francés Victor Wembanyama firmó una planilla descomunal a nivel individual al registrar 29 puntos, 9 rebotes, 4 bloqueos y 2 robos en 39 minutos de acción. No obstante, el esfuerzo del \

se vio empañado por las 4 pérdidas de balón de su cuenta, incluida la del cierre del partido. El novato Dylan Harper volvió a responder con personalidad desde el banquillo al sumar 14 tantos, mientras que Stephon Castle y Jeremy Sochan aportaron 13 unidades cada uno.

Con este resultado, los Knicks de Mike Brown logran una hazaña que solo dos equipos habían conseguido previamente en las Finales de la NBA: ganar los dos primeros juegos en la carretera. Ahora, la serie se traslada al mítico Madison Square Garden para el Juego 3 este lunes. Los Spurs de Mitch Johnson viajan contra las cuerdas, obligados a jugar con el cuchillo entre los dientes y con sangre fría si quieren rescatar la temporada. ¡La mesa está servida para una batalla colosal en Nueva York!

links.title: I heard “coffee”, so I felt thirsty
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaj4kcUTDiHnZmYXHMaCXvNHDwwh7bsLnapVCkADUewtV/img_20260608_151028.jpg)

---
I started the day listening to the story of how my mom didn’t become a coffee addict, unlike her grandmother. I hadn’t planned anything for today, my day off from work, but after hearing the word coffee, I immediately felt the urge to go downtown for an espresso.  

The morning began with plenty of sunshine, but some clouds appeared suddenly. I stepped out confident, expecting shade, but the clouds were so clear that the humidity felt even more intense than the sun’s rays directly hitting the skin.  

Still, I kept walking. I already had in mind a café I’d been wanting to try for a while, but first, I stopped by a bookstore. There weren’t many titles, yet I found two books that will help ease the monotony of these days.  

And thank goodness I bought them. After so much walking, I discovered that the café wasn’t serving coffee. Contradictory? A little, yes. It’s strange for a café not to sell coffee, offering other things instead. But it’s also understandable.There was no electricity, and coffee machines consume a lot of energy.  

So the backup power they had wasn’t enough to run those machines. I felt like staying, but my wallet couldn’t handle anything other than an espresso. So I headed home with my new literary acquisitions.  

Was the outing worth it? Absolutely. I stretched my legs, escaped the swarm of mosquitoes that is my house and neighborhood, and, as I said, I now have new books to exercise my neurons and keep me from losing my mind amid so many blackouts and hardships. Tomorrow I have to work, but I’ll still try to stop by that blessed café to finally give it a try.

links.title: Some simple and ordinary plans
links.body:
>

In life we have a lot of things to handle and we for various reasons can be distracted and lose track. We forget why we started our journey and where we wanted to reach. At the end we become failure in life and because of that having goals and tracking those goals is necessary as it helps us to understand our progress. I also give is the warning about when we need to speed up or when we need to slow down a little bit as everything can’t be done in rush. So, we set some goals to achieve, and we keep moving forward towards our goal. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUC6f3qbQ8Wa18nBF9U6219eCxnyRaEa6XXB2ms5jgHFJ/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-writing-bucket-list-on-book-RLw-UC03Gwc) To be honest, for this year I didn’t set too many goals for myself as I am mostly focused on my offline career. It’s because I completed my post-graduation and I have rested enough to think about many things. Even if I can make money without doing any job but I feel that having a stable earning for the next four or five years is necessary. links.body:
<center>**Hello Hive Students and Alumni👋!** </center>


We welcome y'all to Hivestudents prompt, Week 46.




![1000707281.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23u5VDsVgSamDkYXLdsE9mcYn88Jh7iEJDtMjXqncRwRbaCtuPbU5T67JBQ5KuxYpxvhE.png)


<hr style=\

>

It's another amazing week, and you know what that means - it's the 46th edition of the weekly prompt to spark your creativity and get those ideas flowing in. Hive Student Connect is a community where students on Hive share their blogs. It is a vibrant space for Hive students to engage, learn, connect, and collaborate, fostering growth and development.

Whether you are currently a student or have already finished school, you are welcome to share your perspective.

This is your chance to express yourself and connect with others in the community.

Each week, we bring a unique theme or idea, something that challenges your mind, invites you, and simply pushes you to have fun while playing with words.

So ready to dive in? Below is the week's prompt and guidelines. Please ensure you read them in order not to make any mistakes.

Don't forget to tag the post correctly and share your entries in the Discord channel and not in the comment section. - Very compulsory!



<hr style=\

>


<center>**Title: WRITERS BLOCK.**</center>

This week's topic happens to be one a lot of us writers don't always want to admit we struggle with. And if you're indeed a writer and have been writing for quite some time, there's a high chance that you've experienced it before.
At times you just sit down with your laptop or phone ready to treat a topic or write something down, and your mind will suddenly go blank. You even try to force things, but when you check the innermost part of your mind, you find nothing there; it looks like a newly built apartment...so empty.
It feels as if it wasn't the same you who wrote something amazing just yesterday....ever felt that? That's writer's block.
And it's always different for every one of us; for some it's due to stress, for some it's overthinking, and all... Sometimes we even type, delete, type, delete, and continue it that way for a long time, and at the end of the day we find out we've written absolutely nothing.
Now, writer's block doesn't just affect new writers, not at all; even those who have been writing for years are experiencing it too. And some of the amazing stories and write-ups that we come across, read, and enjoy were probably written by people who at a time had run out of words.
So, this week we are talking about it. Have you ever experienced it? What does it feel like? How did you scale through? What is your way out anytime you experience writer's block?


<hr style=\

>

links.title: Why Big Banks Are Building Blockchain Networks Instead of Fighting Crypto
links.body:
https://i.ibb.co/35ywZn0s/7e25f600a1e4.webp

For years, the relationship between traditional banks and the cryptocurrency industry appeared defined by conflict. Banks questioned the legitimacy of digital assets, while crypto enthusiasts criticized the inefficiencies of traditional finance. Meanwhile, regulators struggled to determine how emerging blockchain technologies fit within existing financial frameworks.

Yet behind the headlines and public debates, a remarkable shift has been taking place.

Some of the world's largest financial institutions are no longer asking whether blockchain technology has value. Instead, they are actively investing in it. From tokenized deposits and digital settlement networks to blockchain-based payment infrastructure and asset tokenization platforms, major banks are increasingly embracing the technology that once threatened to disrupt them.

This global shift raises an important question: **Why are banks suddenly racing to build blockchain networks instead of fighting crypto?**

The answer goes far beyond the daily price movements of Bitcoin or any other cryptocurrency. Financial institutions increasingly recognize that blockchain infrastructure, tokenized assets, and digital payment rails will play a significant role in the future global economy. As a result, adopting this technology has become both an operational necessity and a strategic priority.

---

## The Early Years: From Skepticism to Infrastructure

When Bitcoin emerged in 2009, many financial institutions viewed it as a direct challenge to the traditional banking system. The idea of a decentralized monetary network operating without intermediaries appeared revolutionary, promising lower costs and an open alternative to legacy finance.

Banks, however, remained highly cautious. Concerns surrounding regulatory uncertainty, security risks, money laundering, and intense market volatility limited institutional participation during the industry's early years. For much of the last decade, the narrative centered around competition between crypto and traditional finance.

Today, that narrative is rapidly changing. One of the most important developments is the distinction institutions now make between speculative cryptocurrencies and the underlying blockchain infrastructure.

---

## Solving the Multi-Trillion Dollar Settlement Problem

The primary operational reason banks are focusing on blockchain is simple: **Traditional financial settlement is highly inefficient.**

Even in an era of instant global communication, many financial transactions still require:
* Multiple intermediaries and clearing houses.
* Lengthy, manual reconciliation processes.
* Heavy operational expenses across global segments.
* Cross-border clearing cycles that take days to settle.

Blockchain networks offer a modern alternative. By providing a shared, immutable, and transparent ledger, the technology reduces friction and streamlines transaction processing. For institutions managing trillions of dollars in assets, even modest efficiency improvements generate billions in savings.

---

## Tokenized Deposits Could Change Commercial Banking

One of the most closely watched developments is the emergence of tokenized deposits. Unlike public cryptocurrencies, tokenized deposits represent traditional commercial bank money operating on blockchain networks.

Many analysts believe tokenized deposits will become one of the most important bridges between traditional finance and digital asset infrastructure, offering clear guidance regarding:
* Real-time payment processing and 24/7 liquidity management.
* Instant, programmable settlement via smart contracts.
* Enhanced interoperability between different banking networks.
* Reduced counterparty risks during cross-border transfers.

---

## Stablecoins Forced Banks to Respond

Few developments have influenced banking policymakers as much as the rapid growth of stablecoins. Stablecoins have evolved from niche crypto products into major components of the global digital economy, facilitating billions of dollars in daily transactions.

Their massive success demonstrated a clear market demand for faster and more efficient digital payment systems. Banks quickly recognized that if they failed to innovate, private blockchain-based alternatives could capture an increasing share of global financial activity and settlement fees. As a result, many institutions began exploring their own proprietary blockchain networks.

---

## Asset Tokenization Is Creating New Revenue Streams

While cryptocurrency trading often dominates media headlines, global banks are looking closely at asset tokenization. Tokenization involves representing traditional real-world assets (RWA) on blockchain networks, including:
* Government bonds and Treasury bills.
* Corporate debt and investment funds.
* Commodities like gold, silver, and oil.
* Real estate and private market assets.

Many experts believe tokenization could become a multi-trillion-dollar market over the coming decade. For banks, this represents an opportunity rather than a threat. Financial institutions already possess expertise in asset issuance, custody, and compliance; blockchain technology simply allows them to modernize these services.

---

## Regional Approaches and Competition

The competitive landscape is changing rapidly. Traditional banks are no longer competing solely with each other; they face pressure from fintech platforms, stablecoin issuers, and decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystems. 

Although most institutions agree that innovation is necessary, strategies vary globally:
* **United States:** Institutional participation increases through regulated investment products and major private banking ledgers (like JPMorgan's Onyx).
* **Europe:** Focused on testing wholesale digital money on blockchain rails backed by improving regulatory clarity.
* **Asia:** Financial hubs are actively developing regulatory sandboxes to integrate traditional banking liquidity with digital asset infrastructure.

---

## Why Infrastructure Matters More Than Price Cycles

Many retail investors focus entirely on short-term market fluctuations and token prices. Yet the infrastructure transformation currently underway within the banking sector may have far greater long-term significance than short-term price action.

Market cycles come and go. Infrastructure development, however, shapes how entire industries evolve. The growing involvement of banks suggests that blockchain technology is gradually moving beyond speculation and permanently embedding itself into mainstream global finance.

---

## Conclusion

The relationship between banks and blockchain has evolved dramatically. What began as perceived competition is increasingly becoming collaboration. Major financial institutions are no longer trying to stop blockchain technology; they are actively building on it and integrating it into their long-term strategies.

The reason is simple: blockchain has demonstrated its ability to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and modernize financial infrastructure. The future of finance may not be a battle between banks and blockchain. Instead, it may be a future where banks become some of the largest builders of blockchain networks themselves.

---
