![1000781700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ubglo17/23wMcogLsYvjzETdMWmG7iytkUTdT95Sk4ybpmacE2xaPPhy1RZd9poTAfE74ddUyGHdM.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/men-playing-slot-machines-in-the-casino-7594256)


This is my post on #freewriters3127 #dailyprompt put it in the slot hosted by @marinnewest's.
The humid afternoon air in Uyo hung heavy as Ubong and Paul sat under the shade of a sprawling mango tree, nursing cold bottles of Star lager. They had been friends since primary school, a bond forged in the red earth of their neighborhood and tested by years of hustle.
​\
Ubong said, his voice dropping. He wiped condensation from his bottle, his brow furrowed with the weight of unfulfilled promises. \

\n​Paul leaned back, exhaling a plume of smoke. He looked at his friend, seeing the exhaustion etched into his features. They had scraped together every naira to secure this transport gig, and failure wasn't just a loss—it was the end of their dream to establish their own logistics firm.\n​\
Paul said firmly, his eyes meeting Ubong’s. \

\n​Ubong hesitated, knowing the pride Paul had in standing alone, but he saw the resolve in his friend’s gaze. They were a team. In Uyo, where opportunities often felt like mist—visible but hard to grasp—you didn’t survive by being a lone wolf. You survived by holding the line together.\n​\
Ubong replied, clinking his bottle against Paul’s. The sound was sharp and clear, a signal of their pact. Whatever the weekend brought, they would face it, as they always had: side by side.

links.title: The Truth Always Finds a Way to Surface
links.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc8UnC6eFaW372esyLyxSbDehpTARUatSKdGPJFwf4bMW/1780945708181.png) To be honest I trust my instincts a lot, I always listen to my gut feelings while making a decisions, specially when it's about people. Even if I meet someone for the first time, I can immediately detect if something was wrong or right about them. I don't know how to describe this feelings of mine. My instincts would tell me to be careful. Later, I often discovered that my first impression was correct. I personally believe that I am really good at reading people through their actions or expressions. It doesn't have to be online or offline, I can realize it very fast at anytime or place. Well, I can sense negative energy from someone even though they behave well and present themselves as a friendly person. I feel that are acting like this, from outside they are pious, but from inside they're completely rotten. These people often act like they are very kind, but I have seen such people bringing troubles for others. As time passes, I eventually find out that my feelings were right. For that reason, I have learned to trust my instincts more than anything else. Well, people might start to think that I judge people easily but I do not judge anyone based on where they are from, their race, their appearance. Actually, if I notice something wrong about someone, I always have a doubt on my own opinions. For that reason I try to find valid reasons to doubt on someone. I look for evidence before reaching any conclusions. I know not everyone is a bad or negative person, that's why I don't judge based on one feeling alone. I have a thing like if I discover the truth about someone, I do not let them know that I already know everything. I pretend to not know and they also think the same. I do that because I don't want any drama. If I tell them they would try to convince me, when I actually know their true identity, that how fake they can be and how low they can get. I prefer to stay quiet and watch how they behave. This helps me understand their real personality. They feel superior that they can manipulate me but they don't know that nothing works on me. I always pay attention to the feeling of negativity so that I can protect myself from troubles, and try to keep my family and friends safe from such people. But I never make any decisions without thinking twice. I also think that logic alone cannot always explain and instincts can give us important signals. I am not a stubborn person, I always try to understand that instincts are not always going to be perfect and I try to be careful about it. I accept the fact that I could be wrong. That is why I try to balance instinct with facts and observations. But when I say I'm suspicious about someone I am always sure about it, I say it only when I have valid reasons. I do not take anything personally. They are not my rivals there's no reason for me to doubt on someone for no reason. If I am ever wrong about it, I would accept my fault and take accountability for it. In conclusion, my experiences have taught me that listening to my gut feelings is important because they are often accurate. ____ The thumbnail is created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com). ____

links.title: Buying EPIC cards from Reward Shop
links.body:
Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!

I hope life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world, and that the weekend is going great.

My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

I play the battles regularly in every season, so I keep on earning tokens through daily battles and the end-of-season reward. While it is good to earn more tokens, I think it is also important that one should utilise the tokens in the market because keeping the token balance does not bring any value back. However, if I buy a card and increase my overall card collection, then it is going to help me grow my account. From the last two seasons, I was not able to utilise it, so I thought, why not? So before the season ends, I am here to spend some glint on the reward shop to buy some valuable stuff, and obviously, that is going to be the cards only.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tGXhPaMo4QoaBr3hkAKjJSRiA87t9bxr3RLtg7afGX3C1iBVsySGbgw9sLgdVYMwtm4.png)


I currently have more than 800K glint tokens in my account which is a big amount and I am going to buy Epic cars today where the cost of one card is 15,000 tokens and maximum I can purchase 25 in one go. with this amount the cost will remain same but if I cross it which means if I try to buy in the next attempt then this amount will increase and I don't think that's a good reason so I will not buy again but I will take 25 cards in one go and pay whatever amount will be calculated.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/Enynyi1WCurreVcsyo9mgNWCqDA3FRJqF5t78daZvp3pWMFD2sHgmVD15ZB4hr31vsj.png)

I need to pay 375K tokens for this purchase, which is a good amount,t when I'm happy because at least I'm buying something that is more valuable in the game, and this will help me improve my card collection also.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tm9FrBkBrKBPhs5d1LK7HKx1qbpM4rCCU9kCyYNSNJC5Q5aznxGiBji2sKUcvQxHFvo.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23wgB1JUEu8WBKvCd9xUL2dGEdGJKi46A3hzCmU3Z655LapjKNa8t7XFf2x1sgVEQjRrX.png)

these are the cards I have received out He's 25 packs and I think these cards are good because they are from the modern collection And although I do not play the modern format of the game but later on when I will plan to switch then it will be helpful because by that time I will be able to have some good cards on higher level And because of that probably my dependency on the rental market will reduce. Again, I really don't know how much time it will take for me to grow the collection this way, but at least I'm trying my best to do whatever I can, and it is clear that gradually I am adding more value to my card collection in the game.


Now I have completed my purchase, and with this, I'm left with less than 500K tokens, which is still a good amount. But let's see when I'm going to do it next because the purchase for today is done and I don't want to spend any more. It is a good experience overall when I buy something in the shop, and with Glint tokens, we have the convenience to use them whenever we want. And I know that a lot of people must be doing it; however, it is all good, and I overall like the experience of buying cards from the reward shop using the Glint tokens balance.

links.title: Більше ніж фандом: чому FANCON у Києві — це головна подія року, яку неможливо пропустити
links.body: >Привіт, друзі! Сьогодні я з новинами з фестивалю FANCON у Києві. Це було щось... Також, ділюся своїми деякими фотками...

>Я стояв посеред величезного павільйону МВЦ, і в голові пульсувала лише одна думка: реальність офіційно взяла вихідний. Ліворуч від мене Геральт із Рівії, злегка порушуючи канон, купував каву на фудкорті, праворуч — хлопці з ДСНС спокійно і професійно вчили підлітків основам тактичної медицини, а зі сцени в цей час лунав такий драйвовий K-Pop, що навіть у бетонних стін, здавалося, почали дрижати фундаменти. Тільки-но ти виходиш зі станції метро «Лівобережна» і повертаєш до МВЦ, звичний світ зникає. Навколо тебе починають снувати ельфи, штурмовики із «Зоряних війн» та персонажі з аніме, чиї костюми виглядають так, ніби вони щойно зійшли з екранів кінотеатрів. Коли я переступив поріг гігантського павільйону, у мене буквально перехопило подих: двадцять тисяч квадратних метрів суцільного драйву, де все навколо світиться, грає музика, а очі розбігаються від масштабів фотозон.

>
Маркет Geek Bazaar став зоною мого повного фінансового краху, але я не шкодую ні про одну витрачену гривню. Я годинами блукав між стендами видавництв, буквально вигрібаючи купу свіжої манґи та українських мальописів, бо підтримати наших авторів — це вже справа честі. Але справжнє серце фестивалю — це Алея художників. Поспілкуватися наживо з нашими ілюстраторами, потримати в руках авторські стікери чи артбуки, які пахнуть свіжою фарбою, — це особливий кайф, який не замінить жоден інтернет-шопінг. Я навіть не втримався і долучився до створення колективного графіті — залишив свій невеличкий слід на стіні фестивалю, відчуваючи себе частиною чогось глобального.

>Я прийшов сюди не просто подивитися, я прийшов грати. Спершу я застряг на стенді Samsung, де проходив Galaxy Quest. Мені видали карту учасника, і я, як заведений, бігав виконувати завдання: шукав відповіді через фічу штучного інтелекту Circle to Search, бився у PUBG Mobile прямо на нових смартфонах Galaxy та налаштовував світло для фотозони через SmartThings. А далі мій шлях лежав у величезну зону настільних ігор, яка розкинулася на добру тисячу квадратів. Разом із групою незнайомців, які за секунди стали моїми бойовими товаришами, я сів за стіл Dungeons & Dragons. Майстер із Cats & Dice так майстерно вів гру, що ми кілька годин поспіль «кидали на спритність» і штурмували вигадані замки, забувши про існування телефону та реальних проблем. Це нереальне відчуття єднання з людьми, які ще годину тому були для тебе чужими, а тепер разом із тобою рятують фентезійний світ.

>Коли на головну сцену вийшов ведучий Myach Dreadball, натовп вибухнув так, що в сусідньому районі, мабуть, спрацювали сигналізації. Я стояв у перших рядах під час Cosplay & K-Pop Cover Dance Show, і рівень деталізації костюмів наших косплеєрів — це просто космос. Вони змагалися за гран-прі, але виглядало це не як змагання, а як справжнє мистецтво. Але найбільші мурашки пробігли шкірою від іноземних гостей. Я бачив Maul Cosplay, легендарного Геральта від CD Projekt Red, який приїхав суто підтримати українців, і це багато про що говорить. А Міккі Льюїс, той самий Кібермен із «Доктора Хто», привіз із собою оригінальний екранний костюм. Сфотографуватися з ним та взяти автограф, зробивши при цьому донат на ЗСУ — це спогад, який я берегтиму все життя. До речі, онлайн-інтерв'ю з Джо Аберкромбі стало вишенькою на торті: можливість поставити питання живому класику фентезі через «відкритий мікрофон» — це рівень, який доводить, що ми — частина світової спільноти.

>Однак FANCON — це не лише про ескапізм та ігри, це про нашу реальність. Найсильніші емоції викликав сектор UA Heroes. Стенди Третьої окремої штурмової бригади, ДСНС та Патрульної поліції — це було те місце, де я зупинявся надовго. Спілкування з нашими бійцями, примірка спорядження, розмови про справжні виклики — це повертає до тями, але водночас дарує надію. Там же я зустрів топового блогера OLDboi, який наживо показував унікальну консоль Xbox Series X, кастомізовану під контейнер для артефактів зі S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Я кинув свої гроші в банку на FPV-дрони, бо розумію: цей фестиваль роблять люди з великим серцем для таких самих людей.

>Виходячи з МВЦ після двох днів драйву, я відчував себе одночасно виснаженим і неймовірно наповненим. FANCON — це місце, де ти нарешті почуваєшся «своїм серед своїх». Тут не важливо, хто ти в звичайному житті — менеджер, програміст чи студент. Тут ти — частина великої спільноти, яка вміє і розважатися на повну, і підтримувати одне одного, коли це дійсно потрібно. І знаєте, я вже відклав собі в календар дату наступного фестивалю, бо це стало моєю персональною віддушиною, місцем сили та територією, де магія стає цілком відчутною.

links.body:
**Copilot in Meetings bringt nichts.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSnEwWCxgzpc484X8bNicmC9ekrgqi567hyrQdmfwPehn/img_5209.png)

Diesen Satz lasse ich inzwischen bewusst genau so stehen.

Und ja – er kommt von jemandem, der genau damit arbeitet.

Was ich in der Praxis sehe, passt einfach nicht zu der Erwartung, die viele haben.

Copilot funktioniert technisch sehr gut.
Er protokolliert sauber, fasst Diskussionen zusammen und erkennt To-dos zuverlässig.

Und trotzdem bringt es in vielen Unternehmen – nichts.

**Der Punkt ist:**

Copilot rettet kein schlechtes Meeting.
Er macht es nur sichtbar.

Plötzlich steht da schwarz auf weiß, was vorher einfach im Raum verpufft ist:

	•	keine klare Linie
	•	keine echten Entscheidungen
	•	keine Umsetzung

Und genau hier wird es spannend – und auch ein Stück weit unangenehm.

Viele Unternehmen investieren gerade in KI und hoffen, dass dadurch automatisch Struktur entsteht.

Als würde das Tool die Arbeitsweise gleich mit verändern.

**Das passiert nicht.**

Wenn ein Meeting vorher chaotisch war, ist es danach einfach nur besser dokumentiert.

Mehr nicht.

Die eigentliche Veränderung passiert woanders.

In der Vorbereitung.
In der Klarheit über Ziel und Ergebnis.
In der Disziplin, Entscheidungen wirklich zu treffen und festzuhalten.

Erst dann beginnt Copilot seinen echten Wert zu entfalten.

✅ Zusammenfassungen werden relevanter.
✅ To-dos werden verbindlicher.
✅ Nach dem Meeting passiert auch wirklich etwas.

Ich sehe dieses Muster immer wieder – im Vertrieb, in Führungsteams, in Projekten.

Die Technologie ist selten das Problem.
Die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, meistens schon.

Und das ist der Teil, den man nicht einfach einkaufen kann.

💬 Mich würde interessieren, wie andere das erleben.

Seht ihr das ähnlich – oder habt ihr ganz andere Erfahrungen gemacht?

#copilot #microsoft365 #ki #meetings

links.title: Single or in a Relationship
links.body:
Any relationships has its own positivity and negativity.  I am not sure if my views would ever be considered with respect to this question, because I was born in 1970's.   But life's experience is the greatest experience. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNX9qnnpVU6zwKNA7ixXA86AHiiw3nC88Svzb7tTGqamD/1780944746699.jpg)
[Source](ttps://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-persons-hands-forming-heart-2PODhmrvLik)

Those were times when parents decided our future rather than our choice, especially in my country.  All the references about the to be groom is being investigated through different sources and finally  decision is made. Fortunately, most of the marriages were successful and concluded with a fairytale story ending up with - Happy Married Life. No matter what happens in future. And the proposed marriage age for girls was 21.

Women being the less privileged category then, accepts whatever is being decided by the elders.  Choosing a boy of your own or dating a boy was far away from the madding crowd.  If by chance, we happen to be in a relationship, we are looked down as an alien from another planet, by the society.

Cooking, making children and taking care of the whole family was the assigned job in our in-laws home. If you execute this in a wonderful way, then you are best else you are humiliated.  Our interests, hobbies and degrees never had any values.

This scenario was way back in 70's and 80's. 

Gradually this so called scenario started  changing giving way to new generations with new thoughts. Technology started to advance in 1990's, whereby, men felt it was necessary that he get a working women than an unemployed one.  

So here started the next move, were men and women equally worked and shared equal responsibilities for their family.  Understanding each other was the key point in this relationship.  So here, life was beautiful which was all about sharing and caring.

From the year 2000, technology kept advancing, job opportunities poured in, while working online and offline. This is the period when the beauty of a relationship started distancing. On the race to earn more,  family was given less or rather, no importance.

Very recently live in relationships is given much more imortance.  One of the advantages is, here the parents  are more liberal and decisions are left to the choice of bride/groom.  So once again age is not a bar. 

**The present generation is quite fast, bold and has a vision for their future. They decide whether to go ahead with marriage or stay single and enjoy the privilege of bachelor hood**.

**Conclusion**:

**Life has both its sweetness and bitterness, though you are married or in a relationship.  It is just your sole responsibility to move ahead, when the ball is in your court**

Most times I envied the freedom and guts of the present generation and most often I wished to be one among them.  But no, they are too fast in their needs.

Thankyoudear friends for your patience and time in reading my blog.

Expansion in narrowness ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/468ec2db-fadb-467d-892e-00154aacbe63.jpg) A man opened an eyeglass shop in the city, but for example, the shop was small, only nine feet wide, while eyesight tests are checked by reading from 18 feet. He found a solution to this by putting a mirror on the wall and making 9 feet 18 feet. He used to put the mirror in front of the chart with words and read in the mirror. The distance from the customer to the mirror was 9 feet, then the chart with words from the mirror was 9 feet. The distance from the customer to the chart with words became 18 feet and it worked perfectly This same principle applies to every aspect of life. If you have few opportunities and your scope for expansion is narrow, then there is no need to despair. You can use your intelligence to make your nine feet eighteen feet. If your house is small, you can expand it by making it two-story. If you have little capital, you can compensate for it by proving your honesty. If your degree is mediocre, you can make it more effective through good manners. If you have no chance of winning by fighting, you can control your opponent by adopting the method of wisdom. Every small shop can become a big shop. A shop is small until the shopkeeper uses the wisdom that increases it. After using the wisdom that increases it, no shop in this world is small.

Hello everyone.
I am @naturaluttom, today I will share with you my experience of a Frontier Ranked match in my favorite game Splinterlands.





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmegjqE6KCwd4vDaE51sHB75Yoz7p46tKrYzpYTEn6cG6b/1780944499249.png)

Today's match was a match with a 30 Mana Cap. The ruleset of this match was Lost Legendaries. Due to this ruleset, no Legendary Monsters could be used. So I had to rely more on other cards while forming the team.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQaZFAbuVv5E71JDG7bRkwCCJdA34yd2d5NRoJE82npKB/1780944046459.jpg)

https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_174ac9cef09a61de7aa873d942dee159?ref=naturalutto_lite

In this match, I used Death Splinter. The opponent also entered the field with a Summoner from the Death team. Before the match started, I chose some Monsters that could work well together. My goal was to gradually weaken the opponent's team.

links.title: Things about money
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTBNipjU9uMUNLUDUq1NjSDkJ3MMc8Ee9xfJAeMQbNXV/1780944329707.jpg)

In this life we can't do without money because it is money that crowns every plan we have. That's the reason people are finding money by all means, and some people don't care about the consequences. I'm not disputing the fact that money is a good thing, but we must find it in a legal way.

Some people are just finding this money to oppress another person or to spend lavishly in the club. That's what most guys want. But the truth is that most of them are not thinking that anything can happen to them anytime. They don’t even have the thought of having an emergency fund; all they believe in is spending lavishly.

I remember some years back when I was young. At that time I was making a lot of money, and there was a girl I was seeing. I loved this girl so much, but because I had not been making money at that time, I didn’t have the opportunity to approach her. But when I started making money, I had the boldness to approach her and show my feelings for her. I can’t forget the reply she gave me that day. She asked me how much I had to spend on her, and I replied that I could spend all my savings on her and she agreed to date me.

Five months later, my mom got sick and the hospital was requesting a sum of money to treat her. All my siblings were looking up to me to provide the money because they knew about the business I was running. But the funniest part is that I had spent all my savings on love, and I didn’t have anything in my bank account again because I used to impress this girl with money. I didn’t know how to tell my family that I didn’t have money because I knew they would question me about where all the money I had been making went.

Before we knew it, the sickness was getting serious, and all my siblings told me to help them out because our mother must not die. Well, to cut the story short, I tried all my possible best to get the money by all means, and when my mother was healed, I was seriously broke. One day I saw a message pop up on my phone when I checked, it was this girl texting me. She said she wanted to break up with me, that she was not ready for a relationship. I told her, “With all the money I have spent on you?” and she replied that she was sorry.

I was angry that day. Since then, I have learned a lesson: you should always save money for emergencies because anything can happen at any time.

**Thanks for reading.**

links.title: My Old Laptop Taught Me Everything About Codecs
links.body:
When your footage fights back

Anyone who has edited on an older or modest machine knows the frustration. You drop a clip into your timeline and the playback turns to a slideshow. Scrubbing becomes a guessing game. What went wrong?

The answer, almost every time, is the codec.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbEbg5MJZXx2KQmommZ7K4wpYkvecowH3AFKKT9vJ8g6v/peter-stumpf-yk9VXp4W5-Q-unsplash.jpg 

Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash > What is a codec, exactly? It is the method used to compress and store video. Every codec makes a tradeoff between file size, image quality, and how much work your computer needs to do to play it back. **Two very different kinds of video files** Not all codecs are created equal, and they serve completely different purposes. **DELIVERY** **H.264 / H.265 (HEVC)** Highly compressed. Small files. Used for YouTube, social media, WhatsApp, streaming downloads. The server loves them. Your editing software does not. **EDITING** **HAP / ProRes / DNxHD** Much larger files. Very fast to decode. Built so your editing software can scrub and play without breaking a sweat. Quality is preserved at every cut. The compressed codecs we download and share are designed to save space and bandwidth. To do that, they throw away data and make your CPU or GPU work hard to reconstruct each frame at playback. On a fast machine this is manageable. On an older laptop it is a grind. Converting that same footage to an editing codec like HAP dramatically increases the file size, but the data is now laid out in a way that editing software can read quickly and easily. Playback becomes smooth. Scrubbing feels instant. Your old laptop becomes a capable editing machine again. Cameras that shoot RAW video preserve nearly everything the sensor captures. Color information, highlight detail, shadow information, none of it is thrown away. This is what gives colorists and editors so much room to work in post. The tradeoff is file size and complexity. RAW files are enormous and need conversion before most editing timelines can handle them gracefully. Transcoding into a managed format, something like ProRes or a high-quality intermediate, gives editors the best of both worlds: the original quality, in a container their software loves. **The free tool that handles all of it** **Shutter Encoder** is a free, open source video conversion application built on top of FFmpeg, one of the most powerful media processing tools in existence. The key difference is that Shutter Encoder wraps all of that power inside a clear, approachable interface anyone can learn in an afternoon. links.title: Thoughts On The Upcoming Cradle Of War Expansion In Eve Online
links.body:
![upcoming expo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23tbHLQVrkykUxCigZYhefSh3yu6kf3YWw2DYZJDU8cKDyMDAUsNFktbQ2kqpMmUSYXkh.jpg)
The next expansion in Eve Online Cradle of War is almost here, arriving on June 9th, 2026. This is one of those expansions where it’s going to have something that you are into or just not at all. With it having a focus on Faction Warfare. With some new player experience overall on top. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rYwx4kgI6kk # Faction Warfare And Military Campaigns In the past expansions in Eve Online, even if you did not do something daily, like mining. As we had some updates not that long ago. Chances are, you have done some kind of mining, and many just enjoy doing so. Faction Warfare, on the other hand, is quite different. You have to pick a side and join it. Putting you at war with another faction, regardless of where you are in the game. It’s just something not everyone is into joining or partaking any part of. It seems Military Campaigns will be changing that. With Cradle of War, there is now going to be seasonal campaigns. Once they started talking about people being able to mine to earn points towards it, among other things. I just knew it took an expansion I was not expecting to have anything of not for me to do into something that might keep me busy for quite some time. I've never cared much for joining a faction in faction warfare itself in the past. Opening yourself up to being attacked by the other side while just trying to mine or do other activities. This used to be something people would just toss alts into as something to do if they had nothing else. As someone who has only joined faction warfare ones and long time ago. I really did not care for it. I felt the whole thing kind of stale. There are also just endless issues with spying and luring players into traps. Then you have people ganking their own factions to the point it even has its own term for it. With that in mind, they are playing around with the standing rules just a tad. I don’t think it will fix the issues, but at least an attempt is being made. Now, could a new seasonal campaign fix faction warfare itself, in feeling kind of stale? It might just do that. If the outcomes from winning or losing end up being huge. I just hope they find the right balance between rewarding and changing the game based on outcomes. Along with keeping them in check, those of us who want nothing to do with that system are not finding ourselves forced to make choices. It, however, sounds like that is exactly what they want. We will see how they tune this system over the long run after that fresh new spaceship smell wears off the expansion itself. One thing I like is that they have added in trying to create some usefulness for faction warfare again. Is adding a new line of destroyer ships that can be earned with faction loyalty points. I’ve known some people in the past who have had way too many loyalty points, so offloading them was always an issue. Players would sometimes even get scammed out of their points by trying to bulk sell a bunch of an item to someone with ill intentions. Hopefully, this adds some fresh blood that is needed to the entire loyalty point system across the game. I myself might be tossing an alpha alt into faction warfare. It’s been so long since I've partaken in the activity. It would be fun to see some of the new combat sites they are also adding to the game. Overall, for this part of the expansion. I think it’s giving a lot of needed life into something that has been around forever and has somewhat felt neglected. Only time will tell just how big a game change they plan on making, things like the seasonal campaign. Players could have major push back on this or lose to much of an interest. Military campaigns also seem to be the way to get everyone involved, even if you are not enlisted with a faction for PvP. I’m hoping it adds some fresh new fun to the mix of things. It looks like the entire system will have a lot of tasks in it. Will be interesting to see how many will be PvP or faction warfare related only. I just hope they kept it broad enough for anyone to join and not just make it only worthwhile for those only in faction warfare themselves. Would be fun if I could earn a bunch of points just running exploration sites. I guess we will soon see. # New Player Experience Eve Online, over the past couple of years, has been putting some focus on refreshing the new player experience. Eve Online was always know as that game that had a learning curve that was a cliff. Where people got pushed off the cliff while trying to go up it. For older games like Eve Online to keep going, they do need some fresh blood. Sometimes the game has an issue with far too many bitter, rich, entitled vets who have nothing to do. Part of this change is Eve Online getting a new region of space to the game called Exordium. I’ve already covered a bit of that in the past. I think it will be interesting to see how they manage the no PvP and getting players to leave that area to play in the main part of the game. For now, it seems they are just using reduced rewards. They have also added to the game's terms that abusing this area can get you banned. I suppose it’s not to shocking they need rules to be like that. Even more so if someone with 20 accounts decides they just want to strip mine everything in the area. I think it could be a fun way for some older players to test out some sites they have always stayed away from. As Exordium has weakened versions of a few sites that require the fleet to run. Where a wrong move and you just lost a rather expensive ship. Expect the newer player versions of these sites to be more frigate-level instead of marauder level type of sites. This new region of space is also where new players will get to start. I know some players who plan on starting the game after this expansion releases. They were planning to join sooner, but after hearing about the big changes. Ended up holding off for a bit. I think overall this will be a great way to get new eyes and hopefully fresh blood into Eve Online. It is quite a complex and deep space game. One that is rather intimidating for many to even think about jumping into. I just hope the gates leading outside of this new region. Which there are going to be four. Won’t turn into giant ganking fests. There is a chance this could make trips from one region of the empire space to the other in terms of trade hubs. A lot shorter distance for those looking to go through high-security only. So I could see them becoming choke points as well. Since even older players are allowed to travel through the new region. # Achievements It’s kind of funny thinking eve online went this long without having any real kind of in game achievement system. They don’t even have achievements on Steam if you play the game from there. I’ve known some players to do some silly and long grinding things in video games. All over a rather silly achievement in them. It seems this is kind of what some of them might be. It even looks like there will be achievements for seasonal content. If anything, this is just one way to get the player base a little more active than they sometimes can be. Even more so in between major events. If nothing else, it feels like just a fun addition to the game. I wonder why it was not done a long time ago. There has been a kind of title system that people could award to others. Along with faction warfare having a ranking title system. It seems titles will be expanded out as well with the new achievement system rolling in. # Command Carriers For a while now, Eve Online has been hinting at trying to make carriers a more used ship in the game. I guess it was only a matter of time before something like tier 2 carriers showed up. These ships are going to be made for giving boosts for fleets. As they can fit three command burst modules each. While there are quite a few ships made for boosting fleets. They have always been more for the smaller side of things. It seems this update is for the vets of the game who have level 5 carrier skills and might have never flown one. Funny enough. Every time I'd go on long breaks from the game. I’d set training for the Amarr Carrier. Over my many years of taking breaks and having some extra game time run out without having to log in to start a new skill training. As far back then, the game did not have a training queue. We have now been spoiled for many years. I still don’t see myself ever flying a carrier, let alone commanding one. Anytime I go into some big null-security alliance. It just never ends well. Lots of ISK is set on fire. Along with that, I just don’t find that area of the game to be fun. Other than when I'm exploring though it solo, trying not to get killed exploring. # Final Thoughts Overall, this expansion is going to end up being far more deep then even I was expecting. They ended up putting out some [patch notes](https://www.eveonline.com/news/view/cradle-of-war-expansion-notes?utm_source=launcher&origin=launcher&utm_content=en) the other day for. My opinion a month ago about Cradle of War, and now what I see it could end up doing is quite a massive change of thought about it. links.title: El dia que te sientas fracasado // the day you feel like a failure
links.body:
>


>! [English Version] 
> 
>
>   Our emotions almost always cloud our vision of our successes, as many times we feel that we are really not achieving anything or that you haven't been able to start that business you dreamed of, or that you haven't been able to go on that trip you long for. And it was while watching one of my favorite series that I was able to reflect on this constant doubt, so today we will talk about Jiraya while you accompany me on this new design.



  Nuestras emociones casi siempre nublan nuestra visión sobre nuestros éxitos, ya que muchas veces sentimos que realmente no estamos llegando a nada o que no has podido montar ese negocio con el que soñabas, o no has podido salir a ese viaje que anhelas. Y fue viendo una de mis series favoritas, en la cual pude reflexionar sobre esta duda tan constante, así que hoy hablaremos de Jiraya mientras me acompañas a este nuevo diseño.

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/RR3X3ZVLJoAAAAAC/naruto-jiraiya.gif)


<center>
![output-onlinegiftools-com.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqrzFPZriSMb7YmQ6.gif)
</center>




<div class=\

>

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  Jiraiya is a ninja from the Leaf Village, the mentor of the protagonist Naruto. Sometimes messages come from where we least expect them. Who would have thot that we would learn something from this series that many surely have overlooked, which is learning to see what we ignore about ourselves?


  Jiraya es un ninja de la aldea de la hoja, maestro del protagonista Naruto. A veces los mensajes suelen venir de donde menos esperamos. ¿Quién diría que volvería a aprender algo de esta serie que muchos seguro habrán pasado por alto, que es aprender a ver lo que ignoramos de nosotros mismos?


|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23t7wgFtxm2uLxC9EjkeHHJ7cTkKHirpQ3aFbhpGTvrD545GnDrPTEGCzFbpBDFAudCH9.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tc3eT9KnxM9i7uBVUjMpwiBMBU6qN3zLrfHWTP3wymDK13bRpAd4UnUPejqHbRYLAy9.png)|
|-|-|

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  On his deathbed, the ninja known as Jiraiya reflects on his life and, in retrospect, says that his life was completely full of failures, as he was always rejected by the woman he loved, couldn't stop his friend Orochimaru, lamenting his inability to defend his pupil Minato or his mentor Hiruzen, because, compared to the famous feats of the Hokages, our hero thinks that all his actions have been mediocre and insignificant, and it is here that he tells us he wished he had departed with the honors those Hokages had.


  En su lecho de muerte, el ninja conocido como jiraya reflexiona sobre su vida y este, en retrospectiva, dice que su vida totalmente estuvo llena de fracasos, ya que siempre fue rechazado por la mujer que amaba, no pudo detener a su amigo Orochimaru, lamentando ser incapaz de defender a su pupilo Minato ni a su mentor Hiruzen, porque, comparadas con las célebres hazañas de los hokages, nuestro héroe piensa que todas sus acciones han sido mediocres e insignificantes y es donde este nos dice que desearía haber partido con los honores que tuvieron esos hokages.

 
|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tmUbTFcHYLxVV1TmDUoa3jUdSW5HroctzmxppEDNLsC9xxQoDHZ1o6G3V1FDFd8g3Rf.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tmU8QLPnNvfSjKSs1Epd4TVH2AAL4utdQnWQNr85BchQ5b68vdB45ZXYwTzXgAdQH4C.png)|
|-|-|




<div class=\

> >! [English Version] > >   Well, that's just his self-perception; he genuinely believes he has failed and that the great feat that would erase his failures never came true, but nevertheless, his true form appears before his eyes, and it is that little boy who swore that one day he would become Hokage and that people would see him up there, who is Naruto. This is how Jiraiya comes to a conclusion.   Pues esa es solo su autopercepción; él genuinamente cree que ha fracasado y que la gran hazaña que borraría sus fracasos jamás se hizo realidad, pero sin embargo su verdadera forma aparece frente a sus ojos, y es ese pequeño niño que juró que algún día seria hokage y que las personas lo verían allá arriba, el cual es Naruto. Es así como jiraya llega a una conclusion. |![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tvwGfRUhMqZ1MsZdWzsqQKWscM24NHW1XvkcGUi8NXudXEFRDYPFtrugLq5iotZhWcK.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23uFcaorw8ePHeBeB2Q6oT1n88AK6SA2BHcYmNx6XXUC3YYCt6Ct5PbnrCezisXGdN8NF.png)| |-|-| >! [English Version] > >   Which is to never go back on your word no matter what, and never give up even if you think you should. > >  Those words are directed at his pupil Naruto, and it is there that he realizes that as a teacher he truly has nothing to regret, as he managed to ignite the flame that drives the heart of that young and future Hokage.   El cual es nunca retroceder a tu palabra sin importar qué, y nunca rendirse pese a que creas que debes hacerlo.   Esas palabras están dirigidas a su pupilo Naruto, y es ahí donde se da cuenta de que como maestro realmente no tiene nada de que lamentarse, ya que logro avivar la llama que impulsa el corazon en ese joven y futuro hokage. |![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tH9oMrFzT1whRwNLrxqqeGfvDKMDmNqLj81amLiWaUYRzTPNLWWAAUaTXupJVQdsnz4.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tmN1G1VhMZiUvS4UYCa4gQQFDnQKMqAqYaP8fc9bwGmg5M1NWJzMYQC6oHfsfo391N3.png)| |-|-| >! [English Version] > >   In life, there will always come those moments when the pace slows down, when bad things happen, and it is in that moment that we ask ourselves and question everything, whether what we have done makes any sense or if what we are doing is right, and it is that pressure that makes us forget the value of our actions and the good we have contributed of ourselves to others. > >   So the next time that feeling comes, don't look at others, don't compare yourself to the actions of others; instead, look at yourself... observe your own progress... because, no matter how small we might believe our achievements are compared to others, in the end, they are yours alone. > >   Living a life comparing yourself to others will always leave us unsatisfied, for the right approach is not to live competing against others, but against yourself... At the end of his life, Jiraiya felt like a failure, not because he hadn't achieved anything, but because he always lived comparing himself to those he admired, and it was in his final moments that life reminded him of what he truly was and what he had truly contributed. > >   That's why if you feel inadequate today, I want you to hold on to this beautiful message that the character gave us:   En la vida siempre llegarán esos momentos en que el ritmo bajará, en que malas cosas ocurrirán, y es en ese momento en el que nos preguntamos y cuestionamos todo, si lo que hemos hecho tiene algún tipo de sentido o si lo que estamos haciendo está bien, y es esa presión la que nos hace olvidar el valor de nuestras acciones y de lo bueno que hemos aportado de nosotros mismos a los demás.   Así que la próxima vez que llegue ese sentimiento, no mires a los demás, no te compares sobre las acciones que han tenido otros; si no, mírate a ti mismo... observa tu propio progreso... porque, por más pequeños que pudiéramos creer que son nuestros logros en comparación con otros, al final no son más que tuyos.   Vivir una vida comparándose con otra persona siempre nos mantendrá insatisfechos, pues el enfoque correcto no es vivir compitiendo contra otros, sino contra ti mismo... Al final de la vida, Jiraiya se sentía un fracasado, no porque este no hubiera logrado nada en realidad, sino porque siempre vivió comparándose con aquellos a quienes admiraba, y fue en sus últimos momentos que la vida le recordó lo que realmente fue y que realmente había aportado.   Es por eso que si hoy te sientes insuficiente, quiero que te quedes con este bello mensaje que nos dio el personaje: https://youtube.com/shorts/2prwbmzOgN4?si=QKgQr9zZSZ4CBmNj ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tmKnSwPURqmW9JkbSFTTfbGKVvVbE5DJ5xiA4z5NJvjYqpAD7TjtGcpDWJcqvZVxSvQ.png) >! [English Version] > >   Ironically, they are all warm colors. Colors that are of light, but at the end of the day, I feel empty. > >   I suppose I am a permanent contradiction. Irónicamente, todos son colores cálidos. Colores que son de luz, pero al final del día me siento vacío. Supongo que soy una contradicción permanente.

>\n\nPresentamos la trayectoria de **Malanga**, la agrupación caraqueña que marcó una época en el pop-rock venezolano a través de su evolución desde el \
hacia un sonido de rock latinoamericano.
>\n\nWe present the career of **Malanga**, the Caracas group that marked an era in Venezuelan pop-rock through their evolution from \

to a Latin American rock sound. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AJXY1z6ABzm8Ugai3jQFrv17vk9QBTHxyjC4Va37KWMGMwRSCCiEybJKJRPd6eC.png) # Malanga: La evolución del rock citadino y la fusión

>

**Malanga** es una banda de rock caraqueña formada en el año 1998, cuyo repertorio abarca desde la fusión del rock con ritmos tropicales hasta composiciones enmarcadas dentro del sonido del rock latinoamericano.

La banda surge de la unión de **Arístides Barbella** (ex-cantante de la banda de *covers* Egos), **Rudy Pagliuca** (ex-integrante de **Los Melódicos**), **Chapis Lasca** (ex-bajista de **Los Cañoneros**) y **Juan Luciow** (ex-baterista de diversas agrupaciones de *metal*), cuatro músicos con trayectorias diversas en la escena nacional. Su primer trabajo discográfico fue lanzado en el año 1999 bajo el título *Ta' Trancao*. En esta producción destacó una marcada influencia de la rítmica del Caribe. Canciones como *Ay Guana Parrandear*, *Vueltas* o *Mai Lof* reflejan la integración tropical de la banda, apoyada en una instrumentación con metales y percusiones que dio forma a la propuesta que la agrupación denominó \

. El alcance de su primer disco les permitió realizar giras en Venezuela, así como en ciudades de España, Estados Unidos y Centroamérica. El sencillo *Déjala* formó parte de la internacionalización de su repertorio y fue regrabado posteriormente junto a la cantante española **Pastora Soler**, versión que se incluyó junto a un *remix* en una reedición del álbum. En el año 2002 publicaron *Tren de Vuelta*, su segundo álbum de estudio. El tema *Latin Lover* contó con la colaboración del compositor y cantante panameño **Rubén Blades**, convirtiéndose en una de las piezas referenciales de la agrupación. Esta canción, junto a *Si Tú No Estás*, formó parte de la banda sonora de la telenovela venezolana *Trapos Íntimos*, transmitida por la planta televisiva **RCTV**. Asimismo, el disco incluyó el tema *Acércate*, grabado en colaboración con **Franco De Vita**. Posteriormente, la agrupación modificó su línea compositiva para concentrarse en un sonido volcado estrictamente hacia el rock, prescindiendo de la fusión tropical previa. Bajo esta premisa se estructuró el álbum *Nadie Quiere Estar Solo* (2005). Su tercera producción discográfica obtuvo difusión a través de temas como *Mil Copas*, *No Tienes Corazón* y *Un Nuevo Motivo*, pieza compuesta en apoyo a la selección nacional de fútbol, La Vinotinto, la cual acompañó la campaña de la Copa América 2007 celebrada en Venezuela. El principal promocional del disco fue *De Caracas a Madrid*, tema que ocupó los primeros lugares del renglón radial nacional. Su cuarta producción, titulada *Aunque Mueran las Flores* (2009), mantuvo la línea de rock de su predecesor y tuvo como sencillo principal la canción *Dime*. En el año 2013, la banda retomó los elementos de fusión tropical con el disco *Sr. Malanga*, en el cual destacó el tema *Dejó las Llaves*, una composición original perteneciente al proyecto solista de **Pablo Dagnino** (vocalista de **Sentimiento Muerto** y **Los Pixel**). Luego de este lanzamiento, la agrupación entró en un periodo de pausa debido a la migración de la mayoría de sus miembros. Tras un encuentro en Miami en 2016 y presentaciones en formato acústico por parte de Barbella y Lasca, la alineación completa regresó a los escenarios venezolanos en el festival *Cusica Fest 2019*. Este evento marcó el retorno del grupo al trabajo de estudio. En 2020 publicaron el sencillo *Tal Vez* y, en el año 2024, editaron su sexto álbum de estudio titulado *Nos Volvemos a Encontrar*, promocionado con los temas *El Camino*, *Sin Decir Adiós* y *La Belle Époque*, este último en referencia al recordado local nocturno caraqueño que frecuentaban los integrantes durante sus primeros años de actividad. ------

> 


### Malanga: The Evolution of City Rock and Fusion

**Malanga** is a rock band from Caracas formed in 1998, whose repertoire ranges from the fusion of rock with tropical rhythms to compositions framed within the Latin American rock sound.

The band arose from the union of **Arístides Barbella** (former singer of the cover band Egos), **Rudy Pagliuca** (former member of **Los Melódicos**), **Chapis Lasca** (former bassist of **Los Cañoneros**), and **Juan Luciow** (former drummer for various metal groups), four musicians with diverse trajectories in the national scene. Their first recording work was released in 1999 under the title *Ta' Trancao*. This production featured a marked influence of Caribbean rhythm. Songs like *Ay Guana Parrandear*, *Vueltas*, or *Mai Lof* reflect the tropical integration of the band, supported by instrumentation with brass and percussion that shaped the proposal the group called \

The reach of their first album allowed them to tour in Venezuela, as well as in cities across Spain, the United States, and Central America. The single *Déjala* was part of the internationalization of their repertoire and was later re-recorded alongside Spanish singer **Pastora Soler**, a version included along with a remix in a re-release of the album. In 2002 they published *Tren de Vuelta*, their second studio album. The track *Latin Lover* featured a collaboration with Panamanian composer and singer **Rubén Blades**, becoming one of the group's reference pieces. This song, along with *Si Tú No Estás*, was part of the soundtrack for the Venezuelan telenovela *Trapos Íntimos*, broadcast by the television network **RCTV**. Likewise, the album included the song *Acércate*, recorded in collaboration with **Franco De Vita**. Subsequently, the group modified its composition style to concentrate on a sound strictly focused on rock, dispensing with the previous tropical fusion. Under this premise, the album *Nadie Quiere Estar Solo* (2005) was structured. Their third record production achieved distribution through tracks like *Mil Copas*, *No Tienes Corazón*, and *Un Nuevo Motivo*, a piece composed in support of the national football team, La Vinotinto, which accompanied the 2007 Copa América campaign held in Venezuela. The main promotional single from the album was *De Caracas a Madrid*, a track that occupied the top spots in the national radio charts. Their fourth production, titled *Aunque Mueran las Flores* (2009), maintained the rock line of its predecessor and featured the song *Dime* as its main single. In 2013, the band returned to tropical fusion elements with the album *Sr. Malanga*, which highlighted the track *Dejó las Llaves*, an original composition belonging to the solo project of **Pablo Dagnino** (vocalist for **Sentimiento Muerto** and **Los Pixel**). Following this release, the group entered a period of hiatus due to the migration of most of its members. After a meeting in Miami in 2016 and acoustic format presentations by Barbella and Lasca, the full lineup returned to Venezuelan stages at the *Cusica Fest 2019* festival. This event marked the group's return to studio work. In 2020 they published the single *Tal Vez*, and in 2024, they edited their sixth studio album titled *Nos Volvemos a Encontrar*, promoted with the tracks *El Camino*, *Sin Decir Adiós*, and *La Belle Époque*, the latter in reference to the remembered Caracas nightspot that the members frequented during their early years of activity. #

body.body: ![evermore_20260606_155437_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/48Un7fBH7poFaqDaKeXoQvxc9qxHxGWZYtM5aticG8BC8kJQVqRHhNoCakC44gNG7P.png)

>Hello, my dear friends! I hope you are all doing well! I'm so excited to be back here to share with you my funny experience collecting the official Panini Fifa World Cup 2026 album, which I hadn't collected for several years!

\n\n>

>Hola, mis queridos amigos! Espero que estén muy bien! Estoy muy emocionada de estar nuevamente por aquí para compartir con ustedes mi divertida experiencia coleccionando el álbum oficial Panini del Mundial de Fútbol 2026, el cual no había coleccionado desde hace varios años!

![IMG_20260108_150145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23w3GeX95MkNiZXhYBnwVcm4BwngYMyB7VNsCTLcniF4kt6438tAbaat6fzX1dFkCyq8B.jpg)

>For some time by now, they've been releasing the album in various formats, like softcover and hardcover. However, being old school, I got the softcover version and I absolutely loved it! This year it was distributed in many places, including the Unicasa Supermarket, which is near my house, so I bought it there, along with five packs of stickers. This year the prices are higher compared to the previous World Cup, because the album cost me $7 and each pack of stickers was $2.20. The expense was a bit steep, but I didn't mind too much...and so my adventure began.

\n\n>

>De algún tiempo para acá, han estado sacando a la venta el álbum en varios formatos como tapa blanca y dura sin embargo, yo que soy de la vieja escuela lo adquirí tapa blanda y realmente me encantó mucho! Este año lo distribuyeron en muchos lugares y entre ellos, en el Supermercado Unicasa el cual está cerca de mi casa así que lo compré allá, junto a 5 paquetes de barajitas. Este año los costos son más elevados en comparación al mundial anterior ya que el álbum me costó 7$ y cada paquete de sobres 2.2$ cada uno. El gasto fue un poco grande pero, no me importó mucho... así comenzó mi aventura.

![IMG_20260608_123451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23u6BgtC5BKiwpPBhjisfvqkicXgRiCm9rMqixzvSKcSsvSDv5mkVLNVkqSkSNaN2Vjuq.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_123709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23tvo326nbMvLdbbLT7jGa6SxiG8x7mByTfD8ibJzJqjjcLy1Jz5XBg26rgSWf9W71N5A.jpg)

>Obviously, I was so excited that I started buying stickers almost every day. By the first week, I had collected over 200 stickers, which made me very happy. I set a goal to keep up that pace and complete the set in four weeks. Since my parents supported me, they also helped me buy a lot of packs each week, so by the second week, I was more than halfway there. I was thrilled because I had already gotten some of my favorite players, like Kylian Mbappé, James Rodríguez, Lamine Yamal, and Erling Haaland. The stickers that took the longest to arrive were Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo.

\n\n>

>Obviamente mi emoción fue tanta que empecé a comprar barajitas casi todos los dias, así que en la primera semana había pegado más de 200 barajitas lo cual me hizo muy feliz y me puse la meta de, seguir ese ritmo para llenarlo en 4 semanas y como mis padres me apoyaron también me ayudaron a comprar bastantes sobres semanales así que en la segunda semana ya llevaba más de la mitad y estaba muy emocionada porque ya me habían salido parte de mis jugadores favoritos como Kylian Mbappé, James Rodríguez, Lamine Yamal y Erling Haaland. Las barajitas que más tardaron en llegar fueron Lionel Messi y Cristiano Ronaldo.

![IMG_20260608_125000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23uQp4vnmZ2Py1d7kdXvisDQcveCAfccu3bt48AEbZcHurxM73i4p9e7uvPPNt9wPAFe4.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_125110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23wCNr1rEKmy7Azpk8wP49tpeXGE4VNa8Yzj24f4bhrCBGoPSvrcPK6rtTTVz2degb1Sj.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_125200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23xp26YNxK3RorA6bL3aohu3Degc7zQv5dCQqV6U8izc4cByaaafdtKfdvbFTWSaC9e8P.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_125357.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23wC5n1Ue4fC7rAQ94ymrPHz3BLZT6fXXBapNwAH5rYspEmzU5fXLNbXdL8jWGsQatReC.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_125521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/48PwMJuS4znnBwazaaHRcHyPcCrYEF6yh9zAvQjRPH7ddNdTAojx4VSnoSDm3jwn7u.jpg)

>Something I liked about this album is that it also includes some extra stickers which are not part of the album and are for collecting, and I loved that I got several, especially the one of another of my favorite players, Jude Bellingham from England (I still keep it in my wallet, actually hahaha)

\n\n>

>Algo que me gustó de este álbum es que también incluyen unos stickers extra los cuales, no forman parte del álbum y son para coleccionar, y me encantó que me salieran varios, en especial el de otro de mis jugadores favoritos Jude Bellingham de Inglaterra (todavía lo guardo en mi monedero, de hecho jajaja)

![IMG_20260608_130057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23xL39ykFUNf22jeZSN3Nk4YGRgdMNjrPRk6EbJeZdAp98dGR96FjrNDAQ8RU46yodPTe.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_130159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23w2sLrkfbMHttPxvfDzzr34hYZcYBiAopC9avUTqLwMm6KPSpjoj9UKSkdoS8qGspWHm.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_130638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23wX1177LVAAbuQusKNzHa9Uu7EqJ7qo3YGjr7gJ5XvXdWaYTgjkna31vSrmdUuypaAQe.jpg)

>When I started getting a lot of duplicate stickers, I looked for trading spots, and what better place than trading centers, haha. Although I always knew the main spot was in Los Palos Grandes Square, the first day we went to a club, which was a waste of time because there was nobody there. However, I was lucky that a shop near my house set up another trading point because the owners were also collecting the album, so it went great every time I went, and I traded over 100 duplicates on the first day alone. I also traded with my cousin who lives in Valencia, but we did it remotely, sending and receiving through the MRW courier service, haha. It was a lot of fun, and I loved meeting people and making new friends in the process. My album started filling up quickly, and I was so happy because after three weeks I only needed 30 more stickers.

\n\n>

>Cuando comenzaron a salir bastantes barajitas repetidas, busqué intercambiar y que mejor que los sitios de intercambio jajaja aunque supe desde siempre que el sitio principal era en la Plaza de Los Palos Grandes el primer día nos fuimos a un club, el cual fue tiempo perdido porque no hubo nadie el dia que fuimos, sin embargo tuve suerte de que en una tienda cercana a mi casa pusieran otro punto de intercambio ya que, los dueños también estaban coleccionando el álbum así que me fue excelente todas las veces que fuí, llegando a cambiar el primer día más de 100 repetidas. También intercambié con mi prima que vive en Valencia, pero a distancia fue enviando y recibiendo por la empresa de encomiendas de MRW jajaja. Fue algo muy divertido y me encantó conocer gente y hacer nuevos amigos en el proceso. Mi álbum comenzó a llenarse rápido y yo estaba muy feliz ya que al cabo de 3 semanas sólo me faltaban 30 barajitas.

![IMG_20260608_134230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23wWTPvXkwMq1Z8UNbgSeKdq6bCDewGUA8PzUe4XioUPt7jzDcWCWRpbdcNAoCJBU3xGG.jpg) ![1780940883083.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23u62xfwFZsDJQKw7Wq4HVNj2ZFtPkT4K56ZpG6SF6kCQ5RnV5QUoRWZyHH6KjgTLuhw9.png)

>Part of the adventure was collecting the Coca-Cola stickers, which you got by exchanging two labels from 2-liter bottles of soda at the Zoom offices. It was easier at first because if you bought the sodas at Farmatodo, they also gave you another red envelope. Since I got a bit confident and left these stickers until last, I had to buy the final five at the Farmatodo in the Sambil shopping center in La Candelaria by purchasing ten bottles, which I ended up giving away throughout the day, and this happened because Zoom ran out of sticker packs, haha. But filling that page made me very happy because, with it, I managed to fill the album 100%. I was thrilled to have all my favorite selections filled. Here's a sneak peek!

\n\n>

>Parte de la aventura fue, el coleccionar las barajitas de Coca Cola las cuales se obtenían canjeando 2 etiquetas del refresco de 2 litros en las oficinas de Zoom, y se me hizo más fácil al principio porque, si comprabas los refrescos en Farmatodo también te daban otro sobre rojo. Como me confié y dejé estas barajitas para lo último tuve que adquirir las últimas 5 barajitas en Farmatodo del Sambil de La Candelaria comprando 10 botellas, las cuales terminé regalando durante el dia, y esto pasó porque Zoom se quedó sin paquetes de barajitas jajaja. Pero llenar esa página me hizo muy feliz ya que, con ella logré llenar el álbum al 100%. Me llenó de satisfacción tener todas las selecciones favoritas llenas. A continuación un vistazo!

![IMG_20260608_140522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23tvkjz4bwciZhzXVf4rBdzTGc1p79p9XdPJxrUtwrdygYFjEMvXwk5vcA6Xj8wFiWo5i.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_140740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/EoCjULWSKqekR5Yfrd7PPeidVQRzXpsdggrxGUJbBNKtN35yc4A8y8RzVG8VRPicEDE.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_140814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/48KbxNjSjw1gZK7X2mrQhMczfafRQSQz1ch7Eu7NDXoGJBh45gM9K32PEQAL6QNzYK.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_140856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/EoEqyntsTuQ8gfifBwLjLrVPZQxYVb1beuyy2dPqTT3E1YN3c6twCoP6PdYpM1XckFi.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_140941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/48PwULRFp37Q2sEPMRT3W4CexrXK4RAtE9EBYTEZgXUyhVuWcCenSegGPYHGuCsFxw.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_141044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23uFTZVCbv1B6RfhafTYE28AztyG5EXaAfghvnRsz7VhXFq4jVK1KZcmJXpUpU3u9QGix.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_141140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/EoErV37vERdR1jvsPVD5azSoLvNjG17SguZE6qGFCTbdf3LaiMXH6eG1bStomeQSjmD.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_141231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23tvic28BfmzgfEdeoFQ9Tt116CzWYVnyHFavgSXyAEs5dbNF8aLWQK5LLDrm1KAmcqYN.jpg) ![IMG_20260608_141310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23tSWK1U89KGR84uCbN5VDxpQtHij6DYzva43c3T9k5yHrNTvKimU7kK7iU7rXE2zBg9P.jpg)

>Well, as you can see, even though it was a bit expensive (I spent about $300 in total), I really loved filling the album. The process was full of emotions, and I truly enjoyed it. If you have the chance, I encourage you to collect it! It's an experience that only comes around once every four years! It's been a great pleasure sharing it with you!

\n\n>

>Bueno, como ven aunque fue algo costoso (gasté aproximadamente unos 300$ en total) realmente me encantó llenar el álbum, el proceso estuvo lleno de muchas emociones y realmente lo disfruté bastante, de verdad si tienen la oportunidad anímense a coleccionarlo! Es una experiencia que se vive cada 4 años! Ha sido un gran placer compartirlo con ustedes!

![IMG_20260608_134411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/23tvkRbHx3u9dUtw8okjVMik2NNazqWuzA2jAjh4oUAyYYJq2NbqG2GZuaeeGuJFPbbTB.jpg)

>Well, my dear friends, that's all for today's post. I hope you enjoyed it and found it entertaining. Thank you all so much for your attention and support of my work. I'm sending you all a big hug, and we'll meet again in a new post.

\n\n>

>Bueno queridos amigos, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado y entretenido. Muchas gracias a todos por su atención y apoyo a mi trabajo, les mando un fuerte abrazo y ya nos reencontraremos en un nuevo post.

![Sour_20250817_133722_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iuliapetit2711/48SpaHDSytbxYE2e8vTkBtgiK6f3q1r3qWeZUzUDAtEBt5YSJL7dp5ZjFqczanqeUu.png)

>The welcome and farewell images were created by me using the Canva editor, and the photographs are my property.

\n\n>

>Las imágenes de bienvenida y despedida fueron realizadas por mí con el editor canva, y las fotografías son de mi propiedad.

\n\n

body.title: What If Schools Had No Exams?
body.body: Hello friends, how are you? I hope you're all doing well. I'm doing fine too, friends. These days, whenever the topic of education comes up, the first thing that comes to mind is exams.\n\n
alt=\

/>

What is an exam actually? An exam is basically the performance that students demonstrate after learning in class all year, and the test they take to prove it is what we call an exam. Passing it is also mandatory.

Have you ever thought what would happen if exams didn't exist?

You've also seen that many students, the moment they hear “exam,” start cramming instead of understanding the concepts, because their goal is just to get good grades.

Many times students consider rote memorization more important than understanding concepts, because their goal is to get good grades.

If exams are held in school, we can assess how capable the children are and how we can check this. By giving them return tests and practicals, we can evaluate it.

On the other hand, exams have some benefits. They teach students discipline and the habit of hard work. Teachers and parents also find out how much the student is learning. Therefore, completely eliminating exams may not be the best solution in every case.

In my opinion, the problem isn't the existence of exams but our overreliance on them. The real purpose of education isn't just to earn marks but also to develop knowledge, skills, and character. If schools paid attention to practical learning and creative assessment alongside exams, students could learn much more effectively.

Ultimately, the question is whether we are preparing students just for exams or for life? Perhaps the answer to this question is the key to making education better.

![1000488530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488530.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

> Greetings, friends of #blackandwhite—have a great start to the week! These past few days have been very fruitful, photographically speaking, partly because I’ve made a point of keeping a positive mindset and not letting stress get the better of me, and also because I’ve had an adventure partner: my nephew. Walking around the city just gets more tedious; but with Wisin, I’m more eager to see what I’ll find, and he, with his happy child’s intuition, lights my way. The photos below are the result of these walks.

> Saludos, amigos de #blackandwhite, ¡feliz inicio de semana! Estos días pasados han sido muy provechosos, fotográficamente, en parte por la disposición de tener una mente positiva y no dejarme vencer por el estrés y por tener además a un compañero de aventuras, mi sobrino. Solo se hace más tedioso el caminar por la ciudad; ya con Wisin estoy más a la expectativa de lo que voy a encontrar y él, con su intuición de niño feliz, me alumbra. Estas fotografías a continuación son resultado de estas caminatas. ________ ![1000488548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488548.jpg)

• • •
![1000488547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488547.jpg)

> Although, to tell the truth, sometimes I thought it wasn’t worth it to have Wisin as my assistant because he eats so much, all the time. “Uncle, I’m hungry!” I’m trying to take photos and he’s got a stomach like a bottomless pit.
>\n\nAunque, para decir la verdad, a veces creí que no me da negocio tener de ayudante a Wisin porque come mucho, a cada rato. \

. Yo tratando de hacer fotos y él con la barriga como un pozo sin fondo. ![1000488550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488550.jpg)

• • •
![1000488551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488551.jpg)
> Plus, he already wants me to give him a camera so he can take photos too—as if I’d say no.

> Además, ya quiere que le regale una cámara, para él también hacer fotos, no faltaba más. ![1000488546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488546.jpg)

• • •
![1000488549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000488549.jpg)

> Still, I’m grateful because who knows—maybe he’ll decide to pursue the world of photography. For now, it’s all an adventure for him, and I’m happy to be a part of it. And that’s all for today—thank you so much for everything, and see you soon!!!

> No obstante, estoy agradecido  porque quién sabe y se decida por este mundo de la fotografía, puede ser. Por el momento, todo es una aventura para él y yo feliz por formar parte de ella. Y hasta aquí es todo por hoy, mil gracias por todo y nos vemos pronto!!!

body.title: Ferrari Public Relations Shambles
body.body: \n

/> [source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/ed/57/f9/ed57f98d27b111173b4e51b5ea653ad9.jpg) Nothing is boring in Formula One and over the weekend the teams drivers let slip what is happening behind the scenes. One has to understand the implications because what is going on is unprecedented as teams have similar car set ups for both drivers and never different parts from other manufacturers.

/></center>

[source](https://www.brembogroup.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrem-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F69ed273b7f004b28b6e586faf5092625%3Fv%3D9b45d181&w=3840&q=85)


The public relations fall out is with regard to Brembo Braking systems that has been supplying all the braking needs for the Formula One team and the high end Ferrari road cars since 1975. That is a 50 partnership that Ferrari and Brembo have enjoyed until now.

Last season both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc complained that the F1 car was difficult to control as the brakes were inconsistent. The carbon brake discs handled so differently during the season depending on the type of race track. The over heating of the discs themselves was problematic forcing the team to opt for a lift and coast call to try and overcome these issues. This would help cool the brakes but was not the fastest way to drive the car.

The other problem was the unpredictable handling with the brakes sometimes biting hard or even failing to work and was more of a guessing game with no consistency. The drivers after every race last season kept on mentioning the brakes as being an issue that they were all trying to overcome. At the Singapore race Hamilton had no brakes during the final few laps and at Monaco in 2025 Leclerc had a front and rear end imbalance with his entire braking system.

After yesterdays race in Monaco Hamilton who finished 2nd revealed that the car is performing much better whilst Leclerc crashed out blaming his brakes. Leclerc then mentioned he will be trying the new set up Hamilton has this week for the Barcelona race. 

It turns out since pre season testing at Barcelona earlier in the year Hamilton has been trying to change his Brembo brake discs to another supplier which he had whilst driving at Mercedes. The Ferrari hierarchy would have been against this because what does that say about all their Ferrari cars and the relationship they have with Brembo?

Hamilton was granted his wish and has been using Carbon Industries brake discs since the Japanese Grand Prix where he finished 6th and Leclerc 3rd. In Miami Hamilton finished 6th and Leclerc 8th, Canadian Hamilton 2nd and Leclerc 4th and yesterday in Monaco Hamilton 2nd and Leclerc crashed out.

The deal Ferrari have with Hamilton is that Brembo is the braking system and they will allow Carbon Industries brake discs to be used. The results after switching have proven that this was the right call to make which has now convinced Leclerc to switch for the next race. Obviously this has ruffled a few feathers with Brembo who would not be happy with another supplier fixing the brake problems.

The good thing is that at least Ferrari listened to Hamilton's fix because the team was suffering because of the braking issues. If something is not working you find a solution and what Ferrari have been doing is not normal running two different manufacturers for the same part on two team cars. This has solved their problem which has been ongoing for a good 18 months and maybe much longer, possibly many seasons. 

The partnership of 50 years with Brembo may now be under pressure as a supplier because surely this should have been rectified immediately. Brembo benefitted business wise through supplying the Ferrari Formula One team through the data that was provided. Any other manufacturer faced with heating issues would have found a solution so they only have themselves to blame. At no point did they ever imagine that this relationship they have had would be put to the test.

Brembo have even used the term that they are the \

so this could change things drastically for the company. The saving grace is Brembo is an Italian company so Ferrari will stick by their side until they have no other option. My guess is Brembo is now going to be working on their brake discs which they should have been doing years ago.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/ferrari-public-relations-shambles-eax)

body.title: How To Add Quality Signal On First Context
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=calebmarvel24/zdjtk0ea

Some persons were asking, how can they addsignal to contents on the beta.firstcontext.app. it's very easy to add signals but another thing is to add up a high quality signal.

Watching this video, you will see a step by step guide on how to addsignal to contents and some key things that makes your signal a high quality signal.

***Below are steps to add up signals***

Go to any content of your choice on the beta.firstcontext.app,

* Click on **Mine Signal or Signal Inbox**
You will see different content from creators that you are tracking. 


* Go to any content of your choice and click on **Add Signal**



At this point, you will see two scenes, on is to view the clip or read through the context and the other one is to fill in the needful about it.

We have the below 👇.

* Topic hint: At this point, you gonna tell us the exact topic this content belong to.

* **Tags:** On this note, you are going to drop some tags that the content is all about. For example, this is a football update of the premier League. Our tag should be #premierleague #football and other related tags.

* **Normalized Claim:** At this point, you are going to specify the claim that the signal supports or disputes.

* **Stance:** You gonna indicate if it's support the claim. By: Support, Dispute or Unclear 

* **Best part:**

Under the best part we have the time-stamp or the key-quote

At this point, you gonna add some interest views/action (video) or worlds if its like blog post (text).

It's its a video, you will set the time stamp account to **What happened at that moment**

We have a feature were you can add up to three sections of the *best part* my click on (+add another moment)

Finally, we have  


* **Why it matters (1-2 sentences):**
At this point you gonna add a practical context for why the content worth attention.



Thanks for going through this tutorial section, feel free to tell us which of the areas you may like us to cover in our next tutorial.

Peace and love to @starkerz and all hiveans over the universe! ✌️


* **Note**

The screenshot are from the beta.firstcontext.app web, the video was recorded via Vmix.

body.title: [ENG-SPN] Lebeña: The Sanctuary that Defies the Centuries / Lebeña: El Santuario que Desafía los Siglos
body.body:
![DSCN0111.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqfHSFQ8vtRe8HHfTFqT6VjCho9ZtcYWZ3yRU4AJpXanQ2N7teW65B9EiKfeoMdJrbz.JPG)

Time passes, with its inexorable march, but when you stand before it, the centuries seem to barely touch its ancient architecture. The Church of Santa María de Lebeña, as eternal in appearance as the Picos de Europa mountains that watch over it with the fraternal affection of an old nurse, also guards its age-old secrets.

![DSCN0105.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EnuiRRKdbJ8CY6o6ujzo2X8Lz3FtrfHk7gw9iqxnQS9iXMTtUg4Dj1kvrkwrVGbFm9u.JPG)

The valley that shelters it, beyond the most harrowing part of the La Hermida gorge, whose Achilles' heel is the waters of the Deva River in its joyful descent to the Cantabrian Sea, is as fertile as the breast offered to the hungry mouth of the Christ Child by the venerated image of the Virgin.

![DSCN0113.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EnYSNfbJSvPXqC267weNc4FgPbfB9nAz7HpXHmJ9GcSufrfdeBiX1kDWoFBNxvDYyiK.JPG)

We are standing before one of the oldest and most significant sanctuaries on one of the most challenging pilgrimage routes in Spain: the Camino Lebanensis, or Way of Liébana. And this ancient 9th-century church remains what it always was: a light in the darkness and a wellspring of knowledge for all who learn to see with the eyes of the spirit.

![DSCN0131.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoiYgJfio5jxsLfgQDoJHfbCH9JfHBqPh3S8EFsmChhMFbjEb7xBgxjxWQSH98SRKPn.JPG)

El tiempo pasa, con su inexorable transcurrir, pero cuando la tienes enfrente, parece que los siglos apenas resbalan por su ancestral arquitectura. La iglesia de Santa María de Lebeña, tan eterna, en apariencia, como esos Picos de Europa que la guardan con el fraternal cariño de una vieja nodriza, custodian también sus milenarios secretos.

![DSCN0132.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EnYTJ5DB5X7gxEf7gxQ1bmq5ZbefXqqjyDD4i3e2b8n5Ef1GMYHtkzSESPxzhgr18nU.JPG)

El valle que la cobija, pasada la parte más desgarradora del desfiladero de La Hermida, cuyo talón de Aquiles son las aguas del río Deva en su alegre descenso hasta el mar Cantábrico, es tan fértil como el pecho que ofrece a la hambrienta boca del Niño la venerada imagen de la Virgen titular.

![DSCN0136.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpvmidGjdsfLxRoJQzEAvwr6iiBL7Anuu3H5e6chSVz84D8edgoX23ggpApsXVqePLv.JPG)

Estamos frente a uno de los santuarios más antiguos y significativos de uno de los caminos de peregrinación más duros de España: el Camino Lebanensis o Camino de la Liébana. Y esta arcana iglesia del siglo IX, continúa siendo la que siempre fue: una luz en las tinieblas y un pozo de conocimiento para todo aquel que aprenda a mirar con los ojos del espíritu.

![DSCN0138.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqL8hZAjSFcypny9KsZnZQPpp3cMnMMnqVuWH7DNhwDg44KkGskx1FyMiNfGBeL8kk2.JPG)

body.body:
Hello! Hope you all are doing well. Today I'm going to tell something about earning in student life for the students of a middle class and poor family. In Bangladesh there are million of students. Most of the students are belonging in middle class or poor family. So their parents have to spend a handsome amount for their education comparetively to their income.

 For this most of the gurdians sacrifice their personal happiness for their children’s future. So it is also a duty to the students to support their family when they become adult. If a student want he can support his family in many ways. At least if he manage his educational cost from starting graduation period it will be a good support for his family. In our country a lot if students of school and college are depend on private tutor for getting a good result.  A student of graduation can teach them and earn money. In our country in city areas students depend on private tution for earning. Few of them do part-time jobs. 

But private tution is better tgan part-time job because by teaching a student can revise maths and other subjects which are important for competitive exams of private and government jobs. Private tution helps specially the students of science. Every year lacs of students are completing graduation and the ratio of jobless is increasing. To become ahed of this competitive world every students ave to learn computer also. For this they should admit in computer course and they can do any part-time job for sharpening his skill and earning too.

 During graduation it is also a shameful for a student to take pocket money from their family. So it is very important to do something besides study. It not only helos for earning but also prepare them for getting a goid job.
