body.body: As every Monday, it's time for [**Weekly Street Art**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), your weekly dose of StreetArt. And this week, it really is Monday. Everything's sorted at work, back to \

The [**Mural Festival**](https://muralfestival.com) kicked off last Friday (June 5th) on Saint-Laurent Boulevard in Montreal. It's always cool to see the artists in action on the various walls featured this year. Although the weekend was rainy, luckily for them, Monday brought bright sunshine and pleasant temperatures.\n\n> *Comme chaque lundi, voici venir le temps du [**Weekly StreetArt**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), votre dose de StreetArt hebdomadaire. Et cette semaine, nous sommes vraiment lundi. Tout s'est arrangé au travail, de retour en mode \

. Le [**Mural Festival**](https://muralfestival.com) a débuté vendredi dernier (le 5 juin) sur le boulevard Saint-Laurent. C'est toujours cool de voir les artistes en action sur les différents murs présentés cette année. Bien que le weekend a été pluvieux, heureusement pour eux gros soleil ce lundi avec des températures bien agréables.*

![River June ?](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23uQpMjv6iCXpbRmJEWH1QDA8pmekajtvWTybczA292cxiW5533EbEbGY1pEgzYK9Netj.jpg)

I don't know who the artist is who painted this bird, but the style is very similar to that of [**River June**](https://www.instagram.com/riverjune/). This crane stands out beautifully against the sun breaking through the clouds. Great work, much better than a gray concrete wall.

> *Pour illustrer ce **Weekly StreetArt**, je vous présente une murale découverte ce printemps dans les ruelles du Plateau à Montréal. Je ne sais pas qui est l'artiste qui a peint cet oiseau mais le style se rapproche beaucoup de celui de [**River June**](https://www.instagram.com/riverjune/). Cette grue ressort très bien sous ce soleil sortant des nuages. Beau travail, largement mieux qu'un mur gris en béton.*

body.title: ✏️🌸 A Pencil Drawing Inspired by Imagination and Beauty 🌸✏️/ ✏️🌸 Un Dibujo a Lápiz Inspirado en la Imaginación y la Belleza 🌸✏️
body.body: > Hello, dear Sketchbook community! 🎨✨ Today I want to share one of my latest pencil drawings, a character portrait that I created with great dedication and enthusiasm. 🖌️💖 This artwork was made entirely with graphite pencil on paper, focusing on facial proportions, expressive eyes, and hair texture. ✍️📄 What inspired me to create this drawing was the beauty of anime-style illustrations and the way they can convey emotions through simple yet powerful details. 🌷🌟 I wanted to capture a calm and thoughtful expression, creating a character that feels both gentle and full of personality. 💫😊
>
>\n\n
>\n\n

> While working on this piece, I paid special attention to several artistic elements. 🎨🖋️ The eyes were designed as the focal point of the composition, using clean contour lines and subtle detailing to enhance expression. 👀✨ The hairstyle was developed through multiple directional strokes, helping to create volume, movement, and visual balance. 💇‍♀️🌬️ I also used light hatching techniques in selected areas of the neck and hair to suggest depth and contrast without overwhelming the simplicity of the sketch. 📚✏️ These shading techniques help define form while maintaining the delicate appearance of the drawing. 🌿🖤 One of my favorite parts was working on the facial structure, trying to achieve harmony between the proportions of the eyes, nose, mouth, and jawline. 📐🎭 Every small line contributes to the overall character and mood of the piece. Drawing is a wonderful way to express creativity and relax the mind. 💕✨ Every sketch teaches me something new and motivates me to continue improving my artistic skills. 🚀🎨 Thank you very much for visiting my post and taking the time to look at my artwork. 🤗💖 I hope you enjoy this drawing as much as I enjoyed creating it. 🌹✨ Have a beautiful day, and see you in my next sketch! 🌸✏️🎨 * * *

> ¡Hola, querida comunidad de Sketchbook! 🎨✨ Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes uno de mis dibujos más recientes realizado completamente a lápiz. ✍️📄💖 Es un retrato estilo anime que elaboré con mucha dedicación, paciencia y entusiasmo. 🌷🌟 La inspiración para esta obra nació de mi admiración por las ilustraciones de estilo anime y la capacidad que tienen para transmitir emociones mediante detalles sencillos pero muy expresivos. 💫😊 Quise representar a una joven con una expresión tranquila y reflexiva, creando un personaje que transmitiera dulzura y personalidad. 🌸💕
>\n\n
>\n\n
>\n\n

> Durante el proceso de dibujo presté especial atención a varios aspectos técnicos y artísticos. 🎨🖋️ Los ojos fueron concebidos como el punto focal de la composición, utilizando líneas limpias y detalles sutiles para reforzar la expresividad del personaje. 👀✨ El cabello fue desarrollado mediante múltiples trazos direccionales, una técnica que ayuda a generar sensación de volumen, movimiento y equilibrio visual. 💇‍♀️🌬️ Asimismo, incorporé ligeros sombreados mediante hachurado en algunas zonas del cuello y el cabello para aportar profundidad y contraste sin perder la delicadeza característica del boceto. ✏️🖤📚 Uno de los aspectos que más disfruté fue trabajar la estructura facial, buscando armonía entre las proporciones de los ojos, la nariz, la boca y la línea de la mandíbula. 📐🎭 Cada detalle aporta identidad y carácter al dibujo final. Para mí, dibujar es una forma maravillosa de expresar creatividad, desarrollar habilidades artísticas y encontrar momentos de tranquilidad. 💖✨ Cada nuevo boceto representa una oportunidad para aprender y seguir creciendo como artista. 🚀🎨 Muchas gracias por visitar mi publicación y dedicar unos minutos a observar mi trabajo. 🤗🌹 Espero que disfruten este dibujo tanto como yo disfruté crearlo. ✨💕 ¡Les deseo un excelente día y nos vemos en mi próximo dibujo! 🌸✏️🎨💫

body.title: More Jobs means higher rates
body.body:
On Friday, the market bled. And no, it didn't fall because something went wrong. It fell because something went... too right.

Yes, you read that correctly.

The U.S. economy created 172,000 new jobs in May, while analysts had expected just 80,000. More than double the forecast. And instead of celebrating, Wall Street sent the Nasdaq down more than 4% in a single day, marking its biggest decline since April 2025.

THE U.S. LABOR MARKET

Let's start with the numbers, because that's where the whole story lies.

The U.S. economy added 172,000 jobs in May, while analysts had expected only 80,000. In other words, the figure came in at more than twice expectations.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhNndcC1p69UronkBYKALerkhEs7yo4wfmnBTZCuLRS1/img_8113.png)

And here's something important: it didn't just beat estimates. It beat every single analyst estimate. Not one forecast came close to this number.

On top of that, April's job growth was revised higher to 179,000 jobs, meaning the labor market looks even stronger than previously thought.

The unemployment rate remained steady at 4.3%, exactly where economists expected it to be.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTt9Eb1H3TKztgpV5qQrd43re4p6uDtB22qFQPatw45Lp/img_8114.png)

So where did all these jobs come from?

Mostly from the leisure and hospitality sector, which added 70,000 jobs alone. That's a huge figure, far above the average monthly gain of roughly 14,000 over the past year.

Some believe employers may already be ramping up hiring ahead of the upcoming World Cup.

Another important detail: wage growth slowed to 3.4%.

In other words, employment remains strong, but wages are not accelerating out of control. In theory, that reduces concerns about a wage-price spiral.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXaZD6uBvhntbrYg7Yqhppxz3gpRUC1af5Z7PyLNKXKTk/img_8115.png)

WHY WALL STREET FELL

This is where things get even more interesting.

Normally, such a strong jobs report should be good news. A strong economy means strong companies, which should mean strong earnings.

Right?

Not exactly.

Markets don't just price in how well the economy is performing. They also price in what the Federal Reserve is likely to do next.

When a jobs report comes in this strong, the Fed loses one of its key reasons to cut interest rates. In fact, investors begin talking once again about the possibility of rate hikes.

The result?

Bond yields surged.

And when yields rise, technology stocks tend to fall because their valuations are heavily dependent on future earnings. The higher interest rates go, the less those future profits are worth in today's dollars.

The Nasdaq closed at 25,709 points, down 4.18%, marking its largest one-day drop since April 2025.

Meanwhile, the S&P 500 fell 2.6%.

THE FED'S DILEMMA

Now we arrive at the big question:

What will the Federal Reserve do next?

Not long ago, markets were pricing in interest rate cuts.

After the latest inflation data and this jobs report, markets are now increasingly pricing in the possibility that the Fed's next move could actually be a rate hike.

Yes, a hike.

Not a cut.

\

you might ask.

At the Fed's next policy meeting.

Until then, every economic report, every speech from a Fed official, and every inflation release will have the potential to trigger significant market swings.

body.title: 🚀 ЄС відкрив набір на повністю безкоштовну магістратуру та ІТ-курси для українців — дедлайн уже 20 червня!
body.body: Ініціатива **Digital4Business**, що фінансується Європейським Союзом, відкрила прийом заявок на повністю безкоштовні ІТ-програми європейського рівня. Навчання доступне для українців, які зараз проживають в Ірландії, чи в будь-якій іншій країні ЄС.\n\n
alt=\

/>

Це чудова можливість безкоштовно отримати кваліфікацію міжнародного зразка - як для зміни професії, так і для підвищення поточної кваліфікації.

1.  **Повністю фінансувана магістратура (Master’s Degree)**
    

Є можливість вступити на денну форму магістерської програми з передових цифрових технологій для бізнесу (Advanced Digital Technologies for Business, 60 ECTS).

Формат: 100% онлайн протягом двох семестрів (вересень 2026 — травень 2027).

Хто викладає: Чотири провідні університети ЄС, зокрема Національний коледж Ірландії (National College of Ireland).

Дедлайн: Подача заявок триває до 20 червня 2026 року. Кількість місць обмежена, тому реєстрацію можуть закрити раніше у разі заповнення груп.

2.  **Безкоштовні короткі ІТ-курси (Мікрокваліфікації)**
    

Для тих, хто не має змоги навчатися на повноцінній магістратурі, передбачені короткі сертифіковані ІТ-модулі. Вони також триватимуть із вересня 2026 по травень 2027 року, є повністю безкоштовними та адаптованими для поєднання з роботою чи іншими зобов'язаннями.

3.  **Місця та стипендіальні програми**
    

Проєкт пропонує 400 безкоштовних місць на магістратуру та короткі курси. Окремо виділено 100 додаткових стипендіальних місць для людей із вразливих або недостатньо представлених категорій.

**🔗 Офіційні посилання для реєстрації та ознайомлення:**

Організатори створили окремий ресурс із детальною інформацією для української спільноти, а також прямі посилання на реєстраційні форми:

Головна інформаційна сторінка для українців: [digital4business.eu/...online-this-september](http://digital4business.eu/...online-this-september) ([https://digital4business.eu/study-advanced-digital-business-skills-online-this-september/)/](https://digital4business.eu/study-advanced-digital-business-skills-online-this-september/\)/)

Пряма подача на магістратуру: [digital4business.eu/...fully-funded-digital4business-masters](http://digital4business.eu/...fully-funded-digital4business-masters) ([https://digital4business.eu/applications-open-fully-funded-digital4business-masters/)/](https://digital4business.eu/applications-open-fully-funded-digital4business-masters/\)/)

Портал стипендій: [digital4business.eu/digital4business-scholarships](http://digital4business.eu/digital4business-scholarships) ([https://digital4business.eu/digital4business-scholarships/)/](https://digital4business.eu/digital4business-scholarships/\)/)

Короткі курси (Мікрокваліфікації): [digital4business.eu/our-programme/micro-credentials](http://digital4business.eu/our-programme/micro-credentials) ([https://digital4business.eu/our-programme/micro-credentials/)/](https://digital4business.eu/our-programme/micro-credentials/\)/)

🕊 Дякуємо Skillnet Ireland, National College of Ireland та консорціуму ЄС за інвестиції в освітній розвиток нашої спільноти.

Будь ласка, поширте цю інформацію серед колег та знайомих, кому це може бути актуально.

**Дедлайн - 20 червня.**

body.title: Rafael Leão to Chelsea? I'm Not Sure How to Feel About This One
body.body:
‎I came across a report recently claiming that Chelsea have submitted a €60 million bid for AC Milan winger Rafael Leão, and my reaction was mixed.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS1YPvnam2fF8FAWvTrcHfowvgr6Mhb7ntfDyEtoaGQNK/milan-italy-rafael-leao-of-ac-milan-celebrates-with-teammates-after-scoring-his-teams-second.jpg 

‎[Source](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/rafael-leao?family=editorial&page=2)
‎
‎Normally, when Chelsea are linked with a talented player, I get excited straight away. But this one is different. While I can clearly see what Leão would bring to the team, I also have a few concerns that make me hesitate.
‎
‎First of all, nobody can question his talent. Leão is one of those players that can make something happen out of nowhere. Give him a little space and he can drive past defenders, create chances, or score a goal that changes the entire game. His pace is frightening and he always looks confident when running at opponents.
‎
‎Looking at his numbers this season, 10 goals and 3 assists in 31 appearances may not be mind-blowing. Anyone who watches him regularly knows he is the kind of player defenders hate facing. He brings excitement whenever he gets on the ball.
‎
‎The part that worries me isn't his ability. It's his discipline.
‎
‎I have watched a few games where he allowed frustration to get the better of him. Sometimes he picks up unnecessary bookings, and that's something Chelsea really don't need. A red card at the wrong moment can completely change a match and put extra pressure on the rest of the team.
‎
‎Maybe I'm overthinking it, but consistency and discipline are important if Chelsea want to challenge for major trophies again. Having talented players is great, but having players you can rely on every week is even more important.
‎
‎That said, footballers can grow and improve. A new league, a new manager, and a fresh challenge could bring out the best version of Leão. We have seen players mature significantly after changing clubs, so it's possible he could do the same too.
‎
‎For now, though, I'm trying not to get carried away. Transfer rumors appear every day, and not all of them become reality. Until I see him holding a Chelsea shirt and standing in front of the club badge, I'll remain cautious.
‎
‎If the deal does happen, I'll definitely support him and hope he succeeds. The talent is there for everyone to see. My only hope is that, if he arrives, he brings the best parts of his game and leaves the unnecessary discipline issues behind.
‎
‎What do you think? Would Rafael Leão be a good signing for Chelsea, or should the club focus on other targets this summer?

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/rafael-leo-to-chelsea-im-not-sure-how-to-feel-about-this-one-13d)

**M**y mother has a friend named \

who is a contemporary of hers (around 80 years old) and has been her friend for as long as I can remember. But Antonio is no ordinary guy. (as my sisters affectionately call him) is the kind of polymath you rarely encounter in person in a lifetime. But the story here is rather anecdotal, as the title of this publication traces back to a time, several years ago now, when I was chatting with Antonio at my mother's house and he said to me regarding my photographs: **\
** And, man, to be honest, I was left speechless for a moment, thinking: \

body.title: Hokum (2026) - Honeymoon Suite Dark Secret - REVIEW
body.body:
https://zr.ai15.me/images/2026/06/08/Hokum-2026--REVIEW-000.gif

[Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

I remember reading a post about Hokum last year and people were going wild for this one with Damian McCarthy directing after hits like Caveat and Oddity, love those too. I was already paying attention to it specially when they trow Adam Scoot into it, but not everything is pink and rainbows on this story, its not bad but its not an 8/10, it drags a lot and the witch didnt generate enough chaos, it was more like a executioner instead of the one harrasing characters. McCarthy has been quietly building this reputation as one of the most interesting directors in Irish horror and Hokum feels like the moment where everything he has been practicing with his smaller work finally clicks into something really sharp and confident. You are immediately dropped into the life of Ohm Bauman, this American novelist played by Scott, who is just about the most unpleasant man you could imagine sharing a hotel lobby with, I hated the guy the moment he start opening his mouth and I mean that as a real compliment to both the writing and the performance. He shows up at this small hotel tucked away somewhere in Ireland, to scatter the ashes of his dead parents near a massive redwood tree in the surrounding woods and from the literal second he steps through the front door he treats every single person around him like they are furniture and like everyone owes him. He will not sign a book for the guy checking him in, he looks over the shoulder at the staff, he drinks heavily and the guy is cold AF when a bellboy named Alby excitedly asks him to look at his manuscript, Ohm heats up a spoon over a candle and burns the poor guy on the hand just to get him to leave. That tells you everything you need to know about who this person is in about 15 minutes flat into the story and the movie earns enormous credit for making you sit with someone this toxic without ever walking away from it, honestly even during the moments it drag I never felt like fast forward or looking at something else, reason why I think its not so bad.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt35672862/
- Platform: [PRIME VIDEO](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp)

https://i.ibb.co/spfsksDW/3e19ff01f168.png
<div style=\
align=\

>Rottentomatoes Rating https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.ibb.co/ZRqyWCkH/e3a3df77486c.png [Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp) McCarthy is great at is building dread through very specific physical details and practical problem solving and Hokum is probably the cleanest version of that skill he has shown so far. The whole story at the Bilberry Woods Hotel is so well constructed, you have got the wheelchair bound owner Cob who casually mentions he once trapped a witch inside the locked honeymoon suite upstairs, you have got Fergal who is weird and suspicious, and then there is Mal, the front desk clerk who also happens to be Cob son in law so from the start the entire hotel is fishy, also Mal carries this nervous energy. There is also this guy Jerry, living out of a van in the woods and drinking goat milk mix with mushrooms that gets him high as kite wanting to look at his own reflection, but still seems like the only person Ohm treats with a little bit of respect, he is just totally different with this guy than the rest of the guys at the hotel and then the bartender Fiona, who ends up being the moral center of the whole thing because she is the one who actually saves Ohm when things get really dark. When Fiona goes missing around a Halloween party, Ohm feels responsible in a way that clearly cuts through all of this armor he is suppose to wear as protection against the world because thats how I see him, he is hurting and he just push people away to sink into his guilt and watching Adam Scott carry that guilt while also staying completely in character as this prick difficult man is some of the best work he has done. He never softens Ohm into someone easier to root for and yet somehow you are rooting for him anyway, which is not easy to pull off and I think people are going to underrate how good he is in this thing. The honeymoon suite itself is pretty good for a horror location although once he hits te bed everything changes it just becomes another room, rotting and untouched and absolutely disgusting in every corner, the sequence involving a small elevator hidden in the wall, a clock with a mechanical boy swinging a golf club and a very dark basement below is the kind of stuff that makes you lean forward because the movie creates a lot of tension by trying to manage time, the time it took the golf club boy to hit the button. https://i.ibb.co/Gf6WM8P5/4b244ec8a304.png [Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp) https://i.ibb.co/bRXBP8fq/98970ee3c487.png [Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp) Now we come to the more realisc part of this blog post because the movie is not perfect and the section right in the middle where Ohm is recovering in the hospital after his lowest point drags hard and takes a lot from how this story started, this moment came out of no where, he decides to take his own life without much explanation, yes the movie shows he is hurting for his mother but at this point the movie has not reveal he was the one who accidentally shot his mom. The subplot involving Jerry and his backstory also gets a little confusing when the movie is trying to juggle it alongside everything else happening at the hotel, because there are a few situations where I lost the thread of what the movie wanted me to feel about him versus what I was actually feeling. The pacing in that part of the movie feels all over the place, like McCarthy knew exactly where he needed the story to go but was not quite sure how long to let certain scenes breathe before getting there, and for a movie that is this tight and controlled, those moments stand out more than they probably would in a messier movie, I mean this movie was very messy in that sense, where we dont know why Ohm hang himself, then was his mother trying to torment him or help him? its like all this questions are getting answer towards the end but at the same time during this moments turn the movie very confusing. The dream sequences involving Ohm traumatic childhood are doing a lot of heavy lifting in terms of explaining who he is and why he is so damaged, and while they are unsettling, especially the part involving this nightmare childrens television character named Jack the Jackass who looks like a very bizzar version of Bugs Bunny, I think one or two of those sequences could have been trimmed and the movie would still stand the same, I really though they were going to give more screen time to Jack considering it was shown through the trailers. The entire time felt like the movie was clearly holding something back for reasons that feel more structural than dramatic, like you can sense the chess pieces being moved rather than just watching things happen, but these are complaints I am making about a movie I enjoy, so take them for what they are worth, if you have gotten to this point you might be asking if I like the movie at all? the answer is yes. https://i.ibb.co/h1Xtj3Yn/1a9fa5d84844.png [Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp) https://i.ibb.co/Ld37L8SY/d258b13f23e4.png [Source](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/0IAE9AQALZXSRPBFEUP21R8H28/ref=atv_dp) Hokum really remind me of previous movies I have seen from McCarthy, for example Caveat which was an extremely contained physical space and he use it to generate almost unbearable tension through mechanical logic rather than cheap audio tricks. McCarthy is not interested in making you jump by throwing a loud noise at you, I think on Hokum this is very clear during the honeymoon room shots with Ohm, he is interested in making you sweat because you understand exactly how the trap works and you can see every possible way it could go wrong and the elevator sequence is the clearest expression of that. The clock trick, the chalk circle, the sound design as the witch moves through the dark clanking those shackles, all of it is constructed with this almost puzzle like precision that makes the horror feel earned building the atmosphere, its the classic saying of \

. Compared to Oddity, which I thought had tremendous atmosphere but sometimes let its interesting ideas run a little longer than they needed to not knowing when it was just enough and even felt like going in circles. Hokum is more disciplined and more satisfying as a complete experience if you put the dots together from start to finish, it feels like he learned the right lessons from that movie and applied them here. My biggest complain about the movie is the witch backstory where there is close to none, very little context to the witch story, but I wonder if there is a deeper meaning to it like on other movies, a clear example is Smile where the demon is menthal illness specifically the way Ohm relationship with his own guilt and the ghost of what happened with his parents keeps comming up with those disturbing visions, gives the movie a weight that feels satisfying but you have to think a bit much about it for it to work. That combination of craft and actual feeling is rare and I do not think enough people are going to give this one the credit it deserves.\nhttps://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png\n<div align=\

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png At the end of it all Hokum is exactly the kind of movie I get excited about but in this case I would preffer Oddity (2024) over Hokum (2026), because it is doing something specific and doing it with real confidence and craft rather than just hoping atmosphere alone is going to carry it across the finish line, its that seperation of horror and fantasy, Ohm is the pefect character because I bet he doesnt have a relegion and only believes in men who created the world. Adam Scott is flat out fantastic in a role that asks him to be deeply unlikable for the most part of the movie while still keeping you rooting for him to stay alive and the way the movie closes out his story, with that image of Ohm finally rewriting the ending of his novel about a conquistador and a boy in the desert, changing the cycle of violence into something else entirely, felt like he was finally in peace with himself. You get the bruises on Ohm wrists from the shackles suggesting that whatever happened down in that basement had some kind of physical reality to it, even after the mushroom revelation throws everything into question, was all that real? and I love that the movie throws you into that ambiguity rather than tying it up with a neat explanation. That is the thing about McCarthy's movies, he does not feel the need to explain himself and in a genre where everything tends to get over explained and over justified. I dont find Hokum is his best work so far, a tight, creepy, emotionally piece of horror, I'm giving this movie a 6.5/10 that culd be a 7.5 for many but considering I like more Oddity and gave that a 7, comming from the same director I just can't give Hokum a higher score, I really recommend it if you are into this type of horror movies with some meaning working in the back. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.imgur.com/AbuDA6i.png

body.title: Avoiding Common Relapse Triggers
body.body:
Relapse is not a single moment but a gradual process influenced by emotional, psychological, environmental, and physical factors. Understanding these triggers and developing structured coping mechanisms can significantly reduce the likelihood of returning to substance use. Recovery is less about perfection and more about preparedness—anticipating risks and responding effectively when they arise.

## Understanding Relapse and Its Stages

Relapse typically unfolds in stages rather than occurring suddenly. Emotional relapse involves neglecting self-care and bottling up emotions. Mental relapse introduces internal conflict, where thoughts of past substance use begin to reappear. Physical relapse occurs when use resumes.

Recognizing these stages early allows individuals to intervene before behavior escalates. Many recovery specialists emphasize that awareness is one of the strongest protective tools in long-term sobriety.

## Emotional and Psychological Triggers

Emotional triggers are among the most powerful drivers of relapse. Stress, unresolved grief, anxiety, and depression can create internal pressure that individuals may attempt to escape through substance use. These feelings often build gradually, making them harder to detect.

Trauma-related triggers can also resurface unexpectedly. Certain sounds, environments, or conversations may evoke emotional flashbacks tied to past substance use or difficult experiences. Developing emotional regulation skills—such as mindfulness, journaling, or cognitive behavioral techniques—can help reduce vulnerability.

### Stress, anxiety, and depression

Chronic stress alters brain chemistry and decision-making, increasing impulsivity. Anxiety can create a sense of urgency for relief, while depression often reduces motivation to maintain healthy habits. Together, they form a cycle that can heighten relapse risk if left unmanaged.

## Environmental and Social Triggers

External environments play a major role in shaping behavior. Returning to places associated with past substance use or spending time with individuals who still use substances can increase cravings significantly. Even familiar routines—such as driving a certain route or visiting specific social settings—can act as unconscious cues.

Social pressure is another critical factor. In early recovery, boundaries are essential, especially when relationships are tied to substance use history. Rebuilding a social network that supports sobriety is often a turning point in sustained recovery.

## Physical Triggers and Cravings

Physical conditions such as fatigue, hunger, and illness can weaken self-control. When the body is stressed, the brain becomes more reactive to cravings. Sleep deprivation in particular has been linked to reduced emotional regulation and decision-making capacity.

Hydration, nutrition, and rest are often underestimated in relapse prevention. Maintaining physical stability creates a foundation that supports emotional and cognitive resilience.

## Building a Relapse Prevention Plan

A relapse prevention plan is a structured approach to identifying triggers and preparing responses in advance. It typically includes coping strategies, emergency contacts, and lifestyle adjustments.

A well-designed plan should also account for practical concerns like healthcare access and treatment coverage. For individuals navigating recovery systems, questions such as [does blue cross blue shield cover alcohol detox in nj](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/does-blue-cross-blue-shield-cover-alcohol-detox-in-nj/) often arise when planning medical detox or rehabilitation services. Understanding insurance coverage can reduce delays in receiving care and ensure timely intervention when risk levels increase.

Consistency is key. The most effective plans are not static documents but evolving frameworks that adapt as recovery progresses.

## Support Systems and Professional Help

Recovery is rarely sustained in isolation. Support systems—whether friends, family, counselors, or peer groups—provide accountability and emotional reinforcement. Regular participation in therapy or recovery meetings can help individuals process emotions before they escalate into cravings.

Professional treatment also plays a critical role in relapse prevention, especially for those with co-occurring mental health conditions. Structured programs offer tools for managing triggers, developing coping skills, and building long-term stability.

In addition to emotional support, harm-reduction education is sometimes included in recovery discussions. For instance, medical professionals may clarify misconceptions such as [does narcan work on cocaine](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/does-narcan-work-on-cocaine/), helping individuals understand the specific use cases and limitations of emergency overdose interventions. This kind of knowledge can prevent confusion in high-stress situations and improve safety awareness.

## Managing High-Risk Situations

High-risk situations often arise unexpectedly and require quick decision-making. Events such as weddings, parties, or stressful life changes can reintroduce exposure to substances or emotional overwhelm.

Preparation is essential. This may include having an exit plan, bringing a supportive companion, or practicing refusal skills in advance. Individuals in recovery often benefit from rehearsing responses to peer pressure, reducing the likelihood of impulsive decisions.

Travel can also be a trigger due to disrupted routines and increased stress. Maintaining structure—such as sleep schedules and daily check-ins—can provide stability during uncertain environments.

## Long-Term Recovery Maintenance Strategies

Long-term recovery depends on lifestyle integration rather than short-term abstinence alone. Building a meaningful routine that includes work, hobbies, exercise, and social connection helps replace old behavioral patterns.

Identity reconstruction is another key component. Individuals often benefit from redefining themselves beyond addiction, focusing on values, goals, and personal growth. This shift strengthens motivation and reduces the psychological pull toward old habits.

Consistency in self-reflection is also important. Regularly evaluating emotional state, stress levels, and environmental risks helps maintain awareness and prevents complacency.

## External Reference on Relapse Prevention

Evidence-based recovery frameworks, such as those supported by global health organizations, emphasize a combination of behavioral therapy, medical support, and community-based care. The [World Health Organization](https://www.who.int/health-topics/drugs-psychoactive) provides guidance on substance use disorders, highlighting relapse prevention as a long-term, multi-factor process that requires coordinated support systems, structured treatment, and ongoing monitoring. Their research underscores that recovery outcomes improve significantly when individuals have access to integrated care rather than isolated interventions.

Relapse prevention is ultimately about preparation, awareness, and support. While triggers cannot always be avoided, their impact can be significantly reduced through structured planning, education, and consistent self-care practices.

> Frente al monitor, el software deja de ser software; se convierte en el taller de un artesano. Cada herramienta es una pieza distinta: el corte preciso, el filtro que despierta, el efecto que altera la percepción. Al principio, todo parece disperso. Son fragmentos independientes, huérfanos que esperan una conexión. Sin embargo, llega un momento en que algo cambia. La mente, siempre poderosa, encuentra la combinación entre una imagen, un video y el acorde exacto de una pista de audio. Entonces despierta una fuerza descomunal difícil de describir. El mosaico comienza a tomar forma. Lo que antes eran piezas aisladas empieza a revelar una estructura, un ritmo y una emoción. Es allí cuando se comprende que editar no consiste en rellenar espacios vacíos ni en aplicar efectos porque sí. La edición es un proceso creativo donde la técnica se pone al servicio de una idea. Las herramientas siguen siendo importantes, pero dejan de ocupar el centro de la escena. Lo esencial es la historia que empieza a emerger entre cortes, silencios, transiciones y detalles casi imperceptibles. Cada decisión modifica el resultado final. Un segundo más o un segundo menos puede cambiar la intensidad de una escena. Una pausa puede decir más que un diálogo completo. Un sonido colocado en el instante correcto puede transformar una imagen común en un recuerdo imborrable. Quizás por eso editar tiene algo de magia. No porque exista un truco oculto, sino porque permite convertir elementos separados en una experiencia significativa. Como una tesela dentro de un mosaico, cada fragmento parece insignificante, pero al unirse revela una imagen que acaricia la vista. Y cuando la última pieza encuentra su lugar, descubres que no estabas ensamblando clips o sonidos. Estabas construyendo una historia; un mosaico. Esto también se aplica en las palabras cuando escribimos un relato, una historia. Hasta aquí mis cinco minutos.

> In front of the monitor, software ceases to be software; it becomes an artisan’s workshop. Each tool is a distinct piece: the precise cut, the awakening filter, the effect that alters perception. At first, everything seems scattered. They are independent fragments, orphans waiting for a connection. However, a moment comes when something changes. The mind, ever powerful, finds the combination between an image, a video, and the exact chord of an audio track. Then, a colossal force, difficult to describe, awakens. The mosaic begins to take shape. What were once isolated pieces start to reveal a structure, a rhythm, and an emotion. It is then that one understands that editing is not about filling empty spaces or applying effects just because. Editing is a creative process where technique serves an idea. The tools remain important, but they no longer occupy the center stage. What is essential is the story that begins to emerge between cuts, silences, transitions, and almost imperceptible details. Every decision modifies the final result. A second more or a second less can change the intensity of a scene. A pause can say more than an entire dialogue. A sound placed at the exact right instant can transform an ordinary image into an unforgettable memory. Perhaps that is why editing has a touch of magic. Not because a hidden trick exists, but because it allows separate elements to turn into a meaningful experience. Like a tessera within a mosaic, each fragment seems insignificant, but when joined, it reveals an image that pleases the eye. And when the last piece finds its place, you discover you were not assembling clips or sounds. You were building a story, a mosaic. This also applies to words when we write a tale, a story. That’s it for my five minutes.

body.title: Small Machines from Orle Shelter / Małe maszyny spod Schroniska Orle [EN/PL]
body.body:
## [EN] 
## Small Tracked Machines Near Orle Shelter

While visiting the Orle mountain shelter in the Izera Mountains, I noticed a few small tracked vehicles parked near the buildings.
<center>
[Ink and watercolor] ![1000006796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/planet-rium/1000006796.jpg)
</center>
I have always liked machines with a clearly practical purpose. These immediately caught my attention. They looked slightly military, slightly industrial, yet somehow perfectly suited to the mountain surroundings.

<center>![1000006797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/planet-rium/1000006797.jpg)
</center>

What interested me most was their scale. They are not large machines, but they look capable of handling difficult terrain with ease. Simple shapes, tracks, cables and mechanical details translate very well into drawing, and that is what I wanted to capture.

<center> 
![1000006795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/planet-rium/1000006795.jpg)
</center>

These illustrations were made with ink and watercolor in a simple, slightly comic-inspired style.

---

## [PL] Małe maszyny 

Podczas wizyty w schronisku Orle w Górach Izerskich zwróciłam uwagę na kilka niewielkich pojazdów gąsienicowych stojących obok budynków.

Zawsze lubiłam maszyny o wyraźnie użytkowym charakterze. Te szczególnie przyciągnęły moją uwagę — trochę wojskowe w wyglądzie, trochę przemysłowe, a jednocześnie całkiem naturalnie wpisane w górski krajobraz.

Najbardziej zainteresowała mnie ich skala. Nie są duże, ale sprawiają wrażenie maszyn, które potrafią poradzić sobie w trudnym terenie. Proste bryły, gąsienice, przewody i mechaniczne detale dobrze przekładają się na rysunek i właśnie to chciałam uchwycić.

Prace wykonałam tuszem i akwarelą, zachowując prosty, lekko komiksowy sposób przedstawienia form.

---

<center>![podpis planeta-1.jpg](https://ipfs.busy.org/ipfs/QmYHYcxghAsqge6q3fnnBkfQUxhCzpKiU1LQBCWAH2Hr9Q)</center>

body.title: Can Failure Be the Best Teacher?
body.body: Assalam-o-Alaikum, friends! Today we're going to talk about a topic that many people view negatively: failure.\n\n
alt=\

/>

Source pixabay.com

Most people fear failure and see it as their weakness. But if you look at it more deeply, failure can become the greatest teacher in our lives.  
When we succeed in something, we often just enjoy the result. But when we fail, we learn about our mistakes.

We understand where we fell short and how we can do better next time. That's why failure gives us the opportunity to learn.

Friends, you've probably noticed that in history many successful people went through multiple failures before reaching their goals. If they had given up after the first or second setback, the world might not remember them today. The secret of their success was that they made failure their teacher, not their enemy.

Friends, failure also builds in a person the resilience to face any setbacks in the future with ease, so that they won't be overwhelmed or discouraged.

In my opinion, it's not really a failure to fail at something; the real failure is losing heart and giving up on doing the work altogether.

In the end, all I can say is that we shouldn't be afraid of it; instead, we should face it so that we can successfully achieve our goals. If, by any chance, we fail for any reason, we should keep trying again and again instead of giving up, and we will surely succeed.

body.title: Murder is not only of bodies, it is also of emotions
body.body:
<center>

*`Murder is not only of bodies, it is also of emotions`* `


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTqLdjJ6svwm93gaLe1zoMkQWmHLe4bHjZy7bPNiaHHdC/1780942704061.jpg)

*There are many sacrifices within the four walls of the house that no one can see. Carrying out household responsibilities from morning to evening, washing clothes, cleaning dishes, tidying up the house and then standing in the kitchen despite being tired* *and preparing food with love for your loved ones, all these are not just work, they are ways of expressing love*.
*Especially when a daughter-in-law or any member of the family makes something with full dedication, sincerity and passion and has a desire in his heart that today his hard work will be appreciated, his passion will be valued, then he waits for a few words of praise*.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9SRFQGcwfUexeuNikgLL346mAWSZE9HoFqDbWFYBH12/1780942704128.jpg)

*But when the only criticism he gets in response;* 
\

** 
*So perhaps the speaker does not know that he is not just commenting on the food, but is wounding someone's passion, hard work and sincerity* .
*Make corrections, but do not close the doors of praise. Because where motivation ends, passion dies, love weakens and hearts learn to be silent* .
*Remember, sometimes two words of praise can do what no great blessing in the world can do, and sometimes unjustified criticism buries all the beautiful feelings inside someone* .
*Before finding a deficiency in someone's hard work, be sure to see their sincerity; because killing emotions also hurts, only its wounds are not visible.*

</center>

body.body:
Hello #shadowhunters friends, I welcome you to a new week. It is a new week of creativity with our phones, looking for amazing shadows, and engaging others through our write-up.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYQiFF8Cw5zFE81kxBpsvaW4n9VRYTNiLsoZdN1aAMS9n/image.png)

I intentionally went for my weekly shadow hunting hustle. It has become my daily routine to embark on this assignment.

Walking around the streets and capturing great images has become a side hustle for me. I enjoy this activity because I also engage with people who sometimes get fascinated with what I am doing.

On this occasion, I visited a particular bus stop called Ijegun bus stop. While there, I met a man lying on the floor with some wounds. When I asked questions, I learnt he got drunk and had been knocked down by a motorcycle. I peeped into the crowd attending to the individual and quickly crossed to the other side of the road to capture nice pictures from the sharp scene around the environment.

The first picture has two people walking in an intersection, but at a very fast pace. I followed suit to capture their image.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbrqJau5HNUoPwhV8RxpVfHGqNE83jHwNkm136zg9u971/image.png)

The second person is a man waiting for a bus at the bus stop. I captured the image and waited for more.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPytaDsoS7vRoiJb3ojLLgG2CxoD13fBZBUrj3FcH2Hif/image.png)
I took another photo, which now includes two people—taking those pictures was difficult because of the people's quick movements at the bus stop.

body.title: Travel to the pretty town of Pescia/ Viaja a la bonita ciudad de Pescia.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiwLFXECd3pE9DxPBiNXu6B8gyHb8FXdZwWkvwLdG8bY/1780936643332.jpg)

Good morning, blog friends, how are you? Today I'm taking you with me to another magical and beautiful place in my beautiful Tuscany: Pescia, a magnificent medieval town worth visiting. Pescia is the capital of the Nievole Valley and is located on the border between Lucca and Pistoia. The city is located around the Pescia River, where it once emerged from two main settlements. It gradually grew and expanded thanks to trade and many activities, especially agriculture. Pescia is now divided into many hamlets, but today I'll take you to just one part of the main town, known for its floriculture, its medieval festival, its renowned hospital, and the various festivals and events held there. It's a very vibrant city, and I love it. We entered Pescia through one of the medieval gates surrounding it, Porta Fiorentina, a very elegant gate that leads straight to the city center. The gate was rebuilt and renovated by the Medici family; it's very elegant and beautiful. In the distance, you can admire a bell tower, the tower of the Pescia Cathedral, dedicated to Santa Maria Assunta, which unfortunately I didn't have time to visit. As you can see, Pescia is a typically Tuscan town with small, colorful houses, various cobblestone streets, and beautiful clusters of houses.

> Buenos días, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Hoy los llevo conmigo a otro lugar mágico y hermoso en mi bella Toscana: Pescia, una magnífica ciudad medieval que vale la pena visitar. Pescia es la capital del valle de Nievole y se encuentra en la frontera entre Lucca y Pistoia. La ciudad se ubica alrededor del río Pescia, donde antaño surgió de dos asentamientos principales. Creció y se expandió gradualmente gracias al comercio y a numerosas actividades, especialmente la agricultura. Pescia ahora está dividida en muchas aldeas, pero hoy los llevaré a una parte de la ciudad principal, conocida por su floricultura, su festival medieval, su renombrado hospital y los diversos festivales y eventos que allí se celebran. Es una ciudad muy vibrante, y me encanta. Entramos a Pescia por una de las puertas medievales que la rodean, la Porta Fiorentina, una puerta muy elegante que conduce directamente al centro de la ciudad. La puerta fue reconstruida y renovada por la familia Medici; es muy elegante y hermosa. A lo lejos, se puede admirar un campanario, el de la catedral de Pescia, dedicada a Santa María Asunta, que lamentablemente no tuve tiempo de visitar. Como se puede apreciar, Pescia es un pueblo típico toscano con casas pequeñas y coloridas, calles empedradas y hermosos conjuntos de casas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNUEAmYHEdTtGfDZbcPn7uyixzgh8vrzgr7agT4QpaqsB/1780936692961.jpg)


Continuing our stroll through Pescia, we were enchanted by how charming, well-maintained, and clean this town is. We also noticed a lovely church with a beautiful cloister, and we began to visit it. This parish church is dedicated to Saint Michael the Archangel. Its exterior architecture is simple and unadorned, probably an old oratory or monastery, given its simple appearance. It has a very tall, classical bell tower and is surrounded by lush plants and bushes. It must be very popular, as we found various plants and gifts outside the church. However, my favorite part is its courtyard, which is accessed under some beautiful flowered arches and offers beautiful views of both the adjacent historic buildings and the panorama of the Pescia hills. Pescia is surrounded by beautiful hills and is surrounded by beautiful nature. I really liked this little church, but it's a shame I couldn't visit the interior because there was a mass going on, and it seemed out of place to go in to take photos. Then, of course, we took a walk across one of Pescia's bridges. There are several that connect the city, which is practically divided in two. From the bridge, we could observe the beautiful, placid Pescia stream that winds its way through the valley. It's a beautiful view if you love rivers and nature. To fully explore this city, you'd need several days and certainly several hours. It has so many natural, architectural, and artistic treasures. I hope to return soon!

> Continuando nuestro paseo por Pescia, quedamos encantados con el encanto, el cuidado y la limpieza de este pueblo. También vimos una preciosa iglesia con un hermoso claustro y decidimos visitarla. Esta iglesia parroquial está dedicada a San Miguel Arcángel. Su arquitectura exterior es sencilla y sin adornos, probablemente un antiguo oratorio o monasterio, dada su apariencia simple. Tiene un campanario clásico muy alto y está rodeada de exuberantes plantas y arbustos. Debe de ser muy popular, ya que encontramos varias plantas y regalos en el exterior. Sin embargo, mi parte favorita es su patio, al que se accede bajo unos hermosos arcos floridos y que ofrece unas vistas preciosas tanto de los edificios históricos adyacentes como del panorama de las colinas de Pescia. Pescia está rodeada de hermosas colinas y de una naturaleza exuberante. Me gustó mucho esta pequeña iglesia, pero es una pena que no pudiera visitar el interior porque se estaba celebrando una misa y me pareció inapropiado entrar a sacar fotos. Después, por supuesto, dimos un paseo por uno de los puentes de Pescia. Hay varios puentes que conectan la ciudad, que prácticamente está dividida en dos. Desde el puente, pudimos observar el hermoso y apacible arroyo Pescia que serpentea por el valle. Es una vista preciosa si te gustan los ríos y la naturaleza. Para explorar esta ciudad a fondo, necesitarías varios días, y sin duda muchas horas. Tiene muchísimos tesoros naturales, arquitectónicos y artísticos. ¡Espero volver pronto!

body.title: Frontostriatal Salience Network Shows Nearly Two-Fold Functional Expansion in Depression
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewDjmyMkWVFQVKmZxfaAinWV2x6Wm4QtLsm2wE2XZ163/salience_sag.jpg)

> The Salience Brain Network
Image credit: [o8t](https://www.o8t.com/blog/salience-network)

The more we understand the mechanisms behind depression's effects on the brain, the more effective our prevention and treatment strategies can become. Nature published a major 2024 study of the neuroscience of depression that really advances our understanding of the bases of the disorder. This is one of the more exciting papers I recently came across, as it pulls us away from the old one broken brain region heuristic toward something more nuanced. 

The core finding is that the frontostriatal salience network, the system involved in detecting salient stimuli, switching attention, and integrating our internal thoughts with the outside world is basically double in size (expanded nearly twofold) in people with depression relative to age-matched controls. Importantly, this is not because of physical growth in brain tissue. It is instead a functional expansion; the boundaries in this network have shifted to overlap more with the neighbouring regions involved in thinking and attention.

What is particularly interesting is that this expansion is stable and \

. It was even seen in children years before they started to show depressive symptoms, which indicates that this might be the biological risk factor rather than just a consequence of the illness.

Additionally, people with depression often present with disruptions involving the default mode network (self-referential thinking and rumination), the salience network (attention and switching), and the frontoparietal/executive control network (focusing and cognitive flexibility). Precision functional mapping research shows the salience network to be nearly 2X expanded in most individuals with depression, moving into shared territories of the default mode and frontoparietal networks. 

Given the salience network's role in attention switching and coordinating other large-scale brain networks, this stable incursion across the borderland may explain why people get so rigid in their thinking, as well as having difficulty slipping away from the negative loops and having decreased cognitive flexibility.

They used precision functional MRI (dense, individualised scanning) and found that this effect was repeatable in several samples and caused by network border shifts with three different modes of encroachment for different individuals.

This study gives a lot of evidence that depression is a disorder of brain networks and communication as opposed to just a single brain region. Although more research is needed to know whether these network changes are causal, compensatory, or a marker of pre-existing vulnerability, some recent studies are already exploring this area. 

I definitely find this network perspective promising for understanding and diagnosing depression, and what is really encouraging is that researchers continuously discover more about depression that helps people suffering from it get treated more effectively.

Reference
 Lynch, C. et al. (2024). Frontostriatal salience network expansion in individuals with depression. Nature https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07805-2

body.title: Marrying after the death of a spouse
body.body:
The bible gives us the opportunity to marry again after the death of the person we love dies. Marriage is a lifelong covenant, but when one spouse dies, the surviving partner is no longer bound by that marriage. The apostle Paul taught that a widow or widower is free to marry again, provided the marriage is in harmony with God's will.

When your spouse dies, the bible teaches us to be careful when we want to remarry again. While remaining single can be a valuable choice for some, remarriage after the death of a spouse is not condemned by Scripture. Instead, it is presented as a legitimate and honorable option for those who desire companionship and support in a new marriage relationship.

body.title: WORTH STOPPING FOR
body.body:
![Kopia – Beyond the route.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wgcxmzWaVzgQqYrEWvFg54Q1tmcWHw3VkkzFWS9gy2czWNa3y5jtq6Gahs2TEMTrqQt.jpg)

Today I’m taking you back to the Low Beskids once again, this time to a small village called Zdynia. There is another church here dedicated to the PROTECTION OF THE MOTHER OF GOD. I had the chance to see this church on the last day of my stay in Gładyszów, just before heading back home. It is located right next to the main road, so it is hard to miss.

>Dzisiaj zabieram Was ponownie do Beskidu Niskiego, a dokładniej do małej miejscowości o nazwie Zdynia. Mieści się tutaj kolejna cerkiew pod wezwaniem OPIEKI MATKI BOŻEJ. Cerkiew tę miałam okazję zobaczyć już ostatniego dnia mojego pobytu w Gładyszowie, tuż przed drogą powrotną. Znajduje się ona przy głównej drodze, dlatego trudno jej nie zauważyć.

![20260321_172212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243qFT8dg6DaKczJoneFbQCvnqMvQ52rAx68yGRFatpcyYMPVDBhfZWLv1KJyF1jcwXBB.jpg)


![20260321_172120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243M4q14VZ82X7uVDvFPBUamYWambp6Yu139kkFuTsxh9Ui3zLMBU9XJKFQvyyeRuZVSU.jpg)

Like most churches in this region, it was built from wood. However, this was not only an aesthetic choice — wood was simply the most accessible material in the mountains, and such buildings could be constructed more quickly and repaired more easily.

>Jak większość cerkwi położonych w tym regionie, została zbudowana z drewna. Nie był to jednak wyłącznie wybór estetyczny — drewno było w górach najłatwiej dostępnym materiałem, a takie budowle można było szybciej wznosić i łatwiej naprawiać.

![20260321_172021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242hWWjtzNRxdesdgzsxmr9UtnYTNV2xTJH63ZjHgkHJrqYEbaqFn3P1gHShtNmfW7waX.jpg)


In the photos, you can also see the bell tower standing separately, and this is not a coincidence, as in church architecture it was often built apart from the main structure. This was mainly to protect the church from fire, but it also had a symbolic meaning — it separated the sacred space from the outside world.

>Na zdjęciach widać również dzwonnicę stojącą osobno i nie jest to przypadek, ponieważ w architekturze cerkiewnej często budowano ją oddzielnie od świątyni. Miało to przede wszystkim chronić przed pożarem, ale miało też znaczenie symboliczne — oddzielało sacrum od przestrzeni zewnętrznej.


![20260321_172050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243qH91VLHopyMnLjzLXme5JJrTFbTwcYcx6wqvocVLBkd4TqqskoZaz6qjbbaFqTMzik.jpg)


Like most churches at this time of year, the building was unfortunately closed, so I could only admire it from the outside. It is not as monumental as the church in Kwiatoń, which has been included on the UNESCO World Heritage List. It is rather more modest, calm, and blends into the surrounding landscape. Everything here feels natural and unforced.

>Jak większość cerkwi o tej porze roku, świątynia była niestety zamknięta, więc mogłam ją podziwiać jedynie z zewnątrz. Nie jest ona tak monumentalna jak cerkiew w Kwiatoniu, która została wpisana na Listę Światowego Dziedzictwa UNESCO. Jest raczej bardziej skromna, spokojna i wtapia się w krajobraz. Wszystko wygląda tutaj naturalnie i niewymuszenie.

![20260321_172101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243BaLEMvV84PnfzxYzGJeQxrPqMvaVUtkKLBRtwnrWHugqJRtjBvMM5RYJHZRJx2HTZZ.jpg)

body.title: Mobile Phone Photography Contest Round #116 // Life Lessons I Learned From Simple Pictures
body.body:
----
Good evening to all my friends in this beloved community, I hope you are all always healthy and happy so that you can carry out your daily activities as usual and I hope you all have a pleasant day.
----

![IMG-20260609-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmapD6Ewzqv1sVJ5Qr2xdGdjXCANXEuBvEpr41G44AjmwD/IMG-20260609-WA0007.jpg)

<div class=\

>

On this simple blog, I'd like to share some images with this beloved community as my participation in the contest, which is now in its 116th round.

So, please continue to follow my simple blog to see some of the images I've taken and shared at this meeting, along with a short caption from me.

![IMG-20260609-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmacpga1P6nmpJKQjFkqqYXUZsZXczBGWYyeDq9REnDdJA/IMG-20260609-WA0001.jpg)

I took this photo with my cell phone while riding my motorbike in the afternoon in the hills of Aceh Besar, where the weather was bright blue, the main backdrop. If you've been following my blog lately, you'll have seen my simple blog post about my trip to Pasir Putih Beach. It was during this trip that I took several photos that I'll share on my simple blog as part of a contest.

My friends...
Personally, this image holds a profound lesson for me. I realize that this isn't a photo of a majestic mountain or a blue beach, but rather a simple hill. The ground is dry, with many rocks, and the trees are mostly bare, but the focal point is a tree whose trunk has been cut down, leaving only a single tree, and at the end of that single tree, a single green shoot growing in the opposite direction.

Well...
This image seems to tell us that we can fall, we can be cut down, but we must never stop growing. I think many of us have our own problems, especially us Acehnese people who definitely understand how it feels, from the tsunami, conflict, to economic hardship, we feel like we are alone, but look, the shoots are still there.

![IMG-20260609-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaegRtU6hXBfHDmk3z1xCyvuFKRqxssJRT3SLekDmiyCb/IMG-20260609-WA0004.jpg)

![IMG-20260609-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWAo5GKettCrJd1TPwwZNjkyRLUGLeZfhgvQCswamPcA/IMG-20260609-WA0002.jpg)

![IMG-20260609-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZEB5DfS2YAFjz8JEGZpVgV1vqKLDsx7Cyo9kUtDmA81y/IMG-20260609-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260609-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbirJbKDhq86eM3WJWPLaCkjTw4YqeJVF4pboghPaJiKJ/IMG-20260609-WA0005.jpg)

Besides getting a very meaningful life lesson from the simple picture, another atmosphere that I found while on the way to Pasir Putih Beach was so calming with the view of the hills that spoil the eyes, there were also several electricity poles at that time until there was a path that was the footprint of us humans, but it was a bit unfortunate because beside the road I also saw a pile of scattered garbage which even though this nature is for us to enjoy its beauty, but instead we pollute it with despicable actions.

What made me choose these simple images to participate in this contest is the profound life lessons we can learn from them.

Well, my friends, those are some of the images and short posts from me on this blog. I hope you all enjoy and are entertained by what I share. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me as I strive to create a better blog in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings everyone, and see you in my next blog.

body.title: The Tale of Evan - ENG- SPA
body.body:
![1769956434250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23vhsCyKD96gzqk68LRqL9hn4r6VzgcxcFYhSjV5GM1UuypVpiXqccGFPG8LcxGNQUyeR.jpg)

<div class = \
>\n<div class = \

> The goal was clear: Evan wasn't just thinking about singing and being an ordinary singer who blended in with everyone else without standing out in any way. From a young age, he had looked up to Harry, a singer of his time who worked incredibly hard to sing, but because he didn't rise above the rest, he remained in obscurity, without any recognition or glory. That's exactly what he wanted to avoid when singing became a part of his life. To achieve his goal of becoming someone superior, he set several important objectives. First, he wanted to climb the ranks at the various music festivals held weekly in his country to make a name for himself. That way, he would gain recognition faster than by simply writing songs. After that initial goal, he planned to win the award for best singer at the festival for several consecutive weeks. These were short-term goals. His longer-term objective was to become the best singer in his entire country, and who knows, maybe even the world. Of course, these were very ambitious goals, but he was going to give it his all to achieve them, and that gave him a powerful motivation. And it worked perfectly. The strength he gained from having such clear goals helped him easily reach the first stages of his plan. He managed to sing at the fairs held weekly in his country. And after performing there several times and becoming known, he achieved his first major objective: becoming the best singer at the fair for several consecutive weeks. This was very gratifying for him because he saw his plans coming to fruition, and that gave him the confidence to keep moving forward.

> El objetivo era claro, Evan no pensaba solo en cantar y ser un cantante normal que se mezclara con todos los demás sin sobresalir de alguna forma. El desde pequeño había tenido el referente de Harry un cantante de su tiempo, que se esforzó mucho por cantar pero como no sobresalió por encima de otros se quedó en la miseria sin pena y sin gloria. Pues eso mismo es lo que quería evitar que le sucediera a él cuando cantar se convirtió en parte de su vida. Para lograr el objetivo de ser alguien superior se puso varias metas importantes. Quería primeramente escalar en varias ferias musicales que se hacían cada semana en su país para darse a conocer. De esa forma se daría a conocer más rápido que creando canciones. Después de esa meta inicial pensaba obtener un merito como el mejor cantante de la feria varias semanas consecutivas. Esas fueron a corto plazo. Más a largo plazo el objetivo convertirse en el mejor cantante de todo su país y quién sabe si del mundo. Claro eran metas muy ambiciosas pero él se iba a esforzar al máximo por conseguirlas y eso le daba una fuerte motivación. Y funcionó a la perfección. La fuerza que le dio tener esas metas tan claras le ayudó a alcanzar las primeras fases de su plan con facilidad. Consiguió cantar en las ferias que se hacían cada semana en su país. Y luego de hacerlos varias veces y hacerse conocido logró su primer gran objetivo ser el mejor cantante de de la feria por varias semanas consecutivas. Esto fue muy gratificante para el porque veía como sus planes se iban consiguiendo y eso le dio la seguridad para seguir hacia adelante.
![pexels-anna-pou-8132765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/242DXCdt4Kh5idP2fYDL6BgAGeqg7mTRztMWmsxAjgk7tQwZoPQULGAAxEtvAYDMd42Ly.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> After the boost he received from being the best at the fair and several festivals, and building a loyal fanbase, he released his first major album, featuring all the songs he had created for the fairs and several new ones. It was a remastered compilation with added tracks. This album was truly beneficial for his career because it was a success. In the music industry, he was considered a hidden gem; people couldn't understand why he hadn't achieved fame sooner. Hearing these things and seeing the success of his album continued to give him the strength to overcome the many obstacles he encountered. There were less successful songs and albums not as explosive as his first, but he always created a great buzz and high expectations for his new work. This told him he was on the right track; people, and especially the music industry, were noticing. He had already surpassed his role model, Harry, whom he didn't want to emulate for always being in the shadows and never becoming anyone special. Well, that was behind him now; it was time to think bigger and achieve his new goal: to be the best in the country. This goal was more complicated than the others because to achieve it he had to surpass several other very good singers in the country. So it took him a while. More than 20 years to be exact, almost his entire career focused on this goal. During all that time he observed what worked for others and applied it to his own work. Thus, little by little, he refined his technique and improved remarkably.

> Tras el impulso de ser el mejor de la feria y varios festivales y construir una base de seguidores fieles lanzó su primer gran disco con todas las canciones que había creado para las ferias y varias nuevas. Era una recopilación remasterizada y con más añadidos. Este disco fue realmente bueno para su carrera porque fue un éxito. En la música lo consideraron una joya escondida, no entendían como no había llegado a la fama antes. Estas cosas que el escuchaba y ver el éxito de su disco le continuaron dando más fuerza para seguir superando muchos de los obstáculos que se fue encontrando. Hubo canciones menos exitosas y discos no tan explosivos como el primero pero siempre creaba un gran revuelo y grandes expectativas en sus nuevos trabajos. Eso le iba diciendo que iba por buen camino, la gente y en especial la música lo estaba notando. Ya había a superado a su referente Harry al que no quería parecerse por siempre estar en las sombras y no llegar a ser nadie en especial. Pues ya eso había quedado atrás era momento de pensar en mas grande y conseguir su nueva meta ser el mejor del país. Esta meta fue más complicada que las otras porque para lograrla debía superar a varios otros cantantes del país que eran muy buenos también. Así que esta le tomó su tiempo. Más de 20 años para ser exactos, casi toda su carrera enfocada en esta meta. En todo ese tiempo logró ver que les funcionaba a los demás y lo aplicó en lo que el mismo hacia. Así poco a poco fue puliendo su técnica y mejorando notablemente.
![pexels-anna-pou-8132793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23ywm6H7UdMg7uGNx7EvDJHwx9XS1Ss9QFHjx3TUynv1W2L9Ddd6WEpAbGUPazwyunUnY.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> Sooner or later, at the end of those 20 years, he achieved it. He became the best and most respected singer in the entire country. It was a costly goal in terms of time invested, but the result was well worth it. He had almost accomplished everything he had set out to do; only one thing remained: to be the best singer in the world. This last goal was the most difficult of all and the most symbolic, since no one had ever achieved it. Although he had the strength to continue, and simply looking back at his past showed him that he could do it, things changed for the first time. Evan realized something: although he had gained a lot in his career, he had also lost a great deal. By striving to surpass his self-imposed goals, he had stopped enjoying the journey; everything was always pressure. He never had the opportunity to enjoy other facets of music because he had to do what sold the most. And the most costly thing of all was the time invested. If being the best in his country took him 20 years, being the best in the world would require a whole new lifetime. That's why he decided enough was enough; it was time to continue singing, but now with a different focus and rhythm. His biggest problem was that time was running out, and he had to choose between symbolic goals and those that truly brought him short-term happiness so he could enjoy them. And that's what he did. Now he'll concentrate more on enjoying the present and the past. And the future will be built with more goals, but making the most of each day in the short term.

> Tarde o temprano al final de esos 20 lo logró, se convirtió en el mejor y más respetado cantante de todo el país. Fue una meta costosa en tiempo invertido pero el resultado valía mucho la pena. Casi había logrado todo lo que se había propuesto, solo faltaba una cosa. Ser el mejor cantante del mundo. Esta ultima meta era la más difícil de todas y la más simbólica ya que nadie nunca haba alcanzado. A pesar de que tenia las fuerzas para continuar y el solo hecho de ver su pasado le mostraba que si podía aquí las cosas cambiaron por primera vez. Y es que Evan se dio cuenta de una cosa, aunque había ganado mucho en su carrera también había perdido muchísimo. Por superar sus metas impuestas había dejado de disfrutar del camino, todo siempre fue presión. Nunca tuvo la oportunidad de disfrutar de otras facetas de la música porque debía hacer lo que más vendiera. Y lo más costoso de todo era el tiempo invertido, si ser el mejor de su país le llevó 20 años ser el mejor del mundo requeriría una vida completa nueva. Por eso el decidió que ya era suficiente, era momento de continuar cantando pero ahora con un enfoque y ritmo distinto, porque el mayor problema que tenia es que el tiempo se le agotaba y tenia que escoger entre las metas simbólicas o las que de verdad le daban felicidad al corto plazo para poder disfrutarlas. Y eso hizo, ahora se concentrará más en disfrutar el presente y el pasado. Y el futuro se construirá con más metas pero aprovechando cada día al corto plazo.
![pexels-andersonguerra-1625355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23zkZLEPveMy7gkE2nLMYaheJufNYiKyfCACopgwSxB1diVMpFsDXXQUx2rrapTEvaB2g.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
