links.title: Late-Night Bakery Shift
links.body:
> Hello everyone. Last weekend, I was completely ready to head out the door to visit my regular barber and get a haircut. I was just about to leave when my phone rang. It was a message from the barber notifying me at the last minute that a sudden power failure had hit his area, forcing him to close early. # There I was, fully dressed and ready to go, standing in the middle of my room. It was the weekend, and staying inside after preparing to go out felt like a waste of time. Instead of changing back into comfortable clothes and staying home, I decided take out my phone and call a friend to see if he was available to hang out. Within a couple of minutes, we agreed to meet up at a local bakery we frequently visit. # The plan sounded incredibly simple, and...mundane: just sitting down to eat some sweet bread and drink soda. To anyone else, it might have seemed like a boring way to spend a weekend night, but for us, that bakery has always been a reliable spot. It is a very pleasant place with a welcoming atmosphere, decent background music, stable Wi-Fi, and excellent customer service. More importantly, it features an endless display of fresh bread and cold drinks, which is really all you need to set up a proper conversation. # When I arrived, my friend was already there, and we wasted no time ordering. I have to admit, I absolutely love bread. We sat down and started talking. # What was supposed to be a quick casual meeting quickly turned into a deep session of stories and shared experiences. We started discussing basic updates about our lives, but as the minutes passed, the topics grew more hilarious. We started telling anecdotes and absurd situations we have encountered lately. We laughed a lot, recalling those anecdotes and telling some other stories. # Before we knew it, hours had flown by. The bakery staff started preparing for closing, and the streets outside had gone completely quiet. We looked at our phones and realized it was already very late. So we just leaved. In the end, I got no haircut but hey... at least i had bread and laughed, pretty descent if you ask me... Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time! ------ ---- |

links.body: 1/5 🧵 Morgan Wallen’s career arc is basically: massive commercial success, repeated public screwups, rinse, repeat. The article’s core point is brutal and simple — the hits kept climbing while the controversies kept stacking, from arrests to racial-slur fallout to that absurd rooftop chair throw. 📎 [Source](https://pagesix.com/entertainment/morgan-wallen-controversial-moments/)
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 It starts early. In 2016, Wallen was arrested in Tennessee on an alleged DUI charge, but prosecutors later dropped it and the case appears to have been expunged. In 2020, he was arrested again — this time for public intoxication and disorderly conduct after an incident at Kid Rock’s bar in Nashville. Those charges were also dropped. The pattern matters: even when legal consequences faded, the headlines didn’t.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 Then came the career damage that actually hit his image. In October 2020, “Saturday Night Live” pulled him as musical guest after video showed him partying without following COVID rules. He publicly owned it, said he needed to grow up, and later got a second shot on the show that December. That episode made him look reckless, but not yet radioactive.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The most serious scandal was 2021: video surfaced of Wallen using the N-word. His label suspended him, radio and industry backlash followed, and he issued apologies saying there was no excuse for it. The article also notes criticism that he reportedly blew off the NAACP and that promised donations to Black-led groups were said to have gone missing. That’s the moment where this stopped being “rowdy country star” behavior and became something uglier and far harder to shrug off.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 After that, the mess stayed varied: cheating allegations in 2022 he never addressed publicly, a 2023 concert cancellation minutes before showtime that led to fan backlash and a lawsuit, and the 2024 rooftop-chair incident that ended with guilty pleas, probation, a fine, and a stint at a DUI education center. By 2025, even an awkward “SNL” exit became a mini-scandal. The takeaway: Wallen’s fame keeps surviving behavior that would bury a lot of artists, which is exactly why every new blowup becomes a bigger story. 📎 [Source](https://pagesix.com/entertainment/morgan-wallen-controversial-moments/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 1/5 🧵 The big point: this isn’t a one-day thunderstorm story. It’s a **multi-day severe weather setup** aimed at the Midwest, with **40M+ people** in the threat zone by midweek and a messy combo of **large hail, damaging winds, tornadoes, and flash flooding**. Basically: the atmosphere is loading the dice several days in a row.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 **Monday** starts the sequence with a **Level 2/5 severe risk** stretching from Colorado’s Front Range through central Kansas. Early signs were already serious — including a tornado warning in Newton County, Missouri. Through the day, storms were expected to bring **hail over 2 inches**, **wind gusts above 70 mph**, and the chance of an **isolated tornado**.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 **Tuesday** looks more dangerous in the northern Plains. A dip in the jet stream over the West plus a north-moving surface low and cold front creates the classic ingredients for ugly storms: **instability, moisture, and strong daytime heating**. The article highlights **North Dakota** with a **Level 3/5 risk**, and says the main threats are **very large hail and tornadoes**, with the risk shifting toward **damaging winds overnight** as storms move into the Red River Valley.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 **Wednesday** is the headline day for the Upper Midwest. As the low moves into Canada and the cold front pushes east, the focus shifts into **Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Iowa**, also under a **Level 3/5 risk**. **Minneapolis is singled out as being in the bullseye** for a “potentially significant severe weather event,” with conditions supportive of **supercells and bowed storm lines** — meaning all hazards are on the table again, not just one.
links.author: askrafiki

links.author: mshbd

links.body: 5/5 🧵 **Thursday** keeps the conveyor belt moving east into a **Level 2/5 risk** affecting **26M+ people**, including **Chicago, St. Louis, and Milwaukee**. On top of that, repeated rounds of storms could drop **1–2 inches of rain widely**, with **localized 2–3+ inch totals** in slower-moving areas, raising the flash flood risk. Short version: this is a rolling severe-weather week, not random summer noise. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/06/08/us-news/midweek-storm-threat-grows-as-severe-weather-targets-millions-in-the-midwest/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 1/5 🧵 The Dodgers can survive one ugly 13-5 loss because their starters have been doing the heavy lifting all season. That’s the real story here: LA’s rotation has been so damn efficient that one bullpen-burning disaster against the Angels barely changes the bigger picture.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 Sunday got messy fast. Emmet Sheehan unraveled in the second inning, loading the bases and getting yanked after 36 pitches in the frame because Dave Roberts didn’t want to push him past 40. That forced six relievers into the game, and the bullpen got tagged hard after that. But the damage was softened by what happened the two days before: Roki Sasaki gave them 7 innings Friday, and Yoshinobu Yamamoto gave them 8 on Saturday.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The numbers are the punchline. Dodgers relievers have thrown **206 2/3 innings**, the fewest of any bullpen in baseball. Last year they led the majors in bullpen innings, which is usually code for “your relievers are being cooked by July.” This year, the rotation has covered **375 2/3 innings**, more than any staff in the league. That flips the whole stress profile of the season.

links.title: Trail 🏔️🌏/ Senderos (de los misterios negros)📍🏞️ (En-Es)
links.body:
>This is undoubtedly one of the most incredible trails in Portugal, for several reasons: intensity, beauty, distance, and stunning landscapes. Most interestingly, it has an incredible history, and it will be up to your imagination to confirm its veracity. Angra do Heroísmo, located on Terceira Island in the middle of the Atlantic, offers many trails. While it is not a destination focused on urban tourism or visiting museums, it is the perfect paradise for nature lovers like me📍🗺️ # Este es, sin duda, uno de los senderos más increíbles de Portugal por varias razones: intensidad, belleza, distancia y paisajes. Lo más interesante es su increíble historia, y quedará en tu imaginación confirmar su veracidad. Angra do Heroísmo, en la isla de Terceira, en medio del Atlántico, dispone de muchos senderos. No es un lugar de turismo urbano para visitar museos y cosas similares, ¡pero es un destino ideal para los amantes de la naturaleza como yo!🚩🌋 ![Untitled-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/AJg3F5p7Zng7KWFC6paiyc64MxmNVuoasAakMYpSX3k3MdaLToW8z5fJhexHTJZ.jpg) #
Before continuing, I invite you to visit the blogs and videos.🧭🌋 / Antes de continuar te invito a visitar los blogs y los videos🚩📍
https://youtu.be/oeGHZZOlWao ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23yJEJq3hZgxBZBSMAPR9PMSvEK2FJVT7HmzugupFnv6UG4RTbKikhP47tMULcTM8hxFZ.png) https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@biologistbrito/a-travelers-diary-diario-de-un-viajero-acores-en-es ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xp6UXJVvDAc7KyoW3SuXWvDTDFYgh4R8cswrDiJU1pNsFxAEmUY9z9mhwcXJmdHqu3a.png) https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@biologistbrito/we-visited-the-caves-of-the-azores-extreme-tourism-visitamos-las-cuevas-de-los-acores-en-es ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23w2aaeRmE4NjGGDmKNUivc9vNmzExmw2y2wCjdv2jaBjZ4MbQS5N6e9hpG5Tfm6Aqfyo.png)

#
Where is the most incredible trail in Portugal?🙇🏻‍♀️ / Donde queda el sendero mas increible de Portugal?📍
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tkhqimR5XCr2Vpao9VuhFVRexWTpk3isNFCM5Y2BX4VQMNrXmdrzRV4QSjDstViJJiE.gif)
*Coordinates:38.73791° N, -27.26802° W🌏🧭 / Coordinadas: 38.73791° N, -27.26802° W*📍🌏
![2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tGcNMFLpZW9NunLBzUHH2bGDT1ChCgz3Hyu64KUsuyWhijhFhLgHJaoVJHSPFCQehrL.gif)
![IMG_1217.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246an9cXrjx69fSqfjANVcTAvJjANfvMFghtdDd3WEVZ8Ks9E7d8f6tXqHtwRbVMxoR47.JPG)
*I started the trail at 5:00am🌏🧭 / Comence el sendero a las 5:00am*📍🌏
![IMG_1189.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246aquateAANzgvTPn6AbzQbuupM5vQuAxPEK6VGZVhmq9rfM4VSJ4D2QixoynmWYJZjg.JPG) ![IMG_1215.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246G4apxj6wZ8QybxNxSur8tjpU7fdYoMWsyfqEWxQrMeRc8kTkqBKpNKjbaNAzCepj9x.JPG) ![IMG_1220.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242Y1m6eX5XFBJcY8fu75ehViN8a6NyYALkdp7F3FWY7NtvJVt38L2foeXtbwx262Ru7B.JPG)
Como este es el sendero más visitado de la isla, ¡tiene mucha demanda de personas realizándolo! ¿Cómo te evitas toda esa confusión? Fácil... Te levantas a las 5:00 a. m. y seguramente serás el primero en completarlo. Mucha gente le tiene miedo al sendero por el nombre: «Misterios Negros», y, en realidad, ¡casi todas las personas que vi que iban a empezar cuando yo había terminado estaban acompañadas! O estoy loco o tengo coraje, jeje.🚩🏔️
Since this is the most visited trail on the island, it is incredibly popular! How do you avoid all that crowd? Easy... Get up at 5 a.m. and you will probably be the first one to complete it. Many people are afraid of the trail because of its name, \

In fact, almost everyone I saw starting just as I finished was accompanied by someone! Either I am crazy, or I am just brave, haha.📍🗺️
![gif6_dorado_shimmer.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23twC3hcw4x8Y1qsCn6goYEV4x9NWf6UVG34R2w6WFF2csuDuQtCy4TdwzfaVVon48NV1.gif)
![IMG_1231.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/243q6ppLqJQ2zTErwLq2pbxKzFdf4uxDfsm5wUHU5aZFUZ4RRWuG8qsraaMLPMfJS6cDM.JPG) #
Tips for hiking the trail🙇🏻‍♀️ / Consejos para realizar el sendero📍
![20260520_080616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uFRhUACoQR7AM7uifHgZacspXsizqSYYQeinG7GXuqKqkxXDP79JjgawMb4xcpPKRv3.jpg)
![21.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23zGPc8bNw3uDT2zw1nERcaWYf4C35A5hUG6cXauVqjGiFPens8vqQnvuKNVbcVMVdS6r.gif)
================================================================================= # En: * Bring plenty of water, if you can, more than 2L📍 * Boots and hiking poles are essential; rain boots are recommended if it rains, as there are deep puddles.📍 * If something happens to you, don't panic; someone will always be there for you at any moment. If you can do the trail in dry weather, even better.📍 * Bring food and snacks; there's nothing nearby to buy. Make a plan to visit the \

cave.📍

=================================================================================
# Es:

* Trae mucha agua, si puedes mas de 2L📍

* Las botas y los bastones de excursión son indispensables. Si es posible, lleva botas de lluvia; si llueve, se forman charcos profundos.📍

* Si te pasa algo, no entres en pánico; siempre pasará alguien a tu lado en cualquier momento. Si puedes hacer el sendero en un clima sin lluvia, mejor.📍

* lleva comida, snacks no hay nada cerca para comprar, haz un plan para visitar la cueva \

📍 ================================================================================= ✅ There is no public transport here, you must come in a rental vehicle ✅ Pack a change of clothes and something to store electronic devices in your backpack.
![gif5_verde_animado.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tcQwWKu1QjkmYPLdJN15WRfUrWr5Zze8TmQubBPDAMTVRodNmLrtSsE28CqDNnvviZy.gif)
#
The legend of the Black Lagoon🙇🏻‍♀️ / La leyenda de la laguna Negra📍
![IMG_1241.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wWvpfymzEvNW9ZZ1abGg7tvR5DeTWHJ7EuM83UUetJESJQgf7ieE59YkZsJKazyrUZd.JPG) ![IMG_1246.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/245wHbRBpeo58ezPr8QsBcyiC5LP1CCdL8fwjTCJ68Mn5G5TAsFv2fnGkbPEzecFcw8WC.JPG)
There is a beautiful, romantic story that has been told for generations about how this lagoon was formed. It is believed that a girl, the daughter of wealthy parents, fell in love with an enslaved man. When her father found out, he used every resource at his disposal to pursue the fleeing man, intending to kill him. Exhausted, the man collapsed in this area. Knowing he would never see his beloved again, he began to weep! He wept so much that this lagoon was formed by his tears! What do you think? How true is the legend?📍🏔️
Hay una historia bonita y romántica que se cuenta desde hace generaciones sobre cómo se formó esta laguna. Se cree que una chica, hija de padres ricos, se apasionó por un esclavo. Cuando el padre de la mujer se enteró, usó todos sus recursos para perseguir al esclavo que huía con la intención de matarlo. El esclavo africano cayó rendido de cansancio en esta zona y, sabiendo que nunca más vería a su amada, ¡empezó a llorar! ¡Lloró tanto que esta laguna se formó con sus lágrimas! ¿Qué dices? ¿Qué tan cierta es la leyenda?🌋🚩
![gif6_dorado_shimmer.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23twC3hcw4x8Y1qsCn6goYEV4x9NWf6UVG34R2w6WFF2csuDuQtCy4TdwzfaVVon48NV1.gif)
![IMG_1251.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhyWMLWDtNKXfuY2Bm8MvVgNkuR5BU4E8K3L4KXEJn74r4Pc3vHokuN5j8z6TU7ymdA.JPG)
*Start of the trail🌏🧭 / Inicio del sendero*📍🌏
![3.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23z77B9cBhaaQKP24znnhYtWJNqTm4uJpmJdm5J3DoJng77cCH1d1BXyVdMgFP4ibb8wp.gif)
![20260520_073938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoeFpDyuxXG4Xau1z6yYofGhmXskKNfqjKPFZnFuRBbMj2V5NSjDM6XV5hyp4rGD6cK.jpg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242hjBq4zDbU2s4ZJbRNDWSaVeLJhhSvTQMEqtboEAcQqsUrRnsXAwzGZxAS7w6bmLC2u.png)
https://pt.wikiloc.com/trilhas-trekking/misterios-negros-prc-01-ter-79661791
![IMG_1258.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tvc9aAf1ZCLvKZH1BSoodobKVrscgsY4Vy3ir6oi1umaw6qUNWGDdcrf2eB4qWw35dr.JPG) ![IMG_1259.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uQrLzvEkPS5rW6ZA2xbFTgDx3uNfrq3nqix8NKPb3UiBqPjYiAAng6fGGbJiFtohSpB.JPG) ![20260520_094512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eos1Puggip21q9R9jJ34ysCFHXMVVaGVNW7hzP2XqJztfECHP6rx6S7J4THas7PcDEk.jpg) ![20260520_095003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EqqnCf6qAjzt4MfMXm2i9a1H6mGRzknW5ReRy6swfAtfx73ivPPjLZK82TdXVFX3UR8.jpg) ![20260520_095742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EqqrwE4YRBiN99TVfZwC2vfHfS4fDndrNiBhVgfpmbCdoAj7ieEFfPnxp3d9BRe7SXe.jpg) ![IMG_1260.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wMS1X3gCN9XfuMsVQJot8BLcFNpP3nZu4WeD72gDeLCCjM4x1vRGf3qDGD5wfpzwDHt.JPG)
The trail is difficult; a minimum level of physical fitness and hiking experience are highly recommended. There are many areas where you can easily twist an ankle—or worse, slip—if you are not used to navigating uneven terrain. You will climb to a maximum altitude of 650 meters. It is a circular trail, meaning you return to the starting point. It takes about 3 hours on average if you go fast and do not stop much. It took me 4 hours because I was filming. By the way, don't miss that video on my channel!🗺️📍
El sendero es difícil; se recomienda tener una preparación física mínima y experiencia. Hay muchas zonas donde te puedes doblar un tobillo fácilmente —o peor, resbalarte— si no tienes experiencia en caminatas por terrenos irregulares. Vas a subir a un máximo de 650 metros de altitud. Es un sendero circular, lo que quiere decir que vuelves al punto de partida. Tiene una duración de 3 horas en promedio si lo haces rápido y no te detienes mucho; yo demoré 4 horas porque iba grabando. ¡Por cierto, no te pierdas ese video en mi canal!🏞️🗺️
![IMG_1267.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/2466kKuHXb4SYwHXFrGzYwAe5uBcMsW7Qu5GYR3sSRCmwDDjeoa1qZBjN69r2qYJmfQPV.JPG) ![IMG_1268.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23w2gqCAHgudhiYMXTANMWoVhBdLqwBdhoDVmker37V57737PPkVkw8wKWt5kh5HL2Ldz.JPG) ![IMG_1269.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhsRzKDpPFkwrTJJreCZZ5eGYFhU8ynRcj2CbnowA7a6Rii2B54yBJf8MkwBURjU1WF.JPG) *As you can see, the terrain is not easy. We haven't even entered the toughest areas yet, and we already see mud and water everywhere. They have put up wooden bridges to make the experience easier for hikers, but there are points where these bridges aren't enough, and our feet get completely soaked.🌋🌏* *Como puedes ver, el terreno no es fácil. Aún no hemos entrado a las zonas más duras y ya vemos barro y agua por todos lados. Han colocado puentes de madera para facilitar la experiencia a los senderistas, pero hay puntos en los que estos puentes no son suficientes y nuestros pies quedan totalmente encharcados.🚩🏔️*
![4.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uQpCii77Ae9xaEEe9p1JptzsTe41hb6c5Hk4zF9SVyMjFks7XF2zKVneKJaUyCpZ1PQ.gif)
![20260520_095838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EpdepjVNY9J3gC4iYBB2DjePyCC7GHE36NFrZgwfN9FtafFNeGhX13LVS32kreqAx6H.jpg) ![20260520_100526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EqqrTzsZwRWuJk5eQMFXhdpbiA5m3dwCygw5XVf37cvLSjwTzUmr1PFwrZ3p58k16gQ.jpg) ![20260520_101006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EqfE4MXGmyk9HQKm5B4wGY32zQTs2NJqem1i2cB9fLQta64yCX6R7D1BsWEP7VKTGgN.jpg) ![IMG_1270.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xAMENZspZvV3v9cYSfB5V7EMSiHMqeNkd3jPXPKFRKVF1DwWrtG8VKxeWwmMRPgACZ2.JPG) ![IMG_1271.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uFHFf7BoWQibL23NvxoZ12ASU1eXExdyaPKgt32Hk5mjp4rnfBdWz36AqJYqBRkqZTZ.JPG) ![IMG_1274.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wC5CE8WSdhH7sQLNGgz9nveSt7Nk4x5CVezKrH7LZaahQN2VHgrd3yM3MoQDBFfhbRS.JPG) ![IMG_1275.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xyNygyA9bsQYxLBDBuE58KfiJrjvDsd52XaZoWxQwjne612AZrM11Z4uQsDa7Dbhn9p.JPG) ![IMG_1276.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242DEH5XX1sx4guxYYVxWJNAydHMmvwdFgAk9cWHrYQwUUTu7DUiy8J6Jw7mkum46dCHu.JPG)
Honestly, there's no other trail in Portugal with these characteristics, maybe on another island or Madeira, but not on the mainland! And I've already traveled the country from end to end; and it's a motivation to learn about an ecosystem that thrived despite the harshest soil conditions. Remember, this is a volcanic island.📍🗺️
Honestamente, no hay otro sendero en Portugal con estas características; quizás en otra isla o en Madeira, ¡pero en el continente no! Y mira que ya recorrí el país de punta a punta. Es una gran motivación para conocer un ecosistema que se abrió paso a través de las condiciones de suelo más duras; recuerda que esto es una isla volcánica.🏞️✅
![IMG_1279.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wC12gKnzmnZxUWsbVXumBfsfk4butQt5FSaPrYGwfBgXjCwAdhoYjtkVBwf1yZndFXn.JPG) ![IMG_1280.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhqQj9BsnavZZczm76sW6ATtzNHFiBHnHiGWDcBo9DZgWAXyegQnGSpNFrUn7c12D7b.JPG)

I want you to look closely at this photo because I think it captures the most interesting part of the trail. The roots twisting along the ground create a sci-fi movie atmosphere. This is also the toughest section because the roots are slippery and hard, making it very easy to hurt yourself. In fact, 70% of the trail consists of this exact type of terrain.🏞️🚙
Quiero que detalles esta foto porque me parece que es lo más interesante del sendero. Las raíces en el suelo crean un ambiente de película de ciencia ficción, y esta es la parte más dura porque las raíces son resbaladizas y duras, por lo que puedes lastimarte. El 70 % del sendero es un terreno así.👩🏻‍🦯

![IMG_1294.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wC3Qzh3ne4DFZcHHkaMYNtyekm56ZRYpLYEqVMV1NVHdPFvieXfBhxFYwCjZvog5Erw.JPG) ![IMG_1295.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tvW4hrABoMjfyv9H68niKx54GLvbkuj2Z9RuJgL8zcvWFixvxpmPSupPfQCz9YMuJMB.JPG) ![IMG_1312.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23u5vxGz9Dzyz92VMRHvo54UE66zr1oYCHbFCyQD2yagQuJWTsjNJqcJmF7q12EfigKee.JPG) ![IMG_1317.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wC1UiBkRtD6q9MXPbMddWcBub6EzxPDaoFxtsbo6SSosGZY7GTFB3nSKjHMcve55r7r.JPG) ![IMG_1318.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vsG9bpqXqchxT9v888ikgerBsygbAZ4idvC6WSxCH7387bQJ73ixubZhtn1GJJyPcNz.JPG) ![IMG_1319.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vsG9fZHKvUqt3Fccx8sYmgmjhY3EZLGYahW7Vn8HyTdQoiwaeJ9HxovRbggzpRTcf8Y.JPG) ![IMG_1321.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tbpkNxFKUcWzW4wLQiET6bDzGjQsYyiuAK88XosMs5u1miFY5jwdoUdWvJ1anvoEs7D.JPG) ![IMG_1326.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23u5vRrvEKj268xE1bDEwpM5jBNjBypjM5NUxQ25ZGMyk47fksxZZU2mkQahAViubcKiB.JPG) ![IMG_1327.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tvZiL5qPYeTVF9Ecbmiar3YY3EdewzZ8rqCjwDaDYADDpwn6cvLw2wscgetDpcZnizF.JPG) ![IMG_1329.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23y8mZHfeXbLqC1Job9uzTteME4Ezf9zLPDX1SEwN5YBdQphSFfmCuZMwGqzuWCeujpwm.JPG) ![BeFunky-collage (33).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/AJkRWzRpB4tw3tq9knBgyFxWSdtExc4tJ3CURzF7wA4Go1btYy7w2M7hrskbZ1u.jpg) #
*Walking on volcanic rock🌏🧭 / Caminando en roca volcanica*📍🌏
![IMG_1348.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wC5mxYajyswU2VEk11Jz1jsMQtbbC6yocbfBBpebsFk9h4PSoTcjccQ1wMffCQeLGDj.JPG) ![IMG_1349.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/243fkQfq1UgovhkDhtEmKS2QRooCfvzDuk6nxuCAAQBG6q8o96KwGYkdGyAojphyWn2b5.JPG) ![IMG_1350.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23rB7DEHqZea8TLjVYfpZesBaKyTSCpUQNYCfWeYi1v8RmVXfLxfRFXibDjYgQ4GXNnZ6.JPG) ![IMG_1355.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uFPPvkpPdtMqHrdAyERAKNH2wFMTTpoHov47Qms1KG6m8C64QsaufukhVzmqxpkm8tk.JPG)
One of the most interesting and challenging parts of the trail is when we enter the cooled volcanic lava. The terrain is quite dangerous, with sharp rocks and very dark sections where you can hardly see any trees growing—just a few bushes! By the time you reach this point, you have already completed almost half of the trail.🏞️🚙🏔️
Una de las partes más interesantes del sendero, y también la más dura, es cuando entramos en la lava volcánica fría. El terreno es bastante peligroso, con rocas filosas y tramos muy oscuros; ¡no se ven árboles creciendo aquí, apenas algunos arbustos! Al llegar a esta parte, ya habremos completado casi la mitad del sendero.🌋🌋🌋
![20260520_082310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eou6HjTDFUtoEfiBf6sFYPUCS6P4JA771w95F6ddqyA4pKue2fKRGdNfxPJveoNDyyc.jpg)

#
*Forests of the Giants🌏🧭 / Bosques de los gigantes*📍🌏
![IMG_1377.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wWpSsRYz6Z7SBFKhhBh483FLWBDC3g5dTw4ZKUsp6fmhEQb26ThEXvM1ZW73UpPSUKS.JPG) ![IMG_1381.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uFMUcTpgNJy2ELmTX1bx8GJsFmoyN3KLd5tN4euynigp19KnRhyuzM2WXTWhgtjKyLh.JPG) ![IMG_1391.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wgDXq5ToPpYg6N6JPL64RcxkX4ZDiG9ERaaoAiACPGLR2KvBKXSETtgpMwCTkgqwexj.JPG) ![IMG_1406.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xoxAQG8YdBx41o9s6Uk7m4qB45TMFHU43c6mSrbjzXjh3ra35omYwMkKc9JBr6MEQRF.JPG) ![IMG_1410.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhqassvdMWiJapqNxxztFyU2FVWgPQp26hiGXvJArKUSJCMH6Pon4ehAM9sqx9BUxA9.JPG)
La naturaleza aquí es asombrosa; nos recuerda lo pequeños que somos en un mundo tan gigante. Estos árboles endémicos de la isla hacen que el sendero sea único en todo el mundo junto con sus raíces. Al final, me quedaron los pies doliendo, jaja, ¡hay muchas piedras!🗺️✅
Nature here is amazing; it reminds us how small we are in such a giant world. These trees, endemic to the island, make the trail unique in the entire world, especially with their labyrinth of roots. My feet were so sore afterward—haha, there are just a lot of rocks!🚙🏞️
![IMG_1399.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23r1khhMB5Mz1oeKqspaXj98z4Xp1KRMyU2HcPUu5YTSsME9G2acD2hTkZwYYi3B15qGm.JPG) #
*Final section of the trail🌏🧭 /Tramo final del sendero*📍🌏
![IMG_1423.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhwMxNnTTVp1XoHZZV7Nw6in1NTe21Pg5hHUNZH648zD4xSWntUDiajy7sNAkNGUEyh.JPG) ![IMG_1426.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23w2eTGJusLWJyrrNGqSzyiBEcKjas3FzFGfgyV5MbyQTT2FvAjsWDn9L6kLkcVoKcHdf.JPG) ![IMG_1430.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23w2gc5e2NgJxPuJRESRcp2ChBccHRo98P49CHqJNCJMAnk9CCibR48c9f36vKYfRBNCw.JPG) ![IMG_1431.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246arEkDtihcVZnhz1vgGbR1z84ijT6fFQRMKkqKwPfKBhnmc5tMGC12WTaGsaWiqf14v.JPG) ![IMG_1433.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242Y5ywaapvtjTdu9khrP4bQmnH5ATTyMfU8gDyjJGBn7rNKKrorPWVjMYhGypzMJpNjK.JPG) ![IMG_1439.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23zvBHmqLihh17EoGL9TDFft4v7unDxUFohewsFDXL3GCQNViU66AFxuXnLu69wnCxib7.JPG) ![IMG_1442.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246axpfjYAhJSQ8ypKtdtm2hu6NRDFsV5JqxEN6vfoRCCPBXD7Ace19Ad5L7kfjYqJqT6.JPG) ![IMG_1445.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23zvF6CBXqAdnqRot4duyb4ZiyF1F5mYYQq6wFx6LR2XCjM9SxyXNmEECCjsgsBHxZsG7.JPG)
We left the forest, and this is the easiest part of the trail; now we walk 1 km along the road. The landscape changes, and we see mountains, green scenery, and lots of moss and bushes. Honestly, I thoroughly enjoyed the trail. I don't usually repeat trails, but I would do this one again without hesitation—perhaps in the summer when the light gives it a special touch.🗺️🌋
Salimos del bosque, y esta es la parte más fácil del sendero: ahora caminamos un kilómetro por la carretera. El paisaje cambia y ahora vemos montañas y escenarios verdes con mucho musgo y arbustos. Honestamente, disfruté el sendero; no soy de repetir trilhos, pero este lo haría de nuevo sin pensármelo, sobre todo en una época de verano, donde quizás la luz le da un toque especial.🏔️🌏

links.title: New dress for Vasylisa
links.body:
![IMG_5700.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYt1qQSRBGG2DyKw6z8rp3aPJ4egU573QZKL4LmPifUzD/IMG_5700.jpeg)

Who remembers - well, and who did not know - meet - Vasylisa. Or just Vasya. Chihuahua of my friend Maria from Irpin.

Irpin is a city near Kyiv that some people know from the news of March 2022. This is one of the first places that came into the occupation of the russian fascists. Maria then took out three cats and and a rat. I didn't leave anyone. Then she came back and rebuilt her life.

And in the midst of all this, I dreamed of a chihuahua.

Well, what? War is war, and small dreams do not go anywhere. On the contrary, after such a thing, you somehow especially understand that \

is not always about reality. So the day came when we went to get the puppy. A small warm ball that did not yet know what was waiting for him.

And the following was waiting for him: Bengal cats, a sphinx, and - most importantly - a wardrobe 😄 Maria either buys clothes for Vasya or sews herself. A pink jumpsuit with ears is, as you can see, not an accident, it is a lifestyle.

Vasya has grown up. Became an adult and very serious - how serious can a chihuahua in a bunny costume be. He barks at everything that moves, considers himself the greatest and generally a dog with a firm life position.

links.title: Zabójczy barok i cyfrowy terror. Recenzja „Akordu” W.P. Rdzanka
links.body:
>

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23vhWDHbctGARwrBSxmt2kCdTvPdtHueZf3i6WGwM7rpJPZou63KchwXvJLnVPprShxZx.jpg)

---

Niedawno nadrabiałem zaległości i pisałem o [„Algorytmie”](https://peakd.com/hive-134382/@lesiopm/k225) – pierwszej części trylogii „AI-agent. Mroczne kody” autorstwa tajemniczego W.P. Rdzanka. Zgodnie z zapowiedziami, w maju na księgarskie półki wjechała druga część zatytułowana „Akord”, a na wielki finał przyjdzie nam poczekać zaledwie do sierpnia. Przyznam, że takie tempo wydawnicze w przypadku debiutanta na rynku literackim jest po prostu oszałamiające i cholernie zaskakujące.

### O co tak naprawdę chodzi w tej historii?

Choć „Akord” to bezpośrednia kontynuacja „Algorytmu”, książka została skonstruowana tak sprytnie, że spokojnie mogłaby funkcjonować jako samodzielny byt. Punktem wyjścia jest niecodzienne odkrycie: niemiecki antykwariusz odnajduje w Żarach zaginiony, nieznany dotąd utwór barokowego mistrza Georga Philippa Telemanna. Sielanka nie trwa jednak długo – chwilę później zwłoki mężczyzny zostają znalezione w jednym z warszawskich hoteli.

Śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa przejmuje podkomisarz Ewa Dzik. Sprawą błyskawicznie interesuje się jednak ABW, które deleguje na miejsce kapitana Zygmunta Fiszera – asa od cyberbezpieczeństwa. Fiszer początkowo czuje się jak ryba bez wody, bo klasyczne morderstwo w pokoju hotelowym nijak ma się do jego wirtualnej działki, niemniej rutynowo zabezpiecza elektronikę zabitego Niemca.

Zanim śledczy zdołają złapać jakikolwiek konkretny trop, nad Europą dochodzi do serii katastrof lotniczych. Pięć maszyn transportowych, które wystartowały z belgijskiego Liège, rozbija się we Francji, Niemczech i nad Morzem Północnym. Rdzanek rezygnuje z tradycyjnych materiałów wybuchowych i stawia na nowoczesną broń cyfrową: wirusa, który infekuje i całkowicie blokuje systemy sterowania samolotami.

Odpowiedzialność za zamachy bierze na siebie enigmatyczna organizacja „Dzień Wolności”. W swoim manifeście określają się jako „ostatni bastion społeczeństwa i układ odpornościowy planety, który uruchomił się, by zwalczyć chorobę”. Tą chorobą są według nich zaawansowane prace nad sztuczną inteligencją, a terroryści żądają natychmiastowego i nieodwracalnego zatrzymania wszelkich projektów związanych z GenAI.

Fiszer prosi o pomoc genialnego programistę Karola Koppela, by ten prześwietlił złośliwe oprogramowanie znalezione na telefonie zamordowanego antykwariusza. Koppel przeżywa absolutny wstrząs – z przerażeniem odkrywa, że źródłem potęgi terrorystów jest jego własne, dawne dzieło. Zrozumienie tego faktu uruchamia morderczy wyścig z czasem. Koppel musi dowiedzieć się, jak jego kod sprzed lat wpadł w niepowołane ręce, i w tym celu rusza na lodowatą Alaskę. W międzyczasie Dzik i Fiszer wpadają na trop narzędzia zbrodni, które uśmierciło Niemca oraz dwoje nastolatków w metrze. Tym biologicznym, zabójczym narzędziem okazuje się... zaginiony utwór Telemanna, zagrany w odpowiednim, „śmiertelnym” tempie.

### Moje wrażenia: Czy „Akord” przebija „Algorytm”? Zdecydowanie tak!

W.P. Rdzanek ma niebywały dar do tworzenia historii dynamicznych, nowoczesnych i piekielnie aktualnych. Autor doskonale wyczuwa lęki współczesnego społeczeństwa przed technologią i przekuwa je w opowieść, od której nie sposób się oderwać.

Autorowi udała się rzecz niezwykle rzadka: wplótł motyw klasycznej muzyki barokowej w realia cyfrowego terroryzmu w sposób absolutnie przekonujący. Połączenie XVIII-wiecznej partytury z hakerskim atakiem mogłoby brzmieć jak szalona, przekombinowana improwizacja, a jednak w „Akordzie” to po prostu żre. Zrobiło to na mnie takie wrażenie, że po odłożeniu książki od razu zacząłem wertować sieć, by sprawdzić, kim naprawdę był Telemann i ile jego dzieł faktycznie zaginęło w mrokach dziejów. Dla mnie to najlepszy znak jakości – dobra powieść to taka, która zmusza cię do szukania głębiej.

Rdzanek świetnie buduje napięcie. Nie jest ono tanie, bo płynie z wielu niezależnych źródeł. Autor tka skomplikowaną sieć interesów, politycznych gier i technologicznych zawiłości, a mnogość wątków z czasem idealnie wskakuje na swoje miejsce.

W przypadku „Algorytmu” moim głównym zarzutem było nierówne rozłożenie akcentów na poszczególnych bohaterów. W „Akordzie” ten problem znika. Być może autor wyciągnął wnioski, a być może ta pędząca na złamanie karku akcja tak mocno wciągnęła mnie od pierwszych stron, że po prostu przestałem zwracać uwagę na drobniejsze potknięcia. Nie mogę się doczekać, żeby poznać finał tej historii.

### Ocena: 8/10 ⭐

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23tGc16tr48Mkf9SwQDSXJZmcemRd6S3KYkvTY3UK8aaBFwRzc3NpSsBT8xY1DFSnRLpq.jpg)

<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

links.title: Talanx AG ein schlechtes Vorzeichen der Versicherer
links.body: /> * * * Today, we have another gem from the MDAX with some serious potential. Many stocks have run incredibly hot lately, and Talanx AG is definitely one of them. Similar to Munich Re, which I analyzed earlier, this insurance stock seems to be under a bad sign—at least when it comes to the technical indicators. Ever since it crossed the €40 mark, it has basically gone straight up without ever really stopping to catch its breath. After more than doubling, we were given another chance to jump on the bandwagon at €88. Following a fresh rally starting right from that €88 level, we managed to peak at the €125 mark. That’s where the consolidation kicked in, and since then, the stock has been slowly but surely heading south. However, this sluggish price action might have come to an end, and if it breaks below the €103 level, all hell will break loose. Insurers seem to carry a bad omen right now and could turn out to be this year's losers. The €88 level is likely the first target and would be my Take Profit 1 (TP1), before the stock gathers momentum to pull back all the way to the €40 mark. Of course, if we manage to build up new strength and trigger positive signals, the overall sentiment could brighten up again. Generally speaking, if you look at the stock prices, the insurance sector is still in an uptrend. However, the high valuations are no reason to add to positions right now—it's definitely better to wait for a bargain.

/>

Quelle: stock3

Heute mal wieder ein Schmuckstück aus dem MDAX mit Potenzial. Viele Aktien sind ja sehr heiß gelaufen und eine davon ist die Talanx AG. Diese Versicherung ist ähnlich wie die Münchner Rück, die ich zuvor analysiert habe unter einem schlechten Stern, zumindestens, was die Signaltechnik angeht. Seit der 40 € Marke ging es eigentlich nur noch aufwärts und das ohne einmal richtig Luft zu holen.

Nach mehr als einer Verdoppelung haben wir noch mal eine Chance bei der 88 € bekommen, um auf den Zug aufzuspringen. Nach einem erneuten Satz mit Startpunkt 88 € kamen wir bis zur Spitze an die 125 € Marke. Hier fing die Konsolidierung anschließend an, und seither ging es langsam, aber sicher wieder Richtung Süden. Diese langweilige Bewegung könnte aber ein Ende gefunden haben und mit Ausbruch unter der 103 € Marke ist eh Holland in Not.

Versicherer haben anscheinend ein schlechtes Omen und könnten die Verlierer sein in diesem Jahr. Die 88 € Marke ist wohl das erste Ziel und wäre ein TP eins für mich um anschließend noch mal mit Schwung an die 40 € Marke zurück zu laufen. Sollten wir natürlich neue Kraft schöpfen und positive Signale triggern, dann, so könnte sich das Stimmungsbild wieder bessern. Generell ist ja zu sagen, wir befinden uns in einem Aufwärtstrend in der Versicherungsbranche, wenn ich mir so die Aktienkurse anschaue. Die hohen Bewertungen sind aber kein Grund noch mal nachzulegen, da wartet man doch lieber auf ein Schnäppchen.

links.title: Stir-Fried Rice Noodles with Fish Meatballs
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQZH6GCk2gmGTicmnKoXweFqDfom39ncWqhht9BFhxa2/1780938397282.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today I’m going to share a special stir-fried rice noodle recipe topped with fish meatballs, a generous serving that feeds 7 people. The flavor is spicy, sweet, and savory, and it pairs perfectly with the egg and the seafood toppings and I use fish meatballs as the topping. Let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- 5 sheets of rice noodles
- 1 egg
- 10 fish meatballs
- 1 stalk of green onion
- 1 stalk of celery
- ground spices (shallots, garlic, ground chili, candlenuts blended)
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp salt
- soy sauce
- sweet soy sauce
- oyster sauce
- cooking oil
- 50 ml water

**Instructions:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVmqi3RGoBatVmhXoW4XKebDL1gp1kVG7Z4ZnNBws8yjE/1780938424504.jpg)

- Prepare the rice noodles by soaking them in cold water for 20 minutes

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMyg57rDe8ejvNUfqRUjpjHRCrpMT5FXS6cm7kff1wLa/1780938454828.jpg)

- Sauté the ground spices with enough cooking oil in a pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQjQK4zupnG3BxJ2mMKpETmzDgBcK1FMa9vKG1FjQc8nG/1780938473618.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNrkk2sBxXqUDRzASmxHhL7cgtB3DhsnUg1WdcQntXvdV/1780938473803.jpg)

- Once fragrant, add the fish balls to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbpatEkfZMHxLvjyCKZYEQYHMcgTup2chdSSCSUuK3Esa/1780938519581.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPuDCb8MzGoUqJ1XJL1Y2kZqFJeEVsokX9Fzmnsknz5r5/1780938519815.jpg)

- Add the seasoning (pepper, salt, soy sauce, and sweet soy sauce) to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZdQxHsFEHQGZKKJ9yXEEdENv4aTCHkUoJBxbjwexKxZU/1780938492552.jpg)

- Stir until well combined

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPquyh9pF6FkiFqzw9UhTgvNYd2BiowQhUpcX3VbETEL5/1780938584743.jpg)

- Crack 1 egg and add it to the pan

# Learn Zig Series (#73) - seccomp and Sandboxing

![zig.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHuB6qTWHaSpJHQ1S8FCCRmNQuUxTcPZdU4yKHsJ7vEP/zig-banner.png)

### What will I learn
- What seccomp is and how it restricts which system calls a process can make at the kernel level;
- How to enable seccomp strict mode (read/write/exit/sigreturn only) from Zig using the prctl syscall;
- How seccomp-bpf filter mode works and how to build BPF filter programs that whitelist specific syscalls;
- How to construct a practical sandbox that blocks file creation and network access while allowing normal computation;
- How to test and verify that your sandbox actually works by triggering blocked syscalls and catching the failures;
- How to combine seccomp with other Linux isolation mechanisms (no_new_privs, rlimits, namespaces) for defense in depth;
- How OpenBSD's pledge/unveil model compares to seccomp and what a pledge-like wrapper looks like in Zig.

### Requirements
- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- An installed Zig 0.14+ distribution (download from ziglang.org);
- The ambition to learn Zig programming.

- Intermediate

# Learn Zig Series (#73) - seccomp and Sandboxing

## Solutions to Episode 72 Exercises

**Exercise 1: Syscall tracer using PTRACE_SYSCALL**

```zig
const std = @import(\
, .{});\n    const key = try readOneKeyRaw(0);\n    try stdout.print(\

, .{ key, if (key >= 32 and key < 127) key else '.' });
}
```

The critical detail is restoring the original termios on exit -- even on error. The `defer setTermios(fd, orig) catch {}` ensures cleanup happens regardless of how the function exits. Without this, a crash leaves the terminal in raw mode (no echo, no line buffering) which is seriously annoying.

**Exercise 3: memfd-based IPC channel with futex synchronization**

```zig
const std = @import(\

? That's exactly what **seccomp** does, and it's one of the most powerful security mechanisms Linux offers. Docker uses it. Chrome uses it. Systemd uses it. Flatpak, Firejail, bubblewrap -- all seccomp under the hood. Today we're building our own seccomp filters from scratch in Zig ;-)

## What seccomp is and why it matters

**seccomp** (secure computing mode) is a Linux kernel feature that restricts which system calls a process is allowed to make. It operates at the kernel level -- there's no userspace bypass. Once you install a seccomp filter, the kernel checks EVERY single syscall against your rules before executing it. A blocked syscall either kills the process (SECCOMP_RET_KILL) or returns an error (SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO).

The name comes from the original \

mode introduced in Linux 2.6.12 (2005), which allowed only `read()`, `write()`, `_exit()`, and `sigreturn()`. That's it -- four syscalls. Anything else and the kernel immediately kills your process with SIGKILL. Strict mode is still available and useful for things like processing untrusted data where you genuinely don't need the filesystem or network.

The more flexible **seccomp-bpf** (filter mode) was added in Linux 3.5 (2012). It lets you write a BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) program that inspects each syscall's number and arguments, then decides what to do. BPF is the same technology used for network packet filtering -- it's a small register-based virtual machine that runs inside the kernel, verified to be safe before loading.

Let's start with strict mode since it's the simplest to understand:

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{});
}
```

Notice the subtlety: we must use `_exit` (syscall 60), NOT `exit_group` (syscall 231). The `posix.exit()` function calls `exit_group`, which is NOT in the strict mode whitelist. In strict mode, even your cleanup code can kill you if it calls the wrong syscall. That's the whole point -- the filter is absolutely merciless.

## Building BPF filter programs for seccomp

Strict mode is too restrictive for most real programs. You usually need more than four syscalls but definitely less than 450. That's where **seccomp-bpf** comes in. You write a BPF program (a small bytecode program) that the kernel executes on every syscall entry. The program inspects the syscall number and arguments, then returns an action:

- `SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW` -- let the syscall proceed
- `SECCOMP_RET_KILL` -- kill the process immediately (SIGKILL)
- `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_THREAD` -- kill just the calling thread
- `SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO` -- make the syscall return an error (you choose which errno)
- `SECCOMP_RET_TRAP` -- send SIGSYS to the process (useful for logging)
- `SECCOMP_RET_LOG` -- allow but log it
- `SECCOMP_RET_TRACE` -- notify a ptrace tracer

The BPF instruction format is simple -- 8 bytes per instruction with an opcode, jump targets, and a value field:

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{ pass, fail });
}
```

This is what matters in practice. A lot of people install seccomp filters and never verify them. The attacker will verify them for you, and that's a much worse time to discover you forgot to block `execve`. Run your tests in CI, run them on every kernel upgrade, run them whenever you change the filter.

## Defense in depth: layering seccomp with other isolation

Seccomp is powerful but it only controls WHICH syscalls can be made. It doesn't restrict file paths, network addresses, or memory layouts. For a proper sandbox, you want multiple layers. As we covered in episode 71, rlimits control resource consumption. Combined with seccomp and `no_new_privs`, you get a process that can't escape its syscall jail, can't gain privileges, and can't consume unlimited resources:

```zig

Everything else is invisible.

Compared to seccomp, pledge/unveil are much more ergonomic. You don't write BPF bytecode -- you write human-readable permission strings. But they're OpenBSD-only. On Linux, the equivalent requires combining seccomp (for syscall filtering), Landlock (for filesystem access control, added in Linux 5.13), and namespaces (for network and PID isolation).

Here's what a pledge-like wrapper looks like in Zig, mapping pledge categories to seccomp whitelists:

```zig

, .{});
}
```

This is a simplified version -- real pledge handles more categories and edge cases. But the core idea works: higher-level security APIs on top of raw BPF, no kernel modifications needed. Having said that, Landlock (filesystem access control similar to unveil, added in Linux 5.13) is gaining adoption, so the ecosystem is moving in the right direction.

## A sandboxed file parser: putting it all together

Let's build something practical -- a file parser that can only read one specific file. This is a common pattern for processing untrusted input: you want to parse a file (maybe an image, a PDF, a config) but you don't trust the parser code to be bug-free. A sandbox ensures that even if the parser has a buffer overflow or other vulnerability, the attacker can't do anything useful with it:

```zig
const std = @import(\

pattern -- observe what a program actually calls, then generate a strict filter. Test by profiling a program, then running it with the generated filter.

3. Implement a **pledge-like API with narrowing** -- the program starts with `pledge_narrow(.{ .stdio = true, .rpath = true, .inet = true })` then later drops network with `pledge_narrow(.{ .stdio = true, .rpath = true })`. Each call installs a new seccomp filter (they stack -- kernel runs all and takes the most restrictive). Verify by making a request, narrowing, then trying another request (should get EPERM).

## Thanks for your time!

- **seccomp** restricts which system calls a process can make, enforced by the kernel -- no userspace bypass possible
- **Strict mode** allows only read, write, _exit, and sigreturn -- use it when processing untrusted data with zero need for filesystem or network
- **seccomp-bpf** lets you write BPF filter programs that inspect syscall numbers and arguments, returning allow/kill/errno/trap per call
- `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` is mandatory before installing unprivileged seccomp filters -- it prevents privilege escalation through exec
- **Whitelist over blacklist** -- default-deny with explicit allows is the correct approach because new syscalls are automatically blocked
- The **open-before-sandbox** pattern (parent opens resources, child inherits fds, child installs seccomp) is used by OpenSSH, Chrome, and other security-critical software
- Combining seccomp with rlimits, no_new_privs, and eventually Landlock gives you defense in depth where each layer catches what the others miss
- OpenBSD's pledge/unveil are more ergonomic than seccomp-bpf, but you can build a similar high-level API on top of raw BPF filters in Zig

*A LOT of backtracking as I don't know where to go next in this session, luckily, I'm in the later parts of the Umbrella Training Facility...*

----

**Resident Evil: Zero** is a prequel to the Resident Evil series set right before the mansion incident. The game follows the new STARS member Rebecca and the wanted criminal Billy as they try to survive zombie outbreak! **RE0** features a Dual Protagonists system letting the player switch seamlessly between Rebecca and Billy. Most puzzles require coordination between the two characters.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb51ZWXX1A9cHzfW8XHHjkeTSo2BSUjSYerQZHauNLQzz/1000072766.webp

There are fewer zombies in this game, instead there's a lot of Leeches and feral animals.

While I'd recommend this game to Resident Evil fans, I'm not too fond of how slow the game feels. Too much backtracking. Some Puzzles feel like too much filler, but I loved a few puzzles in my playthrough. I used a guide when I got stuck though... You can watch my playthrough below:

links.title: MLB:  Ofensiva encendida  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
links.body:
Parece una tendencia que comienza recién entrado junio: los bates se han encendido conforme el calor del verano asoma por estos días en la MLB. Lo sabemos porque ayer vivimos otra jornada jonronera para el contingente venezolano. Pero además, fue una fecha histórica. El receptor suplente de los Angelinos de Los Ángeles, Sebastián Rivero, impulsó seis carreras y conectó cinco imparables en la aplastante victoria de 13 por 5 frente a los Dodgers. ¿Por qué fue histórica? De los diez receptores en los anales de las Mayores que han tenido una jornada de esa magnitud (5 hits y 6 remolcadas), Sebastián se convirtió en el único en empujar tal cantidad de anotaciones sin conectar un cuadrangular. Oportuno, por decir lo menos. Y es que el muchacho necesita mostrarse, ya que transita por su cuarta temporada en el Big Show sin mayor pena ni gloria. ¿Lo positivo? Los Angelinos parecen haber depositado su confianza en él porque lo están alineando con mayor frecuencia: en lo que va de zafra, ya superó la cantidad de partidos jugados en cada una de sus campañas previas. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Looks like a trend taking shape early in June. Bats are heating up as summer weather rolls into MLB. We know this because yesterday was another long-ball clinic for the Venezuelan contingent. But it was also a historic day: the Angels' backup catcher, Sebastián Rivero, drove in six runs and went 5-for-5 in a 13-5 blowout against the Dodgers. Why historic? Of the 10 catchers in MLB history with that exact same stat line (5 hits and 6 RBIs), Sebastián became the only backstop to knock in that many without hitting a dinger. Talk about clutch. The kid needs to showcase himself because he's in his fourth big league season and hasn't really panned out yet. The upside? The Halos seem to trust him, pencil him into the lineup more often, and he has already surpassed his game total from any previous campaign this year.

# ---

![Rivero.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wgd2boU6k7JjptbMHf671JAMy62Mv4qouGJN4zY4F6CWkwWS5SvnhJkjPzoX1CppYyq.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/angels-vs-dodgers/2026/06/07/823941/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Impulsar seis carreras sin botar la pelota es una rareza estadística en el béisbol. ¿Por qué? Aunque el swing oportuno depende del bateador, la responsabilidad de embasarse corre por cuenta de sus compañeros. Así las cosas, en su primer y segundo turno al bate, Rivero encontró las bases congestionadas y respondió con sendos sencillos detrás del camarero para traer las primeras cuatro carreras del equipo (dos por cada turno). En su tercera oportunidad, conectó un indiscutible solitario. Otro sencillo remolcador en la alta del séptimo ponía la pizarra 9-5 sobre los Dodgers, y abriendo el noveno, terminó de cerrar su ciclo perfecto al largar su único extrabase del juego: un doblete que trajo la sexta rayita impulsada para el nativo de Maracay. Su rostro de felicidad quedó capturado en la imagen que adorna nuestra publicación justo arriba de estas líneas. Aplausos de pie para él. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Driving in 6 RBIs without a dinger is a total freak stat line. Why? Because while a clutch swing is up to the hitter, getting on base is on his teammates. Here is how it went: in his first two frames, he stepped up with the bags packed and delivered back-to-back knocks right past second base, driving in the team's first four runs with two RBIs per piece. He ripped a base hit in his third at-bat with no one on. Another RBI single in the top of the seventh pushed the lead to 9-5 over the Dodgers, and leading off the ninth, he capped off a perfect day at the dish with his only extra-base hit—a double that brought home the sixth ribbie for the Maracay native. The pure joy on his face is captured in the image right above. Give it up for him.

# ---

![Piñango.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/243zZRGjPQHRK7JTGEiuV1yNb85rEQVttdv7ArpsMqpf3nKQMKPySJRqBNUTkWXEw9UHD.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/orioles-vs-blue-jays/2026/06/07/822807/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El Rogers Centre de Toronto es un escenario histórico. Ha pasado por múltiples remodelaciones, pero sigue siendo el mismo parque donde los Azulejos han mantenido su franquicia estacionada desde su fundación en la MLB. Debido a que las paredes de las esquinas están muy cerca del terreno, la transmisión de televisión no pudo enfocar por completo al jardinero de los Orioles, quien perseguía una línea ceñida a la raya bateada por el camarero venezolano Andrés Giménez, un batazo que impulsó la carrera del empate a cuatro. El público estalló de alegría porque el equipo local venía de atrás con un rally de cinco anotaciones en el cierre del sexto tramo, justo después de haber sido emboscado en el episodio anterior. ¿Quién encendió la chispa ofensiva en esa entrada? El guardabosques novato criollo Yohendrick Piñango, con un soberbio estacazo que recorrió 423 pies desde el plato. Al final, los Azulejos se llevaron la victoria con pizarra de 6-4 y continúan en la persecución de los Rays y los Yankees, quienes se mantienen a la vanguardia del Este de la Americana. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The Rogers Centre in Toronto is a historic venue. It has undergone plenty of facelifts, but it remains the same yard the Blue Jays have called home since their MLB inception. The outfield walls down the lines are right on top of the action, which is why the TV broadcast completely lost track of the Orioles' outfielder chasing down a bullet ripped by Venezuelan second baseman Andrés Giménez—a line drive hugging the chalk that drove in the game-tying run to make it 4-4. The home crowd went absolutely wild as the club capped a 5-run comeback in the bottom of the 6th, right after getting ambushed the inning before. Who ignited that rally? Rookie Venezuelan outfielder Yohendrick Piñango, who crushed a monster 423-foot bomb. In the end, the Blue Jays locked down a 6-4 victory and keep chasing the Rays and Yankees for the top spot in the AL East.

---

![Moreno.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wgRzPoYaB1AAfbBddXNGW9KHEvsXpYQFCP6aCEUcjJtw2NKsUksLXNGau2A4mLACPig.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/nationals-vs-d-backs/2026/06/07/825074/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Los Diamondbacks de Arizona siguen jugando un béisbol aguerrido en su empeño por darle alcance a los Dodgers de Los Ángeles. Ayer aprovecharon al máximo la jornada para recortar distancias, beneficiados por la derrota que reseñamos en el primer bloque de esta publicación. Su sorprendente abridor, Michael Soroka, volvió a responder sobre la lomita al tolerar apenas tres imparables y una carrera, además de ponchar a seis rivales, en ruta a una victoria de Arizona 5 por 1 sobre los Nacionales de Washington. El receptor venezolano Gabriel Moreno contribuyó a la tranquilidad de su serpentinero cuando, en el cierre del quinto inning, pescó un cambio de velocidad a 86 MPH y depositó la pelota en el bullpen visitante. Ese cuadrangular con un compañero a bordo puso el encuentro 4-1. El marcador final se selló en 5-1 y los ofidios se consolidan en el segundo lugar de la División Oeste de la Liga Nacional. Volveremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The Arizona Diamondbacks keep grinding away in their hunt to catch the Los Angeles Dodgers. They took full advantage of yesterday's slate to gain some ground, thanks to the Dodgers' blowout loss mentioned in the first block of this post. Out-of-nowhere starter Michael Soroka delivered once again, dealing a 3-hitter with just one run allowed and fanning six in a 5-1 Arizona victory over the Washington Nationals. Venezuelan backstop Gabriel Moreno gave his starter some breathing room in the bottom of the fifth when he sat on an 86 MPH changeup and parked it deep into the visitors' bullpen for a 2-run blast, making it a 4-1 ballgame. 5-1 was the final score, and the Snakes hold strong in second place in the NL West. We'll be back.

links.title: Islami Bank ATM Disaster and My Field Technical Experience.
links.body:
> ![IMG20260608152624~3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQVE2qsvRtUWLtFrfMfYy1rjKRJmUz5x5URQGwbJB7Ghx/IMG20260608152624~3.jpg)  We realize how important banking services, especially ATM services, are in our daily lives when the entire system suddenly goes down. Today, I faced such an unprecedented and extremely challenging technical problem, which will be a great experience in field engineering life. Suddenly, the system of about 1000 ATM booths of Islami Bank across the country froze simultaneously. Only coding and technical error messages were displayed on the screen. When customers were suffering and making noise all around, I got an urgent call to activate the machine of an important booth. ![IMG20260608112321~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9kvbZVYvq26uqZ9xNCr8sCos6Btg3twYwtNbN7u7osc/IMG20260608112321~2.jpg) Upon reaching the spot, I realized that the problem was quite complex by looking at the condition of the machine screen. This was not a simple local hardware crash. As a first step, I turned off the main power of the machine and disconnected the LAN cable so that the network loop or central could not hit any command repeatedly. Then when I tried to access the admin panel of the machine, a new problem arose. The machine was not stabilizing at all and was repeatedly auto-restarting. ![IMG20260608115819~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwfRbotWgZVpTjqvVVKajcemkboVqp4otGhye69uwXf2/IMG20260608115819~2.jpg) Due to repeated restarts, it became impossible to give commands at the OS level. With great patience, I tried my best for about 30 minutes, matching each step perfectly with the reboot timing. Finally, I was able to access the admin panel successfully. I went there and completed the necessary system configuration recovery and backend urgent tasks step by step. Later, I found out that the problem originally started from the central head office. While making a major update or configuration change to the server or system, the backend team of the head office messed up the entire data communication. The chain reaction of which created this system freeze condition in all the machines across the country. ![IMG20260607133507~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX9F9cLNmPV99jTgU77awT6jwK6VDBpsLyXWo7t3m7Xa2/IMG20260607133507~2.jpg) After completing all the work, when I reconnected the LAN cable and fully activated the machine and put it live, it was as if a big stone had been lifted from my chest. Then I punched the ATM card myself and checked the live transaction. When the money came out of the machine successfully, the long mental and physical fatigue disappeared in an instant. There can be no greater satisfaction for a technician than this. Everyone stay well, I will come forward with more such real experiences of the world inside technology. Thank you all. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

links.title: Green garden looper (Chrysodeixis eriosoma)
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSuTaEKRGgB8XX7brQC9iKqwR99o9XbfYpRpHTjzEjHrD/20260606_181627.jpg)


| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Chrysodeixis eriosoma*** | Jun 06, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

In the nature around us, especially in vegetable or crop fields, various types of caterpillars or larvae can be seen. Among them, one of the most interesting and excellent subjects for macro photography is this caterpillar, which is called '**Green garden looper**' in English. In some countries like New Zealand, it is also known as 'Silver Y'. Interestingly, it bends the middle of its back like a bow while walking, creating a 'loop' or noose, and it has been named so from this strange way of walking.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhm21ARAfDLGxrKNmZtsdmDTwrK4NNUnC6tF2T8hcD1o/20260606_181709.jpg)

​Scientific name:
In the scientific classification of biology, the name of this moth or insect is **Chrysodeixis eriosoma**. The scientist Doubleday was the first to give this name and description in 1843. It also has an old or synonymous name in the scientific world, which is Plusia eriosoma.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFBrqAnTBq65rdmebDfkUmVdAvH9sN8wSH2sxdTZbcSX/20260606_181707.jpg)

Family and Genus:
This moth is mainly included in the order Lepidoptera under the vast phylum Arthropoda and class Insecta. Going deeper into the classification, it can be seen that they are members of the family Noctuidae and their genus or genus name is Chrysodeixis.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZaahHSPMw2PGPKBQy2CFYDkMKaUqym3JQLEUC1ymaYuo/20260606_181658.jpg)

​Size and Physical Structure:
When the Green Garden Looper is a full-fledged moth, its wingspan is about 42 millimeters. The wings of the full-fledged moth have a reddish tint and a beautiful spot like the letter 'Y' in bright golden color on the front wing. However, their larvae or caterpillars look completely different. A larva can be up to about 4 centimeters long. Their body color is bright green and there are faint white lines running vertically along the sides of the body. Sometimes small black dots can also be seen on their bodies. They do not have two pairs of legs (prolegs) at the front of their bodies, which is why they do not walk upright like other common caterpillars, but rather hop and bend their backs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTP5ou33S31frbpJz3qhqCVhJNFihiuoFthDV1fazfvM/20260606_181701.jpg)

​Habitat and habitat:
The Green Garden Looper is widespread over a large part of the world. They are mainly found in the nature of the Asian continent, from Japan, China, India, Sri Lanka to the Malay Peninsula, Australia and New Zealand. Their presence has even been recorded in the Hawaiian Islands, Russia and some parts of North America. They can usually survive easily from agricultural lands, vegetable gardens and open spaces on the plains to mountainous areas at an altitude of 2600 meters.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX56C1KKxet6SC1NR4VDU162ia8RnhUxMqZ14NQfBmD36/20260606_181640.jpg)

​Food:
These larvae are polyphagous in terms of diet, meaning they are omnivorous and eat leaves of various types of plants. According to researchers, they consume leaves of at least sixty species of plants as food. However, cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower and other cruciferae vegetables are their favorite food. They also eat a lot of Solanaceae plants like tomatoes or potatoes and the leaves of various leguminous plants.

​Reproduction:
The duration of their life cycle mainly depends on the weather and temperature. When they enter the pupa or pupal stage after hatching from eggs, it lasts only a few days in summer. But in winter, this pupa stage can be as long as about a month. After a beautiful full-fledged moth emerges from the pupa, it usually lives for only ten to twelve days in nature.

​Benefits:
Like other insects in nature, they play a specific role in the food chain of the ecosystem. Various types of birds, spiders and predatory insects survive by eating their larvae, which helps maintain the natural balance of the environment. In addition, their full-fledged moths play an indirect role in pollination during their short life cycle.

Harmfulness:
This insect is considered a well-known and serious pest to farmers. Their larvae are so voracious that when they attack crop fields in groups, they quickly eat the leaves of vegetables and trees and make them look dull. Especially when they attack cabbage and bean crops, there is a possibility of huge economic losses to the farmer. Therefore, if their outbreak occurs in agriculture, biological or chemical control measures must be taken quickly.

I hope you like the information.



  I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

links.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXthNmo5r3j8FzVGAgNGRRtqMwQJz1fCwu58UKr7HD6e7/img_5078.jpg)

Sharing a few pictures that I took during today’s sunset. At first, I noticed a bush covered with white flowers, and the sun shining above it made the entire sky glow beautifully with warm sunset colours.

>आज के सूर्यास्त के दौरान ली गई कुछ तस्वीरें शेयर कर रही हूँ। सबसे पहले मेरी नज़र सफेद फूलों से भरी एक झाड़ी पर पड़ी। उसके ऊपर चमकती धूप और पीछे के सूर्यास्त के रंगों ने पूरे आसमान को बेहद खूबसूरत बना दिया था।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpMMUcF1xjNfttFuaKRHj78hsmEzoHMsQSNPZbPeMDG1/img_5079.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcr1t9LVFqtFKyLwodG6GZLPhgXhdLt5jF4Y7NBK74oM4/img_5080.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRPuTiFVqP3zUJs7B3aibqsNUUoHq3jQvDpFotznYfco/img_5081.jpg)

I also tried using a black-and-white filter on some of the pictures, and surprisingly, they looked really good that way too. It completely changed the mood of the images and gave them a very different kind of vibe.

>मैंने कुछ तस्वीरों पर ब्लैक एंड व्हाइट फ़िल्टर भी ट्राय किया, और वे उस अंदाज़ में भी काफी अच्छी लगीं। उन तस्वीरों का पूरा मूड बदल गया था और उनमें एक अलग ही तरह की वाइब आ गई थी।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRLhB8F6B21wnSPAtwhyKcrepS6ZaPKvSAFuZxCYJ8mYZ/img_5082.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQc7Nmv36n5prYpyT9pVnshC67VwvwtHjxF5kPP583kc6/img_5083.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV1AEHRipbHBkYzef9dPmSsn6dSYdtW5wF9NdRRaceZGD/img_5084.jpg)

There were electricity wires crossing the sky and even a car passing through the frame, but instead of avoiding them, I tried framing the sun in a way that everything naturally fit into the composition.

>आसमान के बीच बिजली की तारें भी थीं और एक गाड़ी भी फ्रेम में आ रही थी, लेकिन उन्हें हटाने के बजाय मैंने सूरज को इस तरह फ्रेम करने की कोशिश की कि सब कुछ तस्वीर का हिस्सा लगे।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb8vcw8ArH4PZxmyNva2zHQFG6CwzgbUz9powiJJHAzCb/img_5085.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiYAmbHknhzoss56eoBvqNAwB4qrXUNJFZFnwNHr8vuM/img_5086.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS4eh8ngFjNUShJYUacQYKEuc29it566iW8iCYM5XiwDL/img_5087.jpg)

As I walked a little further ahead, I came across trees and bushes naturally surrounding the sunset, so I stopped there for a while and clicked a few more pictures.

>थोड़ा आगे चलने पर पेड़ और झाड़ियाँ सूर्यास्त को चारों तरफ़ से फ्रेम करते हुए दिखाई दिए, तो वहाँ रुककर मैंने कुछ और तस्वीरें ले लीं।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUuXrqgky1jqaRYv5uKiuhqFBhAfG3mSzuXsJgWuMsZf4/img_5088.jpg)

links.title: Not Every Chapter of Your Life Deserves an Audience
links.body:
Two years ago i went through one of the hardest seasons of my life and i told almost nobody.
Not because i was ashamed. Not because i did not need support. But because i had learned something painful before that. Some things get heavier when too many people are watching. Some healing genuinely needs quiet and privacy to actually work. Some battles change shape the moment you put them on display.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXPau4tgzLjEogcdMPrx7k57PSJqjLRPTHuKD4QWKFtwp/1780937957507.jpg)
[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/excited-crowd-cheering-at-concert-or-event-nPz8akkUmDI)
We live in a time where everything gets shared. Every win, every breakdown, every lesson. And sharing is not bad. Real vulnerability creates real connection and i believe that. But somewhere along the way sharing became performing. And performing is exhausting in a way that is hard to explain until you have done it for long enough.

Not every struggle needs a caption. Not every difficult season needs to be documented in real time for people who will scroll past it between videos. Not every breakthrough requires an announcement so other people can validate that it was real.

Some things are just yours. And protecting that is not hiding or being closed off. It is knowing the difference between genuine vulnerability and just feeding an audience. Between sharing because it helps and sharing because the silence feels uncomfortable.

The most grounded people i have observed in my life are not the loudest ones. They are moving quietly, building slowly, sharing selectively. Their lives do not look like content. They just look like lives. Real ones.

You do not need witnesses for your life to count. You do not need likes for a moment to have been meaningful. You do not need everyone to know what you are going through for it to be real and valid and worth taking seriously.

Some chapters are just for you.
And honestly, those are sometimes the most important ones.

links.title: The Classic Hitman is BACK for a new generation - Remakes [ ENG - ESP ]
links.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wzzVpQn1qSedpvP1kDXrYx9xuPv79zNLCcE5R2mn5yQtNwYWgbngKiRmfhwvqTaBczn.png) --- While many gamers were eagerly awaiting 007 First Light, the new James Bond project developed by IO Interactive, the studio capitalized on the attention generated by the British secret agent to announce another surprise that is sure to thrill stealth fans. The return of Agent 47 is now a reality, and it will come in the form of a remastered collection that will bring back some of the most important games in the history of the Hitman franchise. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7JL3NtkqEq3GbsT19NYfDsdDRXxMjwF99gDm851WBMNPi5oDFXGM8yoi87QLPXfRqd.jpg) --- During events held around Summer Game Fest, IO Interactive confirmed that it is working with Saber Interactive on Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered, a compilation that will bring back the first three titles starring the most famous assassin in video games. The collection will include Hitman: Codename 47, Hitman 2: Silent Assassin, and Hitman: Contracts, three installments that helped define the modern stealth genre and marked the beginning of Agent 47's career. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQiHXRhPm7YxNvbfKh1uQG3dqxnw3LCtsJG11BxjnR81GBXXRBGhRNMeaC6RTaBJTiC.png) --- Far from being a simple port, the developers assure that this new version will offer a significant visual upgrade. The games will feature updated character models, improved environments, and high-resolution textures designed to take advantage of current hardware. The goal is to preserve the essence of the originals while adapting them to modern standards. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7DriYGGUYkGLuTzCyw1bUtMCjksfi4VZPU9Sm9gXJ1ktQeWUwnFVp9VVXVwtdLayfZ.png) --- One of the most interesting details is the ability to switch between the classic and remastered graphics with the touch of a button. This feature will allow players to compare both versions in real time and relive the missions exactly as they remember them or enjoy them with a completely revamped presentation. In addition, the collection will include a photo mode to capture some of the most memorable moments from Agent 47's missions. For many veteran players, the return of these titles represents a perfect opportunity to relive the origins of a franchise that became one of the most influential stealth sagas in the industry. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uFVY5VeD3bnsngVea1heHiCZM4f3WFShLRQHUTa1EgYR1UjmEWfHGU8rw3iZiiqMPU3.png) --- On the other hand, those who discovered the series thanks to the recent World of Assassination trilogy will be able to experience firsthand how the Hitman formula has evolved since its early installments. This news comes at a particularly interesting time for IO Interactive. The studio is not only supporting Hitman: World of Assassination, but is also driving the development of 007: First Light, its ambitious James Bond project. Although much of the media attention is focused on Agent 007, the announcement of this remaster demonstrates that the company hasn't forgotten the franchise that made it one of the genre's leading lights. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2cj6nJo4oMR4ZUkvP8egTfeiZcRpYNfYKHQnTycwDgNuUS4ibpv32ogswzoWNSTAz3.png) --- For now, Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered is scheduled for release in 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. While its release is still some time away, the initial reception among fans of the series has been quite positive, especially due to the commitment to preserving the original gameplay while modernizing its visuals. After years of watching Agent 47 star in increasingly complex and ambitious experiences, it's interesting that IO Interactive has decided to return to its roots. Sometimes, to move forward, it's also necessary to remember where it all began.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wzzVpQn1qSedpvP1kDXrYx9xuPv79zNLCcE5R2mn5yQtNwYWgbngKiRmfhwvqTaBczn.png) --- Mientras muchos jugadores estaban pendientes de 007 First Light, el nuevo proyecto de James Bond desarrollado por IO Interactive, el estudio aprovechó la atención generada por el agente secreto británico para anunciar otra sorpresa que seguramente emocionará a los fanáticos del sigilo. El regreso de Agent 47 ya es una realidad, y lo hará a través de una colección remasterizada que recuperará algunos de los juegos más importantes de la historia de la franquicia Hitman. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7JL3NtkqEq3GbsT19NYfDsdDRXxMjwF99gDm851WBMNPi5oDFXGM8yoi87QLPXfRqd.jpg) --- Durante los eventos celebrados alrededor del Summer Game Fest, IO Interactive confirmó que está trabajando junto a Saber Interactive en Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered, una recopilación que traerá de vuelta los tres primeros títulos protagonizados por el asesino más famoso de los videojuegos. La colección incluirá Hitman: Codename 47, Hitman 2: Silent Assassin y Hitman: Contracts, tres entregas que ayudaron a definir el género del sigilo moderno y que marcaron el inicio de la carrera de Agent 47. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQiHXRhPm7YxNvbfKh1uQG3dqxnw3LCtsJG11BxjnR81GBXXRBGhRNMeaC6RTaBJTiC.png) --- Lejos de tratarse de una simple adaptación, los desarrolladores aseguran que esta nueva versión ofrecerá una importante actualización visual. Los juegos contarán con modelos de personajes renovados, escenarios mejorados y texturas de alta resolución diseñadas para aprovechar el hardware actual. El objetivo es conservar la esencia de los originales mientras se adaptan a los estándares modernos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7DriYGGUYkGLuTzCyw1bUtMCjksfi4VZPU9Sm9gXJ1ktQeWUwnFVp9VVXVwtdLayfZ.png) --- Uno de los detalles más interesantes es la posibilidad de alternar entre los gráficos clásicos y los remasterizados con solo pulsar un botón. Esta característica permitirá a los jugadores comparar ambas versiones en tiempo real y revivir las misiones exactamente como las recuerdan o disfrutarlas con una presentación completamente renovada. Además, la colección incorporará un modo foto para capturar algunos de los momentos más memorables de las misiones de Agent 47. Para muchos jugadores veteranos, el regreso de estos títulos representa una oportunidad perfecta para revivir los orígenes de una franquicia que terminó convirtiéndose en una de las sagas de sigilo más influyentes de la industria. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uFVY5VeD3bnsngVea1heHiCZM4f3WFShLRQHUTa1EgYR1UjmEWfHGU8rw3iZiiqMPU3.png) --- Por otro lado, quienes descubrieron la serie gracias a la reciente trilogía World of Assassination podrán experimentar de primera mano cómo evolucionó la fórmula de Hitman desde sus primeras entregas. La noticia llega en un momento especialmente interesante para IO Interactive. El estudio no solo se encuentra apoyando Hitman World of Assassination, sino que también está impulsando el desarrollo de 007 First Light, su ambicioso proyecto basado en James Bond. Aunque gran parte de la atención mediática está centrada en el agente 007, el anuncio de esta remasterización demuestra que la compañía no ha olvidado a la franquicia que la convirtió en uno de los referentes del género. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2cj6nJo4oMR4ZUkvP8egTfeiZcRpYNfYKHQnTycwDgNuUS4ibpv32ogswzoWNSTAz3.png) --- Por ahora, Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered tiene previsto su lanzamiento para 2027 en PC, PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series X|S. Aunque todavía falta tiempo para su llegada, la recepción inicial entre los seguidores de la saga ha sido bastante positiva, especialmente por el compromiso de preservar la jugabilidad original mientras se moderniza su apartado visual. Después de años viendo a Agent 47 protagonizar experiencias cada vez más complejas y ambiciosas, resulta interesante que IO Interactive haya decidido volver a sus raíces. A veces, para avanzar hacia el futuro, también es necesario recordar dónde comenzó todo.
