body.title: My instinct || my pride
body.body:
Greetings!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTzWpCihtB4ypzFuLBNWSvU5k8mjbFExcnxtEsEaXp7uQ/1780930362532.jpg)

While growing up, one of greatest assets that I have known to be is my instinct as it has always helped me in most of my endeavours most especially when I'm about to choose between two different things. My instinct is so powerful and I have never joked with it nor handled it carelessly since I have known it to be my guide.

Although there were times it failed me, that was when I was beginning to doubt its efficiency and efficacies in my dealing with it, however, ever since I stopped doubting its activities in my journey, it has always been my partner and consultant.

Having said this, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, “instinct.” As simple as this topic might sound, I can say that it's not just an ordinary topic but a topic that carries a deep meaning and a heavy weight.

Like I said earlier, one thing I have been thankful for is my instinct which on so many occasions, have saved me from embarrassment and shame. Before doing things according to my instincts, failure was always the order of the day. Although it wasn't my fault entirely as I believed in listening to people's advice and words of encouragement, one thing I noticed then was that, people used their own template to advise me which on so many occasions wouldn't work for me as what works for A might not really work for B.

However, when I noticed that there's a spirit in me that serves as my guide which is my INSTINCT, I decided to always listen to the spirit no matter how ugly and tough the directive of my instinct could be, I would follow and the end there of is always with a testimonies of success.

I could remember me trying to choose a professional path in Law and Education. Then, my instinct was like I should go for education but when I went around to meet people, all they were saying was that I should go for Law, but since my instinct had worked for me before then, I decided to listen to it and thank God I did so as not doing so would have caused me a lot and this was because the person that I have relied on to sponsor me in the journey through the payment of my huge Law school fee disappointed me even while studying a less expensive course and it's from the time he disappointed me that I decided to move on and that's how my instinct saved me on that particular journey.

Had it been I have listened to people's advice which might have seemed right, I would have dropped out in the middle of the journey, but since I followed my instinct, I was able to finish with a good success at the end.

In conclusion, I would thank God for giving me a good instinct which has always helped in guiding me to success in life.

This is my entry to week 221, episode 01 of the weekly featured contest in the Hive Learners community.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: The story of our past shaped our future.
body.body:
Whenever we hear about history, the only things that come to our minds are battles, wars, and conflicts. I have gone through many history books, and they are filled with stories of nations going to war and kings fighting for power. Truly, these events are important; I keep telling people that history is bigger than warfare. History is about traditions, achievements, culture and the life history of our forefathers.





There is a particular history in Nigeria that has nothing to do with war; it is the abolition of the Osu caste system in Igbo land. The osu system is popularly practised in Igbo land; this osu has been existing for centuries, almost in every Igbo community in southeastern Nigeria. Certain individuals and families are labelled 'osu', which means they are dedicated to local deities. Because they are seen as osu, they are treated differently from people who are not osu; no matter your wealth, education, and achievement, the discrimination was severe. Even now this practice still exists in some Igbo lands.





![IMG_0057.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/48RsXYzGx7H4XUxVZRa4x8YjRApmozVGKYmiLjbuVQV6cTNtZKtx8rtdxtvbQuasZZ.png)




I know of a friend whose marriage was cancelled because the man found out that she was an osu person; people who are osu face restrictions on leadership, opportunities, and interacting with people. People who are osu are forbidden from marrying into the non-osu family. People who are osu are mostly treated as slaves. In the olden days, they were excluded from many functions because they were osu.





There is some other history that doesn’t involve war; that is what makes history significant. It is a social struggle and not war. When it comes to the OSU system, there are no armies across battlefields. No king is giving orders to kill other kingdoms; instead, it is a fight to end discrimination.





As the world becomes civilised, many people are questioning the practice of the osu system: individuals, religious organisations, and activists speaking against the discrimination. According to history, in 1956 the eastern government passed legislation to abolish the Osu caste system. The law is to help promote equality among the citizens. Till today there are some people who are osu, and we can see them in some communities.




![IMG_0058.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23ynZ7HYFL9fLKcJ594CdQtrJiRys3Bx5ojNXg7F3q7nTxqFVSrR1jXSm4Bhuv4bZVHUh.png)


The abolishing of the Osu caste system reminds us that everything is not about war; most times the best battle is fought within society itself. They are battles against discrimination, injustice, and so on. Every history must be about war history like this; it is important because it will help us understand the complexity of human history. It helps us have a clearer understanding of how people who existed before us lived their lives; it also shows growth.



History is not only about stories of people who won wars. It is a story of humanity's history that helps us to have a clearer understanding of where we are coming from and how we can build a better future.



The history of the OSU system is an example of history without war. Story about human dignity.

***All image is generated with chatgpt***



Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support, and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

body.title: Ladies of Hive Contest #292 | The One Wish I Would Ask From a Magic Genie
body.body: \n<div class=\

> It is exciting and challenging to have a magic genie give me one wish. It can be a simple question as there are a lot of things a person may want. Some individuals may want to have more wealth, be healthier, famous, successful or able to travel anywhere in the world. Each of these wishes would be appealing but I think if I had only one wish to make would make a much more general and significant one. My prayer would be for peace, wisdom and contentment to abide with mankind forever. When I consider this world we live in today, I can see a lot of issues that are plaguing people in the world. Wars, violence, poverty, discrimination, broken families and emotional problems. There are many people who are walking with burdens that others can't see. Some are concerned about the future and others are not able to make ends meet each day. People are not just lacking in resources; they're lacking in peace, understanding, and compassion for each other. This is a question I'm sure I could only answer from the male point of view, as my experiences and observations are from that angle. But I also know that women might have a different way of thinking about this. There are a lot of things that women might struggle with that men will not be able to fully understand. Others may want to be more safe, more equal, more respected, more secure financially, more healthy in general, or for the world to listen to their voices and value them. These wishes are valuable and significant because they are based on real-life experiences. While my wish is different, I think it would also go a long way to solving many of the woman's and man's concerns. ![1001609668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thepromise/23xATtUkK82hoRTyMUNhXv9GvA1mEWPTDpxTdMdgp4QbXkLTmZf3Cjg5SgiXgfMsy1sGt.jpg) My answer for peace would be because peace touches all aspects of life. With peace, people can work on their families, go after their dreams, and serve others. Communities are strengthened, the lives of children are improved and countries can work and not fight against each other. Peace makes space for expansion, joy and development. Even a rich man can have a difficult time finding happiness without peace. I also would pray for wisdom since wisdom aids the people to make better choices. Poor decisions, selfishness and lack of understanding are many of the problems that cause issues in our world. Wisdom enables people to think beyond themselves and think about the way their actions are impacting others. A wise leader can lead a nation to prosperity. Responsible children can be raised by a wise parent. A good person can prevent a lot of superfluous errors and disagreements. If the world was wiser, than a lot of our social, economic and personal issues would be reduced. Contentment is the third of my wishes, people spend their entire lives looking for things that they feel will make them happy. Of course ambition is not a bad thing, but sometimes one gets too much and forgets to love the thing one already has. This discontent can manifest itself in jealousy and greed and unhealthy competition. The world would be less sad with less bitterness and more grateful, if people would learn to be content when still striving to improve themselves. As with everyone, I have my wishes. I have targets and objectives to go for, and dreams I hope to come true. If I could have a wish for a bit of financial wealth or success in my personal life, my life would be a lot easier. But if you put those wishes next to something that could help a bunch of millions of people, the bigger wish is better, I guess. Many personal problems would seem to be less difficult if men and women enjoyed greater peace, wisdom, and contentment. This wish is particularly meaningful to me because it does not have to be for a specific country or culture, for a particular age group, or gender specific. It will be helpful to all. Men and women, young and old, rich and poor alike would all have the chance to live in a world where kindness, understanding and respect are more likely. It is in this world that people would have more opportunities to fulfil their potential and have a better life. If there was a magic genie in front of me today and I was given one wish, I'd not want riches, fame or power. Rather, I'd pray for peace, wisdom and satisfaction among human beings. I think such a wish would bring about changes that would not affect just my life but generations to come. That would be my best wish! body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 30 Major Chests
body.body:
![ms.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23vsE4kQh5dW9KeSVR6rniRucoY4eMssBafVu4r8YD59n8WCrKqENMx6Km7DZ81ZJB4uG.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening another 30 major chests and see if I'm lucky enough to get some gold and legendary cards. 

This time, I was really lucky getting the legendary drakoshan, Kaori Matsine and two copies of the epic undead, Wailsworn Specter. In addition, I got 2 rare cards and a lot of common cards. I also got, 16 legendary potions, 2 common scrolls and a lot of merits. Finally, I got 13 energy, which is very nice; and 3 entries for the weekly fortune draw.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tGcPN7RLJz711cdMxJ3GZHvCspywNstu7gordetskQ6fEjWMNCATLpKMYxUVuPPkHhB.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkpDP93USf8Bgp6CrY5e4gT2EVEvuxvmaWzwH5tFUtUNwSeKC7KmAfMPbb3zCGtMBEV.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=422473aeeece9929743b87b96d0c9123eb08a7e5&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my drakoshan Kaori Matsine just needs two more copies to reach level 3, where it will gain +1 hit point and +1 magic attack power. And once at level 4, it will gain +1 hit point and learn the Immunity ability.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tGXT42pqT7rSKQoJGCJgVRBTT9AAMBUrGsNb2XHyofd1cmUsDAcPDHTGTDvReJYBahX.png)

---

And my undead, Wailsworn Specter, now needs five more copies to reach level 6 (max), where she will the Invigorate ability, while hse is alive, her allies units cannot be exhausted.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkfuUmpBSwfWqeAtFb9tTUnGeZGku9551w2g7EyuUptgWAku9yDPfKJQa8qRnyrR3Y8.png)

---

Currently, this is my collection of legendary conclave arcana reward cards. I only have one at level 3; and five at level 2, and the rest are at level 1. Little by little they are increasing their level and gaining more stats and abilities, which is always pretty nice. I hope to get more legendary cards next time, and I wish you the same. As always, have fun playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wWnsEPcpGWnJZTouubfuGr5n5LhPqyHSTatC7z5cNrSmbWB4KoXrkJUQP5zhs4oWgU1.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

---

body.title: Past Cold
body.body: <div class=\

> Hello Hive! Especially to the ZapFicers! It's been a while since I published something, and there are definitely a lot of things I wanna share here, but for now, let me start my June here with a ZapFicMonday entry. This one is probably inspired by the alternate end scene I've been imagining lately. I've been back to reading, and since I'm fond of bittersweet endings, I decided to imagine for the novel I just finished. It had happy end by the way, but I have a lot of alternate bittersweet *(bitter for most part actually)* ending of it in the back of my mind, so might as well type it and share one of the scenes that's been playing on my mind and of course, I added coffee since it's the prompt for this week. So here it is, hope you enjoy this short fiction of mine. ---
![fancycrave1-coffee-819362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/Eokd6CPHc3MoYAN5P3hscJtnq6AZypzaxfkPbpU5yzGneNnsTvAgyEGv67h33soXDYj.jpg)
[*Source*](https://pixabay.com/photos/coffee-cup-mug-coffee-cup-819362/)

>

No dagger stares. Nor a mouth of contempt. 

\

, he whispered. 

No words came out of her. No smiles either.

Just pure resignation to move on.

The bill's been paid but it remained untouched. 

The coffee that had once been hot now felt cold.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/Eo8YYcHRhegzdWzJAfqGHeSbHG4u93VFeuzVMEDccvDwid6fGGqCvXvwhqusRwirKWZ.png)
</center>

![1000292384.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/24248P4p8xGEUYVEPPopCvX9wJctWVefxoUrS1RGqi5dDBabC7jhCFpaxsaW9eipviMxU.png)

Este fin de semana largo, aprovechando los días feriados, mi esposo tuvo un poco más de tiempo para dedicarse a una de las cosas que más disfruta: crear con sus propias manos.

Desde hace algún tiempo ha estado viendo ideas y proyectos en internet, guardando inspiración y pensando en nuevas piezas que pudiera fabricar en madera. Incluso compró algunos materiales para proyectos que todavía están en fase de planificación, pero mientras tanto decidió comenzar a trabajar con algunas maderas que ya tenía disponibles.


![1000292368.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AKRCV6NMuzgiWcffrxtQRV3kujaanNEThM2z6K72XDcXv9t9FajYLbRLWrm86rt.jpg)


Uno de los primeros resultados fue una hermosa repisa decorativa de pared. La diseñó pensando en esos espacios del hogar donde solemos colocar pequeños detalles que hacen la diferencia: libros, plantas, fotografías o cualquier objeto que aporte personalidad y calidez a una habitación. Después de cortar cada pieza, ensamblarlas y darles forma, aplicó un acabado con barniz que resaltó las vetas naturales de la madera y le dio un aspecto muy elegante.


![1000292370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AKWwP1yf3LpA3nf6vay1M9jnqXZCrjz4rEATZ4djsLtJpvUbpGtyxeFPkV4bmij.jpg)


Debo confesar que no estuve presente durante todo el proceso. El polvo que se genera al trabajar la madera y el olor del barniz suelen afectarme bastante, así que preferí mantener cierta distancia. Sin embargo, sí pude acercarme en algunos momentos para tomar fotografías y documentar parte del trabajo.

Además de esta repisa, recientemente también ha estado elaborando varios modelos de portavinos de madera. Esta ha sido una de las piezas que más me ha llamado la atención porque combina perfectamente funcionalidad y decoración. Un portavino no solo sirve para almacenar botellas, sino que también puede convertirse en un elemento decorativo que aporta calidez y estilo a cualquier espacio.


![1000292361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AL8pcGBjPTdBYfeapbQNT3dfBhFVhF7VMJfn7S1nnfru7NhcgvidDUmQPBii38b.jpg)



Lo más interesante es ver cómo una idea que comenzó con algunas tablas de madera termina convirtiéndose en una pieza útil y atractiva. Mi esposo ha estado probando diferentes diseños, observando qué detalles puede mejorar y buscando que cada modelo tenga su propio toque especial. El resultado ha gustado tanto que ya le encargaron dos portavinos, algo que nos tiene muy emocionados y nos anima a seguir desarrollando este pequeño proyecto.

![1000292362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AKYMxYwhHdaduKACLnsy4nyKbz2LsxAHdZdihALnN7w7xNhmBFgMWYy3QQCGn9R.jpg)

Aunque todavía estamos dando los primeros pasos, ambos estamos disfrutando mucho esta experiencia. Es muy bonito ver cómo la creatividad, la paciencia y el trabajo manual pueden transformarse en objetos que otras personas valoran y desean tener en sus hogares.

![1000292366.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AKRCRnqYiSPyMLY1535fGxQYhxT3EYJjWY7f39hd87k9zqviNz3N5QY4ByNecdC.jpg)

![1000292367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/AKLsQdf5dEGjU3R1CK1TN9QTcbDQ2Yv8hgZkhiZawgqUVRfdPUDQGNvMy5EnmCk.jpg)

A mí ya me entraron ganas de pedirle varias cosas para decorar nuestra casa, porque cada pieza tiene ese encanto especial que solo poseen los objetos hechos a mano. Saber que detrás de cada creación hay tiempo, dedicación y cariño hace que tengan un valor mucho mayor.

A continuación les comparto algunas fotografías para que puedan apreciar mejor el proceso y el resultado final de estas creaciones.

¿Y ustedes qué opinan? ¿Les gustaron las obras de mi esposo? ¿Cuál de las piezas les llamó más la atención: la repisa decorativa o los portavinos?

body.title: The Traveler Has Arrived: Reality Drift, the Missing Baby Lady, and the Mystery Beyond the Realm
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYsxhHWnjcCCMp7ZBQ7GJ8kLtqizyQ8NrHLms7m1ZdSi/1780928824963.png)


The Baby Lady Multiverse Continues

What began as a simple attempt to defend the realm has evolved into something none of the characters expected.

The activation of the Mixer Shield was supposed to solve a problem.

Instead, it revealed an even greater mystery.

Over the last several episodes, the Baby Lady universe has undergone some of the most dramatic changes since the story began.

Reality itself appears to be changing.

Characters have begun drifting.

Signals are appearing from impossible locations.

Entire realms have become unstable.

And now, a mysterious traveler has arrived.

But to understand where we are today, we need to revisit how this all started.

---

The Mixer Shield

Inspired by Mixer on TON, the Mixer Shield was introduced into the Baby Lady universe as a powerful defensive technology.

Its purpose was straightforward:

Protect the realm.

Disrupt hostile targeting systems.

Prevent attacks from outside forces.

Shield reality itself.

When the shield was activated, it worked exactly as intended.

Reality attacks began failing.

Targeting systems could no longer properly identify the realm.

The team finally appeared to have an advantage.

For a brief moment, everything seemed under control.

Then something unexpected happened.

---

The Arrival of Cocoon

Shortly after the Mixer Shield was activated, a portal opened.

From that portal emerged Cocoon.

Unlike previous arrivals, Cocoon immediately sensed that something was wrong.

Not with the shield.

Not with the team.

Not even with the realm.

Something was wrong with the network itself.

Then came the warning.

«\

»

Naturally, the team assumed the signal originated somewhere within the known realms.

But Cocoon quickly corrected that assumption.

«\

»

Suddenly the mystery became much larger.

This was no longer simply an invasion.

This was something that should not have been possible.

---

The Impossible Signal

As the team attempted to identify the source of the transmission, they discovered a disturbing truth.

The signal could not be traced.

No origin.

No signature.

No identifiable source.

TON CAT and the others were unable to explain it.

Even Cocoon seemed unsettled.

Eventually he summarized the situation in a single statement:

«\

»

A brief pause followed.

Then:

«\

»

That line changed everything.

The threat was no longer merely dangerous.

It violated the rules themselves.

---

Reality Drift Begins

Not long after the signal appeared, strange changes began occurring throughout the realm.

Characters started looking different.

Appearances shifted.

Features changed.

The realm itself became unstable.

At first these changes seemed random.

Then the team realized they were all experiencing the same phenomenon.

TON CAT eventually gave it a name:

«Reality Drift.»

Reality itself appeared to be changing.

Not simply the characters.

Not simply the environment.

Reality.

---

The Disappearance of Baby Lady

The situation escalated when Baby Lady interacted directly with the Mixer Shield.

Moments later, she vanished.

No explosion.

No warning.

No explanation.

One moment she was present.

The next she was gone.

Unlike previous events, this disappearance felt significant.

The team could no longer dismiss what was happening as simple instability.

Someone was missing.

And nobody knew where she had gone.

This immediately created a new mystery.

Is Baby Lady trapped?

Was she transported?

Did the signal somehow reach her?

At the moment, nobody knows.

---

Shapoklyak and the Shadows

As Reality Drift intensified, another strange event occurred.

Shapoklyak disappeared.

But unlike Baby Lady, she did not simply vanish.

Instead, she seemed to reappear in another form.

A massive shadow silhouette began appearing behind Cocoon.

Larger than the other characters.

Watching from the distance.

Observing.

The more the team investigated the signal, the more often the shadow appeared.

This raised a disturbing possibility.

What if Shapoklyak was no longer fully inside the realm?

What if she was moving along its edges?

As Cocoon later warned:

«\

»

The shadow remains one of the largest mysteries currently facing the Baby Lady universe.

---

Clown Cat's Observation

As the team struggled to understand what was happening, Clown Cat delivered one of the most memorable lines of the arc.

In his unmistakable cowboy accent, he observed:

«\

»

A brief pause followed.

Then:

«\

»

That observation perfectly captured the growing feeling within the story.

Reality Drift no longer felt like a random phenomenon.

It felt intentional.

As though something was observing events from beyond the realm.

Waiting.

Watching.

Learning.

---

The Traveler Arrives

After episodes of mystery, tension, and speculation, the signal finally appeared to reach the realm.

The shadows paused.

Reality Drift seemed to slow.

The realm grew silent.

Everyone expected the arrival of a cosmic horror.

A giant monster.

A powerful entity.

Something worthy of all the warnings Cocoon had been giving.

Instead...

A tiny floating egg arrived.

Yolky.

🥚

Needless to say, the reaction was not what anyone expected.

American Idiot immediately voiced what everyone was thinking:

«\

»

A pause.

Then:

«\

»

The contrast could not have been more absurd.

The entire realm had been preparing for a terrifying arrival.

Instead they received a cheerful floating egg.

And yet...

The mystery remains.

---

Who Is Yolky?

At first glance, Yolky appears harmless.

Cute.

Friendly.

Almost ridiculous.

But several facts immediately stand out.

The timing of his arrival.

Cocoon's reaction.

The connection to the signal.

The fact that Reality Drift appeared to pause when he entered the realm.

Most importantly:

Nobody knows who he is.

The team does not understand him.

The signal remains active.

The source remains unknown.

And Yolky has arrived precisely when everything is falling apart.

Coincidence?

Perhaps.

Or perhaps not.

---

What Happens Next?

The Baby Lady universe now faces multiple unanswered questions.

Where is Baby Lady?

What is the signal beyond the realm?

What is Shapoklyak doing in the shadows?

Why is Reality Drift spreading?

Who—or what—is Yolky?

And perhaps most importantly:

Why did he arrive now?

The Traveler has arrived.

The mysteries are growing.

And the story is only beginning.

---

Watch the Latest Short

The newest episode featuring Yolky's arrival is now available on X and TikTok.

X: https://x.com/i/status/2063974138453115325

TikTok: Check out this TikTok I posted!  🚨 THE TRAVELER HAS ARRIVED 🚨 A s... ▶️Watch the full video now!  https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8sSHHd8/

The Traveler has entered the realm.

The signal remains active.

And the answers may be closer than ever.

Or further away than anyone realizes.

🥚⚡👀

To be continued...

body.title: A Day in My Life Blog: A Blessed Sunday's Church Divine Service and I am Assigned as Teacher for the Kids! Also Partial Planning for Fathers Day and for the Upcoming 21st Church Anniversary! 🤗😇😊
body.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** A week has been ended with full of gratitude and thanksgiving to God for all the goodness and blessings He has given to me with my whole family, and even to all of us. As the week had passed, our Church Divine Service has been a great opportunity for us to be blessed from what we have heard from the Word of God. That is why, in today's blog post, another Church Service happenings I will be going to share here with all of you. Now, I am always happy and blessed to share all of this but never I forget to express my gratitude and thanksgiving first to all my supporters,from the continuous support until now. Most especially the Admins, Curators and all commenters, I thank you all. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNuQ8uYq5AZ3q9uNEvsnQqf8dcy6F8Sq3Aia6rSxRiNV/1780926897045.png) We never missed a week that we didn't gather together as family of Christ in which we set every Sunday of the week is God's Day where all Christian Churches will always do this. For today's Church Divine Service, I have been late for a while as I have waited for my friend and a Church Member to go to our house as he will be the one who will drive my Motorcycle knowing that I still can't drive at the moment. That is why, when we arrived at our Church that was around 9:30 in the morning and the Church Service has been already started and currently doing the sharing of life testimonies from some of our Church Members. It has been followed immediately by the next part which is the Praise and Worship. It is a bit different today as our worship leader is new. body.title: The Third Space
body.body:
With my devices being almost brand new (due to the reset) and some errors, I realized some of my minimalist habits were thrown out of the window. I also did a mini-check-in with my yearly goals and things I promised I’d do such as fewer coffee trips but apparently, while I did fewer coffee trips, it became a morality question rather than spending questions. At the same time, to keep me actually working from home, I also need to go back to the idea that my room has to support a working environment just as a cafe/co-working spot for me. So, I am trying to engineer the Cafe effect at home which turns my room into just a place with minimal purpose than what I already have. And this is my diary turning a room into a dedicated spot only for working to minimize my coffee trips even more in Q2. Basically, the psychology of the cafe that I like is that it always offers clean surfaces, minimum lighting and limited object variety. Right now, my studio room is far from that, it is way too cluttered to my liking due to the items that I kept pushing aside and things that should be put inside a storage but never finds its place. The concept of minimalism actually applies here: the table must not have too many clutters and as well as too many decorations. While out there some are like a cluttered table, for some people like myself, a clearer surface helps with thinking better and removes friction. It’s safe to say that I still struggle with trying to add more into my room rather than removing it. So, I am trying to do my best to remove than to add though I am often tempted to just purchase things instead of fixing it. And the reason why minimalist spaces in coffee shops work is because they often have not more than two identities and purposes on them. Currently, even my studio room has multiple purposes that shouldn’t be that way. Not only that it is my work room,it’s also my dressing room, my coffee room and even a place where I work out. So, the whole house that I have now, serves multiple purposes rather than just a single purpose room. Whereas a cafe/coffee shop typically works because we know it’s a space where we get coffee, to work from or to lounge with friends/family. Here’s to working on something again and trying to apply interior design knowledge to my space. And I hope through this, my space would feel even better and lighter.

body.title: Land Manager Update v1.11.0 | Smarter Rentals, Better Results  😎
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23uFPdKf8W8ZX71NBX84EzrbuDWKc44PmSAcGwNRzkmS25BuzUm5ySwCMfrXuThayhsbT.png Welcome back! We are back again with another update, although I have to start with some slightly disappointing news. We all knew the AI boom wasn't going to stay cheap forever. Recently GitHub Copilot changed its pricing model. Technically the subscription price stayed the same, but the amount of AI usage you get for that money dropped dramatically (9x to be precise). For me that was quite the surprise. Before, my current subscription would comfortably last an entire month. After the changes it lasted only three days. Yes... three days. My normal workflow is actually pretty simple. I often play some Frontier while the AI works on a coding task. Between battles I review the generated code, steer it in the right direction, and once everything looks good I test it thoroughly before committing. It worked surprisingly well and allowed me to combine development with some Splinterlands gaming. Without that assistance development becomes much slower. When I'm coding manually I definitely cannot multitask the same way. On the bright side, parts of this release were written completely by hand again and honestly... I loved it. Sometimes it's nice to spend less time prompting and more time actually writing code. ##
Community Testing Pays Off
Before diving into the changes, I want to give a big thanks to **@azircon**. He took the risk of testing various rental configurations and pushing the system in ways I normally wouldn't during my own testing. Most things worked exactly as expected, but during those tests he discovered something interesting. Occasionally the rental planner would select cards that delivered less production power than expected. At first glance the results still looked reasonable, which made the issue difficult to spot. It was only after comparing the actual outcomes against the expected outcomes that we realized the matching algorithm wasn't always finding the most efficient workers available. The good news is that finding this bug ultimately led to a complete redesign of the rental worker matching system. By experimenting with different rental settings and improving his setup, he already managed to increase his production from roughly **54,000 Grain per hour to 64,000 Grain per hour**.
https://images.hive.blog/300x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo6Bm8bR5hYDxCszyQCoq3jcgyh9c3R7GU9w9zdcM6tTqB9smgrCMUehZopAcAHjAfL.png https://images.hive.blog/300x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGVZ5Q7CdsX4QYMzudyjqubEFxKJWKYiPpru8HuRB7xTe5ysqkVn8971kG1sWaF3i7r.png
That result alone highlighted how much optimization can be gained with using the rental system. The redesigned matching system in this release is specifically built to find those opportunities automatically and much more consistently. *(Images here)* One example of the bug looked like this: ![it should have been all minimal 2000 PP](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/245Hh5UAryyc5wfMFD3FBopWotv2uJFppjdbED3HMYzYgHeeNVDpSFj4Pk3ytcRcYDwZm.png) If you ever encounter something similar, please let me know. The most useful information you can provide is: * The rental settings you used * The workers that were selected * The workers you expected to see selected * Screenshots / transactions That information makes reproducing and fixing issues much easier. I also created a special development page to try out different config, mostly because i do not own that much plot muself and most are filled with owned cards 🤣. ##
Always Review The Suggested Plan
One small reminder for everyone using the rental system. After pressing **Find Empty Workers**, the system generates a suggested plan. Always take a moment to review that plan before confirming it. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23z6ZNzun2qxifcVGNCyN9sWMQ4GeJiQdvWsTqwdLc9dy61uVBdqSpTQfBpkk6CW1LYxF.png) ![New view contain important information like PP/DEC this is the main driver for the selection](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRxSKeY7q2TheVugXt8WXseGBAUJptimY3Vk5ZCxKw4vLYgP9RJoyAx4zUiH5c1SqSr.png) ![With minimal 2000 PP](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRxSKK3HkMGKSnkPn37Mq5etWkXnHXCwhi5PsSzTJe8fRNdDvR9FoPL5U1FMCadas7z.png) When you press confirm, the market is evaluated again before the rentals are actually executed. Because rental listings constantly appear and disappear, the final selection may differ slightly from the preview. Normally those differences should be relatively small, although highly active market conditions can still cause larger changes or when you take a long while analyzing the suggested plan. ##
Rental Worker Matching Completely Redesigned
This is by far the biggest change in this release. The entire rental worker matching algorithm has been rewritten from scratch. ### The Problem The previous algorithm processed card types one at a time and assigned workers during the evaluation process. That created a subtle problem. A decent worker could be assigned to a plot early in the process. Later, when a much better worker became available for that same plot, the slot was already occupied. The algorithm was making local decisions instead of evaluating all possibilities globally. As a result, good opportunities could sometimes block even better ones. ### The New Approach The redesigned system separates evaluation from assignment. Instead of making decisions immediately, it first evaluates everything and only assigns workers after identifying the strongest opportunities. ### Phase 1: Global Candidate Selection Every rental market entry is evaluated against every eligible plot. The system calculates the best possible production value each card can achieve and ranks everything globally. Fire cards, Water cards, Earth cards and every other element now compete on the same leaderboard. The result is simple: The highest value opportunities rise to the top regardless of element. No artificial per-element limits. No card type receiving priority treatment. Just pure value. ### Phase 2: Live Listing Evaluation Once the strongest candidates have been identified, the system fetches the actual rental listings. Every listing is then evaluated against every compatible plot. This includes: * Real rental prices * Real biome modifiers * Real rental durations Instead of looking only at production power, the algorithm now evaluates: **Effective Production Power per DEC spent** This creates a much more realistic measurement of value. ### Phase 3: Greedy Assignment After all combinations have been scored, everything is sorted into a single global ranking. The algorithm then walks through that ranking from best to worst. A worker is assigned when: * The listing is still available * The target plot still has an empty worker slot Because the list is already sorted globally, the highest value opportunities are always assigned first. No complicated nested loops. No repeated re-evaluation. No opportunity being accidentally blocked by an earlier decision. ### Biome Modifiers Matter Biome bonuses are now fully integrated into the ranking process. For example: A Fire worker placed on a plot with a 10% Fire bonus will have that bonus applied during scoring. The resulting effective production power is then used throughout the ranking process. Likewise, workers whose element is penalized by a plot's biome are completely excluded from consideration. The system no longer wastes time evaluating combinations that were never good candidates to begin with. ### Better Visibility A small but useful quality of life improvement has also been added. The effective production power of each rented worker is now displayed directly beneath the card image in both the confirmation and dry-run dialogs. Previously this information was hidden inside tooltips. Now it's immediately visible when reviewing a rental plan. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRxSKK3HkMGKSnkPn37Mq5etWkXnHXCwhi5PsSzTJe8fRNdDvR9FoPL5U1FMCadas7z.png) ##
Other Changes
### Updated * Added a development testing page used for experimenting with rental strategies and optimization ideas ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGVYgP9sz1Y7DoEKPWSV6abRATWfwtX39L5QqZA3NcFpUVZBVMp3VoGVFMqiZX6YUm6.png) * Updated the theme system to a tri-state setup including a high-contrast mode Personally i loved the high-contrast of spl-stats so moved it over to here
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23ynqt7i1C7LAvAJSUv9QT2qvqEjsCDs7XQk2U83y4EHDWF9HEPUUMpf5aBgiaPgFEz1Q.png https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23wgBZ5Gmw5JS4ev8y7LLNYXSm7DqKqK5pgfu4yXxXnvoxEDDBTHmh3k9AsNTor7iY6nQ.png https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/48QRDm4oLSAkgizsHjRYBr9N3xxJL7vpznpNRipxT345jswe2DFCBSSwrarUkariyT.png
* Updated the rental dialog interface inlcuding filterable table * Renewal Rental now inlcude land only options, so for user that also rent for battle have the option to only renew card that actually on land ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRvixKTfiauYBnWrNEiBtDeRCwJngSy8QYfhUkgxeW1J2Y2Y4aCJ7sr8gnSnSEKwmW6.png) * Renewal Retnal now move to backend call to using the rental authority (to be tested) * Renting overview table has got some basic sorting and filter and you can directly cancel a renting here or directly remove it of land if that was not intended to be there. Note: when a card is canceled either by you or the owner the renewal should not pick it up!! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23sweNFhZaNv1sg1c7NsFKoWAgwdpXyDU7R2TDqKDBi5TgNbzyYqnPSfdsyDaPkY3w6kM.png) ##
A Quick Note About Scale
One thing I am still keeping an eye on is the number of Splinterlands API calls required to gather rental information. The new system is smarter, but it also performs a lot of evaluation behind the scenes. If you run into unexpected errors or receive a \

message, please let me know. Also, based on current testing, I still recommend processing plots in smaller batches. Around 10 to 20 plots at a time generally produces the most reliable results and avoids placing unnecessary pressure on both my servers and the Splinterlands API. #
🙌 Support the Project
✅ Upvote this post – it really helps! 👉 [Vote for My SPS Validator Node](https://monstermarket.io/validators?validator=beaker007) 💬 Ideas and feature requests are always welcome. No promises but I will take a look and try my best. ##
Final Thoughts
While this update may not look massive on the surface. Most users will simply notice better rental recommendations and improved worker placement. Behind the scenes, however, the entire decision making process has changed. As always, keep the feedback coming, keep reporting strange edge cases, and keep sharing how you're using the tools. Every time someone approaches land differently than I do, it usually leads to another improvement. That's all for this update. Beaker signing off. See you on your land journey or on the battlefield 😄 https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/splinterlands_logo.png Want to be part of this amazing play-to-earn game? Consider using my [referral](https://splinterlands.com?ref=beaker007) link!

body.body: ![Sum (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTYuDCiN7zyFFASNqxrh6KSKivqLu4eefhAusU3pL8hEf/Sum%20(1).jfif)\n\n<div class=\

> Today was a beautiful sunny day that I decided to spend by the river with the kids. These might be the last warm days of summer, so I wanted to make the most of them by relaxing and enjoying the tranquility of nature. When I arrived at the river bank, I was immediately greeted by the soothing sight of flowing water and green trees around me. I decided to find a nice spot near the water where I could sit and enjoy the beauty around. After finding the perfect spot, I spread out my blanket and got comfortable, ready to spend the day resting and relaxing. ![Sum (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPMs8gBPii4LbH9T15JHGSCKBCYjCinyQVQsupTyBuML/Sum%20(7).jfif) Throughout the day, the children played in the water doing various fun activities. There was an inflatable ride in the water that the kids jumped off. It was so much fun watching them laugh and play, making memories for the cold days ahead. For lunch I had prepared a delicious picnic basket full of sandwiches, fruit and cold drinks. We ate slowly, savoring every bite as we listened to the sounds of the river and watched the birds fly overhead. It was a truly fulfilling experience that made me appreciate the simple pleasures in life. ![Sum (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbawvH7wSMUF5QderHdsYfQNUxYjiMEG1UAxnwjUdL1PW/Sum%20(5).jfif) ![Sum (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZpfqLwn4waxUDxtm6wNpGbwuPbzZLvSAXngKPT1vmHVn/Sum%20(6).jfif) After lunch I decided to walk around the river and explore the surrounding area. As I was walking back to my picnic spot, I noticed a group of friends gathering for a barbecue. The appetizing smell of sizzling sausages and juicy steaks filled the air and I couldn't resist joining them. We spent the afternoon sharing stories, laughing and enjoying the delicious food. ![Sum (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ82rxzMBKFG8QvYQ8ofoifk2YzhrA9jqEzkQWQQzMAPy/Sum%20(3).jfif) ![Sum (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQLhRjJSv5sioV8bZd7vKZBLMiL8dsY8R6fuPLnn2gtk/Sum%20(4).jfif) As the sun began to set, casting a warm golden glow over the landscape, I knew I had to capture the moment. I took out my phone and took a picture of my day going. Finally, I photographed a large tree stump covered in small river pebbles. Eventually the day ended and we returned home feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. The feeling of this beautiful day by the river was definitely invigorating, reminding me how important it is to take time to relax and appreciate the beauty of the world around us. ![Sum (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaG2rsSn68WbJd9aEFknPCDiuGvVVhoiswFJed5BpnLHZ/Sum%20(2).jfif)

# <center>THE WILD DARKNESS: BACK TO THE UNFORGIVING FOREST</center>

---

<center>*English*</center>

<div style=\

>

Recently, I decided to revive a mobile game I hadn't touched in years: The Wild Darkness. The premise doesn't need much explanation. Surviving far from civilization, clearing out dark dungeons, crafting your own tools, building shelters, and fighting off the evil spirits that hunt you in the unholy and macabre darkness of the night? Take my money. The game drops you into a hostile environment and expects you to deal with it on your own. And, of course, have fun in the process.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNyZMuP4VHYzyT8tEFaiXtFKHsqvcV5cCNGoNytNU58Ju/1780928567071.jpg)
One thing I genuinely love about this title is its unique and immersive aesthetics. There is something about its visual style and atmospheric gameplay that simply drags you into its world. It makes you immerse yourself in the experience as if you were actually trapped in the middle of nowhere. Anyway, it had been a long time since my last run, and the first thing I noticed upon entering the main menu was the massive amount of new content added through recent updates. I felt completely lost and didn't understand half of the new mechanics, but we learn on the go.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQSzXV2XwAvoTEHHSf1zN5aqwj4CfNzUAPiFa4BwrbDE/1780928567110.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYzCcj42q5g9VHK284ZqcVkdXEamPoPmCkBcMniXT71Z/1780928567153.jpg)
I started the match with the first available option: a level 1 adventurer, without any boosts, perks, or unfair advantages. As soon as my character woke up in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by trees, I set out to execute the most logical and obvious objective anyone would have in a real-life situation like that. And no, it wasn't missing the internet; I simply started collecting resources like a madman.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEkw3yt9ZqkytaY6noVAcNHAKQA8nZsCzBY2RvAUv8ad/1780928567195.jpg)
I spent the first few minutes clearing bushes and gathering wood to craft a crude stone knife and a basic axe. After securing those tools, I gathered more wood, branches, and a few apples. This last item is extremely important. Years ago, during my previous playthroughs, my biggest enemy wasn't the monsters, but starvation. I lost count of how many times I died simply because I forgot to keep my character fed.

#


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNc7c3XATTcYMGG7bDRoiXjPH9h8jpXXmasmZkXDQR7K/1780928601416.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDfUYz9UBme8PALKtN4aeEfpAp3ApdPv7K3TLu5tenxV/1780928601513.jpg)
As the sky began to darken, the game reminded me why it's called \

An evil spirit spawned out of nowhere, but I managed to defeat it without losing too much health. To avoid further dangers lurking in the dark and to keep threats at bay, I built a campfire. I will rest here for the night. As soon as dawn breaks, my priority will be to find the first dungeon, where the materials needed to repair the forest ruins are located, allowing me to unlock more advanced crafting knowledge. ---
*Español*

>

Hace poco me dispuse a revivir un juego móvil que no probaba desde hace años: The Wild Darkness. La premisa no necesita de mucha explicación. ¿Sobrevivir lejos de la civilización, despejar mazmorras oscuras, craftear tus propias herramientas, construir refugios y luchar contra los espíritus malignos que te acechan en la oscuridad impía y macabra de la noche? Toma mi dinero. El juego, te suelta en un entorno hostil y espera que te las arregles solo. Y como no, te diviertas en el proceso.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHr71nF4JudWMTHAwRJwo9QoftpA3bBXrH3NawR6yWqd/1780928601594.jpg)
Algo que realmente amo de este título es su estética única e inmersiva. Tiene un apartado visual y un estilo de gameplay que simplemente te arrastra hacia su mundo. Te hace sumergirte en la experiencia como si realmente estuvieras atrapado en medio de la nada. Como sea, tenía bastante tiempo sin jugarlo y lo primero que noté nada más entrar al menú principal fue la enorme cantidad de contenido nuevo que añadieron con las actualizaciones recientes. Me sentía totalmente perdido y no entendía la mitad de las mecánicas nuevas, pero en el camino vamos aprendiendo.

#


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxNzRsWe6fkFxHBF3vuWuF2YAGYZCgcsM4n2C25w2Vka/1780928601673.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcKrmJ6qyfboS4NdSnoN294E6SuCHpLD3HhKTzhNqxP7A/1780928601764.jpg)
Inicié la partida con la primera opción disponible: un aventurero nivel 1, sin ningún tipo de boost, mejoras ni ventajas injustas. Nada más al despertar en medio de la nada, rodeado de árboles, me dispuse a ejercer el objetivo más coherente y obvio que a cualquiera de nosotros nos surgiría en semejante situación en la vida real. Y no, no fue ponerme a extrañar el internet, simplemente me puse a recolectar recursos como un loco.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxCkGsdNTc9bTUAM93GRH5So348c8dbhtLuEQXT9x8Tm/1780928631199.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXnNkrsSrmtowdHExDo4BuQTeEDgwozXR3JQhuTs2wGD/1780928631271.jpg)
Pasé los primeros minutos cortando arbustos y acumulando madera para fabricar un cuchillo artesanal y un hacha de piedra básica. Luego de asegurar esas herramientas, recolecté algo más de madera, ramas y varias manzanas. Esto último es sumamente importante. Hace años, en mis gameplays anteriores, mi mayor enemigo no eran los monstruos, sino la inanición. Ya perdí la cuenta de cuántas veces morí simplemente por no mantener alimentado al personaje.

#
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSv43tpNtuxNFyK5bV8cxC4zMB5qyhYNBEkVDRULJ76H/1780928631340.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWUR8TULQdqm3QtXoitYDVrnc5Pf3Q5Yw4yEjCiZu7qjg/1780928631420.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZytrEAR3ZpYjyKEub9K9Fh46ciffTwkW3TdmB2WZaWL1/1780928631497.jpg)
Cuando empezó a oscurecer, el juego me recordó por qué se llama \

. Un espíritu maligno apareció de la nada, pero logré derrotarlo sin perder demasiada vida. Para evitar más peligros que acechan en la oscuridad y ahuyentar a las amenazas, hice una fogata. Descansaré por esta noche. Apenas amanezca, la prioridad será buscar la primera mazmorra, donde se supone que están los materiales para reparar las ruinas del bosque y así acceder a un mayor conocimiento de crafteo. ---
| *From my infinite humbleness... / Desde mi infinita humildad...* | | :---: | | @noxys |

body.body:
#1169 - Baguio City Shots for Monday. 

A wonderful Monday dearest amazing Hive family across the globe! I hope everyone is feeling energized and ready to embrace a fresh start. Wishing everyone a productive and joyful Monday. May you find inspiration in the little things and overcome any challenges. Stay safe, keep shining and enjoy your day😉. 

Now for our daily shots with my wife and I on an early morning walk to enjoy the fresh air before the city got too busy. As we strolled along the path, wife had spotted something incredible right next to the trail. It was this spiny orb weaver spider, and it was with a beautiful shade of green.
![1000021435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tbpcCRm6TbPJ4hty1sZDRC7DLgZwxBVZKpArW9LgnDVSqpXu2vWNdrZ2xt7X1DrRWgk.jpg)

We stood there for a while fascinated while the spider was in the middle of building its web. It looked like a tiny architect hard at work. We didn't want to disturb it, so we just watched quietly.
![1000021441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhsZbB9mGuemCF7GjtiX1wta1Afc1n2LChM3t8k7aL4aCnmpWLS45VpE5KQ2UEuCmpA.jpg)

Then we headed to a local spot to get some breakfast. We ordered two dishes, a famous pigar pigar beef and some pork ribs with the smell which was absolutely mouthwatering. It was the perfect end to a great morning, witnessing the beauty of nature via a spider and then enjoying a nice feast.
![1000021448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vsQKZdxoXKCVWKoxY4ih7b52EuS7Avz4HGU7YTpgmrCANVzca5t61HF7aAxhYMy5cbs.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

body.body: alt=\

This morning’s plate came with a little surprise; **a fried fish paired with a steaming cup of coffee**. The fish wasn’t freshly cooked; it was actually a leftover from last night’s dinner. But why not bring it back for breakfast?  
The savory crunch of the fish balanced perfectly with the bitter warmth of the coffee. It’s not the usual bread-and-egg combo, but sometimes the best meals are the ones that break the rules.  
A picture a day tells a story, and today’s story is about making the most of what’s on hand, turning leftovers into a breakfast worth remembering.

body.title: STAYING CALM IN TROUBLES
body.body:
https://youtu.be/AEUpoLO5J28?si=-FSvdiR3nZOo9Np2

In this world, we can't let us escape problems. Problems in general, you know what I'm talking about. It's never about that disorder. Both the poor and the rich, we all face problems.

The young are tormented, same as the old. There's no one that can be exempted. The Lord Jesus Christ told us that we are disciples, that we may encounter tribulation.
So, He said that we will see in the world what consists of tribulation.

That is to say that the world is full of so many tribulations. But thanks be to God that He has offered us that solution. What we need is the peace of God. It's that peace of God that will keep us calm.

When our hearts are fixed, talking to Jesus, we will not have anything to keep sharing or what will happen in the future. There will not be any problem which shall bring trouble upon us.

We love all the Lord. There's no other way to stay calm about our troubles when facing tribulation in the world. We should trust in that Word of God. We have that strong faith in the Lord. We should believe that everything that He has promised must surely come to pass and be fulfilled.

body.title: 📚✨ A book, a window, and a thousand worlds
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVJ83StFsXczi4AMMpbyhMphgCfeQFMnyYNNTzhtNc8te/IMG_9007.jpg 

One of my favorite things about reading is how it can completely change the mood of a day.

I can be sitting in the same chair, in the same room, looking out the same window... and yet, after opening a book, I suddenly find myself somewhere else entirely.

That’s why I’ve always loved stories. Whether it’s a manga, a comic, or a novel, there’s something magical about stepping into another world for a while.

This afternoon felt peaceful. The sunlight coming through the window, the cozy sweater, and a good book in my hands made everything feel a little softer.

Sometimes people think adventures only happen outside.

But some of the greatest adventures I’ve ever experienced happened between the pages of a story.

Every book leaves something behind—a lesson, a memory, a feeling, or even a new way of seeing the world.

And honestly, I hope I never lose that sense of wonder.

Just Lynda, spending another afternoon traveling without leaving her chair 📖💭

body.title: he Sky Before the Storm - Pune Monsoon
body.body:
Pune's monsoon doesn't build slowly. It stacks - fast, dark, loud - and you've got maybe 10 minutes to shoot before the rain kills the light.

These were all taken from my terrace. Phone camera. No editing .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPP6wsracxMfHs1MCgUkp7NKUFd6SJNvTmQ66RSJDg12w/1780928469088.jpg)


The Deccan plateau gets a specific kind of storm. Fast, violent, over in 40 minutes. Nothing like coastal rain. Underrated as a subject.

What's monsoon looking like where you are?

body.title: 0 DAMAGE TAKEN - Thunderhoof Nomad's Hidden Power !!
body.body:
Hello 
Splitelands Lovers !!



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23u5tMP7Cjyg3joYvp7ESVCQhT2seCWnHuXiSeGJrppAQEhvv1AY4RWHqPhVEfQD52V8B.png)

Today, I’m going to introduce you to a card from Splinterlands called the Thunderhoof Nomad. It is a Rare card belonging to the Earth unit. It possesses a unique ability that sets it apart from other cards. As I check right now, its current market price is $5.17 USD. I own the Gold version of this card, and it is currently at Level 2. It features a magic attack and has a very appealing design; thanks to its special ability, it holds a strong position within the Earth team. The card is excellent even in its normal version, and you can boost its power by leveling it up. Because it deals magic damage, you can utilize it very effectively within various strategies.


![Screenshot 2026-06-08 010549.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tGTEBhPR6YBfKj1EikfvXQvsLYFfg3HHM5riiRF3fJoSknBHCEbavzmWHTJ7BoiiAjv.png)

As you can see here, this card possesses an ability called 'Deflect'. What this ability does is render the monster immune to effects like Magic Reflect, Thorns, Return Fire, and Blast splash damage. To illustrate with an example: suppose your monster attacks an enemy that has the 'Thorns' ability. Normally, your monster would attack and then take damage from Thorns in return; however, with this ability, your monster attacks, but the Thorns damage becomes zero. Similarly, Magic Reflect, Return Fire, and Blast damage are completely ignored. It is important to know about this card because it offers a very useful ability that can prove advantageous in battle; that is why I have shared this information with you all.

Conclustion 

Many players are currently overlooking the new cards recently launched by Splinterlands, but you should learn about them; understanding their abilities will allow us to incorporate these new cards into our lineups and secure victories in battle. Today, I shared the best card from my collection with you, and I hope you found this information useful.

Thank U !

body.title: La presentación del álbum musical - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
Cada día en Inglaterra era una experiencia nueva para toda la banda 17, donde compartieron risas con los músicos ingleses y guardaron recuerdos que jamás olvidarían. Finalmente, llegó el día que todos estaba esperando y desde muy temprano todos se estaba organizando, los técnicos ajustaban las luces, cámaras para transmitir el evento, periodistas y enormes pantallas mostraban imágenes de ambas Banda. Esta no era simplemente una presentación, era una gran celebración musical que todo el mundo esperaba. Al caer la noche comenzaron a llegar invitados de todas partes, donde había músicos reconocidos, productores, compositores, representantes de músicos muy importantes, además había música en vivo, comida, bebidas y una enorme alfombra roja por donde desfilaban los invitados, todo en ese lugar parecía de película. Michelle miraba cada detalle, Tomás solo miraba el escenario y los músicos ingleses atentos y comentaron —Ese también es su sueño— >Every day in England was a new experience for the entire 17 band, where they shared laughter with the English musicians and made memories they would never forget. Finally, the day everyone had been waiting for arrived, and from very early on, everyone was getting ready: technicians were adjusting the lights and cameras to broadcast the event, while journalists and huge screens displayed images of both bands. This wasn’t just a performance; it was a grand musical celebration that everyone had been anticipating. # >As night fell, guests began arriving from all over—renowned musicians, producers, songwriters, and representatives of major artists. There was live music, food, drinks, and a massive red carpet where guests paraded; everything in that place looked like something out of a movie. Michelle took in every detail, while Tomás just watched the stage and the attentive English musicians, and they remarked, “That’s his dream, too.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbmd2ib3o5JhHgeNnuHW9XMCVEhJPpBaAtWWEyuzaCyDu/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/auriculares-placa-giratoria-dj-6159058/) Las horas fueron pasando hasta que finalmente llegó el momento, todas las luces se apagaron y la pantalla principal mostró un pequeño video de todos lo que vivieron, como los ensayos, las horas de sueño y cada decisión para poder estar allí. Michelle comenzó a llorar, Lucas apretó los puños, Tomás apenas podía contener la emoción. Pero después de eso comenzaron a sonar varias de las canciones del álbum y todas las personas que estaban presente disfrutaban. Cuando llegó el turno de la colaboración con la banda inglesa, todos se sorprendieron de lo bueno que era la canción, algo jamás visto. Mientras todos seguían disfrutando del evento, los productores revisaron las estadísticas y comentaron —¡Las reproducciones están explotando!— consiguiendo miles de reproducciones y personas de todo el mundo disfrutando de esa gran canción. Esa colaboración con la banda inglesa se convirtió rápidamente en la canción más escuchada Michelle se llevó ambas manos al rostro y dijo —No puedo creerlo— Lucas observó las pantallas una y otra vez, mientras que Tomas veía cómo los números seguían creciendo. La celebración fue todo un éxito y entre la multitud estaba uno de los productores más influyentes de la industria musical internacional, quien escuchó la canción y necesitaba una reunión rápidamente con la banda 17, siendo el comienzo de algo muy grande. >The hours passed until the moment finally arrived; all the lights went out, and the main screen showed a short video of everything they’d been through—the rehearsals, the sleepless nights, and every decision they’d made to get there. Michelle started crying, Lucas clenched his fists, and Tomás could barely contain his excitement. But after that, several songs from the album began to play, and everyone in the audience was enjoying themselves. # >When it was time for the collaboration with the English band, everyone was surprised by how good the song was—something they’d never seen before. While everyone continued to enjoy the event, the producers checked the stats and remarked, “The views are exploding!”—racking up thousands of views and people from all over the world enjoying that great song. # >That collaboration with the English band quickly became the most-streamed song. Michelle brought both hands to her face and said, “I can’t believe it.” Lucas watched the screens over and over, while Tomas watched as the numbers kept climbing. The celebration was a huge success, and among the crowd was one of the most influential producers in the international music industry, who heard the song and needed a meeting with the band 17 right away—marking the beginning of something very big. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmStLDxt3X4Tw6qNhj3m6nGHWR3rH4MUvpzU6uFPJK4GoQ/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/concierto-rendimiento-m%C3%BAsica-4768496/)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: Pancakes for My Kids' Lunch Box
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfXhsAivt6ieYMzjKVDSjRXVn16YHgANQfKE3WEC1WyV6/1780898188579.png)

# Assalam o Alaikum friends!
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and enjoying their day. Today I want to share a very easy pancake recipe that I made for my children's lunch box. My kids like homemade food, so I always try to make something tasty for them instead of giving them packaged snacks.
This morning I decided to make pancakes because they are quick to prepare and children love them. The best thing about pancakes is that they are soft, delicious, and can be served with different fruits. They are also easy to pack in a lunch box.
# Ingredients
2 cups flour
1 tablespoon baking powder
3 eggs
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup oil
Lemon ecence
Sugar according to taste

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWKNvG53UkCQLQBaJS8tttFUZS3ctR18Hp44ZDyUaa86t/1780898211142.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbLA7zvQaBWpdrApYWDB4TwdTS4WbQTjBYT6Dij47wKeF/1780898211560.jpg)

# Method
First, I took a large bowl and added the flour and baking powder salt and sugar mix it well.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRSuh6QTDnykMYMT8gSvrfhWTJVMHo9Ph323z1uxn8X1d/1780898246296.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZVwXjXu9RmGzKZPa5ZoZ79HDBZYUYxTHpRUgjjAeqWp/1780898246645.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdcWkR6BRpAJAxu6aacokwmUk6iw9Kz5qsayoaS59Jgp4/1780898246957.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV3M5LXrgGUoSNDUKqzjqJk8kaidyL8x1LCzFU55Nb7uN/1780898247266.jpg)

 And Then took another bowl add the eggs, milk, oil and mix it well. After that, I mixed dry ingredients in it.and mix with spatula well until you got a smooth batter. The batter should not be too thick or too thin.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPHSoSHQJ7FChVuVEPgHmWgEMJ2PutHgU4MtHKFVtzwn/1780898316941.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUiYVBSpYHYqCduEr2PLqG9Ziz3qjirwBb6TgWEt6KzQ/1780898317264.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQYLbc6tRdgotGrrVaZcXZPBo5dHW6v6pJbCAUezdpg7/1780898317578.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYkoiQ1K4S5Dt5b57Vv5RYWsULW7bYhTFbjZDEExUuzAN/1780898317933.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgGysjvSjKC3Z7SKtM1prkyJYnbrK1tU7WQZqBD32VNR/1780898318205.jpg)

Next, I heated a non-stick pan on medium heat. I added a few drops of oil to the pan. Then I poured some batter into the pan and let it cook for a few minutes. When small bubbles started to appear on the top, I turned the pancake over and cooked the other side until it became light golden.
I repeated the same process until all the batter was finished.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiHCgK3o6WnUDRvNiFLuzMSrBt9s8DN7dRREyrPKNtXk/1780898387043.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQrFWmC7Zpq8mFcdrUcE1t5anpbrxqbEvBdykSKFsWdU6/1780898387403.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1rf3c7RVmaRdM4j6CS5dBRzMNQ1B9UGzbVxUbSdt5ef/1780898387708.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWBwJVn5EQyzVNWkPSoeYqWbsurdkyMuqmRaMsVeGdup/1780898388060.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmckGuyA9aHDNm553woj5mEXLx2jxycdF4spKdtGuZxznJ/1780898388422.jpg)

 Soon, a plate full of soft and fluffy pancakes was ready.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPP6XRRTtb5acuyS51HzVmQSchXhXhwxiaNdD3raZTdek/1780898419152.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbexw894mBBus25SuAZ1Ct7g3QG9yGKyvSjhWavyHUW9/1780898419525.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpSGyRDQbcLfL9qEDMGk6h4gMT9aJBMojphR8pVLvqNj/1780898419873.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsezBmrvPrdiHM6kgwU7kLc8itjYKyWTF22Sp355rdoN/1780898420215.jpg)

# Lunch Box Preparation
After the pancakes cooled down a little, I packed them in my children's lunch boxes. Pancakes can be served with many fruits. You can add any fruit that your children like.
My children love mangoes very much, so I served the pancakes with fresh mango slices. Mango is one of their favorite fruits, especially during the summer season. They were very happy when they saw mangoes in their lunch boxes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPedii7Vd7xmswHHU3Q3oFk4For5P9r46SAX5d5oj2fMc/1780898459486.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQACPwJmPS16UPYnmqySkEgogwmB4o8FVgM2PTKd5Hkg4/1780898459821.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXxMBy1SBPWPNsFxLYXAw89gUY2QoWF75MknHVa14epL/1780898460187.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQS9C9Q8P23JqXZ2jntbixL646rjEdM63bpFEQSZQeH2/1780898460559.jpg)

I think adding fruit makes the meal more colorful and enjoyable. It is also a good way to encourage children to eat more fruit. Sometimes you can add bananas, apples, grapes, or strawberries, depending on what is available at home and what your children enjoy eating.
# My Experience
The pancakes turned out very soft and tasty. The recipe was simple and did not take much time. My children enjoyed them a lot and finished everything in their lunch boxes. That always makes me happy because I know they are eating fresh homemade food.
Thank you for reading my post. I hope you liked this recipe. If you try it, please share your experience with me. See you soon with another simple and delicious recipe.

body.title: Magic vs Double Strike: Kelan Gaines and Delya Compared
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 8, 2026, 11_27_38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wC5YyX4K3d9dbA8J38yz9qXQ5PGUbohmnV7B1DJkNywZKreM6qr1cYbkUGFNSwJwxtR.png)


There are two amazing monsters that are against each other and in todays post I will compare these two monsters. I will tell about their stats and details. we will discuss their different prices and then it will become easy for you to understand which monster should be used in which battle, what should be its positioning and which monster will be better.

First of all it is very important to know that every monster has its own stats, abilities and powers. Understanding these is very important if you want to win battles and grow a good career. 

Some powers and abilities are very important to understand because they help you at the time of selection and guide you which monster should be used in which battle.

Today I am comparing two monsters. One is named Kelan Gaines and the other is Delya. Both are good monsters and are very important in battles.

First I will talk about Kelan Gaines. Its mana cost is 8 which means you can easily play it in mid to high mana battles. In low mana battles it can create difficulties.

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 223311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23z79Y8YmMNtPnKytB1e6XCe8HRN9kpqT42TCdXbBJnq9uv3P8oLbirx7vzbJjZQe6rXG.png)


![Screenshot 2026-04-18 223321.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u5ZEBxJ17dmF8HavHbgjqi41eWCn3oa94TDshA98duka8h4t57NNAZ1DerVxrTtGoPv.png)


Its health is not very high but if you place a tank monster with it, it can survive for a long time. Remember that monsters with low health are actually support units and they should be placed in positions where they can survive longer in battle.

Another feature is its speed which is 5. This means it attacks fast and also helps its allied units attack more effectively. On the left side of the card you can see a purple “2” which shows its magic attack type. 

This is its special ability because it bypasses armor and directly hits the enemys health. It is very powerful against heavily armored enemies. The good thing is that it does not miss because of its speed.

If I talk about its price it is available in the market from $0.65 up to $74.

Now talking about the second monster Delya. This is also considered a dangerous monster. Its mana cost is 9. Again it is good for mid to high mana battles but selecting it in low mana battles would not be a good decision and this is also considered its weak point.

Its health is 6 which is better than the first monster. Its speed is also 5 which is very good. Its main feature is its ranged attack which you can see on the left side as “2”. This means if you place it in mid to backline position it will keep hitting the enemy from a distance.

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 223302.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23xozBezuBXTgw7sWdxKM6F4zMQkqejytm3Sg4LnwAsRwCvRDhRN9WjA1vCnF2FgGE9HX.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 223254.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uEvBi6KdvUhEA1oDx12FK6Zi3NvkSnxZsbCtGkeLN65adZH5zkkFNC6caknLLoVm7TB.png)

Its special ability is Double Strike which means it can attack twice in every round. This is very effective and useful in dealing more damage.

If I talk about its price it is quite an expensive monster. Its minimum price is about $57 and it can go up to $636.

Both monsters are very strong. If you add them to your team with good strategy and proper placement then they can help you win battles. Some of their abilities are similar so it is very important to understand them and select them properly in battles.


What do you people think about these monsters? Which monster do you like the most and what is the reason? Share you views in the comment section.



I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 8 2026
body.body:
Some days you chase the steps. Other days, the trail takes care of them for you. Today was all about trekking. I headed out expecting a good workout and some fresh air, but I underestimated just how much ground we’d end up covering. The trail had a bit of everything—long climbs, rocky sections, a few spots that made me stop and catch my breath, and views that made the effort worth it. What I enjoy most about trekking is that it never feels repetitive. One minute you're focused on the path ahead, and the next you're looking around and realizing how far you've come. Hours passed without me paying much attention to my step count. Even after the trek, the day wasn’t completely over. A few regular activities here and there added a little more movement before I finally sat down for the evening. When I checked my tracker, it showed 38k steps. Definitely one of the biggest days I've had in a while. Days like this remind me that fitness doesn't always have to happen in a gym or on a track. Sometimes the best workouts come from exploring new paths and enjoying the journey along the way. Day 11/30 complete ✅ What's the highest step count you've ever hit in a single day? Was it planned, or did it happen by accident? #actifit #11kchallenge #day11 #trekking #outdooradventure #keepmoving

最近跟两个同事晚上都是在喝茶聊天。经常会聊到婚姻这件事情来。
好像这全部都是社会一个通病。选老婆原本是好好的过日子，但日子过着过着就变味了。
我们三个人遇见自己老婆的三种方式，都说了一遍。做了一个对照。

好像选人结婚好像怎么选都是错的。但看别人的婚姻好像没有出现我们这毛病，特别是表面上。
如果硬是要分析一下，说出婚姻的本质，我们今天上课也是做出了一个总结。
如果想白头偕老，家庭和睦，估计全部都是咬着后槽牙坚持出来的。

我其中一个同事他比较呆板。他老婆老是嫌弃他是一个木头。根本不懂什么浪漫。
另一个却长得很好看，但是他老婆就老是担心他在外面沾花惹草的。
其实男人选女人做老婆，跟女人选男人做老公。怎么选都是那么一回事。

结婚前嘛，这女的看着特舒服。无论是颜值还是气质上都是特别棒的。
一旦成家之后，让他在家里面的厨房待一阵子，你就会知道一旦沾染了柴米酱醋茶。
再怎么精致的女人也精致不出来了。再漂亮的花也熏成了一朵黑色塑料花。

结婚之前吧，总是以为自己已经遇到那个灵魂伴侣。没错，就是他了，这辈子就跟他过。
但你看一下，婚姻过了十年之后。那男人就是躺在沙发上面玩手机的死胖子。
那女人也好不到哪去啊。十个女人里面九个都会说上一句，我这辈子真是瞎了眼。

body.title: The Inner Gossiper & Guide
body.body:
Trust your hunches. They are usually based on the facts filed away just below the conscious level.
-Dr. Joyce Brothers

![1000743189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AKPo7y3TLfyySHQmYunpn6Rg73ArogPrXVSUqd8mjuj36X9t3WzegY5jMGShoWk.jpg)

Instincts are these feelings you have, stating the fact even before your mind gets to tell you anything either on what's about to happen or what is happening presently. It is like a whisper in you hammering what your mind is yet to figure out.

So many times, we may want to do something and then we just seize to doing it even after so many persistence from people around us to do that particular thing till the extent that we may end up been seen as an unserious fellow who isn't ready to take a step in living better but then after a while, that thing ended up turning bad, making people lose themselves and what they've suffered to acquire in the long run. Just then, people tend to wonder how you got to know that thing won't result well. 
Unknowingly to them that your instincts guided you through it and you were so calm to listen to it.

Instincts can sometimes be right and it can somehow be wrong to us. That is, it may not be everytime that our guts get to be right.
There are times when our instincts refuses to flow with somebody and no matter how we try to get close to them, it just keep whispering **\
** and at the end of the day, you find out that he or she wasn't worth moving close to or to be seen together in the first place and at times we may end up seeing it as \

It is not bad though that our instincts get it wrong sometimes and that's why we have to thread carefully when dealing with the information it gives us.

For someone like me, I trust my instincts so much that anytime I had an information from it, I know it's surely a right one and even if it ended up not totally been right then it's just a slight difference.

I've had times when I tested it, doing the opposite of what it tells me and at the end I regretted not listening to it. Just then you would hear me say, \

. I remember having a slight fight with a close person of mine for always going the opposite of what my instinct says which brings me regret afterwards and she would ask me of what I have gained from not following my instincts and staying disobedient.

![1000743187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AJpj8XGaZTeokW8dQMx19a9Qf5YmTMcNiQntqSrfnBoRxBmtWr4CVPcQ62w9Mwk.jpg)

For me, I was trying to justify it to be what I can rely on but at the end, it's always a lesson of not following what it says.
Take for instance, no matter how lenient I am with lending a hand of help either financially or whatsoever, when my instinct go against it especially in terms of loaning out, then I'm definitely not proceeding. I learned that in a hard way as well.

So for the past few months now, I've learned to stay true and obedient to what my instinct tells me BUT I ensure to act wisely if it's a negative warning it is issuing to me. 
I can't still afford to be bad or lose relationships if it ended up been wrong so I act carefully and wisely.
This is why I have been able to manage the people I associate with, been able to escape a bad plot been planned against me or even saying things that ends up looking as if I got to know about a secret and this sometimes made some look at me like I have an evil spirit. These are all works of my instincts.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Learners community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are generated using Meta AI

body.title: What should we build next on PeakD?
body.body:
This is not a release post. No changelog, no long list of tiny fixes, no screenshots of buttons you may or may not care about 😅

This time I just want to ask:

**What would you like to see improved, added, removed, simplified, or experimented with on PeakD?**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23w2m3YbeFzbtDPk7hYUPKZhCgoQQAXB22PuSf3rAoNFeXUxdURSsHbQ7QhpH8STnuTkF.png)


It can be a big feature idea, but it really does not have to be. Small stuff is welcome too:

- \

- ...

Those little things are often the most useful, because they are exactly the kind of annoyances people hit every day and then forget to report.

### A few areas I am especially curious about

To make this a bit more straightforward, here are some parts of PeakD where feedback would be very useful:

- **Discovery:** what helps you find good posts, authors, communities, and discussions?
- **Onboarding:** what would make PeakD easier for new Hive users?
- **Publishing:** what would make writing, editing, formatting, or managing posts easier?
- **Analytics:** what stats would actually help you understand your account or content better?
- **Wallet and governance:** what actions are still too unclear, hidden, or scary to use?

But do not feel limited by that list. If something else bothers you, or if you have a completely different idea, post it.

Given the current HIVE token price feel free to drop even crazy ideas if you feel like those can be helpful.

### No promises, but I will look into it

Not every request will be implemented. Some ideas may be technically not doable on Hive, too messy, too hard to maintain, or just not a good fit for PeakD right now.

But I will read the suggestions, think about them, engage with you and if something looks useful and technically doable I will give it a try.

Sometimes that means a full feature. Sometimes it means a smaller experiment. Sometimes it means I come back and explain why it is harder than it looks.

All of that is useful feedback anyway.

### So...

What should I look at next?

Leave ideas in the comments. Big requests, small annoyances, weird experiments, half-baked thoughts... all welcome.
