body.body: Best support in the game? | Kit Analysis: Mortenax Blade (Ver. 4.3) / (Eng/Esp)
alt=\
>
alt=\

> Hey everyone at Hive Gaming, AlexBit here with a new post for the community. This time, we're diving into the world of Honkai: Star Rail to analyze the highly anticipated version 4.3. If you thought you'd seen it all when it comes to team compositions, think again. Today we're taking an in-depth look at Mortenax Blade, who returns with a revamped role to become one of the best supports and damage amplifiers in the entire game.
alt=\

> As a new playable character, we welcome this Fire-element Blade variant from the Nihility path. Forget slow status effects (DoTs); her kit is a brutal hybrid of offensive sub-DPS and a massive amplifier that scales with her Max HP. Her specialty is shattering defenses, absorbing hits, and exponentially boosting the main DPS (making her the ideal partner for Acheron).
alt=\

>

Skill Kit: The Blood Sacrifice
Basic Attack (Single Target): Deals Fire Damage based on your Maximum Health and applies Taunt for 1 turn. Ideal for protecting fragile allies by diverting damage to them.

Basic Skill (AoE): Does not consume Skill Points (SP)! Consumes 10% of your HP to unleash an area attack and 4 random hits. It only activates under the Infinite Fury state if its life is greater than 1.


<div class=\
>\n
alt=\
>
>\n
alt=\
> Ultimate Ability (Two Phases - Cost: 160): Fornax Ex Corpore: Applies \

to all enemies (-30% Defense and +50% Damage taken for 2 turns). Consumes 20% of its HP to activate a Field Zone and enters Infinite Fury (+20% Critical Hit Chance, +60% Critical Hit Damage, and unlocks its Basic ability). If it receives a fatal hit while in this state, it does not die: it consumes the zone and revives with 50% HP.

Tenax Per Ignem: Once transformed, the Ultimate becomes a massive strike that deals a devastating 350% of its Maximum HP to all enemies.

Talent (Bonus Attack): While the Zone is active, each allied attack grants 1 Charge. Upon reaching 9 Charges, it consumes the points, recovers 25 Energy, and automatically launches an extra Basic Skill as a Bonus Attack (without spending HP or SP).

Technique (Initiation): Taunts all enemies upon entering combat and reduces damage received by Blade by 90% for the first 2 turns.

<div class=\
>\n
alt=\
>
>\n
alt=\

> Key Traces of Primer Level Hardened Bone: Stores up to 80 spare energy points and regenerates energy up to 75% at the start of combat. Refined Heart: With the Zone active, allies gain +50% damage. If another character from Nihility is present, the damage of allied Ultimates is increased by 75%. Charge Accumulation: Blade gains charges for his talent when he takes damage or consumes health, accelerating his additional attacks.

Conclusion and Personal Opinion

Mortenax Blade is a true mechanical beast that's set to disrupt the support meta. However, personally, while this Blade looks extremely interesting and tempting, my priorities are clear: I'm still saving my passes for Cirene, for the spectacular new Himeko Nova, and especially for Rin, the highly anticipated collaboration character. Jade economy is tough, and I have to prioritize!

> Muy buenas mi gente bella de Hive Gaming, aquí AlexBit en una nueva publicación para la comunidad. En esta ocasión, nos sumergimos en el universo de Honkai: Star Rail para analizar la esperadísima versión 4.3. Si pensaban que ya lo habían visto todo en composiciones, agárrense. Hoy desglosamos a fondo a Mortenax Blade, quien regresa con un rol renovado para convertirse en uno de los mejores soportes y amplificadores de daño de todo el juego.
alt=\

> Como nuevo personaje jugable, le damos la bienvenida a esta variante de Blade, de elemento Fuego y de la vía de la Nihilidad. Olvídense de los Estados Dañinos (DoTs) lentos; su kit es un híbrido brutal entre sub-DPS ofensivo y amplificador masivo que escala con su Vida Máxima (Max HP). Su especialidad es destrozar defensas, absorber golpes y potenciar exponencialmente al DPS principal (siendo el compañero ideal de Acheron).
alt=\

>

Kit de Habilidades: El Sacrificio de la Sangre
Ataque Básico (Objetivo Único): Inflige Daño de Fuego basado en su Vida Máxima y aplica Provocación (Taunt) por 1 turno. Ideal para proteger aliados frágiles desviando el daño hacia él.

Habilidad Básica (AoE): ¡No consume Puntos de Habilidad (SP)! Consume 10% de su HP para desatar un ataque en área y 4 golpes aleatorios. Solo se activa bajo el estado de Furia Infinita si su vida es mayor a 1.


<div class=\
>\n
alt=\
>
>\n
alt=\
> Habilidad Definitiva (Dos Fases - Costo: 160): Fornax Ex Corpore: Aplica \

a todos los enemigos (-30% de Defensa y +50% de daño recibido por 2 turnos). Consume 20% de su HP para activar una Zona de Campo y entra en Furia Infinita (+20% Prob. CRIT, +60% Daño CRIT y desbloquea su Básica). Si recibe un golpe letal aquí, no muere: consume la zona y revive con 50% de HP.

Tenax Per Ignem: Ya transformado, la Definitiva se vuelve un golpe masivo que inflige un demoledor 350% de su Vida Máxima a todos los enemigos.

Talento (Ataque Adicional): Con la Zona activa, cada ataque aliado le otorga 1 Carga. Al llegar a 9 Cargas, consume los puntos, recupera 25 de energía y lanza automáticamente una Habilidad Básica extra como Ataque Adicional (sin gastar vida ni SP).

Técnica (Iniciación): Provoca a todos los enemigos al entrar al combate y reduce el daño recibido por Blade en un 90% durante los 2 primeros turnos.


<div class=\

alt=\

> Rastros Clave de Primer Nivel Hueso Endurecido: Almacena hasta 80 puntos de energía sobrante y autoregenera su energía hasta el 75% al iniciar el combate. Acumulación de Carga: Blade gana cargas para su talento cuando recibe daño o consume su vida, acelerando sus ataques adicionales.

Conclusión y Opinión Personal

Mortenax Blade es una auténtica bestia mecánica que viene a romper el meta de soporte. Sin embargo, en lo personal, aunque este Blade se ve sumamente interesante y tentador, mis prioridades están claras: yo sigo firme ahorrando mis pases para Cirene, para la nueva y espectacular Himeko Nova, y sobre todo para Rin, el esperadísimo personaje de la colaboración. ¡La economía de jades está difícil y hay que priorizar!

body.title: Hive About To Be Stress Tested?
body.body:
### So... once more we should expect the unexpected. 

It's starting to get interesting (in a bad way). Hive's price has once more taken a dump and I think we are reaching a point soon which will test the resolve not just of (long time) users, but of the network itself as well. [The debt ratio is now skyrocketing once again](https://hbdstats.com/hbd.html) and we are fast closing in on 30%. As you can see in the chart, we have never been at these levels. We are \
a 40% crash away from \

. The implications of a 30%+ debt ratio essentially means [that no HBD will be issued from post rewards.](https://peakd.com/hbd/@arcange/hive-debt-ratio-and-haircut-rule). Additionally, the Hive > HBD conversation is not functional (although this is already the case). \n\nNothing dramatic will happen should we go over that debt ratio (e.g. the chain will stop working), but the Hive network itself will be under stress since some functionality isn't available anymore. Perhaps the biggest threat would be a decoupling of HBD from the $1 peg. We have seen this before and so far we have avoided it by some network upgrades we saw. A decoupling would be problematic since the mechanisms in place to stabilize it will not work anymore. In a worst case scenario, it could take many months for HBD to go back to $1 and ironically it will depend on Hive's price going back up again. But why should it go back up if the chain is under so much debt/stress? The \

is that a recovery has happened before, so I don't think the network will be caught in a downward spiral, but the threat is there...


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23t752KavQTiARjYSBVApArC6oveC9PzUtKvGmhecckYD2WTYP7dDcJeBeMpHMWUjefQZ.png)

It will probably also be a good idea **to lower the HBD interest** or perhaps completely remove it for a limited period as it is only creating more debt. I will adjust my witness votes accordingly. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23tbJtVZP4aGoqJKsyqAogDKvb5Xox7fUNjmL2v1wSSVd3yCsyiQEiWsKiy8jCTR7X9v6.png)


### Charts

The charts look somewhat strange in that **we just had the third most active trading period in Hive's history** with price going *lower.* Previously I have argued that we would see price going back up, since this has always happened so far. @digi-me has suggested this being simply large exit pumps, and while I am not shocked to see the pump and dump schemes from whales, perhaps this really was just one \

push for whales to exit? The chart looks bleak:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23tHbr9aCVL4YsYQG7GuFKBqof57kjgbrKxTbqWGFDiuHjbmYUzDeMrDJukMUsZ31S6Qa.png)

Price has broken down on the daily and weekly support lines (blue and purple) and is in \

currently, with Hive for the first time breaking into the 4 cent area (if we ignore the 10/10 crash). 

On the macro chart we can see that the brief consolidation period we were in looks like it will break down lower as well. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23t8CfKPvWYGvbeDYdgMcbtiXJN2veoPnNQshWwuMFCR1REVgnV7ADB89QrqBXGdqrbRH.png)

To be clear: **there is no support in the <5 cents area.** The bounce I envisioned can now only rematerialize should we quickly enter into a V-shaped recovery taking price back into the 5-6 cents area. Honestly, it doesn't look good. 

### Conclusion

It looks like we are all about to find out what will happen to Hive with a debt ratio exceeding 30% and a potential HBD decoupling. Hard times ahead. 

---

body.title: Das erste Wiener Aufzug-Café / the first Viennese elevator café
body.body:
Liebe Leser,
in diesem zwar bunten, aber ansonsten unscheinbaren Nachkriegs-Haus am Wiedner Gürtel, vis-a-vis vom Hauptbahnhof, befindet sich das erste (und einzige) Wiener Aufzug-Café.
![IMG_5625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eoptvs3g1prYMZeatN2Ukki8c9xdyAvxanGD188AHSsWCii5DK9bNfLPUgp6UqpiyMy.jpg)

Ohne diesen Eingangsbereich mit dem Schriftzug \

wäre ich vermutlich einfach daran vorbeigegangen.
![IMG_5487.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23ynSNRb2cDKwaHdYC4PMAE416dRryq6wrYxHjFETq4HB3cBfeVY2HQ3cCCwSBLKahPND.jpg)

Aufzug-Cafe? Zuerst dachte ich, man sitzt dort in einem fahrenden Aufzug, aber das stellte sich dann doch als zu utopisch heraus. Das einzige sich bewegende Restaurant in Wien ist (meines Wissens) das im [Donauturm](https://www.donauturm.at/de/gastronomie-and-shop/turm-restaurant/) (das dreht sich um die eigene Achse, auf 170m Höhe), abgesehen von Bootsrestaurants auf der (Alten) Donau.
Stattdessen besteht dieses Kaffeehaus aus einer wilden Mischung aus Aufzugkabinen, alle ausgebaut und somit gerettet im Zuge von Sanierungen alter Wohnhäuser, und in mühseliger Handarbeit originalgetreu hier wieder restauriert und zusammengebaut. Auf diese Weise bleiben diese Zeugnisse frühen Fahrstuhldesigns für die Nachwelt erhalten und haben sogar eine neue Aufgabe bekommen.
![IMG_5488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xVJwG2JyXNRcQFKPGYmrgDnjHMoryNuPw88osrGLxDAYkCpEhMKq37XaCLW7GQQREnH.jpg)

Die meisten stammen aus ca. 1900 bis 1915, Fahrstühle in Europa verbreiteten sich ab ca. 1870 (zuerst noch dampfbetrieben, elektrische ab 1880), in privaten Wohnhäusern aber erst deutlich später oder wurden erst im 20. Jhd. nachträglich eingebaut.

Zwei Paternoster-Kabinen aus der Zentrale des ehem. [Wiener Bankvereins](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiener_Bankverein), Baujahr 1911-12, wurden fix in die Wand integriert. Zuletzt hatte ich ja einen der noch 6 bestehenden Paternoster in Wien im  [Rathaus](https://peakd.com/hive-166496/@stayoutoftherz/das-wiener-rathaus-viennas-city-hall) beschrieben. Der Name entstand übrigens durch die Parallele zum Rosenkranz (und nicht durch Stoßgebete beim Benützen😃).
![IMG_5617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23x1BAJF14f3MruZ2u3e4CjLo5UZsSxPihg98aXEsiJa2SG1AJ5WWcmW4B8aiXaHTEmTu.jpg)

Ich entschied mich für diese gerade freigewordene Aufzugkabine, in die - sitzenderweise - 2 Personen gerade noch reinpassen würden.
![IMG_5612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23yJLg1rSo6AXnmmMjQUKCfdDXckMQBRqDqHfszBbTvSmuVkvefC2Y7WDxxo5r1fkSf6M.jpg)

Laut der originalen Benützungsvorschrift war er aber für 3 Personen und max. 250kg zugelassen. Das könnte heute schon schwierig sein, wo z.B. in D. das Durchschnittsgewicht von erwachsenen Männern lt. Destatis schon bei 85kg liegt!
![IMG_5614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23vi8AysvYV3YQPSyxB8Aya5siFLnM3p2Tan99MfTGjwnjyNazbAjb4CvG6db5SZ9jc9g.jpg)


Ein kleiner Brauner, der minimalistische Klassiker.
![IMG_5616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23zRzsDtHwJZmLTytXdhRZwpqYUcuuLssbkMrJQspTD2Wxmu7syrvpBHJXX1MerBQAVBg.jpg)

Der \

, Christian Tauss, ist auch gleichzeitig Gründer und Chef dieses etwas bizarren, aber durchaus gemütlichen Kaffeehauses.
![IMG_5615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wWrooy1Mtz85xDi3vNKoQq8GPLJ9JqggjV7hfokkUepWvPKBuBH5GJAWRLVAFdKJS3f.jpg)

Neben Kaffee- und Tee-Spezialitäten gibt es auch eine ansprechende Auswahl an kohlenhydratreichen Stärkungen.

![IMG_5618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23u673161LgaWDEDxA27ePv7GRqhh4P1RWa4CDW3pTf88Rx6sarRnUaCf9R9XJdRhGDmr.jpg)

Eine klare Besuchsempfehlung!
![IMG_5621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/EogMqbHmYRdDPbf5vuxuaR9c1CdhuZV3xpDtBL9xUurZc1pAG5VY6ePu8nhX415any9.jpg)


All pics by @stayoutoftherz

**https://aufzug.cafe/**
Adresse:
Wiedner Gürtel 4, 1040 Wien
Öffnungszeiten:
Mittwoch – Sonntag 09:00-17:00

Historische Aufzüge: [Aufzug-Museum](https://www.aufzugmuseum.at/)
Mehr Kaffeehäuser auf Hive: https://peakd.com/ccc/stayoutoftherz/kaffeehauser-in-wien-coffeehouses-in-vienna

body.title: Perspectives
body.body: <div class=\

>


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVayKE9aorctAFt5BBK9XpyVGhCW6ywJ6ojaGC3RfHycc/1780926961554.jpg)


No more wishing in the well, no more living in the thoughts, what's left of me?

What's left is progress. 

My mind is always asking, \

And it answers itself before I could even use it to think of an answer. The answer however is not the most ideal way to think.

The mind imagines an outcome without flaws as perfection. No one is actively considering a mess up or a mishap in their beautifully well laid out plan or fantasized thoughts.

We're all thinking in the \

. Until it's perfect, we have to keep moving. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUXHND8JkBKnAzJCCxvEsMqF3AeLKpN21E2gP81jZCjXa/1780926934683.png) #### Perfectionist > What's your definition of perfect? - I'll tell you mine. If my brain and the brain of the observer thinks there's a better way, we still haven't reached perfection. Based on my definition, is perfection a possibility? Clearly there's no way that'll happen in my lifetime. We have over 8 billion people with different perspectives. Even if we share similar perspectives, we share it at different wavelengths and there are parts of our agreements that we will disagree. > We hit a wall, then we agree to disagree. So why bother looking for what's perfect if we may never find it? I ask you this, did mother nature, the universe and reality itself know what was perfect for life? They obviously had a formula for life otherwise we wouldn't be here, but was it perfect? Is this the best we could have done? I do sometimes sit down and think to myself, maybe there's another earth, in a distant galaxy that has found the cheat code to having life on a planet without the natural disasters. > The question is, why are we calling it natural disasters? Relativity, that's why. It's a disaster for us, otherwise it's the earth's natural way and it's been like this millions of years before we came around. The mosquitoe bites you, injects plasmodium into your blood, gives you malaria and thank God there's medication and remedies, because the next event was your death. And while you're being laid in state, the mosquitoe sees it as progress. So was mother nature trying to be unfair to you or trying to be fair to the mosquitoe? It's bad for the host, but seems like a positive advancement for the parasite. It's bad for the prey, but a filled belly for the predator. ![](Uploading... 1780926946887.png) #### One man's meat is another man's poison. That's an adage in Ghana. You might hate something to a point you would want to kill it but you may be killing the thing someone would kill for. So, is there really an objective truth? There must be. But how objective, to what scale is that so called fact still even a thing? We think we're falling, but because of the physicists, we know now that we're mass and we're being attracted to each other, and that's through the len of physics. Perspectives might be our limitation. Does it mean we can't know the absolute truth? Perhaps not. Perhaps we can use a tool that is not biased or based on our perspectives. Do you know what tool that is? [Image resource sourced from Pixbay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/cartoon-painting-fantasy-5124006/)

body.title: Guest: Barrett Brown - Mapping Peter Thiel’s Panopticon & Mobilizing The Counteroffensive
body.body:
by The Free Thought Project on The Free Thought Project Podcast 
View my bio on Vigilante.TV: https://vigilante.tv/c/thefreethoughtproject [![Guest: Barrett Brown - Mapping Peter Thiel’s Panopticon & Mobilizing The Counteroffensive](https://vigilante.tv/lazy-static/previews/0dd03865-2ab2-41f4-9a73-efb3b03c024c.jpg)](https://vigilante.tv/w/4ZPcNrS36BHnKgpGKwLxFA) 
 
 In this episode of The Free Thought Project podcast, Matt Agorist and Jason Bassler sit down with legendary journalist, essayist, and transparency activist Barrett Brown. Renowned for his early investigations into the cyber-industrial complex and his work with the crowdsourced investigative wiki Project PM, Barrett became a prime target of the national security state following the 2012 Stratfor email leaks. He subsequently endured five years in federal prison, solitary confinement, and restrictive gag orders—a campaign of state retaliation that only solidified his status as an unbroken voice in the liberty movement. Returning to the show, Barrett brings his signature, uncompromising intellect to expose the inner workings of the modern panopticon and the corporate entities currently building it.

The conversation dives deep into the sprawling nexus of the privatized surveillance state, unpacking the true power dynamic behind Palantir Co-Founder Peter Thiel and his deep-seated connections to the intelligence community. The discussion traces the hidden history of narrative control, examining everything from leaked Jeffrey Epstein communications to new corporate schemes like \

—an organization utilizing intelligence-linked actors to score journalist credibility. A major focus centers on the unprecedented infrastructure boom taking place on American soil, where the U.S. already operates over 5,400 data centers—more than the next 14 nations combined—while aggressively constructing thousands more under the guise of \

The dialogue explores the frightening reality of an outsourced, unconstitutional data-gathering grid hidden behind corporate NDAs, a recent institutional mutiny that led to Barrett being blacklisted from a major publication by intelligence assets, and a compelling look at how modern information warfare seeks to render truth entirely irrelevant.\n\nEnding on a powerful \

the episode shifts from the terrifying scale of the cyber-industrial complex to a concrete strategy for dismantling it. Rather than succumbing to defeatism, the discussion highlights the immense vulnerability of these technocratic institutions when faced with decentralized, entirely legal counter-information campaigns. Barrett details an upcoming, real-time demonstration of a massive new crowdsourced investigative offensive. By fusing standard investigative journalism with public research networks and advanced data-processing tools, this hybrid model is designed to crowdsource the exposure of state and corporate corruption at eighty times the speed of previous initiatives. The audience is left with a stark, inspiring reminder: the global surveillance apparatus is structurally weak, entirely dependent on public ignorance, and can be decisively toppled by a focused, legally insulated vanguard committed to reclaiming human liberty. (Length: 1:11:15)

Guest Links & Resources:

body.title: Celebrate Americana Crafting with the Little Bits of America Wool Kit
body.body:
![97D1EA1E-0A12-4A3E-A349-6742B2DA.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/2f9754bc6254c058d833155e30cac93de4e6d7a791aadd091c9623a8bf2a489c)



Patriotic home décor never goes out of style, especially when it is handmade with warmth and character. The “Little Bits of America” wool appliqué kit from[ Midway Wool](https://midwaywool.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) offers crafters a creative and relaxing way to add timeless Americana charm to their seasonal decorating.

Designed with cozy farmhouse aesthetics in mind, this wool appliqué project features miniature patriotic bowl fillers that combine rustic textures, classic red-white-and-blue colors, and handcrafted detail. Whether displayed in a decorative bowl, arranged on a tiered tray, or styled on a shelf, these small accents instantly create a welcoming patriotic atmosphere.

## A Charming Patriotic Wool Appliqué Project

The “Little Bits of America” collection includes beautifully designed mini wool pillows inspired by traditional Americana themes. From tiny American flags to birdhouses and floral accents, each piece captures a nostalgic country-inspired style that works perfectly for summer decorating.

These bowl fillers are ideal for:

*   Memorial Day décor

*   Fourth of July decorating

*   Farmhouse-style interiors

*   Rustic seasonal displays

*   Tiered tray arrangements

*   Handmade gifting ideas

The finished pieces measure approximately 4 x 3 inches, making them compact enough for quick stitching projects while still showcasing beautiful appliqué details.

en el Marketing Web3: Una Espada de Doble Filo
body.body:
<center>![1001023721.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mkt.community/23uQpUdXQdD6b3KGeuHjBoPnknzaPUbTFmHWhG62cgvnzCnMP3VFTTMCGmg7xL33JXynb.png)</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

¡Saludos, Marketers!

En el dinámico universo de Web3, donde las criptomonedas, los NFTs y los contratos inteligentes transforman la economía digital, una emoción humana fundamental se ha convertido en un catalizador de decisiones masivas: el FOMO, o \

en español (miedo a quedarse fuera o perderse de algo). ***¿Qué es el FOMO?*** El FOMO es una respuesta emocional que surge ante la percepción de que otros están viviendo experiencias, obteniendo beneficios o accediendo a oportunidades que nosotros no. En el contexto de Web3, esto puede significar perderse una preventa de tokens, una oportunidad de inversión en un proyecto prometedor o la obtención de un NFT de edición limitada, incluso la opción de educarse gratuitamente. ***El Lado Oscuro del FOMO*** Aunque el FOMO puede ser un poderoso catalizador, también conlleva riesgos importantes, especialmente en un ecosistema descentralizado donde las reglas no siempre están claras: *Decisiones impulsivas:* Los usuarios, por miedo a perder la “oportunidad del siglo”, invierten sin analizar riesgos, lo que puede llevar a estafas o pérdidas financieras. *Vulnerabilidad ante el hype:* Proyectos que se promocionan con promesas exageradas o campañas agresivas pueden aprovechar el FOMO para inflar artificialmente su valor. *Fatiga emocional:* La presión constante por “estar en todo” puede generar ansiedad, burnout e incluso desilusión con el ecosistema Web3. ***¿Cómo usar el potencial del FOMO?*** Sin embargo, no todo es negativo. Cuando se maneja estratégicamente y con ética, el FOMO puede ser una herramienta de marketing muy poderosa: *Crear urgencia real:* Ofrecer promociones temporales o ediciones limitadas puede impulsar la participación sin caer en la manipulación. *Gamificación positiva:* Incluir mecánicas como recompensas exclusivas para los primeros usuarios o beneficios acumulativos puede generar engagement sano. *Construcción de comunidad:* Las campañas que fomentan la participación colectiva (como airdrops por referidos o logros colaborativos) pueden aprovechar el FOMO de forma más inclusiva. --- ***¿Cómo evitar caer en el FOMO TÓXICO?*** Para los usuarios, protegerse ante el FOMO no solo es una cuestión de salud financiera, sino también emocional. Aquí van algunas recomendaciones clave: Haz tu propia investigación (DYOR): No te dejes llevar por el entusiasmo colectivo. Investiga el equipo detrás del proyecto, su hoja de ruta y los fundamentos del token o activo. Verifica fuentes: Asegúrate de que la información provenga de canales oficiales y de la comunidad, no de influencers pagados o anuncios sospechosamente atractivos. Establece límites emocionales y financieros: Define cuánto estás dispuesto a invertir sin comprometer tu bienestar, y sé fiel a tus decisiones, aunque otros estén obteniendo ganancias rápidas. Detente y respira: Si sientes presión por actuar “ya”, haz una pausa. A menudo, lo que parece urgente puede esperar un par de horas mientras analizas con cabeza fría. El FOMO no va a desaparecer, pero sí podemos decidir cómo lo dejamos influir en nuestras acciones. En un mundo tan vertiginoso como el de Web3, el verdadero superpoder no es estar en todo, sino saber cuándo no estar. ¡Nos vemos en un próximo artículo! 🚀 ---

body.title: No Pack Left Behind: The Hidden Genius Of WOO's Progress System
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Sometimes the most important part of a game update is not the feature everyone talks about. Sometimes it is the small detail that quietly solves a problem players did not even realize existed.

For me, one of the smartest parts of the new Land Rewards system is not the weekly rewards themselves. It is the fact that partial progress carries forward. At first glance, that may sound like a minor feature. In reality, I think it is one of the reasons this system will feel rewarding for players over the long term.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t72foynmhHsLW5ZgQEJybghthf4TB725xCYQo44h7BqiTSdtsxEfYpmrsHa1zfopzc8.png)

---

Anyone who has played enough games has probably experienced situations where progress gets rounded down, discarded, or simply lost because it does not fit neatly into the reward structure. Few things are more frustrating than knowing you earned something but never actually received credit for it.

WOO's new system avoids that entirely. Every fraction counts. Every bit of progress matters. Nothing is wasted. That might sound simple, but it creates a surprisingly powerful psychological effect.

## Small Progress Is Still Progress

• Fractional rewards remain valuable.

One of the easiest ways for players to become discouraged is when effort feels wasted. Imagine generating the equivalent of 3.4 packs and only receiving 3 packs while the remaining 0.4 disappears forever. That would feel terrible. Instead, WOO preserves that progress and allows it to continue accumulating toward future rewards. That feels fair.

• Players receive credit for everything they earn.

Fairness is one of the most important aspects of reward design. Players are usually willing to accept slow progression as long as they believe the system is treating them fairly. The carryover system reinforces that trust. Every contribution is recorded. Every fraction remains meaningful.

• Long-term accumulation becomes satisfying.

There is something enjoyable about watching progress gradually increase over time. Even if you do not earn a complete additional pack this week, seeing that saved progress can still feel rewarding because you know it is helping build toward future rewards.

## The Psychology Of Momentum

• Progress bars are surprisingly powerful.

Gamers love progress bars. There is a reason almost every modern game uses them. They create visible momentum. The Land Rewards system essentially creates a similar feeling through accumulated pack progress. Players can see that they are getting closer to their next reward rather than starting from zero every week.

• Every week feels productive.

Even weeks with smaller results contribute toward future gains. That consistency helps maintain motivation because players know their efforts are always advancing them forward. I personally find these systems much more enjoyable than reward structures that rely entirely on luck.

• Long-term participation becomes easier.

Players are more likely to stay engaged when they feel that progress is constantly accumulating. The carryover system reinforces that feeling every single week.

## Why This Supports The Entire Ecosystem

• Land ownership feels more reliable.

One concern players often have with reward systems is inconsistency. The saved progress mechanic helps smooth out some of that variability by ensuring that partial rewards are never lost. That creates greater confidence in the system.

• Training Center investments feel safer.

Upgrading buildings requires commitment. Knowing that every bit of generated value contributes toward future rewards makes those investments feel more worthwhile. That strengthens the overall appeal of land development.

• Reward generation becomes more predictable.

While weekly rolls still introduce excitement, the carryover mechanic ensures that progress continues accumulating regardless of short-term outcomes. That balance between randomness and consistency is important.

## The Difference Between Good And Great Design

• Good systems reward players.

Great systems respect players. That is the distinction I see here. The Land Rewards system does not simply hand out packs. It respects the effort, investment, and patience of players by preserving all earned value. That level of consideration matters.

• Small details create lasting impressions.

Players often remember how a system makes them feel more than the actual numbers involved. A carryover mechanic may seem minor on paper, but it contributes significantly to overall satisfaction.

• The feature reflects thoughtful development.

Whenever I see quality-of-life decisions like this, it gives me confidence that developers are thinking carefully about the player experience. That is always encouraging.

## Final Thoughts

The more I examine this update, the more I appreciate the details hidden beneath the headlines.

Most players will naturally focus on weekly packs, Training Centers, and multipliers. Those features absolutely deserve attention. At the same time, I think the progress carryover mechanic deserves recognition as one of the smartest parts of the entire system. It ensures that nothing is wasted. It rewards patience. It creates momentum. It strengthens engagement. Most importantly, it makes the reward structure feel fair.

Fair systems keep players invested. Fair systems encourage long-term participation. Fair systems help build trust.

As a fan watching WOO continue to evolve, I find these kinds of design choices extremely encouraging. They show attention to detail and a genuine effort to create systems that feel rewarding over time.

The headline may be Land Rewards. The hidden story might be that WOO has found a way to make every fraction of progress matter. And in the long run, that may prove just as important.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

Full Metal Ox Day 1926
Monday 8, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1991
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Good Moonday Lunatics. Welcome to a brand new week on Planet Abundance. 

It’s been a couple of years already since we did our “Shattered Beliefs” series. In case you missed it, which you surely did, we took seven, (of course), “beliefs” that are common and largely taken for granted in occidental lands, stripped them down, and decided whether we “believed in” them, or just casually accepted them as true, for the sake of convenience. 

There has been another one, or maybe two, added to the list just recently. 

Pythagoras said, \

Being a self-styled “numbers guy,” I wanted to believe this. I repeated it, and as “proof” I’d point out that the “correct” time that the Earth orbited the Sun, 365.25 days, would return to base-number nine. The 72 years it takes Earth’s north pole to move one degree relative to its “pole star,” is base 9. Thus procession is based on nine. 

When I was looking at the calendar set-up of this year, 2026, I learned, quite to my amazement, that it’s only every 400th year that a century year is a Leap Year. Year 2000 for example, was a Leap Year. 1900 was not a Leap Year, nor will 2100 be a Leap Year. 

There seems to be an 11 minute discrepancy in the actual length of the year, and in order to correct “time,” three Leap Years must be skipped every 400 years. 

And we complain about Daylight Saving Time. 

These numbers don’t show up in fairy tales, bible stories or epics, because it’s a relatively “new” development. The Gregorian calendar was adopted in the 16th century in western Europe.  

Anyway, it wasn’t God that created the Universe with math. It was hue man who attempted to comprehend “creation” with math. And it doesn’t work. Heavenly bodies, living “create-chures” in space do not conform to man’s whims and fantasies, regardless of the numbers they use to describe them. 

Does this mean your humble vagabond is ditching, perfect numbers, Fibonacci sequences, exponents, and general numbers magic? Nope. Numbers are still truth. They don’t lie. Even when humans apply those numbers to phenomena we do not understand, in an attempt to measure, master, predict and profit off of such phenomena, And neither align, the numbers are still perfect. 

Map the perceivable galaxy in a circle, divide it into 12 parts, associate each part with a creature, assign 30 degrees to each sign, and call it a zodiac, it won’t be long until the drift is noticed, and the map must be “adjusted.” 

The “awakening” factor, is the realization that what humans “know,” humans created, or in most cases, “imagined,” “named,” “measured,” “diagrammed,” and ultimately got wrong. Maybe not wrong. “Close, but no cigar.”  

What was actually shattered was not my faith in numbers, but an already waning faith in the self-celebrated brilliance of humans. 

There are a mouthful of human critters today, attempting to do the same with “consciousness,” that medieval astronomers were attempting to do with space, planets and the unseen, unknown, elements of the solar system. 

There’s not a single, “quantum consciousness” article that doesn’t contain a sentence that goes a little something like this: “If this phenomenon is so, than it means that we are actually compressed energy balls of galactic consciousness.” And then they will invite you to, “sit with that,” or “let that sink in.” But what “most readers” either forget, or ignore, is, “if.” It’s the classic, and now cliche, mistaking the menu for the meal. Does the image of your meal contain the 1500 calories advertised? Is it hot? Tasty? The picture might make your mouth water the same way a soothsayer might excite you, by showing you how the planets are going to align in a “Biblical” pattern in July of 2026, (next month). Then, like a waiter describing the taste and texture of the dish in the picture,  the prognosticator, “interprets,” the geometry as beneficial, or an omen of coming disaster.  

And it’s all made up. But here’s the weird thing. Most of it is angled towards disaster. And they usually get those predictions correct. 

Stay safe, stay strong, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE.

The 120 Year, & Counting, War. Part 1. 
Here’s what nobody tells you about “awakening.” When awakening, intersects with curiosity, critical thinking and instant access to superficial data, (as opposed to deep-diving into biographies and memoirs.)   
In one of the “many” blogs, audios or videos we produce, we were goofing around. Ready to concede that we were living through World War 3, we were like, “World War 2 never really ended. It transitioned. This is still the same war.” 
But then we remembered some historians contend that World War 2 was just a continuation of World War 1. Then there was the World War before the Great War, (the name before it was dubbed WW1), between Russia and Japan. Japan invaded Russia! (1904). Seems incredible given the island nation’s neutered reputation today. [Note, it only seems surprising to this awakening vessel because of our Euro-supremacist brain-washing. How could we even imagine that an Asian Island nation could defeat a European country. Japanese warriors were true badasses back in the day.]   
Everything that’s happened from now, back to 1898, in Cuba, is the same war. It all goes back to the same ethos, the same arrogance that drives the same policies, that kept Europe fighting among itself for 1500 years. They brought that same shit over to the western hemisphere, and James, “Monroe-doctrine” Monroe, declared that Europe shall not interfere with the western hemisphere. 
Yes, James Monroe, was a poet, as well as fifth President of the United States. James Monroe, incidentally was involved with sending African-American slaves back to Africa, to Liberia, (Liberty, get it?), which is why the capital is called Monrovia. But back to the edge of the 20th Century. It’s not just America at War. It’s an “ethos,” and idea. And by 1989, “Whiteness” had become an identity in the US & western Europe. 
There were battles, skirmishes, uprisings, revolutions, invasions, rebellions, coups, color revolutions, but it’s all the same global war.   
This will have to be continued, as a 120 year war, that’s still in effect, will take a few days. 
Spanish-American War (1898): The U.S. emerges as a colonial power, taking the Philippines, Guam, Puerto Rico, and Cuba (as a protectorate). This wasn't just a war; it was a declaration of arrival. It signaled that the old European imperial system now had a new, aggressive partner across the Atlantic.

Boer War (1899–1902): Britain's brutal counter-insurgency (concentration camps, scorched earth) in South Africa, fought to control the world's largest gold deposits, foreshadows every subsequent colonial \

The Bank of London and the Rothschilds financed both sides, showing capital's supra-national loyalty to profit, not country. \nPhilippine-American War (1899–1902): The true sequel to 1898. 200,000 Filipino civilians killed. Concentration camps, water torture, \

orders. This is the template for Vietnam, Algeria, and Iraq. 

Russo-Japanese War (1904–1905): First time a non-European power defeats a European empire. Japan enters the imperial club. This war, mediated by the U.S. (Teddy Roosevelt), establishes the pattern of peripheral powers using Western military technology to challenge old structures. 

From 1898, we see a globalized battlefield. The U.S., Britain, Japan, and Russia are now locked in a competition for spheres of influence that ignores continent boundaries. Finance (London, then New York) underwrites all sides. 

Mexican Revolution & Border Wars (1910–1919): Pershing's expedition (1916) chasing Pancho Villa. U.S. interventions to protect American oil interests, a direct precedent for Central America. 
 
 The Great War and Its \

Wars (1914–1923). 

WW1 (1914–1918): The obvious explosion. But note: Germany's goal of Mitteleuropa, and the Allies' carving of Ottoman territories are direct continuations of 1898's imperial logic. 
Post-WW1 Lesser-Known Wars (1917–1923).  
Russian Civil War (1917–1922): Allied intervention (U.S., UK, Japan, France) fighting to destroy communism. This is the first \

hot conflict. 
Polish-Soviet War (1919–1921): A direct attempt to roll back the Bolshevik revolution. 
Greco-Turkish War (1919–1922): Final act of the Ottoman Empire's partition. 
Irish War of Independence (1919–1921): British counter-insurgency, a model for later, \

\n\nThe League of Nations is supposed to end war, but the 1919–1923 period proves that the Great War never really ended, it just fragmented into smaller, manageable massacres. The distinction between \
and \

is born here.  

The Long Armistice (1923–1939) & The Interwar Interventions.  
Spanish Civil War (1936–1939): The rehearsal for WW2. Germany, Italy, and the USSR test airpower and terror bombing (Guernica). Also a proxy war 30 years before \

was a term. 


Banana Wars (1898–1934): U.S. Marine occupations of Nicaragua, Honduras, Haiti, Dominican Republic. Direct corporate imperialism (United Fruit, Standard Fruit) linking Wall Street to Marine Corps rifle squads. 
British & French Colonial Pacifications (1920s–1930s): In Syria, Iraq, Morocco (Rif War), and India (Waziristan). Poison gas, aerial bombardment of villages, collective punishment, all \

against locals resisting resource extraction (oil, phosphates, cotton).  
Italian Invasion of Ethiopia (1935): Last act of classical imperialism, but also a rehearsal for WW2's mechanized warfare.

**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>**

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tm72cKEbDXDt5Rb967WXBkFXZc1pfTwE61LhjBceFC2gsMg4TFwp5ZFXic9SpDcTyZK.webp)


[Fuente. ](https://lat.motorsport.com/f1/news/f1-monaco-2026-ganadores-perdedores-carrera/10828218/)

<div class=\

>El gran premio de Mónaco dejó una ventaja de 66 puntos entre el líder Kimi Antonelli (156) y el segundo puesto que no, no es Russell sino el múltiple campeón mundial Lewis Hamilton (90). Lo que estamos viendo del piloto de Mercedes en esta parte de la temporada es una absoluta locura, de 6 carreras que llevamos él ha ganado las últimas 5 y Australia que fue la primera del año terminó de segundo; es decir, el dominio total que está teniendo este piloto de 19 años no se había visto en unos cuantos años. Pero no es solo el hecho de que gane carreras, hay que mencionar la diferencia que está sacando con respecto a su compañero de equipo quien en Canadá y ahora en Mónaco no pudo sumar puntos.

> The Monaco Grand Prix left a 66-point gap between championship leader Kimi Antonelli (156) and second place, which, no, isn't Russell but the multiple world champion Lewis Hamilton (90). What we're seeing from the Mercedes driver at this point in the season is absolutely incredible. Of the six races held so far, he's won the last five, and in Australia, the first race of the year, he finished second. In other words, the total dominance this 19-year-old driver is showing hasn't been seen in quite a few years. But it's not just the fact that he's winning races; we also have to mention the gap he's building over his teammate, who failed to score points in Canada and now in Monaco.

>Personalmente ver una carrera de Mónaco me parece una tortura, si bien es verdad es de las míticas de la historia y del calendario, su trazado tan angosto hace que sea imposible hacer cualquier maniobra de sobrepaso lo que limita a que la acción que puede haber sea dada por errores propios de los pilotos; caso de lo ocurrido ayer. Safety Cars, banderas rojas, penalizaciones, retiros de vehículos; un sinfín de cosas que pasaron que le dieron una ligera vida a una carrera de casi 80 vueltas. Vayamos por equipos. Mercedes durante el fin de semana se le vio bien, siempre estando en lo alto pero siempre con un Kimi destacando. El italiano se lleva la Pole siendo un piloto muy arriesgado dando las vueltas, cuando maneja pareciera que tuviera años en la F1.

> Personally, watching a Monaco Grand Prix feels like torture. While it's true that it's one of the most legendary races in history and on the calendar, its narrow circuit makes overtaking virtually impossible, limiting any action to driver errors, as was the case yesterday. Safety cars, red flags, penalties, retirements—a myriad of things happened that gave a brief respite to a race of almost 80 laps. Let's talk about the teams. Mercedes looked good throughout the weekend, always at the front, but always with Kimi Räikkönen standing out. The Italian took pole position, demonstrating his daring style of driving; when he's behind the wheel, it's as if he's been in F1 for years. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xA22yq8S59YdHGVTfswH9hxa4BU6R4BQhodcZFLcugxcuNLw2gp6UAWzNhqEW2R8tJs) [Fuente. ](https://tn.com.ar/fotos/internacional/2026/06/07/del-gp-de-monaco-a-las-elecciones-en-peru-las-imagenes-del-dia/) --- ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/48HBXWRV1fF1qUtov96meTbki8XxZm8TebmXLB9HwL75N8tj2JCevgVVd3x4sKis1c.jpg) [Fuente.](https://norteenlinea.com/kimi-antonelli-gana-el-gran-premio-de-monaco/)

>Antes de seguir decir que Kimi hizo par de cosas interesantes además de ganar, la primera es que empató a gente como Verstappen, Hamilton, Schumacher, Mansell, etc, en pilotos que han ganado 5 carreas consecutivas, ya entró a ese selecto grupo. Y la segunda es que hizo el Grand Slam o Grand Chalem (Pole, vuelta rápida, líder en todas las vueltas de la carrera y ganar el premio). Seguimos. Russell ha tenido mala suerte, en Canadá un problema mecánico y ayer un error garrafal del equipo hicieron que lo sancionaran con la peor penalización que hay, un drive through. Imagino que mentalmente debe de estar abatido porque comenzó muy fuerte pero se ha venido cayendo considerablemente. Ferrari como siempre eran los favoritos con un Leclerc corriendo en casa pero la calamidad también llegó a él. Un problema en los frenos hizo que se pegara contra una de las defensas y se retiró (problema que está generando ruido).

> Before going any further, I should mention that Kimi did a couple of interesting things besides winning. First, he equaled the record of drivers like Verstappen, Hamilton, Schumacher, Mansell, etc., for five consecutive wins, joining that select group. Second, he achieved the Grand Slam (pole position, fastest lap, leading every lap of the race, and winning the award). Moving on, Russell has had some bad luck. In Canada, a mechanical problem, and yesterday a colossal team error resulted in him receiving the worst possible penalty: a drive-through. I imagine he must be mentally devastated because he started very strong but has since declined considerably. Ferrari, as always, were the favorites, with Leclerc racing at home, but misfortune struck him too. A brake problem caused him to crash into a barrier and retire (a problem that's generating a lot of buzz).

>Hamilton hizo una buena carrera, fue penalizado, cumplió y salió airoso terminando en la segunda plaza. Los Ferrari siempre demuestran cosas buenas acá. De Red Bull no se puede decir lo mismo, ayer fueron el yin/yang. Verstappen quien partía segundo después de haber hecho una gran Pole, contra todo pronostico, ayer en la partida se queda fuera por un problema en la unidad de potencia. Duro golpe para él pero no tanto para Red Bull porque Hadjar hizo podio con todo y que estuvo a punto de abandonar. Muy buen resultado para el joven francés. En lo que a McLaren se refiere decir que este definitivamente no está siendo su año, están a años luz de lo que fueron el año pasado, siguen compitiendo si, pero ese nivel demoledor de la temporada anterior no existe.

> Hamilton had a good race, was penalized, but managed to recover and finish in second place. Ferrari always shows promise here. The same can't be said for Red Bull; yesterday they were the complete opposite. Verstappen, who started second after a great pole position, against all odds, was forced to retire at the start due to a power unit problem. A tough blow for him, but not so much for Red Bull, as Hadjar made it to the podium despite almost retiring. A very good result for the young Frenchman. As for McLaren, this definitely isn't their year. They are light years away from where they were last year. They are still competing, yes, but that devastating level of the previous season is gone. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xoYvEhGhZeAyNbGR63pE9q6igaYP5tx7L8vGcadbpYkdhfKv4pdSMxGZEeT5aQaPHX5.jpg) [Fuente.](https://es.autohebdo.fr/noticias/f1/Hamilton-saborea-su-segundo-puesto-en-M%C3%B3naco--una-sensaci%C3%B3n-excepcional..html) --- ![5.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23vhz7TYfv7wow1tkfy2MwzaTh3zjvBX5NJGfjF2m1FFzfGdNTBEaR1m66TEk14UsUV6g.webp) [Fuente.](https://sporza.be/nl/matches/formule-1/2026-06/grote-prijs-van-monaco-5-op-een-rij-voor-kimi-antonelli-jonge-wk-leider-houdt-het-hoofd-koel-in-tumultueuze-race-met-late-herstart-in-monaco~1780305218454/)

>Norris abandonó por problemas mecánicos y Piastri, aprovechando las sanciones de algunos pilotos se coló en la cuarta plaza. Pero ya les digo que no fue el fin de semana que esperaban, eso es seguro. La realidad es que en esta primera etapa del campeonato hay un solo piloto que está dominando ampliamente y ese es Antonelli. ¿Cuánto más durará este envión? - no lo sabemos porque en esta F1 un día están en lo más alto y al otro caes estrepitosamente. Si es por talento, por personalidad y por motor pues deberíamos de ver mucho más de Kimi en la temporada. La próxima carrera es este fin de semana que viene en Barcelona, un circuito que será muy diferente a lo vivido en Mónaco.

> Norris retired with mechanical problems, and Piastri, taking advantage of penalties for some drivers, slipped into fourth place. But I can tell you right now, it wasn't the weekend they were expecting, that's for sure. The reality is that in this first stage of the championship, there's only one driver who is clearly dominating, and that's Antonelli. How much longer will this momentum last? We don't know because in F1, one day you're on top and the next you fall spectacularly. If it's based on talent, personality, and engine power, then we should see much more of Kimi this season. The next race is this coming weekend in Barcelona, ​​a circuit that will be very different from Monaco.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xAby14rAmtvNhUxhp5DgV86RcNQbbqFeMgKfVxFqekJ47zsg75WPVMZcm7NoXjgpzg2.jpg) [Fuente.](https://www.f1latam.com/noticias/kimi-antonelli-victoria-mercedes-gp-monaco-reporte-f1-2026-resumen-vuelta-a-vuelta-posiciones-carrera-19683) ***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!
*** > Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.body:
Greetings, everyone!

>2️⃣ Summer, dry season, wet season, or fall — what is your favorite thing about the current season in your country and/or the thing you dislike the most about it?


According to this contest question:



![1000806982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23tmFvPvE3aQug3TYD28kK8TriJ9LRW43sWXSL7Vo1f1hEBZVo5tKEvzqw9tcw4BQevb6.jpg)
_**Image by me**_


My favorite season is the dry season, and the thing I love most about it is the sunlight. It dries my clothes very well, especially here in Northern Nigeria. When I was in Akwa Ibom, I did not really experience much sunshine until I came to the North.


The dry season in the North is quite intense and comes with extreme heat, which can make you feel uncomfortable, especially at night when you want to sleep. Unless there is NEPA electricity to power a ceiling fan or standing fan, sleeping can be difficult because of the heat.


Another thing I enjoy about the dry season is the freedom of movement. You can go anywhere without worrying about rain soaking your clothes or disrupting your plans.


The dry season is also ideal for drying food items such as fish and grains, especially for people who want to send them by waybill or travel long distances. Dried items last longer and are less likely to spoil during transportation.


It is also the best season for celebrations. In fact, I would love to have my marriage ceremony during the dry season so that I can fully enjoy every moment with my husband and all my loved ones who will be present.


I love the dry season so much because most activities carried out during this period often produce satisfying and tangible results. Market women can also sell their products more easily and with greater satisfaction. While some goods may still spoil, it is generally less challenging than during the rainy season.


I recently returned from Benue State, where it rained continuously for several days and the weather was quite cold. The weather affected my health, and I became ill. However, I thank God that I am now feeling much better, healthier, and stronger.


_**This is my response to the ladiesofhive of contest #292**_

Hier ist eine strukturierte, leicht verständliche Anleitung basierend auf deinem Skript und deinen Systemvorgaben, wie du deine XAIGPUARC ONEKLICK AI-MACHINE erfolgreich startest und Fehler behebst.
🛠️ Schritt 0: Treiber & Intel oneAPI vorbereiten (Wichtig für Arc A770)

Bevor das Skript läuft, müssen alte Treiberkonflikte gelöst und das native Intel-Toolkit sauber im System verankert sein.
1. Alte Laufzeiten entfernen & Arch-native Treiber installieren

Führe diese Befehle nacheinander im Terminal aus, um Binärkonflikte zu vermeiden:
Bash

# 1. Alte Laufzeiten restlos entfernen
sudo pacman -Rns intel-compute-runtime intel-level-zero-gpu oneapi-level-zero

# 2. Native Arch-Treiber und OpenCL-Loader installieren
sudo pacman -S intel-compute-runtime level-zero-loader intel-opencl-clang ocl-icd

2. OpenCL ICD-Konflikte lösen & Umgebung erzwingen

Damit clinfo deine Grafikkarte (z. B. Arc A770) sauber anspricht und nicht über alte Profile stolpert:
Bash

# Doppeltes Profil deaktivieren
sudo mv /etc/OpenCL/vendors/intel64.icd /etc/OpenCL/vendors/intel64.icd.disabled

# Intel-Vendor-Profil für OpenCL erzwingen
export OCL_ICD_VENDORS=/etc/OpenCL/vendors/intel.icd

3. oneAPI Umgebungsvariablen laden

Initialisiere die Pfade für den Intel-Compiler (icx/icpx). Wichtig: Verwende bash, da das Skript nicht nativ mit der fish-Shell kompatibel ist!
Bash

bass source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force

4. Funktionstest der Hardware

Prüfe, ob deine Intel-GPU vom SYCL-Subsystem korrekt erkannt wird:
Bash

sycl-ls && clinfo | grep -i \

🚀 Schritt 1 bis 4: XAIGPUARC Starten

Sobald die Treiber fehlerfrei laufen, kannst du die AI-Machine aufsetzen.
📋 Schritt 1: Skript kopieren

Kopiere deine XAIGPUARC.sh direkt in dein Benutzerverzeichnis:
Bash

# Pfad: /home/DEIN_PCNAME/
cp XAIGPUARC.sh ~/

📂 Schritt 2: KI-Modell (GGUF) herunterladen

Erstelle einen models-Ordner in deinem Heimverzeichnis und lade ein passendes Modell hinein, das in deinen VRAM/RAM passt (siehe Hardware-Empfehlungen unten).
Bash

mkdir -p ~/models/HierAINAME/
# Platziere deine .gguf Datei in diesen Ordner!

✍️ Schritt 3: Skript anpassen & Ausführbar machen

Öffne die XAIGPUARC.sh in einem Editor deiner Wahl und passe den Modellnamen manuell an den Pfad deiner heruntergeladenen Datei an.

Danach gibst du dem Skript im Terminal die nötigen Rechte:
Bash

chmod +x ./XAIGPUARC.sh

🏁 Schritt 4: Die AI-Machine starten!

Starte das System zwingend mit bash. Wenn du die Fish-Shell nutzt, stelle sicher, dass bass installiert ist, oder wechsle temporär zu Bash.
Bash

bash ./XAIGPUARC.sh

💻 Hardware & Modell-Empfehlungen (F16 / Q8 / Q4)

Dein System erzwingt standardmäßig eine maximale Blockgröße von 1024 für Intel Arc Alchemist-Karten, um die maximale Rechenleistung stabil auf die Straße zu bringen. Hier sind optimale Konfigurationen basierend auf deinem verfügbaren Speicher:
🟢 Für 6GB+ VRAM (iGPU Xe / Arc A380 / A730m)

    SmolLM3-3B-f16.gguf (5.8 GB) – Sehr schnell auf iGPU und A730m.

    Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-f16-q4_k.gguf (2.1 GB) – Exzellenter Speed-Tipp.

    phi-2.Q4_K_M.gguf (1.7 GB) – Absoluter \

mit über 800 Pt/s.

🟡 Für 8GB - 12GB VRAM (Arc A750 / B580 / Meteor Lake)

    Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct-f16.gguf (7.8 GB) – Sehr gute Balance aus Logik und Geschwindigkeit.

    solar-10.7b-instruct-v1.0-uncensored.Q8_0.gguf (10.6 GB) – Schnell (über 900 Pt/s auf optimierten Systemen).

🔴 Für 16GB VRAM (Arc A770LE / Modded Setups)

    MathTutor-7B-H_v0.0.1.f16.gguf (14.2 GB) – Nutzt die vollen 142 Watt deiner A770 aus. Exzellent für logische Workflows.

    gpt-oss-20b-F16.gguf (12.8 GB) – Läuft sehr sparsam bei ca. 90W Chip Power, benötigt für volle Leistung aber CPU-Unterstützung (Full CPU Fallback).

    ⚠️ HINWEIS ZUR KÜHLUNG: Da modifizierte Arc-Karten unter Volllast (F16-Modus) zwischen 110W und 145W pro Karte ziehen, halte dein System staubfrei und sorge für einen aggressiven Airflow! Lower die Kontextgröße (CTX-NPG), falls dir der VRAM überläuft.

Möchtest du Anpassungen an den integrierten Sprachsteuerungs-Codewörtern (ENTER, KORREKTUR, ENDE) vornehmen oder hakt es bei der Flash-Attention-Kompilierung über die CMakeLists.txt?

body.title: If I Had a Choice, I Would Prefer to Be in a Relationship
body.body: <div class=\

> ![1001609633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23xVPN9yArmntAKYvDkSEmx5xifFA4xVFHMsHD7izTAVqmgamr1ZdumEE28XYENR4ecep.jpg) At various ages, people ask themselves if they will continue to live alone or go into a relationship. No one can give you a universal recipe as everyone may have different personalities, objectives, and life experiences. There are some who truly enjoy being single and value the freedom that is part and parcel of being single, and then there are others who find happiness in living with a partner. If I was in a position to be able to choose between the two, I would choose to be in a healthy and meaningful relationship. While there are many benefits of being single, I do feel that having a good relationship brings a lot of companionship, support and growth into life and makes it more fulfilling. Independence is one of the biggest advantages of being a single. One individual determines the use of his time, money, and energy. They have the freedom to make decisions without needing to seek advice from anybody. They are able to dedicate themselves to their own objectives, educational development, career advancement, travel, and self-development. Singlehood in this day and age can make people free to establish a firm base for the future as much as they want to pursue their dreams. Single people can also find themselves through being single. People tend to know more about their strengths, weaknesses, interests and values when they are alone. They get used to being alone and gain confidence in themselves. They're great traits to have that can help a person, whether or not they eventually do enter a relationship. I would still prefer a relationship, however, because I think that people are made to connect. All of us want love, understanding and companionship. Friends and family can be crucial in the life of someone but it is different having a life partner who can be so close and constant in life. A loving relationship fosters a bond that can be comforting and joyful in both good and challenging times. One thing that I love about relationships is the emotional support that I get. It's not easy being the human being. We all have difficult times, setbacks, disappointments, failures, and even times we are unsure. During such times, having someone who genuinely cares about your well-being can make a significant difference. A proactive partner can cheer you on when you are discouraged, celebrate your successes when they happen and be there when life gets tough. If a person does have faith in you, then you will be able to carry on. Another one of the reasons why I would select a relationship is because it promotes personal development. When most think about relationships, they consider just love and romance, but they also learn numerous things about life. Patience, communication, trust, understanding and compromise are key factors of a healthy relationship. It forces the person to think outside the box by thinking about how they would feel or need the same person would feel or need. These experiences can foster greater maturity, responsibility and emotional intelligence in individuals. I also am thankful for the concept of developing a future with somebody. It's nice to have same dreams, goals and plans. From starting a family to building a home, traveling the world and more, these moments can be more meaningful if shared with someone you love. Collaborating on shared objectives can foster a connection between two individuals and a sense of shared purpose and partnership. It is, however, not to be forgotten that not all relationships are healthy. An unhealthy or hurtful relationship can cause stress, pain and unhappiness. In these cases, it's really better to be single. That's one of the reasons I wouldn't settle for a relationship just to be in one. I would look for a relationship based on respect, trust, honesty, loyalty and caring. A healthy relationship should be one in which both parties feel valued, supported and respected. I think that a relationship should not consume an individual. Both people should work toward their goals and interests even though living with a partner. The best relationships are the ones where the two people are growing together; where they are both developing. To wrap up, there are pros and cons of being single or in a relationship. The single person can enjoy freedom, independence and opportunities for self-discovery. But, if I had to make a choice, I would stick with a healthy and meaningful relationship. A healthy relationship adds richness and reward to life through companionship, emotional support, personal development and shared experiences. Ideally, I want to have a relationship, but I want it to be on the basis of love, trust, respect, and helping each other to be better people. This can make any moment special and make life more enjoyable and meaningful. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@julie100/if-i-had-a-choice-i-would-prefer-to-be-in-a-relationship-i7)

body.title: Life would be Boring without a mems Because it has become a habit.
body.body:
Hi Hivelearners friends.
Since we came into this world, we have had the era of mobile phones and we are seeing that all the people before us did not have the habit of using mobile phones and this has made technology popular. It has only been a few years now, but social media has changed everything. It has its benefits and some disadvantages. But when we get used to something, then it seems very difficult to live without it.
What I am saying here is that we have become busy in our lives because of mobile phones and we are neither able to meet our friends nor our relatives. But here is that if we are in any problem in our life and are looking at social media, then time passes much faster and we forget about that problem. Here we have been using mobile phones for many years now, it has been about 15 to 20 years that we have been asking questions about mobile phones and now if we think about life without mobile phones,
There will be many changes in it. Some things will be good, such as we will meet each other more, we will know each other better. Here we have become accustomed to using mobile phones and it seems impossible to live without them. So, what we are seeing now through social media is where we see people we don't even meet. We see where they are at the moment and how they are living their lives.
alt=\

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-sign-that-is-on-the-side-of-a-wall-TvJVkbZZCmQ)
Here I have to say that some people say that if we are successful and we should not tell anyone about our progress, then progress starts to end. And because people get greedy and jealous, and this is also a reality and we have seen it happening with our own eyes. And here we are also seeing that people are uploading everything on social media and every person is added to them.
And here people who did not even know how to use social media before now also have touch mobile phones and have accounts on every platform. The whole world can't live without it now. If we think about it, if our internet goes down for a week or our mobile goes down, how much more worried we become and our lives become much sadder.
alt=\

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-black-and-white-photo-with-the-words-making-a-way-out-of-no-way-x\_6Mb5asp0Y)
All ordinary people must have experienced this experience in their lives because some time ago, my mobile also went down, so I also had to wait for my mobile for two or three days. That time seemed to have stopped. So that's why I think that without them, the world will share problems with each other and help each other more. But even after all this, when people go home, after working all day in their busy lives, they definitely use their mobile phones for two to three hours to relax their minds. Without it,
If it ends, many things in the world can go wrong. There will be more fighting with each other. When there is more communication with each other, things will also get worse. So I don't see the world without social media at the moment. In the future, the way software is being developed, the use of social media and sending messages and gif etc. will be more common.

body.title: 𝐃𝐀𝐑 \
𝐆𝐄𝐀𝐑𝐍𝐔𝐓 || 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐇𝐄𝐀𝐋𝐓𝐇 𝐌𝐎𝐍𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐑 𝐈𝐍 𝐒𝐏𝐋𝐈𝐍𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐒!
body.body: alt=\

/>

Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing amazing and welcome to another #Splinterlands post.

Today I want to continue my card spotlight series and talk about a very unique legendary card that instantly catches your attention when you see its stats.

The card is Dar \

Gearnut, a Legendary Life/Dragon unit that currently holds a very special title in #Splinterlands. It has the highest health stat in the entire game with a massive 25 health at max level! When I first saw this card, I honestly had to look twice. A small gnome-looking character having more health than giant dragons and monsters felt kinda crazy. But after looking deeper into its abilities, it started to make sense. This card isn't just a giant health sponge. It also brings damage, utility, and team support all at the same time.
alt=\

></center>

𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰
=========================

*   **Name**: Dar \

Gearnut * **Rarity**: Legendary * **Element**: Life / Dragon * **Mana Cost**: 14 * **Max Level**: 4 * **Melee Damage**: 3 * **Speed**: 3 * **Health**: 25 * **Armor**: 4 At max level, the card gains four abilities: * Trample * Flank * Inspire * Void That is a pretty stacked ability set for a frontline monster. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟏: 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞 ================================= **Trample**: After using a melee attack to defeat a unit, performs another melee attack against the unit in the next position.
alt=\

> This is one of my favorite melee abilities in the game. Whenever Dar finishes off an enemy, he immediately gets another attack. If the enemy team is already weakened, Trample can start a chain reaction that completely changes the battle. Because Dar already has strong melee damage, Trample gives him even more offensive potential. There are battles where a single Trample activation is all you need to secure the win. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟐: 𝐅𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐤 ============================= **Flank**: At the beginning of the battle, if this unit is in the first position, the unit in the second position gains Reach.
alt=\

> I think this ability is often underrated. Flank allows another melee monster behind Dar to attack from the second position, even if that monster normally couldn't. This creates some really powerful melee combinations. Instead of having only one monster attacking from the front, you suddenly have two strong melee threats putting pressure on the opponent from the very first round. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟑: 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐞 ================================= **Inspire**: +1 melee power to all allied units.

> Now things get even better. Not only does Flank allow another melee monster to attack, Inspire makes all your melee monsters stronger as well. That's some really nice synergy. If you're running a melee-heavy lineup, Dar basically boosts your entire team while also serving as a giant tank. I love cards that help both themselves and their teammates. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟒: 𝐕𝐨𝐢𝐝 =========================== **Void**: 50% less damage from magic attacks or 0 damage from magic attacks of 1 power.
alt=\

></center>

This ability makes Dar even harder to bring down.

Normally, high-health tanks can still struggle against strong magic teams because magic ignores armor.

Void helps solve that problem.

When combined with 25 health, Void makes Dar extremely annoying for magic-focused opponents.

Even if they try to burn through his health pool, they'll often need much more time than expected.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝟐𝟓 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬
==============================================

The thing that really separates Dar from other tanks is simply that gigantic health pool.

Twenty-five health is absolutely massive.

In long battles, especially those involving poison, blast damage, or opportunity attacks, having extra health gives you so much room for mistakes.

Many tanks can disappear in a few rounds.

Dar often sticks around much longer and gives the rest of your team enough time to do their job.

That reliability is something I value a lot when building lineups.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Dar \

Gearnut is one of the most unique legendary cards currently available in Splinterlands.

The combination of:

*   The highest health stat in the game (25 HP)
    
*   Trample
    
*   Flank
    
*   Inspire
    
*   Void
    

makes him a very interesting tank and support unit rolled into one card.

Yes, the 14 mana cost is expensive, but you are getting a lot of value in return.

Personally, I think the best part about this card is how many roles it fills at once. It tanks damage, boosts allies, enables melee attacks, and can even become a serious threat with Trample.

That's not something many cards can do.

If you enjoy playing aggressive melee teams or simply want one of the toughest frontline monsters available, Dar \

Gearnut is definitely worth checking out.

And honestly, having the highest health monster in Splinterlands is a pretty cool title on its own!

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Staking Ethereum | Data on Staked ETH Share, Validators, Trends, Top Staking Pools | Jun 2026
body.body:
Staking Ethereum has been a major DeFi play in ever since it was enabled back in September 2022. A lot of protocols have emerged with a business around this, such as Lido, Etherfi, etc. enabling, staking, restaking, and even more complicated loops. One of these protocols have been a victim of the biggest DeFi hack with the rsETH from the KelpDAO.

Let’s take a look how are things going under the current market conditions.

 



![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23u5ZPpTAnqnocGCxhwgvxemBXbCenkkVvvrCPZsYoxpmkSzswU8aot7jmtQeq4enFgXA.png)



Here we will be looking at:
-	Staked Ethereum by date
-	Staked VS Unstaked ETH since the Shanghai update
-	Share of staked ETH
-	Number of validators 
-	Top staking pools

The data presented here is mostly gathered from Dune Analytics and Ethscan.


## Staked Ethereum by Date

Here is the chart.

 





![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EnyoWqRyS6PEYDJTd9bK5uWVMk9apbW4P6EcQwqg8iDZjgvobiwXRAL6w6Xcei9TEoA.png)






This is the amount of staked ETH since the launch of the Beacon chain and the option for staking Ethereum in November 2020, after what it sorts of slowed down, and started growing again in 2025 with a sharp growth towards the end of the year.
In 2026 the amount of staked ETH is sort of sideways, with a small drop in the last month, probably due to the rsETH incident. 

A total of **39.5M** ETH staked at the moment. The record high has been around 41M in March 2026

**If we zoom in 2024-2026 we get this:**

 




![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23swi9xYngHBYrUaq9CFFiMwK9NDfyUY1UgGL1QrUbkYqo28zw4GqPCE8q7W1CVmAui9Y.png)





Here we can notice a strong growth in May 2023. The unstaking option has caused more Ethereum to be staked than unstaked. Probably users felt more comfortable staking now knowing that they can unstake at any moment if needed. 

At the beginning of 2024 there were close to 29M ETH staked while the year ended with 34.2M ETH staked or 5M more. 
For 2025 the year started with 34.2M staked and ended at 36.7M, so more than 2M ETH staked. In 2026 we are close to 40M now so more than 3M ETH staked. 

### Deposits VS Withdrawals Since the Shanghai Update

If take a look at the daily deposits vs withdrawals since the update, we get this:

 




![image005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/Eo6Bn9ZAuVuXRU8SuVsRmiFw6mDeNiFMnAMzqYuSsXZR2LtZJh8SoGdcUKxdDnzTWGk.png)







Most of the days are in positive, meaning that more ETH is being staked in general that ustaked, even with the ustaking option enabled. There are few big unstaking events in April 2023, where more than 100k ETH was unstaked in a day. 

We can notice some bars on the downside that represents the usntaking that has happened in the last period. 

 
### Share of Staked Ethereum

What is the share of staked Ethereum? Here is the historical trend. 



 


![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t797twambpkXJKa87CQe68vVgi2Ez56gVYmDQKZee8ZEuzyf5yeNHwy4FikPHsjPgZd.png)







We can notice that the staking was activated later in the Ethereum lifecycle and since recently it has started to gather more momentum. It’s worth noting that since last year Ethereum cut their inflation down as well and is deflationary in the last period. What this means is that the ETH issuance is lowered, and at the same time the staking is locking more ETH, basically lowering the liquid supply from both ends. 

**The liquid Ethereum supply looks like this:**


 



![image009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t77FXbzZ34phQW3CuGXbJ1PUz3ach32cCWgvTqcsCXwiJQarL36fqAKE6SZ7hwpoTNR.png)






We can see the drop in the liquid ETH supply, from 117M at the top in 2020 to 78M now. It seems that there is finally some slowdown in the amount of ETH staked. Will see where the balance is found. Staking provides APR, but if more ETH is staked this APR goes down. Also, the APR for staking depends on the network activity and the fees paid by users. 

**The current share of staked ETH looks like this:**
 





![image011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t77FXbzZ38kGYD7WboSH5qVR9uLkZagGsDJf7natYG7SZjXXkgaWMK1cKym9jjxN19V.png)







When compared to the total ETH supply that is around 120M now, the 39M staked ETH represents a **34%** of the supply. It seems that there is some equilibrium around this mark.  

## Number of Validators
Here is the chart.


 



![image013.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t76bthUzQnTC4MrMn3ZhGEWVNQqdsycrKbfRivBFxoioNGe3TfcCvXNgByc6vfXD4Lx.png)







The number of validators has also continued to grow. At the moment there are **1.2M** validators. We can notice some drop at the end of 2024 and the beginning of 2025 and a growth again. A drop again in the very last months.

Note that these are not unique validators, as most of them are represented by a pool or some type of CEX. There is now even a proposal to decrease the upper limit for a validator from 32ETH, so at some point the number of validators might consolidate. 


## Top Ethereum Stakers

Who is staking the most? Here is the chart.


 





![image015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tkkCbMnMLfoCBYhAmsrd2CdaUrD6VV7PNDzU4GSGRyQ17VzNJpXt7aMMrzXSTS9secc.png)





The **Lido** pool is on the top with **8.6M** ETH staked. This pool has even its own token for governance. On the second spot is Binance followed by another exchange Coinbase on the third spot.

Lido has dominated in the past, but it seems that it has peaked and now has an even lower amount of ETH staked from the beginning of the year. Probably some of the tokens went to ether.fi. 




All the best
@dalz

body.title: Instincts can mislead sometimes, but God can't
body.body:
Hello guys, is your lady @adaezeinchrist here today. Welcome back to my blog and do enjoy the rest of the days of the week. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZLYrPr7zeveUEhnHKu6hBcfnU7HLDFinygbkdQuCbVc/1780925630774.jpg)
This image belongs to me.

For  Week 221: Episode 01: INSTINCT. I love this topic so much that I will love to do a little check on the word Instinct: in a lay man's language this is what I can say happens to us when we fell that something i going to happen, or whenever we sense what others can't see around us. Sometimes it makes us do what we should not do ordinary. When someone says - my instincts tells me this about that person. This is the feeling that you about someone or something and it helps you take decisions sometimes to avert what is about to happen or to unvail what has happened already.


How well do you trust your instinct? On the scale of 10 I will say 5. Haha 😂. I started laughing immediately I wrote that 5. Does that means I don't trust m instincts? No. I do. But for the fact that I am human I neto realize that sometimes we mix human feelings with our instincts and we are lwad stray when that happens. I need to check and check again to make sure is not what my mind is telling me that I am believing and call it my instincts.



With limited information, can you simply go with your gut on something, knowing it will work out for you?

Like I stated above, i always remember that I am human and can make mistakes sometimes in my judgement about something or someone, because of that when I don't have enough information about something or someone, I trade with carefulness and ask questions again and again to know what to bel. When my instincts tells me something I already said is 5% I give to it. The remaining 5% I use it to consult the holy Spirit. I believe that the Spirit of God knows all truth and things. O also believe that if the Spirit is leading me i won't make any mistakes. So instead of trusting my instincts with all my heart I take time to consult the holy Spirit who dwells in me and knows everything that is happening around me. I just trust his judgement ad follow as directed.


 Do you use this when dealing with people?
I have seen myself go wrong not just once. In fact I can even count the number of times I have failed and make people mock at God because said the wrong thing thinking is the right thing to say or do.  when dealing with people outside I allow God who knows them more than they know themselves to reveal to me every truth to me and that is enough for me. Sometimes when God show me something I will see it different from what my instincts told m and sometimes it will be the same thing. 

 What if your instincts end up being wrong?

If my instincts fails me, that will help me rely on God the more because a not God that knows everything. It will only help me become a better version of myself
