body.title: I Started Over at 76
body.body: alt=\

/>

When I was younger, I thought there would come a day when life would slow down and everything would finally be figured out.

It didn't happen that way.

I'm 76 years old, and in many ways I feel like I'm starting over.

I've had a good life. I raised children, worked for many years, paid bills, worried about things, celebrated victories, and survived disappointments. Like most people my age, I've seen dreams come true and watched other dreams quietly fade away.

I've seen the world change from black-and-white television to artificial intelligence.  
I've seen music change, neighborhoods change, and people change.  
And somehow, through all of it, I kept changing too.  
A few years ago, I found myself asking a simple question:  
What am I going to do with the rest of my life?  
Not next year.  
Not next month.  
The rest of it.  
It was a question that wouldn't leave me alone.  
I could have decided that my best years were behind me. Many people do. Society seems to expect older people to sit quietly and watch life happen from a distance.  
But something inside me refused to accept that.  
I still wake up curious.  
I still want to learn new things.  
I still care deeply about people.  
I still have stories to tell.  
So instead of slowing down, I started building a new chapter.  
I began writing more seriously. What started as a simple desire to share my thoughts became a daily practice. Writing helps me understand my life, but it also helps me connect with others who are traveling their own difficult roads.  
Some days I write about aging.  
Some days I write about freedom.  
Some days I write about life on the road and the unexpected lessons that come from sleeping in parking lots, truck stops, and quiet places far from home.  
The older I get, the more I realize that life isn't about avoiding uncertainty.  
It's about learning how to live alongside it.  
At 76, I don't have all the answers.  
I still worry sometimes.  
I still make mistakes.  
I still wonder what tomorrow will bring.  
But I no longer believe that uncertainty is something to fear.  
In many ways, uncertainty is proof that life is still unfolding.  
Every morning I wake up with another chance to create something meaningful.  
Another chance to help someone.  
Another chance to learn.  
Another chance to love.  
That is what starting over at 76 means to me.  
It doesn't mean pretending to be young.  
It means refusing to grow old in spirit.  
It means believing that purpose doesn't have an expiration date.  
It means understanding that as long as we are breathing, there is still life left to live.  
I don't know exactly what the next ten years will bring.  
But I do know this:  
I want to make them count.  
If you're reading this and wondering whether it's too late to begin again, my answer is simple.  
No.  
As long as you're alive, there is still another chapter waiting to be written.  
And sometimes the most meaningful chapter is the one that comes last.  
Thank you for reading. I'm Carol, a writer exploring aging, freedom, resilience, and what it means to keep living fully—one day at a time.

![IMG_5707](https://i.imglt.com/20260607/3c647fa9c35e073eb1e85a2fcc24c085.jpeg)

我也是偶尔刷到这部剧的，眼瞅着女主常丹丹很眼熟。剧情属于女主重生大渣虐渣的爽剧，全程女主应对的头头是道也的确很爽，看完后着实有种渣男脸皮比城墙厚之感。

从剧情的角度来说，女主是富甲一方的商贾之女。有别于现在有钱约等于有权的社会形态，古时候士农工商做生意的虽然有钱却没有地位，他们需要家中有做官的人出现。

这有点像当年家里有地主的，需要孩子去上山下乡或者嫁给农民有点类似的意味？上辈子女主找了男配，结果这渣男不断PUA女主，不仅夺走她的家产还屠杀她全族人。

重生归来女主立马另选他人，拿出了我选谁做夫君谁就前尘似锦的气势来。在衣食住行上安排得妥妥当当，处理起外面的事也信手拈来，跟男配过招更是游刃有余得很。

这个比男主戏份还多的男配我也是真的醉了，从来没见过那么普信的男的。自己明明没钱没貌也没才，却一直对女主呼来喝去优越感爆棚，除了他本身还有社会因素在。

剧情是非常雷人，但我觉得这里面教会我们挺多道理的。女生在择偶的不要挑选比自己条件差很多的，男性不会因为你下嫁心存感激，他们只会觉得自己值得这一切。

总的来说，剧还算可以吧，但不是太推荐。


（本篇完）

You need to defy these worldly odds if you are ever going to reach the rightful destination. There is more beyond the struggles and the pleasure. The earth is just a stepping stone for further eternal documentation. I am not saying you should care about your life here. Not at all, have goals and pursue them. Nevertheless, make sure you don't become a slave to either Egypt or Babylon.   

To conclude, let me add, you need to get into it; the right decision as concerning what you want in entirety out of your existence here. Mathew 6:19-21 said it all, there are places where thieves can break in and steal. Do bother to even imagine it long; how many ancient great and rich are still here? Death stole life from them and their treasure became [bounties](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-bounty) for others. We need to live out live with all necessary wisdom.

Introduction


Hey, hey! This is @gabrielatravels, and I am pleased to bring you a brand new edition of #TravelDigest! ❤️\n\nToday's post is going to take you on a virtual tour with stops on a beach in Turkey, a gate also in Turkey, and to a unique tourist destination in Indonesia. We also have the honourable mentions list, where you can get a few more travel postcards from Argentina, Venezuela, and France, so don't forget to check these posts too! 😊


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 The Beach Where You Can Walk on Water: Kızkumu Beach / Denizin Üstünde Yürüten plaj; Kızkumu Plajı ( EN-TR) by @passenger777

Lately, we’ve turned our attention to the Aegean Region. I must admit that I’m getting more and more excited as we explore the Aegean. The more new places I see, the more I’ve come to admire the Aegean Coast. We began our Aegean explorations this year in March. Our first stop was Ölüdeniz, with its turquoise-colored sea. Then, in mid-April, our path led us to Marmaris. We spent three days exploring Marmaris and its surroundings. I took the photos you see above at Kızkumu Beach, located in the Orhaniye neighborhood of Marmaris district in Muğla province. The most distinctive feature of Kızkumu Beach, situated about 30 minutes from the center of Marmaris, is that it gives you the sensation of walking right in the middle of the sea.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 EN- A Day Between History, Love, and Sunset in Antalya// TR-Antalya’da Tarih, Aşk ve Gün Batımı Arasında Bir Gün❤️ by @baycan

Today, I took a little historical and exploratory walk around Antalya. My journey started at Hadrian’s Gate. As I walked beneath this gate, which has stood for nearly two thousand years, I couldn’t help but think about the countless people who had passed through these stones before me. Whenever I visit a place filled with history, I always find myself wondering who lived there, what kind of lives they had, what they ate, what they drank, and what their daily lives were like. I’m sure many people have had similar thoughts while standing in places like this.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 BATU SUSUN TOURIST DESTINATION // Explore the natural tourist destination located at an altitude of 1,350 MASL by @riyat

And finally I managed to arrive at my destination, namely the Batu Susun natural tourist destination. When I arrived at this place, I immediately realized that this tourist spot was very simple, its location was also right next to the residents' plantations, so from this tourist spot we could see the activities of the farmers there.

There was a time when I thought success had to happen fast.

I thought I needed huge wins, big opportunities, and perfect timing.

Now I know better.

Most of the progress in my life has come from small steps repeated over and over again.

Answering one more message.
Finding one more customer.
Learning one more lesson.
Trying again after something didn’t work.

It may not look impressive from the outside, but those little efforts add up.

This photo reminds me of that version of myself that kept showing up every day, even when the results weren't immediate.

And honestly, that's something I'm proud of.

Because success isn't always about moving fast.
Sometimes it's simply about refusing to quit.

So today, wherever you are in your journey, remember this:

Small steps still move you forward. ✨

body.title: 🔒 Locked in Time: A Study in Selective Color
body.body: Hey!\nI wanted to share a recent shot I came across on Unsplash that instantly captured my attention. There is something incredibly compelling about the \

tradition found on bridges around the world, but this specific perspective brought a completely different energy to the concept.

Instead of the usual bright, multi-colored chaos of a tourist bridge, this image utilizes a striking **selective color** technique. By stripping away the background colors and leaving only the deep, vibrant reds, the photographer completely shifts the mood.

![riedelmeier-castles-616573_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQvs8dc5Cf9FStVx1AT3qWyrdsH1yVmtD2nV9744Z4PVG/riedelmeier-castles-616573_1920.jpg)
<center>* **Source:** Image downloaded from Unsplash.</center>
### 💡 My Take & Creative Breakdown
What draws me to this image is the contrast between the **industrial texture** of the chain-link fence and the **emotional weight** of what the padlocks represent.
 * **The Focal Point:** The selective red highlights the locks like little beating hearts scattered across a cold, metallic grid. It turns a common tourist cliché into a moody, artistic statement.
 * **Composition:** The shallow depth of field works beautifully here. The sharp focus on the central locks draws your eye right into the middle of the texture, while the foreground and background blur out into a soft, monochromatic gradient.
 * **The Vibe:** It feels less like a celebration of romance and more like a nostalgic, slightly melancholic reflection on time passing and promises left behind.

**What do you think?** Does the selective red color make the image pop, or do you prefer full-color street photography? Let me know below!
*Thank you for stopping by the @solves blog. If you enjoyed this breakdown, feel free to upvote, reblog, and follow for more visual deep dives!*

body.title: Feathered Friends Show Me A Photo Contest Round 274 \
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNj8w4dZUJ1NeAr4ZxzMcRgBxMYqS585QTMoHW7SNhx72/1_1.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. Today's post is on Feathered Friends. The topic of today's post is free theme. In which I saw a photograph of an owlet in your post so I decided to make a post on owlet. Nature often surprises us with beautiful and captivating scenes. One such wonderful scene can be seen in the first photograph presented above. In this scene, a small owl is sitting peacefully in an empty space made of the trunk and branches of a large tree. At first glance, it is difficult to notice this owlet. Because its brown and white feathers blend perfectly with the color and texture of the tree bark. This natural camouflage helps keep the owl safe from predators and allows it to rest peacefully during the day.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTt65HG82PbSvAd3G7oQuruXr6cVSTKAgybqoVheFucwR/2_2.jpg)

Although the owl in the photograph above looks calm, this bird is always alert to the dangers around it. The large bright eyes of this bird are one of its most attractive features. Owls are known for their excellent eyesight, especially in low-light conditions, they can easily see prey. As I mentioned earlier, even though the photograph was taken in daylight, the owl seems alert and aware of its surroundings. The bird's small body is covered in soft feathers adorned with white spots and streaks, giving it a beautiful appearance. Owls are generally nocturnal birds. This means that these birds are most active during the evening and night.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTY9YaZbkBrp3hr8yqvjHFnSs3W1RqFenV3FPWNQ3QWSj/3_3.jpg)

As can be seen in the photograph above, these birds prefer to rest in tree hollows, dense foliage or other shelters during the day. For this bird, a hollow in a tree provides an ideal resting place. This hollow provides this bird with protection from harsh sunlight and intense heat. The tree itself plays an important role in the life of an owl. Large old trees often develop cavities and holes over time. These cavities in trees become natural shelters for many birds. For an owl, a hollow trunk acts as a safe haven. In such places, owls can rest, hide, and sometimes even raise their young. So we can definitely say that this close relationship between birds and trees is mature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUds35tUWbsBxLRTydUvxE4Mmm5hcZF1r4Kif413S7c1L/4_4.jpg)

Despite their small size, owls are skilled hunters. They eat insects, small rodents, lizards and other small animals. Their sharp beak and strong claws help them catch prey effectively. At night, these birds glide quietly in the dark. They rely on their acute hearing and excellent vision to find food. Sitting quietly in a natural shelter, owls show in a calm and balanced way how wild animals live in their environment.

Each photograph presented here beautifully depicts a small owl resting inside a tree trunk. The owl's alert eyes, beautifully patterned feathers and peaceful posture create a captivating scene. A sturdy tree provides shelter and security, while an owl adds life and charm to the landscape.

I hope that my post will accept the Show Me A Photo Contest Round 274.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.body: ![Hive Banners 2026 (72).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48WCiBTin5Knr1aoL3AFqepM7fb5hHnDxa8uodeLJpbnFXdKVNydGvm9RNZsnJNZD8.png) **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/pajaros-vibrantes-posados-en-un-tocon-de-arbol-cubierto-de-musgo-34987980/)**

> Cuando oigo el trinar de las aves, siento que su canto será lo que más extrañaré una vez que me marche de la casa donde pasé parte de mi vida.

¿Qué retos vendrán en el nuevo hogar?, ¿qué es lo que pasará una vez nos establezcamos en ese nuevo territorio por explorar? Lo ignoro por completo.

Quizás empecemos a hacer nuevas amistades; quizás pensemos qué hacer con nuestras vidas a partir de nuestra llegada; o quizás, ya establecidos los puntos de referencia territorial, empecemos a gozar de esa vida tranquila a pesar de lo impredecible que es el futuro que muchos vemos como algo aterrador y desagradable por todo lo que está pasando.

Quizás vuelva a oír el trinar de los pájaros, pero de forma lejana. Un trinar que me recordará de vez en vez que esto es solo una fase más de nuestra vida que debemos vivir, y del cual podemos aprender.

I'm jumping into @lmac's collage contest this week, the [252nd round](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-252-45-hive-in-the-prize-pool). I'm not eligible for a prize, but I love to participate. The round began last Thursday and will conclude on June 22.     

As soon as I saw the template by @seckorama (see below) I thought of a book I once wrote. It was a vampire book, a gothic romp, and it wasn't very good, so I never published it. 


My original plan was to create a vampire who was a complex character and who dealt with life's most profound issues.  The book kinda got out of hand as I tried to make the plot relatable. That extra material ended up being  a little silly.

The vampire sections, which are the best parts of the book, inspired my collage. I've copied a couple of those sections in the body of this blog. 

Here is @seckorama's template, from which my collage was derived:
![seckorama alley.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23u673RMt29zmNJwXPpNSDQVigbhSuwCjguh7Zih9iA3gDyBZdPCtbe8bw7WVzjggmPeF.webp)

  
When you read the first excerpt you will see that the collage could have been an illustration for this piece.


Beware: These excerpts are  bloody (they are, after all, about a vampire).   


<center>**Excerpt #1: Claude, a business man, becomes the vampire's victim.**</center>

Claude closed the thick oak door. He secured the lock and took an elevator to the street. Tomorrow was Friday, and he had a number of important items on his agenda. He wanted to be well rested.

He saw something out of the corner of his eye. A shadow? It was gone. He continued toward First Street.

There it was again, hovering close beside him. Then it disappeared in an alley.  What did that thing want with him? He quickened his step and reflexively balled his hands into tight fists. He walked resolutely toward the bright lights of an all-night deli when...

body.body: Holy Week is the period observed by many Christians to remember the final days of Jesus Christ’s earthly ministry, including His suffering, death, and resurrection. While the Bible records these events in detail, it does not command Christians to observe a specific annual week called Holy Week.\nhttps://youtu.be/PR6KqmOnUJ0?si=WFrffb_WithxXFEx\nAll the events that took place during the holy week are written in the holy bible even though the word holy week is not found in the bible. Jesus entered Jerusalem, shared the Last Supper with His disciples, was crucified for the sins of humanity, and rose from the dead on the third day. These events are central to the Christian faith and are recorded in the Gospels.

![1780667856797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23ywF6a9dTZPrAVqPxYD3bhCt4nJbocSkMhgdudPA4uRUpL8qsACpAUL3qCMLA1iDXhvp.jpg)


<div class=\

> Hey everyone, I'm really excited to share a new drawing with you. Today I wanted to draw a pro card from the game. The one I liked best for today was the Pro 067 TP 440 card. As you can see, it features a nice classic microphone with black and gray colors that make it look very pretty and, above all, elegant. In this post, I'm going to show you step by step how I did it from beginning to end. It'll be fun to watch, as always. To start, I first drew the inner frame of the card, which looks like this: ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxZSAtuUcGEsVPQvNWXuKkYhiGWYQ5uzhLLcLWcZwV9RTRfA8JENFgpN7iWYY.jpg) After drawing the frame, I drew the main body and silhouette of the microphone. To do this, I started by drawing the microphone handle and then the top part. On the top part, I added some protrusions along the edges because that's where the audio pickup grilles will go. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BJ5b2Zi1odeKaBX71XWjK5JQ7eFysM2egNMqoTLYdb9UhkHd7fnUhQv81fxLyDy4.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BJ5b2aHtpnxVijo5uKLPxnWnTVv8h5MzH3ZP4ecn5q2KJoXmnLU9JFNm9z1SCbbm.jpg) In the next step, I added several internal divisions. This way, the microphone is well-defined by zones, making each one stand out more. I also drew the grilles I mentioned earlier. With that, the sketch was finished. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWcbrTG5TFw63HqV5kJiFVL6tYSppKGzgwHqFt264MQAAAMG2LnhoZq2hMQSE.jpg) Now I could move on to painting. As you can see, I used blue and purple for the background and frame. These are the same colors as in the original card, and I thought they were the prettiest and most appropriate for referencing the Pro card. I painted the other elements with their respective colors as well. I'll leave the following screenshots so you can see them. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoH2LRDj5qSNbZYsWTKmgciBFdixrjUAyD5M5NQBT7xi5cwtPvcKLakQ8RxJkS7CREU.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnYJFRGJWaqgzeoyJqWhjf6YD3ZFCBVjMTfvRYgcQx4MkxdjprZwXv7tkvoaaHub1yt.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnuZjr3KxBxPLcSUir1usMrJgTN2eBjK59cf2ETjEcyvhqqjizutCHSNyLfoEZUBjEB.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoTUEQ7xU3s3PYVyNLjKN4WSvHYpa4DUXB5sbhkXosGEcePDgxVK29vWUqLgNS5z5zw.jpg) And finally, here's the finished drawing. See you in the next one, blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/242Cg4FqhYSNkSXDJvRiEv6CkL1FYprn3YnNbhfRDE5wAj1BDKdLTeg84RgQfvjmfU3P7.jpg)

body.title: HYPE Facing a Crash or a Golden Opportunity Amidst the Liquidation Storm
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSRg6AWaBXDaa8S121XMmsL1szSNC7XjTHJt7JvkR3tqD/1000012955.png 

The crypto market is currently experiencing high uncertainty with the Fear and Greed Index hitting an extreme level of 8 points. This condition is worsened by the drama surrounding the $HYPE asset in the Hyperliquid ecosystem. Recent news highlights tension involving Arthur Hayes, who strongly denied buying back HYPE tokens following claims from other parties. Hayes previously claimed to have dumped his entire token holding at a high price before the market suffered a sharp crash. This situation has triggered confusion and speculation among market participants trying to navigate high volatility.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmccnuFXKaJJZp9MjysEFhB6CnuLQDZi2Tj3ETRbwYXJJ9/1000012913.jpg 


​On the other hand, the Hyperliquid ecosystem is showing surprising resilience through institutional interest. **Since mid May 2026, Hyperliquid ETF products like THYP from 21Shares and BHYP from Bitwise have recorded net inflows of up to $160 million.** This has become a highlight because it occurred amidst capital outflows from $BTC products, which reached over $1 billion in one week.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeDT6BQPxi9EKdt2G4kKCTAgS9PR9dg1hhaPJ58uT1BEw/1000012914.png 


​Technically, we can see a broader picture through derivative data. Trading volume on Hyperliquid remains high with dominant activity on major exchanges like Binance. However, what needs to be watched closely is the liquidation data, which shows significant pressure on both long and short positions.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdHfmYkT9s4U61HCdaASHDQtJpaTnc39HabS89ymvhUCm/1000012915.png 


​The volume and total liquidation charts show drastic fluctuations aligned with HYPE price action. Market participants must be very careful when reading these charts because price movements are often followed by massive leverage position clearing on both sides.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaRDguQ79SpznCh6wjXGD9syMGTWF8vnzVx34Z7W3hW2L/1000012916.png 


​The market is currently in a critical phase where extreme fear has enveloped investors widely. This is clearly reflected in the index showing a value of 8, confirming that panic is dominating the global crypto market.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNjB89GZL5mi1HVTBPQi5iVZDZMteNFhtGwoiyDvJQo9T/1000012919.png 


​Technical analysis of the current price movement shows crucial areas that will determine the next trend direction for market participants.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNfGqMBD8Guv9YZcqViYL6Zo7FvecCVPES9CRPyE8JVNG/1000012921.jpg 


# ​My Opinion
​Regarding this situation, my view is quite pessimistic and cautious. We are in a deep crisis of confidence where narrative manipulation by big figures can easily shake the retail mindset. The price crash that occurred is not just about technicals but a reflection of an ecosystem's fragility that relies heavily on momentary sentiment. I see the potential for further selling pressure if market participants cannot maintain the existing psychological support levels. We must be very careful because the market might be trapping those who hope for a quick recovery while the fundamentals are under heavy pressure. This crisis might just be the beginning of a massive cleanup phase that is actually necessary but very painful for small capital owners.

*However, behind this mass panic, isn't a moment like this actually a golden opportunity for us retail investors to enter the market? **When others are busy selling out of fear, we can take over their positions by accumulating or stacking.** The strategy of buying when others are panicked allows us to get a much larger amount of coins even with limited capital. By stacking when prices are depressed, we effectively increase our asset holdings, which will be very valuable when the market returns to a normal phase or a bull run. This is a smart way to build a long term position while the market is offering a massive discount.

​**Sources**
- [Coin Bureau](https://x.com/i/status/2063883340822839700) 
- [HYPE Defies $700M Unlock as Spot ETFs Draw $160M](https://bingx.com/en/news/post/institutional-rotation-shifts-to-hyperliquid-hype-defies-m-unlock-as-spot-etfs-draw-m?hl=id-ID) 
- [Arthur Hayes says ‘I Didn’t Buy’ amid $2M HYPE transfer](https://www.mexc.co/news/1133756?hl=id-ID)

body.title: Climbing 250 Matches: The Real Test in Splinterlands Survival Mode
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqT8RY9ok5mrjUzqsgXhxzjQBsaH4q1RcC89wQzZSWfW/thumbnail_survival.jpg)

Hello Splinterlands warriors, welcome back to my post. This time I want to share a story about a feature that I find quite interesting—not because it introduces new cards or massive rewards, but because it invites players to help shape the future of the game we play every day. Yes, I’m talking about the **Survival Mode Stress Testing for Bracket 4** program, which will take place next season.

When I first read this announcement, I couldn’t help but smile. Usually, we play to chase SPS, Glint, reward chests, or simply to improve our win rate. But this time, Splinterlands is asking players to step in as “field testers” to evaluate the performance of **liquidity bots** in Survival Mode.

And of course, like most players, my first thought wasn’t about the rewards.

Instead, it was something much simpler:

*\

*

## When 250 Matches Feels Like Climbing a Mountain

At first, I thought this was just a typical event. But after reading the requirements more carefully, it turns out players must join **Survival Mode Bracket 4**, play at least **250 matches**, and maintain a **50% or higher win rate** to qualify for a bonus of **250,000 Glint** after submitting an evaluation form.

If your win rate falls below 50%, there’s still a consolation prize of **100,000 Glint**.

On paper, it looks simple.

Play 250 matches.

Win half of them.

Fill out the form.

Done.

But when I imagined actually doing it, I immediately realized that the real challenge isn’t winning—the biggest challenge is staying consistent enough to play that many matches.

As a player who also has to manage Ranked, Brawl, and other Splinterlands activities, 250 matches feels like a huge commitment. I even remembered comments from other players in the community saying:

*\

*

And honestly, I agree.

## Why Is Splinterlands Doing This?

The more I read the announcement, the more I understood the real purpose.

This isn’t just a Glint giveaway event.

The Splinterlands team is collecting real data on how **liquidity bots** perform in a competitive environment.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXXq5n5fwziBpcZ5w8TFUJu7y9C1QnQMG9m7BwX58a2X/survival.png)</center>


They want to determine whether this system is strong enough to eventually be applied more broadly in Modern Ranked Play.

This means that players who participate aren’t just playing the game.

They’re helping develop it.

I really like this approach because it’s rare for blockchain games to openly involve the community in testing features before rolling them out on a larger scale.

## Imagining My Strategy in Bracket 4

If I were to seriously participate in this program, I know I couldn’t just play casually.

In Survival Mode, every decision has consequences.

Card choices must be carefully considered.

You can’t just throw in your favorite monsters and hope everything works out.

And a 50% win rate isn’t something to take lightly.

I imagine myself taking small notes:

Which cards win most often.

Which formations fail.

Which rulesets are the most dangerous.

Maybe even tracking specific opponents who appear frequently.

Does that sound excessive?

Maybe.

But when the reward is 250,000 Glint, a little extra effort feels justified.

## Conclusion

After reading this announcement, I see Survival Mode Stress Testing as more than just an opportunity to earn extra Glint.

It’s a chance for the community to help shape the future of Ranked Play in Splinterlands.

Am I interested in trying it?

Of course.

Am I confident I can complete 250 matches?

Well, that’s a much harder question to answer.

But that’s exactly where the excitement lies.

Sometimes, the biggest challenge isn’t defeating opponents in the arena—but maintaining the motivation to keep playing until match number 250.

My advice is simple: if you have the time and a strong enough card collection to survive in Bracket 4, give it a try. Not only do you have the chance to earn a large amount of Glint, but you’ll also be contributing to making Splinterlands better for all players in the future.

And who knows—maybe the testing report you submit today will be the reason why the next Ranked feature feels much more enjoyable later on. 🔥

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![WDDajpHnBwCI4A1b_1000606768.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/WDDajpHnBwCI4A1b_1000606768/WDDajpHnBwCI4A1b_1000606768.webp)
![p4kHNlfP9YIlGUuG_1000606769.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/p4kHNlfP9YIlGUuG_1000606769/p4kHNlfP9YIlGUuG_1000606769.webp)
![kAGpLZ9DeYLuwX12_1000606767.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/kAGpLZ9DeYLuwX12_1000606767/kAGpLZ9DeYLuwX12_1000606767.webp)
![ECUzF9UwCjIIp6aF_1000617103.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/ECUzF9UwCjIIp6aF_1000617103/ECUzF9UwCjIIp6aF_1000617103.webp)
![Zx6T6mOciZ8OPSW8_1000606799.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/Zx6T6mOciZ8OPSW8_1000606799/Zx6T6mOciZ8OPSW8_1000606799.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这些年，朋友间的重逢，总是带有些甘苦。

这一次回到吉隆坡，有个大学毕业以后久未见面、总是活在脸书或Whatapps里的槟城好友，他也在这哈芝节公假南下到吉隆坡，促成了我们这一次见面的最主要契机就是我们的共同朋友的父亲去世，所以我们约了时间一起去富贵纪念馆吊唁。

久别重逢相聚是喜悦，可是牵引的却是一个不幸的事，五味杂陈。

吊唁的地方就在吉隆坡市中心那里的富贵纪念馆2，本来还以为是比较接近我家、Kuchai Lama 那里的纪念馆；获知是市中心后，有点失策的感觉，得驱车久些，而朋友其实档期满满（其实他也无奈，还得去另去怡保吊唁）。

踏入富贵纪念馆，有点错乱的感觉，这里的布置美轮美奂，感觉像是豪华酒店多于吊唁的地方。也是好事，悲伤的气氛冲淡一些。

停车场电梯处就有间店，售卖各种丧事的必需品：豪宅好车衣物金银纸是标配，连飞机也有！

里面的格局就好像一个一个的阁院、一个府接一个府，落地窗旁的沙发，简直就是五星酒店大厅那样。

伙食也是富贵纪念馆包下，什么自助餐都可以客制。

不过这里边，好像是不可以上香，只得以上花取代。

离开的时候，才看到楼层表，不同楼层不同的功能，这么一站式我还是第一次接触到：

这一次回到吉隆坡，也是另约了老旧没见面的朋友聚一聚，这些年，不主动出击些，搞不好关系就永远断了。

body.title: The Dark Knight Unmasked
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=yakubnoyon/w1m5d3kd

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRPJo7n5jhe44xkdojaJzLNcPjUuQhhXyJXEuyr8qfVr/gaming_photography_2_.gif)

Batman finds himself alone in a dark alley. There are no people around. An overturned car is on fire in front of him. He can't find a way out. So he slowly moves forward and looks around for a way out.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNao9Q6qaXMjVmrBZ6V3wH7FkxwHEXYmW38euXbLoeAd/snapshot_100.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecEnX6iHYGHAsPZ9zkmrEtUXmpLCvoNywgFTfd6UBgDG/snapshot_101.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma7xyaFxd72nL2oqUeyPskdsXuie9PUb9vGjfjTZom8bn/snapshot_102.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBq9q7yMAzyuHsVsmt893g59uPYm3bUecqJ8x7PY2Jyd/snapshot_103.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYUXJE2fJ5oQTZbwbhAPXeHuVLZR5HzY77UgasWiAVPWU/snapshot_104.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYX6LQ4JoN5RbyZLtT6ehiS6FgQEuSDcx6PVmQZE8JMrp/snapshot_105.png)

After going a little way, he saw many doors. He tried to open each door one by one, but all of them were locked from the inside. Just then, suddenly looking back, he saw a horrible sight. The bodies of two people were lying on the ground, a man and a woman.

Batman approaches and is shocked. These are none other than his parents. Their bodies lie exactly as they were when his parents were killed when he was a child. Those old memories instantly come back to his mind. Batman becomes deeply emotional and cannot cope with his pain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXYW42vM5yuqWeC8jZGDpxgeVR53UHx8ykJNbAMAuMSP/snapshot_106.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdA5a5XsDs45yv4fEdHGuwJKNnPBKM5McSBRMGY7wmZQa/snapshot_107.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNm2H4jpzh2XkgBHoSTKyrotf29x29Q4x4s4fdnBfXHp2/snapshot_108.png)

Just then, the Joker suddenly appears from nowhere. He starts teasing Batman and mocking his weaknesses. Batman gets very angry and attacks the Joker. After a while, the Joker breaks into pieces.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUwcFuGE63kg92SKLBoqkonhbz9wAbdDtmcHrj96S3k2r/snapshot_109.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtHNprhfdDZkws9JozydEQ7HJYwq68VbHxbQgTeFtRHV/snapshot_110.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMKp3egu2qbVvgx4cQSb1xR5kQM3Y6xk8xXzH8cpp7Mn/snapshot_111.png)

But that's when the trouble started. Numerous Jokers came from all sides and surrounded Batman. They all started jumping on him at once. Batman also started fighting with them. He started punching, kicking and hitting them one after another. This fight continued for a long time, but the number of Jokers instead of decreasing, kept increasing. At one point, Batman gets so angry that he grabs a Joker and wrings his neck. And at that very moment, everything around him goes dark.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVZ9rWBHDXgoxMPaipbgvrXE6MzPn4fSZN5oUQRcA9hDm/snapshot_112.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd7W7qto5JbLDS6SpH8jXJKL24smehR2EhvVKoiPU4yNF/snapshot_113.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXiWD8CkYfCFivYQuxH82AiDUoYPBAdZkWavef3CgpAoY/snapshot_114.png)

When he regains consciousness after a while, he realizes that none of this was real. He wasn't lost anywhere, not even in an alley. He's still inside the truck and the truck is moving towards its destination. Then Batman realizes that everything he's seen so far was an illusion created by the effects of Scarecrow's toxin.

The truck leaves the city and eventually arrives at Arkham Asylum. This is the place where the Joker was once imprisoned.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAD8y7mw9yv2RmjeAfax2LQkbGMzRsNteM56garkaAPD/snapshot_115.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZssARRjW7YAmqGB3CN3tBVXgice4w9pgTzFPQq7BfyS7/snapshot_116.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaHQpETwDukmTceWLqXxeeqA2nhmAoMc5KxTNm2Yp5gUR/snapshot_117.png)

Upon entering, Scarecrow is seen waiting for Batman. He ties Batman tightly to an iron chair. He is then taken to a room where Commissioner Gordon and Robin are also being held captive.

Not only that, there are numerous television cameras and news channels around. Scarecrow was actually broadcasting the entire incident live. His goal was to reveal Batman's true identity to everyone.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpvDnRh1FfBYNQHRrzHcdrBotwZGAgrBDZpiL6RrESwP/snapshot_118.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYaRFRxkmh84aPAYLxocK5c5L2NSQ1ZoiVU38hvaqKoXP/snapshot_119.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVFAGpmK8K3BVenc7z1mwvfRJX5MZUKmtBsBTQ7g76v8M/snapshot_120.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpWa5BUkXhVTTWXiNxFBuHxtbug6ZRkQhMtjN29h9TFh/snapshot_121.png)

First, he asks Commissioner Gordon to remove Batman's mask. Gordon refuses. Then Scarecrow shoots Robin and threatens that the next shot will be more dangerous if he doesn't remove the mask.

To save his friend, Gordon is forced to remove Batman's mask. The mask is removed, and everyone is surprised. The TV audience, the news crew, Robin, and Gordon, everyone sees that Batman is actually Bruce Wayne, the prince of Gotham.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQj9U475HZcCd5G5aBPtHHS9Endjs7ru4qe3JPrdT9To/snapshot_122.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXoS6gLL4wXPKNvcLsZfvVBH9bXkaLVwDga6ZZghHwVzU/snapshot_123.png)

Scarecrow doesn't stop there. He injects Batman with more fear toxin. Now the question is, what effect will this toxin have on Batman? Will the Joker within him take full control?

That answer will be revealed in the next episode.

---

* **Thank you for reading. See you all on my next blog.**

---

body.title: Sistema de Captación de agua de Lluvia. Cálculos hidrológicos realizados/Rainwater Harvesting System. Hydrological calculations performed
body.body:
Buenos días, Hive.

​Ya nuestro proyecto tiene rostro. Hemos determinado los escurrimientos y con ello podremos ya dimensionar nuestro sistema.

​En la primera imagen que les comparto, se reflejan los datos obtenidos de la lluvia para el área donde se ubica  el proyecto. 1050 mm al año, según el mapa isoyético, es lo que llueve como altura de agua al año para esta zona.

​Se muestra además, el valor obtenido del área de techo de la institución. Con estos valores ya pasamos a realizar el balance hídrico, que no es más que un balance entre lo que se escurre al llover y lo que se consume. Esto, mensualmente.

​La distribución del escurrimiento es esencial, pues de esos 1050 mm que precipitan al  año, nos indica el porciento que corresponde a cada mes. Así que a los meses que pertenecen al período húmedo, de mayo a octubre, corresponde la mayor cantidad.

​Ahora en la imagen 2, se muestra ya la tabla final de este balance. El volumen de agua que escurre hacia la cisterna mes por mes es el resultado de multiplicar la lámina de lluvia de ese mes (mm) por el área del techo.  En la mayoría de los meses, es mayor lo que escurre que lo que se  consume, por ende, la cisterna se mantendrá generalmente llena, incluso vertiendo un volumen que no se podrá almacenar por falta de capacidad.

​Para este caso, la demanda es un dato fijado por la inversión y corresponde a 268 m³, mientras que el volumen de almacenamiento también es un parámetro fijo, siendo su cuantía de 233 m³, referente al volumen real de la cisterna existente.

​Los tres parámetros marcados en amarillo en la tabla, indican que en esos meses lo que llueve y escurre es menor que lo que se consume; es ahí entonces que se suple ese déficit con agua almacenada en la cisterna, y ya para el mes de febrero la misma se queda prácticamente vacía, volumen que recupera totalmente a partir de marzo.

​Ya ahora lo que sigue es calcular las dimensiones de las canaletas que recogerán el agua del techo, los bajantes, los interceptores y la tubería que llevará finalmente el agua hasta la cisterna.

​Hasta la próxima.

---------------------------------------------------------

Good morning, Hive.

​Our project now has a face. We have determined the runoff, and with that, we can now size our system.

​In the first image I am sharing with you, the data obtained regarding rainfall for the area where the project is located is reflected. 1050 mm per year, according to the isohyet map, is the rainfall depth per year for this zone.

​Additionally, the value obtained for the roof area of the institution is shown. With these values, we now move on to perform the water balance, which is nothing more than a balance between what runs off when it rains and what is consumed. This is done on a monthly basis.

​The runoff distribution is essential because, out of those 1050 mm of annual precipitation, it indicates the percentage that corresponds to each month. Thus, the months belonging to the wet period, from May to October, account for the largest amount.

​Now, in image 2, the final table of this balance is shown. The volume of water that runs off into the cistern month by month is the result of multiplying the rainfall depth of that month (mm) by the roof area. In most months, the runoff is greater than what is consumed; therefore, the cistern will generally remain full, even overflowing a volume that cannot be stored due to a lack of capacity.

​For this case, the demand is a figure set by the investment and corresponds to 268 m³, while the storage volume is also a fixed parameter, its amount being 233 m³, referring to the actual volume of the existing cistern.

​The three parameters marked in yellow in the table indicate that in those months, the rainfall and runoff are less than what is consumed; it is then that this deficit is supplied by water stored in the cistern, and by the month of February, it becomes practically empty, a volume that fully recovers starting in March.

​What follows now is to calculate the dimensions of the gutters that will collect the water from the roof, the downspouts, the first-flush diverters, and the pipeline that will finally carry the water to the cistern.

​Until next time.

Well here we go, the second half, the B-Side of the Calgary Stampede album is in the shoots!

Steel Ink Band~ B-Side~ #4. From The North Folk And The Poke!

This track is the ultimate open-door invitation to the province, acting as a rolling roll call that proves the Stampede belongs to every corner of the map. \

serves as the B-side’s grand welcoming committee, reaching out to the hardy souls from the northern muskeg down to the sandstone streets of the south. It’s a song fueled by the highway and the spirit of the people making the trek, whether they’re hauling in from the \
or driving down from the high golden prairies.\nA standout moment in the song is the call to the legendary rodeo heart of Ponoka, Alberta. By giving a rowdy shout-out to the folks from \

From the smokehouses of Mundare to the dinner bells of Innisfail, this anthem captures the momentum of a province on the move. Basically you got the feeling already in your mind and now you are thinking that it won't get true or might happen. So it depends on the situation. I think still many people are getting confuse with this kind of explanation. Let's take an example and understand it way more clear. Imagine you are playing any sports on the a high professional level and you are into the finals with your strong opponent. But before you play you are already feeling something in your mind that either you will lose the game or either you will win the game one sides. body.title: Proposal to Continue Hive-Engine Development
body.body:
I believe this is our fifth proposal for Hive-Engine development funding, and it carries a straightforward message: **we have delivered, and we are willing to keep going.**

Our previous proposals all closed \

, with transparent reporting and more work completed than promised. This cycle follows the same open-ended mandate: fix what needs fixing as it comes up, keep building what the ecosystem requires, and document everything publicly along the way.

---

## Achievements This Cycle

### Hive-Engine Core: The Failover Fix
We diagnosed and resolved a long-standing reliability issue in `hivesmartcontracts` where nodes failed to fail over cleanly during primary Hive RPC degradation. **PR #134 is now merged into main**, delivering:

* **Request-level failover** across the complete `streamNodes` list.
* **Scheduler-level node demotion** to temporarily pause traffic to failing endpoints.
* **Graceful shutdown** reliability improvements.
* **npm dependency audit** cleanup.

### ssc_tokens_history: Security Audit & Modernization
We conducted an audit on the legacy `ssc_tokens_history` repository, resolving **11 vulnerabilities** (including a high-severity CSRF issue in the axios chain). **PR #33** updated `sscjs`, `pg`, `axios`, and `eslint`. 

We also published a scoped modernization roadmap for the next cycle:
* Flexible single-sided timestamp filtering.
* Cursor-based pagination to replace deep `skip/limit` queries.
* Index strategy revisions based on actual account-history query patterns.
* NFT history lookup path improvements.
* Pre-intervention query telemetry.

### hive-nectar Library Upgrades
**v0.2.14** and **v1.0.0** shipped with the following improvements:
* **Dual beacon support** (Peakd + v4v), with thanks to @brianoflondon for the secondary beacon infrastructure.
* **5-minute on-disk node cache** to reduce beacon load and accelerate application startup.
* **Docker/SQLite path fixes** for containerized deployments.
* **Documentation cleanup** for both `hive-nectar` and `nectarengine`, ensuring clean API references on ReadTheDocs.

### Infrastructure & Operator Documentation
We published two critical diagnostic guides to support the Hive-Engine node community:
* **MongoDB WiredTiger Throttle Fix:** Documented the \

method for parallel archive restoration on high-core-count hardware, including the `track_restore.sh` progress script.
* **MongoDB Segfault Isolation:** Traced a post-power-outage crash to a systemd environment variable (`GLIBC_TUNABLES`), documenting the exact diagnostic path and resolution.

### HiveTools and Market-Viewr
* Rebranded neo-beeswap to **Mithril Diesel Pool** with a responsive, theme-aware UI.
* Implemented dynamic OpenGraph preview images for pool links using a Pillow backend.
* Added searchable, scrollable token dropdowns to handle long lists efficiently.
* Resolved dark mode rendering bugs across all pages.
* Wired a dynamic sitemap to the Flask `url_map`.
* Fixed the timeframe filtering bug on the Market-Viewr history chart backend.


## Legendary 1 line PR

We can't forget about [our favorite submission](https://github.com/hive-engine/hivesmartcontracts/pull/135), a one-line quality of life fix for node operators:

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/open.mithril/48iFyLAj7YV4PQNCZdwnAHaAR36exuDgmT7cYb1iyQdfajzAykAVtJSzf1KZj9nmUZ.png)</center>


---

## Upcoming Objectives

* **Execute ssc_tokens_history Modernization:** Implement the published roadmap, prioritizing cursor pagination and index enhancements.
* **hivesmartcontracts Maintenance:** Continue to evaluate a dedicated RPC manager abstraction (so-called Option B) with the community.
* **Emergency Response Infrastructure:** Maintain ongoing, un-scoped technical support for critical failures and debugging.
* **Tooling Updates:** Provide continuous maintenance for `hive-nectar`, `nectarengine`, HiveTools, and Market-Viewr.

---

## Funding Request

We expect to receive approximately **317 BEE per day** in practice at present. We are requesting the maximum cap of **547 BEE per day**, functioning as a \

proposal to utilize remaining daily budget funds after higher-priority proposals are serviced.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/open.mithril/23t74biETtQjtqTarTyxrhnteNcAx4nniVPCKaeGKim65JmittLHPXokuecVCrqvTmZ8n.png)


All funding goes directly to support our Hive-Engine development, with work fully documented across @open.mithril and @thecrazygm posts. Previous posts in this series have been published on @ecoinstar and also @ecoinstant.  You can now see our company page at https://ecoinstats.net. 

We ask you to extend this trust for another six-month cycle, which is the pace we have been managing.  


## Freedom and Friendship

A wonderful  happy day in my life #myday

Iam really proud be a emergency nurse #nurse

In the emergency department, we measure success not just in heartbeats, but in minutes. When a stroke patient rolls through the doors, the clock is already ticking against a narrowing \

—a fleeting frame of time where medical intervention can mean the difference between permanent paralysis and walking out of the hospital. Recently, I stood at the center of that race against time. There is a unique, irreplaceable joy in watching the chaotic choreography of emergency care seamlessly align, knowing that our swift actions directly reclaimed a person's future. This is the story of that shift, and the profound happiness that comes from beating the clock.


Yes Time matters https://img.leopedia.io/DQme6c4mKMHEysSYnNyoki846s5TKcWPRRxqQsXbkx98Z3Y/IMG_7345.png 

On a recent evening shift, the high-stakes reality of emergency nursing unfolded in a matter of minutes. A patient arrived presenting with a slurred speech pattern that had begun just three hours prior—
placing them precariously near the edge of the critical treatment window. 

Though their vitals were stable and physical weakness hadn’t yet set in, our emergency triage team immediately recognized the silent threat of an acute ischemic stroke. 
⏰ 
Within seconds, we activated the stroke code, setting a flawless clinical choreography into motion. The neurology team arrived at the bedside instantly, and within ten minutes, the patient was shifted for a computed tomography (CT) scan.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTNYNDUgPqpjbYQbdi2rSxgpEaPvcas4ceAaSMRte28x5/99EF5632-FD7E-43BB-B2AE-111035F0EBFA.png 

Once the imaging confirmed no hemorrhagic bleed, the decision was made to initiate thrombolytic therapy. Administering a powerful clot-buster is a nerve-wracking tightrope walk, as the risk of catastrophic bleeding looms heavily over every drop. We meticulously managed the patient's blood pressure, monitoring for the slightest sign of neurological decline. 
An hour later, as I transferred the patient to the Neuro Semi-ICU, the ultimate reward of our rush against the clock became clear: the patient’s speech was already beginning to clear, and their condition was visibly improving. In emergency care, we live for these triumphs—the profound happiness of knowing that precise teamwork and swift action saved a mind, and a life, just in time

Diagnosis-Acute stroke

lets discuss..
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUVjqStEN9ZqQzJbhRW6KV8QEfjdENWEFcYBsTviqxvzH/IMG_7342.jpeg 

B - Balance: Sudden loss of balance, coordination, difficulty walking, or severe dizziness.
E - Eyes: Sudden changes in vision, such as blurriness, double vision, or loss of sight in one or both eyes.
F - Face: Sudden numbness or drooping on one side of the face. Try smiling to see if it is uneven.
A - Arms: Sudden weakness or numbness in one arm or leg. Try raising both arms to see if one drifts downward.
S - Speech: Sudden slurred speech, trouble speaking, or difficulty understanding others. Try repeating a simple sentence to check.
T - Time: If you observe any of these symptoms, even if they disappear, call for emergency medical help immediately

Remember the #befast 

Coming to conclusion.
n the world of emergency medicine, there is a well-known maxim: time is brain. Every minute a stroke goes untreated, millions of neurons are irreversibly lost, drawing a stark line between recovery and permanent disability. This patient’s successful outcome was not a matter of luck; it was the direct result of a synchronized race against the clock, where every second saved preserved a piece of that patient's future. For emergency nurses, navigating the intense pressure of the golden window is exhausting, but witnessing a patient regain their speech and their independence makes every high-stakes moment worth it. Ultimately, this victory serves as a powerful reminder that while we cannot stop a stroke from happening, our speed, precision, and quick advocacy in the ER have the definitive power to change the final diagnosis from a tragedy to a triumph

body.title: You Can Borrow Money But You Cannot Borrow Work Ethic
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUq8AfVpYdQqbgF2zBBPwSafZ42SwcyCopKbEFN7LEzHe/1000638263.png 
                       *Image source:AI generated *

Everyone wants to own a business not everyone wants to run one but you see that small or enormous gap between owning and running is where most business dreams quietly die.

I have watched it happen more times than I can count. Someone gets excited,they see an opportunity.
They hear that it is possible to qualify for a loan, secure funding, invest in and suddenly become a business owner so they do exactly that. 

They sign the papers,they get the money,they buy into the dream and then reality shows up uninvited.

Because a loan can buy you a business,It cannot buy you the discipline to run it.
It cannot buy you the patience to handle difficult customers, slow seasons, rising costs and shrinking margins. It cannot buy you the problem solving that happens at midnight when something goes wrong and there is nobody else to call. It cannot buy you the hunger that keeps a true entrepreneur moving when everything says stop.

You can purchase a business in a day,you cannot purchase the mentality it takes to keep one alive.

**Then comes the employee question.**
In a perfect world, there is that one ideal person. The hard worker who shows up early, stays late, cares about the business like it is their own, and runs everything smoothly while you collect the rewards of ownership but the world is not perfect.

That employee does not exist in most cases even when you find someone close to it, they eventually realize they are carrying the full weight of a business they have no ownership in. No equity,no stake,no future in it beyond their monthly salary.

So they leave,they stop caring or they do just enough to keep their job and nothing more.
And suddenly the business you bought with borrowed money is your full responsibility every single day.

Some people do not stop at one they take more loans,they acquire more businesses.
They believe that more ownership means more income but what it actually means is more responsibility, more pressure, more staff problems, more operational headaches, and more debt sitting on your shoulders while the businesses struggle to breathe.

The economy shifts,costs rise,customers disappear,the loan that once felt like an opportunity now feels like a weight you cannot put down.People lose big this way i mean real people. People I have watched go from excitement to exhaustion to complete collapse not because they were not smart enough but because they confused ownership with operation.


**The truth about business that nobody puts in the brochure**
Owning a business is not a passive activity. It is not a certificate you hang on a wall while money flows in. It is daily decisions, daily problems, daily presence and daily responsibility.
If you are not willing to run it,i mean truly run it, then you are not ready to own it.

And borrowing money to fund something you are not ready for does not make you an entrepreneur. It makes you in debt.

This is not to discourage anyone from building something but build it with your eyes open. Understand what you are signing up for before you sign anything. 

Know that the loan is just the beginning of the work, not a replacement for it because at the end of the day, the business does not care whose name is on the paper. It only responds to whoever shows up and does the work.

![1000019998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23xAXVoPthD3Bn5chNqeizsgcyqD4tNCd8GjtXbhsUsWK3HKMLgcyEwtetjiKWB7Bd67b.jpg)


Hi friends! I'm so glad this community keeps on going despite the really depressing price of HIVE. Seriously, hats off to everyone who keeps pressing on. I was just thinking of keeping this as an underground social media account, LOL. 😅 It's actually nicer to stay here than on mainstream social media—everything is just good vibes and chill, and the people are interesting and funny.

I was supposed to write 'caramelized banana rolls' in the title but it didn't sound so right, so yeah, I wrote turon 😅 because well, it is turon. I was asking my fam what do we call it in English and they came back at me telling me I am the teacher here. Lol, I was literally laughing while writing because I honestly don't know what do we call it in English. @hiveph  and @filipinosofhive  friends, please comment down below if you know the English name coz damn, I'm so ignorant lol.


![1000020024.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/242DLc43BFNTu49ESHruFeoigJLnTs9qqhLCwKvPo7osuRDfJ9zj8ECH7KJsUZ746Wr6h.png)

![1000020025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23uaMgQpyinwhmMEcZDhCKUHJMv1BPea5HaEv96JxD3wXhQbWg8KpQ8ZmNbmP9zimFVjY.jpg)


Today it's raining, hallelujah! Praise the gods and the universe.


Still nauseous from the weekend hustle. For real, I wanna throw up during the exam simulation but couldn't—because, well, I'm a broke-ass bitch and really needed my full weekend hours. Anyway, we headed out today and bought some groceries, too.

Near the checkout counter, there's a snack stall. You can find these in all SM Malls and Markets.

![1000019999.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23wWwEnDFX5i26sCL4fPfnVTCqSvi5LSDC8onUBL5nx574Wbx1zgXsHB1P5eRQihjySD9.jpg)


![1000020013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23vsScVMRwLW4WNJs2UzGNBzbPuy3JYGi65pePxRPrwfm2sK5CbBbBCmr8AXNGZDkpRHr.jpg)

![1000020023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23tH5a2dFVh5UfUAkcmeHhLfQD3iYczxRK4WUvyaJhX8ru6GPGAP78q2ZdbdRULS7wBK6.jpg)

Here's what's inside, banana and ripe jackfruit, sucks that it was no longer crunchy because of the long drive home, it doesn't look so appetizing but trust me, this is so bomb. In the Philippines, we can make so many snacks using unripe bananas. You’ll never get bored because they’re all so different! 😅

Anybody else just tried turon with vodka? I know you were all familiar with it with rhum, but I tried it with vodka once when I was in Boracay, and it was really good. I could actually finish two! Although I didn't see any pure vodka there, so I just bought the one with mixed soda, Epic fail! 

While falling in line to pay, I heard the people at my back complaining and praying that the rain would stop, only because it is inconvenient for them. I know commuting during the rainy season is too much of a hassle, but as if the rain would consider a single person's convenience? Oh please, crops are in dire need of rain, we have been experiencing drought since March. Just imagine how expensive rice and vegetables are nowadays because of the persisting drought. It just reminds me how ungrateful creatures we really are.

There you go, back to sleeping (making the most out of it coz my brothers are out so there's peace and quiet) I have yet to recover and need more rest because, well... we are not even halfway there. June is going to be long... whisper can't wait for summer holiday... I'm trying my best to catch up on posts and comments because everyone here is just so cool. I really want to read and visit every single post, but by the time I'm drying my hair before bed, I'm already knocking out... still trying tho!


Thanks for listening to my yapping, can't really wait to catch up with each and everyone soon.

body.title: LLMs na medicina: do benchmark USMLE ao consultório real
body.body:
O o3 da OpenAI marca 96% no MedQA — o exame de licenciamento médico americano (USMLE). O GPT-5 marca 73% no HealthBench. Em abril de 2026, um estudo da Harvard Medical School e Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center publicado com repercussão no NPR concluiu que um modelo de raciocínio da OpenAI igualou ou superou médicos em acurácia diagnóstica para casos de pacientes reais. Esses números são reais. Mas existe uma lacuna entre benchmarks e prática clínica que a indústria ainda não solucionou — e entender essa lacuna é mais importante do que qualquer score individual.

O que os benchmarks médicos medem
---------------------------------

O MedQA é um exame de múltipla escolha com 4 opções por questão, baseado no banco de questões do USMLE. Médicos recém-formados passam com 65%. Médicos experientes tipicamente marcam 85-90%. O o3 marca 96%.

A crítica ao MedQA como medida de competência clínica real é fundamentada: questões de múltipla escolha com 4 alternativas são o ambiente mais favorável possível para modelos de linguagem. O modelo precisa apenas identificar a resposta mais plausível entre opções pré-definidas. Na prática clínica, as opções não estão listadas.

O HealthBench, criado pela OpenAI com 262 médicos de 60 países e 26 especialidades, é uma tentativa de medir o que realmente importa: qualidade de comunicação, manuseio de incerteza, adequação de escalonamento (\

), segurança em triagem de emergência, e orientações clínicas precisas em múltiplos turnos de conversa. O GPT-5 marca 73% — impressionante, mas 23 pontos abaixo do score no MedQA. Essa diferença de 23 pontos é a distância entre saber medicina e praticá-la em contexto real.

A lacuna conhecimento-prática
-----------------------------

Uma revisão sistemática publicada no JMIR em 2025, cobrindo 39 benchmarks clínicos de LLMs, quantificou o problema com precisão. A acurácia diagnóstica cai de 82% em vinhetas clínicas tradicionais para 62.7% em diálogos multi-turno com pacientes — uma queda de 19.3 pontos percentuais. Apenas 5% dos estudos avaliaram desempenho de LLMs em dados reais de pacientes. Apenas 4 estudos com revisão por pares documentaram implementação clínica real em todo o mundo até 2025.

A lacuna existe porque a prática clínica envolve: informações incompletas fornecidas pelo paciente, sintomas que se modificam ao longo da consulta, múltiplas condições simultâneas, contexto socioeconômico que afeta a conduta, e a necessidade de decidir quando dizer \

e encaminhar. Nenhum desses elementos está presente em questões de múltipla escolha.

O produto mais implantado: documentação, não diagnóstico
--------------------------------------------------------

O produto de IA médica com maior penetração em 2026 não é um assistente de diagnóstico. É o Microsoft DAX Copilot (Nuance), um sistema que captura a conversa entre médico e paciente e gera rascunho de nota clínica automaticamente.

O motivo pelo qual DAX Copilot chegou a mais de 10 milhões de encontros clínicos quando outros produtos de IA médica permanecem em piloto é simples: ele não faz diagnóstico. Captura o que o médico disse e faz, e estrutura em formato clínico. O médico revisa e assina. O erro não é crítico — é apenas uma nota mal redigida. A regulação é gerenciável. O valor é imediato: 7 minutos poupados por consulta, 50% menos tempo em documentação após a consulta.

A Hippocratic AI, especializada em agentes para tarefas não-diagnósticas (educação de alta, preparação de cuidador, seguimento pós-internação), usou a mesma lógica: escalar fora do radar da regulação de dispositivos médicos ao não fazer diagnósticos. O resultado são 1.8 milhão de ligações completadas com 8.95/10 de satisfação do paciente.

O caso Harvard/Beth Israel: o que o estudo realmente diz
--------------------------------------------------------

O estudo publicado em abril de 2026, que concluiu que o modelo de raciocínio da OpenAI \

, merece leitura cuidadosa. Ele avaliou casos clínicos apresentados como texto estruturado para o modelo e para médicos em condições de teste — sem contato direto com o paciente, sem exame físico, sem capacidade de pedir exames adicionais. Nas condições do experimento, o modelo foi mais preciso.\n\nNas condições do experimento — não na prática real. A distinção importa. Médicos têm acesso a informações que texto não captura: a aparência geral do paciente (o \

), a forma como ele respira, o resultado do exame físico, a intuição acumulada de anos vendo como doenças se apresentam de formas atípicas. Nenhum desses inputs estava disponível para o médico ou para o modelo no estudo.\n\nO resultado é válido e relevante. Mas não significa que LLMs devem substituir médicos. Significa que, como ferramenta de apoio à decisão em contextos específicos, o potencial é real — e que os próximos 2 a 3 anos definirão que contextos são esses.

body.title: BATU SUSUN TOURIST DESTINATION // Explore the natural tourist destination located at an altitude of 1,350 MASL
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNu2F47xHTHnZwMwtK867G6YvHk8VQYuiP6HRAL5NE9DC/1780920169018.jpg) In this post, I will share my experience when visiting a natural tourist destination located at the top of Pantan Terong, namely Batu Susun. As the name suggests, this place offers many interesting attractions, including breathtaking natural scenery and a unique natural phenomenon,namely naturally arranged stones that are used by local residents to be used as an interesting tourist destination. Batu Susun Tourist Attraction is also located not far from Al Kahfi Peak,however visitors need to hike up a fairly steep hill first before they can discover its unique natural wonder. The journey to this place is also very enjoyable, as it is accompanied by breathtaking natural scenery along the way ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY247cTRNWb853kzd3THysFNPF9N5HQK3yzgWZVdQZGWt/1780920169092.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTDLkwuwdHTK43mQfGz71XYR4DWrDyjywKPFjNTuvg7X7/1780920169190.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZHsyqpQTMFXSAGb6yLmiZPeCdqAnRt3xNCqEtHy3JjCq/1780920169281.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXh4HUaMEEjXPQhyTSwJt4a5y8NAM4h29mGdgnHNFZDSZ/1780920169372.jpg) I don't know where this road leads, but one thing is certain—it is very quiet, as there are only a few houses nearby,but from the top of the hill, I could see several villages scattered across the surrounding area. Along the road, I also came across a few food stalls, cafés, and local plantations stretching across the mountains below,the scenery was truly beautiful and gave me a wonderful sense of peace and comfort. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWpLLL7asJcFVNUMfcLrdaDTwtv7tj9Su5m88C6nQfUjE/1780921766610.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXw3SDcaMs7apPTvvbWsxDyVTj6PW8uZ7TWwTJRAJjGhf/1780921766722.jpg) From the scenery alone, we can already conclude that this is a very peaceful and tranquil place. While I was there, I also had the opportunity to meet several local residents, many of whom worked as farmers. This journey gave me a lot of new knowledge and experiences, especially about how differences can complement one another. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc5aebUB69QZGdQ4qg8pV5omh5fxrnGtBWvi2zx4ZG7pX/1780921766840.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWRUSHUUn83ev3AqAQaGhM6YckkG3DH9cvx2g9sdny3gJ/1780921766935.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEwgUKUNesdTEi5gyMGUPyAdhytsZfVtL1C8e2unBo43/1780921767022.jpg) On the side of the road I also managed to find several unique buildings, I don't know whether they are buildings from tourist attractions or just ordinary buildings built on the side of the road. However, after I looked more closely, it turned out that there was one building that had a dome on top, which indicated that it was a place of worship, but at that time I didn't stop there, and just admired its beauty from the side of the road. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFvDAPHvh2h1isvGyFjYmBR5s4rik6JnahGuWx4nZ4sQ/1780922177661.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeAQS5mDsbyrxcsUQFVWXaoEy9A5WKRE2XpF6tXBWyjzs/1780922177792.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNQR3HHhPdpYa5mnUD2BtroD9SGxzLCqcsihVrUSDRYs/1780922177892.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme1TJqn2kUHw7K92fDz3GnaeRZWjStnoccTdhWt4TS1zk/1780922177986.jpg) And finally I managed to arrive at my destination, namely the Batu Susun natural tourist destination. When I arrived at this place, I immediately realized that this tourist spot was very simple, its location was also right next to the residents' plantations, so from this tourist spot we could see the activities of the farmers there. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT586aTo9zGd1ry2HPcBAajV1mRV16kAxUbimoGg1Lf2X/1780922357671.jpg) At first glance, the main area of this tourist attraction looks quite ordinary,however if we want to witness its true wonder, we must first hike up this hill. I don't know exactly how high it is, but climbing it is definitely exhausting and requires a lot of energy. But don't worry, because on this hill there are stairs provided to make it easier for visitors to climb it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSh8spx6AMEjNTnSShmbZ9a2qkYhHx4YFhyQqvE6n9cxR/1780922534555.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVy1euJJ5bRjeKCGAP18vhTSg2ru4yqc92XpE2YGgDyA/1780922534644.jpg) While climbing this hill, suddenly something I didn't want happened, namely my knees and thighs cramped again, maybe this was also the effect of the long and extreme journey. Oh yes, the miracle of these arranged stones is also in two areas, one is in the middle of the hill and the other area is at the top of this hill. At that time I decided to stop and rest in the middle area of ​​the hill first. In the middle section of the hill, I could also see numerous stones stacked in front of me. According to the information I received from the staff there, these stones were naturally arranged, but whether that information is true or not, I cannot say for certain. As a visitor, I could only observe and admire the beauty and uniqueness of this remarkable place. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPtDugYB1gYFPipuC64onpRsa1NEkYAHzq7bCDHSqyLW/1780923268185.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBTozhRaBBVRsTqqoxc5wyHRgC2R8oH5zoK7bWrAiajx/1780923268278.jpg) However, the natural scenery that I could see from this area was truly breathtaking,and I could even see Al-Kahfi Peak from here. The mountains are the main attraction of the landscape, and below them, we can see several residential areas, plantations, and winding roads stretching across the countryside. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

body.title: eLoan Warehouse (LMS)
body.body:
Lending businesses often run into problems when their operations depend on disconnected tools, manual processes, and limited visibility across the loan lifecycle. What may seem manageable at a smaller scale quickly becomes harder to control as servicing, repayments, collections, and reporting grow more complex. In many cases, the issue is not the lending model itself, but the software environment supporting it.

This is why a strong loan management system matters so much. An effective platform should do far more than store loan records. It should support the full lifecycle of a loan, from onboarding and approvals to servicing, payments, collections, and reporting. When these functions are brought together in one structured system, lending operations become easier to manage, more efficient, and better prepared to scale.

One of the most important parts of this process is loan servicing software. Lenders need more than payment tracking alone. They need visibility into borrower activity, repayment schedules, servicing workflows, and reporting, all in one place. Without that, teams often end up relying on manual coordination and fragmented systems that slow down operations and increase the risk of mistakes.

This is also why businesses increasingly look for an experienced lending software development company when building or modernizing lending platforms. It is no longer enough to create basic fintech functionality and leave the rest to manual work. Modern lending systems often require integrations, workflow automation, lifecycle visibility, secure data handling, and support for both internal teams and borrowers. The right development partner can make the delivery process much more structured and predictable.

At the same time, [lending software development](https://globaldev.tech/case-studies/loan-management-system-for-consumer-lending-operations) itself has become more important as financial companies try to improve efficiency and support growth. Standard tools often fail to reflect the real complexity of lending operations. From borrower management and repayment tracking to collections and platform integrations, custom development gives lenders the flexibility to build around their own workflows instead of adapting to software limitations.

In this context, eLoan Warehouse represents the type of platform modern consumer lending operations increasingly need: a system designed to unify loan servicing, lifecycle management, and operational control in one environment. For lenders aiming to reduce friction, improve visibility, and create a more scalable process, this kind of solution is becoming essential rather than optional.

body.body: <div class=\

>


If a magic genie could grant me one wish , I certainly know that one wish I wouldn't have to think too hard about my answer.

I would wish for a life for me and my kids,,Now I feel like thats one thing thats still not quite right in my life, When people hear \

they think it means becoming super rich or living a fancy lifestyle.. That is not what I mean. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzBqRyqSduwMqFZirwfPvXNRKUSj4aiVtRHzBXoqPNZ3/1780923126384.jpg) A better life means having stability, it means waking up every day without worrying about how things will work out. A better life means having enough to take care of my kids meet our needs and still have peace of mind. As a parent my priorities have changed. I still have dreams for myself, My kids are part of every dream I have, their future is connected to mine, So when I think about what I want most I don't think about cars or huge mansions. I think about opportunities, I think about growth. I think about giving my kids a life where they can focus on becoming who they want to be without stress. I think about supporting their education, interests and dreams without worrying about the cost, that is what a better life looks like to me. Honestly it is not just about money. It's about having peace of mind, It is about being healthy. It is about healing from experiences. It is about waking up with hope, not fear. It is about enjoying life not getting through it. Life has taught me a lot over the years, there have been moments, moments that made me cry moments that made me question myself and moments that made me stronger. Looking back I can see how far I have come. I can also see how far I still want to go, That is why if a genie appeared today and offered me one wish I would use it for something than just myself. I would wish for a life for me and my kids. A life with opportunities. A life with peace, A life where hard work pays off, a life where we can look back and be grateful that we kept going even when things were tough. Because when my kids are okay happy and growing into the version of themselves I know I'll be happy too. So yes if I had one wish that would be it, Not perfection, not wealth, Just a better life, for me and my kids. Honestly that is a wish I wouldn't hesitate to make. *** --- ***Image Is Mine*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)
