body.title: A Japanese-Era Fort on the Coast of Kuthang
body.body: <div class=\
> <div class=\

> ![20260608_144559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/AKp8cgDtpxa3MDZqgwpeS4sFdpqhvzDBuD73qyNMNgxR7QLk5WnZw5pw6btsWfv.jpg)
Pidie Jaya is one of the new provinces experiencing rapid development. The region boasts a long coastline as well as mountainous areas. Life here is quite comfortable, and residents can easily find work. The local community is quite enthusiastic about the region’s rapid progress. Following the 2004 tsunami and the devastating 2016 earthquake, the area was hit by a flash flood in 2025 that submerged many homes. Although full recovery hasn’t been achieved yet, the community has gradually begun to rebuild six months after the disaster. Tourism in this area remains quite active. Both local and out-of-town tourists are eager to visit.
![20260530_180248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Ep1VRvuqGTMSAXCk54Bpv6LxqbeA8F6d67qyADjjcCDWMk1n5ZjCr4N9m9d8nN5L6wq.jpg) Actually, this is a place I haven’t visited in years since my family and I moved to a different city. However, during the Eid al-Fitr holiday, my husband and I made a point to visit my grandmother’s old house. We stayed overnight so we could take the time to visit one of the quite popular beach attractions there. Kuthang Beach is the name of this beach, located right in the village of Peurade, Tringgadeng subdistrict, Pidie Jaya regency.
|![20260530_164647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EqhPpbKSmwszHzUbSDYe9wvwr7m9ntDrr9p5tc71Z1BYGW36Ah8prkn3NovnwcdcxSy.jpg)|![20260530_175539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/245w9MfBywsu7tqZ5JA7suSUDk5WvFTg4h9XrNRk7oHavHrgxuKcMfdaZBdpEdwdX8E3e.jpg)|![20260530_164642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Eoa2aQEeHM7PnMBdkykYhHxMfdQH6fyud98YebkwPVX6kMsGHecGkCrMjjTD1LW1h5k.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Not far from the highway, just past the town of Trienggadeng right on the side of the road, you’ll find a large gate leading to this beach. The entrance fee is quite affordable—parking for one car costs only IDR 5,000, a fantastic price that really surprised my husband and me.
![20260530_164556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpA26vb753YphdUM6cjF4HVouEUgJee1fn2Qce2hA6ebrXvoVh6yESk15GfTQQXDpyw.jpg) Once we arrived, I chose a spot to sit at a traditional open-air hut; as it happened, I had brought along my older sister’s children. We ordered some simple food and enjoyed it at a leisurely pace.
|![20260530_164957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wCGAPku1tYsMY6taCn5UjYQ8pLCCouhihDGK4uUd5WKV94PZuXqdTzLQ9chaDuedE7M.jpg)|![20260530_171606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Eoc7XWzP3fHZPwoYBktuugHqgSsAk4VLWVxh2gcPdSo9RynjuB8Mvm1P1xTKEVfnjhM.jpg)|![20260530_171526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u6BmepakyEST4Uukf8MiT2hVbHKKFjQfCAjJFehvJJs77cLHVbUtRwcnXrn77cWDSuA.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![20260530_164708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23s9TBWpFZ4rd94CAhVrgVe5ZqiPMFe7Wd9dbuzYQ4ST7iL7LDDv9nW7yjdk9yp8CMq7g.jpg)|![20260530_180456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tSSKZghnfxai6s9DHnu9knYhz1tZpwzA3LfctqqVpJhN2jYq8apq7fkKdLa32KGDqPn.jpg)|![20260530_164817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tm9e385A3LS4YUPwwBGWDxxMxEY1Zgz99ivp2UAnxMEoH6nzxauBH8UwrfwchCs7L1W.jpg)|
The sea breeze was very strong, yet the heat was intense, even though it was already getting late in the afternoon. However, the weather that day was indeed so sunny. Without much delay after eating, I suddenly remembered one thing: this beach actually holds an extraordinary piece of history. Specifically, there is a bunker—a remnant of the Japanese military from the past. ![20260530_175913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/246ahqzkTZnBUkJgmTK5e59QtmAQPbggWjgqGYrB31W3VZJdjwmUq2ricQvUapMkhKF7n.jpg) I went straight there to take a closer look. The bunker had become one with nature, its structure embedded in the sand as if it were telling the story of the military from that era. Eroded by time, yet the bunker remained sturdy, with its structure almost entirely intact.
![20260530_180104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/243BU3sDwgRJQu6SB6i46a9kTRwkhqy9GFpQUmPQAShNw2B2Nrbjrpz3rruyHMJPiwtgu.jpg) |![20260530_180050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpxsEdUnStrH9CUaqWHxBNSUBWKg2rFwP6Pu5r33VGEEpAm34PB6d5FKcsXtb8hasr9.jpg) |![20260530_175745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EnoJK6tBp8RvNWuWwPs71pY4YMsZLpPYNgKzJEQTqMuuYqt63QGXJWET1PtvYhGidt3.jpg)|![20260530_175753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpZRprNWE44i6bdBVZG7zBW7WeVjhjPev6auzHXjNRyqdB5A647giatoBAEDSN6DX3g.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Every part of the bunker is still very neat, and look—the interior is also still in excellent condition. This is one of the bunkers I saw; there are about eight of them here. Some of the others are still in great shape—not tilted—and their interiors haven’t been buried yet. Unfortunately, they’re a bit far away, and it was pretty crowded there that afternoon.
|![20260530_180224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zv79kjGgp4fNYNrowmJnLTT9b58SkboiUTAi54es3ZvG85yybgs8TNGBvdD6AQ9QvRQ.jpg)|![20260530_180149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xL4weVnfyFErVKfekEa2HYW7Tetk6MuJPne8dfiBrhbHUDrimvbwLK6SpDDLLB5KF8P.jpg)|![20260530_180200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsUQ7iEMewMJh6qvBqj96m1fLZycsW11M8rpfD1bwbdUEh7J99Z9ZcsvRsNdznwhjZE.jpg)| |-|-|-|
We took some photos there; my older sister and her child are used to coming here. Usually, in the morning after dawn, when the sun rises, they come here to bathe. ![20260530_175848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23v4R11FyQ4f81h6YkYhPbBTnx1q4rJxr3BFF4sPddkmFZtxoWBBkKHuPhLokN2ACqY7X.jpg) The atmosphere is very peaceful; the fortress lined up along the shoreline make us feel a bit nostalgic. Military defenses were heavily guarded back then; apparently, there are eight bunkers remaining, as I mentioned earlier, and they’re still visible and sturdy. However, some are no longer visible at all.
![20260530_175753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpZRprNWE44i6bdBVZG7zBW7WeVjhjPev6auzHXjNRyqdB5A647giatoBAEDSN6DX3g.jpg) Actually, this beach wasn’t originally a tourist spot, but over time—especially after the 2016 earthquake—it was opened to the public. Managed by the local government with remarkable improvements, major city events are usually held here. Now everything is much better; the beach is very active, and the local economy has been greatly boosted. In my opinion, this beach is well worth being designated as a historical tourist destination. Many people in the surrounding area—and perhaps in other cities, like my husband—are unaware of the history behind the construction of the many Japanese military defense forts here. I believe the management of this area should be publicized in the media so that both local and out-of-town tourists can learn its history and understand that there are tourist sites whose origins deserve to be known. This way, the community can enjoy tourism while gaining knowledge about history. Well, for those of you who might be curious and want to visit this tourist spot, come on over—I’m sure these rows of forts will draw you in and make you want to learn more about this place. [//]:# (!worldmappin 5.26648 lat 96.16531 long A Japanese-Era Fort on the Coast of Kuthang d3scr)

body.title: There's a man who lived on Everest alone for a week
body.body: alt=\

/>

When Dawa Sherpa's family in Nepal learned he had gone missing on Everest, they did what families do when there is no longer any hope. They began the funeral rites.

They were wrong.

On Thursday June 4, six days after he was last seen, the 52-year-old Nepali sherpa was found alive near Everest's southern base camp — crawling down the mountain on his hands and knees, severely frostbitten, dehydrated, and with a broken bone. But alive.

<h2 style=\
data-align=\

>How it started Dawa had been guiding a Polish climber toward the summit on May 29 when he ran out of oxygen somewhere between Camp 3 and Camp 4 — both above 7,000 meters. He was forced to stop. The last person to see him was British mountaineer Chris Thrall, who found him sitting and resting, apparently fine. Thrall then turned his attention to the Polish climber, who had also run out of oxygen and was showing early signs of frostbite, assuming the far more experienced Nepali guide would make his way down independently. He didn't. Not for nearly a week.
data-align=\

>Six days at the top of the world Speaking to the BBC, Dawa said he hadn't expected to survive. For the first two days he ate nothing at all. After that, he chewed ice and survived on a few pieces of chocolate he found in his pocket. At some point he fell into a crevasse — and managed to climb out. He was eventually found almost by accident, by a team that had gone up to collect rubbish left behind by climbing expeditions. He was airlifted to HAMS Hospital in Kathmandu, where he is being treated for dehydration, frostbite, and a bone fracture. Pemba Sherpa, executive director of 8K Expeditions — which had overseen the search — called his survival \
Six people have already died on Everest this climbing season.\n\n<h2 style=\
data-align=\

>The aftermath Dawa's family has accused his employer of failing to launch search efforts quickly enough and, according to the New York Times, has filed a formal complaint with police. Meanwhile, six people have already died on Everest this season attempting to reach the summit — a reminder that the mountain rarely offers second chances. Dawa Sherpa used his.

body.title: Fast Line Buergerarmt Termin fuer Personalausweis... Heute habe ich den Termin direkt fuer Morgen Mittag bekommen, wegen damit doppelter Anfrage auf einem System. Noch hoeher Priorisiert.
body.body:
Die Hive Blockchain luegt nicht, ich mache mir das Staendig zu Nutzen und Du so?^^ Fast Line Buergerarmt Termin fuer Personalausweis... Heute habe ich den Termin direkt fuer Morgen Mittag bekommen, wegen damit doppelter Anfrage auf einem System. Noch hoeher Priorisiert.

Tja was sagt man dazu.

Haette ich heute mehr Energie fuer den Bloedsinn um das Service Portal Berlin und die Ticketvergabe gehabt, waehre mein Fall wohl noch interessanter geworden, teaete ich ihn jetzt erst an die entsprechenden Stellen melden, inklusive simpler Loesungswege ohne Extra Kosten des soll mir keiner Erzaehlen und wenn will ich das genau hoeren.

Um 12:12 Morgen Mittag haette ich einen neuen Termin fuer meinen aufgrund vor allem meiner Unwissenheit und Dummheit!!! 10ten! Kontakt mit dem Berliner Buergeramt Buch wegen einer Sache dem Ausweis, naemlich, den bezahlt zu bekommen.

Soweit, kein Witz.

Naja, auf jeden Fall, hat die gute Mitarbeiterin, die ist schneller wie ich am Ackern und sicher auch mehr, also so wegen allem und alles, hat sie es geschafft, sich selbst im Gutem zu Widersprechen, und einfach, Dinge schon erledigt, nachdem sie gesagt hatte, des koenne gerade wegen persoenlicher Abwesenheit garnet erledigt werden.

Ja die arbeiten da alle was in den Aemtern hier in Berlin und das Fleißig. Alle

Kein Scheiß

Normal ist das nicht, nicht wirklich aber Gut ist es schon, so meine ich das nicht.

Ergo ich kenn das Zeug aber von Daheim ja auch schon so, ist es bestimmt, nur deswegen da besser, weil weniger Aerger mit weniger Menschen auf viel mehr Flaeche verteilt.

Nu hier ist das genau andersrum, viele Menschen, viel Aerger, wenig Flaeche.

Ergo, muss man sich da irgendwie fuegen, nu und dann, dauert alles laenger, ist aber ungewoehnlich viel Besser, wenn es dann funktioniert.

Das Programm im Service Portal, hat mich von heute auf morgen Terminiert. Das ist kein Zufall, sondern die Fast Line, die eingebaut ist.

Wenn ich auf dem Selben Amt zweimal einen Termin buche, ist der zweite Schneller-

Aber den ganzen Käse, habe ich ohne weiteren leider auch wieder einfach mitentstandenen Beweis fuer meine Ansicht der Dinge schon vorher erzaehlt.

Des ist nicht Schlecht gemacht!!!

Es ist nur am Ende ganz in der Spitze ein kleiner winziger, aber fatal wirkender Kackfehler, den man leicht aus der Welt schaffen kann, indem, indem!!!!

man dem Menschen ein bisschen eine Auswahl zutraut, und die lautet JA oder NEIN
JA ich verzichte auf einen Termin fuer Notfaelle,

Nein ich kann nicht auf einen Termin fuer Notfaelle verzichten.

Na was glaubt ihr, was ihr alle anklickt, so wie ich auch?

Genau, wenns eilt, klickste Nein, und wenn es nicht Eilt, klickste aller aller meistens, wahrscheinlich JA.

Das heißt, die Leute bekommen, auch wieder Termine, von Heute auf Morgen, nicht so oft, aber, manchmal, normal werden dann zwei bis drei Tage sein, so wie Frueher, vielleicht sogar weniger, weil das System dann endlich mal richtig hart durchfunktioniert, ist es an sich ja nicht schlecht gebaut aber der bloedsinn mit den terminen muss raus, einfach komplett leoschen tutti frutti, dauert net lang will ich wetten und dann. funktion antwort ja nein, termin vergabe, kurzfristig langfristig, ende, dann regelt sich der rest, vollautomatisch durch kollektivmenschenvertrauen von selber und wenn net, kann man es immer noch wieder auf den senf zurueckfueren fuer die sich wohl irgendwie drei fuenf jahre den kopf zerbrochen haben gefuehlt so kompliziert ist der scheiß gebaut, mit sogar, sogar, das man einfach, so vergessen kann, den termin zu buchen, im notfall, haste dann den frei, wenn du auf der matte stehst bei der anmeldung im system damit die gute auch mal was zu guggen hat was jetzt los ist und von gleuck redet, also leute, wir brauchen kein glueck,

wir brauchen mehr selbstvertrauen,^^

Salve

body.title: At the Caracas Cable Car / En el Teleférico de Caracas
body.body:
![Beige Aesthetic New Year Vision Board Collage .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/48JeNH8ZsL22BdipSUaSVPujFQCtf8nqpk4aoeu83FriKs1T6hmQWMUa5p7N23jAxV.png)







*Design created with Canva / Diseño creado con Canva*


<div class=\

> 

***English***


### <center>**At the Caracas Cable Car**</center>

<div class=\

> When you travel to Caracas, the first thing that comes to mind is a chaotic, modern city that seems closed off from the outside world, but the truth is that it’s a Caribbean city; the sea doesn’t lap at its shores, but the people feel as though they’re from the coast. But at the same time, when we look up, we find a mountain over 2,000 meters high, offering us misty landscapes and magical trails that seem straight out of the European Alps.

> 

***Español***

### <center>**En el Teleférico de Caracas**</center>

<div class=\

> Cuando uno viaja a Caracas, lo primero que llega a nuestra mente es una urbe caótica, moderna y encerrada en sí misma, pero la verdad es que se trata de una ciudad caribeña; el mar no golpea su fachada, pero la gente se siente como de la costa. Pero al mismo tiempo, al mirar hacia arriba, nos encontramos con una montaña que supera los 2000 m de altura, regalándonos paisajes nublados y senderos mágicos que parecieran sacados de los Alpes europeos.
![IMG_20260423_171412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EowHXvcsvSxqhYAxyBusd29EEfR4vL7EWv1Nu6Fcq5T7J6mz9WVqhwb7oTS5NZPwZHv.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wqkWgSB5Tqu2ZufgriAYxPNcN9Zyc1ujZgeG4xHMucoP8xD3MhHMYf2MpVeGyg5pDQ5.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep3eJqjfBZtzxC6XZV9RbVxWnGSNCLw2ukR9FeaQ43u2Hvb6Wvt7QQ39jaGtPQoEFrA.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xp8vGkg8fUq2duRCt46T8mGuJ5AD9A8SPkd2c4fyyb6N6S4yVMKVCrKxz8T9GMgRn7S.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xp6G3MNqtHPbTfCovqvgaSRXVFLrapBLJ7GQYBaVxKDaXuwymj2CLhpbyJQvZFjE7VR.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171859(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23x19F3Yi8GRdqyDji8BZgS9UdCqo9xS1ZW9UHjQVQitWpL6Yp4xFyynFUN2WY3BgEJUj.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_173018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqmfWjwiHAynP4CvR6MTYNAQZoxLV87vtQyCmtWEwvH7bTy1dGerZ4JboUmQd13qEQx.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_173154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoTdqoDC9sCnE2XvpAN1jZTcKkaV8zLUxwTeGKekCQdznn3FiskVzwP8kqnwoGp3AXu.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EopuJcAysVwQWLjvL3bmzHiPmhzKDQhk4a8qQQPwYyphgmSrGEBf3yGHYn179JtS6fk.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> Honestly, I was here many years ago, but today I’m back to discover what has changed over time, to fully experience the capital’s adventure, and to uncover those secrets that remain hidden in plain sight. The tour begins under a radiant sun, on the edge of one of the city’s busiest highways; there, the cable car station waits in silence, with its typical 1950s features, yet with that modern touch that characterizes the city.
> \n<div class=\

> Sincero, hace muchos años estuve por acá, pero hoy regreso para descubrir qué ha cambiado con el pasar del tiempo, vivir al máximo la aventura capitalina y descubrir esos secretos que siguen ocultos a la vista de todos. El Paseo comienza bajo un sol radiante, al borde de una de las autopistas más transitadas de la ciudad; allí la estación del teleférico aguarda en silencio, con sus rasgos típicos de los años 50, pero con ese toque moderno que caracteriza la ciudad.
![IMG_20260423_164415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zRw13151rQ5wHhRxmr9k9B5NhhKr6AhAgKPfGn33GE4U4QBM93jBDCE5UzBCxyrPV47.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/2458NSLZQkSj3pHWdCfUo56TaE9xf1H9bUTimZqyDzrxobM5T51ZBPhQ2kPnLPZgf7Xrv.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243qCzTUZmwQxBs2d6gWBoYnAeqVT9Wveud2cpNZ8KtoLDjpNBVYtUGHAj92NVadcq7ma.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zbKNcsnkDsf1LpDsv1kCRkXYWEpTwMHeLMJgHXJY2Vu1sXbLpGMPNR43SjZYYuf3WHJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23yTfCPR6we8Abq611dnDQ9x8qBVuGzmpGqjcpQndhm12ZduZ76n4KZpaGM9AnsVvLp9p.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eoc8RAPuy16mhYnEez7hQEGLrFERuvd52cBpGTq8Z4GLCWPsMxNC3Xf8PYnWBUqmeZ1.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164829(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243Bc349hWk8geLrYcYhcYQuWRjZjpQFsvwueKJuQsnBpzLgr6Dd5ak56z6g8Ujya9NgP.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xyXDNMeXZAnDyMyHGdoGwKg3umLmtBiJjYRzPkj9rnYenYBhjPr5YFzh15VgQnjbKGf.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EowGXBYbyCabsh664wJWcre1mbn4zMug4HSDvGagcPs1Hvn4ZcVcVSatzmJjkBvvzRd.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_164958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zkhrmemcMTL1A349qpq4W83HsK9PmZMj93WDtkz1NKXkvBhm29HpVni9VNgQUTY5cBf.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_165058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243M7JdVYh1pPKPjNu7MwAyct3khtod9NX4HrbAp19za4EgaFBgP9XemSb7XArfgJoM5A.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> The cable car cabins are like little square boxes surrounded by glass, offering a 360-degree view. Little by little, we rise from the ground, leaving the city behind, while ahead of us looms a mountain that is imposing from every angle; this is Warairarepano National Park, which has become the city’s true guardian.
> \n<div class=\

> Las cabinas que componen el teleférico son como unas cajitas cuadradas rodeadas de vidrios, en donde podemos observar una visión de 360 grados. Poco a poco vamos separándonos del suelo y atrás va quedando la ciudad, mientras que al frente nos enfrentamos a una montaña que desde todo punto de vista es imponente; se trata del parque nacional Warairarepano, que se ha convertido en el verdadero guardián de la ciudad.
![IMG_20260423_165135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpEHkF87HY12yesrCcJM26dEoscWzdTX22MWAUFdvBi1FwDW7EV8vqcKNHQ87Z5kK44.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_165211(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EopsWCgzosXf8kictiukyud6LDcht7SsL8xBoryW1T1ix3AatJS4Bhg7JgnYY6sLTEe.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_165347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xefawVVDsCrQ4qAsv9PgbD3hPHXX6Sp2TZHrhKuqQZaBKzuZUebB2PU6QRuC4SGXoYs.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_165424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243M2g5eTJSc3j5qmsutbsuc5f2NqsnromGwRvUcasfETiZyzerqcHTT5FChhLe5HJn5F.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_165458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/241tYuXxvqf6Q5ZQ9cXvex4VcpqkNLh7z7N1AbKyg2r1TT7APs9RwdKLBqZxf1H1BqR4C.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_170105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EnYRsPnPNpwan978Gsopif6isBh37wETLLfP8dsz2T47QqNQE4Mvz9kGBQfKZdfWLcp.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_170301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqJ1Pw5hTkwmqKx2vzbuaYweBtyM98mEy43Kkvhs2NToS6eG3UYanBonX3bDE2amSJt.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> After walking for a few minutes, we find ourselves in a space dominated by clouds, where the temperature drops considerably, the trees sway to the rhythm of a steady breeze, and joy overflows with every step. It’s a somewhat narrow boulevard, but one where you’ll find practically everything, from food stalls to craft vendors; plus, on this small boulevard, you’ll cross paths with people from all over the world; most of us are travelers seeking adventures and unforgettable experiences.
> \n<div class=\

> Después de unos minutos de recorrido, nos adentramos en un espacio dominado por las nubes, en donde la temperatura baja considerablemente, los árboles danzan al ritmo de un viento constante y la alegría se desborda a cada paso. Se trata de un bulevar un tanto angosto, pero en donde encontraremos prácticamente de todo, desde puestos de comida hasta ventas de artesanías; además, en este pequeño bulevar, los cruzaremos con personas de todas las latitudes; la mayoría de ellos somos viajeros que buscamos aventuras y experiencias inolvidables.
![IMG_20260423_170943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpxqNQP7Pefd8xY5hn6aXnkqSZ2ixwyzRzeVzJrHJFp4HpjQXVZw9TmkkEDHeP1Kc3u.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/242DESKQJSiAUDdM2zWiecfr31gPR1f4VgN9NFbDqCyRrCqb39Y3EvaK8dUxJBT4KXmba.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EnmCKHfCvYgGewY9iDVyY2wMGwGBCLuL12CegiHAsms2QgEGsDRrzoe6TjsdBnFcNrq.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/241tUpSToMibihQ8BZ8J1TkoTPDuig3wCJ9xDwgQ5vqXxezB2G7txfmTDgGja2Hqcyp2Z.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_173045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqUducndHLe38DiUPPMFuYFneENPzs5unkDUQsb9Topasb5Rtj6JgCGvxWvmbrSZDqe.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_173126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpJZW8LaK27Cw4Zgip7go57pTuintPXyr66CPkXbxu9ZcEc8TuV1MVrCA5v5ZrUZaBn.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zkpGwFZL5n3YxMFhzGRDJsqU9Cfo3yMGpP4ZtzRhESsdZhD1ukEkVUurzkMNDYN6L7s.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpxrHF4e8Vz3ib6QCc697EAyQSCKo93cho3madLEmvG2XK4huSjLgXkbDazhbMcfm1P.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eqb2VuQYA8dKbCGvdmW23n4pkTYd5UD9UgJEc12ocH8vhYB1vcrBNvcipenXZruPEqr.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqhQhUswyJ1b1EpHgsr8zfVz5pZpr8Szn4SRmXfjiNbW7b5x7jSNo5desU4emPXkbeo.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqWkojuuaoNjDPyznDYnN1VHbbKgsKcF9knhCUVHK9UikuGob2SK2uspoGfPFJP6YD9.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> I think there’s only one ice skating rink in Caracas, and it’s located at the top of the mountain; unfortunately, it was already quite late when I discovered it, so I couldn’t go skating there, but I still stayed for a few minutes to soak up the vibe, laugh a little at people’s antics, and at the same time feel proud to be in such a truly unique place.
> \n<div class=\

> Creo que en Caracas solo existe una pista de patinaje sobre hielo y esta se encuentra en la cima de la montaña; por desgracia, ya era bastante tarde cuando la descubrí y por ello no me pude lanzar a deslizarme sobre ella, pero aun así me quedé unos minutos para disfrutar de su vibra, reírme un poco de las ocurrencias de la gente y al mismo tiempo sentirme orgulloso por estar en un lugar verdaderamente exclusivo.
![IMG_20260423_184946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xKtCmMpv9B3cULqzspCV7SsCu3T6SkAfZERnTqca7oYPKBFWKGPPZd5hRZ3GHcygZ8b.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EokddDB2GKD66Ejca5sZQgPWK3rxEJp9U7kLu9VhqwNjNDArwtP3j1DfPvnT8vcPv6b.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoptNtgungWgcs7QN96tFV74PAUXqwR65ArnJcxqBswaB555ymWzqQqpaqkyodpyvAC.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eos1n3pU6nQ2XVDzp2P94AHPdhnjVWTadjmX39nW2m9NmWzQktD131bdEdJEkmdPHC7.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eo8THtcvRWoLgw8A1EgWN7NAWJiB9GPTzbrFZrSP2Zcm2EoxRHJod9xEbAp221Zsbzd.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wC9dW5nRYTWbnm8skEZ4BKTWFHi79WDbjP4WaeN3sG524bBUE6LfkMHNuMh84FefAjj.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoeFR5XgDDMJu36Bs2FLE3wRAqJSDhDdSsYbFFLE514npD51Lsg7W1paeeAgHxEjPJ2.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> Hydrangeas are a constant throughout the entire route, but alongside them we’ll find signs carved into wood, biodegradable elements, and an environment that seeks to adapt to nature. Perhaps at first the architecture clashed with the landscape, but from my perspective, there’s now a push for a more ecological and self-sustaining touch—where you can enjoy yourself without causing harm and where everything blends together perfectly.
> \n<div class=\

> Las hortensias son una constante a lo largo de todo el recorrido, pero junto a ellas nos encontraremos señalizaciones plasmadas sobre madera, elementos biodegradables y un entorno que busca adaptarse al medio ambiente. Quizás en un inicio la arquitectura rompía con el paisaje, pero desde mi percepción ahora se busca un toque más ecológico y autosustentable, en donde se pueda disfrutar sin necesidad de dañar y en donde todo combine de manera perfecta.
![IMG_20260423_171708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpCAKY2JGrCawNfnAg1GanmBh97jMVDaRQ8Encb63Pf35qoQZfvTWzTMYeY9bUeV7ZE.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoyPUQBRC49esqJzBs2A1mouwiEDZiq7WTCQk5NJZrGYZYh9M88kMUUuCBdyviJZ4Y1.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eonm4Vik1riJ4UgnebvwPYv29WJvv2fbp5meygx9ebqkPKHnT3fNSGhN6hEzeHMBEpo.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wgKua9DJmhz3FyY2u9WBob7ftoQvh2m9Nb68p5VXVKpPpfbvkmqDjSmauiVbcBMLDa2.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wzdfQxBZH6UXyAHNbh47RwCHpJrfLfDRaMCaVoF1U5Uo9C6VBVBDZTsPeHkBw8u9HME.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_191029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23tvB1swojEagjKVbwzjcDB2moxvhRGmF6W25E9b4Ksy8nanRW9cXDAnasG3KNGpFHJmA.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> It strikes me as a very well-maintained space, where during the day everything looks incredibly orderly, clean, and safe, and when night falls, the lighting is excellent, since every corner is bathed in that light so essential for another visit—a perfect experience.
> \n<div class=\

> Me parece que se trata de un espacio muy bien cuidado, en donde de día todo se ve superordenado, limpio y seguro, y al caer la noche la iluminación es excelente, puesto que cada rincón se mantiene con esa luz tan necesaria para otra visita, un recorrido perfecto.
![IMG_20260423_183954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/2449x29qAgpBMmYzHbaPViHzmZh5X4k1e3WdQ9y1T9hccRscqpW8nVJhdmvza2jp92G25.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep7tdvMTDR9h8MhJakXogVewu6asevRK5EMhdiVpzSCjDaEUVdDXXBE6w1wwGSjiYBo.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23yTeoCAiq7hoMwWdueM2HvrKJLzTRNdtWnjiargUQBDUPKKNvUPDmLbzedSoFYTnbyUS.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184812.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23w2iyYqXeqHPWydbLZNr4KWyEoVRoP753B6ueBG36DZLvFK7KpDM8HAs7hnWjeiJhgRM.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23tGZrLLKhit5c7ySw6Ltk8Ae9ByobdZmMeJ5jLpK2XgYfbm3njK3w5yj1EeGPTkx2EBe.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoCbMmdsLNSga58AiQVS8fYCtk17qtrx24s2rjyF2ZpxLZiLVmCHb7j6a3g29kyuoMr.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoK5tWNnFd3H1h8Niinyeaj6DrP8w8BQMEy6YsK45osDS7nse7FRH99zm3LRQ7s6WpN.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eoc5ywmnawYTyJTYYMyFd22yL4vPnVxedLhCtFZF6NoRYzWxesWLErnr1CeydKK5Sbm.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23u5vxARaASfF8B29vJriWx8evaAzVBNv7em8CmiLLp32Hnu4i6PpbhWmo2oNibjxE6yW.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EonkZDb8zCkyCQLHKxNXMofiPjArozyjGRbHVp8JptDvogrMPN6y1RjQCpCpnE2BV4U.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wC5CB4hr7XAHQ4gsU42UoVLNyLtQy47wH6yXRqNAJMfhY1PjkcgkHucQQM5NyrXkv5V.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23vhz1m6n8EZyTDny5meoZVvkuxrysJkDdwDsHzSGEWDMh2ajnDjZPb3DPF7MTc1Ngg7u.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> This place is truly surreal, since no one would believe it’s right on the Caribbean, but that’s nature for you; it surprises us with its whims, and we, with our ingenuity, create a unique symbiosis. This is how one can understand the magic underlying this journey, where we can fully enjoy everything around us, yet at the same time have the opportunity to reconnect with our origins, feel nature more intimately, to recharge our energies and clear our minds, which are often filled with conflicts and contradictions.
> \n<div class=\

> Este espacio es verdaderamente surrealista, puesto que nadie creería que se encuentra a merced del Caribe, pero así es la naturaleza; ella nos sorprende con sus locuras y nosotros con nuestra inventiva generamos una simbiosis única. Es de esta manera como se puede entender la magia que subyace en este recorrido, en donde podemos disfrutar a plenitud de todo en torno, pero al mismo tiempo tendremos la oportunidad de reconectar con nuestros orígenes, sentir a la naturaleza más de cerca, para recargar nuestras energías y despejar nuestra mente que suele estar llena de conflictos y contradicciones.
![IMG_20260423_172322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqfGwdTvWRBkJU9otmiC67nR2nh9XQ7yMmMyKKR3nSyMgMnYpnrHAJGsXzJA94hoaCp.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_172327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpJZbht2dgEZgqozh1GiB1sUeLZkbG3npnqYxCB2fxWSGBNkBPUpCfdeD4hp8kqigvt.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_172734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep3eimAjkgf1GgYS4XNW3aqMVENqnrn8Qsy7yNpj1whvazJqn9KH3dCPpXSeXRhSqvz.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EppLCC9f53RB5xUF3iLVpHtrmEDhE2iTt1m1icR9efUrz1sXwMSuCFVqhpq1QLoz1cG.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EppLB7tbdeKjdnryD48kGwjXHa5pZBnFXgwpgL7i5Uj7J8qGiujhqd8cKo5ygtbQviT.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqL7NMSZZXMZb1gLSG61uzK3UeVB2R3cRFKdTs32R5UNU3WQ8LhAZekP9tg1tQ5yx2Y.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/242hS89ofUZbLzsPbn3aZawTLov9fwjCirifap2TZPSAEjRPqt8TKAwf77H71FxGednXu.jpg)
> \n<div class=\

> The idea of hiking this trail turned out to be a brilliant one; here, without a doubt, life is much happier, trips become unforgettable, and the experiences are truly beautiful. I hope that if you ever come to Venezuela, you’ll also have the chance to explore this trail on the city’s outskirts, as it’s one of the most important and beautiful places the Venezuelan capital has to offer.
> \n<div class=\

> Creció superacertada la idea de recorrer este sendero; aquí, sin duda alguna, la vida es mucho más feliz, los viajes se vuelven inolvidables y las experiencias son realmente bellas. Espero que si algún día vienes a Venezuela, también tengas la oportunidad de conocer este sendero sobre el borde de la ciudad, ya que se trata de uno de los lugares más importantes y lindos que nos regala la capital venezolana.
![IMG_20260423_171422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23vsSmm6h36y52fcJ42BMSxbKsJEM1AcRjddriX3gGEx8giNpYprw1ipLhpuNVR3u3VWH.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_171508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eoke7WnVmhjTTYHGz1myHiCUJzQWX2zuxVmqrypZ4gz3caof7nrQsTvPsSPe626cV1V.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_172038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoeFM4CdXGnJN5fx87VDFuxfsus1nRfijcaxNkjhhQJoYV4DSiS4TBcGGfS1q7FNCD7.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_172103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23yJEPWXu3YAEUYSYLHATr7KL5UPfU7PUPBL3QmvbN1dBvhsSrrpH8tKpSHUauR4YNZjU.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23tveWRLya6BWM9wzCho3gUyv5tRFA2HiU36TvaLZhuirLfMGjRnarE9BgUQHwysNjrno.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpzxHQRTx4E1pzi5xs2JDrnkYiG3SfAn4QGgxuTKRYDQNxZbsTBnSrthS8VbuwjLKFi.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoGwXjp8d3LL7LzJcETLVzXw7sapSSSsQUJnT5prucqaiKEWbG2GwvrCEEqS5XdwzZ5.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xovAkuq7W4stKNVmog9zAQYLcoih2pX6mGEWf4pMeuZSgpPc2gZnrgFr9FNT4YCfFGM.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_190526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoCiA87NZTdgmpCED5gHvodyqxPq27Gd3MkdyeHQ5KhgnnYJAvzp3hyLAKuYn4GdTsw.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_192928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpGQdDSFxJuWcFqqnuQPuCkjGAE7xHL2BYHRtGqmLXjDcuE8bGyirwsubRYzSzVbfG6.jpg) ![FUkUE5bzkAZT3HzV5tJDiU2ik81PCd4JCyhWnRcDN8XJsVFY3UNB8DCg43AbXDuHD2o1pSFmw9t6dCJZXRjDbN9aPZzKb2txM6rGEuPnKkx8GfXnLduM6tAzK3DNLBdCNF2RY6M647qH2B1qbjaJ97h6csSDeEmwq9rE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wgaEdSXsbReeZGB99u1dBBzwFduZr1FZWS3kfueTbv4JABv7TcSLkfsJydhwzuHZvm8.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.541690 lat -66.877208 long At the Caracas Cable Car / En el Teleférico de Caracas d3scr)

body.title: The Voice That Doesn't Explain Itself
body.body:
My instinct has always been right, but for a long while, I have not been paying attention to it until recently. Now, I have learned and understand how to take note of a specific feeling that arrives before my reasoning does. It is not something that distracts or with a loud warning. Just this type of feeling in me that something in me has already made the decision even before my brain catch up, but still waiting for my brain to activate it. And now, the way I trust that feeling is beyond measure. Just two moments ago, there was something that I engaged myself in. Everything looks so fine and perfect. The person was engaging. Everything was just going as planned, like two people know what they are doing. But right before it even began, something in me felt so wrong, like I already knew where everything was heading. Though there were no specific details that I could point to. But you know that feeling that you are doing everything right but you just know that it will not end well. Even though my instinct felt all these before I began, I just had to continue with the whole situation without telling the other person involved. Not up to three weeks after the entire thing started, it all fell apart. Though I was not surprised because I had been mentally prepared before it..I just wanted to give it a try. Because sometimes it is needed. Here is what the majority of people usually miss about instinct that I have gotten to understand through deep understanding and paying attention to myself and a lot of things. Instinct is not a spiritual mystery or a form of magic. Though what I believe is that God usually has a hand in it majority of the time. But for me, it is just a pattern recognition that is running faster than my conscious thoughts. All the discussion and interactions that I have had, all those people who have disappointed me. Every space that felt weird when I entered, that feeling that looks like I have done this particular thing before even before doing it. When something new has a familiar signal, something fires before I can articulate what I am seeing. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjew5DJngZC1hFYm9kmrFeybUYd9tcSutu4VE3FnS6t6/1780922902580.png) And I will also add that the majority of people always have their instincts distrusted due to the environment they grew up in. Like in an environment where they have always been told that this is how we do things here, you are too sensitive, do it like this, therefore their internal signal has been overridden multiple times. After some might have passed through an environment that never saw them, they start to doubt and second guess themselves in anywhere they are. I have been wrong before. I have been in different situations where my instinct told me, Don't do this, and I did it, but it ended badly. Those experiences have taught me that my instinct isn't infallible; it is just faster than logic and usually tells me the right thing to do before logic has finished determining what to do. Now, when my instinct directs me, I don't usually negotiate with it except of I just want to see the true outcome which is always right. body.title: The Collective Awareness from panic & Fear
body.body:
![file_00000000a2487243a12a00d5cd914949.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebY9q58cGQyFZboFkDzNXRqWbFYcCcJ1rqV8jaaJfk5N/file_00000000a2487243a12a00d5cd914949.png)




<Hr>

When it comes to crypto, blockchain or alts projects, **multiple truths can actually coexist** and I do think that these truths are aligned and one is not more relevant than the other. 

For example that are two truths I currently know, they are: Hive is seriously struggling and secondly the general alt market is struggling seriously. I don't think anyone of them outweighs the other as they are both serious truths. 



Yesterday I saw the ecceny proposal for about 250 HBD a day, I felt it was completely ridiculous proposal to ask from a chain that is trying to survive, and I heard that it was actually reduced from 333 HBD a day. I think the question to ask is, can Hive do without ecceny?

>  Yes.

 I'm not undermining what ecceny has built, but these are testing times and a these are periods where the creativity of a frontend comes to play. No establishment or chain has only good times, and even users in the comment section could agree. 


I'm not a DEV and I don't claim to be one, but I think this is the age of AI and most proposals on Hive can be carefully done by AI as they're not core blockchain proposals.

 Claude max is like 31$ per month or something and I think a lot of these proposals owners has to understand that there are times of plenty and there are times of lack, and if people, members of a place cannot collectively find ways to survive periods of scarcity then maybe they don't deserve the period of plenty. 


We all collectively know that the cost of running the chain can reduce by over 80% and people are beginning to realize that a lot of overpriced proposals needs to actually go, but how did they discover? Of course they did because of the plummeting of the market. 

There were many of those proposals we didn't need, like the ones with the endless wells in Ghana that cost hundreds of thousands of dollars, and we're probably just waking up to realize that these were the type of scam proposals that made sure decent proposals at the moment cannot get funded. 

![Screenshot_20260608_114649_Chrome.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmasPh3A7hqi1qA8HdSChHap11fKoZ36CWeotzuz3YqZzU/Screenshot_20260608_114649_Chrome.jpg)


### HiveFest

Yesterday RoelandDP announced Hivefest and 90% of the people in the comment section were absolutely livid.

 I think it was expected, a lot of people are paranoid about the state of Hive, and how we actually need fresh stats and new ideas and something different, I think this is a good reaction because it shows that beyond all, people still care about this platform, this chain and its well-being. 


That said, will the event still hold? Perhaps it might, maybe, maybe not, who knows, but at least the organizers understand the standpoint of the community members, they understand that need for urgency and something creative.

 I like to think this chain has some of the most brilliant mind in the crypto space and we're not lacking big ideas to actually make things better. Ecceny for example can choose to be creative and become more than a frontend. 

They can offer a service, get people to pay, offer something unique, do more than just being a way to access the chain, and probably reduce that 250$ cost by another 70 to 80% 


### Awareness by consequences 


At this point people are becoming more aware of the situation. A few others are becoming paranoid and overstating it. 

There this particular account that rants constantly about Hive name being horrible, I know it's probably one of those rage episodes where they quit in a few months time, it's clearly written and I've seen people do this countless times: rage talk for months and then quit after a while. 

However I still think this is where I emphasis the fact that multiple truths can actually coexist and Hive is not the only alt project suffering, but this doesn't mean we need to sit and not do anything.

body.title: Luxembourg is getting noticed. 🧡
body.body:
Luxembourg is getting noticed. 🧡

Over the last few years, something interesting has been happening. Quietly.
Without too many headlines. Without too much noise.

Luxembourg has been positioning itself as one of Europe's most credible jurisdictions for digital assets.

Major players have taken notice. Institutions have taken notice.
And increasingly... the rest of Europe is taking notice too.

The reasons are not hard to find:

* Regulatory clarity
* Institutional stability
* Financial expertise
* A long-term approach to innovation

From international crypto companies establishing operations in the country to the Luxembourg Sovereign Wealth Fund gaining exposure to Bitcoin ETFs, the signals are becoming difficult to ignore.

But if there is one thing we believe at OffChain Luxembourg, it is this: being attractive is not enough.

To become a true leader, Luxembourg must continue doing something even more important: Listening.

Listening to builders.
Listening to entrepreneurs.
Listening to startups.
Listening to the people actually building products, solving problems and interacting with the technology every day.

Regulation works best when it is built with the ecosystem, not simply for the ecosystem.

And there is another challenge.

Crypto players in Luxembourg need to work together.

The country is too small for fragmentation.
Too small for silos.
Too small for unnecessary competition.

If we want Luxembourg to become a reference point for blockchain and digital finance, we need collaboration between associations, companies, institutions, regulators, educators and builders.

Because the real opportunity is helping an ecosystem succeed.
And ultimately... Helping people.

Helping citizens better understand technology.
Helping businesses innovate.
Helping entrepreneurs build.
Helping Luxembourg remain competitive in a rapidly changing world.

The good news?
We already see many examples of this happening.

Let's keep going.

Less fragmentation.
More dialogue.
More collaboration.

That's how small countries achieve big things. 🧡

body.title: Неймовірна краса наперстянки
body.body:
![IMG_20260608_152016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/244oWSeiSbDLsPpv4ZEmqt6sucGN8NfadPwgJnT8fLiJzSjVrnYDLHqcyPkm4zbkkSpZG.jpg)

Неймовірно розквітла моя наперстянка. Дуже красива квітка, яка цвіте поступово: спочатку розкриваються нижні квіти, а нові з'являються все вище й вище на верхівці довгого міцного стебла. Коли нижні квіти відцвітають, зверху вже розкриваються нові. Мені здається, це дуже зручно придумала сама природа, адже завдяки цьому наперстянка може квітнути практично все літо.

Наперстянка — дворічна рослина, так само як і мальва. У перший рік вона нарощує листя, а зацвітає вже наступного літа. До речі, стебла та спосіб цвітіння в них дуже схожі: мальва також починає цвісти знизу, а нові квіти з'являються в міру росту стебла. Чи є вони родичами — не знаю, та сьогодні не хочеться займатися пошуками інформації.

Це просто імпровізаційний допис про красу, радість і задоволення від споглядання того, як усе навколо квітне. Коли подвір'я доглянуте, трава покошена, а квіти розквітають одна за одною, усе це виглядає ще красивіше.

Звичайно, хотілося б зробити ще дуже багато: облаштувати перголи, створити затишні місця для відпочинку, прокласти садові доріжки. Але все це потребує коштів, навіть якщо робити власними руками. Не кажучи вже про час або необхідність наймати майстрів.

Та поки що я просто насолоджуюся тим, що вже маю, і радію кожній новій квітці у своєму саду.

![IMG_20260608_151940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/245Hf1PcF6fDMNRThn2NtBC77iTVes1cvo8VyHAVH5A2khzbp9DrHWyq7ENER8DWCAKzE.jpg)

body.title: DHF Investment Idea
body.body:
Why don't we focus on investing in/ creating real-world businesses?

Hear me out; what if we were to fund users to start up their own businesses and become financially self-sufficient?

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnHx24A7UVAGif8ARzDKMfPira3XfcckYzupV9vymHJ3/image.png)

[Source](https://ied.eu/project-updates/business-guidance-tips/)

****

**I Want To Open A Coffee Shop**

I'm currently saving toward it, and have signed up for a start your own business course, so I can get a good idea of the ins and outs of running a shop. I'm also looking into grants that might help with getting a business off the ground. 

It will cost somewhere in the ballpark of €20,000 - €30,000 to start it up, and that would be all of the equipment, stock needed and decorating the space. As well as about 6-12 months' rent on the premises.

I would essentially be the only staff member; however, my sister is a barista, and I have some friends who are also baristas, so I would have help if needed from close friends and family. 

Having seen the Hive price drop to an all-time low, and having read some posts about the DHF, I'm wondering why we aren't funding people to start businesses that would have a legitimate way of making income and paying back the investment. 

****

**The Deal**

Let's say the DHF funds a portion of, or all of, the start-up costs associated with starting a business. There could be a contract written up to set a checklist of things that a person needs to do to be eligible for the investment. 

**Repayments:** Nothing in this world is free, so there would be a contract written up before proceeding, which states that 5% or 10% of the profit of the business needs to go back into the DHF to recoup money and reinvest.

**Advertise Hive:** In the shop, the business owner has to advertise that Hive funded their business, and there could be a QR code for customers to create an account. The staff of the shop could also help customers create an account, if needed. 

**Use a percentage of their Profits To Power Up Their Account:** Because the shop stands as an onboarding platform, the business owner should have an active account with enough HP to delegate to, or upvote/ monitor the people they have onboarded. (Having an active account is also important because they can document the process of starting up their business, and remain transparent with their investors.)

**Costumers Could Use Their Hive or HBD:** Maybe allow for customers to pay using their earnings on Hive. (I don't know how that would work with tax, but it's something to think about.)

What an idea like this means is that Hive gains recognition for investing in its own user base. 

It gains eyeballs and users from members of the public who frequent the particular shop.

It ensures that money is coming in, and Hive is being bought, which would offset sell pressure.

It creates financially self-sufficient individuals who will pay it forward to other Hive users.

****

If we funded and helped one person set up a semi-successful shop, that's great, and money would come in. But, if after a number of years we had 10 semi-successful businesses, that much money coming back into Hive could completely offset the cost of projects that maybe cannot generate an income. 

A shop in Ireland onboarding people would be good. But, a shop here, 2 in England, 3 in America, 4 in Venezuela, etc, would mean that people from across the globe have a chance to discover Hive.

They don't all have to be coffee shops either. I'm using a coffee shop in my example because that's what I want to open. 

****

**Secondary Idea:** (I just thought of this as I was about to hit publish) Imagine if one of us set up some kind of drink company, and on the bottle or can, we had a QR to create an account for Hive. 

I don't know if it would be worth looking into, but it's one way to spread the word.

I actually know a beekeeper, I could set up jars with stickers and get him to bottle and sell it at farmers' markets or something. **Hive Honey**

...If I set up my coffee shop, I could design the disposable cups to have QR codes on them so that the customer is walking around with an advertisement, and I could sell the honey in my shop, too. 

I'm just brainstorming here by myself, but with a few people pitching in ideas, we could be onto something big.

body.title: Sprinkles, Potatoe Planting, Hen, Brace, Door, Robin, Wire, Wood, Weeding - Sunday
body.body:
Woke up to it sprinkling yesterday morning which was just a tiny bit from an undeveloped cell moving over us. ![Screenshot_20260607-050455.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w277ZFSKUAjNNBaVUU8LcVtAvjFyoHKTet9E2dqTLhzZXhiri1GFKMBJuqSFcsG42p7.png) The sky was not super cloudy but it got thicker over the day. ![IMG_20260607_050521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/241tLNaoXgfbn2TR9vhG7bd7UTsb7mHBdaPke2QNdckxiHjNMGPsESTjLK2yWhwbfTYuF.jpg) I was out in the garden early planting yellow potatoes that were left over from last year. ![IMG_20260607_094324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tby8DzsWRCL6rF9DKebJGoWPNfPNREqQZsmBYQvHqgQ4zH2R7dRspSSjRmVFMbH3FJ4.jpg) ![IMG_20260607_094327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmHsA5oZ19hTcLfpcsvRkHcQLqaFUGw1c4FcXiKdz2GP8hE5wzQaUXBQb6DXqkr6mQU.jpg) 57 spots got spuds in them above the garlic rows. 19x3. They will be later potatoes than the 4 rows of Nordland reds that are growing well already. ![IMG_20260607_100533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tHA2Kyo9Dgnk1rfnyaSV6J3kn3wZkey163Y84WbaemXDcMWyWmpCXcPscsoFSdBEJW7.jpg) I was rummaging for a board to fix the brace for the yard light wire and found one of a few broody hens we have... Hopefully they wait until we are back next week to hatch them as they will be on their own this weekend. ![IMG_20260607_102214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u63Amvhy83eJzKhYAfHkaFrmmhJgjcyG1hoZfzNxNJcmokEidsPeRXYycRnZXtrpY1H.jpg) Put the new board up and attached the wire to the shed. ![IMG_20260607_102923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wC5cmMQgjdkjbBVgV6zKVLU3bapMTxmSCpcQm9HK6XLFGaBvYX4TK6SNQivnQ6pjdVT.jpg) Mid day a more developed cell rolled through and gave us more sprinkles. That was the weather all day long. ![Screenshot_20260607-123421.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tRtajdBTjaroc12EBAHS2Dwd2Q2M38d67k3yLJtHAvGQ39hMc88ozA8mDqUmJYzHj3m.png) Cloudy, sprinkles, then sunny, then clouds, sprinkles, etc. ![IMG_20260607_123411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yJDx3nyPcR64oC8NjBU5WN6KTjLnrtKiYtKfa6DCLWYu1CYp9PnpSq5D4nGnbcb28Ec.jpg) I had snapped the handle on our kitchen door storm door so removed the one from the door I got from a job. It went on easy and is more solid and new. I had to fix the latch side on the door frame so it sits better. The door now won't just pop open if yarded on when it is locked. ![IMG_20260607_125315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u69LTA9nJ65rRHMZZr5E2F4RS9wmMPbuH5oTHMVtHgByNP8WBbgABe8daiiGAcsTJ15.jpg) The sun was hot, then it got chilly when the clouds rolled over. I was in and out of my fleece all day. ![IMG_20260607_131523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xV8Z54yRvTcPfNcr5WXX3QSKNAA7wrrDduMoDaYu749JXKf8dHjmLHC3n7HnHCSY1Rk.jpg) The cat had a bad case of tape worms so @stryeyz and R went to town to get meds. I was working on removing the rest of the poles from the old pole garden when I flushed the robin from its nest. I think it's the same ones that weren nesting on the studio porch but there was too much traffic for them so they moved across the driveway to the elderberry bush. ![IMG_20260607_133115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbRVAzY35ziP9voYFTo3MUV9jywXWgkrCM6iQVk9uBxt7vv61ZEeXzXYwiZJZo38ZFG.jpg) ![IMG_20260607_133132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhq3411gc3WFUsakYAgfGbUw4KRES5JWmMTqsDzFb1PMbXJfbwUFCVZcoNrwkBZmRkz.jpg) Then I finally took the wires off the other posts and wound the wire into bundles. The poles got stacked against the Tardis. ![IMG_20260607_145756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvebAkD5fYiQEgehWLd6NPYgexdTYo3c37mwUXPS3zK23Z6B67ijeW3qggGKGdCYaSX.jpg) The logs from the tree I had cut down were on the other side of the chicken fence so I lobbed them over to make it easier to haul. ![IMG_20260607_154914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMTpDZdW5cNAkcVKYbzD8xUP9Wzga69G26xDdTvz1S5GaL9AotnhR2EyJrwQPgdbVna.jpg) Last thing my body could handle was weeding the celery and cabbage row. Surprised to have so many celery growing though they will take forever to grow. ![IMG_20260607_161001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xATNa9wPbbwXqDcD8zVTZGYx9NdtfVhpU1SeNFGa48jS8joFTcqjTcqJ6ZNeSTjZ1W5.jpg) Today I get the boys to school then come home and load the car with tools then head down for a day of irrigation installing. I have to get as much done today as I can as I have my appt tomorrow morning that will break up the day. ---

Qué bueno que todo se solucionó satisfactoriamente @germanandradeg !

En la situación que estamos atravesando es un poco complicado llegar a buen fin. Conozco propietarios que cobran muy poco por el alquiler, no tienen contratos entre propietario e inquilino. Esto con la finalidad de que el inmueble no lo invadan. Se arriesgaron a todo. Generalmente son personas mayores que trabajaron y pensaron que el alquiler de las propiedades les daría el sustento para la vejez. Pero, en nuestro país eso no ocurrió. Esas mismas personas que tienen propiedades tienen ayudas económicas de gobiernos extranjeros y con eso completan sus gastos. Si no fuera por eso tendrían que irse a sus países de origen donde, lamentablemente, la mayoría no tiene propiedades. Solo cuenta con la familia y la mayoría de ellos son pensionados; por lo que no se atreven a retornar. Y a veces les invade el miedo porque para solicitar ayuda a esos países tuvieron que decir que solo poseen una propiedad. Están angustiados. Y los precios del mercado nacional todavía no son competitivos.

Feliz día!

body.body: My concern with these newer Neo Geo games is, well simply, most do not look like a Neo Geo game but they are charging Neo Geo game prices, seemingly because \

.

Back in the day, Neo Geo games were so detailed, tons of animation, audio that blew everything else away, etc. It was easy to concince the public that the file size was needed - maybe harder to justify actually buying but the first hurdle was beaten none the less.

These newer Neo Geo games are not that detailed, the audio is not all that impressive, etc. It is like being on Neo Geo is a gimmick alone to gain some kind of free marketing with retro themed platforms rather than the games merits.

I do not know the size of Necro Pop but I am going to go ahead and guess it is somehow 250+ megs on a Neo Geo cart. Granted, that is around 30 megs on PC taking into account the difference in how memory is calculated.

I never understood why the Neo Geo CD is not more supported. It would be cheaper to get the Neo Geo version in fans hands (emulators for example) but it would also make it easier for fans to make illegal copies (CD ripping software is everywhere - not so much for carts).

Based on what I have seen so far, I just don't feel Necro Pop is a Neo Geo focused game, no more than using the Neo Geo as a prop to get news coverage. That is a shame because I love this genre and am still excited for this game, cheap marketing gimmicks aside.

We are comfortable sharing the high-level cost structure and we already publish broader transparency information at https://trust.ecency.com also we have https://status.ecency.com page, not all services/servers there yet but we are moving all there. If there is room to improve the setup, we want people to point it out, as we reach new proposal starting date we will put down latest numbers and changes in spreadsheet. On redundancy, I agree with you. A second independent path matters, especially for RPC and image access. The point is that the dependency does not disappear, it just moves somewhere else.

body.title: Trusted Source          ...What is Real
body.body:
*The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them. ― Ernest Hemingway*


![206da998-3f32-4930-b084-bb53d1937f4a.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmShqxfzaBDLueaLjdatHGL45ByYTHQ7v8X7utAd5fGxxv/206da998-3f32-4930-b084-bb53d1937f4a.png)


He believed him. He was his priest and confessor for fifty years and knew he didn’t murder that little girl. Mrs. Donnelly had taken the call just after lunch and gave him the sad news. “John Ryan’s going to be arrested, Father—he left a message on the phone for you to call.” He immediately telephoned his house. The familiar Irish brogue on the other end of the line was verging on hysteria.

“They asked me to get a lawyer and turn myself in, Father. I’m in a twit to be at Rory O’Hara’s law office now.” “I’m so sorry, John—I can only imagine how you must feel.” “I can’t believe it, Father, after all these years. I told them back in the day I didn’t do it—I was on that train to Chicago when that girl went missing. When they closed the case, I figured it was the end of it.”

The face of the blonde seven year old surfaced in the priest’s mind—the way she appeared on the front page of the Herald. He remembered the sickening fear and oppressive heaviness that enveloped him. Nine months later when they found the tiny body in a woodlot, the same unspeakable weight returned, plunging him into a black depression. He knew the girl and the family. He would have to celebrate the funeral Mass.

“Would you do me a favor, Father?” The high-pitched voice of John Ryan pulled him back to the present. “Of course, John—How can I help?” “Perhaps you could drop by the house and check in on Cogan for me? I don’t know who else to ask.”

Cogan was the one-eyed cat John had rescued years ago and as far as the priest knew, was also his only companion. His neighbors, following their own style of justice, had found him guilty and shunned him accordingly. “I’ll drop by and make sure he has food and water, John.” Thank you, Father—It's only for today—Mrs. Mappin will be around tomorrow.”

Bridge Mappin was the rotund, acid-tongued shrew that tidied up after John and cooked his meals. She constantly complained about her meager pay and would certainly not bestir herself on her day off regardless of circumstances. “I’ll leave the key under the mat. Make yourself a tea, if you have a mind to, Father.” Twenty minutes later he was unlocking the front door to John Ryan’s run-down cottage on Walnut Street. Cogan was sitting on the sofa back staring through the hazy window at some sparrows outside.



“Good day to you, Cogan,” the priest whispered. The gray tabby meowed, arched his back and leapt down onto the rug. The priest found the kibble and shook some into a chipped china bowl and then poured fresh water into its mate. He then filled the kettle and put on the water for his tea. When it had boiled, he took his cup and sat in the sofa chair opposite the window and watched Cogan grooming himself by licking his paws and using them to wash his face. He noticed the worn furniture and faded curtains.

*The house has been neglecting itself for sometime,* John would say. It was a comfortable house, nevertheless, and cosy. A pang of sympathy caused him to inhale sharply. *How could they think such a gentle soul as John would harm a little girl?* They couldn't prove he didn't go to Chicago and wasn't in town when the murder occurred.

The injustice angered him and he struggled to suppress more bitter thoughts. How easy it was for people to rush to judgment and accuse a neighbor. Strangely, John had been patient through the ordeal. He never complained and never fought back. He continued on in the same neighborhood where he had grown up and spent the last fifty years.

The priest glanced absently around the room. What immediately struck him was that it was impersonal. There were no photographs of relatives, or anyone for that matter—only a few dusty pictures of pastoral scenes and an ink engraving of the Sears building in Chicago. The engraving caught his eye and he got up and walked across the room to examine it more closely. In contrast to the other, kitschy, framed art, the engraving was quite good. There was a scrawled signature on the bottom right, but the name was indecipherable. The priest reached out and carefully took down the picture. Perhaps there was some information on the reverse. He turned over the engraving and was shocked to find taped to the back, an unused train ticket to Chicago. He felt the breath go out of him. John Ryan had lied.

body.title: Starting to Discover My Daughter’s Talents: From Simple Videos and Pictures to an Unexpected Affiliate Journey
body.body:
![Blue and Yellow Illustrative Time to Travel Instagram Post.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AJpkVzirhEF7vbgT1gUonikCVLVg5ScqmekqeD8ASDLr3CyQSVznawmdkxmD92W.png)

As a mom, I always want to explore my daughter’s talents and discover her skills at a young age. Now she is 4 years old. She loves being in front of the camera, promoting products, dancing, singing, and sharing stories. Since children grow and develop every day, I believe it is important to support their interests while guiding them along the way.

![IMG_20251120_143007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xAZuWoLECDpLhKcAXcffFVeLUmzeTXHdupDWQyXopjX1xcNUF6bbhYQBzMebyJxgtXS.jpg)

What started as a simple TikTok account and Facebook page became our digital journal. We wanted to document her childhood memories from reading to writing to dancing and eating vegetables to helping on the farm so that one day we would have something beautiful to look back on. We never expected that our content would lead us into affiliate marketing.

![IMG_20260604_113104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2qC9su1vMkgyjnY55QfLtYFX3rLS6sPc8HXLRUykoptie7CYQ3GQLhhQyMDMwwvvFm.jpg)

![IMG_20260604_112537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/244KXdtJw4htZyFjr1cA4PxNAzPodCnGPPQDqDt9dm7mj7nKZrJvorp9D3UKgcMBHFbp8.jpg)

At first, I only shared products that I personally ordered and used. To my surprise, people started buying them. I noticed that whenever my daughter appeared in our videos, engagement increased and sales followed, even for simple and affordable items. In our community, people prefer seeing products demonstrated before purchasing, so our videos became helpful to many parents.

![IMG_20260604_114742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zS2xFPYk6bxKq12vfJffog3ov8xJLVsKA8fE4nsDRU8AVmAHxjkXpQXc4aS9mV5H5iT.jpg)

![IMG_20260607_104110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/243ftZ5TchApThU2RVn3xwfpX6UyqUwwFbxVjoCTt4L5oAW6BjvJLiaj59JdGeryYsJa7.jpg)

![IMG_20260607_104432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245ccwCoGFxFGVVcFueWTnFdnBBy1M3SW8nDGasejSUcg5Nketa1xmQXJxaSvvduDfM43.jpg)

Today, we keep a small product display at home to make content creation easier. My daughter is always excited to film videos, especially after taking a bath and dressing up. I never pressure her, she is usually the one asking to create content. As a reward for her efforts and good behavior, I keep my promises, like treating her to her favorite McDonald's meal whenever we visit the city.


![IMG_20251120_140444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsQKUrmrqp7TvovXDEdC9PGhHQR2VLWVxYV6aabFPyZfneF8QUTHsqncu3hHrTzZKkC.jpg)

![IMG_20251120_133949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23yToM88i6z8e159T1QwW79WKkNwXL7xFV9Lue1eVvV7yttm9Er3oLTDvoDLAXyzLjDcy.jpg)

Beyond content creation and affiliate marketing, I am proud of the values she is learning: responsibility, confidence, creativity, and discipline. She even remembers to put her shoes in the proper place without being reminded. These small habits show that children can learn so much when guided with encouragement. We need to motivate them every day. Be positive always and smile in every people they will meet. 


![IMG_20260310_092942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGj26VTQLmntcByWaBLpd2L2D11wbDn8UVq3sKMp2fKAm9Wi6Ng7aZzyJQk7FrMi17J.jpg)


We may only have a small number of followers, but every day brings progress. More than the earnings, we treasure the memories, lessons, and bonding moments we create together. 

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture and the lead photo was edited in Canva. This journey has become a platform for learning every day and celebrating childhood one video at a time. Have a nice day! 💛

/>**Welcome back to another episode of my Splinterlands adventure as I level up my cards** ** Chapter 10: Another Level, Another Step Toward a Stronger Splinterlands Collection** Ten posts. Ten upgrades. And the journey is getting more exciting with every level gained. Today, I’m back with another milestone in my long-term Splinterlands progression project. What started as a simple card buried in my collection is steadily transforming into a powerful asset that can make a real difference on the battlefield. One of the things I enjoy most about Splinterlands is that progress is visible. Every BCX combined moves a card closer to its maximum potential, and every upgrade feels like a genuine achievement rather than just another number on a screen. This is now the tenth chapter of my card-leveling journey, and looking back at where this card started makes the progress even more satisfying. At the beginning, it was just another option in my deck.
alt=\

/>  
Useful from time to time, but far from being a key piece of my strategy.

Now, after a series of consistent upgrades, that situation is changing.

With each new level, the card gains more strength, more utility, and more potential to influence battles. Having access to stronger cards gives me greater flexibility when building lineups and allows me to adapt more effectively to different rulesets and opponents.

What makes this process so rewarding is that it isn't only about improving a single card.

It's about building a stronger collection.

It's about increasing the competitive value of my account.

It's about preparing for bigger challenges and higher leagues in the future.

Many players focus only on rewards, chests, and daily victories. Those moments are definitely exciting, but there is something uniquely satisfying about watching a card evolve over time through patience and consistent investment.

Every level tells part of a story.

Every upgrade represents progress.

Every chapter brings me closer to my long-term goals within the game.

Today marks upgrade number ten, an important milestone in this ongoing series. Reaching this point motivates me even more to continue pushing forward and see just how far this card can go.

The collection keeps growing.

The power keeps increasing.

And the next upgrade is already waiting.

Ten posts. Ten upgrades. One card becoming something truly special.

The journey continues.

~~The purpose of these blog posts is to show the progress I’m making with my cards, including the SPS I earn in battles and clan wars, as well as the Glints I collect and the Gladius chests I open~~

## Hello, everyone.
I welcome you to my blog and another wonderful edition of the hive learner's featured post. Some of the time trusting your instinct can turn out bad while sometimes it can turn out and that makes trusting your instinct a 50-50 kind of thing because there are times you go with your instinct and end regretting that you ever did and then there are times you go with it and in the end you are glad that you did but one thing is certain it is best to always go with your instinct and not let the result from the last time stop you from doing so.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZVUTDQ1hpxmUakME5PhAxH6P4fBeo5MdxMVCD2pgavjQ/1780921934806.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-sign-that-says-put-up-or-shut-up-IazGP58LMR0)

There are times when going with my instinct landed me in big trouble and there are tikes when it saved, but trust me when I say that my instinct have saved me more times than it has put me in trouble which makes it a lot more reliable, something is reliable when it failure rate is lesser than success rate and I can say that my instinct has done me more good than it has actually harmed me and I can say that I trust my instinct and most of the time go with whatever my instinct tells me.

There are times when my instinct has caused me to miss out on a paying update because I felt it was a scam and won't want to fall for any form of scam and in the ended it turned out not to be a scam, did I have regrets afterwards? Yes definitely but then when I want to judge there are countless update my instinct did not support for same reason and then they ended up being true and just took from all who hopped on the update while we who were on the side lines because our instinct did not support were happy, those who hopped on were in pains and filled with regrets. Your instinct can work both ways, sometimes for you and sometimes against you.

<center>
<div class=\

> Do I Use My Instinct When Dealing With People? Yes definitely I do that all the time, every conversation, every friendship, every relationship, I trust my instinct on which one to forge ahead with and which one to abort before things go sour. Definitely my instinct has caused me to miss out on a friendship that could have turned things around for me but it has also brought those that really did bring a turn around too in the end, so yes I work with my instinct when dealing with people, I can ask others I trust for advise but why I am don g so is just to see if they are on the same side with what my instinct is saying. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdeLzqHrbusSQdd1nnprWC47MLsixXwmPEHoDLKWaNTQx/1780921934848.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/red-no-guts-no-glory-neon-signage-OGfXZo-Jyyg) I don't just go with my guts when I am sure of the end result, even in cases where I am not sure, I go with my guts and hope that the end result favours me. Even in cases where I have to make a choice, I do so with guts. It is more like a lot of decisions made by me are greatly influenced by my guts.

body.title: Concurso de la comunidad Ladies of Hive #292 / Ladies of Hive Community Contest #292
body.body:
Saludos y bendiciones apreciada gente de Hive, bienvenidos a mi blog. Las preguntas del concurso comunitario #292 de @LadiesofHive para esta semana son realizadas por la dama @elizabethbit. >Greetings and blessings, dear Hive community, welcome to my blog. This week's questions for the @LadiesofHive community quiz #292 were submitted by @elizabethbit. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMScX16u6XEDyGbznCFthw83eGc23YiDqRpR52NDnGSB/1780921188180.jpg) **1- Si un genio mágico pudiera concederte un (y sólo uno) deseo, ¿cuál sería ese deseo y por qué?** Se me hace muy difícil imiginar un solo deseo, mucho más pedirlo, hay tantas carencias en el mundo, pero me inclino por desear eliminar la pobreza, creo que vivimos en un mundo poco equitativo en cuanto a la repartición de los recursos, unos tienen mucho, otros tienen algo y hay quienes no tienen nada se me hace injusto esta desigualdad, la pobreza es una condición que no distingue edad aunque los más vulnerables siempre serán los niños y ancianos, pediría a ese genio mejorar ese aspecto y cambiar esa situación social con un acceso real y justo a políticas que cambien la situación económica a quienes viven en estado precario. **>1- If a magic genie could grant you one — and only one — wish, what would that wish be, and why?** It's very difficult for me to imagine a single wish, much less ask for one. There are so many needs in the world, but I'm inclined to wish to eliminate poverty. I think we live in a world that's far from equitable in terms of resource distribution. Some have a lot, others have something, and some have nothing. I find this inequality unjust. Poverty is a condition that doesn't discriminate by age, although the most vulnerable will always be children and the elderly. I would ask that genie to improve this situation and change this social reality with real and fair access to policies that improve the economic circumstances of those living in precarious conditions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYBhw3AZfn51yqX5Hig2EYderG7SJttn8b7nuSBTdeAD/1780921360899.jpg) **2- Verano, estación seca, estación húmeda u otoño: ¿qué es lo que más le gusta de la temporada actual en su país y/o lo que más le desagrada de ella?** Venezuela es un país Sudaméricano donde solo se dan dos estaciones invierno y verano con un clima cálido y tropical. Sequía y humedad dos estaciones muy diferentes cada una tiene sus dificultades y sus atributos, no significa que no se valla a ver lluvia en verano o fuerte sol en pleno invierno, tenemos un clima muy variante, aquí el calor es parejo y continuo durante todo el año., claro con las lluvias baja un poco la temperatura. A finales de abril y comienzo de mayo comienza el invierno, lluvias fuertes, torrenciales aguaceros, se me hace muy oportuna su llegada porque son los meses más calurosos del año, donde el sol y las altas temperaturas no nos dan tregua, los incendios forestales están a la orden del día, llega ese alivio, la naturaleza en su máxima expresión recordandonos que vienen cambios los campos reverdesen y los incendios quedan atrás. **>2- Summer, dry season, wet season, or fall — what is your favorite thing about the current season in your country and/or the thing you dislike the most about it?** Venezuela is a South American country with only two seasons: winter and summer, and a warm, tropical climate. Drought and humidity are two very different seasons, each with its own challenges and characteristics. This doesn't mean there won't be rain in summer or intense sun in the middle of winter; we have a very variable climate. Here, the heat is consistent and continuous throughout the year, although the rains do lower the temperature a bit. Winter begins in late April and early May, bringing heavy rains and torrential downpours. I find its arrival very timely because these are the hottest months of the year, when the sun and high temperatures offer no respite. Forest fires are commonplace, and then comes the relief: nature at its most vibrant, reminding us that changes are coming. The fields turn green again, and the fires are a thing of the past. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZDYQkzcVMM9NCov3sdSTtnhKbAh8YB39CwcbZZDcKdoo/1780921440323.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTSg9udanajd1bNuFx72efB2RoqH9kv1JG4Uf4tvnZRuU/1780921440661.jpg) El invierno con todas sus consecuencias es mi época favorita, amo ese olor a tierra mojada de las primeras lluvias, siento que se limpia el aire, la tierra se fertiliza, ocurre una transformación real para las plantas, la vegetación empieza a crecer, el clima se vuelve más fresco, me da sensación de prosperidad, se ven las flores, los frutos en los jardines, huertos y campos las esperanzas vuelven a renacer. >Winter, with all its consequences, is my favorite time of year. I love that smell of wet earth from the first rains. I feel the air being cleansed, the earth being fertilized, a real transformation happening for the plants, the vegetation starting to grow, the weather becoming cooler, it gives me a feeling of prosperity, the flowers and fruits appear in the gardens, orchards and fields, and hopes are reborn. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaQboGesKdH6GWWN1jWYgSXMrbhighkhAsooPmA4QEH4x/1780921597071.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVS32gTw9Govf5bK8VDLVwxLteek8k62QCgVaWuDKsAQn/1780921597135.jpg)
>
_¡Gracias por leer, hasta una nueva oportunidad !_
>
Las fotografías mostradas son de mi propiedad, .
La Versión en Inglés la realicé con el Traductor de Google.
>
_Thanks for reading, until next time!_

Varios grupos se presentaron, y la música y la danza en vivo brindaron una alegre manera de comenzar esta exposición de arte. ![IMG_20260530_181127.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPR1secNRfFpXzwmU5bcbiQENe63yg27ru6vquzjeEtif/IMG_20260530_181127.jpg) Estuve acompañada de varios representantes, todos presentes para brindar apoyo a nuestros pequeños y con aplausos se dió por finalizado la presentación de danza. ![IMG_20260530_194419.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZru73wU4JMuKitwCEzM9VAnvkYqqgb8wnivQUKJCEKam/IMG_20260530_194419.jpg) Después llegó el momento de la presentación de las obras artísticas, los niños han estado trabajando desde hace unos meses en su preparación, haciendo presente su creatividad e ingenio en los dibujos. ![IMG_20260530_194719.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSY2F5CiFfNQ6NdgV7haHghFJLhVLL8SAKPXcyaifcMd/IMG_20260530_194719.jpg) Me sentí agradecida, ya que es el comienzo de muchas bendiciones en esta área, mi hija feliz por poder mostrar sus creaciones, a la vez nerviosa, pero con la mejor actitud para describir sus obras. ![IMG_20260530_194942.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRG59zY2dQji91pUDvdhnrNL4TBkTSua3daaptp9oBWoz/IMG_20260530_194942.jpg) Fue una noche maravillosa para compartir, porque además de las actuaciones también celebramos el Día de la Madre, como es costumbre en ese lugar, y así terminó mi noche, agradecida y compartiendo muchas bendiciones con mi princesa. > Gracias por leer mi publicación ❤️ --- |English version . | | -------- --- ![Arte .png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjed9nmvFYdMfGemJvtz4AuHbpCNnaVQZQzbc6AE8wMj/Arte%20.png) Happy start to the week, my dear friends at Hive.
