body.title: Movie Review: Blood Sisters
body.body:
![127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eonj3QekjXumzDycfjTmP2tQJV3r1P5gQvS8s6YgNrzKMYEdVXKBGdwX7TfPtw75kCj.jpg) [Source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DZCljLUKlCe/)
After 4 years, following the release of the first season of Blood Sister in 2022, they finally released the second season in 2026. It was pretty interesting with an extension into the life of the two friends turned sisters, Sarah and Kemi. Season 2 focuses on their life in jail following the crime they committed in the first season and the false accusation they have to fight in court from the hands of the Ademolas family. They do not have to face only the consequences of their crime, but they have to struggle with their newfound life in jail with other inmates.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tGwKuaKCAoiX84ZR8PtGTnapz3AgYipxu1zik2PRvTd8PYBUgd22MpzY7FMhRpFhjgg.png) [Source](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertainment/nollywood/878937-netflix-announces-release-date-for-blood-sisters-season-2.html)
I have to say, if you are probably new to blood sisters, you would get to enjoy it more when you watch both seasons at a stretch, and you do not have to worry much about wondering what happened and who is who? For example, I totally forgot Daniel Effiong was in the first season when I watched the second season. Also, the relevance of some characters in the season left me with some unanswered questions. Was the lawyer also in the first season, or did she come in the second season? I think the lack of a quick recap before the start of season 2 would have been really helpful. Something like what was done with the fourth season of The Witcher when they brought in a new Geralt. Aside from this, the movie was on fire.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EogQh4yQvhNsbpBiHSWZr1cVpSVqjyHpnDh4SBmMujtM5JSjmiU7R1Zv8iDFUapRJ4H.png) [Source](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=988179517140692&set=pcb.988179680474009)
I got hooked on the second season right from the first episode because the movie's direction to explore and depict the inner workings of the Nigerian prison. Also, I have to add that they did not hold back in this aspect. They did so much to depict the prison system while doing their best not to invite trouble in their direction. The biggest shock for me was the portrayal of the bathing conditions for the women since it was a women's prison. Nothing will prepare you for what you will see or what will happen next. A good addition to the cast was Blessing and Warripikin because they killed the role they were given. Playing the gang leader in the prison brought a new kind of story to the movie, which made it more interesting and, at the same time, funny to watch. Nobody had an idea these actors were going to be so evil to Sarah and Kemi, the lead characters, hence the blood sisters. Imagine fighting for your life in prison and fighting for your innocence in court. That was the case for Kemi and Sarah.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23wC1Fm3KCFHzBtNTSJpj9GT81z9GKHFSg2aBFn9JxSy18ZvXzCUC2RwjL6t1pZFPHnXf.png) [Source](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertainment/nollywood/878937-netflix-announces-release-date-for-blood-sisters-season-2.html)
Acting from Gabriel Afolayan, Kehinde Bankole, and Kate Henshaw gave me a spark, reminding me that the Ademolas are still a dysfunctional family with so many issues to resolve, but at this point in time, it is too late for them. Kate Henshaw remained the matriarch of the Ademola household, calling the shots and making her children's lives a living hell, while keeping Daniel Effiong as her boy toy. With this, you should get a glimpse of how messed up it was for such a family. Lastly, Uche Jumbo gave us a premium acting of what it means to be a mother, with how she went above and beyond for her daughter in this season. Coming from a place of negligence to the issue at hand in the first season, when her daughter complained to her about the kind of family she had gotten into, she became determined to protect her at all costs and make up for her past mistakes. body.title: Why Grove Doomblade Is One of the Most Dangerous Sneak Attackers
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 8, 2026, 11_19_44 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wCC9Aa6Mv8GaV7nxR5FHwo7V54HXkKJjrNfXHawoAFFotF8uRvM3CDw5R7u7RQ5Amgb.png)


![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


This monster hits amazingly well. Its melee attack is its best power. These are the kinds of monsters players are searching for and want to keep in their deck. Grove Doomblade is exactly such a monster, a melee attacker that is considered a strong hitter.

If I talk about its basic stats its mana cost is 9 which is a bit quite expensive but in mid to high mana battles it is considered a strong monster. Some players also consider it a high risk, high-reward monster because its health is not very high. 

If used properly can be disaster monster against enemy units. But if not placed correctly and other monster selection are not helpful for her then she is considered a useless monster card.

So if you place it on the front line and give it protection then it becomes a disaster monster.

And if it keeps getting protection from a tank and healer then it will perform in a way you cannot even imagine. Its attack type is melee and with 5 damage it attacks every round which is why it is considered very strong.

![Screenshot 2026-04-25 102739.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eoe8DojzN7Enmxsi6qyopfi79wkqN6sBuPVFocFTegTLpgDLUDRCaSwjJsWDenoatH6.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

The interesting thing is that it also has armor. That means if you place it on the front line after a tank monster its armor can protect it to a good extent. First the enemy unit will have to remove its armor before directly hitting its health. 

Therefore if it keeps getting good protection from a tank and healer then this monster will survive for a long time. And the longer it survives the more destruction it will cause for enemy units.

As I told you you can select it in high mana battles and its best positioning is on the front line right after the tank. And right after that you should place a healer so that the tank and healer continuously protect it.

It also has another special ability called Sneak which you can easily get at level 1. In Sneak it targets the enemy in the last position and that is its best advantage.

I think that if you use such a melee attacker monster in high mana battles with 5 power then you should also select a ranged attack monster in the backline with at least 3–4 attack. 

What will happen is that one will keep attacking from near and the other from far which will give a strong shock to the enemy and cause heavy damage to their units.

![Screenshot 2026-04-25 102702.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGydREsPXKv2Nw5THACUN7XENLsScqPAp4LbHyn7ffpGzaxKzXxbG3kuvitTBTV7bm3.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Like other monsters it also has some weaknesses. Its biggest weakness is its high mana cost which limits its flexibility. That means you cannot select it in low mana battles and even sometimes in medium mana battles you may get fewer chances to pick it.

Another weakness is that it is vulnerable to fast and sneak attackers.

If I talk about its price at level 1 it is very affordable you can get it for just 12 cents which is very reasonable. You can buy it, add it to your deck and then gradually upgrade it according to your investment.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.title: STILL AT SEERS DAIRY... STAY TUNED!
body.body:
Hey pals... happy New week to you all.

I heard that the ‎Prophetic revelation is always progressive. So I made no mistake if I decided to share for knowledge sake.
Let's read and learn together.

![IMG_20260529_160414_131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKDhbVTZEGYZjNdHKEsQYa7azFaP2Vp1odgxZCgNeTHYpJvmspU9hS6Az5Utq3M.jpg)

‎
‎We see in part. We prophesy in part. And the seer prophet who treats the first thing they discern as the complete picture has stopped listening before heaven has finished speaking.
‎
‎1 Corinthians 13:9 is not a disclaimer about immature faith. It is a governing principle about how revelation works in this age. God releases understanding in layers. He shows the doorway before the room. He reveals the symptom before the cause. He discloses the beginning before the end.
‎
‎And the seer who does not understand this will consistently mistake the first impression for the final word.
‎
‎You pick up a struggle in someone. You sense resistance around a situation. You feel a burden in prayer. You detect something unusual in the atmosphere. And immediately the mind starts finishing the story. This must be the reason. This must be what is happening. This must be where this is going.

![IMG_20260606_112552_566.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKZoafwaENfMSzPhtWxQkDUADEEcEnmur6XXBWxwwP6dSuakEJMYkbMh4vgjGnt.jpg)

‎
‎But discernment is not interpretation. And perception is not understanding.
‎
‎Many seers have accurately perceived something while completely misunderstanding what it meant. Not because the gift was false. But because they stopped listening too soon.
‎
‎We see this in Samuel. When he looked at Eliab his first impression felt obvious. Surely this is the Lord's anointed. The impression was immediate. The confidence was strong. The conclusion was wrong. The Lord had to teach Samuel something every seer eventually learns. What you see first is not always what God is emphasizing. And what feels obvious is not always what is true.
‎
‎Seer prophet hear this carefully.
‎
‎The first thing you discern is often the beginning of the conversation not the conclusion of it. Mature seers do not rush to explain everything they perceive.
They stay before the Lord. They keep listening. They remain teachable. Because they understand that revelation unfolds.
‎
‎One of the clearest signs of prophetic maturity is becoming genuinely comfortable with not knowing everything immediately.
‎
‎Because the goal is not to reach a conclusion quickly.
‎The goal is to understand what the Lord is actually saying.
‎ 
You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/still-at-seers-dairy-stay-tuned-lds)

body.body:
You clearly have very little understanding of copyright law, or you’re deliberately ignoring it. So I don’t know if there’s any point in explaining anything on this topic.
My objection stems from my view that certain principles should apply among creators: create your own work, don’t use someone else’s.
Just because someone might steal my photo (watermarks don’t protect anything with today’s graphics software) doesn’t mean you should encourage and reward people for doing so with your system. I base my posts mainly on photography, and I know there are better places to promote them than Hive or Reddit.
New users start out with low rewards for their posts, which is why many have either stopped posting or left Hive. If newcomers see that they can get more by using other people’s posts, what motivation will they have to create their own, better posts? What kind of new users will you attract here, and how is the community supposed to grow in such a case? Isn’t it better for the community to reward creators so they want to stay here and create instead of copying others?
Some posts are shared multiple times by different people just to earn Hive from recycling content.
People who share posts almost never vote on them, even though they’re often new, active posts. Their only goal is to use other people’s work to earn Hive. If they got, say, 10% instead of 60% of the reward, do you think they’d be so eager to share posts?
HivePosh isn’t for promotion; it’s for earning Hive.
I’ve been here for 4 years and I see more interesting creators leaving than new ones appearing.

body.title: Supreme Court voids Trump tariffs; $166B refund exposure
body.body:
Good Morning Lions,

The Supreme Court just torched the Trump administration's tariff structure in a 6-3 ruling on February 20, opening the door to $166 billion in potential refunds. # Learn Ethical Hacking (#51) - Incident Response - When Things Go Wrong

![leh-banner.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2LpoeHUPesc4Dy8haRKLJgfuDY6UBKdc3sED8Dz3JH9/leh-banner.jpg)

### What will I learn

- **What incident response is** and why every organization needs a plan before the breach happens;
- **The IR lifecycle** -- preparation, identification, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned;
- **Triage and classification** -- determining severity, scope, and priority under pressure;
- **Evidence collection** -- forensically sound acquisition of memory, disk, logs, and network captures;
- **Containment strategies** -- isolating compromised systems without alerting the attacker or destroying evidence;
- **Root cause analysis** -- tracing the kill chain backwards from detection to initial access;
- **IR playbooks** -- pre-built response procedures for common incident types (ransomware, BEC, data breach);
- Defense: building an IR team, tabletop exercises, IR retainers, and continuous improvement.

### Requirements

- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- Understanding of attack techniques from episodes 1-50;
- Familiarity with logging and monitoring concepts;
- The ambition to learn ethical hacking and security research.

### Difficulty

- Intermediate

# Learn Ethical Hacking (#51) - Incident Response - When Things Go Wrong

### Solutions to Episode 50 Exercises

**Exercise 1:** Red team operation plan (abbreviated).

```text
Target: Apex Financial Services (fictional)
Objectives:
  1. Access the CEO's email inbox
  2. Exfiltrate customer database (prove access, do not copy real data)
  3. Demonstrate ransomware deployment capability on a test subnet

Kill chain mapping:
  Recon: LinkedIn OSINT (T1593), DNS enumeration (T1596)
  Weaponize: Sliver implant with HTTPS C2 (T1587.001)
  Deliver: spearphishing to HR (T1566.001) + credential harvest page
  Exploit: OAuth token theft from O365 (T1528)
  Install: scheduled task persistence (T1053.005)
  C2: HTTPS beaconing via domain-fronted CDN (T1071.001)
  Objective: Kerberoast -> DA -> DCSync -> CEO mailbox (T1558.003)

OPSEC: domain registered 45 days prior, redirector infrastructure
  on separate cloud provider, C2 profile mimicking Slack API traffic.
```

The key insight with this operation plan is that every phase maps directly to ATT&CK technique IDs -- which is not just academic rigor, it's operational necesity. When the engagement is over and you're writing the report (as we discussed in episode 50), those technique IDs are how you tell the blue team exactly where their detection gaps are. \
is infinitely more actionable than \

**Exercise 2:** ATT&CK Navigator coverage map (abbreviated).

```text
APT29 techniques assessed (selection):
  T1566.002 Spearphishing Link:     GREEN (email gateway detects)
  T1059.001 PowerShell:             YELLOW (logged but no alert rule)
  T1003.001 LSASS Memory:           RED (no detection)
  T1053.005 Scheduled Task:         YELLOW (logged, high FP rate)
  T1021.006 WinRM:                  RED (no detection)

Top 5 gaps:
  1. T1003.001 -- no LSASS protection or dump detection
  2. T1021.006 -- WinRM lateral movement unmonitored
  3. T1070.001 -- log clearing undetected
  4. T1090.004 -- domain fronting undetectable at network layer
  5. T1558.003 -- Kerberoasting (no TGS request volume alerting)
```

The Navigator is one of those tools that looks like a toy until you use it on a real environment -- then it becomes genuinely terrifying. You overlay APT29's known techniques, color-code your detection coverage, and suddenly you're staring at a heatmap that says \

That's a conversation-starter for the CISO budget meeting, I can tell you that much ;-)

**Exercise 3:** Mini purple team exercise (abbreviated).

```text
T1059.001 PowerShell: Sysmon Event 1 logged (process creation),
  but no alert rule. Built: alert on powershell.exe with
  -encodedcommand or -e flag.

T1003.001 LSASS dump: Sysmon Event 10 logged (process access to
  lsass.exe). Built: alert on any non-system process accessing
  lsass.exe with READ access.

T1053.005 Scheduled task: Sysmon Event 1 + Windows Event 4698.
  Built: alert on schtasks.exe creating tasks with encoded payloads.

T1021.006 WinRM: Windows Event 6 (WSMan session). No Sysmon event.
  Built: alert on Event 6 from non-admin workstations.

T1070.001 Log clearing: Windows Event 1102 (audit log cleared).
  Built: alert on 1102 -- this should NEVER happen in production.
```

Five techniques tested, five detection rules built. That's the purple team value proposition in miniature. In a traditional red team engagement, you would have tested these same five techniques, written them up in a 40-page report that arrives six weeks later, and the blue team would start building detection rules in Q3. In the purple team model, the detection rules exist before lunch. The feedback loop is everything.

# Learn Ethical Hacking (#51) - Incident Response - When Things Go Wrong

Episode 50 covered red team operations -- the discipline of combining every offensive skill we've built over 49 episodes into a single coordinated operation that simulates a real-world attacker. We walked through the difference between pentests and red teams (pentests find bugs, red teams test whether your organization survives a determined attacker), rules of engagement (the piece of paper that separates \
from \

What do you do RIGHT NOW?

Incident response is the discipline of answering that question -- under pressure, with incomplete information, while the clock is ticking and the damage is compounding every minute you spend figuring out what happened. It is (I argue) the most stressful job in cybersecurity, and the one that matters most when every other defense has failed.

Here we go.

### The NIST Framework -- Six Phases

The canonical incident response lifecycle comes from **NIST SP 800-61** (Computer Security Incident Handling Guide). Six phases, in order:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
\

IR_PHASES = {
    1: {
        'name': 'Preparation',
        'when': 'BEFORE the incident (this is where 90% of success lives)',
        'key_activities': [
            'IR plan: documented, tested, approved by leadership',
            'IR team: defined roles (incident commander, technical lead, '
            'communications, legal, HR)',
```

### Phase 3: Containment -- Stop the Bleeding

Containment has one goal: stop the damage from getting worse. But it has a critical constraint: don't destroy evidence, and if possible, don't tip off the attacker that you know they're there.

```bash

# Network isolation -- CRITICAL: do NOT power off the machine!
# Powering off destroys volatile memory (running processes, network
# connections, encryption keys, malware in RAM-only).

# Option 1: host firewall quarantine (block everything except forensics)
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,blockoutbound

dir=in \\\n    action=allow remoteip=10.10.14.5\nnetsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=\

    action=allow remoteip=10.10.14.5

# Option 2: VLAN quarantine (move host to isolated VLAN at switch level)
# This is preferred because the host itself can't undo it.
# Requires coordination with network team.

# Disable compromised accounts -- do NOT delete them (evidence!)
net user compromised_user /active:no /domain
# PowerShell alternative:
# Set-ADUser -Identity jsmith -Enabled $false

# Block known C2 at the firewall and proxy
# Add attacker IPs and domains to blocklists immediately.
# But remember: sophisticated attackers have backup C2 channels.
# Blocking one domain might trigger a fallback to DNS C2.

# Credential rotation for affected scope
# Reset passwords for ALL compromised and POTENTIALLY compromised
# accounts. Not just the one you found -- the attacker may have
# harvested credentials from other accounts during lateral movement.
# Force re-authentication everywhere (revoke active sessions/tokens).
```

The \

rule is one of those things that seems counterintuitive until you've lost evidence because of it. Your instinct when you find a compromised system is to pull the plug. Fight that instinct. A running system has volatile data in memory -- active network connections (showing where the attacker is connecting from), running processes (showing what malware is executing), decryption keys (if the attacker is using in-memory-only tools, those keys vanish the moment power is cut), and cached credentials. All of that disappears the instant you hit the power button.

That web shell entry is worth emphasizing. If the initial access was through a web application vulnerability (SQL injection from episode 12, file upload from episode 20, deserialization from episode 19), the attacker almost certainly dropped a web shell as their first persistence mechanism. It's a tiny PHP or JSP file sitting in the web root that gives them command execution through a normal HTTP request. The nuclear option for eradication is rebuilding from scratch. ### Evidence Collection -- Getting It Right

Evidence collection in incident response is governed by one overriding principle: **forensic soundness**. Evidence that is not collected properly is useless in court and unreliable for analysis.

```bash
# Evidence collection procedure (Linux)

# Step 1: memory acquisition FIRST (most volatile, most valuable)
# Using LiME kernel module (Linux Memory Extractor):
sudo insmod lime.ko \

# Calculate hash immediately:
sha256sum /evidence/memory.lime > /evidence/memory.lime.sha256

# Step 2: volatile system state (before anything changes)
# Running processes:
ps auxwwf > /evidence/ps_output.txt
# Network connections:
ss -tulnp > /evidence/network_connections.txt
netstat -anp > /evidence/netstat_output.txt
# Logged-in users:
w > /evidence/who_is_logged_in.txt
last -a > /evidence/last_logins.txt
# Open files:
lsof > /evidence/open_files.txt

# Step 3: disk imaging (forensically sound, write blocker required)
# dc3dd is dd with built-in hashing and logging:
sudo dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/evidence/disk.dd \
    hash=sha256 log=/evidence/disk_acquisition.log

# Step 4: log collection
tar czf /evidence/var_log.tar.gz /var/log/
sha256sum /evidence/var_log.tar.gz > /evidence/var_log.tar.gz.sha256

# Step 5: DOCUMENT EVERYTHING
# Chain of custody record for each piece of evidence:
# - What was collected (memory/disk/logs)
# - From which system (hostname, IP, serial number)
# - By whom (name, role)
# - When (timestamp, timezone)
# - How (tool name and version)
# - Hash value (SHA-256)
# - Where it is stored now (evidence locker, encrypted drive)
# Without chain of custody, evidence is inadmissible in court.
```

The **order of volatility** matters. Memory is the most volatile -- it changes every millisecond and disappears entirely when power is lost. Disk is less volatile but can be overwritten by normal system activity (log rotation, temp files). Network captures are only available in real time. You collect the most volatile evidence first because that's the evidence you're most likely to lose.

### The AI Slop Connection

AI is changing incident response in both directions, and the asymmetry is not in the defender's favor.

On the defense side, AI-powered **SOAR** (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) platforms can automate initial triage, correlate thousands of alerts into clusters, execute containment playbooks faster than any human, and dramatically reduce the time between detection and response. An AI system that processes 10,000 alerts per hour and surfaces the 3 that actually matter is genuinely valuable. The SOC analyst spends their time on real incidents in stead of drowning in false positives.

On the attack side, AI accelerates every phase of the kill chain we discussed in episodes 4 through 50. And here's the uncomfortable part for IR teams: AI-generated malware is polymorphic by default. Every sample is slightly different. Signature-based detection (which still underpins most antivirus products) was designed for a world where malware was written by humans and reused across campaigns. AI-generated malware breaks that assumption because generating a unique variant costs nothing. Your IOC (Indicator of Compromise) list from today's incident is useless against tomorrow's AI-generated variant because the hashes, strings, and network signatures will all be different.

The implication for IR: **behavioral detection** becomes the only reliable approach. You can't match signatures for malware that mutates every deployment. You CAN detect the behavior -- unusual process trees, anomalous network connections, credential access patterns that don't match baseline. The techniques we covered in episode 48 (UEBA behavioral baselines) are not just useful for insider threat detection -- they're the foundation of incident detection in an AI-powered threat landscape.

Understanding who is targeting you, what tools they use, and what their objectives are BEFORE they breach your perimeter is the domain of threat intelligence. It transforms security from \

body.title: Spill Your Guts (2)
body.body:
![1000137622.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/48esx7KQK2zjvc8sfHYhEiPJgbwYCoVcgNXXKBtZRpUkE8TEZre5Tbu3LseRDcTGkR.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

***[BEFORE......](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@kemmyb/spill-your-guts)***
_________

<div class=text-justify>

The receptionist barely had time to announce Peter Mercer before he pushed through the door into Dr Laura Hart's office three days later. The therapist glanced up from her computer, her eyes wide with concern. 
 
His eyes narrowed at her composed sight behind her desk. He walked towards her, his jaw clenched so tightly a muscle throbbed along his neck. He held up a document and Laura sighed. 

“You failed me,” he growled through his teeth. 

She calmly stood up. “No, I didn't clear you. There's a difference—”

“That's the same thing, doc,” he snapped and started pacing the office. “My team's deploying next week. Do you have any idea what you've done? Someone else is leading the team…I won't be there to have their backs.”

Laura remained silent, studying him which only aggravated him more. 

“I spilled my guts as you wanted…I told you about Fred. What more do you want?”

She folded her hands across her chest. “What I want is for you not to sound like a wounded child when you speak about your father. You went after those men like a man settling a score.”

Peter scoffed. “They deserved to die.” 

“That was not your choice to make. Your task was to bring the boys home safe.”

“I did bring them back to base safely.”

She nodded. “When you found out their fathers had abandoned them, what did you feel?

Peter stopped pacing and chuckled harshly. “We are doing this again?”

When she stayed silent, he exhaled sharply. “Anger. I wanted to protect the boys.”

“I don't think so.” 

Peter frowned. “Are you calling me a liar?”

“No. You became the frightened boy left behind a dumpster thirty years ago.” He froze for a moment, staring at her. The words struck harder than he expected. Then he sank into a cushion chair. 

“You don't understand,” he muttered, his gaze on the floor. “I waited for him…every Christmas, birthdays, when I joined the academy,” he laughed bitterly. “I'm still waiting. Isn’t that pathetic?”

“No, it's not,” Laura said gently, shaking her head. “It's human. You've built your life around this wound and it's affecting your work. It's time to heal.”

“What if I can't?” He whispered, still staring at the floor.

“You can and you have to…or else, I can't clear you for active duty.” The room fell silent and he stared out the window. “I can make this easy for you,” she said drawing his gaze back to her. 

She held out a file marked *‘classified’* and he took it, his brows furrowed in confusion.

______

*The next morning*

Rows of white headstones stretched across Betfort National Cemetery as Peter Mercer and Dr Laura Hart alighted from a black SUV.

The clouds were grey, promising heavy rain anytime. She stood a few feet behind while Peter drew close to a grave, his shoulders slumped and his eyes weary as he read the inscription on the headstone. 

*Frederick Mercer    
Beloved Father and Friend 
Forever In Our Hearts* 

[*To be continued*]

body.title: 跟妹妹爬千山-大美千山初印象
body.body:
千山乃辽东第一名山，在鞍山境内，属于长白山余脉，这里集青山之灵秀，古刹之禅意，文脉之悠长而闻名，而我在考上大学之后，作为爸爸给我的奖励，带我游览过千山，也是唯一的一次，从此后就再也没登过千山，30多年前的千山肯定和现在不一样了，妹妹说已经有了翻天覆地的变化，而她也不止去了五六回。 

而我也想看看辽南第一名山变化的样子，记得当初跟爸爸登上了天上天，夹扁石，五佛顶，但是其他去过哪里已经早就没了印象。这次妹妹说她要陪着我看看千山的变化，有她陪着我当然非常高兴的去领略一下千山的美啦！

我们两个乘坐出租车先到了鞍山，这是包车那种，只要够4个人，车就可以走了。 司机将我们送到火车站之后，我们便乘坐8路车到了千山风景区，虽然站点多大35站，但公交车司机开的很熟练也很快，差不多40分钟就到了景区。

到了千山的正门，古朴巍峨的石碑坊伫立在群山之前，四重亭式飞檐翘脚，端庄大气，正中的千山二字笔力遒劲，雄浑洒脱，鎏金楹联分列立柱，对仗工整，写尽千山风骨。
![千山 1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4kHSFTVRsHvNuQarHRBdtwN68np41TwJt6FLzBVHeKJ/%E5%8D%83%E5%B1%B1%201.jpg)

从游客中心进入，票可以从网上抖音或者大众点评可以买到，优惠5元，75元左右，有的可能有优惠还能省些。然后便进入到了景区中，出门就是东北第一名山导览图。 

![名山.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma5AMEU9Z9HDkodGJgQnmSM423SPjCKEkXJ3c7hgoyTgo/%E5%90%8D%E5%B1%B1.jpg)

内部风景优美，空气立马不一样，天然氧吧开启，尤其是下过雨后的清晨更是清新无比，这里这个季节来真是太舒服了！景区内有电瓶车可以直达大佛寺，妹妹说大佛寺是后来修建的，里面很壮观。 而我们今天恐怕也只能走到大佛寺，因为爬山时间会很久，千山不来个十次八次的是逛不完的！

这里处处是风景，为了保存体力，妹妹说我们就直接去大佛寺，只看沿途风光，其他的地方先不去，以后有机会再来。后来证实我们俩的决策是对的，因为可以分为几部分走完，不可能一下就去爬山，而且还能爬到最高顶。
![词.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnUqFRqSouCFjFSftvBjJXE4p2Emy3NoKdkCWQbfEAvx/%E8%AF%8D.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyZR6abo7p5AbGk3cCNNgnCwtP4bjaU19sCkHMeem3xd/_.jpg)


我们邂逅的第一个园林便是“雨润梨园”，因为外围感觉特别漂亮，于是我们便走到了里面，果然成片的梨树长的绿油油的叶子，想必春天的梨花一定开的美丽极了。 
![雨润.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDDjXHASSwgVbYkG8XSQA3MjxagYC5XoVevuGtH81dPd/%E9%9B%A8%E6%B6%A6.jpg)

里面有人在拍照，也有人在里面亮嗓子，湿润的环境，尤其是雨后，这里的空气真的是天然氧吧，树上挂着灯笼，还有一些人工风景小鹿等等，这里还有不知名的漂亮小花，据说还是中药呢！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRUyQFkLCYWokgVQLRYjadv4e1yGfV4Qgq5FtUuHQrvq/_.jpg)
![小花.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3oLTd3ANZ51QE4RKhRD9fvrz5ePBu2ZBASk4FTFkhbf/%E5%B0%8F%E8%8A%B1.jpg)
里面玩了一会之后我们便继续走，看到了一个漂亮的舞台，如愿千山！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPxPMtjAaPNcDNqpvEPQa7EcBZiTTgANR2CsKv1ZyEGS1/_.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme588WRicqbCQnKt9frD96iJo37CYn7QVuo8W8YoRMuaB/_.jpg)

沿着步栈道继续往前走，高大茂盛的树叶子将阳光遮住，这里变成了天然空调氧吧，空气绝对新鲜的不得了，难怪妹妹说这里一年四季都是旅游旺季，季节不同各有各的风景。 

***这里可以打卡一下！***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1TLJn1TnUGXLS6vNnhHHxw8xrCGtYkkxqNzsS6vkDmU/_.jpg)
莲花吧！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfHgZrn6pZp2d8Ji1FYg7ZPRuUgBNMXSYhmL4jqJ4h4cE/_.jpg)
这里有很多树干上挂着人工做的鸟窝，小鸟一定会很幸福的喜欢着这个手工为他们准备的窝吧！更为惊奇的是，当我们抬头仰望鸟窝的时候，竟然看到了一个活跃的灰色小松鼠，它比我见到的松树都大，动作也更迅捷，我想拍照都没能拍下来，因为它跳的实在是太快了！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbsGLHBpNpTySgPA8h5HYMw5NrEcMtjAsy22XajX9xuz4/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQze2LcjxJ12MmKqtD1Ub1ati2PDtBoEX1uX6C2EHBDEn/_.jpg)


沿途还有很多这样的石潭水，里面长满了水草，但是非常清新，如果是深夏那一定是凉爽的存在！

几乎是一步一景，如果时间允许，就可以到每个站点多走走，而且一路都有好听的音乐，天籁之音，真如仙境一般。 深吸山间的空气，顿时神清气爽，沁人心脾，这里远离城市的喧嚣，难怪每天都有那么多的人来这里走走，尤其是很多老年人。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUp1esHYefYe3FTQvKD4Yy59NbFYnCe3nrD8Ygdw8SiXn/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsm9Co3q1g1YHCmzhuQp1LQ9VKPGcFTrsrMRsGz3ag38/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbb6Wt8e28H4qpXkE2DpMoiJbXwQHiMFGaHpbxjV4fXYQ/_.jpg)


千山虽然没有五岳大山那样的气势，却自有北方名山的温婉磅礴，千峰错落，万壑藏幽，山石也是千姿百态，或平缓敦厚，或悬崖峭壁，林木葱翠，真是春有梨花夏有荷，秋有枫叶冬有雪，一年四季都有不同的风景。 而千山的灵秀之气给我更深的体验。

在接下来的途中，我们还遇到了很多美丽的风景，以后会慢慢分享给大家！

body.title: Secrets of the Ruins
body.body:
When the fog finally lifted, the landscape that stretched before them was more terrifying than anything Kael had ever seen. The very land seemed scarred by a war fought thousands of years ago. Deep cracks split the ground, stones were blackened and charred, and fallen columns lay scattered across the area. These ruins were remnants of a past so ancient that even the people of Nivareth had forgotten it.

Kael raised the crystal fragment. Its light focused on a massive gate standing at the center of the ruins. Half-buried in the earth and covered in moss, the gate still bore symbols carved into the stone—symbols that remained clearly visible: three interlocking crystal rings. Lira immediately pulled out her book and compared the markings.

“This symbol,” she said excitedly, “marks the first part of the prophecy. It says: _‘The travelers of light shall pass through the forgotten gate and hear the echoes of the past.’_”

As Kael approached the gate, a cold wind seeped through the cracks in the stone. The wind seemed to whisper. He listened carefully; the words were faint, yet filled with meaning:

_\

_

As they stood before the gate, the stones began to tremble. Lira opened her book, and the pages turned on their own. A symbol glowed brightly—one of the three rings appeared broken.

“This shows that one of the crystals has been lost,” Lira said. “So our journey is not only about finding the light… it is also about restoring what was lost.”

At that moment, a deep humming sound emerged from within the ruins. Shadows began to move among the shattered columns. Kael raised the crystal, and its light pushed back the darkness. Yet instead of retreating, the shadows took shape.

A group of figures emerged—the spirits of ancient warriors. Their armor was broken, their eyes empty, yet they still held swords in their hands.

“These,” Lira said with a shiver, “are the echoes of the forgotten war. Their souls are bound to this gate.”

One of the spirits stepped forward. Its voice echoed through the ruins—deep, sorrowful, and burdened with ancient pain:

_\

_ Kael gathered his courage. “I do not forget you. My journey continues with the legacy you left behind.” The crystal fragment shone brilliantly in Kael’s hand. The spirits fell silent, then slowly lowered their swords to the ground. With a mighty rumble, the gate opened. A faint light spilled out from within. Kael and Lira exchanged a glance. This gate was the first true trial of their journey. As they stepped inside, the echoes of the past followed them. **_Notes: Translation and photos were created by artificial intelligence._**

Hey guys, how are you? As for me, I’m pretty tired and stressed out from the end of the semester, which is why my classmates and I decided to come to the pool to spend the day. We still don’t know our grades or which classes we’ll pass and which we won’t, but we don’t care about that today. No matter how things turn out, we wanted to treat ourselves to this day so we could have some fun.

>Hola hivers cómo están? En mi caso bastante cansadany estresada por el final del semestre, es por eso que mis compañeros de clase y yo decidimos venir a una piscina a pasar el día, aún no sabemos nuestras notas, que materias vamos a pasar y cuales no pero no nos importa el día de hoy, independientemente de como resulte todo nos quisimos regalar este día para permirir divertirnos un rato

body.title: Sillas de metal - Entry contest #429 [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmczynzcPLXP9LVUxL7FCxGP2MqYsenSZmTwV5n6gVZxbF/image.png) En mi casa he tenido la oportunidad de poder encontrar varias sombras y seguramente que todos los días aparecerá una y aunque muchas veces no les prestamos atención, es genial poder capturarlas. En estas fotografías se puede observar cómo las sillas de la cocina proyectan sombras sobre el piso de cerámica y son de gran impacto, ya que las sombras no muestran la misma forma de la silla, sino nuevas figuras. Aquí el sol entra por la ventana y cae directamente sobre la mesa y las sillas creando ese efecto. >At home, I’ve had the chance to come across various shadows, and I’m sure a new one appears every day. Even though we often don’t pay attention to them, it’s wonderful to be able to capture them. In these photos, you can see how the kitchen chairs cast shadows on the tile floor, creating a striking effect—the shadows don’t simply replicate the shape of the chairs but form entirely new shapes. Here, the sun streams in through the window and falls directly on the table and chairs, creating that effect. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdGhuGaKdAY9kYXG8MKbaD4oZKTyVhTeEZ4UkEJXq9CE3/image.png) Estas sombras son bastante oscuras, casi perfectamente y crean un gran efecto visual que hace algo sencillo se convierta en toda una obra de arte, además no ocurre en una silla, sino en todas las que están allí puestas. Aquí se puede demostrar que incluso los objetos más comunes como una silla y qué seguros todos tienen en sus casas, pueden crear algo valioso. Además, las sombras nos recuerdan la importancia de la luz y cómo esta puede transformar lo cotidiano en algo digno de ser apreciado. Por eso, vale la pena detenerse de vez en cuando y observar los pequeños detalles que nos rodean como las sombras del hogar. >These shadows are quite dark—almost perfectly so—and create a striking visual effect that turns something simple into a true work of art. Moreover, this isn’t limited to just one chair, but to all of them placed there. This demonstrates that even the most common objects—like a chair, which everyone surely has at home—can create something valuable. Furthermore, the shadows remind us of the importance of light and how it can transform the everyday into something worth appreciating. That’s why it’s worth pausing every now and then to observe the small details around us, such as the shadows in our homes. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBXUB92GchMBxCCjDSN5QWvW5ySAEBEzw78iyvy16Zrs/image.png)

body.title: The Game Plan (2007) [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
<center>

# ENGLISH</center>

---

<div class=\

> # Greetings @Movies&Tvshows community… ---
![REVIEW (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLJpS371gxG92bsH4H5.gif)
---

>Since it's Father's Day month, I thought it fitting to talk about films that deal with the weight of fatherhood and how it can transform even the toughest man. This week I wanted to revisit a Disney family classic that many will surely remember, a film that deals with that paternal bond that is essential in every child's life. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_075904_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoCgcgrzkRNqzVJmeEeQTDwy1ZfpHmS3oujk84AqGA8n5A3DinWoKXQ1E92b5fQJocc.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm686725376/?ref_=ttmi_mi_8_2) ---
# The Game Plan
--- Known in Latin America as Entrenando a Papá (The Training of Dad), it premiered in 2007, directed by Andy Fickman and starring Dwayne Johnson (The Rock), Madison Pettis, Roselyn Sánchez, Kyra Sedgwick, among others. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_075953_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tvgJ3NKpWK5wQe14ca1HCdvowuG9rsZo6FXs8vUfShUnM3UMvYCtBD9UUfcG7QzmBF3.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3505232128/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_1) ---
> # What's the plot about?… ---

>The story follows the life of Joe Kingman, a star quarterback in American football who seems to have it all: fame, money, success, and a bachelor lifestyle perfectly designed to revolve around his own ego. However, this life takes a 180° turn when a little girl named Payton suddenly arrives, who turns out to be his daughter from a past relationship. ---

>This new person in his life brings many changes, especially learning to be a father, with several stumbles along the way, like leaving Peyton behind at the opening of his own restaurant or insisting that everything in the house is his. Nevertheless, Joe goes from designing plays on the court to dealing with toys all over the house, school planners, and even ballet classes to connect with his little girl. This change may gradually overwhelm him, but it will make him realize how important this child is in his life. Will he put aside his egocentrism and become more involved in his daughter's life? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080042_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wX3o2XrCbBHXp26oVHLQhoYSfEDEzcqUfpZT1HtaZ3sp3KXepDs6tq5RiGS1ZfzhDYZ.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3589118208/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1_2) ---
> # Personal opinion ---

>I feel this movie wasn't fully appreciated at the time, and it touches on very important themes that invite reflection. It's one of my favorites, I can't deny it. It would be number one among the films starring The Rock, and it's no wonder. Watching that egocentric character go from worried and fearless to learning to be a father, just to be with his little girl, is captivating and gives the story a lot of dynamism, especially with its ups and downs, from accepting her to the very noticeable change in his life, which makes him feel like he's losing part of the identity he's been building. And that's another point I want to highlight about this movie: those ups and downs that Joe experiences, from finally starting to modify things in his life to involve his daughter, to going back to that single, solo star life. It's normal, because even though he's the biological father, he's learning the role of a father very quickly, since being a father is a position that is built slowly and exercised as you become more involved in it; In fact, someone can fill that role without being related by blood, and vice versa; you are a biological father, but you don't act as one.

---

<div class=\
>Another point in this story that I love, and what I feel the film emphasizes most throughout the plot, is a line from Payton's ballet teacher: \

I feel this is very important to consider, because a father's power is measured more by how present he is than by what he gives. Certainly, providing financially helps, but being emotionally involved in your child's life—that, for me, is priceless. Being that support in happy and dark times, creating a genuine connection with that being who depends on you in their early years, is invaluable. For example, my dad always says that he bought us a lot of things when we were little girls, and this movie basically doesn't show them, and we were really grateful for that. But I wish he had come to Father's Day celebrations at school, or that when we did badly, instead of judging us, he had comforted us. That's why this movie is a clear example that building a relationship goes beyond giving material things; it's about being there for your child at all times.

---

<center>

![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080123_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmFR1TqYZDpuidMgkXpKMhGPuBTf2HPvvrhB5wQP9BNygy7s9XETWhGczWx4zYgDWpG.png)
[Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3387791616/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1)

---

<div class=\

>Now, with all this, I couldn't help but remember a scene that still makes me laugh to this day, because I feel like many of us are like Payton. For image reasons, his daughter helps him with the press and all that, so his social image doesn't get ruined, but only if he gets her into ballet classes. It's basically a trade, and I do that with my dad too, haha. I don't know if you do it too. I was telling my godfather that I do favors for my dad, but because of the effort I put in, I ask him to give me a cookie in return. They're not expensive, and he agrees. My godfather told me that's how his daughter is too; when he sends her to buy bananas, she asks if she can buy a Coke, and he ends up giving in too. So, I'd like to know if you're the same with your dads. And well, to conclude, the performances were very good. I consider The Rock a very good actor, even though I usually see him in action films and such. Here he shows a touch of vulnerability, and everyone did a great job, to sum it up.

---

<center>

![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080207_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23uFTgg4yqLznQ7yHuRp8BWf8Xxqofamtoz7mg2i9GY7pTxPmGhjzifsf8bu5iZ8nGwDD.png)
[Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3622672640/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3)

---

<div class=\
> # Positive points… ---

> - The chemistry between the leads: The duo of Dwayne Johnson and Madison Pettis is the driving force of the film; their connection feels real and endearing. - The Rock's versatility: This was one of the first roles where he demonstrated that he could step away from action, laugh at himself, wear ballet tights, and show vulnerability. - A powerful message about fatherhood: The film succeeds in showing that being a father goes beyond providing financial support; it's about presence and time. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080234_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2qC8ZqABcu1iQKtVa57AeXWqmH3LZ6zE3ZK3wYw9SkWpxuBo8Q2dQCicwSpnLvVnWo.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3538786560/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_2) ---
> # Negative points… ---
>\n\n- Predictable and cliché-ridden plot: It follows the Disney formula of \

to the letter. You know exactly what's going to happen. - Stereotypes of the sports world: It portrays American football and the lives of athletes in a highly exaggerated, superficial, and at times cartoonish way. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080314_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EogNKnyJe3ahf2cP2jEk81xDgmDA5zpmPtDLn7iKJQZvnJJf5jBWJ5MVHxw4C9fnNt8.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3555563776/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1) ---
> # My score… ---
>7.5/10 Story │ 8.8/10 Acting │ 7.5/10 Sound │ 8/10 Set Design │ 8.5/10 Overall ---

>This movie is a must-see. Here we see a character who understands that true success isn't measured in trophies or million-dollar contracts, but in responsibility and unconditional love. You're going to love it. ---

# ESPAÑOL</center>

<div class=\

> # Saludos comunidad de @Movies&Tvshows… ---
![REVIEW (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLJpS371gxG92bsH4H5.gif)
---

>Como es el mes de Papá, me pareció oportuno hablar sobre aquellos filmes que tenga que ver como con el peso de la paternidad y cómo esta puede transformar al hombre más duro. Esta semana quise rescatar un clásico familiar de Disney que seguro muchos recuerdan y que tiene que ver con ese vinculo paternal que es imprescindible en la vida de todo niñ@. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_075904_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoCgcgrzkRNqzVJmeEeQTDwy1ZfpHmS3oujk84AqGA8n5A3DinWoKXQ1E92b5fQJocc.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm686725376/?ref_=ttmi_mi_8_2) ---
# The Game Plan
---

>Conocida en Latinoamérica como Entrenando a Papá, fue estrenada para el año 2007, bajo la dirección de Andy Fickman y de la protagonización de Dwayne Johnson (la roca), Madison Pettis, Roselyn Sánchez, Kyra Sedgwick, entre otros. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_075953_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tvgJ3NKpWK5wQe14ca1HCdvowuG9rsZo6FXs8vUfShUnM3UMvYCtBD9UUfcG7QzmBF3.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3505232128/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_1) ---
> # ¿De qué va la trama?… ---

>La historia sigue la vida de Joe Kingman, un quarterback estrella del fútbol americano que parece tenerlo todo: fama, dinero, éxito y una vida de soltero perfectamente diseñada para girar en torno a su propio ego. Sin embargo, esta vida da una vuelta de 180° cuando de repente llega una pequeña niña llamada Payton, quién resulta ser su hija, fruto de una relación pasada. ---

>Esta nueva persona en su vida implica muchos cambios en la misma, sobre todo, el aprender a ser un padre, con varios tropiezos en el camino como el dejar a Peyton olvidada en la apertura de su propio restaurante o resaltar que todo lo que esta en casa es suyo, no obstante, Joe pasa de diseñar jugadas en la cancha a lidiar con juguetes por toda la casa, agendas escolares y hasta clases de ballet clásico para conectar con la pequeña. Este cambio poco a poco, puede abrumarlo, pero le hará darse cuenta lo importante que esa niña en su vida ¿Dejará a un lado su egocentrismo y se involucrará más en la vida de su hija? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080042_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wX3o2XrCbBHXp26oVHLQhoYSfEDEzcqUfpZT1HtaZ3sp3KXepDs6tq5RiGS1ZfzhDYZ.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3589118208/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1_2) ---
> # Opinión personal ---

>Esta película siento que no fue muy valorada en su momento y que tocas temas muy importantes y que te invita a reflexionar, es una de mis favoritas no puedo negarlo, estaría de primer lugar en los filmes donde participa la Roca y es que, no es por más, ver a ese personaje egocéntrico a uno preocupado y sin miedo aprender a ser padre, con tal de estar con su pequeña, resulta cautivador y le da mucho dinamismo a la historia, más con sus altibajos, de aceptarla en contraste al cambio muy notorio en su vida, que hace que sienta que pierda parte de esa identidad que ha venido construyendo. Y eso es otro punto que quiero resaltar de esta película, esos altibajos que Joe tiene, de que por fin empieza a modificar cosas de su vida para involucrar a su hija, a volver a retroceder esa vida de soltero y estrella única, es algo normal, porque aunque sea el padre biológico, esta aprendiendo el rol como padre de un momento a otro, ya que ser padre es una posición que se erige lentamente y se ejerce a medida que te vayas involucrando en el mismo; de hecho alguien puede ocupar ese rol sin necesidad de llevar su sangre y viceversa, eres padre biológico, pero no lo ejecutas como tal. ---

>Otros de los puntos de esta historia, que me encanta y lo que más siento que la película realza a lo largo de la trama es una frase que dice la profesora de ballet de Payton: “No subestimes el poder de un padre” y siento que es algo muy importante de tomar en cuenta, pues el poder de un padre se mide más por como estas presente a por lo que das, ciertamente el proveer económicamente ayuda, pero el involucrarte emocionalmente en la vida de tu hijo, eso para mí, no tiene precio, ser ese apoyo en los momentos felices y oscuros, es el crear una conexión genuina con ese ser que depende de ti en sus primeros años de vida, es algo invaluable. Por ejemplo, mi papá siempre dice que él nos compro muchas cosas de niña y esto, básicamente no los saca y realmente estábamos agradecidas por ello, pero como me hubiese gustado que hubiese ido a los días del padre en el Colegio, o que cuando nos fuese mal en algo, en vez de juzgarnos, nos hubiese consolado, por ello, esta película es el claro ejemplo que construir una relación va más allá de dar algo material, es estar en todo momento para tu hijo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080123_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmFR1TqYZDpuidMgkXpKMhGPuBTf2HPvvrhB5wQP9BNygy7s9XETWhGczWx4zYgDWpG.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3387791616/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1) ---

>Ahora bien, con todo esto, no pude evitar recordar una escena que me da mucha gracia hasta el día de hoy, porque siento que muchos somos como Payton, y es que, por cuestiones de imagen, la hija lo ayuda con la prensa y eso, a que su imagen social no fuese por los pisos, pero con tal de que, la metiera en clases de ballet, es básicamente un trueque y eso yo lo hago con mi papá jajaja, no sé si también lo hacen, y es que le estuve diciendo a mi padrino que, yo le hago los favores a mi papá, pero por el peso que hago, le digo que me de una galleta por el mismo, las cuales no son caras y él acepta y bueno, mi padrino me dijo que así es su hija, que cuando le manda a comprar plátanos, le dice que si se puede comprar una Coca Cola y él también termina accediendo, así que, quisiera saber si son iguales ustedes con sus papás. Y bueno, ya para finalizar, las actuaciones muy buenas, la roca la considero un muy buen actor, a pesar de que siempre lo veo más en filmes de acción y todo, aquí deja un paso a la vulnerabilidad y todos hicieron un gran trabajo, para resumirlo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080207_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23uFTgg4yqLznQ7yHuRp8BWf8Xxqofamtoz7mg2i9GY7pTxPmGhjzifsf8bu5iZ8nGwDD.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3622672640/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3) ---
> # Puntos positivos… ---

>

- La química de los protagonistas: El dúo entre Dwayne Johnson y Madison Pettis es el motor de la película; su conexión se siente real y entrañable.
- La versatilidad de \

: Fue de los primeros papeles donde demostró que podía salir de la acción, reírse de sí mismo, usar mallas de ballet y mostrar vulnerabilidad. - Un gran mensaje sobre la paternidad: la película acierta al mostrar que ser padre va más allá de dar dinero; se trata de presencia y tiempo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080234_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2qC8ZqABcu1iQKtVa57AeXWqmH3LZ6zE3ZK3wYw9SkWpxuBo8Q2dQCicwSpnLvVnWo.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3538786560/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_2) ---
> # Puntos negativos… ---
>\n\n- Trama predecible y llena de clichés: Sigue al pie de la letra la fórmula Disney de \

. Sabes exactamente qué va a pasar. - Estereotipos del mundo del deporte: Retrata el fútbol americano y la vida de los atletas de una forma muy exagerada, superficial y caricaturesca por momentos. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-08_080314_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EogNKnyJe3ahf2cP2jEk81xDgmDA5zpmPtDLn7iKJQZvnJJf5jBWJ5MVHxw4C9fnNt8.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0492956/mediaviewer/rm3555563776/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1) ---
> # Puntaje que le doy… ---
>7.5/10 Historia │ 8.8/10 Actuaciones │ 7.5/10 Sonido │ 8/10 Escenario │ 8.5/10 General ---

body.title: ‎Hive at $0.048: Should We Be Worried or Patient? ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎I won't lie, seeing Hive drop to around $0.048 was a bit painful for me. As someone who has been around long enough to remember when Hive was trading above $3, it's hard to believe how much things have changed. Back then, there was excitement everywhere. Many people believed Hive had a bright future and that the price would continue climbing.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSU2k9WRw8XbYcXisv8dQB8kTkUddC8ro88d6EdPh7bMW/Screenshot_20260608-122306_1.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZreZLpaaJeRiEPFwTCTJ6fYRa78RMf88SNkPeuiasN9i/Screenshot_20260608-121741_1.jpg 


‎And the situation is very different fast forward to today.
‎
‎After #Hive hitting a new all-time low, I was wondering whether this is finally the bottom or if the price can still go lower. The truth is that nobody actually knows. If there is one thing I have learned from crypto over the years, it is that the market hardly moves the way most people expect.
‎
‎Even though the price action looks terrible, I don't think price tells the whole story. Every day, I still see people just like me posting content, curating, playing games, and supporting communities on Hive. The blockchain is still active. In fact, some of the most dedicated users are the ones who stayed during the difficult times rather than during the bull market hype.
‎
‎That said, we also have to be realistic. Just because a coin has fallen a lot does not mean it can't fall further. We have seen that happen with many cryptocurrencies before. If market conditions remain weak, Hive could still experience more downside. So no one should completely rule that out.
‎
‎What gives me some hope is the fact that markets move in cycles. There was a time when many people thought crypto itself was finished, yet it always found a way to bounce back and climb up again. Whether Hive follows the same path will depend on adoption, development, and the ability of the community to keep building despite the low prices and I can some movement on the Blockchain which is a good sign.
‎
‎For me, I am trying not to focus too much on the daily chart. Watching every little price movement can be exhausting. But instead, I prefer to focus on creating content, engaging with others, and accumulating what I can. Those efforts will be rewarded when Hive eventually recovers because it's not a matter of if but a matter of when because it will surely recover. And at least, I was part of a community that continued to create value when things were tough.
‎
‎For now, I think patience is the key word. The future of Hive remains uncertain just like the crypto market, but one thing is certain, and that's the fact that people who remain active during difficult times are often the ones who appreciate the good times the most when they finally return.
‎
‎What are your thoughts? Do you think Hive has reached its bottom, or is there still more pain ahead?
‎
**Images are screenshot from coingecko**

‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)

body.title: The Beach Where You Can Walk on Water: Kızkumu Beach /  Denizin Üstünde Yürüten plaj; Kızkumu Plajı ( EN-TR)
body.body:
![IMG20260424105609 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaparHxGNjKfvsVvn6PYhRPrj44DtK8s2HHDrjraw2SDs/IMG20260424105609%20(2).jpg)

I don’t know if you feel the same way I do. Whenever I arrive at a place I’ve never seen before, I’m instantly filled with excitement at the beauty of nature. I want to capture every landscape I see, every corner I step into, and every beautiful scene I encounter. Just like the first explorer to settle in that region, I rediscover every detail around me, observing every beauty with great curiosity and admiration. Just like at Kızkumu Beach... 

[//]:# (!worldmappin 36.75938 lat 28.13032 long  d3scr)
>Bilmiyorum siz de benim gibi aynı duyguları yaşıyor musunuz? Daha önce hiç görmediğim bir yere geldiğimde doğanın güzelliği karşısında bir anda heyecanlanıyorum.  Gördüğüm her manzarayı , ayak bastığım her köşeyi  ve karşılaştığım her güzel kareyi ölümsüzleştirmek istiyorum. Sanki o bölgeye ilk yerleşen kaşif gibi  başı gibi, etrafımdaki her ayrıntıyı yeniden keşfediyor, her güzelliği büyük bir merak ve hayranlıkla izliyorum. Tıpkı Kızkumu plajında olduğu gibi... 


![IMG20260424104059.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKeNXekw45n3sm3qv7D8GEptQwvcmLbJ8wFJfC6G1HeP/IMG20260424104059.jpg)


![IMG20260424102827.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbEdXTXugR4gXqbQ92aWLiZ6BfChDNaYPTtALBGbCwKRG/IMG20260424102827.jpg)

![IMG20260424103024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdYnfd2EKbaYPNcrWJVKRWtf5Ku35eEkJqDFiQBbBkB53/IMG20260424103024.jpg)

![IMG20260424110730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeoWBdpaxa2QNdvQvQhhAoCchZHtPsv9DYgWWVA7jsb9k/IMG20260424110730.jpg)

Lately, we’ve turned our attention to the Aegean Region. I must admit that I’m getting more and more excited as we explore the Aegean. The more new places I see, the more I’ve come to admire the Aegean Coast.  We began our Aegean explorations this year in March. Our first stop was Ölüdeniz, with its turquoise-colored sea. Then, in mid-April, our path led us to Marmaris. We spent three days exploring Marmaris and its surroundings. I took the photos you see above at Kızkumu Beach, located in the Orhaniye neighborhood of Marmaris district in Muğla province. The most distinctive feature of Kızkumu Beach, situated about 30 minutes from the center of Marmaris, is that it gives you the sensation of walking right in the middle of the sea.


>Son zamanlarda rotamızı Ege Bölgesine çevirdik. İtiraf etmeliyim ki Ege'yi keşfedereken daha çok heyecanlıyorum. Yeni yerler gördükçe Ege Kıyısına daha çok hayran olmaya başladım.  Ege keşiflerimize bu yıl Mart ayında başladık.  İlk durağımız,  tukuaz renkli deniziyle  Ölüdeniz olmuştu. Ardından Nisan ayının ortalarında  yolumuz Marmaris'e düştü. Üç gün boyunca Marmaris ve çevresini gezdik. Yukarıda gördüğünüz resimleri  Muğla ilinin Marmaris ilçesindeki Orhaniye mahallesinde yer alan Kızkumu plajında çektim. Marmaris ilçe merkezine yaklaşık 30 dakika uzaklıkta yer alan Kızkumu Plajı'nın en önemli özelliği deniz ortasında yürüyormuş hissiyatını vermesidir.

![IMG20260424103104 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQSDXJNJ9CpUEpnA9cSYzLQvLun1uNjbUqE9x3GKVycz/IMG20260424103104%20(1).jpg)

![IMG20260424103550.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4G1coy5Rw9aFEnAeW1N1dSQ1e7xqXZ3KWHqE5LELTEG/IMG20260424103550.jpg)


![IMG20260424102804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnM5aiAM8zLvUx4r1KcZ2aDBvdLwLSrPQa7vRg4b3XAB/IMG20260424102804.jpg)

![IMG20260424103018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUtT4zc1Yxu4kuErjxxnqwzu9k41dbAKGS5F27rS4Lsmt/IMG20260424103018.jpg)

![IMG20260424104052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaK42LGxe86aMj1hgHySc5envCEfRvPxGFNMNehgnEWTx/IMG20260424104052.jpg)

Marmaris is home to one of the most beautiful corners of Muğla Province. On one side of the region lie mountains covered in pine forests, while on the other are coves sparkling with stunningly clear, deep-blue waters. This area ranks among the most captivating destinations, not only for its sea but also for its boat tours, nature hikes, and hidden coves waiting to be discovered. However, the beach that impressed us the most during our trip was Kızkumu Beach. When we first saw the beach, we initially thought we had arrived at an ordinary beach. But we were surprised to see a strip of sand extending into the sea. When you walk on the sand, you get the feeling that you’re walking right in the middle of the sea. I was surprised by the large number of boats docked along the shore. I suppose boat tours stop here for a break, or perhaps their routes pass through this area. There were quite a few privately owned boats. In a way, this place has turned into a small marina. 


>Marmaris, Muğla ilmizin en güzel köşelerinden birine sahip. Bölgenin bir tarafında çam ormanlarıyla kaplı dağlar, diğer tarafında ise, birbirinden güzel masmavi deniziyle ışıldayan koylar bulunuyor. Burası sadece deniziyle değil, tekne turları, doğa yürüyüşleri ve keşfedilmeyi bekleyen saklı koylarıyla en çok dikkat çeken bölgelerin başında geliyor. Ancak gezimiz boyunca bizi en çok etkileyen Kızkumu plajı oldu.  Plajı ilk gördüğümüzde ilk başlarda sıradan bir plaja geldiğimizi sandık. Fakat, denizin içinde uzanan bir kum şeridini görünce şaşırdık. Kumun üzerinde yürüdüğünüzde denizin ortasında yürüyormuşunuz hissine kapılıyorsunuz. Plajda kıyıya yanaşan teknelerin çokluğu beni şaşırtı. Sanırım burada tekne turları mola veriyor. Ya da güzergahları bu taraftan geçiyor. Kişiye ait teknelerinin sayısı oldukça fazlaydı. Burası bi bakıma küçük bir marina haline gelmiş. 

![IMG20260424103727.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd4fxi2ZzXgbUhMUMHUAu7sSqWCSzXorx4W5kJ1xdZb1T/IMG20260424103727.jpg)


![IMG20260424103821.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaNnKiKZ8ns7yw8ZUp9mj7mMRGMhFHrUaokdmvBk7ztkU/IMG20260424103821.jpg)

![IMG20260424103936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUq6Wc1aUdA4Xck4VNJYK6i3KtDiGXPzursiYUGCev1LR/IMG20260424103936.jpg)


![IMG20260424104424.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLP135NbWxg1mN1t4fJ2m3KVfXnnzQ5MY2jynwU3yFuS/IMG20260424104424.jpg)

![IMG20260424104520.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSvdB951cxPpUeAHvjdsKPnkthZJRpA6Zdh5nEjMfHi5/IMG20260424104520.jpg)

When we began our walk along the beach, the weather was calm. The sun wasn’t out, but white clouds adorned the sky in various shapes. The mountains, clad in green, stood tall and proud. The white boats moored along the shore added to the beauty, complementing the mountains and the white clouds.  It was as if the calm of the bay was bringing a postcard-perfect scene to life. A sandy path stretches for about 400 meters from the shore out into the middle of the sea.  Those walking on this shallow sandy path appear as if they are walking right in the middle of the sea.  This sandbar lies just one or two feet below the surface of the water. In some sections, as the water recedes, we can even see the sand in the middle of the sea.  The statue of the girl by the shore was placed here as a memorial to a legendary story that took place here.  They have named this statue the Princess Statue. 

>Plajda gezimize başladığımızda hava sakindi. Güneş yoktu ama beyaz bulutlar gökyüzünü farklı şekillerde süslemişti. Dağlar yeşil giysisini giymiş, özgürce güçlü duruşlarını sergiliyordu.  Kıyıda duran beyaz tekneler, dağları ve beyaz bulutları destekleyen bir güzellik ortaya koyuyordu.  Sanki körfezin dinginliği bir kartpostal görüntüsünü yaşatıyordu. Sahilden denizin ortasında doğru yaklaşık 400 metre boyunca uzanan bir kum yolu bulunuyor.  Sığ bir şekilde kalan bu kum yolunda yürüyenler sanki denizin ortasında yürüyormuş gibi görünüyor.  Bu kum yolu denizin bir veya iki karış altında kalıyor. Bazı bölümlerde suların alçalmasıyla birlikte kumu denizin ortasında bile görebiliyoruz.  Sahilin yanındaki kız heykeli ise, burada yaşanan efsane bir hikayenin anısı için koyulmuş.  Bu kız heykele de Prenses Heykeli adını vermişler. 

![IMG20260424103055.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2YDsgeBLggY1mmLaon1UAPVhNrpbo9H1eVNZUnLxv8i/IMG20260424103055.jpg)

![IMG20260424104226.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZbSyXsw7PEyUNsrSDsFqLHtFbWot81ZrExEdgGYFgz9g/IMG20260424104226.jpg)

![IMG20260424103557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP5JGnSKQDPyUaUxsnWhbsaLkotFTAnZafg67LgWfJfEp/IMG20260424103557.jpg)

![IMG20260424103210.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQaJGYus2AdbJqoVv4xDftdjJeRFkWmK4t1af3P54ckd3/IMG20260424103210.jpg)

![IMG20260424103340.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRb4LVc817hKCo2SE3i15ZrTJQpTHKVFpsZkYuYB36dar/IMG20260424103340.jpg)

![IMG20260424102810.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnmLt8dxjFFE56k1fregxEcExkZof4iShgFKEJ5g7VYe/IMG20260424102810.jpg)

![IMG20260424102739.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYxXoBNohieUsSRd9n6CoB7ZRNf6vpZLiAucL6UhWh7mb/IMG20260424102739.jpg)

Another detail that caught my eye on the beach was the colorful flowers—some growing naturally and others specially arranged and placed by the beachside businesses—right at the water’s edge. As I walked along the shore, the view of the sea and mountains peeking through the flowers and plants was absolutely beautiful. The boats anchored across the way add a special touch to this beauty. The calm waters of the bay, the lush green hills encircling the shore like a barrier, and the scent of pine mingling with the air give this place a very special and natural look. 


>Plajda dikkatimi çeken bir ayrıntı da kıyıda kumun hemen kenarında bazıları kendiliğinden bazıları da özel olarak hazırlanıp, sahil kenarındaki işletmeler tarafından konulan rengarenk çiçekler oldu. Kıyıda yürürken çiçeklerin ve bitkilerin arasından görünen deniz ve dağlar çok güzel görünüyor. Karşıda demirleyen tekneler ise, bu güzellliğe ayrı bir hava katıyorlar.  Körfezin sakin suları, kıyıyı bir abluka gibi çevreleyen yemyeşil tepeler ve havaya karışan çam kokusu burayı çok özel ve doğal bir görünüm kazandırmış. 


![IMG20260424104016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSqUK1ocqGvYga3tzPm9E6BS8RKF514ohJsF5bx3qPjgh/IMG20260424104016.jpg)


![IMG20260424103919.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfEbWs6hAKhNA1zLMUy9mfiyPB2gaVwAiXxhQw2r1pzce/IMG20260424103919.jpg)


![IMG20260424103734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbbrxUeS7LJPmV3n3yxGTRH1UiSF17Wtee2G4oh6VuM9w/IMG20260424103734.jpg)


![IMG20260424103739.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUEiLi2YPCW9hp7MeZZFGowNLEm1qFV1RP7ojBvceAFVZ/IMG20260424103739.jpg)

![IMG20260424111707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4sLXKyF3VeLEAcRydGNQezXmhSF3WHrqVSEQhK2hWeN/IMG20260424111707.jpg)

Just a short distance past Kızkumu Beach lies a private marina. On the way to the marina, you’ll find a row of charming guesthouses and bungalows along the roadside, each with its own front garden and lush greenery. Most of these establishments haven’t opened for the season yet. They’ve beautifully decorated the area, perfectly complementing the beach. The colorful flowers planted along the walking paths and the green grass placed along the edges have made the surroundings look absolutely beautiful. The cafes have created a true atmosphere of relaxation and vacation with their outdoor seating areas and the view across the way. The wooden bungalows are so luxurious and meticulously crafted that one feels as though they’ve escaped the chaos of daily life, even if just for a few days. 

>Kızkumu plajının biraz ilerisinde özel bir yat limanı bulunuyor. Yat limanına giderken yol kenarında birbirinden güzel ve önü bahçe ve yeşilliklerden oluşan çok güzel pansiyon ve bungalov evleri var. İşletmelerin çoğu sezonu henüz açmamış.  Bu işletmeler plaja yakışır bir şekilde etrafı çok güzel süslemişler. Yürüyüş yolları kenarlarında oluşturaulan renkli çiçekler ve kenarlara konulan yeşil otlar etrafı çok güzel göstermiş. Kafelerin önü oturma alanları ve karşıdan görünen manzara ile tam bir dinlenme ve tatil havası yaratılmaya çalışılmış. Ahşap bungalov evleri o kadar lüks ve titizlikle yapılmış ki; insan kendini birkaç günlüğüne de olsa günlük hayatın karmaşasından uzaklaşmış hissediyor. 


![IMG20260424111949.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRC2WbmPB1gdxutsWW7T2sXFNqJiog5JEehraSHLMB9sW/IMG20260424111949.jpg)


![IMG20260424105547.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetULQRb5hfULoUxtMsnrBTxQx9yeDy64LsF84AR2Xx9i/IMG20260424105547.jpg)


![IMG20260424105851.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUdptHhwdmPfdFLgba2hn38JmboVG3Q7gd78ZHJqpowuY/IMG20260424105851.jpg)


![IMG20260424111150.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYimsuGwUyWBWANxef9hqQisAikgCVgVP7vT4brSsq9yk/IMG20260424111150.jpg)


![IMG20260424105620 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWHJE2HYX1A5k7NNCA2hySjHM1L3npHZT5tbirRsWrKF/IMG20260424105620%20(1).jpg)

![IMG20260424111401.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQin4FADcYws5kfNqENpJWgUWKor8T4cyi9zZsdoF5jaS/IMG20260424111401.jpg)


![IMG20260424105529.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPmNH9sr96pFvtYFMkiCii5x1kZaLdq6Vi94raCY1b7QM/IMG20260424105529.jpg)

We spent about an hour and a half at the beach. As we walked along the shoreline, we tried to capture every beautiful scene we saw. The plants, grasses, and flowers along the shore have become so intertwined with this beach that they seem to have become an inseparable part of the sea’s deep-blue expanse. The boats moored along the shore demonstrated that this is not just a beach, but also an ideal destination for sea enthusiasts and those looking to take a boat tour. 

>Plajda yaklaşık bir buçuk saat kaldık. Plajın kıyı şeridi boyunca yürüyerek, gördüğümüz her güzel kareyi ölümsüzleştirmeye çalıştık. Kıyıda yer alan bitkiler, otlar ve çiçekler bu sahilde o kadar özleşmiş ki; sanki denizin masmavi görüntüsüyle ayrılmaz bir parça haline gelmişler. Kıyıya yanaşa tekneler ise, buranın sadece bir sahil değil, aynı zamanda deniz tutkunlarının ve tekne turu yapmak isteyenleri için de  ideal bir bölge olduğunu gösteriyordu.
