body.title: How to Choose the Best Packers and Movers for a Safe Relocation
body.body:
#

![ChatGPT Image Jun 8, 2026, 05_25_08 PM.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/c2780eee3097a2da9a33dc95a8a1351683edfefa4a3e2f96d62409ee66594603)



Relocating to a new home or office is an exciting milestone, but it can also be one of the most stressful experiences if not planned properly. From packing valuable belongings to transporting them safely, every step requires attention and expertise. Choosing the right moving company can make the entire process smooth, secure, and hassle-free. If you are planning a move in Jodhpur, selecting professional [Packers and Movers in Jodhpur](https://www.servicebazzar.com/jodhpur/packers-and-movers) is essential for ensuring the safety of your possessions and a stress-free relocation experience.

In this guide, we will explain how to choose the best moving company, what factors to consider, and how professional relocation services can help you move with confidence.

## Why Choosing the Right Packers and Movers Matters

Moving involves more than simply transporting items from one place to another. Furniture, electronics, kitchen appliances, documents, and personal belongings all need proper handling. A reliable moving company ensures that every item is packed securely, loaded carefully, transported safely, and delivered on time.

Hiring experienced **Movers and Packers Jodhpur** helps reduce the risks of damage, delays, and unnecessary expenses. Professional movers use quality packing materials, trained staff, and suitable transportation vehicles to protect your belongings throughout the journey.

## Understand Your Relocation Requirements

Before selecting a moving company, determine the type of relocation you need. Different moving requirements may require specialized services.

Common relocation services include:

*   Residential relocation

*   Apartment shifting

*   Villa relocation

*   Office relocation

*   Local shifting

*   Interstate moving

*   Vehicle transportation

*   Storage solutions

Understanding your requirements helps you find a company that specializes in the services you need, whether it is **Home Shifting Services Jodhpur** or commercial relocation solutions.

## Research Multiple Moving Companies

One of the biggest mistakes people make is choosing the first moving company they find online. Take time to research multiple providers and compare their services.

Look for companies that:

*   Have a professional website

*   Offer transparent pricing

*   Provide customer support

*   Have positive customer reviews

*   Have experience in the relocation industry

Reading online reviews can give valuable insights into customer experiences and service quality. Consistent positive feedback often indicates reliability and professionalism.

## Check Experience and Industry Expertise

Experience plays a significant role in relocation services. A company that has handled hundreds of moves understands the challenges involved and knows how to manage them efficiently.

When evaluating **Best Packers and Movers in Jodhpur**, ask questions such as:

*   How long have they been operating?

*   Do they handle local and long-distance moves?

*   Are their staff members trained?

*   What types of relocations do they specialize in?

Experienced movers are generally better equipped to handle fragile items, heavy furniture, and complex moving situations.

## Verify Company Credentials

A legitimate moving company should have proper registration and business documentation. Verifying credentials helps protect you from fraudulent operators.

Important checks include:

*   Business registration

*   GST registration

*   Company address verification

*   Contact details

*   Insurance availability

A trustworthy moving company will be transparent about its credentials and willing to share relevant information with potential customers.

## Request a Physical or Virtual Survey

Reliable movers typically conduct a pre-move survey before providing a final quotation. This assessment helps them understand:

*   Volume of goods

*   Packing requirements

*   Transportation needs

*   Access conditions at both locations

*   Special handling requirements

Avoid companies that provide unrealistic estimates without inspecting your belongings. Accurate surveys lead to more precise pricing and better planning.

## Compare Multiple Quotations

Price is important, but it should never be the only deciding factor. Extremely low quotes often indicate hidden charges or poor-quality services.

When comparing quotations, check:

*   Packing charges

*   Loading and unloading costs

*   Transportation fees

*   Insurance costs

*   Additional service charges

*   Taxes and applicable fees

The best value comes from a balance between affordability and service quality rather than choosing the cheapest option.

## Evaluate Packing Standards

Packing quality directly affects the safety of your belongings during transit. Professional movers use specialized materials designed to protect items from damage.

Quality packing materials include:

*   Bubble wrap

*   Corrugated sheets

*   Stretch film

*   Foam sheets

*   Strong cartons

*   Waterproof coverings

Reliable **House Relocation Services Jodhpur** prioritize safe packing to minimize the risk of breakage during transportation.

## Ask About Insurance Coverage

Even with professional handling, unforeseen circumstances can occur during relocation. Insurance provides financial protection against potential loss or damage.

Before hiring movers, ask:

*   What insurance options are available?

*   What items are covered?

*   What is the claim process?

*   Are there exclusions?

Insurance adds an extra layer of security and peace of mind during the moving process.

## Check Vehicle Quality and Transportation Facilities

The condition of transportation vehicles significantly impacts the safety of your belongings. Well-maintained vehicles reduce the chances of delays and damage.

Professional movers generally offer:

*   Closed-body trucks

*   GPS-enabled transportation

*   Secure loading systems

*   Proper tie-down equipment

Reliable transportation ensures that your belongings arrive safely and on schedule.

## Consider Local Expertise

Local knowledge can make a substantial difference in relocation efficiency. Experienced **Local Packers and Movers Jodhpur** understand the city's roads, traffic patterns, residential regulations, and logistical challenges.

Benefits of hiring local experts include:

*   Faster service

*   Better route planning

*   Improved coordination

*   Reduced transportation delays

*   Better understanding of local requirements

Their familiarity with Jodhpur helps ensure smoother relocation operations.

## Review Customer Testimonials

Customer feedback is one of the most reliable indicators of service quality. Read reviews across multiple platforms to gain a balanced perspective.

Look for comments about:

*   Timely delivery

*   Staff behavior

*   Packing quality

*   Pricing transparency

*   Problem resolution

A strong reputation is often a sign of consistent service performance.

## Evaluate Customer Support

Good customer service is essential throughout the relocation process. Responsive support teams help address concerns quickly and keep customers informed.

Signs of quality customer support include:

*   Prompt responses

*   Clear communication

*   Professional behavior

*   Accurate information

*   Regular updates

Strong communication reduces uncertainty and improves the overall moving experience.

## Office Relocation Requires Specialized Planning

Businesses planning to relocate need professional assistance to minimize downtime and maintain productivity.

Experienced providers offering **Office Shifting Services Jodhpur** understand the importance of careful planning and efficient execution.

Office relocation services typically include:

*   Workstation dismantling

*   IT equipment handling

*   Document transportation

*   Furniture relocation

*   Reinstallation support

Choosing experienced office movers helps businesses resume operations quickly after relocation.

## Avoid Common Mistakes When Hiring Movers

Many relocation problems occur because customers overlook important details.

Common mistakes include:

### Choosing Based Only on Price

The cheapest option may result in poor service quality or hidden charges.

### Not Checking Reviews

Ignoring customer feedback can lead to hiring unreliable service providers.

### Failing to Verify Credentials

Always confirm the company's legitimacy before making any payment.

### Ignoring Insurance

Insurance protects your belongings against unexpected incidents.

### Waiting Until the Last Minute

Early planning provides more options and better pricing.

Avoiding these mistakes can save time, money, and unnecessary stress.

## Why Professional Movers Are Worth the Investment

While some people attempt DIY moving to save money, professional relocation services often provide better value in the long run.

Advantages include:

*   Time savings

*   Reduced physical effort

*   Professional packing

*   Safer transportation

*   Lower risk of damage

*   Efficient relocation process

Professional movers handle the complex logistics, allowing you to focus on settling into your new location.

## Finding Reliable Moving Services Through Trusted Platforms

Today, many people rely on online business directories and service platforms to discover trusted relocation providers. These platforms allow users to compare services, read reviews, and connect with verified movers.

[Service Bazzar](https://www.servicebazzar.com) helps users explore reliable relocation companies, compare service providers, and make informed decisions based on their specific moving requirements. This makes it easier for customers in Jodhpur to find trusted professionals for safe and efficient relocation services.

## Final Thoughts

Choosing the right moving company is one of the most important decisions during relocation. Taking time to research providers, compare quotes, verify credentials, and evaluate service quality can help you avoid unnecessary complications.

Whether you need residential relocation, office shifting, or local moving assistance, hiring professional **Packers and Movers in Jodhpur** ensures a safer and more organized moving experience. By focusing on experience, transparency, customer reviews, packing quality, and insurance coverage, you can confidently select a trusted moving partner.

A successful relocation starts with careful planning and the right team. When you choose experienced professionals, you can enjoy a smooth transition to your new home or office without the stress and uncertainty that often accompany moving.




---

body.title: Learn Creative Coding (#88) - Personal Data Art: Quantified Self
body.body:
# Learn Creative Coding (#88) - Personal Data Art: Quantified Self

![cc-banner](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9RYLxs6ywP2gJeBtqGUXwsEnG48CajXQnakcwD6Tf7S/cc-banner-magenta.png)

Last episode we worked with real-time data streams -- WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, rolling buffers, smoothing, spike detection, connection health indicators, batching fast data, and the accumulation technique that turns a canvas into a long-exposure data photograph. Everything was alive and flowing. But here's the thing: all the data sources we've used throughout this arc -- geographic coordinates, timestamps, network connections, text corpora, live price feeds -- came from *outside*. External data about external things. The most intimate data source hasn't been touched yet: you.

Your step count. Your sleep patterns. Your screen time. What music you listened to this week. How many coffees you drank. When you felt happy, anxious, bored, focused. The data of a lived life. Personal data art turns the lens inward. Instead of visualizing earthquakes or stock tickers, you visualize yourself -- your habits, your rhythms, the patterns you can't see while you're living them. And the result is the most honest kind of data art there is.

This episode is about the quantified self as creative material. We'll look at the Dear Data project (the defining work in this space), explore manual vs automatic data collection, design personal visual languages, build week-long and year-long data portraits, compare your data against someone else's, and wrestle with the privacy question that sits at the heart of it all. We used mapping techniques from episode 82, temporal layouts from episode 84, and text analysis from episode 86 -- all of those apply here, but with data that's uniquely yours.

## Dear Data: the project that defined it all

In 2014, Giorgia Lupi and Stefanie Posavec started a year-long project. Each week, they picked a theme -- complaints, phone usage, desires, laughter, doors, jealousy -- tracked data about that theme for seven days, then drew a hand-made visualization on a postcard and mailed it across the Atlantic. Lupi in New York, Posavec in London. Fifty-two weeks, fifty-two postcards each.

Dear Data is the reference point for personal data art. Not because the visualizations are technically complex (they're hand-drawn, sometimes messy), but because the project demonstrated something important: personal data art is a practice, not a product. The act of tracking changes how you pay attention. You notice things you normally filter out. How many times did you complain today? You don't know until you start counting. And once you start counting, you become aware of the pattern, and the pattern changes because you're watching it.

The postcards themselves are beautiful -- custom visual encodings invented fresh each week. One week, complaints are represented as colored spirals where the coil tightness indicates intensity. Another week, phone pickups are dots arranged in a timeline where color indicates the reason (boredom, notification, intentional). There's no standard chart type. Every week invents its own visual language. The legend IS part of the artwork.

We can't mail postcards in code, but we can build the same practice digitally. Track, encode, visualize, reflect.

## Manual vs automatic: two kinds of personal data

Personal data comes from two sources, and they feel completely different.

**Automatic data** is effortless. Your phone tracks screen time without asking. A fitness tracker logs steps, heart rate, sleep duration. Spotify wraps your listening history into neat JSON. Bank transactions record every purchase with timestamps and amounts. The data exists whether you think about it or not. It's comprehensive, precise, and emotionally flat. You didn't *choose* to record it -- a machine did.

**Manual data** requires discipline. You decide to track your mood on a 1-10 scale, five times a day. You tally how many times you said \

body.title: Chicken Cheese Bread.
body.body:
Hello! Today i am here with another delicious recipe of chicken cheese bread baked in electric oven. 
---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtzym7xq6FewLDh1ndWbEMhgKLzYrfLWrhpXU5vRAs3j/1780919927183.jpg)

---
## Dough
3 cups all-purpose flour
1 tbsp sugar
1 tsp salt
2 tsp instant yeast
1 cup warm milk
2 tbsp oil or melted butter
1 egg
---
## Filling
2 cups cooked shredded chicken
1 cup mozzarella cheese
½ cup cheddar cheese
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp black pepper
Salt to taste
---
## Method
Mix dough ingredients and knead for 8–10 minutes until soft. 
Cover and let rise for 1 hour or until double in size. 
Mix all filling ingredients together. 
Roll dough into a large rectangle.
Remeber to Place the filling down the center
Cut diagonal strips on both sides of the dough of around 1 inch each. 
Fold the strips alternately over one another filling to create a braid design
Brush with beatan egg yolk and sprinkle sesame seeds if desired.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25–30 minutes until golden brown. Make sure the oven is preheated for 0 mins. 
Let cool for 5–10 minutes before slicing.
This is often served with tea or fresh juice. 
---

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZiwN5tYiyiDMaeUXhLaAwPa2DtUyBAS1mUTGZkpLB4o/PXL_20260606_143929209.webp)

----------------------------------

As I mentioned in the post from my main account, it was a rough weekend for my nephew and his travel baseball team.  While his school has been quite good the past couple of years, his travel team continues to deal with the same struggles.  I think part of it just the fact that the team is something one of the dad's decided to throw together to keep the kids engaged and active.  I don't think it was every really meant to be an elite group of kids playing at a high level, but maybe I am wrong.  

The Raiders played three games this weekend losing the first game 17 to 0 (I was at that game), the second game they lost 14 to 0, and the third game they played on Sunday they lost 9 to 2.  

The funny thing is, there are a few small things I think they could do differently that would help them out quite a bit.  Of course, on paper and in practice are two entirely different things.  

Despite the losses, the team seemed to be in good spirits. I am not sure I would be able to say the same if I were in that position.  It's going to be interesting to see where this nephew falls as far as sports are concerned.  His younger brother has seemed to already make a choice that he would rather just play basketball.  It's questionable if he will play football at all this year and he gave up on baseball fairly quickly.  

Meanwhile, his older brother has tried just about every sport out there from football to baseball, basketball, and even wrestling.  Word on the street now is that he has his eye on joining the golf team when he finally gets to the high school level.  Like I said, it is going to be interesting to see where he eventually ends up.

At this point, I wouldn't even try to guess. 

I have to admire his willingness to try just about anything.  I don't think I would have had that confidence when I was his age.  Heck, I still don't have that confidence even now.  At some point we are going to need to get back down state to watch his younger brother play some basketball.  They just had their media day and I think the season is going to be ramping up soon.  In addition to that, we need to get down and see our niece play a game with her softball team.  

It's going to be quite a change from the level of play we have gotten used to over the years with our older nieces.  I still remember those days though when they could barely get the ball over the plate as pitchers.  It's going to bring back a lot of memories for sure!

body.title: Mythen und Fakten zu Wärmepumpen
body.body:
#  Wärmepumpen: Die Zukunft des Heizens? – Ein Rückblick auf den Experten-Vortrag im Talbahnhof 🏡🔥

In einem spannenden Vortrag hat uns der Experte **Josef Peuker** tief in die Welt der Wärmepumpen entführt. In einer Zeit, in der die Energiewende und das Bewusstsein für Klimaschutz immer wichtiger werden, ist das Verständnis dieser Technologie essenziell für jeden Hausbesitzer.

Hier ist eine Zusammenfassung der wichtigsten Erkenntnisse für alle, die ihre Heizlösung modernisieren möchten.
Ich (Achim) habe sie mitgeschnitten und zusammen mit einer KI aufbereitet.

---

## 🌡️ Wie funktioniert eine Wärmepumpe eigentlich?

Das Grundprinzip ist eigentlich faszinierend einfach: Eine Wärmepumpe nutzt die vorhandene Energie aus der Umgebung (Luft, Erde oder Wasser), um sie auf ein höheres Temperaturniveau für das Haus anzuheben. Die Wärmepumpe \

quasi ein paar Grad Celsius von Draußen nach drinnen.

Der Prozess basiert auf drei physikalischen Schritten:
1. **Verdampfen:** Ein Kältemittel nimmt die Wärme aus der Umgebung auf und verdampft dabei.
2. **Komprimieren:** Durch das Zusammendrücken des Gases (Kompressor) steigt die Temperatur massiv an. (Das kennen wir von einer Luftpumpe)
3. **Kondensieren:** Das heiße Gas gibt die Wärme an den Heizkreislauf ab 
4. **Entspannen:** Das Kältemittel wird wieder flüssig

Für dieses \

wird Strom gebraucht. Der Faktor zwischen eingeführter und rausgeholter Energie nennt man Wirkungsgrad oder auch COP (Siehe weiter unten).

Wir benutzen dieses Prinzip in fast jedem Haushalt seit über hundert Jahren (ganz ohne Diskussionen) mit unseren Kühlschränken und Klimaanlagen.


---

## 🌍 Die verschiedenen Wärmequellen

Nicht jede Wärmepumpe arbeitet gleich. Es kommt darauf an, woher die Energie \

wird:

* **Luft-Wasser-Wärmepumpen:** Die am weitesten verbreitete Lösung. Sie entnehmen die Wärme direkt aus der Außenluft. Sie sind günstig und einfach zu installieren, verlieren aber bei extrem kalten Außentemperaturen an Effizienz.
* **Erdwärme (Geothermie):** Über Sonden oder Kollektoren wird die konstante Wärme aus dem Boden genutzt. Das ist extrem effizient, aber in der Anschaffung deutlich teurer und oft genehmigungspflichtig.
* **Wasser-Wasser-Wärmepumpen:** Nutzen die Wärme aus Grundwasser oder Oberflächenwasser.


![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23vi6KX9QZYfGgPpr1QwHDr8RkL7ekrAhA1akyRXf2ofaLy41kXhaCeC2XmXyWD3WmjNR.png)


---

## 📊 Effizienz verstehen: COP und SCOP

Wenn man über Wärmepumpen spricht, fallen ständig Begriffe wie **COP** und **SCOP**. Aber was bedeuten sie?

* **COP (Coefficient of Performance):** Der Momentanwert. Er sagt aus, wie viel Wärme man aus einem Kilowatt Strom bekommt (z.B. COP von 4 bedeutet: 1 kW Strom -> 4 kW Wärme).
* **SCOP (Seasonal COP):** Der viel wichtigere Wert für den Alltag! Er betrachtet die Effizienz über das gesamte Jahr hinweg und berücksichtigt wechselnde Außentemperaturen.
* **Jahresarbeitszahl (JAZ):** Die reale Effizienz, die man am Ende des Jahres tatsächlich im Haus gemessen hat.

---
## Sind Wärmepumpen für Altbauten geeignet?

Im Prinzip ja. Man sollte natürlich eine möglichst große Abstrahlfläche haben (z.B. Fußbodenheizung) um die Vorlauftempereatur niedrig zu halten. Das geht aber auch mit bestimmten Heizkörpern. Die guten alten Guss-Radiatoren sind da gar nicht mal so schlecht:

![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23tbyk3vmPEFjt53KPxw7zFW1bDNsgSuctZtvPFiQaXk5RmmG7c7wQpvMz5d5F9D2RRpC.png)

Da aber so oder so geheizt werden muss und Gas und Öl immer teurer werden (wogegen die Stromkosten wohl eher stagnieren werden) ist auf lange Sicht eine Wärmepumpe besser. 


## Was alles saniert werden sollte
Um ein altes Haus zu sanieren, muss u.a. folgendes getan werden:
- Die Heizung muss getauscht werden
- Das Dach muss gedämmt werden
- Die Außenwände müssen gedämmt werden
- Die Fenster und Türen müssen ausgetauscht werden
- ...

Würden alle Maßnahmen umgesetzt, dann kommen locker 200.000 € zusammen.
Daher ist es sinnvoll erst mal nur einzelne Maßnahmen umzusetzen. Jede für sich veringert die Heizkosten um x Prozent, aber die Kurve ist abnehmend. D.h. Wenn 3 von diesen Maßnahmen schon umgesetzt wurden, liegen die Heizkosten bei z.B. 40% des ursprünglichen Verbrauches. Jede weitere Maßnahme kostet zwar viel, bringt aber immer weniger Ersparnis. 


## 💰 Kosten, Förderung und Wirtschaftlichkeit

Die Anschaffung einer Wärmepumpe ist eine Investition, die sich langfristig auszahlt. Besonders attraktiv sind die aktuellen Förderungen (z.B. über die KfW):

* **Grundförderung:** Oft ca. 30%.
* **Bonuszahlungen:** Zusätzliche Prozente für Schnelligkeit, hohe Effizienz oder bei geringerem Einkommen.
* **Wichtig:** Eine gute Planung durch einen Energieberater ist der Schlüssel, um die maximale Förderung zu sichern!

**Tipp:** Unterschätzen Sie nicht die Heizungshydraulik! Ein guter hydraulischer Abgleich sorgt dafür, dass die Wärme gleichmäßig im Haus verteilt wird und die Pumpe nicht unnötig \

(ständig ein- und ausschalten) muss. Auch sollte eher eine etwas zu kleine, als zu große Pumpe installiert werden.

**Tipp:** Hier im Westen von Deutschland lohnt es sich auch mal über die Grenze zu schauen. Die Niederländer und Belgier machen oftmals bessere Preise, als die Deutschen Anbieter.

---
## Ein Beispiel von einem Einfamilienhaus


![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/Ep3fDbJKH8jTUYPqgiVLEFuSFiubMnobyUA2sx6Pi8RMDzkDbUibyqG8bZtZUCcpHDL.png)


![Stromverbrauch](https://f005.backblazeb2.com/file/helbardor/file_100---1105b67d-af05-474a-ab15-e550a355ee03.jpg)



---
## 💡 Fazit

Wärmepumpen sind keine Zukunftsmusik mehr – sie sind heute bereits eine extrem effiziente und zuverlässige Technologie. Ob Luft, Erde oder Wasser: Die richtige Wahl hängt von Ihrem Haus, Ihrem Budget und Ihren langfristigen Zielen ab.



---
*Dieser Beitrag basiert auf dem Vortrag von Josef Peuker im Talbahnhof.*


![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23vi4KpVfkRwaxcxLWmh1CF2ddf3Txv2mmfwDXY5yPXpcZeFy8Ko7vt27f8zSD9iENCJQ.png)

body.title: Companionship Over Everything.
body.body:
Huhm, this is a very deep one. But honestly, if I had a choice I would choose to be in a relationship.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaSQyLMCBkQAxPEafVpvf4EGD2VeKikwp2SBmowMmSqGp/1000017093.jpg


Everything is a matter of choice, some prefer being single, they want their space, they enjoy the freedom that comes with it, and most especially that love that they could do anything and make whatever decisions they like without having to consider the other person. And honestly, there's nothing wrong with it, it's their choice, we can't all be the same. So it is understandable.




But for me, I would still choose to be in a relationship. Even though I've had to go through various experiences, heartbreaks, and all in relationships, still I believe so much in love and companionship. I've learnt to not allow my experiences make me become bitter, but better. I have trusted the wrong people, I have invested my time, I have spent my money, I have sacrificed a lot in relationships that at the end of the day, it didn't end they I thought. And often times, it left me thinking if love was  really worth it.


Even still, I believe in it.


To me, there's just something unique and special about having a partner, you know.... Like there's someone who actually loves you, check in on you, genuinely cares for you, considers you, listens to you, understands you, stand by you in anything... Someone who reminds you that you do not have to face life and what it throws at you alone.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUJMXdkb2XH6yGRMJAPFCZ5DAdZrGegPyRsURkwjdRbVA/1000004965.jpg



One of the best gifts life has to offer is companionship. I personally love the idea of a companion, of a relationship. There are times that the world can be overwhelming and all, but a good partner can make the weight/burdens feel me lighter.



So, if I had a choice, I would choose a healthy and loving relationship over being single. It's a matter of choice, and that is mine. It's not as if I can't live my life, but I just love companionship, I love to have a partner, someone I can call *\

* and vice versa.




🌹

**Images are mine.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

❣️❣️❣️

body.title: 🦆 Качечки, які обпливли пів світу і допомогли вченим
body.body: Уявіть наймасштабніший океанографічний експеримент в історії. Мільярдні бюджети, супутники, суперкомп’ютери, складні датчики, експедиції в штормах… А тепер забудьте все це. Бо найкращими дослідниками Світового океану стали… 28 800 пластикових качечок для ванни.
alt=\

/> Так-так. Тих самих жовти пузатих качечок. Ці дитячі іграшки випадково зробили для науки більше, ніж десятки дорогих експедицій. Січень 1992 року. Контейнеровоз Ever Laurel потрапляє в шторм посеред Тихого океану. Це не просто кораблик — це плавучий багатоповерховий склад, який тягне тисячі контейнерів. Шторм ламає кріплення, і 12 контейнерів летять у воду. В одному — телевізори. В іншому — одяг, запчастини, техніка. Все це моментально йде на дно. А в одному контейнері сиділа качина армія. 28 800 пластикових качок, жабок, бобрів і черепашок. І от саме цей контейнер розколовся так вдало, що іграшки не затонули, а висипались у океан і вирушили у власну кругосвітню подорож. Далі почалося найцікавіше.
alt=\

/>

Одні качечки прибило до берегів Аляски. Інші допливли до Японії.  
Частина пройшла через Берингову протоку, вмерзла в арктичний лід, роками дрейфувала разом із кригою, а потім відтанула й випливла вже в Атлантичному океані.

Деякі подолали майже 29 тисяч кілометрів. Фактично ці жовті пластикові іграшки обпливли пів планети.

Океанографи були в захваті. Бо качки зробили те, що вчені роками намагалися змоделювати лише на комп’ютерах: показали реальні маршрути океанічних течій.

Саме завдяки цій історії вдалося перевірити й уточнити моделі на кшталт OSCUR — системи прогнозування поверхневих течій. Вчені краще зрозуміли, як океан переносить воду, сміття, нафту, рибу і взагалі будь-що між континентами.

І виявилось, що дитяча качечка за 2 долари іноді працює не гірше за дорогий науковий буй.

Але ця історія не тільки смішна. Вона нагадує дві важливі речі.

Перше — океан насправді єдиний. Це не окремі моря на карті, а одна велетенська жива система, де все пов’язане течіями, льодами й вітрами.

І друге — якщо маленька пластикова качка може проплисти через пів планети, то уявіть, куди потрапляє весь пластик, який людство щодня кидає у воду…

До речі, ті самі качечки сьогодні стали раритетом. Вицвілі, потерті океаном і льодами, вони інколи продаються колекціонерам за понад 1000 доларів.

Не кожна іграшка може похвалитися тим, що пережила Арктику, Тихий океан і людську цивілізацію.

Автори: Donovan Hohn, Андрій Уткін, Вікіпедія

body.title: The Universal Language of a Smile: Captured Moments of Pure Joy ✌️ 😊
body.body:
Hey! 👋
There is something incredibly powerful about the unfiltered joy of children. They don’t need much to be happy—just the company of friends, a moment of play, and a camera to flash a peace sign at.

![larm-rmah-AEaTUnvneik-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZzBpkG1Ts7wJqq1kVF8pPpqgz4KYz6ekLVVuaSaiuPM9/larm-rmah-AEaTUnvneik-unsplash.jpg)
<center>**Source:** Unsplash.com</center>
 * **What caught my eye:** Look at those smiles! Despite what looks like humble surroundings, the energy bouncing off this photo is electric. The chaotic mix of peace signs, the bright eyes, and the genuine laughter completely captivated me. It's a gentle reminder that joy isn't something we find in material things; it’s something we create and share.
### Reflection
In our fast-paced lives, we often get caught up worrying about the next big thing, the next milestone, or the daily stressors of life. But looking at this photo instantly grounded me. It reminded me to appreciate the simple moments—the raw, unedited, and beautiful slices of humanity that happen every day all around the world.
> \

— *Phyllis Diller*
> 
I wanted to share this piece of visual sunshine with my Hive family today. I hope it brings a little warmth to your feed and a smile to your face, no matter where you are or what kind of day you're having.
**What does this photo make you feel? Let’s chat in the comments!**
*Thank you for stopping by! If you enjoyed this post, feel free to upvote, reblog, and follow along for more daily inspirations.*

body.title: MY HAMSTER HAS BECOME A MOM!
body.body:
Guys, the day before yesterday I had only 1 hamster. Now I've 7 of them!!!

And it was a complete surprise for me that the hamster who had been given to me only 2 days before wasn't a small baby hamster boy but a grown up hamster girl that was pregnant!

I knew nothing about pregnancy of hamsters, and there were no signs of it! The pet was active, super fast, super positive, and we had no idea we would have such a surprise!

I was out when my son called me and said: 

_- Mom, somebody else except our hamster is moving into her cage...It seems to be its her babies..._

I was SHOCKED! And he was absolutely right - when I came back, 7 hamsters were waiting for me;))

OMG...we had to read much what to do and how not to cause harm to babies and to the Mom now.

She has to have very good nutrition, good conditions, protein food, vitamins and the main - NO TOUCHES TO BABIES otherwise she will feel another smell on them and she will reject from them.

Don't know what will be but we try our best to save thee tiny lives!

body.title: Comerong Island walk after shops : June 7 2026
body.body:
A different day - took my wife shopping. Normally she would do trips like this on her own or with a friend. No can do as she is still not driving. Did the shops and stopped at Two Figs Winery to pick up the quarterly wine pack plus a few bottles ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b9717480-64f4-44bc-be8d-ed0c28a4e3f7.jpg) Grevillea growing in the winery gardens - it is a single flower grevillea - not seen one like this before ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4feb9946-a337-49cc-b746-dad162be8d6b.jpg) View down the Shoalhaven River on a perfect wind free day - 20C perfect for a winter day. Our house is in this shot - left side of the river before the sea ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/86494c1e-d383-4d3e-9a35-e00ec63161df.jpg) View a bit across the river - houses are on the banks of the next river across - Crookhaven River ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/83942c6f-69be-445d-95ce-4536b7fb9f61.jpg) Never tire of these views ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a6dca77a-9182-462f-a5d1-9cba9fbc0bf0.jpg) Unloaded the shopping. Had some lunch and dropped my wife off at the pub. She wanted to listen to some music - our village receptionist sings in a band. I chose to walk Comerong Island for a couple of hours. Fab reflections along the river mouth. Walk crosses the sand of the closed river mouth and onto the island ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4731139f-6ab7-49d4-92c3-41da9ecd4d42.jpg) Orb weaver spider on the island side ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b4d9dbcd-bb39-44e9-9258-cb32ffc0ff52.jpg) At least 20 minute walk to reach the orchids - flowering corybas fimbriatus ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f9381d2c-844f-4630-badd-96c2c91cae2d.jpg) Side on of a different plant ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1b385801-511c-4ca9-9f76-d702225a5344.jpg) Was hoping to find one greenhood flowering - maybe a spike forming - guessing it is more likely another leaf ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/96d1b630-0566-4b2c-89dc-e2c9aab119d9.jpg) Fab mushroom form - bigger size made for an easier photo. About this point met up with a fellow pickleball player. I never meet walkers on this track - first one is someone I know. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2937216a-4d3b-4b95-8c78-4bbb2f3fa808.jpg) Next orchid up - same type - probably also a new leaf only ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4745cca7-72d2-44c2-a05f-e9171619a5f3.jpg) This leaf is different with shorter pedicels - maybe a spike or a new leaf forming ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4ee1639b-82eb-459d-91e3-6863b53c5fd8.jpg) Stages of opening for corybas fimbriatus. Can just see the bristles poking out under the helmet ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/256b64a8-b1ea-4ee6-880a-4490c932714c.jpg) Acianthus fornicatus orchid - pixie caps - saw only a few flowering ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0355d7e4-7dba-4850-9a51-ae0e528fd2e1.jpg) Front on shot of corybas fimbriatus. Got to say am looking forward to the next few weeks - will be a solid greenhood season. Too bad it is a 30 minute walk from where I park the bike and then 15 to the orchids. Still quicker than driving around and paying the $10 ferry fee. Time to think E-fatbike - smash those 40 minutes into 10 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c978b18f-67fd-480d-af53-34cce6121350.jpg) Coolangatta Mountain reflecting on Shoalhaven River on a rising tide ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/52fd621f-0ba4-4208-b061-38c62ea47913.jpg) Fabulous reflection shot in afternoon light. The stranded yacht has since been recovered ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/00aac0da-8cd8-4f71-9037-30d5014fa6a4.jpg) Coolangatta Mountain moods ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4b263d96-9177-4801-890d-0354d643b523.jpg) Listened to Priscilla over a deserved walk beer - my wife and her friend had really enjoyed the gig. I did not miss much as I could hear the music all the way to the island - probably a km away Our friend came over for drinks - brought the dog over. Lucy loves and orange squeaky ball we have - lots of fun Did cook a simple sausage BBQ for dinner - been a while

body.title: A Fun Birthday Celebration At “LA EDLEY RESORT” in Legazpi City, Albay!
body.body:
Hello to all amazing travelers across the globe! 🤗😍

Hello to all of my dear friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this wonderful @worldmappin community! 👋

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing fine right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another travel story of mine with you all.💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/242YBzrQcbMUfahUC3TMtogcsghdz319uFYmGWVtCWeLRFooQMS3gYXyW3cdi5agj4DNA.png)

Last month, my aunt invited our whole family to spend a day swimming at “LA EDLEY RESORT” in Legazpi City, Albay to celebrate the birthday of her son, Jaz. Everyone was excited about the trip because it had been a while since we had a family outing together. It was a great opportunity for us to relax, bond, and create wonderful memories.

![IMG_8837.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi62GaL6XjBakiGNZYdxc9qLwouPkwTaVBVDPqk5S5K6bKwfxiAiHHWiZAFFwvVbRUu.jpeg)

We all gathered early in the morning and boarded a rented van that my aunt had arranged for everyone. We left around 9:00 AM and enjoyed the ride while chatting, laughing, and listening to music. The trip took about an hour, and before we knew it, we had already arrived at the resort.

![IMG_5891.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoK6Mi2tEVk1CwpVwfvpA3q69swguVdnrsWSDaTM1Xofu6HWM1sYYm2oSWikYgmNdHB.jpeg)

![IMG_5892.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCDwC6xD8ZeFbaYLq1ScT3VHtVKRQi74Fw9pRJPANUe2JeUCFqy7TNhUsPG5VBgwLsR.jpeg)

![IMG_6073.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi4KPWbZa8mnM3Gwrbt29QUquG1uZr7djCKJLMfurFCfxrE1LuPi72J178HyMDsCzHx.jpeg)

Upon arriving at “La Edley Resort”, I immediately noticed how peaceful and beautiful the place was. There were only a few visitors at that time, so it almost felt like we had the entire resort to ourselves. The atmosphere was very relaxing because there were many trees surrounding the area, providing fresh air and plenty of shade. It was the perfect place to escape the heat and enjoy nature.

![IMG_5915.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Ep3eHmaeBdcpugJLjsmbmvZSJNcLTgkSrr6Cp3YriqHm6f1tX9gwZ5E87kNArMCxve5.jpeg)

![IMG_5913.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Ep3eFzzjbawi5o23ifNHinDQjKaMPaikf27MTU4k4xCoYnZjG3weNDEzSYUwNzEC2Mc.jpeg)

One thing I really liked about the resort was that it had 3 swimming pools suitable for both kids and adults. My son and his uncle were especially excited and wasted no time jumping into the water. The adults also enjoyed swimming and cooling off from the warm weather. Throughout the day, everyone had fun splashing around, taking photos, and spending quality time together.

![IMG_5919.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpNmw82o2GtDZx4cbff7H23zQK7nNDxyaMpHs4GFBE5dy3xp2RubSd5ywAxv6Lgygq5.jpeg)


![IMG_5921.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Eq5DWNXbsWeS42K33sNPQYkXLqjn4MH7EQqxkxXsfs66aSXeL4uih5HRgXKsnaEr9Wp.jpeg)
![IMG_5918.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EqDhh7p7niBy7VNbLne6UwFAcCpC32THwYsu9SWinHrJ9kY9LQHo9gksXuyfWXa6zwa.jpeg)

![IMG_5920.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EqUbtCmhz18NhJzGbeVQTMgNwT4FMrTSudMH5JEgr2Gk5m5GrGdibQz9k31e1kzFtki.jpeg)

The resort had plenty of tables and benches where family could comfortably stay and enjoy their food. We shared a delicious lunch and some snacks while chatting and celebrating Jaz’s birthday. I also noticed that the resort offers rooms for guests who want to stay overnight, which makes it a good option for longer family vacations.

![IMG_5914.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpEHHjhDvNmUGFtf1SwKd3o5o59zhhb7iWSCiSzihQzsRmvDYzT4icGTrwPAEZZT3QL.jpeg)

![IMG_5908.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EogNppXtAJjPuSZPCHzPnVxVXQWdnmab7kbqDD69dbFRWwTdNv8guEQnZvPtVyC9CAn.jpeg)

![IMG_5910.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoiX9sHZ3GzJeUoLoVH3chkick4VidE99rze39kEf9JZKtNhZWzZXWXQrfER528SqWS.jpeg)

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.✍️👩‍💻

Lots of love,
LJ💗

I think we should respect the will of creators who do not want to be shared. Some create for Hive and only for Hive, perhaps wanting to remain anonymous for the rest of the Internet.

I've noticed one thing since I've been participating in RedditPosh. Many photographers have already paid for the hive and unfortunately I must admit that we are still losing more and I don't think we want to expose the ecosystem to the loss of most photographers. Photography is one of the most popular forms of communication on social media and it is worth doing everything not to lose it on the hive. And if such a photographer creates for hive and clearly marks, then we should respect it. Because we can lose everyone.

So maybe it's worth adding to the latest update of the contribution rules in HivePosh that if someone points out that they don't want to be shared further, we shouldn't do it?

Sorry for my English, I'm using a translator.

<div class=\

> Hello, fellow mushroom lovers, wherever you are, as usual, I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to go about your daily activities smoothly. I hope you all have a wonderful day. body.title: I spent a happy time strolling through, shopping and enjoying at the wet market, Lotus and the local festival in the downtown with my wife.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcPA9DNSPTNBZrWL5QjayHWaneqntWq1gA9BJ4ZfMVoB/1780908161930.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Our autistic son is back to special needs school. After missing school for 9 days, he returned to school today. So my wife and I are completely free to go anywhere or do anything from the morning until 2:00 PM, before we pick up our autistic son from school. We plan to visit the local festival in the downtown, today is the last day. This local festival is celebrated around the monument dedicated to the ancient city's founder and his wife. But before we go to the local festival, we stopped by the market in downtown. We need plastic bags in various sizes and some other things. 

The atmosphere of our journey this morning. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme58KgewYkJiuGVZf7ySBAn5dXxabeLbum4rjCBRzwF5s/1780906224618.jpg)

The atmosphere at the wet market in the downtown.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcDz8MErHH5Wf4RhjE6BZMBy1SL8JTtLXjBCNVPygrYjy/1780907028824.jpg)

After we recharge our energy, Let's go to the local festival. Yesterday and on other days, there were many parades, activities, and shows in this local festival. But today is the last day, so there are only food stalls open during the midday and afternoon. There are no activities or shows. But there are shows at night and food stalls. Night food stalls are more open than those in the daytime and afternoon. We walked around the food stalls and bought lunch and snacks to eat at home.

body.title: We without erasing me
body.body:
My belief is that a good relationship is not the one which cages us; rather, it gives us freedom a safe place to return to. So, If I had a choice, I would certainly choose to be in a relationship. My choice is maybe the result of my personal experiences. However, it does not mean that being single is a bad thing. I simply think life becomes richer when you have someone to share it with.  


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBvyrG3CC8TabwtMnRw893dMVrBP7PjtnWpUQrCWaEHp/1780919106128.jpg)


>**Relationship is not a cage**

Before going any further, I would like to make one thing clear, being in a relationship does not mean that one has to give up his individuality or personal space. Not a critic, but the contest’s picture expresses the same concept. Like there are: freedom, self-growth, travel, hobbies, peace and independence. On the other hand, there are shared experiences such as love, companionship, support, trust, etc. And, once again, this is a normal belief in the present world. We have taken relationships and freedom as two quite opposite poles, but they are not. The assumption that once I have entered into a relationship, my personal agency will be gone. I have never understood this concept. I can be free and, in a relationship, at the same time. I, actually we, can travel together.

>**A healthy relationship**

A healthy relationship is the one which does not take away our real self. I strongly believe that relationship is all about managing, understanding, caring and few changes. From my personal experience, both of us have quite the opposite personalities. It does interfere a lot in our lives, but by now, we have gotten used to it. I loved football; she hated it. She loved BTS; I hated them. Now, with the passage of time, we both watch both of these things together. Few things have changed though, however, thanks to immense love, I find those changes beautiful.

>**Joray Asmano P BAnta h (Marriages made in heaven)**

At the same time, there is this cultural lens – joray asmano p banta h - we grow up with in South Asia. The belief that relationships are written somewhere in destiny long before we ever meet the person. While I love to fantasize this traditional and emotional value; I personally see relationships a little differently. I believe destiny may bring two people together, in the same space. But what happens next is completely shaped by choices, efforts and understanding.

>Love is not just something that happens to us; it is something we actively build every single day.

Sounds poetic, right? Let me make it simple. In this chaotically beautiful life, we humans are full of relations. There are our parents, siblings, aunts, and uncles. The thing is most of these relations are not our choices. I cannot choose someone to be my genetical mother, but I do have a choice in finding the partner. However, even in this contemporary world, relationships are still surrounded by expectations, family approval, societal pressure, and the so-called idea of “perfect match”. It is like finding someone who fits a written script. I believe that no relationship becomes perfect on its own. It is all about creating something meaningful with someone through patience and shared experiences. A relationship is not a destined wooden piece which will fit perfectly, one needs to slowly learn to adjust its edges.

>**We without erasing I**

Another important thing I have realized is that love does not remove the “I”. It just reshapes it, of course, in a healthier way. I still have my own goals, interests and personal space. I still want to grow, build a good career, own a library and explore life. But now, instead of doing everything alone, I have someone who became a part of this journey. The fun part is our goals have increased rather than going down. Relationship is not about losing independence; it is about sharing independence. I can still be “me”, she can still be “she”.

Moreover, being in a healthy relationship comes with many benefits that go beyond just intimacy. There is emotional support during stressful times, where you have someone to lean on, someone who listens, understands and stands by you. Even small moments like talking after a hectic day, sharing meals or planning future goals, become more meaningful when experienced together. Especially in South Asian culture, where family and togetherness are highly valued, a strong relationship is a must.

>**Natural Viewpoint**

People often fear that relationships demand sacrifice of freedom, especially in our cultural setting where emotional attachment is sometimes confused with control. And this control thing is real. People most of the time hesitate to claim that in the name of liberalization. But a healthy relationship is not about control, it is about coordination. It is two people understanding that they can walk together without stepping on each other’s paths. Even when we disagree, we do not stop being ourselves. We learn, we adjust and sometimes we even influence each other in ways that improve both sides. Sometimes we fail to do so, but it does not make it multiplied by zero.

In the end, I do not see love as fate or destiny written in the stars or something that limits my choices. I see it as a decision I make every day. A decision to stay, to understand, to communicate, to fall and grow together. As they say, **“aik (1) or aik giyaran (11) hota h”.**

......................... 

Peace 🕊

........................ 

This is my entry for IndiaUnited [Contest](https://ecency.com/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-241078e50a4f4): If You Had a Choice, Would You Stay Single or Be in a Relationship?

body.title: Lobia Phalli ki Sabzi || Long Green Bean & Potato Curry
body.body:
## <center> Hello all Bloggers </center>

Hi guys...! How are you all, I hope you all are well.
Today my in this blog I will share with you guys a new recipe. 
Last time I shared the recipe of Dum Pukht Mutton, I am happy you all liked my recipe and gave me great feedback. 😍
Today I am going to share with you guys the recipe of Lobia Phalli ki Sabzi.

Let's see how I made it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCytkEaRNKV5hHz9t7s3wYDHqiTnVFcfynAkBwN2S8iP/1780890950539.png)

***

## <center> Ingredients </center>

-  Long Green Beans ( 500 grams )
-  Potatoes ( 250 grams )
-  Oil       ( 1 cup )
-  Onion  ( 50 grams )
-  Ginger-Garlic Paste ( 3 sp )
-  Water ( 2 cup )
-  Tomato  ( 50 grams )
-  Cumin seeds ( 1 tbsp )
-  Salt, turmeric & Ground red chillies ( according to taste )
-   chilli flexes, Cumin & Coriander Powder ( 1 sp )

***

## <center> Process </center>

Guys, so far I have shared most of the recipes with you, so today I am going to share a new dish with you guys. 
So, without wasting time, I will tell you how to make it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUjifQmeo6Mp5m8oEpRLjePCSMKD2NKRC7qZe3U7aqx1N/1780891251287.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBaXhtvhMo3anJRXPBnvs4cxCn3Y934DpSG4f826WZwR/1780891009618.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTymjGuh1pEiXyU4MMio5Xb4FQ7Vt4z7Uc7TgQzr2x5WP/1780891009687.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVmEQSQ1Cfj5qhY8H57agZ8pGcH195rhR7m7SqUiBnWhj/1780891009761.jpg)|
|-|-|

You can buy the fresh bean pods, which we call long green beans, from the  market or you can also remove the seeds yourself from the fresh long beans. 
So first I put cooking oil in a pan or pot and added the onion to it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma2AwNV6ZMSuGG254VZjS5b85W97pLLs5B4q3KmDVUWbt/1780891251227.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaN75dQdZnBofT14rgKbmRSZiSYUsssW9AgRFjj3i4VME/1780891009830.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ31M49vA7w3etUyv6czXL8okYmwEP85gPVNNNvyt9Sen/1780891009893.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPr6E4rrpZUPc8KGN76Xc9GDFkEwktcfAMBZgjudGVaiF/1780891088392.jpg)|
|-|-|

When the onion turned slightly brown, I added cumin seeds and fried them, then I added ginger-garlic paste to it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDtyLSwtQwYGXHGohoK4gp9s9QL1DSW3xSJjaztdUzZF/1780891088453.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRL8AgdyLi5wPgawy5W2mo7yQ7ikn7wo71i6HGe3BNBE5/1780891088505.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXDQbGdysqMUBnA4rUEDMbYJVPEfkMmUdGUHDAJT7MaWF/1780891088560.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1fwV9Y8amN3n9s6WttAEt5BxVC2mk5aseAeVABfMNp3/1780891088612.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I added chopped tomatoes to it and then ground spices which included salt, ground red chillies, turmeric, chili flakes, cumin and coriander powder. 
I roasted these spices for a while and then I added the green Lobia beans to it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXT5t8QmQyitpJx6HCbxAL6Fk3RFuCjVVwkvtaDGetioK/1780891191937.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7cDxk5Y3pc3zMhC8M57rtfiYDgXY6zCEjN3WsQqVSvP/1780891191992.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYRiXHAu4y2QDcfLV47SL9KaCfSp9cDvaaMEt3BsMr1N/1780891192050.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUH6ZG5zCJNvDnhMjQbyHv65ChhdZE5NbLbNvAnVDhueR/1780891192094.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I added chopped potatoes to it and roasted them for a while and now I added water to it and put it on the Steamer for about five to seven minutes. 
After removing the steamer, you can see that it has become a light gravy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdM5f1ejkiBPYJdEfQBFoN4cLb8U6bcPuWWKaLW8uom43/1780891192147.jpg)

This Long Bean & Potato Curry is a beautiful celebration of simple ingredients transformed into a hearty and flavorful meal. 
Nutritious, satisfying, and full of traditional flavors, this dish is a perfect example of how everyday ingredients can create something truly special and delicious.

***

## *Final Look:*

The tender long beans, fresh bean seeds, and soft potatoes come together in a rich tomato-onion gravy, creating a dish that is both wholesome and comforting. 

Its vibrant colors, rustic texture, and homemade charm reflect the care and attention poured into every step of the cooking process. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8vNLNULdJmDu1UD5U32gFmB5u3gg96He7M5jhAtRKVK/1780891251108.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwumHt3Few5HzPVR4BxT6Lz6LW6sq6m2bBU8zFJyfZEJ/1780891251173.jpg)

***
***

I hope you all like my recipe. I will wait for your comments. Now we will meet in the next post with a new recipe. Until then, Good Bye...🤗

body.title: The town of Vrsar in Istria
body.body:
Dear friend,
Today I will take you through a small town in Croatia called Vrsar with a picture and a story.
Vrsar is located in Istria, the largest peninsula of the Adriatic Sea. It is located in the northeast of the Adriatic coast.
Vrasar is a coastal town, located about 10 km from the larger city of Poreč. It is a fishing town, and apart from fishing, the cultivation of vines and of course tourism is also developed. It has its own marina, old buildings, a church with a campanile, a specific bell.
![718309737_27524374597184579_6444608209180824850_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goga14/244xsgiB2Xxyvbc5epHtMS3iZ8rK2txrcA28DfQByzapXE2KYuMmYWVB3SyVmwB5RRFcH.jpg)

body.title: Our Fun Night: Graduation Party
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUKa4nma6S1cVCcSDQkvVAgyLbjsD1abD2WAGhQHtGbfZ/1780900377083.png)

Hello everyone here in the Bayanihive community! 👋
 
Today I want to share a happy night we had recently.

We got invited by our friend Ella to celebrate her college graduation. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTE4sy7ThpEzp57LHFd14omtezApdxV8tpgKqbTBYeJeg/1780900401378.jpg)

Of course, we couldn’t go empty-handed. 

Since we know Ella really loves wine, we decided to get her a bottle of red wine. 😁

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV9iSCe74PbMAXrqktrvVoTyH1j1MCfqpmUtoco5JGncF/1780900420522.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeG7MQB5wDeJoDtND94j4uusJGs6CZ2xBw5hV57ytFUrL/1780900420630.jpg)

We made it look nice by tying a ribbon around it and writing a short dedication. 

After preparing it, we headed to the venue.

When we arrived, the place was already full of food. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUDHPJiE3xLJsqmrftfKbuXdSVRwBSv2gpBVpfkKhwEwk/1780900448183.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXoBN4XEG3pE6SN6KA7oH6GeP3HFm3cqJ5skMjKnRkksq/1780900448245.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNeQkaTmjdk4Qzv2zTCDjLsM2jYV5xygk8q3wWPVYhz88/1780900448322.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvBNYkymFg7KbcU984EbvJZgBBPRoqULbq9zpoD2XDKP/1780900448398.jpg)
 
They prepared everything from snacks to dinner, and it all looked delicious. 

There was pancit bihon, spaghetti, fried tilapia, mechado, puto, and more. 

We tried almost everything, and we loved every single one of them. 😋 The spaghetti was sweet, the tilapia was crispy, and the mechado was so tender and flavorful.

All of us ate happily and enjoyed every bite.

There were also two beautiful cakes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfCcvyzRQhMLyV3jYw6D8sY4sAu56tZ58ZBAYfHriaT5k/1780900498064.jpg)

We saw the chocolate one, and of course… we enjoyed it hahaha. It was sweet, soft, and so yummy. So perfect for dessert. 🤤

After everyone had eaten, there's a fun game for the kids. The Stop Dance! It was so cute and funny to watch the kids move, freeze, and run around. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTU59Edswy8gN3BiZbvuvAVMM2JePZiJvfNA3ehdCmAaB/1780900484603.jpg)

They are so energetic and happy that it turned into a dance showdown. Haha. 

We all cheered and laughed while watching them have the best time. The whole place became joyful and full of life because of it... Such a lovely sight.

And that’s the story of our wonderful night celebrating Ella’s graduation.  

Thank you so much for reading and joining me on this blog! 😁

body.title: Libel vs slander
body.body:
Defamation involves making untrue statements that damage someone’s reputation, and it is typically separated into two main forms. Legal systems distinguish between statements that are written or published and those that are spoken. Within this context of legal analysis, Libel vs slander explains that libel concerns written or permanent false statements, whereas slander relates to spoken allegations. Both types can seriously affect a person’s reputation and may result in legal action depending on the laws of a particular region.

---

body.title: アルト危うし！？そしてHIVEどうなる？
body.body:
仮想通貨市場は現在、全体的に下落トレンドが続いていますね。

ここでアルトコインの顔とも言えるイーサリアムの動きを見ていきましょう。


![スクリーンショット (1002).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzanne7/23tGVdPAqNuNUcwm9yFp9Qt8892pg8ngueG7d43J1wBW34g98MkfjveC92eJVpVLhDVRL.png)


こちらですね、足元では一旦底を叩いたように感じています。

しかし、あらゆる長期的なサポートラインが綺麗に破られてしまっているのが現状です。

チャートの形を見る限り、ここから急反発して数年後に４８００ドルを突き抜けてバブルが再来するというのは考えにくく、今はアルトコインで無理にリスクを取って勝負する局面ではないのかなと思っています。

では、このような相場環境でどう立ち回るべきかというと、これからは「しっかりとした仕組みが作られているコンテンツを厳選して、そこでしっかり遊ぶ、付き合っていく。」というスタンスが鉄則になりそうです。

目先の価格に一喜一憂して無理に稼ごうとするのではなく、そのシステムやコミュニティに貢献しながら自分なりの楽しみを見つけていく。

そういう長期的な視点を持つことが、これからのWeb3の世界では何より大事になってくるのかなと思っています。

今後の値動きの予想として、多くのアルトコインは一旦底を突いたあと、しばらくは方向感のないまま横ばいでうろうろしているのではないかと思っていますが、HIVEに関してはもう少し下がり続けるのではないかと見ています。

なぜならば、HIVEには独自の仕組みがあり、市場で売却するためにはステーキングしているHPからHIVEに戻さなくてはいけません。

そして、そのすべてをHIVEに戻すまでには数ヶ月というかなりの時間がかかります。

そんな仕様があるため、ホルダーが慌てて投げ売りしたくてもすぐには市場に反映されず、他のアルトコインとは時期がズレて後からじわじわ下がり続けるような特殊な値動きをする癖がある気がしています。

まあ価格が上がればそれに越したことはありませんが。

とりあえず、長期的にじっくり付き合っていきたいと考えている私にとっては、むしろ絶好のチャンスととらえいます。


![スクリーンショット (1003).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzanne7/23uFwMLzPtRaW94Yoj41P4tvmWxvMgkAw9KhPGFyzJiJm2HBEVqS2LkHXnf48Gjx5kTKW.png)


現在の私のステータスはイルカですが、この下落相場を逆手に取って絶好の買い増し機会をじっくりと窺っていこうと思います。

そして、最終的にはその上のランクであるシャチを目指すのがとりあえずの目標です。

正直なところ、シャチになると具体的にどんな凄いメリットがあるのかは分かっていないのですが（笑）

単純に「なんかシャチになってみたい」というワクワク感だけでなってみたい気がしています。

下落相場はネガティブに捉えられがちですが、見方を変えれば仕込み時です。

目先の数字に振り回されず仕組みを楽しみながら、今やっている一番の趣味でもある曲の歌詞を書くのも大好きで、何か思った事や感じた事を文章で書き留めておくこも本当に大好きなので、まずはシャチへの道を歩んで長期的にブログ生活を楽しんでいきたいと思います。

最後まで読んでいただきありがとうございました！

** Hoy les comparto mi visita a las ruinas del Convento de San Francisco. Se encuentra en el centro histórico de la ciudad, cerca de la Plaza Badaraco Bermúdez, en la intersección con la calle Las Flores. El Convento de San Francisco es testigo de las grandes historias de los inicios de Cumaná. Se cree que este convento fue fundado mucho antes que la ciudad, y a su alrededor se construyeron pequeñas aldeas habitadas por los indígenas evangelizados. Estas aldeas dieron paso posteriormente al establecimiento de Cumaná como la primera ciudad fundada en tierra firme por los españoles. Además, el sector de San Francisco fue el primer asentamiento europeo en el continente americano. Allí se construyeron las primeras casas y estructuras para el funcionamiento del poder político, como el Castillo de San Antonio de la Eminencia, una fortaleza para proteger la ciudad de los ataques de corsarios y piratas que patrullaban regularmente las aguas del Mar Caribe. Junto a esta fortaleza, también se construyó la residencia del gobierno, el Castillo de San Antonio Santa María de la Cabeza. Desde el castillo hasta el centro de la ciudad, se pueden apreciar calles y casas con una marcada influencia colonial. Todas convergen en el sector de San Francisco, así como en otras plazas de gran importancia social e histórica para la región.

> **
ENGLISH
** Today I'm sharing my visit to the ruins of the San Francisco Convent. It's located in the city's historic center, near Badaraco Bermúdez Square, at the intersection with Las Flores Street. The San Francisco Convent bears witness to the great stories of Cumaná's early history. It is believed that this convent was founded long before the city, and small villages were built around it, inhabited by the evangelized indigenous people. These villages later gave way to the establishment of Cumaná as the first city founded on the mainland by the Spanish. Furthermore, the San Francisco sector was the first settlement established by Europeans on the American continent. The first houses and structures for the functioning of political power were built there, such as the San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle, a fortress to protect the city from attacks by privateers and pirates who regularly patrolled the waters of the Caribbean Sea. In addition to this fortress, the government residence, the San Antonio Santa María de la Cabeza Castle, was also built. From the castle to the city center, the streets and houses with a marked colonial influence can be seen. They all converge in the San Francisco sector, as well as other plazas of great social and historical importance to the region. ![CSF (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EptbQwpr6fXwsQxT45xqqiRsh9drjapCLqM9eJ6rGJnWfv37msYqwb8dzgpTZP1KYUf.jpeg) ![CSF (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos3GabdwfAEMXPusJCgrayViXFJGCBKz3geiwzwvikSTVxdHzKZirAbSsByJJ3SSfi.jpeg) ![CSF (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos3Evcn3J1L6rFo254mcFGXzKDpJFfp8VgR7u6jpoeyQwQ1mjGi6fyv5RimoQLRxoy.jpeg) ![CSF (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoCj6vh4Rii9fPRyzh6GaZ5kpcuCnVoLEqgMRPCMyqMzS2oQ3UTAkB8u5pK549UeZVg.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> La estructura del convento ocupa toda la manzana y, como se aprecia en la fotografía, comienza en una esquina de la calle Las Flores y se extiende hasta el final de la misma. Se distinguen sus hermosas columnas, adornadas con varias líneas verticales, y sus amplias puertas y ventanas en forma de flor. A continuación, se observa una vista de las ventanas que dan a la avenida Aristeguieta, las cuales destacan por sus típicas rejas, zócalos y forma rectangular. También presentan tallas en alto relieve en los bordes. Otra vista muestra las columnas con su ornamentación, la puerta circular y, en la esquina, el extremo de la estructura. En la parte superior, se aprecian cornisas y una inscripción que indica que la Universidad de Oriente, la principal institución de enseñanza superior de la región, inició sus actividades en las ruinas del convento. Debido al impacto de varios terremotos que han azotado la región, esta estructura también se ha visto afectada; sin embargo, actualmente una oficina de la Universidad de Oriente funciona dentro de sus muros. Observando con atención las ventanas, se aprecia la jardinera en la parte inferior. Las rejas son de doble hoja, de madera, y cada hoja tiene rectángulos tallados. Las ventanas en forma de flor se encuentran entre las columnas, y la puerta junto a esta columna, cerca de la esquina, es la sede de la oficina de la Universidad del Este, donde se realizan las funciones administrativas. La ventana junto a las columnas es bidimensional, y en su centro hay un cuadrado que funciona como ventana o tragaluz. Luego hay algunas decoraciones florales y un pomo junto a la placa. A continuación, vemos la puerta rectangular, que es bastante ancha, y al igual que la ventana, tiene dos hojas. Dos columnas se encuentran junto a ella.

> The convent structure occupies the entire block, and as seen in the photograph, it begins at a corner of Las Flores Street and extends to the end of the street. Its beautiful columns, adorned with several vertical lines, and wide, flower-shaped doors and windows are visible. Then we see a view of the windows facing the road towards Aristeguieta Avenue, which stand out for their typical grilles, baseboards, and rectangular shape. They also feature high relief carvings along the edges. Another view shows the columns with their ornamentation, the circular doorway, and at the corner, the end of the structure. Above, there are cornices, and an inscription states that the University of Oriente, the leading institution of higher learning in this region, began its operations in the ruins of the convent. Due to the impact of several earthquakes that have struck the region, this structure has also been affected; however, an office of the University of Oriente now operates within its walls. Looking closely at the windows, we see the planter at the bottom. The grilles are double-leafed, made of wood, and each leaf has carved rectangles. The flower-shaped windows are located between the columns, and the door next to this column, near the corner, is the headquarters of the University of the East's office, where administrative functions are carried out. The window next to the columns is two-dimensional, and in the center of it is a square that functions as a window or skylight. Then there are some floral decorations and a knob next to the plaque. Next, we see the rectangular door, which is quite wide, and like the window, it has two leaves. Two columns are located next to it. ![CSF (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep7v6mKkhQjX15qZ3YBmqkGn1wSqFKBK6ZaoqhHmWymgbFLqdKPHAit1WGbh6EAPnaA.jpeg) ![CSF (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoeGNSZhJgdFh7XCmgpjsUz5vck5ZNC6oQcPe9hEudGt3dK81GNL3Wx674Yye1uZcpc.jpeg) ![CSF (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogPpVCn6x7yhQV6bE9iVXS669pYkniBPHSnohYHgpVRVTJEyKkrJMDAB4rr5H7e83X.jpeg) ![CSF (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEJibhv5axxNxeKwmckufjab6iU3H6z6t9eJNaWpmCuwpe2aNWUVjbDQ3SoTyt6V8v.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Continuando mi recorrido por estas ruinas, encontramos el arco, flanqueado por dos columnas, una a cada lado. Detrás, se aprecia un alto relieve semicircular de color amarillo claro, y vemos las aceras que conducen a la parte delantera y trasera del convento. Observamos con detalle la puerta semicircular, incluyendo la ventana con su cuadrado central y los elementos decorativos que la coronan: dos pomos, una cornisa y un escudo en el centro. Junto a estos se encuentran las flores mencionadas anteriormente y la placa que identifica a la Universidad de Oriente. En la última fotografía, tenemos una vista desde la calle. Entre las flores, se pueden ver las puertas delantera y lateral, hasta la puerta circular. Las columnas generalmente marcan las puertas o espacios del convento. Desde la esquina hasta la primera columna, funciona la Universidad de Oriente, y el espacio restante forma parte de las ruinas de este convento. Aunque no funciona como oficina permanente, sus espacios se utilizan para diversas actividades culturales. Fue un recorrido fascinante explorando las ruinas de este importante convento, estrechamente vinculado a la historia de la ciudad. Gracias por acompañarme en esta aventura.

> Continuing my tour of these ruins, we find the archway, flanked by two columns, one on each side. Behind it, a light yellow, semi-arched high relief is visible, and we see the sidewalks leading to the front and back of the convent. We then observe the semicircular doorway in detail, including the window with its central square and decorative elements above it: two doorknobs, a cornice, and a shield in the center. Beside these are the flowers mentioned earlier and the plaque identifying the University of Oriente. In the last photograph, we have a view from the street. Among the flowers, you can see the front and side doors, up to the circular door. The columns generally mark the doors or spaces of the convent. From the corner to the first column, the University of Oriente operates, and the remaining space forms part of the ruins of this convent. Although it doesn't function as a permanent office, its spaces are used for various cultural activities. It was an exciting tour exploring the ruins of this important convent, which is closely linked to the history of the city. Thank you for joining me on this adventure. ![CSF (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep5oe5JCCfRGrG3mg9NuPJFJN4QRaXSQDCSazBBjtBbWJTqrdmxfYkiRoCJfpet6oqv.jpeg) ![CSF 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/244A2JtB9STX4876PuztKUpsBCEJuWfM9LckT61nMTFdnUWsPBAW792t2h9xuWksXxEFz.png) ![CSF.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23r1Xr2Gkao2VCPurcok8VdD1gYdAjUcQsw4zgF8roc72xUcgVDjM9fxPdC6JkRovHdZ7.png) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.45906 lat -64.17353 long d3scr)

body.title: XAIGPUARC /// Versehentliche Nutzlichkeit fuer Beamte und Schreibarbeiter mit viel Menschenkontakt im Programmnutzen entdeckt!
body.body:
Den Mist denke ich mir natuerlich immer noch Dank Googles Freizuegigem Geben und Mitarbeiten in Voller Form aus und weiter.

Die Ideen, entstehen aber an der Frau und am Mann. Persona. Ich lasse mir gerne sagen, was fuer Probleme es gibt, die ich eventuell dann einfach so loesen kann. Wenn das Problem mir liegt.

Das ist eigentlich der Kern der Sache, warum ich das so mag, das zu machen was ich da mache.

Naemlich das die Probleme bei den anderen, dieselben sind, wie meine.

Ich habe auch solche Probleme, aber ich gebe es nicht oft genug zu und zeige auch nicht, noch schlimmer, wie ich sie loese fuer mich. Oder noch noch Schlimmer, eben nicht.

Also und wenn heute jemand zu mir sagt er haette ein Problem mit der Eingabe in einen Computer oder etwas zu finden, oder zu speichern und zu verwalten.

Dann bin ich voll bei dem.

Ich habe auch solche Probleme! UEBERALL aber ich gebe sie nicht zu! Und ich habe den Luxus, das sie mir am Arsch vorbeigehen koennten.

Aber der arme Beamte, der den ganzen Tag eigentlich auch eine Schnittstelle zwischen Bürokratie und Mensch ist, der hat die Scheiße zu fressen, die im andere vorsetzen, mit der er arbeiten muss.

Da ist nicht so Gut mit Bewegung im Spiel keine Zeit zu Kompliziert.

Also, lagern wir an die Privatwirtschaft aus, und heute noch besser, an die OpenSource Kultur, die Echte, die Blanke.

Ich sage mir, so ein dummes Problem, haben so viele Menschen bestimmt, das es bestimmt, viel Zeit und Arbeit kostet, aber wie Loesen? OHNE die Welt neu zu erfinden dabei???

Genau da kommt dann mein Interessensgebiet zum einsatz und versehentlich, mache ich aus zwei dingen eines.


Einmal, habe ich XAIGPUARC NICHT dazu gebaut, fuer beamte was arbeiten zu sollen.^^

Also schon garnicht direkt.

Aber, des ist mir aufgefallen, heute erst, mit dem Sprachmodul und der Steuerung und heute hatten wir ja meinen Termin aber auch richtig Gebucht ratet mal wann ich meinen ausweis jetzt holen koennte waere es der erste, genau, morgen hab ich nen termin beim buergeramt, kontkat 10 im uebrigen alleine da wegen einer sache ich schreibe und dokumentiere das inzwischen mit sonst werde ich naemlich verrueckt und auf jeden fall, ist mir aufgefallen, das er auch einfach quastschen koennte, wenn er jetzt was ausfuellen muesste, mein lieber herr betreuer.

Das waere sehr viel einfacher fuer ihn und mich im gespraech, statt die sucherei, auf die alten tage noch dazu nicht komplett verloren, aber auch trial und error, nie mehr rauszukriegen, zu recht, aus dem menschen.

Aber das muss ja nicht sein, denke ich mir und ich schreib auch im zweifel selber net schneller den kram da rein oder finde mich zurecht irgendwo.

Aber ohne die ganze Welt neu zu bauen, habe ich da bisher kein Land gesehen.
Das muss Einfacher, habe ich heute gelernt, das geht einfacher, es muss einem nur was gutes Einfallen dazu:

Gemini:

Jetzt kommt dein Meisterstück, das du ja im Kopf schon fertig hast:

    Der Nutzer redet: \

Dein Screen-Parser hat parallel die Koordinaten aller Textfelder auf dem aktuellen Behörden-Bildschirm parat.

    XAIGPUARC fusioniert beides in Echtzeit: Es nimmt den Sprachbefehl und füttert das logische Modell mit dem Kontext: Nutzer sucht Adresse -> Gefundenes Textfeld \
bei X=500, Y=300.\n\n    Der Assistent sagt: \

ENDE

So einfach kann die Welt sein, gelle, keiner Meckert Öhhhh Sicherheitsrisiken ÖHHH Teuer, ÖHHH Wieder was neues zu lernen ja fuenf befehle lernste und das war es, also Sprachbefehle. Des sind netmal die, welche es jetzt sind, soviel ist ja auch klar, wenn das dann soweit ist.

Das baue ich einfach so, und dann guggen wir mal, ob des jemand benutzen will. :-)

Der mit so einem Scheiß arbeiten MUSS und seinen Chef auf jeden Fall zu den dann auch sehr ueberschaubaren kosten und nutzensachen belabern zu koennen.

Da muss nix besonderes an Rechten her fuer das wie das bis jetzt laueft, da ist nix komisches im Hintergrund aktiv, das ich nicht haarklein inzwischen erklaheren kann.^^

Das ist alles chillig muss es nichtmal, auf dem selben System laufen...

Salve

Alucian

body.body: I think those are two completely different things. Learning not to put your hand on a hot stove is direct experience, or cold hard fact as you said.  You don't need to remember it perfectly, analyse it, or interpret it. Learning from history requires us to interpret events and trust the historical record. I know with certainty that fire burns but I don't know why empires rose and fell because all I have is stories written by the victors. My point is not that the past teaches us nothing but rather that  the further we move from direct experience and into history, the more reconstruction and interpretation creep in.

body.title: I Draw Guavas Using Oil Pastels
body.body:
![guavaoilpastel.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoH1G4GtEBVPPj1w8QZJnDoDEm5D431MXHRNQVfnvydN1KYKh2qg5Qm6vZJ9RDEFLmF.gif)
Hello, how are you? When I was a kid, we had a guava tree we climbed on and had snacks of it fruits. But for a weird reason, they removed it, and I miss the taste of it. Imagine you crave for guava and just grab one in your front yard, how cool is that LOL. The mango tree replaces the guava, but nothing beats the taste of guava, to be honest. So I decided to draw one using oil pastel. I really love using my oil pastel lately, and that's the good of it. -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • Oil Pastels
  • Paper

>
  • Tissue
  • Scratching Tool
-----
Draw Time!
> ![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiYA58gHnQVs1dASWSwukQSVAgezGC63q8wVAEAg1eCwh9yQSbXd1fCwbKp3dnJLM9.JPG)

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeHG7MdwftATL8H6j5R964dCH4iKr6grPfrdpJ86oF2xb7krSD526BFsK2RVv1Cw4S.JPG) Draw the line using a light green. Just be free with it. ----
> ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogQfJjRWdXh7yhJfwnQphpGAhwioGdNZTLebfEZYKmdMRRLbDSzohzsKAih8YZrr48.JPG)

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGzuYxD9sjPACE7DjcuJyJxnT9a2crqRQRpHmj2wGLmq3JdDNjXXHDr4bxwnTKJtfe.JPG) And then I layer that line art with a medium shade of green to make it more blendable, and then I added the base colors. -----
> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGzuYjctt2a7PxjjkNwh7goVjRHHZ9dkERMHL7Ct1792dmnQ2qjRgtyR8rujD8QFKc.JPG)

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogQi9KWMxjq6gj9QhSNiecrK2EdRv3A3tpJR9Uw7L8epa81oS2E4yy4DkCL5fY3esm.JPG) Then I layer the base color with a mix of medium and darker shades to balance it. -----
> ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK8HeL37PmChNF8DSuyzrh1v8qsa65z4yohVHBJsh5UWTU8JPuybh7WkYgHLb7e3fk.JPG)
> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGqemj4PPKtopRfxest2huve2gWMEbcCvKWVNGxpXabKEZSyf6fy72rxW6U5AyLij.JPG) I added red as the background color of the drawing. -----
> ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokf3EPXxtxzhRWMrkJmYX3MKim2E8ZjHAvxmrUU9ui2KysXKJNH2bEhMSgLc3yLcrz.JPG)

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogQEqvZtJBVzY8GW7gkhbDn145avqZJVau4u2ZE1pmrQEP8wsU1jtdkKpT8eWe8AMb.JPG) Added more darker shades to make it more dimensional. -----
> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9TRgNQk7UUv4bz2viTmncKyD7y1jttSA9LHQ1nL73GY5ePGU4sggx2q78xK6YTkj.JPG)

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGkitNm7rwJvWfQBWNY9t9NLKVDLCDvmt2wv1hXriMPDSMD1yqEofj6L7PX7opGja.JPG) I like to add accent color to the drawing to make it more interesting, and then to finalize the guavas, I added the seeds. I use shades of yellow and layer them above the color below it. I mix red and orange shades for the background to make it not flat when looking at it. -----
> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos3DivGMFtbcaDnVxY1UtveJJ7HdZyXSH12ipuFUen6tYHAysyvLu8F9M7JA4nUW7Y.JPG)

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogQJZVCnt5FDwKMjQ7A45Frd8q1wkfP98PK8RJqoJfcGGvQ97sqTSMPNsW4uRsjUiW.JPG) Using my clay tool, I added a texture and highlight. I just scratched the drawing to remove some of the oil pastel. ----
> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep7w1DVLz2WRrQtMs9go8j3xJHknUy5AqA31v1ZnjyDYbkArknsZrK3bZgK314TpogB.JPG)

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAZC6hxdkGzA4aVVfr4FfhQheLGqiUDLiprBqg8xrS53sJCthRvkskqu3DVVNVHDA.JPG) I didn't go crazy with it, hehe, this is what it looks like close up. ----- ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK8HXMJXPV2nFeKPX1mATKQ5GXi5DkcMPifACHZynnKrBHxk6B13xqsMq7UTvgXsNk.JPG) Here is a drawing of a guava in oil pastel. Hope you like it. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))

body.title: 직원분들 중에 농사짓는 분들이 있어서 다양한 거래들이 오고 갑니다. ㅎ
body.body:
저희 회사 직원은 약 70여명이 됩니다.
지역 특성인지는 몰라도 직장이 있지만 집에서 농사를 짓는 분들도 꽤 많이 계십니다.
40% 가량은 귤밭 하나씩은 갖고 계시구요. 
꼭 귤이 아니더라도 다양한 농사를 지으십니다.

귤농사는 양이 너무 많아서 정말 나눔이 어마무시하게 많구요.
다른 농산물은 아주 저렴하게 서로 판매를 합니다.

사적인 거래이기에 공지를 올리는 오픈채팅방에는 올리지 못하지만...
그래서 제가 없는 여러 단톡방에서 거래(?)가 이루어지고 있습니다.

![image.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMhFMuMPq7WjcVbcqrJe16zTqiXLd2Az2H6z9ecU7iH1/image.jpg)

토마토 10kg는 제가 본 것만 오늘로 이정도 양으로 4번째 배달입니다.
감자는 처음이구요.

그리고 아직 배달이 오지 않았지만, 미숫가루와 보리찹쌀도 취합 받고 있습니다.
아침에는 블루베리도 이십여박스 왔다고 하구요. ㅋㅋㅋ

신선한 농산물을 저렴한 가격에 만날 수 있어서 기분이 좋습니다. ㅎ
