body.title: The Future of Social Media Marketing: Why Engagement Signals Matter More Than Followers in 2026
body.body:
# The Future of Social Media Marketing: Why Engagement Signals Matter More Than Followers in 2026

Social media marketing has evolved significantly over the past decade. There was a time when brands, influencers, and businesses measured success almost entirely through follower counts. The larger the audience, the more successful an account appeared. However, social media platforms have become increasingly sophisticated, and the metrics that determine success are changing rapidly.

In 2026, engagement signals are becoming far more important than simple follower numbers. Major platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Telegram now focus heavily on user interaction, content quality, and audience behavior when deciding which content deserves greater visibility. As a result, businesses and creators who understand engagement signals have a significant advantage in today's competitive digital landscape.

An engagement signal is any action that demonstrates genuine user interest. This includes likes, comments, shares, saves, watch time, profile visits, link clicks, and other interactions that show audiences are actively engaging with content. These signals help algorithms determine whether content provides value to users.

Follower counts still matter, but they no longer guarantee reach. Many accounts with large audiences struggle to achieve meaningful engagement because their followers are inactive or uninterested. Meanwhile, smaller accounts with highly engaged communities often outperform larger competitors because social media platforms prioritize audience interaction over audience size.

This shift has transformed how businesses approach digital marketing. Instead of focusing exclusively on growing follower numbers, successful brands are now concentrating on creating content that encourages meaningful interactions. The goal is no longer to attract passive viewers but to build active communities that regularly engage with content.

One of the reasons engagement signals have become so important is the growing amount of content being published online. Millions of videos, images, articles, and posts are uploaded every day. Social media platforms must decide which content deserves visibility. Engagement signals help algorithms identify content that users find valuable, relevant, and interesting.

Watch time has become one of the strongest engagement indicators, particularly on video platforms. When users watch a video until the end, platforms interpret this as a sign of quality. Similarly, content that receives shares often reaches larger audiences because sharing indicates strong user approval.

Saves are another increasingly important metric. When users save content for future reference, it suggests the information provides lasting value. Educational content, tutorials, business tips, and industry insights frequently generate higher save rates because users want to revisit the information later.

Comments also play a crucial role in modern social media marketing. Meaningful conversations demonstrate audience interest and create opportunities for community building. Brands that actively respond to comments often develop stronger relationships with followers, leading to higher engagement over time.

For businesses, understanding engagement signals can improve marketing performance significantly. Companies that focus on creating useful, informative, and entertaining content are more likely to generate meaningful interactions. These interactions can improve visibility, strengthen brand authority, and increase customer trust.

The rise of artificial intelligence is also influencing how engagement signals are evaluated. Modern algorithms can analyze audience behavior with remarkable accuracy. They can identify whether interactions appear authentic and determine which content genuinely resonates with users. This makes quality engagement more valuable than ever before.

Businesses operating in competitive markets such as India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Europe face increasing challenges when trying to capture audience attention. In these markets, strong engagement often determines whether content succeeds or disappears among thousands of competing posts. Brands that prioritize audience value typically achieve better long-term results than those focused solely on vanity metrics.

Content creators are also adapting to these changes. Instead of producing content designed only to attract views, many creators now focus on delivering practical value. Educational videos, industry insights, tutorials, case studies, and expert opinions tend to generate stronger engagement because they address specific audience needs.

As social media continues to evolve, engagement signals will likely become even more important. Platforms want users to spend more time engaging with high-quality content, and algorithms are becoming increasingly effective at identifying valuable interactions. Businesses that understand this trend can position themselves for sustainable growth.

The future of social media marketing is not about having the largest audience. It is about building the most engaged audience. Brands that create valuable content, encourage meaningful interactions, and focus on audience satisfaction will continue to outperform competitors in the years ahead.

In conclusion, engagement signals have become one of the most important factors in social media success. While follower counts still contribute to credibility, they no longer guarantee visibility or growth. Businesses and creators who prioritize authentic engagement can improve reach, strengthen audience relationships, and achieve long-term success in an increasingly competitive digital environment.

body.title: 带娃去遛弯 & 看耍猴
body.body:
周日中午骤雨初歇，儿子喊我带他出去放风。虽然我极其懒惰不爱活动，但想着孩子已经在家憋了一上午，就勉为其难地带他出去转转吧。

![20260607_140053.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeSZXf6oGLgxSrzAUbLuzSLtQh3qeWXxGHgQt1k28E2F5/20260607_140053.jpg)

原本只打算带他在小区里遛弯，看看花花草草，可他竟然表示对这些一点兴趣都没有。

问他想去哪，他回复说越远越好，可是越远就意味着浪费更多的时间、更多的体力以及更多的油钱！

他说要不去小河边走上一大圈，或者去大学校园里打蓝球，晕，这些时间和油钱倒是可以接受，就是老父亲我的体力不允许呀。

所以后来我们达成了一个折中的方案，开车带他去阿提图欢乐世界的秘密停车基地，然后在公园里走上一小圈，不浪费多少油钱，不浪费多少时间，我的体力也可以接受，完美。

在秘密基地停好车，对面的摩天轮
![20260607_135120.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQayLmTRguMfDFUbACasmauxHUwarG1pqrxWhFLDtJ3kZ/20260607_135120.jpg)

沿着河边走
![20260607_135222.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTazcPL13sAmnG6UNM95ocE9oUe13m59vk8rh4XxqWPPY/20260607_135222.jpg)

两个水闸
![20260607_135235.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUB8oahy4u6ckMR9y7xa1nvtwPLPriDjTJSL5zKFzfphv/20260607_135235.jpg)

路边的野花
![20260607_135318.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZjhnJfnbuq9DbHen5uumBZPMCnnSojjyturznkEA7xm/20260607_135318.jpg)

雨后的小路看起来超美
![20260607_135410.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaYTsF7yASMKPMp3uGntYH2bTxtZbcBmtRAtPp58dRqns/20260607_135410.jpg)

如意桥
![20260607_135516.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeyyeqnFHj7d6oATSm6qipicfgPaKV2FqKmhd5hcgjsQ7/20260607_135516.jpg)

站在桥上看风景
![20260607_135629.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPoWRHXWGNCmfQXuQkyDvKHoc7PXvgaELGxnCCak8186C/20260607_135629.jpg)

小河流水
![20260607_135656.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdNirQrv3TZT7ZSEG76smpHWnuvXkwzXHEbgJgBE5iJrx/20260607_135656.jpg)

咦，海盗船怎么没开？
![20260607_135814.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ7ELJk85Antb5QE5Rcuh6pQP5GbFSw2WepWM5QsWbCHg/20260607_135814.jpg)

好多游乐设施都没开

我想大概是为了避免在高考期间制造噪音吧
![20260607_135926.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeQXcfEENbmRRS7PYpr2WgspqXWwRNBHB4GoHEAmvVqfJ/20260607_135926.jpg)

雨后的风景还不错，就是这天看起来还要下雨的样子呢

哇，误入侏罗纪公园，发现好多好多恐龙，好可怕

这些点多设施都没开启

这个角度看摩天轮也很好看
![20260607_141019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbAVRy1gccJfMmuH4sdxe1gjS161qdtAitRpV44bdKSYA/20260607_141019.jpg)

哇哦，这个小火车开了，不过其实这附近也没高考考场，况且噪音其实并不大
![20260607_141041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQvZSuX46fba1eZwPViUWotzhzi2rtV4MkqdHanELTfPq/20260607_141041.jpg)

漂亮
![20260607_141142.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYYf9c7rXh7V7n4K3Ven72LuwdhkdW1PGNA29dTM1KUFX/20260607_141142.jpg)

丁香湖东湖的网红石桥
![20260607_141230.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR2uLxALXNdJmvMwDVMic3SRvK81zspeC5PXm4pji3ARj/20260607_141230.jpg)

原来的东湖广场
![20260607_141254.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLN9ak5FAkhjxorhYH9NYqD2sWPNcWD5JwagP4pnqb63/20260607_141254.jpg)

额，石桥被拦上了，虽然我们能爬过去，但是还是不要冒险的好
![20260607_141441.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdHH85reVS4gwR3oHHMnJqDLp2N5u43AkBVnjn8BuEUow/20260607_141441.jpg)

看到几只小野鸭

body.title: An Easy Day - June 7, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Mulch hay - 22 more bales crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EopqwTv1yvFueSYsB55bGURu2dmBFXmDk2UzZWGhTdXmKS8vQaPVCDLidZzU1JYudc7.jpg)

*22 more bales of mulch hay*

On Sunday I was up at 5AM and got the sprinklers going and closed the house up and went back to bed, much to someone’s disgust. I shut the bedroom door vs the screen door.

At 6:45AM he was scratching at the door. I finally got up at 7AM and fed him. My son had met me at the door and wanted to get the truckload of hay done. So I got dressed and we headed up to the barn in the car. I went to start the truck and the battery was totally dead. So we jumped it with the car and got it loaded with hay.

Once it was unloaded at the Big garden I left it running for 45 minutes to recharge the battery.

![Multiflora rose crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoGwVkS8KBbAFXPe33cqBrK6RX5KWiPqbaVXP8TzPdmjLkPVon2F9m8fLJpWrTZQVuL.jpg)

*Multiflora roses*

I went inside and worked on getting my post up. The scent of the multiflora roses all around the farm and in the area is strong right now. It’s one of the scents I look forward to in June.

My brother got up and went out and got the front pasture, middle pasture, and driveway weedwacked. He came down after his shower and wanted to go fill my gas cans so I zoomed around and got ready for the day.

We dropped off the cans once filled and headed out on back roads to go to a place we used to play as kids. It was open from 1PM to 4PM.

![P.I. - 1967, 1968 collage text crop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Ep3heozgPojY9jAAu59nxt1rbbQoBPMzFn1X2LRLCueieceVTQNTQBMLnyqKjLogHCa.jpg)

Powers Institute or P.I. as we always called it, had been the town high school well into the 1940’s. But it had been unused since then. There was a level gravel area between the building and our property line that ran down a hill to the road.

I used to ride my horses over there, and the boys used to zoom their bikes off the small hill as a jump. My brother (on the right in the right hand photo) says the killdeer used to nest in the gravel.

Both my sister and my brother told me about one of our cats getting in, possibly through a broken window back in the 1970’s, and not being found in there for a week. He was in the ductwork and his cries reverberated enough that a neighbor heard him.

(And yes, we had real snow back in the 1960’s!)

![P.I. - front crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23ynUXHJ2j1PeA49UuTNQ5Nb6hxKdT9cXbHjdezgSUKG5yjbs5U6umPH81bSGmjuUydWY.jpg)

In the 1990’s restoration efforts began and weren’t completed until 10 years later. It was converted to a Senior center on the first floor and a historical museum on the second floor.

They had made a well equipped if small Senior center that was a very pleasant area. One room was for dining with a tiny kitchen, and the other room for activities and exercise classes.

As you come in the door, on the right were 2 bathrooms. My brother said that was always the taxidermy room when he toured the place in the mid 1970’s. It had a large boar’s head mounted over the entrance and he was scared of it back then.

![P.I. - the pond Silver Lake crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EopvpJfg8Xq9TfLicKLxeN9rNZQXDLPxCokWycmcJP6zgy3Y5Ygk1C8ZsvYDYXKJhnW.jpg)

*Silver Lake, late 1800’s*

We headed up the steep wooden stairs, worn down to hollows in places, to the museum. My brother particularly likes all the old photos.

He found the picture above of the pond we used to skate on. When we arrived I had remarked about how small it had gotten since we were kids. On the back side (which I wish I had photographed) it said this was a scene from the late 1800’s of Silver Lake.

The house in the background is where I grew up and we never knew it was called that. It was P.I. pond to us. My sister says it was a kettlehole from when the glacier was there and the pond extended up all the surrounding hills much farther. A note on the back of the photo said that the town hearse ended up in the middle of the lake during a July 4 celebration.

Our barn had a large ice house and I expect the ice was cut from Silver Lake and stored there.

I just remember it for skating in the winter. They would clear it with Jeeps with plows for us kids. And in the summer, I spent a lot of time hunting frogs to play with there.

![P.I. - farm tools crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/243zfskF6t6NXYRjnRrzuo89VTuGAN3vkLYEN2HL2dbiNbmiko9M3zMz6g6AyDTf1uW9b.jpg)

One of the local farms, Cushman Farm, donated all these old farm tools. There are ice cutting tools hanging on the wall. Across the main road is Cushman Park and I expect that was where the farm was located.

We toured the taxidermy room and the boar’s head was there. There was also an albino porcupine and an albino fox. There was a gray squirrel that was a light tan color. And lots and lots of all kinds of birds.

![P.I. - Sunday school paper dolls crop June 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoeDx8hU2Ftw7XwJWez8kvWxtQio25FkozRCmtvZWw8tmDvwdVPTFpJYY9v33fZRFnA.jpg)

In the main area there was a pretty display of paper dolls and they were labeled “Sunday School dolls”. I don’t know the story behind that but the label intrigued me.

In the back there was a small room set up as a school room and all the graduating classes were hung on the wall.

It had a lot of other things to look at and it would take another trip at least to see it all. I’d reached my standing limit and sat down while my brother continued to explore.

When we left there, we went to a local ice cream place that my brother’s work supplies the ice cream base for. He got a dish of ice cream and I got a waffle cone of Caramel Creek ice cream.

We continued on backroads and went to Tractor Supply to get gas for the weedwacker and to replace the missing pin for the box blade.

We got home around 4PM and I got a call scheduling the heat pump install for the last week of July. I eventually made some supper. I sat down to watch ‘Two Weeks Notice’ and was ready for bed by 7:30PM.

On Monday I hope to get out to plant the 3 rows of storage onions and get them mulched. It’s to be a cooler day, only just hitting 80F by late afternoon.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: The Dragonnes conquered Budapest: Metz ended Győr's reign and gave France its first ever Champions League
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/23t74pCi9Xws2tAxGni1ai9m5Yy24DN8RfYfpH4rzpp6C4UUQr66g8nFx7bhvvSDvD1ty.png)

I don't think I've ever watched a handball team celebrate the way Metz celebrated tonight in Budapest. Players on the floor crying. Coaches hugging strangers. Johanna Bundsen — the goalkeeper who'd just saved them in the final seconds — standing in the middle of the court with her arms spread wide, looking up at 20,000 people in the MVM Dome like she couldn't quite believe where she was or what she'd done. The woman had 17 saves in the semi-final and then did it again today when it mattered most. She scored two goals from an empty net on Saturday. TWO. A goalkeeper. Scoring goals. And saving everything. What planet is this woman from?

Metz 31-29 Győr. The first Women's EHF Champions League title in French handball history. Let me say that again because the weight of it deserves repetition: no French club — men's or women's — had EVER won the Champions League. Not Metz with all their domestic dominance. Not Brest, who reached the final in 2021 and lost. Nobody. Until tonight.

And they did it by beating the most dominant club in the history of the competition. In Hungary. In front of a crowd that was overwhelmingly cheering for the other side. Against a team going for their THIRD straight title and eighth overall. Metz walked into Győr's backyard and took the crown off their head. The sheer audacity of it.

---

## Saturday: the semi-finals that set the stage

Let me rewind to yesterday because both semi-finals deserve their own moment.

The first game was Metz against CSM Bucuresti at 15:00. Metz had been to the Final Four four times before this weekend. Four times. And four times they'd lost in the semi-finals. It had become a running joke in European handball — Metz are good enough to get to Budapest but not good enough to get past Saturday. The glass ceiling, they called it. The curse. Whatever you want to call it, it was real and it was heavy.

Not anymore. Metz absolutely demolished CSM 32-27 and honestly it wasn't even that close. The scoreline flatters the Romanian side. Sarah Bouktit was perfect — eight goals from eight attempts, including five from five penalties. Eight from eight. In a Champions League semi-final. At the Final Four. Against a team coached by Bojana Popovic, who won this competition SIX times as a player. Bouktit didn't miss once. Not once. And this was her last weekend in a Metz shirt before she joins... Győr. Yes. She was about to play a final against her future club. You can't script this stuff.

Bundsen in goal was phenomenal. 17 saves at 40%. She organized the defense, she came up huge on breakaways, she even scored two goals from the empty net when CSM pulled their keeper. A goalkeeper scoring goals in a Champions League semi-final. I keep saying it because it keeps being absurd.

The second semi-final was supposed to be the all-French final dream. Brest Bretagne vs Győr, with a potential Metz-Brest final on Sunday that would have been historic for French handball. Two French clubs in the same Champions League final? It had never happened. The dream was right there.

Győr killed it. But only just.

The Hungarians trailed for most of the game and Brest led deep into the last quarter. Brest were minutes away from the final. MINUTES. And then Győr happened. Dione Housheer — the Dutch left back who's been arguably the best player in the world this season — scored nine goals and single-handedly dragged Győr back into it. Nine goals. From a left back. In a semi-final. The woman is a machine.

Győr won 31-30 in the last minute. Brest were devastated. The all-French final died. But what we got instead — Metz vs Győr, the first-time finalists vs the two-time defending champions, France vs Hungary in Budapest — was arguably even better from a narrative standpoint.

---

## Sunday: the placement match nobody talks about

Quick mention: CSM Bucuresti beat Brest in the third-place match earlier today. I don't have the exact details but Brest will go home knowing they pushed Győr to the absolute limit in the semi and had them beaten until the last five minutes. Sometimes third place tastes like vinegar. For Brest, today was one of those days.

---

## The final: Metz 31-29 Győr

OK. The big one.

Győr started like they always start in finals — fast, physical, aggressive. Bruna de Paula, the Brazilian left back who used to play for Metz (because of course she did, this weekend was full of these storylines), was central to everything good Győr did in the opening ten minutes. They built an 8-5 lead and the MVM Dome — basically a home crowd for the Hungarian side — was rocking. The noise was incredible. Drums, chants, flags everywhere. It felt like a home game for Győr and for those first ten minutes, it looked like one too.

But Metz are not the team they were two years ago. Or even last year. Emmanuel Mayonnade has built something special in Lorraine — a squad with depth, resilience and an identity that goes beyond any individual player. When Győr came out swinging, Metz didn't flinch. They absorbed the early pressure, tightened their defense, and slowly started clawing back.

The key was Bundsen. Again. Every time Győr looked like they were about to pull away, the Swedish goalkeeper produced a save. A one-on-one stop from Housheer. A reaction save from a pivot shot. A seven-metre throw that she read like a book. She was the wall between Győr and a third consecutive title, and she refused to crack.

By half-time the gap had narrowed. The second half was where Metz truly took over. Tyra Axnér was brilliant on the left back position. The defensive rotations were flawless. And the counter-attacks — those devastating Metz counter-attacks that have been their trademark all season — started finding their mark.

Metz took the lead midway through the second half and never gave it back. Győr kept coming, kept pushing, kept trying to find that extra gear that had saved them against Brest yesterday. But it wasn't there. The legs were heavy from the semi-final. The saves weren't falling for their goalkeeper. And Metz just kept scoring.

The final minutes were pure tension. Győr closed the gap to two. Then one possession could have made it one. But Bundsen made one final save — a monstrous stop in the dying seconds that will be replayed for years — and Lylou Borg scored on the fast break to seal it. 31-29. Final buzzer.

Metz are champions of Europe.

---

## What this means

Where do I even start?

For Metz, this is the culmination of a decade-long project. They've been the dominant force in French women's handball for years — 27 league titles, 13 Coupe de France trophies, four consecutive domestic cups coming into this weekend. But Europe was always the missing piece. Five Final Fours. Four semi-final eliminations. One bronze medal as consolation. The narrative was always \

Tonight they didn't just get it done. They beat the best team on the continent in a final.

For Győr, this is the end of an era. Or at least a pause. Two consecutive titles, seven overall, three straight finals — that's a dynasty by any definition. But they couldn't make it three in a row. Housheer, who was brilliant all weekend, will be back. Bruna de Paula will be back. They'll reload and they'll be favorites again next year. But tonight belongs to someone else.

For French handball, this is seismic. Two clubs in the Final Four — a first. One club winning the title — also a first. And this comes just three weeks after JDA Dijon won the EHF European League. Two European trophies for French women's handball in the same season. The country that invented the sport (well, kind of, it's complicated) is finally producing clubs that can compete at the very top.

For the neutral? This was just an incredible weekend of handball. The MVM Dome was packed for both days. The atmosphere was electric. The quality of play across all four games was outstanding. Nine goals from Housheer in the semi. Eight from eight by Bouktit. Bundsen doing things in goal that shouldn't be physically possible. Brest losing by one in the last minute and then picking themselves up to play again 18 hours later. CSM's youngsters winning the Youth Club Trophy in overtime. Even the placement match had drama.

This is what the Final Four format does when it works. Four teams, two days, one venue, everything on the line. It's the best weekend in club handball and this year might have been the best edition yet.

Metz are the queens of Europe. The Dragonnes breathed fire in Budapest and burned down everyone in their path. And somewhere in the MVM Dome tonight, Johanna Bundsen is probably still standing with her arms spread wide, looking up at the roof, wondering if any of this is real.

It is. All of it. And French handball will never be the same.

body.title: Per-Fect
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20260607_115249651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/244oUSYcSe5D7tpjs3XcfQWHtUSzX9CJUMf56ZCTzKePWCuSqjobRQMqzG5nwUHZ7ozAU.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

We had some of the best weather you could possibly imagine this past weekend.  That's relative I guess.  While some people enjoy the blazing hot weather, others are happy living in the frigid chill of Northern Hemisphere winter. We had neither of those this past weekend.  The days got into the 75 to 85 degree range with not a single cloud in the sky.  Even better, the evenings and nights got down into the low 50's which means you get to keep your windows open all night.  In addition to that, there was a nice steady breeze that kept the hot air pleasant.  We spent a lot of time out on our deck.


<center>![PXL_20260606_143901389.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/245cMskwtGmjoEJP3hx9DnduRdSNDzCrRNoUdJSgimrUL1y5RkUqNQzi5URv4SKqGKucv.jpg)</center>

------------------------

Actually, we started things off on Saturday morning driving down to the Flint, MI area to watch our nephew play baseball with his summer travel team.  It was a rough go for them losing both their games on Saturday by a pretty significant margin, but he put in a lot of effort and I was proud to see him continue to play hard despite how badly they were getting beat.  I think it's odd that leagues like this don't seem to have a run rule because when you are losing 17 to 0 after two innings, they should just call it at that point.  It's not benefitting anyone to keep playing.  That's just my two cents anyway.


<center>![PXL_20260606_155519382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23qrBxADLVLjTQQ8iZxGHubnhT8zPo4YtFiKSkkJ7XUAcnbp4BbEfU7nW4sGrGraJHppr.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

After the baseball game we headed back to our house, picked up some Chinese food, and played cards with @mrsbozz's parents.  She had been asked what she wanted for her upcoming birthday, and that's what she asked for, so that's what she got.  We played a game called [Hand and Foot](https://bicyclecards.com/how-to-play/hand-and-foot) that her parents taught us late last year.  It's a pretty fun game, and we have both picked up on it quite well.  I was paired with my mother in law while @mrsbozz teamed up with her father.  We crushed them.  We didn't even bother counting our points on the last hand because there was no way my wife and her dad could catch up with us.


<center>![PXL_20260606_235556199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tmBR5qKdeypfmfjvjdAtv21p2YojTUrZD65iLMktFt78sNTQFk2122yEYptobqDptxk.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

As I said, we spent a lot of time on our deck this weekend, which is good because pretty soon camping season is going to be in full swing and we won't be home as much to enjoy it.  It seems everyone was out enjoying the nice weather, the street in front of our house was packed with cars due to most of the neighbors having people over. 

Of course, the idiots lighting off fireworks for no reason at 1 in the morning wasn't very welcome, but what can you do I guess...


<center>![PXL_20260607_120912188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tbsFvyPzWrJhbd9WqCv6d8WSzPvcxuF3wBjQ63qTcqCUeqm9cioktGqvMiCyqz3gPik.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

Sunday morning we got up to go for a walk at our local walking path.  Unfortunately, we found it was closed and didn't open until 8 AM. Since it was closer to 7 AM we weren't going to sit around waiting, so we found another path to go walking on.  We came across this massive moth towards the end of our mile and a half walk.  He was about the size of a golf ball if you smashed it flat.  No lie!  He was huge!

After our walk, I went to church with my parents then over to their house to have lunch.  After that, I headed home so I could do some weeding in the garden and mow the lawn.  We then spent the rest of the afternoon sitting on the deck enjoying the beautiful day and the delightful breeze.


<center>![PXL_20260607_200437287.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23u5y7YQEUNHcLUPLHA8VM6LeNxJxhGxnyYFBRLnyQrxyZw37k7ApVStmXB4YtSahEPKW.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260607_202347271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wMepSF7kE7Z1N6TKgnByGEm3VE1CExq1YZci75BABLhupHHquKbeMaYTedA5twvDXro.jpg)</center>

------------------------------

I fired up the Weber kettle towards dinner time and grilled some chicken breasts that we had started marinating earlier in the morning.  The ones at the bottom are a harissa honey blend that we threw together, and the ones on top are a fajita marinade that we buy in the jar from our local grocery chain.  


<center>![PXL_20260607_205425217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xKsyMarxeQFV5wSWUtyaT3tMVkVHASJQDmaoCum3GorjGEv8eATA9G6FuaSveKhLMNi.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

We are having fajitas another night later in the week, but last night we had our harissa honey chicken Mediterranean bowls.  A bit of rice in the bottom, harissa honey chicken, lettuce, avocado, tomato and cucumber blend, pickled onions, a yogurt herb sauce, avocado, and some feta cheese.  It was pretty amazing.  The only thing it was missing was a dab of hummus.  

I'd seriously eat this every day if I could.  It's just that good with so many amazing flavors mixing together.  Plus, besides the rice it's pretty healthy for you too.  A lot better than some of the other stuff I could be  putting in my body I guess.  

Overall, it was a pretty perfect weekend.  How was yours?

body.title: A picture is worth a thousand words: A trip, an experience/Una imagen vale más que mil palabras:  Un viaje, una experiencia [ENG/ESP]
body.body: <div class=\

> A cloudy morning, the most anticipated day arrives when it is time to travel, I have never traveled by plane, only road trips, cars or buses, it is a new experience that I cannot put aside, although I cannot help but be somewhat afraid when I see that I will get on that plane, that I will fly for a while fearing anything that could happen, it is something that worries me, but at the same time I know that it is necessary to do it because the trip will allow me to reach my new destination, to visit my family and to be able to spend some time. with them. --- ![air.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EpvjLBWPjN2bRhK6uAuj8GURNPcJGddMC88vgsBrKwbKimkPRNzg53TG1RWT3qdguJr.jpg) **Image property of @freewritehouse** ---

> Upon arriving at the airport, all the transfers were done quickly, but the departure was a little delayed because the weather became dark, while we were waiting for us to leave, I began to see how they were arranging things on the plane, the suitcases, cleaning the surroundings, arranging every necessary detail to be able to leave as soon as possible, everything seemed to be almost ready to leave, which certainly excited me, it was a great idea, and with the nervousness, despite everything, the idea was still present in making the trip, listening to what needs to be done in do this and have everything calm to travel comfortably. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

>When the plane arrived, I was completely ready to begin its respective journey, preparing everything inside, sitting down, putting away the hand luggage, seeing that everything was ready to leave, my nerves got to me, but I also got excited, I see it as an adventure that I began to enjoy, seeing the sky closer and everything from above that looked so small, a pleasant trip I had. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)
> I hope you enjoyed this reading and I invite @yaslenysofia to participate in this [Contest](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tf444k) ---

> **Thank you very much for reading it. I hope you like it. I will be happy to respond to any comments and if you want to know more about me, I will leave you my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBUvDS4VGUSKXZtnq7Ra7tfg5djZFshgd11HGrP2RvQ1PutmYjxStDen15aEed2vLg.jpg)

> Una mañana nublada, llega el más esperado día en el que toca viajar, nunca he viajado en avión, solo viajes por carretera, carros o autobús, es una nueva experiencia que no puedo dejar a un lado, aunque no puedo evitar tener algo de miedo al ver que me montare en ese avión, que volare un rato temiendo cualquier cosa que pueda pasar, es algo que un me inquieta, pero al mismo tiempo sé que es necesario hacerlo porque el viaje me permitirá llegar a mi nuevo destino, a visitar a mi familia y poder pasar un rato con ellos. --- ![air.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EpvjLBWPjN2bRhK6uAuj8GURNPcJGddMC88vgsBrKwbKimkPRNzg53TG1RWT3qdguJr.jpg) **Imagen propiedad de @freewritehouse** ---

> Al llegar al aeropuerto todos los transmite se hicieron rápido, pero se retrasó un poco la salida porque el tiempo se puso oscuro, mientras se espera que pudiéramos partir, empecé a ver como acomodaban las cosas en el avión, las maletas, limpiando el entorno, arreglando cada detalle necesario para poder partir lo más pronto posible, todo parecía estar casi listo para partir, lo cual ciertamente me emocionaba, era una idea estupenda, y con el nerviosismo también pese a todo la idea seguía presente en lograr hacer el viaje, escuchando lo que hay que hacer en ello y tener todo calmado para lograr viajar con comodidad. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

> Al llegar el avión estaba totalmente listo para empezar su respectivo trayecto, preparando todo adentro sentándose guardando el equipaje de mano, viendo que todo esté listo para partir, los nervios me agarran, pero también me emociono, lo veo como una aventura de la cual comienzo a disfrutar, ver el cielo más cerca y todo desde arriba que se ve tan pequeño, un viaje grato he tenido. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

body.title: True Steadiness Starts Before You Pick Your Outfit
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

I can't believe how long I lived without very little effort in intentionality, since I started to experience the difference. From my mind to how I look, I didn't really care much and just went with the flow and honestly, that has cost me steadiness for the longest time as I think back.

![IMG_20260608_120709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/241tfHGMgnqzgVVDWeCv2HShXqqTwRNGUubDNdfUh52QZLL5AxteWnrzobnxXS8BDphqZ.jpg)

Steadiness from the inside is one that many wish for but very few get to have, we chase the wrong things thinking we'd feel the peace inside when we do but somehow, we grow even more weary or anxious the more we go after those things. I've learned the simple things are the most steady.

Since I started to be more intentional about what goes into my mind, what I wear, what I say and what I do, it's been a different life for me than I even prepared for. But for this prompt, I'll focus on my dressing as it is indeed one aspect that has helped in reflecting how I feel on the inside.

I took the opportunity I found some months back, to explore how to appreciate my body and my life more. It was more random than how I'm saying it now but that opened my mind eyes to see how I've been dressing to please people than dressing to feel good and confident about myself before.

![IMG_20260608_094055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EoK8fMYbDKfHJe4YnRx2qPB6JtaiLyi1QRzfPKYjmkM6eyqgbejxgnsyu7zfPZXsEAg.jpg)

I remember how I'd always be cautious of how people see me in almost every wear I put on, there was nothing steady inside me when I step out. I can still remember the stories I tell myself on the inside when I am walking past a group of people even though I know they don't know me, I'll say in this, *\

*. Yes, that's how unsteady I've been in my wears long before I started to see it as a problem to be solved and I started to admire steadiness, confidence and loving the body I've been created with. After learning more about my body, being intentional about my wears and styles *(It's not even that I changed how I dress)*, things changed. ![IMG_20260531_154937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EpGT3yN9ra4FRWeKmuVhQEPaig77CtQtvS4WPhW7k3DA8N6n7xRsTBTEuKLAS2sxtr8.jpg) I'm going about wearing the same kind of clothes I wore before, I got new ones but the most important change has happened. I started to see more of myself than what I think people are seeing or talking about me. There is this peace I have when I dress up, the confidence that comes from accepting how I look by being intentional. Dressing, no matter how simple or grand it might look, only reflects one's inner steadiness when one choose to accept their look before the extra looks or addition comes to play. I believe people who do too much on their dressing are mostly people who don't appreciate themselves or are seeking steadiness in the wrong style of clothes. **Image used are mine.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/true-steadiness-starts-before-you-pick-your-outfit-jsg)

body.title: A freaky cup  (oil on paper)
body.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Monday to you all! I hope you spent a nice weekend! A new working week is just started, here the sun is shining on the sky and it's an hot day. Yesterday I cook jam thanks the (many) fruits my plum tree gave me this year. They are small fruits, small a little more than a cherry, and so I spent a lot of time ro remove the stones inside of them, but at the end the jam was very good and now 5 jars are ready. It was just the first part of fruits to cook, because the branches of my plum tree are still full of little plum fruits. 😁 Later in the afternoon I'll teach art to the kids of the art class inside my lab room, but waiting that time I'm working, as usual, on my artworks. In a pause from a large painting, I left my hands free to work on a small and fast one. I just finished to paint it so I can show you the final result: ![DSCN0628.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EogQkDYgKijiHVYeh3RBbASi6LqahWQNAU6Y6CdPcv8UvjHH5zgodGtv7mmLmDd6yx4.JPG) This was a sort of exercise, because I wanted to try to paint a different kind of cup. I'm not sure if this one could work for my usual painting, but I had fun to paint it. 😁 It's an oil colors painting on 200 gsm paper in A6 size and, as usual, I took some pics while I was painting it so you can see the process too: ![DSCN0619.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoAbBPQuMTeeV2byone875VAyT2VBW87mFZJ7xe54iwKmqedj9AmHZUAFJfZ1exL7gq.JPG) ![DSCN0620.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eo6LMAGKoY9qHc6mLtBm7EzeTP69pjH95JiK3LwSmwbKUs5ridXrJZX1JKhu2LLmo4D.JPG) ![DSCN0621.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoAbE7vANTpGoCKvakEkE4LahKASBnWWnuNk9VeELoYoBd1PK4UYX9pnU8SWZGdT2Sx.JPG) ![DSCN0622.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eoc82SnMiAMuMZTjp3MQ5hxqGCHAVsSagK6m8rUus1bJ5rSDgqi4bYDC343URufUd8e.JPG) I hope you like it! body.title: At first the famous Peregrine Falcon...
body.body:
...and then a picture joke to get you to laugh.
![030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoCbqBhNvwGVAa45Y8vvhFBmbsxLgbSKysnbgBQ1iDrA7X2DyndyQJqs5J4eWpg48BS.jpg)

I was so happy to at last, get the falcon taking off, and then the picture joke made my day. What is a picture joke you may ask? Wait and see in the second half of the post below.
But first let's concentrate on the falcon, as it is the record holder of the fastest diver of all the birds in the feathered kingdom across the world.

![018.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tvD2SVSxoUJW9bR5VzeSn1z2u3HuXDQnJfgfe8FutZMKhdR7eRnbPLppHiBs3yudwZn.JPG)

He was sitting on his favourite spot in a high tree searching for prey as usual and there are many high trees on the property, but he only sits on this one. An inborn habit to select the best spot with all round views, which is an ideal site to get one of the racing pigeons when they are out on a practise flight.   
![023.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u5bYbvntXVhpSyWPq2xugPg5jJspSDSXjuFZLrr5BYcQhtfjLGvy9KY36DVH38yS9qX.JPG)

I have watched him so many times that I knew that when he changed his seating position, then he would soon fly. 
![035.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tkk9EyU2ARLgk1s3PExGQTLj93otUfz8h5ngYtUCyH6xHCV7kd5jha2h2vP5Nq3ztMy.JPG)

Bang! I got him taking off even though he is very fast. A lesson for me here was that the next time I should change the camera onto the \

setting, as it can capture fast movements.
![032.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u5Yxo3WvfmQh5rgAnKPpsytNtwULeZ5a3rMCDMzM2LoknwjkNBWpYkR3TD1yFYDNXdW.JPG)

**Okay, let me show you below what I see as something to laugh about.**

This Hadeda Ibis came strolling down the road at the front of our place, and I tried to get some shadow pictures. But then something eventful happened.
![044.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tSQNnkYCvn7ZbnobQRozirKYJgmEzrtXv8WJcoFTGZ3NkMRdPsWXWb7dZX2z9H1D28R.JPG)

Suddenly, the bird made a U-turn, and I thought that he was on his way back from where he came from.
![045.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eo24iAgeQzeC9amERfhWhLR1VEZ1mbDgBfLeeN6KdV1ugehdENRsHmSsLfxE3zFMXV6.JPG)

Oh my goodness! I burst out laughing so loud that the neighbours ran out to see what I was laughing at. A bit embarrassing I know, but it took place in a split second, and it was totally unexpected.  
![046.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tbsMpUZ3AhTNL56LoP1PsdR69Udn6933VnfYEJ3GB7D3LCBTFgZyFmT7ToBYm5WfjMw.JPG)

And then he casually walked away. Maybe he wanted to tell me by his actions what he thought about me :) 
![047.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tH5PwpXM7A3uG5ZB5pSd1KJv5MeJmTSRJm9mmBMtbHH714NFc1vHhoNtiL23Md8cUmv.JPG)

But what he didn't know was that Robbie was also watching him, and you can see Robbie pulling his nose up at the smell. Shame, Robbie was really not impressed. And he shouted at the Ibis to use some toilet paper the next time. Lol.
![043.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u69LrxWXqoewbMxtBq43mN5UGppg4iQLqRvAPVTEe2DGBjqGE64ZVeV53WTDDWPhDE2.JPG)

So, now you know what I mean with a picture joke and none of what I said was actually true as it is just my strange sense of humor. In any case, a little bit of lighthearted fun is always welcome to relieve our stresses.

Bird species names in this post.

Peregrine Falcon (Falco peregrinus)
Hadeda Ibis (Bostrychia hagedash)
Cape Robin-chat (Cossypha caffra)

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

body.body:
You can ask people not to share them, it's up to them if they wanna listen or not. It's hard for me to keep track on who doesn't want their posts shared as I already have lots of other things to do on a daily basis. You're posting them on a public open platform and there's no loss from what I can tell from content on hive being shared outside, if anything it may bring value to our ecosystem that's rewarding you in inflation of all stakeholders (it's kind of one of the base ideas behind inflationary rewards). It may also bring new users to our ecosystem who'll directly follow you and engage/curate your future posts. 

I'm not sure what the reason may be why you don't want your photo's shared, maybe consider adding watermarks to them if you think someone might be stealing your photos? I don't think the issue is with sharing, anyone can come in here and share photos/text/other and call it their own outside of hive, whether they're being rewarded for sharing or through other means or just for bragging rights.

Feels like you're going about it the wrong way to ask people not to share pictures when the root issue may be the lack of watermarks on them? Dunno. Kind of a weird situation.

body.title: Wishes and Dreams
body.body: Last month I finally got myself together and cleaned my so called \

, where I keep my unused notebooks and bits and pieces of paper I can use for notes. It's been planned for ages and have been procrastinating it for just as long. The plan was to organize them, take photos and write a post about mt notebooks for mipiano's challenge, that also ended ages ago, but in the end I ended up organizing the notebooks and decided to not write about them. Not because I'm lazy, but because I don't know if anyone cares, besides me honestly. While organizing the individual pieces of papers, I came across a piece with a list on it. It's not something out of the ordinary as I often write lists. Most of you will say I can have digital notes on my phone and save paper, which is true but for me, my own handwriting helps me remember better what it is on the paper by visualizing it. It's a trick I've been using all my life that gives me a huge advantage. ![20240202_111709a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpA4PcsjWCh58bfJmrTtcGuE1kn4VvNcKJ61TQXuc4xogWTNdm1pbT468GYMviWPeXH.JPG) Anyway, the list itself was not a surprise, but what was on it made me smile. It was a wishlist or a list of things I wanted, that I wrote a few years ago. I can assure you, that this is the only one I wrote as it's not a habit of mine to write wishlists. If I want something, I go for it and make it happen as that's the only way to get what you want. Making a list definitely won't get you closer to your goals, so this tells you it was more like a dream, or things that would be great to have, but definitely not a priority. Unfortunately there was no date on it, so I have no idea how many years have passed since I wrote it. Big mistake, that can't be fixed, but I think it was three or four years ago. ![20240311_095516a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8wsu7jU6wg3iwoYpkaECLMQ6JEifCtYDy6iroXSFQUzY7dQmPiqY8srCoxbLudrT2k.JPG) There were four things on the list, in this order: - air conditioning, - wooden shoes, - ear pieces, - office chair. It was funny to read it and even made me smile because I totally forgot about the list, but what was interesting was that three things I could cross over from the list, that's 75%, which is a good achievement. The three things that I got since then were the first three: air conditioning, wooden shoes and ear pieces. ![20240202_110638a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2qC7UVLA6JNCybhZKvHXYzCeeNC1oH24XC2U3hwFHZu3SEGsszcVMyWhaHn5EJRB6w.JPG) This brings me to the main point here. For me, everything is a question of want or need. The two things are not the same and if you want to get ahead with your plans, you need to prioritize based on those two things. The first thing on the list, the air conditioner was the biggest of all and for a good reason. It was both a need and a want. Could I live without it? Of course I can, but how? The weather has changed a lot in the past two decades, summers are so hot that honestly, it's a struggle without air conditioning and two months each year is spent on trying to survive the day, instead of enjoying life the fullest and being productive. Setting in up required investment as the units are not cheap at all, plus what was again a real pain, was the dedicated electric circuit for them as the current circuit would have not supported the consumption, but it's done! Last year I finally made it happen and can enjoy the summer now. ![20240423_213010a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EopuMKPCNFejfCJq5uxaoKDQ4svbRTFDTyHgeDsGHEHCHoxhohQnDexJnBSHu7SNh5P.JPG) The other two were definitely want and not need as you can live without wooden shoes and I had earpieces, just not wireless. Now I have both and I'm happy. Oops, I forgot about the office chair. Well, it's not like I would not enjoy a new one, but the old one is still functional and have been postponing the purchase for years. In other words, this is still a *want*, not a *need*, but I'll buy one when it becomes a *need*. This topic brought back some old memories, from the 90's when MLM was in the vogue and everyone wanted to get rich by recruiting everyone and selling everything. Motivational videos were everywhere, and the most common method everyone suggested was a list with things you want, posted everywhere, to remind you every day. Well, maybe some of us are forgetful and need to be reminded every day of what they want, but if you are really serious, then you work for it, every single day and you don't need any reminder. ![20250417_181951aa.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2esoYFieqN4jbMKj9tSdVzKTeCGbBrG2wSq4VK9DMbfrio6i9hgN5S6j3Q3yLikMYw.JPG) This is kind of similar to the *weight loss/gym* mentality, where people are ready to buy whatever outfit and gadget is trendy these days, hoping these would make them lose weight, then harsh reality slaps them in the face and realize they actually have to put in the work on a daily bases, without exception, if they want results. I'm guilty of many things, from procrastination to laziness in some cases, but know that you need to be consistent and strong, if you want to get where you want to be. Daydreaming won't take you far. What about you? Do you make wish lists? Let me know in a comment.

></center>

body.title: Demutskrankheit: Inzwischen habe ich auch eine Methode entwickelt, wie ich den Prozess sicher unterwegs starten kann.
body.body:
Die Unterscheidet sich nur in einer Sache von meinen bisherigen Niederschriften ueber die Moeglichkeit den Prozess der Loesung von der Demutskrankheit im Laufen also Spazieren kaum bis garnicht.

Im Grunde, lauscht man mit einem Ohr zum Himmel und das natuerlich Abwechselnd.

Den Kopf mit dem Kinn moeglichst nahe an die Brust, aber definitiv weder aufliegend das Kinn, auf irgendwas, noch nicht Locker im Mund gehalten den Unterkiefer.

Das ist immer ziemlich wichtig, nicht versehentlich zu beißen.

Wenn man nicht an der Demutskrankheit leidet, bin ich mir inzwischen fast sicher, muss man auch nicht beißen.

Mit den Zaehnen also schoen locker und flockig bleiben.

Unterweges eigenet sicht die SBahnd Straßenbahn, Bus und Ubahn natuerlich auch. Also alles was Schienen hat, kann die Therapie sogar noch verstaerken und warum?

Weil da minimal ein bisschen Anziehungskraefte auf den Raum durch die Bewegung wirken, und die reichen schon aus, um eine Verstaerkung direkt spuerbar zu machen.

Man lauscht also mit einem Ohr in den Himmel, waehrend man laeuft.

Das ist extrem befriedigend und schaut sicherlich lustig oder dumm aus, interessiert mich aber nicht, was die anderen Denken die koennen ja auch Fragen im Zweifel.

Irritiert sind die Mitmenschen dann aber schon definitv, was mir ja erstmal egal sein soll, ich will nur gesagt haben, das wird auffallen, wenn man irgendwo rumsitz, steht oder laeuft und in den Himmel lauscht und es sollte einem Scheißegal sein!

Man bekommt, und das ist das eigentlich interessante dabei, als Mann fuer mich sowieso, nicht mehr so viel mit, durch die Sinne, mit dem was um einem herum passiert und das beim Sehen natuerlich, man musste ja wie jemand er ueber die Brille guggt nach oben schauen. Demuetig eben.^^

Soweit, habe ich auch Verstanden, das die Sache im Kern wie ich sie Dokumentiert hat stimmt, aber die genaue anatomie nur an der Schluesselstelle hinten am Ohr von mir richtig beschrieben war, ohne es je bewusst betrachtet zu haben.

Erst als ich hier die Bilder hochgeladen habe im letztem Beitrag, habe ich mir das nochmal mit der Erkenntnis ueber die Demutskrankheit angesehen und bin positiv ueberrascht gewesen, das man sogar am knochen außen sehen kann, was ich da beschrieben habe als sicherlich zuvor laie in dem thema wie die meisten anderen eben auch.

Aber ich werd grad ein Profi fuer das System und mein Hirn rattert bei jeder Gelegenheit hier in Berlin ein fuer das oeberflaechlich Belanglos anzusehende Massenproblematik mit solchen Loesungen abarbeiten.

Ich loese Probleme, die sich technisch geben, aber menschlich sind. Das ist echt Schoen, weil mir das voll liegt.^^

Salve

Alucian

It's a game by Klei Entertainment (the folks behind *Don't Starve*)—a game I absolutely love. And, as you might expect, it's all about survival: you have to scavenge and level up while fending off monsters. >Hola, gente de Internet ¿todo bien? Como dije anteriormente hoy estoy aqui para mostrarles mis avances con este juego. Este es un juego de Klei Entertaiment (mismos de Don't Starve) un juego que me encanta y se trata como no podía de ser de otro modo, de supervivencia, hay que hacer rapiña y avanzar de nivel mientras sobrevivimos a monstruos

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wgAwsbqNw4CpHz5Sr9hiQACdKXWsvVWp3McwMbAWE1xeWzGuLV93fkGpqiXUL2qPsXH.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tRrJAnGCZanU4AC7Dwtu6BrJ5FDAVno7xjoVknPSCceP1LQrBMWDXfxCnCcXVvPdUFa.jpeg)

This time, I'm hosting an event where you make your way through the cars of a train, collecting supplies and facing off against bosses and elite monsters (in addition to the regular monsters).

>Esta vez estoy haciendo un evento que se trata de avanzar entre vagones de un trend recogiendo suministros y enfrentando jefes y monstruos de elite (además de los monstruos normales)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tGZn1Ue2QbFbbKn7G9WYM15W6W6ckfFUhpagqN9UkKvtUXU7M9NU5EyoDnYVoUktjFU.jpeg)

It's pretty fun—when monsters die, they drop resources that I can carry in my backpack or upgrade candies. These help me progress because upgrading my character's powers makes them stronger and helps me move forward. They even give me medicine to heal myself, though after a while they stop giving it to me, and it becomes an uphill battle to keep going.

>Es bastante divertido, cuando los monstruos mueren, dejan recursos que llevar en mi mochila o caramelos de mejora, estos ayudan a avanzar ya que al mejorar los poderes de nuestro personaje lo hacen más fuerte y nos ayuda a avanzar, incluso nosdan medicina para curarnos aunque después de un tiempo ya no nos la dan y es cuesta arriba avanzar
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tvB2ofXkuAF9JDCRKSdx7Dc15tY3zaE5wT1hNA5vWwFZZoXaY85NJ1Z6Do2WrmNmTzs.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tbMYBbUki39EZnRasnArVswFCvgpfw7PZLu5qoQ7KitNjZ1c7y6tCzReKa7dK1ggJST.jpeg)

As I made my way through, I ran into a boss—a Bully boss, lol. I laughed so hard when I saw it. My character has the ability to place bells that deal damage to enemies (I think it’s Japanese), and my best strategy is to walk around the area placing bells (it places them on its own; I don’t have a button to do it), and together they deal damage to him. Keeping on the move is the best thing to do, and repairing the doors enough to keep the enemies busy banging on them while the bells do their job so we don’t take any damage

>A medida que avanzaba, me topé con un Jefe, un Bully jefe lol. Morí de risa al verlo. Mi personaje tiene el poder de poner campanas que hacen daño a los enemigos (creo que es japonés) y mi mejor método es caminar por el lugar dejando campanas (las deja el solo, no tengo un botón que lo haga) y entre todas van haciendole daño, no parar de moverse es lo mejor que se puede hacer y reparar las puertas lo suficiente para entretener a los enemigos golpeando la puerta mientras las campanas hacen su trabajo y no sufrimos daño
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tGe1LfCsKzeeuz5Aw27j9q7VuLCBbc5ETeXhSZyQVbYjFjCeDqKMKSnfUAoDjctfYUy.jpeg)

I reached level 20 (there’s a way to escape without dying and losing your loot: press the radio to open a portal, but you need to collect batteries for it), so when I saw my character was about to die, I decided to run away to take what I’d collected with me

>Llegué al nivel 20 (hay un modo de huir sin morir y perder el botin y es presionar la radio que abre un portal y para la cual debes reunir pilas) asi que cuando vi que mi personaje iba a morir preferi huir para llevarme lo que había reunido

These are the characters I've created: each one has different powers. The first one (from the base game) carries a gun, the next one carries scissors (for obvious reasons), the next one (who reminds me of Ada Wong) also carries a gun, and this Japanese guy, who's my favorite :3

>Estos son los aspectos que he logrado para mi personaje, cada uno tiene poderes diferentes, el primero (el del juego base) lleva pistola, el siguiente lleva tijeras (por obvias razones) la siguiente (que me recuerda a Ada Wong) también lleva pistola y este señor Japonés que es el que más me gusta :3

I really like it—it’s a lot of fun. The only thing I don’t like is that there’s a mechanic where you have to watch videos to expand your backpack, open special doors, and so on. That wouldn’t be a problem if it weren’t for the fact that if the videos are too long, the game restarts when they finish, taking you back to the main menu, and you lose all your progress. So that’s the only thing I don’t like. Overall, though, I love it.

>Me gusta basntante es muy divertido, aunque lo que no me gusta es que hay una mecánica de ver videos para expandir la mochila, abrir puertas especiales etc y eso no sería un problema si no fuese porque si los videos duran mucho, al terminar el juego se reinicia y te pone en la pantalla de inicio del juego y pierdes todo el progreso, asi que es lo único que no me gusta. Aunque en general me encanta
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 3.07.35 PM (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tGwQHhk4fPWCsb8bGcMrUPrj2HE8JpypKFzUaASLTNhXm91kZRdfZHwy2L8yxxMBHP9.jpeg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post

body.title: Mría [Book Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Pink Yellow Aesthetic Collage Travel Diaries Vlog YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xKxeJULuYC8BKu2YwC4FwkqfkmDP49nsnpuCvppRg9fJ7haNhLdxEKDnvPns8mMW67U.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

The entire story takes place in the Cauca Valley, Colombia, and tells of the tumultuous yet idyllic romance between two young people, María and Efraín. One of the obstacles they face is their blood relation, as they are cousins, and to make matters worse, María suffers from epilepsy. Ultimately, Efraín's parents, who were caring for María, decided to accept the relationship and allow them to become engaged, but on the condition that he go to Europe to study medicine. Upon his return, they would marry. However, when he comes back... well, I won't tell you more so as not to spoil the expectations of anyone who decides to read this wonderful Latin American novel, which is rarely discussed. >Toda la historia transcurre en el Valle del Cauca, Colombia y se trata del tormentoso aunque idílico romance entre dos jóvenes, María y Efraín, pero uno de los impedimentos que tienen en su contra es su parentesco sanguíneo pues son primos y para colmo María sufre de epilepsia, pero al final de cuenta los padres de Efraín que estaban a cargo de María decidieron aceptar la relación y dejar que se comprometieran para casarse, pero a cambio de que él se fuese a estudiar medicina a Europa, a su regreso se casarían, sin embargo cuando el regresa... bueno, no les contaré más para no arruinar las expectativas de quién decida leer esta maravillosa novela latinoamericana de la que poco se habla.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tvkRAXAJ8BWoNWRk3pMbDDA3wKeE8r7Xjs16GXeno6t5DrLBTjbdS1wBp3KmBS3xuUZ.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/4594867967049517184/)

It has a beautiful narrative and vocabulary; it's romanticism in its purest essence, where love is idealized and experienced with total intensity. The main characters dream of a life together but also tremble before an uncertain future or possible tragedy. Furthermore, nature plays a crucial role in the novel, acting as another character or even, we could say, as a reflection of the main characters' emotions. I love the description of the Cauca Valley; it's almost like an invitation to visit and enjoy all the beauty and wonders the author mentions, and at the same time, it sounds like the perfect setting for romance.

>Tiene una narrativa y un vocabulario precioso, es romanticismo en su más pura escancia, donde el amor es idealizado y se vive con total intensidad, los personajes principales sueñan con una vida juntos pero también se estremecen ante un futuro incierto o la posible fatalidad, pro otra parte la naturaleza juega un papel importantísimo en la novela, actuando como un personaje más o incluso podríamos decir que como un reflejo de las emociones de los personajes principales. Me encanta la descripción del Valle del Cauca, es casi como una invitación a visitarlo y disfrutar de todas las bellezas y maravillas que menciona el autor, y a su vez suena como el escenario perfecto para el romance.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u62xi6L5kgT6R6F7EXc22itnatygwrTXjczmLPxtpBUJb7Yvwn5kof5iFjz1M6fqncZ.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/796081671633222159/)

The story is somewhat reminiscent of Romeo and Juliet, or more accurately Wuthering Heights (perhaps due to the setting), and it reminds me of Romeo and Juliet because of the idealized romance between the protagonists. It's narrated in the first person, with Efraín telling his own story, which makes the novel feel more personal and realistic.

>La historia de cierta manera recuerda a Romeo y Julieta o más propiamente Cumbres Borrascosas (tal vez por el entorno) y me recuerda a Romeo y Julieta por la manera en que está idealizado el romance de los protagonistas. Está narrada en primera persona, siendo Efraín quién cuenta su propia historia y esto hace que la novela se sienta más personal y realista.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xAc8gxBLNLu9EAeyAhzEQq4R4PwYETGsZYJRxdVzirLCcKKauyKD2vpDY43XR8d75w8.jpg)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/540643130260541017/)

It is a work worth reading but I think it is very underrated, in the sense that it is hardly mentioned and seems to get lost among the success of other Latin American works such as One Hundred Years of Solitude or The House of the Spirits.

>Es una obra digna de leer pero me parece que está muy infravalorada, en el sentido de que casi no se menciona y parece diluirse entre el éxito de otras obras latinoamericanas como Cien Años de Soledad o La Casa de los Espíritus.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

body.title: Relaxing After Running Errands [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de LUGARES PARA VISITAR EN MÉXICO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wMajAEUK6w4vQiCP3dkyxLauyhydqh66SQsJg2npuGhbBEv5eEqVD2LZgjMdTueAm36.jpg)
(Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva)
>Cover designed by me in canva editor

These past few days, my sister and I went to the bank to do some paperwork. You know, endless lines and bureaucratic requirements that made me sigh with boredom while I sat on that cold metal bench. I don't know about other countries, but in mine (Venezuela), a single transaction can take a very long time, especially since several bank branches have closed, and therefore the ones that remain are overcrowded. The thing is, after waiting so long, we couldn't even complete the transaction because it was getting too late. >En estos días mi hermana y yo fuimos a hacer algunos trámites bancarios, ya saben, filas interminables y requerimientos burocráticos que me hicieron sus pirar de tedio mientras estaba sentada en aquel frío asiento de metal del banco. No sé en otros paises pero en el mío (Venezuela) una sola transacción puede tardar mucho tiempo, en especial porque han cerrado varias agencias bancarias y por ende las que permanecen se abarrotan de personas, el caso es que luego de esperar tanto ni siquiera pudimos hacer el trámite porque ya se estaba haciendo muy tarde.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.29.47 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23w2kpx575TRNJpnRzHRqn7A3zeEQKpfimXi6RiL88yD8nnr8RRcZfbi19FMnzaGABP9D.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.24.12 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uFRYHkpUHUeQ778PJYen8MnaTNPKUM1fhqamiHeUYvGpysbx8VAZuEhZABCwCXfeTyy.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.08 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpA2bTRXHUWmvKjdGbWFNnATpnToAmXj91tuRAuNPgdKCJsqPrWW96MNZpYYafVu7zM.jpeg)

Anyway, we were hungry and tired, so we both decided to go not just for lunch but to relax at a special place we both know in the city. It's a collection of restaurants with a very interesting eco-friendly concept. We chose one called Mordisco, but it's surrounded by other restaurants anyway. What I liked most about it is that it's all surrounded by green areas, lots of vegetation, and animals like birds, roosters, squirrels, and koi fish in the ponds. By the way, even though the ponds are artificial, they're made in a way that makes them look natural, and the sound of the running water is a delight.

>En fin, ya teníamos hambre, estábamos cansadas, así que las dos decidimos ir n solo a almorzar sino a relajarnos en un lugar especial que ambas conocemos en la ciudad, es un compendio de restaurantes que manejan un concepto ecológico muy interesante, nosotras elegimos uno que se llama Mordisco, pero de todos modos está rodeado de otros restaurantes. Lo que más me gustó de allí es que todo está rodeado también de areas verdes, mucha vegetación y animales como pájaros, gallos, ardillas y peces Koi en los estanques, por cierto que los estanques aunque son artificiales están hechos de una manera que parecen naturales, y además el sonido del agua corriendo es una delicia auditiva.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.07 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eou8Awf9bXNXdBYc81iEvvyofRfjRh7fFBcusxox7NncBms7dVqo5uv4VaYZeXHt4Hn.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.32.03 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vsQprX7G8jhY1qR384jihYbnim7cpNMNsqST2MeQzRUs7TDCL7McEfjDDAqkG2i36c3.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.37.41 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23z7DSiSGddctLxi6EZ9SJpLRk8NRyL8nzSg8u8beCeWCC5WtKyWg1KHHtj5tKBuai6UR.jpeg)

Only when you look up and see the buildings do you realize that you are still in the middle of the city.

>Tan solo cuando alzas la vista y ves los edificios es cuando te das cuenta que sigues en medio de la ciudad.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.56 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpvgxyZsEpLMNdfzM5YVtfDe4oXHi5qwn2efvwpgjorsvKuCrBzmRBqEwa2YMvtaqsf.jpeg)

Among the restaurants, there's one that really caught my attention because of its concept. It's very bohemian, with vintage elements and some antique decorations, like that beautiful old bicycle. But the best thing about it is the book booth, where you can take a book and read it at your leisure while enjoying your meal.

>En medio de los restaurantes hay uno que llamó mucho mi atención por el concepto que tiene, es muy bohemio, tiene elementos muy vintage y algunas antigüedades de decoración, como esa vieja y hermosa bicicleta, pero lo mejor de todo es la cabina de libros, de la que puedes tomar uno y leerlo a voluntad mientras degustas tu comida.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.54 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoiWBJXPdGqmT55ee4i1uZqMU6wfVqP8Bi4oEHzQEb3MYWaRWmmFpykZPrEfW1FxAQ1.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.55 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eos1qu3nDkMkYFHeE2a8vc1vh7MSv1UjcN8F2nrUzXH7frpUv6y9MDfDTRrDJwbfFni.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.56 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EppLePobPXJCQMT2PA7ChvrKgaY1NLDw1146P3tzsYtHuie8vx3FYWcW7SAcGXRMvrx.jpeg)

After our delicious lunch, I opted for a light but delicious snack: a delightful cornstarch alfajor filled with dulce de leche and decorated with shredded coconut. It was the perfect ending, the ideal complement to lunch. So, even though we couldn't complete the banking procedures, we had a pleasant day.

>Luego de nuestro delicioso almuerzo yo opté por merendar con algo ligero pero riquísimo, un delicioso alfajor de fécula de maiz, relleno de dulce de leche y una decoración de coco rallado, fue el cierre perfecto, el complemento ideal para el almuerzo, así que a pesar de que no pudimos concluir los trámites bancarios tuvimos un día agradable.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.57 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Ep1ZkLNzGntTHauros7679La2wMdaWyFdb6TMh5qMQJkaMD1aRt5J3KnGWrtMdS9mKZ.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.12.59 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/243M9TRdqrAU3woUB6GUBTLcvafDAofeYWytCbAXwmJxpY3rtGRfFisZ9fECyX3embPeF.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.46.54 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vhuaphh9aDZrWyLvJh4ULND46rMQXnpxNEWH1eLK4Fx8BKLqSBbeS53PSLnNsXktXRb.jpeg)

I hope to return to that place soon; if so, I'd choose a different restaurant for a different experience. But yes, I definitely managed to relax surrounded by nature and far from the banking bureaucracy, haha.

>Espero pronto volver a ese lugar, en ese caso elegiría otro de los restaurantes para vivir una experiencia diferente, pero sí, definitivamente logré relajarme en medio de la naturaleza y lejos de la burocracia bancaria jeje
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)
>Imagen diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva.

All images in this post are my own, taken with a ZTE Blade A51.

>Todas las imágenes de este post son de mi propiedad, las tomé con un teléfono celular ZTE Blade A51.

body.title: Searching For God
body.body:
You don't want to seek God with all your heart.
Surely you will find Him. So living a life with the assistance of God can create a very big void that can never fill us.

We need to find that missing piece in us, our life, knowing that we lack that presence of God. Seeking God is very important. God wants us to be closer to Him. And what I can imagine, He does not want distractions
to hold us or release us.

It's just impossible to not realize that God is knocking at our door. God will speak to us in this world that when we draw near unto Him, then He is definitely going to draw near unto us.

We need to be willing and open our heart to find God. Nothing should be able to affect our focus or take our gaze from our Creator. Having God in our life is such a big treasure. You cannot equate it to all the witches in this world or anything that can be offered.

So search for God today.

body.title: Which are the Popular Motorbike Tour Circuits in India?
body.body:
India offers some of the world's most rewarding motorcycle journeys, attracting riders from every continent. From high mountain passes to desert landscapes and coastal roads, motorbike tours india provide experiences that go far beyond sightseeing. The country's diverse geography allows riders to experience multiple terrains in a single trip. Popular circuits combine adventure, culture, history, and scenic roads, making them some of the [best motorcycle tours in india](https://www.indiamotorbiketour.com/).

**Top Motorbike Tour Circuits in India**

• Indian Himalayas Motorcycle Tour covering Leh Ladakh, Nubra Valley, Pangong Lake, and high-altitude mountain passes

• Himalayan motorcycle tour routes through Himachal Pradesh, Spiti Valley, and remote mountain villages

• Rajasthan circuit featuring Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer, and desert highways rich in heritage and culture

• South India routes connecting Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka with coastal roads, tea plantations, and wildlife reserves

• Northeast India adventures through Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, and lesser-explored Himalayan landscapes

**Which Circuit Should You Choose?**

For riders seeking adventure and dramatic scenery, the Indian Himalayas Motorcycle Tour remains the most sought-after option. Those interested in history and architecture often prefer Rajasthan's royal routes.

An India Motorbike tour offers a unique way to explore the country's diversity. Whether riding through the mountains, deserts, or coastal regions, these routes continue to rank among the most memorable motorbike tours india experiences for international travelers.

body.body:
Hello there! It is great to see you again. For now, we have a nice group of hosts, so no need of any new application. For the next hangout, we will have @daverick as invited host. Also, don't forget that 3 posts from our members who participate in the new hangout will be considered for curations Last session, we discussed the topic: --- ### ** Can Love Survive Financial Struggles in Today’s World? ** --- Our community debated about love and the financial side, how they go with each other. World is tough and the community thinks that love isn't enough to make a relationship thrive. Economic problems for sure bring a weight of challenge that should make the couple to decide what they want to do next. It was a well-attended --- **THIS WEEK'S TOPIC:** --- ##
SEASONS AND YOU
--- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23xyteUzrnFQV3o3XWSH2VM5kksrTZyR4VHkYof4ixuoFy1c1L4UJoKr8zoMu4ZU9in3h.png) There seems to be a sequence for things in life, as many people would agree with. These could be considered processes in life, which have been termed as seasons, periods or time. But then, do seasons apply to things within our effort that remain unattainable sometimes? We've heard people say “It's not my time...it will happen in my time.” Is it really not one's time or are we missing something or is there an effort we're not making? **Discussion Questions:** - Would you say that there's actually a time for everything? - Delay can be experienced sometimes in life. Is that part of seasons as well? - Have you missed out on a season that you now regret? Do you think you'd do better if you had it back? - What season did you make great use of and you're proud of? - What do you think about missing out on a season in life?
