body.title: The Street Speaks Through Art - DIGITAL ART I NFT ART * II ENG - PT_BR II
body.body:
![TEMPLATE ART ALIEN HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/48Whe3fbWHuQcRjMMQVEMQiHuqW1bWmDG7eCBSAitDLFwxcRvvsZETojqwUEKCJL2e.jpg)









------------------------
















This artwork was born from my admiration for Nervous Records and all the influence the label had on building the identity of one of the rap groups that most marked my journey as a listener. I've always connected with the beats, the rhymes, and the energy that these songs carry, and I felt the desire to transform this inspiration into a visual piece.






     
> Essa arte nasceu da admiração que tenho pela Nervous Records e por toda a influência que a gravadora teve na construção da identidade de um dos grupos de rap que mais marcaram minha trajetória como ouvinte. Sempre me conectei com as batidas, as rimas e a energia que essas músicas carregam, e senti a vontade de transformar essa inspiração em uma peça visual.

------------------------




![nervous.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23vi62FfwronkYqGonLXcoWzWur6v7Q5fANGq7tTRDZC7PynRCgtMtJ51SFVpyPdNL6VH.jpg)












------------------------


The central element of the composition is precisely the iconic character of the record label, a figure that represents an entire era and a visual identity recognized by those who follow this culture. From this, I sought to construct an artwork that directly engages with the streets, the place where much of this culture was born and continues to thrive today.






     
> O elemento principal da composição é justamente o personagem icônico da gravadora, uma figura que representa toda uma era e uma identidade visual reconhecida por quem acompanha essa cultura. A partir dele, procurei construir uma arte que dialogasse diretamente com as ruas, lugar onde grande parte dessa cultura nasceu e continua viva até hoje.
------------------------






![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23tSYcQymABgkUyvKH3KGv3UtjkVD3z7AmAj6v9o7gMGtRjy6gcBJr4jiRuv3bXnq9ayr.png)






------------------------





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23tmDLrSyvLRhuUCXH93xtS1LEvWq1XCjpxvxNYatQ3ecp6ybpAiotK13ftF8CzqPkD8P.png)








------------------------






![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wgRzUqxDS3KRKCDEUtCVY2kioZnG71iyFYfYLbC3eRW1s1inATwNb92rXrJWkVZfxfm.png)




------------------------

The aesthetic follows an urban language, featuring textures of torn paper, collages, and overlays reminiscent of stickers scattered on lampposts, wheatpaste posters covering walls, and the various visual interventions that are part of the urban landscape. I wanted the art to convey that feeling of something built in the streets, absorbing references from graffiti, underground design, and the visual communication we find walking through urban centers.

     
> A estética segue uma linguagem urbana, trazendo texturas de papel rasgado, colagens e sobreposições que remetem aos stickers espalhados pelos postes, aos lambe-lambes ocupando os muros e às diversas intervenções visuais que fazem parte da paisagem das cidades. Quis que a arte transmitisse aquela sensação de algo construído nas ruas, absorvendo referências do graffiti, do design underground e da comunicação visual que encontramos caminhando pelos centros urbanos.
------------------------



![nervous.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23vi62FfwronkYqGonLXcoWzWur6v7Q5fANGq7tTRDZC7PynRCgtMtJ51SFVpyPdNL6VH.jpg)




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wCC5HM86LAywa9nQ6VxDFrSAkRCkB3ehFQfXxHmkp5tAqALd2WSa2cjk7NG8m4beiKR.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xVRJxKkjbexicpD8X64ctSronQFQLcdrmx11pDuYuaDALuSjwCdJxMMteKdSE6s7gHf.png)

------------------------


More than a tribute to the record label, this creation also represents my connection to street culture. It's a blend of music, design, and urban expression—elements that have always influenced my creative vision. Every tear, texture, and detail was carefully considered to reinforce this identity, creating a piece that seeks to respect the origins of this culture while translating it into my visual language.

     
> Mais do que uma homenagem à gravadora, essa criação também representa minha conexão com a cultura de rua. É uma mistura entre música, design e expressão urbana, elementos que sempre influenciaram meu olhar criativo. Cada rasgo, textura e detalhe foi pensado para reforçar essa identidade, criando uma peça que busca respeitar as origens dessa cultura enquanto a traduz para a minha linguagem visual.


------------------------

body.title: Preferred Season For Me. LOH #292
body.body:
Hello Ladies, so if there is one season I always look forward to every year, it is definitely the rainy season

I know that  some people might prefer the dry season because they do not have to worry about getting caught in the rain or that they have to deal  with muddy roads, but  seriously me I will choose the rainy season like eee any day any time.

![1001480593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cohlson/23t752JBw3Yjvb4m62y7PyoCGpB1eGyCV1eDGn3bGbBAVvwBvDtZK6GLC2Yc1PUhKrXZu.jpg)

So the main reason that I like this particular season is because of the weather, fact is that anybody who lives in Nigeria knows how hot the sun can be during the dry season, there are days when you will  go outside just for a few minutes and the sun feels too hot and before you know it even before you get to where you are going you are already sweating from your head to toe 

And that is one thing I do not miss at all.

During the rainy season the weather is usually very much cooler and  also nicer,  the air feels fresher and it is easier to walk around without worrying about you sweating and it is this times that I like taking walke  and those  walks are a lot more fun because I am not too hot or sweaty.

Sometimes, after it rains everything feels different too, I don't know if  I am the only one that thinks that way....

The sky looks calmer.

The air feels cooler.

It is even easier to sleep at night because you are not always turning your pillow to find a cooler side, also another thing I enjoy is  the sound of the rain.

There is something about hearing the rain on the roof when you are inside, It makes me feel peaceful and relaxed, whether I am reading, writing, watching a movie or just resting, the rain makes everything feel so much nicer.

Of course the rainy season is not perfect. Every season has some things about it.

For me, the biggest downside is drying clothes, that is honestly the one thing that can become frustrating sometimes.

You know that during the dry  season you can wash your clothes in the morning and they will be dry  before long , but during the rainy season it can take a long time for your clothes to get dry.

Sometimes the sky will look bright and promising and then suddenly rain just appears from nowhere and now ruins your plans for the day.


Yeah, Thankfully, I don't struggle with it too much because my washing machine spins my clothes dry, which helps me a lot, so it is not  like a major problem for me personally.

Still, there are days when I wish the sun would just come out properly and do its job, not the aggressive dry season sun that wants to roast everybody alive.

Just enough sunshine to dry clothes quickly and disappear again, I think that's the balance I would love.


Cool weather most of the time, with occasional sunny days when needed, overall, though, I still prefer the rainy season.

The cooler temperatures, the fresh air, the comfortable walks, and the relief from the harsh heat make it worth it for me.

Every time the rainy season comes , I find myself enjoying the simple things more, even though waiting for my clothes to dry can be annoying,  it is a small price to pay for the weather that does not make me sweat too much.

So if I had to choose ,I would choose the rainy season every time.

[image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/rain-dropping-from-roof-rNBaaxyeWWM)

body.title: Monochrome Monday  shots from a recent visit to the port
body.body:
# Monochrome Monday shots from a recent visit to the port Good Morning, I hope you all had a good weekend, mine was nice and quiet As I tend to do starting the week with a few Monochrome edits of shots, this time from a walk I took at the Port here in New Bedford one morning, and slipping in one with splash of color I find I like to try mono often on Port shots, especially if they are taken on more darker moody mornings, when the light is nice, I tend to go more for color edits, but I guess these shots are the exception to that, as the morning I took these the light was nice, but some just called to me to do mono edits. Such as this first one of Capt Malc Now this boat has a lot of rust on it, and I think that adds to the feel of how hard working and well used many of the commercial fishing boats are, but I think mono makes it look more rusted and less worn
![mono at the port-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xAXcWqNzyqiidei7ovmwhYfnXpcaA7AFvVfLBvPYp6wXrLaahjyYv8EpUnbtLPteb8D.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F11 6 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xAXcWqNzyqiidei7ovmwhYfnXpcaA7AFvVfLBvPYp6wXrLaahjyYv8EpUnbtLPteb8D.jpg)**

Now here is the splash of color I mentioned, the reds of the frame caught my eye from a distance, and I walked closer for this shot. I tried a mono edit and liked it, but felt it was a shame to hide the reds that first caught my eye
![mono at the port.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48K7mNXDEsyNgXaPp2N5T9DfMFLLHeiiaMSXgYeu4qUMAnFRZSBQ1fZ1QKTQSWqmxD.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F1 3.2 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48K7mNXDEsyNgXaPp2N5T9DfMFLLHeiiaMSXgYeu4qUMAnFRZSBQ1fZ1QKTQSWqmxD.jpg)**

It was quite still that morning, and made for some cool reflections such as on these four boats lined up on one of the piers Sure, there is a little bit of motion blur on a couple of the boats, but I still like this shot

body.body:
Hola, querida amiga @lauramica.

Es muy cierto lo que dices: cuando la compañía es buena, no es necesario visitar lugares lejanos para pasarla bien; basta con un lugar cómodo rodeado de las personas que queremos.

Las termas de Colón son el lugar ideal para desconectarse y pasar un rato agradable festejando el cumpleaños de un amigo. Además, como bien mencionas, no hay que viajar mucho para llegar allí.

Qué precioso parque, las piletas están geniales, amo ese tobogán, y lo bueno es que tienes piscina con agua fría y caliente.

Muchas gracias por compartir esta experiencia.

Que tengas una feliz y próspera semana.  

Hello, dear friend @lauramica.

What you say is so true: when the company is good, you don't need to travel far to have a good time; a comfortable place surrounded by the people you love is enough.

The Colón hot springs are the ideal place to disconnect and spend a pleasant time celebrating a friend's birthday. Plus, as you mentioned, you don't have to travel far to get there.

What a beautiful park! The pools are fantastic, I love that water slide, and the best part is that it has both hot and cold water.

Thank you so much for sharing this experience.

Have a happy and prosperous week.

body.title: Television Review: Signs (Znaki, Seasons 1-2, 2018 - 2020)
body.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/wyMM8LjttRm2TxSCfCbXUJAY8iR.jpg)



*Nordic noir* was always destined to be imitated beyond Scandinavia's borders, and Poland—blessed with a sizeable population and thus a substantial domestic market for crime fiction—has emerged as one of the more prolific adopters of the genre. In recent years, the country best known to fantasy enthusiasts as the birthplace of *The Witcher* has witnessed something of a boom in crime fiction, first in literature and subsequently on screen. Among the televisual offerings is *Signs* (*Znaki*), a series that aired on the international AXN network from 2018 and was, until very recently, available on Netflix in its two-season entirety.

The drama unfolds in Sowie Doly, a fictional town nestled in the Owl Mountains—a wooded, remote region of southwestern Poland hard against the Czech frontier. The settlement is sufficiently minuscule that the protagonist, newly appointed police commander Michał Trela (Andrzej Konopka), is forced to lodge as a tenant on the property of Adriana Nieradka (Helena Sujecka), one of his own subordinates. Trela, whose transfer from Kraków was accompanied by whispers of a drink-sodden past, soon discovers that this ostensibly charming, sleepy hamlet conceals a wealth of dark secrets—including an unsolved murder of a young woman committed several years prior.

Trela must contend with a fresh killing in which one of the initial suspects is none other than Błażej Nieradki (Michał Czernecki), Adriana's husband, whom Trela had previously caught *in flagrante* in an affair with the murder victim. When a second death occurs, Trela realises he may be hunting a serial killer. Complicating matters further is Nina (Magdalena Żak), his adolescent daughter, who befriends Agata (Helena Englert), the \

daughter of Antoni Paszke (Mirosław Kropielnicki), the town mayor. Paszke, meanwhile, is up to his neck in decidedly murky dealings surrounding the construction of a mine financed by shadowy foreign investors.

*Signs* in its first season gives the distinct impression that its creators prized style over substance, and were not unduly concerned with originality. The fundamental premise owes a conspicuous debt to better-known Anglo-American series such as [*Twin Peaks*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-twin-peaks-seasons) and *Broadchurch*—a debt the writers attempt to obscure with a plethora of subplots that function rather awkwardly, and not always successfully, as some sort of coherent whole. What draws the viewer in far more than the narrative is the skilful deployment of the striking mountain locations, which create a genuinely distinctive atmosphere.

A measure of differentiation from standard police procedurals is provided by the incorporation of Catholic motifs—specifically, religious bigotry—which allows for the construction of several intriguing characters: the leader of a local cult and self-proclaimed healer Jonasz (Andrzej Mastalerz); the young, fanatical policeman Sobczyk (Piotr Trojan); and the newly appointed parish priest Śmigielski (Rafał Cieszyński), who clearly harbours a dark secret from his own past. Though the series is rendered rather convoluted by its numerous subplots and risks baffling its audience, it nevertheless functions—and the lion's share of credit belongs to the cast. Andrzej Konopka proves highly effective as a policeman who, despite manifold flaws, ultimately endeavours to do the right thing. Even more impressive is Helena Sujecka, who may well be the sole normal character in this dysfunctional milieu; she brings considerable realism to the role, deftly balancing feminine vulnerability with a hardy, salt-of-the-earth resilience. The first season might thus scrape a passing grade, despite a predictably irritating cliffhanger.

The second season, however, reveals its authors attempting something \
and \
—and, as is so often the case, overreaching considerably. *Signs* abruptly detaches itself from the \

crime genre and ventures into the realm of fantasy, with the screenwriters—having apparently exhausted their exploitation of rural Poland in the late 2010s—plunging deep into the past. Consequently, the series now encompasses Soviets, Nazis, flying saucers, and hints of time travel. All this suggests that fresh inspiration was sought in the German series *Dark*, yet the result is chaos of an even greater magnitude. The problem extends beyond content to form: a new subplot involves the hunt for lost treasure conducted by the young historian Eliza Konieczna (Ewa Jakubowicz), presented through flashbacks and non-linear narration that grows increasingly irksome, and ultimately utterly bewildering. The anticipated multiple cliffhanger at the season's end represents the very embodiment of melodramatic cliché, as well as the creators' inability to offer viewers anything coherent.

The second season thus comprehensively spoils the impression of the series; should the makers wish to salvage its reputation, they shall need to produce something of quite extraordinary quality in a third season—should such a season ever be commissioned.


RATING: 3/10 (+)


*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2021/01/24/recenzija-signs-znaki-sezona-1-2-2018-2020/).)*

body.title: Integration durch Substitution
body.body:
Eine weitere Möglichkeit, ein Integral zu lösen, besteht darin, dass man die Funktion oder Teile der Funktion substituiert. Substitution bedeutet das Ersetzen eines Termes durch einen anderen, weniger komplizierten Term.
Wenn man die Substitutionsregel anwendet, muss man bei bestimmten Integralen auch die Integrationsgrenzen für die Substitutionsvariabel berechnen.

https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/ozelot47/919982c66cf65e49ca1ffda0d86cf9f0baf654ba.png

In diesem Beispiel haben wir einen Bruch mit einer Wurzel im Nenner. Der Lösungsvorschlag ist, den Inhalt der Wurzel zu substituieren. Die Substitutionsvariable lautet hier u. Die entstandene Gleichung wird nach x aufgelöst und dann differenziert. Anschließend wird die Gleichung nach dx aufgelöst, denn dieses müssen wir im Integral ersetzen.

Die neuen Integrationsgrenzen werden berechnet mit u=3x+36. Für x werden die alten Grenzwerte eingesetzt, um die neuen zu erhalten.
Nun wird das Integral so weit wie möglich vereinfacht und dann die Stammfunktion gebildet. Mit dem Einsetzen der Integrationsgrenzen erhält man den Flächeninhalt.

https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/ozelot47/b088abc1b100290983a2ef5fd99372bf8df87c67.jpg

Aber was soll man substituieren, wenn sich das Integral nicht mit der normalen Integration oder der partiellen Integration lösen lässt? Eine eindeutige Antwort ist mir nicht bekannt. Aber es gibt einige Fälle, wo man substituieren kann. Zum Beispiel, wenn es einen Bruch gibt und der Zähler die Ableitung vom Nenner ist. Oder der zweite Faktor ist die Ableitung des ersten Faktors, also f(x)*f'(x).

body.title: Man vs. The Stripped Screw: Booze Runs, Red Devils, and a Fireplace Demolition
body.body:
Welcome back to the blog, fellow Hivers! Let’s talk about weekends. In theory, a weekend is a two-day sanctuary designed for rest, recuperation, and gentle hobbies. In practice, my past weekend was a chaotic symphony of international logistics, football euphoria, and a brutal, agonizing battle against a single piece of hardware in my living room.

Before we get to the physical trauma and the DIY disaster, let’s start with the successes, because chronologically, Saturday actually kicked off on a massive high note.

<h2 style=\
data-align=\
>The Great Border Booze Expedition\n\n
alt=\

/>

Saturday began with a tactical mission. With a big milestone party on the horizon, our local supplies were looking woefully inadequate. When you need to stock up for a proper gathering, you set your GPS for the border. We made the pilgrimage into Germany, specifically aiming for Tüddern.

The mission objective was simple: secure an ungodly amount of hard liquor and a mountain of soda. But here is where the true strategic genius of the operation comes into play. Germany operates on a very strict Pfand (deposit) system for their plastic bottles. If you host a party with loose plastic bottles, your lovely guests will inevitably undergo a temporary drop in IQ after three drinks and chuck those deposit-laden bottles straight into the regular trash.

Our masterstroke? We bought all the plastic soda bottles pre-loaded in hard plastic crates. It’s basic human psychology: a crate commands respect. When a guest empties a bottle, their primitive brain sees an empty slot in a crate, and their OCD takes over. They simply must put the bottle back in the slot. Disaster averted, the environment is saved, and more importantly, our deposit money is safely secured. It was a flawless execution of cross-border commerce.

<h2 style=\
data-align=\

>Red Devils on the Rampage After returning victorious from Tüddern, the liquid assets were secured, and it was time to focus on international football. The Belgian Red Devils were facing off against Tunisia in a friendly warm-up match. It was an absolute delight to watch, walking away with a glorious 5-0 victory. Now, in the interest of full journalistic integrity, I must concede that the match wasn't entirely a balanced affair. Tunisia received a red card shortly after we went 2-0 up, and that completely broke the dam. But you still have to actually score the goals! The squad looked sharp, the passes were crisp, and it was a highly solid performance. It’s the perfect appetizer for next Monday when their World Cup campaign officially starts against Egypt. The Egyptians had a stellar final friendly match themselves, so I am expecting a real clash. My couch is prepped, and the German beverages are chilling.
data-align=\
>Saturday 17:00 - The Hubris of the Unhandy Man\n\n
alt=\

/>

With the German expedition a success and the football team victorious, my confidence was dangerously high. I felt invincible. So, around 5:00 PM on Saturday, I decided it was time to attack the main project: removing the massive, built-in cast iron wood-burning stove (the dreaded inbouwcassette).

I started by systematically dismantling the beast. I am admittedly not the most handy guy in the world, but things were actually going incredibly well. I removed the doors, the grates, the loose internal plates. I was stripping away the weight piece by piece.

\
I thought.\n\n
alt=\

/>

Then, I met my nemesis: the throttle valve.

This valve was held in place by four screws. The first three came out with a bit of elbow grease. The fourth? The fourth screw was a veteran of a thousand fires. It had fused with the cast iron. Worse, the head of the screw was completely stripped. The little slot where your screwdriver goes simply did not exist anymore. It was just a smooth, mocking circle of metal. Brute force means nothing when you have zero grip.

I brought out the Dremel tool. I figured I would just cut a new slot or saw the head off entirely. I hunched over in the cramped, soot-filled fireplace, sparks flying, making a deafening racket. By 10:00 PM, I was covered in black dust, exhausted, and the screw had barely a scratch on it. My wife, stepping in as the voice of absolute reason, looked at the scene and gently declared, \

I surrendered.

Sunday Morning: The Hardware Store Saga
---------------------------------------

  
Sunday morning, I woke up with renewed determination. I drove straight to the local DIY store. The plan was foolproof: buy a fine hacksaw as a backup, and buy a brand new, heavy-duty cutting disc for the Dremel.

I arrived home, triumphant, only to discover a slight logistical flaw. My Dremel is a vintage relic—at least 20 years old. The brand new, state-of-the-art cutting disc did not fit the ancient mechanism of my tool.

Back in the car. Back to the DIY store.

I marched to the counter, explained the issue, and asked for a disc that would fit a two-decade-old machine. The clerk tapped on his keyboard, looked up, and said, \

Now, living near the border means popping over to Germany for cheap booze or Holland for random supplies isn't unusual, but I drew the line at making an international trip for a single Dremel disc. I politely declined and headed home. It was time to do this the old-fashioned way.

Blood, Sweat, and \

I grabbed the fine hacksaw I had bought. There was barely any room to maneuver inside the dark cavity of the stove. What followed was an agonizing period of pure getaffel—that beautifully untranslatable word for clumsy, awkward, frustrating fiddling. Millimeter by millimeter, cramp by cramp, I sawed at that stubborn piece of metal. I am not a patient man, but the sheer spite I held for that screw kept my arm moving. And finally, with a satisfying metallic clink, it gave way. The smoorklep was free. With the final internal obstructions removed, I grabbed my pry bar. After some serious heaving, the entire heavy cassette finally popped loose from the wall. Success! Now came the extraction. I enlisted my wife and my oldest son. We took our positions, gripped the edges of the cast iron shell, and pulled.
alt=\

/> It was immediately apparent that physics was not on our side. The thing weighed an absolute ton, and lifting it awkwardly out of a recess was a recipe for three synchronized hernias. We wisely dropped it back down. Pride is a dangerous thing, but knowing when to call for backup is a sign of maturity. I picked up my phone and called in the cavalry. A couple of strong friends came over, and with enough combined muscle and grunting, we finally hoisted the beast out of its cave and into the light. The hole is empty. My living room looks like a demolition site, my back aches in entirely new places, and I spent a ridiculous percentage of my weekend fighting a single, headless screw. But looking at that empty space? I couldn't be happier.
alt=\

/>

The hardest part is done. The party supplies are safely crated in the fridge, the football team is looking sharp, and I have officially won my battle against the cast iron beast. Let's just hope the Red Devils have an easier time breaking down Egypt's defense on Monday than I had breaking down that smoorklep!

Until next time, keep your screwdrivers sharp and your friends on speed dial.

Cheers,  
Peter

body.title: Patterns!
body.body:
Hi, great minds,

As I write today, I wonder what we haven’t yet spoken or written about. Is there any news? It is all repetition.

Life is a cycle. Whether we accept it or not, some of us are just here to repeat patterns. The law of karma has its root and essence in the cyclical structure of life.

Today, I am not writing to make a point. I am writing because there is a need to scribble down something.

Have you ever wondered what patterns you are here to repeat?

The harsh truth is that some people seem to drift toward destruction, while others move toward greatness. Yet every day presents opportunities that can change the direction of a life.
But does that justify discouragement or give us a license to live irresponsibly?

I think the proof that you are doomed for condemnation is when you begin to accept disappointment, failure, and pain as part of your reality instead of doing something about it.

No wonder God collected the one talent—not because He is a bad God or never loved the guy.

It is because He knew that the guy with one talent was doomed. Giving him the talent was a chance to save him, but he proved to God why he should never have been given the one talent.

As I conclude, let me ask you:

The way you are currently living, are you like the one-talent guy, or are you going to use God’s chance well?

Or prove to Him why He shouldn’t have given you what He gave you?

Thank you for reading!
I will continue, tomorrow.

body.title: Made a Snack in a Snap: Mommy D's Upgraded Version of Banana Fritters -with Sesame Seeds This Time!
body.body: <div class=\

>

![1000037861.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpNrL9NVbh5KondayXysbfZ4Mu3V49io7hDTMiAK5GxZh1KZfgBRrHU4drmYyaZKbBu.png)

As i've mentioned on my recent blog, we received lots of banana, from saba to latundan from a relative and they're turning yellow incredibly fast. We can't just eat them as is because even if we eat three each a day,there's still more and we're really thankful about that..but yeah, they're too fast to ripened and that's a bit bad. But not a problem because Mommy D can always do something for that.

<div class=\
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eq386w1iBTs5giuY4XgtnSDXFekcRuxJgoCpVVAGbJKpFzDnkmybAzy79r9zmM4KMCP.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eq9Uk6MGA8XXz94cg5G4rcfwgxkLe7fSkRqhsLVvGjCqg5onno8EjAVc58t2gJcBJvp.jpg But before I share about our bananas, let me share the we did the other day too because I saw a whole bunch of bananas on our way home when we visit the market. There's a bunch and they are still green, I guess they are delivering it into big cities, not sure where. Banana is kinda expensive now, even Saba was sold by piece and I think the lowest price of it is 2 pesos per piece it also depends on the size. For this kind of bansna I think they're sold per kilo. How much is this in your place guysuu?
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpXLTPqPScDjJPbkeumCGnc8a81LWRXPQZxu9G4ehFTTwC5WyRWaHvuccZbJPdwsVev.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK6ryFREHB4ECskAV5rRUQL147844CUvLDzjc6priq4SQDCjDq6VMJD1ggBDX6Rs2X.jpg The owner of this shop is also the owner of these bananas I think. In some month, we always see lots of different kind of banana in front of her store. Mama just bought kilo of rice from her. Now I miss seeing a banana tree in the yard. Back then when this place is not renovates yet, banana just sprout here and we'll have them instantly. How do we plant banana again? I really have no idea
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EogLt8fRHjtoR6aFXPgYaAs88H55MKWLNbYSc3qxECJqQ1NhoNFyHHhbENkgz9KNPNu.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpA2bSBasPTo6TPJQiVvr96mroWk3KtKXYmQkcCmMyVkGvcejoGxUoQENub9hDkFrqG.jpg So moving on to Mommy D's banana recipe today. This one is just like a upgraded version of banana fritters haha..it still has crushed peanuts and seriously, that's my number one favorite ingredient for this recipe. Mom used ***flour, milk, sugar, water, smashed ripe bananas, pinch of salt, crushed peanuts***. Ans for the **special toppings, Sesame seeds** which is a leftover from last, last, last month, yes, yes, that long (⁠ ⁠/⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠)⁠/⁠♪⁠♪
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAcCbAZHXvankToo3BnN2SPqLGZUzk85QDk9fVE548sgBT6VTHqPMf6cKWJpjLzNbb.jpg\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo4E1124ZNKU5kZYziZeUGFhiyqTiyb4TNr48bPeMnESV8GR1uJoDaiSgGXQLGXqtUS.jpg\n\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo8UpUMjKgXaiN818HjuhYBbHMsASr68dEf95EyRq8BLNuWCiRSQEERskoHa7BHtxo3.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo8UqUBbDGbBEPE5DEf6Zt6LXzWfA2dFSpPebzx1xGyWxKH1XQsHEkn8Nu7xMJVkgmh.jpg Let me just share how much **crushed peanuts** we put in it, this mixture is actually from today and Mommy D used Milo in it instead of milk, but we'll stick to the original I just want to share how much peanuts we put in it. Yum, yum!
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoGvxdcdyBefDFVNTioRM2TnxAwgHJoAXFoFBQKkZ7rxssRUsdCMUJvrqW74irS683A.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAYLaz4n8mMTwUze9Kx8wRALQEQfRjUqHniLwhngbBCppHgPpbW1umoEACx2KKQFGa.jpg The consistency of the batter should not be thick or watery for easy frying. We'll need oil in cooking it, once the oil is hot I adjusted it to low heat coz we don't want to burn it. Then we'll top it with the sesame seeds. Its better to put them immediately to make sure that it will stick strongly to our mixture. And yep, I did the frying mommy D only prepare the mixture for the banana fritters ƪ⁠(⁠‾⁠.⁠‾⁠“⁠)⁠┐
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo6Jw9QkvDF5jQG1ndwpztbkUC65h3HGeEfEdf5ihchntWYgD8eoUAgYRoTxjMTins9.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAZHQPpUHCzuDyS5Qc1ke6ds2hMAfa15PTs971tKQJ3qhnvKMvvyNYRtkztPC5xy8u.jpg Like this, this is the last batch and there's still a lot of sesame that didn't stick well to the mixture. But well, what's important is *mahalaga.*
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoEp1sL4Ry2zFCjGhya6juhGXuHe6ZgEsGUayt9Gy3wmtpTvyjFK6Gcok31rXZ1wNuz.jpg\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK5tJVheayfK6bn5oPokSzoNfffeWANVAsqB5fqsyHbFDpXoBA2Z4Ka89bZ7rhyDiB.jpg\n\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoiXCUp6CDiVzuryLdyGf7s6NX6g6T9RXM59EeGXN3ZRqXdiadsg4sbWuBbU8mhttX2.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EogPCt65rhDEb9UFEDb5ZPW335xbMeQBoMYrxcXge6bjxKEB3qLFa7XRrHaXcmx7SnD.jpg Beautiful, beautiful!! There's a burn part but that's the crispier one..we can't really avoid burning it especially if i'm holding my phone, aigoooo, don't ever do that guys. I got distracted because u see, my favorite Korean Idol **STRAY KIDS** performed for the first time in Governors Ball in New York. When it comes to Festival, Stray Kids is good with that especially with the type of songs they have. I was cooking when I heard a new version, EDM version of Side Effect..and I crazily jumps with the *tugs, tugs, tugs*.. they are seriously the best!!! And thats how I burn a few if my banana fritters by, lolol
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eoc84QXWmdcyTYN9Lrc7hewHVHkDMtD41VKAjhZXJnR9r21bacPQDYpX3oCDNeGW5m2.jpg\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoiVgzewgiMyhGYhoayEsstRDR4ncCP7jqeqRuitsAtP67bFYJ6bEstHy2UrCqrckFz.jpg But they still taste good and that's what matters, we enjoyed it as snacks until now, we actually made a lot, hihi ♪⁠ ⁠\⁠(⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠\⁠ ⁠).... AHHHHHHHHHHHHHH, meori apeuda ♪⁠ ⁠\⁠(⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠\⁠ ⁠)(⁠ ⁠/⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠)⁠/⁠♪⁠♪ ---- Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/89bi1wbjbzewfhf)

body.title: Lawn and Garden Updates with Some Coffee
body.body:
<center>![IMG_2697.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/Eoc7zgmiAD6jEPZQCohBb3BEBgdEGwfonLmeCXsMWLDZ9Q4buPDmBdUbPbRgnFYw9rS.jpeg)</center>

Sitting here sipping on some coffee as I type my words. Trying to recall events of the last week. It's getting harder it seems to recall short term memory. I hate it. But here we are.

We're anticipating rain the next couple of days. After all the rain we had a few days ago, you would think we wouldn't need any. Nope. We have a small drought going on. The ground just sucked up the last rainfall. It's already dried out and cracking. We've been watering the flowers and plants to compensate. The lawn just has to suffer. Not wasting water on it. Lawn isn't doing bad though. Turning a little brown. It'll survive.

Cherry tomatoes are fighting to live. They're still little sprouts. I've transplanted some of the larger ones to pots now. Need to get more potting soil and transplant the strawberries eventually. Not sure they're going to make it though. Working on them. Babying them. But it's all I can do right now.

Wife wants me to just give up on what I planted. Wants me to buy some plants at the store. Nope. Not giving up. These are my troubled tomatoes and strawberries. They made it through a terrible planting, thanks to me. Seeds floating everywhere. Containers falling apart. They survived several days of neglect. Again, that's on me. They did their part. Now I'm finally doing mine. I want them to succeed. I'm so invested in it now. It's almost emotional.

Crazy, eh?

On another note, our push mower started sputtering. Figured it needed a slight tuneup. Changed the spark plug. Changed the air filter. Went to check the fuel filter and found out it didn't have one. Nothing on the fuel line. Checked inside the tank. Nothing there either. I'm thinking the previous owner, my brother in law, did some maintenance on it in the past and removed it. From what I found online it's supposed to have an inline fuel filter. Researched the part number and ordered it last night. Should be here in a couple days.

Not much else to write about for now. Hope you all have a good week ahead.

![HiveDivider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/EoGvX4Va6X4ZfjnYkvBhFi2bqZsCrwoqpWhwgmGDPKVDS9eeZ4zF8foqAfcm44mn84d.png)
Thanks for reading,
Joe

body.title: A Fresh Start: Welcoming the First Day at Buhawen Elementary School
body.body:
The first day of school is a special time for students and teachers alike. It signals the start of a new journey full of opportunities, challenges, and growth. At Buhawen Elementary School, everyone welcomed the new school year with excitement and hope, ready to begin another chapter of learning together.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoChd1gjQuwUwBfqRkZskdGXSbeBxuHZutvNxRUVBqt4MA8hBAkjFGJrPo1WQhUDW2L.jpg)

Early in the morning, teachers arrived at Buhawen with smiles and excitement. After days of preparing classrooms during Brigada Eskwela, everything was ready for the students. The colorful decorations and tidy spaces showed the teachers’ hard work and care for this special day.

Soon, the school was filled with the cheerful voices of children. Some students arrived eager to meet friends and teachers, while others, especially the younger ones, felt shy and nervous in the new setting. The teachers’ warm welcome helped everyone feel comfortable and safe.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoGxSTbJzbBwJ9Wzaeyd62VZnp7VotouEbzM9djDnuXdbUrHAxejgoneDSvSheaLeQa.jpg)

Parents were also an important part of this special day. Many walked their children to school, making sure they were ready for their first day. Their support showed how much they value education and the partnership between home and school.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoChgqS1LyN6uT9nmFR8YVA7w3KNy15p65WhVEMFvTfLXfrGLDXjWGBQCBmpVTiMZnK.jpg)

For teachers, the first day is more than just welcoming students. It reminds them of their role in helping children reach their dreams. Each year brings a new group of students with different strengths and needs. This diversity inspires teachers to keep improving and to make learning meaningful for everyone.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EonkURT4XNj89bDokDtqu7sM83K9sPgymVdeshvZXpBBiSaTjE1NJapBfso29H5SyWS.jpg)

The opening-On the first day, activities helped students learn about school rules and classroom routines. Teachers introduced themselves and invited students to share about themselves, helping everyone make friends. Icebreakers and group activities created a positive classroom where everyone felt valued. 

Excitement, the first day of school, also symbolizes a commitment to growth and improvement. Buhawen Elementary School continues to strive for excellence in providing quality education to all learners. With the support of the school head, teachers, parents, stakeholders, and the community, the school remains dedicated to creating an environment where children can learn, develop, and thrive.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eoc6XxnAGzLpfFNkrJv6iQoXmqtbSKEzBuzJpCnjYMkzsvQVXhqhkhwjt5XC12XUMiM.jpg)

Every school year brings its own challenges. Teachers adjust to new demands, use different teaching methods, and meet the needs of all students. Some students need extra help, while others need more challenges. Through it all, teachers stay passionate and dedicated. The day served as a reminder that challenges should not be feared but embraced as opportunities for growth. 
Every obstacle encountered throughout the school year becomes a stepping stone toward improvement. Whether it involves enhancing literacy and numeracy skills, strengthening learner engagement, or promoting holistic development, every effort contributes to the success of the school and its learners.

One of the best parts of the first day was seeing how eager students were to return. Their smiles and excitement showed why education matters so much. Each student has dreams, and it’s the school’s job to help them reach a brighter future.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Ep3dLHZgWcyVLCGRa3bVCGp1TLtMyE5pty9L944JXSHzXLSEf48tKaWFoRV8Hd8qLoo.jpg)

When classes started, every classroom felt full of hope. Teachers had their lessons and plans ready, and students came prepared with their supplies and a desire to learn. Together, they began working toward success and personal growth.

***The first day of school is more than just starting lessons. It’s the beginning of new friendships, experiences, and memories that will shape the year. It’s also a time to set goals, build confidence, and create a respectful learning environment.***

As we begin another year at Buhawen Elementary School, we do so with gratitude. As we start another year at Buhawen Elementary School, we feel grateful and determined. We look forward to new opportunities, are ready to face challenges, and are committed to making our school a place where every student can succeed. 

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EouA8keemqz99XtU7yCwVUzMNfSVUxBXcJfDF1oBC8AsEJrXdABTd2hv1Zyr2azFUi3.jpg)

It reminds us that education is a journey filled with endless possibilities. With teamwork, dedication, and a shared vision for excellence, Buhawen Elementary School is prepared to embrace another year of growth, achievement, and betterment for the benefit of every learner and the entire school community.

body.title: 喻世明言十二《沈小官一鸟害七命》
body.body:
接上回

一进这禽鸟馆，这只他儿子的画眉还认得老主人呢，就叫得格外的欢畅，还频频地对他点头。这个沈老板睹物思人，想起他的儿子，他就开始嚎啕大哭，抑制不住的悲屈，那个管事儿的问他也不答话，没办法，只得把他给押到了大理寺，一审才知道，他有冤情。
所以大理寺就抓来了进贡的这个人李吉，李吉怎么解释也解释不通，有口难辩呢，鸟属实是买的，但是法官让他说是从谁那里买的呢？姓甚名谁，他也不认识啊，就在路上遇到了买的，他哪知道他是谁？

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVyPu1kPbxdMFvgrRfmFruhqsZvfKBLp8vpv6yb5nzRqS/img_3053.jpg)

所以说，有一些便宜贪不得，来路不明的东西，哎，也真不好说，谁知道他这个鸟儿还是恶手段得来的呢？

那可能就是买东西要去正规的场所买吧。就像现在一些法拍房啊，法拍车什么的，有时候儿听说真是不能乱买，买了以后会遇到一些很难办的事情，很难缠的原主人。

那现在话题回到这个李吉身上，他有口难辩，法官也不讲别的证据，就说你是杀人夺鸟来的，也就像是要你证明你自己是你自己一样，他都证明不了，又挨不过打，屈打成招了，命案就是死刑。
李吉死了之后啊，这案子结了，县官儿就安排把棺木烧了。
沈老板家把这个棺木烧了，把里面的骨灰给撒了。
为什么撒了骨灰呢？这不是正常操作呀，应该是觉得这儿子不争气，又不得好死，以后他们还要好好的生活呀，不要被他死去的儿子所影响吧。

未完待续……


***

body.body:
Not to sound combative here, because I love you guys and I don't want to see you fail. I'm just approaching this purely from a non-biased perspective. Are you comfortable sharing the costs for infrastructure? Because I think you'd find collectively there are enough tech-minded people here who would gladly help you optimise your setup if there is room for improvement. Or make recommendations to improve things.

Really, the 2.5x is the part I'd want broken down though, because with zero egress on R2 the cost can't be bandwidth, so it's coming from somewhere else, and your own list points right at it: transformations. If you're doing on the fly resizing and optimisation, that's almost certainly the driver, not storage.

If that's the case, the cheaper pattern isn't R2 instead of your hoster, it's R2 for storage plus a transform layer that caches variants. Generate each size once, push it to CDN cache, never reprocess it. imgproxy or thumbor on a small box, or even Workers, in front of R2, with aggressive cache headers. Then transforms are a one-time cost per variant instead of per request, and egress stays zero. A naive setup that reprocesses or caches poorly absolutely can come out 2.5x, so I believe your number. I just don't think it's measuring the cheap version.

If financial figures are too much, usage numbers would suffice: rough storage volume, monthly request count, egress GB, cache hit rate, transform volume. With those we can get a clearer picture of the scale.

The redundancy point I'll give you. That's the real argument and it's a good one, especially for RPC. A second independent path matters and someone does pay for api.hive.blog. The only caveat is that a DHF-funded operator being the redundancy is its own kind of dependency, so for images specifically I'd still rather see mirrored, replaceable hosting than one funded host, even if that host is you.

I think this highlights that Hive has a serious problem on a core level. If we're relying on ecosystem apps to ask for funding to sustain core critical redundancy of the chain outside of the chain itself, I think it's worth flagging that as a serious issue with Hive itself and one that could compromise it down the track if our market cap keeps slipping and HBD's pegged value continues to fall.

body.title: How Can You Prevent Logical Volume Management Errors During the RedHat EX200 Exam?
body.body:
You are halfway through your redhat red hat certified system administrator exam and your palms are sweating. You just configured a Logical Volume but after a quick reboot the system drops you straight into a rescue shell.

A single typo in /etc/fstab or a missed dracut update can instantly break your virtual machine. In the high-pressure environment of the RedHat EX200 exam storage errors are the ultimate hidden killers of your hard-earned score.

## Why Do Storage Setups Fail Under Pressure?

It rarely happens because you do not understand the steps. Instead you lose points because your habits fail when the exam clock starts ticking away in the corner of your screen. Your data must flow correctly from the Physical Volume to the Volume Group then to the Logical Volume and finally to the File System. 

Missing a single step like forgetting to resize the actual file system after expanding a drive will cause a breakdown. If the system cannot read the setup data properly during the next boot phase your entire test script fails.

## The Three-Step Checklist to Save Your Score

### 1. Always Check the Permanent Mounts

Never finish a storage task without checking your work. Run mount -a immediately after editing your files to catch typing errors before the examiner reboots your machine.

### 2. Match the Drive Type Exactly

Remember that ext4 uses resize2fs while XFS requires xfs_growfs. Mixing these up under stress is incredibly common but a quick df -T command will save you every single time.

### 3. Build Solid Finger Habits

You cannot just read about these commands you need to practice them until you type them automatically. Using a realistic ex200 practice exam from Pass4success gives you the exact hands-on familiarity you need with these complex drive layouts. Their study material and practice questions match the real test environment so you can make your mistakes now safely instead of during the test.

## Secure Your Certification on the First Try

Failing a test over a silly typing error is incredibly frustrating but it is entirely preventable. Once you master the habit of checking your setup files before every single reboot you take total control of your testing environment. Give yourself the technical edge and the peace of mind you deserve by practicing under real exam conditions today.    

Visit Here: <https://www.pass4success.com/redhat>

body.title: The Iconic Western Look: Every Guy in Leather Chaps Knows It
body.body:
Western fashion has long stood as a symbol of rugged masculinity and independence. Rooted in the harsh realities of frontier life, it reflects strength, resilience, and a no-nonsense sense of style. Over the years, it has evolved from practical ranch wear into an enduring cultural statement that continues to inspire modern fashion.

At the center of this legacy is the [guy in leather chaps](https://leatherchapo.com/mens-leather-chaps/) ****— an unmistakable figure who embodies toughness, confidence, and individuality. His look captures the essence of Western authenticity while adapting effortlessly to changing times. What began as functional gear for riders has transformed into a timeless emblem of masculine style.

Even men in assless chaps, originally designed for comfort and mobility on horseback, have influenced the broader conversation between function and fashion. Today, this daring yet classic look stands as a reminder that true style is as much about purpose as it is about expression.

## Origins of the Leather Chaps Look

The roots of leather chaps trace back to the hardworking cowboys and ranchers of the 19th-century American West. These men spent long hours riding through rough terrain, facing thorny brush, unpredictable weather, and the constant wear of life on the range. To protect their legs and clothing, they turned to leather — a material tough enough to withstand the elements yet flexible enough for long rides.

Chaps were designed with one clear purpose: to serve the rider in every condition. Their functionality made them an essential part of Western life. The key purposes included:

*   Protection: Shielded the legs from brush, thorns, and animal hazards.

*   Practicality: Easy to wear over jeans and allowed full range of movement.

*   Durability: Made from heavy leather to endure rough, outdoor conditions.

Early chaps came in several regional styles, including the snug “shotgun” design and the flared “batwing” version popular among rodeo riders. Made from thick cowhide or sometimes softer hides for flexibility, these early designs laid the foundation for the modern leather chaps we recognize today. What began as a purely functional garment would eventually evolve into one of the most distinctive icons of Western heritage and fashion.

## The Guy in Leather Chaps: Function Meets Fashion

The guy in leather chaps represents the perfect blend of rugged utility and confident style. What once served as protective workwear has evolved into a symbol of individuality and strength. The balance between function and fashion lies at the heart of this enduring look — a mix of toughness, practicality, and unmistakable flair.

Over time, leather chaps transitioned from purely functional gear to a statement of personal identity. As Western culture moved beyond ranches and rodeos, chaps began appearing in films, music, and fashion scenes. They became shorthand for rebellion, adventure, and self-assurance — qualities that still define the Western spirit today.

The combination of function and fashion that defines this look can be seen in several ways:

*   Functional Purpose: Protects the rider’s legs from weather, brush, and saddle friction.

*   Practical Design: Open-backed structure allows ventilation and flexibility.

*   Fashion Appeal: Highlights strength and confidence with a bold, eye-catching silhouette.

*   Cultural Symbol: Represents freedom, masculinity, and the spirit of the American frontier.

Pop culture has played a major role in keeping this image alive. From classic cowboy heroes in Hollywood movies to modern-day performers and musicians, the guy in leather chaps remains a striking figure. Rodeo stars, rock icons, and music video trendsetters have all embraced this bold look, proving that what began as utilitarian ranch wear now stands as a timeless symbol of confidence and style.

## From Cowboys to Clubs: Evolution of the Style

What began as rugged ranch wear has evolved into one of the most daring and expressive looks in men’s fashion. Leather chaps, once a cowboy’s shield against the elements, gradually moved from the countryside to the city, finding new life in subcultures and urban fashion scenes. This transformation reflects how Western aesthetics have continually adapted to modern times while keeping their bold spirit intact.

As Western imagery entered pop culture, the guy in leather chaps took on new meanings. No longer limited to dusty trails or rodeo arenas, this look began to represent confidence, rebellion, and freedom. In the late 20th century, men in assless chaps emerged as symbols of individuality and self-expression in nightlife and performance scenes — from music videos to themed events — turning practicality into a fearless fashion statement.

Modern designers continue to reinterpret this Western legacy. They mix traditional leather craftsmanship with sleek, contemporary elements, reimagining chaps for runways and streetwear alike. Whether styled for fashion shows, music festivals, or high-end editorials, the look remains unmistakably Western — strong, stylish, and unapologetically confident.

## The Symbolism Behind Leather Chaps

Leather chaps hold a powerful place in Western culture — not just as functional gear, but as a lasting symbol of strength, courage, and individuality. Since their earliest days on the frontier, they have represented men who lived by their own rules, facing the challenges of open landscapes and unpredictable work. Over time, this image evolved into something far greater: a cultural statement that speaks to independence and personal pride.

For decades, the guy in leather chaps has embodied the essence of rugged masculinity while also expressing freedom and defiance. This look resonates because it’s both timeless and adaptable — a balance between tradition and self-expression. Whether worn on horseback or on a fashion runway, leather chaps communicate a set of core values that have stood the test of time:

*   **Freedom:** The sense of liberation and open-road spirit that comes from living life without limits.

*   **Rebellion:** A fearless defiance of convention, challenging what society expects from men and style.

*   **Masculinity:** A reflection of toughness, pride, and the enduring appeal of Western heritage.

*   **Confidence:** The self-assuredness to wear something bold and own it completely.

Together, these ideas make leather chaps much more than an article of clothing — they’re a statement of who a man is and what he stands for. They convey authenticity and courage, qualities that have always defined the Western lifestyle.

The influence of this look stretches across decades and communities. In traditional ranching circles, chaps remain a badge of hard work and resilience. In urban fashion and performance scenes, [men in assless chaps](https://leatherchapo.com/assless-chaps/) reinterpret the same spirit through bold expression and creativity. Whether worn for function, fashion, or freedom, the message stays the same: leather chaps symbolize the power to be unapologetically yourself.

## Styling Tips: How to Rock the Western Look Today

Western fashion remains one of the most versatile styles a man can wear. It blends history, craftsmanship, and bold self-expression — and few looks capture that better than the guy in leather chaps. Today, this style can be adapted for everything from casual outings to statement events, combining the classic cowboy feel with modern flair.

To bring the Western aesthetic into your wardrobe, start by pairing leather chaps with timeless essentials. A crisp denim shirt, rugged cowboy boots, and a felt hat create an authentic foundation that pays homage to the traditional cowboy. Add a studded belt or silver buckle for character, and balance the textures with a soft cotton tee or suede vest for contrast. The key is to let leather be the focal point while keeping the rest of the outfit simple and cohesive.

How you style your look depends on your personality and the occasion:

*   **Subtle Western Style:** For everyday wear, choose smaller touches — leather boots, a bolo tie, or a faded denim jacket. These hints of Western influence give your outfit character without overpowering it.

*   **Bold Statement Look:** When you’re ready to stand out, embrace the full Western energy. Men in assless chaps often pair them with fitted shirts, sleeveless vests, or fringe details for festivals, concerts, or photo shoots. Confidence is the key — this look is about presence and attitude.

*   **Modern Western Fusion:** Blend classic cowboy pieces with urban fashion. Try leather chaps over black jeans, a minimalist white tee, and a tailored jacket. This mix gives a contemporary edge while keeping the Western roots intact.

No matter your approach, Western style works best when it feels authentic. It’s not about costume — it’s about attitude. Whether you’re channeling the spirit of the open range or bringing cowboy confidence to city life, wearing leather chaps with purpose makes a lasting impression. The modern guy in leather chaps doesn’t just follow a trend — he defines it.

## Pop Culture Icons and Trendsetters

From the silver screen to the concert stage, pop culture has played a vital role in keeping the Western aesthetic alive. The guy in leather chaps has become more than just a cowboy — he’s a symbol of power, rebellion, and confidence that transcends generations. Each decade has redefined the look, turning it from a symbol of frontier toughness into an enduring icon of individuality and self-expression.

Famous figures have helped cement the influence of leather chaps in mainstream fashion. Classic Hollywood cowboys brought them to life on screen, capturing the spirit of the American West with grit and style. Later, musicians and performers — from country stars to rock and pop icons — adopted the look, giving it a fresh and daring edge. In the 1980s and 1990s, men in assless chaps became emblematic of bold performance wear, embodying both energy and charisma on stage.

Movies, music videos, and festivals continue to celebrate this aesthetic today. Western-inspired fashion remains a go-to choice for those who want to project authenticity and strength. Whether it’s a nod to vintage cowboy heritage or a modern reinterpretation on the runway, the guy in leather chaps endures as a cultural figure who bridges tradition and trend. His influence in media and fashion proves that the Western look isn’t just part of history — it’s a living, evolving symbol of confidence and freedom.  

## Conclusion: The Legacy of the Western Icon

The guy in leather chaps remains one of fashion’s most enduring symbols. From dusty ranches to city streets, from practical necessity to cultural statement, his look continues to evolve without losing its roots.

Leather chaps represent more than style — they’re a bridge between past and present, tradition and self-expression. They remind us that true fashion isn’t about following trends but about embodying confidence, authenticity, and purpose.

So whether it’s on a ranch, a runway, or a modern stage, this Western icon lives on. The legacy of leather chaps rugged, timeless, and undeniably bold — continues to inspire men everywhere to embrace their individuality and wear their confidence with pride.

body.title: Cheese naan recipe // Recette de cheese naans [EN/FR]
body.body:
![cheese naan.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EowJaDb3NhfbuWMHd3xSKtBsYkY4SVXKdqBzema9RRD438EHLTpDR7WJ14Pxjt2Y7yP.jpg)

Hello friends and food lovers! I hope you're all doing great 😁

A few days ago, I shared my chicken tikka masala recipe and told you I served it with cheese naans. I promised to share the recipe with you, so that's what this post is all about 😊

It's quite easy to make and doesn't require many ingredients.

Here's the recipe for 8 naans 👇

## Ingredients

<center>![1 - cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzJc6SVP4srnrpXzFAHjcGxkxBoAUoCL6wKastfVcbcLp45we9WzysEtVWgEQc4GS.jpg)</center>

- 500 grams of flour;
- 5 tablespoons of sunflower oil;
- 150 grams of Greek yogurt;
- 1 packet of active dry yeast;
- 175 ml of lukewarm water;
- 1/2 teaspoon of sugar;
- salt;
- 1 Laughing Cow cheese wedge (it's a brand of processed cheese, but you can substitute another type of soft cheese) per cheese naan.

## Preparation Steps

I started by adding the yeast to a mixing bowl:

![2-- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeEN3SUm5D9P77rcShm4yX497WcXLhGfJuq2XiAsFpp2WJqf5nCwgLyCggWQ1iNbL8.jpg)

Then, I added the lukewarm water and sugar, and mixed:

![3-- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGxtg3AweyAbSGoZsw4kEMcNYMpr418HpF25jVesv2Wrja31cpgTX6jLT519YHLCnZ.jpg)
![4- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK6qsgVmKxvr7GuCtaooMyTvpsdFW9qT9akVqgGJKY7mU6UM2GK6P47V47sqEFhjYv.jpg)
![5- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EonmVwubvDk4dSP3JJKiHV1wVAQnEMhmpbmFFoK68aPV3bGcKMtki7h1epsHvFLbMvG.jpg)

I let it rest for about 10 minutes so the yeast could activate properly.

Next, I added the oil; the 5 tablespoons are about 30 grams:

![6- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo6MqmJ1YcvKfagxBygbcbZurDZsjMAkij9Y5qNYhbZqvhsbDxLGqDuSRpV9PZXkkho.jpg)
![7- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGyutdbX9zLg4aAPJyLWFJPjnzaL21GqHspZWeEQ47ngT5dD8BYRW45T5j9WG8oSeG.jpg)

I added the Greek yogurt:

![8- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eos1phVd5yVHCt7JEcmWwP6Hd2hjpWZA8oXuuZTMZh2asN8KdjJNcnzz1gCUpUau2c5.jpg)

Then the flour and salt:

![9- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EonmUwq9TS8k9n4ZgMMTWt9PPYE7S65hCy6QpgcViw4wvwSqodR31p2Mv5g6cCcnekV.jpg)

And I mixed it all together, first with a spatula, then by hand:

![10- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc7xk7bKJBcWaSkryrVexBmAsudHEMhdJ5uhgWDsZb9Nvq4RQ3oN742ke4vZnxmSD7.jpg)

I then kneaded the dough for about 10 minutes and finally formed it into a ball:

![11- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoEsuj6KKH2Tj6ng4cqSFhurtnHWKqtyKutB2Y9fm1S1WUj1B4PqZ4bvxx7iv6bSg5S.jpg)
![12- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiWkHbX3Kenz4H9uzWYp82VJzHgVeioaZiHYjWfai2LwSrDF1MP9urXPGLzdnGAR5c.jpg)

I let the dough rest in a warm place, in my oven (turned off, in my case), for 45 minutes, until it had risen.

Next, I deflated the dough, floured the work surface, and started dividing it into balls. I divided the dough into 8 roughly equal portions.

![13- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoptpCytAqnUjaRgGmBR2mzDHvRcGnscCyV4jWqBP7U5HJDrBj7mDXnFdKskoLKXocT.jpg)
![14- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9TTjAhvDmrDnz7B7Q33xwyMErSXY7dZzUWTQL4ANyJbqyQKsuQ9gPVo9dEhoPbkX.jpg)
![15- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EokezPFsNxWdW74yyg8QHiaM8VjAVkaxTK5wgKPaThf2y5WqCavbTRDdAgHJLM9njgj.jpg)

I formed balls:

![16- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9rpkdTGTFABsJ9Rr5Z2xrh5ULfptGRDHGmWQdbYXUijkXjQHqrBigPkVg3ymRHR6.jpg)

Then, I took each ball one by one, flattened it slightly by hand, and added the cheese. I then sealed the dough tightly over the cheese and rolled out the naan:

![17- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eopts4ZbDMHBy4KWQywUqqV1iUY8veiieAAhsde2BPKEDL6uWfoN5muhkTaW2Wo3YHk.jpg)
![18- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoEs3GtvGrqNQvApGhqqoc1xbdNwKF4eUHXxLGdnadBCAsXcBDuBHK86ruYjaM3qygc.jpg)
![19- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep3gHXLsHYqN8zcb7q6bB3yrwQgJhtzhHB6Rka7ZB5ipPUjiNqaxY1Bh9kNFb6PVvdw.jpg)
![20- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo8VA9Sz2dxZoLhWVTatL4RypnM7ci7XbP95v9qXarc1FXAYJ21KtAaQFLZzdqRWkot.jpg)
![21- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9STdbcHoyAATJMhoFbQP1WaE5QMpDABtGoAJUtLJxu8idW5ySjrPJnq5hvprXqUe.jpg)

Then I moved on to cooking. On a hot crepe pan, I simply placed a naan and let it cook for a few minutes on each side. The naan should puff up and then deflate.

![22- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogKuYy53K3Sab8wr4wA7EaxRpYFch4LbtagAMbr5Dei18WzTZrdqL7EUodkwhhUFa7.jpg)
![23- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiTNUg3iDv6Qg5wLbyY1t7TfLhcbQ4YM29Uw68evdCPpgfcdQN7o5cP7Ut4xYEh8Wd.jpg)
![24- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK5sHZcSp1VT3NioEuqGgy6qA7vdJkeyDgRTDQTkWkduYuaqYDJLMjpmqSTYkVuLY5.jpg)

Here's how the cheese naans turned out:

![25- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK7pTSKYoDGmpp27VkmHWokiQ5HVqTXFKBJHNyDq84Xg5Jbna948mmtmZ6vLYnhg1z.jpg)
![26- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzojaj9LCE8w7m2xmvbBbXSsBMZJqpw2vgq1KcnGnscLT7txyU2FE1Lu6jiEUsMaD.jpg)
![27- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpJaaGLwJTpzrtToDmHCMKfSjvJKTQqzwX28FDsg1Nb1DjzNPKZKEH6raPLvvAXznDp.jpg)

We ate them with chicken tikka masala, and they were absolutely delicious! 😋

Perhaps they're a little dry on their own. A little butter-parsley sauce would be nice to go with the naans. Or maybe add more cheese, or try a different kind of cheese.

We'll try a different cheese next time to see the difference! 😊

They'd be great with homemade hummus, or any other kind of spread, I think.

Anyway, I hope this has inspired you to try the cheese naan recipe and that you'll enjoy them! 😁

See you soon,
Johanna

PS: I used Google Translate to translate the English part.

Hello les amis et les foodlovers ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien 😁

Il y a quelques jours, je vous ai partagé ma recette du poulet tikka massala et je vous avais dit que j’avais servi ce plat avec des cheese naans. Je vous avais promis de vous partager la recette, alors ça sera le sujet de ce post 😊 

C’est assez facile à réaliser et ça ne demande pas beaucoup d’ingrédients.  

Voici la recette pour 8 naans 👇 

## Les ingrédients 

<center>![1 - cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzJc6SVP4srnrpXzFAHjcGxkxBoAUoCL6wKastfVcbcLp45we9WzysEtVWgEQc4GS.jpg)</center>

- 500 grammes de farine ; 
- 5 cuillères à soupe d’huile de tournesol ; 
- 1 yaourt à la grecque de 150 grammes ; 
- 1 sachet de levure boulangère ; 
- 175 ml d’eau tiède ; 
- ½ cuillère à café de sucre : 
- du sel ;
- 1 Vache qui rit (c’est une marque de fromage industriel, mais vous pouvez remplacer par un autre type de fromage frais) par cheese naan.

## Les étapes de préparation 

J’ai commencé par ajouter la levure dans un saladier : 

![2-- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoeEN3SUm5D9P77rcShm4yX497WcXLhGfJuq2XiAsFpp2WJqf5nCwgLyCggWQ1iNbL8.jpg)

Puis, j’ai ajouté l’eau tiède et le sucre, et j’ai mélangé :

![3-- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGxtg3AweyAbSGoZsw4kEMcNYMpr418HpF25jVesv2Wrja31cpgTX6jLT519YHLCnZ.jpg)
![4- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK6qsgVmKxvr7GuCtaooMyTvpsdFW9qT9akVqgGJKY7mU6UM2GK6P47V47sqEFhjYv.jpg)
![5- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EonmVwubvDk4dSP3JJKiHV1wVAQnEMhmpbmFFoK68aPV3bGcKMtki7h1epsHvFLbMvG.jpg)

J’ai laissé reposer pendant environ 10 minutes pour que la levure puisse s’activer correctement.

J’ai ensuite ajouté l’huile, les 5 cuillères à soupe correspondent environ à 30 grammes : 

![6- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo6MqmJ1YcvKfagxBygbcbZurDZsjMAkij9Y5qNYhbZqvhsbDxLGqDuSRpV9PZXkkho.jpg)
![7- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGyutdbX9zLg4aAPJyLWFJPjnzaL21GqHspZWeEQ47ngT5dD8BYRW45T5j9WG8oSeG.jpg)

J’ai ajouté le yaourt à la grecque : 

![8- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eos1phVd5yVHCt7JEcmWwP6Hd2hjpWZA8oXuuZTMZh2asN8KdjJNcnzz1gCUpUau2c5.jpg)

Puis la farine et le sel : 

![9- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EonmUwq9TS8k9n4ZgMMTWt9PPYE7S65hCy6QpgcViw4wvwSqodR31p2Mv5g6cCcnekV.jpg)

Et j’ai mélangé, d’abord à la maryse, puis à la main : 

![10- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc7xk7bKJBcWaSkryrVexBmAsudHEMhdJ5uhgWDsZb9Nvq4RQ3oN742ke4vZnxmSD7.jpg)

J’ai ensuite pétri la pâte pendant environ 10 minutes et j’ai fini par former une boule : 

![11- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoEsuj6KKH2Tj6ng4cqSFhurtnHWKqtyKutB2Y9fm1S1WUj1B4PqZ4bvxx7iv6bSg5S.jpg)
![12- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiWkHbX3Kenz4H9uzWYp82VJzHgVeioaZiHYjWfai2LwSrDF1MP9urXPGLzdnGAR5c.jpg)

J’ai laissé reposer la pâte dans un endroit tiède, dans mon four éteint pour ma part, pendant 45 minutes, jusqu’à ce que la pâte ait gonflé.

Ensuite, j’ai dégazé la pâte, j’ai fariné le plan de travail et j’ai commencé à découper les pâtons. J’ai divisé la pâte en 8 parts approximativement égales.

![13- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoptpCytAqnUjaRgGmBR2mzDHvRcGnscCyV4jWqBP7U5HJDrBj7mDXnFdKskoLKXocT.jpg)
![14- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9TTjAhvDmrDnz7B7Q33xwyMErSXY7dZzUWTQL4ANyJbqyQKsuQ9gPVo9dEhoPbkX.jpg)
![15- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EokezPFsNxWdW74yyg8QHiaM8VjAVkaxTK5wgKPaThf2y5WqCavbTRDdAgHJLM9njgj.jpg)

J’ai formé des boules : 

![16- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9rpkdTGTFABsJ9Rr5Z2xrh5ULfptGRDHGmWQdbYXUijkXjQHqrBigPkVg3ymRHR6.jpg)

Puis, j’ai pris chaque boule une par une, j’ai légèrement aplati à la main et j’ai mis le fromage. J’ai ensuite refermé la pâte de façon hermétique sur le fromage, puis j’ai étalé le naan au rouleau : 

![17- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eopts4ZbDMHBy4KWQywUqqV1iUY8veiieAAhsde2BPKEDL6uWfoN5muhkTaW2Wo3YHk.jpg)
![18- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoEs3GtvGrqNQvApGhqqoc1xbdNwKF4eUHXxLGdnadBCAsXcBDuBHK86ruYjaM3qygc.jpg)
![19- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep3gHXLsHYqN8zcb7q6bB3yrwQgJhtzhHB6Rka7ZB5ipPUjiNqaxY1Bh9kNFb6PVvdw.jpg)
![20- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eo8VA9Sz2dxZoLhWVTatL4RypnM7ci7XbP95v9qXarc1FXAYJ21KtAaQFLZzdqRWkot.jpg)
![21- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eoc9STdbcHoyAATJMhoFbQP1WaE5QMpDABtGoAJUtLJxu8idW5ySjrPJnq5hvprXqUe.jpg)

Je suis ensuite passée à la cuisson. Sur une poêle à crêpes bien chaude, j’ai simplement déposé un naan et j’ai laissé cuire quelques minutes de chaque côté. Normalement, le naan doit gonfler, puis se dégonfler.

![22- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EogKuYy53K3Sab8wr4wA7EaxRpYFch4LbtagAMbr5Dei18WzTZrdqL7EUodkwhhUFa7.jpg)
![23- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoiTNUg3iDv6Qg5wLbyY1t7TfLhcbQ4YM29Uw68evdCPpgfcdQN7o5cP7Ut4xYEh8Wd.jpg)
![24- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK5sHZcSp1VT3NioEuqGgy6qA7vdJkeyDgRTDQTkWkduYuaqYDJLMjpmqSTYkVuLY5.jpg)

Voici le résultat des cheese naans : 

![25- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoK7pTSKYoDGmpp27VkmHWokiQ5HVqTXFKBJHNyDq84Xg5Jbna948mmtmZ6vLYnhg1z.jpg)
![26- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoGzojaj9LCE8w7m2xmvbBbXSsBMZJqpw2vgq1KcnGnscLT7txyU2FE1Lu6jiEUsMaD.jpg)
![27- cheese naan.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpJaaGLwJTpzrtToDmHCMKfSjvJKTQqzwX28FDsg1Nb1DjzNPKZKEH6raPLvvAXznDp.jpg)

On les a mangés avec le poulet tikka massala et c’était un pur régal ! 😋 

Peut-être que tout seul c’est un peu sec. Il faudrait faire une petite sauce beurre-persil pour accompagner les naans. Ou bien peut-être mettre plus de fromage ou un autre style de fromage.

On va essayer de changer de fromage la prochaine fois pour voir la différence ! 😊

Cela peut se manger avec un bon houmous fait maison, ou toute autre sorte de tartinade, je pense.

Bref, j’espère que cela vous a donné envie de tester la recette des cheese naans et que vous allez vous régaler 😁

À bientôt, 
Johanna 

PS : J’ai utilisé Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

body.body:
New geek event in town




![coveranicom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/24244EyKJDtbMqG13nk9kiER3HCxXeKFD4L74Z6HMXbAVz67rwo5CRQFZgzMKt8GQz1hm.png)


 

> Edit in Canva & Photoshop

------



<div class=\

> Anicom had already been held several times in the city of Acarigua, so there was a lot of anticipation in the local geek community, as this was the first time an edition was held in Barquisimeto. Anicom Lara had been promoted on social media for several months; the organizers were the same ones who organized Matsucon, so they already had experience organizing this type of event. The event lasted only one day, was held on a Saturday, and was very well received from the moment it was announced. Many stores that had already participated in both Matsucon and Expo Comic were part of Anicom, with their booths and products for sale. The venue is already well known to all the followers of the city's geek community: the fourth floor of the Twilight City shopping center, the same place where AMatsucon is held and where the last edition of Comic Expo took place, which will surely return next year in the same space. ---- > Anicom ya se había celebrado en varias ocasiones en la ciudad de Acarigua, por lo que había mucha expectación en la comunidad geek local, ya que era la primera vez que se celebraba una edición en Barquisimeto. Anicom Lara se había promocionado en redes sociales durante varios meses; los organizadores eran los mismos que organizaban Matsucon, así que ya tenían experiencia en la organización de este tipo de eventos. > El evento duró un solo día, se celebró un sábado y tuvo una gran acogida desde el momento de su anuncio. Muchas tiendas que ya habían participado tanto en Matsucon como en Expo Comic formaron parte de Anicom, con sus stands y productos a la venta. > El lugar ya es bien conocido por todos los seguidores de la comunidad geek de la ciudad: la cuarta planta del centro comercial Twilight City, el mismo lugar donde se celebra AMatsucon y donde tuvo lugar la última edición de la Comic Expo, que seguro que volverá el año que viene, en el mismo espacio. ![IMG_20260530_122849_789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpGQo37yN47tykJAJp1G6eXVQ7maGKaf3bnJxAcTpnfoMkKCHQ8nADZLkMe6ZhwXWfd.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260530_122751_309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EoGwYwJumtW19A3h8894MFfzvKEVrxfhV1Kx1PteKG6KUmUN4DfMXf2V4uPmqcQM2Rq.jpg)|![IMG_20260530_123052_677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Eq378NecbS7zrnGTDhirensNJ7QHfL128EZ7gqjimjfeFkC7QhPmvrADTnRSyuHRAsC.jpg) || |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260530_123329_914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Ep3fM8eeuCPPP5dTvQSCgMjz3zwyrhYzGWKq8XQHL6W8FLbKgQd559mFodZVH8DdF8L.jpg)|![IMG_20260530_123435_994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EqL8mMRynkp7dMjPh3R3wdbSXopeJyRsjGkhJS9EsKMjHJEFjVRc8J8MpqnM3p4VCvx.jpg) || ![IMG_20260530_153042_246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpvkNZjjtXCYDXQshbVC6Ykb3WwZWjU4ZZz62KRNpkZGxRVQc6JDwENMXfoNoaAt4ov.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_165518_937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EoeEWSsVuMyqxGfGW8gg2N5hVt7WbFNtgsbibAY4PXacXf1cWm8S9uDYy8VGSmcHvJg.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_144156_829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23zbMzQWT1xWmfnYxRW9B9gGnj8FqRiepNKAYFsEBEkwVRuS6ddv8d6NfWs1R5uj4jVrm.jpg)
----
The stalls offered a wide variety of products, from posters and t-shirts to figurines and badges. Michael Jackson t-shirts were very popular, as was anything related to the King of Pop. There was also a stall selling the Panini World Cup sticker album, with all the stickers printed. It turns out that the official stickers are expensive if you buy them in a box, so many people have pirated the Panini album and printed all the stickers in high resolution. They were selling everything, including the album, for $30. Yes, pirating it is wrong, and the stickers aren't original, but some people don't care, and I assure you it's a product that sells very well. There was also the \

stand, with puppies and kittens for anyone who wanted to adopt a pet. There was an area to buy food and drinks, although many people went down to the second floor of the mall to buy something. There's also a supermarket. For example, I needed to buy a soda. It was more expensive in the food court, and there was a huge line. It was better to go downstairs and buy it at the supermarket for less than a dollar. You have to look for the best deals in an economy like mine.



----



> En los puestos había una gran variedad de productos. Desde láminas y camisetas hasta figuritas y chapas. Las camisetas de Michael Jackson eran muy populares, al igual que cualquier cosa relacionada con el Rey del Pop. También había un puesto que vendía el álbum de cromos Panini del Mundial, con todos los cromos impresos. Resulta que los cromos oficiales son caros si se compran en caja, así que mucha gente ha pirateado el álbum Panini e impreso todos los cromos en alta resolución. Lo vendían todo, incluido el álbum, por 30 dólares. Sí, piratearlo está mal, y los cromos no son originales, pero a algunos no les importa, y les aseguro que es un producto que se vende muy bien.

> También estaba el puesto de \

, con cachorros y gatitos para quien quisiera adoptar una mascota. Había una zona para comprar comida y bebida, aunque mucha gente bajó al segundo piso del centro comercial para comprar algo. También hay un supermercado. Por ejemplo, yo necesitaba comprar un refresco. En el patio de comidas era más caro y había una fila enorme. Era mejor bajar y comprarlo en el supermercado por menos de un dólar. Hay que buscar las mejores ofertas en una economía como la de mi país. ----- ![IMG_20260530_132825_138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpJYbPUCz6Vvg1Tu9xeAUMep2DX12d5TokUJCTG4YULuXH1Gv2qVjfTNshTtRJjCrA1.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260530_124033_153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/243MDNyDZUuJuDoW2QR5rjRNZ3b8dxjCegGL7hWc12wfvbKrG8HWTcw4RLFBb2KPNsF2X.jpg)|![IMG_20260530_141303_985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23xKqyB65vvoEZZ7m9z3X1kiJt4Dpx2wMSLovn4SQBQ6UgTD7MdJJnTf2dTcCgodkq3ra.jpg) || ![IMG_20260530_152644_506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/244y28PzMbnBz6kG2N37TGX3cfNEQCsiw1gQAART5C5JrZTbWAWPGRTp18Pj8v973cCbT.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260530_134911_417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/244KXAusjqkgWPqGdF28Hfqm88vzuqT1e9k8v3YAJjMth4Rh32Dr78Hdv1TSNwThmiMqC.jpg)|![IMG_20260530_135816_547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/243Bni27mTQvJse99Fc9LrFZ8wm2jYRZzVBTAyqvG1wq8xBA84dAKAMH4TrKbLNnHEXPT.jpg) || ![IMG_20260530_142657_560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23zS3AitWpeJAiShVLMLV7jPDa3kYXanZktQtnNsgsJuenkSy1eVC3EABLXm37g3arxpV.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260530_123940_273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/242hdApfQPGWe59KjFuNu3deAPRBBoQfu6NwnEAn4Nk2ZrBW5rk3hRhPTFo3t9u4sRj8f.jpg)|![IMG_20260530_152215_682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/242Nx9WfkkfN37DkYA3BK7Wz4hpV5fqZdMfAq1fNqvsLA4Lt5bqp2i1PS7rLpzPpPpvRu.jpg) || ---- Entry to Anicom Lara was completely free, and the first 300 people to arrive received a ticket for a PlayStation raffle.
