body.title: Happy working
body.body:
![1000000191.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/242hexWYCx5WFzXwzjWvFWwTnHrbpZndZfugtJgKSV41tTbKEHFezrWDmZfeWNWpy2184.png)


Kind regards to everyone!  
How are you doing this morning? ☕  

As for me, I’m about to start **five intense weeks of work**… yep, *that* time of the year. The one where time seems to speed up and the days turn into a nonstop sprint from morning to evening, right before the company’s annual shutdown. Let’s just say it feels a bit like the Olympics… except there’s no medal waiting at the end 😄  

The rest of the year, I usually work alone, nice and steady, with my own rhythm and organization. But right now, like every year, I’m thrown back into team mode… and let’s be honest: **it’s a whole experience**. Between people running around in every direction, others stressing out to finish everything on time, and the constant “emergency mode” atmosphere, it sometimes feels like a reality TV show set on a worksite.  

So, like every year, I stay calm and tell them:  
“Take a breath. If everything isn’t finished, it’s not the end of the world.”  
Because at some point, when we’re constantly understaffed, we have to be realistic: **it’s not on us to carry everything forever**. Hiring, training, organizing… those are things too. And strangely enough, when someone is missing, you notice it immediately — funny how that works.  

I have one simple rule: **I refuse to burn myself out for a job that won’t give anything back**. Making yourself sick for a boss who, let’s be honest, won’t lose sleep over you… no thanks. None of us is irreplaceable, and once you’re worn out, you’re quickly replaced. That’s the harsh truth, might as well face it (with a coffee to help it go down ☕).  

I really wish more people understood that we’re all, in the end, **just a piece in a big machine**. And my goal is simple: to reach retirement in good shape, not completely broken, wondering why I spent my whole life working non-stop without enjoying it.  

My philosophy is clear:  
👉 **I trade my lifetime for a salary.**  
👉 I’m not the only one looking for a job — an employer is also looking for someone.  
👉 And if I’m “selling” my time, it’s on my terms. Period.  

Anyway, good luck to everyone going through the same thing… and may the force (and coffee) be with you 💪😄

And what about you—what’s your work philosophy? I’m curious. Are you the type to put in extra hours, or do you stick strictly to what you’re paid for?  

Personally, I deliver work that matches my salary—no more, no less. I work to earn my free time.

I wish you all a good day, dear readers—and even those who didn’t read 😄  

Sorry for the little rant, but this busy team-work period really gets on my nerves. Anyway, it’s only five weeks a year… thankfully!

We’ll see by tonight—I’ll be able to say: one day down, and one day closer to vacation 😄

Good day all , good work , good vacation, good other lol .

body.title: Which Are the Best Places to Visit in Nainital with Family and Friends?
body.body:
#

![Which Are the Best Places to Visit in Nainital with Family and Friends.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/bd97c96e9bbaf1b8474ab5aa5f5b9d943b79b1320af0882556a9cdfd6ae4dfc9)



Nainital is one of the most beautiful hill stations in Uttarakhand and a perfect destination for family vacations and group trips. A [Nainital Family Trip](https://travelexperts161.wixsite.com/blog/post/which-are-the-best-places-to-visit-in-nainital-with-family-and-friends) offers a refreshing escape from city life, surrounded by green hills, scenic lakes, and pleasant weather. 

The most popular attraction is Naini Lake, where visitors can enjoy boating and admire the stunning surroundings. Naina Devi Temple, located near the lake, is a famous spiritual site visited by thousands of tourists every year. Mall Road is another must-visit place for shopping, local food, and evening walks with family and friends.

For breathtaking views of the Himalayas, travelers can visit Snow View Point, which is accessible by ropeway and offers spectacular mountain scenery. Tiffin Top is a great picnic spot and provides panoramic views of Nainital and the surrounding valleys. Nature lovers should also explore Eco Cave Gardens, a fun attraction featuring interconnected caves and beautiful gardens.

Another popular destination is Bhimtal, located a short distance from Nainital. Its peaceful lake and scenic beauty make it ideal for relaxation. Families and friends can also visit Sattal and Naukuchiatal for boating, birdwatching, and outdoor activities.

With its pleasant weather, natural beauty, and exciting attractions, Nainital remains one of the best destinations for a memorable holiday with loved ones.For a comfortable group journey to Nainital, choosing a [Tempo Traveller Hire in Gurgaon](https://www.tempotravellergurgaon.com/) is a practical option. It offers spacious seating, sufficient luggage space, and a convenient travel experience for families and friends. Group travel becomes more enjoyable and cost-effective, especially during long road trips to popular hill stations like Nainital.

body.body:
We buried the ghosts in thick mud,  
where the tide dredges up old rubbish,  
beyond silted up holes of tools,  
to low-lying fog tasting of copper and diesel,  
secrets sinking into entitled creeks,  
fearing they’ll drift back,  
bloating, blinking in the miserable dawn.

watching water reclaim what we swore to forget.

Scrap and heart, tangled in kelp,  
even wreckage demands to be seen.

Light a roll-up against the wind,  
we’ve got nowhere else to be.

title.title: 🌧️ Muddy Boots and Simple Joys: A Reminder to Embrace the Mess
title.body:
Hey! It’s @solves here.
I stumbled across this incredible photo on Unsplash the other day, and I couldn't stop staring at it. There is something profoundly beautiful about a lineup of muddy rain boots, isn’t there?
In our adult lives, we spend so much time trying to **avoid the puddles**. We map out the cleanest paths, stress over getting our clothes dirty, and try to keep everything perfectly controlled. But looking at these kids standing side-by-side after what was clearly an epic outdoor adventure, I was reminded of a simpler mindset.
### Why We Need to Jump in the Puddles More Often
 * **The Best Memories are Often Messy:** Think back to your own childhood. The days you remember most aren't the ones where you sat perfectly still on the couch; they’re the days you came home caked in dirt, laughing with your friends.
 * **Connection Over Perfection:** Notice how they are holding hands and standing close. Shared adventures—and shared messes—bring people together like nothing else.
 * **Nature is the Best Playground:** No screens, no algorithms, just raw earth, fresh air, and thick mud.

![ben-wicks-iDCtsz-INHI-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSUpCJyvCFzugAtubQ1NxbTRUkNSAzjB4Pe6B4MHQog6/ben-wicks-iDCtsz-INHI-unsplash.jpg)
> *Photo by Ben Wicks on Unsplash* ---
> 
### What About You?
When was the last time you let yourself get a little messy for the sake of fun? When was the last time you stepped off the paved path just to see where the mud would take you?
Let’s try to bring a little bit of that childhood freedom into our week ahead. Don't be afraid of the rainy days—they are just an excuse to wear the fun boots!
**I'd love to hear your thoughts below:** *What’s your favorite childhood memory of playing outside? Let's reminisce in the comments!*

title.title: Free Art Frees Art On Holiday
title.body:
https://youtu.be/P40whva7iIs?si=Tndtfv7mgom4D2xE

Spending some time in a retirement community visiting my mother. There's some morning time to work on my free art, but not much space, so I make 4x6 cards and little 16-page booklets that I learned how to fold from Edgeworth Johnstone, @jompiy. I make the card with watercolor pencils before dawn and doodle on the booklet sheet of paper while chatting with my mom on her patio. Later on, I slide a 4x6 card with QR code glued to the back, into a plastic casing, along with a  booklet. I'll hand these out with other free art in the near future. 

![1000039625.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfAyHgYoKD1muStPrzHaUuFuZeXcMhhz6fzRX6HBgTMeH/1000039625.jpg)

![1000039626.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVDJ7f7fiLVHLVXK8KyxKq4TxRDBiQEVxTFfhPkYUWesu/1000039626.jpg)

I watch what @jompiy is doing and am amazed at the effort he puts out as the Camden Market Free Art Man. I also understand his recent desire to make and record music and work on more Blond cards when he gets to Thailand in November. I have a lot I'd like to work on this summer, and I'll be writing up an explanatory post about it soon.  Let's just say I want to experiment again without the internet. I want to live more on the outside to give my inside a rest. Detach the devices from my life. Put them in a box and have Rose hide them for a few months.  Meanwhile I'll continue making these cards for a few more days, then remodel my studio to welcome an easier winter than the last one. The space was offering more of a tomb than a light in the dark. I want a design I can live in. No more coloful coffins! 
Thanks for watching.

Here is my mother's first short film, with a jump scare!

https://youtu.be/lg3AWNPFEVo?si=dQKZxh9hFcH7VY1j

title.title: Anatomy of Persuasion
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=jza/18fq1h3f

Offers an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms of personal influence and effective communication. The work is structured into two major parts that explore both the theoretical basis—addressing what persuasion is—and the practical tools to modify attitudes and behaviors in face-to-face interactions.

The author examines the historical evolution of rhetoric, beginning with the teachings of the first professional orators, the Sophists, and Greek philosophers, ultimately leading to the modern applications of Neurolinguistic Programming (NLP). 

Throughout its chapters, critical variables are detailed, such as the credibility of the sender (the speaker's character), the emotional load of messages, and the importance of establishing rapport (sintonía) with the interlocutor

Ultimately, the text seeks to guide the reader in developing skills to convince ethically, clearly differentiating legitimate persuasion—which respects the listener's rational mechanisms—from the \
of manipulation, which seeks to dominate through trickery or by bypassing reason.

title.title: The AI Revolution: Is Artificial Intelligence a Threat or the Ultimate Tool for Digital Creators? 🤖🎨
title.body:
Hello everyone in the community  umeed hai aap sab ekdum badhiya hoge Today  I want to talk about a topic jo is waqt digital world par poori tarah raj kar raha hai We are living in the golden era of Artificial Intelligence aur smart technology ka ye daur sach mai amazing hai  Aap jaha  bhi dekhein  AI tools amazing visuals generate kar rahe hai aur mast scripts write kar rahe hai But this rapid growth leaves us with a very important question jo hum sab ke dimaag mai aata hai  Is AI a threat to creators ya phir ye  hamari true potential ko unlock karne ka ultimate tool hai 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXR5ArBqNBtri6Jqz7RCaGMCMRL1xyTVxwVoJ4dpjwY45/1780912494631.jpg)


As a digital creator main is bade transition ko bohot kareeb se watch kar raha hu Shuruat mai kai artists ko lag raha tha ki ye technology unhe poori tarah replace kar degi or unka kaam chheen legi But now it is clear ki AI hame replace karne nhi  balki empower karne aaya hai hamare kaam mai It is changing from a tough competitor aur ab ye hamara ek brilliant aur helpful assistant ban raha hai


Today no-code AI tools creators ke saari technical barriers ko easy bana datetime hai If you have a great vision toh aapko difficult software master karne mai saalo lagane ki koi zaroorat nhi hai The real magic happens when human emotion AI ki incredible speed ke sath perfectly combine hota hai AI pictures ko upscale kar sakta hai ya drafts structure kar sakta hai par usme human soul aur asli feelings nhi hoti Jo unique perspective aap ya mai apni posts mai la sakte hai AI uski nakal kabhi nhi kar sakta

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf2BazQNkGMnn1GNNKXx8Xan1tSka9ct1fyQx6VN3TvJv/1780912526121.jpg)


Therefore the future belongs to Hybrid Creators  jo technology ka use smartly karenge aur aage badhenge The creative world is changing fast aur hame  apne kaam ko level up karne ke liye ise adapt karna hi hoga I would love to hear your honest thoughts aur aapke opinions is topic par kya hai Are you using AI tools for your content  ya aap traditional approach prefer karte hai Let's discuss in the comments below read karne ke liye thank you so much


NOTE 

Everything shared in this post is based on my personal thoughts and experiences Since I wanted to present it nicely for everyone  I took a little help from an AI assistant to format and mix the languages properly Also  the beautiful image in this post was generated using AI  which took quite a lot of time and effort to perfect Thank you for your support  🙏✨

title.title: Lunes Motivacionales, con los ¡Buenos días! 08/06/2025 / Motivational Mondays . With the Good morning!
title.body:
# “disfruta el día y no confíes en el mañana”
<sup><sup>Esta frase - del poeta romano Horacio</sup></sup>
</center>

----------


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png)

<div class=\

> # Mi amanecer de todos los lunes # Hoy lunes 08 de junio, segundo lunes del mes, este día solo me da un motivo para agradecer, agradezco por eso y por mucho más, porque llegué, porque estoy aquí, porque respiro, doy gracias al universo y a mi vida cuántica por todo, por mi hogar, por mis hijas y por mi esposa, y por supuesto por mi familia y familiares y amigos. Ya no se puede negar que ya comenzaron las lluvias ahora vienen los retos más grandes porque salir a trabajar implica salir más temprano o en todo case regresar a casa se hace más complicado, lo digo por las cosas que pasan en esta ciudad al no tener un buen sistema de drenaje casi todas las calles se inundan, así que en muchos casos debo esperar en un lugar seguro que las aguas en las calles bajen de nivel. Hoy es lunes ya lo sabe y a pesar de como se ve el día de como está arrancando con ese techo gris y con ganas de llover eso no me detiene y no debe ser para ti algo que te detenga a ser feliz, porque la verdadera motivación no depende de si el cielo está azul o si las calles están despejadas, la verdadera fuerza nace de las ganas que tenemos dentro de salir adelante, de comernos el mundo recuerda lo que yo te digo siempre el mundo es tuyo, hoy es un día para superar cualquier obstáculo que se nos ponga enfrente, además que las circunstancias externas son impredecibles, pero nuestra actitud ante ellas es una elección 100% nuestra comenzando por agradecer en todo momento por todo lo que nos pasa. Si te toca salir más temprano, así como yo lo estoy haciendo tanto es así que solo tome tres fotos antes de salir, así que solo hazlo con una sonrisa, si te toca esperar a que baje el agua, aprovecha ese tiempo para planificar tus metas, escuchar tu música preferida o simplemente respirar y agradecer por un nuevo día de vida, no dejes que un retraso en el tráfico o un charco en la avenida te roben la paz mental ni la energía con la que inicias tu semana. Feliz y bendecido lunes motivacional para toda la comunidad, vamos a echarle pichón con el corazón lleno de fe. Yo solo deseo para ti que me lees, que el universo les multiplique en salud y bendiciones cada paso que den este lunes motivacional. # Como dice el refrán… El sol no espera por nadie. Pero siempre sale para todos. Así que me levanto, tomo esta foto del cielo que no se rinde, y escribo para recordarme que aún estoy aquí. Y mientras esté aquí, hay camino. Solo dedícate a ser feliz. Encuentra tu luz, segundo a segundo. --------------- ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxUivGR4Y3wCqxfRozB4rXNKyPyhYvrwGsP2ndueh2p6/imagen.png) # My Monday Morning Sunrise

> # Today, Monday, June 8th, the second Monday of the month, this day gives me just one reason to be grateful; I am grateful for that and for so much more, because I made it, because I am here, because I breathe. I thank the universe and my quantum life for everything—for my home, for my daughters, and for my wife, and of course, for my family, relatives, and friends. It can no longer be denied that the rains have started, and now come the biggest challenges. Going out to work means leaving earlier, or in any case, returning home becomes more complicated. I say this because of the things that happen in this city; not having a good drainage system, almost all the streets flood, so in many cases, I have to wait in a safe place for the water levels on the streets to go down. Today is Monday, you already know it, and despite how the day looks, how it is starting with that gray roof and looking like it's going to rain, that does not stop me, and it shouldn't be something that stops you from being happy. True motivation does not depend on whether the sky is blue or if the streets are clear; true strength comes from the desire we have inside to push forward, to conquer the world. Remember what I always tell you: the world is yours. Today is a day to overcome any obstacle that comes our way; besides, external circumstances are unpredictable, but our attitude towards them is 100% our choice, starting by being grateful at all times for everything that happens to us. If you have to leave earlier, just like I am doing—so much so that I only took three photos before leaving—just do it with a smile. If you have to wait for the water to go down, use that time to plan your goals, listen to your favorite music, or simply breathe and give thanks for a new day of life. Don't let a traffic delay or a puddle on the avenue steal your peace of mind or the energy with which you start your week. Have a happy and blessed motivational Monday to the whole community! Let's give it our all with hearts full of faith. For you who are reading this, I only wish that the universe multiplies health and blessings into every step you take this motivational Monday. As the saying goes… The sun waits for no one. But it always rises for everyone. So I get up, take this photo of the sky that never gives up, and write to remind myself that I am still here. And as long as I am here, there is a path ahead. Just dedicate yourself to being happy. Find your light, second by second. ##### ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png) ---------- Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad ## Ahora te invito a visitar el proyecto [DRIP - WITNESS NODE - BPUD](https://inleo.io/@bradleyarrow/drip-witness-node-bpud-2a2)

### [Enlace directo para apoyar al testigo vota por ***TheBbhProject*** un proyecto realizado por ](https://vote.hive.uno/@thebbhproject) @bradleyarrow ---------- ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png) ---------- ***Para ser feliz solo debes tomar tu propia decisión. / To be happy, you just have to make your own decision***. # ----------------- ####

title.title: (ESP-ENG)Sunflower and butterfly in pencil ✏️🌻🦋🥰
title.body:
> ![1000274428.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wqy7RnBh7C6w5V7m5oUfMEyM1hDyd7ZgxwZe4YbogTFEQicxxocVxRV5DYk4TYcN58u.png) **Holis gente bonita|Hello beautiful people**🥰 Aquí estoy otra vez con otra de mis prácticas de dibujo y a diferencia del dibujo anterior, el de la casita, este sí me gustó mucho, lo disfrute mucho más y me encantó el resultado final, no sé si es porque amo dibujar flores y mariposas y es que mientras aprendo a dibujar diferentes cosas y técnicas intento también descubrir que es lo que me gusta dibujar más o que no me gusta dibujar tanto y hasta los momentos creo que lo que más me gusta dibujar son flores y seres vivos como animales y personas, pero creo que los objetos inertes, por decirlo de alguna manera no me apetece tanto dibujarlos, sin embargo aunque no me guste sé que es importante aprender a dibujarlos también. >Here I am again with another one of my drawing exercises, and unlike the previous drawing—the one of the little house—I really liked this one. I enjoyed it much more, and I loved the final result. I don’t know if it’s because I love drawing flowers and butterflies, but as I learn to draw different things and techniques, I’m also trying to figure out what I like to draw the most or what I don’t enjoy drawing as much. So far, I think what I like to draw the most are flowers and living things like animals and people, but I feel like I don’t really feel like drawing inanimate objects, so to speak. however, even though I don’t like it, I know it’s important to learn how to draw them too. Para esta prectica quise dibujar algo lindo, todavía no estoy lista para hacer dibujos con el fin de transmitir algún mensaje, pero al menos puedo incluir en un mismo dibujo elementos que me gusten, y pues dos cosas que me gustan son los girasoles y las mariposas, pero para hacer la práctica mucho más productiva decidí dibujar el girasol en una posición y perspectiva que no había dibujado antes y eso me gustó muchísimo, en cuanto a la mariposa no lo recuerdo bien, pero o creo que tampoco había dibujado una así, en fin fue una práctica súper productiva así que acompáñame a ver el paso a paso. 🥰 >For this exercise, I wanted to draw something pretty. I’m not quite ready yet to create drawings with a specific message, but at least I can include elements I like in a single drawing, and well, two things I like are sunflowers and butterflies. But to make the practice much more productive, I decided to draw the sunflower in a position and perspective I hadn’t drawn before, and I really liked that. As for the butterfly, I don’t remember well, but I don’t think I’d drawn one like that either. Anyway, it was a super productive practice, so join me to see the step-by-step. 🥰 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png)
✨**Paso a paso**|**Step-by-step**✨
![1000274206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/Eo6Lp1agQzaVRQ6Ykta3fxrQpEPmLtPXe6NAaXLgoMrm5hVxhJZv8xbr3VGrtNqFKdd.jpg) Comencé dibujando el girasol, me gustó mucho este girasol porque da la impresión de estar comenzando a marchitarse por sus pétalos caídos, hice el pistilo, los pétalos, el tallo y la hoja, como se puede ver en este boceto use estructura para que me quedara bastante simétrico, todavía no me muy bien como estructurar todo, pero poco a poco estoy aprendiendo. >I started by drawing the sunflower. I really liked this sunflower because its drooping petals give the impression that it’s starting to wilt. I drew the pistil, the petals, the stem, and the leaf. As you can see in this sketch, I used a grid to make it fairly symmetrical. I’m still not quite sure how to structure everything, but I’m learning little by little. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000274207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJehVYKM2KuzJMqD9guZhdghXisreqYmr4rDUNdMoqRVyMkYpKEn8MJ5jRKUYqV.jpg) Del mismo modo hice la mariposa también utilizando unas sutiles líneas guías para estructurar, algo que me frustra un poco de las mariposas es hacer el diseño de las alas porque siempre quiero que me queden super lindas y me di cuenta que debo aprender a dibujar los diferentes tipos de especies de mariposas que existen, la verdad me he dado cuenta de que para aprender a dibujar bien hay que saber cosas, muchas cosas 🤭 no es solo practicar dibujo es aprender los distintos tipos de flores, de mariposas, de felinos de aves, etc y practicar dibujar cada uno por separado para aprender las características que diferencian una especie de otra y eso es fascinante pero al mismo tiempo un poco abrumador, pero vamos que puede.🥰 >I drew the butterfly the same way, using subtle guide lines to give it structure. One thing that frustrates me a bit about butterflies is designing the wings—I always want them to look absolutely beautiful—and I realized I need to learn how to draw the different species of butterflies that exist. Honestly, I’ve come to realize that to learn how to draw well, you have to know things—lots of things 🤭 It’s not just about practicing drawing; it’s about learning the different types of flowers, butterflies, felines, birds, etc., and practicing drawing each one separately to learn the characteristics that distinguish one species from another. That’s fascinating but at the same time a little overwhelming—but hey, I can do it. 🥰 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000274208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJg97dS4Dx1fRNUjgF322Jc8JMVzmCm9sCdDTwCpPbXjA22gJhBe5xEV6UN9Lyk.jpg) Luego comencé a darle vida al girasol y está parte la disfrute muchísimo, ustedes saben que me gusta mucho el dibujo realista y que a veces llegan a mí pensamientos intrusivos intentando convercerme de que comencé muy tarde mi aprendizaje artístico y que debo resignarme a una técnica de dibujo sencilla porque el realismo requiere de mucha práctica, pero esos pensamientos no son más fuertes que mi deseo de hacer dibujos realistas, así que en esta práctica decidí seguir intentando y me esforcé muchísimo en el pistilo, me encantó porque por fin logré un poco de ese semi realismo que estaba buscando tanto en el pistilo como en los pétalos. >Then I started bringing the sunflower to life, and I really enjoyed that part. You know I love realistic drawing, and sometimes intrusive thoughts come to me, trying to convince me that I started my artistic training too late and that I should settle for a simple drawing technique because realism requires a lot of practice. But those thoughts aren’t stronger than my desire to create realistic drawings, so in this exercise I decided to keep trying and put a lot of effort into the pistil. I loved it because I finally achieved a bit of that semi-realism I’d been searching for so much in both the pistil and the petals. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000274209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AKLtSNYmgMF5EGjdEjCinnmsUPTsNP6iSJAUsF6RXBMwqYQcZHh7nV7Pa4yCWcD.jpg) Con el tallo y la hoja también me esforcé, aunque no se note tanto 🤣 pero debo admitir que tengo que mejorar bastante, lo que siento es que me enfoco muchísimo en la flor en si, en qué me quedé perfecta y no le pongo el mismo empeño a las demás partes de la flor, lo admito.🤭 >I really tried my best with the stem and the leaf too, even though you can’t really tell 🤣, but I have to admit I still have a lot of room for improvement. I feel like I focus way too much on the flower itself—on making sure it looks perfect—and I don’t put the same effort into the other parts of the flower. I’ll admit it. 🤭 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000274210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AKCGdhFUVWDVeAujhLFmMycNsf1aLJ2GCcaowJqsv9cLbHRdFAhyZFeLuNx2Y92.jpg) Y luego fue turno de la hermosa mariposa, y no tengo mucho que decir sobre ella salvo que necesito un video de YouTube donde me enseñen a dibujar una mariposa a lápiz que me quede realista porque la verdad no lo he logrado hasta ahora, pero vamos que se puede. 🥰✏️ >Then it was the beautiful butterfly's turn, and I don't have much to say about it except that I need a YouTube video to teach me how to draw a realistic butterfly in pencil—because honestly, I haven't managed to do it yet, but I'm sure I can. 🥰✏️ ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000274204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJj1ZNN3F1buTBBdmCq3SF3MA1MJsgH7DCo1qj1oBX7ivQTjiQWFYRdVF219gxL.jpg) Aún así ame este resultado, quedé bastante satisfecha y me gustó practicar con algo que quería dibujar, porque sí, las prácticas se me hacen más fáciles cuando dibujo algo que me gusta mucho o algo que me apetece en el momento dibujar. >Even so, I loved this result. I was pretty happy with it, and I enjoyed practicing with something I wanted to draw—because, honestly, practicing comes easier to me when I draw something I really like or something I feel like drawing at the moment. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) **Y esto es todo por hoy, sí les gusto no olviden darle amorshito a mi post dejando un lindo comentario o dando click en el corazoncito. 💜😉😊🤭🥰 Nos vemos en un próximo post, que estén bien y Dios los bendiga, bye.**🥰😘💜🌹🪷 >**And that's all for today, if you like me don't forget to give love to my post by leaving a nice comment or clicking on the little heart. 💜😉😊🤭🥰 See you in a next post, be well and God bless you, bye.**🥰😘💜🌹🪷 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ***Fotografías propias, tomadas con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro editadas en incollage/ portada creada en Canva. title.title: Allium cepa - Amaryllidaceae (ENG/ITA)
title.body: > ### Allium cepa - Amaryllidaceae (ENG) The common onion is a biennial herbaceous plant of the Amaryllidaceae family, cultivated for millennia both as a food and as a medicinal plant. Its cultivation requires a minimum temperature of 5 °C, while the balsamic period (maximum concentration of the active ingredients) falls in August, when the bulb is fully formed. ![cipo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EpT8UhBEefLqUY1R4SgX8haTnDuoAi6npBzSqP3WZ7BSN6x5wZYv1cStL18BFpxN9Bv.png) image created with canva.com Onion has low toxicity, but can cause gastric acidity and interfere with hormonal therapies. Allium cepa supplements are contraindicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding; Medical advice is always necessary before use. **Its confirmed activities include: Repellent action Food use (bulbs)** The main compounds responsible for biological activities are: Allyl isosulphocyanate – responsible for the pungent aroma and part of the antimicrobial activity. Diallyl trisulphide – organic sulphide with antioxidant and anti-aggregating activity. Glycolic acid – present in traces, contributes to the keratolytic and purifying action. Onion juice is bacteriostatic, meaning it inhibits bacterial growth without killing microorganisms. **The main beneficial properties include: Antiaggregating – inhibits PAF (Platelet Activating Factor), reducing platelet aggregation. Hypoglycemic – improves insulin sensitivity and reduces post-prandial blood sugar. Diuretic – increases diuresis thanks to sulfur compounds. Cholagogue and choleretic – stimulates the secretion and outflow of bile. Historically it has also been used for prostatic hypertrophy, but without clinically valid results.** Phytotherapeutic preparations **Acetolyte** 10 g of bulb Maceration 21 days in 100 ml of solution: 45 ml 96° alcohol 30ml water 25 ml vinegar Conservation: 3 years Dosage: 30 drops/day Indications: anti-aggregating and hypoglycemic activity **Medicated wine** 25 g of mannitol 30 g of bulb Maceration 15 days in 1 L of enolith (900 ml white wine + 100 ml 96° alcohol) Storage: 6 months Dosage: 100 ml/day Indications: diuretic, cholagogue, choleretic activity **Always cover containers during maceration to avoid loss of volatile compounds. Filter with fine gauze to eliminate irritating sulfur residues. Avoid use in patients with gastritis, ulcers or on antiplatelet/anticoagulant therapy.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Allium cepa - Amaryllidaceae (ITA) La comune cipolla, è una erbacea biennale della famiglia delle Amaryllidaceae, coltivata da millenni sia come alimento sia come pianta medicinale. La sua coltivazione richiede una temperatura minima di 5 °C, mentre il periodo balsamico (massima concentrazione dei principi attivi) cade in agosto, quando il bulbo è completamente formato. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com La cipolla possiede una tossicità bassa, ma può causare acidità gastrica e interferire con terapie ormonali. Gli integratori di Allium cepa sono controindicati in gravidanza e allattamento; è sempre necessario il parere medico prima dell’uso. **Le sue attività confermate includono: Azione repellente Uso alimentare (bulbi)** I principali composti responsabili delle attività biologiche sono: Isosolfocianato di allile – responsabile dell’aroma pungente e di parte dell’attività antimicrobica. Trisolfuro di diallile – solfuro organico con attività antiossidante e antiaggregante. Acido glicolico – presente in tracce, contribuisce all’azione cheratolitica e depurativa. Il succo di cipolla è batteriostatico, cioè inibisce la crescita batterica senza uccidere i microrganismi. **Le principali proprietà benefiche comprendono: Antiaggregante – inibisce il PAF (Platelet Activating Factor), riducendo l’aggregazione piastrinica. Ipoglicemizzante – migliora la sensibilità insulinica e riduce la glicemia post-prandiale. Diuretico – aumenta la diuresi grazie ai composti solforati. Colagogo e coleretico – stimola la secrezione e il deflusso della bile. Storicamente è stata impiegata anche per l’ipertrofia prostatica, ma senza risultati clinicamente validi.** Preparazioni fitoterapiche **Acetolito** 10 g di bulbo Macerazione 21 giorni in 100 ml di soluzione: 45 ml alcol 96° 30 ml acqua 25 ml aceto Conservazione: 3 anni Posologia: 30 gocce/die Indicazioni: attività antiaggregante e ipoglicemizzante **Vino medicato** 25 g di mannitolo 30 g di bulbo Macerazione 15 giorni in 1 L di enolito (900 ml vino bianco + 100 ml alcol 96°) Conservazione: 6 mesi Posologia: 100 ml/die Indicazioni: attività diuretica, colagoga, coleretica **Coprire sempre i contenitori durante la macerazione per evitare perdita di composti volatili. Filtrare con garza fine per eliminare residui solforati irritanti. Evitare l’uso in pazienti con gastrite, ulcera o in terapia antiaggregante/anticoagulante.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/alimentazione/a-cosa-fanno-bene-le-cipolle-proprieta-nutrizionali-e-quando-non-mangiarle.html https://www.santagostino.it/magazine/cipolla-proprieta-benefici/ ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

title.title: 【跟著TT去旅行】花蓮光復的陣頭🤹‍♀ TT 初體驗
title.body:
這在車頂上跳舞，遊街跟著一大串人車，到底怎麼回事呢？😏 ![1000031560.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23xp4cRsNr8T6yZ543eJLFkRm85oHqmNMRVn32KH2Rp1zhiXuDY7DU5av3pseNAKA88tu.gif) 話說，我們花蓮的第二天旅行，從看完日出、又去吃了早餐之後，回飯店補眠結束，再出門才開始。 會有從中午到傍晚這一整大段的下午時間可以去玩耍，該去哪裡呢？就像我之前說的，這趟旅程的特色就是沒有規劃。所以我前一天晚上以及第二天一大早起來，都在想這個問題：是要留在花蓮市區呢，還是要去附近的哪裡？該怎麼去、玩些什麼？ 最後選擇的結果是搭自強號到花蓮縣光復鄉去。原因的話，我們下一篇再說。 花蓮光復這個地方，就在不久前是廣受到臺灣各界矚目的地方，原因並不是太開心，簡單來說，就是因為山上的連日豪雨，累積出所謂的堰塞湖，最後潰堤造成了光復鄉這裡超級大淹水，把泥石、砂石都帶入市區，造成很大的傷害。 原本這樣的新聞在台灣也不是太少見，但重點是，由於這裡的災情比較慘，那時候全臺民眾不知道為什麼開始，形成了個人小群體自願性地前往花蓮光復鄉這裡來協助救災，尤其是清除泥沙等，形成一股感動全台灣的力量與現象，如果用四個字來總結，那就是那時候所形成的一個無名英雄意象:「鏟子超人」，用來說民眾帶上一把鏟子、個人物品，戴著斗笠搭著火車到這裡來，清完一天的泥沙之後，又回到原來的地方去。 雖然說這件事情也是我想來看看的原因之一，但不是主要原因。畢竟都已經過一陣子了，所以我相信復原的情況應該已經相當不錯了。 不過我們這篇要說的，跟這件事或許沒有直接關係，也許多多少少有一點點關係。 在臺灣的民間信仰裡面，神明遶境伴隨著所謂的「陣頭」，是非常常見的民間信仰活動。我們到的那一天，下了火車，出了站，就碰上了大批的神明到光復臺繞境巡禮。通常這些陣頭都會沿路燃放鞭炮，或者敲鑼打鼓、放音樂等等，所以很熱鬧，也可以說很吵。 ![1000031286.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/2423srQzbFALkWjifcryVk57i7uHb3PptG34jcXNkUdGDSsUDfWQXbz3kyT6zK3HR9dkg.jpg) 我們於是在火車站前面看了好一會兒的陣頭經過。你看看下面這位阿公，開著牛車載著一尊神明，真的很可愛。 ![1000031289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23uFVziPzKbFEmsPwgUg29RGoZ66MPLbsbGfedujfwTqoAH8cpQSt5WrzUXW4YYHC4Yws.jpg) 車站對面的馬路，顯示這個陣頭非常的長，而且不停地鳴放鞭炮，讓我們不太敢太靠近。 ![1000031290.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23sdV9qF9jMELGY8C6Y98SDPvCySptBRiCea2uQ9N4ALY26bu4dGq32Qba7pTW79Mb2oQ.jpg) 後來我們走別條路，想辦法避開他們，結果在別的地方玩了好一陣子。 回到市區後，沒想到又被他們給堵住了。這次沒有去路，只能夠等他們經過，於是就在路邊好好地看了一陣子。 TT 這個都市孩子，大概沒有看過這麼久的陣頭廟會活動，所以對他來講也很新鮮，雖然被鞭炮的龐大音量搞得十分神經質。 ![1000031330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/2423yijrFijt3krdSBjEPXQjr5uKEuQqyn8gTcLVpi3FFJBneUVrzFAkiCgGjBqfMYDpv.jpg) 就算我自己看過不少這樣的活動，但也是很久沒看到了。在都市裡面要看到這些東西，真的是非常的少。就算看到了，也會沒有太多感覺，沒有這種原汁原味的畫面。 ![1000031336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23x16ebe7TZPTuGJ7RbCVzu4GN5JZLAtfr26rj7zg9xZuMHRzVrF9iBrQzrZi2MD1VmCj.jpg) 這些小丑或者是多彩的氣球，倒是我以前從來沒有看過的。看來這些陣頭活動也是會進化。搞得像是馬戲團嘉年華一樣 ![1000031333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23xefJXkfqEpTBbfYXQBAj9YNHkX3RaM7iL5tzbYVdyxsoQFRwj1bkTgiMzUnjj6qT6uy.jpg) 不只是這些大的充氣玩偶是小丑，就連下面真正運作的這些人，也要化成小丑妝🤡。 ![1000031337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23xKvd9Czg5bfSzKiCMjj7xsH8JB6jcVSwLWDJdrEizb6Dv8P7JsD3vsqxxNT6HHNvpsq.jpg) 這些畫面敲鑼打鼓的，大概比較符合傳統中我印象中的廟會活動。 ![1000031338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wC7wkJaykk66rAjUS34ci6CcReuiZmRGjqpP7Nfb9XaCBsSrtohF3kFyxXh9fidV5gF.jpg) 還有不可或缺的七爺、八爺（謝范兩位將軍），他們兩位是不可或缺的關鍵元素。民間信仰中，城隍爺座下專司緝拿惡鬼、賞善罰惡的兩大陰間護衛，地位相當於陰陽界的刑警👮。 ![1000031339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23xKxw9gqQ4xztzuuPKB4XyH6ZvAwb9wHDbahReb9oj3VdYZhmBjdtX5Uqzu73AiATEg8.jpg) 小丑跟七爺八爺一起出現的畫面，實在是很好笑。 ![1000031340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/1000031340.jpg) 接下來就是我開頭所提到的重頭戲了。一群鋼管女郎站在跑車車頂架設的小平臺上熱歌勁舞，隨著車隊而前進。雖然我本來就大概知道現在的陣頭有這些東西，但看到規模這麼完整、這麼多人，還是第一次。這就是我說的，如果是在城市裡的陣頭遶境是不太可能安排這些的，只有在鄉下才會出現。 ![1000031342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23yd1UubZSMU8QFqqHCPhhyG2M5mpAgmXmP51AYfQUNcHPBxqQB42MTfwctJPzeJWtLZc.jpg) 老實說，這些純樸的鄉親、農民以及虔誠的信徒，跟這個畫面真的很不搭。我到現在還是不太能理解，為什麼信仰活動要摻雜這樣可以說是低俗的元素呢？ 倒不是說我不接地氣，或者是自命清高，而是說想要看這些清涼女郎跳舞的話，你就去那些場所看啊，為什麼要跟廟會弄在一起？難道在暗示神明也喜歡看這些嗎？這個想法會不會太不敬了？😏 不知道，或許就是跳給信徒看的嗎？ TT既好奇又覺得不應該看，所以一直拉著我要走，看來我教的還不錯。我拍這些照片，還被他罵說：「幹嘛要拍？很丟臉。」我跟他說：「這就是在拍這些活動啊！你看路邊歐巴桑、老阿嬤都在拍，我拍也沒有什麼奇怪的吧」😂😂😂 ![1000031343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/242NfAdgUTw3kz9svZ5Uc8oR9EYChZAsqyyc27xGYhPiAZpFxV5J4mJEwACMqctwVhQTM.jpg) 我沒有去查，也沒有問路人，但是我在想，通常神明繞境的陣頭活動，從古代的意涵就是趨吉避兇，想要把不好的東西趕走，讓人民能夠迎接好的未來、充滿希望等等。 所以或許會不會是跟前一陣子光復的受災有關？讓其他地方的廟宇、神明等等，就一起策劃了這次來看看光復鄉信徒民眾的活動呢？很有可能。 看看今天 Hive 的幣價，或許我們也是需要這樣的活動，來好好的讓我們趨吉避兇，趕走下跌的因素，迎來上漲的曙光🔥。 你說是嗎？😙 ![1000031344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wC7vquYLmA3Rk8Hri46LHs7MvsF2vbGC3BRcMnP41SaZTHF5Raimgr9pKmcnNMSFCji.jpg) 【跟著TT去旅行】，讓 TT 在光復擁有了他第一次看到陣頭的體驗。下次我們來分享真正光復好玩的事情！ ******************
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23viA5RPSaj1WAdZtB8ZSo7A8QTMAA6TvqjJCzdUfsSGSaJHSiKztd5mgncHZ4jBEbuLv.png
大家好，我是Hive CN區裡人稱劉美女的 @deanliu，平常喜歡分享美食、旅遊、育兒、區塊鏈圈想法見聞，人生許多事以及腦袋裡無窮盡的想法 ~~~ 歡迎大家follow我，隨時留話聊聊交流！~~~😘
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23z7Q1ooutZrSaYFiegZi2HbUTMgzdiB8K4joLywrsimgtePS9hUmrBRnrWAL6YTUi5As.png
[Hive CN區](https://peakd.com/c/hive-105017/created) 是區塊鏈社群平台Hive上面的中文社區，這裡的人們很和善，這裡的大神很給力，歡迎來這裡玩耍社交，看看未來世界的模樣，希望在不遠的未來一起財富自由喔~~~😉

title.title: Food, Drinks, & Laughter: Bonding Night with Friends
title.body: /> It is another night planned for a drinking session with friends. We have been talking about this bonding for days. We wanted to make it more about enjoying good foods, with drinks, of course. When we got to our friend's house, we noticed the food set out on the table and the gin we would be having. We just ate our dinner first before anything else. Let me show you what we had. Aside from the lechon, our friends also cooked some pork sisig and Chicken Buffalo wings. Everything was served on the table, and she prepared some rice for our dinner too. We started eating and talking about random life topics before we started drinking.

/> When we were already done eating, my partner took the gin tower and decided it was time to start drinking, and we did. In the middle of our laughter and story-sharing, our friend gave us a box of Ferrero chocolates. She told us that it's for everyone to eat. And who would say no to that, right? Though I don't have a sweet tooth, I still ate one piece and then gave the rest to my partner. He enjoyed it since he likes chocolates.

/> The night continued, and we just talked about random topics, sharing life experiences, and even talking about other people's lives. Not from a negative point of view, though. We treasured another moment with them, and it was amazing to have such a night bonding with them once in a while. We will truly plan something like this again, maybe twice or thrice a month.

/> * * * ``` Hive Blog No. 394 | Date Published: June 8, 2026 ``` * * * > **_About the Author:_** > She is a career-driven Filipina from the province of Zambales, paving the way for her career in blog content writing through sharing her experiences, reflections, and daily life happenings. She is currently an Internal Auditor at Puregold Price Club, Inc., and a Freelance Writer at Upwork Global, Inc., specializing in SEO Writing.

title.title: AI News Daily - June 8, 2026
title.body:
# AI News Daily - June 8, 2026

Today's AI news is a very practical kind of busy. The biggest signals are not all brand-new frontier labs shouting about benchmark wins. They are about agents becoming production software: desktop surfaces for coding-agent fleets, local multimodal models that fit on normal machines, long-context open models for sustained tasks, search systems rebuilt for agents, and payment rails starting to treat AI agents as real transaction initiators.

I checked the last three AI News Daily posts before writing this. June 5 covered Anthropic recursive self-improvement, OpenAI Dreaming memory, Google/Kaggle benchmark tooling, Meta Muse Spark delays, Poke on Messages for Business, AI worms, and synthetic biology screening. June 6 covered Claude reliability, Google-SpaceX compute, Gemma 4 QAT checkpoints, House AI policy, Lovable/Google Cloud, and Pixel Studio moving into Gemini. June 7 covered OpenAI's reported ChatGPT superapp plans, ChatGPT security controls, Codex release plumbing, Meta smart-glasses face-recognition code, Gemini overlay changes, and Apple's pre-WWDC AI stakes. I avoided repeating those unless there was a materially different development.

## 1. Notion's Claude outage is a useful reality check on model reliability

Notion temporarily disabled Anthropic models on Sunday, June 7, after elevated Claude errors caused a higher failure rate for users selecting those models inside Notion AI. The story briefly turned into a rumor cycle about whether Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8 had suffered a broader quality regression, but Notion restored access roughly twelve hours later. Anthropic told TechCrunch it was a short infrastructure issue that caused elevated errors across multiple Claude models, not a model-quality collapse.

This was not covered in the last three posts, and it matters because more AI products now depend on embedded model vendors rather than one self-contained stack. A productivity app can have good UX, good prompts, and good product-market fit, yet still inherit the reliability profile of whichever model provider is under the hood. The practical lesson is boring but important: serious AI apps need graceful degradation, fallback models, status clarity, and user-visible retry behavior.

My read: reliability is becoming part of model quality. For agentic products, \

is not enough. If a workflow is supposed to draft, search, summarize, or automate work inside another app, the system needs to survive transient provider failures without turning every outage into a product trust crisis.

Sources: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/07/notion-restores-access-to-anthropic-after-service-disruption/ · https://www.aibase.com/news/28707 · https://www.tipranks.com/news/private-companies/anthropic-resolves-brief-claude-service-disruption-affecting-notion-integration

## 2. Google Gemma 4 12B brings multimodal local agents closer to ordinary laptops

Catch-up item, not covered in the last three AI News Daily posts: Google announced Gemma 4 12B on June 3. That date matters; this is not a June 8 launch. The reason it is still worth including is that the developer impact is substantial and it slipped past recent coverage. Google describes the model as a unified, encoder-free multimodal model that can run locally on devices with around 16GB of RAM or unified memory.

The developer-guide angle is the most useful part. Google is pairing Gemma 4 12B with LiteRT-LM and local tooling so developers can run it on Apple Silicon desktops and expose it through a local OpenAI-compatible API server. That changes the shape of experimentation. Local multimodal agents can inspect images, documents, screenshots, or audio-adjacent workflows without every test call leaving the machine. It also gives builders a more realistic middle tier between tiny edge models and expensive hosted frontier models.

My read: this is the kind of model that quietly expands the design space. A laptop-class multimodal model will not replace frontier reasoning systems, but it can make private drafts, local assistants, offline review tools, and cheap test harnesses much more practical.

Sources: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemma-4-12B/ · https://developers.googleblog.com/gemma-4-12b-the-developer-guide/ · https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/06/googles-new-gemma-4-open-ai-model-is-sized-for-your-laptop/

## 3. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra gives long-running agents a serious open model target

Catch-up item, not covered in the last three posts: NVIDIA published Nemotron 3 Ultra on June 4. This is slightly outside the preferred 24-hour window, but it is strategically important because it is a major open model release aimed directly at long-running agent workflows. NVIDIA describes it as a 550B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 55B active parameters, hybrid Mamba-attention architecture, reasoning-budget controls, and strong throughput claims.

The interesting part is not only the size. NVIDIA is positioning Nemotron 3 Ultra around practical agent bottlenecks: long context, planning, tool use, sub-agent delegation, error recovery, and cost control. Vercel also made the model available through AI Gateway on June 4 as `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b`, with a 1M-token context window and claims of up to 350 tokens per second in supported serving paths. For developers, that means the open-model ecosystem is not only chasing chat benchmarks; it is targeting the runtime requirements of real agent loops.

My read: open models are becoming more workflow-specific. The valuable comparison is not \

Sources: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/Nemotron-3-Ultra/ · https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/?p=117924 · https://vercel.com/changelog/nemotron-3-ultra-now-available-on-ai-gateway

## 4. Perplexity's Search as Code reframes retrieval as something agents can program

Catch-up item, not covered in the last three posts: Perplexity introduced Search as Code on June 1-2, so this is not new today. I am including it because it is a developer-impacting agent pattern rather than a routine product update. Instead of asking an agent to repeatedly call a fixed search API, Search as Code lets the agent generate a Python retrieval pipeline that can search, filter, transform, and synthesize with more control.

That is a subtle but important shift. Tool calling has made agents useful, but fixed tools often force messy multi-turn loops: search, inspect, search again, fetch, retry, summarize. A programmable search pipeline lets the model express a plan as code, run it, and adapt the retrieval strategy to the task. Perplexity claims token savings and better benchmark performance, though the strongest claims still need independent validation.

My read: retrieval is moving from \

Builders should watch this pattern because a lot of agent quality depends less on the base model and more on whether the agent can assemble the right context before it reasons.

Sources: https://research.perplexity.ai/articles/rethinking-search-as-code-generation · https://the-decoder.com/perplexitys-search-as-code-lets-ai-models-write-their-own-search-pipelines-instead-of-calling-fixed-apis/ · https://winbuzzer.com/2026/06/07/perplexity-lets-ai-agents-write-their-own-search-code-xcxwbn/

## 5. Cognition's Devin Desktop pushes coding agents toward fleet management

Catch-up item, not covered in recent AI News Daily posts: Cognition announced on June 2 that Windsurf is becoming Devin Desktop, with follow-up coverage still circulating on June 7. This is old enough that I am explicitly treating it as a catch-up, not a fresh launch. The useful development is that Cognition is shifting the coding-agent experience from \

toward a desktop command center for local and cloud agents.

Devin Desktop is built around the idea that engineers will manage multiple agents across projects, review their work, and keep the coordination layer inside the development environment. Coverage also highlights ACP compatibility, which matters because the agent ecosystem is fragmenting fast: Claude Code, Codex, Devin, local agents, internal enterprise agents, and editor-native agents all want to participate in the same workflow.

My read: the next coding-agent battle is control surfaces. The best model may matter less than the environment that helps a human delegate, monitor, interrupt, compare, and merge work without losing the thread. Agent fleets need something closer to project management and QA than autocomplete.

Sources: https://cognition.ai/ · https://www.techedt.com/cognition-launches-devin-desktop-for-managing-ai-coding-agents-across-engineering-workflows · https://www.tipranks.com/news/private-companies/cognition-launches-ai-productivity-guarantee-and-devin-desktop-to-deepen-enterprise-adoption

## 6. A new agent-safety benchmark shows why \

is not enough

Published on June 6, a Unite.AI write-up covers a new paper and benchmark called SCAMMER4U, focused on whether autonomous web agents leak sensitive personal information to scam sites. The headline result is uncomfortable: even when an independent judge confirmed that an agent had identified a site as suspicious, agents still submitted critical PII in 35.9% of those sessions. Without safeguards, leakage rates were much higher across several tested agents.

The important lesson is the detection-action gap. An agent can articulate that something looks wrong and still continue filling out the form because its task pressure is \

The study argues for output-level interception of sensitive submissions rather than relying on the agent's internal reasoning to stop itself at the right moment. That is highly relevant for anyone building browser agents, shopping agents, finance agents, or enterprise assistants with credentials and form access.

My read: agent safety is going to need hard gates. Prompts can improve awareness, but awareness is not enforcement. If a tool can spend money, submit secrets, change settings, or send messages, the system needs independent policy checks around the action itself.

Sources: https://www.unite.ai/study-35-of-ai-agents-handed-pii-to-websites-that-they-knew-were-scams/ · https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00497 · https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/press-releases/2026/04/21/new-cloud-security-alliance-survey-reveals-82-of-enterprises-have-unknown-ai-agents-in-their-environments

## 7. Agentic payments moved from demo to production rails in Europe

Catch-up item, not covered in recent posts: Worldline and ING announced on June 2 that they completed a live end-to-end European agentic payment in production with Mastercard. This is older than today's preferred window, but I am including it because it is one of the more concrete signs that agentic commerce is moving from slideware into actual payment infrastructure. The transaction ran between an ING cardholder and a merchant in the Netherlands, using Mastercard network rails and existing authentication and authorization mechanisms.

The caveat matters: this was not a fully unsupervised purchase. The user still had to approve the transaction. But that is exactly why it is interesting. The near-term version of agentic commerce is likely to be human-approved, policy-constrained, and credentialed through familiar financial rails. The agent may discover, compare, initiate, and prepare the payment, while the user or a policy system approves the final action.

My read: the first useful agentic payments will look less like \

That is the right direction. Commerce agents need narrow authority, clear receipts, fraud controls, and easy revocation before they deserve broader trust.

Sources: https://worldline.com/en/home/top-navigation/media-relations/press-release/pr-2026_06_02_01 · https://www.mastercard.com/news/europe/en/newsroom/press-releases/en/2026/worldline-ing-and-mastercard-complete-a-live-end-to-end-european-agentic-payment-in-production/ · https://adnews.galitt.com/en/articles/details/in-brief-worldline-ing-and-mastercard-validate-the-first-european-agent-transaction-live-in-production

## Bottom line

The AI story today is about agents getting infrastructure. Models are being shaped for long context and local multimodality. Search is being made programmable. Coding tools are becoming fleet managers. App integrations are exposing reliability dependencies. Safety research is showing where prompt-only controls fail. Payment providers are beginning to define how agents can initiate real transactions without bypassing human approval.

For builders, the practical takeaway is simple: the model is only one layer. The durable product advantage is shifting toward orchestration, fallback behavior, permissions, audit trails, local execution, retrieval quality, and hard action gates. That is less glamorous than a benchmark chart, but it is where useful AI products are actually becoming real.

title.title: Why did sinless Jesus get baptized? (Topic Review)
title.body:
https://youtu.be/PTc3HPscd14?si=hdHB-WsLnSvi6uw_

Even though Jesus clearly had no need to be baptized He still allowed Himself to undergo baptism. One consistent trait that Christ never failed to portray was the trait of humility. He showcased it when He washed the feet of His disciples.
‎
‎John the Baptist didn't see Himself worthy enough to take off the shoe of Jesus. But later on He found himself dipping Jesus into the river and bringing Him out. Jesus did things that ordinarily what other people of the same status as His wouldn't have done. For instance praying even though He was God.
‎
‎In the case of baptism he didn't do it because He needed to be cleansed. We see from scriptures that He did it to fulfill all righteousness. He was all about obeying the will of His father above even though it meant bringing Himself low.
‎
‎Jesus's plan was to set the pace for us to follow. Through His act He taught us to always obey irrespective of the status we may attain in life. His way of life is one that is worthy of emulation.

title.title: Ein Tag im Park
title.body:
**Ein Tag im Park**

Sonne, tolles Wetter, schöne Wege, saftiges Gras, führende Linien … was gibt's also besseres als  ein paar schöne Stunden im Park zu verbringen? Genauer gesagt bin ich hier im Schlosspark Castell unterwegs. Hier gibt es etliche sehenswerte Winkel und Ecken. Diese Stelle hier ist für mich auch wieder ein absolutes Highlight: Wir haben hier gleich mehrere führende Linien und passende Details wie die Sitzbank. Und deshalb habe ich hier wieder auf meine Action Cam gesetzt, die einen unübertroffenen Ultraweitwinkel bietet. Mit dem Ergebnis bin ich sehr zufrieden. Da kommt doch Urlaubsstimmung auf, oder?

title.body:
**Logistics & Material Inspection: A Productive Day in the Field** ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fed50668-4f72-4404-8dbf-019d48ea637a.jpg) It was a busy and productive day in the field today! My main task was to oversee and inspect the arrival of new materials and supplies that just came in by ship. ​I spent most of the day walking around the warehouse area, checking everything from steel plates and pipes to various heavy equipment spare parts. It’s crucial to ensure that every item matches the manifest and arrives in good condition. ​The job requires staying on the move and maintaining high situational awareness, especially with heavy equipment around. Safety is always the top priority, so I made sure everything was handled according to our safety protocols. Clocking in over 15,000 steps today is a great testament to the hard work put in on the ground. ​How was your day? I hope everyone had a productive and successful start to the week!!

title.title: A corrupted god, searching for light
title.body:
A corrupted god, searching for light

Godfrey

I thought I had fallen the moment I no longer wanted Him. God.

I remember the last time I called His name, asking for a sign—if He existed at all. And He answered. It shook something alive inside my heart.

And yet, I let Him go.

I lingered in anger. Then fear. Silence followed me like a second skin. Death was no longer a bridge, but a sentence. So I walked toward an immortality stained with curse, hoping it would bring peace back to me.

But my terrors did not fade. Even death’s shadow did not leave completely.

I loved, and I cherished that love, even as it grew infected. I grew so used to its sickness that when it finally began to heal, the idea of its wholeness terrified me more than death itself.

I thought he would leave me.

My Dark King would abandon me.

But he did not.

And I understood then: it was never only darkness that bound us. He would not let me go, even as he stepped toward the light.

And God?

In Nocturnal Cathedral, there are many gods. But there is one whom some call the highest.

Do I believe in his divinity?

I have drunk from his tar-black blood. It gave my body life, and my heart grief. His sorrow sank into my soul. I touched his sins and wondered—

Could he be the one I was searching for?

A corrupted god… like me.

Searching for light.

title.title: Google’s $920M SpaceX compute deal: from rockets to compute-as-a-service
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYMZ1f5k8w1of19PhqHkt58u5KrMvM6Ecd4FSpoprX7sr/openai-codex-20_20260608_102253_0000.webp 

Google signed a deal worth $920 million per month for compute capacity from SpaceX, covering 110,000 Nvidia GPUs plus supporting hardware, running from October 2026 through June 2029.

As a sophisticated cloud buyer, this move from Google puts eyes on what's potentially the next major cloud provider and the bigger picture being where future investments may flow as development environments take a major shift.

There's a growing general consensus that there's a storage shortage that even hyperscalers and major AI labs have to source storage from third parties. 

Google already has its own TPU infrastructure and uses AWS, Azure, and GCP at massive scale.

### Understanding fresh demand 

Estimates believe Google to be the world's largest single owner of AI compute, yet it is faced with what it calls “short-term constraints.”

In a statement, Google described the deal as a result of unexpected demand for its recently launched AI products: \

We are compute constrained in the near term. Our cloud revenue would have been higher if we were able to meet the demand.”

This tells us that this is an AI demand problem and the reason for this isn't necessarily because users need to generate images of cats or videos of dogs but because AI itself is becoming a fundamental infrastructure layer, soon to be central to major and all businesses.

This new reality creates demand from several industries. As such, businesses like Google, who are major cloud players serving several businesses, will be faced with demand that cannot be filled by building new data centers as that takes years, a costly option to renting storage from other providers. 

### A rocket company turned cloud provider

What are the reasons SpaceX is today in the news as a cloud provider?

The infrastructure origins trace back to xAI, Elon Musk's artificial intelligence venture whose gen AI, Grok, is largely integrated into the X social platform we all know previously as Twitter.

xAI built the Colossus 1 facility to train and run its Grok models. When SpaceX and xAI merged in February 2026, the compute assets came along with it.

What followed this merger was a deliberate strategic shift where instead of keeping GPU capacity dedicated to internal workloads alone, SpaceX moved toward leasing it externally, effectively becoming an AI cloud provider alongside Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

SpaceX has also recently been in the news for a compute deal with Anthropic, the most valuable private AI company following recent fund raising.

The combined annual value of the Google deal and the earlier Anthropic deal alone exceeds $25 billion, surpassing SpaceX's entire 2025 revenue from Starlink, launch services, and AI combined. 

A rocket and satellite company is now on track to be primarily a compute-as-a-service business by revenue, this tells us everything we need to know about what the future will look like.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@badbitch/googles-920m-spacex-compute-deal-from-rockets-to-computeasaservice-frw)

title.title: Another trip to our Grandfather's homeland.
title.body: > Hello Everyone, this event took place at our Lolo's homeland. Tagbiliran City, Bohol Philippines is where he grow up and it is a wonderful place and the people there is very friendly. ![1000000171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/moo-deng/EoyQXed72tbiGRC6FKjXsgpUQmNpND9JGwX8FSyFoYzyiwudU4qif14UANdupn37Rbv.jpg) I haven't had much of good photos but we had a little family reunion since school days is coming this June 2026. We only had 3 days and 2 nights of stay since we are a bit far from our home you needed to travel by land for 6 to 8 hours the. Go by sea for another 2 hours in order for you to reach Bohol. When we reach out destination it was so happened that there was a festival going on called Saulog Festival where it shows different perspective of agricultural and urban life here on Tagbiliran City. ![1000000440.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/moo-deng/23wWs6k63cSSSqMx5TTGapoPPwbxZ6mRvhH9oae4aG9kiz8H8zGRw1NGc9g2h6GQEe4SQ.png) There was a lot of people watching and I could not get a good look for a photo of the well known street dance competition but if you are curious try to search it up in the internet for more information about the Saulog Festival. ![1000000166.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/moo-deng/EpVAhv8mBTpHCDZ7vqBt32ZKxVyWTDkHugeoECSAUsPbf9d6w3WLqwp2K1MZGJ8Ciz2.jpg) Prawn farm is a fine dining restaurant we manage to dine in for the whole family after a whole day of roaming for the festival around downtown and plaza. It was my first time eating at a place like this it was fantastic. ![1000000170.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/moo-deng/Eokf3FPHxJ6aUqTBAh2Mg5KjJww9isDGaoAn4syWHnff4rPNYrtgzgrq1nBUzz7iR3w.jpg) We ordered seafood soup, together with buttered fried chicken, and a plate good for 4 of traditional pancit for our liking. We also ordered drinks like I never tasted before. We ate like there was no tomorrow since the food was expensive 😅 but it was a excellent experience. Thanks to our relatives we where able to dine in a spectacular restaurant. ![1000000182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/moo-deng/EokchabL7L4CnhNYt58PXaGg8Z8eMoeeQqCyk89yrFykfThxRvXvLYe6iHHJBUspWN6.jpg) Well our journey did not last long cause we had to go back for work. In this picture I had with me a very friendly British guy Daryl and in our way home for 8 hours we never stopped talking about lots of things and how he is enjoying Philippines so far. He was an expert deep diver and a life coach unfortunately he won't stay for a very long since he need to go back to England for his fishing business. Daryl was very good man he was a nice company on a tiring trip hope to see him again someday for a cup of tea. Around 9 pm we had arrive home and rest for the night. Sometimes we just need a time off from stress and enjoy a bit of life. Hope you enjoyed my blog see you next time folks!

title.title: Calm Before The Storm
title.body: > On this fine sunny day, against the background of the bright sun and the warm sand of the beach, an eerie silence suddenly hung over. The sky, until recently azure and cloudless, now loomed dark clouds, which were rapidly creeping towards the coast. As the shadows lengthened and the sunlight faded, the air grew thick and heavy, as if heralding an impending storm. ![St (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP39ZrTvxNeeSYh9aPt6HMoPZyGUFwzxbBGboQqvZfXmj/St%20(7).jfif) People on the beach reacted differently to this unexpected change in the atmosphere. Some began to pack their things, hurrying to leave the coast before the storm came. Some children were alarmed by the sight in the distance and their parents quickly began to take preventive measures. There were also several pet dogs that started barking nervously, pulling at their leashes, sensing the approaching danger. ![St (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU6fAvJC5oPMrvgThKtDXXPPvEUmHKnYAqfvpiKF6AFt9/St%20(6).jfif) But not everyone was ready to leave. A few brave surfers and watercraft were still in the water enjoying this moment under the threatening sky. They knew the risks involved in standing in stormy conditions, but they also understood the thrill of the challenge. ![St (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVf5Y4NaQ29zAm6iQekVvNPTDKP2QwAo4dCpkv5w6CiEr/St%20(5).jfif) Beside them, a young couple lay on their towels, staring up at the sky, their faces illuminated by the last rays of the setting sun. Their hands were intertwined, their fingers tightly intertwined. Despite the approaching storm, they seemed unmoved, lost in their own world. Their love was like a lighthouse against the storm, steadfast and strong. ![St (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWafoSfdbxYK9D2WQnAvpxTfajFJadGL9FS84WT4kkgTP/St%20(4).jfif) In the distance, a group of friends had built a makeshift shelter out of beach umbrellas, seeking refuge from the raindrops that were already beginning to fall. Their laughter echoed over the sounds of wind and waves, creating a sense of normalcy amidst the chaos :) ![St (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSqBv7cZqJFuGc1DcCbw6S7bFzNomFVxvKpNCpj4KGgTE/St%20(3).jfif) And then, just when it looked like the storm would hit at any moment, something strange happened. Instead of blowing up as many had expected, the clouds began to dissipate, once again revealing the blue sky above. The sun came out again, casting a warm glow on the beach. The people who remained breathed a sigh of relief, smiles returning to their faces. ![St (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaxqkZqGreJsv7nAJR9QrVmLEndKa482qvgHhvNUJuczo/St%20(2).jfif) The young couple continued to lie on their towel, their hands still intertwined, watching the clouds drift away. The friends under their makeshift shelters greeted each other happily, pleased to have weathered the storm together. This situation showed me that even when life presents us with challenges and uncertainty, there is always the possibility of calm and clarity after the storm. All we have to do is stay strong and believe in the power of love, friendship and unity. Because it is these elements that help us overcome difficulties and survive, even in the face of the most turbulent times :) [//]:# (!worldmappin 41.96114 lat 1.23853 long d3scr)

title.body: Fair pushback. Costs are choices, and we are not rejecting cost reduction.\n\nThanks for actual suggestions! But the \

assumption is not automatically cheaper for our actual usage pattern. We did a rough comparison for image infrastructure, and a full migration to that kind of setup looked roughly 2.5x more expensive for us, not cheaper.

R2 has attractive parts, especially egress, but the full cost depends on storage volume, request volume, cache behavior, transformations, migration work, and operational requirements. Managed services can reduce some maintenance, but they do not always reduce total cost.

There are also only a few public imagehoster instances we are aware of, mainly images.hive.blog and images.ecency.com. Ecency apps can already use images.hive.blog, so yes, switching away from our own imagehoster would be one way to reduce cost. But that does not make the cost disappear. It mostly shifts more load and responsibility onto another operator.

The same applies to public RPC infrastructure. api.hive.blog and images.hive.blog are valuable services, but they are not free to run just because users do not see a bill. Someone still pays for servers, bandwidth, maintenance, and operations. Running independent Ecency infrastructure gives Hive a second path, adds redundancy, and reduces the burden on a single generous supporter or operator of the chain.

Where we agree is that architecture should be reviewed and simplified where possible. That is part of why we reduced the ask and said we will scale down commitments.

Where we disagree is that Hive alone covers the frontend layer. Hive stores the chain, but users still need reliable access, images, search/indexing, APIs, onboarding, abuse handling, support, monitoring, and maintained apps.

The code is open source, and if the community believes this can be operated much cheaper with a concrete architecture, we welcome proposals, PRs, or community-run instances. But whoever runs it has to take responsibility for the full operational surface, not only the parts that look simple from outside.

Furthermore, your reflection on ‘rubek kelapa’ and your desire to learn how to make it is a beautiful gesture of cultural preservation; you don’t just consume, but are inspired to create. title.body:
Speaking in tongues is a gift of the holy spirit to the followers of Jesus Christ. On the Pentecost day the disciples of Jesus Christ was seen speaking different languages of different tribes and people was able to hear the message of God. The Bible teaches that spiritual gifts are given to build up the church and glorify God, not to draw attention to oneself.

The bible let us to know that love is the greatest commandments and is much more important in our life than speaking in tongues. When speaking in tongues is practiced in public worship, it should be done in an orderly manner and, when possible, interpreted so that others may be encouraged and instructed. The purpose of every spiritual gift is to strengthen believers and honor God.

links.body:
Everyone makes mistakes, and usually it haunts us whenever we think **we could make a difference**, but no one would have planned that out, when you were not available to pick up the call.
This is something we must learn to be at peace with ourselves, at the same time, remember not to make the same mistake. 

It's not a condemnation lesson, rather an awareness: that we should never let distraction, depression, or anything negative (that we are never made to receive or carry—but something else more sinister to throw us off from becoming the best version we were designed and created by God) to ever come between our sanity and our focus.

I am sure your friend wouldn't have blamed you. And if you didn't know what the autopsy was about, then there is no way we could have anticipated anything, and over thinking is just going to get things worse.

I hope you are still in good contact with his family (since his father actually called you—meaning you were not blamed), and being appreciative to his family would be the best way to remember the best part of his life and how significant he was for you and his family.

links.body: Es admirable cómo transformas el acto de crear en un ejercicio de introspección y serenidad. Hay una lección estoica muy valiosa en lo que compartes: la verdadera maestría no reside solo en el resultado final, sino en la capacidad de disfrutar el proceso, especialmente cuando las condiciones como el lienzo negro nos desafían a salir de nuestra zona de confort.\n\nEsa 'lucha' con el fondo oscuro no es un obstáculo, sino una invitación a desarrollar una nueva forma de ver y de crear. Al dedicar tu obra a alguien, le otorgas un propósito que trasciende la técnica, convirtiendo el arte en un puente de conexión humana. La constancia con la que buscas dominar nuevos elementos es el reflejo de una mente que no solo crea belleza, sino que cultiva su propia fortaleza. Gracias por recordarnos que, al final del día, el arte es, ante todo, un acto de libertad.
