links.title: Mi historia en relación con los cementerios, un lugar de energías. (ES-EN)
links.body:
> --- En determinados lugares se tiene sensaciones muy fuertes, además de que los sentidos detectan cosas fuera de lo normal. Los cementerios son lugares donde la gente de alta sensibilidad vive experiencias únicas. >In certain places, one experiences very strong sensations, and the senses pick up on things that are out of the ordinary. Cemeteries are places where highly sensitive people have unique experiences. --- ![20260606_184724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyTNjNeknmNieoEhwHHHBVRJhAtjBixpZnTd6eqUGBaHTLWGne3JkCAU6XvirAAC6kP.jpg) --- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6wQdjJrb8Ec Para escuchar mientras se lee la historia – To listen to whilst reading the story [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YGCCSToraPc)
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

As I have mentioned on other occasions, many people dislike cemeteries, whether because they find them terrifying, frightening or saddening, and this is probably because they remind them of loved ones who are no longer with us. It is their final resting place. And I always say that it was my maternal grandfather who used to take me, when I was just three years old, to visit the graves of my great-grandparents; that is how I came to know them, and I would even talk to them. At that age, I thought they were there, albeit separated from their souls. Over time, one learns, and I know that there is nothing left there; the body fades away and the soul departs the very moment the person dies. Death is merely a transformation; the soul never dies, it simply goes to another place. >The fact is, I’ve always wandered through cemeteries. Before, in my hometown, I used to go on important dates with my grandmother and mother; when my grandfather passed away and that grave was the last one to visit, I liked to have a long chat with him. I would sit down and ask him to look after my grandmother and my mother. And although he wasn’t there, I know he was listening to me because he loved me so much and because he had left without being able to enjoy life to the full. I remember I always cried at his grave, because he was gone and he was a good man. I used to believe that good people never died. --- ![20260604_173614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCA6aGgvd1E711nmHZQPLFdXJT6zHgkwiTswWeTQ67mQi1sEw9Lbk13BXujxrAvPoDL.jpg) ![20260604_174047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAdzEbKkYmoLTCYiTeNEQxkkqye3SAiVnHAgvHwMES6UULXBVoq1bGwct11Bgf62joP.jpg) --- But I enjoyed going there; as I had no close blood relatives, no uncles or cousins, almost all my family were elderly, and many had passed away. My walk through the cemetery in the city of Bahía Blanca was like going to visit those people I had never even met in person, but I would talk to them, without suspecting that later in life I would see spirits or, as in the case of my grandfather and grandmother, that they would visit me and I would see them whilst awake. I wandered the paths of that cemetery just as I wandered the historic cemetery of this city, Málaga, only four days ago, because in a way they are similar. I have many stories about cemeteries, dreams and vivid sensations. Today I remember those days as a little girl when my grandfather would take me by the hand and we would take flowers to our relatives. >I have cried a lot at my relatives’ graves and niches, but today I know they weren’t there but with me; I have felt that energy that emanates from the body, they have even touched me, and it is wonderful to feel their presence. ---

![20260604_172312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMaerhMbymRNegaHQ5gpphUSyEZsrXBvFfTXNpNTnob819DxiekuZGguq3dfCuMMgcf.jpg)
![20260604_174344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMWDukRkSZsVniC2KrdcmRWTgHqGokX39oChSM4pSecgeZ5KDtoSnYqc9KmyqqVkKKW.jpg) --- I recently dreamt of my great-aunt, my maternal grandmother’s sister; she was smiling at me and hugging me. It is a sign; I know everything will be alright. I hadn’t seen her for so many years, almost thirty, and I used to go and visit her at the cemetery all the time. I’ve always felt a sense of peace in those places, a peace similar to what one feels in churches, for those who practise a religion, a peace I’d describe as taking a deep breath in a place where there are no worries, no stress, no problems and no anxieties, because I believe that’s what’s conveyed by those energies that have passed on, but which were once there. That peace isn’t mine; it’s conveyed by them, even by people I don’t know. >I haven’t always felt that in a cemetery, but that’s another story. People don’t always die in peace and tranquillity, and depending on how that moment was, that’s the energetic impression they leave behind in the place. It’s like a mark that never fades. And highly sensitive people can feel it. It has even caused me distress, sorrow and pain at times. I have experienced many things. Things that cannot be seen, but can be felt, and of course I will tell you about them soon. --- ![20260604_174722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi21HEUrssTEpQGNQhuYesEaesCrhaLzg2G5L4XnvLHFm1kRej4dt2N26z31bWWkKb3.jpg) ![20260604_175529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFRQYU2u5FNEjxTUMNdoCqjatgFMugHKfNL2yvXyE8gAk2oZGuxAPxD8uJWj3BykRyo.jpg) --- Thank you very much for joining me today, and if you’d like to share your experiences, I look forward to hearing from you in this new community initiative. I’d like to invite @marydeluz and @brujita18. Warm regards to you all. See you soon. Amonet.

Como he mencionado en otras ocasiones, a muchas personas les disgustan los cementerios, sea porque les da terror, miedo o pena y es probable que eso sea porque les recuerdan a sus seres queridos que ya no están en este plano. Es su último lugar. Y siempre digo que mi abuelo materno fue quien me llevaba cuando sólo tenía yo tres años a visitar las tumbas de mis bisabuelos, así los conocí y hasta hablaba con ellos. A esa edad pensaba que ellos estaban allí, aunque separados de su alma. Con el tiempo uno aprende y se que ya allí no hay nada, el cuerpo se desvanece y al alma se fue en el mismo instante en que la persona muere. La muerte es solo una transformación, el alma nunca muere, sólo va a otro lugar. >El hecho es que desde siempre recorro cementerios, antes, en mi ciudad, iba en fechas importantes con mi abuela y madre, cuando falleció mi abuelo y esa tumba era la última en visitar, me gustaba tener una gran charla con él. Me sentaba y le pedía que cuide de mi abuela y mi madre. Y aunque él no estaba allí, sé que me escuchaba porque me amaba demasiado y porque se fue sin poder disfrutarlo plenamente. Recuerdo que siempre lloraba en su tumba, porque se había ido y él era bueno. Creía que la gente buena nunca moría. --- ![20260604_172504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xATSzneuvKWcBbEBz3oEw3ebTZjaqBwBUN8anRpoDVDPzvkFkTWtU5hr9bzvPrzhu2z.jpg) ![20260604_172153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsNPcZtBh3yitqX86Z3M9j7chi5MvYcoosZuX5VbUV2eD3d38fKTfz4dwCGT5yFfb86.jpg) --- Pero yo disfrutaba de ir allí, al no tener tíos ni primos de sangre y cercanos, casi toda mi familia eran gente mayor y muchos se habían ido. Mi recorrido por el cementerio de la ciudad de Bahía Blanca, era como ir visitar a esas personas que ni siquiera habia conocido en persona, pero con ellas hablaba, sin sospechar que más adelante en mi vida, vería espíritus o como en el caso de mi abuelo y abuela me visitarían y los vería estando despierta. Recorría las calles de ese cementerio como he recorrido hace solo cuatro días el cementerio histórico de esta ciudad, Málaga, porque en cierta medida se parecen. Tengo muchas historias son los cementerios, sueños y sensaciones vividas. Hoy recuerdo esos días de pequeña cuando mi abuelo me llevaba de la mano y llevábamos flores a los familiares. >He llorado mucho en las tumbas y nichos de mis familiares, pero hoy sé que no estaban allí sino conmigo, esa energía que sale del cuerpo la he sentido, incluso me han tocado y es maravilloso sentir la presencia de ellos. --- ![20260604_172139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmFiN5kL6anmqLtCoPnEsJ27mtL2kuFrPT2HZCZNnnsZ24dJjG9vK5f6jYkFDcwMSZL.jpg) ![20260604_173404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2h7bxEFPMwF9fw4UrczrzwC7VmnQ2usdZUzwQa4ArbALoCGHN8LBEczoekTv9wHwRF.jpg) --- Recientemente soñé con mi tía abuela, hermana de mi abuela materna, me sonreía y me abrazaba. Es una señal, sé que todo estará bien. Hace tantos años que no la veía, casi treinta años, y siempre iba a verla al cementerio. Siempre sentí paz en esos lugares, una paz parecida a la que se siente en las iglesias, para aquellos que son practicantes de alguna religión, una paz que la describo como respirar profundo en un lugar en donde no hay preocupaciones, estrés, problemas ni angustias, porque creo que eso es lo que transmiten esas energías que se fueron, pero en algún momento estuvieron allí. Esa paz no es mía, es transmitida por ellos, aún gente que no conozco. >No siempre sentí eso en un cementerio, pero esa es otra historia. No siempre la gente muere en paz y tranquilidad y depende de como haya sido ese momento, así será la impresión energética que dejan en el lugar. Es como un sello que nunca se va. Y las personas con alta sensibilidad pueden sentirlo. Incluso a veces me ha dado angustia, pena, dolor. He vivido muchas cosas. Cosas que no se ven, pero se sienten y por supuesto que próximamente se las contaré. --- ![20260604_172212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqiMNjDkgduPtUZgeBpVic7jdgWLZJu2REEZh4Z2fyiMP1QEGLhaEDc7NhsBzKsr99j.jpg) ![20260604_172922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJEES8r92ppv5LdxaMPnqzp6oy5ADh7joRxtLm6PZsj2WYZtQWXST7vQCQPqdHp4qQ5.jpg) --- Muchas gracias por acompañarme el día de hoy, y si desena contarme sus experiencias los espero en esta nueva iniciativa de la comunidad. Invito a @marydeluz y @brujita18. Les envío un gran saludo. Hasta pronto. Amonet. ---

links.title: Como transmitir nuestra fe
links.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/1323550/pexels-photo-1323550.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/1323550/pexels-photo-1323550.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

## Hay temporadas que prueban nuestra fe. Temporadas donde debemos aferrarnos a las promesas de Dios.

> Estas cosas os he hablado para que en mí tengáis paz. En el mundo tendréis aflicción; pero confiad, yo he vencido al mundo.

Juan 16:33

##### Qué importante es entender que el amor de Dios no se parece a nada que hayamos experimentado antes. Es un amor que no falla, que no se rinde y que no depende de lo que nosotros hagamos para manifestarse en nuestras vidas.

##### La bendición de Dios no siempre se ve como esperamos. Pero cuando miramos hacia atrás podemos ver Su mano guiándonos en cada paso. Y eso nos da la confianza para seguir adelante.

##### Dios nos ha dado todo lo que necesitamos para vivir una vida de piedad. No nos falta nada. Pero muchas veces buscamos fuera lo que El ya puso dentro de nosotros por medio de Su Espíritu.

##### La salvación no se gana, se recibe. No es el resultado de nuestros esfuerzos sino el regalo de Dios para nosotros. Y ese regalo viene por medio de la fe en Jesucristo, no por nuestras obras.

##### A veces esperamos que Dios haga algo grande y espectacular cuando El está obrando en lo pequeño y en lo silencioso. Una voz apacible y delicada, no en el terremoto ni en el fuego, sino en un susurro.

##### Dios te dice hoy: no temas, porque yo estoy contigo. No desmayes, porque yo soy tu Dios. Te fortaleceré, ciertamente te ayudaré, sí, te sostendré con la diestra de mi justicia.

##### Hoy es un buen día para recordar que Dios no ha terminado contigo. El que comenzó la buena obra en tu vida la va a completar. No te rindas justo antes de ver el milagro.

##### Dios tiene un propósito en cada estación de nuestra vida. No hay tiempo perdido en el Reino de Dios. Todo lo que vivimos, las pruebas y las bendiciones, todo obra para nuestro bien y para Su gloria.

##### Que el amor de Dios llene tu corazón hoy y que puedas descansar en la certeza de que El tiene el control de todas las cosas. Confía en El con todo tu corazón y no te apoyes en tu propia prudencia.

> De modo que si alguno está en Cristo, nueva criatura es; las cosas viejas pasaron; he aquí todas son hechas nuevas.

2 Corintios 5:17

##### Dios nos invita a confiar en El cada día, a depositar nuestras cargas a sus pies y a descansar en la certeza de que El tiene el control de todas las cosas. Bendiciones.

*****
*******

*Muchas Gracias por compartir esta lectura, deseo que el Espíritu Santo de Dios traiga revelación de su palabra a nuestras vidas.*

<center>![](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYH4hAwopGmcAs8LgkwPjZ16zjiUAzunvLxFfFWRpGGfr/image.png)</center>

links.title: Finishing \
- Chapters 16-21 - My Thoughts (Book 8 of 12)
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvWN674RD3yCTJqhADJ7DADRw3B4TnTL7MyHCmS8Wwqf/1779293120710.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEeBaR4FnHN8LAnReWZw54bf3NSA9JsuZe1FEU8tyvYL/1779293120789.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

### Chapters Read: 

Well, *'Allies of the Night'* was certainly enjoyable don't get me wrong. But overall, it may have been one of my least favorite of the series so far. I hate to say it but, practically all of my posts are basically detailed rants about how much I love this series anyway, I don't see the harm in admitting that one of them was a little less awesome. 

Again, this book was *not bad* by any means at all! It certainly had some awesome moments and a lot of good strengths. I don't have a singular strong reason I don't like it quite as much as the others but, it just is what it is. 

Darren has reunions with a lot of older characters, and that aspect of the book is quite intriguing and memorable. It's always fascinating how meeting old faces gives you a hard-to-explain feeling in your heart. In real life, when you see an old friend in public, it's like meeting an unidentified version of someone you used to know. A living, sort of ghost. The person resembles who you used to know. There's similarities, but something feels off. Not that the individual necessarily feels off, but the old connection you and the person used to have feels janky, and weak. I use the word bittersweet a lot, but this feeling is more like eerie, and confusing, and sad at times. It's really a sign we're all aging, and that the end is indeed coming for us all. In some ways, moments like those are the most unpleasant feeling someone can have. 

Meeting Debbie again was fairly nice. But soon that even developed in an unfortunate, rather painful way as their connection is just not the same for obvious reasons. 

Meeting Steve again was also incredibly frightening. He seemed nice initially, turns out that was far from the truth. More on that shortly. 

And at the end of this book, Darren learns the individual that attacked him in the alley was actually R.V. and well, poor R.V. has lost his marbles fully and he's quite angry at Darren. 

But yeah so, these last four chapters were quite good, the best of the whole book. These books always have an incredible ending. That's something that is always reliable in this series. 

Steve finally reveals himself as a half-vampaneze, still wanting revenge on Darren and Mr. Crepsley. 

Steve *doesn't* immediately reveal that he's the Lord of the Vampaneze though which definitely surprised me! The timing of all of these plot twists always surprises me. My memory has failed me for sure! 

I mean besides Steve not revealing who he fully is *yet* I have to mention just how ballsy Steve is. Of course saying he's evil and twisted is stating the obvious here. But a formidable, entertaining bad guy always pushes a good story to the next level. 

Steve is no unbeatable bad guy of course. He's rather shallow which is unsurprising, and he also is stubborn to a very stupid degree. He can be sort of scattered and like overly determined and of course Steve has a ton of other flaws and weaknesses. Again, besides his basic villain traits. 

BUT his fundamental plot here, is just pretty wicked, ruthless and clever. I mean, he pulled off things Voldemort or Galbatorix would never dream of pulling off. I mean, Steve isn't necessarily like, on their level villain wise but I'm beginning to reconsider. Mr. Tiny is arguably the main villain too but, he's kind of the very essence of fate itself so, he's kinda in a whole different category of villain/character. 

Steve straight up infiltrated the three very vampires that are destined to possibly literally kill him. He befriended the majority of them besides Mr. Crepsley. Earned their friggin trust, and led them into the arms of the vampaneze. Like, what? 

I mean, the amount of risk and the amount of sheer recklessness displayed by Steve is truly pretty next level. For some reason, I sort of overlooked this plot when I first read the series. Like I said, I even completely forgot that Steve acted like a good guy to begin with. 

I think I overlooked this because, interestingly, Darren kinda whoops Steve's butt after Steve reveals that he was a half-vampaneze. Like, seriously Darren messes him up rather good so Steve's clever plan is briefly forgotten. Also, at this point Steve hasn't revealed who he truly is yet. So he just seems to be an angry vengeful individual at this point rather than the literal Vampaneze Lord putting the entire fate of the war at risk. So Steve's full plot and it's significance wasn't really fully understood at this point. 

Darren not only whoops Steve surprisingly well, Darren had multiple chances to kill Steve and man, it's just crazy to me how close victory really was. The whole fake Vampaneze Lord propped up just gives me chills to this day. I'll never forget how duped I was!

Even if a reader saw Steve's betrayal coming, the layers this story has is so impressive. The sheer misdirection is so good. First, it's like ok Steve might be good. Then, ok Steve was lying. Then, ok he's just an angry dude trying to get back at Darren and Mr. Crepsley. Then, ok he's literally The Lord of the Vampaneze. Sheesh!

You'd think the whole 'hiding in plain sight' tactic would have like, crossed everyone's minds but still, the sheer audacity of Steve's plan is bonkers. The actual implications and statement made by Steve can't be overlooked. He's proven he's willing to do whatever it takes to achieve his goals. It's truly a creepy level of determination. 

I can't remember the gang's reaction from my prior read, but like the mental turmoil and just demoralizing feeling that must be felt once Steve reveals himself as the Vampaneze Lord, has got to be just unfathomable. To be right next to Steve for that long, the very man they're supposed to eliminate like, it's actually pretty embarrassing if I'm being honest. 

The fight at the end was a bit confusing since like, it's implied the vampaneze aren't really trying to truly kill the gang apparently? Gannen's excuse is odd and weak, they say that he doesn't want to lose more men since like, a fight to the death gets grimy or something? I guess they're afraid of losing Steve in the chaos as Darren literally has the chance to kill Steve, if the fight gets too ruthless and chaotic, Steve will probably die since he's unconscious? 

I guess this will ultimately be revealed in the next book. 

The ending of this one completely surprised me too. Steve is literally being held hostage, as is Debbie as she's captured by R.V. I really totally forgot just how much Steve is involved **directly** prior to him being revealed as the Lord of the Vampaneze. 

I'm actually grateful at how much I've forgotten. I get to re-experience this in a semi-fresh way all over again. 

I recall book nine being one of the better books even though of course it's also arguably the saddest one too...

Book nine here I come...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmesQ78PGYutPu2DKh4YBFxEPaNM4GbX5Zmcv4J4sRr3k9/1779293120941.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1Kt2y3vXP2amzyCqoSQ9XK8Br2qTK4LWKjw3e1xSYWG/1754644078339.png)

links.body: Hay una sabiduría estoica profunda en tu relato: la capacidad de detenerse a contemplar un atardecer no es solo un acto romántico, es un ejercicio de presencia. Mientras el sol se oculta, nos recuerda que todo ciclo tiene su final, pero que en ese proceso de 'esconderse' siempre hay una luz capaz de teñir el mundo de colores únicos.\n\nEs muy humano buscar capturar esos instantes en una imagen, y aunque hayamos tomado mil fotografías, la que elegimos es la que mejor resuena con nuestra verdad interior en ese momento. Esa búsqueda de la imagen perfecta es, en realidad, un reflejo de nuestra búsqueda por encontrarnos a nosotros mismos en medio de la inmensidad del paisaje. Gracias por compartir no solo tu belleza física, sino esa sensibilidad que te permite ver la magia en lo simple. Son recordatorios necesarios para todos nosotros.

Those things I found sometimes amazed me. Like these kinds of flowers that I haven’t ever seen in my life before. I just learned from one of my friends in TikTok that this flower is called “Dok Krading Nang Fa”. Dok means flower Krading means bell Nang Fa means angel I think the appearance of this flower is like a beautiful bell, that’s why its name came from.
/> These orchids are very gorgeous. I found them decorating the trees beside the road.

/> I like to notice even little creatures… I found this one on the side-road. I almost stepped on it. It was very big and it walked very quickly and the way it walked was like the train, that’s why I stopped and made a video of it…

links.title: The relative death of backpacking
links.body: While backpacking is still a thing for some people I have noticed that there has been a real decline in this wonderful activity in the past 20 years or so.  \n\nWhen I first started traveling it seemed as though backpacking for months or even a year or so to be a right of passage of sorts for people that were in their early 20's.  There were some grizzled older folks that would do it as well and at least with all the groups I ended up with, there was no age discrimination that I discovered or participated in.   Now I am one of the older travelers and while I do engage in budget travel, the \

for the most part doesn't exist anymore and it is really understandable why that is.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/trip-hop/Eq5GrzfnjdZjtiEWY7Se4SugydtHpDBY5qt7nZpAdWJonkfJFLfT5NgK5h7PoQ4Yb8X.png)
[src](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSlMNFYx2TfyZOiJozBfLtYwjidfKg542qgXg&s)
</center>

When i first started backpacking in the early naughts, things were very different than they are not, as you would expect.  The internet existed but not everything was driven by it.  Smartphones didn't exist yet and very few people even bothered with simcards or phone plans once overseas because they were often more trouble than they were worth.

I arrived in Singapore late one night and had a plan to travel through Malaysia, then to Thailand, and was going to go through Laos and Vietnam as well.  There was still some level of fear about Cambodia back in those days so I had opted to skip that.   

My total duration of stay was 28 days and needless to say, my ambitious travel plans didn't happen like I had planned.   I met up with some people in Singapore almost immediately and we decided as a group to travel on to Malaysia together.   When we would arrive somewhere, we were at the mercy of the bus as to where that would be.   Then as a team we would figure out how to get to a part of town that had a bunch of cheap guesthouses.  We worked together with our Lonely Planet maps and even though we failed quite frequently, part of the adventure was figuring out how to get to our destination as cheaply as possible.  

Then we would get some rooms just wherever and probably get something to eat, a few beers, and then discuss what we were going to do in the lobby or hangout area of the hostel.   It was there that we would end up meeting even more people and exchange information with one another about things we had just experience in the past 48 hours or so. 

There wasn't any extensive online research to be done and for the most part, nobody bothered to try.  Not just every place had a website and if review websites did exist at all, they certainly weren't well-known.  

<center> https://ik.imgkit.net/3vlqs5axxjf/PCWW/uploadedImages/uploads/2013/04/hostelworld.jpg?tr=w-1200%2Cfo-auto
[src](https://ik.imgkit.net/3vlqs5axxjf/PCWW/uploadedImages/uploads/2013/04/hostelworld.jpg?tr=w-1200%2Cfo-auto)</center>

These days I don't think anyone just rocks up to a city and figures out where they are going to stay by walking around.  Instead massive booking companies like HostelWorld would kind of make those decisions for you.   The people that are traveling like this today are really missing out on a big part of what made travelling so much of an adventure back 20 years ago.  The unknown was the adventure, and you were forced to meet people and speak to strangers along the way.  A lot of my friends were made by doing exactly that and some of them I still keep in touch with to this day and made an effort to meet them at some point later as well.

These days, I am kind of too old to feel comfortable in a hostel, so normally I will opt to stay in cheaper hotels or guesthouses and unfortunately, I also book them online ahead of time.  

The days of just walking around in an area that you heard about from a fellow traveler are kind of behind us.  These days it seems like people go to a specific destination and will book a taxi using an app and arrive right at the door of exactly where they are meant to go to.   For these people, they miss out on a lot of the off the beaten path stuff and they are also subjected to market manipulation by whoever the big players in the game happen to be.

A large part of what remains of the backpacking industry is basically a monopoly of giant party hostel chains that incorrectly try to give youths a unique experience that mostly involves getting very close to alcohol poisoning.  I have no problem with drinking but I've seen these places and they specialize in sexuality and taking as much of their guests money as possible by keeping them hammered drunk all day, every day. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/trip-hop/23uQnR1HoSdp9hbrwQJmBBZ3K66PQUMu1ZZXub5LqsGmkuUHjtv1bvtLSQGEi4p11iRhS.png)
[src](https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/1c/9f/07/d0/drinks-on-our-terrance.jpg?w=500&h=400&s=1)</center>

Slumber Party and Booze and Snooze are two of the big hostel operations that kind of \

backpacking in my mind.   I did plenty of drinking when I was backpacking, but it wasn't my primary focus.  These sorts of operations keep their customers in house and sort of discourage people wandering out on their own to explore.  They arrange tours and events and pub crawls and all of it seems very regimented.  It almost seems like a bit of a cult when you are somewhere and see a bus turn up with everyone wearing matching shirts as they go from bar to bar drinking shots and basically acting like loons.

I'm trying to not be a grumpy old man here and if that's your thing then go for it but on the flip side these people are not even seeing most of what an area has to offer by staying inside the network whose sole purpose seems to  be relieving you of as much of your money as possible by keeping you drunk all the time.  This is likely illegal in western countries but I don't really have any idea.

These days when I see people with a backpack I kind of immediately think that they are wasting their time having that equipment because if they are in the party hostel network, they are never going to do anywhere that a backpack is actually necessary for.  They may as well make their travel easier by just using a rolling suitcase.  I have also noticed that most of the \

today seem to be carrying all of their worldly possessions with them where as with true backpacking the entire point was to bring as little with you as possible.  \n\nGone are the days where you would just get dropped off on a particular street in a city and then you and your \

that you just met, perhaps on the bus to get there, now branch out and work to find accommodation.  Now when I see people with backpacks they almost always have their phones out as they are being directed straight to a place that they probably booked many weeks before they even got here.

To those folks I say have a great time.  I don't think that it would be possible to roll like we did 20 years ago and often immigration for a lot of countries require proof of accommodation booking as a condition for your visa.   

I don't like that this has happened but I guess I should just consider myself lucky that I got to experience it before they changed it all.  For those that are traveling today, I suppose ignorance is bliss and well, since for a lot of the younger people out there they have always had smart phones, they probably wouldn't really enjoy just getting out there and walking around until they figure it out somehow.

An update on the future of HELIOS.voter:

After evaluating the recent technical issues with the burn-for-vote script, we’ve decided to officially sunset the program.

Every project has its lifecycle, and we've reached a point where it makes more sense to retire this service rather than pour more development time into maintaining it. This pivot allows us to clear the decks and focus fully on building out the new projects and utilities that will drive the future of the HELIOS ecosystem.

A huge thank you to everyone who utilized and supported HELIOS.voter over the years. We're excited to turn the page and look forward to showing you what we're building next.

links.body: It is fascinating how an object designed to measure something as abstract as time ends up becoming a guardian of our personal history. Accepting that the day has passed—with its headaches and unfinished tasks—without judging ourselves for what we couldn’t manage, is the first step towards true peace of mind. As you rightly say, time is the same for everyone, but our ability to imbue it with meaning is what makes the difference.\n\nI am particularly moved by the story of these clocks: from the one resting in the cellar, waiting for a second chance, to the one that sets the rhythm of the home and gently stops to protect a grandchild’s sleep. These objects do not merely measure hours; they measure love, legacy and the evolution of our priorities. Thank you for reminding us that, beyond the precision of a mechanism, what truly matters is the care we show to people and the memories we choose to cherish. A very insightful invitation to value the present.

links.title: Happy wife, happy life !
links.body:
Every person has their own thoughts and understanding. In any relationship, whether marital or family, listening to each other, understanding, and making decisions by mutual consent are signs of a strong relationship. Listening to and understanding others is not a sign of weakness, but rather a sign of understanding and maturity. In today's era of equality and understanding, the foundation of a good relationship  rests on mutual communication and respect. However, there was a time when women saying in household matters were limited. Many times in society, men who listen carefully to women are considered weak or inferior on the scale of 'manliness' i.e masculinity. A man listening and following his wife advices raises question on his manhood. It is strange to see the old stereotype thought still exists in many households. 


![20260512_141403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/244oXC7B5QpWYyGE8qobRoNAgGDP7aCNGiLrBS9PGGLSqXfFxSXNtPxbX7jV7R4HDdVve.jpg)


Yesterday, I was at a relative home, when I heard an old lady around 75 years of age raising question on his grandson masculinity merely because he usually listen to his wife. And she thinks that by doing so he is his wife slave. In English, the most formal and common word for a husband who is controlled by his wife is referred as **henpecked**. But coming across to the old lady words made me to wonder how and why obeying to wife always test a man's masculinity. In old stereotypical family structures, women held a subordinate status, functioning primarily as caretakers and homemakers. They were largely excluded from public life and financial independence, heavily relying on men for decisions. Men were viewed as the head of the household and the sole financial providers. Men held the authority to make all major financial and life altering decisions for the family. Thereby reducing the woman involvement in any family and social matters. Those people who does listen or obey to woman were seen as weak and inferior. ***Joru ka Gulaam*** is what used to taunt such person. 

In the modern era, time has evolved. Many things have changed and the outlook towards society and family matters have evolved too. In todays time women can been seen raising their voices with ease and their were competing against the Men world with head and shoulders. In a recent newspaper article, it was clearly mentioned that Man who listen to their Women were more happy. It is easily noticeable that, women brings a new perspective and dimension in decision making. Listening to women bridges gaps in perspective, broadens emotional intelligence, and fosters healthier relationships. Women often possess high emotional intelligence and situational awareness. Paying attention to these details can help men see situations with more clarity and nuance. Men who actively listen to women and value their perspectives report higher levels of relationship satisfaction and mental well being.

Listening to the old lady does made me sick for a while. Time has changed but it is very difficult to change the thought and outlook of our older generation. They still live in their past and consider them as the best things. But judging a Man masculinity for obeying wife words is still not getting pass my throat.


**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

(the smell), though the due date is still long to go. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXKCiTwPdmeUT2kzUB5nWHhHYQzEahpqNawUpB2VgtLNC/20260608_084819.jpg)

Because it came in a bulk for less than $1.50 USD, and I am going to try substitute rice with this, I might as well purchase in bulk, but I think it has been a while there and you can see on the lower left there's a lot of whey juice there.

##### However, nothing a wash with water could not fix
It will take out probably 80% of the \

smell from these hard tofu.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbzYwwT29jwedabvNjMnShbYeK7NWYBbxvqW1aKmg3RbN/20260608_093732.jpg)

With similar [instructions](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6VpS7bQiVaw) I saw from the video, a 3 minute microwave of the tofu (instead of fry or steam) just to get the last bit of water is necessary to create this dry brittle texture that supposed to mimic rice.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjLxjUvU4t9n8oQ3vm8LetNKReSB6Wma31UoRC5kwYdr/20260608_094406.jpg)

White squeezing and crumbling the tofu, I also steamed some mixed frozen vegetables and my last bits of frozen rice and black beans with quinoa so that they do not feel that dry, place them nicely side by side just like any bibimbap / poké would display

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjoSQAykigYZFReiqLf2wTjXr9K4WS7GWQWcP9VjUfKu/20260608_095621.jpg)

While I couldn't find _Gochugaru_ (Korean spice powder), I found this _Gouchujang_ for half a price, which actually already has vinegar inside so I didn't have to add additional! That would have saved me a lot; and with proper storage in the fridge, this could last me white a while.

For me who hasn't been taking much spicy food of late because I needed to accommodate my seniors, a teaspoon of this dark red sauce is more than enough. I am definitely not targeting any \

so a little heat should just be enough to keep me awake.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiG1hi2GSksTjqFz41ZZp872dEe3kWmogHS1LepN3LBH/20260608_095643.jpg)

My office pantry still had this honey vinegar from the last Chinese New Year hamper received (and no one is using it) and this is perfect for adding the right amount of sweetness without too much sugar. I eye-balled around a tablepoon for that before eyeballing another teaspoon of soy sauce for that umami balance.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSHYvdZeopur1hQQvRqS5GvUCFXEn3fiLM3J6ejpvubJ/20260608_100416.jpg)
I woke up a little late and only managed to fry an egg in a rush, losing 80% of the saucy yolk but I think it is still great for that eggy feel. That's the only meat I have in here at the moment but the original recipe actually has sausages / minced meat to add on.

Since there's already quinoa and black bean + peas and tofu, that's ample protein packed in this one meal.

---

## The verdict?
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdqVb52vcpX9gn6TjzcQQg2wo8bZETbT1ETvHJZiPQTJm/20260608_100604.jpg)

When everything is mixed properly together, just like any bibimbap, despite only little more of a tablespoon of sauce, it turned out great.

The hard tofu didn't taste weird at all even though it smelt a little fermented, and it still tastes refreshing. 

Probably without the rice next round I might feel less \

from the carbs... but let's see if I can keep this up tomorrow.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahGYPUKSE5aHDF19BWLPy8pA7mZCJuLq5ALSCKduPFw7/20260429_100119.jpg)

I had a 4 crackers with spread and _Edam Cheese block_ (low sugar) around 2 hours later and right now I am still feeling full (after 6 hours). I guess my body still urge to have some snacking, and if I do, either yoghurt or a few more slices from the cheese block could fix it.

Let's see if it can last till way past sunset today.

## What's the recipe?

##### Ingredients 
- 1 square of firm tofu (unchanged)
- mixed frozen vegetables (replaced the diced cucumbers because I couldn't find any good ones)
- 1 teaspoon of vinegar gochujang (replacing gochugaru and rice vinegar)
- 1 cube Black bean quinoa rice portion (which is 1/2 of a bowl of plain rice), not needed if on a strict diet
- 1 tablespoon of honey vinegar (replacing any sweet sauce)
- approximately 1/2 tablespoon of soy sauce (the original recipe requires 1 tablespoon)
- One fried egg (recipe preferred Sunny Side Up to have that creamy feeling)

##### How to eat
Mix all together evenly on a huge bowl and slowly enjoy it. 

## How about you?
Do you think you'd give this a try, with or without going on a diet?

I believe this is more of a lazy version of bibimbap as the original has a lot more condiments, but the simple, lean, morish version would have served well enough as a \

meal. # Until Then Stay healthy, stay curious and learn new things, and stay happy! ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/GLhDmHx9sqz2PfsVn8wmBCwMuAjSEj5N9rRH9KxQYTWLtELcDRXZtVdjbN2AibXohZTX8B3xfvGWjtzGDkgEE8a3iAFobu3fDp84Hi8Teia5j7Q3QebpP3iBXwoiux2rDd2ALKGSdmxF5xfCp25jXZswvbNo7FF6cpm5iNH3qcPafYq7u8UDsRd3ecUXNMvoQFNKnGh94Zn7LkEVgKFEa8t35DvqrEGAx66S1mDshn5.webp?format=webp&mode=fit) ![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://cdn.liketu.com/media/littlenewthings/images/clqq5wgah0097g1sz2uqqc3u5_littlenewthings-buymeacoffee/clqq5wgah0097g1sz2uqqc3u5_littlenewthings-buymeacoffee.webp) If you would like to give some encouragement outside HIVE with some fiat backing, please feel free to visit: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/littlenewthings You can also support me in HIVE

links.title: Rally Upgrade - Use RLP Instead of $ETH For Submissions
links.body:
I went from being a teacher to making what can only be described as a schoolboy error. Back in 2015, I sold 6.7 BTC for what felt like a decent profit at the time.

Looking back today, it wasn't profit... it was tuition. Expensive tuition and memories that come back to hunt me again and again! That moment became my crypto villain origin story.

Like many people who have been in this space long enough, I spent years replaying the decision in my head. What if I had held? What if I had understood Bitcoin's potential sooner?

What if I had simply forgotten my wallet existed? The truth is that one mistake pushed me deeper down the rabbit hole than any success ever could, and this is why I am still here today.

I became obsessed with understanding this industry, learning how decentralized systems worked, studying market cycles, exploring new protocols, and trying to understand where the future was heading.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWiwbPQuRbm1vxBNECfu49eWkYWgziUxV9VxZ7wPYgcS/image.png)


I never looked back. In many ways... Web3 adopted me. That journey eventually led me to Rally, and wish I had push it harder when this was at the very early stages! 

Rally has consistently focused on helping creators participate in the onchain economy without unnecessary complexity. No pumped leaderboards full of boted content! 

As someone who spends a lot of time creating content and engaging with communities, I've been waiting for a specific improvement for quite some time.

Now it's finally here! Rally users can pay gas fees using RLP instead of needing ETH for transactions. To some people, that might sound like a small update.

To anyone who has onboarded new users into Web3, it's a massive quality-of-life improvement. One of the biggest friction points in crypto has always been gas fees.

You can explain wallets, tokens, and communities to someone relatively quickly, but the moment they need a separate asset just to perform a basic action, confusion begins.

Suddenly they need ETH, they need enough ETH, they need to understand gas fluctuations, and they need to make sure they don't run out. It's frustrating for everyone! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6HiyTMdRjVshx5bVsQYW453tuawNraBY82srFgnV4vW/image.png)


My biggest issue wasn't even the transaction itself. It was the extra layer of fees attached to every interaction. Those small costs add up over time and create barriers that don't need to exist.

By allowing creators to pay directly with RLP, Rally removes a major onboarding hurdle and makes participation far more intuitive. It's a simplified process that makes it better! 

Creators should be focused on creating, and communities should be focused on engaging. Neither should have to think about topping up ETH every time they want to perform a simple action.

What deserves even more recognition is that Rally didn't make this change in isolation. The team listened to community feedback and delivered something users genuinely wanted.

In an industry where projects often talk about community-first development, it's refreshing to see a team actually ship improvements that directly address real user pain points.

Quality over quantity! Sometimes they're the invisible upgrades that make everything smoother. Sometimes they're the difference between a new user staying or leaving. 

Users can spend 100 RLP instead of approximately $1.20 worth of ETH to submit a tweet. That might seem insignificant on a single transaction but what about thousands of interactions?

These are the improvements that strengthen an ecosystem over time. As for my 103,000 RLP bag.... if we use the rough comparison of 100 RLP equaling $1.20 that would imply $123 dollars?

Not bad for someone who once sold 6.7 Bitcoin for peanuts. PVM officially gives Rally the cookie they deserve.  Sometimes the most important innovations aren't the ones making headlines.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJBzKekchPgG4zEb8EasHimh56FKtmEr9J553dFWsY8C/image.png)

Imagine if we could get 100 people doing just 1 blog post about the curation trail. Do you think the membership would go up quickly?

Give it a shot, the more, the better for everyone.

And if you are following the trail please support our witness. @thebbhproject. 

## DRIP DAY 

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.
If you own 1,000 or more BBH tokens you get a drip of swap.hive and TOOFUCKEH.
If you own 5,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive and the PIMP token, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER and CTP Tokens.
If you own 10,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive, PIMP, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER, CTP, and LEO tokens.

If you stake 20,000 or more BBHO tokens you get a drip of swap.btc, and ALIVE tokens
If you stake 5,000 or more BBHO tokens you got a drip of ALIVE tokens.

All just for owning BBH. There are two ways you can get BBH. First you can buy them from the open market. I use TribalDex myself.

Or they can be tipped to you. The great part about BBH tipping is that when you tip a token to someone else you do not loose any of your own. There is a central pool that supplies them.

And a third way to get BBH would be people gift them to you. There was an update to the tipping bot. If you now tip 1 BBH you get 1 BBH also. How facking awesome is that.

And now a forth way to get BBH with the BBH Miner.

The goal is to have 1 BBH = 1 Satoshi. I do a bit of math and get the price. ## BBH AND BBHO TOKEN DIFFERENCE
It seems some people are still confused. So I am putting this section into my daily post.

BBH token was my first token. It is a tipping bot and a passive income token. You only need to hold it, hold 10 or more to get a drip on drip day(below).

BBHO token is the native token of The BBH Project Tribe. The same as LEO is the native token of InLeo.

It is that simple. I did add drips to stakers of BBHO also as I work on building out use cases for the token.

Hope this helps.

>While Israel and Iran exchanged attacks on the mainland one by one in two months after the ceasefire, tensions in the Middle East increased as Yemen stepped into the war again.

>According to the Times of Israel's report on the 8th (local time), a missile attack warning was issued in central Israel, including Jerusalem and Tel Aviv, earlier in the day.
Immediately after the alert was issued, the Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) said, \

The IDF declared the entire missile intercept and the end of the situation soon after.
If the Israeli military's claim that missiles were fired from Yemen is true, Yemen attacked Israel shortly after Israel launched airstrikes in central and western Iran in response to Iran's ballistic missile attack.
There is a possibility that the pro-Iranian militant Houthis were behind the missile attack on the Buddha statue launched from Yemen. As Israel launched a retaliatory attack on Iran, the Houthis may have launched another retaliation. So far, the Houthis have not made an official statement.
However, the Houthi said in a statement on the 7th, \
\nIran's Supreme Leader Shil Ali Akbar Belayati, an adviser on international affairs, further said, \

If Israel continues to violate the ceasefire, it intends to move the Houthis to block the Babel Mandev Strait and block the Red Sea.

>Israel doesn't listen to Trump
U.S. President Donald Trump, who is currently negotiating the end of the war with Iran, is trying hard to calm the escalation of the conflict between Iran and Israel, but has not had much effect.
In a telephone interview with U.S. media including Fox News and Axios on the 7th, President Trump said to Iran, which fired missiles into Israel for the first time since the ceasefire, \
\nRegarding Israel's attack on Lebanon, which Iran used as a justification for its attack on Israel, he said, \

\nU.S. media reported that President Trump appeared to have talked to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on the phone. He is believed to have expressed concerns about escalation through retaliation and urged Netanyahu to refrain from it, but Netanyahu has already ignored Trump's warnings several times and insisted on escalation.\nOn the 1st, President Trump expressed strong dissatisfaction with the expansion of Lebanon's military operation by using harsh expressions such as \

in a phone call with Netanyahu, who said he would attack Beirut.
On the 3rd, Israel and Lebanon agreed to a ceasefire through President Trump's mediation, but Israel launched another airstrike on southern Lebanon just hours later.

>Trump in a hurry before the World Cup
President Trump said on the 7th that he was very close to reaching a deal with Iran, adding, \

\nSome interpret the remarks as expressing a strong will to agree on a memorandum of understanding (MOU) that calls for extending the 60-day ceasefire and starting denuclearization negotiations before the opening of the North Korea-China World Cup on the 11th.\nThe successful hosting of the World Cup could be President Trump's achievement ahead of the upcoming midterm elections in November, but the World Cup in the midst of war could be only a \

with unrest around the world.
Unlike President Trump, who is anxious, Israel and Iran are continuing their off-the-shelf battles by warning of retaliation with the intention of entering an all-out war at any time, so tensions in the Middle East are not expected to fade for the time being.
Reporter Song Hyun-seo

Trump’s diplomatic incompetence is on full display.
At this point, it is unclear what the war was even for, and he cannot even bring it to an end as intended.
The current situation—where even Israel, considered a closest ally, is not being effectively controlled—
is entirely due to Trump’s incompetence.
The American people need to recognize the true nature of Trump as soon as possible.

> # **ENGLISH** --- # Hello everyone, good morning. Going out these winter days has been a bit tedious, considering that without a car, getting from one city to another is complicated by the unreliable transportation system. Added to this, with the avenues flooded, it's understandable that drivers avoid those areas for fear of getting stuck… for that reason, we've had to arm ourselves with coats and umbrellas to walk as far as we have to. A few days ago, I had to go to El Tigre to do some shopping for my food business. Mercedes came with me; she also had some shopping to do for her new business. She lives there, and I live in the neighboring city of El Tigrito (San José de Guanipa). I left the house all dressed up, and the sky seemed clear. I hadn't walked a couple of blocks when it started to rain… well, I bundled up in my hooded coat and got my umbrella. I don't want to have a relapse after the flu I had last month. The funniest thing is that I almost felt like Mary Poppins, because the breeze was so strong that the umbrella nearly flew away, and I was holding it, hahaha, I wasn't going to let go for anything in the world. The truth is, after running our errands and buying supplies at a baking shop, we went into a little café in Tigre called Il Piccolo Café to chat. It's a very quiet place in the mornings, and it gets busy at lunchtime, when they sell various kinds of pastichos… the specialty is the mushroom one.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTdG6ThqLsVkZBvmYkW5ZBu1DLbB8k2BkzCY8pdW3V1S/3362c1e6_8ea6_466f_bf64_d7f511be7294.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYsA4o6CsgmodZj1yH9xkRpmaT5SijdEuzgQh6tp7D2Mx/2ba1854b_ce04_4167_b860_0f52412f8e02.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRDK9YL6KVgmHD8JEH5UGoSeb2nozFFuPrDwShrTUphHN/3a7ae137_4307_47ec_9e1d_6e9e3ad38ad3.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCUgpDQkMAXpMMwz6WWKTUnsXWkKRpEbjjLHNxauCQ8g/31eb501d_20e7_4160_bac7_ea16324a2b94.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeXWuQ1PpM56DSnLkb7whsXd6QJzjJWgyc6bYpF3tUmyG/60e95ff3_5441_4544_bdee_688fbd2c9a0a.jpg)

> This café is located on Avenida Francisco de Miranda, one block before the Banco Provincial, next to the old Ugma headquarters. I wanted to have a café con leche, but sometimes I avoid dairy products too often because they don't agree with me. So I ordered a black coffee, which, by the way, was an espresso and was very good. Mercedes ordered a café con leche and told me it was also very tasty. We met for coffee to chat about our businesses, among other things, and she brought a presentation of her new cookies—delicious, by the way—made with oats and prunes. She not only took the opportunity to sell them, but we also exchanged ideas on production, promotion, and sales. The bakery we went to is one of the best in El Tigre and has more affordable prices. We both took the opportunity to buy supplies for our production. It was a cold winter morning, but quite productive. We had a great time; coffee, as always, is the perfect accompaniment to good times. And these winter days, it continues to be a staple, along with any kind of cookies and good company. This is my entry in the [Coffee Shop Prompt or week 171](https://peakd.com/hive-152524/@cinnccf/the-coffee-shop-prompt-or-week-171-june-4-10)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYATaAetBz4scUCSs3MfospJwcgYwDTmrHPhFMGaZd4F/capture_20231103_111308.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdD7Nwx3TYfz4ejAERESM2WRR12Hqaq8Rqzc4z6KbGSM8/893438d3_e668_4e46_9a5b_8c67a64a059b.jpg)

**ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola a todos, muy buenos días. Salir en estos días de invierno ha resultado un poco tedioso, considerando que sin carro y trasladarse de una ciudad a la otra, se complica por el sistema de transporte tan irregular. Aunado a esto, con las avenidas inundadas, es natural que los transportistas eviten pasearse por esos sitios, debido al temor de quedarse atascados… por esa razón ha tocado armarse con abrigos y paraguas para caminar lo que se tenga que caminar. Días atrás, tuve que ir al Tigre a hacer unas compras para mi emprendimiento de comidas. Me acompañó Mercedes que también tenía unas compras que hacer para su nuevo emprendimiento, ella vive allá, yo vivo en la ciudad vecina, El Tigrito (San José de Guanipa). Salí de la casa toda coqueta y aparentemente el cielo estaba despejado, no terminé de caminar un par de cuadras, cuando comenzó a llover… bueno, me forré con mi abrigo de capucha, y saqué mi paraguas. No quiero tener recaída después de la gripe del mes pasado. Lo más cómico es que casi me sentí Mary Popins, porque era tanta la brisa que el paraguas casi sale volando, y yo con él, jajajaja, no lo pensaba soltar por nada del mundo. Lo cierto es que después de hacer nuestras diligencias, y comprar materiales en una tienda de repostería, entramos a conversar a un cafetín en el Tigre que se llama Il Piccolo Café. Es un sitio muy tranquilo en las mañanas, y se pone concurrido a la hora del almuerzo, que venden pastichos de varios tipos… la especialidad, el de champignones.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ2BcKQargAAp7iyJ12A7zNJwVpL74zJxWFwQuvYLChtL/a2c3e437_91e9_465b_bad8_cb6de24b203d.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPLTDp3roDKHQJL27KRsgWion6cujQD64ndjZ8vEChUV/a33ea2b4_08e8_4800_bb82_877d4238d260.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeqFkeZUgC3mrKA75fd8sghMPtbJ5f2T8WbBFswbg9H7/c0fff5c7_4d76_4fbb_89d4_8d59ace3cfe7.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPycGrmKwbG7e7GPKSWaZ1LQ1bd39AAYLqiWL6kFgFApj/c017ae42_c10d_4912_9c00_527aa6836d0a.jpg)

> Este cafetín queda ubicado en la Av. Francisco de Miranda, una cuadra antes del Banco Provincial, al lado de la antigua sede la Ugma. Yo quería tomarme un café con leche, pero a veces evito tomar lácteos tan seguido porque me caen mal. Así que pedí un café negro que por cierto, era expreso y estaba muy rico. Mercedes pidió un café con leche y me dice que estaba muy sabroso también. Nos reunimos a tomar un café para conversar de nuestros emprendimientos entre otras cosas, y ella me llevó una presentación de sus nuevas galletas, por cierto, deliciosas, elaboradas con avena y ciruelas pasas. No sólo aprovechó para hacer su venta, sino que intercambiamos ideas para producir, promocionar y vender. La tienda de repostería a la que fuimos, es una de las mejores en El Tigre, y tiene precios más accesibles. Ambas aprovechamos de comprar materiales para nuestra producción. Fue una fría mañana de invierno pero bastante productiva, la pasamos muy bien, el café como siempre, es el acompañante de buenos momentos. Y en estos días de invierno sigue estando presente junto a cualquier tipo de galletitas y buenas compañías. Ésta es mi participación en el [Coffee Shop Prompt or week 171](https://peakd.com/hive-152524/@cinnccf/the-coffee-shop-prompt-or-week-171-june-4-10)

links.title: Facial Swelling and Tooth Infections: When to Seek Immediate Care\n
links.body:
/>

Facial swelling is often more than just an uncomfortable symptom—it can be a warning sign of a serious dental infection. In many cases, swelling develops when bacteria spread from a damaged tooth into the surrounding tissues, creating inflammation and pressure. If left untreated, the infection can worsen and affect overall health. For some patients, an [**emergency tooth extraction charlotte nc**](https://trudentalclt.com/tooth-extractions/) may be necessary when a severely infected tooth can no longer be saved. Understanding the causes of facial swelling and knowing when to seek professional care can help prevent serious complications.

<h2 style=\

>What Causes Facial Swelling? Facial swelling related to dental problems typically occurs when an infection develops inside a tooth or gum tissue. Deep cavities, untreated tooth fractures, advanced gum disease, and failed dental restorations can all allow bacteria to enter areas beneath the tooth surface. As the infection progresses, the body's immune system responds by sending fluids and white blood cells to the affected area. This response often results in noticeable swelling around the jaw, cheek, or mouth.

>Understanding Tooth Infections A tooth infection, often referred to as a dental abscess, develops when bacteria invade the inner portion of the tooth. The pulp inside the tooth contains nerves and blood vessels that can become infected due to decay, trauma, or cracks. Common symptoms of a tooth infection include: Persistent tooth pain Sensitivity to hot and cold temperatures Swollen gums Facial swelling Fever Bad taste in the mouth Difficulty chewing Ignoring these symptoms can allow the infection to spread beyond the tooth and into nearby tissues.

>Why Facial Swelling Should Never Be Ignored Many people assume facial swelling will disappear on its own, but this is rarely the case when infection is involved. Swelling is often a sign that the body is actively fighting bacteria. Without proper treatment, the infection can continue to spread and create additional complications. Severe infections may affect the jawbone, surrounding soft tissues, and in rare cases, other areas of the body. Seeking prompt dental care can help stop the infection before it becomes more difficult to manage.

>Signs You Need Immediate Dental Attention While mild discomfort may be manageable for a short period, certain symptoms require urgent evaluation by a dental professional. Warning signs include: Rapidly increasing swelling Severe or throbbing pain Difficulty swallowing Trouble opening the mouth Fever or chills Swollen lymph nodes Pus drainage around the tooth These symptoms often indicate a progressing infection that requires immediate treatment.

>Treatment Options for Tooth Infections The appropriate treatment depends on the severity and location of the infection. In many cases, dentists can save the tooth through procedures such as root canal therapy. However, when the tooth is severely damaged or the infection is too advanced, extraction may be the most effective solution. Professional evaluation helps determine the best course of action while preventing further complications and discomfort.

>The Importance of Timely Care Prompt treatment is one of the most important factors in preventing serious dental complications. Delaying care may allow bacteria to spread deeper into surrounding tissues, making treatment more complex. Patients experiencing swelling, infection, or significant pain should consider seeking [**emergency dental services Charlotte nc**](https://trudentalclt.com/emergency-dentistry/) to receive an accurate diagnosis and timely treatment. Early intervention often leads to better outcomes and a faster recovery.

>How to Manage Symptoms Before Your Appointment While professional care is essential, there are a few temporary steps that may help reduce discomfort before reaching a dental office. Rinse gently with warm salt water. Apply a cold compress to the outside of the face. Stay hydrated. Avoid chewing on the affected side. Follow recommended over-the-counter pain relief instructions. These measures may provide temporary comfort but should never replace professional dental treatment.

>Preventing Future Dental Infections Good oral hygiene plays a significant role in reducing the risk of tooth infections. Brushing twice daily, flossing regularly, and attending routine dental checkups can help identify problems before they become serious. Addressing cavities, damaged fillings, and gum disease early can prevent infections from developing and protect long-term oral health.

>When Urgent Care Makes a Difference Dental infections can worsen quickly, making it important to recognize when immediate treatment is necessary. Swelling accompanied by severe pain, fever, or difficulty swallowing should never be ignored. Access to [**dental urgent care Charlotte nc**](https://trudentalclt.com/emergency-dentistry/) can help patients receive prompt attention and prevent infections from progressing into more serious conditions.

>Final Thoughts\n\nFacial swelling is often a sign that an underlying dental problem requires professional attention. Recognizing the symptoms of a tooth infection and seeking timely treatment can help protect both oral and overall health. Whether treatment involves infection management, restorative care, or extraction, acting quickly can make a significant difference in recovery. For trusted and compassionate dental care in Charlotte, [**Tru Dental**](https://trudentalclt.com/) is committed to helping patients address urgent dental concerns and maintain healthy, confident smiles.

body.body:
Most of these costs are a choice, not a law of nature, and that's what the whole post talks around.

Images on object storage plus a CDN cost a fraction of self-hosted hosting, R2 and friends have zero egress, managed Postgres and search are cheap and simple. You don't need an in-house fleet of nodes, search, indexing and signing services at full redundancy to run a frontend. You've chosen the expensive architecture and you're asking the DHF to fund the difference. The post even admits cheaper setups exist, then reframes picking the costly one as resilience. That's not resilience, that's a spending decision dressed up as a principle.

Hive IS the resilience. The whole point of Hive is that it is decentralised and absorbs a lot of the costs a normal front-end would have to incur. You admit that you have knowingly made things more expensive and complex, but the reasoning doesn't add up for me. I've been around long enough to remember before the rise of cloud computing providers like AWS. It's so cheap to host and run stuff now, and it's safe and easy to configure to abide to by a heap of regulations and standards out of the box.

The Lithuanian fine is unfortunate but it's a one-off, and one-off legal costs don't justify a recurring daily ask. UGC exposure also comes down to how and where you incorporate and operate. The DHF didn't choose to put Ecency under EU jurisdiction. That's on Ecency, and the answer is to structure smarter to limit it, not to bill Hive for it. Europe is a notoriously legislative heavy continent. When you choose to do business in Europe you know you're going to pay more than incorporation somewhere else.

Nobody's saying Ecency does nothing. It does real work and obviously it costs money. But the real conversation is leaner infrastructure at a smaller number, not 250 a day to keep running everything the most expensive way available.

You guys/gals need to get someone who knows what they're doing to get things setup properly for you. Otherwise what's to say you're not going to get another unexpected fine or problem? Ecency is great, but you can't operate with an open source/zero sum mindset or what happens when a cost comes up you can't pay next time?

body.title: Childhood Joy in the Great Outdoors
body.body: There is something special about childhood moments spent outdoors. Parks, playgrounds, and open spaces provide children with opportunities to explore, learn, and create lasting memories with friends and family.
alt=\
/>\n\n
data-align=\

>Image Source: Pexels (free stock photography)

This photo captures a cheerful young child sitting confidently in the foreground while other children and adults gather in the background. The bright red hats add a playful touch and create a strong visual contrast against the natural green surroundings. The shallow depth of field helps draw attention to the child's curious expression, making the image both engaging and heartwarming. Outdoor activities play an important role in a child's development. They encourage physical movement, social interaction, creativity, and a connection with nature. Whether it is a group activity, a family outing, or simply a day of fun in the park, these experiences contribute to healthy growth and happy memories. I was drawn to this image because it perfectly reflects the innocence, energy, and sense of adventure that define childhood. The natural lighting and candid composition create a warm atmosphere that reminds us of the simple joys found in everyday moments. Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts about your favorite childhood outdoor memories in the comments.

body.title: The step by step process of how to make a two pieces dress.
body.body:
# Hello needlework.

Happy and blissful needleworkmonday to you all and happy new month, how are you all fairing today and how was your weekend, hope everything goes perfectly fine, nice to meet you all again in this amazing needleworkmonday community, so I'm here to share with you all on the step by step process of how to make a two pieces dress.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeLyGUeddMv59KsCkfD8yfs3WXH6bpPuiXzPpaLhEhDc/1780900232745.jpg)

My best customer brought this beautiful Ankara fabric two weeks ago, I was about traveling to my village she told me it's a traditional marriage uniform and she needed pieces dress, two side rush shirt and a Palazzo's trouser, so I collected the fabric and keep, it's a beautiful and soft fabric.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaUTg4tJTxDCVZGbgSJJLhNgvJihE5mejsJh4BzSzS8pu/1780900320471.jpg)

So I came back so I to complete the remaining dress I kept, the marriage was on the last Saturday of May which was last month, so I started the cutting process, starting with the shirt.
I folded the fabric by two, so I took the full length of the shirt and I took the the shoulder divided by two, then I took her burst measurements divided by four and I took it down, so I also took the arm hold, and I cut it out then I cut out the back neck as well.
After cutting the back side out I quickly folded the fabric again by two and I placed the back side on it, I added 2 inches for the front buttons bending and cut out the neck part and the body too.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaU8GosvYeMnj8mjqKioC9uLB5B6UPbyHhaiWGCDpfqx/1780900418149.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVukk4ksbAzy6paYKrp5Nu3gyCzvnxnDEYz58tHU2S4s/1780900418337.jpg)

I quickly moved ahead to the trouser's cutting, I folded the fabric by two I drafted the full length and the flab length, so I divided the waste by four and I added an extra 4 inches for the elastic gathers, so I then  took what I have at the waste for the flap length and I divided the lap measurements by two and I added an extra 1.5 inches for the crutch extension so I took from the crutch extension down so the palazzo will be very free as desires.
Finishing with the front cutting I then placed it on the remaining fabric on fold, I then go up by 2.5 for the back waste, I added 2 inches for the waste part and 4 inches for the back crutch extension, so I added 2 inches for the back body part, then I cut it out.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY16Tnsy4U6rqkVdSY9cHdUVC5ju7DXZSvVmVqMCW1Ac7/1780900563664.jpg)

Finishing with all the cutting I now start with the trouser's sewing, I put the two side front slant pocket and joined the back and the front side flap then I joined the front and the back together and quickly  joined the crutch extension too.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPisDxvVuDdMTeHRW7yaZY6fVYXBPn5gDNXPQ2ueypN3a/1780900731830.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY8rTWXw9hZveDVpWfWPhWvZVPNUDoppzZP6dZ4b4wGBf/1780900731966.jpg)

So I cut out the waste band and iron it probably then I stitched and top stitched it carefully so I kept a small space for the elastic trap then I used the safety pin and insect the elastic on it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9YFPKJsdMfcgVy7hTYS776bNoe4s9a5HDkPFPDSScWH/1780900805971.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZQrJHY3NQJ4aGt6ZxZCUzWEVfB6mmTGQ3dDAAUca9S7/1780907040994.jpg)

So I'm quickly done with the trouser and start sewing the shirt, I iron the button's bending carefully and top stitched the both side, then I joined the body then I cut out the two sides sleeves and bend the down hem then i joined together.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNWwU8CrbgavReFBixMu2ZbLT3cnUsaTkKjP4GNnoSgvb/1780906419510.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYWP7BDgsRGK8NycYfpQ71Y9o4TKbt4As5FkoGCzRyUaR/1780906419688.jpg)

And I also cut out the collar and fixed it probably then I bend the down hem and the side rush trap then i cut the four pieces of roop and stitched them properly then i used a safety pin and insect them very well.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4tuJ2i1dTUQ6LhjyUHCKMqL2Z1H8uzMs7eGEDHFSuou/1780906810721.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJiJ1ymRC1TRD3gZ43GDMAEctNKLLbYWBtLxYE2KehY9/1780906810892.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdVAK4GKqUZvUugP9Y6cyzR8JwDd3Nd7y5pscAALmh8r/1780906811034.jpg)


**Here is outcome of the two pieces.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZA6WsyhC9HZy8xzz2nrYnBKG45cFS1GSyh7savxMGaD4/1780906525709.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAbJd4ACe2CaB2E6pWrDwzaMk3B6jytF6EEc7xSHNSYV/1780906525902.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZpJZKj7zco2NjM4BDwwRbJ1TxPod7DefDEvXvrvDBHzN/1780906526025.jpg)

The outcome is so beautiful and nice, i was so excited that i was able to deliver in time because there was a lots of work to finish and deliver, well, somenof them was so simple but i tried my nest to finished them, my client was so excited too, although she brought the fabric earlier, thank to her for understanding, she love the dress and it look really njce on her, hope tou like it.

body.title: The beauty of a relationship
body.body:
My city keeps reminding me of Japan in ways more then I can imagine. These days wherever I am going I am finding Japanese themes. Yesterday I was meeting a friend for lunch at the mall. To my surprise the mall also had a decor with Japanese theme. Me and my friend had a hearty laugh over it, she was telling me, looks like the Universe wants you to visit the place again. The restaurant we visited, it's not a Japanese cuisine restaurant but even their decor was of the same theme with red lanterns. Looks like Japan is too much in the air in Mumbai city and everyone is heavily influenced by the beauty and culture of this country. 

It was a nice cozy afternoon catching up with my friend after almost 5 months. It is our ritual whenever I am in town to have a couple of meals together. We have known each other for more then 20 years now, so the bond is strong and it's no more just friends, it's like family. Always there by each other's side. It's beautiful to have such relationships in life, and I am blessed, because most of my friends come a long way with me. 

Life will never be the same if my girls are not present in them, so they mean a lot to me. We have huge age gaps but we think alike and there are no gaps in our mind and heart which is the beauty of our relationship. And it's not like we get to meet often, it is twice or thrice in a year, but still the bond remains strong. Good friendship does not need daily contact, it's about even if you meet after years, you should be able to catch up from where you left without any complaints and grudges. That's what true friendship is all about.

Clicked some pictures at the mall, you can see the theme in the decor.

body.title: Campomanesia Plant flower
body.body:
Hi friends, how are you all, I hope you are well and I wish you good health. Like every Sunday, today I am sharing a post which is Monday. Today I am sharing a fruit-like flower in a natural environment that I found very beautiful to see and I enjoyed the beauty of this flower. Because I liked it, I took a few pictures with my own mobile and today I am sharing those pictures with my friends. The name of this beautiful flower is Campomanesia Plant flower and it looks very beautiful. This flower is very familiar to me and this flower plant is cultivated in our country. The few pictures I took of this flower are presented in stages.



![20260528_104557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anisurdalim7/23uQnRQgYwbZkhTWzuo7byBhY2H4oLNNsVj5UZpCkncDgcuSXSc5A7kZSR86vLe7RmS4Y.jpg)

![20260528_104555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anisurdalim7/48Qu36PERk2ZmxEpuW8qaMVuXKwFqWSShdrR9kZ523ADNapu45qkBHYNHBWJhDJkEH.jpg)

![20260528_104602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anisurdalim7/23u62oeFVeCoobJ2hrCN93pTEf3hRGe4yUaa9xsQ8oVTS7kVu8HBpMrhvykbneHyQHe3T.jpg)

I went to my village house a few days ago and we have a garden there and in that garden there is a guava tree and I liked the beautiful flowers in that tree and I took those pictures with my own mobile and I am sharing them today. I saw two flowers together in the tree and to me both flowers looked very beautiful. It is a fruit type flower and the fruit that comes from this flower is very tasty and nutritious. But there is natural beauty in this flower. There is no fragrance in this flower but there is natural beauty which I felt myself.









![20260528_104628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anisurdalim7/23uQpVyHH4D9kcwsivwv1ZPDxp4w729NFdHUC682uiZbTtNxDd2Pq6tGuPVkn61ub8mqX.jpg)

Flowers are the worshipers of beauty and flowers play an effective role in expressing the feelings and joy of any human being. People like to open their eyes only to enjoy beauty and flowers can brighten the mind of any human being by displaying their beauty and can give happiness to people. I personally enjoyed the beauty of these flowers and I liked them. These flowers are usually white in shape and look quite beautiful. These flower plants are most commonly seen in our village area. However, I am sharing some of the pictures I took with the Hive community friends. Thank you to all friends.

body.title: Comensando la semana con fideo y churrascon de carne de resºººººStarting the week with noodles and beef brisket
body.body:
Hola a todos, la verdad amigos es de estrañarce la carne de res cuando llega el dia domingo, como lo que me paso, bueno, lo que pasa es que este que paso concidere mas importante disfrutar un poco de las nuevas novedades de flores en mi jardin, como lo han podido leer en mi post, las cuales son las nuevas adquisiciones y que son unas maravillas, bueno referente a la comida, para este almuerzo prepare unos churrascos de carne de res, cortados bien finos, porque de esa manera son mas faciles de cocinar, acompañados con fideo, los cuales los tenia frizados, al llevarlos al microhondas quedan como se ve en esta fotografia.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EoEqXZgPGbMWFqxiRSy2etWkZGqQs5Bi5qug8aEVkzzcCytFXioWWwJ5hefjmTFdour.png)

La verdad que ni siquiera pierden el gusto, ademas le agregue un poco de queso rallado para darle mas sabor, luego de revolverlos muy despacio para que no se hagan un masacote y asi poder acompañar la carne de res.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wX1EyYeyuFHAUiocvdxpPKGCwM32iMctPEjyF2v7GFZYtQh4rF9QFQ1iZnsvnq5WJZw.png)

Hablando de carne de res la misma se trata de churrascos de cuadril, cortados muy finos, como bien dije es mas facil de cocinarlos, porque es darle vuelta y vuelta, de esa forma salen mas jugosos y con el fideo sale todomuy sabroso.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN BUEN COMIENZO DE SEMANA.

ENGLISH

Hello everyone, the truth is, friends, it's hard to miss beef when Sunday comes, like what happened to me. Well, what happened is that this time I considered it more important to enjoy a bit of the new flower updates in my garden, as you might have read in my post, which are the new acquisitions and they are wonderful. Well, regarding the food, for this lunch I prepared some beef steaks, cut very thin, because that way they are easier to cook, accompanied with noodles, which I had frozen, and when heated in the microwave, they turn out as seen in this photograph.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EoEqXZgPGbMWFqxiRSy2etWkZGqQs5Bi5qug8aEVkzzcCytFXioWWwJ5hefjm

The truth is they don't even lose their flavor, plus I added a bit of grated cheese to give it more taste, then I stirred them very slowly so they wouldn't turn into a mush and could accompany the beef.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wX1EyYeyuFHAUiocvdxpPKGCwM32iMctPEjyF2v7GFZYtQh4rF9QFQ

Speaking of beef, it consists of very thinly sliced flank steaks, as I mentioned, it's easier to cook them because you just flip them over, that way they come out juicier, and with the noodles, everything turns out very tasty.

Thank you very much for following and reading me, have a great start to the week.
