body.title: All Good Things... (Must Come to an End?)
body.body: The old truism says that *\

*

I often wonder about that... it has definitely held true, in my own life... and these days it seems like more than a few people are pondering this, in relation to our Hive Community.

![0041-Rainbow.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/244UqrwekHFLA2FbwGHiDzSoDKcUYnw38rrAoK1dKKNjdmTmcckSPkMykCQvSwhhBjDiB.jpg)
*What is at the end of YOUR rainbow?*

I've often thought the *\
* truism was a bit odd in the sense that *bad* things seem more likely to drag on for an eternity. I guess we just can't have *\

*

Of course, where you have light, you will typically also find darkness.

The funny/sad thing about *\
* seems to be that as soon as they manifest, *everybody* wants to get on the bandwagon... and as soon as that happens, it's that very action that marks the beginning of the demise. Many *\

* can only remain good when there's a limited audience.\n\nEven consider that amazing local hamburger place... as soon as it gets noticed and rapidly expands to multiple locations the quality that made it *\
* often goes out the window, and the *\

* comes to an end.

![0886-Cilantro.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EoK7DBVR5TsZQidk3xNZ95F3EVq3YUEP66Hz8uBf979zNJ4nT9qXCCBbrn2zEPM38UD.JPG)

It's certainly not something specific to Hive — although, let it be said that I'm not entirely sure Hive is about to meet with its demise — it's something I have experienced with *all* good things in my life, without fail. 

We typically have no say, and no control, in the matter. My original art gallery primarily failed because a 24-month highway construction project made it all but inaccessible. The best job I ever had ended because the founding brothers of the company ended up suing each other and the company went bankrupt. My beach combing business died because someone watched me, noticed I was making money, and then *everybody* wanted a slice of the pie... till the pie was completely gone. My paper collectibles business was made redundant by the online era, and my the fact that my customer base basically *\

*. 

That's not a litany of complaints, it's simply the *facts.*

Perhaps the assertion that *bad* things seem to last forever is a bit of an overstatement, but — on the balance — heavy periods seem to have outweighed good periods by a factor of about 3-to-1. 

![0115-RedPoppy.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23x1HtiVj3h4Ean3q5D8j2XinfLan2pcdD4mbXu31sRpnUm6zwZnKVGyrgw2nswgzjLfT.jpg)

Perhaps what makes it all feel so exhausting — *on a personal level* — is the fact that I have the sort of personality that would just as well have everything be *unspectacularly constant* rather than a wild rollercoaster ride... even though that is not really how the world of 2026 operates.

Thanks for stopping by, and have a great week ahead!

#
Holozing Curation Compilation #452

**Welcome to this issue of Holozing Curation Compilation!**

Hello everyone! This is our curation effort that aims to curate posts that are shared in the Holozing community. These posts highlighted are the finest content that our Holozing curators submit for curation. We also encourage you to visit these blogs and show these great Holozingers your support and encouragement. Engagement is what makes the community thrive, so we hope that you are taking the time to visit each other's posts.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wWnbxHa7UXLedjPeCZB7KxgHLTQsRa58xhDtUizsyyYtbFzBE9Tk6YqabvU6wf2J5hW.png

![1000058464.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/solumviz/48J9jrU6YbLgXL9G5JnVVgYJa3vovsdKsgge9GignokAf9ySAK3ox4SH2RaY5AhbgC.jpg)

>Holozing/ Female Light Healer > I’ve drawn the female Ocean and Forest healer before so now it was time to draw the female light healer. I really liked working on this portrait of the light healer because I used several colors for painting her face, colors that I usually don’t use when I work on skin. I designed some cool accessories that would fit her. In the end, I drew lots of more hair strands to make her hair look more realistic and then worked on the lighting...
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wWnbxHa7UXLedjPeCZB7KxgHLTQsRa58xhDtUizsyyYtbFzBE9Tk6YqabvU6wf2J5hW.png
Author: @hiddenshadows Curator: @solumviz
![1000058463.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/solumviz/AJhUjm8xexaqCzu77ePt9qabujia8L5FLtxrjpJ53ntnB64fboPVmQifkPnU6rG.jpg)

>Sculpting - Light Healer Knuckle Ring > I'm here with another version of light healer inspired knuckle ring and I do hope you like this version too. I think I'm falling in love with sharp surfaces and won't really be working with rounded and smoother surfaces for the meantime, what do you think? Leaving those sharp edges gives my model a little bit of realism...
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wWnbxHa7UXLedjPeCZB7KxgHLTQsRa58xhDtUizsyyYtbFzBE9Tk6YqabvU6wf2J5hW.png
Author: @manuel2395 Curator: @solumviz
![1000058465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/solumviz/AKYH5PZA61cSnsbyzaJDrtpxFejYwz5wZ1Y922TwZcB4j1ETBduhP9dsEytM4FB.jpg)

>Holozing Fan Art | A Stunning Chirpily Radiant, in a hybrid version 🦜 > Basically, my idea this time for (Chirpily) was to adapt it to a hybrid style between animal and human. What I came up with was to draw the character with a strong physical resemblance to the Ocean Healer, with a slender build and straight, slightly longer hair. I worked on the skin using light brown tones I had saved in my own color palette. I began to create a bit of subtle volume with the airbrush and to define some highlights and shadows with the watercolor brush, which also makes it easier for me to blend and soften the strokes...
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wWnbxHa7UXLedjPeCZB7KxgHLTQsRa58xhDtUizsyyYtbFzBE9Tk6YqabvU6wf2J5hW.png

body.title: Obsidian is incredible and everyone should use it
body.body:
I came across this software as a solution to my note taking, something I didn't really do and so didn't really need a solution to. But I like to try new things and, well, it has certainly taken over large parts of my life. So it's a note taking program/app. That's it. # OR IS IT? It's also a LOT of gimmicks. Its most powerful concept is the existence of *community plugins*, where nerdy people have exceptional power to make it into almost anything in the world. Currently, I'm using it for a whole number of things I never did before, but now wouldn't want to continue without: ### Diary
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23uQg8fUsSykXCTMmq1EKMvwQqTDrUvMcb8p6AcNuYEvkTaVSbRsPh1Cm9dZFdfaK9E9E.png
Sometimes I have a lot to say and nobody to say it to, and I'm not about to start seeking an AI best friend. So I write them down. This is way more powerful than the most basic sounding thing I've just described it as, later. ### Music business ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23tcGBtP72mfRbjW4Vv3nsGEFREJGKgcRxohcbx3pKst99VGGKd25Qc4Qv4rS3sewPg2C.png) Over the last year or so I've been logging my actual music theory classes from my day job onto Obsidian, and creating my own curriculum from Beginner to Advanced. This includes images and audio examples, but also walls of text which, although great for me personally, I can see would not be conducive to actual learning if I were to sell it as teaching materials or something. More on *that* later too. ### A Music Theory Canvas Here was an idea I've since abandoned (For reasons I'll bring up later) that forms a kind of summary of the concepts in flowcharts which hyperlink to those lessons as needed. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/48Hh78Typ9KhNSghwu4vpaXakEbMUKEQBpX7iU6iW5WppHZGfHAFYqg2kWdDnvVziQ.png) #
Then, something happened.
It was great that I had all my ideas down somewhere so that I can call back on them forever, never needing a new idea henceforth. But with this background idea of turning into products I could sell, it just wasn't cutting it in terms of quality and design. I mean, it's a note-taking app. I thought, conceptually, you could sell the entire *vault* as a complete product for students or teachers to use on Obsidian, which is possible and people do that with various things - a popular thing people do is transform Obsidian into a D&D campaign thing. It's pretty intense. But you'd have to change the designs, install the plugins and set everything up exactly the same if it's to go smoothly, and I didn't like that. But then I saw one particular community plugin: **Excalidraw** Suddenly, my shitty canvas page and my overly-dull music theory pages could come together as an *art*. Now, I could connect my Wacom... drawing pad thingy, and draw my ideas and lessons out. And it works So. Damn. Well. My handwriting is abysmal, my drawings are worse, but this Excalidraw fixes it all. Here's the first attempt at making a little poster about the Piano's keyboard, using a screenshot from my Musescore Notation software: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23xLLDdub4GQnApJ6a3V7V65cz9d2WbKxcb3WoatQBTrekQu9WHeUMBxKvwx9Zujkiku6.png) Most of the first round of creations had screenshots from the notation software; scales, notes, clefs, whatever. I just found it wholly unsatisfying. Then it occurred to me I can just... create my own IP and draw out my own keyboards and notes. This is advantageous in so many ways. Not only have you got your own style, but you can then rapidly edit every individual facet at any time to match the occasion. They're also of infinite quality compared to screenshots. I went with a scruffy hand-drawn approach which matched my terrible handwriting: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23wgmQySBtz7LkfhjejuvzgoCCJkL8v2YJcu2vDX3Ps4z5vcLTozUZYdArdDFHzmrswEE.png) Here's another example of screenshots turning into my own style:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23uRHrtGXdTbnZ2HkigjuyfL1EZ1LFxfgA6aAHWnWXTKS5HvUQU64STdzyMs21SVspGA9.png
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23sxmq7RqoWVhnxbHBe1h6xbKrEQRinZKRxuV2tbkeqsXLwebLrVrqoyiysaaWDSapmVi.png
Infinitely better! And, if you zoom in, you'll see I scribbled all the notes and the staff lines have a kind of sketch roughness to them: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23tmjaeVLM6BTmR7Jww1Ro99n2xUuMc6iyG5yjUFi4f6yAyAbQjsue5Kgk1T5Ysv45kVK.png) What if I want to change the piano to, say, red keys for some reason? Takes 2 seconds. Zoomed in you can really appreciate the sketchy style: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/EpXPJrpXybe49vRiyRepXazRhs48kSU87p2dLXbQzs16t85eRQrtAMUMoykuByy88Ep.png) One cool thing I only just realised is that you can add your creations into a library, and just pull them up whenever you want in the future, edit accordingly:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23u6WhHXGGEjodm9TDZZ8Vu1EywsyeWeQ8qcYWgfiGoSFepaKpcsWWbT5GULZoFJQDnLf.png)
So far I have five lessons, all of which are still in the kind of blueprint stage, since I'm entirely new to this digital drawing stuff. But it's all just ready-made content I'm converting from text pages in Obsidian to images in Obsidian. Honestly I've almost forgotten about the reason for doing this, to sell a product. I just seem to be doing it because It's fun. #
Ok, what else do I have on here...
### A recipe book of my favourite home cooked successes ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23wr3GUxzpQigeECPAHHw1Ctg2ShzkhG3w6qvjVjVAcM2zzCHW6zSGDmzCEBiRYUFAuP6.png) ### A little digital recreation of my cats
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23yd9qLrgJ4tntwwt4etrqPwTE2YvhJbAjPFB6QF5QXQUDnxMZE6ZD15LPk725qvMocT3.png)
Because why not? You can play with a stick or throw balls, and it's kinda funny because my cats favourite toy above everything else - in fact, nothing else is remotely interesting - is these bright fluffy balls of these exact colours. They get lost under the sofa, so I replace them, and then one day I move the sofa and then 50 of them start getting re-discovered. This picture is pretty much my actual life but with a nicer house I'll never afford. ### A representation of my note-taken brain thus far ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23tHZEJJQiT1ry4PEDJHxN4FddTNb4SZy92PGQdV7FZiU34gmnYMreTxVJswmJVs9GzRg.png) I'm not sure that has any practical use but it does help you just sit back and see how everything is connected. For example, you can see in the middle there a bunch of the musical lessons are connected with keywords and topics: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23t8AS6y9cbd2rGEiZXDU4Uc5Y1bkajye3QapxSWEWx92NLXD7mEL9cziiZ6Xv9RUmTCk.png) and if I show every attachment and beyond, it starts to look like my own brain planet: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23tmjDQHxEiJ68e3GZKWtSbjhXjmbCz3sdhGd6mEc258RvsDyVsMk7MVDk9CurEt2EurQ.png) # AND THEN SOMETHING ELSE HAPPENED *AI happened. * Now, I don't trust or like AI, but I do use it. You have to keep up with the times. I mostly use to fact check or *google* things that are too complicated to actually google like 'You know that song that goes like doo doo doo, but has that section that really kicks ass?' - AI can generally fill that void for me. But my concern was always that I'm basically selling myself off to these big companies whose agreements tend to say things like they'll keep your data for a minimum of 5 years and have complete and total rights to access it whenever they please. Obsidian, like PewDiePie, has solved this and created an admittedly slow solution by having an AI that runs entirely locally, no WIFI even needed. Nothing gets out if you don't want it to. I now have AI implemented into my app, privately, and can use it to discuss, review, suggest and summarise all of my vaults, or whatever else people use AI for, in the context of my own little brain world here. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23tcJE3JV6ncsYvP6GY4j5M2HdN3Nq4fFkPPVGZnCqRgK5E2LQyy7YnLyMeNEQJscTuCd.png) It's slow and obviously not as polished as some multi-trillion dollar corporate, commercial AI engine, but it does as much as I'd ever need it to. Also, faster computers and different AI models will yield different results. I'm just on a laptop so you can't expect all that much. # Health Tracking I got annoyed at Samsung's app. It's great I guess, can calorie track and it'll chart progress in weight loss etc. But on a phone it's just a bit lame; you can't see the entire chart over time. So I got a Chart-making plugin and inputted some of the data from my Smart Ring since January to now, as well as my Bench Press progress and voila: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23wMyoHaRb1z622Uu6kFSgzEo81t7oJ32mRy2FYH9M4ohKE1GdPghoxgF4kkzkD6mAxCq.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/48PxfiAMyrhSo4uKNiCbREyhj3hgqaSfw4kJbfh9We7F6G55386hg1FvnpVgycenwX.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/EoeLhrgKchmHgkeCUbFq7gT8fxTAX1acsh8vrpTfVLV17AVPPB7iFmUusbWd8bUJsTa.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23uRHw6uXZv1UayBP92EFTVMWHfHcPUxcNmzC5BGm4WW141YzuCoDzVdWHCAUsFXAU9PD.png) # Scratching the Surface Like I said, some people use this for TTRPG Campaigning and more. I'll probably start using it for language learning when I get time to set that up, but people use it for writing books & lore, PDF annotation, website building, basically anything. I have barely even delved into the depths that exist. Here's some examples online, and you can see how many different themes exist out there (You can make your own too): ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23xyVLz7Kt6r1qsQxmVBMcV4tx3q1g77zsCaNbP2LvS8bpExFcLPVwpQRPpGLESY7EACR.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23wByEVX3bVm2rgcx4wZFXeP5f3XYPRDBDcMbs4m9wZb9bDhjY5m4W7RX92V77xyBCHps.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mobbs/23wCb1BHKSrYAafhi2cEzQ59pTqFt8yHtHMNAstMgq6cjqpoS4LSNLuqsE1mtLMk8hQgK.png) I dunno it just makes me so much more productive with my time. Everyone should give it a go! #Notsponsored)

body.title: They Give Me Joy I Never Imagine
body.body:
Seriously, the last time I watched a BTS music video, I felt like I had it all figured out. Their energy, their smiles, their personalities, it is impossible not to feel lighter after watching them.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQUFzkKRVmQt2dVdWofEFSJtWMF12LuuQ3NEFz3oqEGwt/1000227918.jpg
  

Then I watched a BLACKPINK video, and wow… I can’t even explain the joy it gave me. There is something about the way they move, the way they own the screen, that just makes me smile. And honestly, sometimes I don’t even know why.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPDJ8gzGBC614Crx4pY7cKgDwVzC2R8nNBsCKWDcU9d9n/1000227919.jpg

I’ve been into K-pop for a while, but I never thought a music video could have this kind of effect. It is more than the songs or the choreography. Watching them actually heals. It feels like a little pause button for my brain, the stress melts away, worries fade, and suddenly, I just feel happy after a moody day.

BTS has this warmth that feels so personal. Their videos are full of laughter, playful gestures, and moments that feel real. Even with perfect choreography, there is always room for a silly face, a wink, or a random move that makes me grin. Watching them is like spending time with friends who just get you.

BLACKPINK, though… they hit joy differently. Their videos are bold, stylish, and full of energy, but underneath all that shine, there is this spark that makes you smile without thinking. Lisa’s energy, Jennie’s charm, Rosé’s emotion, Jisoo’s presence, it all hits at once. I catch myself smiling mid-video and think, “I don’t even know why, but I’m happy.”

Now I realize watching these videos is like medicine for my mind. BTS brings warmth, BLACKPINK brings fierce joy, and both reset me in ways I didn’t expect. K-pop has always been more than music for me, but now I understand, it’s a little burst of happiness, right when I need it.

So yeah, I don’t know why it works, but it does. BTS and BLACKPINK aren’t just music, they are experiences that leave me smiling, sometimes for no reason at all. And honestly? That’s something I didn’t know I needed.

*All images are screenshots*



**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/they-give-me-joy-i-never-imagine--6c5)

午后，我们溜达进一家精品屋，坐落于坊巷分叉路的中段，虽说之前也来过几次，不过这次来发现变化还是挺大的，最主要的变化之一就是老板完全放手当了撒手掌柜了，店内的摆着精致物件，啥都有，mini木质小猫咪，还有小不点可爱鸭，以及小屁点大黄金豆子。。

当然，这里的黄金豆，肯定是真金，制作成一颗颗小元宝的黄金豆，装在一小玻璃瓶内，为了好的寓意“发财豆”“发财瓶”，价格倒也实惠一瓶才5元，能看出来销量还是不错的。

毕竟，走在我们前面的两个人，她们各买了瓶小发财瓶，OK，重点来了哈，店内的所有物品销售，全靠客人自觉扫码消费哦，老板不在，也没有工作人员招呼你。

扫码提示会贴在店内各处显眼的位置，当然，也有提醒说店内有实时监控，劝解某些伸手党，不要乱来，，寻思着老板虽然不在店里吧，但他能通过实时监控看到店内所发生一切啊，哈哈，也就是你的一举一动都在我眼皮子底下，别乱来哦。

店内各种小玩意还挺吸引人，大多数都小巧玲珑为主，也有福州各大景点的冰箱贴，还有各种美好祝福的小相框以及钥匙扣，价格基本上单件都在20元以内就能搞定。。

逛个小店也花了我们30分钟左右时间，小姐妹说要喝奶茶，我们又往东街方向走去，也有许久没喝陈文鼎家珍珠奶茶了，确实想念那醇厚口感，这夏日里，那必须是来冰镇的珍珠奶茶，3分糖就够，全糖的那简直是齁甜。。我之前甚至点过无糖的口味珍珠奶茶，也觉得能接受，因为那珍珠本身就有甜味，加上牛奶本身也有自带甜味，OK的。

今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福周一愉快，喜乐平安。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

body.title: A Day in The Life of A MUA.
body.body:
My day started in a rush. I had a bride to attend to, and I needed to be at the hotel early to get her ready for her wedding.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtH6SX5TrQhgMCEdFf6FQ8zVs6guFUMQuhViAYu4qEN2/1780906096265.jpg)


I woke up at 4:45 a.m., got dressed, and was ready by 5:00 a.m. However, it was still quite dark outside, so I waited until 5:25 a.m. before leaving home.




I arrived at the hotel by 6:15 a.m. and met the hairstylist already working on the bride's hair. While she handled the hair, I focused on the bridal train and successfully completed makeup for all six bridesmaids.



By 10:30 a.m., I was done and started packing up.
That's  when it  hit me—I hadn't taken a single picture of my work! I had been so focused on the job and working against time that documenting the process completely slipped my mind.



I stood for almost five straight hours without sitting down. Surprisingly, I didn't feel the strain until the work was finished. That's when the tiredness and body aches decided to show up.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDWTVSwwK9kXeHNHT1wZKc7SBg7ZoFT3o4WrJMgyM5wN/1780906151273.jpg)


I got home and immediately got dressed for service by 1:35pm. Sitting there, I could feel my bones crying in pains, I was feeling sleepy, feeling so tired and just be present based on determination.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV5m38C7a9zJQ7EJZR7kSpZ9q3rj76TETixVx4zXZQMMt/1780906263566.jpg)


Still, as exhausting as it was, I'm grateful. It was a productive weekend, a successful job.
And a reminder that sometimes we can be so busy that we forget to capture the moment.

body.title: Just be kind =/= Sei einfach mal nett 🌞🌈💖 ENG-GER
body.body: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/AL35dn8a7GSfPSAv2B7ijnuJMT85rD7TneAZbWuHQHjUBtFxzPyBnCfYHR3LaEu.png) ### **“In a world where you can be anything, be kind.”** We’ve heard this phrase many times and forgotten it just as quickly—until it suddenly sticks with us a little longer. Perhaps because it’s so simple. And also because, in its simplicity, it touches on something that often gets lost in the hustle and bustle of everyday life. In a world full of possibilities, full of paths and wrong turns, full of expectations and decisions, and also full of mistakes, it reminds us that kindness doesn’t need a grand stage. It’s in the small things that its meaning becomes clear: a brief moment of patience, a kind word, a smile at just the right time. None of this is spectacular; none of it changes the world instantly—and yet, for a single person, it can be exactly the right gesture they need at that very moment. Perhaps that is the true essence of this phrase: not the big picture, but the many small decisions we have to make every day, all the time. Being friendly and kind doesn’t mean always giving in or forgetting about yourself. Rather, it means acting consciously—with respect, with attentiveness, and with the knowledge that other people too have their own battles to fight. In the end, perhaps that is exactly what makes these words so timeless: it doesn’t ask for anything impossible. It simply reminds us that, with all the possibilities we have, we should always be kind and considerate, and offer our fellow people a little smile every now and then. So what are we waiting for? Let’s get started right away... You see, actually it could be so simple. There is great support level on Bitcoin price chart. 200-Week moving average was great support on Bitcoin price chart. It supported Bitcoin price after market crash. Bitcoin price went down from 80K to 60K. There is 200-Day moving average on 80K USD level. This is why Bitcoin price reversed down from this level. 200-x moving average is important resistance and support level on Bitcoin price chart.

Here you can see weekly chart of Bitcoin price. We have seen same scenario as before. Bitcoin price broke down 200-week average before. It was consolidation time for Bitcoin price chart. We may see breaking down 200-week moving average again.

Bitcoin price will go down for a few weeks. We need to see bottom on these major indicator before reverse up.

body.title: HIGADO FILETEADO Y ARROZ-----SLICED LIVER AND RICE
body.body:
Buenos dias a todos los que componen este grandiosa plataforma social de HIVE, en la que con libertad nos sentimos en escribir y dejar una poco de nuestra historia, referente al tema que se nos venga en mente, mas cuando de comida se trata se me hace mas facil, porque asi puedo estar compartiendo con todos ustedes un poco de mis, como en esta ocacion en donde prepare para el almuerzo higado el cual lo corte en filetes pequeños y para cocinarlo, agregue en la holla un poco de aceite, luego cebolla cortada bien fina, ajo y la carne antes mencionada, la cual la se le da vuelta y vuelta mesclandola bien y una ves bien cocinada ya esta.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/EogLr3imygTAP65vPFqDfnPMdo5VUZ4c3mCvR55kfgPv6aMxqfw2ciBmQyHTpS3ULqY.png)

El arroz, en cambio para cocinarlo se agrega una olla con agua en la hornalla de la cocina, cuando la mis a comienza su hervor, le vamos agregando el arroz y revolviendo muy despacio, luego le agregamos un poco de asafran y asi una ves cocinado queda como lo vemos en la foto, la verdad todo muy rico.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning to everyone who makes up this wonderful social platform of HIVE, where we feel free to write and leave a bit of our history, on any topic that comes to mind, but when it comes to food, it becomes easier for me, because this way I can share a bit of mine with all of you, like this time when I prepared liver for lunch, which I cut into small filets and to cook it, I added a bit of oil to the pot, then finely chopped onion, garlic, and the aforementioned meat, which I turned and mixed well, and once well cooked, it was done.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/EogLr3imygTAP65vPFqDfnPMdo5VUZ4c3mCvR55kfgPv6aMxqfw2ciBmQyHT

The rice, on the other hand, is cooked by adding a pot of water to the stove, and when it starts to boil, we add the rice and stir it very slowly. Then we add a bit of saffron, and once it's cooked, it looks like what we see in the picture. Honestly, everything is very delicious.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

body.title: The Simple Magic of Childhood (A Reflection on a Pexels Find)
body.body:
![pexels-antonius-ferret-5274620~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSaR94CFHuChYiYyjpdcAozQMtKgnMGskQtDMaABdcDbb/pexels-antonius-ferret-5274620~2.jpg)
<center>*(Image Source: Pexels)*</center>
While browsing through Pexels today, I stumbled upon this beautiful photograph, and it instantly made me pause. There is something incredibly powerful about a child completely lost in their own world of imagination, turning a plain pavement into a canvas with just a piece of chalk.
In a world dominated by screens, algorithms, and flashing digital toys, this image served as a gentle reminder of what pure creativity looks like.
### What This Image Reminded Me Of
Looking at this captured moment brought a few distinct reflections to mind:
 * **The Power of Presence:** Children have a superpower that adults often lose—the ability to be 100% present. This child isn't worried about tomorrow; they are entirely invested in the sun they are drawing *right now*.
 * **Simplicity is Everything:** You don’t need expensive gadgets to spark joy. A simple, budget-friendly box of sidewalk chalk is enough to unlock a child's entire universe.
 * **Creating Your Own Sunshine:** Literally and metaphorically, if the world feels a bit gray, children will sit down and draw their own sun on the ground.
> *\

* — Christopher Moore
> 
### Over to the Community...
Finding this photo made me incredibly nostalgic for the days when my biggest daily decision was choosing between the pink or the yellow chalk.
 * **What simple childhood activities did you use to lose yourself in for hours?**
 * **Do you think modern children are missing out on these screen-free, simple pleasures, or are they just finding them in different ways?**
I’d love to read your thoughts and reminiscences in the comments below!

body.title: Trying to get involved in Deadwood (series) but it's not easy
body.body: Deadwood is one of those shows that a lot of people will tell you is absolutely amazing and one of those \

sorts of things. I have tried in the past on several occasions to get into it and failed. I have at one point or another owned a DVD set of the first season and it appealed to me so little that I don't even know what happened to them. I must have loaned them out to someone else and then forgot about them and I wasn't concerned enough about it to figure out where they went. Whoever borrowed those from me and didn't return them, I hope you enjoyed it a great deal more than I did. Or maybe you ended up feeling the same way I did about it and that's why you too, probably forgot you even had them. Who knows. I started to watch this again because it has been on my group's server for quite some time and I am now at a point where I'm not really digging any of the new series and I am mostly watching Deadwood before I get back into House of the Dragon to refresh my memory before the new season drops later this month. Let's dig into what I think *Deadwood* kind of suffers from, and how I think I will most likely fail yet again at trying to watch it this time around as well.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23vsE573DN6VqhRXNPAHne5zuet6sgTvrhsm4sop9XNEayzxGm46zgcEpd4NWGjS8xms8.png) [src](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/MV5BMjE5MDc1MmUtZjE5Yy00ODI2LTk1M2EtODAwZTJmNWJiMTM0XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)
It's hard to imagine this and it makes me feel old but this much lauded series is more than 20 years old. Westerns are a tough sell in the entertainment marketplace but they managed to do so with this one and they probably ended up winning some awards because of it. Deadwood is set in the 1870's in South Dakota before the area had truly been governed. The area is presented as being rather lawless and there are no authority figures that are officials of the USA at the time. Society is run by whoever has the guts to try to rule and while it is a work of fiction, it is meant to be based at least to some degree on actual happenings during that time. I'm not going to look into the authenticity of these claims.
https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Deadwood_a_l.jpg?w=1440&h=810&crop=1 [src](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Deadwood_a_l.jpg?w=1440&h=810&crop=1)
Even if you haven't seen the show you probably recognize Ian McShane as one of the main characters. He is presented very early on as being a corrupt and rather evil leader of Deadwood, Al Swearengen. This much I know is true in that Al was a real person and was notorious for being cutthroat and business savvy. He keeps his friends close and his enemies closer and has his dirty little fingers in a lot of dirty pies. He will lie, cheat, steal, and murder his way to keeping his power and mostly he is quite reviled yet respected and feared by the residents of Deadwood. Much of what I have seen and can remember about having watched this show in the past revolves around him. Other characters come and go and there are some real historical figures that pop in that most people would at least recognize the names of such as Wild Bill Hickock and Wyatt Earp. The writers took a lot of liberty in writing their involvement in the city and it is understandable why they would have to do that because there isn't going to be a lot of records about a city that wasn't even governed for a long time. But let's get into what I like about this series and what I do not like.

Pro: Beautiful and authentic looking sets

https://stinkyipod.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/222225_9193257254_943_n.jpg [src](https://stinkyipod.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/222225_9193257254_943_n.jpg)
Rebuilding a city based on a couple of very blurry photographs and really old drawings of a city that had no law can't be easy and now you have to do it while attempting to make it look authentic to the time period in question all while doing so with modern actual equipment. This is a very tough thing to do in movies or shows and I have first-hand experience in how hard this can be and how there is a relative army of people that work only on ensuring that there are no accidental modern things like wrist-watches or Starbucks cups in any scene. I actively search for things like this but even when you check exhaustive lists online there are not many mistakes the likes of how there is an airplane flying overhead in *Troy* and the famous Starbucks coffee cup that appears in *Game of Thrones*. The dusty and old timey feel of the show is really well done and I would imagine that there was plenty of complaining going on by the people that were involved in the making of this series. I'll give credit where it is due and they did a fantastic job of this.

Con: The story moves alarmingly slow

https://static01.nyt.com/images/2016/01/09/arts/deadwood/deadwood-articleLarge.jpg?quality=75&auto=webp&disable=upscale [src](https://static01.nyt.com/images/2016/01/09/arts/deadwood/deadwood-articleLarge.jpg?quality=75&auto=webp&disable=upscale)
Shows can all be shootouts and explosions, this much I know. But in the case of *Deadwood* the first 4 episodes almost nothing happens at all. I have been told by people that love the show that you have to endure this, but then things get a lot better with plenty of surprises mixed in if you can tough it out until later. I'm currently really struggling to make this happen because I know that the slew of characters are so widespread that just a little bit of Instagramming while it is on is going to result in me missing some very crucial information that will be very important later on. I seriously struggle to say focused while watching this show and have to find other things to do in the same room like laundry or doing some sit ups or something like that to pass the time. Each episode is about an hour and multiple times I have pushed the button to see how much time is left and honestly, I sometimes just wish they would fucking get on with it already. There's 12 episode in each of the 3 seasons as well as a film that I have also not seen. I am very hopeful that it will \

soon and I am reminded how I initially gave up on *Game of Thrones* for the same reason but a friend basically begged me to continue. It now is one of my favorite series of all time so I am hopeful that *Deadwood* can somehow end up being the same.

Con: Super long intro

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jO0Ly9wB3V0 This intro has a nice song, and I enjoyed it the first 2 or 3 times I saw it but at nearly 2 minutes long I feel as though this really shouldn't have been that way. This is a true sign of the times though because it seems to me that only recently did people start to get so impatient. Perhaps a 2 minute intro was just normal back then, or a super long one, like this, was a sign of how great the production actually was. For me, the intro of *Breaking Bad* kind of flipped everything because that intro was just a few seconds long and to me, that was perfect. My setup doesn't allow me to automatically skip an intro so I often have to just guess whether or not I skipped too much. *Deadwood*'s first couple of minutes of every episode thus far has just been establishing shots, so up to now my trigger happy skipping of many minutes hasn't resulted in me ruining any crucial moments of the show, and this is probably just lucky.

Pro: Very good actors

https://beam-images.warnermediacdn.com/2025-07/wild-bill-hickok-1920.jpg?host=wbd-dotcom-drupal-prd-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com [src](https://beam-images.warnermediacdn.com/2025-07/wild-bill-hickok-1920.jpg?host=wbd-dotcom-drupal-prd-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com)
There are so many good actors in this show that no matter who they are focusing on, they are probably going to be putting on a very high level of performance. There are a few exceptions such as \

but her being annoying might have been intentional and actress Robin Weigert may have done such a good job that we were maybe meant to be annoyed by her.   

I mistakenly thought that the actor playing Wild Bill Hickok was Hugh Laurie from *House* but it is actually someone named Keith Carradine, who I am actually not very familiar with.   

Anyway, this series doesn't suffer from any bad acting.  They absolutely nailed that side of things, even with the few child actors and that is something I am normally very picky about.   

<hr> 

I am not one to really tolerate stories that move exceptionally slow.  I will admit that much like almost anyone else on planet Earth, the availability of internet all over the place has kind of drastically reduced my attention span.   

I'm going to stick this one out at least for the first season though.  Finally something really interesting happened with the death of a character that they had set up as being central and it kind of reminded me of when they offed Ned Stark in the first season of *Game of Thrones*.  I had not read the book at that point in my life yet, so that really caught me off guard.  The fact that they would do this so early on in *Deadwood* has me believing that there could be some wonderfully unpredictable things to come.   For that reason alone, I am going to keep going even though at least at 5 episodes in, I feel as though it is quite an accomplishment to just pay attention for an hour in a row.   

If you have watched *Deadwood* and enjoyed it, let me know in the comments below!

body.title: On the Hive blockchain we can all create our own story
body.body:
What is amazing about the Hive blockchain is that you can create your own story through the content you create, share, comment about and the interactions with the other users and communities. Everyone starts with a clean sheet and it is up to each of us to decide which path to take. Sometimes it us tempting to take shortcuts, but doing so we'll soon find out that it is not to way to grow in this ecosystem and probably we'll encounter some ethical barriers along the way and some voices will tell that's not the way to do it and that it is not fair to continue like this compared with the other participants to this ecosystem. It happened to me also few times, but I understood each stance on that and corrected my way of doing some things.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23wgL5gNkj81SNoEEfsgY2f3RiscpEkTt9JZA53nPQT22FtgPhgnrQHguGRgPbcniHmYB.png)

There isn't any hard book on how to interact or act in different situations and while experimenting we might cross the line one way or another. And if constructive feedback comes our way, we should be open to see other's points if view and find a solution for it. I always like to be also part of the solution and not only the problem and this mindset helped me navigate conflicts or divergent opinions. But I believe there is common ground everywhere, we just need to be willing and make the effort to find it and understand it. Sometimes we cannot but wonder if that's worth it, but in the end doing something is better that not doing it. Usually the energy you put in, should return back one way or the other.

Many of us, myself included, see the Hive blockchain as a revenue stream maybe even more than the reason it was build for: social media freedom through a decentralization and ownership of your data. By focusing on the earning angle it us easy to lose ourselves and seek shortcuts to get faster at the top. And this leads to mistakes, lower quality of content and shady actions. And time proved that doing that simply doesn't work and users and communities react sooner or later. And what has been yielded on a fast track usually stops together with a tainted reputation. And from there on, it is very hard to grow back and still get support from others.

The story that takes shape through our content, engagement and actions on the Hive blockchain, is representing us, us representing what we like, our passions, our frustrations, our goals and whatever we want to get out there in the open. And believe me that it is out there in the open, transparent and maybe even living in perpetuity. There is some kind of anonymity to it, but regardless if there is a mask or not put in front, behind it is us in a shape or another. We might have different faces, we might show to others only what we want or just a layer, but it is something that comes from within. So regardless if the story, good or bad, it exposes something from within or about us. It us our story and it us upon us how we want to write it.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23t7FUE1BUnSUt5ygXjj2MgytbrZHDvZ8mYysDsTYdhHPn4KFpbWX4SUxpupKnr6sdVSm.png

Sometimes going to origins and revisiting the purpose of why the Hive blockchain was created and its tumultuous cinematic history, we might rediscover some values and principles lost along the way. But if we take the time to contemplate at that, we will find out that it is upon us how and what story to tell. This empowerment alone gives true ownership, identity and control of the digital destiny in this ecosystem.

## So, what story do you want to tell on the Hive blockchain?

明天周二高考要占用我娃学校做考场，所以要放假一天，但是学校为了赶进度，这一天也是要用补课的形式偿还的，我记得我以前好像占用教室就直接放掉了，现在怎么还要补回来，不理解。

所以昨天周日他去上学，他还问我，你上班吗？我说不上。他问我，那下周二你放假吗？我说不放假，我办公室又不要做考场。他偷乐了一下，我猜他是想在家打游戏，我是你亲娘，你脑子里什么坏心思我还不知道吗？

反正我明个上班要把手机ipad电视遥控器全部带走，电子设备一件不留，你要么睡醒了来公司找我写作业，要么就在家自己看书玩点玩具，这二十来号就期末考了，还整天心思想着玩，也是无语了。对于自控能力差的娃只能用这个办法了，也是下下策，也是没招之举。

昨天早上本来想说让他自己去学校的，我闹钟响了实在起不来，生物钟告诉我是周日啊，所以一直清醒不了。后来想想还是送吧，不能偷懒，于是起床做早饭，去的时候我还以为记错时间了，因为周日的清晨马路上人车都好少啊。

我问娃，今天是真的上学吗？他说老师说了要上，我说怎么那么少人，那去了学校如果不上课你就自己坐公交车回来，哈哈哈。高考了都不让学生休息一下，害得我们上班的家长还要起早送去学校。

不过回来我差不多睡到中午，啥事不用想，不用惦记娃不用惦记上班不用做饭的感觉太美妙，躺了一天身心都舒畅了。

body.title: I thought I met the one.....
body.body:
Okay so let me take you back to summer.

You know those summers?
The ones where everything tastes like mango and salt, the sun doesn’t set until 9pm, and you randomly meet someone who just clicks.

That was him.

We met at a little beach spot. Nothing fancy.
He made me laugh until my stomach hurt. We went for late night ice cream, walked along the pier, talked about stupid stuff like favorite cartoons and whether aliens exist.
He remembered my coffee order. He held my hand like he meant it.
For a couple weeks, I actually thought:
Damn. Maybe I found him. Maybe I found the greatest guy to ever exist.

Yeah.
I was that girl.

---

Then school started.

First day. New semester.
I walk into class and there he is.
Same messy hair. Same smile he gave me when he said goodnight.

My heart did that stupid jump.
You know the one. Like a little kid on a trampoline.
I started thinking all that cheesy nonsense – fate, timing, universe brought us back together, the whole cringe movie script.

I literally planned how I’d walk up to him after class. Casual. Cool.
“Hey, stranger. Small world, right?”

---

Class ends.

I walk toward him, smiling.

And then she shows up.

His wife.

Daughter of the principal.

He saw me.
For half a second, I saw something in his eyes – like a flicker of the guy from summer.
Then it was gone.

He just… looked away.

Fake confusion. Like he didn’t know me at all.

She grabbed his arm. He followed her like a little trained dog.

---

Days passed. Weeks.

Every morning, he’d sit there and steal glances at me.
I could feel it.
Like he wanted to say something. Like deep down, the funny, wild, electric guy from the beach was still in there somewhere.

But he never said a word.

Not one.

And me?
I just watched him shrink, class after class.
That loud, bright, ridiculous summer boy?
Gone.

Replaced by someone quiet. Someone small.
A guy chained to a woman he clearly doesn’t love – but who probably pays his bills, or protects his future, or holds something over his head.

Honestly?
I don’t even feel sad anymore.

I’m just curious.
How do you go from fire to doormat that fast?


· \

Hello friends, it's me again after a while! How have you been?

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gen-quimba/23wCGUHNfnnmhiQYqF3KibUko1zpjkoQz8LJPPYfSnYuALXWk8B3k6tyGE1kJeFpy3pBa.png

I didn't write much recently because I had to care about so many things, and I will keep it short: I simply didn't earn enough to build a sustainable business in the Philippines, so that this June 19th I have to go back to work in Hong Kong. Unfortunately, safety won once again over freedom. Life in the Philippines is so expensive: electricity, public transportation, the school of my son... And people are not ready to buy similar prices for food like in Hong Kong - quality is less important than price.

Making food is a joy but living from it in the Philippines is a very hard task.

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gen-quimba/23xAXxjL9a13oMeBN2tZwSijHkJyEJP9geYd4gAs1nyFkTHpnQmjtEH1sfR3RCy9CepbW.png
</center>

I hope I can come back again, but for now I need to earn enough money to survive.

But where is rain also the sun shines from time to time:

- Despite the first workers cheated me and ran away with my money, finally I could fix my house so that I can rent out all rooms while I am in Hong Kong.

- On YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@GensLife-42) and X (https://x.com/GenQuimba) I gained quite some followers, so that I could promote my book there and maybe in future I can monetize my content.

body.title: Domingo de paseo
body.body:
Me duelen hasta las pestañas como decimos en Venezuela cuando estamos muy cansados, creo que ya no estoy para estas diversiones, son otros tiempos que llevaba a mis hijos a las piscina y playas de la ciudad de Lecherías. Pero no puedo negar que el parque es hermoso, con mucha seguridad para los más pequeños. 


![1000891235.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWH7jZiyX8jGfZwb4eSHahqbkgmhubKZ6aEhHohfN2g1F/1000891235.jpg)


![1000891675.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNc2TYcvbvjdy1b7vFVixxd9HR24dbJL3YpQL4ZvxmiT5/1000891675.jpg)


Pero el día no comenzó por allí, full de preparativos por parte de mi hija, panes, queso, salchichón, refresco, agua e hielo. 

Teníamos que hacer una parada en un pueblo Pinto para recoger en el Renfe a un amigo que nos iba acompañar. También se iban acercar la sobrina con la niña pequeña y una amiga. 

Un buen desayuno para aguantar el día que nos esperaba. 
![1000892070.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9rAwuqTCaRi7FUbbrUGVsAjArRdFKsJXvirMfJh15YS/1000892070.jpg)

![1000892037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXr9UZLpCLHLj7nU36hNFWzFMg4Mup9PzF8wjw7hyg3WE/1000892037.jpg)

La torre de pinto o torre de Éboli es una torre medieval del siglo XIV, fue utilizada como prisión de estado y aunque fue comprada y restaurada hay un acuerdo para permitir sus visitas al pagar su entrada. 


![1000892040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7PFXiG4ERGr63iRKMDJUSFsa5dNRx5bmYuR7xMkW8uZ/1000892040.jpg)

![1000892046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX7BSR6e8wqfJkjuF8oSEHMkWtFfMMMmxkqeQST7dWM9j/1000892046.jpg)

![1000892057.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZsJXgvjmJbL2ZLQ3PitPwjB7XKYQbRzuGNrSTyTy2qq2/1000892057.jpg)


![1000892042.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU2pcjiT5hx2Ea59ja4Um9Uik8QfmPohrhQe7YKZkV7AA/1000892042.jpg)

![1000892051.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWSnr4tta7hxVZC8N2VfcaxQQFP1SG7xyVWangm1Y2KMA/1000892051.jpg)

![1000892052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNu9B47M7QLNEJQ9SRoRD9gRaoxwiyCEWTQmEko7DXKzb/1000892052.jpg)

Mientras esperábamos la llegada del amigo de mi hija y yerno dimos una vuelta caminando y conociendo esa parte del pueblo, vimos la parada del autobús que lleva al parque, es uno de los pueblos más cercanos al parque acuático. 


![1000892498.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3Tgt2CjPy7T5sY7xrc4zHkfM6BStheZ7wib3CQyuTzE/1000892498.jpg)

![1000892494.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZL3LEL98caEuETaV5NjscrKW2KmzcGYsZrA2c51yUNh/1000892494.jpg)


![1000892507.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnnNqDtKYiyS2B2dxwL5UiVDX6cad2WPjacwVDz3iHom/1000892507.jpg)

![1000892468.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfHk5X2xHr7U9nhUBKUb1JfDP4uFnjCFx7yUGRFVEg2TV/1000892468.jpg)

![1000892470.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT3NFUVdEWqqKf9Qb8L1PhwYSpi93QDakF5PJS5hPyHz7/1000892470.jpg)

El camino largo, pagamos el estacionamiento del coche, porque las entradas ya las había comprado mi hija por la página. Los viejitos y niños pagan menos. No se puede entrar con comida por eso la dejamos en el coche, pero adentro venden. El agua estaba súper fría y para el calor que hacía estaba deliciosa. 

![1000892155.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRBRgELf3Jos2nMgAJHTz7ut64ReoDTyztb8qp8hbYDp/1000892155.jpg)

![1000892169.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTTFUbWu8gc1GGmSUu8WVbMnzMij8xh9kqZabiQxa4Tk3/1000892169.jpg)

![1000892168.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVDnZG8uL1fW9vbY2BbQ6Va5FFawuGHn3qWvFKnX8MzRS/1000892168.jpg)

Íbamos al de las piscinas y al lado hay otro de juegos que suben y bajan si eres valiente. 


![1000892453.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnSKEgLpz4v7DRWPHKaqoezTPHWaUi4n8W5PXxD9baer/1000892453.jpg)

![1000892430.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaECKDDPRMSfRmFn9bYWT6mLvGUyad5Gjz7JFdoQVCE7i/1000892430.jpg)


![1000892375.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb9wQEApxmV4JTo4s4PkEhhdUT5UR3vQHtVgACbuBeXCK/1000892375.jpg)

![1000892373.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRc9mPK7dUGrDRG3NBWRG26JmKvuYcvTAfY9rRyAagdYs/1000892373.jpg)


![1000892452.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzKUMLvTTGadGYj5wBhGYb9NuogPAJFqv1YrBAFhSFW6/1000892452.jpg)

Mi hija metió mi móvil en un bolsito transparente anti agua y me dijo niños ajenos no se fotografían para su protección, pero no quería que mi teléfono sufriera algún percance, además estuve descansando un poco mientras me bañaba con esa agua helada en verdad. Había mucha seguridad cada tantos metros alrededor de la piscina de niños un salvavidas y adentro del agua otros más, el piso antiresbalante una maravilla, los chorros de agua divertidos y de todo tamaño, la sobrina pequeña jugó hasta que se cansó y su mamá compro nugest de pollo y una bebida en envase de corre caminos. Adentro todo cuesta su dinero. 


![1000892482.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedRqAfoWqhR2WLcjxu2GtrakkkpvWcJvQbbD95aaayaU/1000892482.jpg)

![1000892477.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7cTb85Bv8KGTu466qZBb36CmPCC9ABAZySQh1aEoeQt/1000892477.jpg)

![1000892484.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYhm7CbXBTHCyZrkCTEDrQKe67tYgbrhnpoBpvughug6g/1000892484.jpg)

Ahora a descansar por mi parte. Mi hija salió temprano a Zaragoza hubiese sido una excelente oportunidad para abrazar a @palomap3, pero el cupo de tren normalito estaba lleno, solo quedaban los más costosos. Ella viaja para esa localidad con cierta frecuencia va a estar pendiente de avisarme. Tengo oportunidad hasta octubre, ya tengo ganas de conocerla. 

Esta semana voy al teatro a ver Cenicienta, tengo una cita de manicure y un viaje a Málaga de dos días. Así que nos vemos en el camino de la vida.

body.body:
I am not sure if you know of a Youtube channel called WildYourGardenWithJoelAshton, but there he shares a lot of tips for how to make your gardens more wildlife friendly, especially for wild pollinators. Your insect hotel reminded of the one he had in one a few of his videos.

I have noticed even now people confuse wild pollinators with honey bees. It is the wild pollinators that are struggling the most and the honey bees actually contribute to aggressively taking food away from the wild bees. 

If I had a land on which I could make up my own rules depending on the size of it I would have some wild meadows that I would allow to go to bloom at least or on a smaller land a few grass islands that are allowed to go to bloom so that the bees can have even bigger variety of native plants. Also looking for more native plants to plant in your garden can help a lot not just for bees but also butterflies.

body.title: El mago / Tarot / dibujo hecho mano / Es- En
body.body: data-align=\

>Este viernes por fin me anime a hacer o mejor dicho a iniciar mi tarea en la que debo hacer 4 cartas del Tarot de los Arcanos Mayores, la primera es el Mago, que es la carta numero 1, esta va justo después de la carta del loco. El Mago simboliza el aprendizaje, la búsqueda del conocimiento, la creatividad, el uso, la experimentación y entendimiento de los elementos que se tienen a mano y están disponibles en el entorno, en la mesa dispone de la copa, que simboliza el agua (sentimientos y emociones); el basto, que simboliza el fuego (acción, movimiento); el athame que es el aire (pensamientos, análisis) y por ultimo el oro o pentaculo, que representa la tierra (material, físico, dinero); arriba tiene un infinito que representa el potencial ilimitado que tenemos para crecer y evolucionar.
data-align=\

>El mago sostiene arriba una vara que canaliza la energía, esta conecta con la parte espiritual o elevada, mientras la otra mano señala hacia abajo para indicar que debemos estar conectados a la tierra , la conexión con lo elevado y lo terrenal, manteniendo el equilibrio, en su vestimenta el blanco es pureza y el rojo es pasión, los elementos florales representa la belleza, vitalidad del espíritu.
data-align=\

>Para crear la carta me entregaron una tarjeta de cartulina blanca, yo compre un marcador negro doble punta (fina y ultra-fina), y unos colores muy económicos en una de las tantas tiendas de chino, la verdad mis colores están en resguardo en otra casa pero preferí no molestar y probar estos, que al final resultaron bien funcionales.
data-align=\
>PROCESO\n\n
alt=\
/> Con un lápiz de grafito normal, empece a hacer el boceto del dibujo, como pueden ver borraba y demás, pero porque no estoy muy acostumbrado a dibujar a mano, definí las figuras y sus posiciones.
alt=\
/>\n\n
data-align=\
>Con el marcador empece a delinear y a jugar con distintos anchos de linea negra, ya finalizado los trazados, procedo a borrar todo lo que esta hecho a lápiz. creo esta parte me quedo bien.
alt=\
>
data-align=\

> Por ultimo toco colorear todo el dibujo con los lapices de colores, no soy experto coloreando pero aun así me quedo muy bien, quede contento y refleja la energía que quería transmitir. Espero les haya gustado este post sobre esta carta del mago que hice a mano.

-------- English - Google Translate English - Google Translate
data-align=\

>This Friday I finally got around to doing, or rather starting, my assignment in which I have to draw 4 Major Arcana Tarot cards. The first is the Magician, which is card number 1, and it goes right after the Fool. The Magician symbolizes learning, the search for knowledge, creativity, the use, experimentation, and understanding of the elements that are at hand and available in the environment. On the table, he has the cup, which symbolizes water (feelings and emotions); the wand, which symbolizes fire (action, movement); the athame, which is air (thoughts, analysis); and finally the pentacle, which represents earth (material, physical, money). Above it is an infinity symbol, which represents the unlimited potential we have to grow and evolve.

The magician holds a wand above him, channeling energy. This connects us to the spiritual or higher realm, while his other hand points downwards to indicate that we must be connected to the earth, the connection between the sublime and the earthly, maintaining balance. In his attire, white represents purity and red represents passion. The floral elements represent beauty and the vitality of the spirit. To create the card, I was given a white card. I bought a double-tipped black marker (fine and ultra-fine) and some very inexpensive colored pencils from one of the many discount stores. Actually, my colored pencils are stored at another house, but I preferred not to bother them and try these, which turned out to work quite well. data-align=\
>PROCESS\n\n
alt=\

/> Using a regular graphite pencil, I started sketching the drawing. As you can see, I erased and so on, but that's because I'm not very used to drawing by hand. I defined the figures and their positions.
alt=\
/>\n\n
data-align=\
>With the marker, I started outlining and playing with different widths of black lines. Once the outlines were finished, I erased everything done in pencil. I think this part turned out well.
alt=\
>
data-align=\

>\n\nFinally, I colored the entire drawing with colored pencils. I'm not an expert at coloring, but it still turned out very well. I'm happy with it, and it reflects the energy I wanted to convey. I hope you liked this post about this Magician card I drew by hand.

body.title: My treasures of fleshy leaves [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTSmKWviMVLxkUJoGyyRZL5tHEA1PYt4u846TNUh8DNg/1780903586586.jpg)




***
***
It is no secret that plants are one of my passions, and if I had to choose the jewels of my green crown, they would undoubtedly be two echeverias that I keep with an almost ridiculous affection. Today I want to introduce them to you as they deserve.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUe9bYgwbxqkEDjqfLkyGAhcKSLWAcsvNJ5paqYkj7zu9/1780903587941.jpg)

***
The first has a first and last name: Echeveria pallida. It came into my life a couple of years ago, small and somewhat wilted. I had no idea then of the spectacle it would become. Its leaves are a pale green shade that becomes iridescent in the evening light, but what fascinates me most is its size: it grows with serene elegance, forming rosettes that look like porcelain flowers. When I look at it, I understand why botanists named it “pallida”; it must be because it is not a sickly pallor, but that of alabaster, that of the moon just before it becomes full.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNb7MPeN7MKcAE6yrAxMn8TvMbF9WhEMTWrjrB8z6qJQv/1780903588460.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyvgt2VFCfj83FWchKCspWXJwKXjip9QFtu7eJNGQMxe/1780903588203.jpg)

***
The other is a mystery. It arrived without a label; I do not know its scientific name, and sometimes I like not knowing. I only know that its leaves are a marvel: they widen into spoons, and their edges are not smooth like those of common echeverias, but curled, wavy, as if someone had run tiny crimping irons along each of their margins. The color is a soft green that bursts at the tips with a blush of pink. That pink is not constant; it appears more intense when the sun hits it directly, or when the temperature drops a little at night. Sometimes, I confess, I find myself staring at those pink edges and thinking they look like a ballerina's fingertips after a long rehearsal.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWuSYV6h2AGwqi5UJziA651Qf12MiXsqyefRT2AWgybP/1780903682381.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7mfJz3n8CD7Y7rtznuLikiuTd5cqvdSa9tMEwtJ9n9Z/1780903683534.jpg)

***
I often jokingly tell my friends that they are my “elegant lettuces” because from a distance they could be mistaken for one of those expensive purple lettuces, but you just need to get closer to see they are living art.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYtDuxZP9LLEqZj89wZQEQjnz3RGpueFMLqQsbBHrgAa/1780903682843.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYurYMfStdG38cWSwmeaBggCmZ4JNFZzXtTvaveuGpFab/1780903682051.jpg)

***
Both live in my garden, but not directly in the ground; I keep them in pots with a substrate that I mix myself. It took me years to learn that what kills these beauties is too much affection in the form of watering, so I water them sparingly, and when I do, I wait for the waxing crescent moon.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUuY6niU9tMf5a9v7WNn6Y2mtSzbcs43sQ52Xtq1Sa6J/1780903683184.jpg)

***
Caring for them has taught me patience because echeverias do not ask for much: just light, but not direct sun during the harshest hours; water, but never too much; and a watchful eye to detect a mealybug or fungus in time. In return, they give me that daily miracle of seeing new little leaves sprout from the center, tight, perfect, as if someone were weaving them.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1780292702177.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.

### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>Mis tesoros de hojas carnosas</center>




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdeAkcrHxNQhgVx8wdA8DeQ8tGXnZ37eq6RrYdFZqoz1/1780903587302.jpg)


***
***



Para nadie es un secreto que las plantas son una de mis pasiones y si tuviera que elegir las joyas de mi corona verde, sin duda serían dos echeverias que conservo con un amor casi ridículo. Hoy quiero presentártelas como se merecen.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUe9bYgwbxqkEDjqfLkyGAhcKSLWAcsvNJ5paqYkj7zu9/1780903587941.jpg)


***
La primera tiene nombre y apellido: Echeveria pallida. Llegó a mi vida hace un par de años, pequeña y algo desmejorada. No imaginaba entonces el espectáculo en que se convertiría. Sus hojas son de un tono verde pálido, que se vuelve iridiscente con la luz de la tarde, pero lo que más me fascina es su tamaño: crece con una elegancia serena, formando rosetas que parecen flores de porcelana. Cuando la miro, entiendo por qué los botánicos le pusieron “pallida”; debe ser porque no es una palidez enfermiza, sino la del alabastro, la de la luna justo antes de llenarse.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNb7MPeN7MKcAE6yrAxMn8TvMbF9WhEMTWrjrB8z6qJQv/1780903588460.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyvgt2VFCfj83FWchKCspWXJwKXjip9QFtu7eJNGQMxe/1780903588203.jpg)

***
La otra es un misterio. Llegó sin etiqueta, no sé su nombre científico, y a veces me gusta no saberlo. Solo sé que sus hojas son un prodigio: se ensanchan en cuchara, y sus bordes no son lisos como en las echeverias comunes, sino rizados, ondulados, como si alguien hubiera pasado una tenacilla diminuta por cada uno de sus márgenes. El color es de un verde suave que estalla en los extremos con un rubor sonrosado. Ese rosa no es constante; aparece más intenso cuando el sol le da de lleno, o cuando la temperatura baja un poco en las noches. A veces, confieso, me quedo mirando esos bordes rosados y pienso que parecen las puntas de los dedos de una bailarina después de mucho ensayo.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWuSYV6h2AGwqi5UJziA651Qf12MiXsqyefRT2AWgybP/1780903682381.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7mfJz3n8CD7Y7rtznuLikiuTd5cqvdSa9tMEwtJ9n9Z/1780903683534.jpg)

***
Suelo decirles en broma a mis amigos que son mis “lechugas elegantes” porque desde lejos podrían confundirse con una lechuga morada de esas que venden caras, pero basta acercarse para ver que son arte vivo.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYtDuxZP9LLEqZj89wZQEQjnz3RGpueFMLqQsbBHrgAa/1780903682843.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYurYMfStdG38cWSwmeaBggCmZ4JNFZzXtTvaveuGpFab/1780903682051.jpg)

***
Las dos viven en mi jardín, pero no en tierra directa; las tengo en macetas con un sustrato que yo mismo mezclo. Me tomó años aprender que a estas bellezas les asesina el exceso de cariño en forma de riego, por eso las riego poco y cuando lo hago, espero a que la luna esté en cuarto creciente.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUuY6niU9tMf5a9v7WNn6Y2mtSzbcs43sQ52Xtq1Sa6J/1780903683184.jpg)


***
Cuidarlas me ha enseñado paciencia, pues las echeverias no piden mucho: solo luz, pero no sol directo en las horas más agresivas; agua, pero nunca en exceso; y una mirada atenta para detectar a tiempo una cochinilla o un hongo. A cambio, me regalan ese milagro cotidiano de ver cómo nacen nuevas hojitas desde el centro, apretadas, perfectas, como si alguien las estuviera tejiendo.


<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQA2nwFQo3sZ1vuEqgLphQMjgqrarqB5nhtG2BYMxCbV/1780292702295.jpg)

body.title: 网恋需警慎，莫上头...
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![OnBYX4mqEoBDSfRH_45543.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrpointp/images/OnBYX4mqEoBDSfRH_45543/OnBYX4mqEoBDSfRH_45543.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

看到这个标题，可千万不要误以为我在搞网恋，话题是来源于今天一大早“吃的瓜”。虽然网恋引发的诈骗事件在网上见得多，但亲眼看见当事人并且听到具体细节，还真是感觉不一样。

今天一大早我就拿着无人机去派CHU所报备，话说这件事情我也拖延的够久了，考虑到年假要出去玩，所以才决定这两天搞定报备这件事情。现在无人机管理越来越严格，我看网上有人分享被警告、罚款什么的，都有点“恐飞”了。

言归正传，我正在办理此事的时候，一位男生进来报案，他说自己被诈骗了。这本来属于人家的隐私，我一个来办事的人本不应该窥探，但无奈说话的声音太大，被动地吃了一次瓜。

他说自己在外地上班，然后在网上认识了一位女生（女生是我们本地的），然后两人再网上聊了一阵之后，男生给对方转了点钱，可是女生回过头来就不再与他往恋爱的方向发展了，男生就认为自己被骗了。

也不知道男生从哪里得知女生的具体地址，按着地址就找到了本地派CHU所。在描述事件过程中，男生表示自己真的是太糊涂了，既生对方的气、也生自己的气，他的诉求是获取女生的具体信息或者立案。

然而工作人员告知他由于金额达不到无法立案，并且也不能随意把居民信息透露给他。男生把解决问题的方式想的很简单，他认为只要通过正式途径通知对方退钱就行，完全不考虑自己诉求的合法合规性。

后续如何处理不太清楚，仅仅作为一个观众，如果男生真的是被骗了，我感到同情的同时又觉得他挺傻的，假如这笔钱真的追不回来，就算是他恋爱的学费吧...

---

body.body:
I think it’s (unfortunately) more a case of Hive Fest attracting active people with resources and loyalty rather than actually generating them. It’s a bit like saying that campaign rallies generate more politicians than online discussions just because when you count the attendees, politicians are much more represented there than in your Facebook feed. Or in random Joe's FB feed at least, I don't know how yours look like :)

Attending HF requires resources. This year’s Barcelona for two (flying with a European low-cost carrier and staying in budget-friendly place; not a hostel, though) would probably set you back about €2,000. Including HF tickets for two.

If you have those resources (and are willing to spend them on a trip like this), it’s likely that:
* You’re already a loyal user. Otherwise, you’d just take that money and go on a much more interesting or longer vacation of your choicec.
* You have the means to run a witness server. It’s an investment. And I’m guessing that at today’s prices, it’s a losing game for anyone outside the top 20. Attending HF then becomes a way to gain political points to help you break into that top 20.
* You have enough RC to create alt accounts. And maybe the wil to play around with them. For example, I created @actifit-godfish and more recently @dead-pets. But realistically, I haven’t onboarded any actual new users with these two accounts. And those I did actually bring in signed up through something like Ecency, so they wouldn't even show up in this kind of metric anyway.
* And finally: you have enough resources so that you don't depend on Hive for extra income. You don’t have to spend hours here every day grinding out posts and comments for a few dollars, so you’re not at such a high risk of burnout. A price drop doesn't become an existential threat to you. body.title: The Act Of Giving
body.body:
Many religions practice the act of giving, believing that they will receive great rewards from their Creator for helping the less privileged and their fellow human beings without expecting anything in return.

Different religions demonstrate this act of generosity in various ways. For instance, African Traditional Religion (ATR) promotes giving by preparing meals and inviting as many people as possible to eat freely. Christianity encourages charity through providing food, clothing, and shelter for the hungry and homeless. Islam also emphasizes giving by supporting and feeding Almajiri children and other people in need.

The act of giving is a common practice among many religions, and believers often testify to its positive impact on their lives. Some claim that whenever they give to the less privileged, they receive blessings and rewards many times over from their Creator, while others remain uncertain about such outcomes.

![556BC8CD-B344-43F2-A6C8-604CD81AF534.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chichebem/48m9hjLZJ5g12DRg8GYQJFprst14A4j2oVT7jHaUZTt4GE4NynfdNwRu6MaJwzRMaV.png)

One thing these religions have in common is the belief that giving should be done with a sincere heart. A person should be in their purest state of mind, remain devoted to their faith, believe in the value of generosity, and hope for divine favor from their Creator.

In my opinion, whether one receives a reward from their Creator or not, the act of giving—especially to the less privileged—should be encouraged by all religious bodies. Doing so allows those in need to benefit from the resources of those who are more fortunate.

I therefore urge everyone to embrace the practice of giving. By helping one another and caring for the needy, we can collectively build a better and more compassionate world.
Does your practice “act of giving”?
What’s your take on it???

body.title: Views from the peak of Mount Nemrut. Accumulated snow mass. Tatvan, Turkey
body.body: The unusually heavy rainfall in Türkiye this year has affected many things. While the season at Nemrut Caldera usually opens in the first week of May, this year visitors started visiting the caldera in the first week of June. _Bu yıl Türkiye'de yaşanan alışılmadık derecede yoğun yağışlar birçok şeyi etkiledi. Nemrut Kalderası'nda sezon genellikle Mayıs ayının ilk haftasında açılırken, bu yıl ziyaretçiler kalderayı Haziran ayının ilk haftasında ziyaret etmeye başladı._
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> On one side of Mount Nemrut lies Lake Van, Türkiye's largest lake, while on the other side is Nemrut Crater Lake, the world's second largest lake. It is possible to admire breathtaking views from the peak of Mount Nemrut. _Nemrut Dağı'nın bir tarafında Türkiye'nin en büyük gölü Van Gölü varken öte yanında ise dünyanın en büyük 2. gölü olan Nemrut Krater Gölü var. Nemrut dağı zirvesinden eşsiz manzaraları izlemek mümkün oluyor._
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> At the summit of Mount Nemrut, there's an area where heavy snowfall has caused snow accumulation. Currently, the snowdrift is around 5 meters high. It was even more a week ago, but it's melting due to the warmer temperatures. I think we could still see this snow mass here even in the July heat. There are people who mix this snow with molasses and enjoy it. _Nemrut Dağı'nın zirvesinde, yoğun kar yağışında tipinin kar biriktirdiği bir alan var. Şu an kar birikintisinin boyu 5 metre civarında. Bir hafta önce daha fazlaymış, hava sıcaklığı karşısında erimeler oluyor. Temmuz sıcağında bile bu kar kütlesini burada görebileceğimizi düşünüyorum. Buradaki karı pekmez ile karıştırıp keyif yapan insanlar var._
alt=\
/>\n\nVisitors had written their own names and the names of their loved ones on the snowdrift. Some had written the date of the day. I wrote \
there. _Ziyaretçiler kar birikintisi üstüne kendi ve sevdikleri kişilerin isimlerini yazmıştı. Kimileri günün tarihini yazmıştı. Ben de oraya HİVE yazdım._
alt=\

/> The breathtaking views of Lake Van, the high mountains, and the snow still unmelted on the mountains. It's possible to gaze at these landscapes for hours from here. There are people who come here with their caravans and stay for days. To be honest, I couldn't stay here for very long. The inner part of the Nemrut Caldera, the area with the lakes, endemic plants, and animals, is so beautiful that I wanted to descend from the summit as quickly as possible. _Van Gölü'nün eşssiz manzaraları, yüksek dağlar ve dağlarda henüz erimemiş karlar. Buradan manzaraları saatlerce izlemek mümkün. Karavanı ile gelip burada günlerce kalan insanlar var. Doğrusu burada çok fazla kalamadım. Nemrut Kalderasının iç tarafı, göllerin, endemik bitkilerin, hayvanların olduğu alan o kadar güzel ki bir an önce zirveden aşağıya doğru inmek istedim._
alt=\

/>

We drove down into the caldera. The roads were damaged due to heavy rainfall. There are still large masses of snow that haven't melted inside the caldera. I plan to share the rest, and most important part, of this visit in a few days.

_Araba ile kalderanın içine doğru iniş yaptık. Yoğun yağıştan dolayı yollar bozulmuş. Kalderanın içinde hala erimemiş çok fazla kar kütlesi var. Bu ziyaretimin geri kalan ve en önemli kısmını bir kaç gün sonra paylaşmayı düşünüyorum._

[//]:# (!worldmappin 38.562680 lat 42.267341 long H778+3W Çekmece/Tatvan/Bitlis, Türkiye d3scr)

body.title: What Every Pet Owner Should Know About Animal Grooming
body.body:
The responsibility of caring for your pet goes beyond more than just providing food as well as shelter and love. It is a commitment to cleanliness and maintenance that helps your pet’s overall health from the inside. [Rockwall pet grooming](https://www.riversdogretreat.com/grooming/) experts have seen in person how regular grooming can improve a dog’s health and well-being by reducing discomfort, preventing the spread of infections and enhancing the relationship between pet and pet owner. 



![Dog Grooming in Rockwall.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/5725dc3b2b9d8059b90c12f605251d1a4aadd89bad74f044037f060ddc86392b)



If your dog is sporting the thickest two-coat, rough texture of a terrier or a sleek, short coat that appears to be low maintenance Every breed can benefit from a structured grooming regimen that is executed using the appropriate equipment and techniques. Understanding the essence of grooming and why it is important medically and how to create a routine that is sustainable at home, and in conjunction by consulting a professional is the premise of responsible pet care.

**The Medical Case for Grooming That Most Owners Overlook**

Grooming is usually portrayed as a luxury cosmetic procedure however the reality of medicine has a totally different picture. The health of the coat and skin are a direct indicator of a dog’s health internally If you don’t take care of it regularly, it causes problems that extend beyond appearance. The matt fur traps heat, water, and bacterial growths against the skin, leading to uncomfortable hot spots and fungal growth and sores that could be infected with no warning. Dogs who have ear canals that are not properly managed build up wax and debris that can cause yeast and bacteria which can lead to persistent ear infections which cause severe pain that can hinder hearing if untreated. 

Nail growth is another commonly overlooked problem. If nails are excessively long, they cause unnatural pressure distribution over the paw, straining the tendons and joints. This can gradually affect mobility and posture particularly in senior dogs. Regular grooming sessions provide experts with the training to inspect the skin folds, look for signs of parasites such as fleas and ticks, look for early signs of lesions or lumps and identify anything that requires a vet follow-up. The observations that are made during routine appointments have revealed serious health issues at a time which treatment is much cost-effective and less expensive.

**How Coat Type Determines the Right Grooming Frequency and Approach**

One of the most frequent mistake pet owners can make is to apply the same grooming routines. Different types of coats require different amounts of attention Incorrectly applying this approach can result in excessive grooming or neglect which strip off the coat’s protective oils. Double-coated breeds, such as Labrador Retrievers, German Shepherds along with Bernese Mountain Dogs shed heavily during the seasons and require a consistent brushing schedule several times a week to control loose undercoat and to prevent matting. In the time of shedding the use of a professional deshedding treatment will remove much more hair dead than simply brushing on its own and significantly reduce how much hair is shed around your house. 

The curly and wavy coats that are found are common on Poodles, Doodles, and Bichon Frises continue to grow and can mat up quickly, usually require professional trimming every 4 to 6 weeks to maintain the coat at an acceptable length and avoid painful tangles that form close to the skin. Smooth coat breeds such as Beagles and Boxers require fewer frequent trimming, yet nevertheless require regularly scheduled baths, nail trimmings as well as ear exams to maintain a healthy and clean. Knowing your dog’s specific requirements and establishing a grooming program in line with those needs will ensure that each session at home, and with a professional will provide real health benefits, instead of just marking an item off.

**Building a Grooming Habit That Your Dog Will Actually Tolerate**

Most effective grooming method involves one your pet is able to accept without hesitation, and that level of comfort doesn’t happen on its own. The dogs who are groomed when they are puppies become accustomed to being handled with their entire bodies such as paws, ear and mouths. This can make each subsequent grooming session more enjoyable. For older dogs who have a limited grooming experience, patience as well as gradual desensitization are crucial. Begin with short, solitary sessions that concentrate on one particular area at a given time, and using an emphasis on positive reinforcement, remaining steady and calm helps the majority of dogs to reach a level of true tolerance and pleasure. 

In between professional visits, a regular or more often-than-weekly grooming keeps the coat in great condition and provides owners with a regular chance to examine their pet’s overall physical health. For pet owners who want to incorporate this type of care into their daily routines [Rockwall pet grooming](https://www.riversdogretreat.com/grooming/) services offer professional know-how and expertise specific to breeds that makes the process comprehensive as well as safe and beneficial for dogs of every phase of their lives.

---

body.title: မိုးနဲ့ အတူ
body.body:
မိုးဦးသို့ ဝင်ရောက်ခဲ့ပေသည်။ မိုးဦးစောသည်ဟု
ပြောရပေမည်။ မိုးကောင်းချက်က ‌ခြံဘေးရေမြောင်း
ရေလျှံသွားသည်။ ပုံမှန်မိုး ဆိုပါမူ မြောင်းအတွင်း
ရေမရှိတတ်ပေ။ မိုးကောင်းသဖြင့် တောင်ပေါ်
ဒေသများ ရေကြီး မြေပြိုသည်။ တနေ့က သတင်း
မှာ ကြည့်ရသည်။ ရှမ်းပြည်တောင်ပိုင်း ရေကြီး
သည်။ တောင်ပေါ်ဒေသမှာ ရေကြီးသည်မှာ
ယခုအခါနှင့်ဆိုပါမူ နှစ်ခါတိတိကြားရသည်။ 

ရာသီဥတု၏ဒဏ်ကို ခံနိုင်သော သစ်ပင်၊ သစ်တော၊
တောတောင်တို့က လူတို့၏ လောဘဖြင့် ပျောက်ဆုံး
ကုန်ကြသည်။ ဒီတော့ လောဘ၏သားကောင်များ
ဘဝသို့ ရောက်ရှိကြရသည်။ သစ်ပင် သစ်တော
ချစ်ခင်တဲ့ လူမျိုးတို့၊ ရွှေတိုက်ကို စိုးတို့ စသဖြင့်
ခရီးသွားခဲ့စဉ်က ဖတ်ခဲ့ရသည်။ ထိုစာများကို
သစ်တောကြီးများ၏ သစ်ပင်များမှာ ရေးသားထားသည်။  
ထိုဆိုင်းဘုတ်လေးများလည်း
ရှိကြသေးရဲ့လား၊ ဘယ်ဆီသို့ ရောက်ပေကြသလဲ
မသိပေ။ 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmct1q47SxbyCjekaxLkZLoRXVKFbReMQvrre7vCeJCT14/image_88a276bd_bf71_455f_b412_26c354a7e0e51881317823424207589.jpg)

သစ်တောကြီးများကို မပြုလုပ်နိုင်ပေသိ။ ကိုယ့်ခြံနှင့်
ပတ်ဝန်းကျင်ကိုဖြင့် သီးပင်၊ စားပင်နှင့် ပန်းအလှပင်များ
စိုက်ပျိုးရပေသည်။ ယခု မိုးရာသီဦးမှာ သစ်ပင်
များစပြီး စိုက်ပျိုးပါရင်ဖြင့် သစ်ပင်များ ရှင်သန်ဖို့
ရာခိုင်နှုန်းသေချာပေသည်။ မိုးရာသီ သစ်ပင်
စိုက်ပွဲများလည်း ပြုလုပ်ဖို့ မေ့နေကြပေမည်လား။
သစ်ပင်စိုက် စိုက် ဆိုပြီး စိုက်သွားကြသည်။
ထိုစိုက်ခဲ့သော သစ်ပင်ကို ရေလောင်း
ပြုစုပျိုးထောင်ဖို့ ဆက်လက်ပြီး မဆောင်ရွက်
ကြတော့ပေ။ 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVCywPpuHkQuf3Z7MRMEfHKtfUrprfDjEZ8CUBNK4qX6d/image_8482d1f8_7d48_46fc_96cc_b48207a540118915682486511280708.jpg)

ကျွန်‌တော်က ပန်းအလှပင်ထက် သီးပင်၊ စားပင်ကို
ပိုပြီး စိုက်ပျိုးချင်သည်။ တနေ့က အိမ်‌ရှေ့တရုတ်ခြံမှ
ငှက်ပျောပင်ပေါက်များ တောင်းယူပြီး ခြံဘေးမှာ
စိုက်ပျိုးထားသည်။ သစ်ပင်ကိုသာ တောင်းပြီး
စိုက်နေသည်။ သစ်ပင်စိုက်စရာ နေရာက သစ်ပင်
များဖြင့် ခြံအပြင်၊ ခြံအတွင်း ပြည့်နေသည်။
ခြံအပြင် မြေလွတ်မည့်နေရာ၊ နေရောင်ခြည်
ရမည့်နေရာကို ငှက်ပျောပင် စိုက်သည်။ ငှက်ပျော
ပင်ပေါက် နှစ်ပင်အနက် တပင်ကို ခြံတောင်ဘက်မှာ
စိုက်ပြီး၊ တပင်ကို ခြံအရှေ့မှာ စိုက်သည်။ 

ထိုငှက်ပျောပင်နှစ်ပင်ကို တောင်ဘက်ရှိ အပင်အား
ကျွန်တော်က တာဝန်ယူရမည်။ ခြံအရှေ့ရှိ အပင်ကို
အမက တာဝန်ယူသည်။ ကျွန်တော့်အပင်က
နေရောင်ရသည်။ အမ၏ အပင်က ပိတောက်ပင်နှင့်
ဗာဒံပင်များက မိုးထားသဖြင့် နေရောင် ကောင်းစွာ
မရပေ။ မည်သည့်အပင်က ရှင်သန်ကြီးထွားမလဲ
ဆိုသည်ကို စောင့်ကြည့်ရပေအုံးမည်။ အပင်များ
ကောင်းစွာရှင်သန်ဖို့ ရေလောင်းရပေအုံးမည်။
တိရစ္ဆာန်များရန်မှလည်း ကာကွယ်ရပေအုံးမည်။
