body.title: ‎The Special One Returns? Mourinho's Real Madrid Comeback Could Be Closer Than Ever ‎
body.body:
‎As a football fan, there are certain stories that instantly grab your attention, and the possibility of José Mourinho returning to Real Madrid is definitely one of them.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVqrgiuLnA4US3SaajXkva8tKkm23xVtjE8MKUEE3Um7K/lisbon-portugal-alvaro-arbeloa-head-coach-of-real-madrid-speaks-to-jose-mourinho-head-coach.jpg 

‎[Source](https://www.gettyimages.in/photos/jose-mourinho)
‎
‎Following Florentino Pérez's re-election as Real Madrid president, reports have emerged suggesting that Mourinho is set to make a dramatic return to the Santiago Bernabéu. If the deal goes through, it will be more than a decade after his first spell at the club ended.
‎
‎What makes this story even more interesting is that Pérez has never hidden his admiration for Mourinho. During his post-election speech, he proudly spoke about Real Madrid's future and even welcomed back \

Those words have only fueled speculation that the Portuguese manager's return is now just a matter of time.
‎
‎I still remember Mourinho's first stint in Madrid. It was not always smooth, and there was plenty of drama along the way, but there is no denying the impact he had on the team. He built a side that could go toe-to-toe with Pep Guardiola's dominant Barcelona and helped Real Madrid reclaim the La Liga title. That period produced some unforgettable matches and intense rivalries that football fans still talk about today.
‎
‎Since leaving Madrid in 2013, Mourinho has managed several clubs, experiencing both success and difficult moments. While he has not won a domestic league title since guiding Chelsea to the Premier League trophy in 2015, his reputation as a winner remains intact. Love him or dislike him, Mourinho has always been a coach who knows how to attract attention and create belief within his teams.
‎
‎If he does return, he will inherit a club that is once again aiming to dominate both Spanish and European football. Expectations at Real Madrid are always sky-high, and supporters will be hoping that Mourinho can bring his experience and winning mentality to the squad.
‎
‎Personally, I think this would be one of the most fascinating managerial appointments in recent years. Football has really changed a lot since Mourinho last stood in the Real Madrid dugout, and it would be interesting to see how he adapts to the modern game and a new generation of players.
‎
‎For now, fans can only wait for official confirmation. But if Mourinho really is heading back to Madrid, one thing is certain, and that's the football world will be paying very close attention.
‎

> In the old age, between all those tons of sand. There it was, living a unique creature. It was part of the dog family, the White Fox. This creature has a moody nature, which makes it hard to pet. But, if it was to be pet, it may be called Foxy. It has a unique ability of adapting to different environment. While the desert is its home. body.title: Preserving Childhood in a World Obsessed with Social Media
body.body: Before the Covid year, a lot of individuals found peace and gainful employment off social media. Many did not care about whether or not they could earn from putting their faces out there, even if you told them such an opportunity existed on the internet for their kids as well. They were more invested in their physical jobs and treated social media as a place where they could come cool off some steam. Then, the Covid year came and a whole lot of people were forced to sit at home for at least six whole months. This spiked an increase in the number of people interested in creating content, especially since they all thought earning a side income or followership from just dancing online, cracking jokes, and engaging in the messiest drama, was better than being idle. As the year went by, more people kept adopting social media as a place to make ends meet, and somewhere in the middle of this, parents decided that their kids were the ultimate tools for gaining engagement, gifts, and a full income from this gold mine called the internet.
alt=\

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-filming-a-person-with-a-camera-MSO8Og5Vvdg) You could open an Instagram business page today and you would see an under-10-year-old child consistently being used to advertise a product that is in no way related to their age or interests. You could also go through the social media pages of popular celebrity couples and realize that their only child has become the center of their content, and the number of videos they churn out sort of proves their need to gain social media validation and money through that kid, which is clearly a form of exploitation. Even worse, couples who have just given birth to their babies have made it a habit to create an Instagram page for their one-day-old kid who probably wouldn’t have loved to be an internet favorite, or even an extrovert like their parents have already dictated for them. These parents call for attention to the pages created and decide the social lives of their kids without proper thinking. I’m not saying it’s wrong for parents to want to set up their children for life with the opportunities that present themselves, but it is important to know that it’s very difficult to prioritize privacy and safety when one starts receiving so much engagement and significant income from their child’s content. In fact, it would be harder to consider the child’s needs over all the juicy offers and incentives the content brings, and we see this happening a lot on the internet.
alt=\

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-filming-a-person-with-a-camera-MSO8Og5Vvdg) Many of these children who have been turned into content creators are constantly harassed by perverts. So many unsolicited comments are sent to their pages by random strangers on the internet, and there’s just no privacy for these kids in most cases. Even the kids may grow up without the desire to be all out in people’s faces, but the fact that they live under their media-obsessed parents makes it harder for them to say NO to creating content. All of this could be dangerous, and somehow, these parents fail to understand it. Given the many disadvantages, I would advocate for the erasure of kids as content creators, especially for video content. But if they must, their engagement on social media should be seasonal. Their entire lives should not be put up every single week or day on the internet for strangers to see, follow, or dissect. I also believe that children should be at least teenagers before they become part-time content creators. Even then, they should be supervised at all times until they become adults. If they ever do decide at any point to leave content creation, it should be accepted without any withdrawal of privileges or exertion of control over them. I admit this might be difficult for parents who have built their lives on the internet, but I do hope that they can begin to protect their children more, even if it means ditching the social media incentives to prioritize the well being of their kids. * * *

content.description:
HiveReactKit improves vote precision, refreshes Activities UX, and adds inline editing with Snap poll voting.

# HiveReactKit 
## Precise Vote Percentage Display Improvements

### Two-Decimal Vote Percentage Support

- Vote percentages across HiveReactKit now display with two decimal places instead of rounding to whole numbers.  

- Vote values now correctly show precise strengths such as:
  - `0.25%`  
  - `1.50%`  
  - `12.75%`  


### Updated Across Multiple Screens

- Updated vote precision support in:
  - Post Votes list  
  - Simplified voters list  
  - User profile Curation Rewards section  
  - Activities tab  
  - Outgoing Votes  
  - Incoming Votes  


### Consistent Vote Strength Rendering

- Ensured vote percentages remain visually consistent across all engagement and reward-related UI sections.  

- Improved transparency for low-strength and fractional voting behavior.  


### HiveSuite Live Development Sync

- Linked local HiveReactKit directly into HiveSuite:
  - Changes appear instantly during development without publishing updates  


- Outcome:
  - More accurate reward and voting visibility  
  - Improved transparency for Hive users  
  - Better consistency across engagement interfaces  


Precise Vote Percentages
![Precise Vote Percentages](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc7Am1zSN5E7WGo6fmUeBgswjx94c9hXJsCdq9LjHoTfK/image.png)

Curation Rewards Vote Strength
![Curation Rewards Vote Strength](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMqg63Z1jdymDA6tbANK1566hTLuxWjsqTtbYfc5CKg2/image.png)



---

## Activities Tab UX Refresh

### Grouped Activity Filter Picker

- Refreshed Activities tab with grouped filter picker and mobile-friendly interaction improvements.  

- Activities filter now uses the same grouped layout as HiveHub:
  - Social Activities  
  - DApps  
  - Wallet  
  - Rewards  
  - Governance  
  - Account  
  - Others  


### Built-In Filter Search

- Added integrated search box directly inside the filter picker.  

- Improved discoverability for large activity-filter lists.  


### 3-Way Direction Toggle

- Replaced old direction dropdown with new 3-way toggle:
  - Left → Out  
  - Center → All  
  - Right → In  


- Center (`All`) is now the default state.  


### Mobile Layout Improvements

- Removed Activities tab search bar for cleaner layout.  

- Filter row now fits on a single line on mobile devices:
  - Direction toggle on left  
  - Filter picker + refresh on right  


- Added shorter labels:
  - Out  
  - All  
  - In  


### Profile Persistence

- Added support for host applications to remember:
  - Last-opened user profile tab  


- Outcome:
  - Cleaner Activities interface  
  - Better mobile usability  
  - Faster activity filtering and navigation experience  


Grouped Activity Filters
![Grouped Activity Filters](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWwJzsqvNATSAjQUJXcMoV1UEbwzPxN5MCWJRcnAXhbp/image.png)



3-Way Direction Toggle
![3-Way Direction Toggle](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQmpJG1AvbQU8NXsQKhpyT1GNQxBgpmyLdLfpkw1MoJEj/image.png)



---

## Inline Editing & Poll Voting in Snaps Feed

### Post & Comment Editing

- Added Edit support for content owners across HiveReactKit.  

- Post owners now see:
  - Edit option on post detail pages  


- Editor opens pre-filled with existing content for faster editing workflow.  


### Comment Editing Support

- Comment owners now see:
  - Edit option beside Reply  


- Supported across:
  - Standard comments  
  - Nested replies  


### Snap Editing Support

- Snap owners now see:
  - Edit option inside 3-dot Snap menu  


- Improved consistency between posts, comments, and Snaps management flows.  


### Poll Voting Inside Snaps Feed

- Snaps containing polls now render:
  - Poll question  
  - Poll choices  
  - Live vote tallies  
  - Vote button directly inside Snap cards  


- Poll layout matches the detail-page voting experience.  


### Advanced Poll Support

- Supports:
  - Single-choice polls  
  - Multi-choice polls  
  - “Change my vote” workflows (when enabled by poll settings)  


### Permission Visibility Rules

- Edit and poll-management actions remain hidden for:
  - Non-owners  
  - Logged-out viewers  


- Outcome:
  - Faster editing workflow for creators  
  - Richer interactive Snap experience  
  - Better inline engagement across HiveReactKit feeds  


Inline Post & Comment Editing
![Inline Post & Comment Editing Icon](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEApRmtVtcabR9AehrbFkNygjNytxxFQBv4mdythLJne/image.png)
![Comment Editing Composer](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwa89jZ7HmHoyiExoSTbPVZXELNeUu7ymP525Fg16FfG/image.png)



Poll Voting Inside Snaps Feed
![Poll Voting Inside Snaps Feed](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4oyttKZptPKDVNkRLSVgpDbnA2MZ1W6fqZKK3iYHsTJ/image.png)



---

## Powering the Hive Ecosystem

- Continuously improving creator workflows, engagement transparency, and interaction systems for Hive applications  
- Building scalable and creator-focused UI infrastructure for the Hive community  
- Contributing towards a cleaner, more interactive, and feature-rich Hive ecosystem

body.title: A Little Peace Under the Trees (eng-tr)
body.body:
Some days, we do not need a big plan to feel good. A quiet walk, a green park, a cup of tea, and a little time away from the internet can be enough. After walking among the trees, I found a calm place on the grass and decided to stay there for a while. The weather was beautiful. The sun was bright, but the trees gave a soft shade. The sky was blue, the grass was fresh, and everything around me felt peaceful.

>Bazı günler iyi hissetmek için büyük planlara ihtiyacımız olmuyor. Sessiz bir yürüyüş, yeşil bir park, bir bardak çay ve internetten biraz uzak kalmak yetebiliyor. Ağaçların arasında yürüdükten sonra çimenlerin üzerinde sakin bir yer buldum ve bir süre orada kalmaya karar verdim. Hava çok güzeldi. Güneş parlaktı ama ağaçlar yumuşak bir gölge veriyordu. Gökyüzü maviydi, çimenler tazeydi ve etrafımdaki her şey huzurlu hissettiriyordu.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwn1oZ3CbzRB2ER1T7VJFSZpEJGwAvZPYkFUcwx8ZZxC/img_3384.jpg)


This time I did something that I do not always do: I turned off my internet. No messages, no scrolling, no notifications. I just wanted to be there, in that moment. I had a few quiet instrumental songs downloaded on my phone, so I listened to them for a while. But after some time, I turned the music off too. I wanted to hear only the sound of the leaves, the birds, and the wind. It felt very simple, but it was exactly what I needed.

>Bu kez her zaman yapmadığım bir şey yaptım: internetimi kapattım. Mesaj yok, sosyal medya yok, bildirim yok. Sadece orada, o anın içinde olmak istedim. Telefonumda indirdiğim birkaç sakin, sözsüz müzik vardı; bir süre onları dinledim. Ama bir süre sonra müziği de kapattım. Sadece yaprakların, kuşların ve rüzgârın sesini duymak istedim. Çok sade bir andı ama tam da ihtiyacım olan şeydi.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmberwJhZN38vyBbXR3D8mGaJWtXHEKkRNkRvkpjQetY1V/img_3373.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXE9ysqB8Sxb54m97U81bnj7jQ7mBFFyCWktsgv9BhdLS/img_3374.jpg)

I had brought my tea with me. Since Eid had just passed, there were still some Eid candies at home, so I took a few of them too. I also had a small piece of lokum. Sitting on the grass with my tea, candies, and lokum made me smile. It reminded me that small joys are sometimes the most beautiful ones. A tiny sweet, a warm tea, and a quiet corner under the trees can change the mood of the whole day.

>Yanıma çayımı da almıştım. Bayram yeni geçtiği için evde hâlâ bayram şekerleri vardı, ben de birkaç tanesini yanıma aldım. Küçük bir lokumum da vardı. Çimenlerin üzerinde çayım, şekerlerim ve lokumumla oturmak beni gülümsetti. Küçük mutlulukların bazen en güzel mutluluklar olduğunu hatırlattı. Minicik bir tatlı, sıcak bir çay ve ağaçların altında sakin bir köşe bütün günün ruh halini değiştirebiliyor.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsGTCzPqHVoFkyah4qiNNwnBs78cUcMQVh3qNT3UJbsb/img_3377.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkeu2EEmXZbRmEeZYPFouF7fLB2idRTnWsmXFxSpDPaC/img_3376.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUethKXm2FBiNxrY2vN9fMsAKAm2mGT8q4ZV3Tqht1m7y/img_3375.jpg)

I stayed there for almost two hours. I leaned against a tree and just watched life around me. Children were playing in the park. Families were sitting together. Some people had brought their chairs and were having a small picnic. Some were talking, some were resting, and some were simply enjoying the fresh air. Watching them made me feel calm and motivated. It was like a small reminder that life is still beautiful in its ordinary moments.

>Neredeyse iki saat orada kaldım. Bir ağaca yaslandım ve sadece etrafımdaki hayatı izledim. Çocuklar parkta oynuyordu. Aileler birlikte oturuyordu. Bazı insanlar sandalyelerini getirmiş, küçük bir piknik yapıyordu. Kimi sohbet ediyor, kimi dinleniyor, kimi de sadece temiz havanın tadını çıkarıyordu. Onları izlemek bana sakinlik ve motivasyon verdi. Sanki hayatın sıradan anlarında da hâlâ çok güzel olduğunu hatırlatan küçük bir sahne gibiydi.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSBQrBZsH2BerZHPhGWHdT7t1YFzxCpQghrkh4WUHVHy/img_3378.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVTUJRiikdR7rc6CR9SgT76McSY4cx6EJXU2LQYmRuaF/img_3380.jpg)

Of course, I took some photos too. The trees, the green grass, the tea, the candies, the lokum… They were all part of this peaceful little memory. I love taking photos of simple moments like this because they carry a feeling. Later, when I look at them again, I can remember not only what I saw, but also how I felt.

>Tabii ki birkaç fotoğraf da çektim. Ağaçlar, yemyeşil çimenler, çay, şekerler, lokum… Hepsi bu huzurlu küçük anının bir parçasıydı. Böyle sade anları fotoğraflamayı seviyorum çünkü içlerinde bir duygu taşıyorlar. Daha sonra tekrar baktığımda sadece ne gördüğümü değil, nasıl hissettiğimi de hatırlıyorum.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcUokZKdkEAb9d9K1ac6tSmhdSuk9uFyRhvVPFw6yH4Aj/img_3381.jpg)

After this peaceful break, I slowly walked back home. On my way, I saw beautiful pink flowers by the fence. They looked so bright and full of life that I stopped and photographed them too. It felt like nature was saying goodbye to me with flowers. That little walk back home became a nice ending to my quiet afternoon.

>Bu huzurlu moladan sonra yavaş yavaş eve doğru yürüdüm. Yolumun üzerinde çitin kenarında çok güzel pembe çiçekler gördüm. O kadar canlı ve hayat dolu görünüyorlardı ki durup onları da fotoğrafladım. Sanki doğa bana çiçeklerle veda ediyordu. Eve dönüş yürüyüşüm de bu sakin öğleden sonraya güzel bir kapanış oldu.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrGv99UXKiw6mLfviiB39p9ZBoWQ3xDJWJ62nRf66WMp/img_3386.jpg)

When I came home, I felt lighter. I was not far away from the city, but for two hours I felt away from the rush of life. Turning off the internet helped me listen more, see more, and feel more. This small green break was not a big trip, but it became a beautiful memory for me. I am happy to share these simple, peaceful moments with the Photography Lovers community.

>Eve geldiğimde kendimi daha hafif hissettim. Şehirden çok uzağa gitmemiştim ama iki saatliğine hayatın telaşından uzaklaşmış gibiydim. İnterneti kapatmak daha çok dinlememe, daha çok görmeme ve daha çok hissetmeme yardımcı oldu. Bu küçük yeşil mola büyük bir gezi değildi ama benim için çok güzel bir anı oldu. Bu sade ve huzurlu anları Photography Lovers topluluğuyla paylaşmak beni mutlu ediyor.

Hoy fue uno de esos días tranquilos 🤍

Me desperté, hice café, respondí algunos mensajes y seguí con mis cosas de siempre. Afuera estaba haciendo más frío de lo normal, así que me tocó sacar uno de mis busos favoritos del clóset ☁️✨

Entre pendientes, pausas para pensar demasiado y uno que otro antojo durante el día, encontré un momento para sentarme un rato y simplemente disfrutar la calma. No pasó nada extraordinario, pero a veces esos terminan siendo mis días favoritos.

Definitivamente soy de las que se ponen de mejor humor cuando baja la temperatura 🫶🏼❄️

.
.
.
.
Today was one of those quiet, simple days 🤍

I woke up, made some coffee, replied to a few messages, and got on with my usual routine. It was colder than usual outside, so I finally had an excuse to pull out one of my favorite sweatshirts ☁️✨

Between work, random cravings, and a few moments spent overthinking, I found some time to sit down and simply enjoy the calm. Nothing extraordinary happened, but somehow those always end up being my favorite kind of days.

I'm definitely one of those people who instantly gets in a better mood when the temperature drops 🫶🏼❄️

Farmers, gardeners, and woodworkers need a reliable chainsaw that can handle tree pruning, firewood preparation, and farm maintenance efficiently.

For heavy-duty applications, petrol chainsaws are a popular choice because they offer strong cutting power and long working hours. They are suitable for cutting thick logs, branches, and hardwood. For lighter tasks, battery-operated and mini chainsaws provide excellent portability and ease of operation.

When selecting a chainsaw, consider factors such as engine performance, chain quality, safety features, ergonomic design, and maintenance requirements. A durable machine can reduce manual effort and help complete cutting tasks faster.

Modern chainsaws are designed to improve productivity while ensuring operator comfort and safety. Whether you work on a farm, manage a garden, or need a tool for regular wood-cutting jobs, investing in a quality chainsaw can make daily work easier and more efficient.

body.title: I've noticed something strange about the comfort of a city, any city.
body.body:
I've noticed something strange about the comfort of a city, any city. Or rather, it's not so much strange as it is contradictory, given the globalists' plans to lock people in a concrete jungle. The greener the city, the more parks and lawns it has, the more comfortable it is. That's true, but it runs counter to progress, which simply can't compete with nature in terms of comfort. ![42artstorDSC07714.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSixWZPqPBsK6hZz7aEJjTTP6pvS2cn4PyHQb6fypibDB/42artstorDSC07714.png) Moreover, control over natural spaces within cities is high because nature can easily reclaim the space that people have sealed off with concrete and asphalt. ![DSC01353.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcfyNjK4Qt7i72GzuPTPsASaF2Q5fDDjLkgHyjdR6hRgi/DSC01353.JPG) Not even the most educated architect can control this, and, in fact, lawns will always be a risk zone for cities, and without them, people will simply slide into a depressive abyss. ![43artstorDSC01822.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUH5jK57h9ZxrRxhkNKKHSKd2j6AkgcYTpxKZSiFsVbdq/43artstorDSC01822.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: Notes From the Waiting Room
body.body: # Notes From the Waiting Room\n\nSunday night. Kevin Warsh is about twenty-four hours away from the most watched Federal Reserve meeting in years — his first as Chair, the one the market has been stress-testing since February — and the President of the United States just went on NBC to say a rate hike would be \

Take a breath. Hold it.

The May jobs report dropped Thursday: 172,000 nonfarm payrolls, against a consensus sitting somewhere between 80,000 and 85,000. More than double what the street expected. Unemployment held at 4.3%. The three-month average is running at 188,000, which is not a labor market softening under pressure; it is a labor market that has decided the pressure isn't real. Rate hike odds at the CME jumped to 70% within hours. The Nasdaq dropped approximately 4% on the day of the jobs release as the implication travelled from the data to the bond market to the equity market in the sequence it always does when the Fed's next move suddenly looks like it's going in the wrong direction for risk assets.

And then, into this, Trump surfaces on Meet the Press to tell the incoming Fed Chair that tightening would be a mistake.

This is not a subtle market communication. It is a very loud one, delivered publicly, one day before the FOMC statement. The administration sent Warsh into the room with a presidential position paper already attached to his chair.

Warsh, to his credit, spent his entire confirmation process performing independence. He spoke carefully. He left room for data dependency. He did not promise cuts. He understood — or appeared to understand — that arriving as a known Trump appointment, in an institution whose prior chair was the subject of a Justice Department probe that most of the Fed's governors viewed as political intimidation, required some visible distance between himself and the White House policy wish list. Jerome Powell, to his considerable credit and considerable discomfort, is still sitting at that table. His governor term runs until 2028. The most recent FOMC meeting before Powell's chairmanship ended saw the most dissents in thirty-four years. Warsh inherits a committee that is not uniformly deferential. Paul Tudor Jones said flatly in May there was \
Warsh cuts rates. Capital Economics is writing about \

in the second half of the year.

Into this committee, into this inflation picture — CPI running at 3.3% year-over-year in March, the highest since 2022, still moving away from the 2% target rather than toward it, largely driven by the energy shock out of the Iran conflict but not exclusively — the new chair walks on his first day of the job and the market is pricing a 70% probability of a hike before year-end.

And the President says hiking would be wrong.

There's a version of Warsh's biography in which this was always the destination. He came in with a reputation as an inflation hawk, a balance sheet disciplinarian, a man who thought the post-pandemic Fed stayed easy for too long and said so loudly. He was supposed to be the tightening chair, the credibility-restoration project. Then the inflation surprise hit, the bond market started asking harder questions, and suddenly the \
framing that followed his appointment is colliding at 60 miles per hour with an economy adding 172,000 jobs in a month that everyone expected to be quiet.\n\nEd Yardeni, who coined the phrase \

in 1983 and has been watching this movie since before most of the traders currently pricing rate probabilities were born, argued recently that Warsh may have to hike simply to establish credibility with the bond market — that failing to signal attunement to inflation risks would invite the vigilantes to do the job for him via rising Treasury yields. That's the trap. You come in wanting to cut, the economy won't let you, and now the choice is between doing nothing and watching yields drift uncomfortably higher, or hiking and making the President publicly angry within the first week of the job.\n\nGoldman Sachs, characteristically, is holding the line: \

This is what Goldman always does — they build a sensible central case and then stay there until reality becomes too loud to ignore. The pause case is coherent. The labor market is tighter than expected but not booming; hiring mobility is below historical norms; white-collar categories are still running negative on three-month job growth; wage gains are present but not aggressive. The inflation surge has an identifiable external cause. A reasonable central banker might look at this and decide that holding at 3.5-3.75% is the right call, let the oil pass-through fade, revisit in September.

But that's the technical analysis. The political analysis is dirtier.

The bond market does not particularly care about the internal FOMC deliberations. It cares about whether the institution is credible and whether the Chair has the spine to follow the data regardless of who appointed him. Every public statement from the White House pressuring the Fed in one direction raises the implicit cost of moving in that direction. If Warsh holds or hints at cuts this week, a non-trivial part of the market will wonder whether the data drove the decision. The doubt is the damage, even if the decision itself is technically defensible.

Powell understood this. His entire final chapter at the Fed was a slow-motion demonstration that the institution would move based on inflation and employment data even if the political pressure was pointing somewhere else. He paid for that understanding in ways most Fed chairs don't. Warsh has watched all of it from close range.

The June meeting will hold. Almost certainly. The jobs number alone doesn't create the consensus for a hike, and hiking at a debut meeting, over presidential objection, with Goldman and several FOMC governors publicly skeptical, would be a different kind of statement. But the statement Warsh makes in the press conference — how he characterizes the inflation trajectory, whether he opens or closes the door to future action, how he handles the first question that implicitly references the President's comments on NBC — that is the actual event.

Monetary policy is made at the margin of language. Everyone already knows the rate is holding. What they don't know is whether the new chair has decided, quietly, who he actually works for.

That question will be partially answered tomorrow. Not fully. These things rarely are.

body.title: Opportunity Favours The Prepared
body.body: <div class=\

> Everyone desires opportunities, like a good job, business growth, academic success, leadership position, or one form of success or the other. However, one very fundamental truth about success that I have observed is that opportunities will always favour the ones prepared for it. It is true that opportunities may come unexpectedly and even from places you may least expect, but it takes a level of preparedness to be able to even recognise opportunity when it comes, and then maximise it to produce a good result.
![20260607_164632.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSkSp7kFm3ZSrQzD6wtMafxNmAJPZwxyQbCNjfKJXqivX/20260607_164632.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/shadow-of-a-hand-holding-a-key-on-wall-8470841)
While we were in school, I and a couple of my friends decided to acquire a particular school. We shared the idea with others. Some accepted the idea, while some did not. It was during the break period. So we started the training. The people who accepted contributed some funds and called a facilitator who trained us. The training lasted about 6 weeks and then we gained extensive knowledge about the skills. We did not see an immediate gain in it, but we still acquired it nonetheless. Others said that we were wasting our time, but it did not stop us from completing it. Fastforward to when we wanted to go for our internship for a couple of months, and there was a particular company that we wanted. The company was highly competitive because a lot of students wanted it, so they brought in another qualification for new intakes. Incidentally, the requirement was that the intakes would have to possess that skill for immediate consideration. Those of us who had it was given instant employment. Then the others were passed through some very rigorous interview processes, which some lost out. You see, the opportunity was available for all of us, but what made a difference was that some were prepared for it, while some did not prepare. This should show you that opportunities often favour the people who are prepared for them. Preparation includes the process of developing skills, character, knowledge, discipline, and getting ready for future opportunities. More often than not, it happens quietly even long before you will see the reward. But unfortunately, a lot of people only focus on the opportunity that they want to have, while neglecting the processes that would make them to maximise the blessedness in it. Even when the opportunity arrives, they may not be able to take full delivery of it. Imagine someone who wants to become a barrister but he has not taken time to go to law school. If the opportunity comes to be called to bar, they will not include him because he has not attended law school. One of the reasons why preparation is very important is that opportunities will no give you prior notice or advance information before they come. The question you should ask yourself is; if the job you are waiting for, or the connection you need, or the scholarship you expect, or the leadership role you want, etc, just suddenly come your way, how prepared are you to take delivery of it and maximise it? Those who have invested time, effort, and resources towards building and developing themselves, will be ready to take the next step forward. On the other hand, those who do not prepare themselves will not even know when opportunity comes, and they will keep hoping for it.
![20260607_165148.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS87b9dFgguJ6RtNJPq37ukMx3nZtxJ6jUHtwQezmkUbp/20260607_165148.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/text-on-wall-17242671)
It is worthy to note that preparation gives one extra confidence. If you are going into an examination that you have extensively studied for, for example, there will be a kind of confidence that you will have to be able to pass it well. This is actually the reason why you see athletes train and prepare before they go for competition. When you practice well, it will make you to believe more in your ability to handle new responsibilities. You will agree with me that confidence is not based on wishful thinking, but on competence. You are more likely to perform effectively when you have prepared for a task. You do not have to wait for the opportunity that you have been wishing for to come knocking at your door first before you prepare for it. In fact, you need to get ready and then live ready. The truth is that the more you prepare, the better your chances to even recognise opportunities when they come, and the more you will be able to take advantage and maximise them. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Homefront (2013) | Movie Review
body.body: <div class=\

>


![HOMEFRONT.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23vho8Ars1UHiZhQP8V6vNCGGRz9Aq46DUQ3nCo8bqFkTDPaedZT5Bs3zodUZxZ8BnQik.png)


I've watched many movies and plots about a retired hero tries to leave his dangerous past behind only to be forced back into violence when trouble finds him, but Homefront (2013) is one of my most favorite action movie. Despite its familiar premise, the film manages to be more engaging than expected thanks to its emotional core, solid performances, and a surprisingly effective father-daughter relationship.

<div class=\
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/Eo8QqHEQgpscQS9yPKEADuU6KjjquwmBGCyhHCKrn1fJb4QSwBj1TaUM4w1E7X9yZCx.png

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23tvaTBVFEDpNiYsjnYQocqaTvGv3ZkP1jfHURCCxFa3sgomC21HRJ6LvjYnazN3BYMkq.png --- Directed by Gary Fleder and written by Sylvester Stallone, Homefront is based on the novel by Chuck Logan. The film stars **Jason Statham** as Phil Broker, a former DEA agent who moves to a quiet Louisiana town with his young daughter, hoping for a fresh start after a turbulent past. Unfortunately, what begins as a simple schoolyard conflict (involving his daughter) quickly escalates into a dangerous feud involving local criminals and drug traffickers. ####
**A Different Kind of Jason Statham Film**
Most people watch a Jason Statham movie expecting fast-paced action, brutal fights, and a nearly unstoppable protagonist. Homefront certainly delivers those elements, but what makes it stand out is that it spends time developing its characters before the punches start flying. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23uQtf1GAdJeuWcGBzPedTmmqz5fsR1fXFcSkDWwxHTcuUMyTLqJCeSeby2wZU13Qxm6P.png) Phil Broker (Jason Statham) is not portrayed as a reckless action hero looking for trouble. Instead, he is a father trying to protect his daughter and build a peaceful life. The film takes its time showing their bond, making the stakes feel more personal whenever danger approaches. Rather than fighting because he enjoys it, Broker fights because circumstances leave him with no other choice. This approach gives the story more emotional weight than many action films in the same genre. ####
**Strong Performances Across the Board**
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wBTc5mLX7w6aWJX7m7Pva5iBvEC2cuZNoBprHQFB9xNfpVR4D1T2swqGMMrniKc8Xkc.png) Jason Statham delivers one of the more restrained performances of his career. While he remains convincing during the action sequences, some of the film’s best moments come from unchaotic scenes between Broker and his daughter, Maddy. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23zGWGdchq1vc3FofRpxnbCXUc3swfyNUeggssbrAtSvN7SoKLbM2Yniw3hNhdjudD3yZ.png) Young actress Izabela Vidovic does an excellent job portraying Maddy. She is not written as a helpless child who constantly needs rescuing. Instead, she is intelligent, brave, and emotionally grounded, making her relationship with her father feel authentic. Anyways, she is brought up and taught to fight back. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/Eo6Cd4RjG5fx2J1dJ8FokgG5TAjWGadZxhKnZRu13aeGBTJ5PbjK1o7gYdtPrggoYf1.png) The supporting cast also deserves recognition. James Franco plays Gator Bodine, a local drug dealer who becomes entangled in the conflict. Rather than creating a cartoonishly evil villain, Franco portrays Gator as a flawed and increasingly desperate man whose bad decisions continue to spiral out of control. Meanwhile, Winona Ryder and Kate Bosworth add tension and unpredictability to the story. ####
**What Works Best**
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23w2D6Z3JRzrazm36EvkMcFrzWFaLUvUA7y9VwCPQzv5eRGeyUwL9nUJh5ALD5odYRTcW.png) Actually, one of the film's greatest strengths is its pacing. The conflict develops gradually instead of immediately exploding into gunfights and explosions. A seemingly minor incident between children triggers a chain reaction that grows larger with each decision made by the adults involved (the lesson I learned the hard way). This progression makes the escalation feel believable within the film's world. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/Eo1wMPBLpDVNf3VkMEPqAkAp6vW639LGHU7UmQHbcRDwGvkjycGveqGgBwSnyPKKgsq.png) The Louisiana setting also contributes to the atmosphere. The rural environment, isolated properties, and backwoods criminal operations create a sense of unease that fits the story well. The town feels less like a backdrop and more like an active part of the narrative. ####
**Where the Film Falls Short**
Despite its strengths, Homefront is not without flaws. Some plot developments require a considerable suspension of disbelief, and certain action-thriller clichés are difficult to ignore. The story occasionally relies on convenient circumstances to keep the conflict moving forward. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23tvAeiYFaouMAJSTGucx9XG6wwFNbucE8HYvcDHCScs4gjXie9PJAqq5CMudBWnoWx8U.png) The final act also shifts into more traditional action-movie territory. While entertaining, it abandons some of the nuanced character work that the film carefully builds earlier. Viewers hoping for a completely fresh take on the genre may find the conclusion somewhat predictable. ####
**Final Verdict**
The way I see it, Homefront is not a revolutionary action thriller, nor does it attempt to reinvent the genre. But, it succeeds by combining satisfying action with genuine emotional investment. For me, the father-daughter relationship gives the story heart, while the performances help elevate what could have been a routine action film into something more memorable. So if you're looking for a deep psychological drama, this may not be the movie for you. But if you enjoy action films and unapologetic, tough guy cinema, this movie is for you. **Rating**: 8.9/10 Homefront proves that sometimes a familiar story can still be effective when it's told with sincerity, strong performances, and characters worth caring about.

body.body:
Hiking kit. Every traveler has their own tried-and-true set of essentials for a hike, no matter what the trip. Lately, I've been trying to pack a minimum of useful gear: a camera in case I have the opportunity to capture something interesting, a bag, and a pocketknife in case I find mushrooms or berries in the forest. But recently, I've been thinking about carrying a merp with me when walking around the lake. LOL. Yes, it might look strange, but by cutting some dried reeds, you can grow oyster mushrooms on them. ![DSC04064.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWdB1khKTAzU5PZBSC45xHbHHuM8dMk1a7EjXbUJBCf39/DSC04064.JPG) Judging by the fact that municipal services spend a lot of money clearing reeds from lakes, they'll be grateful if you save them some extra work. body.title: Large push to eliminate fleas and ticks at the Tiger Cave Temple
body.body:
Fleas and ticks as well as other parasites are a very big problem for dogs and cats all around the world.  This is especially true in a place like Thailand where the weather is warm or even blisteringly hot all the time.   The humidity contributes to this environment being absolutely perfect for parasites to spread and even thrive on animals, especially those without real homes.   This is more true with dogs than with cats because dogs are pack animals and will gather together even if one or more of them is infested.  Ticks aren't all that harmful on their own, but they can lead to wounds that can become infected and this is a big problem particularly if the dog cannot reach the area in order to clean it.  

Bravecto is just one of many brand names that involves *fluralaner* which is an ingredient that kills parasites and prevents re-infestation for up to 4 months.  In Thailand this product is very affordable but for an organization like ours that is always stretched so thin with our budget, we can't afford as much of it as we would like.  So this donation from a donor who wishes to remain anonymous was so wonderful to receive.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23wMaeodVsmfSRM63JF6pboKsXkeXLQYFNAu2G194XJichFVM8z6oqpKc3rwnoQLeCAKt.png)
</center>

We are not sponsored by Bravecto (I wish we were!) so this isn't an advertisement for them in any way.  Honestly, there isn't much difference between any of these products but Bravecto is just the one that is most readily available here in Krabi, Thailand.   

What makes this product so great is that most dogs are happy as can be to simply eat the medicine because they have engineered it so that it is a treat of sorts.  The dogs that are a bit more fussy about what they eat can be convinced to swallow it with a bit of peanut butter or chicken broth.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23uQvrqLxWzrvrUEKPM3iMQmRiUCgrUDCv4vnLydDQwsZQM8axUt9qUos1iAVXTz3XzB2.png)
</center>

There are more than 50 stray dogs that reside at the Tiger Cave Temple, and the location is a bit of a pet project for us because even since we got involved at this temple, the quality of life for all the animals here, even the native monkeys, have improved since we took the project on. 

Fighting parasites is a tough thing to do because it is a battle that you can't ever truly win.   By treating all of the dogs at the same time though, this gives us  3-4 month window of opportunity to evaluate other potential issues with the dogs and cats that live there.  The real issue was ensuring that we didn't accidentally dose any of the dogs twice.  This was solved with a can of water soluble \

that is actually an antiseptic that is commonly used on minor wounds for dogs, cats, and even people in Thailand.   

<center> https://mariposatree.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/img_4714.jpg
[src](https://mariposatree.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/img_4714.jpg)</center>

It didn't occur to me to take a photo of all the purple dogs when we were doing this, because it was a very busy day.  It can be quite complicated to give each animal just one treat without there being some sort of competition between the males, and then of course we have the stubborn ones that don't really want to eat it.   

It isn't massively dangerous if a dog ends up with more than one dose.  We weren't afraid of overdose, we were afraid of accidentally wasting our limited supplies.  It was a pretty effective and cute process though, if the dog was already purple, that meant that they already had their medicine. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23xVM9UmkEBLDD65VJrthxf7C6GKUUz5d47VBrQya3htFXtzBEmZMGLMGzrocgvjX7tBf.png)
</center>

This marks the first time ever that we have been able to treat every single animal at the same time anywhere, so it is a pretty special day for our organization.  

This is a temporary \

though, we are aware of this. While it would be possible at a private residence to completely eliminate fleas and ticks as well as prevent their reintroduction, there are hundreds of monkey at that also live at this temple and there is no way you would ever be able to treat all of them. While I wouldn't exactly call the monkeys and dogs pals, they do wander among one another and after the 3-4 months, the monkeys will end up re-introducing fleas and ticks to the dog pack. This is fine and normal, but this mass treatment gives us a chance to really get the situation under control and make sure that it stays that way as long as we pay attention. The monks are instrumental in helping us with this because they live there and we do not. They have been very helpful as far as letting us know about any problems. All of our fur-friends will be a lot less itchy this rainy season, and that makes everyone happy.
If you would like to see how you can help out or simply spread the word, please visit our website at

http://krabianimalwelfare.org

![21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXHEhXj4e6AzsbAJKsFo8csozuoq1uUcMSdFQTYifzi55/21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg)
Krabi Animal Welfare is a charity run entirely by volunteers and are a registered non-profit organization in Thailand and the U.K.. We aim to relieve the pain and suffering of dogs and cats within Krabi Province. เป็นผู้สนับสนุนรายเดือนหรือบริจาคครั้งเดียวได้ที่: http://krabianimalwelfare.org

body.title: О четвертій дня буває ніч
body.body:
Гуляючи чудовим червневим ранком із собачкою околицями нашого містечка, частіше за все думається про життя. Краса навколишнього світу тішить око, але війна в Україні, горе та руйнування, які принесли нам російські загарбники, затьмарюють будь-яку красу. І коли любиш червневу пору саме за довгий світловий день, бо маєш +6 годин савітла вечорами і +6 - ранками, порівняно з листопадом-груднем, - мимоволі усвідомлюєш, що росіянські варвари і в червні приносять багатьом людям темряву. Адже на випалених землях, де повно мін, у зруйнованих селах, де жодна хата не вціліла, де посічені снарядами сади та ліси перестають бути надійним прихистком для тварин і птахів, не скоро настане ось таке світло, як маю я... І не пройдеться ніхто понівеченими полями, не зупиниться біля ставу, щоб сфотографувати красуню чаплю... Не зачепить рукою повні пилку квітучі трави, здійнявши ароматну хмару алергенного пилку і чхаючи потім до самого обіду...
Ніч о четвертій дня буває природною, якщо це осінь та зима. А буває рукотворною, коли ті, хто пішов на заклик безумного царя вбивати і руйнувати, забулися, що вони народжені ТВОРИТИ...
Війна закінчиться. Відродяться з часом ліси, луки, поля і ріки. Відбудуються міста та села. 
Виростуть нові покоління незламних українців.

##### 2️⃣ Summer, dry season, wet season, or fall — what is your favorite thing about the current season in your country and/or the thing you dislike the most about it? > Verano, estación seca, estación húmeda u otoño: ¿qué es lo que más le gusta de la temporada actual en su país y/o lo que más le desagrada de ella?
![1622823420865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/Ep7u5B2tw6pzWExycRHCzovEzYyDQmYdLPV95hg9Y96if7af3A18YSftbdUyfZ4wCtg.jpg)

> The seasons of the year represent changes that we should appreciate with love, but there is always one that we like the most. Although I am a lover of warm weather—the kind that gives us dry days and beautiful sunsets—I must say that I also like humid weather, since in one way or another, it brings us closer to nature. However, it’s not great all the time, as too much humidity can cause discomfort. Generally speaking, I love warm climates with average, comfortable temperatures for human beings, but a little sun from time to time is good. Currently, though, there is a lot of rain in my city, which frustrates me a bit since there are things you just can't do during this season. Even so, I still enjoy the things that life and nature bring us. The city where I am currently living is quite humid. You can see it with the naked eye just by looking at the facades of some buildings, and for me, that's a bit uncomfortable. However, I’m getting used to it since I come from a very hot city near the sea to another one that is totally different. Truth is, I love my hot weather, but I can't deny that this humid climate makes you want to hug your pillow and sleep peacefully. It does become tragic when we have to work, though, because this humid season makes you feel so lazy, which makes working feel like a much bigger chore. I thank God that in our country we can count on different climates, with seasons that play a fundamental role in the life of every human being. Not all seasons of the year occur in Venezuela, but the ones we do have make us see life in a different way; they make us adapt and smile at whatever happens around us.

> ``` Las estaciones del año representan cambios los cuales debemos apreciar con amor, pero siempre hay uno que nos gusta más, aunque soy amante al clima cálido, esos que nos regala un tiempo seco como hermosos atardecer, debe decir que el clima húmedo también me gusta ya que de alguna u otra forma nos acerca a la naturaleza, pero no todo el tiempo es bueno ya que mucha húmeda puede ocasionar malestar. En lo general amo los climas cálidos, con temperaturas promedios para el ser humano, pero de vez en cuando el sol es bueno, aunque actualmente en mi ciudad hay muchas lluvias y eso me enfada un poco ya que hay cosas que no permite que se hagan bajo esta estación, aun así disfruto de las cosas que nos brinda la vida y la naturaleza. En la ciudad donde me encuentro actualmente viviendo, es bastante húmeda, eso lo podemos ver a simple vista solo con las fachadas de algunos lugares, y eso para mi es algo que me incomoda, pero que me estoy acostumbrando ya que vengo de una ciudad muy caliente y cerca del mar, a otra totalmente distinta, de verdad que amo mi clima caliente, pero no puedo dejar atrás este clima húmedo que nos da con abrazar la almohada y dormir plácidamente, pero se vuelve trágico cuando tenemos que trabajar, ya que esta estación húmeda da mucha flojera, entonces trabajar lo hace más flojo. Doy gracias a Dios de que en nuestro país podemos contar con climas diferentes con estaciones que juegan un papel fundamental en la vida de cada ser humano. Las estaciones del año no todos se dan en Venezuela, pero las que tenemos nos hacen ver la vida de otra manera, nos hace adaptarnos y sonreír con lo que sucede a nuestro alrededor. ```

body.title: The Biggest Myths About SSC Exams That Are Slowing You Down
body.body:
Every year, thousands of aspirants prepare for SSC and railway exams with the dream of securing a stable government career. Yet many students delay their preparation or lose confidence because of common myths surrounding competitive exams. These misconceptions create unnecessary fear, confusion, and self-doubt, making preparation harder than it actually is.  
With proper guidance, structured learning, and consistent practice, cracking SSC exams becomes much more achievable. Institutes like DOTS Academy have helped many aspirants across Kerala overcome these misconceptions through practical training methods and exam-focused preparation strategies.  
Myth 1: You Need to Study 10–12 Hours Every Day  
One of the biggest myths about SSC preparation is that success requires studying all day. In reality, smart preparation matters far more than long study hours.  
Many successful candidates are college students, part-time workers, or working professionals who prepare consistently for a few focused hours daily. Regular revision, mock tests, and proper planning often produce better results than exhausting study routines.  
This is why structured programs such as SSC degree level coaching in Kerala, SSC degree level coaching in Kollam, and SSC higher secondary level coaching in Kerala focus on productivity, time management, and concept clarity rather than simply increasing study hours. Aspirants searching for reliable SSC coaching in Kerala, SSC coaching in Kollam, or SSC coaching in Trivandrum are now focusing more on smart preparation strategies instead of long study schedules.  
Myth 2: SSC Exams Are Only for Toppers  
A large number of aspirants believe SSC exams can only be cleared by exceptionally brilliant students. The truth is completely different.  
SSC exams mainly test:  
• Accuracy  
• Consistency  
• Speed  
• Practice  
• Time management  
Most toppers improve gradually through regular preparation and mock test practice. Students preparing through SSC online coaching Kerala and Online SSC classes in Kerala often experience steady improvement because of disciplined learning and continuous evaluation.  
Myth 3: Online Coaching Is Less Effective Than Classroom Coaching  
Many aspirants still believe online learning cannot match offline classroom coaching. However, modern online preparation methods provide flexibility and accessibility that benefit busy students and working professionals.  
Programs like SSC CGL online coaching in Kerala allow aspirants to:  
• Attend classes from anywhere  
• Access recorded sessions  
• Revise difficult topics multiple times  
• Practice online mock tests regularly  
• Manage studies alongside work or college  
This flexible learning approach has become increasingly popular among aspirants preparing for SSC, PSC, and railway exams across Kerala. Many students looking for SSC coaching in Trivandrum and SSC coaching in Kollam now prefer hybrid learning options that combine online and offline support.  
Myth 4: Railway Exams and SSC Exams Need Completely Separate Preparation  
Another common misconception is that RRB and SSC exams require entirely different preparation strategies. In reality, much of the syllabus overlaps, especially in:  
• Quantitative aptitude  
• Reasoning  
• General awareness  
• English language  
Aspirants preparing through RRB Coaching in Trivandrum or RRB coaching in Kollam can often prepare simultaneously for SSC exams with proper planning and guidance.  
Integrated preparation strategies help candidates maximize opportunities across multiple government exams without starting from scratch every time.  
Myth 5: English Medium Students Have a Bigger Advantage  
Students from Malayalam medium backgrounds sometimes feel disadvantaged while preparing for SSC exams. But SSC exams are not designed only for English medium students.  
With regular practice and proper mentorship, students from all academic backgrounds can improve their communication skills, reasoning ability, and exam performance. Coaching programs like CHSL coaching in Trivandrum and CHSL coaching in Kollam are designed to support aspirants step by step, helping them build confidence gradually.  
Myth 6: It’s Too Late to Start SSC Preparation  
Many aspirants postpone preparation because they think others are already ahead. But success in SSC exams depends more on focused preparation than on how early someone starts.  
A well-planned preparation strategy that includes:  
• Daily practice  
• Revision  
• Mock tests  
• Performance analysis  
• Time management  
can create noticeable improvement within a few months.  
Guided learning platforms such as DOTS Academy help aspirants follow systematic preparation methods without feeling overwhelmed by the competition. Students searching for trusted SSC coaching in Kerala often benefit more from consistency and expert mentorship than from rushed preparation methods.  
Stop Believing Myths and Start Preparing Smartly  
Myths and unnecessary fear often become bigger obstacles than the exams themselves. SSC preparation becomes much easier when aspirants focus on consistency, smart strategies, and proper guidance instead of misinformation.  
Whether you are searching for Best online PSC classes in Kerala, CGL coaching in Trivandrum, flexible Online SSC classes in Kerala, or dependable SSC coaching in Kollam, the right preparation approach can make a huge difference in your confidence and performance.  
With structured learning, regular mock tests, expert mentorship, and flexible preparation methods, DOTS Academy continues to support aspirants preparing for SSC, RRB, CHSL, and PSC exams across Kerala. From SSC coaching in Trivandrum to SSC degree level coaching in Kollam, DOTS Academy helps aspirants move confidently toward government exam success with disciplined and result-oriented preparation.

body.title: Shy princess flower
body.body: > Amidst the green grass and lush foliage, a beautiful flower was flaunting its beauty. Its color was stunning, a stunning purplish pink. It was the shy princess flower, or Mimosa pudica in Latin. This plant doesn't grow in a manicured garden, but rather in the wild alongside other grasses and shrubs. Although the plant receives no human attention or care, it produces flowers no less beautiful than those found in ornamental gardens.

> I didn't find any other flowers there, just that one flower. It stood gracefully, like a secret of nature revealed only to those willing to pause and observe. Its charm was truly breathtaking. Look at its stunning petals, resembling strands of silk threads radiating from a single point. From a distance, the flower resembles a ball of cotton playing in the wind among the green leaves.

> This plant is one of the most unique plants I've ever encountered. When touched, its leaves close and reopen when conditions are safe. A truly unique characteristic that no other plant has ever had.

body.title: Children into Social Media as influencers
body.body: alt=\

/>

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

There was a popular family whose husband and wife are both celebrities. They gave birth to a child, and just a few weeks later, they created a social media account for the child. At the announcement, the account hit a million followers. The account had no content yet, but it already had a million followers. One would ask: what made people follow the account when it was empty and belonged to a child whose account was being controlled by the parents? Anyway, I don't know what motivated people to follow the account. I don't fall for such things because I see no reason for parents to rush to create social media accounts for a child who isn't even a year old. I also blame the _gullible_ people who followed the account. But that's the trend now, we can't help it.

I see the actions of the parents as exploitation and nothing more.

No lies, I know that the internet is one of the ways people make a good living these days through various activities on social media, and it is surely a good way to secure a substantial amount of money for children to cater to their education and other needs. However, the rate at which people are doing it these days is quite appalling.

The example I mentioned above is even acceptable because the parents are definitely going to control the account until the child reaches a certain age. However, there are some cases where children are allowed to have control of their own accounts. Even when the parents maintain control of the account, it can still be viewed as exploitation.

On the other hand, children being influencers can be a good way to bring out their potential. I have seen cases where children developed confidence in public speaking through their involvement in social media content. Now they're grown, it has become a part of their life, and crowds don't frighten them at all. Most times, these Children grow up mastering a good craft, and it becomes part of them and also makes a way for them when they're adults, with this, even though the parents were about making ends meet through the account, the career of the child is being built gradually.

There was one we had a few years back, Emmanuella by name, a very little girl at the time she came into the spotlight, who was known for her sharp comedic acts. She was brought up by a comedy group, although they have parted ways already. The girl is now an adult. She was well managed by the group, although there were also cases of exploitation. The girl was very young when she was dragged into social media.  
The girl, now an adult, has millions of followers on her social media accounts, and she has bagged a lot of ambassadorial deals that are making waves for her.

So, if these accounts and contents are properly managed, and the child is adequately guided, there may not be any problem. However, it becomes a serious issue when the child is allowed to post inappropriate or weird content simply for the sake of making money.

Thanks for reading.

body.body: Why had tying her shoelaces become so difficult? A group of girls was waiting for her, but she had no real place among them. In truth, they were not her friends. Only one of them was her neighbor; the rest were friends of hers. She lifted her head and walked along with them. No one spoke to her on the way. No one seemed to care whether she was there or not. To the others, she was little more than a vague shadow, someone they instinctively avoided. When she got home, she didn't want to go back to school anymore. She wanted to lock the doors and disappear into her solitude forever. Then came the day of the school trip. Groups of girls were scattered around the garden, chatting, laughing, and sharing snacks. She drifted from one group to another, but everywhere she went, the same feeling followed her: she didn't belong. The trip came to an end, and everyone headed back toward the bus. The bus was only half full, and the driver hadn't even climbed aboard yet when it suddenly began to roll forward. Some students screamed. Others tried to jump off the moving bus. She, however, pushed her way to the driver's seat and pulled the handbrake. The bus came to a stop. Now she was a hero. People looked at her differently. She was still a stranger, but now she was a heroic stranger. In the schoolyard, students gathered around her, asking about that day and wanting to hear the story again and again. Even the teachers wanted to hear the story from her own lips. In the hallways, everyone called her a hero. Yet she still had no friends. Being a hero felt like an empty shell—something people could see from the outside, while there was nothing inside it that truly belonged to her. She wished she could be one of them, but she wasn't. Everyone else seemed relieved. The story had found its ending for them. But not for her. She didn't want to be the star hero, the girl who saved the bus. She just wanted to be Star—herself. She wanted people to know her as she was, not through a single moment frozen in time. But now an entire title had swallowed her whole. Everything she was—her thoughts, her fears, her contradictions, the hidden corners of her personality—had been buried beneath a single name: The Girl Who Saved the Bus.

title.title: A Glimpse of Last Month's Manggahan Festival in Guimaras
title.body:
/>

Manggahan Festival is one of the fun and colorful festivals in Guimaras. There were a lot of events, activities, and programs held for almost a month. The official program lasted 10 days, but there were pre-festival activities in and out of the province. For that, I captured so many photos since the start.

<table style=\

>

* * * * * * Today, I will share some of the photos I took in the Manga Village. It was where the Mango Eat-all-you-can was held. There were also souvenir shops, gift shops, and travel treats stalls. Here are photos of some souvenir stalls selling wood crafts, hats, accessories, bags, fans, keychains, wallets, and more.
/> * * * * * * The mango stores are next. They displayed mango chandeliers to make their booth attractive to guests and customers. There was also an art display.
/> * * * * * * In one corner, I saw a photo booth. I saw kids and parents loving the area because of some fun accessories and props they can use.
/> * * * * * * At the back, there were RTW shops that sell clothes. Some offer printing services where you can buy t-shirts, purses, and hats with Manggahan prints on them.

>Texts and Images by @vvodjiu
The lead photo was edited on Canva
All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements
