title.title: Teil 3 - Ein theoretisches Modell biologischer Planetenkolonisation / Part 3 - A theoretical model of biological planetary colonisation
title.body: >Kapitel 3 – Eusoziale Organisation und Kastenstruktur des Mars-Superorganismus / Chapter 3 – Eusocial Organization and Caste Structure of the Martian Superorganism

>

Die extremen Umweltbedingungen des Mars begünstigen Strategien, bei denen Ressourcen zentral verwaltet und Risiken auf viele Individuen verteilt werden. Unter solchen Bedingungen könnte die Evolution eines eusozialen Systems erhebliche Vorteile bieten.

Im vorliegenden Modell wird davon ausgegangen, dass die marsianische Spezies nicht als Ansammlung einzelner Organismen betrachtet werden kann. Vielmehr bildet die gesamte Kolonie einen funktionalen Superorganismus, dessen einzelne Mitglieder hochspezialisierte biologische Aufgaben übernehmen.

Ähnlich wie die Organe eines Körpers nur gemeinsam lebensfähig sind, besitzen die verschiedenen Kasten des Schwarms außerhalb des Kollektivs nur eine begrenzte Überlebensfähigkeit.

>

The extreme environmental conditions on Mars favor strategies in which resources are managed centrally and risks are distributed among many individuals. Under such conditions, the evolution of a eusocial system could offer significant advantages.

In the present model, it is assumed that the Martian species cannot be regarded as a collection of individual organisms. Rather, the entire colony forms a functional superorganism whose individual members perform highly specialized biological tasks.

Just as the organs of a body are only viable when working together, the various castes of the swarm have only limited survivability outside the collective.

* * *

>

3.1 The Basic Principle of Eusociality

>

Die Organisation basiert auf drei biologischen Grundprinzipien:

>

The organization is based on three fundamental biological principles:

>

Arbeitsteilung

Jede Kaste erfüllt klar definierte Aufgaben.

>

Division of Labor

Each caste performs clearly defined tasks.

>

Cooperative brood care

The chicks are raised collectively.

>

Reproduktive Spezialisierung

Nur wenige Individuen pflanzen sich fort.

>

Reproductive Specialization

Only a few individuals reproduce.

>

Diese Struktur ermöglicht eine wesentlich höhere Effizienz als ein System unabhängiger Einzelorganismen.

>

This structure allows for significantly greater efficiency than a system of independent individual organisms.

* * *

>

Eine typische Kolonie besteht aus mehreren Ebenen.

>

A typical colony consists of several levels.

>

Oberflächenzone

Verantwortlich für:

● Rohstoffgewinnung

● Erkundung

● Energiegewinnung

● Verteidigung

Bewohner:

● Arbeiter-Drohnen

● Krieger

● Späher

>

Surface Zone

Responsible for:

● Resource gathering

● Exploration

● Energy production

● Defense

Inhabitants:

● Worker drones

● Warriors

● Scouts

>

Subterrane Produktionszone

Verantwortlich für:

● Nahrungsproduktion

● Brutpflege

● Wasserspeicherung

● Materialaufbereitung

Bewohner:

● Brutpfleger

● Tunnelbauer

● Symbiontenzüchter

>

Subterranean Production Zone

Responsible for:

● Food production

● Brood care

● Water storage

● Material processing

Inhabitants:

● Brood caretakers

● Tunnel builders

● Symbiont breeders

>

Zentraler Kern

Verantwortlich für:

● Fortpflanzung

● Informationsverarbeitung

● Schwarmsteuerung

Bewohner:

● Königin

● Nervennetzwerk

● Kommunikationsorgane

>

Central Core

Responsible for:

● Reproduction

● Information processing

● Swarm control

Inhabitants:

● Queen

● Neural network

● Communication organs

>

Funktionelle Rolle:

Grundlegende Versorgungseinheit.

Aufgaben:

● Ressourcensammlung

● Transport

● Tunnelbau

● Wartung

Anteil an der Gesamtpopulation:

ca. 70–80 %

Die Arbeiter-Drohne stellt die häufigste Kaste dar und bildet die funktionelle Basis des Schwarms.

>

Functional Role:

Basic supply unit.

Tasks:

● Gathering resources

● Transport

● Tunneling

● Maintenance

Percentage of the total population:

approx. 70–80%

The worker drone is the most common caste and forms the functional foundation of the swarm.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung einer Arbeiter Drone /Depiction of a worker drone_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Morphologie

Im Vergleich zur Arbeiter-Drohne:

● massiver Panzer

● stärkere Extremitäten

● reduzierte Sensorik

● vergrößerte Energiereserven

Aufgaben

● Verteidigung der Brutkammern

● Abwehr konkurrierender Kolonien

● Schutz von Sternenmüttern

● Sicherung strategischer Ressourcen

Krieger werden nur bei Bedarf produziert.

Ihre Aufzucht verursacht hohe energetische Kosten.

>

Morphology

Compared to the worker drone:

● Heavy armor

● Stronger limbs

● Reduced sensory capabilities

● Increased energy reserves

Tasks

● Defending the brood chambers

● Repelling rival colonies

● Protecting Queen Stars

● Securing strategic resources

Warriors are produced only when necessary.

Raising them incurs high energy costs.

\n\n

/>_Darstellung eines Kriegers / Depiction of a warrior_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Diese Kaste verbringt ihr gesamtes Leben innerhalb der Brutkammern.

Aufgaben:

● Versorgung von Larven

● Temperaturregulierung

● Feuchtigkeitskontrolle

● Reinigung von Brutkammern

Ihre Anatomie ist stark spezialisiert.

Viele Individuen verlieren im Laufe ihrer Entwicklung die Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen Nahrungssuche.

>

This caste spends its entire life inside the brood chambers.

Tasks:

● Caring for larvae

● Regulating temperature

● Controlling humidity

● Cleaning brood chambers

Their anatomy is highly specialized.

Many individuals lose the ability to forage for food on their own as they develop.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung eines Brutpflegers / Depiction of a foster parent_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Tunnelbauer sind auf die Umgestaltung des Untergrunds spezialisiert.

Besondere Merkmale:

● verstärkte Grabwerkzeuge

● Sekretdrüsen für Baustoffe

● hohe Muskelmasse

Sie erschaffen:

● Wohnkammern

● Wasserspeicher

● Nährstoffdepots

● Kommunikationskanäle

Große Kolonien können über Jahrhunderte kilometerlange Netzwerke errichten.

>

Tunnel builders specialize in reshaping the underground environment.

Distinctive features:

● reinforced digging tools

● secretory glands for building materials

● high muscle mass

They create:

● living chambers

● water reservoirs

● nutrient depots

● communication channels

Large colonies can build networks stretching for kilometers over the course of centuries.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung eines Tunnelbauers / Depiction of a Tunnel builder_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Späher besitzen die höchste individuelle Wahrnehmungsfähigkeit.

Merkmale:

● vergrößerte Sensororgane

● erhöhte Mobilität

● längere Extremitäten

Aufgaben:

● Kartierung neuer Gebiete

● Suche nach Wasser

● Lokalisierung geologischer Aktivität

● Früherkennung von Gefahren

Ihre Informationen fließen anschließend in das Schwarmnetzwerk ein.

>

Scouts possess the highest individual sensory capabilities.

Characteristics:

● enlarged sensory organs

● increased mobility

● longer limbs

Tasks:

● mapping new territories

● searching for water

● locating geological activity

● early detection of dangers

Their information is then fed into the swarm network.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung eines Spähers / Depiction of a Scout_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Die Königin stellt das reproduktive Zentrum einer Kolonie dar.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

● Eiablage

● hormonelle Steuerung

● Kastenregulation

● Koordination lokaler Aktivitäten

Im Gegensatz zu vielen irdischen Eusozialen wird angenommen, dass die Königin zusätzlich über hochentwickelte neuronale Strukturen verfügt.

Sie fungiert nicht nur als Fortpflanzungsorgan, sondern auch als lokales Entscheidungszentrum.

>

The queen is the reproductive center of a colony.

Her responsibilities include:

● Egg-laying

● Hormonal regulation

● Colony regulation

● Coordination of local activities

Unlike many eusocial species on Earth, the queen is believed to possess highly developed neural structures.

She functions not only as a reproductive organ but also as a local decision-making center.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung einer Königin / Depiction of a Queen_

* * *

<table style=\

>

Die Sternenmutter stellt die seltenste und strategisch bedeutendste Kaste des marsianischen Superorganismus dar.

Während die Königin für die Reproduktion einer einzelnen Kolonie verantwortlich ist, übernimmt die Sternenmutter die langfristige Expansion der Spezies.

Ihre Aufgabe besteht in der Produktion und dem Abschuss biologischer Samenkapseln, welche neue Kolonien auf entfernten Regionen des Mars oder potentiell auf anderen Himmelskörpern gründen können.

Aus evolutionärer Sicht repräsentiert die Sternenmutter das Fortpflanzungsorgan der gesamten Art, während die Königin lediglich die Fortpflanzung einer einzelnen Kolonie gewährleistet.

>

The Star Mother represents the rarest and most strategically significant caste of the Martian superorganism.

While the Queen is responsible for the reproduction of a single colony, the Star Mother oversees the long-term expansion of the species.

Her task consists of producing and launching biological seed capsules capable of establishing new colonies in distant regions of Mars or potentially on other celestial bodies.

From an evolutionary perspective, the Star Mother represents the reproductive organ of the entire species, while the Queen merely ensures the reproduction of a single colony.

>

Sternenmütter entstehen nicht regelmäßig.

Die Umwandlung einer Larve zur Sternenmutter wird nur ausgelöst, wenn bestimmte Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind:

● ausreichende Ressourcenreserven

● hohe Populationsdichte

● langfristige Stabilität der Kolonie

● Zustimmung des planetaren Kommunikationsnetzwerks

In den meisten Kolonien entsteht niemals eine Sternenmutter.

>

Star Mothers do not emerge regularly.

The transformation of a larva into a Star Mother is triggered only when certain conditions are met:

● Sufficient resource reserves

● High population density

● Long-term stability of the colony

● Approval from the planetary communication network

In most colonies, a Star Mother never emerges.

>

Im Gegensatz zu allen anderen Kasten besitzt die Sternenmutter keine Mobilität.

Nach Abschluss ihrer Entwicklung verwächst sie dauerhaft mit dem Untergrund.

Der Organismus entwickelt:

● tiefreichende Ankerwurzeln

● großvolumige Energiespeicher

● Druckkammern

● Samenkapselkammern

● biologische Abschusskanäle

Die Größe ausgewachsener Exemplare wird auf 40–60 Meter Höhe geschätzt.

Ein erheblicher Teil der Biomasse befindet sich unterhalb der Oberfläche.

>

Unlike all other casings, the Star Mother has no mobility.

Once its development is complete, it becomes permanently fused with the ground.

The organism develops:

● deep anchor roots

● large-volume energy storage units

● pressure chambers

● seed capsule chambers

● biological launch tubes

The height of mature specimens is estimated at 40–60 meters.

A significant portion of the biomass is located below the surface.

>

Die Entwicklung einer Sternenmutter kann mehrere Jahrhunderte dauern.

Während dieser Zeit transportieren Millionen Arbeiter-Drohnen kontinuierlich Wasser, Mineralien, organische Biomasse und energiereiche Vorstufen zur Sternenmutter.

Diese Ressourcen werden in spezialisierten Speicherorganen konzentriert.

Die gesamte Kolonie investiert somit über Generationen hinweg Energie in einen einzigen Organismus.

>

The development of a Star Mother can take several centuries.

During this time, millions of worker drones continuously transport water, minerals, organic biomass, and high-energy precursors to the Star Mother.

These resources are concentrated in specialized storage organs.

The entire colony thus invests energy in a single organism over the course of generations.

>

Im oberen Bereich der Sternenmutter entstehen die sogenannten Sternensaat-Kapseln.

Jede Kapsel enthält:

● Eier

● Larven

● symbiotische Mikroorganismen

● genetische Archive

● Wasserspeicher

● Nährstoffreserven

Eine einzelne Kapsel stellt faktisch eine vollständige Kolonie im Ruhezustand dar.

>

The so-called Star Seed capsules form in the upper region of the Star Mother.

Each capsule contains:

● Eggs

● Larvae

● Symbiotic microorganisms

● Genetic archives

● Water reservoirs

● Nutrient reserves

A single capsule effectively represents a complete colony in a dormant state.

>

Nach Erreichen der erforderlichen Energiemenge erfolgt der Aussaatzyklus.

Dabei werden die gespeicherten chemischen Energiereserven innerhalb kürzester Zeit freigesetzt.

Die entstehende Druckwelle beschleunigt die Samenkapsel durch den biologischen Abschusskanal.

Der Vorgang ähnelt funktionell einer biologischen Rakete oder Massenschleuder.

In den meisten Fällen wird die Sternenmutter dabei irreversibel zerstört.

>

Once the required amount of energy has been accumulated, the dispersal cycle begins.

During this process, the stored chemical energy reserves are released in a very short time.

The resulting shock wave propels the seed capsule through the biological launch channel.

Functionally, the process resembles a biological rocket or slingshot.

In most cases, the star mother is irreversibly destroyed in the process.

>

Die Sternenmutter besitzt die höchste biologische Investition aller Kasten.

Sie kann mehrere Jahrhunderte wachsen, ohne jemals einen Aussaatvorgang durchzuführen.

Ihr gesamter Lebenszyklus dient einem einzigen Ziel:

der Verbreitung des Schwarms über die Grenzen der bestehenden Kolonien hinaus.

Sie stellt damit die extremste Form reproduktiver Spezialisierung innerhalb des bekannten Modells dar.

>

The Star Mother represents the greatest biological investment of all castes.

She can grow for several centuries without ever reproducing.

Her entire life cycle serves a single purpose:

to spread the swarm beyond the boundaries of the existing colonies.

She thus represents the most extreme form of reproductive specialization within the known model.

>

Obwohl Königinnen die tägliche Organisation einer Kolonie kontrollieren, besitzen Sternenmütter innerhalb des planetaren Schwarms den höchsten strategischen Rang.

Eine vereinfachte Hierarchie lautet:

  1. Planetares Netzwerk (Überkönigin)

  2. Sternenmütter

  3. Königinnen

  4. Spezialisierte Kasten

  5. Arbeiter-Drohnen

Die Sternenmutter wird daher nicht als Individuum einer Kolonie betrachtet.

Sie gilt als Organ des planetaren Superorganismus selbst.

>

Although queens oversee the day-to-day organization of a colony, star mothers hold the highest strategic rank within the planetary swarm.

A simplified hierarchy is as follows:

  1. Planetary Network (Superqueen)

  2. Star Mothers

  3. Queens

  4. Specialized Castes

  5. Worker Drones

The Star Mother is therefore not considered an individual member of a colony.

She is regarded as an organ of the planetary superorganism itself.

\n\n

/>

_Darstellung einer Sternenmutter/ Depiction of a Star Mother_

* * *

<table style=\

>

3.10 The Origins of the Caste System

>

Alle Individuen besitzen identisches Erbgut.

Die spätere Entwicklung wird durch Umweltfaktoren bestimmt.

Entscheidende Einflussgrößen:

● Nahrungsangebot

● Temperatur

● Hormonkonzentrationen

● Schwarmbedarf

Der Entwicklungsweg lautet:

Ei → Larve → Puppe → Spezialisierte Kaste

Dadurch kann die Kolonie ihre Zusammensetzung flexibel an aktuelle Anforderungen anpassen.

>

All individuals have identical genetic material.

Subsequent development is determined by environmental factors.

Key influencing factors:

● Food availability

● Temperature

● Hormone concentrations

● Swarming needs

The developmental pathway is:

Egg → Larva → Pupa → Specialized caste

This allows the colony to flexibly adapt its composition to current requirements.

* * *

>

Die größte Besonderheit des Systems besteht darin, dass keine Kaste vollständig autonom existieren kann.

Jede Kaste übernimmt die Funktion eines biologischen Organs:

>

The most distinctive feature of the system is that no caste can exist completely autonomously.

Each caste performs the function of a biological organ:

>

Die Kolonie selbst wird dadurch zum eigentlichen Organismus.

Einzelne Individuen besitzen nur begrenzte Bedeutung.

Die evolutionäre Selektion wirkt primär auf die Kolonie als Ganzes.

>

The colony itself thus becomes the actual organism.

Individual members are of only limited significance.

Evolutionary selection acts primarily on the colony as a whole.

* * *

>

A fully grown colony could include:

>

Die Kastenstruktur stellt die zentrale Anpassung des marsianischen Superorganismus an eine lebensfeindliche Umwelt dar. Durch extreme Spezialisierung einzelner Individuen entsteht ein biologisches System, dessen Leistungsfähigkeit die Fähigkeiten jedes einzelnen Organismus weit übertrifft.

Die Kolonie wird dadurch zu einer funktionalen Einheit, deren Eigenschaften eher mit einem vielzelligen Organismus als mit einer klassischen Tiergesellschaft vergleichbar sind.

Im folgenden Kapitel wird untersucht, wie aus Millionen biologischer Einheiten eine gemeinsame Schwarmintelligenz entstehen könnte.

>

The caste structure represents the central adaptation of the Martian superorganism to a hostile environment. Through the extreme specialization of individual organisms, a biological system emerges whose capabilities far exceed those of any single organism.

The colony thus becomes a functional unit whose characteristics are more comparable to a multicellular organism than to a classical animal society.

The following chapter examines how a collective swarm intelligence could emerge from millions of biological units.

title.title: AND NOW ... SOMETHING THAT WILL PROBABLY NEVER GET FINISHED
title.body:
There was a weird time in the year of our lord 2023, I mean, it was weird for me, at least, when I used to draw some absurd shit becouse I felt kinda bored and disgusted, but I can't tell you anymore why exactly my mood went that way in that period. A vague memory and some ... well, let's call them artworks in the lack of a better word ... are all that remains. 
The following link can take you to one of those that was published, for better or worse, at that time here on Hive.
https://ecency.com/@borjan/a-low-effort-mistery-2
But this post isn't about that. I mean, it isn't about the old, already published stuff. Nope. Today I wanna show you some unfinished stuff from that period. I have no intention to finish it becouse I'm not into that anymore, but there is enough finished in that unfinished ... let's call it art, for now ... to make it worth a post. Maybe. Probably not. But I feel the need to put it out there, so I'll do it anyway.

<a href=\

> (Enlargeable) This is the most completed part of the whole thing. A GIF imagined to be the beginning of ... let's call it a story, in the lack of a better term. If you wanna know if the dude shown here entered the church and what he found if he did enter, you have to start drawing and finish the thing, becouse I won't do it. Not for you nor for me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfV4eWf6qAyoNPS1P41LNJi85kP4vueTyFEaLJBr4SH8X/dvolik_za_post.jpg) Here you can see the two drawings of Mr Pembelton in two poses. I used those to make him move across the scenery inside the GIF. I didn't take much to animate him becouse the animation wasn't meant to be sophisticated or great. I wasn't in the mood for greatness back then. All I wanted to do was draw, write, and animate some silly crap to make me laugh at what the heck I'm doing and to make myself wonder where that need for absurdity came from, and why.

> (Enlargeable) In this collection of nine, kinda unnecessary images, I collected most of the sequences I used for the GIF I started the post with. I mean, I started the post with some words, but that was the first picture. And it was in motion. Which is cool. Not too bad for a start. If you wonder about what I'm trying to say here, the answer is nothing. I'm just trying to make this shitpost longer. I'm practicing the noble ancient art of concealed shitposting. If you like art, that's art too. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc3fyvZ9fmdnixL8Vz9DCU4aH3rkencrREtEyN8DShNrD/pembchurch_drugoosnova.jpg) This is the next piece of the story. I mean, it was meant to be more like the start of the next piece of the story. Once passed through this door, our hero was supposed to see something surreal inside the church. Don't ask me what. If you are really curious about what's inside that church on the hill, you'd better start drawing, or imagining things, at least, becouse I won't do it. Nope. I'm done with this. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVne8YFhDnpLkRAk2aFiXbiRNURu81ueiok2ccXNwF8qd/nedovrseni_kraj_za_post.jpg) As always, here on Hive, the art and stuff are in all segments my work.

title.title: Hotel Palco an ideal space to share [EN/ES]
title.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23yd1Gqaxdq7o7VyyayYbLR6VQmibc3v6SQ5eq7D1QZRwdRn99q44e91GTQqdhT8G6phX.jpg) # English Version It always excites me to discover places that, although they have existed for a long time, become new to me when I visit them for the first time. That is what happened with my recent visit to Hotel Palco, which is located in a residential area of Havana where tranquility can be felt. It is on 146 Avenue, in the Miramar neighborhood, and in the surroundings the streets are lined with leafy trees, large mansions with their eclectic style, embassies and diplomatic residences, which provide a distinguished and serene air to the environment. It is a peaceful place where the calm of the surroundings mixes with the vitality of the people who walk through these streets. # ![IMG_20260604_151141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23ycyQkG23NFMjmmaJf6DquisWr57oKzLLynQvdPbD4KaTx8gNrHhDhBDHxfXzGjgJaEy.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_151302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23xVCunhmALFpQajrgjD1eYTrgCymkKyAgDQGTNeRfduj58TDM4NSuYVGc7QUJZikw5Qk.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_151650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/241tNJwU7Ty2LfsnkVKN4cEeq6fXoLG5uU31LDejip7GDd8t99YZunaoVTVXZ9C5G7aeK.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_151206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/244oQDgaxv5BvH52wQDGqLgAPk9i3A69tV4DT1pg24wXnnRDwUYuyj5kZa3faR4wxyU9T.jpg)
The hotel has a modern design, with architecture that combines straight lines and large windows through which natural light enters to create open spaces designed for the people who visit the facility. Something that I loved about this place is how it integrates natural elements into its decoration, using vegetation to create unique spaces, full of beauty and harmony. In its interior gardens one feels absolute peace, surrounded by plants, water and simple wooden details, together with a pleasant design intended for rest. All this decorated with numerous works of art: paintings, sculptures and wood carvings by different visual artists which enrich the atmosphere. # ![IMG_20260604_151321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23tviXHYbhnPneuqi9cehVz1kvhWSVVUCRK6MqjiybRyrZFmwmMibdAaZuEPabonUP3LC.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23vhz1jsDw3HLTFRQ3wYQ2LRUfWa74V56MAR9ADM4Nvdgk3WKb9saWf72vvUohXULzMby.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23vsLXHB6JXJrJVBJEQUUdb5gdz8FyPocm8eFZvgz1gnZdWFwF1ZowmMBM871ALtUMAEE.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23w2qGtMPboUWfKX1sa5mSveZmLjkFQ9mYcQc7d5jBNuRRRzX7HqpadHnodfBeiHa1wu6.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_151713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23tvgqQGAyQVbgppgR39jcs72sCGK4uXzVRDQY9AXhAG12sRhFuKiBi2ziZfkbc5AVvWk.jpg)
Hotel Palco has become a very visited place due to the quality of its services and good treatment. Among all its facilities the pool area is the most popular, since here one can reserve to share and spend a special day with family or friends, enjoying a relaxed and fun environment. At this time of early summer, the pool area becomes the perfect place to cool off from the heat. Children find their best moment there, playing in the water, laughing and creating memories, while adults take advantage to rest on the loungers, talk or simply enjoy a unique instant. Without a doubt I would love to live this experience, since it is a very attractive option. I am sure I will return soon to enjoy it. # ![IMG_20260604_152914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23uFTYtFAVNxfhj4x7vrVEiLfcG5AY3ty39J2gPy3SAoY9kfLZAg4it8hkmV5uMFqBrP4.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23xARNykEmsjfu2dTpENXko9cmBzotSPjhFHdsc3xi2Y9pqJdvNm362pWkRRdLFPCxayB.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_153006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wWvtxtDuZjL4r3UV35QQadZYb4HFYefwtSTHvZX2bdmPnDYgaKJbqd8hN3nDxnBuNjS.jpg)
Another very busy space is the Lobby Bar, with national and international cocktail service. It is one of the preferred places to spend the day, not only because of the atmosphere and the offers, but because many use it as a workplace. In a city where the internet connection is not always stable, here one can access the hotel’s wifi service, which allows tasks to be advanced while enjoying the environment. # ![IMG_20260604_151516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23xei2bpbmGgmMWN4u32JCgh758gbHQDqWa1RfoqEHfADz4xBKEe87AajrxJR5v1KDPTh.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_151536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23x17EJdkBkjo25PtSm5e4qsfsmAq7sVBsekPQRAqKGVL9Loso9PrkUTUt1cTqcSWgdSr.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wgHYAHzQA9GfNPyjXRutZMqcJgfG6XrxifiKpYi8LCSWM3ybiX2cKJMm16sJEGES4c5.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23uFS1FQmDRKH7uWdGhK1b2f1JaCst5sxUesKZpSFyah2wTVe1w2RAEsfYwxHsHr39PwH.jpg)
The combination of fun, comfort and a modern style makes Palco a place that invites one to return. That is why many have made it a frequent place, ideal both for rest and recreation. # ![IMG_20260604_152329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EoAaGdTUcHcmpEmuEyN73KejS4jYSkQdQT9pTvhDK7kzSpUEbTHui3t3fNQxBp7zxSh.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23vhwxeZr9LWeLPTb6qrGri8jvc47nMumkV9Rh24ABbxrs44GobtzQwRKKSNoR4YBDdsu.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23vhuankeE1MvSNGHV9ik9hHXvJUwNrENnuuD3JsSaAAjjTRoMa1YcwLWD7rW5ptHfdty.jpg) # ![IMG_20260604_152613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23xoymTf5D2ZekYHH9CitMwhuqAs49rhfobofMNs7Xkotxs567uUzgm7PyLWLJMBpBJxR.jpg)
I hope you enjoyed the tour. Cheers, and until next time! [//]:# (!worldmappin 23.08867 lat -82.45383 long d3scr)
Versión en Español

Hotel Palco, un espacio ideal para compartir Siempre me emociona descubrir lugares que, aunque existen desde hace tiempo, se vuelven nuevos para mí al visitarlos por primera vez. Así me ocurrió con mi reciente visita al Hotel Palco, que se encuentra en una zona residencial de La Habana donde se respira tranquilidad. Está en la avenida 146, del Reparto Miramar, en los alrededores las calles están rodeadas de árboles frondosos, de grandes mansiones con su estilo ecléctico, embajadas y residencias diplomáticas, que aportan un aire distinguido y sereno al entorno. Es un lugar apacible donde la calma de los alrededores se mezcla con la vitalidad de las personas que transitan por estas calles. El hotel tiene un diseño moderno, con una arquitectura que combina líneas rectas y amplios ventanales por donde entra la luz natural para crear ambientes abiertos pensados en las personas que visitan la instalación. Algo que me encantó de este sitio es cómo integra elementos naturales en su decoración, utilizando la vegetación para crear espacios únicos, llenos de belleza y armonía. En sus jardines interiores se siente una paz absoluta, rodeados de plantas, agua y detalles sencillos en madera, junto a un diseño agradable pensado para el descanso. Todo esto decorado con numerosas obras de arte: pinturas, esculturas y tallas en madera de diferentes artistas plásticos lo que enriquecen el ambiente. El Hotel Palco se ha convertido en un lugar muy visitado por la calidad de sus servicios y el buen trato. Entre todas sus instalaciones el área de la piscina es la más popular, pues aquí se puede reservar para compartir y pasar un día especial en familia o con amigos, disfrutando de un ambiente relajado y divertido. En esta época de inicios del verano, el área de la piscina se convierte en el lugar perfecto para refrescarse del calor. Los niños encuentran allí su mejor momento, jugando en el agua, riendo y creando recuerdos, mientras los adultos aprovechan para descansar en las tumbonas, conversar o simplemente disfrutar de un instante único. Sin dudas me encantaría vivir esta experiencia, ya que es una opción muy atractiva. Estoy segura de que volveré pronto para disfrutarla. Otro espacio muy concurrido es el Lobby Bar, con servicio de coctelería nacional e internacional. Es uno de los sitios preferidos para pasar el día, no solo por el ambiente y las ofertas, sino porque muchos lo utilizan como lugar de trabajo. En una ciudad donde la conexión a internet no siempre es estable, aquí se puede acceder al servicio de wifi del hotel, lo que permite adelantar tareas mientras se disfruta del entorno. La combinación de diversión, comodidad y un estilo moderno hace que el Palco sea un sitio que invita a regresar. Por eso, muchos lo han convertido en un lugar frecuente, ideal tanto para el descanso como para la recreación. Espero que hayan disfrutado del recorrido. Un Saludo, ¡y hasta la próxima!

title.title: Піонова краса
title.body:
Обожнюю мамині піонові клумби навколо хати. Стільки різних сортів, кольорів, ароматів, що підходячи до них через декілька хвилин, помічаєш, як все змінюється і живе своїм життям. Над бутонами гудуть бджоли та джмелики, цілий комашиний всесвіт сформувався навколо клумби. Просто неймовірно, як все в природі функціонує.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUyar54RKWEMW7ouVVw2eZQFrkGDv8c9hy3wu2dDkiRL7/1780894035219.jpg)

І мені здається, що цього року кущі півоній якось по особливому рясно квітнуть, дуже багато великих і масивних бутонів, та й самі кущі дуже пішли в ріст. Чи то морозна зима стимулювала, чи то дощовий квітень-травень. Продовжуємо насолоджуватися літом та його красою.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUj3HjRZzk97s9maQJEgGpB2Z4wsfrB2FvLbYHeybHF8N/1780894035181.jpg)

title.title: El Oso en el Árbol / The bears in the tree
title.body:
<center>

Una alpaca solitaria,
por la pradera anda,
lleva un oso de tonalidad clara
y con insistencia lo carga. 

Se sienta un rato bajo el árbol 
y observa lo que hay a su lado 
se alza y deja el oso colgado
en una rama y se va afanado.

>A lone alpaca,
wanders through the meadow,
carrying a light-colored teddy bear
and persistently lugging it along.

>It sits for a while under the tree
and looks at what’s beside it,
it stands up, leaves the teddy bear hanging
from a branch, and hurries off.

![63642.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJEKFQ3oMQbXqJbPzpMHVdKzphZmjRkAEfLYkCuQJiaun1amnnsNoc9CSsBsBYQ55fN.gif)

Pasan los días
y el oso continúa en la rama elegida,
de repente, le cambia la vida
y llega un perro de mirada bonita.

El canino observa el oso claro
no sabe si está solo o acompañado 
hasta que decide tomarlo
y se va feliz con el oso encontrado. 

>The days go by,
and the bear remains on the branch he chose,
when suddenly, his life changes
and a dog with a kind gaze arrives.

>The dog watches the bear closely,
not sure if he’s alone or with someone else,
until he decides to take him
and walks away happily with the bear he found.

![63644.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23tmFqyGqaqWJB3sceCcyD46biCNWCK8PQP7xwADaq17FU3JeGkoEqfcFDp7uFKHdCzJE.gif)

Lo lleva hasta su vivienda
y en el sofá lo sube con delicadeza,
lo abraza con clemencia
y se queda dormido junto al oso de felpa. 

Cuando llega el dueño de la casa,
ve una escena tierna en la sala,
su perro,un oso abraza,
es un nuevo juguete que apareció de la nada. 

>He takes it to his home
and gently lifts it onto the sofa,
hugs it tenderly,
and falls asleep next to the stuffed bear.

>When the homeowner arrives,
he sees a heartwarming scene in the living room,
his dog is hugging a bear,
a new toy that appeared out of nowhere.

![63643.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xpAuwyECkEhSwk86JDh8p3x3vW9nN5sn1zAk1KS2Q8ANsnrxoJ7qLh6pCMH2U1bAZc4.gif)

Muchas veces tenemos cosas,
que no usamos, tampoco sobran,
es mejor darlas sin zozobra
y a otros alegrar con esta obra. 

>We often have things
that we don’t use, but we don’t need to keep either,
it’s better to give them away without hesitation
and bring joy to others through this act.

</center>

<center>
![InShot_20230630_124621147.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/EoAfYKqkd84fmD8iEEbc9Es3YuzFg1JTfQ4Hw7VLmJMMx3Db3HdE4WL8Y1yyd2Ms4vL.gif)

title.title: 「生活」年度体检
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![xsGFhiZ6fgCR8PGu_IMG_7962.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/xsGFhiZ6fgCR8PGu_IMG_7962/xsGFhiZ6fgCR8PGu_IMG_7962.webp)

![a5GeWMcLK1Nxk0GA_IMG_7964.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/a5GeWMcLK1Nxk0GA_IMG_7964/a5GeWMcLK1Nxk0GA_IMG_7964.webp)
![BB1f20DBq1e5AD8N_IMG_7965.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/BB1f20DBq1e5AD8N_IMG_7965/BB1f20DBq1e5AD8N_IMG_7965.webp)
![p3g1szH5qtYhUpPl_IMG_7969.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/p3g1szH5qtYhUpPl_IMG_7969/p3g1szH5qtYhUpPl_IMG_7969.webp)
![NT1V9hno5aqmAG1W_IMG_7987.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/NT1V9hno5aqmAG1W_IMG_7987/NT1V9hno5aqmAG1W_IMG_7987.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨天晚上去学校做了考前指导，因为今天考英语，学校安排我们回去守两节自习，也算给学生打一针“强心剂”，让孩子们别太慌张。说真的我自己反倒挺紧张，到校那种心情和上开学第一课一模一样，一想到学生马上就要毕业了，心里满是感慨。

昨天上完这次指导课，我基本上就算正式放假了。顶多七月份回学校参加一场培训，没别的繁杂工作。只要学校不打电话安排我再接新一届高三，我的假期就彻底开启。

昨晚和朋友商量着抓紧订机票，目的地早就定好了，机票却迟迟没敲定，总算顺利订完，接下来就慢慢挑选酒店。

说回正题啦，今天一早要配合高考送考，孩子八点五十要到校。我原本打算送完他再去吃早饭，可当时已经饿得厉害，想着横竖都饿了许久，干脆打电话咨询体检中心，问问学校统一体检现在能不能做，毕竟学校还没下发相关通知。

没想到时机刚好，那边告知可以直接过去体检。正好送完孩子顺路过去，择日不如撞日，既节省来回奔波的时间，也能把近期要办的事提前处理妥当，之后出门游玩也能安心。

每年翻看体检项目清单，都忍不住吐槽学校，体检项目一年比一年缩减，这里少一项、那里减一项。往年我都会自费额外加几项检查，去年已经做过TCT和HPV，今年就不用重复检查，换成了甲状腺功能项目，另外再加一项我每年必查的幽门螺旋杆菌。算上学校报销的部分，自己额外补上的费用一共也就一千多块。

这次体检全程体验感特别好，心情十分舒畅，体检的人不多，整套流程顺畅又规范。以前做彩超得自己到处排队等候，完全不清楚什么时候能轮到自己。

现在微信扫码就能实时查看各个科室叫号状态，直接前往对应区域等候就可以。体检单上标注好了固定检查顺序，做完第一项，单据会写明下一个检查窗口，到号会直接喊名字，条理清晰，再也不像从前那样杂乱无序。

其余项目全部完成后只剩彩超，这项等候时间稍久，大概二十多分钟。做彩超时，医生看到我的个人信息，询问我是学校行政人员还是任课教师，顺带提起他家孩子在读初中，想请教英语该如何提升。我们简单交流了一番，我给他推荐了两本教辅，也因此耽搁了一小会儿。

所有体检项目做完全程不到一小时，之后下楼吃早餐。今年早餐对比往年改善很大，新增了热菜，还有包子、馒头、鸡蛋和小米粥。往年只有牛奶面包，吃着总觉得不得劲儿。Btw今天遇到的所有工作人员服务态度都特别和善，一整天下来心情格外舒心。


---

title.title: Delicious meatballs
title.body:
![Brown Red and Green Wood Table Vegetable Illustrative How To Make Hot Spicy Meatballs YouTube Thumbnail.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23viEq9M9eKLuvLaXpdRZqjT1VL1JnVGFXZaSeq4KVyGsrNexqFuGhv7Bxt594ftc4Ugy.png)

<sub>Image edited with Canva</sub>  


<div class=\

>Las albóndigas siempre me han gustado, pero no suelo hacerlas muy seguido ya que somos 3 personas en casa y se gasta bastante carne para hacerlo, realmente es complicado ya que suelo comprar carne en pequeñas cantidades, pero hace poco compre mas de un kg y me arriesgue a hacer albóndigas hoy y para mi la mejor combinación es albóndigas con arroz y pure de papa, a muchas personas le gusta mas con pasta pero yo prefiero de esta manera, es delicioso. > I've always liked meatballs, but I don’t make them very often since there are three of us at home and it takes quite a bit of meat to make them. It’s really tricky because I usually buy meat in small quantities, but recently I bought more than a kilogram and decided to take a chance on making meatballs today. For me, the best combination is meatballs with rice and mashed potatoes; many people prefer them with pasta, but I prefer them this way—it’s delicious. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)
**Proceso/Process**

>Para comenzar tome la cantidad de carne que iba a utilizar en mi caso fueron como 300 gramos o un poco más de carne, la sazone usando sal, adobo y salsa de ajo, inglesa y de soya. Luego hice las bolitas y las coloque a freír en un sartén con un poco de aceite, después de que estén un poco cocidas las saco del fuego. > To start, take the amount of meat you plan to use—in my case, it was about 300 grams or a little more—and season it with salt, marinade, garlic sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and soy sauce. Then I shaped the meat into small balls and fried them in a skillet with a little oil; once they were partially cooked, I removed them from the heat. ![collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFY4gB6YW7JsCZ4YryRvL9o6ad5VVa75z7wJWcWNcZSP69WJ8WXdunzdZDJtiTrUzJL.png)

>En el aceite que quedo en el sartén coloqué onoto molido para darle color y sabor, luego añadí las albóndigas hasta que se colorearan de naranja y mientras tanto tome 1 tomate, medio pimentón, un poco menos de la mitad de una cebolla morada y un ajo en la licuadora con un poco de agua, lo batí hasta triturarlo por completo, descubrí que de esta manera mi hijo se come los vegetales sin problema jaja. > I added ground annatto to the oil left in the pan to give it color and flavor, then I added the meatballs until they turned orange. Meanwhile, I put 1 tomato, half a bell pepper, a little less than half a red onion, and a clove of garlic in the blender with a little water, and blended it until completely smooth. I found that this way, my son eats his vegetables without any trouble, haha. ![collage1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tSYoyrJ9fcYL4VWi6nFGCrSYXdzTi4sdfqxcHGR1igb7S1bqX2QfsFcZuiDpj3SV2pw.png)

>Y le agregue los vegetales licuados a mis albóndigas, deje cocinar hasta que se reduzca un poco la salsa y agregue pasta de tomate para mas sabor e intensidad en el color, deje cocinar hasta que la salsa se espesara, finalmente serví el arroz, pure y las albóndigas, fue un almuerzo muy exquisito. > I added the blended vegetables to my meatballs, let them cook until the sauce reduced a bit, and added tomato paste for more flavor and a deeper color. I let it cook until the sauce thickened, and finally served the rice, mashed potatoes, and meatballs—it was a truly delicious lunch. ![collage2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vi4JxBQsSADC9sZdR2XcUZWU5orLFYfjnuGJzGMm6LnV4h8u1ZMA8bBbkxTk5g115uk.png) ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png) ![IMG_20260607_150143.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xydkJLpc58FKRsH6hCUpGyF9Le5v6wYJcYDQHbdaMDQhTgunX9LagvLf8w95VHkQufo.jpg)

title.title: Bulgur with Meat and Cabbage\\Bulgur mit Fleisch und Kohl
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll be cooking bulgur with fried cabbage, pumpkin, meat, and raisins in a frying pan. Bulgur is great in any form; it's a very tasty grain. This recipe isn't the most complicated; everything is cooked in one pan. Let's go, it's going to be delicious!



![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRXjEaCtQQEzziTQoZxeFyVjYfdFtEZmh8pCDV2cWkyPn/1.jpg)


Ingredients:

● Bulgur - 1 cup
● Water or broth - 2 cups
● White cabbage - 200 g
● Pumpkin - 100 g
● Ham (but neck is better) - 400 g
● Fresh garlic - 3 cloves
● Raisins - 1/3 cup
● Cumin - 1 tsp, to taste
● Sugar - 1 tbsp
● Apple cider vinegar 6% - 1 tbsp
● Vegetable oil for frying, salt, pepper, hot pepper, green onions, and herbs – to taste

1.Shred the cabbage. Peel and seed the pumpkin, then cut into pieces. Fry in vegetable oil. Fry for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage browns and smells like fried cabbage.


![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZwySKJQPpbFxUrL1UigLwQaTA2fjCxCbQs5kUP7pzYJA/2.jpg)


2.Place the ham or neck pieces in the pan. I lightly marinated the meat in a mixture of soy sauce, starch, sugar, apple cider vinegar, and hot pepper. 20 minutes on the counter and you're done! Add the meat to the pan, pushing the cabbage and pumpkin aside. Fry the pieces of meat on all sides for 10-15 minutes.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmac4xzvSpUz1tXtkWkdvAi6EQj1o8RV9ReSrfrMDhRNdr/3.jpg)


3.Mix the fried meat with the cabbage and pumpkin, then add the steamed seedless raisins. Raisins paired with bulgur are always rich and festive!



![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXWjA26M5PhAYXAgeMXYxfcDjFacqjESbyzWbeH386rMx/4.jpg)


4.Place the bulgur in the pan. Mix the bulgur and the pan contents thoroughly.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVjkNzFfHGeYxsPMRq91nsUp6tmVy8UUGMr5dphkvsHZ/5.jpg)


5.Then pour in a couple of cups of boiling broth (or just water) with salt, a spoonful of apple cider vinegar, cumin, and hot pepper. Stir and cover. Reduce the heat to low. Cook the bulgur for 20-25 minutes, covered.



![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbehhXsQHApsNB2GvB4tFrszMNBa9pjQG73JKTJoUXtZv/6.jpg)


6.The bulgur has steamed well, and all the liquid has evaporated. Now simply stir the pan contents. Taste the dish and, if needed, add any missing flavorings: salt, pepper, and sugar. The cabbage has given the bulgur a juicy flavor; it's not dry.



![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTgMmVCLhHowGCP41yzEwjSjVHWDKHxpHZWAaUKkgVKxp/7.jpg)


7.Arrange the bulgur with the fried cabbage and meat on plates. Garnish with herbs. Bulgur is truly something! How did we ever live without it?



![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNHccAhzRLw1TnwdbKzG3DgT8RrmKhFdhwyHFuyMGsmK/9.jpg)


Shall we cook it?


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir Bulgur mit gebratenem Kohl, Kürbis, Fleisch und Rosinen in der Pfanne zu. Bulgur ist in jeder Form köstlich; es ist ein sehr schmackhaftes Getreide. Dieses Rezept ist nicht besonders kompliziert; alles wird in einer Pfanne zubereitet. Los geht's, es wird lecker!

Zutaten:

● Bulgur – 1 Tasse
● Wasser oder Brühe – 2 Tassen
● Weißkohl – 200 g
● Kürbis – 100 g
● Schinken (am besten Nacken) – 400 g
● Frischer Knoblauch – 3 Zehen
● Rosinen – 1/3 Tasse
● Kreuzkümmel – 1 TL, nach Geschmack
● Zucker – 1 EL
● Apfelessig (6 %) – 1 EL
● Pflanzenöl zum Braten, Salz, Pfeffer, Chili, Frühlingszwiebeln und Kräuter – nach Geschmack

1.Den Weißkohl hobeln. Den Kürbis schälen, entkernen und in Stücke schneiden. In Pflanzenöl anbraten. 15 Minuten braten, dabei gelegentlich umrühren, bis der Kohl gebräunt ist und nach gebratenem Kohl duftet.

2.Die Schinken- oder Nackenstücke in die Pfanne geben. Ich habe das Fleisch leicht in einer Mischung aus Sojasauce, Stärke, Zucker, Apfelessig und Chilipulver mariniert. Nach 20 Minuten bei Zimmertemperatur ist es fertig! Das Fleisch in die Pfanne geben und Kohl und Kürbis beiseite schieben. Die Fleischstücke von allen Seiten 10–15 Minuten anbraten.

3.Das gebratene Fleisch mit Kohl und Kürbis vermengen und die gedämpften, kernlosen Rosinen hinzufügen. Rosinen und Bulgur ergeben immer ein leckeres und festliches Gericht!

4.Den Bulgur in die Pfanne geben und gut mit dem Pfanneninhalt vermengen.

5.Anschließend ein paar Tassen kochende Brühe (oder Wasser) mit Salz, einem Löffel Apfelessig, Kreuzkümmel und Chilipulver dazugeben. Umrühren und abdecken. Die Hitze reduzieren und den Bulgur zugedeckt 20–25 Minuten köcheln lassen.

6.Der Bulgur ist gut durchgegart und die gesamte Flüssigkeit verdampft. Nun den Pfanneninhalt nur noch einmal umrühren. Probieren Sie das Gericht und würzen Sie gegebenenfalls mit Salz, Pfeffer und Zucker nach. Der Kohl verleiht dem Bulgur eine saftige Konsistenz; er ist nicht trocken.

7.Richten Sie den Bulgur mit dem gebratenen Kohl und dem Fleisch auf Tellern an. Mit Kräutern garnieren. Bulgur ist wirklich etwas Besonderes! Wie konnten wir nur jemals ohne ihn leben?

Sollen wir ihn kochen?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

Hello hello how was your weekend I was relaxing at home playing Roblox the game is surviving natural disasters a calm and casual game that doesn’t require much player experience just trying to find a safe place before facing a natural disaster.

>

Como existen muchos jugadores el juego tiene desafío de tener que nosotros estar pendientes de qué desastre vendrá y cómo evitaremos que nos afecte, luego está la otra parte, tenemos a jugadores que pueden hacer alguna travesura para que seas eliminado lo que convierte a todos en enemigos y a no buscar estar cerca de alguien porque no sabemos si será un aliado o un enemigo.

Since there are many players the game has the challenge of staying alert for what disaster will come and how we will avoid being affected then there’s the other part players who can troll you to get you eliminated turning everyone into enemies and making you avoid being close to anyone because you don’t know if they’ll be an ally or an enemy.

>

En esta oportunidad el fuego fue de lo más sencillo que encontramos en esta partida, estaba el fuego lejos y no se propagó de una manera peligrosa por tal razón lo conseguimos súper fácil.

This time the fire was the easiest disaster we found in the match the fire was far away and didn’t spread dangerously so we survived it very easily.

title.title: El café y yo
title.body:
![1000558267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgMydb8m5Xait3P7iXJUpx7LvtFTpo5dw5v6gJdyxKNCQuEKgw5Vim1K19W97M7TvGV.jpg)
Consideraba que muchos de los alimentos y bebidas que consumimos guardan estrecha relación con lo que nos ofrecen en casa durante nuestros años de infancia. Sé de niños que desde muy pequeños los acostumbran a tomar café con leche durante el desayuno, así que es lógico que cuando sean adultos sigan con el gusto por el café e incluso que lo aumenten pasando a tomar café negro; es normal que esta bebida forme parte de su vida, principalmente por estar presente desde sus años de infancia. Esta bebida pasa a ser un hábito familiar que une a este, ahora adulto, a recuerdos de su infancia. > I believe that many of the foods and beverages we consume are closely linked to what we were served at home during our childhood. I know of children who, from a very young age, are accustomed to drinking coffee with milk for breakfast, so it makes sense that as adults they would continue to enjoy coffee and even develop a preference for black coffee; it’s normal for this beverage to be a part of their lives, mainly because it has been a part of their lives since childhood. This beverage becomes a family tradition that connects this now-adult to memories of their childhood. ![1000558268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wMYkywWoQ6td2Yy4espFmSzCSLt5xmB9cqKZuDsvB8bUroAmLidQpWYiphTcKieMH4z.jpg) ![1000558236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wMWc6vJtCMjKaGMgUv1MSM5cUAVZxiiXqPvLasNFfo1UZRCCDsLve4qgyhaVaKo9aJM.jpg) Vengo de una familia donde este hábito jamás existió, así que mi relación con el café digamos que no es muy cercana. Lo probé siendo adulta y jamás me ha gustado el café negro, pero de vez en cuando, ya en mi adultez, mi mamá, cuando venía de visita, preparaba café negro y café con leche, y probando este último con mucha azúcar, me gustó. Ahora puedo disfrutar un sabroso café con leche, y si lo acompaño con un cachito hecho en casa, mucho mejor. El mundo del café ha avanzado de forma gigantesca durante los últimos años. El *boom* del barismo ha hecho que muchas personas se interesen en este arte. Existe gran oferta de café y entre ellos se encuentran los de especialidad. > I come from a family where this habit never existed, so let’s just say my relationship with coffee isn’t exactly close. I tried it as an adult and have never liked black coffee, but every now and then, once I was an adult, my mom would make black coffee and coffee with milk when she came to visit, and when I tried the latter with lots of sugar, I liked it. Now I can enjoy a delicious coffee with milk, and if I pair it with a homemade pastry, even better. The world of coffee has made enormous strides in recent years. The barista boom has sparked many people’s interest in this art. There’s a wide variety of coffee available, including specialty coffees. ![1000558237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xp8m8KybywattfkbPWzomHDWaUbKRe87JtcF6CXNzDiKQ3b8JwNsYLVfZ3Bskoqwb35.jpg) ![1000558235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wqiBqUBPC8RgsUMWfov5uYa8UEuDMe3rgZLsgVwnnyLC9uLuDucdWZpSnXkjV3x4mDb.jpg) Pero también sucede que, aunque no hayas adquirido ese gusto por el café en tu infancia, ese *boom* del barismo te haya alcanzado. A esto le llamo el poder de la *tendencia*. Tengo un primo que se formó como barista, y pasó de no tomar café a verlo como un ritual. Desde comprar los granos de café, tostarlos, molerlos y así todos los procesos necesarios para que beber una taza de su café sea una experiencia genial al poder presenciar este ritual. But it also happens that, even if you didn’t develop a taste for coffee as a child, that barista *boom* has caught up with you. I call this the power of the *trend*. I have a cousin who trained as a barista, and he went from not drinking coffee to seeing it as a ritual. From buying the coffee beans, roasting them, grinding them, and all the other steps involved—drinking a cup of his coffee is a great experience because you get to witness this ritual. ![1000558239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wCLAJkMcGqwqi71iPXXSVGSi341WePC9Y3275rSU8XDFJdSsfxpHZCenpChBLQrhPHC.jpg) Gracias a él, pude probar un café de especialidad, perteneciente a la marca *Café y Ciencia*, un producto venezolano creado en 2020. Este pertenece a un *Special Nano Lot*, un café premium proveniente de un *nanolote*, una pequeña selección de café de alta calidad. Así es como la vida nos sorprende y algo que no nos gustaba, algo que no estaba presente en nuestro mapa, ahora nos guíe por momentos especiales. >Thanks to him, I was able to try a specialty coffee from the *Café y Ciencia* brand, a Venezuelan product launched in 2020. It’s part of a *Special Nano Lot*, a premium coffee sourced from a *nanolot*, a small selection of high-quality beans. >That’s how life surprises us—something we didn’t like, something that wasn’t on our radar, now guides us through special moments.

*Gracias por pasar por aquí, por detenerte a leer o a escuchar, por comentar, por votar-*
**¡Gracias por todo tu apoyo!**

title.title: Fear: The Invisible Wall Between Us and the Life We Want
title.body:
There was a time when I thought my biggest problems were lack of money, lack of opportunities, and bad luck. Whenever something went wrong, I blamed circumstances. If I delayed an important task, I said I was tired. If I avoided a challenge, I said the timing was not right.

But over time, I started noticing a pattern.

Behind many of my decisions was something I rarely admitted to myself: fear.

Fear is strange because it does not always look like fear. Sometimes it appears as procrastination. Sometimes it wears the mask of comfort. Sometimes it hides behind excuses that sound perfectly reasonable.

For example, I used to postpone important work for days. I thought I was being lazy. Later I realized I was afraid of failing. If I never started, I could never fail. The fear was protecting my ego, but at the same time it was preventing my growth.

The same thing happens in many areas of life.

A person may stay in a job they dislike because they fear uncertainty. Someone may avoid expressing their feelings because they fear rejection. Another person may keep spending money they do not have because temporary comfort feels safer than facing reality.

The problem is that fear often gives short-term relief while creating long-term pain.

One thing I learned is that fear is not an enemy. Many motivational speakers tell us to destroy fear, but I do not think that is possible. Fear is part of being human.

When we care about something, we become afraid of losing it.

When we dream about something, we become afraid of failing.

When we love someone, we become afraid of being hurt.

The goal is not to eliminate fear. The goal is to stop letting fear make our decisions.

A simple example from daily life is public speaking. Most people feel nervous before speaking in front of others. The fear never completely disappears. The difference is that confident people act despite the fear while others wait for fear to disappear first.

I have noticed that many fears become smaller when I examine them honestly.

What is the worst thing that can happen?

Will I survive it?

Will life continue?

Most of the time, the answer is yes.

Maybe things will not go perfectly. Maybe I will make mistakes. Maybe people will judge me. But none of these things are the end of the world.

Another lesson is gratitude. Fear usually focuses on what might go wrong. Gratitude focuses on what is already right. When I appreciate what I have today, my mind becomes less obsessed with imaginary disasters tomorrow.

Life is always changing. New challenges appear, old problems disappear, and unexpected opportunities arrive. Fear will probably walk beside us throughout the journey.

The question is not whether fear exists.

The real question is: will fear sit in the passenger seat, or will we hand it the steering wheel?

For me, the answer is becoming clearer every day. I still feel fear, but I am learning not to let it decide where my life goes.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] My backyard was bathed in sunlight with the annual arrival of the araguaney.
title.body: > **A great week is beginning, and before I get back to my tasks, I just have to wish you all the very best as well. My week is packed with commitments—the kind that bring new challenges and learning opportunities—but today I want to take a moment to tell you about something that filled me with joy and made my Sunday truly special: my araguaney tree has bloomed in all its glory.**

> *Una buena semana comienza, y antes de seguir con mis tareas no puedo dejar de desearles que a ustedes también les vaya muy bien. La mía viene cargada de compromisos, de esos que traen nuevos retos y aprendizajes, pero hoy quiero detenerme un momento para contarles algo que me llenó de alegría y que hizo que mi domingo fuera realmente especial; mi araguaney floreció en toda su plenitud.*
![photo_2026-06-08_00-01-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq375YznUqq4TgLZMWjfY1bpd4ShqCkqfzGTUB1tn6GxGCSYzNv5PcP6Kv58gPmg8od.jpg)

> **For those unfamiliar with this tree, the araguaney is Venezuela’s national tree, a symbol of strength, resilience, and beauty. It is a tree that, no matter how severe the drought, always finds a way to bloom. It typically blooms in May, when the first rains begin, as if nature were giving it the signal to awaken. This year, however, the rains were slow in coming; the drought was longer and more intense than usual. It has only been raining intermittently for the past week, but it has been enough for many of Margarita’s mountains to be covered in that vibrant yellow that heralds the arrival of the araguaney.**

> *Para quienes no conocen este árbol, el araguaney es el árbol nacional de Venezuela, símbolo de fuerza, resistencia y belleza. Es un árbol que, por más dura que sea la sequía, siempre encuentra la manera de florecer. Su floración suele llegar en mayo, cuando comienzan las primeras lluvias, como si la naturaleza le diera la señal para despertar. Este año, sin embargo, las lluvias se hicieron esperar; la sequía fue más larga y más intensa de lo habitual. Apenas desde hace una semana llueve de forma intermitente, pero ha sido suficiente para que muchas montañas de Margarita se cubran de ese amarillo vibrante que anuncia la llegada del araguaney.*
![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXH3bxPNdAwicuw45ykqs4fFCjrzVNN881gfwULY4oKXCnDYaTgpo9qk9SAtffEPax.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LWHxtDJ6CgRo4w8xgpL98RzFQkmXL2YVCXi7HH86yHaJiqqwF2qiTfqNuuPwBwgR.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23zkkGbcZQoqx6yPXfco7GvngRqKAiSSKrXcGXXEHX3yJxwef68ARC6mkYP64Zbbd2UeD.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23rB3HixVjVc73qLW3gE1NQq42CLYK8EyhGC4ZqUqkJEia3Gc5391ax4mLQiRWT5YxVBf.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYt8F15hzGHrRZMFzRvSy2F4ha28AoVMBtSybX7j3Eqfsh3cPLKavFW6GyChT23q2U.jpg) ![video_2026-06-08_00-12-43.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23zkhxbEaZudaf6mYuKn2jjUoVAZm93ijN28v6fmG1ytV77KDE9i6NueQjbZhsPzFvt8n.gif)

> **I am fortunate enough to experience this firsthand, because one of those trees lives right in my backyard. Throughout the year, it remains full of leaves, offering shade and movement, but between March and April, when it hardly rains, it begins to lose them little by little until it is completely bare. Only its dry, still branches remain, as if it were asleep. But at the tips, small buds begin to appear, patiently waiting for the first rain to awaken.**

> *Yo tengo la fortuna de vivir esa experiencia muy de cerca, porque uno de esos árboles vive conmigo en mi patio. Durante todo el año permanece lleno de hojas, ofreciendo sombra y movimiento, pero entre marzo y abril, cuando casi no llueve, comienza a perderlas poco a poco hasta quedar completamente desnudo. Solo quedan sus ramas secas, quietas, como si estuviera dormido. Pero en las puntas empiezan a aparecer unos pequeños botones que esperan pacientemente la primera lluvia para despertar.*
![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eqb21BTvUks112ahJ9BqgXGqwVBuELcaaD3iDC3vrV3tCAvFUwZeSJUVRgLwkMSk88R.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWkPcjBgB3hBdGbW9Q9wkbMBPxxUT53XLPGRUtfvDF9UTg3tLkND7L9P2HaicHy34D.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wMcP4cSY54SQFHno1fCP2BnJ55fLHi528c1UCz2QMkmKyd28tL5XYTpw22FxPEV4sXB.jpg)

> **And when that first drop falls, the magic begins. The buds swell, slowly opening, and the tree begins to turn yellow. It’s a process that’s truly moving, because every day you can see a change, a new glow.**

> *Y cuando cae esa primera gota, comienza la magia. Los botones se hinchan, se abren lentamente, y el árbol empieza a tornarse amarillo. Es un proceso que emociona, porque cada día se nota un cambio, un brillo nuevo.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3fiSb5xViWQ8wgHtfM6BxDnzfi2y4kXfRUTCDG8j5B5uF55WL8zWfBP1ozbXQ7Yjx.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eou8DnMCPo3xxJRykxA2D24R6YKFkP7Y3h7E51dqxSFvfTAyUiHPWq8aFeTQrcsfuFD.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep1WzgZziWpBte6pHGobL5vRTKhBLRZuU81t6TbqsxyUhe8iw38vyCKFGJiPQBoWsN5.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EonmV4BtzDsgg6BZ5nWnkeYb5xuarsWPuw8p3fWuvFa9P3hLHqHupBzTDPM9PYTXxQJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-12-30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEJHP8Q5xebwzaXJT7aKAp6Uhoae2QdA9fP1aXAksShnnCemd2oQ42j9KBxbG2nA7W.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eou9kfdwHQW6mrfEbnSa8FBLUSGUh9Yv8xFFbcTdAzVu5RWfUbodpKyQqkH6KZtGKEs.jpg)
> **Until, all of a sudden, the entire tree is cloaked in a deep, radiant, almost luminous yellow. It’s as if, in the midst of cloudy days, the sun had decided to settle upon it.**

> *Hasta que, de un momento a otro, el árbol entero se viste de un amarillo intenso, radiante, casi luminoso. Es como si, en medio de los días nublados, el sol decidiera posarse sobre él.*
![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq9UDrB4czehZszdHCjXDJdcJinfYXXtu95NVExsw6GBx5R1jjuFYSjPKARfqCq6vYG.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT3fv1NgKqUNrASFwx5ZEegA2RwVA8VGAfamrHVzLkDC2WXzbqCXg6YWDMXpELGCGD.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJZYsQgE6venc47vyxywttYuBasmgfyzYP2ZL5jy8ZLgEjeSMcVRpe4PQJ5aw1yHZe.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7xS7YFjxYhcjtrNXXCtwbmQw5wgUbkbqAx8sJmsZ2ARx1bar2hhKf8EfywPaGAeM1.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-01-58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnGEWWUJbu9eNtK1piML2d1UnXxZFJn3DYcwk7XxKGEJAEe2iTgHWr3aT1AREewCVX.jpg)

> **That burst of color lasts only a few days, because then the flowers begin to fall gently, forming a golden carpet on the ground. Then new leaf buds appear, which will quietly accompany it for a whole year, until the next blooming.**

> *Esa explosión de color dura solo unos días, porque luego las flores comienzan a caer suavemente, formando una alfombra dorada en el suelo. Entonces aparecen los nuevos brotes de hojas que lo acompañarán silenciosamente durante un año entero, hasta la próxima floración.*
![photo_2026-06-08_00-01-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpLgYf6yitudPfDvPQkA6DVhAEQSe81H86CKZkeAueRowsY4ifzrpobd6p1QxYtSei4.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-01-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnYSsgstKPbRWReQY35MfWeVMvd3AEd9XaGSoz1ukoGmdxfEKspwooCmFDVBPQeCC8f.jpg)

> **This is the third year my araguaney has bloomed, and each time it does so with greater vigor and beauty. My neighbors already know it; many stop by for coffee and to take pictures of it, because it really is a sight to behold. I feel happy and grateful to have it at home, to watch it grow, and to share it with those who appreciate it. Last year, after blooming, the tree produced seed heads. I managed to pick one before it opened and scattered in the wind. I gave it to a neighbor, and they planted it; it’s still small, but our hope is that, over time, we’ll be able to share more araguaney trees with anyone who wants one in their yard. Our street is named “Araguaney,” and paradoxically, there’s only one—mine. We want to change that, even though we know it’s a slow process. Trees have their own rhythm, and they just ask for patience. Dear friends, I couldn’t resist sharing with you the joy that my araguaney’s blooming brought me. I hope you enjoyed the photos I took to show you this little bit of the happiness we share at home.**

> *Este es el tercer año que mi araguaney florece, y cada vez lo hace con más fuerza y más belleza. Mis vecinos ya lo conocen; muchos pasan a tomar café y a fotografiarlo, porque realmente es un espectáculo. Yo me siento feliz y agradecida de tenerlo en casa, de verlo crecer y de compartirlo con quienes lo aprecian. El año pasado, después de la floración, el árbol dio espigas con semillas. Logré tomar una antes de que se abriera y se dispersara con el viento. Se la regalé a un vecino y la sembró; aún está pequeña, pero nuestra idea es que, con el tiempo, podamos repartir más araguaneyes entre quienes quieran tener uno en su patio. Nuestra calle lleva por nombre “Araguaney”, y paradójicamente solo existe uno; el mío. Queremos cambiar eso, aunque sabemos que es un proceso lento. Los árboles tienen su propio ritmo, y solo piden paciencia. Queridos hivers, no podía dejar de compartir con ustedes la emoción que me regaló la floración de mi araguaney. Espero que hayan disfrutado las fotografías que tomé para mostrarles este pedacito de la alegría, que compartimos en casa.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq375YznUqq4TgLZMWjfY1bpd4ShqCkqfzGTUB1tn6GxGCSYzNv5PcP6Kv58gPmg8od.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23uR2pQZe931Jb7gtuL4S1VyGdbnjkDooqVZkGdSsFnJLvNA6w2cGQvSW2jgbjZnTYzN7.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/244AAq5M7wDkr2PKs6wrgv5p4uLwjZqo15YFu1AZGtDZkgwVaJicD2orcZPzK1VSaBWA4.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqL7MMtoS2qcVoB52qtg9d4xt9TyU679miZhG4QXqsyXVjGVynQSmAYr6nyFxURfh3J.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-08_00-02-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA2XR79hkbTSGzSjsNRgo2N58PXspkDqKkdCV3dzQVm9idZhPamLnogQtoDrtegS6t.jpg)

body.title: a long journey
body.body:
# a long journey
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-08 at 11.19.06.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVzwH7Md8bMmpzQSKZqHC5PnGgF6jrSQxv3sStQko6J6p/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-06-08%20at%2011.19.06.jpeg)
* This is a trip of my little family, specifically in Indonesia. We traveled by car, and along the way, it was very bright with the beautiful chirping of birds. We didn't know whether it was the chirping of birds fighting, mating, singing, maybe one of those.
 
# Throughout the journey we chatted inside the car
>husband: where are we going today?  
wife: to the beautiful beach  
husband: okay, ready princess, let's go to the beach
# beach edge
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-30 at 21.53.44.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhuHRiASs6fyvfjX3Neyg6s87vxR5eaNDZN6SKYPfCbz/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-30%20at%2021.53.44.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 10.09.07.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQPARJHaNY8Bgb8ykRWF6Fh53HgLt8RYghs7PAxuDzyH/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-31%20at%2010.09.07.jpeg)
* Finally we arrived at the beautiful and lovely sea, and our hearts were calm with the sound of the waves and the cool breeze, as if whispering 'swim, the water is clear, the water is clean, come on, just jump a little,' that's how the whisper of the waves and the cool breeze felt.
The roaring waves, the cool wind, the clean water, and the beautiful and nice corals on the edge of this beach, we can only look at the sea from the edge of the beach on the rocks where we stand. The water is clean and clear, but the waves are sharp and big, and we decided not to go into the water, even though the sea is very tempting and whispers to dive in.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 10.09.06 (1).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUb573zUtjDBRg7xKztN9RK2kvzefGDGViqRCd13Pxfx/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-31%20at%2010.09.06%20(1).jpeg)
# cat passing by
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 10.09.06.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmefPWsHFCqRCyuPq6wKbn6SUosHfa9KQTRUmkkQAVtJRQ/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-31%20at%2010.09.06.jpeg)
* The beach shore with a cool breeze and the sound of the waves roaring noisily but making the heart feel calm, suddenly a beautiful clean cat passed by, maybe this cat has an owner, the color is nice, the fur is beautiful. She walked on the rocks towards us, maybe she was hungry, but unfortunately, we didn't bring cat food, then she walked past us.
We have been here for a long time, the day is starting to get dark, we are preparing to go home. On the way home, we talked to each other about the beauty of the blue sea, the cool breeze, the beautiful corals, the green trees, the passing scenery was very beautiful. It's a pity we couldn't stay there long because the sky was getting dark. It's not good to travel along the beach at night with insufficient lighting, because we avoid being by the sea at night since the place is quiet and lacks lighting. Even though there is some lighting, it is only at a few houses, the rest of the road is dark.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-08 at 11.19.06 (1).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRMxW6ABW35K61hM8F5mQkhBYf1QDx3APKegYnWUbj8uR/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-06-08%20at%2011.19.06%20(1).jpeg)

body.body: <div class=\

> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23y8N5wmANXx764aTdaQBFCmigc6tKNfT1why57rB4xbUBtWbFeLLR5jRvWdProy6phEg.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 08.06.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5ZXWhfs7XCouGcWmg39LQGrFSw4AH6JchVhHykiMp7h4tC94N5FvnC4gSL3YPcUk2y.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Windows Netlogon — krytyczna luka RCE w protokole domenowym aktywnie eksploitowana***

BleepingComputer alarmuje: krytyczna podatność w protokole Windows Netlogon — mechanizmie uwierzytelniania między komputerami a kontrolerami domeny Active Directory — jest aktywnie eksploitowana przez atakujących. Luka umożliwia zdalne wykonanie kodu na kontrolerach domeny bez żadnego uwierzytelnienia, co w praktyce oznacza pełne przejęcie całej infrastruktury sieciowej organizacji w jednym kroku. Kontroler domeny to \
sieci Windows: kto go ma, ten ma klucze do wszystkiego. Badacze porównują wagę tej luki do historycznego \

z 2020 roku. Microsoft wydał łatkę — aktualizacja natychmiastowa jest absolutnie obowiązkowa dla wszystkich organizacji używających Active Directory.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wMcSUweiKvgZBcf4keuf49ck4HMni24fJSW8ZwMkF13WSUkWWU2dkNzdVdit6jpujQ8.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/critical-windows-netlogon-remote-code-execution-flaw-now-exploited-in-attacks/) [EN]*

---

### ***Operacja Dragon Weave — chińskie APT używa Microsoft Azure jako C2 do ataków na Czechy i Tajwan***

Seqrite Research opisuje nową, zaawansowaną kampanię szpiegowską powiązaną z chińskim wywiadem: atakujący, zamiast budować własną infrastrukturę C2, używają Microsoft Azure — legalnej platformy chmurowej — jako serwera dowodzenia. Złośliwy kod komunikuje się wyłącznie przez Azure API, przez co ruch wygląda identycznie jak legalny ruch firmowy do usług Microsoft. Blokowanie tej komunikacji jest praktycznie niemożliwe bez zakłócenia normalnej pracy organizacji. Kampania jest wymierzona w instytucje rządowe Czech i podmiotów powiązanych z Tajwanem.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tGXzJi6oN1oTRp7vZrcdphH711w2K8YHAa4QTtTN5VWuVGvzZCUX7MdJpcx1GXSjYhf.png)

*Źródło: [Seqrite](https://www.seqrite.com/blog/operation-dragon-weave-uncovering-a-china-linked-campaign-targeting-czech-republic-and-taiwan-using-azure-cloud-c2/) [EN]*

---

### ***Kulisy ścigania cyberprzestępców — jak Europol koordynuje operacje przeciwko gangs***

WNP.pl opublikował obszerny materiał za kulisami działania Europolu jako globalnego centrum dowodzenia w walce z cyberprzestępczością. Europol łączy ludzi, dane wywiadowcze i operacje między 44 krajami, by szybciej identyfikować i rozbijać grupy cyberprzestępcze. Artykuł opisuje konkretne mechanizmy: jak działa baza danych o przestępcach i ich narzędziach, jak koordynowane są jednoczesne przeszukania w wielu krajach i dlaczego operacje na ciemnej sieci są tak trudne do prowadzenia. Fascynujące spojrzenie na stronę \

w tej wojnie.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tGcDiCKPx9ipBK3QQdWRFuBEKi72HLjGXUQcsPxBzQBMPAWcr8A8491sMAfwR1kwKM8.png)

*Źródło: [WNP.pl](https://www.wnp.pl/tech/tak-sciga-sie-cyberprzestepcow-kulisy-operacji-europolu,1063994.html) [PL]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***DentaQuest — ShinyHunters publikują dane 2,6 miliona pacjentów stomatologicznych***

Security Affairs potwierdza: ShinyHunters opublikowali skradzione dane z DentaQuest — platformy zarządzającej świadczeniami stomatologicznymi dla milionów Amerykanów. Ujawnione dane 2,6 miliona osób obejmują dane osobowe, informacje o ubezpieczeniu i historię leczenia stomatologicznego. To kolejna ofiara gangu ShinyHunters w ich imponującej serii 2026 roku. Dane medyczne są szczególnie wartościowe dla cyberprzestępców: w połączeniu z danymi kontaktowymi i ubezpieczeniowymi umożliwiają wyrafinowane ataki phishingowe i wyłudzenia.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23w28sqKkBFErLjcsQAt7EE5RhQNfFWeD3uY5fzqEcFfBLivJeJgxPcM3YAQ8E7q766wW.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/193274/data-breach/dentaquest-breach-shinyhunters-publish-data-impacting-2-6m-people.html) [EN]*

---

### ***C0xmo — nowy botnet eksploituje lukę w routerach DD-WRT i eliminuje rywali***

BleepingComputer opisuje C0xmo — nowy botnet, który rozprzestrzenia się przez podatność w popularnym alternatywnym firmware DD-WRT (stosowanym na setkach tysięcy routerów domowych i firmowych). Po infekcji C0xmo nie tylko dodaje router do swojej sieci DDoS, ale aktywnie skanuje i usuwa inne złośliwe oprogramowanie z zainfekowanego urządzenia — walcząc o \
. To zjawisko \

o zasoby zainfekowanych urządzeń jest coraz powszechniejsze.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23swe5Pin9Q3ZjLjo9Xz3CMthfLcQEKn9hNiXov7B6g7RNyHjMERo3e3hoBnGKQ16tRzJ.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/c0xmo-botnet-spreads-via-dd-wrt-router-flaw-kills-rival-malware/) [EN]*

---

### ***Silent Ransom Group — fałszywe połączenia IT support kradną dane kancelarii prawnych***

BleepingComputer opisuje szczegóły taktyki grupy Silent Ransom Group: atakujący dzwonią do pracowników kancelarii prawnych podając się za pracowników IT wsparcia (helpdesk) i nakłaniają do zainstalowania narzędzia do zdalnego pulpitu \

. Uzyskany zdalny dostęp jest natychmiast używany do eksfiltracji poufnych danych klientów. Kancelarie prawne są wyjątkowo atrakcyjnym celem — przechowują strategie sądowe, umowy, dane transakcji i tajemnice korporacyjne. Pracownicy prawniczy rzadziej przechodzą szkolenia cyberbezpieczeństwa niż IT.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wWnHdDrj98nZTdpMZzHRS7D88BEyipDZkmiaxpPVmwspJYcC6X8N3svHQ44qkRkubmN.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/silent-ransom-group-targets-law-firms-with-fake-it-support-calls/) [EN]*

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***Autonomiczne agenty AI w Google Cloud mogą uzyskiwać dostęp do danych firmy — nowe pytania o prywatność***

Virtual-IT.pl opisuje rosnące obawy dotyczące nowych agentic AI features w Google Cloud: autonomiczne systemy AI mogą uzyskiwać szeroki dostęp do zasobów danych firmowych — poczty, dokumentów, baz danych — aby \
w automatyzacji. Bez wyraźnych polityk ograniczania dostępu (principle of least privilege), AI agent może \

znacznie więcej niż powinien. Artykuł wskazuje na konieczność audytu uprawnień agentów AI jako nowego elementu bezpieczeństwa organizacyjnego.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/AJiu5qFFsqFowCEcL46ZJKbiAmWjbdDHU8vSFhvFxrDYVgkLSJW6ats98cZZF4U.png)

*Źródło: [Virtual-IT.pl](https://virtual-it.pl/15650-autonomiczne-systemy-ai-w-google-cloud-moga-uzyskiwac-dostep-do-danych-firmy.html) [PL]*

---

### ***FCC: Operatorzy komórkowi nie mogą śledzić lokalizacji abonentów bez zgody — przełomowy wyrok***

Telepolis relacjonuje ważny wyrok Federalnej Komisji Komunikacji (FCC) USA: operatorzy telekomunikacyjni nie mają prawa przekazywać danych o lokalizacji abonentów stronom trzecim bez ich wyraźnej zgody. Kilku głównych operatorów zostało ukaranych wielomilionowymi grzywnami za historyczne naruszenia. Wyrok ma implikacje dla prywatności i jest sygnałem dla europejskich regulatorów. W Polsce RODO już formalnie chroni takie dane — lecz pytania o rzeczywistą egzekucję pozostają otwarte.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48SMMrjDUPkqMGETqnkKGzuZeWxFoTYj1DMT1QTbYrUpqhtQDBrAYyEmzc5XJtDA9Z.png)

*Źródło: [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/bezpieczenstwo/wyrok-fcc-namierzanie-abonentow) [PL]*
