## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Fałszywy sklep pod markę \
— jak rozpoznać oszustwo online***\n\nCERT Orange Polska opublikował ostrzeżenie i analizę fałszywego sklepu internetowego podszywającego się pod polską markę odzieżową/streetwear \

(powiązaną z popularną kulturą polskiego internetu). Sklep jest precyzyjną kopią prawdziwego brandu — logo, produkty, zdjęcia — lecz wyłącznie zbiera płatności bez realizacji zamówień. CERT Orange opisuje konkretne techniki weryfikacji: sprawdzanie daty rejestracji domeny, brak danych kontaktowych firmy, nierealistyczne ceny. Artykuł jest świetnym praktycznym przewodnikiem po weryfikacji stron e-commerce.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48K6EqP2NZnPoJU2xXYe2pn7wbydv57B9Hbtogt4tbZMa3Km47QXY4EaxbmFRHEzRu.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Orange Polska](https://cert.orange.pl/ostrzezenia/falszywy-sklep-wykorzystuje-popularnosc-latwoganga-jak-rozpoznac-oszustwo/) [PL]*

---

### ***Pink — nowa grupa ekstorcji wyłudza dostęp do kont Microsoft 365 przez vishing***

Hackread opisuje grupę \

— nowy podmiot używający vishingu (telefonicznych ataków socjotechnicznych) do uzyskiwania dostępu do firmowych kont Microsoft 365 i przechowywanych tam danych. Atakujący dzwonią do pracowników działów IT lub zarządu, podszywając się pod pracowników Microsoftu lub dostawców usług chmurowych, i nakłaniają do podania poświadczeń lub kliknięcia spreparowanego linku \

. Po uzyskaniu dostępu firma otrzymuje żądanie okupu za nieujawnianie skradzionych danych. Pink jest prawdopodobnie odgałęzieniem lub naśladowcą Scattered Spider.

*Źródło: [Hackread](https://hackread.com/pink-extortion-microsoft-365-cloud-data-vishing-scams/) [EN]*

---

### ***Scamy — czym właściwie są i jak nie dać się okraść w sieci***

Demagog.pl opublikował obszerny, edukacyjny przewodnik po typach internetowych oszustw: od klasycznych phishingowych e-maili, przez fałszywe sklepy, inwestycyjne schematy Ponziego, po nowoczesne deepfake'owe fraudy. Artykuł jest napisany przystępnym językiem i przeznaczony dla szerokiej publiczności — nie dla specjalistów IT. Zawiera konkretne przykłady, zdjęcia i checklisty weryfikacyjne. Idealna pozycja do udostępnienia starszym rodzicom lub znajomym mniej biegłym w cyfrowym świecie.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/Ep1WPHegF5b9AR1Kzd8UZhkxKQ16GtqgjQZqQvY1KcktcVkPRvmdcgWuWcFh1AAhoUr.png)

*Źródło: [Demagog.pl](https://demagog.org.pl/analizy_i_raporty/scamy-czyli-wlasciwie-co-jak-nie-dac-sie-okrasc-w-sieci/) [PL]*

---

## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА

### ***FSB Matrioszka — Sekoia ujawnia szczegóły GammaPhish i GammaWorm grupy Gamaredon***

Sekoia.io opublikowała pierwszy z trzech zaplanowanych raportów o kampanii FSB \

— szczegółową analizę techniczną narzędzi grupy Gamaredon (rosyjskie GRU/FSB). GammaPhish to zestaw narzędzi phishingowych precyzyjnie dostrojonych pod ofiary w Ukrainie, GammaWorm zaś to robak propagujący się przez zainfekowane stacje robocze. Raport dostarcza pełnych wskaźników kompromitacji (IoC) i jest nieocenionym materiałem dla polskich i ukraińskich CSIRT-ów. Gamaredon jest aktywny od 2013 roku i od 2022 roku operuje z bezprecedensową intensywnością. ![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tSyukFYEYstZDvLop5pScWgzMEkKXJYB2PTHZdYhVpT9LgkxgCq3abC2uoM5KqpjLVo.png) *Źródło: [Sekoia.io Blog](https://blog.sekoia.io/fsbs-matryoshka-1-3-gamaredons-gifts-that-keeps-unpacking-gammaphish-and-gammaworm/) [EN]* --- ### ***Izrael — krytyczny poziom zagrożeń i centrum uwagi amerykańskiego kontrwywiadu*** Infosecurity24.pl opisuje alarmujące dane z raportów wywiadowczych: Izrael stał się jednym z głównych ognisk aktywności szpiegowskiej na świecie — zarówno jako cel, jak i jako podmiot aktywny w operacjach wywiadowczych wobec USA. Kontrowersje wokół użycia Pegasusa, napięcia dyplomatyczne i intensywność regionalnych konfliktów zbrojnych sprawiają, że CIA i FBI monitorują przypadki szpiegostwa powiązane z Izraelem z wyjątkową uwagą. Artykuł opisuje konkretne sprawy sądowe i trendy operacyjne. ![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tSSEizHk6qhsvVHyewBbLYC9gccTot58x9VYDggBiBauy9hGxy2FQG2g3Gi8RXniEkj.png) *Źródło: [Infosecurity24.pl](https://infosecurity24.pl/za-granica/krytyczny-poziom-zagrozenia-izrael-w-centrum-uwagi-amerykanskiego-kontrwywiadu) [PL]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 7 czerwca 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

body.title: 打卡世界名人蜡像馆
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![56fATdlq7xCqLcZG_IMG_20260601_152451.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/56fATdlq7xCqLcZG_IMG_20260601_152451/56fATdlq7xCqLcZG_IMG_20260601_152451.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

到了11楼我们才发现这里不仅有蜡像馆，还是“世界文化大观园”。

电梯出楼处就是各个朝代皇帝的雕像，小宝身体好了心情也更好了，不停的让我给她拍照。

走廊的确像是一座大观园，又是没来得及拍照的一天。

三皇五帝的铜像，我家小宝在每个铜像面前都一一跪拜了，这份诚心天地可鉴呀！我妈信奉佛教，早晚给菩萨上香之时，小宝都会在旁边模仿。

拜完还不忘对我说：“妈妈，我每个都磕头了。”嗯，真不错。
秦始皇，始皇帝的腿都被摸到反光了，想必不少人与他合照，小宝也坐在他怀中

汉武帝刘彻

唐太宗李世民

好了时间不早了，我们得赶紧去蜡像馆

篮球巨星——迈克尔乔丹

姚明，蜡像做得很逼真

国外运动员

玛丽莲梦露，每个蜡像小宝都要跑过去合影

功夫巨星李小龙

奥黛丽赫本

成龙大哥，小宝这样凝视着他，不知道小脑袋瓜在想写什么

邓丽君

童话世界，小朋友的最爱

以上是国家领导人，大家都认识

真正的大佬首富

巾帼英雄（花木兰、穆桂英、梁红玉等）

查询资料我才发现“万家丽购物中心”有多牛，楼顶有8个直升机停车位，据说顾客可以直接开飞机来购物。可以吹吹楼顶的晚风、看看长沙的日落和夜景。这里很好逛，可以玩上一整天，朋友们下次来长沙万家丽是个不错的选择喔！

从万家丽出来我们就直接打车前往高铁站，六一长沙之行到这里就结束了。

---

body.title: My new achievement in Splinterlands: Nerissa Tridawn card purchase experience
body.body:
While playing Splinterlands I am always looking for some cards that can strengthen my team give me extra advantage battlefield. For a long time, I was looking for  strong damage dealer for Water Splinter. After researching various cards, I finally decided to buy the Nerissa Tridawn card. I recently purchased this card for 235.51 DEC and today I want share a few words about my new achievement.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY8uBPjHmt822J7Le9bjbFpAnNWKUGWQoADDQbMP2Aqw1/1780894566116.png)

I have say that Nerissa Tridawn's artwork attracted me at first sight. Her appearance is like a mysterious warrior emerging from the depths sea. The trident in her hand and the confident posture make her truly extraordinary. In Splinterlands, not only being strong is enough, the visual design of the card also carries a lot of importance to a player. In that regard, Nerissa Tridawn is a great addition to me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPL7uRy6x5FLDEeS6WpMi3ccSEmJgRJYiL6dEpsis7Jz/1780894566241.jpg)

The main strength card is its huge Health.  At level 1 it has Health 9 Magic Attack 3 and Speed 2. Although it has Armor its Health is so high that it can often withstand enemy attacks for a long time. Especially because of its Magic Attack, it is effective against opponents who have a lot of Armor. Because Magic Attack directly affects Health.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZypg3u57YzXLEfrVLdUMumg2idZtuknXtzc4B5X1BsN/1780894566396.jpg)

When I first saw stats this card, I realized that it could be a valuable asset for Water Splinter. Most time, we look for cards that have multiple Abilities. But even though Nerissa Tridawn has no Abilities, its Raw Stats are so strong that they make it special. Sometimes simple but powerful cards can change  outcome  match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXYpUbq5QpnPDqJ3NZKh2DH9xSewSMWNCcTiigdigZXTq/1780894566180.jpg)

In my opinion, the biggest advantage this card is its reliability. It becomes even more powerful when forming a team based on Magic Attack.

I like playing Water Splinter because there are many strong Magic Attackers.  When I added Nerissa Tridawn to my team, my entire strategy became more balanced. It can deal consistent Magic Damage in the back row and can also survive in the front row if needed. This versatility is what motivated me to buy the card.

The level-up potential is also another big attraction of this card. The stats table I saw shows that its Magic Attack and Health increase further at higher levels. This gives me the opportunity to upgrade it by collecting more copies in the future. This is an important factor in long-term planning in Splinterlands. Because investing in a good card can increase its value in the future.

When buying the card, I observed various offers on the market. Finally, I was able to collect it for 235.51 DEC. This price seemed quite reasonable to me, because as a strong Magic Unit of Epic rarity, it can perform well in the long run. Card prices fluctuate  lot market so buying at right time is very important.

 Speaking Nerissa Tridawns effectiveness on battlefield, it is especially useful when the opponent Armor-based strategies. Since Magic Attack directly hits Health, it is possible to break down many opponent's defenses very quickly. I believe this card will play an important role for me in many future matches.

Another thing I like is its Est. Power. According to statistics, collecting it increases the overall power of the account. In Splinterlands, not only winning matches, but also Collection Power is important. Nerissa Tridawn is a great addition in that regard.

In my personal experience, the joy of buying a new card is always different. Especially when that card is part of a long-term plan. After buying Nerissa Tridawn, I feel like I have been able to take my Water Deck a step further. Now I feel more motivated to test new combinations.

I plan upgrade this card a higher level future. Because its effectiveness will also increase as the level increases.  I think this is a card that can be useful for both new experienced players. Its a great choice, especially for those who prefer Magic Attack-based strategies.

Finally, Nerissa Tridawn is an important addition to my Splinterlands journey. I was impressed by its powerful Magic Attack, high Health, and attractive design. I am happy with my decision to purchase this card for 235.51 DEC. I hope it will lead me to victory in many future battles.

Every new card is not just a digital asset, but also opens the door to new possibilities. Nerissa Tridawn is just such a name for me. Now I just have to wait and see how it plays out in some more great matches. I believe this card will strengthen my Water Splinter deck and help me achieve better results in the future.

This was my experience collecting the new Epic Water Unit Nerissa Tridawn. I hope this card will prove itself as one of the best assets in my collection in the days to come.

body.title: FIRST DAY OF SCHOOL TURNED INTO A NIGHTMARE: At 7:46 AM, Classes Stopped, Buildings Damaged, Families Praying
body.body:
![Blue and Yellow Travel Photo Collage (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48UHPv8MMwzLNGZTdaV7wJVmehNkj4ekkjkWL7q5RmKTe9JLnik3g8eBpShLpjcTUz.jpg)

June 8, 2026 marked the first day of classes in the Philippines for most learners, except for daycare pupils. Many children woke up early, excited to wear their uniforms, meet their teachers, and see their classmates again after the break.

But at around 7:46 in the morning, everything changed.
We live in Sultan Kudarat, part of the SOCCSKSARGEN Region, in the Philippines one of the areas greatly affected by the powerful magnitude 7.8 earthquake that struck Mindanao. Instead of hearing stories about classrooms and school activities, people were talking about damaged buildings, terrified students, and the possibility of aftershocks.

At the time of the earthquake, my husband was driving a van in General Santos City. Not long after the shaking stopped, my phone rang. It was him.
His first concern was our safety.


![FB_IMG_1780882302561.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/Ep5koHsqpao93CL2rkDBCsbWHvKTmHsbD7UmCcVQyhzmv8ekJgy7d7zC1bgHVBLCeJ2.jpg)

He immediately asked how we were doing and if everyone at home was okay. As much as I was relieved to hear his voice, I was worried about him too. He told me how strong the impact felt while he was on the road. Despite the fear, he focused on ensuring the safety of his passengers first before thinking of himself.
For that, I am truly grateful.

![FB_IMG_1780881286122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wC7ZbFg8ahx5Vn24kDVFNTAaF1hkWkmvpKQ5CkibKVXrfd4ofLRkF49ULV3R1HGSerF.jpg)

As the day went on, social media became flooded with live videos and photos showing the extent of the damage. One of the places that caught my attention was the Jollibee branch near the Oval Plaza in General Santos City, close to my former workplace. I used to visit that branch often for snacks, lunch breaks, and meetings.

![717228799_28068794549390560_823517562347822896_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EphxsP9suFy7HoH4MGdGXaNmE9RbykgAzCjLoEeHEwd81XgF6bhXv9rS6Y6vzLz1aZW.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1780880044631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EoPLfui5iGx8vFyp3pEfXGfutHYgmh3iTu47bJaEBFa9DTPUD54WfwNYPagfbXKNsoP.jpg)



Seeing it damaged broke my heart.

My thoughts immediately went to the people who were inside when the earthquake happened. Were they able to get out safely? Were there injuries? The many unanswered questions left me feeling heavy and emotional.


![FB_IMG_1780880025250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EpVAi1ESrCRJVLj9vqSviMzef5j4TQ9KxFxn5sDYjBsUSXkgTiqHJbmrFUJ5gLwdGip.jpg)


Reports also showed damage to parts of Gaisano Malls, while several schools and establishments required immediate inspection. Students and teachers who were supposed to be enjoying the first day of school instead experienced fear and uncertainty. Some children cried. Teachers tried to remain calm while guiding students to safety.

![FB_IMG_1780882353407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EpVCbfjwSpmYn8KKJDUSshc3teTttJatsLqSLiY2DAwXfKKQFgxK1WGpTy4b9g6TFje.jpg)

Government offices, public schools, and private schools were later advised to suspend classes and operations as safety assessments continued.


Today reminded me how fragile life can be.

In just a matter of seconds, everything can change. A family can lose a loved one. A worker can lose a livelihood. A business owner can lose years of hard work. An ordinary school day can suddenly become a day of survival.

As I write this, aftershocks are still being expected. Many families remain anxious, while others are grieving losses and assessing damages.

Today, I am thankful that my family is safe. I am thankful that my husband and his passengers made it through the frightening experience on the road. But my heart also aches for those who were not as fortunate. Until now my head is not okay because aftershocks in 15 minutes, i pray to be alright. 

![FB_IMG_1780881297773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xedSbwcrDNGGi3dD6Ljj7Fb7bwBMyqD2dTCXHhmtRjj7wfPL6NXpaT2oRissQ7dkUgP.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1780881358178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xKp3n1UMJSnSPbL7KTmGafjHxneBXBRyhixNG4pieSBcBPZzCS83YHVXg9eG596AWPW.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1780880054132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245cKWonW3diq9MhpoNSH2ojpyZ4vUB1GKYWfcLyPRAKPdTGnYPPLb3tz5kUgfw6QixP5.jpg)

Let us continue praying for all the victims, for the rescue teams, for our teachers and students, and for every family affected by this disaster.
May God protect us all and give us strength as we recover from this tragedy.

Photo Credits: Some photos used in this post were sourced from My friend Facebook Page of Hazel Kezai Gellangarin

body.title: The best kinds of distractions
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbmJzD84kXB4qkSEt8jpoaMMnBqdZRVRy2ExtwRHbrjep/img_3248.png)


It’s been a while! 

I’ve hardly noticed the time pass, I’ve been swamped with one thing after another.  Mostly I’ve been working through the process of making physical CD’s and practicing for a very big show in two weeks. 

I’m not sure how thorough companies in other countries are but the CD printing company in Japan gave me a 52 page explainer for how to format the art (which they require is done in adobe illustrator, which I’ve never used) so I’ve been studying how to use the software, not to mention rewarding through all that with my less than perfect Japanese, dictionary app in hand. 

I also had to change the music to DDP format which required another new program and learning curve. At least next time will be easier. 

I’m printing 500 copies, which is way too much for me to feel comfortable about being able to sell in the digital age, but in Japan a lot of people buy CD’s if they like you because they are collectors, and because it’s a good way to support the artist. 

I went with 500 because the cost of 100 an 500 is only about a 30% difference (rough math), about $2 a CD for 500 when it would have been about $9 a CD for 500! 

In order to make that back, I’ll need to sell about 60 copies in order to make that back, which shouldn’t be too hard, and then I’ll have another 440 to sell at 100% profit. 

If I can sell 3-6 cds per show, that’s an extra $50-$100 per show, and if the crowds are twice as big as they have been up until now (and due to some unforeseen circumstances, that seems like it might be the case) that’s another $50-100 per show.  Hardly enough to eat but enough to justify prioritizing more shows, since it doesn’t conflict with my other work.

I never wanted to play music with money as a priority and I don’t think I ever will, but I like mapping these things out in my mind to make them as sustainable as possible, and the most sustainable way would be to be able to earn a living while keeping my other work, so I’d never feel compelled to compromise. 

On my own it would be very very hard to draw 25-50 people a show. When you play once every 2-3 months, friends try hard to make it out, but when it’s every week they become much more passive.  But thanks to the magical way the universe grants exponential growth to things with enough energy, we are receiving all kinds of support I wasn’t expecting. 

A venue I’ve played 3-4 times in the past invited me to come back and play again, this time opening for a well known French artist…. A little more well known than I’m used to, 500k monthly listeners on Spotify ….waaaat?

I still don’t feel ready or all that interesting in playing big stages but luckily this guys audience is much smaller in Asia than it is in Europe, but I still think the 50 body capacity be will fill up…. Nice! 

I’m a bit worried about our ability to play well enough to sway the crowd though because we’ve become more experimental, which casual audiences read as “strange”, but when we play our best, I think people can see beyond the unfamiliar and appreciate our sound. 

I’m practicing in hyperdrive just because I don’t wanna get booed by a bunch of people half my age 😝. It’s not about wanting to be liked, it’s about wanting to pull off a magical evening with conditions that are challenging for me. And being liked certainly won’t hurt!

Meanwhile another shop nearby which we love and which I’ve played before asked us to play and they have their own scene with loyal customers so we wouldn’t even have to promote that show very hard, audience guaranteed.  

Meanwhile it’s only rumblings but yesterday I was told by a friend and collaborator of our favorite band that they will organize a big festival at multiple small venues. He said he will put in a good worth for us with them and we might be able to play it. 

We dreamed of getting involved with them when we first discover them but they’ve been getting bigger and bigger to the point where they are touring Europe for festivals and selling out some of the biggest non-stadium venues in Japan.  We are not sure how we feel about going for bigger and grander, but we also know if we are invited by the right people we won’t want to turn it down. There are some people you want to work with enough to step out of your comfort zone. 

Also, I played two shows this year organized by another band I’d put on my top 10 Japanese indie band list, and a lot of other artists in that scene played there. 

It’s interesting to see the same bands sell out 8000 person venues and then organize shows in rooms meant for 50-100 people with no real contradiction. I like the decentralization of attention. It means almost no one is too far away to reach and that vibe speaks much louder than words. 

We always know we were of the same vibe as these people, at least to a meaningful degree. 

I still don’t know if we will play there, but even if it’s just a possibility, I don’t want to not be ready and so I am practicing my ass off, not only for the show in two weeks but with late summer in mind. 

Most of the bands playing that show will be hard rock, punk, or loud in some way, though not exclusively. If we are actually invited, I would like to prepare for such an environment and so I’m thinking of asking a drummer friend to join us, and maybe a bass player too though I’m not sure we will be able to prepare enough together since schedules in Tokyo are always crazy. 

If we are not invited, at least the practice will help me with the studio album I’ve started recording.  That seems to be getting pushed back due to all the practice, but I can’t complain since things are on a very positive trajectory a they are being interrupted by the best kinds of distractions. 

Part of me just wants to work on new songs for album 2 but album 1 isn’t even recorded yet and album 0 (live album) still needs physical release and promoting.  Phew!  One step at a time right?

body.body: <div class=\

>
Hello .. !! My dear Hive friends, I am @samadbro08 from Bangladesh. Today is Monday , June 08/2026
Hi everyone , How are you all, I hope you are well, today I will taking aout to the SplinterVibes shop. If you love background music in the game and at the same time want additional benefits from in-game assets or lands, then this feature is for you. In today's blog, we will know about SplinterVibes Shop, its Series 1 and one of the attractions of this series, Cinder and Land Resources. Let's start with it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqeFMnY6rANrGstacZnZidWj1o1Q9BuGwKJpRyZEPepM/1780893197188.png) [Source](https://chatgpt.com/) First, let's know what SplinterVibes is and how it works? Simply put, SplinterVibes is Splinterlands' own music NFT. Each music track is based on the theme of one of the popular characters in the game, such as Llama Mage, Arcane Skinwalker. There is no obligation for you to buy the NFT to listen to these songs, anyone can listen to them on the in-built player of the game. However, if you own a track, it is 100% your property. You can buy and sell it to other players if you want.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQw81n9XWYZwVP7GWMgv5Q4hjrJUwT6rhK6126yasRZ9L/1780893930306.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
SplinterVibes started with Series 1. Although there are plans for a lot of tracks throughout the project, only 12 unique tracks have been brought in the first series. There are only 100 copies of each track and a total of 1,200 NFTs. The game team has put together some great ways to get these tracks, such as the DEC and Glint shops, where some tracks can be purchased directly by spending in-game currency, such as the Llama Mage track for 2000 DEC or the Yaba's Pickle track for 20,000 Glint. However, if you play the game regularly, you can get this music NFT completely free with just a 0.05% chance from a Minor Chest or Frontier Jackpot drop. This is a great opportunity.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWHCGqof49KUaCK2YitYg21oDPY2YZyot8HvgSoyiCGNL/1780892383626.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
This feature works as a masterstroke to increase the usefulness of the land or land in Splinterlands. Several special music tracks in Series 1 require land-based resources rather than regular currency. For example, the Craniax track can be purchased with Grain. The Jicarilla track can be purchased with Wood. The Possibilus track can be purchased with Stone. And the Zarin track can be purchased with Iron. As a result, the game's land economy is becoming stronger and a permanent demand or \

of land-based products is being created, which is also quite good for the game.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTAdqmjqPSW3x2uouz1vgbpPEk8DsMcQ5gzoFZZ9GYQxG/1780892367506.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
Craftable cards have been added to the SplinterVibes and Land updates, one of which is Cinder. Players can craft this powerful card directly in the game using specific resources from their land. According to the game rules, a maximum of 60,000 copies of this card can be crafted. Not only cards, but if desired, it is also possible to create exclusive skins for these cards with land resources. This has opened up new doors of income for both gamers and land owners.
The best part about this SplinterVibes and Land update for Splinterlands is that it is not forced into the core mechanics of the game. It is completely cosmetic and optional, which adds to the fun of the game. If you are a land owner, this is the best opportunity to utilize your resources and if you are a regular player, you can win some great releases by playing the game. Anyway, I am finishing my post here today, thank you everyone. If you want to know more about this, visit here [Splinterlands] (https://splinterlands.com/shop/music) .
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrz5aqaQE8fjygAMZycWabiPgeX3MVzAH2gttLdN2ixX/1752476713171.jpg)
Picture of myself

Especially we are two brothers of parents. I am the eldest son of the family. My educational qualification is I am an honors 4th year student of Bengali department.

body.title: Splinterlands: A'lan Musketeer is an amazing card in Tis But Scratches
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used A'lan Musketeer.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uQGVAujPdt3a875NFcoacptLuGbChqJrg2bKXdNxgtE9PYnhuWNTNqRZ7YDBRFL4Wkj.png)
A'lan Musketeer is a neutral monster that costs 8 mana. It only has the double strike ability, but I think it is a fairly good card in Frontier. I got this card recently, and I have noticed that it's a good addition because it is neutral and it can be placed in most fights if I need it. I absolutely love using this card in Frontier due to its damage.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/242hSZGFYBBheqCGDW4GpoEEqX4DR4FZBgXG8NnsBYc3XCW6oVt9bxN2avUhtpaARQR2g.png)</center>

The rulesets this time are Brute Force and Tis But Scratches. This means that attack goes first in turn order and all monsters gain the cripple ability. There is also 35 mana available, and I can use every [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except earth.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Barthalamas|6|Summoner|+1 speed|
|Frankarsgard|7|1st||
|Chaos Furybringer|6|2nd|Reach|
|Sturdy Axe Warden|8|3rd||
|A'lan Musketeer|8|4th|Double Strike|
|Total Mana:|35|||

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. I went with Barthalamas as my archon for the +1 speed, and Frankarsgard is my tank. Chaos Furybringer is my backup tank with reach because of its high stats. After that are my ranged monsters as damage dealers.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmMvUc2Bb5bNAxYic2qJqQT4K44jeixXYwHQppUqMtRPC63zfyHXqWJpqGcGHFB4vet.png)
At first glance, I think that this match can go either way, but I have a slight advantage because I have faster speed than my opponent. A'lan Musketeer is such a great card, but it will also get hit hard due to my opponent's backline monsters. However, that spread-out damage is another disadvantage that they have. 

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u697SdKF1KUuCQqZYWNxLwouaSD25PBpk8fEouJdE5amQsQUEhdYFDLLKjUDDx7Hga2.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent's lineup is reduced to 2 monsters, while I still have all of mine. However, my monsters are also low health, so it was quite dangerous. I have this win in because I focused all my damage, and my monsters are faster than my opponent's.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EoErSsvU9SDdrF4NRhn7hsmQeNDYUvBqZRNtZquv8t5biZRSZubQWvMQLiSiCVt2wWa.png)

I won the match as I expected.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. I love using A'lan Musketeer as it is such a powerful card, and it was the only reason I could take out my opponent's tank fast enough. My cards were close to dying, and it was quite dangerous, so it was nice to see that my opponent messed up by spreading out his damage.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_82b95d1837d05f26f407b2b452425bf8?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

body.title: The offer move - how to price package and position what you sell
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEBiTk1iGU8bayDvohTBR78tdFXjCj3rT3rHCyxxt2Ux/img_7891.png)

The Offer Move — How to Price, Package, and Position What You Sell So People Don't Hesitate

Disclosure: This post contains affiliate links. If you purchase through my links, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.


I see the same problem over and over in the business plans that cross my desk.

The person has a solid product. They know their market. They can explain exactly what they do and who it's for.

But their offer is weak.

They're charging too low because they're scared of scaring people off. They're using vague language like \
without saying how or by how much. They're trying to compete on price instead of value.\n\nAnd then they wonder why people say \

and disappear.


THE OFFER IS EVERYTHING

Myron Golden puts it simply: most businesses don't fail because the product is bad. They fail because the offer is weak.

Think about it. You can have the best service in your industry. But if your offer is confusing, vague, or easy to say no to — nobody buys.

The Offer Move is the first move in Myron's B.O.S.S. Moves framework, and it's the foundation everything else sits on. If your offer isn't right, it doesn't matter how good your lead generation or sales skills are. People won't buy.


WHAT MAKES AN OFFER WORK

According to the framework, a strong offer does three things:

1. It's clear. People understand immediately what they're getting and why it matters to them. If someone has to work to figure out your offer, they won't bother.

2. It's specific. \
means nothing. \

means something. Specificity builds trust and gets attention.

3. It reduces perceived risk. If someone's worried about wasting their money, they won't buy. Good offers include guarantees, clear expectations, and social proof that takes the fear out of saying yes.


THE PRICING PROBLEM

Here's where most entrepreneurs go wrong — they price based on fear.

They look at competitors and try to be cheaper. They worry that if they charge too much, people will say no. So they set their price low and hope volume makes up for it.

But here's the thing: low prices attract the worst customers. The ones who negotiate everything, demand the most support, and leave the moment someone else is $5 cheaper.

Myron teaches the opposite approach. Raise your prices and raise your faith. Charge what you're actually worth. The customers you attract at higher prices are better customers — they're less demanding, more loyal, and actually let you do your best work.


WHO THIS IS FOR

If you're getting inquiries but no sales, your offer is probably the problem.

If you're competing on price and losing margin, the Offer Move shows you how to compete on value instead.

If you've never thought strategically about how you position and price what you sell, this framework is worth studying.


THE BOTTOM LINE

You can have the best product in the world. But if your offer is weak, people won't buy.

The Offer Move in B.O.S.S. Moves teaches you how to make an offer so clear, so specific, and so compelling that saying yes feels like the obvious choice.

Check out the book here: https://www.bossmovesbook.com/bossmoves?affiliate_id=4302472

body.title: Is it possible to use hope as a driving force and motivation in achieving our goals? (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
![lotus.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wgPuq6t8kk6NmQcoPeKqd3eUEzb4XBenK7gui6V2cehTmEYbEiT5wv2ZbgTWa3vyG19.png)


<hr>


<div class=text-justify> 
<div class=\

> **
INGLÉS
** Hello friends of the @holos-lotus community, it's a pleasure to greet you, wishing you an excellent and blessed week. This is my contribution to the topic of our friend @emiliorios [Nos Urge Hablar de la Esperanza: ¿Cómo la Cuidas y Alimentas? -Esta es La Iniciativa No. 24 en Domingo de Séptimo Día-](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen), Hope is a word we use daily, but it encompasses a great context, and in certain situations, it determines whether we achieve great goals and projects. When we go through a difficult situation, hope becomes our greatest ally. We try to look to the future with optimism, gratitude, and faith. Clinging to hope, we stay focused on what we want to achieve. When we face adversity, hope is the driving force that propels us forward with the firm conviction that what lies ahead will be much better, and that what we are currently experiencing will only be temporary because there is always light at the end of the tunnel, and a moment of happiness awaits us. I firmly believe that hope and faith—that conviction we have that the situation will improve—go hand in hand and are a great motivator for achieving a specific goal. When we begin a project, whether personal, professional, or familial, we always hope to obtain the best results. Even if there are bumps and obstacles along the way, our hope and our goal are that we will succeed. I believe that focusing on hope prevents us from being distracted by elements that could become barriers and keeps our gaze fixed on the objective we aspire to achieve. With hope, we also see life from a different perspective and are grateful for what we have, yearning for a much better future.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola amigos de la comunidad @holos-lotus, es un placer saludarles, deseando que tengan una excelente y bendecida semana, este es mi aporte para el tema del amigo @emiliorios, [Nos Urge Hablar de la Esperanza: ¿Cómo la Cuidas y Alimentas? -Esta es La Iniciativa No. 24 en Domingo de Séptimo Día-](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen), esperanza es una palabra que usamos a diario pero que encierra un gran contexto y de ella depende en ciertas situaciones que alcancemos grandes metas y proyectos, cuando atravesamos por una situación difícil la Esperanza se convierte en nuestra gran aliada, tratamos de ver con optimismo, agradecimiento y Fe el porvenir, aferrados a la esperanza se mantiene el norte en lo queremos lograr. Cuando enfrentamos situaciones adversas, es la esperanza el motor que nos impulsa a seguir adelante con la firme convicción de que lo que viene será mucho mejor y esto que estamos enfrentando solo será algo pasajero porque al final del túnel siempre hay una luz y nos aguarda un momento de felicidad; creo firmemente que la esperanza y la fe, esa convicción que tenemos de que la situación mejorará, van de la mano y son de gran motivación para lograr un determinado objetivo. Cuando iniciamos un proyecto, ya sea personal, laboral o familiar, siempre tenemos la esperanza de obtener los mejores resultados, aunque en el camino hayan baches y obstáculos nuestra esperanza y la meta es que lo vamos a lograr, creo que enfocarnos en ella (la esperanza), nos impide distraernos en aquellos elementos que pudieran convertirse en barrera y mantener nuestra mirada en el objetivo que aspiramos lograr. Con ella, también vemos la vida desde otra óptica y somos agradecidos por lo que tenemos, anhelando que en el futuro sea mucho mejor. ![mixtas (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoAadHynkcNY4mz3dPvVsEKrihZC776Ph4xZYozMa4XqwrsmbmiKcmAyZsNYCby4JZP.jpeg)

> Losing hope, or ceasing to cultivate it, would mean that our dreams, for which we have strived for years, would be shattered. All the projects we have envisioned and sometimes discussed with family members would remain only on paper. Without hope that they can be achieved, we abandon them, and our minds focus on the negative, seeing anything that might hinder our plans. Without hope, the strengths and abilities we possess to achieve what we so deeply desire can become obstacles. When hope is lost, negativity, anxiety, and complaining take over, leading us to see everything from a negative perspective, assuming that nothing is possible, and giving up without even trying. Cultivating hope means seeing life with gratitude. I don't mean to imply that we should live in a detached reality; on the contrary, hope allows us to situate ourselves within reality and, at the same time, see possible solutions and paths forward to continue moving forward with a firm step and achieve the goals we have. Perhaps they won't be achieved in the short or medium term, but our determination and persistence will be what leads us to them. Some goals are achieved very quickly, others require time, and there are those that, although they seem impossible, can be reached when we maintain hope and perseverance in what we want. Maintaining hope, believing that everything will improve and that we will have a better tomorrow, is the driving force that should propel us each day. We must work towards it with determination and love. It's not about living with illusions, about thinking that something will happen simply by declaring it or saying it. The essential thing is to work and focus on making what we so deeply desire a reality, whether at home, at work, or in the realm of personal goals we have set for ourselves.

> Perder la esperanza, o dejar de cultivarla significaría que nuestros sueños, por los cuales hemos luchado durante varios años, quedarían truncados, también todos los proyectos que hemos pensado y en algunas ocasiones conversado con los familiares, solamente estarán en papel, pues al no tener esperanza de que se pueden alcanzar los dejamos de lado y nuestra mente se enfocaría en la parte negativa, viendo aquello que podría ser un impedimento para concretar nuestros planes. Con la ausencia de la esperanza, se pueden convertir las fortalezas y habilidades que tenemos para alcanzar aquello que tanto queremos, en un obstáculo. Cuando se pierde la esperanza el negativismo, la ansiedad y la queja son las que toman control y nos conducen por ende, a ver todo desde un ángulo negativo, asumiendo que nada es posible y darnos por vencido sin al menos hacer un intento. Cultivar la esperanza, es ver la vida con agradecimiento, no quiero decir con esto, que vamos a vivir una realidad descontextualizada, al contrario, la esperanza nos permite ubicarnos en la realidad y al mismo tiempo, ver las posibles soluciones y salidas para seguir avanzando con paso firme y lograr concretar esos proyectos que tenemos; tal vez no se logren a corto o mediano plazo, pero nuestra determinación y persistencia será lo que nos llevará a alcanzarlos, algunos objetivos se logran muy rápido, otros requieren su tiempo y están aquellos que aunque parecen imposibles se pueden alcanzar cuando mantenemos la esperanza y constancia en lo que queremos. Mantener la esperanza, creer que todo mejorará y tendremos un mejor mañana, es el motor que debe impulsarnos cada día y trabajar en ello con determinación y amor, no se trata de vivir con ilusiones, de que por decretar o por decir va a suceder, lo esencial es trabajar y enfocarse en ello para hacer realidad aquello que tanto queremos en la casa, en el trabajo, o en el ámbito de metas personales que nos hemos trazado. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23z7HmsEJB7dQpzVpGZMxNPj6hjqsK3qGDTioxdfcr4wRNM7tyKwVNNC1Tcf8mbD1RUpq.png)
> ![dese 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpJerr1oXKqGDAkuKANVYJxxPkkbbCC9JpnPVn63tASDTw5wm5GKjCcbBXEfAu45fKz.png) Blessings!

> ![dese.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xpa97s1nEmxvZDqAMx4ZzmjvkUmxhHxiCA1BRqEKxTZWwMi7qP93b8ZBqN27bMBVLD2.png) ¡Bendiciones! ![298840ed-dc99-44dd-88ae-e5dd98c6a2fd-e077c470-b3b4-41b7-8298-8b73f49e1a25-v1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/AKCBArsVymhAtxSEXuQEXVtGFqs179BAJqxscwbiHjeUjfHW4BXK94BrzTQoN88.png)

body.title: Always Not Yet
body.body:
I thought I needed a little more time.
That was the reason in the beginning.

A little more preparation. A little more research. A little more confidence.
The plan seemed reasonable. There was no point rushing into something important without being ready for it.

So I kept working behind the scenes. Reading. Learning. Improving things. Fixing details that probably didn't need fixing.

Whenever the opportunity came up, I had the same answer.
\

I wasn't avoiding it. At least that's what I told myself.
I genuinely believed I was getting closer.

But after a while, I noticed something strange.
The people who started after me were already moving.
Some of them weren't as prepared.

Some of them made mistakes I could have avoided.
Some of them clearly had less knowledge.

Yet they were gaining experience while I was still making adjustments.
Months passed.

Then one day, I opened one of my old notes.
I read through all the plans, all the ideas, all the things I intended to do when I was finally ready.

Most of them were still sitting there untouched.
Not because they were impossible.
Not because I couldn't do them.

Just because I kept preparing for a beginning that never came.
And for the first time, I realized something uncomfortable.

The thing holding me back wasn't lack of preparation anymore.
It was the habit of preparing.

This story is fictional and written to share a life lesson

body.title: Tanera and Dura palm fruit, I want to share a little about the differences.
body.body:
Hello Hive friends and the ASEAN Hive community.

This time, I'd like to share a little knowledge about the differences between Tenera and Dura oil palms. The photo I took today shows a cross-section of the fruit, which can be used to identify the two types directly in my field.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjhjXw8H2KSsMWfU4RcBjNCyXXTDZHuH7dhvahgZ7Af8/1780892156234.jpg)

Understanding Oil Palm Fruit Types
In oil palm cultivation. 

there are several types of fruit based on their shell thickness. The two most well-known are Dura and Tenera.
1. Dura Palm
The Dura palm is characterized by its thick shell. When the fruit is cut open, the shell appears larger and thicker, while the flesh is relatively thinner.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxgqaUfv8s4UAE5ScKzjaqnXUE6237Fydwb5wB3hUsZZ/1780892377867.jpg)

Dura Characteristics:

*Very thick shell.
*Thinner flesh.
*Lower oil content.
*Rarely used as a main crop in modern plantations.

2. Tenera Palm Oil
The Tenera oil palm is a cross between the Dura and Pisifera varieties. This variety is most commonly grown on plantations due to its high productivity.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqxB5q1zZM4gFNJf77ttd1Z81vmAFFQRvCuFsrLiq5yk/1780892551050.jpg)

Tenera Characteristics:

*Thinner shell.
*Thicker flesh.
*Higher oil content.
*Better bunch production and oil yield.

The Differences Visible in the Photos

*From the results of observations on the split fruit.?
Fruit with a thick shell and thin flesh indicates Dura characteristics.
*Fruit with a thinner shell and thicker orange flesh indicates Tenera characteristics.

This difference is very important because the thickness of the fruit flesh directly affects the amount of oil that can be produced.

Thank you for visiting my post. I hope this simple article is helpful and provides insight into the types of oil palm fruit we often encounter on plantations.

Warm greetings from Indonesian palm oil plantations. 🌴😊

Let your eyes look straight ahead and your sight be focused in front of you.  Carefully walk a straight path, and all your ways will be secure.  Do not lean to the right or to the left. Walk away from evil. - Proverbs 4:25-27 (GOD'S WORD® Translation (©1995))

The enemy will do his very best to keep you distracted from the path God has for you using the things of this world.  He's not a stupid devil...he has had thousands of years of practice enticing the hearts of men away from their Creator.  Don't allow yourself to get side-tracked from the calling of the Lord on your life.

body.title: My story today is taking the kids to go find something to eat.
body.body: alt=\

/> Hello everyone. How are you? How are you these days? How is the news? I haven't been on this platform much. Because during this time I still have a lot of busy work to do, but I sometimes sneak in to check on my friends. Today is the first day of school and the kids have gone to school so I've had some time to get back to writing posts as usual. Today is a story that will be told to friends. Let's try to follow today's story.
alt=\

/> 11:00 a.m. Take the children to the supermarket to buy vegetables and fruits to eat. There were quite a lot of people today but it wasn't a problem for us.Hehehe I picked up some vegetables and put them in the kids' carts and brought them to the weight technician to label them. After buying vegetables, we went to find some snacks.
alt=\
/> Walking around to see other departments with the children leading the way. In the end we each got one drink hahaha and I bought kitchen supplies.
alt=\

/> When finished, let's drive to refuel and then take the kids to eat dessert. Oh, there are so many people today. Every time I come, there are always so many people. And the desserts at this shop are inexpensive too. Red beans boiled in sugar and delicious Patongko Unfortunately, it didn't match the hot atmosphere at all.
alt=\

/> The children complained that it was hot but if it were Thailand they would probably add ice too. But here Chinese people like to eat it hot. Husband eats red beans boiled in sugar. As for the children, because they only eat Patongko.
alt=\

/> After finishing eating, let's try our luck this time. Here we can try our luck at a very low price. You can try your luck at just 2 ringgit. Even though we didn't win the prize, we don't have any regrets. My husband went inside to try his luck as he waited in the car. When we're finished, it's now 4:00 p.m. When we get home, it's time to cook dinner.
alt=\
/> Today's menu, Tofu Songkhrueng, is a favorite menu of children because it is an easy food to eat. The taste is not spicy but delicious and mellow.
alt=\

/> Chili paste menu eaten with fresh vegetables. I really like this menu, and now my husband likes it too. Every time he gets this, he eats twice as much rice. Every time he gets this, he eats twice as much rice.
alt=\

/>

When the food was prepared, this time I took the children out to sit in front of the house. The atmosphere is very good, the wind blows cool and the children play happily. As for me, I help my husband plant plants by decorating them and putting them in new pots. Until it was time to take the children to eat. Then take the children to get ready for bed because they have to go to school.

Thank you friends for stopping by and reading my article today.

body.title: Un espacio para Emmaris / Reportando sus publicaciones (Esp-Eng)
body.body: <div class=\

>
![portada_gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/EqNFgWgbujaaX8LbnXsatSqCVQUks7bWhoPsCGGMwHgLE4ex1d7bYhqG4dsjuN3zobG.gif)
Este será un espacio para reportar el contenido publicado por @emmaris e igualmente las ganancias serán destinadas para ella al 100%. Hemos decidido crear este reporte para tenderle una mano amiga a una joven madre venezolana, de 36 años, que lucha contra el cáncer que le diagnosticaron en el Estado Nueva Esparta (Isla Margarita) en Venezuela. Específicamente, se le descubrió hace pocos meses un Carcinoma de mamá izquierda y el 23 de febrero le practicaron una Mastectomía Radical. Emmaris es miembro de nuestra comunidad, porque ella publica contenido sobre su hijo de 10 años con autismo no verbal. Además de su príncipe azul, tiene dos hijas pequeñas, una de 6 años y una bebé con pocos meses de nacida. Desde este espacio los invitamos a corroborar la veracidad de su situación a través de sus propias publicaciones, las cuales serán compartidas aquí semanalmente o de acuerdo al ritmo que Emmaris mantenga publicando en HIVE.
![informeMEDICO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23sxdY7gZzqdL5YtWfR6S6FD2Y33jGDLq7a1y7ZDzW5oEFH4PmL9DPcJEB1HZEwowaw3J.jpg)
Informe médico de @emmaris
Ya inicio el tratamiento con quimioterapia, como ella misma lo ha documentado para poner al tanto a la comunidad de HIVE a quien ha pedido apoyo para costear sus gastos médicos. A continuación, te invitamos a visualizar las siguientes publicaciones de @emmaris 💙 >! [English] This will be a space to share content posted by @emmaris, and 100% of the proceeds will go to her. We have decided to create this initiative to lend a helping hand to a 36-year-old Venezuelan mother who is battling cancer diagnosed in the state of Nueva Esparta (Margarita Island) in Venezuela. Specifically, she was diagnosed with left breast carcinoma a few months ago, and on February 23, she underwent a radical mastectomy. Emmaris is a member of our community because she posts content about her 10-year-old son with nonverbal autism. In addition to her “little prince,” she has two young daughters, a 6-year-old and a baby just a few months old. We invite you to verify the accuracy of her situation through her own posts, which will be shared here weekly or as often as Emmaris continues to post on HIVE.
![informeMEDICO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23sxdY7gZzqdL5YtWfR6S6FD2Y33jGDLq7a1y7ZDzW5oEFH4PmL9DPcJEB1HZEwowaw3J.jpg)

body.title: Shredded chicken stew with mixed vegetables (Eng-Esp)
body.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL9TQG8yJEhQZqUkLpitWbt5tJXFqdrS1qWsmbAyXjrDjAo5hLoxQRU56F26X6nyPG7.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening friends, I hope you had a super fun weekend! This time, I'll explain how to prepare a \

This recipe is very versatile; you can serve it with countless side dishes or use it as a filling for lasagna, empanadas, cannelloni, arepas, spaghetti... Let's put on our aprons and get started!\n\n>* Buenas noches amigos, espero que hayan pasado un fin de semana super divertido! En esta ocasión, les explicaré como preparar un \

. Esta receta es muy versátil, pueden acompañar con infinidad de contornos o utilizar como rellenos para realizar: lasañas, empanadas, canelones, arepas, espaguetis... Pongámonos el delantal para empezar nuestro divertido proceso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EnabFMXtV27UWt5gh76QfEf8kc5u317mT1aBpt428UmQr9jkGAGgwGT885kM8tsVDVF.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the pan, sauté the onion, along with the garlic cloves... Sauté for 3 minutes (season with salt and pepper).

>* Incorporamos 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva al sartén, sofreímos la cebolla, junto con los dientes de ajo... Salteamos durante 3 minutos (salpimentamos). 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFWDEJAKjeYuzbfrhieQwybGVRJ9B1HPHkfo2r9MLNHfZSKLwFwVDooTio3UV51qj8u.png)</center>

* Next, we add the bell pepper (red or green)... We place the zucchini, and cut both ingredients into small cubes.

>* A continuación, integramos el pimiento (rojo o verde)... Colocamos el calabacín, cortamos en cubos pequeños ambos ingredientes.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6BDM6G4BynCq9tFW5gHeNjH2XnM3bNqBbhf39ed6zw5xDSuc61CHPQ3BWUTNyWdMHJ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFaRaQ9FbhMxPrqnT4Y9thjx6gMtKSkrN9GpSZ1M6yX1G2hu8ZCW3eV8EjWvjAabDjr.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w2soMtzFB7eTLLBUETsUYX17n1NGkdVFdqCeQz694WzFvBXkyrXBDC5LZqNhkX6QWJE.png)</center>

* In this step, we add the ripe tomatoes (remove the seeds)... We add the shredded chicken. For a truly delicious and flavorful dish, we'll season it with: black pepper, sweet paprika, dried oregano, ground turmeric, and salt to taste.
We add 1/2 cup of water, cover, and cook for 30 minutes, or until tender.

>* En este paso, agregamos los tomates maduros (extraemos las semillas)... Añadimos el pollo desmechado. Para disfrutar de un sabor MUY sabroso y sustancioso, vamos a condimentar con: pimienta negra, pimentón dulce, orégano en polvo, cúrcuma en polvo y sal al gusto.
Colocamos 1/2 taza de agua, tapamos y cocinamos durante 30 minutos o hasta comprobar que está listo.

body.title: Mi primera long cake💕✨🎂 [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![Mi primera long cake_20260607_232227_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXiUsbq7nxUkHsjM3wmSbUx79hHaJJeicBic5m8ym6Ad9/Mi%20primera%20long%20cake_20260607_232227_0000.jpg)

**Y aunque por más de medio año no emprendimiento estuvo parado debido a la enfermedad y fallecimiento de mi mamá, luego de esto decidí retomar mi emprendimiento y con mucha más fuerza. Para este fin de semana una de las amigas que hicimos en el hospital me encargo una torta y en esta ocasión me solicitó una torta que no había realizado antes y que no tenía ni el molde pero que sin lugar a dudas me saco de mi zona de confort y quedó realmente hermoso. Realice un long cake que actualmente están muy de moda además puse en práctica algunas de las cosas que aprendí en el taller que hice en el estado Anzoátegui de crema Chantilly, es una crema que no trabajaba mucho por miedo a que me quedara mal pero en esta oportunidad la realice y me quedo bastante bien. Y lo más importante de todo es que la clienta quedó contenta con su pedido.**

 >And although my business was on hold for over six months due to my mother's illness and passing, I decided to relaunch it with renewed energy. This past weekend, one of the friends I made in the hospital ordered a cake. This time, she requested a cake I hadn't made before and didn't even have the right mold, but it definitely pushed me out of my comfort zone, and it turned out beautifully. I made a long cake, which is very trendy right now, and I also put into practice some of the things I learned in the Chantilly cream workshop I took in Anzoátegui state. It's a cream I hadn't worked with much for fear of messing it up, but this time I made it, and it turned out quite well. And most importantly, the client was delighted with her order.


![IMG-20260608-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVKajdTvmxDhv61H8nGkEyMUpua5AR5HTDnLuUG6Je33/IMG-20260608-WA0002.jpg)

**El primer desafío fue encontrar la base para colocar la torta y es que fui a varias tiendas de repostería y en ninguna encontré la base que necesitaba así que opte por comprar unas bases más pequeñas y pegarlas, pero aún así te iba miedo que la base no fuera tan fuerte como yo lo necesitaba.**

>The first challenge was finding the base to place the cake on. I went to several baking stores and couldn't find the base I needed, so I opted to buy some smaller bases and glue them together. But even then, I was afraid that the base wouldn't be as strong as I needed it to be.


![IMG-20260607-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdz9RqMWeWjFSvhKyJjwfzCwhGARhDCpPqnCGMQoMioCa/IMG-20260607-WA0021.jpg)

![IMG-20260607-WA0020.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV3JX5nUCCVR22qwGj29fs3vVDvi4oVSK196zkKQF25ja/IMG-20260607-WA0020.jpg)


**Realice la torta en un molde grande que tenía, que era de mi mamá. Luego que la torta estuvo lista la corte del tamaño que la necesitaba y procedió a rellenarla con arequipe y gotas de chocolate. Luego realice un muro de contención con ganache para darle un poco más de estabilidad a la torta. Esto lo hice el día anterior y dejé la torta toda la noche en la nevera.**

>I baked the cake in a large pan that belonged to my mom. Once the cake was baked, I cut it to the size I needed and filled it with dulce de leche and chocolate chips. Then I made a raised edge with ganache to give the cake more stability. I did this the day before and left the cake in the refrigerator overnight.


![IMG-20260607-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRQLh7iat84F6Ybvy3eX8LiQRgBhmhNZ7FpsPrTkUBvUr/IMG-20260607-WA0019.jpg)

![IMG-20260607-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwYxRVijFdEGQgVxEgvGKf77cghbHUiLSwKvWmJkVjdC/IMG-20260607-WA0018.jpg)

**En la mañana procedi a preparar un litro de Chantilly para cubrir la torta, primero realice un Chantilly firme podría decirse que lo batimos en exceso pero esto lo hacemos para agregar la capa recoge migas, luego de hidrata la Chantilly y se coloca otra capa que ayuda a que la torta quede mucho mejor. Luego pinté varios tonos de chantilly para decorar la torta tal cual la pidió la clienta.**

>In the morning, I prepared a liter of Chantilly cream to cover the cake. First, I made a firm Chantilly cream—you could say we over-whipped it, but we do this to add the crumb coat. Then, I hydrated the Chantilly cream and added another layer, which helps the cake look much better. Afterward, I tinted the Chantilly cream in various shades to decorate the cake, just as the client requested.


![IMG-20260607-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6zyTMuGLzZAJtAkmCtsGbquaeRzcp797ebL59Fw9i1B/IMG-20260607-WA0017.jpg)

![IMG-20260607-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRt1Qoe4fNKQ55GyksxfDnTTDstEzsgCoCfREeVwVW5sp/IMG-20260607-WA0016.jpg)

**La torta llevaba una decoración con colores pasteles, muchas fresas y algunas flores. La verdad que el resultado final fue hermoso y agradezco que mis clientes me saquen de mi zona de confort para crear tortas hermosas. De verdad que Dios fue maravilloso al bendecir mis manos para crear estás bellezas.**

>The cake was decorated with pastel colors, lots of strawberries, and a few flowers. The final result was truly beautiful, and I'm so grateful that my clients push me out of my comfort zone to create such lovely cakes. God was truly wonderful to bless my hands with the ability to create these beautiful things.



![IMG-20260607-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRusa5jkgZdSbbvJ12HbSVQxyhmgNMAk1ADiDLNFCyoWU/IMG-20260607-WA0013.jpg)

![IMG-20260607-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSMeKgu7omiTxbbFusjVtPc2PfdpkZdvuTwxt7t5njyCC/IMG-20260607-WA0012.jpg)

**Una vez la torta estuvo lista le pase la foto a la clienta y está quedó encantada. También le pase la foto a mi mejor amiga y ella también amo el resultado final de esta torta.**

>Once the cake was ready, I sent the photo to the client, and she was thrilled. I also sent the photo to my best friend, and she loved the final result too.



https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8zQvWGvgFGUDN9e3Bb4t7X8D4eUG4P7htGwNCX75ibf/IMG-20241008-WA0019.jpg

body.body:

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ |
|     Genus Carrhotus      |      Jun 08, 2026      |       Sontala, Bangladesh      | 

---

### Hello Dear Nature Observer Fam and Hive Members!
Now I am sharing a beautiful moment of a spider. I took this picture when I was out for a walk in the morning. A spider was eating a moth, although I did not understand this scene at first, but when I was doing macro photography, this scene emerged.

The color and structure of the spider's body looked very beautiful in the soft morning sunlight. Some scenes in nature are not easy for our eyes to see, but when we spend time in nature, many scenes are seen and its beauty can also be enjoyed.

See you again in the next post, thanks everyone.

> Content by me • Translation by Google Translate.

body.title: Ceffu Receives Full Financial Services License in Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City
body.body:
https://cryptocrunches.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/image1.png

[Ceffu](https://www.ceffu.com/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=announcements&utm_campaign=licensebt) today announced that it has been granted a **Financial Services License** by the **Gelephu Financial Services Office** in **Gelephu Mindfulness City, Bhutan**.

The full license follows Ceffu’s **In-Principle Approval**, received in **March 2026**, and authorises the company to conduct regulated activities in and from Gelephu Mindfulness City.

Through this license, Ceffu is positioned to expand its institutional digital asset offering across three regulated service areas:

- **Custody Services:** Institutional-grade safeguarding and governance infrastructure for digital assets.
- **Dealing in Investments as Agent:** Support for institutional transaction flows and intermediary execution services across digital asset markets.
- **Arranging Credit:** Institutional credit intermediation designed to help clients access regulated financing facilities across digital markets.

The milestone reinforces Ceffu’s commitment to building within robust regulatory frameworks while extending institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure across emerging global financial hubs.

## Supporting Regulated Digital Asset Growth in Bhutan

Gelephu Mindfulness City is developing as a purpose-built financial and innovation hub designed to support regulated participation in digital assets and broader financial services.

Ceffu’s licensed presence in Gelephu Mindfulness City will enable the company to contribute institutional products built around the operational, security, and compliance requirements of global market participants. These services are designed to support institutions including asset managers, trading firms, fintech platforms, and other professional counterparties seeking regulated access to digital asset markets.

“Securing the Financial Services License from the Gelephu Financial Services Office marks an important milestone in Ceffu’s regulatory and institutional growth journey. We are proud to be part of Gelephu Mindfulness City and to contribute institutional-grade solutions that prioritize security, governance, and long-term market sustainability in Bhutan.

As institutional participation in digital assets continues to evolve globally, regulated digital asset services will remain fundamental to enabling scalable and compliant market access, particularly in forward-looking jurisdictions that actively support responsible innovation and the development of next-generation financial ecosystems.”

**Ian Loh, CEO of Ceffu**

## Looking Ahead

Gelephu Mindfulness City represents a forward-looking vision for a globally connected financial centre grounded in sustainability, governance, and long-term economic development.

Ceffu remains committed to supporting this vision through regulated infrastructure, institutional-grade security, and continued collaboration with regulatory stakeholders. As digital asset markets continue to mature, Ceffu believes trusted and compliant infrastructure will be essential to enabling sustainable institutional participation.

Through its licensed operations in Bhutan, Ceffu looks forward to contributing to the continued development of Gelephu Mindfulness City as an innovative hub for regulated digital finance.

## About Gelephu Mindfulness City

The **Gelephu Mindfulness City Special Administrative Region** is a visionary initiative creating a world-class economic hub in southern Bhutan, centered on mindfulness, sustainability, and innovation. The SAR integrates traditional Bhutanese values with globally recognized legal frameworks, cutting-edge design and technology, while harnessing the Kingdom’s abundant renewable energy resources to serve as a global exemplar of holistic development.

For more information, visit [www.gmc.bt](https://www.gmc.bt/) or contact info@gmc.bt.

## About Ceffu

[Ceffu](https://www.ceffu.com/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=announcements&utm_campaign=licensebt) is a compliant, institutional-grade custody platform offering custody and liquidity solutions that are **ISO 27001 and 27701 certified** and **SOC2 Type 2 attested**. Its multi-party computation technology, combined with a customizable multi-approval scheme, provides bespoke solutions allowing institutional clients to safely store and manage their virtual assets.

**Media contact:** pr@ceffu.com

body.title: La última vuelta 🎹✨💜 [ENG/ESP]
body.body: ![IMG_5141.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpA5NxpKyCcgVzw361G7P1PdRf1nnuTThh5no1FapwHzfueGMSjEBayeK3W25u4oDAV.jpeg) ![IMG_5139.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqNG7buuL9o7SfSjTzs2BCzNnkKnvSMMWcw9TcDFRCwwo6MzmKUB9B29LahHXJtc5De.jpeg) ![IMG_5138.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqJ1MBLc7QFa1kk2VYJdwWP1dsJ5ceZ7czcrwc8bj33Y6AkWCWV5bCHjQX7L8ABXffF.jpeg)

>Greetings to the entire Lifestyle community! Today I’m joining you here to share another day in my life. This time, I’m bringing you another day of choir rehearsal with Canticum Merú. As I’ve mentioned in recent days, we have several musical performances coming up this week (in Bolívar and Caracas), so we’ve been rehearsing as much as we could this past week. However, the rain and other issues—like getting sick because of the rain—have made things a bit difficult to manage. The good news is that little by little, some things have been resolved, and everything is practically ready to go.

\n\n>

>Saludos a toda la comunidad de Lifestyle, el día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta ocasión les traigo otro día de ensayo en el coro con Canticum Merú. Cómo he venido comentando en los días anteriores, esta semana estaremos teniendo varias presentaciones musicales (en Bolívar y en Caracas), por lo que para esta última semana estuvimos ensayando todo lo que pudimos. Sin embargo, las lluvias y otras situaciones, (cómo caer enferma por las lluvias) han hecho que todo se vuelva un poco difícil de llevar. Lo bueno es que poco a poco algunas cosas se han resuelto y está todo prácticamente listo para salir.

![IMG_5137.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqSWXVR4Vn6mwnLSrVchBHBnHprpcXQyDguVsckwpCyJTq8UKUP44SmvwM5v9DNi8HH.jpeg) ![IMG_4953.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpEKmkvZfpk4Qix2ikbLS6NsWVPGPja7jSg5h72FSSiNUF8W1eK85H365CxDrXMGGtY.jpeg)

>As for me, I’ve been feeling a little under the weather. I thought the flu had gone away, but it seems to have come back with a bit more intensity, and I think it’s because of this bad weather and all the activities I’ve had. I’ve tried everything I can: acetaminophen, tea, salt-water steam, rest, and eating better. I think it’s just a matter of time before I can shake off all this discomfort. I really want to sing, to be there and represent the choir. It will be a beautiful moment. I feel more confident with the songs, but the only thing that really worries me is that when the day of the performances arrives, I might still be sick. For now, I’ll try to do my best. I’m sharing the dinner my husband made for me to ease my troubles a little. Without further ado, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Con respecto a mí, he estado un poco enferma. Pensé que la gripe había desaparecido pero parece que volvió con un poco más de fuerza y creo que se debe a este mal clima y a que he tenido muchas actividades. Me he tomado todas las cosas posibles: acetaminofén, té, vapor de agua con sal, reposo y comer mejor. Creo que es cuestión de tiempo poder despejar todo malestar de mí cuerpo. Tengo muchas ganas de cantar, de poder estar allí y representar al coro. Será un momento muy bello. Me siento más segura con las canciones, sin embargo lo único que me tiene realmente muy preocupada es que llegado el día de las presentaciones, todavía este enferma. Por los momentos, intentaré hacer lo mejor posible. Comparto la cena que me hizo mi esposo para aliviar un poco las penas. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

body.title: NEEDLEWORKMONDAY-Nuevas prendas nuevos desafíos. [New clothes, new challenges.]
body.body: alt=\

> Feliz lunes needleworkers :3 mi entrega final de corsetería ya pasó por suerte, pero vamos camino a la segunda donde hay que hacer corpiños y partes inferiores, como bóxer, vedetina y ese tipo de prendas, pero mi entrega tuvo otras prendas aparte del body negro y el azul, en este caso fue un cubrecabeza y un nuevo body.
Happy Monday needleworkers :3 My final corsetry assignment has thankfully passed, but we're on our way to the second one where we have to make bras and bottoms, like boxer shorts, bikinis and that kind of garment, but my assignment had other garments besides the black and blue bodysuits, in this case it was a head covering and a new bodysuit.
alt=\

> El body verde no es un nuevo molde, sino que es el body negro, pero en una tela que estira y mucho, esta tela es mágica jajaja, el talle es un 42, pero yo que soy un talle 48 puedo usarlo sin problemas, eso es mágico.
The green bodysuit isn't a new design; it's the same as the black bodysuit, but in a very stretchy fabric. This fabric is magical, haha. The size is 42, but I, who am a size 48, can wear it without any problems. That's magic.
alt=\

> En cuanto al elástico compré uno nuevo que es más grueso, es de unos 2 cm, pero también es más rígido, así que para coser esto tuve que estirar mucho más, lo malo es que esto lo descubrí cuando ya había empezado a coser.
As for the elastic, I bought a new one that is thicker, about 2 cm, but it is also more rigid, so to sew this I had to stretch it much more, the bad thing is that I discovered this when I had already started sewing.
alt=\

> El armado del body es así, primero la espalda, que está en dos partes por que lleva una especie de pinza de entalle, así que vamos a coser esto primero.
The bodysuit is assembled like this: first the back, which is in two parts because it has a kind of waist dart, so we're going to sew this first.
alt=\

> Después cosí la v del escote, esto es más simple si lo hago antes de unir las piezas.
Then I sewed the V of the neckline; this is simpler if I do it before joining the pieces.
alt=\

> Luego se une por hombros y entrepierna, en esta parte es dónde debería tener un refuerzo, pero eso no existe aún.
Then it joins at the shoulders and crotch; this is where it should have reinforcement, but that doesn't exist yet.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> Luego toca elastizar, yo hice piernas, sisa y después el cuello, pero acá no hay como una receta, ya que cada parte es independiente. Entonces se puede empezar por cualquier parte, solo que, si creo que el escote debería estar terminado antes de hacer el cuello, es mucho más fácil hacerlo de esta manera.
Next comes the elasticizing. I did the legs, armholes, and then the neckline, but there's no set method, as each part is independent. So you can start anywhere, but I think the neckline should be finished before the neckline; it's much easier to do it that way.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> Para el cubrecabezas hice el molde y lo corté, la verdad esto fue bastante una lotería, el molde por momentos era confuso y decidí hacerlo con las medidas estándar en vez de unas propias, y rezar en que la tela ayudaría, todavía no fui a la tienda de telas, me estoy manejando con las que tengo disponibles por ahora.
For the head covering, I made the pattern and cut it out. To be honest, this was quite a lottery. The pattern was confusing at times, and I decided to use standard measurements instead of my own, and pray that the fabric would help. I haven't been to the fabric store yet; I'm working with what I have available for now.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> Corté las partes del molde en papel nuevo y estas mismas partes en tela, son 3 partes, dos de la parte posterior y una de la parte del frente, pero decidí tomar algunas decisiones y hacer un corte en el frente para poder terminar el visor.
I cut the pattern pieces out of new paper and these same pieces out of fabric. There are 3 pieces, two for the back and one for the front, but I decided to make some decisions and make a cut in the front to be able to finish the visor.
alt=\

> Usé el elástico partido, pero esto no fue una buena idea, el visor está un poco chico, y como lo hice un día antes de la entrega jaja no tuve tiempo de corregirlo, ya aprendí mi lección con esto.
I used the split elastic, but this wasn't a good idea; the visor is a bit small, and since I did it the day before the deadline, haha, I didn't have time to fix it. I've learned my lesson from this.
alt=\

> Uní todo el cubrecabeza con overlock, si bien mi tela estira, se siente un poco apretado, realmente es una prenda que no usaría, pero seguro haga algún tocado para otra materia en algún momento así que me sirve la experiencia.
I joined the whole head covering with an overlock stitch. Although my fabric stretches, it feels a bit tight. It's really not a garment I would wear, but I'll probably make a headpiece for another subject at some point, so the experience is useful.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> Para terminar, usé elástico partido en la parte inferior, esto fue otro error, porque la tela es demasiado fina para lo grueso que es este elástico, pero ya aprendí.
Finally, I used split elastic at the bottom, this was another mistake, because the fabric is too thin for how thick this elastic is, but I've learned my lesson.
alt=\

> Mi entrega fue moldes y prendas, entregue todo lo que tenía y también nos pidieron videos para ver cómo se comportan las prendas en un cuerpo real, en este caso fue mi hermana quien se probó todo, por suerte esa parte salió bastante bien. lo próximo son prendas inferiores y superiores, pero eso será para otra ocasión ya que hay mucha moldaría que hacer.
My submission consisted of patterns and garments. I delivered everything I had, and they also asked us for videos to see how the garments fit on a real body. In this case, my sister tried everything on, and luckily that part went quite well. Next up are lower and upper garments, but that will have to wait for another time since there's a lot of pattern making to do.
Hasta la próxima ❤️ Yowi. See you next time ❤️ Yowi.
alt=\
>
alt=\

>

All photos were taken by me**
</center>
