body.title: Primer taller Orocolor || First Orocolor workshop
body.body:
![1001117544.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uFViCj39kQT77dn1xZUqErK813XLvNpfRHJ7UCAAEApSEYo86GsTUiRWKX68dFx5zbk.png) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Está es la continuación de una historia que les dejé hace días, y es que luego de bastante tiempo, inversión y esfuerzo por ser notada por la marca de pinturas más importante del país, por fin logré obtener un apoyo de su parte. Algo que causó mucha emoción y dicha tanto a mi como a mi familia, pues ellos más que nadie sabían lo que representaba obtener un logro similar. Estos materiales que recibí estaban destinados a hacer una serie de talleres y el primero de ellos quise dirigirlo a mis alumnos y amigos. La idea la venía planeando desde hace tiempo y es que mi intención era hacer una pancarta enorme que estuviera decorando una de las paredes que se encuentran en la entrada del local. En un principio mi idea era darle un sentido y que los alumnos llegaran siguiendo esos lineamientos, pero por falta de tiempo no pude hacer el boceto y decidí dejar que ellos plasmaran lo que quisieran, dándoles total libertad. Adicional a esto unimos esto a la celebración de mi cumpleaños y todos los que iban hasta ese momento del año. Como se acercaba nuestra galería la siguiente semana y siempre procuramos hacer un compartir, todo iba más que perfecto para hacerse. Así que llegó el gran día acomodamos todo mi hijo y yo para irnos un poco más temprano y que nos diera tiempo de organizar todo antes de la llegada de los chicos.

Hi Guys!

This is a continuation of a story I shared with you a few days ago. After quite some time, investment, and effort to get noticed by the country's leading paint brand, I finally managed to secure their support. This brought a lot of excitement and joy to both me and my family, as they, more than anyone, understood what achieving something like this meant. The materials I received were intended for a series of workshops, and I wanted to dedicate the first one to my students and friends. I had been planning this idea for some time; my intention was to create a huge banner to decorate one of the walls at the entrance of the shop. Initially, my idea was to give it a specific theme so that the students would follow those guidelines, but due to lack of time, I couldn't make a sketch and decided to let them create whatever they wanted, giving them complete freedom. In addition to this, we combined it with my birthday celebration and everyone else's birthdays up to that point in the year. Since our gallery opening was the following week, and we always try to have a get-together, everything was more than perfect. So the big day arrived, and my son and I packed everything up so we could leave a little early and have time to organize everything before the kids arrived.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png) ![1001007513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2kgNAz7TtmRemZoScga5QSGgyNErpJqwptYtBsXAW6QhezddMp6ECYyNHBu7X2K9Pj.jpg)
![1001007508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23yJLUW4YgnbmnrSPfJ5e4S1oa6rcEbVBx7psoLxDc6wVWB1VenDL8dNgLjokLq4V4Lcu.jpg) ![1001007424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wCG1jGHtmrKa7jmQwtKBZtTJTrfVnzLW2WXk7Br71ZBSozbAo3HGQd7XL3YKKtPYUzL.jpg) Al llegar acomodamos la mesa, pegué la pancarta en el suelo y así comenzaron a llegar poco a poco. Les iba explicando lo que haríamos, y se fueron incorporando uno a uno en el suelo con su lápiz y trazaron su boceto. Fue chistoso ver cómo todos se montaron literalmente sobre la pancarta hasta llenar cada rincón de dibujos lápiz. Cuando noté que ya habían trazado todo, nos fuimos con las pinturas.
![1001007524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uQvaSywAHVUcHZDk8xnuYkyNjbMtiS9SrxLo2pCWuD4qzqevPgP69uwKrcvZysK99xm.jpg) ![1001007438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xyVRh3nwkzh99QK5GNXuxtbTuLjam5v2crq535bajiET934J1yYWJyp2ZXxH1VnWZkU.jpg) When we arrived we set up the table, I stuck the banner on the floor and that's how they began to arrive little by little. I was explaining to them what we would do, and they sat up one by one on the floor with their pencil and drew their sketch. It was funny to see how everyone literally climbed on the banner until every corner was filled with pencil drawings. When I noticed that they had already traced everything, we went with the paints.
![1001007425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgPr14nccMpApzKSQnVZWyZb3CJUVNK4EAE4HW5xi7iBBdHzPMnCkkwdhSZs3Riy7eg.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001007496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsJTETLquKGwkw8Ed4nyC5XyyZw6fzAAZrsLDSGZUbfRDzg1UF4akjWog4seDArekvk.jpg) Fui dando vueltas alrededor de la pancarta con cada uno de los colores para ir dándole a cada uno los colores que necesitaban e inmediatamente se pusieron manos a la obra. Al mismo tiempo les iba dando los snacks que habían llevado para compartir.
![1001007440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tmFiLkVe3Dkb1rUNfehRqUSenqmWpk536y5PyaT44jGLoGhm9NXUkn3xspWRDupeHpS.jpg) I walked around the banner with each of the colors, giving each child the colors they needed, and they immediately got to work. At the same time, I gave them the snacks they had brought to share.
![1001007526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsQYTdtkeLYhNa2poFH9DcmZhLYa4utjt1QnSHXPUrjRwShWFT4E3FZE9MTNK5K5wwX.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001007477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wC7meQUUTJ1mdSC1zaabVujsKea5wbfuvvHwuGyTeKPxQg7Y8vgo7YpbKyR5XcF9M1N.jpg) ![1001007453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2kttYnrHhZAwP5xQxTEtkfmU9AiqSPfHePFSB4bgQS2rbteFmNAmKeTj7d9n3zTpim.jpg) Cuando ya íbamos más avanzados hicimos la rifa de unos regalos por parte de la marca que eran unos pequeños Kits de pintura. Para todas las actividades me habían obsequiado 3 Kits y me alegró muchísimo poderles dar ese regalo a mis alumnos, además de los chicos de los otros talleres que serían en un colegio cercano. La pasamos genial ese día, los chicos disfrutaron un montón y me hizo súper feliz el haber podido llevar hasta allá este hermoso taller. Pronto les contaré un poco más de los otros talleres. 💜
![1001007525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wWxyQp9RpUdXmtb9C1z3hhMpbHZBx8mApf8QPDh9vhrDJbSmqYQk99aJ5ntSoPXT2aR.jpg) ![1001007456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tvgE96DGm9rKnAvXHzDwddQUfrhoLmvrbLX147QEGaPiYvgmtiXX7RMRUpbD1M5meZV.jpg) As we progressed further, we held a raffle for some gifts from the brand: small painting kits. I had received three kits for all the activities, and I was so happy to be able to give them to my students, as well as the children in the other workshops that would be held at a nearby school. We had a fantastic day; the children enjoyed it immensely, and I was so happy to have been able to bring this wonderful workshop there. I'll tell you more about the other workshops soon. 💜
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

body.title: Philipe's Story, All or nothing for the group
body.body: Warm greetings, dear friends of Buskeria! I'm excited to share with you today the story I've written about Philipe and Javi. They work together in a band; they're a duo. But something happens between them because of something. I can't tell you what that \

is right now, because I don't want to spoil it. You'll find out by reading the story, so there you have it. With that said, let's begin. I hope you enjoy it.

> Saludos cordiales estimados amigos de Buskeria, con mucho quiero compartirles hoy la historia que he escrito sobre Philipe y Javi. Ellos dos trabajan juntos en una banda musical, son un dúo. Pero algo pasa entre ellos por culpa algo. No les puedo decir ahora que será ese “algo” porque sino les hago spolier. Eso lo podrán conocer leyendo la historia, así que ya saben. Dicho esto arrancamos espero que les guste.

<div class=\

> ![1780690900248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23zRyKW1iPBf7bgroCCWg7T7MED1Yy63HgHyUH4U57YbB9abcUZHvv2gzDwLKu8GVidHy.jpg) Image created by me in canva Even now, so much time later, no one knows why such a brilliant duo as Los Ángeles could have separated in such a shocking way. Philipe and Javi seemed almost inseparable, and they always stood together through any problem the duo faced. That's why it was so surprising to learn that they had separated for good and would never sing together again. Many think that the problems between them began on the very day of their separation, but they are wrong. The cracks in their working relationship started long before the split; they weren't as close as they appeared in their songs. It wasn't always like that. When they first got together, they were a duo that truly supported each other. There was no difference between them. Everything they did was for the mutual benefit of the group. The beginning of the group was very beneficial for both of them. Almost everyone in Buskeria liked their music. Most people had a picture of them in their room, because, since that was the most musical region in the world, they wanted to be like them. Young people saw them as role models because they started from the bottom and had already reached the top. > A día de hoy tanto tiempo después nadie sabe por qué un dúo tan genial como Los Ángeles pudo haberse separado de una forma tan impactante. Philipe y Javi parecían casi inseparables, y ante cualquier problema que enfrentó el dúo siempre habían estado juntos. Por eso fue tan sorpresivo saber que se habían separado para siempre y que no cantarían de nuevo jamás. Muchos piensan que los problemas entre ellos comenzaron ese mismo día de la separación, peri están equivocados. Las fracturas en su relación de trabajo comenzaron mucho tiempo atrás antes de la separación, no eran tan unidos como se veían en las canciones. > No siempre fue así, ellos al principio cuando se unieron eran un dúo que se apoyaba de verdad. No había diferencia. Cada cosa que hacían era para beneficio mutuo del grupo. El inicio del grupo fue muy beneficioso para los dos. Su música les gustaba a casi todos en Buskeria. La mayoría tenía un retrato suyo en su cuarto, pues como esa era la región más musical del mundo, querían parecerse a ellos. Los jóvenes los veían como un ejemplo a seguir porque empezaron de lo más bajo y ya estaban en lo más alto.

> ![arron-choi-7XmD-q2eFO8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wMUMZN1ZFz8KppXg4buLLQiqF8kaQu36astqQ9WayG1fCvZ78wzWsyjCqbt2584cMkV.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Things started to go wrong after they reached the peak of musical success. It began with something small. Philipe had a charisma that made him sing much better than Javi, which is why people laughed at what he said or connected with him more when he was emotional. It wasn't that he sang better than Javi, because Javi sang very well; it was just that his way of expressing himself was more communicative. That's why when Philipe sang, whether at concerts or elsewhere, people went wild. When Javi started, they didn't scream nearly as much. Despite not having as much charisma, they were equally loved as a group. The only one who got angry about all this was Javi himself. He began to see his friend as an existential threat to his music. He never said it, but from the moment he started seeing him that way, they were no longer friends, they were enemies. Javi wanted to change people's perception of Philipe to gain more visibility. Since he was in charge of writing the songs and arranging how they would be performed in concerts, and who would start singing, he used that power to put himself in the best places and moments in the songs. > Las cosas empezaron a ir mal luego de llegar a cima del éxito musical. Empezó por algo pequeño. Philipe tenía un carisma para cantar mucho mejor que Javi, por eso la gente se ría con lo que decía o cuando era algo emocional conectaban mejor con el. No es que cantara mejor que Javi pues el lo hacia muy bien, era solo que su forma de expresarse era más comunicativa que la de el otro. Por eso cuando el cantaba ya sea en conciertos la gente enloquecía cuando salía Philipe a cantar. Cuando empezaba Javi no gritaban tanto. A pesar de que no tenia tanto carisma eran amados por igual como grupo. > El único que se enfadó con todo esto fue el mismo Javi. El empezó a ver en su amigo una amenaza existencial para su música. Nunca se lo dijo pero desde que empezó a verlo con esos ojos ya no eran amigos, eran enemigos. Javi quería cambiar la percepción que tenia la gente sobre Philipe para el obtener más visibilidad. Como el era el encargado de escribir las canciones y de ordenar como iban a salir en los conciertos, quien empezaría cantando el aprovechó ese poder para el ponerse así mismo en los mejores lugares y momentos en las canciones.

> ![sander-sammy-q7ZlbWbDnYo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tbK2G9X5K2zq2r3yTKsnYWcz3fPpi8SA7oNsd2UfWBKuJ11GSA2SuC6VEvZpMQBHego.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Philipe noticed something strange about him, but it never crossed his mind that he was plotting something. Things happened the opposite of what Javi expected. In the brief appearance he was giving the other, the crowd went wild for him, making a lot of noise. They truly connected with him. Even if he sang the entire song himself, just one minute of Philipe's appearance was enough for the audience to show him even more support. Pride, envy, and fury consumed Javi. He couldn't accept being inferior to his friend; he had to be older, since he was the leader of the duo. It was at a concert where the shocking separation occurred. They were singing, and suddenly, as always, the crowd started making noise because Philipe had come out to sing—it was their way of showing their support. When Javi saw that they weren't doing the same for him, he couldn't take it anymore. He stopped the music and stopped singing. Everything was silent. They didn't know what was happening. Javi simply said, \

and left. Not even Philipe expected that. The controversy it generated was brutal.

> Philipe notaba algo raro en el pero no le pasó por la cabeza que eran esas cosas que estaba tramando. Las cosas pasaron al contrario de lo que Javi pensaba. En la pequeña participación que le estaba dando al otro la gente enloquecía por el, y hacían mucha bulla. En verdad conectaban con el. Aunque el mismo cantara la canción completa con solo aparecer 1 minuto Philipe con eso era suficiente para que la gente le demostrara más apoyo a él. El orgullo, la envidia y la furia consumieron a Javi, no concebía ser menor que su amigo, el debía ser mayor, pues era el líder del dúo.

> Fue en un concierto donde ocurrió la separación impactante. Ellos estaban cantando y de pronto la gente como siempre empezó a hacer bulla porque había salido Philipe a cantar, era su forma de demostrarle su apoyo. Al Javi ver que no lo hicieron con el no aguantó más. Paró la música y dejó de cantar. Todo era silencio.  No sabían que pasaba. Javi solo dijo, si lo prefieren a el pues quédenselo y se fue. Ni Philipe se esperaba eso. Fue brutal la polémica generada. 

<div class=\

> ![anthony-delanoix-hzgs56Ze49s-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wqnKoyGfsehHYJgTj9k4ZwXzBGNxwfZsjfXDZogVJbt6vmuhZcXuYHbrmTyRCspUbwx.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) They each went their separate ways. But envy prevented Javi from ever thriving again; people already knew why he had left. Although he tried to return to music later, no one listened to him. Everyone stayed with Philipe, who continued as a solo artist. He was humble and never said anything against his other friend. In fact, he was the one who suffered the most from all of this because he never expected everything that had happened. He only wishes him the best and hopes that one day he will let go of the resentment he holds. That was all that happened between them: one failed, and the other persevered. > Cada uno se fue por su lado. Pero la envidia no dejó prosperar jamás a Javi de nuevo, la gente sabía ya porque se había ido. Aunque intentó regresar a la música más tarde nadie lo escuchó. Todos se quedaron con Philipe, que siguió como solista. El era humilde y nunca dijo nada en contra de su otro amigo. El de hecho fue quien más sufrió de todo esto, porque nunca se esperó todo esto que había pasado, solo le desea lo mejor y que algún día deje el rencor que le tiene. Eso fue todo lo que ocurrió entre ellos, uno fracasó y el otro continuó.
> ![red-can-official-zJCErytJa_E-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tvAV3sKAe5sm8qxYndNEt58ritgfiYSYJpAy3k4zDp1h87yxSbxVwq5nsh9gfFNa6FT.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com)

> ![177 Philipe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23ynWkt8uFjEXktZeSkNFYiZbmJGuvMbDQEfV5NPTkqhTNmoAFYH1dyD8RXL19Afr7GvT.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

body.title: SUMMARY - (STREET PHOTOGRAPHY)
body.body:
![Ccats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AKAsRXsAkoxBQBwHLc794rgcswqQpChBETHCsoM2bvVHG4tutyi9EYGNiND5vea.jpg)

-----

**I**n summary, the last week consisted of days with gray skies and slow rains, the kind that dampen the spirits of even the most cheerful. And yet, as usually happens on these days of that white, flat, and uniform light, the colors remained vivid... Almost automatically, I kept looking at what I saw, stealing with a \

from time what I found happening and, at the same time, observing my thoughts as if standing from the outside, as if every single thing passing through my head were a gray, slow fish moving along the course of a river whose waters run absurdly slow. That, in short, was how I understood this past week. And there were almost no shadows because the white light came from everywhere, or at least so it seemed. And the most curious thing: the people around seemed to fake normalcy and tried to quicken their pace, but it was to no avail; the town was slow, frankly slow...

>**E**n resumen, la semana fue de días con cielos grises y lluvias lentas, de esas que hacen decaer los ánimos aun a los más alegres. Y sin embargo, como suele suceder en estos días de esa luz blanca, plana y pareja, los colores se mantuvieron vivos... Casi de manera automática, fui mirando lo que miré, robándole con un «click» al tiempo lo que encontré sucediendo y, al mismo tiempo, observando mis pensamientos como parado desde afuera, como si cada cosa que pasaba por mi cabeza fuera un pez gris y lento, yendo por el cauce de un río cuyas aguas corren absurdamente lentas. Así, en resumen, fue como entendí esta semana que pasó. Y casi no hubo sombras porque la luz blanca venía de todas partes, o cuando menos así lo parecía. Y lo más curioso: las personas alrededor parecían fingir normalidad e intentaban apurar el paso, pero no servía de nada; el pueblo estaba lento, francamente lento...

----

![C01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wX5mkGXxrTgXNU1npGSMmFyZCKukM57ffHw5yyHSbUAye58MovGEVZDfhPz9N5GxHjh.jpg)
**📷 01 - The man standing at the lottery ticket kiosk... / <sub> El hombre en la venta de boletos de lotería... </sub>**

----

![C02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xyXDLvuqAdUpGs9GtyYN3jc2vGCiHFAFt5LWvC5Q2AiqdaVyfFeNR1hQDwF2jt2Kqyv.jpg)
**📷 02 - The red in the frappé machine... / <sub> El rojo de la maquina de hacer frappé... </sub>**

----

![C03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tvkg5aVPjDf7A9qXSnWNDezdLTWNAMGJ4NLLhUWSvgLDaqy9ehbRTJ581mEPZsGxcGV.jpg)
**📷 03 - Abstract and chaos on the bark of a palm tree... / <sub> Abstracto y caos en la corteza de un árbol de palma... </sub>**

----

![C04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/241thrbidDwuHGd3NmqhagwH1J7RqBbGFeJ5ybcmfDymrtChHAeiDmwZWW2si5rXtf95B.jpg)
**📷 04 - Without Romulus and without Remus, little pocket Luperca... / <sub> Sin Rómulo y sin Remo, pequeña Luperca de bolsillo... </sub>**

----

**T**he first paragraph of this post is also a photo, I suppose. But one made with letters that form words that sound a bit jumbled. Just as jumbled as the things passing through my head sound, while I was, this past week, walking through these streets saturated with bright clarity and dampness... Just like in that paragraph, it is also valid to make a \

I suppose...

>**E**l primer párrafo de esta publicación también es una foto, supongo. Pero una hecha con letras que forman palabras que suenan un poco revueltas. Así como revueltas suenan las cosas que pasan por mi cabeza mientras iba, esta semana pasada, caminando por estas calles saturadas de claridades y humedades... Así, como en ese párrafo, también es válido hacer «click», supongo... 

----

![C05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243g2iHhA6xUhMZwxefQrdsf4D4LoBA5dVzL3BmPjz1TGcL1FSA16ARUAxrCGtXfFbEf5.jpg)
**📷 05 - The dead door of the \
, the one belonging to the teacher named Marina... / <sub> La puerta muerta de la \

, la de la maestra llamada Marina... </sub>**

----

![C06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23u5vsQg9zqcshEW5JVFaN7QH2Atbz2sMhQTXaJjFufFqazpANNazWdWwU1PJGQaCD6w4.jpg)
**📷 06 - Someone wants to go for a motorcycle ride, despite the gray day... / <sub> Alguien quiere pasear en moto, a pesar del día gris... </sub>**

----

![C07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23u6Q2GWN666GNhCurigfoqwVaTqq9b6PXkC9QZMvnzDZVRaL4EMhgYur8nVmnysLbsJN.jpg)
**📷 07 - Abstraction with the back of the dog with four black spots... / <sub> Abstracción con el lomo del perro de cuatro manchas negras... </sub>**

----

![C08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tSWFabNWA4k3dbLksYKd2kEeBGD2Ve8LtAGpv7DQF8WFcFp1zGLtdodVmu1W1i5rdAQ.jpg)
**📷 08 - And now, abstract with the palm leaf... / <sub> Y ahora, abstracto con la hoja de la palmera... </sub>**

----

**A**nd it's good to learn to ramble. Is that something you can learn? I don't know, but I do know it's good, and even better is writing down the ramblings that stick in your memory, like abstract stains that can say things (and this last thought also crossed my mind while I was wandering the streets taking these photos)...

>**Y** es bueno aprender a divagar. ¿Eso se aprende, acaso? No lo sé, pero sí sé que es bueno; y aun más bueno es escribir las divagaciones que se quedan pegadas en la memoria, como manchas abstractas que pueden decir cosas (y esto último también me pasó por la cabeza mientras deambulaba por las calles haciendo estas fotos)...

body.title: 中国人的自信来自哪里
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![4nbR6xbsiKNnRyHY_36020260608113918.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/4nbR6xbsiKNnRyHY_36020260608113918/4nbR6xbsiKNnRyHY_36020260608113918.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近因为关注“足球小将”所以刷了不少相关的视频，也包括主教练董路的直播片段。

董路这个人还是很有自己的思想和独特的认知。他以足球为切入点，聊了一个很有意思的话题，中国人的自信来自哪里？

按照董路的观点，西方很多人追求个人主义，个体思想独立。所以西方很多人不管个体是怎么样的一个状态，他都可能是自信的。比如一个农民，一个乞丐，他都可能是自信的。或者说自我认同吧。

所以，西方也容易有一些“信仰”的教派。

但是中国人不怎么信教，中国的文化里，中国这么多年的发展经验里，中国人的自信来自“物质”。

中国人信仰物质，我生活过得好，我比你强，我就自信。

感觉似乎很有道理。想象一下农村的村里头，你要是赚大钱的，在外面当大官的，你走在村里都是昂着头的。但是你没有这些物质的光环来加身，你就地人一头。

中国的人情社会，家庭社会，周边的人与人的关系，似乎都有这样的影子。你拥有什么财富，地位，这些都是自信的源头。

在中国，如果你很穷又很自信，那可能你会被当成是个傻帽，脑袋有毛病。在农村，你说你精神丰富读书很多，自信自己的精神追求，但是没有地位和财富，你依然可能被人当成是读书读傻了。

这些年，常提一个词叫“文化自信”，很多年轻人也都开始崇尚自己的文化了，似乎变得自信起来了。

但是，中国有五千年的文化，如果本身就自信，为什么也就是这几年才有类似的现象。以前，可还是崇洋媚外，看国外的综艺和动画片的，国外的都特香。

本质里，还是这些年中国经济发展起来了，物质丰富起来了，于是我们过得更好了，自然自信起来了。

所以，中国人的自信，来自于“物质”，似乎有那么些道理。

---

body.title: Rainy days have their charm too (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
<center>
## English version
</center>

<div class=\

> A landscape can also be a reflection of the observer, just as the sea will always be a reflection of the sky. Today was a rainy day, so the sky darkened; the usual blue gave way to a rather pronounced leaden gray that stretched across the heavens. The images, though neither colorful nor projecting optimism, were nonetheless appealing for appreciating nature from a perspective far removed from the conventional.
![1000452811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonkvR4i81nm2dXgCb1VnQ23MVeWjGWBddLCipt8epDoks5RaGtLebiPPwKDcRm75Fw.jpg)
On my usual walk along Caigüire Beach, on a cool afternoon thanks to the chilly breeze, I was able to appreciate this landscape, which I particularly like because it looks like a metaphor for life and its mysteries. The other coast of Sucre was not visible; it remained hidden behind a misty curtain that lent an air of mystery to this scene.
![1000452810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnCp6Mm44SvpeXyuNzyHxkMrc9vEBPpzzq9roHF9E4wLdJD725kCd12jpyYgaiPTH9.jpg)
![1000452807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eos1rydKLWE5zYEhto4V7zd18Vhgut114ae8HwjaTTNJVQHL1Z3HYDMqip1Ky3QzWM3.jpg)
It looked like rain—that much was clear—but I still enjoyed the damp atmosphere, recalling the many times I’d been caught in a downpour on the street. Ever since I started walking for fun and health, I’ve come to enjoy all these unexpected moments. My wife loves the scent of rain and damp earth; she tells me that it transports her back to her childhood, and thanks to her, I’ve started paying special attention to these details that are part of our personal experiences.
![1000452806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq5EWVJf9QN8cjH8D8PkmcKCwnAQtg3gjGKTmoUdSoEGZUAsgq2nGS3Bu1mYmW8Nmar.jpg)
![1000452809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJvGefA9qCGrcSsxELqsbiNczAnTeYqaAPJvtn8XA5zwGMohVntmtPYpmF4yPDfkb.jpg)
![1000452805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqHzszEKsewuV4WjodygrrWXJvCznvpXarKif2yin8aCL2UQVs9xjUpNRUJk7SeiWbH.jpg)
Like me, several people were walking along the Perimetral Avenue boulevard on the beach side, so bad weather is no excuse to break the routine—which shows that discipline and perseverance trump the rain. While the sun is a source of energy and is usually motivating, this scene isn’t bad for spending a pleasant time.
![1000452804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpNoM3JxWik8kBQBv9mHseuY7VUV67hjhPefEszfChjaceyQXPyXxhaQo4rsLEBakRG.jpg)
![1000452803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpQvpos4gVEgS5DG5wETycGMT8UfKb8tLEKoVEAuwzZE5MggvZLrKz95LRv1UvvnbKd.jpg)
![1000452802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpA33TTDgPNy8wasZhUELepSWiuNuTxq35eSd9EQARtp6LhQRJfaWFGokjTr7yFebSP.jpg)
Sunsets in this area are usually spectacular because of the combination of colors that often appear in the sky: yellow, white, orange, red, black, and blue blend together as the sunlight—which just a few hours ago was blazing—fades away to make way for darkness, metaphors for life that unfold at every moment. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Un paisaje puede también ser el reflejo de quien observa, así como el mar siempre será un reflejo del cielo. Hoy fue un día lluvioso, por lo tanto el cielo se oscureció, el habitual color azul cedió ante un gris plomizo bastante pronunciado que se extendía hacia el firmamento. Las imágenes, aunque no eran coloridas ni proyectaban optimismo, de igual manera resultaban atractivas para apreciar la naturaleza desde una perspectiva alejada de lo convencional.
![1000452811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonkvR4i81nm2dXgCb1VnQ23MVeWjGWBddLCipt8epDoks5RaGtLebiPPwKDcRm75Fw.jpg)
En mi habitual recorrido por la playa de Caigüire, en una tarde fresca debido a la brisa fría, pude apreciar este paisaje que en lo particular me agrada porque luce como una metáfora de la vida y sus misterios. La otra costa sucrense no se podía apreciar, permanecía escondida tras una nebulosa cortina que concedía un aire de misterio a este panorama.
![1000452810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnCp6Mm44SvpeXyuNzyHxkMrc9vEBPpzzq9roHF9E4wLdJD725kCd12jpyYgaiPTH9.jpg)
![1000452807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eos1rydKLWE5zYEhto4V7zd18Vhgut114ae8HwjaTTNJVQHL1Z3HYDMqip1Ky3QzWM3.jpg)
Amenazaba lluvia, era evidente, igual disfrutaba del ambiente húmedo, recordando las tantas ocasiones que un aguacero me cayó encima en la calle. Desde que empecé a caminar por diversión y salud, suelo disfrutar de todos estos imprevistos. Mi esposa disfruta el aroma a lluvia y a tierra húmeda, me dice que sus sentidos la trasladan hacia su infancia y gracias a ella es que le he puesto especial atención a estos detalles que forman parte de las vivencias personales.
![1000452806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq5EWVJf9QN8cjH8D8PkmcKCwnAQtg3gjGKTmoUdSoEGZUAsgq2nGS3Bu1mYmW8Nmar.jpg)
![1000452809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpXJvGefA9qCGrcSsxELqsbiNczAnTeYqaAPJvtn8XA5zwGMohVntmtPYpmF4yPDfkb.jpg)

Tenía que celebrar el cumpleaños de mi esposo, y para eso siempre nos preparamos unos meses antes con el regalo, y pensar que más vamos hacer para poder reunir el dinero, este cumpleaños algunas veces se me complica por que luego aldia del padre falta muy poco y es doble regalo, al menos nos da tiempo dos semana más.

body.title: Coconut Cake (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
<center>
## English version
</center>

<div class=\

> Today I made a coconut cake because tomorrow is my birthday—there’s nothing better than celebrating life with a delicious dessert. Since this is a no-bake cake, it needs to be refrigerated for at least 24 hours. Join me on this pre-birthday adventure.
![1000119703.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyR84vaeMEE5UHXx4r9zaneqixjqESMqZoQrcnMHbpBREuceznZrjKeXQfrR8aucLZp.jpg)
## Ingredients: For the cake: - 8 eggs - 3 cups self-rising flour - 3 cups of sugar - 2 tablespoons of vanilla - 1 lemon For the coconut cream: - 2 coconuts - 1 liter of milk - 5 tablespoons of sugar - 4 tablespoons of all-purpose flour - 4 egg yolks - 1 can of condensed milk
![1000119664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsSpagf8bV78zWzheucQw2je6oajy4wdv46BzeQtWu7A47PCFMAjsEmeGpXwZxpCTjn.jpg)
## Preparation: First, separate the egg yolks from the whites, taking great care to keep them from mixing. Place the egg whites in a bowl and begin beating them with an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually add one cup of sugar while continuing to beat. The goal is to achieve a stiff meringue.
![1000119673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi8P3i1B8gmk1vJCh2fYdz5WRz8qyPgNxo8mcLCed9LxUNJwytXBJjzDWg9n2CDiA1e.jpg)
Next, I added the yolks and the remaining two cups of sugar. The mixture will change color from white to light yellow. Once the consistency was perfect, I turned off the mixer and added the flour, using a wooden spatula to fold it in gently. Next, I grated the lemon zest and added it to the mixture. Then I added two tablespoons of vanilla; these two ingredients give the cake a unique and pleasant flavor.
![1000119669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1BQN9BYHhq7SqWecABUAGaAUab5J51VjiFYfnnumqjQq29bVW2s9pD1T87AkPEpvaT.jpg)
After that, I took a cake pan and greased it with butter and dusted it with flour. I poured the mixture into the pan and baked it in the oven for forty minutes at 250 degrees. Meanwhile, I split the coconuts, set the water aside in a container, and removed the flesh with a knife. I put one part in the blender with a cup of water to make coconut milk, and I grated the other part.
![1000119679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMcomU48GPhVN9CuCEpiJ9nNZTQJ8mg8pJUFRPcUxKWzhCgpEF6TpmiR89xwPVB3KDt.jpg)
Then I poured 500 ml of milk into a saucepan along with the shredded coconut, placed it over medium heat, added the wheat flour, and stirred thoroughly to break up any lumps. In a blender, I combined the remaining 500 ml of milk with the egg yolks and sugar, then poured this mixture into the saucepan. I let it come to a boil until it thickened into a creamy consistency, then set it aside to cool.
![1000119695.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2oVKKdXeAjXoES8i2ZjvMZJaWyCqBdMAokkNUTLPzMQ8gR6RXxZEXMN8ZaRMcXCdCm.jpg)
When I took the cake out of the oven, I let it cool at room temperature for a while until it had cooled down, then I cut it in half, made small holes with a fork, and soaked it with coconut milk; I also added a layer of condensed milk here. Then I filled it with the coconut cream. I placed the other layer on top and made more holes, then soaked it with a little coconut milk. I decorated it with the leftover cream and shredded coconut.
![1000119693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xKzZzN65ebzzwXkTwVrzefaAmMu1ASMR34mFMDWmN2nUJ4zTqWhhxt1RhhuzDiP8C1F.png)
![1000119687.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1DgRv9Xi3o6LH1vhSsFqNrW8vX6wuNgCEFvAB6z7oQgswCvPjtRfTPkZ3xj8pHCdoJ.jpg)
All that was left was to put it in the fridge and wait to enjoy it. I knew in advance that it would turn out spectacular—the proportions and quality of the ingredients were just right. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy preparé una torta de coco porque mañana es mi cumpleaños, nada mejor que celebrar la vida con un postre delicioso. Como es una torta fría necesita permanecer refrigerada al menos 24 horas. Acompañénme en esta aventura de precumpleaños.
![1000119703.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyR84vaeMEE5UHXx4r9zaneqixjqESMqZoQrcnMHbpBREuceznZrjKeXQfrR8aucLZp.jpg)
## Ingredientes: Para el bizcocho: - 8 huevos - 3 tazas de harina de trigo leudante - 3 tazas de azúcar - 2 cucharadas de vainilla - 1 limón Para la crema de coco: - 2 cocos - 1 litro de leche - 5 cucharadas de azúcar - 4 cucharadas de harina de trigo - 4 yemas de huevo - 1 leche condensada
![1000119664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsSpagf8bV78zWzheucQw2je6oajy4wdv46BzeQtWu7A47PCFMAjsEmeGpXwZxpCTjn.jpg)
## Preparación: Lo primero que se hace es agarrar los huevos y separar las yemas de las claras, con mucho cuidado para evitar que se mezclen. Las claras se colocan en un envase y se comienza a hacer espuma con una batidora eléctrica, luego se agrega una taza de azúcar, de forma paulatina y sin dejar de batir. El objetivo es lograr un merengue firme.
![1000119673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi8P3i1B8gmk1vJCh2fYdz5WRz8qyPgNxo8mcLCed9LxUNJwytXBJjzDWg9n2CDiA1e.jpg)
Luego añadí las yemas y las otras dos tazas de azúcar. La preparación cambiará de color, de blanco a amarillo claro. Una vez que tenemos la consistencia perfecta, apagué la batidora y añadí la harina de trigo, usé una paleta de madera para mezclar de forma envolvente. Después rallé la cáscara del limón y la incorporé a la mezcla. Luego las dos cucharadas de vainilla, estos dos ingredientes conceden un sabor único y agradable al bizcocho.
![1000119669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1BQN9BYHhq7SqWecABUAGaAUab5J51VjiFYfnnumqjQq29bVW2s9pD1T87AkPEpvaT.jpg)
Posteriormente, agarré una tortera y le puse mantequilla y harina de trigo en la superficie. Acá vertí la mezcla y la llevé la horno durante cuarenta minutos a una temperatura de 250 grados. Por otra parte, dividí los cocos, aparté el agua en un envase y saqué la pulpa con un cuchillo. Llevé una parte a la licuadora junto a una taza de agua para obtener leche y la otra parte la rallé.
![1000119679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMcomU48GPhVN9CuCEpiJ9nNZTQJ8mg8pJUFRPcUxKWzhCgpEF6TpmiR89xwPVB3KDt.jpg)
Luego llevé 500 ml de leche a una olla junto con el coco rallado, lo coloqué en fuego medio, agregué la harina de trigo y mezclé muy bien para disolver los grumos. En la licuadora adicioné los otros 500 ml de leche con las yemas y el azúcar, esta preparación la agregué a la olla, allí dejé hervir hasta obtener una crema espesa y dejé enfriar.
![1000119695.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2oVKKdXeAjXoES8i2ZjvMZJaWyCqBdMAokkNUTLPzMQ8gR6RXxZEXMN8ZaRMcXCdCm.jpg)
Cuando saqué la torta del horno la dejé un buen rato a temperatura ambiente hasta que perdiera el calor, la dividí a la mitad, hice pequeños agujeros con un tenedor y la mojé con la leche de coco, acá también añadí una capa de leche condensada. Luego rellené con la crema de coco. Coloqué la otra capa e hice otros agujeros, mojé con un poco de leche de coco. Decoré con el sobrante de la crema y del coco rallado.
![1000119693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xKzZzN65ebzzwXkTwVrzefaAmMu1ASMR34mFMDWmN2nUJ4zTqWhhxt1RhhuzDiP8C1F.png)
![1000119687.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x1DgRv9Xi3o6LH1vhSsFqNrW8vX6wuNgCEFvAB6z7oQgswCvPjtRfTPkZ3xj8pHCdoJ.jpg)
El resto fue llevar a la nevera y esperar para degustarla. Sabía de antemano que quedó espectacular, la proporción y calidad de los ingredientes era la ideal. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: - Chapters 11-15 - My Thoughts (Book 8 of 12)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvWN674RD3yCTJqhADJ7DADRw3B4TnTL7MyHCmS8Wwqf/1779293120710.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEeBaR4FnHN8LAnReWZw54bf3NSA9JsuZe1FEU8tyvYL/1779293120789.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

### Chapters Read: 11-15

These chapters were a lot more interesting than the first half of the book overall I feel. These chapters were just way more intriguing in general. 

Steve's deception is very cleverly constructed in general. In re-reads, noticing certain patterns the second or third time around is often very easy. Like, it's usually easy to say characters should have seen certain things coming, the signs are usually a bit more obvious from a reader's perspective. 

But honestly, Steve is really executing this plan pretty excellently. The only obvious thing I feel the gang should have seriously questioned was the fact that Steve is wearing gloves and that the medicinal herbs and whatnot are concealing his scent. Steve's excuse here is pretty great though, he says that he's basically prone to illness from Mr. Crepsley tasting his blood all those years ago.

Otherwise, Steve is acting really well at playing this sort of anti-hero role for now. 

In fact, I am actually putting a lot of blame on Mr. Crepsley here. Well, I suppose it's ultimately Mr. Tiny. But to avoid a much bigger conversation, I'll be hopefully more specific. The gang overall is at fault as well, but I think most importantly this is on Mr. Crepsley. 

Ok, so what do I mean? I mean Mr. Crepsley's arrogance and slight lack of compassion really hurt the situation here. Only *slightly* on the compassion part. 

Ok so, Mr. Crepsley vehemently swears that Steve's blood is quite evil. Honestly, fair enough I'm not at all doubting that. But Mr. Crepsley should have either pressed and convinced the gang more to tell them not to trust Steve, or simply thought a bit deeper about Steve's abrupt arrival and taken matters into his own hands kind of. I say this because, if Mr. Crepsley truly thinks Steve's blood was that bad, his arrival all of a sudden should probably have blown his mind. Steve swore many years ago he'd kill Mr. Crepsley and Darren. 

With everything going on with this war, I believe Steve's arrival should have been a massive gigantic red flag. Mr. Crepsley has the most unique perspective about Steve over anyone in that room. 

The gang, including Vancha and Darren, do a good job at sort of calmly telling off/convincing Mr. Crepsley to chill since Steve has apparently 'helped' the cause and 'saved' Darren and has turned a new leaf. So it's not all arrogance for Mr. Crepsley. 

But a lot of it is arrogance, I believe. Mr. Crepsley probably not only still sees Steve as an angry child but, for whatever reason I feel that Mr. Crepsley doesn't think Steve is a real genuine threat. I mean, if Steve didn't randomly arrive during a huge war with the vampaneze, perhaps there'd be less reason to be so paranoid or worried about Steve. But these are far from ordinary circumstances whatsoever. Mr. Crepsley himself seems particularly enamored with Mr. Tiny and his capabilities! At this point, if you're Mr. Crepsley, mental dominoes have to be tumbling I feel! I'm unsure if Mr. Crepsley would literally think Steve is the Vampaneze Lord, but I feel like something bigger should have crossed his mind. 

I think that again, Mr. Crepsley dismisses humans as a real threat and well, Steve is a human in the eyes of everyone of course at this point in time. Mr. Crepsley should have had perhaps a layer of grudging respect, rather than sort of perceiving Steve as some random evil nuisance. This is such a surprising fumble by Mr. Crepsley. Also, The Lord of the Vampaneze has been a legend in the vampire world for hundreds of years, you gotta think a being like that is gonna be clever or whatnot. 

Now, Mr. Crepsley is outranked by Vancha and Darren here, so there's that. And Vancha brings up the point that just because Mr. Crepsley tasted evil, doesn't mean the individual must *do* evil, and on that point Mr. Crepsley agrees. 

To an extent, I suppose it's also the gangs fault for not respecting Mr. Crepsley's word. So, there's that too. The gang should respect Mr. Crepsley a bit more!

The best moment I have to give Mr. Crepsley credit for, was when he challenged Vancha to test Steve's blood. That would have been an absolute checkmate! That would have instantly proved Steve is not just evil but half-vampaneze! I just know Steve was sweating! Man! Vancha doesn't because he basically claims he trusts Darren and Harkat. 

Finally, and this is perhaps the most speculative aspect of my whole rant here, I wonder how this ENTIRE thing, this whole story, would have gone down if Mr. Crepsley didn't just blatantly show disgust and hostility when he tasted Steve's evil blood. Perhaps if Mr. Crepsley showed a smidge of remorse or like, caring or something remotely similar, maybe Steve wouldn't have been *quite* as vengeful or *quite* as evil? 

But Mr. Crepsley does claim that Steve's blood was pretty much *abnormally* filled with evil. Like, not just some or traces. So maybe the taste was so great that, Mr. Crepsley couldn't even justify showing anything but disgust. 

Maybe, *just maybe*, Mr. Crepsley sealed Steve's fate that very night. Steve may have always been a jerk, or a criminal, or something who knows, but maybe Mr. Crepsley really pushed Steve over the edge.

Or maybe Mr. Crepsley didn't have anything to do with it, and Steve's evil path was inevitable. I really don't know. 

Steve himself says something quite interesting when he said to Mr. Crepsley himself that Mr. Crepsley's rejection tore him apart and that it almost drove him to evil. Obviously this was a lie but it is slightly interesting. I wonder if, in a roundabout way, there was some truth to that. 

Fnally, and this is really pushing it, I wonder if anything would have changed in this very moment when Steve and Mr. Crepsley met once again. What if Mr. Crepsley himself had a change of tone or something towards Steve after all tose years? Like, to be blunt, in an imaginary scenario, what if Mr. Crepsley offered some genuine whole hearted apology, even if he did or didn't believe it was fully justified? Would Steve have maybe acted differently after a moment like that? 

Steve grew up without a father, and some mythical vampire man just refuses to accept him. As a kid, hearing that must have hurt, regardless of what anyone thinks. Of course Mr. Crepsley had no obligation to just take in a child as an assistant, but he did take in Darren who had a very good, well balanced family, pretty much out of pure random pettiness. I can actually see why Steve is upset more than I did before. Nobody can just say Steve, as a kid, should have known better. I don't know, something to think about. Maybe this very moment is where Mr. Crepsley could have turned the fate of the war. 

I'm not going to say that someone without a father figure is gonna be some awful individual, but I do believe that society acts like not having a dad is 'no biggie'. Funny enough, many times men are constantly blamed for not being there or being deadbeats which is wildly assumption based and simplistic but, even if I grant that, those same people bashing men for not being there can't *also* say that not having a dad isn't a big deal. Like those viewpoints are completely, insanely contradictory. I'm not saying absent, bad fathers don't exist, but I'm just sick of the lazy takes. 

There's a lot of moving parts I feel with all of this. Maybe it's not as deep as I'm making it seem but, eh I'm just having fun with it. Saying my opinion. I like this series, and it's fun to speculate and ramble. Sue me. 

Maybe Mr. Crepsley should have had more of a respect/wariness of what Steve could be capable of. 

*\

* — James Patterson

Maybe the gang should have trusted Mr. Crepsley a lot more. Steve is just a random dude at this point to most of the people in that room, while Mr. Crepsley is one of the most respected vampires ever. Yikes, that's a tough look for the gang too. 

I don't know, I could contemplate so many things! All this mess sort of explains life to an extent!

Last portion of book eight now, let's go!

body.title: 體重焦慮...
body.body: 沒想到一個大男人的我，竟也有了體重焦慮。 其實自從兩星期去完順德後，我體重大約重了差不多半公斤，起初我以為是吃多了身體積水比較多，但後來發現不是，再加上我剛剛好這個時間在Keep裡面的智能訓練計劃結束，系統給我安排的新計劃強度卻比之前低，本來我都跟從安排去做，但兩星期下來，我體重明顯的重了半公斤了。 我這大半年主張的都是慢慢減，把運動和飲食融入習慣裡，所以之前對於這慢速減重甚至停滯都沒什麼大感覺，但直到這次體重回升，我卻發現我接受不了，哈哈。我想主要原因是我還在以減重為目標，也沒有說放鬆，但一兩個事件就輕易令我回升半公斤，以我之前的進度，這可是要半個月才能減掉半公斤。 雖然體重不是唯一指標，體脂才是更具參考性的數字，但我還是有點焦慮，結果就是把早上的運動重新換成較高強度的，節食日也嘗試節多一點，當然不能太多，就多一點點，希望能快點回到本來體重吧。 另外，買了一雙新跑鞋。
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/> 事緣我現在旅行多了，又會在旅行途中跑步，平時我都是拖行李箱，多放一雙鞋沒問題，不過夏天帶的衣服比較少，我就背背包比較多，所以就買了一雙可跑步，但又比較休閒風的鞋子，逛街跑步兩不誤，這就可以少帶一雙鞋了。
alt=\

/>

當然，日常的練習是不能少的，星期日的10KM，雖然天氣挺熱，但成績不錯。

呀，希望快點回到本來體重，希望快點看到身體線條吧。

body.title: Xiao Han y Mina: Historias de amor, resiliencia y dos guerreros de cuatro patas // My two furry warriors 🐾
body.body: ¡Hola, comunidad de Hive Pets! Tras el hermoso recibimiento de mi presentación, hoy quiero abrirles las puertas de mi hogar y de mi corazón para presentarles a las dos razones que me alegran los días más grises y difíciles: mis perros, Xiao Han y Mina. Ambos son sobrevivientes y cada uno me ha enseñado el verdadero significado de la lucha. _Hello, Hive Pets community! After the beautiful welcome on my introduction post, today I want to open the doors of my home and my heart to introduce you to the two reasons that bring joy to my grayest and most difficult days: my dogs, Xiao Han and Mina. Both are survivors, and each has taught me the true meaning of fighting._
alt=\

/> Xiao Han: Mi consentido de ojos marrones El machito de la casa se llama Xiao Han. El próximo 23 de junio cumplirá 6 años. Es una mezcla de Pug con Spaniel Tibetano; me lo vendieron como esto último, pero al crecer se notó la diferencia: básicamente, es un Pug con pelo largo color champagne y unos grandes ojos marrones que me derriten. Es el perro más dócil, tranquilo, mimado y sociable que he tenido. _Xiao Han: My brown-eyed spoiled boy_ _The little man of the house is named Xiao Han. He will turn 6 years old this June 23rd. He is a mix of Pug and Tibetan Spaniel; he was sold to me as the latter, but as he grew, the difference became obvious—basically, he is a long-haired, champagne-colored Pug with big brown eyes that just melt me. He is the most gentle, calm, spoiled, and sociable dog I have ever had._ Hace 4 años vivimos una de las peores experiencias de mi vida: enfermó de erlichiosis. Creí que lo perdería. Desesperada, comuniqué mi dolor en un grupo de Facebook; gracias a los consejos de personas empáticas, me di cuenta de que su veterinario de entonces no estaba haciendo lo suficiente. Cambié de médico a tiempo. Fueron noches de desvelo y una ansiedad espantosa, hasta que al octavo día pude dormir tranquila al ver su mejoría. Lamentablemente, desde hace un año ha tenido recaídas frecuentes. El médico sospecha que pueda ser otra condición, pero la falta de empleo y dinero me dificulta seguir el tratamiento adecuado. Esta vez no se pudo completar el ciclo de pastillas, pero mi meta actual es reunir lo necesario para que en la próxima recaída tenga todo a mano. _Four years ago, we lived through one of the worst experiences of my life: he fell ill with ehrlichiosis. I thought I would lose him. Desperate, I shared my pain in a Facebook group; thanks to the advice of empathetic people, I realized his vet at the time wasn't doing enough. I changed doctors just in time. Those were nights of sleeplessness and terrible anxiety, until the eighth day when I could finally sleep peacefully after seeing him improve. Unfortunately, he has been having frequent relapses over the past year. The current vet suspects it might be another condition, but my lack of employment and money makes it hard to follow the proper treatment. This time I couldn't complete the full cycle of medication, but my current goal is to gather what is needed so that I have everything on hand for his next relapse._
alt=\

/>

Mina: La luchadora de ojos verdes

La otra integrante es Min Ah, aunque le decimos simplemente Mina. Es una perra criolla (sin raza) con una voluntad férrea desde pequeña. Llegó a nuestras vidas en octubre del año pasado con apenas un mes de nacida. El novio de mi hermana la adoptó, pero al segundo día sufrió un accidente terrible: se cayó desde la segunda planta de la casita donde estaban. No murió de milagro.

_Mina: The green-eyed fighter_

_The other member of the family is Min Ah, though we simply call her Mina. She is a criolla (mixed-breed) dog with an iron will since she was a puppy. She came into our lives last October when she was barely a month old. My sister's boyfriend adopted her, but on her second day, she suffered a terrible accident: she fell from the second floor of the little house where they were staying. It was a miracle she survived._

Tras la caída, comenzó a tener unas crisis donde gritaba como un perro torturado; era desgarrador ver tanto dolor en un cuerpo tan diminuto. El primer veterinario nos dijo que \

y darle vitaminas. Al verla al borde de la muerte y notar que ella seguía luchando, mi mamá y yo prometimos que si pasaba de la noche, buscaríamos a otro médico costara lo que costara. Así lo hicimos. El nuevo veterinario le salvó la vida al descubrir que los chillidos no eran fracturas, sino una infección severa de parásitos que la estaban comiendo viva por dentro y que nadie había tratado. Desde la primera dosis, volvió la paz.\n\n_After the fall, she started having crises where she would scream like a tortured dog; it was heartbreaking to see so much pain in such a tiny body. The first vet told us \

and give her some vitamins. Seeing her on the brink of death but noticing that she kept fighting for her life, my mom and I promised that if she made it through the night, we would take her to another doctor no matter what it cost. And so we did. The new vet saved her life by discovering that the screams weren't from fractures, but from a severe parasite infection that was eating her alive from the inside, which no one had treated. From the very first dose, peace returned._

Por si fuera poco, hace mes y medio enfermó de parvovirus. Con solo 7 meses, fue otra odisea. Yo ya estaba sin trabajo y no había dinero, pero en casa empezamos a vender nuestra ropa y pertenencias para costear el tratamiento. Con fe y la ayuda de un buen veterinario, Mina se salvó. Casi nadie le dice que es linda porque es una perrita criolla, grande, blanca y marrón. Pero yo veo esos ojitos verdes, su carita juguetona, hiperactiva y descarada, y me desbordo de amor. Veo a una guerrera que ha puesto todo de su parte para seguir viviendo.

_As if that weren't enough, a month and a half ago she fell ill with parvovirus. At only 7 months old, it was another odyssey. I was already out of work and there was no money, but at home, we started selling our clothes and belongings to pay for a good vet. With faith and the help of a great doctor, Mina made it. Hard to find anyone who calls her pretty because she is a large, brown-and-white mixed-breed dog. But I look into those green eyes, her playful, hyperactive, and cheeky face, and I just melt with love. I see a warrior who has done her absolute part to keep living._

Ellos son mi refugio, mi cable a tierra y la demostración de que el amor todo lo puede. ¡Gracias por leer! Me encantaría saber en los comentarios si también tienen historias de guerreros en casa.

_They are my refuge, my anchor, and the proof that love conquers all. Thank you for reading! I would love to know in the comments if you also have stories of warriors at home._

Thankfully they have a garden hose bib attached to the back of the shop!👍 We found a flexible water tank on Amazon that holds approx 130 gallons, that works out to be 1,084 pounds! Just perfect for my 1/2 ton pickup truck!😇 With half a ton of water in the back of my pickup, I started towards home driving up several steep on the way!😅 The crystal clear water started flowing from the water tank, filling the tub! Thirty minutes later the flexible water bladder was empty, ready for round two, a second truckload of water!💧 Two trips to town, and two full loads of water, and our hot tub was plugged in and circulating!🤗 PEPE had just returned from the Ocean as we finished……….. “Dis water look nice Silbertop, how many Lady Frogs you think Dis tub hold?”🐸 “Silvertop……….. you tell PEPE he can take “ALL” his Lady Frogs back to the BIG POND at Boulevard Park, this hot tub is just for us!”🥰🤔 “Sorry PEPE, you heard the Mrs, NO Lady Frogs!”😇 “Dis OK Silbertop, hot tub not BIG enough fer ALL PEPE Ladies!”🐸 Hmmm………..🙄 “Crank the heat up Liz, I’m ready for a dip if you are!”😍 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

title.title: THE SILENT STRUGLES OF ASKING FOR HELP
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdCGPxcmqtpGQtvP7pAdC1wbwg4brtYYxC3vnh6UTfKiG/Gemini_Generated_Image_rzi62orzi62orzi6.png 

image generated using Gemini AI

It is better to give than to receive, blessed is the one that giveth than the one that taketh, this are popular statement that is made by people all the time. People sometimes find it difficult to be on the receiving end, so they find it hard to seek help from others, even when they are in need. Some people are scared of disappointment; asking for help from others means putting all their hopes on them, and, as humans are known not to be a trustworthy species, it is usually unsafe to bank on help from another human.

Others may find it difficult to ask for help from others because they may feel big or uncomfortable doing so, as well as not wanting to feel like a burden to the next person. It usually takes a strong emotional tool for people to ask for help for many reasons, among which have been mentioned. A lot usually goes through a person's mind who has the intention of asking for help from another person. People want to be seen as strong and independent, sometimes even when it has been proven that no one can do it alone, and we are all stronger and can do even more when we let others help us.

Asking for help sometimes only shows others our vulnerability, and as a result, a lot of people will rather hold on to it than ask another person for help. When we rely on ourselves, we face many struggles, but it gives us control over everything, even the outcome of the event. By asking for help, you give the next person the power to either build you or destroy you.
Relying on another person opens you to the risk of emotional sting of rejection or disappointment, and a lot of people would rather face it hard alone, which seems safer than dealing with the emotional pain of being let down by another human. 

A person who seems to be self-reliant in everything and is looked up to by others may feel too big to ask for help so as to protect their pride. Asking for help only makes a person lose their entire self-image of being entirely self-sufficient; it forces them to admit to themselves that their own capacity may sometimes not be enough, which is usually heavy for them and a large pill of ego to swallow.

I strongly believe that every human needs the help of another human, and asking for help does not show weakness but rather the strength of the human race. It takes a strong person to ask for help from another person, and as such, I advocate for people to always ask for help when their strength is not enough for any task.

My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive-Reachout Weekly Prompt 102>>\

title.title: Television Review: Form and Void (True Detective, S1X08, 2014)
title.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/n1FWUF1WcYW9l00hVZlLyVUzQ4G.jpg)

**Form and Void (S1x08)**

Airdate: 9 March 2014

Written by: Nic Pizzolatto
Directed by: Cary Jo Fukunaga

Running Time: 54 minutes


The eighth episode of HBO's *True Detective* will leave many viewers feeling rather dissatisfied—though not, perhaps, for the reasons one might expect. The majority shall simply be displeased that it has ended at all; the next twelve months shall see them endure the pangs of withdrawal until the network releases the announced second season with its entirely new plot, characters, and cast. A smaller contingent shall grumble that the season comprised a mere eight episodes, with the unfortunate consequence that many questions raised throughout the series remain less than perfectly answered, and that the promised \

conclusion appeared somewhat rushed. And naturally, there shall be those most aggrieved that their painstakingly constructed theories—so diligently researched and eloquently argued across the Internet—have now been rendered utterly irrelevant.\n\nWriter Nic Pizzolato, however, remained faithful to his assurances that he would not gratuitously \
his work with supernatural elements or contrived \

plot twists. The first season—and the investigation pursued by our two protagonists—concludes precisely as Hollywood convention dictates: with the unmasking and elimination of a monstrous murderer, executed in the most dramatically satisfying manner possible. Pizzolato, alongside director Cary Joji Fukunaga, rather skilfully recycles the action of [the fifth episode](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-the-secret-fate-of-all-life-true-detective-s1x05-2014), which apparently was intended to resolve the case and conclude the series. Yet one protagonist—or to be precise, a single protagonist—fatally \

on that occasion, and is now compelled, alongside his companion but burdened with excess kilograms and lacking police credentials, to sit a remedial examination of sorts. Cohle and Hart are once again forced to operate as freelancers, mounting a raid upon an isolated property in the back of beyond where a depraved and violent enemy awaits, enjoying all the advantages of home turf. Unlike that similar operation in 1995, viewers are not afforded the luxury of hearing about this assault through the protagonists' retrospective narration; consequently, we are left uncertain whether either man shall escape with his life. It is precisely this uncertainty that provides the episode's greatest tension—not cheap gimmicks such as body counts, explosions, or physical altercations.\n\nThe matter that most occupied the series' devotees—the identity of the killer—was already resolved in the previous instalment, meaning the opening of episode eight, which depicts his quotidian existence, initially appears rather superfluous. Indeed, this may represent the series' weakest segment, given that the character portrayed by Glenn Fleschler seems somewhat overloaded with serial killer clichés. To many, he shall appear an almost parodic combination of Buffalo Bill from [*The Silence of the Lambs*](https://peakd.com/aaa/@drax/retro-film-review-the-silence-of-the-lambs-1991) and Norman Bates from [*Psycho*](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-psycho-1960), not to mention his daily practice of incest. At this juncture, *True Detective* perhaps does not cross the threshold into exploitative \

but it certainly positions itself uncomfortably close to it.\n\nThose most disappointed by *True Detective*, however, shall be those who—perhaps precisely because the series led its protagonists and audience into the \
—expected it to conclude in that very same stygian place. The final confrontation unfolds within the semi-mythical \

which proves as dark and terrifying a location as many had imagined, yet simultaneously appears rather banal and realistic. Pizzolato, however, declines to subject his audience to the sort of shock that [*Se7en*](https://peakd.com/aaa/@drax/retro-film-review-se7en-1995) delivered two decades prior. Some might argue he does so at the cost of the finale occasionally resembling a *deus ex machina*—though everything might have appeared rather more polished had the episode run some ten minutes longer, allowing for scenes that would clarify certain details.\n\nThis approach, conversely, permits some of the \

scenes—those allowing the cast to demonstrate their considerable talents once more—to be presented within an unusually lengthy epilogue for this genre. Within these sequences, the characters finally confront the emotional and other consequences of their actions, experiencing something approximating \

—a sort of enlightenment after which they shall view their lives and the universe in an entirely different manner. These scenes may not align in tone or philosophy with the preceding episodes, yet they feel like something the protagonists—and the viewers who patiently sat before their screens for two months—richly deserved.

RATING: 8/10 (+++)

title.title: Desayuno saludable// Waffles de plátano con avena//(Esp/Eng)
title.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000492335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tSamMQKZeUVHffSSVXAKUY9iDM2nbzRC6xPFHXdRKxN8aavuoTEaPZvcfX9zeJq1RH4.jpg)

> Hola, amigos, hoy les traigo una receta especial para comenzar el día lleno de energía y sabor; se trata de unos deliciosos waffles de avena y plátano. Les cuento que desde que probé esta receta se ha convertido en uno de mis desayunos favoritos, ya que no consumo harina de trigo ni azúcar Lo que me gusta combinar con el plátano es que le da el sabor dulzón y, junto con la avena, la hace muy nutritiva. Es sencilla de preparar y quedan con una textura suave por dentro y doradita por fuera. Se las recomiendo para un desayuno, merienda o cena. Espero que les guste. Aquí les dejo el paso a paso. > Hi, everyone! Today I’m sharing a special recipe to start your day full of energy and flavor: delicious oatmeal and banana waffles. I have to tell you that ever since I tried this recipe, it’s become one of my favorite breakfasts, since I don’t eat wheat flour or sugar. What I love about combining it with bananas is that they give it a sweet flavor, and together with the oats, it makes it very nutritious. It’s easy to make, and they turn out soft on the inside and golden brown on the outside. I recommend them for breakfast, a snack, or dinner. I hope you like them. Here’s the step-by-step guide.
![1000490746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFTybHbB8wWzDTLYVEh9e7bEWUKSQvo5zCssonDG3CBZ3rUYA8xiA1PKFqMNt2xE7Y3.jpg)
--- ![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg) ---
> - 1 plátano maduro - 2 huevos - 1 taza de avena - 1 aceite de oliva - 1 cucharadita de canela - 1 cucharadita de polvo de hornear - Sal

> - 1 ripe banana - 2 eggs - 1 cup rolled oats - 1 tablespoon olive oil - 1 teaspoon cinnamon - 1 teaspoon baking powder - Salt

![1000490710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgMdNc4fYHSfwvrTE7J5LxVR2y84M5HSGZmBtR7ECqPU914j5y49DENzeVmZ1kEnkid.jpg)
--- ![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg) ---
- Lo primero que hacemos es retirar la piel al platano, luego lo cortamos en trozos medianos y lo añadimos en un bol. > - First, peel the banana, then cut it into medium-sized pieces and place them in a bowl.
![1000490712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wqkB4ZwmGt5STNiafG7TggpAXMVreJpMzEFVYMoyyPpGWREng1CGCntzey3Lkk6yyEu.jpg)
- Ahora agregamos la avena junto con los plátanos, añadimos los huevos y la canela. > - Now add the oats along with the bananas, then add the eggs and cinnamon.
|![1000490714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvgNScTb7uotmrJe2gHJ4CC7yBp4XdZVAZZbfdJ3XY4mA5FAqEJrnU4nwYSJbWF2BWK.jpg)|![1000490717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJGPEovQz2dJLLkJPjKMqqVATaBkqcapsb2ohSj57ZPYhtALcfxZCz4QpF1vRPnnTam.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000490719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmL4urnyXvitqSLcBUh14anzX19mgb4UKLaqYYMYbKkBuWS6PVVx23CrpkQgQWciCWU.jpg)|![can1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgMWddn3qEhTEN1Y8iW8zvdT8CW6KzwKcKDji1wnHDUQun4gTDCH6h2diXwvKL7PQZ9.jpg)|
>- Ahora lo colocamos en el vaso de la licuadora, añadimos una pizca de sal y licuamos hasta formar una mezcla. > - Now place it in the blender jar, add a pinch of salt, and blend until smooth.
![1000490726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tbw4LnAeVwrvGvu2Shtpn3eeFGiS5PGnGEZy8hgZ8QQw5qc5S5qMEy85vXbkpfBKVkK.jpg)
- Luego añadimos el polvo de hornear y mezclamos. > - Then add the baking powder and mix.
![1000490728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvg5y7y7KFbtd85TWQ75jQcLqFpLQ5WoUJXfaQz78Vaj2Zrw8ETKAvsHeEfJ5a2G5nR.jpg)
- Mientras que la mezcla repose, vamos calentando la wafflera unos 5 minutos. > - While the batter is resting, preheat the waffle iron for about 5 minutes.
![1000490725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zkkekyxSkiKG9dfJjnuLj1sQHpDRu1hmNsLBxdT3uvsygWmJX2MoAyq2xsxiDo3jgbS.jpg)
- Ahora engrasamos la wafflera con aceite de oliva con una brocha para que los waffles no se peguen. > - Now brush the waffle iron with olive oil so the waffles don't stick.
![1000490731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xyR7yUKXUMcMVy96r2bY2WQZhpEYFrJoruECtFyT3hih7NY4js7K4L4YNNLEw5pPqSU.jpg)
- Luego añadimos una porción de la mezcla, aproximadamente 1/2 taza, dependiendo del tamaño de tu wafflera. > - Then add a portion of the batter—about 1/2 cup, depending on the size of your waffle maker.
|![1000490734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgKcgj5JDRYthT7SUaPoZgcMYTvQ36E6DngzQdV2ZRDWnhsiZ6mkvBJHr3JaMsLf86y.jpg)|![1000490738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x19TWBB9eGZRraM71poAgY7WYQXAa7a53CQ4qnDLSrQPqqM8X6W2VsVoVKwNYEMNDWF.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora cerramos la wafflera y dejamos que se cocine durante 4 a 6 minutos; todo depende o cuando la veas dorada. > - Now close the waffle maker and let it cook for 4 to 6 minutes; it all depends on when it looks golden brown.
|![1000490740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zkkGXkm4xiiHDeotycdCk2MzPcz5U6dKv2xF2PPpa8kjmzFQqyaYJtmiKsaGKdFRjKR.jpg)|![1000490742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xKvVREaryAFX1kbpgfRKkz4wM2JwNdXk3rkbZ3if6URrBDhiCYyRoaEUmWDmTRz1z64.jpg)| |-|-|
- Pasado el tiempo retiramos las waffles y seguimos con el mismo procedimiento hasta terminar la mezcla. Con esta cantidad se hicieron un total de 7 waffles. > - Once the time is up, remove the waffles and repeat the process until all the batter is used up. This amount made a total of 7 waffles.
|![1000490743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23y8sscCbG4ZmeJ52Gxdn4LbEHiAURiiRJFNnrg2aUppn2rQriRYkNqShNK3Ndii1J6d3.jpg)|![1000490745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u67Fr8ckor8XqkoVLUAaq1dX5TFA7u4vz55dCPzc3LifJCZwzMwW4QmjajNLr2JLZZB.jpg)| |-|-|
Estos waffles de plátano y avena los acompañé con queso mano y aguacate. Buen apetito. > I served these banana and oatmeal waffles with queso mano and avocado. Enjoy!
![1000490755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yTjRkVE142hTc3yxe7o989iEEeiD8jMjg9dBM19SFskp3zeDCYqbeDV2LEWTcE75JXc.jpg)| ![1000490759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmJB1Hzqx3yb6efy2LcFxYYQJu5FUJJ3XtFA4AYX4MBSWVWKFENtATnxyAiTNMGMa9W.jpg) ![1000490753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFYH8wT9YcZP7XYbPEA9JCwsEdLux6wuWLYqfP8WtomCugGRy6Exa2ESoKN782KsY4A.jpg) --- ![Diseño sin título (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x1axniJV5q89au6oZkLKQn5zqKQL2UH9VQRMAhFxoQy7tTZc1CDCNKKeT7px9B83tMn.jpg)

title.title: Hardcore Townsmen! #15 Trying to Recover [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
title.body:
> Hello Hive Gamers! Today I bring you the 15th part of my hardcore Townsmen run. Following up on the chaotic events of the previous days, I ended up completely losing my stone mine to that devastating fire. Now, stone has become incredibly scarce, creating a massive bottleneck that severely limits my ability to clear or build several key structures. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWnSMZ6zsBvFGUxRnrm7johZDnNChz8E2n7XQziKmK6Yz/1780889026391.jpg) Even though the fire tower was eventually completed, it was too late to save the mine. Now I find myself in a tight spot where I desperately need more wood for two main priorities: rebuilding the destroyed stone mine from scratch and keeping my coal production running. Coal remains my financial lifeline here, as it's the primary good I sell to the merchant to generate the Thalers necessary to fund the rest of my village projects. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVPXHpmyUD5cXjzLp49GddRpJWQykaVoL6wXJuvxdFSc6/1780889026485.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU76ZUoy9M7CWgoe44B8U8adXWKUhC2sHXSZk71bb1e8e/1780889026573.jpg) To add to the pressure, groups of bandits launched several attacks during this transition period. However, this time the outcome was different. Since my city guard is now slightly better equipped with the armor pieces I started producing earlier, and because I successfully increased the total number of active soldiers, they managed to repel the raiders with much greater ease. The military investment is finally paying off and giving the village some breathing room. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYXGCxYvNykE4QPY9HNdo2e3fQG5ZzMgu9u3nqzTaSeSB/1780889056421.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWPLoXrk9pwyePs7XQSyuzjAzMKWFwsTVbD2TgUiKrpB/1780889056508.jpg) With the defenses holding the line, I focused on structural recovery. I put the construction of a new lumberjack hut into motion and manually placed trees near the building to guarantee an immediate and efficient supply of wood for the worker. Additionally, I finally ordered the complete reconstruction of the destroyed stone mine. It is a slow process, but bit by bit, I am pulling the settlement out of this resource crisis to continue improving the village infrastructure. # |

> ¡Hola Gamers de Hive! Hoy les traigo la 15va parte de mi partida hardcore de Townsmen. title.title: Trust brings more emotions to people.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/6540658/pexels-photo-6540658.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-photo-of-baby-s-hand-on-parent-s-hands-6540658/ ) Trust is a very important and very personal thing in our life. Whom we trust and who we do not trust depends entirely on ourselves. However, we often make many mistakes in trusting some people. Many people come in our life whom we trust and get cheated, that is, we trust them too much even though they are not worthy of our trust. We should understand that trust is our own thing, so we cannot do it to anyone. Because it is very difficult for us to trust depending on the environment around us at present. We should be very careful in trusting any object or person. If we trust the wrong person, then in some cases, trusting will be the biggest mistake of our life and we will have to bear the cost of that mistake for the rest of our life. Just as trust is an emotion, we also have another emotion in us which is doubt. And this doubt should be done before believing anything. Just as excessive trust is not good, excessive trust is never good. We need to have faith in those we trust that they can let us in at any time. That is, we must maintain a little doubt even in our faith. If we do not have blind faith and it can be any person around us or our family or our very dear person, we must have a little doubt behind our faith in them. Because if we trust too much, even our closest people do not hesitate to deceive us. When we trust a person too much, that is, we trust them blindly, then that person also thinks that since we trust them blindly, we will never doubt them and we will not understand that they are betraying us. And because of this thinking, the people close to us will constantly destroy our faith behind our trust, so before trusting every person, we should always have a little doubt whether that person is worthy of our trust or not, and even when they are worthy of our trust and we start trusting them, we must maintain a limit of trust, never blindly trust anyone. Sometimes if our loved one breaks our trust, our mind gets hurt the most and that hurt can become so intense that our mental balance can get bad and we can lose the enthusiasm to live beautifully in life and can ruin our life. Therefore, we should always keep our emotions under our control and maintain ourselves in such a way that no one else can control us. We need to keep our mind, mentality, love, emotions, everything under our own control. Just as we need to keep our other emotions under our control, we also need to keep our trust under our control. Trust is something that once broken, it does not want to be fixed again, just like a glass vessel or a glass mirror. Therefore, just as we will trust to a certain extent, we should also do such things so that the trust of our loved ones is never broken by any bad action of ours. We should never do anything that causes our loved ones pain and makes them lose faith in us. We should never trust anyone too easily, just as we should not trust ourselves, so too should our loved ones be made aware that we should not trust anyone too easily without verifying. Because different people are attacking us all around us to cheat us in different ways, and the most common betrayal is financial. Therefore, we can get betrayal from different people in all aspects, whether it is financial, mental or physical, so we always need to be aware. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)
