title.title: When Trump's Crypto Project Froze Your Tokens: The HTX vs WLFI Standoff Nobody Saw Coming
title.body:
![panisanpb](https://hivepostify.cloud/uploads/posts/8f05991503e52b7de882d82d299882f3.webp)



A UK sanctions designation, a hidden smart contract backdoor, and regular investors caught in the crossfire; here's everything that happened and why it matters for every crypto holder.

---

Imagine waking up one morning, opening your exchange app, and seeing your tokens tokens you legally bought and paid for suddenly frozen. No warning. No email. No explanation. Just a void where your assets used to be.

That's what happened to an unknown number of regular users on the HTX exchange on June 5, 2026. The entity that froze their assets? World Liberty Financial the Trump family-backed DeFi project that promoted itself as a pathway to financial freedom.

This story involves geopolitics, a $1.5 billion sanctions allegation, a hidden smart contract function, Justin Sun, and a question the crypto industry has avoided for years.

---

## Start here: what actually happened

On May 26, 2026, the UK government sanctioned Huobi Global S.A. a Panama-registered entity directly tied to the HTX exchange under its Russia sanctions regulations. The allegation was serious: UK authorities claimed this entity helped facilitate over $1.5 billion in financial flows aimed at evading Russia-related international sanctions.

HTX formerly known as Huobi, one of the oldest and largest crypto exchanges worldwide found itself under scrutiny from one of the strictest financial regulatory regimes.

Here's where it gets complicated. World Liberty Financial, which issues the WLFI governance token and the USD1 stablecoin, decided it needed to act. Its team identified HTX-linked on-chain addresses and did something most token holders didn’t even know was possible: it activated a freeze function embedded in the WLFI smart contract, locking tokens in those addresses.

| Key Detail | What Happened |
|---|---|
| UK sanctions date | May 26, 2026 |
| Entity sanctioned | Huobi Global S.A. (Panama) |
| Alleged flows | $1.5 billion+ for Russia sanctions evasion |
| HTX trading suspension | June 5, 2026 at 13:00 UTC |
| Trading pairs affected | WLFI/USDT, USD1/USDT, BTC/USD1, ETH/USD1 |
| USD1 fate | Auto-converted to USDT at 1:1 ratio |
| WLFI tokens | Frozen on-chain not lost, not gone |

---

## The part WLFI did not advertise

Every blockchain project loves to talk about decentralization and user ownership. WLFI was no different in its marketing. But hidden within the WLFI token's smart contract is an admin-controlled blacklist and freeze function a feature that allows the project team to lock any wallet address at any time without notice.

Most retail investors who bought WLFI had no idea this capability existed.

HTX responded quickly and with public outrage. The exchange pointed out something often overlooked in regulatory discussions: the frozen addresses do not belong to HTX. They are not the exchange's treasury. They belong to ordinary retail investors who bought WLFI tokens on the open market and had no involvement with Russia, sanctions evasion, or geopolitical disputes.

\

said an HTX spokesperson.

HTX asked the tough question in their public statement: do users actually own their assets, or can any project revoke access whenever it suits them?

---

## How this escalated: a timeline

**September 2025**   The first use of the freeze function. WLFI blacklists Tron founder Justin Sun's personal wallet after he moves roughly $9 million in WLFI tokens to addresses, including ones on HTX. Sun later files a lawsuit, claiming the WLFI smart contract contains a hidden backdoor that allows the team to freeze investor funds without notice or consent.

**May 26, 2026**   The UK government designates Huobi Global S.A. under Russia sanctions regulations, alleging $1.5 billion in evasion flows. This entity is directly linked to HTX.

**Early June 2026**   The WLFI team activates the freeze mechanism on HTX-linked on-chain addresses. No prior communication is given to HTX or to any of the affected users.

**June 5, 2026**   HTX suspends all WLFI and USD1 trading pairs effective 13:00 UTC. USD1 balances are automatically converted to USDT and returned to user accounts. WLFI withdrawals are halted pending resolution.

**June 6, 2026**   HTX issues a full public statement demanding WLFI lift the freeze. An open standoff begins with no resolution timeline from either side.

---

## The Justin Sun angle   this is not the first time

If you’re wondering whether WLFI has done this before, the answer is yes and the previous victim was one of the most influential figures in the crypto industry.

When Justin Sun moved his WLFI tokens in September 2025, the project team blacklisted his wallet without warning. Sun filed a lawsuit soon after, making a specific, damaging claim: that the WLFI smart contract has a hidden backdoor that was never properly disclosed to investors who bought the token.

That lawsuit remains unresolved. Now the same mechanism has been used a second time against regular users who had no idea they were exposed to this kind of unilateral action from a project they trusted with their money.

---

## What this means for anyone holding DeFi tokens

Let’s be clear about the implications, because they extend beyond HTX and WLFI.

If you hold any token issued by a centralized or semi-centralized project and most DeFi tokens qualify you need to ask one simple question before you invest: does this contract have an admin freeze function?

If it does, and the issuer decides your address is associated with something they disapprove of, your tokens can be locked without any due process, no warning, and no recourse. The blockchain record will confirm your tokens exist. You just won’t be able to access them.

Three questions every WLFI holder should ask now:

Is my wallet address connected to any HTX-linked address, even indirectly through transaction history?

Was the freeze function clearly disclosed when I purchased WLFI, or was it hidden in technical documents that normal investors wouldn't read?

If the project can freeze tokens for compliance reasons, who makes that decision and is there any process for appealing it?

HTX has assured users that the tokens are not lost. They remain on-chain and verifiable. The expectation is withdrawals will resume once the freeze is lifted. But there’s no timeline for when that will happen, and no guarantee.

---

## The deeper problem this exposes

This incident highlights a clash between two worlds that were bound to collide.

On one side is the original promise of blockchain: permissionless, censorship-resistant, user-owned assets. On the other side is the reality of operating in a world governed by nation-state sanctions, AML regulations, and governmental pressure on every point in the financial system.

WLFI chose compliance over user protection. Whether that was legally required or just the easiest choice is unclear. The UK sanctions didn’t name individual token holders. They didn’t specify the tokens themselves. The freeze was a discretionary decision made by the WLFI team done without notice, without transparency, and without any way for affected users to challenge it.

HTX's public statement made it clear: \

This isn’t just exchange politics. It’s a warning to everyone holding a DeFi token on any centralized platform globally.

---

## What to watch going forward

Several key points are worth monitoring as this situation continues.

Whether WLFI provides any clear public information about which addresses were frozen, why, and what the unfreezing process looks like. So far, communication from them has been very limited.

The Justin Sun lawsuit carries more weight now that the freeze function has been used again. If a court finds that the mechanism was not adequately disclosed to investors, World Liberty Financial could face significant legal exposure.

Regulators in both the US and the EU, who are closely watching the DeFi space, will likely reference this case when formulating future rules regarding token issuer responsibilities, smart contract disclosure standards, and investor rights in decentralized finance.

---

If you hold WLFI tokens on HTX or anywhere else your tokens are not lost, but they are not fully yours either.

And that difference, it turns out, is very important.

---

If this breakdown highlighted something that mainstream coverage missed, feel free to share it. The smart contract aspect is the real story here and many outlets overlooked it.

title.body:
|ENG ESP|

_________

No es la cantidad de detalle, es lo mucho que te hace sentir con tan poco 

It's not the amount of detail, it's how much it makes you feel with so little.

**___________________________________________________**

🇺🇸- ⬇️⬇️

Hello community ✌🏻🖤 First and foremost, I want to thank everyone who has supported me and liked my art. I was thinking of quitting before, and I know this is already a community that supports people like me, but I never imagined I'd receive more than I expected. Even though a vote is worthless, just a simple like, it's very valuable to me. I still have a long way to go to interact and connect with you all, so please be patient 😅 but little by little, and again, thank you so much ✨🖤 


These past few days I've been visiting a relative (excuse the photos 😅😅), but I still decided to do a drawing. Yep, back to the sketchbook pages 😫 But this time I wanted to focus on just one area, as the description says. The important thing is what it conveys, what it makes you feel from your perspective, and that question is really beautiful, which is why I like to include a title and a description. Reinterpretation, because a design, a drawing, a shape, etc., is different for each person, and that's why, through art and a few words, I want to share my perspectives. I hope you like it, and please excuse the long text 🖤✌🏻

______

🇪🇸- ⬇️⬇️

hola comunidad ✌🏻🖤

principalmente, quisiera agradecerles a todos y todas las personas que me han apoyado y les ha gustado mi arte ya que antes pensaba en retirarme, se que de por si ya es una comunidad para a poyar a todas las personas como yo, pero nunca crei poder recibir mas de lo que esperaba, aun que un voto no valga nada se convierte en un simple like pero para mi es muy valioso, aún me falta mucho para interactuar y conectar con ustedes, tenganme paciencia 😅 pero poco a poco, y nuevamente muchas gracias ✨🖤


en estos dias he estado de visita, donde un familiar (me disculpan las fotos 😅😅) pero aun así decidí hacer un dibujo, sip volvemos a las hojas de cuaderno 😫

pero esta ves quise centrame solo en una zona y dice la descripción, lo importante es que trasmite, desde tu perspectiva que te hace sentir, y ese cuestionamiento es muy lindo, por eso me gusta poner un título y una descripción de reinterpretación, por que un diseño, un dibujo, una forma etc para cada persona es distinta, y por eso mediante el arte y unas \

mostrarles mis perspectivas.

espero les guste y me disculpan mucho texto 🖤✌🏻

title.title: Prioriza tu paz, tu energía y tu salud mental. [Esp-Eng] ❤️
title.body:
>

<center>
![InShot_20260607_230834909.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbSi6CwL2ZLPwhD6po8EztoicKT637A5hZjrYsjpUtVFm/InShot_20260607_230834909.jpg)
</center>

¿Te ha pasado que has salido de tu casa con la mejor de las energías y la mejor de las actitudes y al llegar a algún sitio sientes que toda tu energía cambió?

¿Te ha pasado que te sientes muy bien, con mucha paz y al hablar con una persona casi de manera automática tu humor cambió? 

Creo que todos hemos tenido esa desagradable experiencia, pues hay personas con una energía tan tóxica que todo a su alrededor se contamina, tanto que hasta el ambiente, el espacio, el lugar donde están se convierte indeseable.

<div class=\

> ![InShot_20260607_231025675.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdFo7ZuRYUFXf45CUBADLRVuovr8gKmatcZfE3UTWKFx/InShot_20260607_231025675.jpg) Lo mejor que podemos hacer en esos casos es proteger nuestra paz y nuestra energía, a veces alejarnos es la mejor manera de continuar y de honrar lo que sentimos por esa persona y por su entorno, no podemos estar cerca de una persona con tanta carga negativa, porque al final esa relación se va a dañar, los sentimientos que nos unen se van a torcer y nosotros vamos a salir perjudicados. Sé que es difícil alejarse de una persona que queremos o que el vínculo es superior, pero proteger nuestra salud mental siempre debe ser nuestra prioridad, alejarse debe ser una decisión consciente y sin culpas, no es egoísmo, no es abandono es salud mental. Inclusive tomar distancia de una persona narcisista con energía tóxica y contaminante, es una manera de no fracturar más la relación, pues su personalidad, sus conversaciones y su energía al hacerte daño te van creando una capa, donde sin querer tus sentimientos se van fracturando, te vas resintiendo... Claro hay relaciones dónde tomar distancia es más difícil en el caso de un familiar cercano o un jefe, en este caso establecer límites, medir el tiempo de convivencia o la cercanía que demos es fundamental. No podemos transitar el camino de la vida contaminándonos y permitiendo que nos roben la paz, porque si una persona decidió vivir en caos ese es su problema, no podemos salvar a quién no quiere ser salvado y no podemos permitir que nos marchiten, ni nos apaguen el brillo. Porque nuestra luz, nuestra energía y nuestra paz es el resultado de las decisiones que hemos ido tomando en el transitar de la vida, un solo error, una sola relación dañina, intentar salvar a una sola persona puede ser un error gigante, puede ser abrir la puerta al caos y la autodestrucción de tu vida... Ni tú, ni yo tenemos la responsabilidad de \
a otro, cada quien debe ser responsable de sus decisiones y de sus actos, en la vida cada uno de nosotros \

> ![InShot_20260607_231148839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUoJvF5cRcTCrdoHgEnv5rMJZaezDdcgZN3h9MWrJRo5W/InShot_20260607_231148839.jpg) Sé que es un camino difícil, sé que ante la sociedad o tu entorno puedes parecer frío, malvado... Pero debemos aprender a establecer límites saludables y entender que con el tiempo manejar la situación va a ser más sencillo y natural, incluso la persona narcisista va a entender que su veneno no causa daño en ti y eso lo va a alejar, porque una persona así necesita robar energía y si tú no le enciendes esa \

no le serás útil.

Recuerda no cometer errores innecesarios, aléjate de quien pueda dañarte, establece límites con quién te puede apagar, tú prioridad es tu luz, tu paz y tú salud mental.



______

### <center>❤️❤️❤️❤️English Version.❤️❤️❤️❤️</center>

_______

<center>
![InShot_20260607_230903501.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXttRn4htdjL58vdgCXouw9CyQ6UgqNdCTXxWBh7qWBdU/InShot_20260607_230903501.jpg)
</center>

Have you ever left home full of energy and with the best attitude, only to arrive somewhere and feel like your energy has completely shifted?

Have you ever felt great, at peace, only to have your mood change almost automatically after speaking with someone?

I think we've all had that unpleasant experience. Some people have such toxic energy that everything around them becomes contaminated, so much so that even the atmosphere, the space, the place they're in becomes unwelcome.


<div class=\

> ![InShot_20260607_231025675.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdFo7ZuRYUFXf45CUBADLRVuovr8gKmatcZfE3UTWKFx/InShot_20260607_231025675.jpg) The best thing we can do in these situations is protect our peace and energy. Sometimes, distancing ourselves is the best way to move forward and honor what we feel for that person and their environment. We can't be close to someone with so much negativity, because ultimately, the relationship will be damaged, the feelings that bind us will become distorted, and we will be the ones who suffer. I know it's difficult to distance ourselves from someone we love or with whom we have a strong bond, but protecting our mental health should always be our priority. Distancing ourselves should be a conscious decision, free of guilt. It's not selfishness, it's not abandonment, it's mental health. Even distancing yourself from a narcissistic person with toxic and polluting energy is a way to avoid further damaging the relationship, because their personality, their conversations, and their energy, by hurting you, create a layer where, without realizing it, your feelings are fractured, and you become resentful... Of course, there are relationships where distancing yourself is more difficult, such as with a close family member or a boss; in this case, setting boundaries and measuring the amount of time spent together or the closeness we show is fundamental. We cannot journey through life contaminating ourselves and allowing others to steal our peace. If someone chooses to live in chaos, that's their problem. We cannot save those who don't want to be saved, and we cannot allow them to wither us or extinguish our light. Because our light, our energy, and our peace are the result of the decisions we've made along life's journey. A single mistake, a single harmful relationship, trying to save just one person can be a colossal error, can open the door to chaos and self-destruction. Neither you nor I have the responsibility to \
another. Each person must be responsible for their own decisions and actions. In life, each of us carries our own baggage.\n\n<div class=\

> ![InShot_20260607_231148839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUoJvF5cRcTCrdoHgEnv5rMJZaezDdcgZN3h9MWrJRo5W/InShot_20260607_231148839.jpg) I know it's a difficult path. I know that to society or those around you, you might seem cold, even cruel... But we must learn to set healthy boundaries and understand that with time, managing the situation will become easier and more natural. Even the narcissistic person will understand that their poison doesn't harm you, and that will drive them away. Because a person like that needs to drain energy, and if you don't ignite that \

you won't be of any use to them. Remember not to make unnecessary mistakes. Stay away from anyone who can hurt you. Set boundaries with those who can dim your light. Your priority is your own light, your peace, and your mental health. _____ # ![1746651717170760710626541328692.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetewFXFfpLPkHUT3bqXyuaa5BHUDoDt3Lm8aFTakkWSf/1746651717170760710626541328692.png) * Portada creada en Inshot con fotografía personal. * Demás imágenes utilizadas son de mi galería personal. title.title: 朋友們搶演唱會門票
title.body: >Unsplash 昨天聽到朋友討論搶演唱會門票的事，由於這兩個朋友都是第一次搶韓國的演唱會票，所以擬定了很多策略考量，包括場次時間啊，還有該場次的交通方便程度，還有選位的區域等等。 我聽了覺得過程蠻有趣，但也覺得好麻煩啊，看個演唱會要考慮那麼多，心中浮現了一種怕怕的感受，我也不知道為什麼😂，我也沒要去，但總覺得那種煩躁、擔心的感受繚繞載我心頭。 我只看過一場演唱會，是學生時代所迷的樂團叫做簡單計劃，那時候好朋友有組樂團，曾經去看過他們表演過這個樂團的歌曲喜歡上的，所以接下來幾年都在聽類似的歌曲，聽到樂團要來台灣的時候，就跟朋友商量去演唱會。 那次印象深刻，但也覺得很累人啊，我又很怕臨時想上廁所之類的，因為我有腸躁症，有時候感覺來了，就是刻不容緩的狀況😓，沒去過演唱會就會擔心很多，不過那次沒什麼狀況發生，甚至連找廁所都不曾過。 後來就沒什麼契機去演唱會，要是沒有熟悉的同好，說走就走的決心，就沒什麼動力去看演唱會，後來也沒在跟流行的歌曲，自然都不感興趣，有時候很佩服那種追星追到每場演唱會都追的，行動力跟意志力都十分堅強，甚至有的在過程中培養出技能，我有認識兩三個這樣的人，以前在追星的時候可能不被傳統觀念看好，但後來出社會後的工作表現，很大程度受益於追星過程學到的東西。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/4sd5ia)

Length of Earth's Orbit around the Sun is 299 million km wide 

In this video, I use Kepler's third law to calculate the length of Earth's elliptical orbit to be around 299,000,000 km wide and takes about 365.25 days to complete 1 full revolution. The equation for Kepler's 3rd law shows that the square of the period of revolution is proportional to the cube of the length of the semi-major axis (half the major axis) of the ellipse. The proportionality constant only depends on the mass of the Sun and the gravitational constant. Thus, we can calculate the major axis of any planet just by knowing how long it takes to revolve around the Sun!

#math #vectors #calculus #ellipse #keplerslaws

title.title: Shredded chicken (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Today I made shredded chicken with onions, bell peppers, and carrots. I love the combination of these ingredients; it had been a while since I’d made chicken this way, and it turned out really delicious.I served it with Dedalitos pasta. Just a sprinkle of cheese turned it into a complete and nutritious lunch.
![1000119725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z7Bhzv28xa9v7LNhRXxQothEawwpkP8KXVvLe9PtCvFe7Rv5YDd9EjbtKWUBg5L5k1V.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 1/2 chicken breast - 3 onions - 5 sweet peppers - 1 carrot - Pinch of salt - 4 cups of water - Oil
![1000119714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xyVE9FX2vcWjXELehxX9MUXrB1YRJvNzazPV9tHW6z3DcwugKucvsikBBhp3Qij8aGH.jpg)
## Preparation: I poured 4 cups of water into a pot, added the 1/2 chicken breast and a tablespoon of salt to parboil it. It was tender in twenty minutes. I let it cool, removed it from the water, and shredded the chicken with a fork. Then I set it aside.
![1000119717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehVEhbDoBM7VH1XidmLbdGLEuq6NiMZrtvMmgjMduejaub7axAgJTZow3dvN7toZzR.jpg)
![1000119720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uFVvNeiZaJUpaLryFB2P7qZ5oVDHHMenJRdXZBsgSBMH7Ni3rXudEw7TGseXtF5ZraS.jpg)
I washed the herbs and the carrot, removed the seeds from the chili peppers and the skins from the onions and carrot. I cut them into medium-sized pieces. I put all of this in a skillet with a little oil, sautéed it for five minutes, then added the shredded chicken breast.
![1000119723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23t7iz9kELGAXLbm5rE6BsFA6paEdRhqrBj7TSQzuYEepU33D377GGxs9M14wcMsBLXfx.jpg)
I stirred it well and added half a cup of chicken broth (using the same water I’d blanched the chicken in). I covered it and let it cook for another ten minutes. The chicken turned out delicious; the combination worked perfectly and achieved a balance of flavors. I served it with short pasta that I prepared very quickly using my usual recipe. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy preparé pollo desmenuzado con cebolla, ajíes y zanahoria, me agrada la combinación de estos ingredientes, tenía tiempo que no preparaba pollo de esta manera y realmente quedó muy bueno. Acompañé con pasta corta en forma de Dedalitos. Solo con rociar un poco de queso se volvió un almuerzo completo y nutritivo.
![1000119725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z7Bhzv28xa9v7LNhRXxQothEawwpkP8KXVvLe9PtCvFe7Rv5YDd9EjbtKWUBg5L5k1V.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 1/2 pechuga de pollo - 3 cebollas - 5 ajíes dulces - 1 zanahoria - Pizca de sal - 4 tazas de agua - Aceite
![1000119714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xyVE9FX2vcWjXELehxX9MUXrB1YRJvNzazPV9tHW6z3DcwugKucvsikBBhp3Qij8aGH.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué en una olla 4 tazas de agua, agregué la 1/2 pechuga de pollo y una cucharada de sal para sancochar. Estuvo blanda en veinte minutos. Esperé que enfriara, la saqué del agua y con la ayuda de un tenedor desmenucé el pollo. Entonces reservé.
![1000119717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehVEhbDoBM7VH1XidmLbdGLEuq6NiMZrtvMmgjMduejaub7axAgJTZow3dvN7toZzR.jpg)
![1000119720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uFVvNeiZaJUpaLryFB2P7qZ5oVDHHMenJRdXZBsgSBMH7Ni3rXudEw7TGseXtF5ZraS.jpg)
Lavé los aliños y la zanahoria, quité las semillas de los ajíes y las conchas de las cebollas y zanahoria. Dividí en pedazos medianos. Llevé todo esto a un sartén con un poco de aceite, los sofreí por cinco minutos, luego agregué la pechuga desmenuzada.
![1000119723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23t7iz9kELGAXLbm5rE6BsFA6paEdRhqrBj7TSQzuYEepU33D377GGxs9M14wcMsBLXfx.jpg)
Mezclé muy bien para agregar media taza de caldo de pollo (aprovechando la misma agua donde se sancochó). Tapé y dejé cocinar por diez minutos más. El pollo quedó delicioso, la combinación funcionó perfectamente y logró un equilibrio de sabores. Acompañé con pasta corta que preparé de forma muy rápida con la receta de costumbre. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: International Day of Slayer! - My Actifit Report Card: June 6 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fd705740-7dee-4fa2-9954-4632ced94a05.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Let's start with the obvious, the cover photo is AI generated (Copilot). This was the original photo I fed to Copilot. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cf21b49f-7604-442b-8ee0-6cc68258c1b5.jpg) I don't often use AI generated photos, almost never actually, but I thought it was a good idea to blend our routine activities with the other event of the day: International Day of Slayer! I've been listening to Slayer since my teens years (I won't say exactly when it was, but let's just say it was a long time ago...), and yet I had never heard of this *holiday* until a few days ago while randomly surfing the web. The idea is pretty simple, just blast out Slayer music as much as you can, as loud as you can, anywhere and everywhere! I couldn't find any local *Slay outs*, so we just had to do our own, listening to Slayer all day long, even during our routine activities. I am not sure Le Chat is exactly a fan but she didn't complain. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a6589aaf-78dc-40a1-b463-9f8153bcbeac.jpg) She did show off how flexible she is while grooming herself. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bf81715c-c21f-4662-9da8-d8f6be2931ff.jpg) Of course, with the sunny weather, although a bit too warm for us, we tried to spend good time outside, including our daily walk to the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8457972d-770f-4acd-8c9d-267fcce3963d.jpg) Seeing all these spotty and brown leaves, I was worried the heat was already burning them, but I just checked, it's the normal life cycle of these plants called Mayapples. They start early spring, then go dormant when the tree canopy gets thicker and apparently will disappear soon until next Spring. Cool! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/30c5038b-e370-4fbb-8d67-335ea18e2ade.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/30099561-ce0d-4302-968c-66a10591ae9a.jpg) The rest of the forest is very green and hopefully it will stay this way for a few months. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/534c9804-71bd-4337-b911-d1292b6c4174.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e4e7b5c7-0a29-47f1-818f-38b9d1bfd38b.jpg) Kaia and Le Chat reunited when we got out of the forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5c96a1f1-cc4d-4faf-968b-982fc0632f67.jpg) And Le Chat stayed behind for a while, eating grass. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/efe21986-3328-4f68-bdd3-fd9ecb31a1b6.jpg) In the meantime, we went for a short loop in the neighborhood. Beautiful sun and reflections! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bb9e8aa2-a0be-4da4-a09d-2adc69e6f064.jpg) I kept plenty of time for a run. For the first run in summer heat this year, I wanted to keep it short, just about 5km. And guess what I was listening in my earbuds, of course Slayer! Gotta be careful though, it's though not to run way to fast when South of Heaven or Rain in Blood starts! The run wasn't too bad, since I waited as late as possible, it was 'only' around 83F (28C) but still quite humid. It will take time to get my body used to this weather while running, which is why I wanted to keep it short. And we finished the day with more Slayer of course, this time live shows on YouTube. By the way, it's a shame none of the main streaming platforms have Slayer videos included with their subscriptions. Anyways, that old show when they finish with Raining Blood song while actual blood (well fake I hope) rain on the stage, so good! Taking part in the International Day of Slayer was fun! As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

title.title: Argentina - An afternoon with friends at the Colón Hot Springs: the perfect plan to escape the routine. / Tarde con amigas en las Termas de Colón: el plan perfecto para escapar de la rutina.😃❤️
title.body:
> Sometimes, what you need in life is a little trip with friends to reset from the rush of everyday routine. Now that all of my friends and I have steady jobs, our schedules can be complicated, but we never miss the chance to go on a small getaway. We don’t need to travel far to have a good time because we enjoy ourselves wherever we are, but if we can make it to a great destination, even better. That’s why we chose the city of Colón in Entre Ríos province for a long weekend escape, and the hot springs became our favorite place to relax and unwind 😃.
A veces lo que se necesita en la vida es un pequeño viaje con amigas para reiniciarse de la apurada rutina. Ahora que todas mis amigas y yo tenemos nuestros trabajos fijos, tenemos horarios complicados, pero nunca perdemos la oportunidad de ir a hacer un pequeño paseo. No nos hace falta ir tan lejos para tener un buen momento, ya que nosotras la pasamos bien en cualquier lugar, pero si podemos llegar a un lugar genial, mejor. Fue por eso que elegimos la ciudad de Colón en la provincia de Entre Ríos para ir a hacer una escapada de fin de semana largo, y las termas fue nuestro lugar predilecto de descanso 😃.
--- ---

> --- --- The city of Colón is located about 360 kilometers from my home, so getting there by bus took us around five hours. What I like about this place is that it’s small and peaceful, situated on the banks of the Uruguay River. I had already visited the city before, but my friends hadn’t, so it became the destination we chose to celebrate one of their birthdays. While there are several things to do there, the main attraction is its large thermal park.
La ciudad de Colón se encuentra a unos 360 km de casa, por lo que llegar ahí en micro nos tomó unas 5 horas. Lo que me gusta de este lugar es que es pequeño y tranquilo, ubicado a orillas del río Uruguay. Yo ya conocía esta ciudad, pero mis amigas no, así que fue el destino que elegimos para ir a festejar el cumpleaños de una de ellas. Si bien hay varias cosas para hacer en este lugar, el atractivo principal es su gran parque termal.
---

> --- My friends and I rented an apartment right across from the park, so it took us less than two minutes to get there. The three-day holiday weekend in October was forecast to have great weather, and Sunday was the day we chose to visit. One of the best things about this thermal park is that visitors are allowed to bring their own food and drinks, making it perfect for spending the entire day having a picnic. Admission cost us around $10, which gave us access to all of the pools and walking trails throughout the park.
Mis amigas y yo alquilamos un departamento justo frente al parque, por lo que llegar hasta él nos tomaba menos de 2 minutos. El fin de semana largo de tres días en octubre tenía pronosticado un buen clima, siendo el domingo el día elegido para ir. Lo bueno de este parque es que te dejan entrar con comida y bebida, perfecto para ir a pasar todo el día haciendo picnic. La entrada nos costó unos $10 con los que podías acceder a todas las piletas y senderos para recorrer el parque.
---

features both cold and hot water pools, allowing visitors to create their own circuit according to their preferences. It is generally recommended to start with the colder pools and gradually move to warmer temperatures. The coldest pool includes water slides that can be enjoyed by both children and adults, adding a bit of excitement and adrenaline to the experience.\n\n<blockquote>El parque, normalmente llamado \

, cuenta con piletas de agua fría y caliente, en las que se puede ir haciendo un circuito de acuerdo a tu gusto. Lo recomendable es empezar por las de agua fría e ir aumentando la temperatura cada vez. La pileta con agua más fría cuenta con toboganes que pueden usar niños y adultos, agregando un poco de adrenalina a la estadía. ---

> --- But if you prefer a peaceful experience from beginning to end, there are quieter pools where children are not allowed. Throughout the park, there are around eight pools to enjoy, some featuring hydrotherapy jets and even lounge chairs where visitors can sit back and relax. The outdoor pools also hosted aquagym classes, which, with their upbeat atmosphere and music, helped make the afternoon even more enjoyable. The park truly offers something for every taste and preference.
Pero si deseas que tu estancia sea tranquila de principio a fin, hay piletas más relajadas en donde incluso no se permiten niños. En todo el parque hay unas 8 piletas que pueden disfrutarse, algunas con chorros de agua de hidromasajes y hasta reposeras para sentarse a descansar. En las piletas del exterior también habían clases de aquagym, que con buena onda y música lograban alegrar la tarde. El parque ofrece experiencias para todos los gustos.
---

> --- My friends and I spent the day doing a little bit of everything, but without a doubt, our favorite pool was the outdoor one with warm water. Since the day was quite hot, it was the perfect choice—not too cold and not too warm. We also brought our own picnic with leftovers from the previous night's meal, and we stayed until the park was almost closing. It was an amazing afternoon that gave us the chance to disconnect from our daily routines and simply enjoy the moment.
Mis amigas y yo pasamos el día haciendo un poco de cada cosa, pero sin dudas nuestra pileta preferida fue la del agua templada al aire libre. Como el día estaba caluroso, esta pileta era la adecuada para no pasar frío ni calor. También llevamos nuestro propio picnic con la comida que nos habría sobrado de la noche anterior, y nos quedamos hasta que casi cerró el parque. Fue una tarde increíble, que sirvió para desconectarnos de nuestra rutina diaria.
---

> --- I really enjoyed visiting the Colón Hot Springs again after several years and creating new happy memories with my friends. Choosing this destination in the province of Entre Ríos for a long weekend getaway turned out to be a great decision, as we were able to reach a beautiful place without traveling too far. I would definitely recommend this park to anyone looking to relax and spend an enjoyable afternoon doing something different. My friend was very happy with her birthday celebration, and seeing her enjoy it so much filled all of us with satisfaction 💕.
Me gustó mucho haber visitado las Termas de Colón después de unos cuantos años y tener nuevos buenos recuerdos con mis amigas. Elegir este destino de la ciudad de Entre Ríos para pasar un fin de semana largo fue una muy buena opción, porque pudimos llegar rápido a un lugar hermoso. Recomiendo este parque como opción para relajarse y pasar una buena tarde haciendo algo diferente. Mi amiga estuvo muy feliz por el festejo de su cumpleaños, y eso nos llenó de satisfacción a todas 💕.
--- ---

❤️ Hope you liked this post! Thanks for reading. ❤️

❤️¡Espero que les haya gustado este post! Gracias por leer. ❤️

title.title: Length of Earth's Orbit around the Sun is 299 million km wide
title.body:
![4-length-of-earth-s-orbit-6e52d10a00d4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/mes/lkt-mq4mz6nq-zpyeplma/4-length-of-earth-s-orbit-6e52d10a00d4.webp)

In this video, I use Kepler's third law to calculate the length of Earth's elliptical orbit to be around 299,000,000 km wide and takes about 365.25 days to complete 1 full revolution. The equation for Kepler's 3rd law shows that the square of the period of revolution is proportional to the cube of the length of the semi-major axis (half the major axis) of the ellipse. The proportionality constant only depends on the mass of the Sun and the gravitational constant. Thus, we can calculate the major axis of any planet just by knowing how long it takes to revolve around the Sun!

title.title: Challenge #04908-M159: Deserved Reward
title.body:
![gala-iv-ub1LfMKkdF0-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23tSf7xh4JNYJnJvmeFFQBoyuBhSVPxGXZqEQjMTYJtyjtmGPFVJDK6CpJj94VMkLsrZv.jpg)

> An all-service spa offers Wraithvine and hir friends the works. Hair Washes, trims, scale-grooming, hoof-polishing, the works. The price? One copper per being. Why so low? It was all about helping people have a good day and be comfortable. Though, people who were rude and entitled WERE charged an \

. -- Anon Guest

[AN: I should be keeping track and I have been a naughty bean about doing that. So. The stories this relates to in order: [Strictly by Chance](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04902-m153-strictly-by-chance), [Impact of Concerns](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04906-m157-the-impact-of-concerns), and [Essential Learning](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04907-m158-essential-learning) ]

The place looked like a castle, but its chimneys were active despite the late hour. Bibrid sniffed and said, \
Wraithvine squinted at the distant signage, \
muttered Bibrid. One guarding hand found the top of Chance's head. Indicating exactly who the bathhouse-inn might have an issue with.\n\n\
Ze held hir hands as if offering help, showing the sign ze saw. The sign of Two Kind Hands. This bathhouse was apparently a temple to Wraithvine... or hir efforts in the world.\n\n\
Bibrid grumbled. Clinging to Chance as strongly as the little Hellkin clung to him.\n\n\

\n\nThe _greeter_ was a Hellkin and, because of the scales patterning their mauve cheekbones, part Dragon. The instant they saw Chance, they rumbled something in Voulspeak. They switched back to the Trader Tongue. \

There was every kind of comfort anyone could ask for, including horizontal companionship if it was politely requested. Not that either of the adults would be requesting any. They were still on guard for the catch.

Of _course_ the children went straight for the therapeutic mud pits. Though Chance once again had trouble with the 'disrobing' part of 'bath' as a concept. This time, it was Wraithvine's turn to teach the child how the system worked.

\

and followed suit. More because they were eager to play in the mud rather than confident that their clothes would still be there.

The mud was warm, fragrant, and fluid. Of course, it was messy, because children _adored_ splashing in it. The bathhouse was prepared, since the mud was charmed to slither back to the pit from whence it came. Which, of course, amused the children more.

A different Hellkin staffer tended to Chance's horns, and the skin around where they emerged. Soon having the child in purring delight. \

As long as they could play with the mud and help themselves to the abundant snacks, Chance was a happy little Hellkin. They didn't even notice the hasp on their hooves, carefully abrading too much growth down to a more sensible length.

It wasn't just Hellkin as staff. Halfbreds of many types worked in the assorted rooms of the establishment. Of course they were. Unwelcome People tended to adhere to _anywhere_ that accepted them. It was no great shock that so many of them found their way to a Temple of Kind Hands.

\
piped an insistant voice with all the charm and allure of fingernails running down a blackboard. \

The people of this temple were tolerant, but there was only so much they were willing to tolerate. Wraithvine could _sense_ the acolytes and staff resisting every urge to retaliate.

\
\n\nWicked, anticipatory glee lit the faces of the staff all around hir. \

Wraithvine entered an enclave as a regular customer. Ze left it in the persona of the haughtiest Elf alive. Replete with the fanciest hairdo that the acolytes could arrange in the quickest possible time. The decorative combs and pins did a lot of the work for an impressive presentation. So too did the elevated heels to give Wraithvine a more impressive height.

Ze looked down hir nose at the objectionable Human. \

While Wraithvine wasn't wrathful, ze implied that wrath could be a possibility in an instant.\n\nAt a time long in the past, the ancient ancestors of Humanity had been kept by tribes of Elves as servants, slaves, or pets. There was still an ancestral reflex to grovel at Elven arrogance. This particular example of Humanity resisted it mightily, but there was still a tremble in her knees. \

and without another word, Wraithvine summoned hir magic to lift her up in the air. Ze sought out an empty mud pit and thrust her into the middle of it. Then crammed her mouth with too much cake.\n\nShe spat her mouthful into the mud. \
Ze lifted hirself up off the ground, letting an eldritch wind dramatically unfurl hir borrowed robe, allowing magical lightning to coruscate all over hir form. \
To drive the point home, ze held a glowing orb of raw power above each palm, and made hir eyes glow bright red.\n\nThat particular aromatic mud pool became further polluted with the smell of urine. \
squeaked the alleged Noble.\n\nWraithvine allowed hirself to return to the floor, and eased off hir pyrotechnics. \

Wraithvine pushed hir mind onto other matters. More favourable matters. If all went well, henceforth, ze would never be bothered by that woman again. Most likely, her 'noble' heritage was from a forgotten king of a collapsed reign some many centuries prior. A thin veneer to excuse her arrogance. Nothing actually real.

If ze wasn't here with hir family, she was going to get a _solid_ lesson in humility.

Wraithvine returned the robe and resumed hir slow intake of finger food while Chance and Scramble amused themselves with the mud.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeqGLt3uuXqmbfH1wtPXDxUJ95e1JAvjAH18yd5CqN8vn/1000719939.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNxKJy1uTqER4VjkewknSy3V34WZ9X6m6Vb4yD4UvcBVj/1000719937.jpg 
The latest escalation began after Israeli strikes targeted areas in Beirut associated with Hezbollah.
Iran viewed those attacks as crossing a red line and responded by launching missiles toward Israel. Israeli air-defense systems intercepted the incoming missiles, preventing major damage, but the political message was clear:
Iran is willing to respond directly when it believes its regional interests are threatened. 
https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/jun/07/israel-lebanon-southern-beirut-hezbollah-idf-ceasefire-iran-latest-news-updates?utm_source

The problem is that neither side appears willing to back down.
Israel insists it will continue operations against Hezbollah.
Iran warns that future attacks could trigger broader retaliation.
History has shown that this combination can be extremely dangerous.
**Why The World Should Pay Attention**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQme23DQ1PmwW699nahEcVrXGqM5E84PksNVSgf3mr1Kyny/1000719956.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSVFixWRtba1Ctkjk8k1HwjGLNB8DpRDchbhGCdCJJSbz/1000719958.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSEUQfdBtRSD4TX4rUncakua2NBJA9T6gqjnjMxeeda5L/1000719960.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXqEKRYEWaBvfYeixr5FqPwdJEaf3VQCMuRuMZvktHN4P/1000719962.jpg 
Many people see Middle Eastern conflicts as distant events.
But modern economies are deeply interconnected.
What happens between Iran and Israel can quickly affect:
Oil prices
Global inflation
Shipping routes
Financial markets
Investment confidence
The Middle East remains one of the world's most critical energy regions.
Whenever tensions rise, markets immediately begin pricing in potential disruptions. Investors fear that military escalation could affect production, transportation, or strategic waterways that supply energy to the world. 
https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-stock-futures-slide-oil-prices-surge-as-new-attacks-threaten-the-cease-fire-with-iran-6e433c90?utm_source

**The Strait of Hormuz: The World's Energy Lifeline**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY6YC56xGzRSVqgyQoinPryM32AuHi4sFcVmzkVN4TiVY/1000720031.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYxXaDjcm5dHKFHJ5uh1AMLFpo28kB3qQY36Vimr2wdht/1000720025.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZawfV6WsYnzv628RkNYvEVnaZFJugBRQopNfq2PENDmB/1000720029.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRatXskw7CE8EUdr3xN59sWZ649NZKdnBmDA3JjMGhpaP/1000720027.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYncpBziLx1ZxzsVQr8Afh3cpPTeHNDemMT2a9Lz9XaNs/1000720033.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNUwdgA3GUGhgeKUY5RF8UHfoZDFUdnfmW2peuittLATx/1000720035.jpg 
One of the biggest concerns is the Strait of Hormuz.
This narrow waterway serves as one of the most important oil transportation routes on Earth.
If military tensions continue rising, shipping activity in the area could face disruptions, delays, or security risks.
Even the possibility of disruption is often enough to send energy markets higher.
In recent days, tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz have already become part of broader diplomatic discussions between regional and global powers. 
https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-attacks-iranian-coastal-sites-after-iran-launches-drones-latest-flare-up-2026-06-06/?utm_source

A prolonged crisis could eventually affect fuel prices in countries thousands of kilometers away from the conflict zone.
**Why Oil Prices Matter More Than Most People Realize**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPDkTGsLHYLQ7BbAZgJ8ZKEfuKtzrCGH6SqbHwcsaYxbm/1000720046.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZk7TAy3nLzfaGkUhTUsptHrVPgAFKQdCUwwE35YQ3pLN/1000720052.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWb7RjDLcaP5SqY2hodXX9EVBpDgJ1uKR8FR8FPYZtiXJ/1000720048.jpg 
When oil becomes more expensive, the impact spreads through the economy like a chain reaction.
Higher fuel costs mean:
More expensive transportation.
Higher food prices.
Increased manufacturing costs.
More pressure on households.
Recent market reactions already show concern, with oil prices moving higher following the latest escalation. 
https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-stock-futures-slide-oil-prices-surge-as-new-attacks-threaten-the-cease-fire-with-iran-6e433c90?utm_source

This is why geopolitical crises often become economic crises.
The connection is not always immediate, but it is real.

**Gold and Bitcoin: The Traditional Safe Havens**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNX2w7ruZkquuEw6w4k35xYmJuaCDSZX9UixpG3FmyehA/1000720062.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaoaZ4Y8Y6oJUcp2FEbTcnmTkfyReFTtFjk15h2So7kKy/1000720054.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUR1t5q5nbL4WAiRn9jpWjdxTo2dGzPZvMFhkRDgAwGm9/1000720056.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZBSD2CKztrbWqy3JMNyZHeapX6wmNE6R9gSPn45KQL9q/1000720064.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVGiZ69J2cGXbX4ZeX8pn3xW6S7cDzgwAxpmiWPDwgCT4/1000720060.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeXSq1NkV5L2HxBQKpyfNuxYcV43c4HNeBfMiYNzpbVHA/1000720058.jpg 
Whenever uncertainty increases, investors begin searching for protection.
Historically, gold has benefited during periods of geopolitical instability.
Bitcoin and other digital assets have also attracted attention from investors looking for alternatives to traditional financial systems.
According to market reports, Bitcoin and oil both experienced notable movements as investors reacted to the latest developments in the Middle east.
The key factor is confidence.
When confidence falls, capital often seeks safety.

**Could This Become a Regional War?**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXBhBDv4wqSouJ6nas1ZT6R3xSTsLqfgQkR8u3LQupxwt/1000720070.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcMzemBB69PjnLrxNGFjL1b7grmAnsfCNvAYgiSp84erU/1000720066.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcqBmRNzwf1UcMMF6xfLBhiojmnuGzjgcJWNyLkvdxrDm/1000720068.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRf3RaTHY99v1AKX4ZRDtUgVXjPjTLxeEX7AqpZDRtC5z/1000720074.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQLSLGjwwp1Krt37Qp2aj1DMnPe6ckgVPPHUBLsRNsSNf/1000720072.jpg 
This is the question worrying governments around the world.
Iran is not acting alone.
Israel is not acting alone.
The region contains numerous actors, alliances, and armed groups that could become involved if the situation escalates further.
What begins as a limited exchange can sometimes expand into something much larger.
Analysts are particularly concerned because the current tensions involve multiple fronts simultaneously, including Israel, Lebanon, Hezbollah, Iran, and broader diplomatic negotiations involving the United States. 
https://apnews.com/article/iran-israel-hezbollah-ceasefire-timeline-war-trump-f24c01d8b0cbc90b00fe90a79dbdaa1e

The more parties involved, the greater the risk of miscalculation.

**The Human Cost Behind the Headlines**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXtZZqHZ98eA9faMsP7utpRzNb7iA1gEfEgQS2emYDK56/1000720076.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVsmdEVdjWWJqcYRw1HN93HVZepao7YUAdbA8iydkWN7g/1000720080.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYPEPwZqqWheUwLX6krR14WgJJhDdjZg31qV2Qu5uAxFD/1000720082.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPVTgQNVzqoTGminhkLffkw4wQappfW1KTDBefqUYmrC6/1000720084.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUod1Nt3Sc49S9Hirgm7UkZ3S1F5BaWZRicPFRBR5xm9J/1000720078.jpg 
Behind every missile launch and military statement are ordinary people.
Families worry about safety.
Businesses struggle with uncertainty.
Communities face disruption.
While financial markets often dominate headlines, the human consequences are always the most important.
Every escalation increases the risk of suffering for civilians who have little control over political decisions made by leaders.
Final Thoughts
Today's missile exchange between Iran and Israel is about much more than military retaliation.
It is a reminder of how quickly fragile stability can disappear.
The world is watching not only because of the conflict itself but because of what could follow:
Higher oil prices.
Increased inflation.
Market volatility.
Regional instability.
New risks to global growth.
For now, diplomacy still has a chance.
But every missile fired makes that path narrower.
The coming days may determine whether this becomes another temporary crisis—or the beginning of a much larger confrontation that reshapes the Middle East and sends shockwaves through the global economy. 
https://www.axios.com/2026/06/07/iran-israel-missiles-us-tehran-negotiations-ceasefire-risk?utm_source

title.title: My first impressions playing Fate/Extra. —eng/esp
title.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/Ep7sgTTSTMSgh2U8FKGmfnvJFDhEkkGH7NvasEFnErZu3VZzWttGfHL8dpqCXmya7UN.png [_Source_](https://www.eurogamer.es/games/fateextra)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. El otro día me propuse la meta de ponerme a jugar un videojuego de forma seria, ya saben, intentar pasármelo completo, ya que, siéndoles sincero, hace muchísimo tiempo que no termino un juego de forma que vea los créditos y me sienta realmente realizado. También es porque me pasaron ciertos imprevistos que desaniman a uno; por ejemplo, estuve jugando Resident Evil 1 para PSX y, en serio, lo tenía muy avanzado, con buena cantidad de armas y municiones. Me había quedado justo después de matar a la serpiente y bajar por unas escaleras donde hay una puerta y donde Barry, de forma sospechosa, parece que dejó caer la cuerda. El problema es que, añadiendo más juegos, la consola explotó y tuve que instalar todo otra vez, así que adiós partida. En este caso, decidí ponerme serio con un juego de PSP que está basado en uno de mis animes favoritos, el cual es Fate/stay night. Así que, sin más dilación, hablemos un poco de mis primeras impresiones jugando Fate/Extra.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you doing today? I hope very well. The other day I set myself the goal of properly playing a video game, you know, trying to complete it fully, because, to be honest with you, it's been a very long time since I last finished a game in a way that I see the credits and feel truly fulfilled. It's also because certain unforeseen events happened that get you down; for example, I was playing Resident Evil 1 for the PSX and, seriously, I had made a lot of progress, with a good amount of weapons and ammunition. I had just got to the point after killing the snake and going down some stairs where there's a door and where Barry, rather suspiciously, seems to have dropped the rope. The problem is that, after adding more games, the console crashed and I had to reinstall everything all over again, so goodbye save file. In this case, I decided to get serious with a PSP game that is based on one of my favourite animes, which is Fate/stay night. So, without further ado, let's talk a bit about my first impressions playing Fate/Extra.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/23uQrif9ZuQcDujm8utnXyHC5jY2xvVzSzYwRU6ZWbLNMWdsKxE1PfQf5wmxdeovob24Q.png
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Comenzando el juego, manejaremos a un estudiante de pelo negro. Haremos vida diaria en la mítica escuela a la que asistía Shirou en el anime. Estamos cansados de la monotonía y de hacer siempre lo mismo una y otra vez: ver las mismas clases, los mismos sucesos, para luego ir a casa y volver a la escuela. Aunque todo comenzará a volverse un poco raro cuando, por los trabajos que se nos encomiendan investigar para el periódico escolar, presenciemos cosas insólitas que sinceramente a nadie parecen importarle, como ver gente desapareciendo en la azotea, ver niñas fantasmas, ver a un profesor rodeado de un montón de cadáveres de estudiantes. Todo eso se lo informaremos a la presidenta del club de periodismo, pero ella actúa como si nada. Sin lugar a dudas, parece que hay algo raro. Todo cambiará para nosotros rotundamente con la aparición de un chico llamado Leo, que parece venir de Europa y ser de la realeza. Él, particularmente, no dura mucho en la escuela: solo dos días. Al segundo, dice al frente de la clase que se va y desaparece, para luego aparecer en el pasillo. Lo seguiremos y él atravesará una pared; nosotros, con toda nuestra voluntad de saber qué pasa, lo seguiremos y nos llevará a otra dimensión donde hay una extraña marioneta, la cual nos atacará y moriremos. Resulta que éramos un simple NPC. A nuestro verdadero personaje le asignaremos nombre y seremos capaces de elegir a nuestro Espíritu Heroico, comenzando de verdad la historia del juego.

Starting the game, we control a black-haired student. We'll go about daily life in the mythical school that Shirou attended in the anime. We're tired of the monotony and of doing the same thing over and over again: seeing the same classes, the same events, then going home and then back to school. Although everything will start to become a bit strange when, through the investigations we're tasked with for the school newspaper, we witness some bizarre things that, honestly, no one seems to care about, like seeing people disappearing on the rooftop, seeing ghost girls, seeing a teacher surrounded by a pile of dead students. We'll report all of this to the president of the journalism club, but she acts as if nothing is wrong. Without a doubt, something seems strange. Everything will change radically for us with the appearance of a boy named Leo, who seems to come from Europe and be of royal descent. He, in particular, doesn't last long at school: just two days. On the second day, he announces in front of the class that he's leaving and disappears, then reappears in the corridor. We'll follow him, and he'll walk through a wall; we, with all our determination to find out what's going on, follow him, and he'll take us to another dimension where there's a strange puppet, which will attack us and we'll die. It turns out we were just an NPC. Our real character will be given a name, and we'll be able to choose our Heroic Spirit, as the game's story truly begins.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/EoeFQtKVpgGFeWMr4vfrFhqpsPGNWeYDAnFojaKMhMFiJhwwTuZrU1NLmMzdRDDSAun.png
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Esa introducción me gustó mucho, aunque sinceramente, actualmente está muy quemado eso de que todo sea una simulación y tengamos que salir de ella, pero lo dejaré pasar porque sí se me hizo extraño que desde el principio no me dejara ponerle nombre al personaje. En cuanto al Espíritu Heroico que elegí, pues fue Caster, porque es más que obvio que los otros dos son Saber y Archer; ya los tengo conocidos, por lo que los dejaré para después. Tengo entendido que hay varios finales en función de las elecciones que hagas durante la aventura y, además de, obviamente, el Espíritu Heroico que escojas, también hay finales en los que mueres. Respecto al sistema de combates, no es nada novedoso, pero consiste en un RPG donde atacas en base a piedra, papel o tijeras, pudiendo seleccionar 6 veces cada uno de ellos. Si ambos seleccionan lo mismo, empatan; y si lo que elegiste es efectivo contra lo que eligió tu rival, pues le harás daño. Si aciertas tres veces, luego harás un ataque extra. No hay más, solo los ataques especiales que aún no sé en qué consisten. Luego lo que viene es una especie de Battle Royale donde deberé hacerle frente a los demás Masters que también quieren el Santo Grial, cosa que certifico cuando me dicen el número restante de participantes. Lo que puedo esperar es un videojuego lleno de mucho texto, pero con muy buena historia, donde deberé enfrentarme a los personajes del anime, por lo que voy a por todas. Les estaré informando de mi progreso.

I really liked that introduction, although, honestly, the whole 'it's all a simulation and we have to escape from it' thing is a bit overdone these days, but I'll let it slide because it did strike me as odd that the game didn't let me name the character from the start. As for the Heroic Spirit I chose, well, I chose Caster, because it's quite obvious the other two are Saber and Archer; I'm already familiar with them, so I'll leave them for later. I understand there are multiple endings depending on the choices you make during the adventure, and also, obviously, depending on which Heroic Spirit you pick, plus there are endings in which you die. Regarding the combat system, it's nothing new, but it consists of an RPG where you attack based on rock-paper-scissors, being able to select each of them six times. If both pick the same, they tie; and if what you pick is effective against what your opponent picks, then you'll deal damage. If you land three correct guesses, you then perform an extra attack. That's it, apart from the special attacks, which I don't yet know how they work. What follows is a sort of Battle Royale where I'll have to face off against the other Masters who also want the Holy Grail – something that's confirmed when they tell me the remaining number of participants. What I can expect is a video game full of a lot of text, but with a very good story, where I'll have to face characters from the anime. So I'm going all in. I'll keep you updated on my progress.

___

title.title: Cycling Down the Baja - Breaking Away from the Bothers of San Quintín
title.body:
Sometimes you get into a place and your immediate reaction is to just run away as soon as possible. That's how I felt when I rolled into San Quintín. 

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-07 at 19.51.44.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/241tUpLDdoAoMq8zWp7jJ5ReCkhdYY4ftBscZrrF4ApHGzxwmr2Prq3WPWLyzRaTWNA6w.jpeg)

The day's ride from Diáz Ordáz had already been hard on my nerves. The highway's shoulder had reappeared briefly, but then it vanished just as quickly, only to come back to tease me off and on again. I have talked about *soft shoulders, sandy shoulders*, and *disappearing shoulders*, of which now I got to know the Mexican varieties. Though here I was also introduced to *trashy shoulders* and the treacherous *crater shoulders*, which were essentially potholes that had been paved over... except for on the shoulder where I was riding.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-07 at 09.58.56.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/242XxzUvy66go1sm8n7JfVwzKmChYzwXuvE6jroYdfX9nHFxcX7hHudn9RZKqGMNwkxbG.jpeg)

To make things worse, the two-lane road was barely able to handle the heavy traffic, and I would regularly get honked at, to get off the road. I obliged, let everyone behind me pass, but two minutes later the same thing would repeat again, until I decided that I'd make more progress riding down in the dirt. Sometimes, usually when I passed the huge berry-packing or coke bottling plant, the shoulder was wider than the lanes themselves, running along the length of the entire facilites, but as soon as I was past them, things returned to their frustrating normality. 

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 07.39.43 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/244KQq7JMEUicJ21tfV8KfwW8XDdMxef9cSGU6DY2NZ41c45Aj3oKhiZhwqx1N2C592kw.jpeg)

This is how I reached San Quintín, where my WS host was waiting for me. I remember the beautifully quaint Mexican small town in my mind, but the reality of the place was nothing like it. The highway was more of the same as I got to experience all day. And once I turned into a side street everything stopped... Unpaved surfaces made of sand, gravel, but mostly fine brown dust. It was so light, even a strolling dog whirled up a dust cloud. And huge empty spaces with a house here, a shack there, or a ruin in between. This is how I imagine Afghanistan. I don't mean to be ripping on Afghanistan, I'm sure it has some gorgeous spots, just like every country. But the stereotypical image was on the spot.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 07.39.45 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23ycwLKxidpSosXzMx87yC6GMJK8Czj4LtXHvhWn5TZfZGd3o8tX4ybx7TNHS7DrB4BEY.jpeg)

My host Jorge also explained that it's not a good idea to keep the windows open, as the dust would get in, settling on everything. He also said that it rained no more than 150 mm a year, but when it did, the effects were close to a blizzard in other places. The clay dust turned into heavy mud, shutting down traffic on the unpaved streets. I managed to hold myself back, but I felt like asking him: **\

** It didn't take me long to find out though.\n\nJorge is a biologist, and among other projects in this region, he has written a book on all the birds you can find in the San Quintín valley, most of which are migratory. Apparently there is a huge biodiversity of numerous species, thanks to the vast habitats the natural conditions provide. It's amazing what you can find once you venture outside ... hahaha, I feel ridiculous calling this \

!

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-04 at 17.53.35.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/244A2bKghgjuqoxZ2sdmFRfW65ocLXRqPKLpQohcP4GgtQEgm31QpNGLUo1Wo1nDCnfwd.jpeg)

Following Jorge's recommendation, I hiked out to the nearby volcanoes. I left my bike at home, as I already knew that the terrain would probably make both of us suffer. Besides, I was going to cross sand dunes and climb volcanoes. There are seven to twelve of them, depending on how you count, all along the coast, with an array of bays, capes, marshes, long sandy spits, beaches, and tall rocky shores. It's quite a complex system of a great variety. No wonder birds love it here, and of course a bunch of other life forms.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23xpEgpRb3uTpnbLrgtVMxk7TYXV57zTCyuzy1viAxYUYH8EqHdMhupBZ8R8YKFmU38e5.png)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 06.32.50 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/245T7gAfeBxVgk2EbguiXBmRAkzCTZTMCSTRKiMDVFxZRz4VgURLC8N8ocMwvTjP5pM3Q.jpeg)

Walking out of the town was hardly inspiring, and even the village of *Chapala* was just more dustbowl settlement. Past it, however, things started to change. By the time I reached the *Ceniza* volcano, it was actually quite pretty. Long strands of moss (or was it lichen?) grew from the porous volcanic rock, making the hillside shine silver-green. From the top of *Ceniza* I had a fantastic view over the different types of lands and waters as they wove in and out of each other.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-04 at 17.53.38 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23vsScZpwNT6FK6yBph3ksiDQXLLMt5MyXmwKK37mjXDgyt3J7kcExPtdMxZKKBdkfNRp.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-04 at 17.53.39.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/241ZhSJPwPZKq7TwQ1tyJEnJThYKpxVNdgHbpA8hSKTzcwAJo2GP18qqmMeh6Wzdw8jtB.jpeg)

After descending from *Ceniza*, I walked around what's called *False Bay* past many oyster farms, to the volcano known simply as *Sudoeste*, that is Southwest. After stopping in the village of *La Chorera* for a delicious sea-food meal at the [Marea Baja 4x4](https://www.instagram.com/mariscos_marea_baja4x4/), I walked along the beach to the volcano. There was even a sign that camping was allowed, so I did not even try to hide while making myself at home in mom's house.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-04 at 17.53.41.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23w2sCht5vKygnv8fKG8j5xajRzz5JdqQHz5p6pnDDQCtREbChYqBa8gLvRdAfPt8ZDpE.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 06.32.48 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/2458HyV6c1fdadZb35Rvcza8L78irTjhh45mSoFT7Z489YznNwUvb6g3Y9ArrBjXoEFZ7.jpeg)

The next day I got up bright and early, taking advantage of the cloudy mornings, to climb the volcano. Another magnificent view gave me a perfect start for the day. My walk back to town was cut short as the same lady who had served me in the Marea Baja restaurant happened to pass me in her car, and stopped to give me a ride.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 06.32.51.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/2458NinHtSWjDAcWzmngo4fx5AqLxwTyjE5AxbQ4rnZxXtuuKZjcfsKB2wtkv3ytKG5oG.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 06.32.51 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23wCBw2PAPURysh6umfcxrGbHA2ZeKmaXYWPFUFB7o7Wg7H5REVEEpuEDJvZEiojeqdzp.jpeg)

The following day Jorge took me on one of his bird projects, looking for the endangered [Least tern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Least_tern) who is known to choose the dry lakebed of *Laguna Figueroa* as nesting ground. We saw the bird, though it still just before nesting season. Jorge volunteers his efforts in monitoring this bird, its eggs, chicks, ringing hatchlings and all, which the US Fish and Wildlife service receives valuable information from. So I took this as as an immersive opportunity of some deep eco-tourism. 

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-07 at 09.56.19.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23wqkWkvCozAvMGFZ3aeSTmPGrSAmrcgcKFXa4Z6PbSKNBNrer2aDVTCy3eE826ySSp72.jpeg)

Thanks to Jorge, my first impressions of this ugly, dusty town turned into something valuable. In fact, now I look at San Quintín as a beautiful experience, and a place I can most highly recommend. Though I must admit, it is not the actual settlement, but the surrounding nature that's worth seeing.

title.title: Creamy Tofu Sisig: Easy Mix Method
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPqxxXuJKF22tJE4oB9RpEMV5Fgaomj241JJ1f9zKgUa/1780887464426.png)

Hello, lovely foodies here in the Hive Food Community! 🫰🏻🥰🫰🏻 
‎
‎In my hubby's recent post, we visited my brother’s new house. There, he made us a tofu sisig, and I told myself that I have to make this at home. 😍 
‎
‎It was so creamy, tasty, and full of flavor, way better than I expected. I couldn’t stop thinking about it, so I decided to copy his recipe and make it for my family too. 😋😍
‎
‎**Ingredients:**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3gyTCUSzMJTMf6azayf3ZkFpLE7po6yFmk7ipuTR4r5/1780887499798.jpg)
‎
‎• 4 blocks tofu
‎• 5 tablespoons mayonnaise 
‎• 1 small can liver spread 
‎• 2 medium red onions 
‎• 2 calamansi
‎• 1 large red chili
‎• 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce
‎• 1/2 teaspoon salt & black pepper 
‎• cooking oil
‎
‎**Let's cook!**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqT95JSS9GZPHvAugg4quqeUCsd2q45wbUwQjz5DeKDr/1780887523495.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPcYZWXapcaxLQ8ajCrLCdAjKgMWjmmFwiJQZsdVbaE85/1780887523677.jpg)

‎First, I heated some cooking oil in my pan, enough to fry the tofu well. When the oil was hot enough, I dropped the tofu pieces in and fried them until they turned light golden brown and got a little crisp on the outside. I didn’t overcook them, just enough so they wouldn’t break easily. Once done, I took them out and set them aside for later.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRxTw9pUntwTooZ4XpzGXcvVgUH3Gk6VURHvv1kTQszVo/1780887571508.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGVaaZ5fjvqHu52Doyz6xQYt2w3BXZ1pwGmtQusiKi7t/1780887571710.jpg)

‎While the tofu cooled a little, I got a separate clean bowl and prepared all the ingredients for the special sauce. I scooped the liver spread and put all of it into the bowl, then added mayonnaise. Then I squeezed calamansi, added soy sauce, and sprinkled a little salt and ground black pepper. I mixed everything really well until it became smooth, thick, and evenly blended.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ59AYBEEmxpyNn4YPt83SutvRiuP6krw66YfRxH6NJK8/1780887597386.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNStv7X3hyeTs3uHhSoWv56jNvFHFHYM5J2rSaZ1xyZUm/1780887597665.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQ8a7Ts86NLd8DoqDt1vzuzGyhoKEhcK3nuh3ShvHfcB/1780887597873.jpg)

‎Next, I took the fried tofu and put all the chopped red onion right on top of it. The onion adds a nice fresh crunch and mild sweetness that goes perfectly with the tofu. Then I poured all the creamy sauce I just made over the tofu and onions. I mixed everything gently, making sure every piece got coated nicely with the sauce.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNkbUrQGhVAhj8Mx3kBcouWD5hu9cSGF4UsAEVqmvpz1S/1780887626253.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRkBkZqXJ9DVhpPPRCJ1vLYP3pmhTWvHvv6o5t3BXcKWg/1780887626455.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyBP8hoMW7JsMHq1pKrN2BXMEnYmT6gnSx64WM7PfRSL/1780887626580.jpg)

‎Now because we have kids at home, I just sliced the big red chili into thin pieces, but I did NOT mix it into the sisig. I just sprinkled and arranged all the chili slices right on top of the finished dish. This way, the kids can enjoy their serving without any spice.
‎
‎And that’s it! Just simple mixing, and we already had this delicious tofu sisig ready to eat.
‎
‎Until my next recipe...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1778497869588.png)

title.title: Visiting Quiero Pizza to celebrate Bitcoin pizza day
title.body: **. Warm regards to all of you I hope you have a great week and are happy. Last month, on May 22 to be exact, we celebrated #BitcoinPizzaDay, because all of us who use this platform and others know that it’s a very important day that marked a turning point in the history of cryptocurrencies. It was the first and most expensive transaction in the crypto world. It was 16 years ago when someone bought two pizzas with Bitcoin. This purchase is considered a historic milestone. Since then, we’ve held many celebrations—all you have to do is eat pizza on this day. Celebrations used to be better back then, since hivesucre always promoted them alongside all the city’s hivers; those were unforgettable moments. Even though the community no longer exists, the tradition of going out to a pizzeria and enjoying that delicious dish has remained. So I went out with my partner to a pizzeria I’d never been to before, one that was recommended for its quality and good prices. That May 22nd around noon, we went to the restaurant **Quiero Pizza**. When we arrived, we ordered a pizza with our favorite toppings—bacon, ham, mozzarella cheese, bell peppers, and the Quiero sauce—for $7; I thought it was a good deal. The place was packed, so we had to wait 45 minutes—that was the only thing I didn’t like about the restaurant. But I have to tell you, it was delicious—the flavor and the thin, crispy crust—so I highly recommend it. That’s all for now, my fellow adventurers.

> >! [English,Here]> **Feliz HIVE cumpleaños para mi**, Muchos saludos, deseándoles una grandiosa, semana; espero estén felices. El mes pasado, exactamente el 22 de mayo se celebro el #BitcoinPizzaDay pues todos los que usuarios de esta plataforma y otras sabemos que es un día muy importante y que marco la historia de las cripto monedas. Pues fue la primera transacción Y más cara en el mundo cripto. Fue hace 16 años cuando alguien compró dos pizzas con bitcoin. Esta compra es considerada un hito histórico. Desde allí hacemos muchas celebraciones, para eso simplemente hay que comer pizza este día. Antes las celebraciones eran mejores ya que hivesucre siempre la promocionaba junto a toda los hivers de ciudad, unos momentos inolvidables. A pesar que ya no hay comunidad, siempre quedó la costumbre de salir a una pizzería y deleitarse con ese delicioso Plato. Para eso salí con mi pareja a una pizzería que nunca había ido y era recomendada por su calidad y buenos precios. Ese 22 de mayo en horas del medio día nos fuimos al restaurante **Quiero Pizza**, al llegar ordenamos una pizza con nuestros ingredientes favoritos como tocineta, jamón, queso mozzarela, pimentón y la salsa Quiero, por un costo de 7$, me pareció económica. El lugar estaba lleno, así que tuvimos que esperar 45 minutos, fue lo que no me gustó de ese restaurante. Pero les cuento que estaba delicosa, su sabor y su pan delgado y crujiente, así que las recomiendo. Hasta aqui mis aventureros.

原本这个周末我没有任何出行计划，只打算按往常安排去健身房。结果老公的朋友邀约我们一家去乡音梦粮谷玩。三八节学校工会曾组织活动来过这里，我对这印象不深，起初还以为没什么好玩的，但盛情难却，我们便带着两个孩子，在中午赴约。

高考日，天气骤然降温，算是上天有眼。只是整日风雨不断，出门之后才发觉降温的威力。我们出门只穿了短袖短裤，被冷风冻得瑟瑟发抖，完全低估了天气的变化。

抵达梦粮谷后，我才发现来了好几户相熟的朋友家庭，都是二胎家庭。其中两户人家是两个可爱的女儿，我们和另外一户则是两个男孩。一群孩子凑在一起热闹又欢乐，自顾自追逐嬉戏，肆意玩耍，大人们几乎不用费心照看。

邀约我们的朋友是梦粮谷老板的独生女，她安排的伙食很好，中午的美食我们先品尝了特色烤全羊，丝毫不逊色于我们之前在宜宾吃过的。吃完烤全羊，大家又在餐厅享用了丰盛的中餐，菜品规格很高。相比之下，上次学校安排的餐标就太低了。


午后雨势依旧很大，原本计划的小孩们去真人CS户外活动只能取消。为了不让孩子们扫兴，大家让小朋友们穿上雨衣，由研学老师带着去体验了钓小龙虾的乐趣。这里原本还有采摘李子的项目，但雨后泥泞不堪，担心孩子们弄得满身泥污，便没有前往。即便如此，孩子们钓完龙虾后依旧狼狈不已。老大不仅收获了几只小龙虾，还抓到了几只小青蛙，浑身湿透、沾满泥巴，一群妈又是前前后后给他们清洗。

因为晚上需要赶回学校上最后两节课，我们在五点多便提前告辞返程。同样是珠嘉之行，这次私人邀约的体验，和之前学校工会组织的活动截然不同。临走时，主人家还热情相送，给我们准备了土鸡蛋、粮油、酒水，还有刚从地里采摘的新鲜蔬菜，满满一大袋土特产，真是收获满满。

我和米特两个人到大阪旅游，由于我们住的酒店靠近「黑门市场」，几乎在大阪的每一天都会往那里去一趟。 就在大阪的第二天，下午逛完「难波八阪神社」，我们步行了 20 分钟就去到了「黑门市场」，抵达的时候是下午四点多，很多商店都还没关门。 ---
**大阪五天四夜之旅
18/5/2026 - 22/5/2026
第二天**
--- 我们在「黑门市场」里面看到了一间“章鱼烧店”，来到日本怎么能不尝尝章鱼烧呢？当下就决定购买这家的章鱼烧…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48WD8vnDCRKH356hrEtRKxD9fxpvFGQm4FH5XPSBWT4VMX3fMNdpBJsr5krM77NX1L.jpeg) 这间位于「黑门市场」里的章鱼烧店在店门口摆摊，而店内有桌椅可让顾客进去坐着慢慢食用，店内还有免费自助饮用水，自己去拿杯子装。 可惜的是我没拍到店内环境的照片，当时人太多了，我们也艰难的才在角落找到一个位置坐下。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48RsieBDopfjWQxJnwYKdHtJd4kM6XkedVVc7wnExSKmBpygStEQTQPYLcudgVD5ya.jpeg) 一开始，我让米特去买普通的章鱼烧，也就是图片里那个价钱 700 日元的 “Basic Takoyaki”。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48SMZakHsrArpyhNzBTuFiQdanZUcgG6osTjN45nJaEb66d9PRWidtNfoem6LzhSXa.jpeg) 而我在默默地看着店员制作章鱼烧…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48JeaoWX3V6AGKPUgr5rChhj7AdAcaLH8VoKfn9WdLrLVutt8PAzbKV78ShiFHk6Ws.jpeg) 一份共有 8 粒章鱼烧，我跟米特一人吃 4 粒。一人一半，感情不散。 我先来说说这家的章鱼烧，我感觉可能顾客太多，店员手脚很快一煮好就拿出来装盒子了，不过我吃起来整粒不够厚实。 至于味道呢？还算合格，而且刚煮出来超热的，一咬下去烫舌头，我直接挖开一半拼命往里面吹气让其快点冷却。 **价钱：日元 ￥700** 这间店里面都是游客，真真赚游客价钱的章鱼烧店，连我旁边桌子的游客，听口音像是马来西亚人。

title.title: Đánh giá năng lực chuyên môn tại trung tâm y học bào thai Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa
title.body:
Trung tâm y học bào thai Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa được nhiều gia đình quan tâm khi cần theo dõi thai kỳ chuyên sâu. Năng lực chuyên môn là yếu tố then chốt quyết định độ chính xác trong chẩn đoán và hiệu quả quản lý thai kỳ, đặc biệt với các trường hợp nguy cơ cao.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm: 

<https://baoangiang.com.vn/trung-tam-y-hoc-bao-thai-phenikaamec-dia-chi-can-thiep-bao-thai-uy-tin-tien-phong-quan-ly-thai-ky-a472134.html>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Quy-trinh-kham-va-theo-doi-thai-ky-1342428174>

\-

## **Đội ngũ chuyên gia là nền tảng cốt lõi**

Trong y học bào thai, kinh nghiệm và trình độ của bác sĩ ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến chất lượng chẩn đoán. Trung tâm y học bào thai Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa quy tụ đội ngũ chuyên gia có học hàm, học vị cao, bao gồm giáo sư, phó giáo sư, tiến sĩ và bác sĩ chuyên khoa sâu.

Các bác sĩ không chỉ tham gia điều trị mà còn đóng góp trong nghiên cứu khoa học và giảng dạy, giúp cập nhật liên tục các tiến bộ y học. Điều này đảm bảo các quyết định lâm sàng dựa trên bằng chứng và phù hợp với từng trường hợp cụ thể.

## **Mô hình phối hợp đa chuyên khoa**

Một điểm đáng chú ý trong đánh giá năng lực chuyên môn là khả năng phối hợp giữa các chuyên ngành. Tại đây, các trường hợp phức tạp được hội chẩn giữa sản khoa, chẩn đoán hình ảnh, di truyền học và nhi khoa. Cách tiếp cận này giúp đánh giá toàn diện tình trạng thai nhi, hạn chế bỏ sót thông tin quan trọng. Đồng thời, việc đưa ra hướng xử trí có sự thống nhất giữa các chuyên gia, tăng độ tin cậy trong quyết định điều trị.

## **Hệ thống công nghệ hỗ trợ chẩn đoán**

Năng lực chuyên môn không tách rời với hệ thống trang thiết bị. Trung tâm được đầu tư các thiết bị hiện đại như siêu âm độ phân giải cao, MRI và các công nghệ chẩn đoán trước sinh. Các công cụ này giúp bác sĩ quan sát chi tiết cấu trúc và sự phát triển của thai nhi, từ đó nâng cao độ chính xác trong phát hiện bất thường. Công nghệ đóng vai trò hỗ trợ quan trọng, đặc biệt trong các trường hợp nghi ngờ dị tật hoặc thai kỳ nguy cơ cao.

## **Kết luận**

Đánh giá năng lực chuyên môn tại trung tâm y học bào thai Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa cho thấy sự kết hợp giữa đội ngũ chuyên gia, mô hình đa chuyên khoa và hệ thống công nghệ hiện đại. Với định hướng y học hàn lâm và chăm sóc toàn diện, PhenikaaMec đáp ứng tốt nhu cầu theo dõi thai kỳ chuyên sâu, đặc biệt trong các trường hợp cần đánh giá chính xác và kịp thời.
